(* Summaries derived from a facts file (mini-analyze -facts -no-models),
 * each function of the units named: its arity and ops, or why not; with
 * -models, Models.ml's beside, for those it has; with -o file, the
 * summaries written there (mini-analyze -summaries file reads them).
 * usage: Derive.exe facts-file unit... [-models] [-o file] *)

let () =
  let args = List.tl (Array.to_list Sys.argv) in
  let models = List.mem "-models" args in
  let rec out = function "-o" :: f :: _ -> Some f | _ :: r -> out r | [] -> None in
  let o = out args in
  let rec plain = function "-o" :: _ :: r -> plain r | "-models" :: r -> plain r | x :: r -> x :: plain r | [] -> [] in
  match plain args with
  | file :: units ->
      let facts = Summaries.parse (In_channel.with_open_bin file In_channel.input_all) in
      let all = Summaries.derive ~units facts in
      Option.iter
        (fun (f : string) ->
          let ok = List.filter_map (function g, Ok s -> Some (g, s) | _, Error _ -> None) all in
          Out_channel.with_open_bin f (fun oc -> output_string oc (Summaries.to_text ok)))
        o;
      List.iter
        (fun ((f, r) : string * (int * Summaries.op list, string) result) ->
          (match r with
           | Ok (n, ops) ->
               Printf.printf "%s (%d): %d ops\n" f n (List.length ops);
               List.iter (fun o -> Printf.printf "    %s\n" (Summaries.show o)) ops
           | Error why -> Printf.printf "%s: not summarized, %s\n" f why);
          if models then
            match Models.find f with
            | Some (n, ops) ->
                Printf.printf "  Models (%d): %d ops\n" n (List.length ops);
                List.iter (fun o -> Printf.printf "    %s\n" (Summaries.show o)) ops
            | None -> ())
        (List.sort compare all)
  | [] -> prerr_endline "usage: Derive.exe facts-file unit... [-models]"; exit 2
analyzers/summaries/Summaries.ml
24128
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Summaries.mli *)

type op = Models.op =
  | New of Models.v
  | Load of Models.v * Models.v * string
  | Store of Models.v * string * Models.v
  | Assign of Models.v * Models.v
  | Scalar of Models.v
  | Call of Models.v * Models.v * Models.v
  | Raise of string
  | Global of Models.v * string
type fact = string * string list

(* ---- the facts' text: rel('a', 'b\'', 3). *)

let parse_line (l : string) : fact option =
  match String.index_opt l '(' with
  | None -> None
  | Some p ->
      let rel = String.sub l 0 p in
      let n = String.length l in
      let args = ref [] and b = Buffer.create 32 in
      let i = ref (p + 1) in
      while !i < n && l.[!i] <> ')' do
        (match l.[!i] with
         | '\'' ->
             incr i;
             while !i < n && l.[!i] <> '\'' do
               if l.[!i] = '\\' && !i + 1 < n then incr i;
               Buffer.add_char b l.[!i]; incr i
             done;
             incr i
         | c when (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c = '-' ->
             while !i < n && l.[!i] <> ',' && l.[!i] <> ')' do
               Buffer.add_char b l.[!i]; incr i
             done
         | _ -> incr i);
        if Buffer.length b > 0 || (!i > 0 && l.[!i - 1] = '\'') then begin
          args := Buffer.contents b :: !args; Buffer.clear b end;
        while !i < n && (l.[!i] = ',' || l.[!i] = ' ') do incr i done
      done;
      Some (rel, List.rev !args)

let parse (text : string) : fact list =
  List.filter_map parse_line (String.split_on_char '\n' text)

(* ---- the facts by relation, by their first atom *)

type index = (string, string list list) Hashtbl.t

let index (facts : fact list) : (string, index) Hashtbl.t =
  let t = Hashtbl.create 64 in
  List.iter
    (fun ((r, args) : fact) ->
      match args with
      | [] -> ()
      | a :: _ ->
          let ix =
            match Hashtbl.find_opt t r with
            | Some ix -> ix
            | None -> let ix = Hashtbl.create 1024 in Hashtbl.replace t r ix; ix in
          Hashtbl.replace ix a (args :: (try Hashtbl.find ix a with Not_found -> [])))
    facts;
  t

let rows (t : (string, index) Hashtbl.t) (r : string) (a : string) : string list list =
  match Hashtbl.find_opt t r with
  | Some ix -> (try Hashtbl.find ix a with Not_found -> [])
  | None -> []

let all (t : (string, index) Hashtbl.t) (r : string) : string list list =
  match Hashtbl.find_opt t r with
  | Some ix -> Hashtbl.fold (fun _ l acc -> l @ acc) ix []
  | None -> []

exception Not_summarized of string

let rec derive ~(units : string list) (facts : fact list) :
    (string * (int * op list, string) result) list =
  let t = index facts in
  let globals = Hashtbl.create 1024 in
  List.iter (function [ g ] -> Hashtbl.replace globals g () | _ -> ()) (all t "global_var");
  let is_global g = Hashtbl.mem globals g in
  (* who is inside whom; every variable's functions; every call's *)
  let children = Hashtbl.create 1024 in
  List.iter (function [ g; x ] -> Hashtbl.add children x g | _ -> ()) (all t "inner");
  let next_stage = Hashtbl.create 1024 in
  List.iter (function [ g; x ] -> Hashtbl.replace next_stage x g | _ -> ()) (all t "curried");
  let vars_of = Hashtbl.create 4096 and funs_of_var = Hashtbl.create 65536 in
  List.iter
    (function
      | [ v; x ] -> Hashtbl.add vars_of x v; Hashtbl.add funs_of_var v x
      | _ -> ())
    (all t "var_in");
  let calls_of = Hashtbl.create 4096 in
  List.iter (function [ i; x ] -> Hashtbl.add calls_of x i | _ -> ()) (all t "in_function");
  let raises_of = Hashtbl.create 1024 in
  List.iter (function [ i; x ] -> Hashtbl.add raises_of x i | _ -> ()) (all t "raise_in");
  let tries = Hashtbl.create 64 in
  List.iter (function x :: _ -> Hashtbl.replace tries x () | _ -> ()) (all t "try_in_function");
  let one r a = match rows t r a with x :: _ -> Some x | [] -> None in
  let param x = match one "parameter" x with Some [ _; _; p ] -> Some p | _ -> None in
  let result x = match one "return" x with Some [ _; r ] -> Some r | _ -> None in
  (* a root: a unit's toplevel function, its global of the same name *)
  let roots =
    List.filter_map
      (function
        | [ f; u; _ ] when List.mem u units && is_global f -> Some f
        | _ -> None)
      (all t "closure") in
  let summarize (f : string) : int * op list =
    (* the tree: f, its stages, every function inside *)
    let tree = Hashtbl.create 16 in
    (* (and a closure one of its variables is given that is no unit's
     * toplevel: a local let rec, a lambda, inner does not say them all) *)
    let rec add x =
      if not (Hashtbl.mem tree x) then begin
        Hashtbl.replace tree x ();
        List.iter add (Hashtbl.find_all children x);
        List.iter
          (fun v ->
            List.iter
              (function
                | [ _; g ] when rows t "closure" g <> [] && not (is_global g) -> add g
                | _ -> ())
              (rows t "assign_address" v))
          (Hashtbl.find_all vars_of x)
      end in
    add f;
    let in_tree x = Hashtbl.mem tree x in
    Hashtbl.iter (fun x () -> if Hashtbl.mem tries x then raise (Not_summarized "a try")) tree;
    let rec chain x = x :: (match Hashtbl.find_opt next_stage x with Some y -> chain y | None -> []) in
    let stages = chain f in
    let n = List.length stages in
    (* its variables, each a Tmp; a global read, a Tmp its Global holds *)
    let tmps = Hashtbl.create 64 and count = ref 0 in
    let ops = ref [] in
    let emit o = ops := o :: !ops in
    let tmp (v : string) : Models.v =
      match Hashtbl.find_opt tmps v with
      | Some k -> Models.Tmp k
      | None ->
          incr count; Hashtbl.replace tmps v !count;
          if is_global v then emit (Global (Models.Tmp !count, v));
          Models.Tmp !count in
    let vars = Hashtbl.create 64 in
    Hashtbl.iter
      (fun x () -> List.iter (fun v -> Hashtbl.replace vars v ()) (Hashtbl.find_all vars_of x))
      tree;
    let mine v = Hashtbl.mem vars v && not (is_global v) in
    (* (a variable of the tree alone: one of the toplevel's too is the
     * closure's place, init's, not the tree's) *)
    let only_mine v =
      mine v && List.for_all in_tree (Hashtbl.find_all funs_of_var v) in
    (* the parameters, copied; the result *)
    List.iteri
      (fun i x -> match param x with
        | Some p -> emit (Assign (tmp p, Arg (i + 1)))
        | None -> ())
      stages;
    (match result (List.nth stages (n - 1)) with
     | Some r -> emit (Assign (Ret, tmp r))
     | None -> ());
    (* the closures of the tree a variable may hold *)
    let holds : (string, string list) Hashtbl.t = Hashtbl.create 64 in
    let get v = try Hashtbl.find holds v with Not_found -> [] in
    let changed = ref true in
    let flow d s =
      let hs = get s in
      if hs <> [] then begin
        let hd = get d in
        let nw = List.filter (fun g -> not (List.mem g hd)) hs in
        if nw <> [] then begin Hashtbl.replace holds d (nw @ hd); changed := true end
      end in
    let calls = Hashtbl.fold (fun x () acc -> Hashtbl.find_all calls_of x @ acc) tree [] in
    let target i = match one "call_indirect" i with Some [ _; v ] -> Some v | _ -> None in
    let arg i = List.find_map (function [ _; "1"; a ] -> Some a | _ -> None) (rows t "argument" i) in
    let ret i = match one "call_ret" i with Some [ _; r ] -> Some r | _ -> None in
    Hashtbl.iter
      (fun v () ->
        List.iter
          (function [ _; g ] when in_tree g -> Hashtbl.replace holds v (g :: get v) | _ -> ())
          (rows t "assign_address" v))
      vars;
    while !changed do
      changed := false;
      Hashtbl.iter
        (fun d () -> List.iter (function [ _; s ] -> flow d s | _ -> ()) (rows t "assign" d))
        vars;
      List.iter
        (fun i ->
          match target i with
          | Some v ->
              List.iter
                (fun g ->
                  (match param g, arg i with Some p, Some a -> flow p a | _ -> ());
                  match result g, ret i with Some r', Some r -> flow r r' | _ -> ())
                (get v)
          | None -> ())
        calls
    done;
    (* each fact of a variable of the tree, an op *)
    Hashtbl.iter
      (fun v () ->
        if mine v then begin
          List.iter
            (function
              | [ _; s ] -> emit (Assign (tmp v, tmp s))
              | _ -> ())
            (rows t "assign" v);
          List.iter
            (function
              | [ _; g ] when in_tree g -> ()
              | [ _; g ] when String.length g > 5 && String.sub g 0 5 = "prim:" -> ()
              | [ _; g ] when is_global g -> emit (Global (tmp v, g))
              | [ _; g ] -> raise (Not_summarized ("a closure of another tree: " ^ g))
              | _ -> ())
            (rows t "assign_address" v);
          List.iter
            (function [ _; s; fld ] -> emit (Load (tmp v, tmp s, fld)) | _ -> ())
            (rows t "assign_load_field" v);
          List.iter
            (function [ _; fld; s ] -> emit (Store (tmp v, fld, tmp s)) | _ -> ())
            (rows t "assign_store_field" v);
          if rows t "new_block" v <> [] then emit (New (tmp v));
          if rows t "scalar" v <> [] then emit (Scalar (tmp v))
        end
        else if v = "exn" then ()
          (* (the exception a raise puts there: raise_of's Raise says it) *)
        else if is_global v then begin
          (* a global written in the tree: its body kept *)
          List.iter
            (function [ _; s ] when only_mine s -> raise (Not_summarized ("a global written: " ^ v)) | _ -> ())
            (rows t "assign" v);
          if rows t "assign_store_field" v <> [] then
            raise (Not_summarized ("a global's field written: " ^ v))
        end)
      vars;
    (* the calls: inside the tree its parameters and result, else a Call *)
    List.iter
      (fun i ->
        match target i with
        | None -> ()
        | Some v ->
            if List.exists (function [ _; g ] -> String.length g > 5 && String.sub g 0 5 = "prim:" | _ -> false)
                 (rows t "assign_address" v)
            then raise (Not_summarized "a primitive called through a variable");
            let gs = get v in
            List.iter
              (fun g ->
                (match param g, arg i with
                 | Some p, Some a -> emit (Assign (tmp p, tmp a))
                 | _ -> ());
                match result g, ret i with
                | Some r', Some r -> emit (Assign (tmp r, tmp r'))
                | _ -> ())
              gs;
            (* (a call through what is not only the tree's closures) *)
            let only_tree =
              gs <> []
              && rows t "assign_load_field" v = []
              && List.for_all (function [ _; g ] -> in_tree g | _ -> false) (rows t "assign_address" v)
              && not (List.exists (fun x -> param x = Some v) stages)
              && not (is_global v) in
            if not only_tree then begin
              let a = match arg i with Some a -> tmp a | None -> (incr count; Models.Tmp !count) in
              let r = match ret i with Some r -> tmp r | None -> (incr count; Models.Tmp !count) in
              emit (Call (r, tmp v, a))
            end)
      calls;
    Hashtbl.iter
      (fun x () ->
        List.iter
          (fun i ->
            List.iter (function [ _; e ] -> emit (Raise e) | _ -> ()) (rows t "raise_of" i))
          (Hashtbl.find_all raises_of x))
      tree;
    (n, List.rev !ops) in
  let raw =
    List.map (fun f -> (f, try Ok (summarize f) with Not_summarized why -> Error why)) roots in
  let table = Hashtbl.create 256 in
  List.iter (function f, Ok s -> Hashtbl.replace table f s | _ -> ()) raw;
  List.map
    (function
      | f, Ok (n, ops) -> (f, Ok (n, simplify (one_heap (simplify (inline table [ f ] ops)))))
      | r -> r)
    raw

(* ---- a summary's heap as a type's: the objects it makes at one call
 * that are one structure, one object (plan_analysis_scale.md)
 *
 * Two objects one stored in the other's field (through copies of their
 * variables) are one structure: Hashtbl's record, its array, its bucket
 * cells; a list's cells. Each structure one object at each call, as
 * Models' table, its fields kept apart by their names (fld:data,
 * arr:elt, con:Cons.1): a find of a table still reaches its own
 * table's values. The object untyped (a fresh Tmp the result copies):
 * typed as the result, a cell loaded out of it into a variable of the
 * bucket's type would be filtered out, its values lost.
 * old: an object each New of the summary, a derived Hashtbl's record,
 * array, cells each, multiplied by -exn's contexts: mini-ml 8 GB *)
and one_heap (ops : op list) : op list =
  let news = List.filter_map (function New (Tmp k) -> Some k | _ -> None) ops in
  (* the News whose object a variable may hold, through copies *)
  let holds (v : Models.v) : int list =
    List.filter
      (fun n ->
        let rec reach (seen : Models.v list) (x : Models.v) =
          if List.mem x seen then seen
          else List.fold_left (fun acc o -> match o with Assign (d, s) when s = x -> reach acc d | _ -> acc) (x :: seen) ops in
        List.mem v (reach [] (Tmp n)))
      news in
  (* a group a structure: union of the News a Store joins *)
  let parent = Hashtbl.create 16 in
  let rec find (k : int) = match Hashtbl.find_opt parent k with Some p when p <> k -> find p | _ -> k in
  let union a b = let ra = find a and rb = find b in if ra <> rb then Hashtbl.replace parent ra rb in
  List.iter
    (function
      | Store (o, _, s) -> (
          match holds o @ holds s with
          | k :: rest -> List.iter (union k) rest
          | [] -> ())
      | _ -> ())
    ops;
  let groups = List.sort_uniq compare (List.map find news) in
  if List.length groups = List.length news then ops
  else
    let top = List.fold_left (fun m o -> max m (top_tmp o)) 0 ops in
    let fresh = List.mapi (fun i g -> (g, top + 1 + i)) groups in
    List.concat_map
      (fun o ->
        match o with
        | New (Tmp k) -> [ Assign (Tmp k, Tmp (List.assoc (find k) fresh)) ]
        | o -> [ o ])
      ops
    @ List.map (fun (_, t) -> New (Tmp t)) fresh

(* ---- a summary simplified, what it says the same (the analysis is
 * flow-insensitive: a variable is the set of what it may point to)
 *
 * 1. copies merged: Tmps in a cycle of Assigns have one set, one
 *    variable; a Tmp defined only by a copy is its source;
 * 2. a definition no op reads dropped (Load, Assign, Scalar, New,
 *    Global into a Tmp read by none), until none is left; a Load kept,
 *    a field read, what dead.dl asks.
 * A Store is kept: two variables may point to one object, a value
 * stored through one loaded through the other, which this does not
 * see. *)
and simplify (ops : op list) : op list =
  let subst (f : Models.v -> Models.v) (ops : op list) : op list =
    List.sort_uniq compare (List.map (map_op f) ops)
    |> List.filter (function Assign (a, b) -> a <> b | _ -> true) in
  (* the Tmps a definition writes *)
  let dst (o : op) : Models.v option =
    match o with
    | Assign (d, _) | Load (d, _, _) | New d | Scalar d | Call (d, _, _) | Global (d, _) -> Some d
    | Store _ | Raise _ -> None in
  let defs (ops : op list) (v : Models.v) : op list =
    List.filter (fun o -> dst o = Some v) ops in
  (* 1. a cycle of copies one variable: the Tmps reached both ways *)
  let rec merge_cycles (ops : op list) : op list =
    let edges = List.filter_map (function Assign ((Tmp _ as d), (Tmp _ as s)) -> Some (s, d) | _ -> None) ops in
    let rec reach (seen : Models.v list) (x : Models.v) : Models.v list =
      if List.mem x seen then seen
      else List.fold_left (fun acc (s, d) -> if s = x then reach acc d else acc) (x :: seen) edges in
    let tmps = List.sort_uniq compare (List.concat_map (fun (s, d) -> [ s; d ]) edges) in
    match
      List.find_map
        (fun x ->
          let fwd = reach [] x in
          match List.filter (fun y -> y <> x && List.mem x (reach [] y) && List.mem y fwd) tmps with
          | [] -> None
          | ys -> Some (x, ys))
        tmps
    with
    | Some (x, ys) -> merge_cycles (subst (fun v -> if List.mem v ys then x else v) ops)
    | None -> ops in
  (* 1. a Tmp whose one definition is a copy: its source *)
  let rec copies (ops : op list) : op list =
    match
      List.find_map
        (fun o ->
          match o with
          | Assign ((Tmp _ as a), b) when defs ops a = [ o ] && b <> a -> Some (a, b)
          | _ -> None)
        ops
    with
    | Some (a, b) -> copies (subst (fun v -> if v = a then b else v) (List.filter (( <> ) (Assign (a, b))) ops))
    | None -> ops in
  (* 2. a definition of a Tmp no op reads *)
  let reads (o : op) : Models.v list =
    match o with
    | Assign (_, s) | Load (_, s, _) -> [ s ]
    | Store (a, _, b) -> [ a; b ]
    | Call (_, f, a) -> [ f; a ]
    | New _ | Scalar _ | Global _ | Raise _ -> [] in
  let rec unused (ops : op list) : op list =
    let read = List.concat_map reads ops in
    let dead (o : op) =
      match o, dst o with
      (* (a Load is a field read, what dead.dl's dead fields ask: kept,
       * its value unread or not; old: dropped, Hashtbl's size dead) *)
      | (Call _ | Load _), _ -> false
      | _, Some (Tmp _ as d) -> not (List.mem d read)
      | _ -> false in
    if List.exists dead ops then unused (List.filter (fun o -> not (dead o)) ops) else ops in
  let rec fix (ops : op list) : op list =
    let ops' = unused (copies (merge_cycles ops)) in
    if ops' = ops then ops else fix ops' in
  fix (List.sort_uniq compare ops)

(* a call of a summarized function given all its arguments, its summary
 * in its place, renumbered (List.rev's List.rev_append: rev's cells its
 * call's own, as Models writes them); not one being written already *)
and inline table (stack : string list) (ops : op list) : op list =
  let top = List.fold_left (fun m o -> max m (top_tmp o)) 0 ops in
  let next = ref top in
  let uses (x : Models.v) : int =
    List.length (List.filter (fun o -> List.mem x (vars_of_op o)) ops) in
  let calls = List.filter_map (function Call (d, f, a) -> Some (d, f, a) | _ -> None) ops in
  let removed = ref [] and added = ref [] in
  (* each chain on its own: a global's variable may serve several calls
   * (stable_sort's four of rev_append); old: one call through it only *)
  let globals = List.filter_map (function Global (v, g) -> Some (v, g) | _ -> None) ops in
  List.iter
    (fun ((d0, f0, a0) : Models.v * Models.v * Models.v) ->
      match List.assoc_opt f0 globals with
      | Some g when Hashtbl.mem table g && not (List.mem g stack) ->
          let n, body = Hashtbl.find table g in
          (* the chain: f a1, then what it returned applied to a2, ... *)
          let rec chain (d : Models.v) (k : int) (acc : (Models.v * Models.v * Models.v) list) =
            if k > n then Some (List.rev acc)
            else
              match List.filter (fun (_, f', _) -> f' = d) calls with
              | [ ((d', _, _) as c) ] when uses d = 2 -> chain d' (k + 1) (c :: acc)
              | _ -> None in
          let first = (d0, f0, a0) in
          (match if n = 1 then Some [ first ] else chain d0 2 [ first ] with
           | Some cs when List.length cs = n ->
               let args = List.map (fun (_, _, a) -> a) cs in
               let ret = (match List.rev cs with (d, _, _) :: _ -> d | [] -> Models.Ret) in
               let base = !next in
               let body = inline table (g :: stack) body in
               next := base + List.fold_left (fun m o -> max m (top_tmp o)) 0 body;
               let sub (x : Models.v) : Models.v =
                 match x with
                 | Arg i -> List.nth args (i - 1)
                 | Ret -> ret
                 | Tmp k -> Tmp (base + k) in
               removed := List.map (fun (d, f, a) -> Call (d, f, a)) cs @ !removed;
               added := !added @ List.map (map_op sub) body
           | _ -> ())
      | _ -> ())
    calls;
  List.filter (fun o -> not (List.mem o !removed)) ops @ !added

and vars_of_op (o : op) : Models.v list =
  match o with
  | Global (v, _) -> [ v ]
  | New v | Scalar v -> [ v ]
  | Load (a, b, _) | Store (a, _, b) | Assign (a, b) -> [ a; b ]
  | Call (a, b, c) -> [ a; b; c ]
  | Raise _ -> []

and top_tmp (o : op) : int =
  List.fold_left (fun m x -> match x with Models.Tmp k -> max m k | _ -> m) 0 (vars_of_op o)

and map_op (f : Models.v -> Models.v) (o : op) : op =
  match o with
  | Global (v, g) -> Global (f v, g)
  | New v -> New (f v)
  | Scalar v -> Scalar (f v)
  | Load (a, b, s) -> Load (f a, f b, s)
  | Store (a, s, b) -> Store (f a, s, f b)
  | Assign (a, b) -> Assign (f a, f b)
  | Call (a, b, c) -> Call (f a, f b, f c)
  | Raise e -> Raise e

let v (x : Models.v) : string =
  match x with
  | Arg k -> Printf.sprintf "Arg %d" k
  | Ret -> "Ret"
  | Tmp k -> Printf.sprintf "Tmp %d" k

let show (o : op) : string =
  match o with
  | Global (x, g) -> Printf.sprintf "Global (%s, %S)" (v x) g
  | New x -> Printf.sprintf "New (%s)" (v x)
  | Load (d, s, f) -> Printf.sprintf "Load (%s, %s, %S)" (v d) (v s) f
  | Store (d, f, s) -> Printf.sprintf "Store (%s, %S, %s)" (v d) f (v s)
  | Assign (d, s) -> Printf.sprintf "Assign (%s, %s)" (v d) (v s)
  | Scalar x -> Printf.sprintf "Scalar (%s)" (v x)
  | Call (d, f, a) -> Printf.sprintf "Call (%s, %s, %s)" (v d) (v f) (v a)
  | Raise e -> Printf.sprintf "Raise %S" e

(* ---- the summaries' file: List.rev 1, then  Load T3 A2 con:::.0 *)

let token (x : Models.v) : string =
  match x with Arg k -> "A" ^ string_of_int k | Ret -> "R" | Tmp k -> "T" ^ string_of_int k

let line (o : op) : string =
  match o with
  | New x -> "New " ^ token x
  | Load (d, s, f) -> String.concat " " [ "Load"; token d; token s; f ]
  | Store (d, f, s) -> String.concat " " [ "Store"; token d; f; token s ]
  | Assign (d, s) -> String.concat " " [ "Assign"; token d; token s ]
  | Scalar x -> "Scalar " ^ token x
  | Call (d, f, a) -> String.concat " " [ "Call"; token d; token f; token a ]
  | Raise e -> "Raise " ^ e
  | Global (x, g) -> String.concat " " [ "Global"; token x; g ]

let to_text (l : (string * (int * op list)) list) : string =
  String.concat ""
    (List.map
       (fun ((f, (n, ops)) : string * (int * op list)) ->
         Printf.sprintf "%s %d\n%s" f n
           (String.concat "" (List.map (fun o -> "  " ^ line o ^ "\n") ops)))
       l)

let untoken (s : string) : Models.v =
  match s.[0] with
  | 'A' -> Arg (int_of_string (String.sub s 1 (String.length s - 1)))
  | 'T' -> Tmp (int_of_string (String.sub s 1 (String.length s - 1)))
  | _ -> Ret

let of_text (text : string) : (string * (int * op list)) list =
  let acc = ref [] and cur = ref None in
  let close () =
    match !cur with
    | Some (f, n, ops) -> acc := (f, (n, List.rev ops)) :: !acc; cur := None
    | None -> () in
  List.iter
    (fun (l : string) ->
      if l = "" then ()
      else if l.[0] = ' ' then begin
        let o =
          match String.split_on_char ' ' (String.trim l) with
          | [ "New"; x ] -> New (untoken x)
          | [ "Load"; d; s; f ] -> Load (untoken d, untoken s, f)
          | [ "Store"; d; f; s ] -> Store (untoken d, f, untoken s)
          | [ "Assign"; d; s ] -> Assign (untoken d, untoken s)
          | [ "Scalar"; x ] -> Scalar (untoken x)
          | [ "Call"; d; f; a ] -> Call (untoken d, untoken f, untoken a)
          | [ "Raise"; e ] -> Raise e
          | [ "Global"; x; g ] -> Global (untoken x, g)
          | _ -> failwith ("a summary's op: " ^ l) in
        match !cur with
        | Some (f, n, ops) -> cur := Some (f, n, o :: ops)
        | None -> failwith ("an op before its function: " ^ l)
      end
      else begin
        close ();
        match String.rindex_opt l ' ' with
        | Some i ->
            cur := Some (String.sub l 0 i, int_of_string (String.sub l (i + 1) (String.length l - i - 1)), [])
        | None -> failwith ("a summary's head: " ^ l)
      end)
    (String.split_on_char '\n' text);
  close ();
  List.rev !acc
analyzers/summaries/Summaries.mli
2319
(* A library function's summary, derived from its facts, in Models'
 * vocabulary (plan_analysis_scale.md, step 3): what Models.ml writes by
 * hand for List and Hashtbl, made of the code itself.
 *
 *     lib_core's facts            a function's tree: its curried
 *     (-no-models: List and  -->  stages, its local functions; its
 *     Hashtbl as written)         variables Tmps, its parameters
 *                                 copied from Arg i, its result Ret
 *                                    |
 *                                    v
 *     a call in the tree: its parameters and result (inside, Andersen's)
 *     a call through anything else: Call (the caller's analysis makes it)
 *     a global read: Global;  raise_of: Raise;  the rest one op a fact
 *
 * design: why a summary is the tree and not each function. A call of a
 * local function, or of the function itself, is written as assignments
 * to its parameters, not as a call: the tree's objects are then the
 * caller's call's, however deep the code went, which is what makes
 * Models precise (Models.ml's design note); a loop over a list becomes
 * c = l, c = c.tl. A tree with a try, a global written, or a primitive
 * called through a variable is not summarized: its body is kept. *)

type op = Models.op =
  | New of Models.v
  | Load of Models.v * Models.v * string
  | Store of Models.v * string * Models.v
  | Assign of Models.v * Models.v
  | Scalar of Models.v
  | Call of Models.v * Models.v * Models.v
  | Raise of string
  | Global of Models.v * string

(* a fact: its relation, its atoms (numbers as their digits) *)
type fact = string * string list

(* [derive ~units facts]: each function of those units (by its symbol,
 * List.iter) summarized: its arity, its ops; or why not *)
val derive :
  units:string list -> fact list ->
  (string * (int * op list, string) result) list

(* facts read from mini-analyze -facts's text *)
val parse : string -> fact list

(* an op as Models.ml writes it (Load (Tmp 3, Arg 2, "con:::.0")) *)
val show : op -> string

(* the summaries as a file's text, a function a line (its symbol, its
 * arity) then its ops a line each, indented (Load T3 A2 con:::.0); and
 * read back *)
val to_text : (string * (int * op list)) list -> string
val of_text : string -> (string * (int * op list)) list
apps/files/Files.ml

(* Claude Code

(* mini-files: folders in a window, and a file opened by a double click
 * or Enter without knowing which program reads it
 * (docs/plans/done/plan_files.md):
 *
 *   /  home  pad  docs                   <- the path, the parents a click away
 *   Name                  Size       Day <- a click: sorted by it, again:
 *   games/                     2026-10-30   the other way
 *  #report.pdf#####     1.2 MB 2026-10-29#
 *   song.mod             31 KB 2026-10-02
 *   application/pdf: page                <- what Enter will do
 *
 *   the file's first bytes --File_kind--> application/pdf
 *                                               | ~/.mailcap, the built-in
 *                                               v rules (Helpers)
 *                                         page /home/pad/docs/report.pdf
 *                                               |
 *                                               v a window of its own
 *
 * Folder says what a directory holds and the history of this kind of
 * program. A file's kind is a read of 4,096 bytes: for its icon, asked of
 * the rows on the screen and of a few of them a frame (a big folder does
 * not stop the window), never of a whole folder.
 *
 * A window of its own under mini-rio, and on Linux a process beside; on
 * mini-9pi's bare screen a program would fight this one for the screen
 * and the mouse: the status line asks for rio first (Helpers.run). *)

open Playground

type caps =
  < Cap.readdir ; Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out ; Cap.env ; Cap.exec ; Cap.wait ; Cap.exit ; Cap.argv ; Cap.stdout ; Cap.stderr
  ; Cap.draw ; Cap.mouse ; Cap.keyboard ; Cap.fork >

let usage =
  "usage: mini-files [dir] [root=dir]    a folder in a window (root=: not above it)\n\
   in the window:\n\
  \  up, down, the wheel         the selection, the list moved\n\
  \  Enter, a double click       a folder entered, a file opened by its program\n\
  \  Backspace                   the folder above;  b  the one before\n\
  \  a click on the path         that folder\n\
  \  a click on Name, Size, Day  sorted by it; again, the other way\n\
  \  .                           the names that begin with a dot, shown or not\n\
  \  c, x, then v                copied or cut, put in the folder shown\n\
  \  a row dragged on a folder   moved there (the path's folders too)\n\
  \  r                           renamed;  n  a new folder\n\
  \  d                           deleted, after a question\n\
  \  q                           the end\n"

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The model *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* what the status line asks, the keys meanwhile being for it *)
type asking = Deleting | Renaming | New_folder

(* c or x: nothing changes until v, in the folder then shown *)
type clip = Copied of string | Cut of string

(* the button down on a row: where, and which entry *)
type press = { row_pressed : int; px : float; py : float }

type model = {
  root : string; (* no folder above it is shown *)
  dir : string;
  entries : Folder.entry array; (* in the order shown *)
  kinds : string option array; (* of the entries: known once they were on the screen *)
  order : Folder.order;
  reversed : bool;
  dots : bool; (* the names that begin with a dot, shown *)
  selected : int;
  top : int; (* the first row shown *)
  before : string list; (* the folders left, the last first *)
  said : string; (* the status line, when an action said something *)
  asking : asking option;
  field : string; (* what is typed after the question *)
  clip : clip option;
  press : press option;
  button_held : bool; (* last frame's: a press is the frame it goes down *)
  rules : Helpers.rule list; (* read once *)
  kind : string; (* the selected file's, and its program's name *)
  last_click : (int * float) option; (* the row, when: for a double click *)
  held : string Set_.t;
}

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Reading the folder *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let selected_entry (m : model) : Folder.entry option =
  if m.selected >= 0 && m.selected < Array.length m.entries then Some m.entries.(m.selected) else None

(* the rule for the selected file, and what it is *)
let rule_of (caps : caps) (m : model) (e : Folder.entry) : string * Helpers.rule option =
  let path = Folder.join m.dir e.name in
  if Sys_plan9.is_device caps path then ("a pipe or a device", None)
  else
    match File_kind.of_path caps (Fpath.v path) with
    | kind -> (kind, Helpers.for_type m.rules kind)
    | exception Sys_error why -> (why, None)

let with_kind (caps : caps) (m : model) : model =
  match selected_entry m with
  | Some e when not e.is_dir ->
      let kind, rule = rule_of caps m e in
      { m with kind = (match rule with Some r -> kind ^ ": " ^ Helpers.name r | None -> kind) }
  | _ -> { m with kind = "" }

let with_selected (caps : caps) (m : model) (i : int) : model =
  let n = Array.length m.entries in
  let i = max 0 (min i (n - 1)) in
  if i = m.selected then m else with_kind caps { m with selected = i; said = "" }

(* the folder read again, the same name selected if it is still there *)
let read (caps : caps) (m : model) (selected : string option) : model =
  match Folder.list caps m.dir with
  | exception Unix.Unix_error (e, _, _) ->
      { m with entries = [||]; kinds = [||]; selected = 0; top = 0; kind = ""; said = m.dir ^ ": " ^ Unix.error_message e }
  | all ->
      let shown = if m.dots then all else List.filter (fun (e : Folder.entry) -> e.name.[0] <> '.') all in
      let entries = Array.of_list (Folder.sort m.order ~reversed:m.reversed shown) in
      let rec find (i : int) =
        if i >= Array.length entries then 0 else if Some entries.(i).name = selected then i else find (i + 1)
      in
      with_kind caps { m with entries; kinds = Array.make (Array.length entries) None; selected = find 0; top = 0 }

(* the folder one comes up to: selected what one came from *)
let came_from (dir : string) (old : string) : string option =
  let prefix = Folder.join dir "" in
  if String.starts_with ~prefix old then
    let rest = String.sub old (String.length prefix) (String.length old - String.length prefix) in
    Some (List.hd (String.split_on_char '/' rest))
  else None

let enter (caps : caps) (m : model) (dir : string) : model =
  if dir = m.dir then m
  else read caps { m with dir; before = m.dir :: m.before; said = "" } (came_from dir m.dir)

let initial (caps : caps) (root : string) (dir : string) : model =
  read caps
    { root; dir; entries = [||]; kinds = [||]; order = By_name; reversed = false; dots = false; selected = 0; top = 0;
      before = []; said = ""; asking = None; field = ""; clip = None; press = None; button_held = false; rules = Helpers.rules caps; kind = ""; last_click = None; held = Set_.empty }
    None

let open_selected (caps : caps) (m : model) : model =
  match selected_entry m with
  | None -> m
  | Some e when e.is_dir -> enter caps m (Folder.join m.dir e.name)
  | Some e -> (
      let path = Folder.join m.dir e.name in
      match rule_of caps m e with
      | kind, None -> { m with said = Printf.sprintf "no program for %s" kind }
      | _, Some rule ->
          if not (Helpers.windows ()) then { m with said = Helpers.name rule ^ ": start rio first, for its window" }
          else (
            Helpers.run caps (Helpers.command rule ~url:path ~file:(Some path));
            { m with said = Printf.sprintf "%s given to %s" e.name (Helpers.name rule) }))

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The layout *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let size = 16.
let row = 24.
let path_bar = 30.
let status_bar = 26.
let icon_room = 22.

let ink = rgb 32 33 36
let grey = rgb 95 99 104
let bars = rgb 232 234 237
let chosen = rgb 26 115 232
let target = rgb 200 225 250

let advance (c : string) : float =
  let g = Glyph_unicode.glyph c in
  float_of_int (g.right - g.left) *. size /. Hershey.units_per_em

let width (s : string) : float = List.fold_left (fun w c -> w +. advance c) 0. (Text.chars s)

(* [s] from [x], cut at [room] *)
let text (color : color) ~(bold : bool) ~(room : float) (x : float) (baseline : float) (s : string) : shape =
  let rec place (x0 : float) acc l =
    match l with
    | [] -> List.rev acc
    | c :: rest ->
        let w = advance c in
        if x0 +. w > x +. room then List.rev acc else place (x0 +. w) ((x0, c) :: acc) rest
  in
  letters color { size; bold; italic = false; baseline; at = place x [] (Text.chars s) }

(* what is measured from the screen: the columns' left ends, the rows *)
type area = { left : float; right : float; top_y : float; size_x : float; day_x : float; rows : int }

let area (computer : computer) : area =
  let w = computer.screen.width and h = computer.screen.height in
  let left = (-.w /. 2.) +. 8. and right = (w /. 2.) -. 8. in
  { left; right; top_y = h /. 2.;
    size_x = right -. 225.;
    day_x = right -. 125.;
    rows = max 1 (int_of_float ((h -. path_bar -. status_bar -. row) /. row)) }

(* the row's middle *)
let row_y (a : area) (i : int) : float = a.top_y -. path_bar -. row -. (row /. 2.) -. (float_of_int i *. row)

(* the row under a height, on the screen *)
let row_at (a : area) (y : float) : int option =
  let from_top = a.top_y -. path_bar -. row -. y in
  if from_top < 0. then None
  else
    let i = int_of_float (from_top /. row) in
    if i < a.rows then Some i else None

(* the buttons of the path: the name, the folder, where it begins *)
let path_buttons (a : area) (m : model) : (string * string * float) list =
  let _, l =
    List.fold_left
      (fun (x, acc) (name, path) -> (x +. width name +. 18., (name, path, x) :: acc))
      (a.left, [])
      (Folder.parents ~root:m.root m.dir)
  in
  List.rev l

let keep_shown (a : area) (m : model) : model =
  if m.selected < m.top then { m with top = m.selected }
  else if m.selected >= m.top + a.rows then { m with top = m.selected - a.rows + 1 }
  else m

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The update *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let sorted (caps : caps) (m : model) (order : Folder.order) : model =
  let reversed = m.order = order && not m.reversed in
  let name = Option.map (fun (e : Folder.entry) -> e.name) (selected_entry m) in
  read caps { m with order; reversed } name

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Changing files *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the action's failure, in words *)
let tried (action : unit -> unit) : string option =
  match action () with
  | () -> None
  | exception Folder.Refused why -> Some why
  | exception Unix.Unix_error (e, _, what) -> Some (Filename.basename what ^ ": " ^ Unix.error_message e)
  | exception Sys_error why -> Some why

(* the folder read again after an action, what it said on the status line *)
let shown (caps : caps) (a : area) (m : model) (name : string option) (said : string) : model =
  keep_shown a { (read caps m name) with said; asking = None; field = "" }

let selected_name (m : model) : string option = Option.map (fun (e : Folder.entry) -> e.name) (selected_entry m)

(* the row that takes a deleted one's place *)
let next_name (m : model) : string option =
  let n = Array.length m.entries in
  if m.selected + 1 < n then Some m.entries.(m.selected + 1).name
  else if m.selected > 0 then Some m.entries.(m.selected - 1).name
  else None

let delete (caps : caps) (a : area) (m : model) : model =
  match selected_entry m with
  | None -> m
  | Some e -> (
      match tried (fun () -> Folder.remove caps (Folder.join m.dir e.name)) with
      | None -> shown caps a m (next_name m) (e.name ^ " deleted")
      | Some why -> shown caps a m (Some e.name) why)

(* the field, a name of one folder, given to the action *)
let named (caps : caps) (a : area) (m : model) (action : string -> unit) (said : string -> string) : model =
  let name = m.field in
  if not (Folder.good_name name) then
    { m with said = "a name is not empty, and has no / in it"; asking = None; field = "" }
  else
    match tried (fun () -> action name) with
    | None -> shown caps a m (Some name) (said name)
    | Some why -> shown caps a m (selected_name m) why

let copy_or_cut (m : model) (clip : string -> clip) (word : string) : model =
  match selected_entry m with
  | None -> m
  | Some e ->
      { m with
        clip = Some (clip (Folder.join m.dir e.name));
        said = Printf.sprintf "%s %s: v in the folder it goes to" e.name word }

let paste (caps : caps) (a : area) (m : model) : model =
  let here (from : string) = Filename.dirname from = m.dir in
  match m.clip with
  | None -> { m with said = "nothing to put here: c or x first" }
  | Some (Cut from) when here from -> { m with said = Filename.basename from ^ " is already here" }
  | Some (Cut from) -> (
      let name = Filename.basename from in
      match tried (fun () -> Folder.move caps from (Folder.join m.dir name)) with
      | None -> shown caps a { m with clip = None } (Some name) (name ^ " moved here")
      | Some why -> shown caps a m (selected_name m) why)
  | Some (Copied from) -> (
      let base = Filename.basename from in
      let taken (name : string) = Folder.exists caps (Folder.join m.dir name) in
      let name = if here from then Folder.copy_name ~taken base else base in
      match tried (fun () -> Folder.copy caps from (Folder.join m.dir name)) with
      | None -> shown caps a m (Some name) (name ^ " copied here")
      | Some why -> shown caps a m (selected_name m) why)

(* while a question is on the status line: y alone deletes *)
let answer (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (a : area) (m : model) (q : asking) : model =
  let keys = computer.keyboard.keys in
  let pressed (name : string) = Set_.mem name keys && not (Set_.mem name m.held) in
  let typed = computer.keyboard.typed in
  let dropped = { m with asking = None; field = ""; said = "" } in
  match q with
  | Deleting -> if typed = "y" then delete caps a m else if typed = "n" || pressed "Escape" then dropped else m
  | New_folder when pressed "Enter" ->
      named caps a m (fun name -> Folder.make_folder caps (Folder.join m.dir name)) (fun name -> name ^ ": a new folder")
  | Renaming when pressed "Enter" -> (
      match selected_entry m with
      | Some e when e.name <> m.field ->
          named caps a m (fun name -> Folder.rename caps (Folder.join m.dir e.name) name) (fun name -> "now " ^ name)
      | _ -> dropped)
  | Renaming | New_folder ->
      if pressed "Escape" then dropped
      else if pressed "Backspace" then
        { m with field = String.concat "" (List.rev (match List.rev (Text.chars m.field) with [] -> [] | _ :: rest -> rest)) }
      else { m with field = m.field ^ String.concat "" (List.filter (fun c -> c >= " ") (Text.chars typed)) }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Dragging *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let moved_enough (computer : computer) (p : press) : bool =
  abs_float (computer.mouse.mx -. p.px) +. abs_float (computer.mouse.my -. p.py) >= 6.

(* what is under the pointer that a file could be dropped in: a folder's row
 * (not the one dragged), or a folder of the path, not the one shown *)
let drop_target (computer : computer) (a : area) (m : model) (p : press) : string option =
  let x = computer.mouse.mx and y = computer.mouse.my in
  if y > a.top_y -. path_bar then
    match List.find_opt (fun (name, _, x0) -> x >= x0 && x < x0 +. width name +. 12.) (path_buttons a m) with
    | Some (_, path, _) when path <> m.dir -> Some path
    | _ -> None
  else
    match row_at a y with
    | Some i when i + m.top < Array.length m.entries && i + m.top <> p.row_pressed ->
        let e = m.entries.(i + m.top) in
        if e.is_dir then Some (Folder.join m.dir e.name) else None
    | _ -> None

let drop (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (a : area) (m : model) (p : press) : model =
  match drop_target computer a m p with
  | None -> m
  | Some dir -> (
      let e = m.entries.(p.row_pressed) in
      let m = { m with selected = p.row_pressed } in
      match tried (fun () -> Folder.move caps (Folder.join m.dir e.name) (Folder.join dir e.name)) with
      | None -> shown caps a m (next_name m) (Printf.sprintf "%s moved to %s" e.name (Filename.basename dir))
      | Some why -> shown caps a m (Some e.name) why)

let click (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (a : area) (m : model) : model =
  let x = computer.mouse.mx and y = computer.mouse.my in
  let (Time now) = computer.time in
  if y > a.top_y -. path_bar then
    match List.find_opt (fun (name, _, x0) -> x >= x0 && x < x0 +. width name +. 12.) (path_buttons a m) with
    | Some (_, path, _) -> enter caps m path
    | None -> m
  else if y > a.top_y -. path_bar -. row then
    if x >= a.day_x then sorted caps m By_day else if x >= a.size_x then sorted caps m By_size else sorted caps m By_name
  else
    match row_at a y with
    | Some i when i + m.top < Array.length m.entries -> (
        let i = i + m.top in
        match m.last_click with
        | Some (j, t) when j = i && now -. t < 0.5 -> open_selected caps { m with last_click = None; selected = i }
        | _ -> { (with_selected caps m i) with last_click = Some (i, now) })
    | _ -> m

let browse (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (m : model) : model =
  let keys = computer.keyboard.keys in
  let pressed (name : string) = Set_.mem name keys && not (Set_.mem name m.held) in
  let typed = computer.keyboard.typed in
  let a = area computer in
  let was = m.selected in
  let m =
    if pressed "ArrowDown" || pressed "down" then with_selected caps m (m.selected + 1)
    else if pressed "ArrowUp" || pressed "up" then with_selected caps m (m.selected - 1)
    else if pressed "PageDown" then with_selected caps m (m.selected + a.rows)
    else if pressed "PageUp" then with_selected caps m (m.selected - a.rows)
    else if pressed "Enter" then open_selected caps m
    else if pressed "Backspace" then enter caps m (Folder.parent ~root:m.root m.dir)
    else if typed = "b" then (
      match m.before with
      | dir :: before -> read caps { m with dir; before; said = "" } (came_from dir m.dir)
      | [] -> m)
    else if typed = "." then
      read caps { m with dots = not m.dots } (selected_name m)
    else if typed = "c" then copy_or_cut m (fun path -> Copied path) "copied"
    else if typed = "x" then copy_or_cut m (fun path -> Cut path) "cut"
    else if typed = "v" then paste caps a m
    else if typed = "d" && selected_entry m <> None then { m with asking = Some Deleting; said = "" }
    else if typed = "r" && selected_entry m <> None then
      { m with asking = Some Renaming; field = (match selected_name m with Some name -> name | None -> ""); said = "" }
    else if typed = "n" then { m with asking = Some New_folder; field = ""; said = "" }
    else if typed = "q" then CapStdlib.exit caps 0
    else m
  in
  let m = if m.selected <> was then keep_shown a m else m in
  let m =
    match m.press with
    | Some p when computer.mouse.mclick && moved_enough computer p -> drop caps computer a { m with press = None } p
    | _ when computer.mouse.mclick -> click caps computer a { m with press = None }
    | None when computer.mouse.mdown && not m.button_held -> (
        match row_at a computer.mouse.my with
        | Some i when i + m.top < Array.length m.entries && computer.mouse.my <= a.top_y -. path_bar -. row ->
            { m with press = Some { row_pressed = i + m.top; px = computer.mouse.mx; py = computer.mouse.my } }
        | _ -> m)
    | Some _ when not computer.mouse.mdown -> { m with press = None }
    | _ -> m
  in
  let last = max 0 (Array.length m.entries - a.rows) in
  let wheel = int_of_float computer.mouse.mwheel in
  let m = if wheel <> 0 then { m with top = max 0 (min last (m.top - (3 * wheel))) } else m in
  m

(* the kinds of the rows shown, a few a frame: each is a read *)
let learn_kinds (caps : caps) (a : area) (m : model) : unit =
  let left = ref 4 in
  for i = m.top to min (m.top + a.rows) (Array.length m.entries) - 1 do
    let e = m.entries.(i) in
    if !left > 0 && (not e.is_dir) && m.kinds.(i) = None then (
      decr left;
      m.kinds.(i) <- Some (fst (rule_of caps m e)))
  done

let update (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (m : model) : model =
  let a = area computer in
  let m =
    match m.asking with
    | Some q -> answer caps computer a m q
    | None -> browse caps computer m
  in
  learn_kinds caps a m;
  { m with held = computer.keyboard.keys; button_held = computer.mouse.mdown }

(* The view *)

let status (m : model) : string =
  match (m.asking, selected_entry m) with
  | Some Deleting, Some e ->
      Printf.sprintf "delete %s%s? y or n" e.name (if e.is_dir then " and all it holds" else "")
  | Some Renaming, _ -> "new name: " ^ m.field ^ "_"
  | Some New_folder, _ -> "new folder: " ^ m.field ^ "_"
  | _, Some e when m.said = "" && not e.is_dir -> m.kind
  | _ -> if m.said <> "" then m.said else Printf.sprintf "%d items" (Array.length m.entries)

let look_of (m : model) (i : int) (e : Folder.entry) : Icons.look =
  if e.is_dir then Icons.Folder
  else match m.kinds.(i) with Some kind -> Icons.of_kind kind | None -> Icons.Other

(* while a row is dragged: the row it would go in, under the rows' text *)
let drop_row (computer : computer) (a : area) (m : model) : shape list =
  match m.press with
  | Some p when moved_enough computer p -> (
      match (drop_target computer a m p, row_at a computer.mouse.my) with
      | Some _, Some i when computer.mouse.my <= a.top_y -. path_bar -. row ->
          [ move 0. (row_y a i) (rectangle target computer.screen.width row) ]
      | _ -> [])
  | _ -> []

(* ... and its name under the pointer *)
let dragged (computer : computer) (m : model) : shape list =
  match m.press with
  | Some p when moved_enough computer p ->
      let e = m.entries.(p.row_pressed) in
      let x = computer.mouse.mx and y = computer.mouse.my in
      [ move (x +. 16.) (y -. 2.) (Icons.draw (look_of m p.row_pressed e));
        text ink ~bold:true ~room:300. (x +. 28.) (y -. 7.) e.name ]
  | _ -> []

let view (computer : computer) (m : model) : shape list =
  let a = area computer in
  let w = computer.screen.width and h = computer.screen.height in
  let bar_at (y : float) (height : float) = move 0. y (rectangle bars w height) in
  let base (y : float) = y -. 5. in
  let header (x : float) (name : string) (order : Folder.order) =
    let mark = if m.order <> order then "" else if m.reversed then " v" else " ^" in
    text grey ~bold:true ~room:200. x (base (a.top_y -. path_bar -. (row /. 2.))) (name ^ mark)
  in
  let one_row (i : int) (e : Folder.entry) : shape list =
    let y = row_y a (i - m.top) in
    let selected = i = m.selected in
    let color = if selected then white else ink in
    let name = if e.is_dir then e.name ^ "/" else e.name in
    (if selected then [ move 0. y (rectangle chosen w row) ] else [])
    @ [ move (a.left +. 8.) y (Icons.draw (look_of m i e));
        text color ~bold:e.is_dir ~room:(a.size_x -. a.left -. 32.) (a.left +. icon_room) (base y) name ]
    @ (if e.is_dir then [] else [ text color ~bold:false ~room:95. a.size_x (base y) (Folder.size_text e.size) ])
    @ [ text color ~bold:false ~room:125. a.day_x (base y) (Folder.day_text e.mtime) ]
  in
  let rows =
    List.concat
      (List.init
         (min a.rows (Array.length m.entries - m.top))
         (fun (k : int) -> one_row (m.top + k) m.entries.(m.top + k)))
  in
  [ rectangle white w h;
    bar_at (a.top_y -. (path_bar /. 2.)) path_bar;
    bar_at ((-.h /. 2.) +. (status_bar /. 2.)) status_bar ]
  @ List.map
      (fun (name, _, x) -> text chosen ~bold:false ~room:(width name +. 1.) x (base (a.top_y -. (path_bar /. 2.))) name)
      (path_buttons a m)
  @ [ header a.left "Name" By_name; header a.size_x "Size" By_size; header a.day_x "Day" By_day ]
  @ drop_row computer a m
  @ rows
  @ [ text ink ~bold:false ~room:(a.right -. a.left) a.left (base ((-.h /. 2.) +. (status_bar /. 2.))) (status m) ]
  @ dragged computer m

let absolute (caps : caps) (path : string) : string =
  let path = if Filename.is_relative path then Filename.concat (FS.getcwd caps ()) path else path in
  FS.cleanname path

let () =
  Cap.main (fun caps ->
      Exit.exit caps
        (Exit.catch (fun () ->
             Logging.setup caps ~name:"mini-files";
             let own = (caps :> caps) in
             let flags = Playground_platform.flags caps in
             if List.mem_assoc "help" flags then (
               Console.print caps usage;
               Exit.OK)
             else
               let dirs = List.filter (fun (name, value) -> value = "" && name <> "window") flags in
               let start = match dirs with (d, _) :: _ -> d | [] -> FS.getcwd caps () in
               let root = match List.assoc_opt "root" flags with Some r -> absolute own r | None -> "/" in
               let dir = absolute own start in
               let dir = if String.starts_with ~prefix:root dir then dir else root in
               Playground_platform.run_app caps
                 (* (idle=wait: looked at 4 times a second when nothing changes:
                  * Plan9_loop. old: 60, 58% of mini-9pi's processor under QEMU) *)
                 (flags @ [ ("window", ""); ("idle", "wait") ])
                 (Playground.game view (update own) (initial own root dir));
               Exit.OK)))

(* See Folder.mli *)

type entry = { name : string; is_dir : bool; size : int; mtime : float }
type order = By_name | By_size | By_day

let list (caps : < Cap.readdir ; .. >) (path : string) : entry list =
  List.filter_map
    (fun (d : Sys_plan9.dir) ->
      if d.name = "." || d.name = ".." then None
      else Some { name = d.name; is_dir = d.qid_type land Sys_plan9.dmdir <> 0; size = d.length; mtime = d.mtime })
    (Sys_plan9.dirread caps path)

let sort (order : order) ~(reversed : bool) (entries : entry list) : entry list =
  let by_name (a : entry) (b : entry) = compare a.name b.name in
  let by (a : entry) (b : entry) =
    let c =
      match order with
      | By_name -> by_name a b
      (* a folder's size, not shown, is its file system's (ext4's 4096,
       * tmpfs's by its entries): folders stay by name *)
      | By_size -> if a.is_dir then 0 else compare a.size b.size
      | By_day -> compare a.mtime b.mtime
    in
    if reversed then -c else c
  in
  let folders, files = List.partition (fun (e : entry) -> e.is_dir) entries in
  List.stable_sort by (List.sort by_name folders) @ List.stable_sort by (List.sort by_name files)

let size_text (n : int) : string =
  let tenths (unit : int) (name : string) =
    let t = n * 10 / unit in
    if t >= 100 then Printf.sprintf "%d %s" (t / 10) name else Printf.sprintf "%d.%d %s" (t / 10) (t mod 10) name
  in
  if n < 1024 then Printf.sprintf "%d bytes" n
  else if n < 1024 * 1024 then tenths 1024 "KB"
  else if n < 1024 * 1024 * 1024 then tenths (1024 * 1024) "MB"
  else tenths (1024 * 1024 * 1024) "GB"

let day_text (t : float) : string =
  let tm = Unix.gmtime t in
  Printf.sprintf "%d-%02d-%02d" (tm.Unix.tm_year + 1900) (tm.Unix.tm_mon + 1) tm.Unix.tm_mday

let parent ~(root : string) (path : string) : string = if path = root then root else Filename.dirname path

let parents ~(root : string) (path : string) : (string * string) list =
  let rec up (p : string) (acc : (string * string) list) =
    if p = root then ("/", p) :: acc
    else if Filename.dirname p = p then (p, p) :: acc
    else up (Filename.dirname p) ((Filename.basename p, p) :: acc)
  in
  up path []

let join (dir : string) (name : string) : string = if dir = "/" then "/" ^ name else dir ^ "/" ^ name

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Changing files *)
(*****************************************************************************)

exception Refused of string

type caps = < Cap.readdir ; Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out >

let exists (caps : < caps ; .. >) (path : string) : bool =
  match Sys_plan9.dirstat caps path with
  | (_ : Sys_plan9.dir) -> true
  | exception Unix.Unix_error _ -> false

let is_dir (d : Sys_plan9.dir) : bool = d.qid_type land Sys_plan9.dmdir <> 0

let good_name (name : string) : bool = name <> "" && name <> "." && name <> ".." && not (String.contains name '/')

let copy_name ~(taken : string -> bool) (name : string) : string =
  let rec try_ (i : int) =
    let new_name = Printf.sprintf "copy %d of %s" i name in
    if taken new_name then try_ (i + 1) else new_name
  in
  let first = "copy of " ^ name in
  if taken first then try_ 2 else first

let copy_file (caps : < caps ; .. >) (from : string) (dest : string) (perm : int) : unit =
  let from_fd = FS.open_in_fd caps from in
  Fun.protect
    ~finally:(fun () -> Unix.close from_fd)
    (fun () ->
      let to_fd = FS.open_out_fd caps dest perm in
      Fun.protect
        ~finally:(fun () -> Unix.close to_fd)
        (fun () ->
          let buf = Bytes.create 8192 in
          let rec go () =
            let n = Unix.read from_fd buf 0 8192 in
            if n > 0 then
              if Unix.write to_fd buf 0 n = n then go () else raise (Refused (dest ^ ": short write"))
          in
          go ()))

(* the day kept, as mv's; a file server may refuse it, and that is no failure *)
let rec copy_tree (caps : < caps ; .. >) (from : string) (dest : string) : unit =
  if Sys_plan9.is_link caps from then raise (Refused (Filename.basename from ^ ": a link, not copied"));
  if Sys_plan9.is_device caps from then raise (Refused (Filename.basename from ^ ": a pipe or a device, not copied"));
  let d = Sys_plan9.dirstat caps from in
  if is_dir d then (
    FS.mkdir caps dest (d.perm lor 0o700);
    List.iter (fun (e : entry) -> copy_tree caps (join from e.name) (join dest e.name)) (list caps from))
  else copy_file caps from dest d.perm;
  try Sys_plan9.set_mtime caps dest d.mtime with Unix.Unix_error _ -> ()

(* a link removed is the link: is_dir says what it points to, which stays *)
let rec remove (caps : < caps ; .. >) (path : string) : unit =
  if is_dir (Sys_plan9.dirstat caps path) && not (Sys_plan9.is_link caps path) then
    List.iter (fun (e : entry) -> remove caps (join path e.name)) (list caps path);
  FS.remove_any caps path

let check_free (caps : < caps ; .. >) (dest : string) : unit =
  if exists caps dest then raise (Refused (Filename.basename dest ^ " is already there"))

let copy (caps : < caps ; .. >) (from : string) (dest : string) : unit =
  check_free caps dest;
  if String.starts_with ~prefix:(from ^ "/") dest then raise (Refused (Filename.basename from ^ " can't go inside itself"));
  try copy_tree caps from dest
  with e ->
    (try remove caps dest with Unix.Unix_error _ -> ());
    raise e

let rename (caps : < caps ; .. >) (path : string) (name : string) : unit =
  check_free caps (join (Filename.dirname path) name);
  Sys_plan9.rename caps path name

let move (caps : < caps ; .. >) (from : string) (dest : string) : unit =
  if Filename.dirname from = Filename.dirname dest then rename caps from (Filename.basename dest)
  else (
    copy caps from dest;
    remove caps from)

let make_folder (caps : < caps ; .. >) (path : string) : unit =
  check_free caps path;
  FS.mkdir caps path 0o777

(* Folder: a directory as mini-files shows it: its entries, in an order,
   their sizes and days in words, and the parents of a path.

       /home/pad/docs --list--> entries --sort--> folders first, then
                                 (Sys_plan9's      files, by name, size
                                  dirread)         or day

   cs-history:
   The folder as a window of icons is the Xerox Star's (1981): a
   document is a picture on a desktop, opened by pointing, what it holds
   decides what opens it, and there is no program to name. The
   Macintosh's Finder (1984) took it to where people could buy it, one
   window a folder, each remembering its place. Norton Commander (Peter
   Norton's, John Socha's, 1986) went the other way on the same machines
   as DOS's command line: two panes of lists, the keys F5 and F6 copying
   and moving from one to the other, for those who knew what a file is.
   Windows Explorer (1995), and a list with a tree beside it, is what
   most people have used since.

   plan9-is-cleaner:
   Plan 9, which had rio, had no file manager, and did not want one:
   any window can show a directory (ls, lc), a name on the screen can be
   pointed at to open it, by the plumber (2002), which is rules over
   text and not over a file's kind. Acme's directory window is a list
   one clicks in, and it is the nearest thing. That answer is for someone
   who lives in the shell; this program is for someone who does not. *)

type entry = {
  name : string;
  is_dir : bool;
  size : int; (* bytes *)
  mtime : float; (* seconds *)
}

type order = By_name | By_size | By_day

(* what the directory holds, unsorted, "." and ".." not among them;
   Unix_error if it cannot be read *)
val list : < Cap.readdir ; .. > -> string -> entry list

(* folders first; in the order given, the other way when [reversed] *)
val sort : order -> reversed:bool -> entry list -> entry list

(* "1.2 MB", "31 KB", "120 bytes" *)
val size_text : int -> string

(* "2026-10-30", the day in UTC as ls's *)
val day_text : float -> string

(* the path and each of its parents to [root], the outermost first, each
   with the name to show: [parents ~root:"/" "/a/b"] is
   [("/", "/"); ("a", "/a"); ("b", "/a/b")]; [root] itself is shown "/" *)
val parents : root:string -> string -> (string * string) list

(* the directory above, not above [root] *)
val parent : root:string -> string -> string

(* [join dir name]: without a second '/' in the root *)
val join : string -> string -> string

(* Changing files. Nothing here overwrites: a name that is taken is
   [Refused], where Linux's rename would have replaced it. The window waits
   while a big tree is copied.

   Moving to another folder is a copy and then a removal, as mv's on
   Plan 9, whose rename stays in its directory: the source goes only once
   the copy is whole; a copy that fails halfway removes what it made.

   A symbolic link (Linux's) is not followed: removed, it is the link
   that goes; in a copy it is [Refused], the folder it may point to, even
   a parent, not being part of the tree. A pipe or a device is refused
   too: reading one may never end. *)

(* said in words, for the status line; also Unix_error from the system *)
exception Refused of string

type caps = < Cap.readdir ; Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out >

val exists : < caps ; .. > -> string -> bool

(* a name in one folder: no '/', not "." nor ".." *)
val good_name : string -> bool

(* "copy of a", then "copy 2 of a", for a copy in its own folder *)
val copy_name : taken:(string -> bool) -> string -> string

(* [copy caps from dest], [move caps from dest]: whole paths, a tree or a
   file; [dest] not in [from] itself *)
val copy : < caps ; .. > -> string -> string -> unit
val move : < caps ; .. > -> string -> string -> unit

(* [rename caps path name]: in the folder it is in *)
val rename : < caps ; .. > -> string -> string -> unit

(* a file, or a folder with all it holds *)
val remove : < caps ; .. > -> string -> unit

val make_folder : < caps ; .. > -> string -> unit

(* See Icons.mli *)

open Playground

type look = Folder | Text | Web | Picture | Sound | Film | Book | Program | Archive | Other

let of_kind (kind : string) : look =
  let is (prefix : string) = String.starts_with ~prefix kind in
  if is "text/html" then Web
  else if kind = "text/x-abc" || is "audio/" then Sound
  else if is "text/x-script" then Program
  else if is "text/" then Text
  else if is "image/" then Picture
  else if is "video/" then Film
  else if kind = "application/pdf" || kind = "application/x-office" then Book
  else if kind = "application/x-executable" then Program
  else if kind = "application/gzip" || kind = "application/x-tar" then Archive
  else Other

let at = move

(* a sheet with a dark edge, what most kinds are drawn on *)
let sheet (paper : color) : shape list =
  [ rectangle (rgb 90 95 100) 12. 16.; rectangle paper 10. 14. ]

let lines (ink : color) : shape list =
  List.map (fun (y : float) -> at 0. y (rectangle ink 6. 1.)) [ 4.; 1.; -2.; -5. ]

let draw (look : look) : shape =
  let parts =
    match look with
    | Folder ->
        let tab = rgb 200 150 40 and body = rgb 240 190 70 in
        [ at (-3.) 5. (rectangle tab 8. 4.); at 0. (-1.) (rectangle tab 16. 11.); at 0. (-1.) (rectangle body 14. 9.) ]
    | Text -> sheet white @ lines (rgb 95 99 104)
    | Web ->
        sheet white
        @ [ circle (rgb 26 115 232) 4.; at 0. 0. (rectangle white 8. 1.); at 0. 0. (rectangle white 1. 8.) ]
    | Picture ->
        sheet (rgb 180 220 245)
        @ [ at 2. 3. (circle (rgb 245 200 40) 2.);
            polygon (rgb 60 150 80) [ (-5., -7.); (5., -7.); (5., -3.); (1., 0.); (-2., -3.); (-5., -1.) ] ]
    | Sound ->
        let ink = rgb 130 60 170 in
        [ at (-3.) (-5.) (circle ink 3.); at 3. (-3.) (circle ink 3.);
          at (-1.) 1. (rectangle ink 1. 12.); at 5. 3. (rectangle ink 1. 12.);
          polygon ink [ (-1., 7.); (6., 9.); (6., 6.); (-1., 4.) ] ]
    | Film ->
        let strip = rgb 50 52 56 and hole = white in
        [ rectangle strip 14. 16.; rectangle (rgb 120 190 240) 8. 10. ]
        @ List.concat_map
            (fun (y : float) -> [ at (-5.5) y (rectangle hole 2. 2.); at 5.5 y (rectangle hole 2. 2.) ])
            [ 6.; 2.; -2.; -6. ]
    | Book -> sheet (rgb 250 225 220) @ (at (-3.) 5. (rectangle (rgb 200 50 40) 4. 3.) :: lines (rgb 200 50 40))
    | Program ->
        [ rectangle (rgb 50 52 56) 16. 14.; at 0. 5. (rectangle (rgb 120 125 130) 16. 3.);
          polygon (rgb 90 220 110) [ (-6., 2.); (-1., -1.); (-6., -4.) ]; at 3. (-4.) (rectangle (rgb 90 220 110) 5. 1.) ]
    | Archive ->
        let ink = rgb 150 110 60 in
        [ rectangle ink 14. 14.; at 0. 0. (rectangle (rgb 215 180 125) 12. 12.); at 0. 0. (rectangle ink 2. 14.);
          at 0. 0. (rectangle ink 14. 2.) ]
    | Other -> sheet (rgb 225 227 230)
  in
  group parts

(* Icons: a picture for each kind of file, drawn of plain shapes, 16 pixels
   square.

       text/plain --of_kind--> Text --draw--> a page with lines on it

   cs-history:
   The icon is David Canfield Smith's word (his thesis, Pygmalion, 1975), and
   the Xerox Star's picture (1981): a document looks like a sheet, a folder
   like a folder. Susan Kare drew the Macintosh's in 1983, on graph paper,
   32 by 32 and one bit deep, and those are what people mean by the word.
   They worked because a picture is recognised before a name is read. *)

type look = Folder | Text | Web | Picture | Sound | Film | Book | Program | Archive | Other

(* what a content type looks like (File_kind's strings) *)
val of_kind : string -> look

(* centred on the origin, to be moved *)

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* mini-open: a file given to the program that reads it, whichever that
 * is, as macOS's open (2001) and Linux's xdg-open (2006):
 *
 *     mini-open song.mp3
 *
 * The same dispatch as mini-files', for the terminal (lib_mime's
 * File_kind then Helpers: ~/.mailcap's rules, the built-in ones).
 *
 * References: RFC 1524, the mailcap file. *)

type caps = < Cap.env; Cap.open_in; Cap.open_out; Cap.readdir; Cap.exec; Cap.wait; Cap.stdout; Cap.stderr >

let usage = "usage: mini-open [-n] file
  the file given to the program for its kind (~/.mailcap, the built-in rules)
  -n: only say its kind and the command"

let fail (caps : < caps; .. >) (why : string) : Exit.t = Console.eprint caps ("mini-open: " ^ why ^ "\n"); Exit.Err why

let main (caps : < caps; .. >) (argv : string array) : Exit.t =
  let said, args = match List.tl (Array.to_list argv) with "-n" :: rest -> (true, rest) | args -> (false, args) in
  match args with
  | [ file ] -> (
      match FS.path file with
      | Error why -> fail caps why
      | Ok path -> (
          match File_kind.of_path caps path with
          | exception Sys_error why -> fail caps why
          | kind -> (
              match Helpers.for_type (Helpers.rules caps) kind with
              | None -> fail caps (Printf.sprintf "%s: no program for %s" file kind)
              | Some rule ->
                  (* (whole: a window of mini-rio's has another directory) *)
                  let file = if Sys.os_type = "Plan9" && Filename.is_relative file then Filename.concat (FS.getcwd caps ()) file else file in
                  let command = Helpers.command rule ~url:file ~file:(Some file) in
                  if said then Console.print caps (kind ^ ": " ^ String.concat " " command ^ "\n")
                  else Helpers.run caps command;
                  Exit.OK)))
  | _ -> Console.eprint caps (usage ^ "\n"); Exit.Err "usage"

let () = Cap.main (fun caps -> Exit.exit caps (Exit.catch (fun () -> main caps (CapSys.argv caps))))

let user_agent = "mini-maps/0.1 (+https://github.com/aryx/ix)"

let get (caps : < Cap.network; Cap.open_in; .. >) ~(more : Http.header list) (url : string) : (Http.response, string) result =
  let said = ("User-Agent", user_agent) :: more in
  let options = { Http_client.defaults with said; keep = true } in
  Result.map snd (Http_client.fetch_with options caps ~post:None url)

let get_once (caps : < Cap.network; Cap.open_in; .. >) (url : string) : (Http.response, string) result =
  let said = [ ("User-Agent", user_agent) ] in
  let options = { Http_client.defaults with said; keep = false } in
  Result.map snd (Http_client.fetch_with options caps ~post:None url)

(* Map_http: what mini-maps asks of a server, always saying who is asking:
 * OSM's services and Open-Meteo all want a User-Agent of the program's
 * own, and may block a stock one. One connection kept open, a host being
 * asked many times in a row (Keep_alive). *)

(* [get caps ~more url]: the answer, whatever its status; [more]: other
 * headers to say. Only the worker calls it. *)

(* See Map_look.mli *)

module P = Playground

let text (color : P.color) ~(size : float) (x : float) (baseline : float) (s : string) : P.shape * float =
  let rec place (x0 : float) (acc : (float * string) list) (l : string list) =
    match l with
    | [] -> (List.rev acc, x0)
    | c :: rest ->
        let g = Glyph_unicode.glyph c in
        place (x0 +. (float_of_int (g.right - g.left) *. size /. Hershey.units_per_em)) ((x0, c) :: acc) rest
  in
  let at, x1 = place x [] (Text.chars s) in
  (P.letters color { size; bold = false; italic = false; baseline; at }, x1 -. x)

let width_of (s : string) : float = snd (text P.black ~size:14. 0. 0. s)

let cut (room : float) (s : string) : string =
  if width_of s <= room then s
  else
    let rec go (acc : string) (l : string list) : string =
      match l with
      | c :: rest when width_of (acc ^ c ^ "...") <= room -> go (acc ^ c) rest
      | _ -> acc ^ "..."
    in
    go "" (Text.chars s)

(* as much of [s] as fits in [room], and "..." if it does not *)

(* Claude Code

(* See Map_services.mli *)

module P = Playground

type caps =
  < Cap.fork; Cap.kill; Cap.wait; Cap.network; Cap.open_in; Cap.open_out; Cap.env;
    Cap.clock; Cap.pipe >

let default_places = "https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org"
let default_weather = "https://api.open-meteo.com"
let default_roads = "https://overpass-api.de"

let places_base_of (flags : P.flags) : string =
  match List.assoc_opt "places" flags with Some b -> b | None -> default_places

let forecast_of (caps : < Cap.network; Cap.open_in; .. >) (base : string) (lat : float) (lon : float) : (Weather.t, string) result =
  match Map_http.get caps ~more:[] (Weather.url base lat lon) with
  | Error why -> Error why
  | Ok r when r.status <> 200 -> Error (Printf.sprintf "%d %s" r.status r.reason)
  | Ok r -> ( try Ok (Weather.of_json r.body) with Failure why -> Error why)

(* cache=DIR, or the user's; cache=off, none *)
let cache_dir (caps : caps) (flags : P.flags) : string option =
  let env (name : string) : string option =
    match CapSys.getenv caps name with "" -> None | v -> Some v | exception Not_found -> None
  in
  match (List.assoc_opt "cache" flags, env "XDG_CACHE_HOME", env "HOME", env "home") with
  | Some "off", _, _, _ -> None
  | Some dir, _, _, _ -> Some dir
  | None, Some cache, _, _ -> Some (Filename.concat cache "mini-maps")
  | None, None, Some home, _ | None, None, None, Some home -> Some (Filename.concat (Filename.concat home ".cache") "mini-maps")
  | None, None, None, None -> None

(* the last places: a file beside the cache's tiles *)
let places_file (caps : caps) (flags : P.flags) : Fpath.t option =
  Option.map (fun (dir : string) -> Fpath.v (Filename.concat dir "places")) (cache_dir caps flags)

let known_places (caps : caps) (flags : P.flags) : (string * Place.t) list =
  match Option.bind (places_file caps flags) (fun (f : Fpath.t) -> FS.read_opt caps f) with
  | None -> []
  | Some lines -> List.filter_map Place.of_line (String.split_on_char '\n' lines)

let save_places (caps : caps) (flags : P.flags) (l : (string * Place.t) list) : unit =
  let lines = String.concat "" (List.map (fun (e : string * Place.t) -> Place.to_line e ^ "\n") l) in
  match places_file caps flags with
  | None -> ()
  | Some f -> ( try FS.write caps f lines with Sys_error _ | Unix.Unix_error _ -> ())

let words_of (flags : P.flags) : string list =
  List.filter_map (fun ((k, v) : string * string) -> if v = "" && k <> "window" then Some k else None) flags

let roads_base_of (flags : P.flags) : string =
  match List.assoc_opt "roads" flags with Some b -> b | None -> default_roads

let weather_base_of (flags : P.flags) : string =
  (* (forecast=, weather being the terminal's command word, a flag too) *)
  match List.assoc_opt "forecast" flags with Some b -> b | None -> default_weather

let place_asked = ref 0.

(* the terminal's: a place from the last ones or asked of the service *)
let place_of (caps : caps) (flags : P.flags) (query : string) : (Place.t, string) result =
  let known = known_places caps flags in
  match List.assoc_opt (Place.normal query) known with
  | Some p -> Ok p
  | None -> (
      let base = places_base_of flags in
      (* (a route asks two, a second apart: the service's rule) *)
      let wait = !place_asked +. 1. -. CapUnix.gettimeofday caps () in
      if wait > 0. then CapUnix.sleepf caps wait;
      place_asked := CapUnix.gettimeofday caps ();
      match Map_http.get caps ~more:[] (Place.search_url base query) with
      | Error why -> Error why
      | Ok r when r.status <> 200 -> Error (Printf.sprintf "%d %s" r.status r.reason)
      | Ok r -> (
          match Place.of_json r.body with
          | p :: _ ->
              save_places caps flags ((Place.normal query, p) :: known);
              Ok p
          | [] -> Error (Printf.sprintf "no place called %s" query)
          | exception Failure why -> Error why))

let forecast_lines (caps : caps) (flags : P.flags) (query : string) : (string list, string) result =
  match place_of caps flags query with
  | Error why -> Error why
  | Ok p -> Result.map (Weather.lines p.name) (forecast_of caps (weather_base_of flags) p.lat p.lon)

let route_lines (caps : caps) (flags : P.flags) (from : string) (goal : string) : (string list, string) result =
  match place_of caps flags from with
  | Error why -> Error why
  | Ok a -> (
      match place_of caps flags goal with
      | Error why -> Error why
      | Ok b ->
          Result.map
            (fun ((r, plain) : Routing.t * int option) -> Routing.lines r plain)
            (Routing.find caps ~base:(roads_base_of flags) ~dir:(cache_dir caps flags) ~give:None
               ~dijkstra:true a b))
