(* mini-pim (docs/plans/done/plan_pim.md): with no command, its window
 * (Pim_window: the suite, Home and its views); with one, from a
 * terminal ("the same store from a terminal, for real use and for the
 * tests"), its mail, of plan_mail.md's stages 2 to 4 and 7, here, and
 * the rest of the store, Pim_store's:
 *
 *     mini-pim send file               the message sent by SMTP
 *     mini-pim list [-n 20] [-q search] [-m mailbox]
 *                                      the newest conversations
 *     mini-pim read uid                a message, marked read
 *     mini-pim reply [-all] uid        the reply to edit, then send
 *     mini-pim forward uid             the forward to edit, then send
 *     mini-pim archive uid...          out of the Inbox, kept
 *     mini-pim snooze uid words        out of it until a day, back then
 *     mini-pim contact uid             its sender made a contact
 *     mini-pim people                  the address book
 *     mini-pim event words             an event (Capture), import file.ics
 *     mini-pim today                   the day: events, tasks, snoozed
 *     mini-pim register, balance       the money (Books), import file.qif
 *     mini-pim remind                  what is due said as its minute comes
 *     mini-pim sync                    Google's calendars (Calendars), the mail
 *     mini-pim budget, assign          the envelopes (Envelopes)
 *
 * By default to Gmail (smtp.gmail.com:465 to send, imap.gmail.com:993
 * to read, TLS from the first byte), as -u, the whole address, with an
 * app password (plan_mail.md: Google's one exception to OAuth), read
 * from the store's file password if the author made one (mode 600,
 * Mail_sync.saved_password), else from the first line of standard
 * input; never written by mini-pim.
 * -s host:port and -plain (no TLS): mini-maild on this machine.
 *
 * send: to whom the message's To:, Cc: and Bcc: say (Smtp.envelope),
 * from its From:; each message's outcome a line. reply and forward
 * print a draft (Mail_compose: Re:, the thread's ids, the text quoted;
 * Fwd:), mutt's way: kept in a file, edited, then sent by send, which
 * sends a file with Attach: (files) or Forward: (the attachments of
 * the message forwarded, from the cache) as a draft, -u its From:. list: a line a
 * conversation (Gmail's X-GM-THRID), the newest first: its newest
 * message's UID, "*" if any of it is unread, the date, who sent it, how
 * many messages, the subject. -q: Gmail's search syntax, done by Gmail
 * (X-GM-RAW). read: the headers to read and the text (Mail_text);
 * archive: Gmail's gesture, the \Inbox label taken off.
 *
 * What list and read fetch is kept in mini-pim's store (Items.mli): a
 * message's item, its headers and labels, written by each list; its
 * bytes in the cache once read. -offline: list and read from the store
 * alone, what the last list and the reads kept, no server. *)

type caps =
  < Cap.network
  ; Cap.open_in
  ; Cap.open_out
  ; Cap.readdir
  ; Cap.env
  ; Cap.stdin
  ; Cap.stdout
  ; Cap.stderr
  ; Cap.fork
  ; Cap.exec
  ; Cap.wait
  ; Cap.clock >

let usage =
  "usage: mini-pim [-s host:port] [-plain] [-u user] command\n\
  \  send file                         a message sent\n\
  \  list [-n 20] [-q search] [-m mailbox]\n\
  \                                    the newest conversations\n\
  \  read uid                          a message, marked read\n\
  \  fetch [-m mailbox]                the texts of what list kept, for offline\n\
  \  reply [-all] uid, forward uid     a draft to edit, then send\n\
  \  archive uid...                    out of the Inbox\n\
  \  star uid..., unstar uid...        Gmail's star; -m '[Gmail]/Starred' list\n\
  \  snooze uid words                  out of it until a day: monday, in 3 days\n\
  \  search query                      the store's items: from:alice is:task\n\
  \                                    label:travel before:2026-12-01 -word\n\
  \  show id                           an item, its links both ways\n\
  \  contact uid, people               the sender a contact; the address book\n\
  \  add id [name=value...]            an item (task:pay-rent due=2026-11-05)\n\
  \  set id name=value...              its fields (name= takes one away)\n\
  \  event words                       an event: lunch with alice tue 12:30\n\
  \  import file.ics, import file.qif  an iCalendar file's events; a bank's\n\
  \                                    lines, those not there yet (-a account)\n\
  \  register [-a account], balance    the money: a register; every account\n\
  \  today                             the day's events, tasks late and due\n\
  \  sync                              the calendars of ~/.ix-pim/calendars\n\
  \                                    fetched; with -u the Inbox too\n\
  \  import file.vcf                   contacts (Google Contacts' export)\n\
  \  budget, assign Groceries 400      the envelopes; money to one\n\
  \  remind [-every 5]                 each reminder as its minute comes, and\n\
  \                                    with -u new mail from people\n\
  \  -s      the server (smtp.gmail.com:465 to send, imap.gmail.com:993 else)\n\
  \  -plain  no TLS (mini-maild, on this machine)\n\
  \  -offline  list and read what the store has, no server\n\
  \  -v, -debug  what it reads, writes and fetches, on standard error\n\
  \  -u      the account: log in as that user, the password the store's\n\
  \          file (~/.ix-pim/password, mode 600) or the first line of stdin;\n\
  \          without -u, the store's file user (~/.ix-pim/user)\n\
  with no command, the window: mini-pim user=... [server=host:port]\n\
  \                             [smtp=host:port] [plain]"

type options = {
  server : (string * int) option;
  plain : bool;
  user : string option;
  count : int;
  query : string option;
  mailbox : string;
  offline : bool;
  all : bool; (* reply to all *)
  today : Civil.date; (* -today, for the tests: else the clock's *)
  account : string; (* -a, the money's: Assets:Checking *)
  at : int option; (* -at 12:20, remind's one minute, for the tests *)
  every : int; (* -every, remind's minutes between two looks at the mail *)
  args : string list; (* the command and its arguments *)
}

let rec options (o : options) (args : string list) : options option =
  match args with
  | [] -> if o.args = [] then None else Some { o with args = List.rev o.args }
  | "-s" :: hp :: rest -> (
      match String.rindex_opt hp ':' with
      | Some i -> (
          let port = String.sub hp (i + 1) (String.length hp - i - 1) in
          match int_of_string_opt port with
          | Some port ->
              options { o with server = Some (String.sub hp 0 i, port) } rest
          | None -> None)
      | None -> None)
  | "-plain" :: rest -> options { o with plain = true } rest
  (* (every ix program's: docs/man/1/common.md) *)
  | "-v" :: rest -> Logs.set_level (Some Logs.Info); options o rest
  | "-debug" :: rest -> Logs.set_level (Some Logs.Debug); options o rest
  | "-quiet" :: rest -> Logs.set_level None; options o rest
  | "-u" :: u :: rest -> options { o with user = Some u } rest
  | "-n" :: n :: rest -> (
      match int_of_string_opt n with
      | Some n -> options { o with count = n } rest
      | None -> None)
  | "-q" :: q :: rest -> options { o with query = Some q } rest
  | "-m" :: m :: rest -> options { o with mailbox = m } rest
  | "-offline" :: rest -> options { o with offline = true } rest
  | "-all" :: rest -> options { o with all = true } rest
  | "-a" :: a :: rest -> options { o with account = a } rest
  | "-at" :: t :: rest -> (
      match Events.minutes t with
      | Some m -> options { o with at = Some m } rest
      | None -> None)
  | "-every" :: n :: rest -> (
      match int_of_string_opt n with
      | Some n when n > 0 -> options { o with every = n } rest
      | _ -> None)
  | "-today" :: d :: rest -> (
      match Search.date d with
      | Some today -> options { o with today } rest
      | None -> None)
  (* (a search's words as they are: -is:message is a word, no flag; an
   * assignment's, -50 an amount) *)
  | "search" :: (_ :: _ as words) when o.args = [] ->
      Some { o with args = "search" :: words }
  | "assign" :: (_ :: _ as words) when o.args = [] ->
      Some { o with args = "assign" :: words }
  | flag :: _ when String.length flag > 1 && flag.[0] = '-' -> None
  | a :: rest -> options { o with args = a :: o.args } rest

let fail = Pim_store.fail

(* the store's password file (Mail_sync.saved_password), else the first
 * line of standard input *)
let password (caps : < Cap.env ; Cap.open_in ; Cap.stdin ; .. >) :
    (string, string) result =
  match Mail_sync.saved_password caps with
  | Error e -> Error e
  | Ok (Some p) -> Ok p
  | Ok None -> (
      match In_channel.input_line (Console.stdin caps) with
      | Some p -> Ok (String.trim p)
      | None -> Error "no password: ~/.ix-pim/password, or standard input")

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Sending *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let server (o : options) (default : Mail_sync.server) : Mail_sync.server =
  match o.server with
  | Some (host, port) -> { Mail_sync.host; port; plain = o.plain }
  | None -> { default with plain = o.plain }

(* a message as written; or a draft (reply, forward: what has attach:
 * or forward:), made the message then *)
let send (caps : < caps ; .. >) (o : options) (file : string) : Exit.t =
  let mail = Mail.parse (FS.read caps (Fpath.v file)) in
  let s = server o Mail_sync.gmail_smtp in
  let draft = Mail.get mail "attach" <> None || Mail.get mail "forward" <> None in
  let auth =
    match o.user with
    | None -> Ok None
    | Some u -> Result.map (fun p -> Some (u, p)) (password caps)
  in
  match (auth, o.user) with
  | Error why, _ -> fail caps why
  | Ok (Some (user, password)), Some _ when draft -> (
      let store = Items.at (Items.place caps) in
      match
        Mail_sync.send_draft caps store s ~user ~password
          (Mail_compose.of_item mail)
      with
      | Ok said -> Console.print caps (said ^ "\n"); Exit.OK
      | Error why -> fail caps why)
  | Ok _, _ when draft -> fail caps "-u: a draft is sent as the user"
  | Ok auth, _ -> (
      (* (a reply's file has no From: yet: the user's) *)
      let mail =
        match (Mail.get mail "from", o.user) with
        | None, Some u -> Mail.set "From" u mail
        | _ -> mail
      in
      match Mail_sync.send caps s ~auth (Mail_compose.complete mail) with
      | Error why -> fail caps why
      | Ok outcomes ->
          List.iter
            (fun o -> Console.print caps (Mail_sync.said o ^ "\n"))
            outcomes;
          if List.for_all (function Smtp.Sent _ -> true | _ -> false) outcomes
          then Exit.OK
          else Exit.Err "refused")

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Reading *)

(* the store, and the account (-u): the online commands' and the
 * offline ones'; then [online] in a session or [offline] *)
let reading (caps : < caps ; .. >) (o : options) ~(wake : bool)
    ~(online : Items.t -> string -> Imap.t -> (unit, string) result)
    ~(offline : Items.t -> string -> (unit, string) result) : Exit.t =
  let store = Items.at (Items.place caps) in
  let server = server o Mail_sync.gmail in
  match o.user with
  | None -> fail caps "-u: the user (the account)"
  | Some user -> (
      let r =
        if o.offline then offline store user
        else
          match password caps with
          | Error e -> Error e
          | Ok password -> (
              (* (the snoozed whose day has come back first: Mail_sync) *)
              let woken =
                if wake then
                  Mail_sync.wake caps store server ~user ~password
                    ~today:o.today
                else Ok 0
              in
              match woken with
              | Error e -> Error e
              | Ok _ ->
                  Mail_sync.session caps server ~user ~password
                    ~mailbox:o.mailbox (online store user))
      in
      match r with Ok () -> Exit.OK | Error e -> fail caps e)

(* a line a conversation *)
let show (caps : < Cap.stdout ; .. >) (l : Imap.summary list) : unit =
  List.iter
    (fun (c : Imap.summary list) ->
      let s = List.hd c in
      let many =
        if List.length c > 1 then Printf.sprintf " (%d)" (List.length c) else ""
      in
      Console.print caps
        (Printf.sprintf "%5d %s %-10s %-20s %s\n" s.uid
           (if Conversations.unread c then "*" else " ")
           (Conversations.day s.headers)
           (Conversations.who s.headers ^ many)
           (Conversations.header s.headers "subject")))
    (Conversations.group l)

let list (caps : < caps ; .. >) (o : options) : Exit.t =
  reading caps o ~wake:(o.mailbox = "INBOX")
    ~online:(fun store account t ->
      match
        Mail_sync.list caps store t ~account ~mailbox:o.mailbox ~query:o.query
          o.count
      with
      | Error e -> Error e
      | Ok l -> show caps l; Ok ())
    ~offline:(fun store account ->
      if o.query <> None then Error "-q: a search is the server's"
      else
        let items = Items.all caps store in
        show caps
          (Mail_sync.newest o.count
             (Mail_item.listed items ~account ~mailbox:o.mailbox));
        Ok ())

let print (caps : < Cap.stdout ; .. >) (text : string) : unit =
  let m = Mail.parse text in
  List.iter
    (fun name ->
      let v = Conversations.header m name in
      if v <> "" then
        Console.print caps (String.capitalize_ascii name ^ ": " ^ v ^ "\n"))
    [ "from"; "to"; "cc"; "date"; "subject" ];
  let t = Mail_text.text m in
  Console.print caps
    ("\n" ^ t ^ if String.ends_with ~suffix:"\n" t then "" else "\n")

(* [f] of a message's text and its key in the cache: from the cache
 * when it is there, from the server and into the cache else; marked
 * read on the server and in its item *)
let fetch (caps : < caps ; .. >) (o : options) (uid : int)
    (f : string -> Items.t -> string -> string -> unit) : Exit.t =
  let mailbox = o.mailbox in
  let key store account =
    match Mail_sync.item_of caps store ~account ~mailbox uid with
    | Some item -> Mail_item.key item
    | None -> ""
  in
  reading caps o ~wake:false
    ~online:(fun store account t ->
      match Mail_sync.message caps store t ~account ~mailbox uid with
      | Error e -> Error e
      | Ok text -> f text store account (key store account); Ok ())
    ~offline:(fun store account ->
      match Mail_sync.item_of caps store ~account ~mailbox uid with
      | None -> Error (Printf.sprintf "no message %d in %s here" uid mailbox)
      | Some item -> (
          let key = Mail_item.key item in
          match Items.cached caps store key with
          | Some text -> f text store account key; Ok ()
          | None -> Error (Printf.sprintf "message %d not read yet" uid)))

let read (caps : < caps ; .. >) (o : options) (uid : int) : Exit.t =
  fetch caps o uid (fun text _ _ _ -> print caps text)

(* reply, forward: the draft as a file's text, to edit and send *)
let draft (caps : < caps ; .. >) (o : options) (uid : int) ~(forward : bool) :
    Exit.t =
  fetch caps o uid (fun text _ account key ->
      let m = Mail.parse text in
      let d =
        if forward then Mail_compose.forward ~id:"" ~key m (Mail_text.text m)
        else Mail_compose.reply ~id:"" ~all:o.all ~me:account m (Mail_text.text m)
      in
      let item = Mail_compose.to_item d in
      (* (the item's id: and stamp: are the store's, not the file's) *)
      let fields =
        List.filter
          (fun (f : Mail.field) -> f.name <> "id" && f.name <> "stamp")
          item.fields
      in
      let fields =
        List.map
          (fun (f : Mail.field) ->
            (* in-reply-to is In-Reply-To *)
            let words = String.split_on_char '-' f.name in
            { f with
              name = String.concat "-" (List.map String.capitalize_ascii words) })
          fields
      in
      Console.print caps (Mail.to_string { item with fields }))

(* archive: Gmail's gesture, on the server and in the items *)
let archive (caps : < caps ; .. >) (o : options) (uids : int list) : Exit.t =
  reading caps o ~wake:false
    ~online:(fun store account t ->
      Mail_sync.archive caps store t ~account ~mailbox:o.mailbox uids)
    ~offline:(fun _ _ -> Error "archive: the server's, not -offline")

(* fetch: the texts of the messages listed in the mailbox (-m), those
 * not in the cache yet, to read them offline (Mail_sync.prefetch) *)
let fetch (caps : < caps ; .. >) (o : options) : Exit.t =
  reading caps o ~wake:false
    ~online:(fun store account t ->
      match
        Mail_sync.prefetch caps store t ~account ~mailbox:o.mailbox
          ~said:(fun d n ->
            Console.print caps (Printf.sprintf "%d of %d fetched\n" d n))
      with
      | Ok 0 ->
          Console.print caps "nothing to fetch: all in the store\n";
          Ok ()
      | Ok _ -> Ok ()
      | Error e -> Error e)
    ~offline:(fun _ _ -> Error "fetch: the server's, not -offline")

(* star, unstar: Gmail's star (\Flagged), on the server and the items *)
let star (caps : < caps ; .. >) (o : options) (uids : int list) ~(on : bool) :
    Exit.t =
  reading caps o ~wake:false
    ~online:(fun store account t ->
      Mail_sync.star caps store t ~account ~mailbox:o.mailbox uids ~on)
    ~offline:(fun _ _ -> Error "star: the server's, not -offline")

(* contact: the sender of a message listed made a contact, BBDB's
 * way *)
let contact (caps : < caps ; .. >) (o : options) (uid : int) : Exit.t =
  let store = Items.at (Items.place caps) in
  match o.user with
  | None -> fail caps "-u: the user (the account)"
  | Some account -> (
      match
        Option.bind
          (Mail_sync.item_of caps store ~account ~mailbox:o.mailbox uid)
          People.of_sender
      with
      | None -> fail caps (Printf.sprintf "no sender of %d here" uid)
      | Some c -> (
          match Items.find caps store (Item.id c) with
          | Some _ -> fail caps (Item.id c ^ ": already a contact")
          | None ->
              Items.save caps store c;
              Console.print caps (Item.id c ^ "\n");
              Exit.OK))

(* snooze: the uid's conversation archived until the day the words say,
 * back in the Inbox that day (Mail_sync) *)
let snooze (caps : < caps ; .. >) (o : options) (uid : int) (words : string) :
    Exit.t =
  match When.parse ~today:o.today words with
  | None -> fail caps (words ^ ": not a day (monday, in 3 days, nov 5)")
  | Some until ->
      reading caps o ~wake:false
        ~online:(fun store account t ->
          let listed =
            Mail_item.listed (Items.all caps store) ~account ~mailbox:o.mailbox
          in
          let conversation =
            match
              List.find_opt
                (List.exists (fun (s : Imap.summary) -> s.uid = uid))
                (Conversations.group listed)
            with
            | Some c -> List.map (fun (s : Imap.summary) -> s.uid) c
            | None -> [ uid ]
          in
          match
            Mail_sync.snooze caps store t ~account ~mailbox:o.mailbox
              conversation ~until
          with
          | Error e -> Error e
          | Ok () ->
              Console.print caps ("until " ^ Mail_sync.day until ^ "\n");
              Ok ())
        ~offline:(fun _ _ -> Error "snooze: the server's, not -offline")

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Reminders *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* a notification too, on Linux: notify-send's, if it is there *)
let notify (caps : < caps ; .. >) (text : string) : unit =
  let path = try CapSys.getenv caps "PATH" with Not_found -> "" in
  if
    List.exists
      (fun d -> d <> "" && Sys.file_exists (Filename.concat d "notify-send"))
      (String.split_on_char ':' path)
  then
    let pid =
      Procs.spawn caps "notify-send" [ "mini-pim"; text ] ~stdin:Unix.stdin
        ~stdout:Unix.stdout
    in
    ignore (Procs.waitpid caps pid)

(* the reminders of the minutes [from, upto) of [day], each a line *)
let say_due (caps : < caps ; .. >) (day : Civil.date) ~(from : int)
    ~(upto : int) ~(bell : bool) : unit =
  let items = Items.all caps (Items.at (Items.place caps)) in
  List.iter
    (fun (m, i) ->
      let text = Remind.say i in
      Console.print caps
        (Printf.sprintf "%s%-6s %s\n" (if bell then "\007" else "")
           (Events.clock (((m mod 1440) + 1440) mod 1440))
           text);
      if bell then notify caps text)
    (Remind.due items day ~from ~upto)

(* the Inbox fetched (the snoozed back first), and the conversations
 * from people not read that were not there before said *)
let new_mail (caps : < caps ; .. >) (o : options) ~(user : string)
    ~(password : string) (today : Civil.date) : unit =
  let store = Items.at (Items.place caps) in
  let server = server o Mail_sync.gmail in
  let from_people () =
    List.filter
      (fun (k, _) -> match k with Today.From _ -> true | _ -> false)
      (Today.lines (Items.all caps store) ~account:user today)
  in
  let before = from_people () in
  let fetched =
    match Mail_sync.wake caps store server ~user ~password ~today with
    | Error e -> Error e
    | Ok _ ->
        Mail_sync.session caps server ~user ~password ~mailbox:"INBOX"
          (fun t ->
            match
              Mail_sync.list caps store t ~account:user ~mailbox:"INBOX"
                ~query:None o.count
            with
            | Error e -> Error e
            | Ok _ -> Ok ())
  in
  match fetched with
  | Error e -> Console.eprint caps ("mail: " ^ e ^ "\n")
  | Ok () ->
      List.iter
        (fun (k, what) ->
          match (k : Today.kind) with
          | From who when not (List.mem (k, what) before) ->
              Console.print caps (Printf.sprintf "\007mail   %s: %s\n" who what);
              notify caps (who ^ ": " ^ what)
          | _ -> ())
        (from_people ())

(* sync: Google's side read (plan_pim.md): each calendar of the store's
 * calendars file fetched (Calendars), then with -u the Inbox, what is
 * new from people said *)
let sync (caps : < caps ; .. >) (o : options) : Exit.t =
  let calendars =
    match Calendars.sources caps with
    | Error e -> Error e
    | Ok l ->
        List.iter
          (fun (s : Calendars.source) ->
            match Calendars.fetch caps s with
            | Ok (saved, removed) ->
                Console.print caps
                  (Printf.sprintf "%-10s %d saved, %d removed\n" s.name saved
                     removed)
            | Error e -> Console.eprint caps (e ^ "\n"))
          l;
        Ok ()
  in
  match (calendars, o.user) with
  | Error e, _ -> fail caps e
  | Ok (), None -> Exit.OK
  | Ok (), Some user -> (
      match password caps with
      | Error e -> fail caps e
      | Ok password ->
          new_mail caps o ~user ~password o.today;
          Exit.OK)

(* remind: plan_pim.md's idea 6, a process of the suite's that says each
 * reminder as its minute comes, the window open or not; every few
 * minutes the calendars fetched, and with -u the mail, what is new
 * from people said. -at: the minute -today, said once, for the
 * tests *)
let remind (caps : < caps ; .. >) (o : options) : Exit.t =
  match o.at with
  | Some m ->
      say_due caps o.today ~from:m ~upto:(m + 1) ~bell:false;
      Exit.OK
  | None -> (
      let password =
        match o.user with
        | None -> Ok None
        | Some _ when o.offline -> Ok None
        | Some _ -> (
            match password caps with Ok p -> Ok (Some p) | Error e -> Error e)
      in
      match password with
      | Error e -> fail caps e
      | Ok password ->
          let zone = Zone.local caps in
          let rec loop (day, minute) (looked : float) =
            let now = CapUnix.gettimeofday caps () in
            let day', minute' = Zone.clock zone now in
            (* the minutes since the last look, a new day's from its
             * first *)
            let from = if day' = day then minute + 1 else 0 in
            say_due caps day' ~from ~upto:(minute' + 1) ~bell:true;
            let looked =
              if now -. looked < float_of_int (o.every * 60) then looked
              else begin
                (* the calendars (Calendars), quietly, then the mail *)
                (match Calendars.sources caps with
                | Ok l ->
                    List.iter
                      (fun s ->
                        match Calendars.fetch caps s with
                        | Ok _ -> ()
                        | Error e -> Console.eprint caps (e ^ "\n"))
                      l
                | Error e -> Console.eprint caps (e ^ "\n"));
                (match (o.user, password) with
                | Some user, Some password ->
                    new_mail caps o ~user ~password day'
                | _ -> ());
                now
              end
            in
            (* (to just after the next minute's start) *)
            CapUnix.sleepf caps (60. -. Float.rem now 60. +. 0.1);
            loop (day', minute') looked
          in
          let now = CapUnix.gettimeofday caps () in
          let day, minute = Zone.clock zone now in
          Console.print caps
            (Printf.sprintf "mini-pim remind: %s %s\n" (Mail_sync.day day)
               (Events.clock minute));
          loop (day, minute - 1) 0.)

let main (caps : < caps ; .. >) (argv : string array) : Exit.t =
  let default =
    {
      server = None;
      plain = false;
      user = None;
      count = 20;
      query = None;
      mailbox = "INBOX";
      offline = false;
      all = false;
      today = When.today caps;
      account = "Assets:Checking";
      at = None;
      every = 5;
      args = [];
    }
  in
  let uids l = List.filter_map int_of_string_opt l in
  let assignments = Pim_store.assignments in
  let parsed = options default (List.tl (Array.to_list argv)) in
  (* (no -u: the store's file user) *)
  let parsed =
    match parsed with
    | Some ({ user = None; _ } as o) -> Some { o with user = Items.user caps }
    | p -> p
  in
  (* (after the options: -v is one) *)
  Logs.info (fun m -> m "store: %s" (Items.place caps));
  match parsed with
  | Some ({ args = [ "send"; file ]; _ } as o) -> send caps o file
  | Some ({ args = [ "list" ]; _ } as o) -> list caps o
  | Some ({ args = [ "read"; uid ]; _ } as o) when uids [ uid ] <> [] ->
      read caps o (int_of_string uid)
  | Some ({ args = [ "reply"; uid ]; _ } as o) when uids [ uid ] <> [] ->
      draft caps o (int_of_string uid) ~forward:false
  | Some ({ args = [ "forward"; uid ]; _ } as o) when uids [ uid ] <> [] ->
      draft caps o (int_of_string uid) ~forward:true
  | Some ({ args = "snooze" :: uid :: (_ :: _ as words); _ } as o)
    when uids [ uid ] <> [] ->
      snooze caps o (int_of_string uid) (String.concat " " words)
  | Some { args = "search" :: (_ :: _ as words); _ } ->
      Pim_store.search caps (String.concat " " words)
  | Some { args = [ "show"; id ]; _ } -> Pim_store.show caps id
  | Some ({ args = [ "contact"; uid ]; _ } as o) when uids [ uid ] <> [] ->
      contact caps o (int_of_string uid)
  | Some { args = [ "people" ]; _ } -> Pim_store.people caps
  | Some ({ args = "event" :: (_ :: _ as words); _ } as o) ->
      Pim_store.event caps o.today (String.concat " " words)
  | Some ({ args = [ "import"; file ]; _ } as o) ->
      Pim_store.import caps o.account file
  | Some ({ args = [ "register" ]; _ } as o) ->
      Pim_store.register caps o.account
  | Some { args = [ "balance" ]; _ } -> Pim_store.balance caps
  | Some ({ args = [ "remind" ]; _ } as o) -> remind caps o
  | Some ({ args = [ "sync" ]; _ } as o) -> sync caps o
  | Some { args = [ "budget" ]; _ } -> Pim_store.budget caps
  | Some ({ args = [ "fetch" ]; _ } as o) -> fetch caps o
  | Some ({ args = "assign" :: (_ :: _ :: _ as words); _ } as o) ->
      Pim_store.assign caps o.today words
  | Some ({ args = [ "today" ]; _ } as o) ->
      let account = match o.user with Some u -> u | None -> "" in
      Pim_store.today caps ~account o.today
  | Some ({ args = "add" :: id :: l; _ } as o) when assignments l <> None -> (
      match Pim_store.days o.today (Option.get (assignments l)) with
      | Ok fields -> Pim_store.add caps id fields
      | Error e -> fail caps e)
  | Some ({ args = "set" :: id :: (_ :: _ as l); _ } as o)
    when assignments l <> None -> (
      match Pim_store.days o.today (Option.get (assignments l)) with
      | Ok fields -> Pim_store.set caps id fields
      | Error e -> fail caps e)
  | Some ({ args = "archive" :: (_ :: _ as l); _ } as o)
    when List.length (uids l) = List.length l ->
      archive caps o (uids l)
  | Some ({ args = ("star" | "unstar") :: (_ :: _ as l); _ } as o)
    when List.length (uids l) = List.length l ->
      star caps o (uids l) ~on:(List.hd o.args = "star")
  | _ ->
      Console.eprint caps (usage ^ "\n");
      Exit.Err "usage"

(* the window (Pim_window, the suite), its screen the window's; the
 * platform's words on the command line, and the window's flags *)
let window (caps : < caps ; Cap.argv ; .. >) : Exit.t =
  let flags = ("window", "") :: Playground_platform.flags caps in
  (* (no user=: the store's file user) *)
  let flags =
    match (List.assoc_opt "user" flags, Items.user caps) with
    | None, Some u -> ("user", u) :: flags
    | _ -> flags
  in
  Logs.info (fun m -> m "store: %s" (Items.place caps));
  let wcaps = (caps :> Pim_window.caps) in
  Playground_platform.run_app caps flags
    (Playground.game Pim_window.view (Pim_window.update wcaps)
       (Pim_window.initial wcaps flags));
  Exit.OK

let commands =
  [ "send"; "list"; "read"; "reply"; "forward"; "archive"; "snooze"; "search";
    "show"; "add"; "set"; "contact"; "people"; "event"; "import"; "today";
    "register"; "balance"; "remind"; "sync"; "budget"; "assign"; "star";
    "unstar"; "fetch" ]

let () =
  Cap.main (fun caps ->
      Exit.exit caps
        (Exit.catch (fun () ->
             let argv = CapSys.argv caps in
             (* the traces' reporter, before the flags: -v, -debug *)
             Logging.setup caps ~name:"mini-pim";
             (* a command: the command line; else the window *)
             if List.exists (fun a -> List.mem a commands) (Array.to_list argv)
             then main caps argv
             else window caps)))

(* Claude Code

(* See Pim_store.mli *)

type caps =
  < Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out ; Cap.readdir ; Cap.env ; Cap.stdout
  ; Cap.stderr ; Cap.clock >

let fail (caps : < Cap.stderr ; .. >) (why : string) : Exit.t =
  Console.eprint caps (why ^ "\n");
  Exit.Err why

let store (caps : < Cap.env ; .. >) : Items.t = Items.at (Items.place caps)

let line (caps : < Cap.stdout ; .. >) (prefix : string) (item : Item.t) :
    unit =
  Console.print caps
    (Printf.sprintf "%s%-24s %-16s %s\n" prefix (Item.id item)
       (String.concat " " (Item.stamps item))
       (Search.title item))

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Every item *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let search (caps : < caps ; .. >) (query : string) : Exit.t =
  List.iter (line caps "") (Search.search query (Items.all caps (store caps)));
  Exit.OK

(* show: the item's file, and its links both ways *)
let show (caps : < caps ; .. >) (id : string) : Exit.t =
  match Items.find caps (store caps) id with
  | None -> fail caps (id ^ ": no such item")
  | Some item ->
      let items = Items.all caps (store caps) in
      Console.print caps (String.trim (Item.to_string item) ^ "\n");
      let say heading l =
        if l <> [] then begin
          Console.print caps ("\n" ^ heading ^ "\n");
          List.iter
            (fun (field, i) ->
              line caps (if field = "" then "  " else "  " ^ field ^ ": ") i)
            l
        end
      in
      (* (a person's page: the mail with them first, People) *)
      if Item.has_stamp item "contact" then
        say "mail:" (List.map (fun m -> ("", m)) (People.with_ items item));
      say "links:" (Links.links items item);
      say "linked from:" (Links.backlinks items item);
      Exit.OK

let people (caps : < caps ; .. >) : Exit.t =
  List.iter (line caps "") (People.contacts (Items.all caps (store caps)));
  Exit.OK

let assignments (l : string list) : (string * string) list option =
  let one a =
    match String.index_opt a '=' with
    | Some i when i > 0 ->
        Some (String.sub a 0 i, String.sub a (i + 1) (String.length a - i - 1))
    | _ -> None
  in
  let l' = List.filter_map one l in
  if List.length l' = List.length l then Some l' else None

(* due= and until= as words: "friday" is 2026-10-30 (When) *)
let days (today : Civil.date) (fields : (string * string) list) :
    ((string * string) list, string) result =
  List.fold_right
    (fun (name, v) acc ->
      match acc with
      | Error e -> Error e
      | Ok l ->
          if (name <> "due" && name <> "until") || v = "" then Ok ((name, v) :: l)
          else (
            match When.parse ~today v with
            | Some d -> Ok ((name, Mail_sync.day d) :: l)
            | None -> Error (v ^ ": not a day (friday, in 3 days, nov 5)")))
    fields (Ok [])

let add (caps : < caps ; .. >) (id : string) (fields : (string * string) list)
    : Exit.t =
  match (Items.find caps (store caps) id, String.index_opt id ':') with
  | Some _, _ -> fail caps (id ^ ": already an item")
  | None, None -> fail caps (id ^ ": an id is kind:name (task:pay-rent)")
  | None, Some i ->
      let stamps =
        match List.assoc_opt "stamp" fields with
        | Some s -> String.split_on_char ' ' s
        | None -> [ String.sub id 0 i ]
      in
      let fields = List.filter (fun (n, _) -> n <> "stamp") fields in
      Items.save caps (store caps) (Item.make ~id ~stamps fields "");
      Exit.OK

let set (caps : < caps ; .. >) (id : string) (fields : (string * string) list)
    : Exit.t =
  match Items.find caps (store caps) id with
  | None -> fail caps (id ^ ": no such item")
  | Some _ when List.mem_assoc "id" fields -> fail caps "id: an item's name"
  | Some item ->
      let item =
        List.fold_left
          (fun item (name, v) ->
            if v = "" then Mail.remove name item else Mail.set name v item)
          item fields
      in
      Items.save caps (store caps) item;
      (* (a repeating task done: its next one, Today.again) *)
      (match List.assoc_opt "done" fields with
      | Some d when d <> "" -> (
          match Today.again item with
          | Some next ->
              Items.save caps (store caps) next;
              line caps "next: " next
          | None -> ())
      | _ -> ());
      Exit.OK

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The calendar and the day *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let event (caps : < caps ; .. >) (today : Civil.date) (words : string) :
    Exit.t =
  let people = People.contacts (Items.all caps (store caps)) in
  let e = Capture.event ~today ~people words in
  let id = Printf.sprintf "event:%.0f" (CapUnix.gettimeofday caps () *. 1e6) in
  let item = Capture.to_item ~id e in
  Items.save caps (store caps) item;
  Console.print caps (String.trim (Item.to_string item) ^ "\n");
  Exit.OK

let import (caps : < caps ; .. >) (account : string) (file : string) : Exit.t
    =
  let text = FS.read caps (Fpath.v file) in
  if Filename.check_suffix (String.lowercase_ascii file) ".vcf" then begin
    (* a person already there keeps their name, and gets the addresses,
     * phones and birthday they did not have *)
    List.iter
      (fun (c : Item.t) ->
        let item =
          match Items.find caps (store caps) (Item.id c) with
          | None -> c
          | Some old ->
              List.fold_left
                (fun (i : Item.t) (n, v) ->
                  if n = "name" || List.mem v (Mail.get_all i n) then i
                  else if n = "email" || n = "phone" then
                    { i with fields = i.fields @ [ { name = n; raw = " " ^ v } ] }
                  else if Item.field i n = "" then Mail.set n v i
                  else i)
                old
                (List.map
                   (fun (f : Mail.field) -> (f.name, String.trim f.raw))
                   c.fields)
        in
        Items.save caps (store caps) item;
        line caps "" item)
      (List.filter_map Vcard.to_item (Vcard.of_string text));
    Exit.OK
  end
  else if Filename.check_suffix (String.lowercase_ascii file) ".qif" then
    match Qif.read text with
    | Error e -> fail caps (file ^ ": " ^ e)
    | Ok txns ->
        let register =
          List.map snd (Books.register (Items.all caps (store caps)) account)
        in
        List.iteri
          (fun k (t : Ledger.txn) ->
            let id = Printf.sprintf "money:%.0f.%d" (CapUnix.gettimeofday caps ()) k in
            let item = Books.of_txn ~id ~account t in
            Items.save caps (store caps) item;
            line caps "" item)
          (Books.fresh register txns);
        Exit.OK
  else begin
    let events = Events.of_ics (Zone.local caps) ~message:"" text in
    List.iter (Items.save caps (store caps)) events;
    List.iter (line caps "") events;
    Exit.OK
  end

let today (caps : < caps ; .. >) ~(account : string) (today : Civil.date) :
    Exit.t =
  let items = Items.all caps (store caps) in
  Console.print caps (Mail_sync.day today ^ "\n");
  List.iter
    (fun (k, what) ->
      let label =
        match (k : Today.kind) with
        | At (Some m) -> Events.clock m
        | At None -> "all day"
        | Late -> "late"
        | Due -> "due"
        | Back -> "back"
        | From who -> who
      in
      Console.print caps (Printf.sprintf "%-10s %s\n" label what))
    (Today.lines items ~account today);
  match Today.page items today with
  | [] -> Exit.OK
  | l ->
      Console.print caps "\ntoday's page\n";
      List.iter (fun l -> Console.print caps ("  " ^ l ^ "\n")) l;
      Exit.OK

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The money *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let register (caps : < caps ; .. >) (account : string) : Exit.t =
  let reg = Books.register (Items.all caps (store caps)) account in
  List.iter2
    (fun (_, (t : Ledger.txn)) (_, b) ->
      Console.print caps
        (Printf.sprintf "%s %-4s %-18s %-18s %10s %1s %10s\n"
           (Civil.to_string t.date) t.num t.payee t.category
           (Money.to_string t.amount)
           (match t.status with Open -> "" | Cleared -> "*" | Reconciled -> "R")
           (Money.to_string b)))
    reg
    (Ledger.balances (List.map snd reg));
  Exit.OK

let balance (caps : < caps ; .. >) : Exit.t =
  let items = Items.all caps (store caps) in
  List.iter
    (fun a ->
      Console.print caps
        (Printf.sprintf "%12s  %s\n" (Money.to_string (Books.balance items a)) a))
    (Books.accounts items);
  Exit.OK

let budget (caps : < caps ; .. >) : Exit.t =
  let items = Items.all caps (store caps) in
  Console.print caps
    (Printf.sprintf "%-18s %10s\n" "to assign"
       (Money.to_string (Envelopes.to_assign items)));
  List.iter
    (fun (e : Envelopes.envelope) ->
      Console.print caps
        (Printf.sprintf "%-18s %10s %10s %10s\n" (Books.category e.account)
           (Money.to_string e.assigned) (Money.to_string e.spent)
           (Money.to_string e.available)))
    (Envelopes.envelopes items);
  Exit.OK

let assign (caps : < caps ; .. >) (today : Civil.date) (words : string list) :
    Exit.t =
  match List.rev words with
  | amount :: (_ :: _ as name) -> (
      match Money.of_string amount with
      | None -> fail caps (amount ^ ": not an amount")
      | Some c ->
          (* (to the microsecond: assignments typed one after the other) *)
          let id = Printf.sprintf "budget:%.0f" (CapUnix.gettimeofday caps () *. 1e6) in
          let name = String.concat " " (List.rev name) in
          Items.save caps (store caps) (Envelopes.assign ~id today name c);
          Exit.OK)
  | _ -> fail caps "assign: an envelope and an amount (Groceries 400)"

(* Pim_store: mini-pim's commands over the store, from a terminal, those
   that need no mail server (Pim has the mail's, and reads the command
   line): every item, the calendar and the day, the money.

       mini-pim search from:alice is:task      a line an item:
       contact:alice@ix         contact          Alice Martin
       mini-pim show contact:alice@ix          its file, its links
       mini-pim add task:pay-rent due=friday   an item; set its fields
       mini-pim event lunch with alice tue 12:30
       mini-pim import file.ics, file.qif      events; a bank's lines
       mini-pim today                          the day (Home's Today)
       mini-pim register -a Assets:Checking    Quicken's columns
       mini-pim balance                        every account's

   Each command reads the store again (Items.all) and writes an item
   at once; what they print is what the tests (session.sh) compare. *)

type caps =
  < Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out ; Cap.readdir ; Cap.env ; Cap.stdout
  ; Cap.stderr ; Cap.clock >

(* the reason on standard error, and the exit's *)
val fail : < Cap.stderr ; .. > -> string -> Exit.t

(* an item's line: [prefix], its id, its stamps, its title *)
val line : < Cap.stdout ; .. > -> string -> Item.t -> unit

(* the items a query matches (Search) *)
val search : < caps ; .. > -> string -> Exit.t

(* the item's file, then its links both ways; a person's mail first *)
val show : < caps ; .. > -> string -> Exit.t

(* the address book *)
val people : < caps ; .. > -> Exit.t

(* "due=2026-11-05" ...: the names and values, None if one is not *)
val assignments : string list -> (string * string) list option

(* [days today fields]: due= and until= given as words made days *)
val days :
  Civil.date -> (string * string) list -> ((string * string) list, string) result

(* add: an item made, stamped its id's kind unless stamp= says; set: its
 * fields given, an empty value taking one away *)
val add : < caps ; .. > -> string -> (string * string) list -> Exit.t
val set : < caps ; .. > -> string -> (string * string) list -> Exit.t

(* [event caps today words]: a line made an event (Capture) *)
val event : < caps ; .. > -> Civil.date -> string -> Exit.t

(* [import caps account file]: an iCalendar file's events (Events.of_ics),
 * an event already there replaced; a .qif file's lines in the account's
 * register (Books), those already there left out *)
val import : < caps ; .. > -> string -> string -> Exit.t

(* [today caps ~account day]: the day (Today): its events, the tasks
 * late and due, what is back from a snooze, the unread mail of
 * [account] from people; then the day's page *)
val today : < caps ; .. > -> account:string -> Civil.date -> Exit.t

(* register: an account's lines, the balance after each; balance: every
 * account's *)
val register : < caps ; .. > -> string -> Exit.t
val balance : < caps ; .. > -> Exit.t

(* budget: the envelopes (Envelopes), what is to assign first; assign:
 * money to one, "Groceries 400" (a negative amount takes it back) *)
val budget : < caps ; .. > -> Exit.t
val assign : < caps ; .. > -> Civil.date -> string list -> Exit.t

(* See Conversations.mli *)

let group (l : Imap.summary list) : Imap.summary list list =
  let key (s : Imap.summary) =
    if s.thread = "" then string_of_int s.uid else s.thread
  in
  let rec go (acc : (string * Imap.summary list) list) l =
    match l with
    | [] -> acc
    | s :: rest ->
        let k = key s in
        let acc =
          match List.assoc_opt k acc with
          | Some ms -> (k, s :: ms) :: List.remove_assoc k acc
          | None -> (k, [ s ]) :: acc
        in
        go acc rest
  in
  (* (oldest first in: the newest message's conversation ends on top) *)
  List.map snd (go [] l)

let unread (c : Imap.summary list) : bool =
  List.exists (fun (s : Imap.summary) -> not (List.mem "\\Seen" s.flags)) c

let header (m : Mail.t) (name : string) : string =
  match Mail.get m name with Some v -> Mime.decode_words v | None -> ""

let who (m : Mail.t) : string =
  match Mail.address (header m "from") with
  | Some a -> Mail.who a
  | None -> header m "from"

let day (m : Mail.t) : string =
  match Option.bind (Mail.get m "date") Mail.date with
  | Some d -> Printf.sprintf "%04d-%02d-%02d" d.day.year d.day.month d.day.day
  | None -> ""

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Mail_compose.mli *)

type draft = {
  id : string;
  to_ : string;
  cc : string;
  subject : string;
  in_reply_to : string;
  references : string;
  forward : string;
  attach : string;
  text : string;
}

let blank ~(id : string) : draft =
  { id; to_ = ""; cc = ""; subject = ""; in_reply_to = ""; references = "";
    forward = ""; attach = ""; text = "" }

let header (m : Mail.t) (name : string) : string =
  match Mail.get m name with Some v -> Mime.decode_words v | None -> ""

(* "Re: x" once, whatever the case of the Re: there *)
let prefixed (prefix : string) (subject : string) : string =
  let n = String.length prefix in
  if
    String.length subject >= n
    && String.lowercase_ascii (String.sub subject 0 n)
       = String.lowercase_ascii prefix
  then subject
  else prefix ^ subject

let quoted (text : string) : string =
  String.concat "\n"
    (List.map
       (fun l -> if l = "" then ">" else "> " ^ l)
       (String.split_on_char '\n' (String.trim text)))

let same_mailbox (a : Mail.address) (b : Mail.address) : bool =
  String.lowercase_ascii a.mailbox = String.lowercase_ascii b.mailbox

let reply ~(id : string) ~(all : bool) ~(me : string) (m : Mail.t)
    (text : string) : draft =
  let target =
    let r = header m "reply-to" in
    if r <> "" then r else header m "from"
  in
  let targets = Mail.addresses target in
  let others =
    if not all then []
    else
      List.filter
        (fun (a : Mail.address) ->
          String.lowercase_ascii a.mailbox <> String.lowercase_ascii me
          && not (List.exists (same_mailbox a) targets))
        (Mail.addresses (header m "to") @ Mail.addresses (header m "cc"))
  in
  (* (an address once, though in To: and Cc: both) *)
  let others =
    List.fold_left
      (fun acc a -> if List.exists (same_mailbox a) acc then acc else acc @ [ a ])
      [] others
  in
  let msgid = header m "message-id" in
  let references =
    String.trim (String.concat " " [ header m "references"; msgid ])
  in
  {
    (blank ~id) with
    to_ = String.concat ", " (List.map Mail.address_to_string targets);
    cc = String.concat ", " (List.map Mail.address_to_string others);
    subject = prefixed "Re: " (header m "subject");
    in_reply_to = msgid;
    references;
    text =
      Printf.sprintf "\n\nOn %s, %s wrote:\n%s\n" (header m "date")
        (header m "from") (quoted text);
  }

let forward ~(id : string) ~(key : string) (m : Mail.t) (text : string) :
    draft =
  let line name label =
    let v = header m name in
    if v = "" then [] else [ label ^ ": " ^ v ]
  in
  let head =
    List.concat
      [ line "from" "From"; line "date" "Date"; line "subject" "Subject";
        line "to" "To"; line "cc" "Cc" ]
  in
  {
    (blank ~id) with
    subject = prefixed "Fwd: " (header m "subject");
    forward = key;
    text =
      "\n\n---------- Forwarded message ---------\n"
      ^ String.concat "\n" head ^ "\n\n" ^ String.trim text ^ "\n";
  }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* A draft as an item *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let fields (d : draft) : (string * string) list =
  List.filter
    (fun (_, v) -> v <> "")
    [ ("to", d.to_); ("cc", d.cc); ("subject", d.subject);
      ("in-reply-to", d.in_reply_to); ("references", d.references);
      ("forward", d.forward); ("attach", d.attach) ]

let to_item (d : draft) : Item.t =
  Item.make ~id:d.id ~stamps:[ "draft" ] (fields d) d.text

let of_item (t : Item.t) : draft =
  let f = Item.field t in
  { id = Item.id t; to_ = f "to"; cc = f "cc"; subject = f "subject";
    in_reply_to = f "in-reply-to"; references = f "references";
    forward = f "forward"; attach = f "attach"; text = t.body }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The message sent *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let date_string ~(date : float) ~(offset : int) : string =
  let day, time = Clock.local ~offset date in
  (* (whole seconds: Date: has no fraction) *)
  let time = { time with second = Float.of_int (int_of_float time.second) } in
  Mail.date_to_string { day; time; offset }

let new_msgid ~(from : string) (date : float) (n : int) : string =
  let domain =
    match Mail.address from with
    | Some a -> (
        match String.index_opt a.mailbox '@' with
        | Some i -> String.sub a.mailbox (i + 1) (String.length a.mailbox - i - 1)
        | None -> "mini-pim")
    | None -> "mini-pim"
  in
  Printf.sprintf "<%.0f.%d.mini-pim@%s>" date n domain

let message ~(from : string) ~(date : float) ~(offset : int)
    ~(msgid : string) ~(files : (string * string) list) (d : draft) : Mail.t =
  let text = Mime.text_part d.text in
  let content, body =
    match files with
    | [] ->
        ( List.filter_map
            (fun name ->
              match Mail.get text name with
              | Some v -> Some (name, v)
              | None -> None)
            [ "Content-Type"; "Content-Transfer-Encoding" ],
          text.body )
    | _ ->
        Mime.multipart
          ~boundary:("=_mini-pim." ^ msgid)
          (text
          :: List.map
               (fun (name, bytes) -> Mime.attachment ~filename:name bytes)
               files)
  in
  let optional name v = if v = "" then [] else [ (name, v) ] in
  Mail.make
    (List.concat
       [ [ ("From", from); ("To", d.to_) ]; optional "Cc" d.cc;
         [ ("Subject", Mime.encode_words d.subject);
           ("Date", date_string ~date ~offset); ("Message-ID", msgid) ];
         optional "In-Reply-To" d.in_reply_to;
         optional "References" d.references;
         [ ("MIME-Version", "1.0") ]; content ])
    body

let complete (m : Mail.t) : Mail.t =
  if
    Mail.get m "content-type" <> None
    || String.for_all (fun c -> Char.code c < 128) m.body
  then m
  else
    let text = Mime.text_part m.body in
    let m = Mail.set "MIME-Version" "1.0" m in
    let m =
      List.fold_left
        (fun m name ->
          match Mail.get text name with
          | Some v -> Mail.set name v m
          | None -> m)
        m
        [ "Content-Type"; "Content-Transfer-Encoding" ]
    in
    { m with body = text.body }

(* Mail_compose: a message being written (plan_mail.md, stage 7): new,
   a reply, a reply to all, a forward; kept as a draft in the store
   while it is written; made the message SMTP sends.

   A reply, Gmail's and every mailer's since the 1980s:

       To: Carol <carol@ix>               <- Reply-To:, else From:
       Cc: bob@ix                         <- to all: To: and Cc: too,
       Subject: Re: the plan                 less me and the To:
       In-Reply-To: <2@ix>                <- what threads it: the
       References: <1@ix> <2@ix>             conversation's ids
                                             (Mail_thread, X-GM-THRID)
       (the cursor, an empty line)
       On Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:00:00 +0100, Carol <carol@ix> wrote:
       > "Yes", à midi.                    <- the text quoted

   A forward: "Fwd: ", no thread, the message's headers then its text,
   its attachments sent again (taken from the cache when it is sent:
   the draft names the message, not its bytes).

   A draft is an item (Item, plan_pim.md's idea 1) stamped draft, its
   fields the message's own, so the file reads as the message:

       id: draft:1730193600.4
       stamp: draft
       to: Carol <carol@ix>
       subject: Re: the plan
       in-reply-to: <2@ix>
       references: <1@ix> <2@ix>

       See you there.

   The message sent has a Date: and a Message-ID: of the time it is
   sent, MIME-Version:, the text a text part (UTF-8, quoted-printable
   when it is not ASCII), the subject an encoded word when not ASCII;
   with attachments, a multipart/mixed. *)

type draft = {
  id : string; (* the item's id, draft:... *)
  to_ : string;
  cc : string;
  subject : string;
  in_reply_to : string; (* "" for none, as the three below *)
  references : string;
  forward : string; (* the cache's key of the message forwarded *)
  attach : string; (* files to attach, separated by spaces *)
  text : string;
}

(* [blank ~id]: a new message *)
val blank : id:string -> draft

(* [reply ~id ~all ~me headers text]: the reply to the message of
 * [headers] whose text to read is [text]; [me] the account, left out
 * of a reply to all *)
val reply : id:string -> all:bool -> me:string -> Mail.t -> string -> draft

(* [forward ~id ~key headers text]: [key] the message's in the cache *)
val forward : id:string -> key:string -> Mail.t -> string -> draft

(* a draft as an item and back *)
val to_item : draft -> Item.t
val of_item : Item.t -> draft

(* [message ~from ~date ~msgid ~files draft]: the message sent, From:
 * [from], [date] seconds since the epoch at [offset] minutes east,
 * [files] each attachment's name and bytes *)
val message :
  from:string -> date:float -> offset:int -> msgid:string ->
  files:(string * string) list -> draft -> Mail.t

(* a message's file to send, as the author wrote it: when its text is
 * not ASCII and it says nothing of its type, MIME's headers, the text
 * UTF-8 in quoted-printable (its Date: and Message-ID:, when it has
 * none, are the server's: Gmail adds them) *)
val complete : Mail.t -> Mail.t

(* "<1730193600.4.mini-pim@ix>": an id unique to this time and
 * counter, at the sender's domain *)
val new_msgid : from:string -> float -> int -> string

(* Claude Code

(* See Mail_item.mli *)

let id (s : Imap.summary) : string =
  "mail:" ^ if s.msgid <> "" then s.msgid else string_of_int s.uid

(* the headers kept, those Imap.summaries asks *)
let headers =
  [
    "from";
    "to";
    "cc";
    "subject";
    "date";
    "message-id";
    "in-reply-to";
    "references";
  ]

(* "INBOX 12" -> "INBOX"; "[Gmail]/All Mail 345" -> "[Gmail]/All Mail" *)
let in_mailbox (v : string) : string =
  match String.rindex_opt v ' ' with Some i -> String.sub v 0 i | None -> v

let uid_in (item : Item.t) (mailbox : string) : int option =
  List.find_map
    (fun v ->
      let v = String.trim v in
      match String.rindex_opt v ' ' with
      | Some i when String.sub v 0 i = mailbox ->
          int_of_string_opt (String.sub v (i + 1) (String.length v - i - 1))
      | _ -> None)
    (Mail.get_all item "in")

let update ~(account : string) ~(mailbox : string) (s : Imap.summary)
    (old : Item.t option) : Item.t =
  let item =
    match old with
    | Some item -> item
    | None -> Item.make ~id:(id s) ~stamps:[ "message" ] [] ""
  in
  let item =
    if Item.has_stamp item "message" then item
    else
      Mail.set "stamp" (String.concat " " ("message" :: Item.stamps item)) item
  in
  let header name =
    match Mail.get s.headers name with Some v -> v | None -> ""
  in
  let fields =
    [
      ("account", account);
      ("mailbox", mailbox);
      ("uid", string_of_int s.uid);
      ("thread", s.thread);
      ("labels", Imap.list s.labels);
      ("flags", Imap.list s.flags);
    ]
    @ List.map (fun h -> (h, header h)) headers
  in
  let item =
    List.fold_left
      (fun item (name, value) ->
        if value = "" then Mail.remove name item else Mail.set name value item)
      item fields
  in
  (* its UID in each mailbox it was listed in (a UID is a mailbox's):
   * this one's line replaced, the others' kept *)
  let others =
    List.filter
      (fun (f : Mail.field) ->
        not
          (String.lowercase_ascii f.name = "in"
          && in_mailbox (String.trim f.raw) = mailbox))
      item.fields
  in
  { item with
    fields =
      others
      @ [ { Mail.name = "in"; raw = Printf.sprintf " %s %d" mailbox s.uid } ] }

let summary (item : Item.t) : Imap.summary =
  let list name =
    match Imap.values (Item.field item name) with
    | [ l ] -> Imap.texts l
    | _ -> []
  in
  let id = Item.id item in
  {
    uid =
      (match int_of_string_opt (Item.field item "uid") with
      | Some u -> u
      | None -> 0);
    flags = list "flags";
    labels = list "labels";
    thread = Item.field item "thread";
    msgid =
      (match String.index_opt id ':' with
      | Some i -> String.sub id (i + 1) (String.length id - i - 1)
      | None -> id);
    headers =
      Mail.make
        (List.filter_map
           (fun h ->
             match Mail.get item h with Some v -> Some (h, v) | None -> None)
           headers)
        "";
  }

let listed (items : Item.t list) ~(account : string) ~(mailbox : string) :
    Imap.summary list =
  (* (listed there once: its UID there, whatever was listed since) *)
  let l =
    List.filter_map
      (fun item ->
        if
          (not (Item.has_stamp item "message"))
          || Item.field item "account" <> account
        then None
        else
          match uid_in item mailbox with
          | Some uid -> Some { (summary item) with uid }
          | None when Item.field item "mailbox" = mailbox ->
              Some (summary item)
          | None -> None)
      items
  in
  let l =
    if mailbox = "INBOX" then
      List.filter (fun (s : Imap.summary) -> List.mem "\\Inbox" s.labels) l
    else l
  in
  List.sort (fun (a : Imap.summary) (b : Imap.summary) -> compare a.uid b.uid) l

let key (item : Item.t) : string = (summary item).msgid

let gone (item : Item.t) ~(mailbox : string) : Item.t =
  let item =
    { item with
      fields =
        List.filter
          (fun (f : Mail.field) ->
            not
              (String.lowercase_ascii f.name = "in"
              && in_mailbox (String.trim f.raw) = mailbox))
          item.fields }
  in
  if mailbox <> "INBOX" then item
  else
    let labels = List.filter (fun l -> l <> "\\Inbox") (summary item).labels in
    Mail.set "labels" (Imap.list labels) item

(* Mail_item: a message as an item of mini-pim's store (Item.mli), what
   makes the mail the suite's (plan_mail.md, "what makes it the
   suite's"; plan_pim.md, idea 1):

       id: mail:1784                  <- Gmail's X-GM-MSGID: the same in
       stamp: message                    every mailbox, where a UID is
       account: bob@gmail.com            the mailbox's
       mailbox: INBOX                 <- where it was last listed, and
       uid: 12                           its UID there
       in: INBOX 12                   <- its UID in each mailbox listed
       in: [Gmail]/All Mail 345          in (a UID is a mailbox's)
       thread: 1784                   <- Gmail's conversation
       labels: (\Inbox travel)        <- as IMAP writes them (Imap.list)
       flags: (\Seen)
       from: Alice <alice@ix>         <- its headers, unfolded, the ones
       subject: the plan                 Imap.summaries asks
       ...

   Written by each list, so that a list without the network shows what
   the last one did; its body is not in it but in the store's cache,
   once read. What the server says replaces what the item said; what a
   person added (a stamp "task", a due date) stays. *)

(* the item's id of a summary: "mail:" and its X-GM-MSGID (its UID when
 * the server gives none) *)
val id : Imap.summary -> string

(* [update ~account ~mailbox summary old]: the item, made, or [old]
 * with the server's fields replaced *)
val update : account:string -> mailbox:string -> Imap.summary ->
  Item.t option -> Item.t

(* the summary an item stands for, to be shown as a listed one *)
val summary : Item.t -> Imap.summary

(* [listed items ~account ~mailbox]: the summaries of the messages
 * listed in that mailbox once, with their UID there (in: lines, one a
 * mailbox), INBOX's those still labelled \Inbox, by UID *)
val listed : Item.t list -> account:string -> mailbox:string ->
  Imap.summary list

(* the key of a message's bytes in the store's cache *)
val key : Item.t -> string

(* [gone item ~mailbox]: no longer in [mailbox] (a list found it not
 * there: archived elsewhere, on Gmail's site, a phone); its in: line
 * taken off, and in INBOX its \Inbox *)
val gone : Item.t -> mailbox:string -> Item.t

(* the item's UID in [mailbox], if it was listed there *)
val uid_in : Item.t -> string -> int option

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Mail_sync.mli *)

type server = { host : string; port : int; plain : bool }

let gmail = { host = "imap.gmail.com"; port = 993; plain = false }
let gmail_smtp = { host = "smtp.gmail.com"; port = 465; plain = false }

let connect (caps : < Cap.network ; Cap.open_in ; .. >) (s : server) :
    (Lines.t, string) result =
  Logs.info (fun m ->
      m "mail: connecting to %s:%d%s" s.host s.port
        (if s.plain then "" else ", TLS"));
  let conn =
    if s.plain then Lines.plain caps ~host:s.host ~port:s.port
    else
      Lines.tls caps ~trust:(Tls_client.system_roots caps) ~host:s.host
        ~port:s.port
  in
  match conn with
  | Ok c -> Ok c
  | Error why -> Error (Printf.sprintf "%s:%d: %s" s.host s.port why)

let all_mail = "[Gmail]/All Mail"
let starred = "[Gmail]/Starred"

(* the server's name of [mailbox]: All Mail's is found by its \All,
 * Starred's by its \Flagged (a French Gmail's "Tous les messages",
 * "Suivis") *)
let named (t : Imap.t) (mailbox : string) : (string, string) result =
  let attribute =
    if mailbox = all_mail then "\\all"
    else if mailbox = starred then "\\flagged"
    else ""
  in
  if attribute = "" then Ok mailbox
  else
    match Imap.mailboxes t with
    | Error e -> Error e
    | Ok l -> (
        let all (attributes, _) =
          List.exists (fun a -> String.lowercase_ascii a = attribute) attributes
        in
        match List.find_opt all l with
        | Some (_, name) -> Ok name
        | None -> Ok mailbox)

let session (caps : < Cap.network ; Cap.open_in ; .. >) (s : server)
    ~(user : string) ~(password : string) ~(mailbox : string)
    (f : Imap.t -> ('a, string) result) : ('a, string) result =
  match connect caps s with
  | Error why -> Error why
  | Ok conn -> (
      let ( let* ) r f = match r with Ok x -> f x | Error e -> Error e in
      let r =
        let* t = Imap.connect conn in
        let* () = Imap.login t ~user ~password in
        Logs.info (fun m -> m "mail: logged in as %s" user);
        let* name = named t mailbox in
        let* _ = Imap.select t name in
        Logs.info (fun m -> m "mail: %s selected" name);
        let r = f t in
        Imap.logout t;
        r
      in
      match r with
      | Ok x -> Ok x
      | Error e -> Lines.close conn; Error e)

let saved_password (caps : < Cap.env ; Cap.open_in ; .. >) :
    (string option, string) result =
  match Items.secret caps "password" with
  | Error e -> Error e
  | Ok None -> Ok None
  | Ok (Some text) -> (
      match String.trim (List.hd (String.split_on_char '\n' text)) with
      | "" -> Ok None
      | p -> Ok (Some p))

let keep (caps : < Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out ; .. >) (store : Items.t)
    ~(account : string) ~(mailbox : string) (l : Imap.summary list) : unit =
  List.iter
    (fun (s : Imap.summary) ->
      (* (Gmail leaves the selected mailbox's label out of X-GM-LABELS:
       * listed in INBOX, it is in the Inbox) *)
      let s =
        if mailbox = "INBOX" && not (List.mem "\\Inbox" s.labels) then
          { s with labels = "\\Inbox" :: s.labels }
        else s
      in
      let old = Items.find caps store (Mail_item.id s) in
      Items.save caps store (Mail_item.update ~account ~mailbox s old))
    l

let newest (n : int) (l : 'a list) : 'a list =
  let k = List.length l in
  List.filteri (fun i _ -> i >= k - n) l

let list (caps : < Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out ; Cap.readdir ; .. >)
    (store : Items.t)
    (t : Imap.t) ~(account : string) ~(mailbox : string)
    ~(query : string option) (n : int) : (Imap.summary list, string) result =
  let q = match query with Some q -> "X-GM-RAW " ^ Imap.quote q | None -> "ALL" in
  match Imap.search t q with
  | Error e -> Error e
  | Ok uids -> (
      (* every UID the mailbox has: those the store has of it and the
       * server no longer, gone from it (a list's whole, not a search's) *)
      if query = None then
        List.iter
          (fun item ->
            match Mail_item.uid_in item mailbox with
            | Some u
              when Item.field item "account" = account && not (List.mem u uids)
              ->
                Items.save caps store (Mail_item.gone item ~mailbox)
            | _ -> ())
          (Items.all caps store);
      match Imap.summaries t (newest n uids) with
      | Error e -> Error e
      | Ok l ->
          Logs.info (fun m ->
              m "mail: %d of %d messages' headers fetched, kept in the store"
                (List.length l) (List.length uids));
          keep caps store ~account ~mailbox l;
          Ok l)

let message (caps : < Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out ; .. >) (store : Items.t)
    (t : Imap.t) ~(account : string) ~(mailbox : string) (uid : int) :
    (string, string) result =
  match Imap.summaries t [ uid ] with
  | Error e -> Error e
  | Ok [] -> Error (Printf.sprintf "no message %d in %s" uid mailbox)
  | Ok (s :: _) -> (
      let key = Mail_item.key (Mail_item.update ~account ~mailbox s None) in
      let text =
        match Items.cached caps store key with
        | Some text -> (
            match Imap.store t [ uid ] "+FLAGS (\\Seen)" with
            | Ok () -> Ok text
            | Error e -> Error e)
        | None -> (
            match Imap.message t uid with
            | Ok text -> Items.cache caps store key text; Ok text
            | Error e -> Error e)
      in
      match text with
      | Error e -> Error e
      | Ok text ->
          let seen =
            if List.mem "\\Seen" s.flags then s
            else { s with flags = s.flags @ [ "\\Seen" ] }
          in
          keep caps store ~account ~mailbox [ seen ];
          Ok text)

let prefetch (caps : < Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out ; Cap.readdir ; .. >)
    (store : Items.t) (t : Imap.t) ~(account : string) ~(mailbox : string)
    ~(said : int -> int -> unit) : (int, string) result =
  let missing =
    List.filter_map
      (fun (s : Imap.summary) ->
        match Items.find caps store (Mail_item.id s) with
        | Some item when Items.cached caps store (Mail_item.key item) = None ->
            Some (s.uid, Mail_item.key item)
        | _ -> None)
      (Mail_item.listed (Items.all caps store) ~account ~mailbox)
  in
  let total = List.length missing in
  (* fifty a request: a response's size bounded, the progress said *)
  let rec go (done_ : int) (l : (int * string) list) : (int, string) result =
    match l with
    | [] -> Ok done_
    | _ -> (
        let batch = List.filteri (fun k _ -> k < 50) l in
        let rest = List.filteri (fun k _ -> k >= 50) l in
        match Imap.messages t (List.map fst batch) with
        | Error e -> Error e
        | Ok texts ->
            List.iter
              (fun (uid, text) ->
                match List.assoc_opt uid batch with
                | Some key -> Items.cache caps store key text
                | None -> ())
              texts;
            let done_ = done_ + List.length batch in
            said done_ total;
            go done_ rest)
  in
  go 0 missing

let item_of (caps : < Cap.open_in ; Cap.readdir ; .. >) (store : Items.t)
    ~(account : string) ~(mailbox : string) (uid : int) : Item.t option =
  let l = Mail_item.listed (Items.all caps store) ~account ~mailbox in
  match List.find_opt (fun (s : Imap.summary) -> s.uid = uid) l with
  | Some s -> Items.find caps store (Mail_item.id s)
  | None -> None

let archive (caps : < Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out ; Cap.readdir ; .. >)
    (store : Items.t) (t : Imap.t) ~(account : string) ~(mailbox : string)
    (uids : int list) : (unit, string) result =
  match Imap.store t uids "-X-GM-LABELS (\\Inbox)" with
  | Error e -> Error e
  | Ok () ->
      List.iter
        (fun uid ->
          match item_of caps store ~account ~mailbox uid with
          | None -> ()
          | Some item ->
              let s = Mail_item.summary item in
              let labels = List.filter (fun l -> l <> "\\Inbox") s.labels in
              Items.save caps store (Mail.set "labels" (Imap.list labels) item))
        uids;
      Ok ()

(* [star ... uids ~on]: Gmail's star, IMAP's \Flagged, set or taken off,
 * and the items saying so *)
let star (caps : < Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out ; Cap.readdir ; .. >)
    (store : Items.t) (t : Imap.t) ~(account : string) ~(mailbox : string)
    (uids : int list) ~(on : bool) : (unit, string) result =
  match
    Imap.store t uids ((if on then "+" else "-") ^ "FLAGS (\\Flagged)")
  with
  | Error e -> Error e
  | Ok () ->
      List.iter
        (fun uid ->
          match item_of caps store ~account ~mailbox uid with
          | None -> ()
          | Some item ->
              let s = Mail_item.summary item in
              let flags = List.filter (fun f -> f <> "\\Flagged") s.flags in
              let flags = if on then "\\Flagged" :: flags else flags in
              Items.save caps store (Mail.set "flags" (Imap.list flags) item))
        uids;
      Ok ()

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Snooze *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let day (d : Civil.date) : string =
  Printf.sprintf "%04d-%02d-%02d" d.year d.month d.day

let snooze (caps : < Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out ; Cap.readdir ; .. >)
    (store : Items.t) (t : Imap.t) ~(account : string) ~(mailbox : string)
    (uids : int list) ~(until : Civil.date) : (unit, string) result =
  (* (their ids first: archived, they are no more INBOX's) *)
  let ids =
    List.filter_map
      (fun uid -> Option.map Item.id (item_of caps store ~account ~mailbox uid))
      uids
  in
  match archive caps store t ~account ~mailbox uids with
  | Error e -> Error e
  | Ok () ->
      List.iter
        (fun id ->
          match Items.find caps store id with
          | Some item ->
              Items.save caps store (Mail.set "until" (day until) item)
          | None -> ())
        ids;
      Ok ()

(* the account's messages whose until: has come *)
let due (caps : < Cap.open_in ; Cap.readdir ; .. >) (store : Items.t)
    ~(account : string) ~(today : Civil.date) : Item.t list =
  List.filter
    (fun item ->
      Item.has_stamp item "message"
      && Item.field item "account" = account
      &&
      match Search.date (Item.field item "until") with
      | Some d -> Civil.days_from_civil d <= Civil.days_from_civil today
      | None -> false)
    (Items.all caps store)

let wake (caps : < Cap.network ; Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out ; Cap.readdir ; .. >)
    (store : Items.t) (s : server) ~(user : string) ~(password : string)
    ~(today : Civil.date) : (int, string) result =
  match due caps store ~account:user ~today with
  | [] -> Ok 0
  | items ->
      session caps s ~user ~password ~mailbox:all_mail (fun t ->
          let one (item : Item.t) : (unit, string) result =
            let sm = Mail_item.summary item in
            match Imap.search t ("X-GM-MSGID " ^ sm.msgid) with
            | Error e -> Error e
            | Ok [] -> Ok () (* (gone from the server: deleted) *)
            | Ok uids -> (
                match Imap.store t uids "+X-GM-LABELS (\\Inbox)" with
                | Error e -> Error e
                | Ok () ->
                    let labels =
                      if List.mem "\\Inbox" sm.labels then sm.labels
                      else "\\Inbox" :: sm.labels
                    in
                    Items.save caps store
                      (Mail.remove "until"
                         (Mail.set "woke" (day today)
                            (Mail.set "labels" (Imap.list labels) item)));
                    Ok ())
          in
          let rec all (l : Item.t list) =
            match l with
            | [] -> Ok (List.length items)
            | i :: rest -> (
                match one i with Error e -> Error e | Ok () -> all rest)
          in
          all items)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Sending *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let send (caps : < Cap.network ; Cap.open_in ; .. >) (s : server)
    ~(auth : (string * string) option) (mail : Mail.t) :
    (Smtp.outcome list, string) result =
  let sender =
    match Option.bind (Mail.get mail "from") Mail.address with
    | Some a -> a.mailbox
    | None -> ( match auth with Some (u, _) -> u | None -> "")
  in
  match connect caps s with
  | Error why -> Error why
  | Ok conn -> (
      let c =
        Smtp.client ~hello:"mini-pim" ~auth [ Smtp.envelope ~sender mail ]
      in
      let c = Lines.talk conn Smtp.step c (fun c -> Smtp.finished c <> None) in
      let why = Lines.why conn in
      Lines.close conn;
      match Smtp.finished c with
      | Some (Ok outcomes) -> Ok outcomes
      | Some (Error said) -> Error ("the server: " ^ said)
      | None ->
          Error (match why with Some w -> w | None -> "the connection ended"))

let said (o : Smtp.outcome) : string =
  match o with
  | Sent (n, []) -> Printf.sprintf "sent to %d" n
  | Sent (n, refused) ->
      Printf.sprintf "sent to %d, refused: %s" n (String.concat "; " refused)
  | Refused why -> "refused: " ^ why

(* now, and the minutes east of UTC of this place (Zone): a Date: as
 * the writer's clock says it *)
let now (caps : < Cap.open_in ; Cap.env ; .. >) : float * int =
  let t = CapUnix.gettimeofday caps () in
  (t, Zone.offset (Zone.local caps) t / 60)

let sent = ref 0

(* a draft's files: those it names, and a forwarded message's *)
let files (caps : < Cap.open_in ; .. >) (store : Items.t)
    (d : Mail_compose.draft) : ((string * string) list, string) result =
  let named =
    List.filter (fun w -> w <> "") (String.split_on_char ' ' d.attach)
  in
  let read =
    List.map
      (fun f ->
        match FS.read_opt caps (Fpath.v f) with
        | Some bytes -> Ok (Filename.basename f, bytes)
        | None -> Error (f ^ ": cannot read it"))
      named
  in
  match List.find_opt Result.is_error read with
  | Some (Error e) -> Error e
  | _ ->
      let forwarded =
        match d.forward with
        | "" -> []
        | key -> (
            match Items.cached caps store key with
            | None -> []
            | Some text ->
                List.map
                  (fun (l : Mime.leaf) ->
                    ( (match l.filename with Some f -> f | None -> "attachment"),
                      l.data ))
                  (Mime.attachments (Mail.parse text)))
      in
      Ok (List.filter_map Result.to_option read @ forwarded)

let send_draft
    (caps : < Cap.network ; Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out ; Cap.env ; .. >)
    (store : Items.t) (s : server) ~(user : string) ~(password : string)
    (d : Mail_compose.draft) : (string, string) result =
  match files caps store d with
  | Error e -> Error e
  | Ok files -> (
      let date, offset = now caps in
      incr sent;
      let msgid = Mail_compose.new_msgid ~from:user date !sent in
      let m = Mail_compose.message ~from:user ~date ~offset ~msgid ~files d in
      match send caps s ~auth:(Some (user, password)) m with
      | Error e -> Error e
      | Ok outcomes ->
          let taken (o : Smtp.outcome) =
            match o with Sent _ -> true | Refused _ -> false
          in
          let text = String.concat "; " (List.map said outcomes) in
          if List.for_all taken outcomes then begin
            if d.id <> "" then Items.remove caps store d.id;
            Ok text
          end
          else Error text)

(* Mail_sync: the mail between the server and mini-pim's store, what the
   command line (Pim.ml) and the window (Mail_window) both do: a session
   opened and logged in, the newest messages listed into the store's
   items (Mail_item), a message's bytes fetched into its cache, a
   message archived on the server and in its item.

   Each is one IMAP session, opened and closed, as a person asks:
   simple, and slow only by a TLS handshake. (IDLE, a session kept and
   told of new mail, is the window's later.) *)

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Mail_text.mli *)

let of_html (html : string) : string =
  let page = Line_mode.render 72 (Html_tree.of_string html) in
  let links =
    match page.links with
    | [] -> []
    | l ->
        ""
        :: List.mapi (fun i href -> Printf.sprintf "[%d] %s" (i + 1) href) l
  in
  String.concat "\n" (page.lines @ links)

let blank (s : string) : bool = String.trim s = ""

let size (n : int) : string =
  if n < 1024 then Printf.sprintf "%d bytes" n
  else if n < 1024 * 1024 then Printf.sprintf "%d KB" (n / 1024)
  else Printf.sprintf "%d MB" (n / (1024 * 1024))

let text (m : Mail.t) : string =
  let leaves = Mime.leaves m in
  let said (l : Mime.leaf) =
    l.mime = "text/plain" && l.filename = None && not (blank l.data)
  in
  let html = List.filter (fun (l : Mime.leaf) -> l.mime = "text/html") leaves in
  let body =
    if List.exists said leaves || html = [] then Mime.text m
    else
      String.concat "\n\n"
        (List.map (fun (l : Mime.leaf) -> of_html l.data) html)
  in
  let attached =
    List.map
      (fun (l : Mime.leaf) ->
        let name = match l.filename with Some f -> f | None -> "(no name)" in
        Printf.sprintf "[attached: %s, %s, %s]" name l.mime
          (size (String.length l.data)))
      (Mime.attachments m)
  in
  match attached with
  | [] -> body
  | l -> String.concat "\n" ((String.trim body ^ "\n") :: l)

(* ix: the author's playground's appkits/money/Ledger.ml
