(* See Ledger.mli *)

type status = Open | Cleared | Reconciled

type txn = {
  date : Civil.date;
  num : string;
  payee : string;
  category : string;
  memo : string;
  amount : Money.cents;
  status : status;
}

let date_of_string (s : string) : Civil.date option =
  let s = String.trim s in
  (* QIF's 9/14'04: an apostrophe before the year is the 2000s *)
  let s, century = match String.index_opt s '\'' with Some i -> (String.mapi (fun j c -> if j = i then '/' else c) s, 2000) | None -> (s, 1900) in
  match List.map int_of_string_opt (String.split_on_char '/' s) with
  | [ Some month; Some day; Some year ] ->
      let date : Civil.date = { year = (if year < 100 then century + year else year); month; day } in
      if Civil.is_valid date then Some date else None
  | _ -> None

let date_to_string (d : Civil.date) : string =
  if d.year >= 1900 && d.year < 2000 then Printf.sprintf "%d/%d/%02d" d.month d.day (d.year - 1900)
  else Printf.sprintf "%d/%d/%d" d.month d.day d.year

let sort (txns : txn list) : txn list =
  List.stable_sort (fun (a : txn) (b : txn) -> compare (Civil.days_from_civil a.date) (Civil.days_from_civil b.date)) txns

let balances (txns : txn list) : (txn * Money.cents) list =
  let _, lines = List.fold_left (fun (balance, acc) (t : txn) -> (balance + t.amount, (t, balance + t.amount) :: acc)) (0, []) txns in
  List.rev lines

let quickfill (txns : txn list) (prefix : string) : txn option =
  let prefix = String.lowercase_ascii prefix in
  let n = String.length prefix in
  if n = 0 then None
  else
    List.find_opt
      (fun (t : txn) -> String.length t.payee >= n && String.lowercase_ascii (String.sub t.payee 0 n) = prefix)
      (List.rev txns)

let by_category (txns : txn list) : (string * Money.cents) list =
  let add acc (t : txn) =
    let sum = match List.assoc_opt t.category acc with Some s -> s | None -> 0 in
    (t.category, sum + t.amount) :: List.remove_assoc t.category acc
  in
  List.sort compare (List.fold_left add [] txns)

let next_check (txns : txn list) : string =
  match List.filter_map (fun (t : txn) -> int_of_string_opt t.num) txns with
  | [] -> "101"
  | nums -> string_of_int (List.fold_left max 0 nums + 1)

(* Ledger: a checking account's register, the paper one's columns.
 *
 * Quicken's idea (Scott Cook and Tom Proulx, Intuit, 1984) was not an
 * algorithm but a picture: the screen is the register people already
 * kept in their checkbook -- date, check number, payee, payment,
 * deposit, the running balance -- and not an accountant's ledger. So a
 * transaction is one line with one signed amount, and the balance is
 * the sum of the lines above it. (Accountants keep *double entry*,
 * each amount written twice, a debit here and a credit there;
 * QuickBooks, 1992, kept it behind the same register.)
 *
 * Two things the register adds to paper:
 *
 * - **categories**: each line says what the money was for
 *   (Groceries, Utilities, Salary), and a report is the lines summed by
 *   category -- the register is a database whose query is the tax
 *   return ([by_category]);
 * - **QuickFill**: the payee typed is completed from the register
 *   itself, and the rest of the line (category, amount) copied from the
 *   last time you paid them ([quickfill]) -- most of a household's
 *   checks are the same few, every month. *)

(* open, marked cleared while reconciling ('*'), reconciled ('R') *)
type status = Open | Cleared | Reconciled

type txn = {
  date : Civil.date;
  num : string; (* the check's number, or DEP, or nothing *)
  payee : string;
  category : string;
  memo : string;
  amount : Money.cents; (* a payment is negative, a deposit positive *)
  status : status;
}

(* "9/14/84", "9/14/1984", and QIF's "9/14'04" for 2004; two digits
 * are the 1900s *)
val date_of_string : string -> Civil.date option
val date_to_string : Civil.date -> string

(* by date, a day's lines in the order they were written *)
val sort : txn list -> txn list

(* each line with the balance after it, from zero *)
val balances : txn list -> (txn * Money.cents) list

(* [quickfill txns prefix]: the latest line whose payee starts with
 * [prefix], case aside; None for an empty prefix *)
val quickfill : txn list -> string -> txn option

(* the lines summed by category, in the order of the categories'
 * names; the uncategorized under "" *)
val by_category : txn list -> (string * Money.cents) list

(* the check number after the highest one written, or "101" for a new
 * checkbook *)
val next_check : txn list -> string

(* Claude Code

(* ix: the author's playground's appkits/money/Money.ml
 * (plan_pim.md, stage 6) *)

(* See Money.mli *)

type cents = int

let digits s = s <> "" && String.for_all (fun c -> c >= '0' && c <= '9') s

let of_string (s : string) : cents option =
  let s = String.concat "" (String.split_on_char ',' (String.trim s)) in
  let negative, s = if s <> "" && s.[0] = '-' then (true, String.sub s 1 (String.length s - 1)) else (false, s) in
  let s = if s <> "" && s.[0] = '$' then String.sub s 1 (String.length s - 1) else s in
  let whole, fraction =
    match String.split_on_char '.' s with
    | [ w ] -> (w, "")
    | [ w; f ] -> (w, f)
    | _ -> ("", "x")
  in
  let whole = if whole = "" && fraction <> "" then "0" else whole in
  if digits whole && (fraction = "" || (digits fraction && String.length fraction <= 2)) then
    let fraction = fraction ^ String.make (2 - String.length fraction) '0' in
    let c = (int_of_string whole * 100) + int_of_string fraction in
    Some (if negative then -c else c)
  else None

let to_string (c : cents) : string =
  let a = abs c in
  let whole = string_of_int (a / 100) in
  (* a comma every three digits, counted from the right *)
  let n = String.length whole in
  let buf = Buffer.create (n + 4) in
  String.iteri
    (fun i ch ->
      if i > 0 && (n - i) mod 3 = 0 then Buffer.add_char buf ',';
      Buffer.add_char buf ch)
    whole;
  Printf.sprintf "%s%s.%02d" (if c < 0 then "-" else "") (Buffer.contents buf) (a mod 100)

let ones =
  [| ""; "one"; "two"; "three"; "four"; "five"; "six"; "seven"; "eight"; "nine"; "ten"; "eleven"; "twelve";
     "thirteen"; "fourteen"; "fifteen"; "sixteen"; "seventeen"; "eighteen"; "nineteen" |]

let tens = [| ""; ""; "twenty"; "thirty"; "forty"; "fifty"; "sixty"; "seventy"; "eighty"; "ninety" |]

(* 0 to 999: "one hundred twenty-three" *)
let below_thousand n =
  let hundreds = n / 100 and rest = n mod 100 in
  let rest_words =
    if rest < 20 then ones.(rest)
    else if rest mod 10 = 0 then tens.(rest / 10)
    else tens.(rest / 10) ^ "-" ^ ones.(rest mod 10)
  in
  String.concat " " (List.filter (( <> ) "") [ (if hundreds > 0 then ones.(hundreds) ^ " hundred" else ""); rest_words ])

(* in groups of three digits, each with its scale's name *)
let rec in_words n =
  let scales = [ (1_000_000_000, "billion"); (1_000_000, "million"); (1_000, "thousand") ] in
  match List.find_opt (fun (s, _) -> n >= s) scales with
  | Some (s, name) ->
      let rest = n mod s in
      in_words (n / s) ^ " " ^ name ^ if rest > 0 then " " ^ in_words rest else ""
  | None -> below_thousand n

let words (c : cents) : string =
  let c = abs c in
  let dollars = if c / 100 = 0 then "zero" else in_words (c / 100) in
  Printf.sprintf "%s%s and %02d/100" (String.uppercase_ascii (String.sub dollars 0 1)) (String.sub dollars 1 (String.length dollars - 1)) (c mod 100)
apps/pim/money/Money.mli

(* Money: amounts in whole cents, never in floats.
 *
 * The first thing to know about a program that keeps money: a float
 * cannot hold 0.10. Binary fractions are sums of halves, quarters,
 * eighths..., and a tenth is not such a sum, so it is rounded, and the
 * roundings add up:
 *
 *   0.1 +. 0.2 = 0.30000000000000004      (floats)
 *   10 + 20    = 30                        (cents)
 *
 * A checkbook that is off by a cent after a thousand additions is
 * wrong, and the person reconciling it will find the cent. So an
 * amount is an int of cents: addition is exact, and only the screen
 * puts a point two digits from the right. COBOL's decimal arithmetic
 * (1959) was the same answer, built into the language.
 *
 * And the other thing a check needs: the amount in words, what the
 * bank reads when the figures are unclear (and what makes changing
 * 100 into 900 harder). Worked example, checked by the tests:
 *
 *   123.45  ->  One hundred twenty-three and 45/100
 *)

type cents = int

(* "1,234.56", "-42.17", "$42", "42.5": Some cents; a third decimal,
 * or anything that is not a number, None *)
val of_string : string -> cents option

(* 123456 -> "1,234.56", -4217 -> "-42.17" *)
val to_string : cents -> string

(* the amount in words as a check spells it: the dollars in words, the
 * cents as a fraction of 100 -- 0.07 is "Zero and 07/100"; a negative
 * amount is written as its size *)
val words : cents -> string

(* ix: the author's playground's appkits/money/Qif.ml
 * (plan_pim.md, stage 6); Option.value a match *)

(* See Qif.mli *)

let write (txns : Ledger.txn list) : string =
  let record (t : Ledger.txn) =
    let field code v = if v = "" then [] else [ code ^ v ] in
    List.concat
      [
        [ "D" ^ Ledger.date_to_string t.date; "T" ^ Money.to_string t.amount ];
        field "N" t.num; field "P" t.payee; field "L" t.category; field "M" t.memo;
        (match t.status with Ledger.Open -> [] | Ledger.Cleared -> [ "C*" ] | Ledger.Reconciled -> [ "CX" ]);
        [ "^" ];
      ]
  in
  String.concat "\n" ("!Type:Bank" :: List.concat_map record txns) ^ "\n"

(* a record's fields, by their letter *)
let of_fields (n : int) (fields : (char * string) list) : (Ledger.txn, string) result =
  let get c = match List.assoc_opt c fields with Some v -> v | None -> "" in
  match (Option.bind (List.assoc_opt 'D' fields) Ledger.date_of_string, Option.bind (List.assoc_opt 'T' fields) Money.of_string) with
  | Some date, Some amount ->
      let status = match get 'C' with "*" | "c" -> Ledger.Cleared | "X" | "R" -> Ledger.Reconciled | _ -> Ledger.Open in
      Ok { Ledger.date; num = get 'N'; payee = get 'P'; category = get 'L'; memo = get 'M'; amount; status }
  | _ -> Error (Printf.sprintf "record %d: no valid date or amount" n)

let read (s : string) : (Ledger.txn list, string) result =
  let lines = List.map String.trim (String.split_on_char '\n' s) in
  (* records, each its fields in reverse; the last one's may be empty *)
  let rec go n fields acc = function
    | [] -> if fields = [] then Ok (List.rev acc) else Result.map (fun t -> List.rev (t :: acc)) (of_fields n fields)
    | "^" :: rest -> ( match of_fields n fields with Ok t -> go (n + 1) [] (t :: acc) rest | Error e -> Error e)
    | line :: rest when line = "" || line.[0] = '!' -> go n fields acc rest
    | line :: rest -> go n ((line.[0], String.sub line 1 (String.length line - 1)) :: fields) acc rest
  in
  go 1 [] [] lines

(* Qif: the Quicken Interchange Format, the text in which personal
 * finance programs and banks exchanged a register (later Quickens,
 * Microsoft Money, and banks' "download your statement" before OFX).
 *
 * A line per field, its first character saying which, a record ended
 * by ^, after a header naming the kind of account:
 *
 *   !Type:Bank
 *   D9/14/84          date
 *   T-42.17           amount, a payment negative
 *   N101              number
 *   PSafeway          payee
 *   LGroceries        category
 *   MFriday's         memo
 *   C*                cleared, a star; reconciled, X
 *   ^
 *
 * Small enough to read in an evening, and it shows what a format with
 * no schema costs: unknown letters are skipped, a missing date is an
 * error, and nothing says which of the world's date orders was meant
 * (month first, here, as Quicken wrote it). TinyQuicken's file. *)

val write : Ledger.txn list -> string

(* the records of a bank register; Error names the first record that
 * has no valid date or amount *)
val read : string -> (Ledger.txn list, string) result

(* Claude Code

(* ix: the author's playground's appkits/money/Reconcile.ml

(* See Reconcile.mli *)

type hint =
  | Missing of Ledger.txn list
  | Extra of Ledger.txn
  | Wrong_sign of Ledger.txn
  | Transposed of Ledger.txn * Money.cents
  | Nine

let sum_of status txns = List.fold_left (fun s (t : Ledger.txn) -> if List.mem t.status status then s + t.amount else s) 0 txns
let opening txns = sum_of [ Ledger.Reconciled ] txns
let cleared txns = sum_of [ Ledger.Reconciled; Ledger.Cleared ] txns
let difference ~statement txns = statement - cleared txns

(* the amounts [a] becomes with two neighbouring digits swapped *)
let swaps (a : Money.cents) : Money.cents list =
  let s = string_of_int (abs a) in
  List.filter_map
    (fun i ->
      if s.[i] = s.[i + 1] then None
      else
        let b = Bytes.of_string s in
        Bytes.set b i s.[i + 1];
        Bytes.set b (i + 1) s.[i];
        let v = int_of_string (Bytes.to_string b) in
        Some (if a < 0 then -v else v))
    (List.init (max 0 (String.length s - 1)) Fun.id)

(* up to three of [items] whose amounts add up to [target], the
   fewest first *)
let subset (items : Ledger.txn list) (target : Money.cents) : Ledger.txn list option =
  let rec pick k start sum chosen =
    if k = 0 then if sum = target then Some (List.rev chosen) else None
    else
      let rec from = function
        | [] -> None
        | (t : Ledger.txn) :: rest -> (
            match pick (k - 1) rest (sum + t.amount) (t :: chosen) with Some c -> Some c | None -> from rest)
      in
      from start
  in
  List.fold_left (fun found k -> match found with Some _ -> found | None -> pick k items 0 []) None [ 1; 2; 3 ]

let hints ~statement (txns : Ledger.txn list) : hint list =
  let diff = difference ~statement txns in
  if diff = 0 then []
  else
    let open_ = List.filter (fun (t : Ledger.txn) -> t.status = Ledger.Open) txns in
    let ticked = List.filter (fun (t : Ledger.txn) -> t.status = Ledger.Cleared) txns in
    let missing = match subset open_ diff with Some ts -> [ Missing ts ] | None -> [] in
    let extra = List.filter_map (fun (t : Ledger.txn) -> if t.amount = -diff then Some (Extra t) else None) ticked in
    let sign = List.filter_map (fun (t : Ledger.txn) -> if 2 * t.amount = -diff then Some (Wrong_sign t) else None) ticked in
    let transposed =
      List.concat_map
        (fun (t : Ledger.txn) -> List.filter_map (fun a -> if a - t.amount = diff then Some (Transposed (t, a)) else None) (swaps t.amount))
        ticked
    in
    let nine = if transposed = [] && diff mod 9 = 0 then [ Nine ] else [] in
    missing @ extra @ sign @ transposed @ nine

let finish (txns : Ledger.txn list) : Ledger.txn list =
  List.map (fun (t : Ledger.txn) -> if t.status = Ledger.Cleared then { t with status = Ledger.Reconciled } else t) txns
apps/pim/money/Reconcile.mli
2585
(* Reconcile: the register balanced against the bank's statement.
 *
 * Once a month the bank says what it has seen: an ending balance.
 * You tick, in the register, each line the statement lists (it is
 * "cleared"); the register's cleared lines, added to what was
 * reconciled last month, must come to the statement's balance. The
 * **difference** is the whole screen:
 *
 *   cleared balance   = reconciled before + the lines ticked now
 *   difference        = statement - cleared balance
 *
 * and zero means done: the ticked lines become reconciled ('R'), and
 * next month starts from them.
 *
 * A difference that is not zero is a mistake, and its size says which
 * one -- the arithmetic people learned doing it by hand, done here for
 * them ([hints]):
 *
 * - a line **not ticked** that the statement has: the difference is
 *   its amount -- or two or three lines' together, a small subset sum
 *   (searched up to three lines);
 * - a line **ticked** that the statement does not have: the
 *   difference is minus its amount;
 * - a line entered with the **wrong sign**, a deposit as a payment:
 *   the difference is minus twice it;
 * - two **digits swapped** in typing, 45.10 for 54.10: the difference
 *   is a multiple of 9 (9.00 here). Always: swapping digits a and b
 *   in places p and p+1 changes a number by (a - b) * 9 * 10^p. So a
 *   line whose amount, with two neighbouring digits swapped, gives the
 *   difference is the suspect; and when none does, the 9 is still
 *   worth saying.
 *
 * Worked example, checked by the tests: a payment of 54.10 typed as
 * 45.10 and ticked. The statement is 9.00 lower than the register
 * ([Transposed], the line and the 54.10 it should say). *)

type hint =
  | Missing of Ledger.txn list (* not ticked, and their amounts are the difference *)
  | Extra of Ledger.txn (* ticked, and not on the statement *)
  | Wrong_sign of Ledger.txn
  | Transposed of Ledger.txn * Money.cents (* the line, and the amount it should say *)
  | Nine (* a multiple of 9 and no line found: look for two digits swapped *)

(* reconciled before: where this month starts *)
val opening : Ledger.txn list -> Money.cents

(* reconciled before, and ticked now *)
val cleared : Ledger.txn list -> Money.cents
val difference : statement:Money.cents -> Ledger.txn list -> Money.cents

(* the explanations the difference allows, the likeliest first; none
 * when it is zero *)
val hints : statement:Money.cents -> Ledger.txn list -> hint list

(* the ticked lines reconciled: this month done *)
val finish : Ledger.txn list -> Ledger.txn list

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Books.mli *)

type posting = { account : string; amount : Money.cents }

(* "Expenses:Groceries  42.17": the account, and its amount if it has
 * one; the last two spaces part them *)
let posting (line : string) : string * Money.cents option =
  let line = String.trim line in
  let n = String.length line in
  let rec find i =
    if i < 0 then None
    else if line.[i] = ' ' && line.[i + 1] = ' ' then Some i
    else find (i - 1)
  in
  match find (n - 2) with
  | Some i -> (
      let account = String.trim (String.sub line 0 i) in
      match Money.of_string (String.trim (String.sub line i (n - i))) with
      | Some c -> (account, Some c)
      | None -> (line, None))
  | None -> (line, None)

let postings (i : Item.t) : posting list =
  let ps = List.map posting (Mail.get_all i "posting") in
  let known =
    List.fold_left
      (fun s (_, a) -> match a with Some c -> s + c | None -> s)
      0 ps
  in
  List.map
    (fun (account, a) ->
      { account; amount = (match a with Some c -> c | None -> -known) })
    ps

let is_transaction (i : Item.t) : bool =
  Mail.get_all i "posting" <> []
  && ((not (Item.has_stamp i "task")) || Item.field i "done" <> "")

let accounts (items : Item.t list) : string list =
  List.sort_uniq compare
    (List.concat_map
       (fun i ->
         if is_transaction i then List.map (fun p -> p.account) (postings i)
         else [])
       items)

let balance (items : Item.t list) (account : string) : Money.cents =
  List.fold_left
    (fun s i ->
      if not (is_transaction i) then s
      else
        List.fold_left
          (fun s p -> if p.account = account then s + p.amount else s)
          s (postings i))
    0 items

let prefixed (p : string) (s : string) : bool =
  String.length s > String.length p
  && String.sub s 0 (String.length p) = p

let category (account : string) : string =
  let cut p =
    String.sub account (String.length p)
      (String.length account - String.length p)
  in
  if prefixed "Expenses:" account then cut "Expenses:"
  else if prefixed "Income:" account then cut "Income:"
  else "[" ^ account ^ "]"

let account_of ~(amount : Money.cents) (c : string) : string =
  let c = String.trim c in
  let n = String.length c in
  if n >= 2 && c.[0] = '[' && c.[n - 1] = ']' then String.sub c 1 (n - 2)
  else if String.contains c ':' then c
  else if c = "" then if amount < 0 then "Expenses:Unknown" else "Income:Unknown"
  else if amount < 0 then "Expenses:" ^ c
  else "Income:" ^ c

(* the day it is in the books: date:, else a bill's done: *)
let day (i : Item.t) : Civil.date option =
  match Search.date (Item.field i "date") with
  | Some d -> Some d
  | None -> Search.date (Item.field i "done")

let status (i : Item.t) : Ledger.status =
  match Item.field i "cleared" with
  | "R" -> Reconciled
  | "*" -> Cleared
  | _ -> Open

let register (items : Item.t list) (account : string) :
    (Item.t * Ledger.txn) list =
  let lines =
    List.filter_map
      (fun i ->
        if not (is_transaction i) then None
        else
          let ps = postings i in
          match (List.partition (fun p -> p.account = account) ps, day i) with
          | ([], _), _ | _, None -> None
          | (mine, others), Some date ->
              let category =
                match others with
                | [ p ] -> category p.account
                | [] -> ""
                | _ -> "--Split--"
              in
              let title =
                match Item.field i "payee" with "" -> Item.field i "title" | p -> p
              in
              Some
                ( i,
                  ({ date; num = Item.field i "num"; payee = title; category;
                     memo = Item.field i "memo";
                     amount = List.fold_left (fun s p -> s + p.amount) 0 mine;
                     status = status i } : Ledger.txn) ))
      items
  in
  List.stable_sort
    (fun (_, (a : Ledger.txn)) (_, (b : Ledger.txn)) ->
      compare (Civil.days_from_civil a.date) (Civil.days_from_civil b.date))
    lines

let with_status (s : Ledger.status) (i : Item.t) : Item.t =
  match s with
  | Open -> Mail.remove "cleared" i
  | Cleared -> Mail.set "cleared" "*" i
  | Reconciled -> Mail.set "cleared" "R" i

let of_txn ~(id : string) ~(account : string) (t : Ledger.txn) : Item.t =
  let opt name v = if v = "" then [] else [ (name, v) ] in
  with_status t.status
    (Item.make ~id ~stamps:[ "money" ]
       (List.concat
          [ [ ("date", Civil.to_string t.date) ]; opt "num" t.num;
            [ ("payee", t.payee) ]; opt "memo" t.memo;
            [ ("posting", account_of ~amount:t.amount t.category ^ "  "
                          ^ Money.to_string (-t.amount));
              ("posting", account) ] ])
       "")

let fresh (register : Ledger.txn list) (txns : Ledger.txn list) :
    Ledger.txn list =
  let near (a : Ledger.txn) (b : Ledger.txn) =
    a.amount = b.amount
    && abs (Civil.days_from_civil a.date - Civil.days_from_civil b.date) <= 3
  in
  (* (each line of the register matches one of the file's at most) *)
  let rec go left acc l =
    match l with
    | [] -> List.rev acc
    | t :: rest -> (
        match List.partition (near t) left with
        | _ :: others, kept -> go (others @ kept) acc rest
        | [], _ -> go left (t :: acc) rest)
  in
  go register [] txns

let report (items : Item.t list) ~(year : int) ~(month : int) :
    (string * Money.cents) list =
  let sums = Hashtbl.create 16 in
  List.iter
    (fun i ->
      match day i with
      | Some d when is_transaction i && d.year = year && d.month = month ->
          List.iter
            (fun p ->
              if prefixed "Expenses:" p.account || prefixed "Income:" p.account
              then
                let sum =
                  match Hashtbl.find_opt sums p.account with
                  | Some s -> s
                  | None -> 0
                in
                Hashtbl.replace sums p.account (p.amount + sum))
            (postings i)
      | _ -> ())
    items;
  List.sort compare (Hashtbl.fold (fun a s acc -> (a, s) :: acc) sums [])

(* Books: the money (plan_pim.md, stage 6), double entry under
   Quicken's register. A transaction is an item stamped money, its
   postings summing to zero, ledger's way (John Wiegley's ledger, 2003,
   plain text accounting):

       id: money:1730193600.1
       stamp: money
       date: 2026-10-30
       payee: EDF
       num: 101
       posting: Expenses:Utilities  62.40     <- an account, two spaces,
       posting: Assets:Checking                  an amount; one may be
       cleared: *                                left out: the rest's
                                                 opposite

   A category is an account: a payment's Groceries is
   Expenses:Groceries, a deposit's Salary Income:Salary, and a transfer
   is written [Assets:Savings], Quicken's brackets. So a register (an
   account's lines, each its posting's amount and the other account as
   its category, Ledger.txn) and a category report are the same books
   read two ways, and the books always balance.

   A bill is a task with postings (idea 1: stamped task money, due
   the 5th): it is in the books once done, on the day it was paid. *)

type posting = { account : string; amount : Money.cents }

(* the item's posting: lines, the one left out filled in *)
val postings : Item.t -> posting list

(* in the books: postings, and not a task still to do *)

(* "Expenses:Groceries" -> "Groceries", "Assets:Savings" ->

 * deposit's an income *)

val account_of : amount:Money.cents -> string -> string

(* [of_txn ~id ~account txn]: a register's line as an item: its

(* cleared: as the status says *)

(* the month's [Expenses:] and [Income:] sums by account, a
 * report's lines *)

type source = { name : string; url : string }

let sources (caps : < Cap.env ; Cap.open_in ; .. >) :
    (source list, string) result =
  match Items.secret caps "calendars" with
  | Error e -> Error e
  | Ok None -> Ok []
  | Ok (Some text) ->
      Ok
        (List.filter_map
           (fun l ->
             let l = String.trim l in
             if l = "" || l.[0] = '#' then None
             else
               match String.index_opt l ' ' with
               | Some i ->
                   Some
                     { name = String.sub l 0 i;
                       url =
                         String.trim (String.sub l i (String.length l - i)) }
               | None -> None)
           (String.split_on_char '\n' text))

let merge (items : Item.t list) (name : string) (fetched : Item.t list) :
    Item.t list * string list =
  let fetched = List.map (Mail.set "calendar" name) fetched in
  let ids = List.map Item.id fetched in
  let changed =
    List.filter
      (fun (f : Item.t) ->
        match List.find_opt (fun i -> Item.id i = Item.id f) items with
        | Some old -> Item.to_string old <> Item.to_string f
        | None -> true)
      fetched
  in
  let gone =
    List.filter_map
      (fun i ->
        if Item.field i "calendar" = name && not (List.mem (Item.id i) ids)
        then Some (Item.id i)
        else None)
      items
  in
  (changed, gone)

let fetch (caps : < Cap.network ; Cap.env ; Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out ;
                    Cap.readdir ; .. >) (s : source) : (int * int, string) result =
  (* (its name, not its address: a secret) *)
  Logs.info (fun m -> m "calendar %s: fetching" s.name);
  match Http_client.get caps s.url with
  | Error e -> Error (s.name ^ ": " ^ e)
  | Ok r when r.status <> 200 ->
      Error (Printf.sprintf "%s: %d %s" s.name r.status r.reason)
  | Ok r ->
      let store = Items.at (Items.place caps) in
      let fetched = Events.of_ics (Zone.local caps) ~message:"" r.body in
      let changed, gone = merge (Items.all caps store) s.name fetched in
      List.iter (Items.save caps store) changed;
      List.iter (Items.remove caps store) gone;
      Logs.info (fun m ->
          m "calendar %s: %d events, %d saved, %d removed" s.name
            (List.length fetched) (List.length changed) (List.length gone));
      Ok (List.length changed, List.length gone)

(* Claude Code

(* See Capture.mli *)

type event = {
  title : string;
  day : Civil.date;
  time : int option;
  ends : Civil.date option;
  repeat : string;
  with_ : string list;
}

(* "12:30", "12h30", "12h", "4pm", "11am", "noon", "midi" *)
let time_of (w : string) : int option =
  let w = String.lowercase_ascii w in
  let n = String.length w in
  let hm h m =
    match (int_of_string_opt h, int_of_string_opt m) with
    | Some h, Some m when h >= 0 && h < 24 && m >= 0 && m < 60 ->
        Some ((h * 60) + m)
    | _ -> None
  in
  let ends s =
    let k = String.length s in
    n > k && String.sub w (n - k) k = s
  in
  if w = "noon" || w = "midi" then Some (12 * 60)
  else if String.contains w ':' then Events.minutes w
  else if String.contains w 'h' then
    match String.split_on_char 'h' w with
    | [ h; "" ] -> hm h "0"
    | [ h; m ] -> hm h m
    | _ -> None
  else if ends "am" || ends "pm" then
    match int_of_string_opt (String.sub w 0 (n - 2)) with
    | Some h when h >= 1 && h <= 12 ->
        let h = h mod 12 in
        Some ((if ends "pm" then h + 12 else h) * 60)
    | _ -> None
  else None

let weekdays =
  [ ([ "sunday"; "dimanche" ], "SU", 0); ([ "monday"; "lundi" ], "MO", 1);
    ([ "tuesday"; "mardi" ], "TU", 2); ([ "wednesday"; "mercredi" ], "WE", 3);
    ([ "thursday"; "jeudi" ], "TH", 4); ([ "friday"; "vendredi" ], "FR", 5);
    ([ "saturday"; "samedi" ], "SA", 6) ]

(* "every monday": the rule, and its first day from [today] (today if
 * it is one) *)
let repeat_of ~(today : Civil.date) (w : string) : (string * Civil.date) option =
  let t = Civil.days_from_civil today in
  let w = String.lowercase_ascii w in
  let plain f = Some ("FREQ=" ^ f, today) in
  match w with
  | "day" | "jour" -> plain "DAILY"
  | "week" | "semaine" -> plain "WEEKLY"
  | "month" | "mois" -> plain "MONTHLY"
  | "year" | "an" | "année" -> plain "YEARLY"
  | _ ->
      List.find_map
        (fun (names, code, wd) ->
          if List.exists (fun n -> n = w || String.sub n 0 3 = w) names then
            let d = (wd - Civil.weekday t + 7) mod 7 in
            Some ("FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=" ^ code, Civil.civil_from_days (t + d))
          else None)
        weekdays

let event ~(today : Civil.date) ~(people : Item.t list) (line : string) :
    event =
  let ws = List.filter (fun w -> w <> "") (String.split_on_char ' ' line) in
  (* the time, and an "at" before it *)
  let rec cut_time acc l =
    match l with
    | [] -> (List.rev acc, None)
    | w :: rest -> (
        match time_of w with
        | Some t ->
            let acc =
              match acc with
              | ("at" | "à" | "a") :: before -> before
              | _ -> acc
            in
            (List.rev acc @ rest, Some t)
        | None -> cut_time (w :: acc) rest)
  in
  let ws, time = cut_time [] ws in
  (* the repeat *)
  let rec cut_repeat acc l =
    match l with
    | ("every" | "chaque") :: w :: rest -> (
        match repeat_of ~today w with
        | Some r -> (List.rev acc @ rest, Some r)
        | None -> cut_repeat (w :: "every" :: acc) rest)
    | w :: rest -> cut_repeat (w :: acc) rest
    | [] -> (List.rev acc, None)
  in
  let ws, repeat = cut_repeat [] ws in
  let title, day = When.ending ~today (String.concat " " ws) in
  (* "roma nov 3 to nov 7": the day found its last, the one before "to"
   * (au, -, until, jusqu'au) its first *)
  let title, day, ends =
    let words = List.rev (String.split_on_char ' ' title) in
    match (day, words) with
    | Some last, ("to" | "au" | "-" | "until" | "jusqu'au") :: rest -> (
        match When.ending ~today (String.concat " " (List.rev rest)) with
        | t, Some first
          when Civil.days_from_civil first < Civil.days_from_civil last ->
            (t, Some first, Some last)
        | _ -> (title, day, None))
    | _ -> (title, day, None)
  in
  let day, repeat =
    match (day, repeat) with
    | Some d, Some (r, _) -> (d, r)
    | Some d, None -> (d, "")
    | None, Some (r, first) -> (first, r)
    | None, None -> (today, "")
  in
  (* the people: the word after with or avec *)
  let rec names l =
    match l with
    | ("with" | "avec") :: w :: rest -> String.lowercase_ascii w :: names rest
    | _ :: rest -> names rest
    | [] -> []
  in
  let who (name : string) : string option =
    List.find_map
      (fun c ->
        let first =
          match String.split_on_char ' ' (Item.field c "name") with
          | f :: _ -> String.lowercase_ascii f
          | [] -> ""
        in
        let addressed e =
          String.length e >= String.length name
          && String.sub e 0 (String.length name) = name
        in
        if first = name || List.exists addressed (People.emails c) then
          Some (Item.id c)
        else None)
      people
  in
  { title; day; time; repeat; ends;
    with_ = List.filter_map who (names (String.split_on_char ' ' title)) }

let to_item ~(id : string) (e : event) : Item.t =
  let when_ =
    Civil.to_string e.day
    ^ match e.time with Some t -> " " ^ Events.clock t | None -> ""
  in
  let opt name v = if v = "" then [] else [ (name, v) ] in
  Item.make ~id ~stamps:[ "event" ]
    (List.concat
       [ [ ("title", e.title); ("when", when_) ]; opt "repeat" e.repeat;
         opt "with" (String.concat " " e.with_);
         (match e.ends with
         | Some d -> [ ("ends", Civil.to_string d) ]
         | None -> []) ])
    ""

(* Capture: one line typed, made an event (plan_pim.md, idea 4: the
   Agenda's and the Newton's "lunch with alice tue 12:30"), the
   recognizer's words for a day (When), a time, a repeat and people:

       lunch with alice tue 12:30
         -> title "lunch with alice", Tuesday, 12:30,
            with: contact:alice@ix         <- alice is in People
       standup every monday 9h30
         -> FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO, the next Monday, 9:30
       dentist nov 5 at 4pm

       roma nov 3 to nov 7               <- to, au, -, until: its last
         -> November 3, ends: November 7    day
       déjeuner avec alice mardi 12h30     <- the author's French

   A time: 12:30, 12h30, 12h, 4pm, 11am, noon, midi (an "at" or "à"
   before it dropped). A repeat: every (chaque) day, week, month,
   year, or a weekday. A day: When's words, at the end of what is
   left; none, today (a repeat's first day: the next one). A person:
   the word after "with" ("avec") that is a contact's first name or the
   start of their address. The title is the line less the day, the
   time and the repeat. *)

  repeat : string; (* RRULE's text, "" for none *)
  with_ : string list; (* the contacts' ids *)
}

 * after midnight *)
val time_of : string -> int option

val event : today:Civil.date -> people:Item.t list -> string -> event

val to_item : id:string -> event -> Item.t

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Detect.mli *)

type kind =
  | Day of Civil.date * int option
  | Amount of Money.cents
  | Address of string * string

type found = { said : string; kind : kind; line : string }

(* a word as written, and as read: its punctuation around taken off *)
let core (w : string) : string =
  let strip c = String.contains ".,;:!?()\"'<>[]" c in
  let n = String.length w in
  let rec first i = if i < n && strip w.[i] then first (i + 1) else i in
  let rec last j = if j > 0 && strip w.[j - 1] then last (j - 1) else j in
  let i = first 0 and j = last n in
  if i >= j then "" else String.sub w i (j - i)

let is_digit (c : char) : bool = c >= '0' && c <= '9'

(* where [sub] begins in [s] *)
let index (s : string) (sub : string) : int option =
  let n = String.length s and k = String.length sub in
  let rec go i =
    if i + k > n then None
    else if String.sub s i k = sub then Some i
    else go (i + 1)
  in
  go 0

(* "1,937.60", "62,40", "1.000,50", "12": the last separator followed
 * by two digits the cents', the others thousands' *)
let cents_of (s : string) : int option =
  let n = String.length s in
  if
    n = 0
    || (not (String.for_all (fun c -> is_digit c || c = ',' || c = '.') s))
    || (not (is_digit s.[0]))
    || not (is_digit s.[n - 1])
  then None
  else
    let digits t =
      String.concat ""
        (String.split_on_char ','
           (String.concat "" (String.split_on_char '.' t)))
    in
    let decimal = n >= 3 && (s.[n - 3] = '.' || s.[n - 3] = ',') in
    let whole = if decimal then String.sub s 0 (n - 3) else s in
    let cents = if decimal then String.sub s (n - 2) 2 else "00" in
    match (int_of_string_opt (digits whole), int_of_string_opt cents) with
    | Some w, Some c -> Some ((w * 100) + c)
    | _ -> None

let currencies =
  [ "$"; "€"; "£"; "eur"; "usd"; "gbp"; "euros"; "euro"; "dollars" ]

(* "$62.40", "62,40€", "€12": a sign stuck to the number *)
let stuck (w : string) : int option =
  let lw = String.lowercase_ascii w in
  List.find_map
    (fun c ->
      let k = String.length c and n = String.length lw in
      if n > k && String.sub lw 0 k = c then cents_of (String.sub w k (n - k))
      else if n > k && String.sub lw (n - k) k = c then
        cents_of (String.sub w 0 (n - k))
      else None)
    [ "$"; "€"; "£" ]

(* a day's words alone, without a number: few, so that "sun" or "may"
 * in a sentence are no day *)
let day_words =
  [ "today"; "tomorrow"; "aujourd'hui"; "demain"; "monday"; "tuesday";
    "wednesday"; "thursday"; "friday"; "saturday"; "sunday"; "lundi"; "mardi";
    "mercredi"; "jeudi"; "vendredi"; "samedi"; "dimanche" ]

let in_line ~(today : Civil.date) (line : string) : found list =
  let words =
    Array.of_list
      (List.filter (fun w -> w <> "") (String.split_on_char ' ' line))
  in
  let n = Array.length words in
  let cores = Array.map core words in
  let lower k = String.lowercase_ascii cores.(k) in
  (* the words from i to j as written, less the punctuation before the
   * first's core and after the last's: "(tuesday 12:30)." *)
  let said i j =
    let s = String.concat " " (Array.to_list (Array.sub words i (j - i))) in
    let start = match index words.(i) cores.(i) with Some p -> p | None -> 0 in
    let last = words.(j - 1) and c = cores.(j - 1) in
    let stop =
      match index last c with
      | Some p -> String.length last - p - String.length c
      | None -> 0
    in
    String.sub s start (String.length s - start - stop)
  in
  let found = ref [] in
  let add f = found := f :: !found in
  let k = ref 0 in
  while !k < n do
    let i = !k in
    (* a day: the longest of 3, 2, 1 words When reads *)
    let day =
      List.find_map
        (fun len ->
          if i + len > n then None
          else
            let phrase =
              String.concat " " (List.init len (fun d -> lower (i + d)))
            in
            let single_ok =
              len > 1 || List.mem phrase day_words
              || (String.length phrase >= 8 && is_digit phrase.[0])
            in
            if not single_ok then None
            else
              match When.parse ~today phrase with
              | Some d -> Some (len, d)
              | None -> None)
        [ 3; 2; 1 ]
    in
    match day with
    | Some (len, d) ->
        (* a time after it: "tuesday 12:30", "nov 5 at 4pm" *)
        let j = i + len in
        let j' =
          if j < n && (lower j = "at" || lower j = "à") then j + 1 else j
        in
        let time, upto =
          if j' < n then
            match Capture.time_of (lower j') with
            | Some t -> (Some t, j' + 1)
            | None -> (None, j)
          else (None, j)
        in
        add { said = said i upto; kind = Day (d, time); line };
        k := upto
    | None -> (
        let w = cores.(i) in
        let amount =
          match stuck w with
          | Some c -> Some (c, i + 1, i)
          | None -> (
              match cents_of w with
              | Some c when i + 1 < n && List.mem (lower (i + 1)) currencies ->
                  Some (c, i + 2, i)
              | Some c when i > 0 && List.mem (lower (i - 1)) currencies ->
                  Some (c, i + 1, i - 1)
              | _ -> None)
        in
        match amount with
        | Some (c, upto, from) ->
            add { said = said from upto; kind = Amount c; line };
            k := upto
        | None ->
            (match String.index_opt w '@' with
            | Some p when p > 0 && p < String.length w - 1 ->
                (* "Dan Brown <dan@ix>": the capitalized words before *)
                let rec name j acc =
                  if j >= 0 && j >= i - 3 && cores.(j) <> ""
                     && Char.uppercase_ascii cores.(j).[0] = cores.(j).[0]
                     && not (is_digit cores.(j).[0])
                  then name (j - 1) (cores.(j) :: acc)
                  else acc
                in
                let named =
                  if words.(i).[0] = '<' then name (i - 1) [] else []
                in
                add
                  { said = w;
                    kind =
                      Address
                        (String.concat " " named, String.lowercase_ascii w);
                    line }
            | _ -> ());
            k := i + 1)
  done;
  List.rev !found

let find ~(today : Civil.date) (text : string) : found list =
  let all =
    List.concat_map
      (fun l -> in_line ~today (String.trim l))
      (String.split_on_char '\n' text)
  in
  (* once each *)
  List.fold_left
    (fun acc f ->
      if List.exists (fun g -> g.kind = f.kind) acc then acc else acc @ [ f ])
    [] all

(* Detect: what a message's text says that the suite could keep
   (plan_pim.md, idea 4: "the same recognizer runs over mail, as Data
   Detectors: a date, a person, an amount in a message, underlined, and
   a key makes it an event, a contact, a posting"; Apple's, Mac OS 8,

       Lunch on tuesday at 12:30? It's 24,50 € a head.
                ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~        ~~~~~~~
       Dan Brown <dan@ix> comes too.     a day and its time, an
       ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~                 amount, an address

   A day is When's words (Capture's time after it, "at" between): two
   or three words ("nov 5", "in 3 days", "next week"), or one of the
   few that are a day alone (today, tomorrow, the weekdays, English and
   French, an ISO date), so that "may" or "sun" in a sentence are none.
   An amount is a number with a currency sign stuck to it or a word

type kind =
  | Day of Civil.date * int option (* the time, minutes after midnight *)
  | Amount of Money.cents
  | Address of string * string (* the name ("" for none), the address *)

(* [said] as it is in the text, [line] the line it is in *)

(* Claude Code

(* See Envelopes.mli *)

type envelope = {
  account : string;
  assigned : Money.cents;
  spent : Money.cents;
  available : Money.cents;
}

let prefix (p : string) (s : string) : bool =
  String.length s >= String.length p && String.sub s 0 (String.length p) = p

let assignment (i : Item.t) : (string * Money.cents) option =
  if not (Item.has_stamp i "budget") then None
  else
    match Money.of_string (Item.field i "amount") with
    | Some c -> Some (Item.field i "envelope", c)
    | None -> None

let envelopes (items : Item.t list) : envelope list =
  let assigned = List.filter_map assignment items in
  let names = List.sort_uniq compare (List.map fst assigned) in
  let txns = List.filter Books.is_transaction items in
  List.map
    (fun account ->
      let a =
        List.fold_left
          (fun s (e, c) -> if e = account then s + c else s)
          0 assigned
      in
      (* what was spent from it: its postings, refunds taken back *)
      let spent =
        List.fold_left
          (fun s i ->
            List.fold_left
              (fun s (p : Books.posting) ->
                if p.account = account then s + p.amount else s)
              s (Books.postings i))
          0 txns
      in
      { account; assigned = a; spent; available = a - spent })
    names

let cash (items : Item.t list) : Money.cents =
  List.fold_left
    (fun s a -> if prefix "Assets:" a then s + Books.balance items a else s)
    0 (Books.accounts items)

let to_assign (items : Item.t list) : Money.cents =
  cash items
  - List.fold_left
      (fun s e -> if e.available > 0 then s + e.available else s)
      0 (envelopes items)

let assign ~(id : string) (today : Civil.date) (envelope : string)
    (c : Money.cents) : Item.t =
  Item.make ~id ~stamps:[ "budget" ]
    [ ("envelope", Books.account_of ~amount:(-1) envelope);
      ("amount", Printf.sprintf "%s%d.%02d" (if c < 0 then "-" else "")
         (abs c / 100) (abs c mod 100));
      ("date", Civil.to_string today) ]
    ""

(* Envelopes: YNAB's "give every dollar a job" (You Need A Budget,
   Jesse Mecham, 2004; plan_pim.md's Money): the money there is assigned
   to envelopes before it is spent, each spending taken from one, so a
   budget is what one has, not a forecast. The envelopes of a
   household's kitchen drawer, on a screen.

       To assign: 1,037.60          <- the cash less what is in envelopes
       Groceries    400.00   42.17   357.83     assigned, spent,
       Rent         900.00  900.00     0.00     available (the next
       Utilities     50.00   62.40   -12.40     month's too: kept)

   In double entry an envelope costs little: it is an expense account
   (Expenses:Groceries), its spending what the books already post to
   it, and an assignment an item of its own:

       id: budget:1761900000.1
       stamp: budget
       envelope: Expenses:Groceries
       amount: 400.00
       date: 2026-11-01

   What is left in an envelope stays in it, month after month (YNAB's
   rule, unlike a monthly budget); one overspent is red, and what is to
   assign is the cash (the Assets: accounts) less what the envelopes
   hold. Moving money between envelopes is two assignments, one
   negative. *)

  available : Money.cents;

val assign : id:string -> Civil.date -> string -> Money.cents -> Item.t

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Events.mli *)

let minutes (s : string) : int option =
  match String.split_on_char ':' s with
  | [ h; m ] -> (
      match (int_of_string_opt h, int_of_string_opt m) with
      | Some h, Some m when h >= 0 && h < 24 && m >= 0 && m < 60 ->
          Some ((h * 60) + m)
      | _ -> None)
  | _ -> None

let clock (n : int) : string = Printf.sprintf "%d:%02d" (n / 60) (n mod 60)

let start (i : Item.t) : (Civil.date * int option) option =
  match String.split_on_char ' ' (String.trim (Item.field i "when")) with
  | [ d ] -> Option.map (fun d -> (d, None)) (Search.date d)
  | [ d; t ] -> Option.map (fun d -> (d, minutes t)) (Search.date d)
  | _ -> None

let length (i : Item.t) : int =
  match (start i, Search.date (Item.field i "ends")) with
  | Some (d, _), Some e ->
      max 1 (Civil.days_from_civil e - Civil.days_from_civil d + 1)
  | _ -> 1

(* each occurrence's first day, of those that cover a day of [from,
 * upto]: a repeat's computed, those the series skips (except:) left
 * out; with the item's length in days *)
let occurrences (i : Item.t) ~(from : Civil.date) ~(upto : Civil.date) :
    (Civil.date * int option) list =
  match start i with
  | None -> []
  | Some (day, time) ->
      let n = length i in
      (* (one begun before [from] that lasts into it) *)
      let from' = Civil.civil_from_days (Civil.days_from_civil from - n + 1) in
      let days =
        match Ics.rule_of_string (Item.field i "repeat") with
        | Some r when Item.field i "repeat" <> "" ->
            let at = match time with Some t -> t * 60 | None -> 0 in
            Recur.occurrences ~at r ~start:day ~from:from' ~upto
        | _ ->
            let k = Civil.days_from_civil day in
            if k >= Civil.days_from_civil from' && k <= Civil.days_from_civil upto
            then [ day ]
            else []
      in
      let except = String.split_on_char ' ' (Item.field i "except") in
      List.filter_map
        (fun d ->
          if List.mem (Civil.to_string d) except then None else Some (d, time))
        days

let spans (items : Item.t list) ~(from : Civil.date) ~(upto : Civil.date) :
    (Civil.date * int * Item.t) list =
  List.concat_map
    (fun i ->
      if (not (Item.has_stamp i "event")) || length i < 2 then []
      else List.map (fun (d, _) -> (d, length i, i)) (occurrences i ~from ~upto))
    items

let birthdays (items : Item.t list) ~(from : Civil.date) ~(upto : Civil.date)
    : (Civil.date * Item.t) list =
  let f = Civil.days_from_civil from and u = Civil.days_from_civil upto in
  List.concat_map
    (fun c ->
      let b = Item.field c "birthday" in
      (* "1980-03-15", or "--03-15" without its year *)
      let year, md =
        if String.length b = 10 && b.[4] = '-' then
          (int_of_string_opt (String.sub b 0 4), String.sub b 5 5)
        else if String.length b = 7 && String.sub b 0 2 = "--" then
          (None, String.sub b 2 5)
        else (None, "")
      in
      match
        ( Item.has_stamp c "contact",
          int_of_string_opt (String.sub (md ^ "00000") 0 2),
          int_of_string_opt (String.sub (md ^ "00000") 3 2) )
      with
      | true, Some month, Some day when md <> "" && month >= 1 && month <= 12 ->
          List.filter_map
            (fun y ->
              (* (the 29th of February, the 28th of the other years) *)
              let day = min day (Civil.days_in_month y month) in
              let d = { Civil.year = y; month; day } in
              let n = Civil.days_from_civil d in
              if n < f || n > u then None
              else
                let name = Item.field c "name" in
                let title =
                  match year with
                  | Some by when by < y ->
                      Printf.sprintf "%s's birthday (%d)" name (y - by)
                  | _ -> name ^ "'s birthday"
                in
                Some
                  ( d,
                    Item.make
                      ~id:("birthday:" ^ Item.id c ^ ":" ^ string_of_int y)
                      ~stamps:[ "event"; "birthday" ]
                      [ ("title", title); ("when", Civil.to_string d);
                        ("calendar", "birthdays"); ("re", Item.id c) ]
                      "" ))
            (List.init (upto.year - from.year + 1) (fun k -> from.year + k))
      | _ -> [])
    items

let between (items : Item.t list) ~(from : Civil.date) ~(upto : Civil.date) :
    (Civil.date * int option * Item.t) list =
  let f = Civil.days_from_civil from and u = Civil.days_from_civil upto in
  let all =
    List.map (fun (d, i) -> (d, None, i)) (birthdays items ~from ~upto)
    @ List.concat_map
      (fun i ->
        if not (Item.has_stamp i "event") then []
        else
          let n = length i in
          List.concat_map
            (fun (d, time) ->
              (* every day it covers in the range; its time on its first *)
              List.filter_map
                (fun k ->
                  let day = Civil.days_from_civil d + k in
                  if day < f || day > u then None
                  else
                    Some
                      (Civil.civil_from_days day, (if k = 0 then time else None), i))
                (List.init n (fun k -> k)))
            (occurrences i ~from ~upto))
      items
  in
  let key (d, t, _) =
    (Civil.days_from_civil d, match t with Some t -> t | None -> -1)
  in
  List.stable_sort (fun a b -> compare (key a) (key b)) all

(* a UTC moment at this place's clock (Zone): Google writes most times
 * in UTC *)
let local (zone : Zone.t) (m : Ics.moment) : Ics.moment =
  match m.time with
  | Some t when m.utc ->
      let u =
        (float_of_int (Civil.days_from_civil m.date) *. 86400.)
        +. float_of_int t
      in
      let date, minute = Zone.clock zone u in
      { date; time = Some (minute * 60); utc = false }
  | _ -> m

(* a uid as a file's name: no / in it *)
let safe (s : string) : string =
  String.map (fun c -> if c = '/' || c = ' ' then '-' else c) s

let of_ics (zone : Zone.t) ~(message : string) (text : string) : Item.t list =
  let cal = Ics.of_string text in
  let at (m : Ics.moment) =
    let m = local zone m in
    match m.time with
    | Some t -> Civil.to_string m.date ^ " " ^ clock (t / 60)
    | None -> Civil.to_string m.date
  in
  (* the dates a series skips: its EXDATEs, and those moved or cancelled
   * by an event of its UID with a RECURRENCE-ID *)
  let skipped (uid : string) : string list =
    List.concat_map
      (fun (e : Ics.event) ->
        if e.uid <> uid then []
        else
          (match e.recurrence_id with
          | Some r -> [ Civil.to_string (local zone r).date ]
          | None -> [])
          @ List.map (fun m -> Civil.to_string (local zone m).date) e.exdates)
      cal.events
  in
  List.filter_map
    (fun (e : Ics.event) ->
      if e.cancelled then None
      else
        let end_ =
          match e.end_ with
          | Some ({ time = Some _; _ } as m) -> (
              match (local zone m).time with
              | Some t -> [ ("end", clock (t / 60)) ]
              | None -> [])
          | _ -> []
        in
        (* its last day when it lasts more than one: a date's DTEND is
         * the day after (all day, RFC 5545), a time's its own *)
        let ends =
          match e.end_ with
          | Some m ->
              let m = local zone m in
              let last =
                Civil.days_from_civil m.date - if m.time = None then 1 else 0
              in
              let first = Civil.days_from_civil (local zone e.start).date in
              if last > first then
                [ ("ends", Civil.to_string (Civil.civil_from_days last)) ]
              else []
          | None -> []
        in
        let opt name v = if v = "" then [] else [ (name, v) ] in
        let id, repeat =
          match (e.recurrence_id, e.rrule) with
          | Some r, _ ->
              let day = Civil.to_string (local zone r).date in
              ("event:" ^ safe e.uid ^ "@" ^ day, [])
          | None, Some r ->
              ( "event:" ^ safe e.uid,
                ("repeat", Ics.rule_to_string r)
                :: opt "except" (String.concat " " (skipped e.uid)) )
          | None, None -> ("event:" ^ safe e.uid, [])
        in
        Some
          (Item.make ~id ~stamps:[ "event" ]
             (List.concat
                [ [ ("title", e.summary); ("when", at e.start) ]; end_; ends;
                  repeat;
                  opt "where" e.location; opt "re" message ])
             e.description))
    cal.events

(* Events: what the calendar shows, items stamped event (plan_pim.md,
   idea 1 and stage 3):

       id: event:1730193600.1
       stamp: event
       title: lunch with alice
       when: 2026-11-03 12:30             <- a day, and its time if it has
       end: 13:30                            one (a day's event has none)
       repeat: FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU       <- iCalendar's RRULE (Recur, Ics)
       where: the canteen
       with: contact:alice@ix             <- a link (Links)

   A repeating event is one item, its rule; its days are computed for
   the days a calendar shows (Recur.occurrences), never stored. Times
   are the author's clock's, no zone (Ics's floating time): the zone's
   rules wait for a second place to be in.

   An invitation (iMIP, RFC 6047: a mail with a text/calendar part,
   Ics) becomes such an item, linked to its message by re:. *)

(* "12:30" as minutes after midnight, and back *)
val minutes : string -> int option
val clock : int -> string

(* an event's first day and its time, from when: *)
val start : Item.t -> (Civil.date * int option) option

(* how many days it lasts: from its start to its ends: (its last day,
 * an event of several days: Rome, a trip), 1 without *)
val length : Item.t -> int

(* [spans items ~from ~upto]: the occurrences of the events of several
 * days that cover a day of those, each its first day (perhaps before
 * [from]) and its length: what a week's and a month's bars show *)
val spans :
  Item.t list -> from:Civil.date -> upto:Civil.date ->
  (Civil.date * int * Item.t) list

(* [birthdays items ~from ~upto]: the contacts' birthdays (birthday:
 * 1980-03-15, or --03-15 without its year: Vcard's) on those days, each
 * an event made for it, not kept: "Alice's birthday (46)", its
 * calendar "birthdays", re: the contact (o opens the person); the
 * 29th of February the 28th of the other years *)
val birthdays :
  Item.t list -> from:Civil.date -> upto:Civil.date ->
  (Civil.date * Item.t) list

(* [between items ~from ~upto]: the events' occurrences on those days,
 * the contacts' birthdays among them (birthdays)
 * (both included), an event of several days on each of its days (its
 * time on its first), by day, the day's events (no time) first, then
 * by time *)
val between :
  Item.t list -> from:Civil.date -> upto:Civil.date ->
  (Civil.date * int option * Item.t) list

(* [of_ics zone ~message text]: an invitation's or a calendar's events
 * as items, [message] the id of the mail they came in ("" for a file);
 * one of several days its ends: (a date's DTEND the day after its
 * last, RFC 5545's);
 * UTC times at [zone]'s clock, a TZID's as written (floating); a
 * cancelled event left out; an occurrence moved its own item
 * (event:uid@its date), the series skipping that date and its
 * EXDATEs (except: the days, which [between] leaves out) *)
val of_ics : Zone.t -> message:string -> string -> Item.t list

type t = Mail.t

let make ~(id : string) ~(stamps : string list)
    (fields : (string * string) list) (text : string) : t =

  match Mail.get t name with Some v -> v | None -> ""

    (Mail.get_all t "stamp")

let has_stamp (t : t) (stamp : string) : bool = List.mem stamp (stamps t)

let parse (text : string) : t = Mail.parse text
let to_string (t : t) : string = Mail.to_string t

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Items.mli *)

type t = { dir : string }

let place (caps : < Cap.env; .. >) : string =
  let env name =
    match CapSys.getenv caps name with
    | "" -> None
    | s -> Some s
    | exception Not_found -> None
  in
  match (env "PIM_STORE", env "HOME", env "home") with
  | Some d, _, _ -> d
  | None, Some h, _ -> Filename.concat h ".ix-pim"
  | None, None, Some h -> Filename.concat (Filename.concat h "lib") "pim"
  | None, None, None -> "pim"

let at (dir : string) : t = { dir }

(* a directory and those above it, made where they are not *)
let rec mkdir_p (caps : < Cap.open_out; .. >) (d : string) : unit =
  if d <> "/" && d <> "." && d <> "" && not (Sys.file_exists d) then begin
    mkdir_p caps (Filename.dirname d);
    try FS.mkdir caps d 0o755 with Unix.Unix_error _ -> ()
  end

(* an id as a file's name: no '/', no leading '.' *)
let file_name (id : string) : string =
  let s = String.map (fun c -> if c = '/' || c = '\\' then '_' else c) id in
  if s = "" || s.[0] = '.' then "_" ^ s else s

let path (t : t) (part : string) (name : string) : string =
  Filename.concat (Filename.concat t.dir part) (file_name name)

let find (caps : < Cap.open_in; .. >) (t : t) (id : string) : Item.t option =
  Option.map Item.parse (FS.read_opt caps (Fpath.v (path t "items" id)))

let save (caps : < Cap.open_out; .. >) (t : t) (item : Item.t) : unit =
  Logs.debug (fun m -> m "store: writing %s" (Item.id item));
  mkdir_p caps (Filename.concat t.dir "items");
  FS.write caps (Fpath.v (path t "items" (Item.id item))) (Item.to_string item)

let all (caps : < Cap.open_in; Cap.readdir; .. >) (t : t) : Item.t list =
  let dir = Filename.concat t.dir "items" in
  if not (Sys.file_exists dir) then begin
    Logs.debug (fun m -> m "store: no %s yet" dir);
    []
  end
  else
    let names = Array.to_list (Sys.readdir dir) in
    Logs.debug (fun m -> m "store: reading %d items of %s" (List.length names) dir);
    List.map
      (fun name -> Item.parse (FS.read caps (Fpath.v (Filename.concat dir name))))
      (List.sort compare names)

let cached (caps : < Cap.open_in; .. >) (t : t) (key : string) : string option =
  Logs.debug (fun m -> m "store: the cache's %s" key);
  FS.read_opt caps (Fpath.v (path t "cache" key))

let cache (caps : < Cap.open_out; .. >) (t : t) (key : string)
    (bytes : string) : unit =
  mkdir_p caps (Filename.concat t.dir "cache");
  FS.write caps (Fpath.v (path t "cache" key)) bytes

let remove (caps : < Cap.open_out; .. >) (t : t) (id : string) : unit =
  let p = path t "items" id in
  if Sys.file_exists p then FS.remove caps (Fpath.v p)

let secret (caps : < Cap.env; Cap.open_in; .. >) (name : string) :
    (string option, string) result =
  let file = Filename.concat (place caps) name in
  match Unix.stat file with
  | exception Unix.Unix_error _ ->
      Logs.info (fun m -> m "store: no %s" file);
      Ok None
  | st when st.st_perm land 0o077 <> 0 ->
      Error
        (Printf.sprintf "%s: others may read it (chmod 600 %s), not used"
           file file)
  | _ ->
      Logs.info (fun m -> m "store: reading %s" file);
      Ok (FS.read_opt caps (Fpath.v file))

let user (caps : < Cap.env; Cap.open_in; .. >) : string option =
  let file = Filename.concat (place caps) "user" in
  match FS.read_opt caps (Fpath.v file) with
  | Some text -> (
      match String.trim (List.hd (String.split_on_char '\n' text)) with
      | "" -> None
      | u ->
          Logs.info (fun m -> m "store: the user %s, from %s" u file);
          Some u)
  | None -> None

(* See Links.mli *)

(* the words of an item's fields but its id: and stamp:, each with its
 * field's name *)
let named (item : Item.t) : (string * string) list =
  List.concat_map
    (fun (f : Mail.field) ->
      let name = String.lowercase_ascii f.name in
      if name = "id" || name = "stamp" then []
      else
        let words =
          String.split_on_char ' '
            (String.map (fun c -> if c = ',' || c = '\t' then ' ' else c)
               (Mail.unfold f.raw))
        in
        List.filter_map
          (fun w -> if w = "" then None else Some (name, w))
          words)
    item.fields

(* the ids in [[ ]] of a text, a note's links (plan_pim.md, stage 7) *)
let bracketed (text : string) : string list =
  let n = String.length text in
  let rec from i acc =
    if i + 1 >= n then List.rev acc
    else if text.[i] = '[' && text.[i + 1] = '[' then
      let rec close j =
        if j + 1 >= n then None
        else if text.[j] = ']' && text.[j + 1] = ']' then Some j
        else if text.[j] = '\n' then None
        else close (j + 1)
      in
      match close (i + 2) with
      | Some j ->
          from (j + 2) (String.trim (String.sub text (i + 2) (j - i - 2)) :: acc)
      | None -> from (i + 2) acc
    else from (i + 1) acc
  in
  from 0 []

(* what an item names: its fields' words, and its text's [[ ]], named
 * "text" *)
let named (item : Item.t) : (string * string) list =
  named item @ List.map (fun id -> ("text", id)) (bracketed item.body)

let links (items : Item.t list) (item : Item.t) : (string * Item.t) list =
  let by_id = Hashtbl.create 64 in
  List.iter (fun i -> Hashtbl.replace by_id (Item.id i) i) items;
  List.filter_map
    (fun (name, w) ->
      match Hashtbl.find_opt by_id w with
      | Some i when Item.id i <> Item.id item -> Some (name, i)
      | _ -> None)
    (named item)

let backlinks (items : Item.t list) (item : Item.t) : (string * Item.t) list =
  let id = Item.id item in
  List.filter_map
    (fun i ->
      if Item.id i = id then None
      else
        match List.find_opt (fun (_, w) -> w = id) (named i) with
        | Some (name, _) -> Some (name, i)
        | None -> None)
    items

(* Claude Code

(* See People.mli *)

let lower = String.lowercase_ascii
let id (a : Mail.address) : string = "contact:" ^ lower a.mailbox

let of_sender (message : Item.t) : Item.t option =
  match Mail.address (Item.field message "from") with
  | None -> None
  | Some a ->
      let name =
        if a.display <> "" then Mime.decode_words a.display else a.mailbox
      in
      Some
        (Item.make ~id:(id a) ~stamps:[ "contact" ]
           [ ("name", name); ("email", lower a.mailbox) ]
           "")

let emails (contact : Item.t) : string list =
  List.map (fun v -> lower (String.trim v)) (Mail.get_all contact "email")

let contacts (items : Item.t list) : Item.t list =
  List.stable_sort
    (fun a b ->
      compare (lower (Item.field a "name")) (lower (Item.field b "name")))
    (List.filter (fun i -> Item.has_stamp i "contact") items)

(* the addresses of a message's From:, To: and Cc: *)
let addresses (m : Item.t) : string list =
  List.concat_map
    (fun f ->
      List.map
        (fun (a : Mail.address) -> lower a.mailbox)
        (Mail.addresses (Mime.decode_words (Item.field m f))))
    [ "from"; "to"; "cc" ]

let with_ (items : Item.t list) (contact : Item.t) : Item.t list =
  let mine = emails contact in
  let seconds (m : Item.t) =
    match Mail.date (Item.field m "date") with
    | Some d -> Mail.seconds d
    | None -> 0.
  in
  List.stable_sort
    (fun a b -> compare (seconds b) (seconds a))
    (List.filter
       (fun m ->
         Item.has_stamp m "message"
         && List.exists (fun a -> List.mem a mine) (addresses m))
       items)

let who (items : Item.t list) (address : string) : Item.t option =
  let a = lower address in
  List.find_opt
    (fun i -> Item.has_stamp i "contact" && List.mem a (emails i))
    items

(* See Remind.mli *)

let lead = 10

(* an event's minutes before, its remind: field's; None: "no" *)
let before (i : Item.t) : int option =
  match Item.field i "remind" with
  | "" -> Some lead
  | "no" -> None
  | s -> int_of_string_opt s

(* the reminders of [day], each its minute of the day (negative: the
 * day before's, an event just after midnight) *)
let of_day (items : Item.t list) (day : Civil.date) : (int * Item.t) list =
  let events =
    List.filter_map
      (fun (_, time, i) ->
        match (time, before i) with
        | Some t, Some b -> Some (t - b, i)
        | _ -> None)
      (Events.between items ~from:day ~upto:day)
  in
  (* a task's remind: "2026-11-03 9:00" *)
  let tasks =
    List.filter_map
      (fun i ->
        match String.split_on_char ' ' (Item.field i "remind") with
        | [ d; t ] when Item.has_stamp i "task" && Item.field i "done" = "" -> (
            match (Search.date d, Events.minutes t) with
            | Some d', Some m when d' = day -> Some (m, i)
            | _ -> None)
        | _ -> None)
      items
  in
  events @ tasks

let due (items : Item.t list) (day : Civil.date) ~(from : int) ~(upto : int) :
    (int * Item.t) list =
  let next =
    Civil.civil_from_days (Civil.days_from_civil day + 1)
  in
  let all =
    of_day items day
    @ List.map (fun (m, i) -> (m + 1440, i)) (of_day items next)
  in
  List.stable_sort
    (fun (a, _) (b, _) -> compare a b)
    (List.filter (fun (m, _) -> m >= from && m < upto) all)

let say (i : Item.t) : string =
  match Events.start i with
  | Some (_, Some t) when Item.has_stamp i "event" ->
      Search.title i ^ " at " ^ Events.clock t
  | _ -> Search.title i

  | Out -> "out"

let place (items : Item.t list) ~(account : string) :
    Imap.summary list -> place =
  (* (read once, then each conversation a lookup: a store of thousands
   * of messages read again at each list's load) *)
  let decided = Hashtbl.create 64 in
  let known = Hashtbl.create 256 in
  List.iter
    (fun i ->
      if Item.has_stamp i "sender" then
        Hashtbl.replace decided
          (String.lowercase_ascii (Item.field i "email"))
          (Item.field i "screen")
      else if Item.has_stamp i "contact" then
        List.iter (fun e -> Hashtbl.replace known e ()) (People.emails i))
    items;
  let on = since items in
  let me = String.lowercase_ascii account in
  fun (c : Imap.summary list) ->
    (* the newest message not the account's own *)
    match List.find_opt (fun s -> address s <> me) c with
    | None -> Imbox
    | Some s -> (
        let a = address s in
        match Hashtbl.find_opt decided a with
        | Some "feed" -> Feed
        | Some "paper" -> Paper
        | Some "out" -> Out
        | Some _ -> Imbox
        | None -> (
            if Hashtbl.mem known a then Imbox
            else
              match on with
              | None -> Imbox
              | Some day ->
                  (* (who wrote before the Screener was on is let in) *)
                  let before =
                    List.exists
                      (fun s ->
                        address s = a && Conversations.day s.headers < day)
                      c
                  in
                  if before then Imbox else Screener))

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Search.mli *)

type term =
  | Word of string
  | Field of string * string (* name, value *)
  | Is of string
  | Label of string
  | Before of Civil.date
  | After of Civil.date

(* each term, and whether it is negated *)
type t = (bool * term) list

let lower = String.lowercase_ascii

let contains (s : string) (word : string) : bool =
  let s = lower s and w = lower word in
  let n = String.length s and k = String.length w in
  let rec at i = i + k <= n && (String.sub s i k = w || at (i + 1)) in
  at 0

let date (s : string) : Civil.date option =
  match
    String.split_on_char '-'
      (String.map (fun c -> if c = '/' then '-' else c) s)
  with
  | [ y; m; d ] -> (
      match (int_of_string_opt y, int_of_string_opt m, int_of_string_opt d) with
      | Some year, Some month, Some day ->
          let d : Civil.date = { year; month; day } in
          if Civil.is_valid d then Some d else None
      | _ -> None)
  | _ -> None

(* the words of a query, a quoted phrase one *)
let tokens (q : string) : string list =
  let n = String.length q in
  let rec go i (cur : Buffer.t) (quoted : bool) (acc : string list) =
    let flush () =
      if Buffer.length cur = 0 then acc else Buffer.contents cur :: acc
    in
    if i >= n then List.rev (flush ())
    else
      match q.[i] with
      | '"' -> go (i + 1) cur (not quoted) acc
      | (' ' | '\t') when not quoted ->
          let acc = flush () in
          go (i + 1) (Buffer.create 8) false acc
      | c ->
          Buffer.add_char cur c;
          go (i + 1) cur quoted acc
  in
  go 0 (Buffer.create 8) false []

let term (tok : string) : term =
  match String.index_opt tok ':' with
  | None -> Word tok
  | Some i -> (
      let name = lower (String.sub tok 0 i) in
      let v = String.sub tok (i + 1) (String.length tok - i - 1) in
      match (name, date v) with
      | "is", _ -> Is (lower v)
      | "label", _ -> Label v
      | "before", Some d -> Before d
      | "after", Some d -> After d
      | _ -> Field (name, v))

let parse (q : string) : t =
  List.map
    (fun tok ->
      if String.length tok > 1 && tok.[0] = '-' then
        (true, term (String.sub tok 1 (String.length tok - 1)))
      else (false, term tok))
    (tokens q)

let day (item : Item.t) : Civil.date option =
  let field = Item.field item in
  let prefix s = if String.length s >= 10 then String.sub s 0 10 else s in
  match (date (prefix (field "due")), date (prefix (field "when"))) with
  | Some d, _ | None, Some d -> Some d
  | None, None -> (
      match Mail.date (field "date") with Some d -> Some d.day | None -> None)

let holds (item : Item.t) (t : term) : bool =
  let values =
    List.map (fun (f : Mail.field) -> Mail.unfold f.raw) item.fields
  in
  let word w = List.exists (fun v -> contains v w) (item.body :: values) in
  let compare_day f =
    match day item with Some d -> f (Civil.days_from_civil d) | None -> false
  in
  match t with
  | Word w -> word w
  | Field (name, v) ->
      if Mail.get item name <> None then contains (Item.field item name) v
      else word (name ^ ":" ^ v)
  | Is "unread" ->
      Item.has_stamp item "message"
      && not (contains (Item.field item "flags") "\\seen")
  | Is "read" ->
      Item.has_stamp item "message"
      && contains (Item.field item "flags") "\\seen"
  | Is stamp -> List.mem stamp (List.map lower (Item.stamps item))
  | Label l -> contains (Item.field item "labels") l
  | Before d -> compare_day (fun x -> x < Civil.days_from_civil d)
  | After d -> compare_day (fun x -> x >= Civil.days_from_civil d)

let matches (q : t) (item : Item.t) : bool =
  List.for_all (fun (negated, t) -> holds item t <> negated) q

let search (q : string) (items : Item.t list) : Item.t list =
  let q = parse q in
  List.filter (matches q) items

let title (item : Item.t) : string =
  match
    List.find_opt (fun v -> v <> "")
      (List.map (Item.field item) [ "subject"; "title"; "name"; "payee" ])
  with
  | Some v -> Mime.decode_words v
  | None -> (
      match String.split_on_char '\n' (String.trim item.body) with
      | l :: _ -> l
      | [] -> "")

       alice lunch          words: in any field's value, or the text

val title : Item.t -> string

(* See Today.mli *)

type kind = At of int option | Late | Due | Back | From of string

let to_do (items : Item.t list) (today : Civil.date) : Item.t list =
  let t = Civil.days_from_civil today in
  let later (i : Item.t) =
    match Search.date (Item.field i "until") with
    | Some d -> Civil.days_from_civil d > t
    | None -> false
  in
  List.filter
    (fun i ->
      Item.has_stamp i "task" && Item.field i "done" = ""
      && Item.field i "someday" = "" && not (later i))
    items

let day (i : Item.t) : int =
  match Search.day i with Some d -> Civil.days_from_civil d | None -> max_int

let late (items : Item.t list) (today : Civil.date) : Item.t list =
  let t = Civil.days_from_civil today in
  List.filter (fun i -> day i < t) (to_do items today)

let due (items : Item.t list) (today : Civil.date) : Item.t list =
  let t = Civil.days_from_civil today in
  List.filter (fun i -> day i = t) (to_do items today)

(* a bill (a task with postings) says its amount *)
let task (i : Item.t) : string =
  match Books.postings i with
  | p :: _ -> Search.title i ^ "   " ^ Money.to_string (abs p.amount)
  | [] -> Search.title i

let from_people (items : Item.t list) ~(account : string) :
    (kind * string) list =
  List.filter_map
    (fun c ->
      match c with
      | (last : Imap.summary) :: _ when Conversations.unread c -> (
          match Mail.address (Item.field last.headers "from") with
          | Some a when People.who items a.mailbox <> None ->
              Some
                ( From (Conversations.who last.headers),
                  Conversations.header last.headers "subject" )
          | _ -> None)
      | _ -> None)
    (Conversations.group (Mail_item.listed items ~account ~mailbox:"INBOX"))

let lines (items : Item.t list) ~(account : string) (today : Civil.date) :
    (kind * string) list =
  List.map
    (fun (_, time, i) -> (At time, Search.title i))
    (Events.between items ~from:today ~upto:today)
  @ List.map (fun i -> (Late, task i)) (late items today)
  @ List.map (fun i -> (Due, task i)) (due items today)
  @ List.filter_map
      (fun i ->
        if Item.field i "woke" <> "" then Some (Back, Search.title i) else None)
      items
  @ from_people items ~account

let page (items : Item.t list) (today : Civil.date) : string list =
  match
    List.find_opt (fun i -> Item.id i = "day:" ^ Mail_sync.day today) items
  with
  | Some i ->
      List.filter (fun l -> String.trim l <> "") (String.split_on_char '\n' i.body)
  | None -> []

let again (i : Item.t) : Item.t option =
  match (Ics.rule_of_string (Item.field i "repeat"), Search.day i) with
  | Some r, Some due when Item.field i "repeat" <> "" -> (
      let d = Civil.days_from_civil due in
      match
        Recur.occurrences ~at:0 r ~start:due
          ~from:(Civil.civil_from_days (d + 1))
          ~upto:(Civil.civil_from_days (d + 400))
      with
      | next :: _ ->
          (* (the same id and its day: task:rent.2026-12-05) *)
          let base =
            let id = Item.id i and n = String.length (Item.id i) in
            if
              n > 11 && id.[n - 11] = '.'
              && Search.date (String.sub id (n - 10) 10) <> None
            then String.sub id 0 (n - 11)
            else id
          in
          let id = base ^ "." ^ Mail_sync.day next in
          Some
            (Mail.set "id" id
               (Mail.set "due" (Mail_sync.day next)
                  (Mail.remove "done" (Mail.remove "until" i))))
      | [] -> None)
  | _ -> None

(* See Vcard.mli *)

type card = {
  name : string;
  emails : string list;
  phones : string list;
  birthday : string;
  org : string;
  note : string;
}

(* "item1.EMAIL" -> "EMAIL": Apple's and Google's groups *)
let ungrouped (n : string) : string =
  match String.rindex_opt n '.' with
  | Some i -> String.sub n (i + 1) (String.length n - i - 1)
  | None -> n

(* "19800315", "1980-03-15", "--0315", "--03-15" -> "1980-03-15",
 * "--03-15" *)
let day (v : string) : string =
  let d = String.concat "" (String.split_on_char '-' (String.trim v)) in
  let year_less = String.length v > 1 && String.sub v 0 2 = "--" in
  match String.length d with
  | 8 when not year_less ->
      Printf.sprintf "%s-%s-%s" (String.sub d 0 4) (String.sub d 4 2)
        (String.sub d 6 2)
  | 4 when year_less ->
      Printf.sprintf "--%s-%s" (String.sub d 0 2) (String.sub d 2 2)
  | _ -> ""

let card_of (props : (string * string) list) : card =
  let all n =
    List.filter_map (fun (k, v) -> if k = n then Some v else None) props
  in
  let one n = match all n with v :: _ -> v | [] -> "" in
  let name =
    match one "FN" with
    | "" -> (
        (* N: family; given; ... *)
        match String.split_on_char ';' (one "N") with
        | family :: given :: _ -> String.trim (given ^ " " ^ family)
        | [ family ] -> family
        | [] -> "")
    | fn -> fn
  in
  { name;
    emails =
      List.map (fun e -> String.lowercase_ascii (String.trim e)) (all "EMAIL");
    phones = List.map String.trim (all "TEL");
    birthday = day (one "BDAY");
    org =
      (match String.split_on_char ';' (one "ORG") with o :: _ -> o | [] -> "");
    note = one "NOTE" }

let of_string (s : string) : card list =
  let rec go lines current acc =
    match lines with
    | [] -> List.rev acc
    | (n, _, v) :: rest -> (
        match (ungrouped n, current) with
        | "BEGIN", _ when String.uppercase_ascii v = "VCARD" ->
            go rest (Some []) acc
        | "END", Some props when String.uppercase_ascii v = "VCARD" ->
            go rest None (card_of (List.rev props) :: acc)
        | n, Some props -> go rest (Some ((n, Ics.unescape v) :: props)) acc
        | _, None -> go rest None acc)
  in
  go (List.filter_map Ics.content_line (Ics.unfold s)) None []

(* "Jean Dupont" -> "jean-dupont": letters and digits (UTF-8's kept),
 * the rest a dash *)
let slug (s : string) : string =
  String.concat "-"
    (List.filter (fun w -> w <> "")
       (String.split_on_char ' '
          (String.map
             (fun ch ->
               match ch with
               | 'a' .. 'z' | '0' .. '9' -> ch
               | 'A' .. 'Z' -> Char.lowercase_ascii ch
               | _ when Char.code ch >= 128 -> ch
               | _ -> ' ')
             s)))

let to_item (c : card) : Item.t option =
  (* its id: its first address's, else its name's, its company's, its
   * phone's (a person of a phone's book has often no address) *)
  let id, shown =
    match c.emails with
    | first :: _ ->
        ( Some (People.id { display = c.name; mailbox = first }),
          if c.name = "" then first else c.name )
    | [] ->
        let named =
          List.find_opt (fun s -> slug s <> "")
            ([ c.name; c.org ] @ c.phones)
        in
        ( (match named with Some s -> Some ("contact:" ^ slug s) | None -> None),
          match named with Some s -> s | None -> "" )
  in
  match id with
  | None -> None
  | Some id ->
      let opt n v = if v = "" then [] else [ (n, v) ] in
      Some
        (Item.make ~id
           ~stamps:[ "contact" ]
           (List.concat
              [ [ ("name", shown) ];
                List.map (fun e -> ("email", e)) c.emails;
                List.map (fun p -> ("phone", p)) c.phones;
                opt "birthday" c.birthday; opt "org" c.org ])
           c.note)

let weekdays =
