let lookup (names : (string list * int) list) (w : string) : int option =
  List.find_map (fun (l, n) -> if List.mem w l then Some n else None) names

let month (w : string) : int option =
  lookup (List.mapi (fun i l -> (l, i + 1)) months) w

let today (caps : < Cap.open_in ; Cap.env ; .. >) : Civil.date =
  fst (Zone.clock (Zone.local caps) (CapUnix.gettimeofday caps ()))

let parse ~(today : Civil.date) (words : string) : Civil.date option =
  let t = Civil.days_from_civil today in
  let plus n = Some (Civil.civil_from_days (t + n)) in
  (* the next [wday], 1 to 7 days on *)
  let next wday =
    let d = (wday - Civil.weekday t + 7) mod 7 in
    plus (if d = 0 then 7 else d)
  in
  let ws =
    List.filter (fun w -> w <> "")
      (String.split_on_char ' ' (String.lowercase_ascii (String.trim words)))
  in
  let ws = match ws with ("in" | "dans") :: rest -> rest | l -> l in
  let count n unit =
    match unit with
    | "day" | "days" | "jour" | "jours" -> plus n
    | "week" | "weeks" | "semaine" | "semaines" -> plus (7 * n)
    | "month" | "months" | "mois" -> Some (Civil.add_months today n)
    | _ -> None
  in
  (* a month's day, this year's, else next year's *)
  let on m d =
    let in_year y : Civil.date = { year = y; month = m; day = d } in
    let this = in_year today.year in
    if not (Civil.is_valid this) then None
    else if Civil.days_from_civil this >= t then Some this
    else Some (in_year (today.year + 1))
  in
  match ws with
  | [ ("today" | "aujourd'hui") ] -> plus 0
  | [ ("tomorrow" | "demain") ] -> plus 1
  | [ ("weekend" | "week-end") ] | [ "this"; "weekend" ] -> next 6
  | [ "next"; "week" ] | [ "la"; "semaine"; "prochaine" ] -> next 1
  | [ "next"; "month" ] | [ "le"; "mois"; "prochain" ] ->
      Some (Civil.add_months today 1)
  | [ w ] when lookup weekdays w <> None -> (
      match lookup weekdays w with Some d -> next d | None -> None)
  | [ w ] when Search.date w <> None -> Search.date w
  | [ n; unit ] when int_of_string_opt n <> None -> (
      match (int_of_string_opt n, month unit) with
      | Some d, Some m -> on m d
      | Some n, None -> count n unit
      | None, _ -> None)
  | [ m; d ] when month m <> None -> (
      match (month m, int_of_string_opt d) with
      | Some m, Some d -> on m d
      | _ -> None)
  | _ -> None

let ending ~(today : Civil.date) (line : string) : string * Civil.date option =
  let ws = List.filter (fun w -> w <> "") (String.split_on_char ' ' line) in
  let n = List.length ws in
  let first k = List.filteri (fun i _ -> i < k) ws in
  let last k = List.filteri (fun i _ -> i >= n - k) ws in
  (* the longest tail that is a day, a word at least left before it *)
  let rec try_ k =
    if k = 0 then (String.concat " " ws, None)
    else if k >= n then try_ (k - 1)
    else
      match parse ~today (String.concat " " (last k)) with
      | Some d ->
          let title =
            match List.rev (first (n - k)) with
            | w :: rest
              when rest <> []
                   && List.mem (String.lowercase_ascii w)
                        [ "by"; "on"; "due"; "pour" ] ->
                List.rev rest
            | l -> List.rev l
          in
          (String.concat " " title, Some d)
      | None -> try_ (k - 1)
  in
  try_ 4

(* When: a day typed as words, the way a person says it (plan_pim.md,
   idea 5: snooze "monday", "in 3 days"; the recognizer's dates, idea

       today  tomorrow                     aujourd'hui  demain

  location : string;

let occurrences (e : event) ~(from : Civil.date) ~(upto : Civil.date) : Civil.date list =
  match e.rrule with
  | None ->
      let s = Civil.days_from_civil e.start.date in
      if s >= Civil.days_from_civil from && s <= Civil.days_from_civil upto then [ e.start.date ] else []
  | Some r -> Recur.occurrences
        ~at:(match e.start.time with Some t -> t | None -> 0) r ~start:e.start.date ~from ~upto

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Lines *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let unfold (s : string) : string list =
  let lines =
    String.split_on_char '\n' s
    |> List.map (fun l -> if String.ends_with ~suffix:"\r" l then String.sub l 0 (String.length l - 1) else l)
  in
  let continued l = String.length l > 0 && (l.[0] = ' ' || l.[0] = '\t') in
  List.fold_left
    (fun acc l ->
      match acc with
      | prev :: rest when continued l -> (prev ^ String.sub l 1 (String.length l - 1)) :: rest
      | _ -> l :: acc)
    [] lines
  |> List.rev |> List.filter (fun l -> l <> "")

let fold (line : string) : string =
  let n = String.length line in
  (* a byte continuing a UTF-8 character: 10xxxxxx *)
  let inside i = i < n && Char.code line.[i] land 0xC0 = 0x80 in
  let rec chunks from limit =
    if n - from <= limit then [ String.sub line from (n - from) ]
    else
      let cut = ref (from + limit) in
      while inside !cut do decr cut done;
      String.sub line from (!cut - from) :: chunks !cut 74 (* the space makes 75 *)
  in
  String.concat "\r\n " (chunks 0 75)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Content lines *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let content_line (l : string) : (string * (string * string) list * string) option =
  let n = String.length l in
  let rec upto i stops = if i < n && not (List.mem l.[i] stops) then upto (i + 1) stops else i in
  let name_end = upto 0 [ ';'; ':' ] in
  (* the parameters, from [i] (at a ';' or the ':') *)
  let rec params i acc =
    if i >= n then None
    else if l.[i] = ':' then Some (List.rev acc, String.sub l (i + 1) (n - i - 1))
    else
      let eq = upto (i + 1) [ '='; ';'; ':' ] in
      if eq >= n then None
      else if l.[eq] <> '=' then
        (* vCard 2.1's bare parameter: TEL;HOME:... is TYPE=HOME *)
        params eq (("TYPE", String.uppercase_ascii (String.sub l (i + 1) (eq - i - 1))) :: acc)
      else
        let pname = String.uppercase_ascii (String.sub l (i + 1) (eq - i - 1)) in
        let v_end =
          if eq + 1 < n && l.[eq + 1] = '"' then
            match String.index_from_opt l (eq + 2) '"' with Some q -> upto q [ ';'; ':' ] | None -> n
          else upto (eq + 1) [ ';'; ':' ]
        in
        let v = String.sub l (eq + 1) (v_end - eq - 1) in
        let v = if String.length v >= 2 && v.[0] = '"' then String.sub v 1 (String.length v - 2) else v in
        params v_end ((pname, v) :: acc)
  in
  if name_end = 0 || name_end >= n then None
  else
    Option.map
      (fun (ps, value) -> (String.uppercase_ascii (String.sub l 0 name_end), ps, value))
      (params name_end [])

let escape (s : string) : string =
  let b = Buffer.create (String.length s) in
  String.iter
    (function
      | '\\' -> Buffer.add_string b "\\\\"
      | ';' -> Buffer.add_string b "\\;"
      | ',' -> Buffer.add_string b "\\,"
      | '\n' -> Buffer.add_string b "\\n"
      | c -> Buffer.add_char b c)
    s;
  Buffer.contents b

let unescape (s : string) : string =
  let b = Buffer.create (String.length s) in
  let n = String.length s in
  let rec go i =
    if i < n then
      if s.[i] = '\\' && i + 1 < n then (
        Buffer.add_char b (match s.[i + 1] with 'n' | 'N' -> '\n' | c -> c);
        go (i + 2))
      else (
        Buffer.add_char b s.[i];
        go (i + 1))
  in
  go 0;
  Buffer.contents b

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Values *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let digits (s : string) (from : int) (len : int) : int option =
  if from + len > String.length s then None
  else
    let sub = String.sub s from len in
    if String.for_all (fun c -> c >= '0' && c <= '9') sub then int_of_string_opt sub else None

let moment_of_string (s : string) : moment option =
  let ( let* ) = Option.bind in
  let* year = digits s 0 4 in
  let* month = digits s 4 2 in
  let* day = digits s 6 2 in
  let date : Civil.date = { year; month; day } in
  if not (Civil.is_valid date) then None
  else
    match String.length s with
    | 8 -> Some { date; time = None; utc = false }
    | (15 | 16) when s.[8] = 'T' && (String.length s = 15 || s.[15] = 'Z') ->
        let* h = digits s 9 2 in
        let* m = digits s 11 2 in
        let* sec = digits s 13 2 in
        (* 60: a leap second, which the format allows *)
        if h > 23 || m > 59 || sec > 60 then None
        else Some { date; time = Some ((h * 3600) + (m * 60) + sec); utc = String.length s = 16 }
    | _ -> None

let moment_to_string (m : moment) : string =
  let d = Printf.sprintf "%04d%02d%02d" m.date.year m.date.month m.date.day in
  match m.time with
  | None -> d
  | Some t -> Printf.sprintf "%sT%02d%02d%02d%s" d (t / 3600) (t / 60 mod 60) (t mod 60) (if m.utc then "Z" else "")

let weekdays = [ "SU"; "MO"; "TU"; "WE"; "TH"; "FR"; "SA" ]

exception Unsupported

let rule_of_string (s : string) : Recur.rule option =
  let int_of v = match int_of_string_opt v with Some i -> i | None -> raise Unsupported in
  (* a weekday's two letters; "1FR" or "-1SU" (an ordinal) is refused *)
  let weekday v =
    let rec index i = function [] -> raise Unsupported | w :: rest -> if w = v then i else index (i + 1) rest in
    index 0 weekdays
  in
  let part (r : Recur.rule option) (kv : string) : Recur.rule option =
    match String.index_opt kv '=' with
    | None -> raise Unsupported
    | Some i -> (
        let k = String.uppercase_ascii (String.sub kv 0 i) and v = String.sub kv (i + 1) (String.length kv - i - 1) in
        let r = match r with Some r -> r | None -> Recur.make Daily in
        let list f = String.split_on_char ',' v |> List.map f in
        match k with
        | "FREQ" ->
            let freq : Recur.freq =
              match v with
              | "DAILY" -> Daily
              | "WEEKLY" -> Weekly
              | "MONTHLY" -> Monthly
              | "YEARLY" -> Yearly
              | _ -> raise Unsupported
            in
            Some { r with freq }
        | "INTERVAL" -> Some { r with interval = max 1 (int_of v) }
        | "COUNT" -> Some { r with count = Some (int_of v) }
        | "UNTIL" -> (
            match moment_of_string v with
            | Some { date; time = None; _ } -> Some { r with until = Some (Until_date date) }
            | Some { date; time = Some t; _ } -> Some { r with until = Some (Until_time (date, t)) }
            | None -> raise Unsupported)
        | "BYDAY" -> Some { r with by_day = list weekday }
        | "BYMONTHDAY" ->
            Some
              { r with
                by_month_day = list (fun d -> let d = int_of d in if d = 0 || abs d > 31 then raise Unsupported else d) }
        | "WKST" -> Some { r with week_start = weekday v }
        | _ -> raise Unsupported)
  in
  let parts = String.split_on_char ';' s |> List.filter (fun p -> p <> "") in
  let has k = List.exists (fun p -> String.starts_with ~prefix:(k ^ "=") (String.uppercase_ascii p)) parts in
  match List.fold_left part None parts with
  | exception Unsupported -> None
  | None -> None
  | Some r ->
      (* BYDAY and BYMONTHDAY mean other things under the other
       * frequencies (every Monday of the month...): refused *)
      if (not (has "FREQ")) || (r.by_day <> [] && r.freq <> Weekly) || (r.by_month_day <> [] && r.freq <> Monthly)
      then None
      else Some r

let rule_to_string (r : Recur.rule) : string =
  let freq = match r.freq with Daily -> "DAILY" | Weekly -> "WEEKLY" | Monthly -> "MONTHLY" | Yearly -> "YEARLY" in
  let weekday i = List.nth weekdays i in
  [ Some ("FREQ=" ^ freq);
    (if r.interval > 1 then Some (Printf.sprintf "INTERVAL=%d" r.interval) else None);
    (if r.week_start <> 1 then Some ("WKST=" ^ weekday r.week_start) else None);
    (if r.by_day <> [] then Some ("BYDAY=" ^ String.concat "," (List.map weekday r.by_day)) else None);
    (if r.by_month_day <> [] then Some ("BYMONTHDAY=" ^ String.concat "," (List.map string_of_int r.by_month_day))
     else None);
    Option.map (Printf.sprintf "COUNT=%d") r.count;
    Option.map
      (function
        | Recur.Until_date d -> "UNTIL=" ^ moment_to_string { date = d; time = None; utc = false }
        | Until_time (d, t) -> "UNTIL=" ^ moment_to_string { date = d; time = Some t; utc = false })
      r.until ]
  |> List.filter_map Fun.id |> String.concat ";"

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Components *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type property = string * (string * string) list * string
type component = { name : string; props : property list; children : component list }

(* the lines up to [name]'s END (or the end of the text), nested
 * components included *)
let rec component (name : string) (lines : property list) : component * property list =
  let rec go lines props children =
    match lines with
    | [] -> ({ name; props = List.rev props; children = List.rev children }, [])
    | ("END", _, v) :: rest when String.uppercase_ascii v = name ->
        ({ name; props = List.rev props; children = List.rev children }, rest)
    | ("BEGIN", _, v) :: rest ->
        let child, rest = component (String.uppercase_ascii v) rest in
        go rest props (child :: children)
    | p :: rest -> go rest (p :: props) children
  in
  go lines [] []

let value (c : component) (name : string) : string option =
  List.find_map (fun (n, _, v) -> if n = name then Some v else None) c.props

let text (c : component) (name : string) : string =
  match value c name with Some v -> unescape v | None -> ""
let moment (c : component) (name : string) : moment option = Option.bind (value c name) moment_of_string

let event_of (c : component) : event option =
  Option.map
    (fun start ->
      { uid = text c "UID";
        summary = text c "SUMMARY";
        description = text c "DESCRIPTION";
        location = text c "LOCATION";
        start;
        end_ = moment c "DTEND";
        (* a rule we can't follow: the first occurrence still shown *)
        rrule = Option.bind (value c "RRULE") rule_of_string;
        recurrence_id = moment c "RECURRENCE-ID";
        (* (each EXDATE line, each a list) *)
        exdates =
          List.concat_map
            (fun (n, _, v) ->
              if n = "EXDATE" then
                List.filter_map moment_of_string (String.split_on_char ',' v)
              else [])
            c.props;
        cancelled = value c "STATUS" = Some "CANCELLED" })
    (moment c "DTSTART")

let todo_of (c : component) : todo =
  { uid = text c "UID";
    summary = text c "SUMMARY";
    due = moment c "DUE";
    priority =
      (match Option.bind (value c "PRIORITY") int_of_string_opt with
      | Some p -> p
      | None -> 0);
    completed = value c "STATUS" = Some "COMPLETED" || value c "COMPLETED" <> None }

let of_string (s : string) : calendar =
  let root, _ = component "" (unfold s |> List.filter_map content_line) in
  (* the VCALENDAR's components, or the text's own if it has none *)
  let top = match List.find_opt (fun c -> c.name = "VCALENDAR") root.children with Some cal -> cal | None -> root in
  { events = List.filter_map (fun c -> if c.name = "VEVENT" then event_of c else None) top.children;
    todos = List.filter_map (fun c -> if c.name = "VTODO" then Some (todo_of c) else None) top.children }

let to_string ~(stamp : moment) (cal : calendar) : string =
  let line name value = [ name ^ ":" ^ value ] in
  let text name s = if s = "" then [] else line name (escape s) in
  let moment name (m : moment) =
    line (if m.time = None then name ^ ";VALUE=DATE" else name) (moment_to_string m)
  in
  let opt f = function Some x -> f x | None -> [] in
  let event (e : event) =
    List.concat
      [ line "BEGIN" "VEVENT"; line "UID" (escape e.uid); moment "DTSTAMP" stamp; moment "DTSTART" e.start;
        opt (moment "DTEND") e.end_; opt (fun r -> line "RRULE" (rule_to_string r)) e.rrule;
        text "SUMMARY" e.summary; text "DESCRIPTION" e.description; text "LOCATION" e.location;
        line "END" "VEVENT" ]
  in
  let todo (t : todo) =
    List.concat
      [ line "BEGIN" "VTODO"; line "UID" (escape t.uid); moment "DTSTAMP" stamp; text "SUMMARY" t.summary;
        opt (moment "DUE") t.due;
        (if t.priority > 0 then line "PRIORITY" (string_of_int t.priority) else []);
        (if t.completed then line "STATUS" "COMPLETED" else []);
        line "END" "VTODO" ]
  in
  List.concat
    [ line "BEGIN" "VCALENDAR"; line "VERSION" "2.0"; line "PRODID" "-//ocaml-elm-playground//Tiny//EN";
      List.concat_map event cal.events; List.concat_map todo cal.todos; line "END" "VCALENDAR" ]
  |> List.map fold |> List.map (fun l -> l ^ "\r\n") |> String.concat ""
apps/pim/time/Ics.mli
4410
(* Ics: iCalendar files, read and written (the subset a calendar and a
   to-do list use).

   The format every calendar exchanges since 1998 (RFC 2445, now
   5545): text, a property per line, components between BEGIN and END,
   the same shape as vCard (Vcard.mli), the address books' format,
   from the same Versit consortium:

       BEGIN:VCALENDAR
       VERSION:2.0
       PRODID:-//ocaml-elm-playground//Tiny//EN
       BEGIN:VEVENT
       UID:1@tiny
       DTSTAMP:20260924T120000Z
       DTSTART:20260928T090000               <- floating: 9:00 wherever
       DTEND:20260928T100000
       RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,TH         <- Recur.mli
       SUMMARY:Standup\, then coffee         <- a comma escaped
       END:VEVENT
       BEGIN:VTODO
       UID:2@tiny
       SUMMARY:Write the plan
       DUE;VALUE=DATE:20261001               <- a date, no time
       PRIORITY:1
       END:VTODO
       END:VCALENDAR

   Three layers, each in its function below:
   - lines: a line longer than 75 bytes is *folded*, cut and continued
     on the next line after a space ([fold], [unfold]), the line
     length limit of the e-mails the format was meant to travel in;
   - a content line: NAME;PARAM=value;...:value ([content_line]), text
     values escaping \ ; , and newlines ([escape]);
   - values: dates (20260928), date-times (20260928T090000, with a Z if
     UTC), and RRULE's rules ([rule_of_string]).

   Read leniently, as the RFC asks: unknown properties and components
   (VTIMEZONE, an event's VALARM) are skipped, a component missing
   what it needs (an event without DTSTART) is dropped. A TZID is read
   as floating time: this program has no tz database (plan_pim.md).

   Worked example: RFC 5545's first example (section 4), a conference
   with a description folded over three lines, in the tests. *)

(* a date, or a date and a time of day (seconds after midnight), UTC
 * or floating (the same clock time wherever you are) *)
type moment = { date : Civil.date; time : int option; utc : bool }

type event = {
  uid : string;
  summary : string;
  description : string;
  location : string;
  start : moment;
  end_ : moment option;
  rrule : Recur.rule option;
  (* ix: what Google's calendars write. An occurrence moved: the
   * series' UID, and the date it replaces (RECURRENCE-ID); the
   * occurrences taken off a series (EXDATE); STATUS:CANCELLED *)
  recurrence_id : moment option;
  exdates : moment list;
  cancelled : bool;
}

type todo = {
  uid : string;
  summary : string;
  due : moment option;
  priority : int; (* 1 the highest .. 9, 0 none *)
  completed : bool;
}

type calendar = { events : event list; todos : todo list }

(* the days [e] happens on between [from] and [upto] (both included):
 * its start's, or its rule's occurrences (Recur.occurrences) *)
val occurrences : event -> from:Civil.date -> upto:Civil.date -> Civil.date list

(* the file's text, leniently (see above); never raises *)
val of_string : string -> calendar

(* [to_string ~stamp cal]: the file's text, CRLF line ends, folded.
 * [stamp] is when it is written (every VEVENT's required DTSTAMP): a
 * library reads no clock, the caller gives the time *)
val to_string : stamp:moment -> calendar -> string

(* {2 The layers, shared with Vcard} *)

(* the logical lines of a text: CRLF or LF ends, a line starting with
 * a space or a tab continuing the one before (without that character);
 * empty lines dropped *)
val unfold : string -> string list

(* a logical line cut into lines of at most 75 bytes, joined by CRLF
 * and a space, never inside a UTF-8 character *)
val fold : string -> string

(* [content_line "DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:20261001"]:
 * ("DTSTART", [("VALUE", "DATE")], "20261001"), the names uppercased,
 * a quoted parameter value's ':' and ';' not ending it; a bare
 * parameter (vCard 2.1's TEL;HOME:...) read as ("TYPE", "HOME") *)
val content_line : string -> (string * (string * string) list * string) option

(* TEXT values: \\ \; \, and \n (or \N) for a newline *)
val escape : string -> string
val unescape : string -> string

val moment_of_string : string -> moment option
val moment_to_string : moment -> string

 * None for what Recur.mli leaves out (an ordinal BYDAY, BYSETPOS, ...) *)
val rule_of_string : string -> Recur.rule option
val rule_to_string : Recur.rule -> string

(* ix: the author's playground's libs/core/time/Recur.ml
 * (plan_pim.md, stage 3); occurrences' ~at said by every caller, its
 * polymorphic variant a type *)

(* See Recur.mli *)

type freq = Daily | Weekly | Monthly | Yearly
type until = Until_date of Civil.date | Until_time of Civil.date * int

type rule = {
  freq : freq;
  interval : int;
  by_day : int list;
  by_month_day : int list;
  week_start : int;
  count : int option;
  until : until option;
}

let make (freq : freq) : rule =
  { freq; interval = 1; by_day = []; by_month_day = []; week_start = 1; count = None; until = None }

(* the [k]th period's first day, and the days picked in it, as day
 * numbers, in order *)
let period (r : rule) (start : Civil.date) (k : int) : int * int list =
  let s = Civil.days_from_civil start in
  let n = k * r.interval in
  match r.freq with
  | Daily -> (s + n, [ s + n ])
  | Weekly ->
      (* the week holding the start, from its [week_start] *)
      let first = s - (((Civil.weekday s - r.week_start) + 7) mod 7) + (7 * n) in
      let days = if r.by_day = [] then [ Civil.weekday s ] else r.by_day in
      (first, List.map (fun wd -> first + (((wd - r.week_start) + 7) mod 7)) days |> List.sort_uniq compare)
  | Monthly ->
      let m = Civil.add_months { start with day = 1 } n in
      let last = Civil.days_in_month m.year m.month in
      let days = if r.by_month_day = [] then [ start.day ] else r.by_month_day in
      let first = Civil.days_from_civil m in
      ( first,
        days
        |> List.map (fun d -> if d < 0 then last + 1 + d else d)
        |> List.filter (fun d -> d >= 1 && d <= last)
        |> List.map (fun d -> first + d - 1)
        |> List.sort_uniq compare )
  | Yearly ->
      let y = start.year + n in
      let d : Civil.date = { start with year = y } in
      (Civil.days_from_civil { year = y; month = 1; day = 1 }, if Civil.is_valid d then [ Civil.days_from_civil d ] else [])

(* what picking a period's days found: go on, or the rule has ended *)
type picked = More of int * int list | Done of int list

let occurrences ~(at : int) (r : rule) ~(start : Civil.date) ~(from : Civil.date) ~(upto : Civil.date) : Civil.date list =
  let s = Civil.days_from_civil start in
  let from = Civil.days_from_civil from and upto = Civil.days_from_civil upto in
  let within_until (n : int) =
    match r.until with
    | None -> true
    | Some (Until_date u) -> n <= Civil.days_from_civil u
    | Some (Until_time (u, t)) ->
        let u = Civil.days_from_civil u in
        n < u || (n = u && at <= t)
  in
  (* period by period; [seen]: the occurrences so far, for [count] *)
  let rec go k seen acc =
    let first, days = period r start k in
    if first > upto then List.rev acc
    else
      let rec pick days seen acc =
        match days with
        | [] -> More (seen, acc)
        | n :: rest ->
            if n < s then pick rest seen acc
            else if (match r.count with Some c -> seen >= c | None -> false) || not (within_until n) || n > upto then
              Done acc
            else pick rest (seen + 1) (if n >= from then n :: acc else acc)
      in
      match pick days seen acc with
      | Done acc -> List.rev acc
      | More (seen, acc) -> go (k + 1) seen acc
  in
  go 0 0 [] |> List.map Civil.civil_from_days
apps/pim/time/Recur.mli

(* Recur: a repeating event as a rule, not a list.

   "Every other week on Monday, Wednesday and Friday until Christmas"
   is a rule; its dates are computed when a calendar shows a window
   of days, and never stored -- a rule with no end has infinitely
   many. This is iCalendar's RRULE (RFC 5545, 3.3.10), its common
   subset; the text form ("FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=MO,WE,FR") is
   Ics.mli's business, this module is what it means.

   A rule cuts time into periods (days, weeks, months or years, every
   [interval]th one from the start's) and picks days in each:

       FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=MO,WE,FR, from Monday 1997-09-01

       week of   Sep 1       Sep 8     Sep 15      Sep 22    Sep 29
                 M . W . F   (skip)    M . W . F   (skip)    M . W . F
                 1   3   5             15  17  19            29 ...

   The picking, per frequency:
   - DAILY: the period's day;
   - WEEKLY: the [by_day] weekdays (the start's if none), the week
     beginning on [week_start] (Monday unless WKST says otherwise);
   - MONTHLY: the [by_month_day] days (the start's day if none), -1 the
     last, -3 the third-to-last; a month without the day is skipped
     (the 31st: no February, no April);
   - YEARLY: the start's month and day (a 29 February: leap years only).

   Then the occurrences before the start are dropped, and the rule ends
   after [count] of them, or after [until], or never.

   Worked examples: RFC 5545's own (3.8.5.3), in the tests, e.g. the
   one above: Sep 1, 3, 5, 15, 17, 19, 29, ... until Dec 22.

   Left out (a rule using them is refused by Ics.rule_of_string rather
   than misread): BYDAY with an ordinal (the 1st Friday, 1FR), BYMONTH,
   BYYEARDAY, BYWEEKNO, BYSETPOS, and the sub-day frequencies
   (HOURLY...).

   Reference: RFC 5545, "Internet Calendaring and Scheduling Core
   Object Specification (iCalendar)" (Bernard Desruisseaux, 2009). *)

type freq = Daily | Weekly | Monthly | Yearly

(* the last occurrence allowed: a day, or a day and a time (seconds
 * after midnight), compared with the occurrence's own time *)
type until = Until_date of Civil.date | Until_time of Civil.date * int

type rule = {
  freq : freq;
  interval : int; (* every [interval]th period, 1 or more *)
  by_day : int list; (* weekdays, 0 Sunday .. 6 Saturday (WEEKLY) *)
  by_month_day : int list; (* 1..31 or -31..-1 (MONTHLY) *)
  week_start : int; (* a weekday, 1 (Monday) by default *)
  count : int option;
  until : until option;
}

(* [make freq]: every period, no end *)
val make : freq -> rule

(* [occurrences ~at rule ~start ~from ~upto]: the days the event
 * happens on between [from] and [upto] (both included), in order.
 * [start] is the first one (DTSTART), [at] its time of day in seconds
 * (0 for a day's event), which only [Until_time] looks at. Computed from
 * [start], since [count] counts from there. *)
val occurrences :
  at:int -> rule -> start:Civil.date -> from:Civil.date -> upto:Civil.date -> Civil.date list

(* See Zone.mli *)

(* a rule of POSIX's TZ, "CET-1CEST,M3.5.0,M10.5.0/3": the offsets east
 * of UTC in seconds, and when summer time begins and ends, each a
 * month, a week (5 the last), a weekday (0 Sunday), and the second of
 * the local day *)
type change = { month : int; week : int; wday : int; at : int }

type rule = { std : int; dst : (int * change * change) option }

type t = {
  (* from each UTC second on, the offset, the oldest first *)
  transitions : (float * int) list;
  first : int; (* before the first *)
  rule : rule option; (* after the last *)
}

let utc : t = { transitions = []; first = 0; rule = None }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* POSIX's rule, the footer of a TZif file *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* "-1", "5", "-3:30", "2", "/3": hours[:minutes[:seconds]] *)
let hms (s : string) : int option =
  let neg = String.length s > 0 && s.[0] = '-' in
  let s =
    if String.length s > 0 && (s.[0] = '-' || s.[0] = '+') then
      String.sub s 1 (String.length s - 1)
    else s
  in
  let parts = List.map int_of_string_opt (String.split_on_char ':' s) in
  if parts = [] || List.mem None parts then None
  else
    let n =
      List.fold_left ( + ) 0
        (List.mapi
           (fun k p ->
             (match p with Some p -> p | None -> 0)
             * (match k with 0 -> 3600 | 1 -> 60 | _ -> 1))
           parts)
    in
    Some (if neg then -n else n)

(* the name: letters, or anything between < > ("<+03>") *)
let name (s : string) (i : int) : int =
  let n = String.length s in
  if i < n && s.[i] = '<' then
    match String.index_from_opt s i '>' with Some j -> j + 1 | None -> n
  else
    let rec go j =
      if j < n && ((s.[j] >= 'a' && s.[j] <= 'z') || (s.[j] >= 'A' && s.[j] <= 'Z'))
      then go (j + 1)
      else j
    in
    go i

(* the offset after a name: the digits, signs and colons *)
let number (s : string) (i : int) : int =
  let n = String.length s in
  let rec go j =
    if j < n && (String.contains "+-:" s.[j] || (s.[j] >= '0' && s.[j] <= '9'))
    then go (j + 1)
    else j
  in
  go i

(* "M3.5.0/3" *)
let change (s : string) : change option =
  let s, at =
    match String.index_opt s '/' with
    | Some i ->
        (String.sub s 0 i, hms (String.sub s (i + 1) (String.length s - i - 1)))
    | None -> (s, Some 7200)
  in
  match (String.length s > 1 && s.[0] = 'M', at) with
  | true, Some at -> (
      match
        List.map int_of_string_opt
          (String.split_on_char '.' (String.sub s 1 (String.length s - 1)))
      with
      | [ Some month; Some week; Some wday ] -> Some { month; week; wday; at }
      | _ -> None)
  | _ -> None

let rule (s : string) : rule option =
  let s = String.trim s in
  let a = name s 0 in
  let b = number s a in
  (* (POSIX's offsets are west of UTC: CET-1 is an hour east) *)
  match hms (String.sub s a (b - a)) with
  | None -> None
  | Some west -> (
      let std = -west in
      let c = name s b in
      if c = b then Some { std; dst = None }
      else
        let d = number s c in
        let dst =
          if d = c then Some (std + 3600)
          else
            match hms (String.sub s c (d - c)) with
            | Some w -> Some (-w)
            | None -> None
        in
        match
          (dst, String.split_on_char ',' (String.sub s d (String.length s - d)))
        with
        | Some dst, [ ""; b; e ] -> (
            match (change b, change e) with
            | Some b, Some e -> Some { std; dst = Some (dst, b, e) }
            | _ -> None)
        | _ -> None)

(* the day number of a change in [year]: its week's weekday in the
 * month, the 5th the last *)
let day_of (year : int) (c : change) : int =
  let first = Civil.days_from_civil { year; month = c.month; day = 1 } in
  let d = first + ((c.wday - Civil.weekday first + 7) mod 7) + ((c.week - 1) * 7) in
  let last = first + Civil.days_in_month year c.month - 1 in
  if d > last then d - (7 * ((d - last + 6) / 7)) else d

let rule_offset (r : rule) (t : float) : int =
  match r.dst with
  | None -> r.std
  | Some (dst, b, e) ->
      let year =
        (Civil.civil_from_days
           (int_of_float (Float.floor ((t +. float_of_int r.std) /. 86400.))))
          .year
      in
      (* the changes' UTC seconds: the start said in standard time, the
       * end in summer time *)
      let utc_of (c : change) (off : int) =
        (float_of_int (day_of year c) *. 86400.) +. float_of_int (c.at - off)
      in
      let s = utc_of b r.std and e = utc_of e dst in
      let summer = if s < e then t >= s && t < e else t >= s || t < e in
      if summer then dst else r.std

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The files *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let be32 (s : string) (i : int) : int =
  let b k = Char.code s.[i + k] in
  let n = (b 0 lsl 24) lor (b 1 lsl 16) lor (b 2 lsl 8) lor b 3 in
  if n land 0x80000000 <> 0 then n - 0x100000000 else n

(* TZif (RFC 8536), version 1's data, 32-bit times to 2037, and the
 * footer's rule after them *)
let of_tzif (s : string) : t option =
  if String.length s < 44 || String.sub s 0 4 <> "TZif" then None
  else
    let count k = be32 s (20 + (4 * k)) in
    let isut = count 0 and isstd = count 1 and leap = count 2 in
    let times = count 3 and types = count 4 and chars = count 5 in
    let at = 44 in
    let idx = at + (4 * times) in
    let info = idx + times in
    let size =
      info + (6 * types) + chars + (8 * leap) + isstd + isut
    in
    if String.length s < size || types = 0 then None
    else
      let offset k = be32 s (info + (6 * k)) in
      let transitions =
        List.init times (fun k ->
            (float_of_int (be32 s (at + (4 * k))), offset (Char.code s.[idx + k])))
      in
      (* the rule: between the last two newlines *)
      let rule =
        if s.[4] = '\000' then None
        else
          match String.rindex_opt s '\n' with
          | Some j when j > 0 -> (
              match String.rindex_from_opt s (j - 1) '\n' with
              | Some i -> rule (String.sub s (i + 1) (j - i - 1))
              | None -> None)
          | _ -> None
      in
      Some { transitions; first = offset 0; rule }

(* Plan 9's /env/timezone: "CET 3600 CEST 7200", then the UTC seconds
 * where the offset changes, summer's first, each other one *)
let of_plan9 (s : string) : t option =
  match
    List.filter (fun w -> w <> "")
      (String.split_on_char ' '
         (String.map (fun c -> if c = '\n' || c = '\t' then ' ' else c) s))
  with
  | _ :: std :: _ :: dst :: times -> (
      match (int_of_string_opt std, int_of_string_opt dst) with
      | Some std, Some dst ->
          let transitions =
            List.mapi
              (fun k t -> (float_of_string t, if k mod 2 = 0 then dst else std))
              (List.filter (fun t -> float_of_string_opt t <> None) times)
          in
          Some { transitions; first = std; rule = Some { std; dst = None } }
      | _ -> None)
  | _ -> None

let offset (z : t) (t : float) : int =
  let rec go (last : int option) l =
    match l with
    | (u, off) :: rest when u <= t -> go (Some off) rest
    | [] -> (
        match (z.rule, last) with
        | Some r, _ -> rule_offset r t
        | None, Some off -> off
        | None, None -> z.first)
    | _ -> ( match last with Some off -> off | None -> z.first)
  in
  go None z.transitions

let local (caps : < Cap.open_in ; Cap.env ; .. >) : t =
  let read path = try Some (FS.read caps (Fpath.v path)) with _ -> None in
  let tz = try CapSys.getenv caps "TZ" with Not_found -> "" in
  let from_file path =
    match read path with
    | Some s -> (
        match of_tzif s with Some z -> Some z | None -> of_plan9 s)
    | None -> None
  in
  let found =
    if tz = "UTC" || tz = "UTC0" then Some utc
    else if tz <> "" && tz.[0] = ':' then
      from_file ("/usr/share/zoneinfo/" ^ String.sub tz 1 (String.length tz - 1))
    else if tz <> "" then
      match from_file ("/usr/share/zoneinfo/" ^ tz) with
      | Some z -> Some z
      | None -> (
          match rule tz with
          | Some r -> Some { utc with rule = Some r }
          | None -> None)
    else
      match from_file "/etc/localtime" with
      | Some z -> Some z
      | None -> from_file "/env/timezone"
  in
  match found with Some z -> z | None -> utc

let clock (z : t) (t : float) : Civil.date * int =
  let local = Float.floor (t +. float_of_int (offset z t)) in
  let days = int_of_float (Float.floor (local /. 86400.)) in
  let seconds = int_of_float (local -. (float_of_int days *. 86400.)) in
  (Civil.civil_from_days days, seconds / 60)

(* Zone: the local time, a zone's offsets from UTC through the year
   (plan_pim.md, stage 3: "the zone's rules from the system's zoneinfo
   on Linux, /env/timezone on mini-9pi"). ix's own: mini-ml's Unix has
   gmtime and no localtime, and the C library's zone is not ix's.

       /etc/localtime (TZif, RFC 8536)       the zone's history: from
       +--------+---------------+--------+   each UTC second on, an
       | header | transitions   | footer |   offset; the footer
       | TZif2  | 1980... 2037  | CET-1CEST,M3.5.0,M10.5.0/3
       +--------+---------------+--------+   POSIX's rule, the years
                                             after the last transition

   M3.5.0 is March's last Sunday (the month, the 5th week, Sunday),
   at 2:00 local unless /time says. A "slim" file has few transitions,
   its rule all the rest; this reads both. Plan 9's file is a line
   "CET 3600 CEST 7200" and the UTC seconds where it changes, summer's
   first. TZ= is looked at first (UTC, a zone's name, a POSIX rule),
   then /etc/localtime, then /env/timezone, else UTC.

   Not here: leap seconds (UTC's seconds count none), the zone's name
   (CET, CEST), the rules Jn and n of POSIX (a day of the year), which
   no zone of the tz database writes. *)

(* See Calendar_window.mli *)

open Playground
open Pim_look

type caps = Mail_window.caps

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The model *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type span = Day | Week | Month
type mode = Browsing | Asking

type model = {
  span : span;
  cursor : Civil.date; (* the day selected *)
  today : Civil.date;
  (* the occurrences of the days shown *)
  shown : (Civil.date * int option * Item.t) list;
  (* the events of several days among them, each its first day and its
   * length: the week's and the month's bars *)
  spans : (Civil.date * int * Item.t) list;
  selected : int; (* in the day's list *)
  mode : mode;
  field : string; (* an event typed *)
  status : string;
  held : string Set_.t;
}

let store (caps : caps) : Items.t = Items.at (Items.place caps)

let days (d : Civil.date) : int = Civil.days_from_civil d
let date (n : int) : Civil.date = Civil.civil_from_days n

(* the week's Monday (ISO 8601's week, Europe's) *)
let monday (d : Civil.date) : Civil.date =
  date (days d - ((Civil.weekday (days d) + 6) mod 7))

(* the month's grid: from the Monday of its first week, six weeks *)
let grid_start (d : Civil.date) : Civil.date = monday { d with day = 1 }

let range (m : model) : Civil.date * Civil.date =
  match m.span with
  | Day -> (m.cursor, m.cursor)
  | Week -> (monday m.cursor, date (days (monday m.cursor) + 6))
  | Month -> (grid_start m.cursor, date (days (grid_start m.cursor) + 41))

let load (caps : caps) (m : model) : model =
  let from, upto = range m in
  let items = Items.all caps (store caps) in
  let shown = Events.between items ~from ~upto in
  let n = List.length (List.filter (fun (d, _, _) -> d = m.cursor) shown) in
  { m with shown; spans = Events.spans items ~from ~upto;
    selected = max 0 (min m.selected (n - 1)) }

let initial (caps : caps) (flags : Playground.flags) : model =
  let today =
    match List.assoc_opt "today" flags with
    | Some d -> (
        match Search.date d with Some d -> d | None -> When.today caps)
    | None -> When.today caps
  in
  load caps
    { span = Week; cursor = today; today; shown = []; spans = []; selected = 0;
      mode = Browsing; field = ""; status = ""; held = Set_.empty }

let refresh (caps : caps) (keys : string Set_.t) (m : model) : model =
  load caps { m with held = keys }

let on (m : model) (d : Civil.date) : (Civil.date * int option * Item.t) list =
  List.filter (fun (d', _, _) -> d' = d) m.shown

(* the event [id]'s day, it selected *)
let show (caps : caps) (m : model) (id : string) : model =
  match Option.bind (Items.find caps (store caps) id) Events.start with
  | None -> { m with status = id ^ ": not an event" }
  | Some (d, _) ->
      let m = load caps { m with span = Day; cursor = d; selected = 0 } in
      let rec find k l =
        match l with
        | [] -> 0
        | (_, _, i) :: rest -> if Item.id i = id then k else find (k + 1) rest
      in
      { m with selected = find 0 (on m d); status = "" }

type command =

  | Next_period
  | Previous_period
  | Today

let menus : (string * (string * command) list) list =

let made = ref 0

let create (caps : caps) (m : model) (line : string) : model =
  let st = store caps in
  let people = People.contacts (Items.all caps st) in
  (* (the words' days from today, as the line says them) *)
  let e = Capture.event ~today:m.today ~people line in
  if String.trim e.title = "" then m
  else begin
    incr made;
    let id = Printf.sprintf "event:%.0f.%d" (CapUnix.gettimeofday caps ()) !made in
    Items.save caps st (Capture.to_item ~id e);
    let m = load caps { m with cursor = e.day } in
    { m with
      status =
        e.title ^ ", " ^ Civil.to_string e.day
        ^ (match e.time with Some t -> " " ^ Events.clock t | None -> "") }
  end

let step (caps : caps) (m : model) (by : int) : model =
  load caps { m with cursor = date (days m.cursor + by); selected = 0 }

let command (caps : caps) (m : model) (c : command) : model * go option =
  match c with
  | Get -> (
      (* Google's, read (Calendars): the store's calendars file's *)
      match Calendars.sources caps with
      | Error e -> ({ m with status = e }, None)
      | Ok [] ->
          ({ m with status = "no calendars: see Calendars.mli" }, None)
      | Ok l ->
          let said =
            List.map
              (fun (s : Calendars.source) ->
                match Calendars.fetch caps s with
                | Ok (saved, removed) ->
                    Printf.sprintf "%s %d new, %d gone" s.name saved removed
                | Error e -> e)
              l
          in
          (load caps { m with status = String.concat "; " said }, None))
  | Create -> ({ m with mode = Asking; field = ""; status = "" }, None)
  | Today -> (load caps { m with cursor = m.today; selected = 0 }, None)
  | Day_ -> (load caps { m with span = Day; selected = 0 }, None)
  | Week_ -> (load caps { m with span = Week }, None)
  | Month_ -> (load caps { m with span = Month }, None)
  | Next_period | Previous_period -> (
      let sign = if c = Next_period then 1 else -1 in
      match m.span with
      | Day -> (step caps m sign, None)
      | Week -> (step caps m (7 * sign), None)
      | Month ->
          ( load caps { m with cursor = Civil.add_months m.cursor sign },
            None ))
  | Open_ -> (
      match m.span with
      | Week | Month -> (load caps { m with span = Day; selected = 0 }, None)
      | Day -> (
          match List.nth_opt (on m m.cursor) m.selected with
          (* (an invitation: its mail) *)
          | Some (_, _, i) when Item.field i "re" <> "" ->
              (m, Some (Item (Item.field i "re")))
          | _ -> (m, None)))
  | Back -> (load caps { m with span = Week }, None)

let short_weekdays = [ "Mon"; "Tue"; "Wed"; "Thu"; "Fri"; "Sat"; "Sun" ]

(* "12:30 lunch", or "lunch" for a day's event *)
let line (t : int option) (i : Item.t) : string =
  match t with Some t -> Events.clock t ^ " " ^ title i | None -> title i

let light = rgb 218 220 224

(* a calendar's color, Google Calendar's palette (Peacock, Sage,
 * Tomato, Grape, Tangerine, Basil, Lavender, Flamingo, Banana,
 * Blueberry), chosen by its name, the same at each start; the suite's
 * own events (no calendar:) its blue *)
let palette =
  [ rgb 3 155 229; rgb 51 182 121; rgb 213 0 0; rgb 142 36 170;
    rgb 244 81 30; rgb 11 128 67; rgb 121 134 203; rgb 230 124 115;
    rgb 246 191 38; rgb 63 81 181 ]

let color (i : Item.t) : color =
  match Item.field i "calendar" with
  | "" -> blue
  | c ->
      let n = ref 0 in
      String.iter (fun ch -> n := ((!n * 31) + Char.code ch) mod 1009) c;
      List.nth palette (!n mod List.length palette)

(* a week's bars: each event of several days in a lane, the first lane
 * free on its days (the longest first, Google's way); each with its
 * first and last column (0 Monday .. 6) in the week of [monday] *)
let lanes (spans : (Civil.date * int * Item.t) list) (monday : Civil.date) :
    (int * int * int * Item.t) list =
  let m = days monday in
  let cut =
    List.filter_map
      (fun (d, n, i) ->
        let a = days d - m and b = days d + n - 1 - m in
        if b < 0 || a > 6 then None else Some (max 0 a, min 6 b, n, i))
      spans
  in
  let cut =
    List.stable_sort
      (fun (a, _, n, _) (a', _, n', _) -> compare (a, -n) (a', -n'))
      cut
  in
  List.fold_left
    (fun placed (a, b, _, i) ->
      let rec free lane =
        if
          List.exists
            (fun (l, a', b', _) -> l = lane && not (b' < a || b < a'))
            placed
        then free (lane + 1)
        else lane
      in
      placed @ [ (free 0, a, b, i) ])
    [] cut

(* the week's or the month's cells: their left, the top of their first
 * row, a column's width, a row's height, how many rows, the month's
 * weekdays' line above *)
type grid = { left : float; top : float; w : float; h : float; rows : int;
              head : float }

let grid (computer : computer) (m : model) : grid =
  let a = area computer in
  let bottom = (-.computer.screen.height /. 2.) +. 10. in
  let top = a.top -. bar in
  let w = (a.room +. 16.) /. 7. in
  match m.span with
  | Month ->
      { left = a.x0 -. 8.; top; w; h = (top -. bottom -. 24.) /. 6.; rows = 6;
        head = 24. }
  | Week | Day -> { left = a.x0 -. 8.; top; w; h = top -. bottom; rows = 1;
                    head = 0. }

let first_day (m : model) : Civil.date =
  match m.span with Month -> grid_start m.cursor | Week | Day -> monday m.cursor

(* a cell's lines, under its [bars] lanes: each the event it is of (None
 * for "+n more"), its dot's color, its text; a week's wrapped in their
 * column, a month's cut; an event of several days its bar's *)
let cell_lines (m : model) (d : Civil.date) ~(w : float) ~(h : float)
    ~(bars : int) : (Item.t option * color option * string) list =
  let lines =
    List.concat_map
      (fun (_, t, i) ->
        let ls =
          if m.span = Week then wrap (w -. 22.) (line t i) else [ line t i ]
        in
        List.mapi
          (fun k l -> (Some i, (if k = 0 then Some (color i) else None), l))
          ls)
      (List.filter (fun (_, _, i) -> Events.length i < 2) (on m d))
  in
  let fits = max 0 (int_of_float ((h -. 30.) /. 20.)) - bars in
  if List.length lines <= fits then lines
  else
    List.filteri (fun k _ -> k < fits - 1) lines
    @ [ (None, None, Printf.sprintf "+%d more" (List.length lines - fits + 1)) ]

(* a click on the week or the month: its day, and the event under it
 * (a bar, a line), if one is *)
let clicked_grid (computer : computer) (m : model) :
    (Civil.date * Item.t option) option =
  let mouse = computer.mouse in
  let g = grid computer m in
  if
    m.span = Day || (not mouse.mclick) || Gui.modal () || mouse.mx < g.left
    || mouse.mx >= g.left +. (7. *. g.w)
  then None
  else
    let col = int_of_float ((mouse.mx -. g.left) /. g.w) in
    let fy = g.top -. g.head -. mouse.my in
    let row = if fy < 0. then -1 else int_of_float (fy /. g.h) in
    if row < 0 || row >= g.rows then None
    else
      let week = date (days (first_day m) + (7 * row)) in
      let d = date (days week + col) in
      let y = g.top -. g.head -. (float_of_int row *. g.h) in
      let placed = lanes m.spans week in
      let nb = List.fold_left (fun n (l, _, _, _) -> max n (l + 1)) 0 placed in
      (* a bar's band: 17 high round its baseline's +4 *)
      let lane =
        int_of_float (Float.floor ((y -. 38. +. 12.5 -. mouse.my) /. 20.))
      in
      let bar =
        List.find_map
          (fun (l, a, b, i) ->
            if l = lane && a <= col && col <= b then Some i else None)
          placed
      in
      match bar with
      | Some i -> Some (d, Some i)
      | None -> (
          let k =
            int_of_float
              (Float.floor
                 ((y -. 42. -. (float_of_int nb *. 20.) +. 15. -. mouse.my) /. 20.))
          in
          match
            List.nth_opt (cell_lines m d ~w:g.w ~h:g.h ~bars:nb) (max 0 k)
          with
          | Some (Some i, _, _) when k >= 0 -> Some (d, Some i)
          | _ -> Some (d, None))

let update (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (m : model) : model * go option =
  let keys = computer.keyboard.keys in
  let pressed name = Set_.mem name keys && not (Set_.mem name m.held) in
  let menu = chosen computer ~first:1 menus in
  let m, go =
    match m.mode with
    | Asking ->
        if pressed "Escape" then ({ m with mode = Browsing; field = "" }, None)
        else if pressed "Enter" then
          (create caps { m with mode = Browsing; field = "" } m.field, None)
        else if pressed "Backspace" then
          ({ m with field = without_last m.field }, None)
        else ({ m with field = m.field ^ printable computer.keyboard.typed }, None)
    | Browsing when Gui.modal () -> (m, None)
    | Browsing -> (
        let key =
          if pressed "c" then Some Create
          else if pressed "j" then Some Next_period
          else if pressed "k" then Some Previous_period
          else if pressed "t" then Some Today
          else if pressed "d" then Some Day_
          else if pressed "w" then Some Week_
          else if pressed "m" then Some Month_
          else if pressed "o" || pressed "Enter" then Some Open_
          else if pressed "u" || pressed "Escape" then Some Back
          else if pressed "g" then Some Get
          else None
        in
        (* the mouse: a span of the sidebar; in a day, an event *)
        let side_ =
          match sidebar_click computer with
          | Some 0 -> Some Day_
          | Some 1 -> Some Week_
          | Some 2 -> Some Month_
          | _ -> None
        in
        let clicked =
          match row_click computer with
          | Some k when m.span = Day && k < List.length (on m m.cursor) -> Some k
          | _ -> None
        in
        let on_grid = clicked_grid computer m in
        match (menu, key, side_, clicked) with
        | Some c, _, _, _ | None, Some c, _, _ | None, None, Some c, _ ->
            command caps m c
        | None, None, None, Some k -> ({ m with selected = k }, None)
        | None, None, None, None when on_grid <> None -> (
            (* a day of the week or the month clicked: its page, the event
             * clicked selected, its details under the list *)
            match on_grid with
            | Some (d, ev) ->
                let m = load caps { m with cursor = d; span = Day; selected = 0 } in
                let k =
                  match ev with
                  | Some e ->
                      let rec index j l =
                        match l with
                        | (_, _, i) :: rest ->
                            if Item.id i = Item.id e then j else index (j + 1) rest
                        | [] -> 0
                      in
                      index 0 (on m d)
                  | None -> 0
                in
                ({ m with selected = k }, None)
            | None -> (m, None))
        | None, None, None, None ->
            (* the arrows: a day, a week; in a day, its events *)
            let n = List.length (on m m.cursor) in
            if m.span = Day && pressed "ArrowDown" then
              ({ m with selected = min (n - 1) (m.selected + 1) }, None)
            else if m.span = Day && pressed "ArrowUp" then
              ({ m with selected = max 0 (m.selected - 1) }, None)
            else if pressed "ArrowRight" then (step caps m 1, None)
            else if pressed "ArrowLeft" then (step caps m (-1), None)
            else if pressed "ArrowDown" then (step caps m 7, None)
            else if pressed "ArrowUp" then (step caps m (-7), None)
            else (m, None))
  in
  ({ m with held = keys }, go)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The picture *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let view (computer : computer) (m : model) : shape list =
  let a = area computer in
  let bottom = (-.computer.screen.height /. 2.) +. 10. in
  let top = a.top -. bar in
  let title_ =
    match (m.mode, m.span) with
    | Asking, _ -> "an event: " ^ m.field ^ "_"
    | _, Day ->
        Printf.sprintf "%s %d %s %d"
          (Civil.weekday_name (Civil.weekday (days m.cursor)))
          m.cursor.day
          (Civil.month_name m.cursor.month)
          m.cursor.year
    | _, Week ->
        let d = monday m.cursor in
        Printf.sprintf "Week of %d %s %d" d.day (Civil.month_name d.month)
          d.year
    | _, Month ->
        Printf.sprintf "%s %d" (Civil.month_name m.cursor.month) m.cursor.year
  in
  let right =
    if m.status <> "" then m.status
    else
      (* (an event of several days once, not once a day) *)
      count
        (List.length
           (List.sort_uniq compare
              (List.map (fun (_, _, i) -> Item.id i) m.shown)))
        "event"
  in
  (* a cell: its box's top left, its width and height; its day's number
   * and its events' lines *)
  let cell ~(x : float) ~(y : float) ~(w : float) ~(h : float) ~(head : string)
      ~(bars : int) (d : Civil.date) : shape list =
    let is_cursor = d = m.cursor and is_today = d = m.today in
    let grey_day = m.span = Month && d.month <> m.cursor.month in
    let lines = cell_lines m d ~w ~h ~bars in
    (if is_cursor then
       [ rectangle (rgb 232 240 254) w h |> move (x +. (w /. 2.)) (y -. (h /. 2.)) ]
     else [])
    @ [ rectangle light w 1. |> move (x +. (w /. 2.)) y;
        rectangle light 1. h |> move x (y -. (h /. 2.));
        text
          (if is_today then blue else if grey_day then light else grey)
          ~bold:is_today ~room:(w -. 8.) (x +. 6.) (y -. 20.) head ]
    @ List.concat
        (List.mapi
           (fun k (_, dot, l) ->
             let ly = y -. 42. -. (float_of_int (k + bars) *. 20.) in
             (* a timed event's dot, its calendar's color *)
             (match dot with
             | Some c -> [ circle c 3.5 |> move (x +. 10.) (ly +. 5.) ]
             | None -> [])
             @ [ text (if grey_day then grey else ink) ~bold:false
                   ~room:(w -. 20.) (x +. 17.) ly l ])
           lines)
  in
  (* a week's bars, from its row's top [y], its columns [w] wide *)
  let bars ~(x0 : float) ~(y : float) ~(w : float) (monday : Civil.date) :
      int * shape list =
    let placed = lanes m.spans monday in
    let n = List.fold_left (fun n (l, _, _, _) -> max n (l + 1)) 0 placed in
    ( n,
      List.concat_map
        (fun (lane, a, b, i) ->
          let left = x0 +. (float_of_int a *. w) +. 3. in
          let width = (float_of_int (b - a + 1) *. w) -. 6. in
          let by = y -. 38. -. (float_of_int lane *. 20.) in
          [ rectangle (color i) width 17. |> move (left +. (width /. 2.)) (by +. 4.);
            text white ~bold:false ~room:(width -. 8.) (left +. 5.) by (title i) ])
        placed )
  in
  let main =
    match m.span with
    | Week ->
        let w = (a.room +. 16.) /. 7. in
        let n, bar_shapes = bars ~x0:(a.x0 -. 8.) ~y:top ~w (monday m.cursor) in
        List.concat
          (List.init 7 (fun k ->
               let d = date (days (monday m.cursor) + k) in
               cell ~x:(a.x0 -. 8. +. (float_of_int k *. w)) ~y:top ~w
                 ~h:(top -. bottom)
                 ~head:(Printf.sprintf "%s %d" (List.nth short_weekdays k) d.day)
                 ~bars:n d))
        @ bar_shapes
    | Month ->
        let w = (a.room +. 16.) /. 7. in
        let head_h = 24. in
        let h = (top -. bottom -. head_h) /. 6. in
        List.mapi
          (fun k name ->
            text grey ~bold:false ~room:w
              (a.x0 -. 2. +. (float_of_int k *. w)) (top -. 17.) name)
          short_weekdays
        (* each of the six weeks: its bars, then its days under them *)
        @ List.concat
            (List.init 6 (fun r ->
                 let y = top -. head_h -. (float_of_int r *. h) in
                 let first = date (days (grid_start m.cursor) + (7 * r)) in
                 let n, bar_shapes = bars ~x0:(a.x0 -. 8.) ~y ~w first in
                 List.concat
                   (List.init 7 (fun c ->
                        let d = date (days first + c) in
                        cell
                          ~x:(a.x0 -. 8. +. (float_of_int c *. w))
                          ~y ~w ~h ~head:(string_of_int d.day) ~bars:n d))
                 @ bar_shapes))
    | Day ->
        let events = on m m.cursor in
        if events = [] then
          [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:a.room a.x0 (row_y a 0)
              "Nothing this day: c adds an event (lunch with alice 12:30)." ]
        else
          let rows =
            List.concat
              (List.mapi
                 (fun k (_, t, i) ->
                   let y = row_y a k in
                   (if k = m.selected then [ selected a y ] else [])
                   @ [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:90. a.x0 y
                         (match t with Some t -> Events.clock t | None -> "all day");
                       text ink ~bold:false ~room:(a.room -. 100.) (a.x0 +. 100.)
                         y (title i) ])
                 events)
          in
          (* the selected one's details under the list *)
          let details =
            match List.nth_opt events m.selected with
            | None -> []
            | Some (_, _, i) ->
                List.filter_map
                  (fun (name, label) ->
                    match Item.field i name with
                    | "" -> None
                    | v -> Some (label ^ v))
                  [ ("end", "until "); ("ends", "the last day: ");
                    ("where", "where: "); ("calendar", "calendar: ");
                    ("repeat", "repeats: "); ("with", "with: ");
                    ("re", "from the mail: o opens it, ") ]
                @ wrap a.room (String.trim i.body)
          in
          let k0 = List.length events + 1 in
          rows
          @ List.mapi
              (fun k l ->
                text grey ~bold:false ~room:a.room a.x0 (row_y a (k0 + k)) l)
              details
  in
  (rectangle white computer.screen.width computer.screen.height
   :: title_bar computer title_ right)
  @ sidebar a
      [ ("Day", m.span = Day); ("Week", m.span = Week);
        ("Month", m.span = Month) ]
  @ main

(* Calendar_window: the suite's calendar (plan_pim.md, stage 3), the
   events (Events: items stamped event) by day, week or month, Google
   Calendar's keys:

       Pim   Event   View
       Week of 2 November 2026                                3 events
      +-----------+-------+-------+-------+-------+-------+----+----+
      | Day       |Mon 2  |Tue 3  |Wed 4  |Thu 5  |Fri 6  |Sat |Sun |
      |#Week######|9:30   |12:30  |9:30   |16:00  |       |    |    |
      | Month     |standup|lunch  |standup|dentist|       |    |    |
      +-----------+-------+-------+-------+-------+-------+----+----+

   c creates an event from one line (Capture: "lunch with alice tue
   12:30", "standup every monday 9h30"); j k the next and the previous
   period; t today; d w m a day, a week (Monday first), a month (six
   weeks); the arrows move the day selected; o or Enter that day's

apps/pim/window/Found_window.ml

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Found_window.mli *)

open Playground
open Pim_look

type caps = Mail_window.caps

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The model *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* a thing found, and the message it was found in *)
type row = {
  message : string; (* its item's id *)
  subject : string;
  from : string; (* the sender's address *)
  found : Detect.found;
  due : Civil.date option; (* the message's first day, a bill's *)
}

type model = {
  rows : row list;
  made : (int * string) list; (* a row made an item: its id *)
  selected : int;
  today : Civil.date;
  status : string;
  held : string Set_.t;
}

let store (caps : caps) : Items.t = Items.at (Items.place caps)

let initial (caps : caps) (flags : Playground.flags) : model =
  let today =
    match List.assoc_opt "today" flags with
    | Some d -> (
        match Search.date d with Some d -> d | None -> When.today caps)
    | None -> When.today caps
  in
  { rows = []; made = []; selected = 0; today; status = ""; held = Set_.empty }

let start (keys : string Set_.t) (m : model)
    (messages : (string * Mail.t) list) : model =
  let rows =
    List.concat_map
      (fun (id, mail) ->
        let found = Detect.find ~today:m.today (Mail_text.text mail) in
        let due =
          List.find_map
            (fun (f : Detect.found) ->
              match f.kind with Day (d, _) -> Some d | _ -> None)
            found
        in
        let from =
          match Mail.address (Conversations.header mail "from") with
          | Some a -> String.lowercase_ascii a.mailbox
          | None -> ""
        in
        List.map
          (fun f ->
            { message = id; subject = Conversations.header mail "subject";
              from; found = f; due })
          found)
      messages
  in
  { m with rows; made = []; selected = 0; status = ""; held = keys }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* What a row makes *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* "Re: lunch" -> "lunch" *)
let topic (subject : string) : string =
  let rec go s =
    let low = String.lowercase_ascii s in
    let cut k = go (String.trim (String.sub s k (String.length s - k))) in
    if String.length s > 3 && String.sub low 0 3 = "re:" then cut 3
    else if String.length s > 4 && String.sub low 0 4 = "fwd:" then cut 4
    else s
  in
  let t = go (String.trim subject) in
  if t = "" then "(no subject)" else t

let made = ref 0

let fresh (caps : < Cap.clock; .. >) (kind : string) : string =
  incr made;
  Printf.sprintf "%s:%.0f.%d" kind (CapUnix.gettimeofday caps ()) !made

(* a row made an item, linked to its message by re:; the item's id and
 * what to say *)
let make (caps : caps) (r : row) : string * string =
  let items = Items.all caps (store caps) in
  match r.found.kind with
  | Day (day, time) ->
      let with_ =
        match People.who items r.from with
        | Some c -> [ Item.id c ]
        | None -> []
      in
      let e =
        Capture.to_item ~id:(fresh caps "event")
          { title = topic r.subject; day; time; ends = None; repeat = ""; with_ }
      in
      let e = Mail.set "re" r.message e in
      Items.save caps (store caps) e;
      (Item.id e, "in the Calendar: " ^ title e)
  | Amount c ->
      let fields =
        [ ("title", "pay: " ^ topic r.subject); ("re", r.message);
          ( "posting",
            Printf.sprintf "Expenses:Bills  %d.%02d" (c / 100) (c mod 100) );
          ("posting", "Assets:Checking") ]
        @ match r.due with Some d -> [ ("due", Mail_sync.day d) ] | None -> []
      in
      let t =
        Item.make ~id:(fresh caps "task") ~stamps:[ "task"; "money" ] fields ""
      in
      Items.save caps (store caps) t;
      (Item.id t, "a bill to pay: " ^ Money.to_string c)
  | Address (name, a) -> (
      match People.who items a with
      | Some c -> (Item.id c, "")
      | None ->
          let c =
            Item.make
              ~id:(People.id { display = name; mailbox = a })
              ~stamps:[ "contact" ]
              [ ("name", if name = "" then a else name); ("email", a) ]
              ""
          in
          Items.save caps (store caps) c;
          (Item.id c, "in People: " ^ title c))

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The keys *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type command = Make | Next | Previous | Back

let menus : (string * (string * command) list) list =
  [ ( "Found",
      [ ("Keep It  (Enter)", Make); ("Next  (j)", Next);
        ("Previous  (k)", Previous); ("Back to the Message  (Esc)", Back) ] )
  ]

let command (caps : caps) (m : model) (c : command) : model * go option =
  match c with
  | Next ->
      let last = List.length m.rows - 1 in
      ({ m with selected = max 0 (min last (m.selected + 1)) }, None)
  | Previous -> ({ m with selected = max 0 (m.selected - 1) }, None)
  | Back -> (m, Some (View Mail))
  | Make -> (
      match
        (List.assoc_opt m.selected m.made, List.nth_opt m.rows m.selected)
      with
      | Some id, _ -> (m, Some (Item id))
      | None, Some r ->
          let id, said = make caps r in
          (* (a contact already there: opened) *)
          if said = "" then (m, Some (Item id))
          else ({ m with made = (m.selected, id) :: m.made; status = said }, None)
      | None, None -> (m, None))

let update (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (m : model) : model * go option =
  let keys = computer.keyboard.keys in
  let pressed name = Set_.mem name keys && not (Set_.mem name m.held) in
  let key =
    if Gui.modal () then None
    else if pressed "j" || pressed "ArrowDown" then Some Next
    else if pressed "k" || pressed "ArrowUp" then Some Previous
    else if pressed "Enter" || pressed "o" then Some Make
    else if pressed "Escape" || pressed "u" then Some Back
    else None
  in
  let m, go =
    match (chosen computer ~first:1 menus, key) with
    | Some c, _ | None, Some c -> command caps m c
    | None, None when wheel computer <> 0 ->
        ( { m with
            selected = moved m.selected (wheel computer) (List.length m.rows) },
          None )
    | None, None -> (m, None)
  in
  ({ m with held = keys }, go)

(* The picture *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let view (computer : computer) (m : model) : shape list =
  let a = area computer in
  let kind (r : row) =
    match r.found.kind with
    | Day (d, t) ->
        ( "day",
          Civil.to_string d
          ^ match t with Some t -> " " ^ Events.clock t | None -> "" )
    | Amount c -> ("amount", Money.to_string c)
    | Address (n, a) -> ("address", if n = "" then a else n ^ " <" ^ a ^ ">")
  in
  let main =
    if m.rows = [] then
      [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:a.room a.x0 (row_y a 0)
          "Nothing found in this message: no day, amount or address." ]
    else
      List.concat
        (List.mapi
           (fun i (r : row) ->
             let y = row_y a (2 * i) in
             let what, read = kind r in
             (if i = m.selected then
                [ selected a y; selected a (y -. row) ]
              else [])
             @ [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:80. a.x0 y what;
                 text ink ~bold:true ~room:250. (a.x0 +. 90.) y r.found.said;
                 text blue ~bold:false ~room:(a.room -. 380.) (a.x0 +. 360.) y
                   ((if List.mem_assoc i m.made then "\xe2\x9c\x93 " else "")
                    ^ read);
                 text grey ~bold:false ~room:(a.room -. 90.) (a.x0 +. 90.)
                   (y -. row) r.found.line ])
           m.rows)
  in
  let right =
    if m.status <> "" then m.status
    else
      match List.nth_opt m.rows m.selected with
      | Some _ when List.mem_assoc m.selected m.made ->
          "Enter: open what was made"
      | Some r -> (
          match r.found.kind with
          | Day _ -> "Enter: an event"
          | Amount _ -> "Enter: a bill"
          | Address _ -> "Enter: a contact")
      | None -> ""
  in
  let subject = match m.rows with r :: _ -> topic r.subject | [] -> "" in
  (rectangle white computer.screen.width computer.screen.height
   :: title_bar computer ("Found in: " ^ subject) right)
  @ sidebar a [ (count (List.length m.rows) "thing" ^ " found", true) ]
  @ main

(* See Mail_model.mli *)

type caps =

(* what waits for the password *)
type action = Fetch | Open | Archive | Star of bool | Send | Snooze of Civil.date
type asking = Password | Search | Until | Due
type mode = Browsing | Reading | Composing | Asking of asking

type model = {
  account : string;
  server : Mail_sync.server;
  smtp : Mail_sync.server;
  mailbox : string; (* INBOX, All Mail, or the store's drafts *)
  (* the Screener (Screen): on or not, the Inbox's list shown, how many
   * wait in the Screener *)
  screening : bool;
  screen : Screen.place;
  waiting : int;
  (* Gmail's Unread: the Inbox's (the Imbox's) not read, a view of it;
   * how many *)
  unread : bool;
  unread_count : int;
  password : string option; (* kept while the window is open *)
  query : string; (* the search's words, "" for none *)
  conversations : Imap.summary list list;
  drafts : Mail_compose.draft list; (* the drafts mailbox's *)
  today : Civil.date; (* today= (the tests'), else the clock's *)
  selected : int;
  (* the conversation opened: its messages, oldest first, each its text
   * when the cache has it *)
  reading : (Imap.summary * string option) list;
  scroll : int; (* the first line of the conversation shown *)
  mode : mode;
  (* the message written: its fields, its text being edited, and the
   * mode its window goes back to *)
  draft : Mail_compose.draft;
  body : Text_edit.t;
  back_to : mode;
  field : string; (* what is typed after a question *)
  after : action option;
  (* what waits one frame, the status saying it first: the window draws
   * nothing while the server is asked *)
  soon : action option;
  status : string;
  held : string Set_.t; (* the keys down at the last frame *)
}

let store (caps : caps) : Items.t = Items.at (Items.place caps)

(* the drafts, a mailbox of the store's, not the server's *)
let drafts = "Drafts"

let contains (s : string) (word : string) : bool =
  let s = String.lowercase_ascii s and w = String.lowercase_ascii word in
  let n = String.length s and k = String.length w in
  let rec at i = i + k <= n && (String.sub s i k = w || at (i + 1)) in
  at 0

(* every word of the query in who sent one of its messages, or in its
 * subject *)
let matches (query : string) (c : Imap.summary list) : bool =
  List.for_all
    (fun w ->
      List.exists
        (fun (s : Imap.summary) ->
          contains (Conversations.who s.headers) w
          || contains (Conversations.header s.headers "subject") w)
        c)
    (List.filter (fun w -> w <> "") (String.split_on_char ' ' query))

(* the conversations again from the store, those back from a snooze on
 * top; the drafts *)
let load (caps : caps) (m : model) : model =
  let items = Items.all caps (store caps) in
  let l = Mail_item.listed items ~account:m.account ~mailbox:m.mailbox in
  let cs = List.filter (matches m.query) (Conversations.group l) in
  (* the Inbox's: the list asked of the Screener's, the screened out
   * in All Mail only *)
  let screening = Screen.since items <> None in
  let place = Screen.place items ~account:m.account in
  let waiting =
    if screening then
      List.length (List.filter (fun c -> place c = Screen.Screener) cs)
    else 0
  in
  let cs =
    if m.mailbox <> "INBOX" then cs
    else List.filter (fun c -> place c = m.screen) cs
  in
  let unread_count =
    if m.mailbox = "INBOX" && m.screen = Screen.Imbox then
      List.length (List.filter Conversations.unread cs)
    else m.unread_count
  in
  let cs =
    if m.mailbox = "INBOX" && m.unread then List.filter Conversations.unread cs
    else cs
  in
  let woke =
    List.filter_map
      (fun i -> if Item.field i "woke" <> "" then Some (Item.id i) else None)
      items
  in
  let back (c : Imap.summary list) =
    List.exists (fun s -> List.mem (Mail_item.id s) woke) c
  in
  let cs = List.filter back cs @ List.filter (fun c -> not (back c)) cs in
  let ds =
    List.map Mail_compose.of_item
      (List.filter (fun i -> Item.has_stamp i "draft") items)
  in
  let n = if m.mailbox = drafts then List.length ds else List.length cs in
  { m with conversations = cs; drafts = ds; screening; waiting; unread_count;
    selected = max 0 (min m.selected (n - 1)) }

let initial (caps : caps) (flags : Playground.flags) : model =
  let flag name =
    match List.assoc_opt name flags with Some v -> v | None -> ""
  in
  (* server=host:port, else Gmail's *)
  let server name (gmail : Mail_sync.server) : Mail_sync.server =
    let plain = List.mem_assoc "plain" flags in
    match String.rindex_opt (flag name) ':' with
    | Some i -> (
        let hp = flag name in
        match
          int_of_string_opt (String.sub hp (i + 1) (String.length hp - i - 1))
        with
        | Some port -> { Mail_sync.host = String.sub hp 0 i; port; plain }
        | None -> gmail)
    | None -> { gmail with plain }
  in
  (* the store's password file, if the author made one *)
  let password, status =
    match Mail_sync.saved_password caps with
    | Ok p -> (p, "")
    | Error e -> (None, e)
  in
  load caps
    {
      account = flag "user";
      server = server "server" Mail_sync.gmail;
      smtp = server "smtp" Mail_sync.gmail_smtp;
      mailbox = "INBOX";
      screening = false;
      screen = Screen.Imbox;
      waiting = 0;
      unread = false;
      unread_count = 0;
      password;
      query = "";
      conversations = [];
      drafts = [];
      today =
        (match Search.date (flag "today") with
        | Some d -> d
        | None -> When.today caps);
      selected = 0;
      reading = [];
      scroll = 0;
      mode = Browsing;
      draft = Mail_compose.blank ~id:"";
      body = Text_edit.of_string "";
      back_to = Browsing;
      field = "";
      after = None;
      soon = None;
      status;
      held = Set_.empty;
    }

type place = {
  name : string;
  mailbox : string;
  list : Screen.place; (* the Screener's, in the Inbox *)
  unread : bool; (* Unread, the Inbox's not read *)
}

let places (m : model) : place list =
  let p name mailbox list unread = { name; mailbox; list; unread } in
  (if not m.screening then [ p "Inbox" "INBOX" Screen.Imbox false ]
   else
     [ p "Imbox" "INBOX" Screen.Imbox false;
       p (Printf.sprintf "The Screener (%d)" m.waiting) "INBOX" Screen.Screener
         false;
       p "The Feed" "INBOX" Screen.Feed false;
       p "Paper Trail" "INBOX" Screen.Paper false ])
  @ [ p (Printf.sprintf "Unread (%d)" m.unread_count) "INBOX" Screen.Imbox true;
      p "Starred" Mail_sync.starred Screen.Imbox false;
      p "All Mail" Mail_sync.all_mail Screen.Imbox false;
      p "Drafts" drafts Screen.Imbox false ]

let shown (m : model) (p : place) : bool =
  p.mailbox = m.mailbox
  && (p.mailbox <> "INBOX" || (p.list = m.screen && p.unread = m.unread))

let refresh (caps : caps) (keys : string Set_.t) (m : model) : model =
  load caps { m with held = keys }
