(* where the message's fields, its text and its buttons are: under the
 * title bar, right of the sidebar *)
let field_box (computer : computer) (i : int) : Widget.box =
  let w = computer.screen.width and h = computer.screen.height in
  let x0 = (-.w /. 2.) +. side +. 16. and room = w -. side -. 32. in
  { Widget.x = x0 +. 80. +. ((room -. 80.) /. 2.);
    y = (h /. 2.) -. menu_bar -. bar -. 26. -. (float_of_int i *. 34.);
    w = room -. 80.; h = 26. }

let area_box (computer : computer) : Widget.box =
  let w = computer.screen.width and h = computer.screen.height in
  let x0 = (-.w /. 2.) +. side +. 16. and room = w -. side -. 32. in
  let top = (h /. 2.) -. menu_bar -. bar -. 26. -. (3. *. 34.) -. 26. in
  let bottom = (-.h /. 2.) +. 56. in
  { Widget.x = x0 +. (room /. 2.); y = (top +. bottom) /. 2.; w = room;
    h = top -. bottom }

let button_box (computer : computer) (i : int) : Widget.box =
  let w = computer.screen.width and h = computer.screen.height in
  let x0 = (-.w /. 2.) +. side +. 16. in
  { Widget.x = x0 +. 60. +. (float_of_int i *. 130.); y = (-.h /. 2.) +. 28.;
    w = 120.; h = 30. }


(* the conversation read as lines: each message's head (bold), its text
 * wrapped at [room], a blank *)
let reading_lines (room : float) (m : model) : (bool * string) list =
  List.concat_map
    (fun ((s : Imap.summary), t) ->
      let head =
        Conversations.who s.headers ^ "   " ^ Conversations.day s.headers
      in
      let body =
        match t with
        | Some t -> wrap room (String.trim (Mail_text.text (Mail.parse t)))
        | None -> [ "(not fetched: g gets the mail)" ]
      in
      ((true, head) :: List.map (fun l -> (false, l)) body) @ [ (false, "") ])
    m.reading

let reading_fits (computer : computer) : int =
  int_of_float ((computer.screen.height -. bar -. 60.) /. 22.)

let bottom (computer : computer) : float = (-.computer.screen.height /. 2.) +. 10.

(* (the rows between the first's top and the bottom) *)
let list_fits (computer : computer) : int =
  let a = area computer in
  int_of_float ((row_y a 0 +. 19. -. bottom computer) /. row)

let lines (computer : computer) (m : model) : int =
  List.length (reading_lines (area computer).room m)

let name (m : model) : string =
  if m.mailbox = "INBOX" then
    match (m.screening, m.screen) with
    | _ when m.unread -> "Unread"
    | false, _ -> "Inbox"
    | true, Screen.Imbox -> "Imbox"
    | _, Screen.Screener -> "The Screener"
    | _, Screen.Feed -> "The Feed"
    | _, Screen.Paper -> "Paper Trail"
    | _, Screen.Out -> "Screened Out"
  else if m.mailbox = Mail_sync.all_mail then "All Mail"
  else if m.mailbox = Mail_sync.starred then "Starred"
  else if m.mailbox = drafts then "Drafts"
  else m.mailbox

let view (computer : computer) (m : model) : shape list =
  let h = computer.screen.height in
  let a = area computer in
  let x0 = a.x0 and room = a.room and top = a.top in
  let title =
    match m.mode with
    | Asking Password ->
        "password: " ^ String.make (List.length (Text.chars m.field)) '*'
    | Asking Search -> "search: " ^ m.field ^ "_"
    | Asking Until -> "snooze until: " ^ m.field ^ "_"
    | Asking Due -> "a task, due: " ^ m.field ^ "_"
    | Composing ->
        (if m.draft.subject = "" then "New message" else m.draft.subject)
        ^ " \xe2\x80\x94 " ^ m.account
    | Browsing | Reading -> name m ^ " \xe2\x80\x94 " ^ m.account
  in
  let right =
    if m.status <> "" then m.status
    else if m.mailbox = drafts then count (List.length m.drafts) "draft"
    else count (List.length m.conversations) "conversation"
  in
  let sidebar =
    Pim_look.sidebar a
      (List.map (fun (p : place) -> (p.name, shown m p)) (places m))
    @
    if m.query <> "" then
      [ text blue ~bold:false ~room:(side -. 24.) (a.left +. 16.)
          (row_y a (List.length (places m) + 1))
          ("/" ^ m.query) ]
    else []
  in
  let main =
    match m.mode with
    | Composing ->
        (* the fields' names; the fields, the text and the buttons are
         * the toolkit's (Gui.draw) *)
        List.mapi
          (fun i name ->
            let b = field_box computer i in
            text grey ~bold:false ~room:76. x0 (b.y -. 5.) name)
          [ "To"; "Cc"; "Subject"; "Attach" ]
    | Browsing when m.mailbox = drafts ->
        if m.drafts = [] then
          [ text grey ~bold:false ~room x0 (row_y a 0) "No drafts." ]
        else
          List.concat
            (List.mapi
               (fun i (d : Mail_compose.draft) ->
                 let y = row_y a i in
                 (if i = m.selected then [ selected a y ] else [])
                 @ [ text ink ~bold:false ~room:190. x0 y
                       (if d.to_ = "" then "(no one)" else d.to_);
                     text ink ~bold:false ~room:(room -. 200.) (x0 +. 200.) y
                       (if d.subject = "" then "(no subject)" else d.subject) ])
               m.drafts)
    | Reading ->
        let subject =
          match m.reading with
          | (s, _) :: _ -> Conversations.header s.headers "subject"
          | [] -> ""
        in
        let lines = reading_lines room m in
        let fits = reading_fits computer in
        let shown =
          List.filteri (fun i _ -> i >= m.scroll && i < m.scroll + fits) lines
        in
        (* what Detect finds in a line underlined, x to keep it *)
        let underlined (y : float) (l : string) =
          List.filter_map
            (fun (f : Detect.found) ->
              match Detect.index l f.said with
              | Some p ->
                  let w = width f.said in
                  Some
                    (rectangle blue w 1.5
                    |> move (x0 +. width (String.sub l 0 p) +. (w /. 2.))
                         (y -. 4.))
              | None -> None)
            (Detect.find ~today:m.today l)
        in
        text ink ~bold:true ~room x0 (top -. bar -. 32.) subject
        :: List.concat
             (List.mapi
                (fun i (bold, l) ->
                  let y = top -. bar -. 62. -. (float_of_int i *. 22.) in
                  text (if bold then ink else grey) ~bold ~room x0 y l
                  :: (if bold then [] else underlined y l))
                shown)
        @ scrollbar computer ~bottom:(bottom computer) ~n:(List.length lines)
            ~fits ~first:m.scroll
    | Browsing | Asking _ ->
        if m.conversations = [] then
          [ text grey ~bold:false ~room x0 (row_y a 0) "No mail here: g gets it." ]
        else
          let fits = list_fits computer in
          let first = max 0 (m.selected - fits + 1) in
          scrollbar computer ~bottom:(bottom computer)
            ~n:(List.length m.conversations) ~fits ~first
          @
          List.concat
            (List.mapi
               (fun i (c : Imap.summary list) ->
                 if i < first || i >= first + fits then []
                 else
                   let s = List.hd c in
                   let y = row_y a (i - first) in
                   let bold = Conversations.unread c in
                   let many =
                     if List.length c > 1 then
                       Printf.sprintf " (%d)" (List.length c)
                     else ""
                   in
                   let day = Conversations.day s.headers in
                   (if i = m.selected then [ selected a y ] else [])
                   @ [
                       text ink ~bold ~room:190. x0 y
                         (Conversations.who s.headers ^ many);
                       text ink ~bold ~room:(room -. 310.) (x0 +. 200.) y
                         (Conversations.header s.headers "subject");
                       text grey ~bold
                         ~room:(width day +. 4.)
                         (x0 +. room -. width day)
                         y day;
                     ]
                   (* starred (Gmail's star: a message flagged), a gold
                    * dot before the day *)
                   @
                   if
                     List.exists
                       (fun (s : Imap.summary) -> List.mem "\\Flagged" s.flags)
                       c
                   then
                     [ circle (rgb 244 180 0) 5.
                       |> move (x0 +. room -. width day -. 16.) (y +. 5.) ]
                   else [])
               m.conversations)
  in
  (rectangle white computer.screen.width h :: title_bar computer title right)
  @ sidebar @ main

(* how many rows the list shows, how many lines the reading; the lines
 * of the conversation read (its scrollbar's length); the lists'
 * bottom *)
val list_fits : Playground.computer -> int
val reading_fits : Playground.computer -> int
val lines : Playground.computer -> Mail_model.model -> int
val bottom : Playground.computer -> float

(* the list's name: Inbox, Starred, The Screener... *)
val name : Mail_model.model -> string

(* the view, under the menu bar and the menus, which the suite draws *)
val view : Playground.computer -> Mail_model.model -> Playground.shape list

(* See Mail_window.mli *)

open Playground
open Pim_look
open Mail_model

type caps = Mail_model.caps
type model = Mail_model.model

let initial = Mail_model.initial
let refresh = Mail_model.refresh

(*****************************************************************************)
(* What the keys and the menus do *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let current (m : model) : Imap.summary list =
  match List.nth_opt m.conversations m.selected with Some c -> c | None -> []

(* [f] in a session, its error the status *)
let online (caps : caps) (m : model) (password : string)
    (f : Imap.t -> ('a, string) result) : ('a, string) result =
  Mail_sync.session caps m.server ~user:m.account ~password ~mailbox:m.mailbox f

(* the conversation opened: its texts from the server (and so the
 * cache) when the password is known, from the cache else *)
let open_ (caps : caps) (m : model) : model =
  let messages = List.rev (current m) in
  let cached (s : Imap.summary) = Items.cached caps (store caps) s.msgid in
  let texts =
    match m.password with
    | None -> Ok (List.map (fun s -> (s, cached s)) messages)
    | Some p ->
        online caps m p (fun t ->
            Ok
              (List.map
                 (fun (s : Imap.summary) ->
                   match
                     Mail_sync.message caps (store caps) t ~account:m.account
                       ~mailbox:m.mailbox s.uid
                   with
                   | Ok text -> (s, Some text)
                   | Error _ -> (s, cached s))
                 messages))
  in
  match texts with
  | Error e -> { m with status = e }
  | Ok reading ->
      let missing = List.exists (fun (_, t) -> t = None) reading in
      (* (back from a snooze, and now seen: in its place again) *)
      List.iter
        (fun (s : Imap.summary) ->
          match Items.find caps (store caps) (Mail_item.id s) with
          | Some i when Item.field i "woke" <> "" ->
              Items.save caps (store caps) (Mail.remove "woke" i)
          | _ -> ())
        messages;
      let m = load caps m in
      {
        m with
        reading;
        scroll = 0;
        mode = Reading;
        status = (if missing then "g: get the mail to read it all" else "");
      }

let run (caps : caps) (m : model) (action : action) : model =
  match m.password with
  | None -> { m with mode = Asking Password; field = ""; after = Some action }
  | Some p -> (
      match action with
      | Open -> open_ caps m
      | Fetch -> (
          (* (the snoozed whose day has come back first) *)
          let woken =
            if m.mailbox <> "INBOX" then Ok 0
            else
              Mail_sync.wake caps (store caps) m.server ~user:m.account
                ~password:p ~today:m.today
          in
          let listed =
            match woken with
            | Error e -> Error e
            | Ok _ ->
                online caps m p (fun t ->
                    Mail_sync.list caps (store caps) t ~account:m.account
                      ~mailbox:m.mailbox ~query:None 50)
          in
          match (woken, listed) with
          | _, Error e | Error e, _ -> { m with status = e; password = None }
          | Ok k, Ok l ->
              let m = load caps m in
              let back =
                if k = 0 then "" else Printf.sprintf ", %d back from snooze" k
              in
              {
                m with
                status =
                  count (List.length l) "message" ^ " fetched" ^ back;
              })
      | Snooze until -> (
          let uids = List.map (fun (s : Imap.summary) -> s.uid) (current m) in
          match
            online caps m p (fun t ->
                Mail_sync.snooze caps (store caps) t ~account:m.account
                  ~mailbox:m.mailbox uids ~until)
          with
          | Error e -> { m with status = e }
          | Ok () ->
              let m = load caps { m with mode = Browsing } in
              { m with status = "snoozed until " ^ Mail_sync.day until })
      | Send -> (
          match
            Mail_sync.send_draft caps (store caps) m.smtp ~user:m.account
              ~password:p m.draft
          with
          | Error e -> { m with mode = Composing; status = e }
          | Ok said -> load caps { m with mode = m.back_to; status = said })
      | Archive -> (
          let uids = List.map (fun (s : Imap.summary) -> s.uid) (current m) in
          match
            online caps m p (fun t ->
                Mail_sync.archive caps (store caps) t ~account:m.account
                  ~mailbox:m.mailbox uids)
          with
          | Error e -> { m with status = e }
          | Ok () ->
              let m = load caps { m with mode = Browsing } in
              { m with status = "archived" })
      | Star on -> (
          (* (the newest message, as Gmail's s in a list) *)
          let uids =
            match current m with (s : Imap.summary) :: _ -> [ s.uid ] | [] -> []
          in
          match
            online caps m p (fun t ->
                Mail_sync.star caps (store caps) t ~account:m.account
                  ~mailbox:m.mailbox uids ~on)
          with
          | Error e -> { m with status = e }
          | Ok () ->
              let m = load caps m in
              { m with status = (if on then "starred" else "unstarred") }))

(* the next or the previous conversation; opened, when one is *)
let next (caps : caps) (m : model) (d : int) : model =
  let n =
    if m.mailbox = drafts then List.length m.drafts
    else List.length m.conversations
  in
  let m = { m with selected = max 0 (min (n - 1) (m.selected + d)) } in
  if m.mode = Reading then open_ caps m else m

(* what a person can ask, by a key or by a menu *)
type command =
  | Get
  | Search_
  | Open_
  | Back
  | Archive_
  | Star_
  | Starred_list
  | Unread_list
  | Next
  | Previous
  | Inbox
  | All_mail
  | Compose
  | Reply
  | Reply_all
  | Forward
  | Send_
  | Save_draft
  | Discard
  | Drafts
  | Snooze_
  | Task
  | Add_sender
  | Invitation
  | Screener_on
  | List_of of Screen.place
  | Sender_to of Screen.place

(* the menu bar, after the suite's: each menu its title, then its
 * items, each with its command and its key, said in the item (a menu
 * is where the keys are learnt) *)
let menus : (string * (string * command) list) list =
  [ ( "Mail",
      [ ("Get Mail  (g)", Get); ("Compose  (c)", Compose);
        ("Search...  (/)", Search_);
        ("Turn On the Screener", Screener_on) ] );
    ( "Conversation",
      [ ("Open  (o)", Open_); ("Back to List  (u)", Back);
        ("Reply  (r)", Reply); ("Reply All  (a)", Reply_all);
        ("Forward  (f)", Forward); ("Archive  (e)", Archive_);
        ("Star  (s)", Star_);
        ("Next  (j)", Next); ("Previous  (k)", Previous);
        ("Snooze...  (z)", Snooze_); ("Make a Task...  (t)", Task);
        ("Sender to People  (p)", Add_sender);
        ("Add to Calendar  (i)", Invitation) ] );
    ( "Message",
      [ ("Send", Send_); ("Save Draft  (Esc)", Save_draft);
        ("Discard", Discard) ] );
    ( "Mailbox",
      [ ("Inbox  (Tab)", List_of Screen.Imbox); ("All Mail  (Tab)", All_mail);
        ("Drafts", Drafts); ("Unread", Unread_list); ("Starred", Starred_list);
        ("The Screener", List_of Screen.Screener);
        ("The Feed", List_of Screen.Feed); ("Paper Trail", List_of Screen.Paper);
        (* (the Screener's decisions, the sender's: Screen) *)
        ("Sender: Imbox  (y)", Sender_to Screen.Imbox);
        ("Sender: Feed", Sender_to Screen.Feed);
        ("Sender: Paper Trail", Sender_to Screen.Paper);
        ("Sender: Out  (n)", Sender_to Screen.Out) ] ) ]

(* [action] at the next frame, this one saying it (Gmail's answer takes
 * seconds, during which nothing is drawn) *)
let later (m : model) (action : action) : model =
  let what =
    match action with
    | Fetch -> "getting " ^ Mail_view.name m ^ " from the server..."
    | _ -> "..."
  in
  { m with soon = Some action; status = what }

let switch (caps : caps) (m : model) (mailbox : string) : model =
  let m =
    load caps { m with mailbox; selected = 0; mode = Browsing; status = "" }
  in
  (* (fetched when the password is known: what the store has of the
   * other mailbox may be old, or nothing) *)
  if m.password <> None && mailbox <> drafts then later m Fetch else m

(* the conversation of the message whose item is [id], opened: in the
 * Inbox if it is there, else the mailbox it was last listed in *)
let show (caps : caps) (m : model) (id : string) : model =
  match Items.find caps (store caps) id with
  | None -> { m with status = id ^ ": not in the store" }
  | Some i -> (
      let inbox =
        List.exists
          (fun v -> String.length (String.trim v) > 6
                    && String.sub (String.trim v) 0 6 = "INBOX ")
          (Mail.get_all i "in")
        && List.mem "\\Inbox" (Mail_item.summary i).labels
      in
      let mailbox =
        if inbox then "INBOX"
        else match Item.field i "mailbox" with "" -> "INBOX" | b -> b
      in
      let m =
        load caps { m with mailbox; query = ""; mode = Browsing; status = "" }
      in
      let has (c : Imap.summary list) =
        List.exists (fun s -> Mail_item.id s = id) c
      in
      let rec find k l =
        match l with
        | [] -> None
        | c :: rest -> if has c then Some k else find (k + 1) rest
      in
      match find 0 m.conversations with
      | None -> { m with status = id ^ ": not listed in " ^ mailbox }
      | Some k ->
          let m = { m with selected = k } in
          if m.password = None then open_ caps m else run caps m Open)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Writing *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let made = ref 0

(* a draft's id: the time, and a count *)
let new_id (caps : < Cap.clock; .. >) : string =
  incr made;
  Printf.sprintf "draft:%.0f.%d" (CapUnix.gettimeofday caps ()) !made

(* the window writing [d]; back after to the list, or the conversation *)
let compose (m : model) (d : Mail_compose.draft) : model =
  { m with
    draft = d;
    body = Text_edit.of_string d.text;
    mode = Composing;
    back_to = (if m.mode = Reading then Reading else Browsing);
    status = "" }

let write (caps : caps) (m : model) (to_ : string) : model =
  compose { m with mode = Browsing }
    { (Mail_compose.blank ~id:(new_id caps)) with to_ }

let write_mailto (caps : caps) (m : model) (t : Mailto.t) : model =
  let m =
    compose { m with mode = Browsing }
      { (Mail_compose.blank ~id:(new_id caps)) with
        to_ = String.concat ", " t.to_;
        cc = String.concat ", " t.cc;
        subject = t.subject;
        text = t.body }
  in
  (* (the composer has no Bcc: said, not sent) *)
  if t.bcc = [] then m
  else { m with status = "bcc left out: " ^ String.concat ", " t.bcc }

(* a reply to the conversation's newest message read, or its forward;
 * the conversation opened first when only listed *)
let answer (caps : caps) (m : model) (c : command) : model =
  let m =
    if m.mode = Reading || current m = [] then m else open_ caps m
  in
  let read = List.filter (fun (_, t) -> t <> None) m.reading in
  match List.rev read with
  | ((s : Imap.summary), Some text) :: _ ->
      let mail = Mail.parse text in
      let shown = Mail_text.text mail in
      let id = new_id caps in
      compose m
        (if c = Forward then Mail_compose.forward ~id ~key:s.msgid mail shown
         else
           Mail_compose.reply ~id ~all:(c = Reply_all) ~me:m.account mail
             shown)
  | _ -> { m with status = "g: get the mail to answer it" }

(* t: the conversation's newest message stamped task, due that day: the
 * same item, now in the tasks too (plan_pim.md, idea 1) *)
let task (caps : caps) (m : model) (due : Civil.date) : model =
  match current m with
  | [] -> m
  | s :: _ -> (
      match Items.find caps (store caps) (Mail_item.id s) with
      | None -> { m with status = "not in the store: g first" }
      | Some i ->
          let i =
            if Item.has_stamp i "task" then i
            else Mail.set "stamp" (String.concat " " (Item.stamps i @ [ "task" ])) i
          in
          Items.save caps (store caps)
            (Mail.remove "done" (Mail.set "due" (Mail_sync.day due) i));
          load caps { m with status = "a task, due " ^ Mail_sync.day due })

(* i: the invitations of the conversation's messages read (iMIP, RFC
 * 6047: a text/calendar part) made events, each linked to its mail
 * (Events.of_ics) *)
let invitation (caps : caps) (m : model) : model =
  let m =
    if m.mode = Reading || current m = [] then m else open_ caps m
  in
  let events =
    List.concat_map
      (fun ((s : Imap.summary), t) ->
        match t with
        | None -> []
        | Some t ->
            List.concat_map
              (fun (l : Mime.leaf) ->
                if String.lowercase_ascii l.mime = "text/calendar" then
                  Events.of_ics (Zone.local caps) ~message:(Mail_item.id s) l.data
                else [])
              (Mime.leaves (Mail.parse t)))
      m.reading
  in
  List.iter (Items.save caps (store caps)) events;
  { m with
    status =
      (match events with
      | [] -> "no invitation here"
      | [ e ] -> "in the Calendar: " ^ title e
      | l -> count (List.length l) "event" ^ " in the Calendar") }

let opened (m : model) : (string * Mail.t) list =
  if m.mode <> Reading then []
  else
    List.filter_map
      (fun ((s : Imap.summary), t) ->
        match t with
        | Some t -> Some (Mail_item.id s, Mail.parse t)
        | None -> None)
      m.reading

(* the draft kept, the window back where it was *)
let leave (caps : caps) (m : model) (status : string) : model =
  load caps { m with mode = m.back_to; status }

let command (caps : caps) (m : model) (c : command) : model =
  (* (writing, the conversation's commands wait) *)
  let while_writing =
    match c with
    | Send_ | Save_draft | Discard | Inbox | All_mail | Drafts | Get -> true
    | _ -> false
  in
  if m.mode = Composing && not while_writing then m
  else if m.mode <> Composing && (c = Send_ || c = Save_draft || c = Discard)
  then m
  else
  match c with
  | Get -> if m.password = None then run caps m Fetch else later m Fetch
  | Search_ -> { m with mode = Asking Search; field = m.query }
  | Open_ when m.mailbox = drafts -> (
      match List.nth_opt m.drafts m.selected with
      | Some d -> compose m d
      | None -> m)
  | Open_ ->
      if current m = [] then m
      else if m.password = None then open_ caps m
      else run caps m Open
  | Back -> { m with mode = Browsing }
  | Archive_ -> if current m = [] then m else run caps m Archive
  | Star_ ->
      (* (starred: any of its messages flagged; s takes it off) *)
      let starred =
        List.exists
          (fun (s : Imap.summary) -> List.mem "\\Flagged" s.flags)
          (current m)
      in
      if current m = [] then m else run caps m (Star (not starred))
  | Starred_list -> switch caps m Mail_sync.starred
  | Next -> next caps m 1
  | Previous -> next caps m (-1)
  | Inbox -> switch caps m "INBOX"
  | List_of p -> switch caps { m with screen = p; unread = false } "INBOX"
  | Unread_list ->
      switch caps { m with screen = Screen.Imbox; unread = true } "INBOX"
  | Screener_on ->
      Items.save caps (store caps) (Screen.turn_on m.today);
      load caps { m with status = "the Screener on: new senders wait in it" }
  | Sender_to p -> (
      match current m with
      | [] -> m
      | c -> (
          let me = String.lowercase_ascii m.account in
          match List.find_opt (fun s -> Screen.address s <> me) c with
          | None -> m
          | Some s ->
              let a = Screen.address s in
              Items.save caps (store caps) (Screen.decide a p);
              load caps
                { m with
                  status =
                    a ^ (match p with
                        | Screen.Imbox -> ": in the Imbox"
                        | Screen.Feed -> ": in the Feed"
                        | Screen.Paper -> ": in the Paper Trail"
                        | Screen.Out -> ": screened out"
                        | Screen.Screener -> "") }))
  | All_mail -> switch caps m Mail_sync.all_mail
  | Drafts -> switch caps m drafts
  | Add_sender -> (
      match current m with
      | [] -> m
      | s :: _ -> (
          let st = store caps in
          match
            Option.bind (Items.find caps st (Mail_item.id s)) People.of_sender
          with
          | None -> { m with status = "no sender here" }
          | Some c when Items.find caps st (Item.id c) <> None ->
              { m with status = Item.id c ^ ": already in People" }
          | Some c ->
              Items.save caps st c;
              load caps { m with status = title c ^ " added to People" }))
  | Snooze_ ->
      if current m = [] then m
      else { m with mode = Asking Until; field = ""; status = "" }
  | Task ->
      if current m = [] then m
      else { m with mode = Asking Due; field = ""; status = "" }
  | Invitation -> if current m = [] then m else invitation caps m
  | Compose -> compose m (Mail_compose.blank ~id:(new_id caps))
  | Reply | Reply_all | Forward -> answer caps m c
  | Send_ -> run caps m Send
  | Save_draft ->
      Items.save caps (store caps) (Mail_compose.to_item m.draft);
      leave caps m "draft saved"
  | Discard ->
      Items.remove caps (store caps) m.draft.id;
      leave caps m "discarded"

(* the message's widgets this frame (immediate mode), the draft written
 * to the store as it changes (the Palm's: no Save needed); a button's
 * command, or the menu's *)
let writing (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (m : model)
    (menu : command option) (escape : bool) : model =
  let d = m.draft in
  let field i v =
    Gui.field_in ~enabled:true computer (Mail_view.field_box computer i) v
  in
  let to_ = field 0 d.to_ in
  let cc = field 1 d.cc in
  let subject = field 2 d.subject in
  let attach = field 3 d.attach in
  let body = Gui.text_area_in computer (Mail_view.area_box computer) m.body in
  let button i label =
    Gui.button_in ~enabled:true computer (Mail_view.button_box computer i) label
  in
  let send = button 0 "Send" in
  let save = button 1 "Save Draft" in
  let discard = button 2 "Discard" in
  let d' =
    { d with to_; cc; subject; attach; text = Text_edit.to_string body }
  in
  if d' <> d then Items.save caps (store caps) (Mail_compose.to_item d');
  let m = { m with draft = d'; body } in
  let c =
    match menu with
    | Some c -> Some c
    | None ->
        if send then Some Send_
        else if save || escape then Some Save_draft
        else if discard then Some Discard
        else None
  in
  match c with Some c -> command caps m c | None -> m

let update (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (m : model) : model =
  match m.soon with
  (* (the frame before said it: now done) *)
  | Some action -> run caps { m with soon = None } action
  | None ->
  let keys = computer.keyboard.keys in
  let pressed name = Set_.mem name keys && not (Set_.mem name m.held) in
  let menu = chosen computer ~first:1 menus in
  let m =
    match m.mode with
    | Asking a ->
        if pressed "Escape" then
          { m with
            mode = (if m.after = Some Send then Composing else Browsing);
            field = "";
            after = None }
        else if pressed "Enter" then
          match a with
          | Password -> (
              let m =
                { m with password = Some m.field; field = ""; mode = Browsing }
              in
              match m.after with
              | Some action -> run caps { m with after = None } action
              | None -> m)
          | Search ->
              load caps
                { m with query = m.field; field = ""; mode = Browsing;
                  selected = 0 }
          | Until | Due -> (
              let m' = { m with field = ""; mode = Browsing } in
              match When.parse ~today:m.today m.field with
              | None ->
                  { m' with
                    status = m.field ^ ": not a day (monday, in 3 days)" }
              | Some d when a = Until -> run caps m' (Snooze d)
              | Some d -> task caps m' d)
        else if pressed "Backspace" then { m with field = without_last m.field }
        else { m with field = m.field ^ printable computer.keyboard.typed }
    | Composing -> writing caps computer m menu (pressed "Escape")
    | (Browsing | Reading) when Gui.modal () -> m
    | Browsing | Reading -> (
        let reading = m.mode = Reading in
        let key =
          if pressed "j" || ((not reading) && pressed "ArrowDown") then Some Next
          else if pressed "k" || ((not reading) && pressed "ArrowUp") then
            Some Previous
          else if pressed "o" || pressed "Enter" then Some Open_
          else if pressed "u" || pressed "Escape" then Some Back
          else if pressed "e" then Some Archive_
          else if pressed "s" then Some Star_
          else if pressed "c" then Some Compose
          else if pressed "r" then Some Reply
          else if pressed "a" then Some Reply_all
          else if pressed "f" then Some Forward
          else if pressed "z" then Some Snooze_
          else if pressed "t" then Some Task
          else if pressed "p" then Some Add_sender
          else if pressed "i" then Some Invitation
          else if pressed "g" then Some Get
          else if pressed "/" then Some Search_
          (* (the Screener's yes and no, HEY's) *)
          else if pressed "y" && m.screen = Screen.Screener then
            Some (Sender_to Screen.Imbox)
          else if pressed "n" && m.screen = Screen.Screener then
            Some (Sender_to Screen.Out)
          else if pressed "Tab" then
            Some (if m.mailbox = "INBOX" then All_mail else List_of Screen.Imbox)
          else None
        in
        (* the mouse: a place of the sidebar, a conversation of the list
         * (opened, as Gmail's click) *)
        let row =
          match Pim_look.row_click computer with
          | Some k when not reading ->
              let fits = Mail_view.list_fits computer in
              let i = max 0 (m.selected - fits + 1) + k in
              let n =
                if m.mailbox = drafts then List.length m.drafts
                else List.length m.conversations
              in
              if i < n then Some i else None
          | _ -> None
        in
        (* the scrollbar pressed or dragged: the list's row, the
         * reading's line at that place *)
        let bar_at =
          if reading then
            Pim_look.scrollbar_press computer ~bottom:(Mail_view.bottom computer)
              ~n:(Mail_view.lines computer m) ~fits:(Mail_view.reading_fits computer)
          else
            Pim_look.scrollbar_press computer ~bottom:(Mail_view.bottom computer)
              ~n:(List.length m.conversations) ~fits:(Mail_view.list_fits computer)
        in
        match (menu, key, Pim_look.sidebar_click computer, row) with
        | None, None, _, _ when bar_at <> None -> (
            match bar_at with
            | Some k when reading ->
                { m with scroll = max 0 (k - (Mail_view.reading_fits computer / 2)) }
            | Some k -> { m with selected = k }
            | None -> m)
        | Some c, _, _, _ | None, Some c, _, _ -> command caps m c
        | None, None, Some k, _ when k < List.length (places m) -> (
            match List.nth_opt (places m) k with
            | Some { mailbox = "INBOX"; list; unread; _ } ->
                command caps { m with screen = list; unread } Inbox
            | Some p when p.mailbox = drafts -> command caps m Drafts
            | Some p when p.mailbox = Mail_sync.starred ->
                command caps m Starred_list
            | Some _ -> command caps m All_mail
            | None -> m)
        | None, None, _, Some i -> command caps { m with selected = i } Open_
        | None, None, _, _ when wheel computer <> 0 ->
            (* the wheel: the message read scrolled, the list's selection
             * moved (the list follows it) *)
            if reading then { m with scroll = max 0 (m.scroll + wheel computer) }
            else
              let n =
                if m.mailbox = drafts then List.length m.drafts
                else List.length m.conversations
              in
              { m with selected = moved m.selected (wheel computer) n }
        | None, None, _, _ ->
            if reading && (pressed "ArrowDown" || pressed "space") then
              { m with scroll = (m.scroll + if pressed "space" then 10 else 1) }
            else if reading && pressed "ArrowUp" then
              { m with scroll = max 0 (m.scroll - 1) }
            else m)
  in
  { m with held = keys }

let view = Mail_view.view
apps/pim/window/Mail_window.mli

(* Mail_window: mini-pim's mail in a window (plan_mail.md, stage 5), the
   store's messages as Gmail shows them, and Gmail's keys:

       Pim   Mail   Conversation   Message   Mailbox  <- the menu bar
       Inbox -- erin@ix                              3 conversations
      +-----------+---------------------------------------------------+
      | Inbox     |  news@ix               weekly          2026-10-29 |
      | All Mail  |# Carol (2)             Re: the plan    2026-10-29 |<- the
      | Drafts    |                                                   |  selected
      | /plan     |                                                   |
      +-----------+---------------------------------------------------+

   A view of the suite (Pim_window: its Pim menu, its switcher at the
   sidebar's foot). Every action is in the menu bar (Mail,
   Conversation, Message, Mailbox), each item saying its key, Gmail's:

   j k (and the arrows): the next and the previous conversation; o or
   Enter: open it, its messages one under the other, oldest first; u or
   Escape: back to the list; e: archive it; /: search the store, words
   in who sent it and the subject; Tab: Inbox or All Mail (fetched when
   the password is known); g: get the mail, the app password asked once
   and kept while the window is open, never written (or read from the
   store's file password, if the author made one: Mail_sync). Unread
   conversations are in bold.

   HEY's Screener (Screen), once Mail > Turn On the Screener: the Inbox
   is four lists (the Imbox, the Screener, the Feed, the Paper Trail,
   in the Mailbox menu and the sidebar), a conversation in the one its
   sender's decision says; a new sender's waits in the Screener, y
   lets them in, n screens them out (All Mail still has them); Mailbox
   > Sender: Feed, Paper Trail decide for the sender of the selected
   conversation anywhere.

   Writing (plan_mail.md, stage 7): c a new message; r, a, f a reply,
   a reply to all, a forward of the conversation's newest message
   (Mail_compose). The message is written in the toolkit's widgets
   (lib_gui: To, Cc, Subject, Attach -- files, separated by spaces --
   and the text), kept in the store as a draft at each change, the
   Palm's way; Send (SMTP: Gmail's, or smtp=), Save Draft (or Escape),
   Discard. Mailbox > Drafts lists them; o opens one again.

   The suite's (plan_mail.md, stage 8): z snoozes the conversation
   until a day typed as words (When: monday, in 3 days), archived
   meanwhile and back on top of the Inbox that day, at the next g
   (Mail_sync.wake); t makes its newest message a task, due a day
   typed so, the same item (plan_pim.md, idea 1), then in the suite's
   Tasks (Tasks_window). p adds the conversation's sender to People
   (BBDB's way: by a key, not every address seen; People_window). i
   adds an invitation (a text/calendar part, iMIP) to the Calendar,
   linked to its mail (Events.of_ics).

   The window shows mini-pim's store (Items), not the server: it opens
   at once, with or without the network, on what the last list kept,
   and g fetches (Mail_sync, one IMAP session). A message opened is
   read from the cache, and fetched into it when the password is known
   (marked read on the server then); else the window says g gets it.

   The flags of the program: user= (the account), server=host:port
   and smtp=host:port (Gmail's by default), plain (no TLS:
   mini-maild), today=2026-10-29 (the tests': else the clock's). *)

type caps =
  < Cap.network ; Cap.open_in ; Cap.open_out ; Cap.readdir ; Cap.env ; Cap.exit ;
    Cap.clock >

type model

(* the store's mailbox, as the flags say *)
val initial : caps -> Playground.flags -> model

(* the store read again, as the suite comes back to the view; [keys]
 * those down now, not pressed again *)
val refresh : caps -> string Set_.t -> model -> model

(* [show caps m id]: the conversation of the message whose item is [id]
 * opened (a task's, a person's page's) *)
val show : caps -> model -> string -> model

(* [write caps m to_]: a new message to [to_] *)
val write : caps -> model -> string -> model

(* a message written from a mailto: link (Mailto: its to, cc, subject
 * and text; a bcc said, left out) *)
val write_mailto : caps -> model -> Mailto.t -> model

(* the conversation read, its messages fetched: their items' ids and
 * the messages (Found_window's, x); none when not reading *)
val opened : model -> (string * Mail.t) list

val update : caps -> Playground.computer -> model -> model

(* the view, under the menu bar and the menus, which the suite draws *)
val view : Playground.computer -> model -> Playground.shape list
apps/pim/window/Money_window.ml
23183
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Money_window.mli *)

open Playground
open Pim_look

type caps = Mail_window.caps

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The model *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type mode =
  | Register
  | Report
  | Envelopes
  | Assigning
  | Form
  | Statement
  | Reconciling

(* a new line, as typed in the register's columns *)
type form = {
  date : string;
  num : string;
  payee : string;
  category : string;
  payment : string;
  deposit : string;
}

type model = {
  accounts : string list; (* Assets: and Liabilities:, Checking first *)
  account : string;
  (* the register's lines, each with the balance after it *)
  lines : (Item.t * Ledger.txn * Money.cents) list;
  report : (string * Money.cents) list; (* the month's *)
  envelopes : Envelopes.envelope list;
  to_assign : Money.cents;
  selected : int;
  mode : mode;
  form : form;
  statement : Money.cents; (* the bank's ending balance, reconciling *)
  today : Civil.date;
  field : string; (* the statement's balance, typed *)
  status : string;
  held : string Set_.t;
}

let store (caps : caps) : Items.t = Items.at (Items.place caps)

let checking = "Assets:Checking"

let blank (m : model) : form =
  { date = Civil.to_string m.today; num = ""; payee = ""; category = "";
    payment = ""; deposit = "" }

let load (caps : caps) (m : model) : model =
  let items = Items.all caps (store caps) in
  let own a =
    let p s =
      String.length a > String.length s
      && String.sub a 0 (String.length s) = s
    in
    p "Assets:" || p "Liabilities:"
  in
  let accounts =
    checking :: List.filter (fun a -> own a && a <> checking) (Books.accounts items)
  in
  let reg = Books.register items m.account in
  let bal = Ledger.balances (List.map snd reg) in
  let lines = List.map2 (fun (i, _) (t, b) -> (i, t, b)) reg bal in
  { m with accounts; lines;
    report = Books.report items ~year:m.today.year ~month:m.today.month;
    envelopes = Envelopes.envelopes items;
    to_assign = Envelopes.to_assign items;
    selected = max 0 (min m.selected (List.length lines - 1)) }

let initial (caps : caps) (flags : Playground.flags) : model =
  let today =
    match List.assoc_opt "today" flags with
    | Some d -> (
        match Search.date d with Some d -> d | None -> When.today caps)
    | None -> When.today caps
  in
  let m =
    { accounts = []; account = checking; lines = []; report = [];
      envelopes = []; to_assign = 0;
      selected = max_int; mode = Register;
      form = { date = ""; num = ""; payee = ""; category = ""; payment = "";
               deposit = "" };
      statement = 0; today; field = ""; status = ""; held = Set_.empty }
  in
  load caps { m with form = blank m }

let refresh (caps : caps) (keys : string Set_.t) (m : model) : model =
  load caps { m with held = keys }

(* the line [id] selected, in the register of the first own account it
 * posts to *)
let show (caps : caps) (m : model) (id : string) : model =
  match Items.find caps (store caps) id with
  | None -> { m with status = id ^ ": not in the store" }
  | Some i -> (
      let m = load caps { m with mode = Register } in
      let posts =
        List.map (fun (p : Books.posting) -> p.account) (Books.postings i)
      in
      match List.find_opt (fun a -> List.mem a posts) m.accounts with
      | None -> { m with status = id ^ ": in no account's register" }
      | Some account ->
          let m = load caps { m with account } in
          let rec index k l =
            match l with
            | [] -> m.selected
            | (j, _, _) :: rest ->
                if Item.id j = id then k else index (k + 1) rest
          in
          { m with selected = index 0 m.lines; status = "" })

(*****************************************************************************)
(* What the keys and the menus do *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type command =
  | New_line
  | Record
  | Cancel
  | Clear
  | Reconcile_
  | Finish
  | Next
  | Previous
  | Next_account
  | Report_
  | Envelopes_
  | Assign

let menus : (string * (string * command) list) list =
  [ ( "Register",
      [ ("New Line  (n)", New_line); ("Record  (Enter)", Record);
        ("Cancel  (Esc)", Cancel); ("Mark Cleared  (c)", Clear);
        ("Next  (j)", Next); ("Previous  (k)", Previous) ] );
    ( "Account",
      [ ("Reconcile...  (r)", Reconcile_); ("Finish  (f)", Finish);
        ("Next Account  (Tab)", Next_account);
        ("Categories", Report_); ("Envelopes", Envelopes_);
        ("Assign...  (a)", Assign) ] ) ]

let made = ref 0

(* the form a line in the books, its amount the deposit less the
 * payment *)
let record (caps : caps) (m : model) : model =
  let f = m.form in
  let amount s = if String.trim s = "" then Some 0 else Money.of_string s in
  match (Search.date f.date, amount f.payment, amount f.deposit) with
  | None, _, _ -> { m with status = f.date ^ ": not a date (2026-10-30)" }
  | _, None, _ | _, _, None -> { m with status = "an amount: 42.17" }
  | Some date, Some pay, Some dep ->
      if String.trim f.payee = "" || dep - pay = 0 then
        { m with status = "a payee and an amount" }
      else begin
        incr made;
        let id = Printf.sprintf "money:%.0f.%d" (CapUnix.gettimeofday caps ()) !made in
        let t : Ledger.txn =
          { date; num = String.trim f.num; payee = String.trim f.payee;
            category = String.trim f.category; memo = ""; amount = dep - pay;
            status = Open }
        in
        Items.save caps (store caps) (Books.of_txn ~id ~account:m.account t);
        let m = load caps { m with mode = Register; selected = max_int } in
        { m with form = blank m; status = "recorded: " ^ t.payee }
      end

(* the selected line's cleared mark, ticked or not (a reconciled line
 * stays so) *)
let clear (caps : caps) (m : model) : model =
  match List.nth_opt m.lines m.selected with
  | Some (i, t, _) when t.status <> Reconciled ->
      let s : Ledger.status = if t.status = Cleared then Open else Cleared in
      Items.save caps (store caps) (Books.with_status s i);
      load caps m
  | _ -> m

let txns (m : model) : Ledger.txn list = List.map (fun (_, t, _) -> t) m.lines

let finish (caps : caps) (m : model) : model =
  if Reconcile.difference ~statement:m.statement (txns m) <> 0 then
    { m with status = "the difference is not zero" }
  else begin
    List.iter
      (fun (i, (t : Ledger.txn), _) ->
        if t.status = Cleared then
          Items.save caps (store caps) (Books.with_status Reconciled i))
      m.lines;
    load caps { m with mode = Register; status = "reconciled" }
  end

let command (caps : caps) (m : model) (c : command) : model =
  match c with
  | New_line -> { m with mode = Form; form = blank m; status = "" }
  | Record -> if m.mode = Form then record caps m else m
  | Cancel -> { m with mode = Register; status = "" }
  | Clear -> clear caps m
  | Reconcile_ -> { m with mode = Statement; field = ""; status = "" }
  | Finish -> if m.mode = Reconciling then finish caps m else m
  | Next -> { m with selected = min (List.length m.lines - 1) (m.selected + 1) }
  | Previous -> { m with selected = max 0 (m.selected - 1) }
  | Next_account -> (
      (* the accounts, then the report, the envelopes, the first again *)
      if m.mode = Report then { m with mode = Envelopes }
      else if m.mode = Envelopes then
        load caps
          { m with account = checking; mode = Register; selected = max_int }
      else
        let rec after l =
          match l with
          | a :: (b :: _ as rest) -> if a = m.account then Some b else after rest
          | _ -> None
        in
        match after m.accounts with
        | Some a ->
            load caps
              { m with account = a; mode = Register; selected = max_int }
        | None -> { m with mode = Report })
  | Report_ -> { m with mode = Report }
  | Envelopes_ -> { m with mode = Envelopes }
  | Assign -> { m with mode = Assigning; field = ""; status = "" }

(* the register's columns, from the text's left edge: where each
 * begins, or ends for the amounts (right-aligned) *)
let col_num = 124.
let col_payee = 172.
let col_category = 336.
let end_payment = 574.
let end_deposit = 668.
let col_c = 682.

(* the form's fields, in the columns, at the window's foot *)
let form_y (computer : computer) : float = (-.computer.screen.height /. 2.) +. 60.

let form_box (computer : computer) (left : float) (right : float) : Widget.box =
  let a = area computer in
  { Widget.x = a.x0 +. ((left +. right) /. 2.); y = form_y computer;
    w = right -. left -. 6.; h = 26. }

(* 2000.00: an amount in a field, no commas (they take its room) *)
let plain (c : Money.cents) : string = Printf.sprintf "%d.%02d" (c / 100) (c mod 100)

let writing (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (m : model)
    (menu : command option) (key : string -> bool) : model =
  let f = m.form in
  let field l r v = Gui.field_in ~enabled:true computer (form_box computer l r) v in
  let date = field (-4.) col_num f.date in
  let num = field col_num col_payee f.num in
  let payee = field col_payee col_category f.payee in
  let category = field col_category (end_payment -. 100.) f.category in
  let payment = field (end_payment -. 100.) end_payment f.payment in
  let deposit = field end_payment end_deposit f.deposit in
  let a = area computer in
  let record_ =
    Gui.button_in ~enabled:true computer
      { Widget.x = a.x0 +. a.room -. 50.; y = form_y computer; w = 96.; h = 30. }
      "Record"
  in
  let f' = { date; num; payee; category; payment; deposit } in
  (* QuickFill: a payee typed, the rest of their last line copied *)
  let f' =
    if
      f'.payee <> f.payee && f.category = "" && f.payment = "" && f.deposit = ""
    then
      match Ledger.quickfill (txns m) f'.payee with
      | Some t ->
          { f' with
            payee = t.payee; category = t.category;
            payment = (if t.amount < 0 then plain (-t.amount) else "");
            deposit = (if t.amount > 0 then plain t.amount else "") }
      | None -> f'
    else f'
  in
  let m = { m with form = f' } in
  match menu with
  | Some c -> command caps m c
  | None ->
      if record_ || key "Enter" then record caps m
      else if key "Escape" then command caps m Cancel
      else m

let update (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (m : model) : model * go option =
  let keys = computer.keyboard.keys in
  let pressed name = Set_.mem name keys && not (Set_.mem name m.held) in
  let menu = chosen computer ~first:1 menus in
  let m =
    match m.mode with
    | Form -> writing caps computer m menu pressed
    | Statement ->
        if pressed "Escape" then { m with mode = Register; field = "" }
        else if pressed "Enter" then
          match Money.of_string m.field with
          | Some c ->
              { m with mode = Reconciling; statement = c; field = "";
                status = "" }
          | None ->
              { m with mode = Register; status = m.field ^ ": not an amount" }
        else if pressed "Backspace" then { m with field = without_last m.field }
        else { m with field = m.field ^ printable computer.keyboard.typed }
    | Assigning ->
        (* "Groceries 400": an envelope's name, then the amount *)
        if pressed "Escape" then { m with mode = Envelopes; field = "" }
        else if pressed "Enter" then
          let words = String.split_on_char ' ' (String.trim m.field) in
          match List.rev words with
          | amount :: (_ :: _ as name) -> (
              match Money.of_string amount with
              | Some c ->
                  incr made;
                  let id =
                    Printf.sprintf "budget:%.0f.%d" (CapUnix.gettimeofday caps ()) !made
                  in
                  let name = String.concat " " (List.rev name) in
                  Items.save caps (store caps)
                    (Envelopes.assign ~id m.today name c);
                  load caps
                    { m with mode = Envelopes; field = "";
                      status = Money.to_string c ^ " to " ^ name }
              | None ->
                  { m with mode = Envelopes;
                    status = amount ^ ": not an amount" })
          | _ -> { m with mode = Envelopes; status = "an envelope and an amount" }
        else if pressed "Backspace" then { m with field = without_last m.field }
        else { m with field = m.field ^ printable computer.keyboard.typed }
    | (Register | Report | Envelopes | Reconciling) when Gui.modal () -> m
    | Register | Report | Envelopes | Reconciling -> (
        let key =
          if pressed "j" || pressed "ArrowDown" then Some Next
          else if pressed "k" || pressed "ArrowUp" then Some Previous
          else if pressed "n" then Some New_line
          else if pressed "c" || (m.mode = Reconciling && pressed "space") then
            Some Clear
          else if pressed "r" then Some Reconcile_
          else if pressed "f" then Some Finish
          else if pressed "Escape" then Some Cancel
          else if pressed "Tab" then Some Next_account
          else if pressed "a" then Some Assign
          else None
        in
        (* the mouse: an account, the categories, the envelopes of the
         * sidebar; a line of the register (under its head, row 0) *)
        let n = List.length m.accounts in
        let line =
          match row_click computer with
          | Some k when k > 0 && (m.mode = Register || m.mode = Reconciling) ->
              let foot = if m.mode = Reconciling then 7 else 3 in
              let fits =
                int_of_float
                  ((computer.screen.height -. menu_bar -. bar -. 40.) /. row)
                - foot
              in
              let i = max 0 (m.selected - fits + 1) + k - 1 in
              if i < List.length m.lines then Some i else None
          | _ -> None
        in
        match (menu, key, sidebar_click computer, line) with
        | Some c, _, _, _ | None, Some c, _, _ -> command caps m c
        | None, None, Some k, _ when k < n ->
            load caps
              { m with account = List.nth m.accounts k; mode = Register;
                selected = max_int }
        | None, None, Some k, _ when k = n -> { m with mode = Report }
        | None, None, Some k, _ when k = n + 1 -> { m with mode = Envelopes }
        | None, None, _, Some i -> { m with selected = i }
        | None, None, _, _
          when (m.mode = Register || m.mode = Reconciling)
               && wheel computer <> 0 ->
            (* (selected is max_int at first: the last line) *)
            let n = List.length m.lines in
            { m with selected = moved (min m.selected (n - 1)) (wheel computer) n }
        | None, None, _, _ -> m)
  in
  ({ m with held = keys }, None)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The picture *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* "Checking" of "Assets:Checking" *)
let short (account : string) : string =
  match String.index_opt account ':' with
  | Some i -> String.sub account (i + 1) (String.length account - i - 1)
  | None -> account

let hint_text (h : Reconcile.hint) : string =
  let line (t : Ledger.txn) =
    t.payee ^ " " ^ Money.to_string t.amount ^ " (" ^ Civil.to_string t.date ^ ")"
  in
  match h with
  | Missing l ->
      "not ticked, on the statement? " ^ String.concat ", " (List.map line l)
  | Extra t -> "ticked, not on the statement? " ^ line t
  | Wrong_sign t -> "entered with the wrong sign? " ^ line t
  | Transposed (t, c) ->
      "two digits swapped? " ^ line t ^ ", which should say " ^ Money.to_string c
  | Nine -> "a multiple of 9: two digits swapped somewhere"

let view (computer : computer) (m : model) : shape list =
  let a = area computer in
  let x0 = a.x0 in
  let balance =
    match List.rev m.lines with (_, _, b) :: _ -> b | [] -> 0
  in
  let title_ =
    match m.mode with
    | Statement -> "the statement's ending balance: " ^ m.field ^ "_"
    | Report ->
        Printf.sprintf "Categories, %s %d" (Civil.month_name m.today.month)
          m.today.year
    | Reconciling -> "Reconcile " ^ short m.account
    | Envelopes -> "Envelopes"
    | Assigning -> "assign: " ^ m.field ^ "_   (Groceries 400)"
    | Register | Form -> short m.account
  in
  let right =
    if m.status <> "" then m.status
    else if m.mode = Report then ""
    else if m.mode = Envelopes || m.mode = Assigning then
      "to assign " ^ Money.to_string m.to_assign
    else "balance " ^ Money.to_string balance
  in
  let amount_at (right_edge : float) (y : float) (s : string) (color : color) =
    text color ~bold:false ~room:(width s +. 4.) (x0 +. right_edge -. width s) y s
  in
  let main =
    match m.mode with
    | Report ->
        let total = List.fold_left (fun s (_, c) -> s + c) 0 m.report in
        if m.report = [] then
          [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:a.room x0 (row_y a 0)
              "Nothing this month." ]
        else
          List.concat
            (List.mapi
               (fun k (acct, c) ->
                 let y = row_y a k in
                 [ text ink ~bold:false ~room:300. x0 y acct;
                   amount_at 400. y (Money.to_string (-c))
                     (if c > 0 then red else ink) ])
               m.report)
          @ [ text ink ~bold:true ~room:300. x0 (row_y a (List.length m.report + 1))
                "what is left";
              amount_at 400. (row_y a (List.length m.report + 1))
                (Money.to_string (-total)) ink ]
    | Envelopes | Assigning ->
        let head_y = row_y a 0 in
        let money x y s c = amount_at x y (Money.to_string s) c in
        [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:200. x0 head_y "Envelope";
          amount_at 400. head_y "Assigned" grey;
          amount_at 520. head_y "Spent" grey;
          amount_at 640. head_y "Available" grey ]
        @ (if m.envelopes = [] then
             [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:a.room x0 (row_y a 1)
                 "No envelopes: a assigns money to one (Groceries 400)." ]
           else [])
        @ List.concat
            (List.mapi
               (fun k (e : Envelopes.envelope) ->
                 let y = row_y a (k + 1) in
                 [ text ink ~bold:false ~room:250. x0 y
                     (Books.category e.account);
                   money 400. y e.assigned ink; money 520. y e.spent ink;
                   money 640. y e.available
                     (if e.available < 0 then red else ink) ])
               m.envelopes)
        @
        (* every dollar a job when it is 0 *)
        let y = row_y a (List.length m.envelopes + 2) in
        [ text ink ~bold:true ~room:250. x0 y "to assign";
          money 640. y m.to_assign (if m.to_assign < 0 then red else ink) ]
    | Register | Form | Statement | Reconciling ->
        let head_y = row_y a 0 in
        let head =
          [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:90. x0 head_y "Date";
            text grey ~bold:false ~room:40. (x0 +. col_num) head_y "Num";
            text grey ~bold:false ~room:170. (x0 +. col_payee) head_y "Payee";
            text grey ~bold:false ~room:170. (x0 +. col_category) head_y "Category";
            amount_at end_payment head_y "Payment" grey;
            amount_at end_deposit head_y "Deposit" grey;
            text grey ~bold:false ~room:20. (x0 +. col_c) head_y "C";
            amount_at a.room head_y "Balance" grey ]
        in
        let foot = if m.mode = Reconciling then 7 else 3 in
        let fits =
          int_of_float ((computer.screen.height -. menu_bar -. bar -. 40.) /. row)
          - foot
        in
        let first = max 0 (m.selected - fits + 1) in
        let rows =
          List.concat
            (List.mapi
               (fun k (_, (t : Ledger.txn), b) ->
                 if k < first || k >= first + fits then []
                 else
                   let y = row_y a (k - first + 1) in
                   (if k = m.selected && m.mode <> Form then [ selected a y ]
                    else [])
                   @ [ text ink ~bold:false ~room:(col_num -. 4.) x0 y
                         (Civil.to_string t.date);
                       text ink ~bold:false ~room:44. (x0 +. col_num) y t.num;
                       text ink ~bold:false ~room:(col_category -. col_payee -. 6.)
                         (x0 +. col_payee) y t.payee;
                       text grey ~bold:false
                         ~room:(end_payment -. col_category -. 90.)
                         (x0 +. col_category) y t.category ]
                   @ (if t.amount < 0 then
                        [ amount_at end_payment y (Money.to_string (-t.amount)) ink ]
                      else
                        [ amount_at end_deposit y (Money.to_string t.amount) ink ])
                   @ [ text ink ~bold:true ~room:20. (x0 +. col_c) y
                         (match t.status with
                         | Open -> ""
                         | Cleared -> "*"
                         | Reconciled -> "R");
                       amount_at a.room y (Money.to_string b)
                         (if b < 0 then red else ink) ])
               m.lines)
        in
        let empty =
          if m.lines = [] then
            [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:a.room x0 (row_y a 1)
                "No lines yet: n writes one (QuickFill: a payee's last line)." ]
          else []
        in
        let reconciling =
          if m.mode <> Reconciling then []
          else
            let t = txns m in
            let d = Reconcile.difference ~statement:m.statement t in
            let say k s c =
              text c ~bold:(k = 0) ~room:a.room x0
                ((-.computer.screen.height /. 2.) +. 150.
                -. (float_of_int k *. 24.))
                s
            in
            say 0
              (Printf.sprintf "statement %s   cleared %s   difference %s"
                 (Money.to_string m.statement)
                 (Money.to_string (Reconcile.cleared t))
                 (Money.to_string d))
              (if d = 0 then blue else ink)
            :: List.mapi
                 (fun k h -> say (k + 1) (hint_text h) grey)
                 (List.filteri
                    (fun k _ -> k < 3)
                    (Reconcile.hints ~statement:m.statement t))
            @ [ say 5
                  (if d = 0 then "f: finish, the ticked lines reconciled"
                   else "space or c ticks a line the statement lists")
                  grey ]
        in
        head @ rows @ empty @ reconciling
  in
  (rectangle white computer.screen.width computer.screen.height
   :: title_bar computer title_ right)
  @ sidebar a
      (List.map
         (fun acct ->
           ( short acct,
             acct = m.account
             && not (List.mem m.mode [ Report; Envelopes; Assigning ]) ))
         m.accounts
      @ [ ("Categories", m.mode = Report);
          ("Envelopes", m.mode = Envelopes || m.mode = Assigning) ])
  @ main

apps/pim/window/Notes_window.ml

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Notes_window.mli *)

open Playground
open Pim_look

type caps = Mail_window.caps

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The model *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type shown = Notes | Days
type mode = Browsing | Editing | Asking

type model = {
  shown : shown;
  notes : Item.t list; (* the list shown's *)
  selected : int;
  mode : mode;
  (* the note open, its text being edited, what it names and what names
   * it (-> and <-) *)
  note : Item.t option;
  body : Text_edit.t;
  links : (bool * Item.t) list;
  today : Civil.date;
  field : string; (* a new note's title, typed *)
  status : string;
  held : string Set_.t;
}

let store (caps : caps) : Items.t = Items.at (Items.place caps)

let is_day (i : Item.t) : bool =
  String.length (Item.id i) > 4 && String.sub (Item.id i) 0 4 = "day:"

(* the notes by title; the days, the last first *)
let load (caps : caps) (m : model) : model =
  let items = Items.all caps (store caps) in
  let notes = List.filter (fun i -> Item.has_stamp i "note") items in
  let l =
    match m.shown with
    | Notes ->
        List.stable_sort
          (fun a b ->
            compare (String.lowercase_ascii (title a))
              (String.lowercase_ascii (title b)))
          (List.filter (fun i -> not (is_day i)) notes)
    | Days ->
        List.rev
          (List.stable_sort
             (fun a b -> compare (Item.id a) (Item.id b))
             (List.filter is_day notes))
  in
  let links =
    match m.note with
    | None -> []
    | Some n ->
        List.map (fun (_, i) -> (true, i)) (Links.links items n)
        @ List.map (fun (_, i) -> (false, i)) (Links.backlinks items n)
  in
  { m with notes = l; links;
    selected = max 0 (min m.selected (List.length l - 1)) }

let initial (caps : caps) (flags : Playground.flags) : model =
  let today =
    match List.assoc_opt "today" flags with
    | Some d -> (
        match Search.date d with Some d -> d | None -> When.today caps)
    | None -> When.today caps
  in
  load caps
    { shown = Notes; notes = []; selected = 0; mode = Browsing; note = None;
      body = Text_edit.of_string ""; links = []; today; field = "";
      status = ""; held = Set_.empty }

let refresh (caps : caps) (keys : string Set_.t) (m : model) : model =
  load caps { m with held = keys }

(* the note opened, to be written in *)
let edit (caps : caps) (m : model) (n : Item.t) : model =
  load caps
    { m with mode = Editing; note = Some n; body = Text_edit.of_string n.body;
      shown = (if is_day n then Days else Notes); status = "" }

let show (caps : caps) (m : model) (id : string) : model =
  match Items.find caps (store caps) id with
  | Some n -> edit caps m n
  | None -> { m with status = id ^ ": not in the store" }

(* "The Plan, again" -> "the-plan-again", an id a person can type
 * between [[ ]]; made unique by a number *)
let slug (caps : caps) (t : string) : string =
  let s =
    String.concat "-"
      (List.filter (fun w -> w <> "")
         (String.split_on_char ' '
            (String.map
               (fun c ->
                 match c with
                 | 'a' .. 'z' | '0' .. '9' -> c
                 | 'A' .. 'Z' -> Char.lowercase_ascii c
                 | _ -> ' ')
               t)))
  in
  let s = if s = "" then "note" else s in
  let rec free k =
    let id = if k = 1 then "note:" ^ s else Printf.sprintf "note:%s-%d" s k in
    if Items.find caps (store caps) id = None then id else free (k + 1)
  in
  free 1

(* today's page, made when first asked (plan_pim.md, stage 7: the
 * daily note) *)
let day_note (caps : caps) (m : model) : model =
  let id = "day:" ^ Mail_sync.day m.today in
  match Items.find caps (store caps) id with
  | Some n -> edit caps m n
  | None ->
      let n =
        Item.make ~id ~stamps:[ "note" ]
          [ ("title", Mail_sync.day m.today) ]
          ""
      in
      Items.save caps (store caps) n;
      edit caps m n

(*****************************************************************************)
(* What the keys and the menus do *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type command =
  | New_
  | Today
  | Open_
  | Back
  | Next
  | Previous
  | Notes_list
  | Days_list

let menus : (string * (string * command) list) list =
  [ ( "Note",
      [ ("New Note...  (n)", New_); ("Today's Note  (d)", Today);
        ("Open  (o)", Open_); ("Back to List  (Esc)", Back);
        ("Next  (j)", Next); ("Previous  (k)", Previous) ] );
    ("List", [ ("Notes  (Tab)", Notes_list); ("Days  (Tab)", Days_list) ]) ]

let command (caps : caps) (m : model) (c : command) : model =
  match c with
  | New_ -> { m with mode = Asking; field = ""; status = "" }
  | Today -> day_note caps m
  | Open_ -> (
      match List.nth_opt m.notes m.selected with
      | Some n when m.mode = Browsing -> edit caps m n
      | _ -> m)
  | Back -> load caps { m with mode = Browsing; note = None }
  | Next when m.mode = Browsing ->
      { m with selected = min (List.length m.notes - 1) (m.selected + 1) }
  | Previous when m.mode = Browsing ->
      { m with selected = max 0 (m.selected - 1) }
  | Next | Previous -> m
  | Notes_list ->
      load caps { m with shown = Notes; selected = 0; mode = Browsing;
                  note = None }
  | Days_list ->
      load caps { m with shown = Days; selected = 0; mode = Browsing;
                  note = None }

(* where the text is, and the links under it *)
let links_shown = 5

let area_box (computer : computer) : Widget.box =
  let a = area computer in
  let top = a.top -. bar -. 10. in
  let bottom =
    (-.computer.screen.height /. 2.) +. 20. +. (float_of_int links_shown *. row)
  in
  { Widget.x = a.x0 +. (a.room /. 2.); y = (top +. bottom) /. 2.; w = a.room;
    h = top -. bottom }

let link_y (computer : computer) (k : int) : float =
  (-.computer.screen.height /. 2.) +. 14.
  +. (float_of_int (links_shown - 1 - k) *. row)

(* the link clicked under the text, if one was *)
let link_click (computer : computer) (m : model) : Item.t option =
  let a = area computer in
  let mouse = computer.mouse in
  if (not mouse.mclick) || mouse.mx < a.x0 || Gui.modal () then None
  else
    List.find_map
      (fun (k, (_, i)) ->
        let y = link_y computer k in
        if mouse.my >= y && mouse.my < y +. row then Some i else None)
      (List.filteri (fun k _ -> k < links_shown)
         (List.mapi (fun k l -> (k, l)) m.links))

let update (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (m : model) : model * go option =
  let keys = computer.keyboard.keys in
  let pressed name = Set_.mem name keys && not (Set_.mem name m.held) in
  let menu = chosen computer ~first:1 menus in
  let m, go =
    match m.mode with
    | Asking ->
        if pressed "Escape" then ({ m with mode = Browsing; field = "" }, None)
        else if pressed "Enter" then
          let t = String.trim m.field in
          if t = "" then ({ m with mode = Browsing }, None)
          else begin
            let n =
              Item.make ~id:(slug caps t) ~stamps:[ "note" ] [ ("title", t) ] ""
            in
            Items.save caps (store caps) n;
            (edit caps { m with field = "" } n, None)
          end
        else if pressed "Backspace" then
          ({ m with field = without_last m.field }, None)
        else ({ m with field = m.field ^ printable computer.keyboard.typed }, None)
    | Editing -> (
        (* the text written to the store as it changes, the Palm's way *)
        let body = Gui.text_area_in computer (area_box computer) m.body in
        let m =
          match m.note with
          | Some n when Text_edit.to_string body <> n.body ->
              let n = { n with body = Text_edit.to_string body } in
              Items.save caps (store caps) n;
              load caps { m with note = Some n; body }
          | _ -> { m with body }
        in
        match (menu, link_click computer m) with
        | Some c, _ -> (command caps m c, None)
        (* (a note opened here, the rest where it lives) *)
        | None, Some i when Item.has_stamp i "note" -> (edit caps m i, None)
        | None, Some i -> (m, Some (Item (Item.id i)))
        | None, None ->
            if pressed "Escape" then (command caps m Back, None) else (m, None))
    | Browsing when Gui.modal () -> (m, None)
    | Browsing -> (
        let key =
          if pressed "j" || pressed "ArrowDown" then Some Next
          else if pressed "k" || pressed "ArrowUp" then Some Previous
          else if pressed "o" || pressed "Enter" then Some Open_
          else if pressed "n" then Some New_
          else if pressed "d" then Some Today
          else if pressed "Tab" then
            Some (if m.shown = Notes then Days_list else Notes_list)
          else None
        in
        let side_ =
          match sidebar_click computer with
          | Some 0 -> Some Notes_list
          | Some 1 -> Some Days_list
          | _ -> None
        in
        let clicked =
          match row_click computer with
          | Some i when i < List.length m.notes -> Some i
          | _ -> None
        in
        match (menu, key, side_, clicked) with
        | Some c, _, _, _ | None, Some c, _, _ | None, None, Some c, _ ->
            (command caps m c, None)
        | None, None, None, Some i ->
            (command caps { m with selected = i } Open_, None)
        | None, None, None, None when wheel computer <> 0 ->
            ( { m with
                selected =
                  moved m.selected (wheel computer) (List.length m.notes) },
              None )
        | None, None, None, None -> (m, None))
  in
  ({ m with held = keys }, go)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The picture *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* "note", "contact", "mail": what an item is, by its id *)
let kind (i : Item.t) : string =
  match String.index_opt (Item.id i) ':' with
  | Some k -> String.sub (Item.id i) 0 k
  | None -> ""

let view (computer : computer) (m : model) : shape list =
  let a = area computer in
  let title_ =
    match (m.mode, m.note) with
    | Asking, _ -> "a note: " ^ m.field ^ "_"
    | Editing, Some n -> title n
    | _ -> if m.shown = Notes then "Notes" else "Days"
  in
  let right =
    if m.status <> "" then m.status
    else
      match (m.mode, m.note) with
      | Editing, Some n -> Item.id n
      | _ -> count (List.length m.notes) (if m.shown = Notes then "note" else "day")
  in
  let main =
    match m.mode with
    | Editing ->
        (* the text is the toolkit's (Gui.draw); the links under it *)
        if m.links = [] then
          [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:a.room a.x0 (link_y computer 0 +. 9.)
              "No links: [[contact:alice]] or [[note:the-plan]] in the text \
               makes one." ]
        else
          List.mapi
            (fun k (out, i) ->
              text (if out then blue else grey) ~bold:false ~room:a.room a.x0
                (link_y computer k +. 9.)
                ((if out then "\xe2\x86\x92 " else "\xe2\x86\x90 ")
                 ^ title i ^ "   (" ^ kind i ^ ")"))
            (List.filteri (fun k _ -> k < links_shown) m.links)
    | _ when m.notes = [] ->
        [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:a.room a.x0 (row_y a 0)
            (if m.shown = Notes then "No notes: n writes one."
             else "No days: d writes today's.") ]
    | _ ->
        List.concat
          (List.mapi
             (fun i (n : Item.t) ->
               let y = row_y a i in
               let first =
                 match String.split_on_char '\n' (String.trim n.body) with
                 | l :: _ -> l
                 | [] -> ""
               in
               (if i = m.selected then [ selected a y ] else [])
               @ [ text ink ~bold:false ~room:240. a.x0 y (title n);
                   text grey ~bold:false ~room:(a.room -. 250.) (a.x0 +. 250.)
                     y first ])
             m.notes)
  in
  (rectangle white computer.screen.width computer.screen.height
   :: title_bar computer title_ right)
  @ sidebar a [ ("Notes", m.shown = Notes); ("Days", m.shown = Days) ]
  @ main
