(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See People_window.mli *)

open Playground
open Pim_look

type caps = Mail_window.caps

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The model *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type mode = Browsing | Page | Asking

type model = {
  people : Item.t list; (* by name *)
  selected : int;
  (* the page open: the person, what is with them by section (the
   * items linking to them, the money paid to them, the mail with them),
   * the row selected *)
  person : Item.t option;
  page : (string * Item.t) list;
  at : int;
  mode : mode;
  field : string; (* a new person, typed *)
  status : string;
  held : string Set_.t;
}

let store (caps : caps) : Items.t = Items.at (Items.place caps)

(* a person's page (plan_pim.md, idea 2): what links to them by its
 * kind, the next events first; the money whose payee is their name;
 * the mail from or to them *)
let page (items : Item.t list) (c : Item.t) : (string * Item.t) list =
  let backs = List.map snd (Links.backlinks items c) in
  let backs =
    List.fold_left
      (fun acc i -> if List.memq i acc then acc else acc @ [ i ])
      [] backs
  in
  let day (i : Item.t) =
    match Search.day i with Some d -> Civil.days_from_civil d | None -> 0
  in
  let named = String.lowercase_ascii (title c) in
  let paid =
    List.filter
      (fun i ->
        Item.has_stamp i "money" && (not (List.memq i backs))
        && String.lowercase_ascii (Item.field i "payee") = named)
      items
  in
  let section name stamp l =
    List.map (fun i -> (name, i))
      (List.filter (fun i -> Item.has_stamp i stamp) l)
  in
  section "Events" "event"
    (List.stable_sort (fun a b -> compare (day a) (day b)) backs)
  @ section "Tasks" "task"
      (List.filter (fun i -> not (Item.has_stamp i "message")) backs)
  @ section "Money" "money"
      (List.filter (fun i -> not (Item.has_stamp i "task")) backs @ paid)
  @ section "Notes" "note" backs
  @ List.map (fun i -> ("Mail", i)) (People.with_ items c)

let load (caps : caps) (m : model) : model =
  let items = Items.all caps (store caps) in
  let ps = People.contacts items in
  let page = match m.person with Some c -> page items c | None -> [] in
  { m with people = ps; page;
    selected = max 0 (min m.selected (List.length ps - 1)) }

let initial (caps : caps) (_flags : Playground.flags) : model =
  load caps
    { people = []; selected = 0; person = None; page = []; at = 0;
      mode = Browsing; field = ""; status = ""; held = Set_.empty }

let refresh (caps : caps) (keys : string Set_.t) (m : model) : model =
  load caps { m with held = keys }

(* the person [id]'s page *)
let show (caps : caps) (m : model) (id : string) : model =
  match Items.find caps (store caps) id with
  | Some p -> load caps { m with mode = Page; person = Some p; at = 0 }
  | None -> { m with status = id ^ ": not in the store" }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* What the keys and the menus do *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type command = New_ | Open_ | Back | Write_ | Next | Previous

(* a page's rows: a section's name, an item; each section's name where
 * it begins *)
type row = Heading of string | Row of Item.t

let page_rows (page : (string * Item.t) list) : row list =
  let rec go last l =
    match l with
    | [] -> []
    | (name, i) :: rest ->
        (if name <> last then [ Heading name ] else []) @ (Row i :: go name rest)
  in
  go "" page

let menus : (string * (string * command) list) list =
  [ ( "Person",
      [ ("New Person...  (n)", New_); ("Open  (o)", Open_);
        ("Back to List  (u)", Back); ("Write To  (c)", Write_);
        ("Next  (j)", Next); ("Previous  (k)", Previous) ] ) ]

let current (m : model) : Item.t option =
  match m.mode with
  | Page -> m.person
  | Browsing | Asking -> List.nth_opt m.people m.selected

(* "Dan <dan@ix>" or "dan@ix" made a contact, BBDB's way by hand *)
let add (caps : caps) (m : model) (line : string) : model =
  match Mail.address (String.trim line) with
  | None -> { m with status = line ^ ": not an address (Dan <dan@ix>)" }
  | Some a ->
      let name = if a.display <> "" then a.display else a.mailbox in
      let c =
        Item.make ~id:(People.id a) ~stamps:[ "contact" ]
          [ ("name", name); ("email", String.lowercase_ascii a.mailbox) ]
          ""
      in
      if Items.find caps (store caps) (Item.id c) <> None then
        { m with status = Item.id c ^ ": already in People" }
      else begin
        Items.save caps (store caps) c;
        load caps { m with status = name ^ " added" }
      end

let command (caps : caps) (m : model) (c : command) : model * go option =
  match (c, m.mode) with
  | New_, _ -> ({ m with mode = Asking; field = ""; status = "" }, None)
  | Open_, Browsing -> (
      match current m with
      | Some p ->
          (load caps { m with mode = Page; person = Some p; at = 0 }, None)
      | None -> (m, None))
  | Open_, Page -> (
      match List.nth_opt m.page m.at with
      | Some (_, i) -> (m, Some (Item (Item.id i)))
      | None -> (m, None))
  | Back, _ -> ({ m with mode = Browsing; person = None }, None)
  | Write_, _ -> (
      match current m with
      | Some p -> (
          match People.emails p with
          | e :: _ ->
              let display = if title p = e then "" else title p in
              (m, Some (Write (Mail.address_to_string { display; mailbox = e })))
          | [] -> (m, None))
      | None -> (m, None))
  | Next, Page ->
      ({ m with at = min (List.length m.page - 1) (m.at + 1) }, None)
  | Previous, Page -> ({ m with at = max 0 (m.at - 1) }, None)
  | Next, _ ->
      ({ m with selected = min (List.length m.people - 1) (m.selected + 1) },
       None)
  | Previous, _ -> ({ m with selected = max 0 (m.selected - 1) }, None)
  | Open_, Asking -> (m, None)

let update (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (m : model) : model * go option =
  let keys = computer.keyboard.keys in
  let pressed name = Set_.mem name keys && not (Set_.mem name m.held) in
  let menu = chosen computer ~first:1 menus in
  let m, go =
    match m.mode with
    | Asking ->
        if pressed "Escape" then ({ m with mode = Browsing; field = "" }, None)
        else if pressed "Enter" then
          (add caps { m with mode = Browsing; field = "" } m.field, None)
        else if pressed "Backspace" then
          ({ m with field = without_last m.field }, None)
        else ({ m with field = m.field ^ printable computer.keyboard.typed }, None)
    | (Browsing | Page) when Gui.modal () -> (m, None)
    | Browsing | Page -> (
        let key =
          if pressed "j" || pressed "ArrowDown" then Some Next
          else if pressed "k" || pressed "ArrowUp" then Some Previous
          else if pressed "o" || pressed "Enter" then Some Open_
          else if pressed "u" || pressed "Escape" then Some Back
          else if pressed "n" then Some New_
          else if pressed "c" then Some Write_
          else None
        in
        let clicked =
          match (m.mode, m.person, row_click computer) with
          | Browsing, _, Some i when i < List.length m.people ->
              Some { m with selected = i }
          | Page, Some p, Some k -> (
              (* (the page's rows: the addresses, a blank, the sections) *)
              let k0 = List.length (People.emails p) + 1 in
              match List.nth_opt (page_rows m.page) (k - k0) with
              | Some (Row i) ->
                  let rec index j l =
                    match l with
                    | (_, x) :: rest -> if x == i then j else index (j + 1) rest
                    | [] -> -1
                  in
                  Some { m with at = index 0 m.page }
              | _ -> None)
          | _ -> None
        in
        match (menu, key, sidebar_click computer, clicked) with
        | Some c, _, _, _ | None, Some c, _, _ -> command caps m c
        | None, None, Some 0, _ -> command caps m Back
        | None, None, _, Some m' -> command caps m' Open_
        | None, None, _, None when wheel computer <> 0 ->
            if m.mode = Page then
              ({ m with at = moved m.at (wheel computer) (List.length m.page) },
               None)
            else
              ( { m with
                  selected =
                    moved m.selected (wheel computer) (List.length m.people) },
                None )
        | None, None, _, None -> (m, None))
  in
  ({ m with held = keys }, go)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The picture *)
(*****************************************************************************)


let view (computer : computer) (m : model) : shape list =
  let a = area computer in
  let title_ =
    match (m.mode, m.person) with
    | Asking, _ -> "a person: " ^ m.field ^ "_"
    | Page, Some p -> title p
    | _ -> "People"
  in
  let right =
    if m.status <> "" then m.status
    else if m.mode = Page then count (List.length m.page) "item"
    else count (List.length m.people) "person"
  in
  let main =
    match (m.mode, m.person) with
    | Page, Some p ->
        (* the page: the addresses, then each section, its heading
         * where it begins *)
        let emails = People.emails p in
        let k0 = List.length emails + 1 in
        let rows = page_rows m.page in
        let shown (i : Item.t) =
          if Item.has_stamp i "message" then
            (Conversations.day i, Conversations.who i ^ "   " ^ title i)
          else
            ( (match Search.day i with
              | Some d -> Civil.to_string d
              | None -> ""),
              title i
              ^ match Books.postings i with
                | p :: _ when Item.has_stamp i "money" ->
                    "   " ^ Money.to_string (abs p.amount)
                | _ -> "" )
        in
        List.mapi
          (fun k e -> text grey ~bold:false ~room:a.room a.x0 (row_y a k) e)
          emails
        @ (if m.page = [] then
             [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:a.room a.x0 (row_y a k0)
                 "Nothing with them in the store yet." ]
           else [])
        @ List.concat
            (List.mapi
               (fun k r ->
                 let y = row_y a (k0 + k) in
                 match r with
                 | Heading name -> [ text ink ~bold:true ~room:a.room a.x0 y name ]
                 | Row i ->
                     let n =
                       let rec index j l =
                         match l with
                         | (_, x) :: rest ->
                             if x == i then j else index (j + 1) rest
                         | [] -> -1
                       in
                       index 0 m.page
                     in
                     let left, right = shown i in
                     (if n = m.at then [ selected a y ] else [])
                     @ [ text ink ~bold:false ~room:120. a.x0 y left;
                         text ink ~bold:false ~room:(a.room -. 130.)
                           (a.x0 +. 130.) y right ])
               rows)
    | _ when m.people = [] ->
        [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:a.room a.x0 (row_y a 0)
            "No one: n adds a person, p in Mail a conversation's sender." ]
    | _ ->
        List.concat
          (List.mapi
             (fun i (c : Item.t) ->
               let y = row_y a i in
               (if i = m.selected then [ selected a y ] else [])
               @ [ text ink ~bold:false ~room:190. a.x0 y (title c);
                   text grey ~bold:false ~room:(a.room -. 200.) (a.x0 +. 200.)
                     y (String.concat ", " (People.emails c)) ])
             m.people)
  in
  (rectangle white computer.screen.width computer.screen.height
   :: title_bar computer title_ right)
  @ sidebar a [ ("People", true) ]
  @ main

  [ (Home, "Home"); (Mail, "Mail"); (Calendar, "Calendar");
    (People, "People"); (Tasks, "Tasks"); (Notes, "Notes"); (Money, "Money") ]

let menu_bar = 30.
let size = 16.
let row = 28.
let side = 170.
let bar = 40.

let ink = rgb 32 33 36
let grey = rgb 95 99 104
let blue = rgb 26 115 232
let red = rgb 197 34 31

let menu_box (computer : computer) (i : int) : Widget.box =
  let w = computer.screen.width and h = computer.screen.height in
  (* (as wide as the longest item, "Back to List  (u)") *)
  { Widget.x = (-.w /. 2.) +. 89. +. (float_of_int i *. 174.);
    y = (h /. 2.) -. (menu_bar /. 2.); w = 170.; h = menu_bar -. 4. }

let chosen (computer : computer) ~(first : int)
    (menus : (string * (string * 'c) list) list) : 'c option =
  List.fold_left
    (fun found (i, (title, items)) ->
      let labels = title :: List.map fst items in
      let k = Gui.menu_in computer (menu_box computer (first + i)) labels 0 in
      (* (0: the title, nothing chosen) *)
      if found <> None || k = 0 then found
      else Option.map snd (List.nth_opt items (k - 1)))
    None
    (List.mapi (fun i menu -> (i, menu)) menus)

(* a letter's width, Hershey's at [size] *)
let advance (c : string) : float =
  let g = Glyph_unicode.glyph c in
  float_of_int (g.right - g.left) *. size /. Hershey.units_per_em

let width (s : string) : float =
  List.fold_left (fun w c -> w +. advance c) 0. (Text.chars s)

let text (color : color) ~(bold : bool) ~(room : float) (x : float)
    (baseline : float) (s : string) : shape =
  let rec place (x0 : float) acc l =
    match l with
    | [] -> List.rev acc
    | c :: rest ->
        let w = advance c in
        if x0 +. w > x +. room then List.rev acc
        else place (x0 +. w) ((x0, c) :: acc) rest
  in
  letters color
    { size; bold; italic = false; baseline; at = place x [] (Text.chars s) }

let wrap (room : float) (s : string) : string list =
  List.concat_map
    (fun line ->
      let words = String.split_on_char ' ' line in
      let rec go cur acc ws =
        match ws with
        | [] -> List.rev (cur :: acc)
        | w :: rest ->
            let next = if cur = "" then w else cur ^ " " ^ w in
            if cur <> "" && width next > room then go w (cur :: acc) rest
            else go next acc rest
      in
      go "" [] words)
    (String.split_on_char '\n' s)

let title : Item.t -> string = Search.title

let printable (typed : string) : string =
  String.concat "" (List.filter (fun c -> c >= " ") (Text.chars typed))

let without_last (s : string) : string =
  match List.rev (Text.chars s) with
  | [] -> ""
  | _ :: rest -> String.concat "" (List.rev rest)

type area = { left : float; top : float; x0 : float; room : float }

let area (computer : computer) : area =
  let w = computer.screen.width and h = computer.screen.height in
  let left = -.w /. 2. in
  (* (the menu bar above the rest) *)
  { left; top = (h /. 2.) -. menu_bar; x0 = left +. side +. 16.;
    room = w -. side -. 32. }

let title_bar (computer : computer) (title : string) (right : string) :
    shape list =
  let w = computer.screen.width in
  let a = area computer in
  [
    rectangle (rgb 241 243 244) w bar |> move 0. (a.top -. (bar /. 2.));
    text ink ~bold:true ~room:(w /. 2.) (a.left +. 16.) (a.top -. 26.) title;
    text grey ~bold:false ~room:(w /. 2.)
      (-.a.left -. 16. -. width right)
      (a.top -. 26.) right;
  ]

let row_y (a : area) (i : int) : float =
  a.top -. bar -. 12. -. (float_of_int i *. row) -. 19.

let selected (a : area) (y : float) : shape =
  rectangle (rgb 232 240 254) (a.room +. 16.) row
  |> move (a.x0 -. 8. +. ((a.room +. 16.) /. 2.)) (y +. 19. -. (row /. 2.))

let sidebar (a : area) (entries : (string * bool) list) : shape list =
  List.concat
    (List.mapi
       (fun i (name, shown) ->
         let y = row_y a i in
         (if shown then
            [ rectangle (rgb 211 227 253) side row
              |> move (a.left +. (side /. 2.)) (y +. 19. -. (row /. 2.)) ]
          else [])
         @ [ text ink ~bold:shown ~room:(side -. 24.) (a.left +. 16.) y name ])
       entries)

(* the row a point is in, the bands [selected] and [sidebar] draw *)
let row_at (a : area) (y : float) : int option =
  let top = row_y a 0 +. 19. in
  if y > top then None else Some (int_of_float ((top -. y) /. row))

let sidebar_click (computer : computer) : int option =
  let a = area computer in
  let mouse = computer.mouse in
  if (not mouse.mclick) || Gui.modal () || mouse.mx < a.left
     || mouse.mx > a.left +. side
  then None
  else row_at a mouse.my

let row_click (computer : computer) : int option =
  let a = area computer in
  let mouse = computer.mouse in
  if
    (not mouse.mclick) || Gui.modal () || mouse.mx < a.x0 -. 8.
    || mouse.mx > a.x0 +. a.room +. 4.
  then None
  else row_at a mouse.my

(* the scrollbar's track: in the right margin, from the list's first
 * row to [bottom] *)
let track (computer : computer) (bottom : float) : float * float * float =
  let a = area computer in
  let top = row_y a 0 +. 19. in
  (a.x0 +. a.room +. 10., top, top -. bottom)

let scrollbar (computer : computer) ~(bottom : float) ~(n : int) ~(fits : int)
    ~(first : int) : shape list =
  if n <= fits || fits <= 0 then []
  else
    let x, top, h = track computer bottom in
    let thumb = max 20. (h *. float_of_int fits /. float_of_int n) in
    let at =
      top
      -. ((h -. thumb) *. float_of_int first /. float_of_int (n - fits))
      -. (thumb /. 2.)
    in
    [ rectangle (rgb 232 234 237) 10. h |> move x (top -. (h /. 2.));
      rectangle (rgb 154 160 166) 8. thumb |> move x at ]

let scrollbar_press (computer : computer) ~(bottom : float) ~(n : int)
    ~(fits : int) : int option =
  let mouse = computer.mouse in
  let x, top, h = track computer bottom in
  if
    n <= fits || (not mouse.mdown) || Gui.modal ()
    || Float.abs (mouse.mx -. x) > 8.
    || mouse.my > top || mouse.my < top -. h
  then None
  else
    let k = int_of_float ((top -. mouse.my) /. h *. float_of_int n) in
    Some (max 0 (min (n - 1) k))

let wheel (computer : computer) : int =
  let w = computer.mouse.mwheel in
  if w = 0. || Gui.modal () then 0
  else
    let n = int_of_float (Float.abs w) in
    let n = if n = 0 then 1 else n in
    if w > 0. then -3 * n else 3 * n

(* [i] moved by [d] within [0, n) *)
let moved (i : int) (d : int) (n : int) : int = max 0 (min (n - 1) (i + d))

let count (n : int) (one : string) : string =
  let many =
    if n = 1 then one
    else if one = "person" then "people"
    else one ^ "s"
  in
  Printf.sprintf "%d %s" n many

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Pim_window.mli *)

open Playground
open Pim_look

type caps = Mail_window.caps

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The model *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* what Home says of each view, read from the store as it is shown *)
type home = {
  unread : int; (* the Inbox's conversations not read *)
  inbox : int;
  late : int; (* the tasks to do whose day is past *)
  due_today : int;
  to_do : int;
  people : int;
  notes : int;
  events_today : int;
  money : (string * Money.cents) list; (* the first accounts' balances *)
  next_event : string; (* the next today, "" for none *)
  day_written : bool; (* today's page has a text *)
  (* the late tasks and today's, the mail back from a snooze *)
  today_list : (bool * string) list; (* late?, what *)
  page : string list; (* today's page's first lines *)
}

type model = {
  view : view;
  account : string;
  today : Civil.date;
  home : home;
  mail : Mail_window.model;
  tasks : Tasks_window.model;
  people : People_window.model;
  notes : Notes_window.model;
  calendar : Calendar_window.model;
  money_ : Money_window.model;
  (* a search over every view, shown over the view searched from *)
  finding : bool;
  search : Search_window.model;
  (* what the message read says, x in Mail, shown over it *)
  keeping : bool;
  found : Found_window.model;
  held : string Set_.t;
}

let store (caps : caps) : Items.t = Items.at (Items.place caps)

let home (caps : caps) ~(account : string) ~(today : Civil.date) : home =
  let items = Items.all caps (store caps) in
  let cs =
    Conversations.group (Mail_item.listed items ~account ~mailbox:"INBOX")
  in
  let events = Events.between items ~from:today ~upto:today in
  let page = List.filteri (fun k _ -> k < 4) (Today.page items today) in
  {
    unread = List.length (List.filter Conversations.unread cs);
    inbox = List.length cs;
    late = List.length (Today.late items today);
    due_today = List.length (Today.due items today);
    to_do = List.length (Today.to_do items today);
    people = List.length (People.contacts items);
    notes = List.length (List.filter (fun i -> Item.has_stamp i "note") items);
    events_today = List.length events;
    money =
      List.filteri (fun k _ -> k < 2)
        (List.filter_map
           (fun a ->
             if String.length a > 7 && String.sub a 0 7 = "Assets:" then
               Some (String.sub a 7 (String.length a - 7), Books.balance items a)
             else None)
           (Books.accounts items));
    next_event =
      (match events with
       | (_, Some t, i) :: _ -> Events.clock t ^ " " ^ title i
       | (_, None, i) :: _ -> title i
       | [] -> "");
    day_written = page <> [];
    page;
    today_list =
      List.map
        (fun (k, what) ->
          match (k : Today.kind) with
          | At (Some t) -> (false, Events.clock t ^ " " ^ what)
          | At None -> (false, what)
          | Late -> (true, "late: " ^ what)
          | Due -> (false, "due today: " ^ what)
          | Back -> (false, "back from snooze: " ^ what)
          | From who -> (false, "from " ^ who ^ ": " ^ what))
        (Today.lines items ~account today);
  }

let initial (caps : caps) (flags : Playground.flags) : model =
  let flag name =
    match List.assoc_opt name flags with Some v -> v | None -> ""
  in
  let account = flag "user" in
  let today =
    match Search.date (flag "today") with Some d -> d | None -> When.today caps
  in
  let mailto = Mailto.parse (flag "write") in
  {
    view =
      (match flag "view" with
      | _ when mailto <> None -> Mail
      | "mail" -> Mail
      | "tasks" -> Tasks
      | "people" -> People
      | "notes" -> Notes
      | "calendar" -> Calendar
      | "money" -> Money
      | _ -> Home);
    account;
    today;
    home = home caps ~account ~today;
    mail =
      (let m = Mail_window.initial caps flags in
       match mailto with Some t -> Mail_window.write_mailto caps m t | None -> m);
    tasks = Tasks_window.initial caps flags;
    people = People_window.initial caps flags;
    notes = Notes_window.initial caps flags;
    calendar = Calendar_window.initial caps flags;
    money_ = Money_window.initial caps flags;
    finding = false;
    search = Search_window.initial caps flags;
    keeping = false;
    found = Found_window.initial caps flags;
    held = Set_.empty;
  }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Going from view to view *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the view [v], read again from the store: another view may have
 * changed it (a task made in Mail, a sender added to People) *)
let switch (caps : caps) (s : model) (keys : string Set_.t) (v : view) : model =
  let s = { s with view = v; finding = false; keeping = false } in
  match v with
  | Home -> { s with home = home caps ~account:s.account ~today:s.today }
  | Mail -> { s with mail = Mail_window.refresh caps keys s.mail }
  | Tasks -> { s with tasks = Tasks_window.refresh caps keys s.tasks }
  | People -> { s with people = People_window.refresh caps keys s.people }
  | Notes -> { s with notes = Notes_window.refresh caps keys s.notes }
  | Calendar ->
      { s with calendar = Calendar_window.refresh caps keys s.calendar }
  | Money -> { s with money_ = Money_window.refresh caps keys s.money_ }

let go (caps : caps) (s : model) (keys : string Set_.t) (g : go) : model =
  match g with
  | View v -> switch caps s keys v
  | Item id -> (
      (* where it lives: a message (a task too) in Mail, then by its
       * stamp *)
      let i = Items.find caps (store caps) id in
      let has stamp =
        match i with Some i -> Item.has_stamp i stamp | None -> false
      in
      if has "message" then
        let s = switch caps s keys Mail in
        { s with mail = Mail_window.show caps s.mail id }
      else if has "contact" then
        let s = switch caps s keys People in
        { s with people = People_window.show caps s.people id }
      else if has "task" then
        let s = switch caps s keys Tasks in
        { s with tasks = Tasks_window.show caps s.tasks id }
      else if has "event" then
        let s = switch caps s keys Calendar in
        { s with calendar = Calendar_window.show caps s.calendar id }
      else if has "note" then
        let s = switch caps s keys Notes in
        { s with notes = Notes_window.show caps s.notes id }
      else if has "money" then
        let s = switch caps s keys Money in
        { s with money_ = Money_window.show caps s.money_ id }
      else s)
  | Write to_ ->
      let s = switch caps s keys Mail in
      { s with mail = Mail_window.write caps s.mail to_ }

(* the suite's menu, the first: Outlook's Go > Mail, Calendar,
 * Contacts, Tasks, and their keys, Ctrl and the view's number; the
 * search over them all *)
type command = Go_to of view | Find | Exit

let pim_menu : (string * (string * command) list) list =
  [ ( "Pim",
      List.mapi
        (fun i (v, name) ->
          (Printf.sprintf "%s  (Ctrl+%d)" name i, Go_to v))
        views
      @ [ ("Search...  (Ctrl+E)", Find); ("Exit", Exit) ] ) ]

(* the switcher's places, at the sidebar's foot *)
let switcher_y (computer : computer) (i : int) : float =
  (* (above the platform's line, at the very foot, of the tests') *)
  (-.computer.screen.height /. 2.) +. 70.
  +. (float_of_int (List.length views - 1 - i) *. row)

(* the view whose place in the switcher was clicked *)
let switcher_click (computer : computer) : view option =
  let mouse = computer.mouse in
  let left = -.computer.screen.width /. 2. in
  if not mouse.mclick || mouse.mx < left || mouse.mx > left +. side then None
  else
    List.find_map
      (fun (i, (v, _)) ->
        let y = switcher_y computer i in
        if mouse.my >= y && mouse.my < y +. row then Some v else None)
      (List.mapi (fun i v -> (i, v)) views)

(* Home's tiles: a view each, three a row *)
let tiles : (view * string) list = List.filter (fun (v, _) -> v <> Home) views

let tile_box (i : int) : Widget.box =
  { Widget.x = -260. +. (float_of_int (i mod 3) *. 260.);
    y = 250. -. (float_of_int (i / 3) *. 190.); w = 220.; h = 170. }

(* the key that opens a view from Home *)
let home_keys : (string * view) list =
  [ ("m", Mail); ("c", Calendar); ("p", People); ("t", Tasks); ("n", Notes);
    ("b", Money) ]

let tile_click (computer : computer) : view option =
  let mouse = computer.mouse in
  if not mouse.mclick then None
  else
    List.find_map
      (fun (i, (v, _)) ->
        let b = tile_box i in
        if
          Float.abs (mouse.mx -. b.x) <= b.w /. 2.
          && Float.abs (mouse.my -. b.y) <= b.h /. 2.
        then Some v
        else None)
      (List.mapi (fun i t -> (i, t)) tiles)

let update (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (s : model) : model =
  let keys = computer.keyboard.keys in
  let pressed name = Set_.mem name keys && not (Set_.mem name s.held) in
  let menu = chosen computer ~first:0 pim_menu in
  let by_key =
    if not (Set_.mem "Control" keys) then None
    else
      List.find_map
        (fun (i, (v, _)) -> if pressed (string_of_int i) then Some v else None)
        (List.mapi (fun i v -> (i, v)) views)
  in
  let clicked =
    if Gui.modal () then None
    else if s.view = Home && not s.finding then tile_click computer
    else switcher_click computer
  in
  let home_key =
    if s.view <> Home || s.finding then None
    else List.find_map (fun (k, v) -> if pressed k then Some v else None) home_keys
  in
  let find =
    (Set_.mem "Control" keys && pressed "e")
    || (s.view = Home && (not s.finding) && pressed "/")
  in
  let menu = if menu = None && find then Some Find else menu in
  let day_page = s.view = Home && (not s.finding) && pressed "d" in
  let keep =
    s.view = Mail && (not s.finding) && (not s.keeping) && pressed "x"
    && Mail_window.opened s.mail <> []
  in
  let s =
    match (menu, by_key, clicked, home_key) with
    | Some Exit, _, _, _ -> CapStdlib.exit caps 0
    | None, None, None, None when day_page ->
        let s = switch caps s keys Notes in
        { s with notes = Notes_window.day_note caps s.notes }
    | Some Find, _, _, _ ->
        { s with finding = true;
          search = Search_window.start caps keys s.search s.view }
    | Some (Go_to v), _, _, _
    | None, Some v, _, _
    | None, None, Some v, _
    | None, None, None, Some v ->
        switch caps s keys v
    | None, None, None, None when keep ->
        { s with keeping = true;
          found = Found_window.start keys s.found (Mail_window.opened s.mail) }
    | None, None, None, None when s.keeping -> (
        let f, g = Found_window.update caps computer s.found in
        let s = { s with found = f } in
        match g with
        | Some (View Mail) ->
            (* (back to the message, the keys down now not pressed) *)
            { s with keeping = false; mail = Mail_window.refresh caps keys s.mail }
        | Some g -> go caps s keys g
        | None -> s)
    | None, None, None, None when s.finding -> (
        let f, g = Search_window.update caps computer s.search in
        let s = { s with search = f } in
        match g with Some g -> go caps s keys g | None -> s)
    | None, None, None, None -> (
        match s.view with
        | Home -> s
        | Mail -> { s with mail = Mail_window.update caps computer s.mail }
        | Tasks -> (
            let t, g = Tasks_window.update caps computer s.tasks in
            let s = { s with tasks = t } in
            match g with Some g -> go caps s keys g | None -> s)
        | People -> (
            let p, g = People_window.update caps computer s.people in
            let s = { s with people = p } in
            match g with Some g -> go caps s keys g | None -> s)
        | Notes -> (
            let n, g = Notes_window.update caps computer s.notes in
            let s = { s with notes = n } in
            match g with Some g -> go caps s keys g | None -> s)
        | Calendar -> (
            let c, g = Calendar_window.update caps computer s.calendar in
            let s = { s with calendar = c } in
            match g with Some g -> go caps s keys g | None -> s)
        | Money -> (
            let b, g = Money_window.update caps computer s.money_ in
            let s = { s with money_ = b } in
            match g with Some g -> go caps s keys g | None -> s))
  in
  { s with held = keys }

let weekdays =
  [ "Sunday"; "Monday"; "Tuesday"; "Wednesday"; "Thursday"; "Friday";
    "Saturday" ]

let months =
  [ "January"; "February"; "March"; "April"; "May"; "June"; "July";
    "August"; "September"; "October"; "November"; "December" ]

(* "Thursday 29 October 2026" *)
let long_day (d : Civil.date) : string =
  Printf.sprintf "%s %d %s %d"
    (List.nth weekdays (Civil.weekday (Civil.days_from_civil d)))
    d.day
    (List.nth months (d.month - 1))
    d.year

(* a view's picture on its tile: an envelope, a list ticked, a face *)
let icon (v : view) (b : Widget.box) : shape list =
  let at dx dy sh = sh |> move (b.x +. dx) (b.y +. dy) in
  let line = rgb 60 64 67 in
  match v with
  | Mail ->
      [ at 0. 30. (rectangle line 84. 54.); at 0. 30. (rectangle white 80. 50.);
        at (-20.) 40. (rectangle line 50. 2. |> rotate (-32.));
        at 20. 40. (rectangle line 50. 2. |> rotate 32.) ]
  | Tasks ->
      List.concat
        (List.init 3 (fun k ->
             let y = 52. -. (float_of_int k *. 20.) in
             [ at (-30.) y (rectangle line 12. 12.);
               at (-30.) y (rectangle white 9. 9.);
               at 10. y (rectangle line 56. 3.) ]))
  | People ->
      [ at 0. 46. (circle line 15.); at 0. 46. (circle white 12.);
        at 0. 12. (oval line 56. 30.); at 0. 10. (oval white 50. 26.);
        at 0. 2. (rectangle white 60. 16.) ]
  | Notes ->
      [ at 0. 34. (rectangle line 56. 70.); at 0. 34. (rectangle white 52. 66.) ]
      @ List.init 4 (fun k ->
            at 0. (54. -. (float_of_int k *. 13.)) (rectangle line 36. 2.))
  | Calendar ->
      [ at 0. 34. (rectangle line 70. 60.); at 0. 31. (rectangle white 66. 50.);
        at 0. 60. (rectangle line 70. 6.) ]
      @ List.concat
          (List.init 6 (fun k ->
               [ at (-22. +. (float_of_int (k mod 3) *. 22.))
                   (44. -. (float_of_int (k / 3) *. 18.))
                   (rectangle line 12. 10.) ]))
  | Money ->
      [ at 0. 34. (rectangle line 84. 46.); at 0. 34. (rectangle white 80. 42.);
        at 0. 34. (circle line 13.); at 0. 34. (circle white 10.);
        at (-30.) 34. (circle line 4.); at 30. 34. (circle line 4.) ]
  | Home -> []

let home_view (computer : computer) (s : model) : shape list =
  let h = s.home in
  let says (v : view) : string list =
    match v with
    | Mail ->
        [ Printf.sprintf "%d unread" h.unread;
          Printf.sprintf "%d in the Inbox" h.inbox ]
    | Tasks ->
        [ count h.to_do "task" ^ " to do";
          Printf.sprintf "%d late, %d today" h.late h.due_today ]
    | People -> [ count h.people "person" ]
    | Calendar ->
        [ Printf.sprintf "%d today" h.events_today;
          (if h.next_event = "" then "nothing today" else h.next_event) ]
    | Money ->
        if h.money = [] then [ "no lines yet" ]
        else List.map (fun (a, c) -> a ^ " " ^ Money.to_string c) h.money
    | Notes ->
        [ count h.notes "note";
          (if h.day_written then "today's page written" else "no page today") ]
    | Home -> []
  in
  let tile i (v, name) =
    let b = tile_box i in
    [ rectangle (rgb 218 220 224) (b.w +. 4.) (b.h +. 4.)
      |> move (b.x +. 3.) (b.y -. 3.);
      rectangle white b.w b.h |> move b.x b.y ]
    @ icon v b
    @ [ text ink ~bold:true ~room:b.w (b.x -. (width name /. 2.)) (b.y -. 30.)
          name ]
    @ List.mapi
        (fun k l ->
          text grey ~bold:false ~room:b.w (b.x -. (width l /. 2.))
            (b.y -. 54. -. (float_of_int k *. 20.)) l)
        (says v)
  in
  let a = area computer in
  let today =
    if h.today_list = [] then
      [ (false, "Nothing today: no event, nothing late or due.") ]
    else List.filteri (fun i _ -> i < 7) h.today_list
  in
  (* today's page under the list, d to write in it (Notes) *)
  let page_y = -110. -. (float_of_int (List.length today) *. 24.) -. 30. in
  let page =
    text ink ~bold:true ~room:500. (-390.) page_y "Today's page"
    :: List.mapi
         (fun k l ->
           text grey ~bold:false ~room:780. (-390.)
             (page_y -. 30. -. (float_of_int k *. 24.)) l)
         (if h.page = [] then [ "Nothing written yet: d writes it." ] else h.page)
  in
  [ rectangle (rgb 241 243 244) computer.screen.width computer.screen.height;
    text ink ~bold:true ~room:500. (a.left +. 40.) (a.top -. 50.) "mini-pim";
    text grey ~bold:false ~room:500.
      (-.a.left -. 40. -. width (long_day s.today))
      (a.top -. 50.) (long_day s.today) ]
  @ List.concat (List.mapi tile tiles)
  @ [ text ink ~bold:true ~room:500. (-390.) (-80.) "Today" ]
  @ List.mapi
      (fun k (late, l) ->
        text (if late then red else ink) ~bold:false ~room:780. (-390.)
          (-110. -. (float_of_int k *. 24.)) l)
      today
  @ page
  @ [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:900. (-390.)
        ((-.computer.screen.height /. 2.) +. 24.)
        ("m, c, p, t, n, b or a click opens a view, d today's page, / "
         ^ "searches; Ctrl+0 to 6 goes to one.") ]

(* the switcher: the views, the one shown marked *)
let switcher_view (computer : computer) (s : model) : shape list =
  let left = -.computer.screen.width /. 2. in
  let top = switcher_y computer 0 +. row in
  (rectangle (rgb 218 220 224) side 1. |> move (left +. (side /. 2.)) (top +. 6.))
  :: List.concat
       (List.mapi
          (fun i (v, name) ->
            let y = switcher_y computer i in
            (if v = s.view then
               [ rectangle (rgb 211 227 253) side row
                 |> move (left +. (side /. 2.)) (y +. (row /. 2.)) ]
             else [])
            @ [ text (if v = s.view then ink else grey) ~bold:(v = s.view)
                  ~room:(side -. 24.) (left +. 16.) (y +. 9.) name ])
          views)

let view (computer : computer) (s : model) : shape list =
  let body =
    match s.view with
    | _ when s.keeping ->
        Found_window.view computer s.found @ switcher_view computer s
    | _ when s.finding ->
        Search_window.view computer s.search @ switcher_view computer s
    | Home -> home_view computer s
    | Mail -> Mail_window.view computer s.mail @ switcher_view computer s
    | Tasks -> Tasks_window.view computer s.tasks @ switcher_view computer s
    | People -> People_window.view computer s.people @ switcher_view computer s
    | Notes -> Notes_window.view computer s.notes @ switcher_view computer s
    | Calendar ->
        Calendar_window.view computer s.calendar @ switcher_view computer s
    | Money -> Money_window.view computer s.money_ @ switcher_view computer s
  in
  let top = (computer.screen.height /. 2.) -. menu_bar in
  body
  @ [ rectangle (Gui.theme ()).face computer.screen.width menu_bar
      |> move 0. (top +. (menu_bar /. 2.)) ]
  (* (the menus last: an open one over the rest) *)
  @ Gui.draw ()

   a Home that launches the views, and the views, Mail, Calendar,
   People, Tasks, Notes, Money, over the one store. The terminal's
   commands (Pim) are the same suite without a window; this is the one
   to look around in.

       Pim                                                <- the menu bar
       mini-pim                          Thursday 29 October 2026
         +----------+     +----------+     +----------+

         |   Mail   |     | Calendar |     |  People  |     a click, or

       Today

       late: answer Carol                                 <- in red

       back from snooze: the plan
       from Alice: lunch?                <- unread, from the address book
       Today's page

   Home is the plan's Today (idea 4): the day's events first, what is
   late or due (a bill with its amount), back from a snooze, the
   unread mail from people of the address book (not every newsletter),
   and under them the day's page, the daily note, d to write it in
   Notes. The suite opens
   on it (view=mail, calendar, people, tasks, notes or money opens a
   view: the tests').

   In a view the first menu is the suite's, Pim (Home, Mail,
   Calendar, People, Tasks, Notes, Money, each with its key, Ctrl and
   its number, Outlook's Go menu and keys; Search, Ctrl+E; Exit), then

   asks the suite for another (Pim_look.go): an item opened where it
   lives (a message in Mail, an event in Calendar, a person in People,

apps/pim/window/Search_window.ml

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Search_window.mli *)

open Playground
open Pim_look

type caps = Mail_window.caps

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The model *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type model = {
  back : view; (* the view searched from, Esc's *)
  items : Item.t list; (* the store as it was when the search began *)
  query : string;
  (* the items found, by view, in the views' order *)
  found : (view * Item.t list) list;
  only : view option; (* Tab: one view's, else every one's *)
  selected : int;
  today : Civil.date;
  held : string Set_.t;
}

(* where an item opens (Pim_window.go's order: a message that is a task
 * too is a message) *)
let lives (i : Item.t) : view option =
  List.find_map
    (fun (stamp, v) -> if Item.has_stamp i stamp then Some v else None)
    [ ("message", Mail); ("contact", People); ("task", Tasks);
      ("event", Calendar); ("note", Notes); ("money", Money) ]

let day (i : Item.t) : int =
  match Search.day i with Some d -> Civil.days_from_civil d | None -> min_int

(* the newest first where an item has a day (mail, events, money), else
 * by title *)
let order (v : view) (l : Item.t list) : Item.t list =
  match v with
  | Mail | Calendar | Money ->
      List.stable_sort (fun a b -> compare (day b) (day a)) l
  | _ ->
      List.stable_sort
        (fun a b ->
          compare (String.lowercase_ascii (title a))
            (String.lowercase_ascii (title b)))
        l

let find (m : model) : model =
  let hits =
    if String.trim m.query = "" then [] else Search.search m.query m.items
  in
  let found =
    List.filter_map
      (fun (v, _) ->
        match List.filter (fun i -> lives i = Some v) hits with
        | [] -> None
        | l -> Some (v, order v l))
      views
  in
  let only =
    match m.only with
    | Some v when List.mem_assoc v found -> m.only
    | _ -> None
  in
  { m with found; only; selected = 0 }

(* the rows shown: a view's name, then its items *)
type row = Heading of view * int | Found of Item.t

let rows (m : model) : row list =
  List.concat_map
    (fun (v, l) ->
      if m.only = None || m.only = Some v then
        Heading (v, List.length l) :: List.map (fun i -> Found i) l
      else [])
    m.found

let results (m : model) : Item.t list =
  List.filter_map (fun r -> match r with Found i -> Some i | _ -> None) (rows m)

let initial (caps : caps) (flags : Playground.flags) : model =
  let today =
    match List.assoc_opt "today" flags with
    | Some d -> (
        match Search.date d with Some d -> d | None -> When.today caps)
    | None -> When.today caps
  in
  ignore caps;
  { back = Home; items = []; query = ""; found = []; only = None;
    selected = 0; today; held = Set_.empty }

let start (caps : caps) (keys : string Set_.t) (m : model) (back : view) :
    model =
  find
    { m with back; items = Items.all caps (Items.at (Items.place caps));
      query = ""; only = None; held = keys }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* What the keys and the menus do *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type command = Open_ | Next | Previous | Next_view | Close

let menus : (string * (string * command) list) list =
  [ ( "Search",
      [ ("Open  (Enter)", Open_); ("Next  (Down)", Next);
        ("Previous  (Up)", Previous); ("Next Component  (Tab)", Next_view);
        ("Close  (Esc)", Close) ] ) ]

let command (m : model) (c : command) : model * go option =
  let n = List.length (results m) in
  match c with
  | Open_ -> (
      match List.nth_opt (results m) m.selected with
      | Some i -> (m, Some (Item (Item.id i)))
      | None -> (m, None))
  | Next -> ({ m with selected = max 0 (min (n - 1) (m.selected + 1)) }, None)
  | Previous -> ({ m with selected = max 0 (m.selected - 1) }, None)
  | Next_view ->
      (* every view's, then each one's in turn, then every view's again *)
      let vs = List.map fst m.found in
      let rec after l =
        match l with
        | v :: (w :: _ as rest) -> if Some v = m.only then Some w else after rest
        | _ -> None
      in
      let only =
        match (m.only, vs) with
        | None, v :: _ -> Some v
        | None, [] -> None
        | Some _, _ -> after vs
      in
      ({ m with only; selected = 0 }, None)
  | Close -> (m, Some (View m.back))

(* how many rows fit under the title bar, and the first shown *)
let fits (computer : computer) : int =
  let a = area computer in
  let bottom = (-.computer.screen.height /. 2.) +. 40. in
  int_of_float ((a.top -. bar -. 12. -. bottom) /. row)

let first (computer : computer) (m : model) : int =
  (* the selected item's row, headings counted *)
  let rec at k j l =
    match l with
    | [] -> 0
    | Heading _ :: rest -> at (k + 1) j rest
    | Found _ :: rest -> if j = m.selected then k else at (k + 1) (j + 1) rest
  in
  max 0 (at 0 0 (rows m) - fits computer + 1)

(* the item clicked, if one was *)
let click (computer : computer) (m : model) : Item.t option =
  let a = area computer in
  let mouse = computer.mouse in
  if (not mouse.mclick) || mouse.mx < a.x0 || Gui.modal () then None
  else
    let top = row_y a 0 +. row -. 9. in
    let k = int_of_float ((top -. mouse.my) /. row) + first computer m in
    if mouse.my > top then None
    else
      match List.nth_opt (rows m) k with Some (Found i) -> Some i | _ -> None

let update (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (m : model) : model * go option
    =
  ignore caps;
  let keys = computer.keyboard.keys in
  let pressed name = Set_.mem name keys && not (Set_.mem name m.held) in
  let key =
    if pressed "ArrowDown" then Some Next
    else if pressed "ArrowUp" then Some Previous
    else if pressed "Enter" then Some Open_
    else if pressed "Tab" then Some Next_view
    else if pressed "Escape" then Some Close
    else None
  in
  let m, go =
    match (chosen computer ~first:1 menus, key, click computer m) with
    | Some c, _, _ | None, Some c, _ -> command m c
    | None, None, Some i -> (m, Some (Item (Item.id i)))
    | None, None, None when Gui.modal () -> (m, None)
    | None, None, None when wheel computer <> 0 ->
        ( { m with
            selected =
              moved m.selected (wheel computer) (List.length (results m)) },
          None )
    | None, None, None ->
        (* the query as it is typed, the items found at each letter *)
        if pressed "Backspace" then
          (find { m with query = without_last m.query }, None)
        else
          let typed = printable computer.keyboard.typed in
          if typed = "" then (m, None)
          else (find { m with query = m.query ^ typed }, None)
  in
  ({ m with held = keys }, go)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The picture *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* what is said after an item's title: who and when, a day, an address *)
let detail (today : Civil.date) (i : Item.t) : string =
  let date =
    match Search.day i with
    | Some d when d = today -> "today"
    | Some d -> Civil.to_string d
    | None -> ""
  in
  match lives i with
  | Some Mail -> Conversations.who i ^ "   " ^ date
  | Some Calendar -> Item.field i "when"
  | Some People -> Item.field i "email"
  | Some Tasks ->
      if Item.field i "done" <> "" then "done"
      else if Item.field i "due" <> "" then "due " ^ date
      else ""
  | Some Money -> (
      match Books.postings i with
      | p :: _ -> date ^ "   " ^ Money.to_string (abs p.amount)
      | [] -> date)
  | Some Notes -> (
      match String.split_on_char '\n' (String.trim i.body) with
      | l :: _ -> l
      | [] -> "")
  | Some Home | None -> ""

let view (computer : computer) (m : model) : shape list =
  let a = area computer in
  let n = List.length (results m) in
  let name v = List.assoc v views in
  let main =
    if String.trim m.query = "" then
      List.mapi
        (fun k l -> text grey ~bold:false ~room:a.room a.x0 (row_y a k) l)
        [ "Type to search every component: mail, events, people, tasks,";
          "notes, money. Words match any field or the text;";
          "from:alice  is:task  label:travel  before:2026-12-01  -is:read";
          "";
          "Up and Down choose, Enter opens it where it lives, Tab one";
          "component's, Esc back." ]
    else if n = 0 then
      [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:a.room a.x0 (row_y a 0)
          ("Nothing matches " ^ m.query ^ " in the store.") ]
    else
      let first = first computer m in
      let rec draw k j l =
        match l with
        | [] -> []
        | r :: rest when k < first ->
            draw (k + 1) (match r with Found _ -> j + 1 | _ -> j) rest
        | _ when k - first >= fits computer -> []
        | Heading (v, c) :: rest ->
            text ink ~bold:true ~room:a.room a.x0 (row_y a (k - first))
              (Printf.sprintf "%s (%d)" (name v) c)
            :: draw (k + 1) j rest
        | Found i :: rest ->
            let y = row_y a (k - first) in
            (if j = m.selected then [ selected a y ] else [])
            @ [ text ink ~bold:false ~room:330. (a.x0 +. 16.) y (title i);
                text grey ~bold:false ~room:(a.room -. 360.) (a.x0 +. 360.) y
                  (detail m.today i) ]
            @ draw (k + 1) (j + 1) rest
      in
      draw 0 0 (rows m)
  in
  (rectangle white computer.screen.width computer.screen.height
   :: title_bar computer ("search: " ^ m.query ^ "_") (count n "item"))
  @ sidebar a
      (("Everything", m.only = None)
       :: List.map
            (fun (v, l) ->
              (Printf.sprintf "%s  %d" (name v) (List.length l), m.only = Some v))
            m.found)
  @ main

apps/pim/window/Tasks_window.ml
14231
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Tasks_window.mli *)

open Playground
open Pim_look

type caps = Mail_window.caps

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The model *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type shown = To_do | Someday | Done
type asking = New | Due | Until
type mode = Browsing | Page | Asking of asking

type model = {
  shown : shown;
  tasks : Item.t list; (* the list shown's *)
  snoozed : int; (* the tasks to do put away until a later day *)
  today : Civil.date;
  selected : int;
  mode : mode;
  field : string; (* what is typed after a question *)
  status : string;
  held : string Set_.t;
}

let store (caps : caps) : Items.t = Items.at (Items.place caps)

let days (d : Civil.date option) : int =
  match d with Some d -> Civil.days_from_civil d | None -> max_int

(* the tasks to do, by their day, those without one last, those
 * snoozed to a later day left out (plan_pim.md, idea 5); or those
 * done, the last done first *)
let load (caps : caps) (m : model) : model =
  let items = Items.all caps (store caps) in
  let tasks = List.filter (fun i -> Item.has_stamp i "task") items in
  let later (i : Item.t) =
    days (Search.date (Item.field i "until")) <> max_int
    && days (Search.date (Item.field i "until"))
       > Civil.days_from_civil m.today
  in
  let to_do = List.filter (fun i -> Item.field i "done" = "") tasks in
  let someday i = Item.field i "someday" <> "" in
  (* GTD's inbox first: what was captured and has no day yet, to be
   * decided (a day, a snooze, someday, done) *)
  let day i = match Search.day i with None -> min_int | d -> days d in
  let l =
    match m.shown with
    | To_do ->
        List.stable_sort
          (fun a b -> compare (day a) (day b))
          (List.filter (fun i -> not (later i || someday i)) to_do)
    | Someday -> List.filter someday to_do
    | Done ->
        List.stable_sort
          (fun a b -> compare (Item.field b "done") (Item.field a "done"))
          (List.filter (fun i -> Item.field i "done" <> "") tasks)
  in
  { m with
    tasks = l;
    snoozed = List.length (List.filter later to_do);
    selected = max 0 (min m.selected (List.length l - 1)) }

let initial (caps : caps) (flags : Playground.flags) : model =
  let today =
    match List.assoc_opt "today" flags with
    | Some d -> (
        match Search.date d with Some d -> d | None -> When.today caps)
    | None -> When.today caps
  in
  load caps
    { shown = To_do; tasks = []; snoozed = 0; today; selected = 0;
      mode = Browsing; field = ""; status = ""; held = Set_.empty }

let refresh (caps : caps) (keys : string Set_.t) (m : model) : model =
  load caps { m with held = keys; mode = Browsing }

(* the task [id]'s page, in the list it is in *)
let show (caps : caps) (m : model) (id : string) : model =
  match Items.find caps (store caps) id with
  | None -> { m with status = id ^ ": not in the store" }
  | Some i -> (
      let shown =
        if Item.field i "done" <> "" then Done
        else if Item.field i "someday" <> "" then Someday
        else To_do
      in
      let m = load caps { m with shown; selected = 0 } in
      let rec find k l =
        match l with
        | [] -> None
        | t :: rest -> if Item.id t = id then Some k else find (k + 1) rest
      in
      match find 0 m.tasks with
      | Some k -> { m with selected = k; mode = Page; status = "" }
      | None -> { m with status = id ^ ": snoozed" })

(*****************************************************************************)
(* What the keys and the menus do *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type command =
  | New_
  | Open_
  | Back
  | Done_
  | Due_
  | Snooze_
  | Next
  | Previous
  | Someday_
  | To_do_list
  | Someday_list
  | Done_list

let menus : (string * (string * command) list) list =
  [ ( "Task",
      [ ("New Task...  (n)", New_); ("Open  (o)", Open_);
        ("Back to List  (u)", Back); ("Mark Done  (x)", Done_);
        ("Due...  (d)", Due_); ("Snooze...  (z)", Snooze_);
        ("Someday  (s)", Someday_);
        ("Next  (j)", Next); ("Previous  (k)", Previous) ] );
    ( "List",
      [ ("To Do  (Tab)", To_do_list); ("Someday  (Tab)", Someday_list);
        ("Done  (Tab)", Done_list) ] ) ]

let current (m : model) : Item.t option = List.nth_opt m.tasks m.selected

let made = ref 0

(* a task captured, its id the time and a count *)
let capture (caps : caps) (m : model) (line : string) : model =
  let title, due = When.ending ~today:m.today line in
  if String.trim title = "" then m
  else begin
    incr made;
    let id = Printf.sprintf "task:%.0f.%d" (CapUnix.gettimeofday caps ()) !made in
    let due =
      match due with Some d -> [ ("due", Mail_sync.day d) ] | None -> []
    in
    Items.save caps (store caps)
      (Item.make ~id ~stamps:[ "task" ] (("title", title) :: due) "");
    load caps
      { m with shown = To_do; status = "a task: " ^ title }
  end

(* a field of the selected task set, the list read again *)
let set (caps : caps) (m : model) (name : string) (value : string)
    (status : string) : model =
  match current m with
  | None -> m
  | Some i ->
      let i =
        if value = "" then Mail.remove name i else Mail.set name value i
      in
      Items.save caps (store caps) i;
      load caps { m with mode = Browsing; status = status ^ title i }

let command (caps : caps) (m : model) (c : command) : model * go option =
  match c with
  | New_ -> ({ m with mode = Asking New; field = ""; status = "" }, None)
  | Open_ -> (
      match current m with
      | None -> (m, None)
      (* (a message: the mail shows it) *)
      | Some i when Item.has_stamp i "message" -> (m, Some (Item (Item.id i)))
      | Some _ -> ({ m with mode = Page }, None))
  | Back -> ({ m with mode = Browsing }, None)
  | Done_ -> (
      match (current m, m.shown) with
      | None, _ -> (m, None)
      | Some i, (To_do | Someday) -> (
          let m = set caps m "done" (Mail_sync.day m.today) "done: " in
          (* (a repeating task, a monthly bill: its next one) *)
          match Today.again i with
          | Some next ->
              Items.save caps (store caps) next;
              ( load caps
                  { m with status = m.status ^ "; next " ^ Item.field next "due" },
                None )
          | None -> (m, None))
      | Some _, Done -> (set caps m "done" "" "to do again: ", None))
  | Someday_ -> (
      match current m with
      | Some i when Item.field i "someday" = "" ->
          (set caps m "someday" "yes" "someday: ", None)
      | Some _ -> (set caps m "someday" "" "to do: ", None)
      | None -> (m, None))
  | Due_ when current m <> None ->
      ({ m with mode = Asking Due; field = ""; status = "" }, None)
  | Snooze_ when current m <> None && m.shown = To_do ->
      ({ m with mode = Asking Until; field = ""; status = "" }, None)
  | Due_ | Snooze_ -> (m, None)
  | Next ->
      ({ m with selected = min (List.length m.tasks - 1) (m.selected + 1) }, None)
  | Previous -> ({ m with selected = max 0 (m.selected - 1) }, None)
  | To_do_list ->
      (load caps { m with shown = To_do; selected = 0; mode = Browsing }, None)
  | Someday_list ->
      (load caps { m with shown = Someday; selected = 0; mode = Browsing }, None)
  | Done_list ->
      (load caps { m with shown = Done; selected = 0; mode = Browsing }, None)

let update (caps : caps) (computer : computer) (m : model) : model * go option =
  let keys = computer.keyboard.keys in
  let pressed name = Set_.mem name keys && not (Set_.mem name m.held) in
  let menu = chosen computer ~first:1 menus in
  let m, go =
    match m.mode with
    | Asking a ->
        if pressed "Escape" then ({ m with mode = Browsing; field = "" }, None)
        else if pressed "Enter" then
          let m' = { m with field = ""; mode = Browsing } in
          match a with
          | New -> (capture caps m' m.field, None)
          | Due | Until -> (
              match When.parse ~today:m.today m.field with
              | None ->
                  ( { m' with
                      status = m.field ^ ": not a day (monday, in 3 days)" },
                    None )
              | Some d when a = Due ->
                  let m = set caps m' "due" (Mail_sync.day d) "" in
                  ({ m with status = "due " ^ Mail_sync.day d }, None)
              | Some d ->
                  let m = set caps m' "until" (Mail_sync.day d) "" in
                  ({ m with status = "snoozed until " ^ Mail_sync.day d }, None))
        else if pressed "Backspace" then
          ({ m with field = without_last m.field }, None)
        else ({ m with field = m.field ^ printable computer.keyboard.typed }, None)
    | (Browsing | Page) when Gui.modal () -> (m, None)
    | Browsing | Page -> (
        let key =
          if pressed "j" || pressed "ArrowDown" then Some Next
          else if pressed "k" || pressed "ArrowUp" then Some Previous
          else if pressed "o" || pressed "Enter" then Some Open_
          else if pressed "u" || pressed "Escape" then Some Back
          else if pressed "n" then Some New_
          else if pressed "x" then Some Done_
          else if pressed "d" then Some Due_
          else if pressed "z" then Some Snooze_
          else if pressed "s" then Some Someday_
          else if pressed "Tab" then
            Some
              (match m.shown with
              | To_do -> Someday_list
              | Someday -> Done_list
              | Done -> To_do_list)
          else None
        in
        (* the mouse: a list of the sidebar; a task, opened *)
        let side_ =
          match sidebar_click computer with
          | Some 0 -> Some To_do_list
          | Some 1 -> Some Someday_list
          | Some 2 -> Some Done_list
          | _ -> None
        in
        let clicked =
          match (m.mode, row_click computer) with
          | Browsing, Some k ->
              let h = computer.screen.height in
              let fits = int_of_float ((h -. bar -. 12.) /. row) in
              let i = max 0 (m.selected - fits + 1) + k in
              if i < List.length m.tasks then Some i else None
          | _ -> None
        in
        match (menu, key, side_, clicked) with
        | Some c, _, _, _ | None, Some c, _, _ | None, None, Some c, _ ->
            command caps m c
        | None, None, None, Some i -> command caps { m with selected = i } Open_
        | None, None, None, None when m.mode = Browsing && wheel computer <> 0 ->
            ( { m with
                selected =
                  moved m.selected (wheel computer) (List.length m.tasks) },
              None )
        | None, None, None, None -> (m, None))
  in
  ({ m with held = keys }, go)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The picture *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let view (computer : computer) (m : model) : shape list =
  let h = computer.screen.height in
  let a = area computer in
  let title_ =
    match m.mode with
    | Asking New -> "a task: " ^ m.field ^ "_"
    | Asking Due -> "due: " ^ m.field ^ "_"
    | Asking Until -> "snooze until: " ^ m.field ^ "_"
    | Page -> (match current m with Some i -> title i | None -> "")
    | Browsing -> (
        match m.shown with
        | To_do -> "To Do"
        | Someday -> "Someday"
        | Done -> "Done")
  in
  let right =
    if m.status <> "" then m.status
    else if m.shown = To_do && m.snoozed > 0 then
      count (List.length m.tasks) "task"
      ^ Printf.sprintf ", %d snoozed" m.snoozed
    else count (List.length m.tasks) "task"
  in
  let main =
    match (m.mode, current m) with
    | Page, Some i ->
        (* the task: its fields, its text, what names it *)
        let fields =
          List.filter_map
            (fun name ->
              match Item.field i name with
              | "" -> None
              | v -> Some (name ^ ": " ^ v))
            [ "due"; "until"; "done"; "stamp" ]
        in
        let lines =
          fields @ [ "" ] @ wrap a.room (String.trim i.body)
        in
        List.mapi
          (fun k l ->
            text (if k < List.length fields then grey else ink) ~bold:false
              ~room:a.room a.x0 (row_y a k) l)
          lines
    | _ when m.tasks = [] ->
        [ text grey ~bold:false ~room:a.room a.x0 (row_y a 0)
            (match m.shown with
            | To_do ->
                "Nothing to do: n adds a task, t in Mail makes one of a message."
            | Someday -> "Nothing for someday: s puts a task off to it."
            | Done -> "Nothing done yet.") ]
    | _ ->
        let fits = int_of_float ((h -. bar -. 12.) /. row) in
        let first = max 0 (m.selected - fits + 1) in
        List.concat
          (List.mapi
             (fun i (t : Item.t) ->
               if i < first || i >= first + fits then []
               else
                 let y = row_y a (i - first) in
                 let day =
                   if m.shown = Done then Item.field t "done"
                   else Item.field t "due"
                 in
                 let late =
                   m.shown = To_do
                   && days (Search.day t) < Civil.days_from_civil m.today
                 in
                 let mail =
                   if Item.has_stamp t "message" then "  (mail)" else ""
                 in
                 (if i = m.selected then [ selected a y ] else [])
                 @ [ text (if late then red else grey) ~bold:false
                       ~room:(width "2026-10-30" +. 4.) a.x0 y
                       (if day <> "" then day
                    else if m.shown = To_do then "inbox"
                    else "-");
                     text ink ~bold:false ~room:(a.room -. 130.) (a.x0 +. 130.)
                       y (title t ^ mail) ])
             m.tasks)
  in
  (rectangle white computer.screen.width h :: title_bar computer title_ right)
  @ sidebar a
      [ ("To Do", m.shown = To_do); ("Someday", m.shown = Someday);
        ("Done", m.shown = Done) ]
  @ main

assembler/Asm.ml
12838
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* Plan 9's assembly language, for arm and arm64: the instructions
 * mini-asm reads and writes, unencoded, into an object file, and that
 * mini-ld lays out and encodes.
 *
 *     TEXT  strchr(SB), $8           a function, the size of its frame
 *     MOVW  c+4(FP), R6              an argument: FP is the caller's frame
 *     MOVW  $table(SB), R1           an address: SB is the static base
 *     MOVW.EQ R1, R2                 a condition, as a suffix (arm)
 *     BNE   2(PC)                    a branch, counted in instructions
 *     DATA  msg+0(SB)/8, $"Hello, w" initialized data
 *     GLOBL msg(SB), $14             its size
 *
 * {b Why the assembler only parses, and the linker encodes.} This is
 * Plan 9's design (Thompson's and Pike's toolchain), the one xix
 * follows, and the one ix keeps, because it is the smallest:
 *
 * - {b No relocations.} The linker encodes after it has laid out the
 *   whole program, so every address is known when a word is made:
 *   objects carry no relocation records, and the linker has no
 *   relocation machinery, most of a Unix linker's complexity.
 * - {b One encoder per machine.} The C compiler will write these same
 *   instruction lists into an object, as 5c does, without printing
 *   assembly; the encoder is written once, in the linker, shared by
 *   both paths, instead of in the assembler and again in the compiler.
 * - {b Decisions made once, with everything known}: which form a branch
 *   takes, where literal pools go, how a large constant is built (an
 *   immediate where the machine has a form that holds it, else a load
 *   from a literal pool, on arm and on arm64), what a function's
 *   prologue is. With the encoding in the assembler, each needs a guess
 *   now and a fixup later.
 * - {b The machine is in one place.} This module and the parser are the
 *   same for both targets but for a table of register names; which
 *   instructions exist, with which operands, is decided by the linker's
 *   module for each machine (linker/Arm, linker/Arm64), which is where
 *   having two targets forces the code to say what is general.
 *
 * The costs don't matter here: an object is not machine code, so it
 * can only be listed, not disassembled; and the linker redoes the
 * encoding at each link, which is why Go moved it back into its
 * compiler and assembler in Go 1.3 (2014), for Google's large
 * programs.
 *
 * evolution:
 * This toolchain has had three lives. Thompson wrote it for Plan 9
 * (his paper of 1990 has the MIPS and the 68020 for its examples),
 * and a machine after another was added to it. Go started from
 * those sources: its first releases had Plan 9's 6a, 6c and 6l in
 * them, the Go compiler beside them writing the same objects, and
 * Go's assembler is still this language, pseudo-registers and all;
 * its linker gave the encoding back to the compiler in Go 1.3 (the
 * paragraph above). And 9front keeps the original, with a 7 for
 * arm64 where Plan 9's 7 was the Alpha.
 *
 * {b One instruction type for both machines} (xix has a typed tree per
 * machine): an opcode, its dot suffixes, and operands from one set.
 * The linker's classifier rejects what a machine can't encode.
 *
 * Where it stands: this file is the contract between four programs.
 * Parser_asm makes these items from a .s, mini-cc and mini-ml make
 * them from C and ML; mini-ar keeps objects in a library; Link reads
 * them into Program's instructions, which are these with what
 * linking adds (an address, a branch's target). The object file is
 * the value marshalled with a version number in front, so a program
 * of another day's types says so and does not crash.
 *
 * terminology:
 * The four pseudo-registers. SB, FP, SP and PC in an operand are not
 * registers of the machine but four ways of naming a place, which
 * the linker turns into a real register and an offset once it knows
 * the layout. name(SB), the static base: a global, by its name.
 * name+4(FP), the frame pointer: an argument, from the caller's
 * side of the frame; the name is a comment. name-4(SP): a local, from
 * the top of the frame. 2(PC): an instruction, counted from this
 * one. A function can so be written without knowing the size of its
 * own frame, which is on its TEXT line, and nothing changes in its
 * body when that size does. (On arm the real SB is R12, set once to
 * the data's start; SP is R13.)
 *
 * terminology:
 * TEXT, DATA, GLOBL are the three segments' names, kept from the
 * a.out of the first Unix (Exe.mli draws them): the text is the
 * code, read-only and shared; the data is what has an initial value
 * in the file; the bss, what a GLOBL with no DATA makes, is only a
 * size, zeroed when the program starts.
 *
 * others:
 * The operands go left to right, the destination last, on every
 * machine: MOVW $1, R0 puts 1 in R0. That is the order of the PDP-11's
 * assembler and of AT&T's syntax for the 386; ARM's own manuals, and
 * Intel's, put the destination first (mov r0, #1). The opcodes are
 * Plan 9's too, the same on all its machines where it can be (MOVW
 * is a load, a store or a move by its operands, where ARM has ldr,
 * str and mov), which is what lets one compiler's back end be
 * ported by changing little.
 *
 * References: Ken Thompson, "Plan 9 C Compilers" (Summer 1990 UKUUG
 * Conference, London), the design paper of this split: its loader
 * "combines the roles of second half of the assembler, global
 * optimizer, and loader", with the MIPS and the 68020 as examples;
 * Rob Pike, "A Manual for the Plan 9 assembler", for the syntax, the
 * pseudo-registers FP and SB, and the remark that the assemblers "are
 * really just variations of a single program" -- which one instruction
 * type makes literal; Russ Cox, "Go 1.3 Linker Overhaul" (2013), for
 * the move back, the encoding done once per package by the compiler
 * and the assembler because linking large programs redid it. *)

(* (No Asm.mli: the module is its types, and what goes with them.) *)

type arch = Arm | Arm64

(* a global name; [static] for name<>(SB), local to its file *)
type name = { sym : string; static : bool }

(* what a memory reference is relative to *)
type base = R of int | SB | FP | SP | PC

(* << >> -> @> *)
type shift_kind = Lsl | Lsr | Asr | Ror
(* old: an int, 0 to 3, the one the machines encode, indexing a table
 * of the arrows to print *)

(* a shift's count: a constant, or a register's *)
type shift_by = By_imm of int | By_reg of int
type shift = { reg : int; kind : shift_kind; by : shift_by }

type mem = {
  base : base;
  name : name option;        (* sym+off(SB) (and BL f(SB) is a call), or a
                                comment in name+off(FP) *)
  off : int64;
  index : shift option;      (* (R1)(R2), R2<<2(R1) *)
}

type operand =
  | Reg of int               (* R3; on arm64 31 is ZR or RSP, by context *)
  | FReg of int              (* F3 *)
  | Special of string        (* CPSR, FPCR, ...: registers without a number *)
  | Spr of int64             (* SPR(0x182000): a system register of arm64's, by its bits in MRS and MSR *)
  | Imm of int64             (* $42 *)
  | Fimm of float            (* $1.5 *)
  | Str of string            (* $"text" *)
  | Mem of mem               (* 8(R1), x+4(SB), c+4(FP), s-4(SP) *)
  | Addr of mem              (* $x(SB), $s-4(SP): the address itself *)
  | Shifted of shift         (* R1<<2 *)
  | Regs of int list         (* [R0-R3] *)
  | Pair of int * int        (* (R1, R2) *)
  | Target of int            (* a branch: an index into the object's items *)

type instr = { op : string; suffixes : string list; args : operand list }

type item =
  | Text of name * int * int64          (* flag, frame size *)
  | Globl of name * int * int64         (* flag, size *)
  | Data of name * int64 * int * operand (* offset, width, value *)
  | Ins of instr

(* the history (5a's AHISTORY): where each file starts, a global line
 * (an item's line, counted over the preprocessed text), and where it
 * ends (None), a #include's inside its includer's; what the linker's
 * symbol table names an instruction's file and line by *)
(* and acid's declarations of the file's types, each once (mini-cc -g:
 * Acid's; mini-ld -g puts them in the program) *)
type obj = { arch : arch; file : Fpath.t; items : (item * int) array (* and its line *);
             history : (string option * int) list; acid : string list }

(* the conditions both machines test, as 5a and 7a name them (CS and
 * CC are HS and LO); shared by the assembler, the linkers and the
 * compiler *)
(* old: strings in each, and in each linker a table inverting them *)
type cond = EQ | NE | HS | LO | MI | PL | VS | VC | HI | LS | GE | LT | GT | LE

(* the opposite condition *)
let invert = function
  | EQ -> NE | NE -> EQ | HS -> LO | LO -> HS | MI -> PL | PL -> MI | VS -> VC | VC -> VS
  | HI -> LS | LS -> HI | GE -> LT | LT -> GE | GT -> LE | LE -> GT

(* the code both machines give it (arm's always is 14) *)
let cond_bits = function
  | EQ -> 0 | NE -> 1 | HS -> 2 | LO -> 3 | MI -> 4 | PL -> 5 | VS -> 6 | VC -> 7
  | HI -> 8 | LS -> 9 | GE -> 10 | LT -> 11 | GT -> 12 | LE -> 13

let string_of_cond = function
  | EQ -> "EQ" | NE -> "NE" | HS -> "HS" | LO -> "LO" | MI -> "MI" | PL -> "PL" | VS -> "VS" | VC -> "VC"
  | HI -> "HI" | LS -> "LS" | GE -> "GE" | LT -> "LT" | GT -> "GT" | LE -> "LE"

let cond_of_string =
  let all = List.map (fun c -> string_of_cond c, c) [ EQ; NE; HS; LO; MI; PL; VS; VC; HI; LS; GE; LT; GT; LE ] in
  function "CS" -> Some HS | "CC" -> Some LO | s -> List.assoc_opt s all

(* the objects: marshalled, with a version, as xix's; 4: a shift's
 * count By_imm or By_reg, not a polymorphic variant;
 * 5: an operand may be a system register (Spr) *)
let version = 5

(* an object as version 5 has it: [obj] but its history, which follows
 * it in the file as a second value (2026-10-29), so that an object
 * made before is read (with no history) and an older linker reads a
 * new one (the bytes after the first value not looked at): the tools
 * and the objects of a checkout's _mk change at different times *)
type stored = { s_arch : arch; s_file : Fpath.t; s_items : (item * int) array }

(* No_sharing: an object's bytes its value's alone, not which of its
 * parts are one block in memory, which depends on the compiler that
 * built the tool (mini-cc by OCaml and by mini-ml: the same code, 5 of
 * libc's objects not the same bytes, plan_self_hosting.md), for 5% more *)
let stored (o : obj) = { s_arch = o.arch; s_file = o.file; s_items = o.items }
(* (the declarations a third value, after the history, which is then
 * written even if empty: the same way, an object without them read) *)
let history_bytes (o : obj) =
  if o.history = [] && o.acid = [] then ""
  else Marshal.to_string o.history [ Marshal.No_sharing ] ^ (if o.acid = [] then "" else Marshal.to_string o.acid [ Marshal.No_sharing ])

(* the value at [pos], then the history and the declarations if there
 * are bytes after it *)
let with_history (b : string) pos (st : stored) : obj =
  let next = pos + Marshal.total_size (Bytes.unsafe_of_string b) pos in
  let history = if next < String.length b then (Marshal.from_string b next : (string option * int) list) else [] in
  let next = if next < String.length b then next + Marshal.total_size (Bytes.unsafe_of_string b) next else next in
  let acid = if next < String.length b then (Marshal.from_string b next : string list) else [] in
  { arch = st.s_arch; file = st.s_file; items = st.s_items; history; acid }

(* a library's member (Link): the object without the version *)
let to_bytes o = Marshal.to_string (stored o) [ Marshal.No_sharing ] ^ history_bytes o
let of_bytes b : obj = with_history b 0 (Marshal.from_string b 0)

(* the files through the capabilities
 * old: Marshal.to_string (version, o) [] *)
let save caps file (o : obj) =
  FS.write caps file (Marshal.to_string (version, stored o) [ Marshal.No_sharing ] ^ history_bytes o)

(* (a file that is not one, its header's magic number and size checked
 * first: Marshal.from_string's own errors are Invalid_argument, read as
 * a bug of the linker, docs/plans/bugs/ix.md) *)
let marshalled (b : string) : bool =
  String.length b >= Marshal.header_size
  && (match Marshal.total_size (Bytes.unsafe_of_string b) 0 with
      | n -> n <= String.length b
      | exception Failure _ -> false)

let load caps file : obj =
  let b = FS.read caps file in
  if not (marshalled b) then failwith (Fpath.to_string file ^ ": not an object");
  let v, (st : stored) = Marshal.from_string b 0 in
  if v <> version then failwith (Fpath.to_string file ^ ": an object of another version");
  with_history b 0 st

(* (an item as text, the linker's messages and listing: Show_asm) *)
assembler/CLI.ml
