(* A row's values, packed as bytes: a record.
 *
 * A header of types, then the values, no separators:
 *
 *      07 | 00 | 80 80 80 11 | 04 | 61 62 | 00 00 01 2c
 *      |    |    |             |    |       |
 *      |    |    |             |    "ab"    300
 *      |    |    |             a 4-byte integer
 *      |    |    text of (17 - 13) / 2 = 2 bytes
 *      |    NULL (the primary key, stored as the row's key instead)
 *      the header's size, this byte included
 *
 * (the row (1, "ab", 300) of t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT,
 * n INTEGER), as chidb writes it; checked). The types are SQLite's
 * serial types, cut to five: 0 NULL, 1, 2 and 4 for integers of 1, 2
 * and 4 bytes, big-endian and signed, and 2n+13 for a text of n bytes.
 * chidb writes a text's type as a varint of 4 bytes always (7 bits a
 * byte, the high bit set on all but the last), the others as 1 byte;
 * a reader takes a type with its high bit set as a varint.
 *
 * References: SQLite's record format ("The Database File Format",
 * section "Record Format", sqlite.org), where a varint takes from 1
 * to 9 bytes; chidb's fileformat page, "Database records" (checked:
 * docs/chidb-website/chidb/fileformat.html). *)

(* an integer's size in the record *)
type width = W8 | W16 | W32

type value =
  | Null
  | Int of width * int      (* the value, sign-extended from its width *)
  | Text of string

(* a record that is none of these types (chidb's SQL_NOTVALID) *)
exception Invalid_type of int

val pack : value list -> string

(* the record at [off] in the bytes *)
val unpack : Bytes.t -> int -> value list

(* its size in bytes, header included, from its header *)
val packed_size : Bytes.t -> int -> int

(* 4-byte varints and big-endian integers, as chidb's util.c *)
val get_varint32 : Bytes.t -> int -> int
val put_varint32 : Bytes.t -> int -> int -> unit
val get4 : Bytes.t -> int -> int
val put4 : Bytes.t -> int -> int -> unit
val get2 : Bytes.t -> int -> int
val put2 : Bytes.t -> int -> int -> unit

(* See Acid_dwarf.mli *)

open Dwarf_info

let sprintf = Printf.sprintf

(* acid's keywords: a name that is one written with a $ (mini-cc's Acid) *)
let kwd = [ "adt"; "aggr"; "append"; "builtin"; "complex"; "defn"; "delete"; "do"; "else"; "eval";
            "head"; "if"; "local"; "loop"; "return"; "tail"; "then"; "union"; "whatis"; "while" ]
let amap s = if List.mem s kwd then "$" ^ s else s

(* DW_TAG_s and DW_AT_s *)
let t_struct = 0x13 and t_union = 0x17 and t_member = 0x0d and t_typedef = 0x16 and t_pointer = 0x0f
let t_base = 0x24 and t_array = 0x01 and t_enum = 0x04 and t_variable = 0x34
let t_subprogram = 0x2e and t_param = 0x05 and t_lexical_block = 0x0b
let at_type = 0x49 and at_size = 0x0b and at_encoding = 0x3e and at_member_loc = 0x38 and at_location = 0x02
let at_declaration = 0x3c

let decls units =
  let idx = index units in
  let get r = Hashtbl.find_opt idx r in
  let typ d = match ref_ d at_type with Some r -> get r | None -> None in
  (* through the typedefs, const and volatile *)
  let rec strip d = if d.tag = t_typedef || d.tag = 0x26 || d.tag = 0x35 then (match typ d with Some t -> strip t | None -> d) else d in
  (* a structure's name: its own, or the typedef's of an unnamed one *)
  let names = Hashtbl.create 64 in
  let rec walk d =
    if (d.tag = t_struct || d.tag = t_union) && name d <> None then Hashtbl.replace names d.off (Option.get (name d));
    if d.tag = t_typedef then
      (match typ d, name d with
       | Some t, Some n when (let t = strip t in (t.tag = t_struct || t.tag = t_union) && not (Hashtbl.mem names t.off)) ->
           Hashtbl.replace names (strip t).off n
       | _ -> ());
    List.iter walk d.children in
  List.iter walk units;
  let sname d = Hashtbl.find_opt names d.off in
  (* a scalar's format, 5c's letters (acidchar) *)
  let format d =
    let d = strip d in
    let size = match int d at_size with Some n -> n | None -> 8 in
    if d.tag = t_pointer then Some (if size = 8 then 'Y' else 'X')
    else if d.tag = t_array then Some 'a'
    else if d.tag = t_enum then Some (if size = 8 then 'V' else 'D')
    else if d.tag = t_base then
      match int d at_encoding, size with
      | Some 0x04, 4 -> Some 'f' | Some 0x04, _ -> Some 'F'
      | Some (0x06 | 0x05), 1 -> Some 'C'
      | Some (0x08 | 0x07 | 0x02 | 0x10), 1 -> Some 'b'
      | Some 0x05, 2 -> Some 'd' | Some (0x07 | 0x10), 2 -> Some 'u'
      | Some 0x05, 4 -> Some 'D' | Some (0x07 | 0x10), 4 -> Some 'U'
      | Some 0x05, _ -> Some 'V' | Some (0x07 | 0x10), _ -> Some 'W'
      | _ -> None
    else None in
  let offset m =
    match attr m at_member_loc with
    | Some (Int n) -> Some n
    | Some (Block b) when String.length b >= 2 && b.[0] = '\x23' ->
        (* DW_OP_plus_uconst n *)
        let rec uleb o v sh = let c = Char.code b.[o] in let v = v lor ((c land 0x7f) lsl sh) in
          if c land 0x80 <> 0 then uleb (o + 1) v (sh + 7) else v in
        Some (uleb 1 0 0)
    | _ -> None in
  let member m =
    match name m, offset m, typ m with
    | Some n, Some off, Some t ->
        let t = strip t in
        let n = amap n in
        if (t.tag = t_struct || t.tag = t_union) then
          Option.map (fun s -> sprintf "\t%s %d %s;\n" (amap s) off n) (sname t)
        else if t.tag = t_pointer then
          (match Option.map strip (typ t) with
           | Some p when (p.tag = t_struct || p.tag = t_union) && sname p <> None ->
               Some (sprintf "\t'A' %s %d %s;\n" (amap (Option.get (sname p))) off n)
           | _ -> Option.map (fun c -> sprintf "\t'%c' %d %s;\n" c off n) (format t))
        else Option.map (fun c -> sprintf "\t'%c' %d %s;\n" c off n) (format t)
    | _ -> None in
  let out = Buffer.create 4096 and seen = Hashtbl.create 64 in
  let rec types d =
    (if (d.tag = t_struct || d.tag = t_union) && attr d at_declaration = None then
       match sname d, int d at_size with
       | Some s, Some size when not (Hashtbl.mem seen s) ->
           Hashtbl.replace seen s ();
           let s = amap s in
           Buffer.add_string out (sprintf "sizeof%s = %d;\naggr %s\n{\n" s size s);
           List.iter (fun m -> if m.tag = t_member then Option.iter (Buffer.add_string out) (member m)) d.children;
           Buffer.add_string out "};\n\n"
       | _ -> ());
    List.iter types d.children in
  List.iter types units;
  (* the globals of a complex type, a pointer to one too (5c's acidvar),
   * and a function's parameters and locals (complex T f:v) *)
  let rec deref d = let d = strip d in if d.tag = t_pointer then (match typ d with Some t -> deref t | None -> d) else d in
  let complex v n =
    match typ v with
    | Some t ->
        let t = deref t in
        if t.tag = t_struct || t.tag = t_union then
          Option.iter (fun s -> Buffer.add_string out (sprintf "complex %s %s;\n" (amap s) n)) (sname t)
    | None -> () in
  let rec locals f d =
    List.iter (fun v ->
      if v.tag = t_lexical_block then locals f v
      else if v.tag = t_param || v.tag = t_variable then
        Option.iter (fun n -> complex v (amap f ^ ":" ^ amap n)) (name v)) d.children in
  List.iter (fun u ->
    List.iter (fun v ->
      match name v, attr v at_location with
      | Some n, Some (Block b) when v.tag = t_variable && String.length b > 0 && b.[0] = '\x03' -> complex v (amap n)
      | Some f, _ when v.tag = t_subprogram -> locals f v
      | _ -> ()) u.children) units;
  Buffer.contents out

(* A program's DWARF types as acid's declarations (plan_debugger.md,
 * stage 8a): what 5c -a writes of a C file, made from what gcc wrote
 * in .debug_info (Dwarf_info), for a program of gcc's that has no
 * .acid; mini-acid runs it as the program's declarations, and print
 * shows a structure by its members (port.acid's pcomplex):

 *     structure_type "Node" (or a typedef's of an unnamed one)
 *       member "name" char*, at 0       'Y' 0 name;
 *       member "p" Point, at 8          Point 8 p;
 *       member "next" Node*, at 16      'A' Node 16 next;
 *     variable "n1" Node, DW_OP_addr    complex Node n1;
 *     subprogram "walk"

 * the members' formats 5c's letters by their base types' encodings and
 * sizes (C, b, d, u, D, U, V, W, f, F; Y a pointer of 8 bytes, a an
 * array); a local's address is Frame64's (its location on the

(* Claude Code

(* acid's tree (principia's acid.h: Node, and the Store of a constant,
 * one recursive structure: a value may be code, and code holds
 * constants). The values' meaning is Value's; the grammar is
 * Parser.mly, acid's dbg.y. *)

type kind =
  | Int of int64
  | Float of float
  | String of string
  | List of cell option        (* None: the empty list *)
  | Code of expr               (* what eval runs *)

(* a value and its format (Value.mli says what the letters are), and
 * its complex type, an aggr's name, when it is the address of one
 * (acid's Node's comt: what e.m reads by, what print calls) *)
and value = { kind : kind; fmt : char; comt : string option }

(* acid's lists: cells, changed in place by append and + *)
and cell = { mutable value : value; mutable next : cell option }

and binop =
  | Mul | Div | Mod | Add | Sub | Rsh | Lsh
  | Lt | Gt | Leq | Geq | Eq | Neq
  | Land | Xor | Lor

and expr =
  | Const of value
  | Name of string
  | Bin of binop * expr * expr
  | Cand of expr * expr                 (* && *)
  | Cor of expr * expr                  (* || *)
  | Assign of expr * expr
  | Fmt of expr * char                  (* e\X *)
  | Plus of expr                        (* unary + *)
  | Not of expr
  | Indm of expr                        (* *e: the process's memory *)
  | Indc of expr                        (* @e: the program's file *)
  | Preinc of expr | Predec of expr
  | Postinc of expr | Postdec of expr
  | Head of expr | Tail of expr
  | Append of expr * expr
  | Delete of expr * expr
  | Eval of expr
  | Cast of string * expr               (* (T)e: a complex type *)
  | Index of expr * expr
  | Dot of expr * string                (* e.m, e->m *)
  | Call of string * expr list * bool   (* builtin f(...): true *)
  | Construct of expr list              (* {a, b} *)
  | What of string option               (* whatis *)
  | Frame of string * string            (* f:v, a local's address *)

(* a complex type's member (aggr's): its format, its offset, its name,
 * the complex type it is, if one *)
type member = { mfmt : char; moffset : int; mname : string; mtype : string option }

type stmt =
  | Expr of expr option
  | Block of stmt list
  | If of expr * stmt * stmt option
  | Loop of expr * expr * stmt          (* loop a, b do s *)
  | While of expr * stmt
  | Return of expr
  | Local of string list
  | Complex of string * expr            (* complex T v (or f:v): v is a T *)

(* a function's parameter: its name, and whether it is *name, which
 * gets its argument's code, not its value (eval runs it) *)
type param = { pname : string; by_name : bool }

type toplevel =
  | Stmt of stmt
  | Defn of string * param list * stmt list
  | Undefn of string                    (* defn f, alone: f forgotten *)
  | Aggr of string * member list

open Ast

let error fmt = Printf.ksprintf (fun s -> raise (Eval.Error s)) fmt

let one name = function [ v ] -> v | _ -> error "%s(value)" name

let str name v = match (one name v).kind with String s -> s | _ -> error "%s(string)" name

(* strtoull's base 0 on a prefix of digits (atoi "12x" is 12) *)
let atoi s =
  let s = String.trim s in
  let n = String.length s in
  let neg = n > 0 && s.[0] = '-' in
  let s = if neg || (n > 0 && s.[0] = '+') then String.sub s 1 (n - 1) else s in
  let base, s =
    if String.length s > 2 && (String.sub s 0 2 = "0x" || String.sub s 0 2 = "0X") then 16, String.sub s 2 (String.length s - 2)
    else if String.length s > 1 && s.[0] = '0' then 8, String.sub s 1 (String.length s - 1)
    else 10, s in
  let digit c = match c with
    | '0' .. '9' -> Char.code c - 48 | 'a' .. 'f' -> Char.code c - 87 | 'A' .. 'F' -> Char.code c - 55 | _ -> 99 in
  let rec go i acc = if i < String.length s && digit s.[i] < base then go (i + 1) (Int64.add (Int64.mul acc (Int64.of_int base)) (Int64.of_int (digit s.[i]))) else acc in
  let v = go 0 0L in
  if neg then Int64.neg v else v

(* itoa's format (acidfmt): one of Plan 9's for an integer, %d by
 * default: its flags and width, then u, l, h, # (%ux: unsigned
 * hexadecimal), then the verb; x with 0x as principia's (acid's xfmt),
 * 32 bits, 64 with ll (%llux) *)
let itoa i f =
  match f with
  | None -> Int64.to_string i
  | Some f ->
      (match String.index_opt f '%' with
       | None -> f
       | Some k ->
           let j = ref (k + 1) in
           while !j < String.length f && (f.[!j] = '0' || f.[!j] = '-' || (f.[!j] >= '1' && f.[!j] <= '9')) do incr j done;
           let flags = String.sub f (k + 1) (!j - k - 1) in
           let mods = !j in
           while !j < String.length f && String.contains "ulh#" f.[!j] do incr j done;
           let ls = ref 0 in
           for k = mods to !j - 1 do if f.[k] = 'l' then incr ls done;
           let long = !ls >= 2 in
           if !j >= String.length f then error "itoa: bad format";
           let width = try int_of_string (if flags <> "" && flags.[0] = '-' then String.sub flags 1 (String.length flags - 1) else flags) with Failure _ -> 0 in
           let digits = match f.[!j] with
             | 'x' -> Printf.sprintf "0x%Lx" (if long then i else Int64.logand i 0xffffffffL) | 'X' -> Printf.sprintf "%LX" i | 'o' -> Printf.sprintf "%Lo" i
             | 'u' -> Printf.sprintf "%Lu" i | 'c' -> String.make 1 (Char.chr (Int64.to_int i land 255))
             | _ -> Int64.to_string i in
           let pad = String.make (max 0 (width - String.length digits)) (if flags <> "" && flags.[0] = '0' then '0' else ' ') in
           let body = if flags <> "" && flags.[0] = '-' then digits ^ pad else pad ^ digits in
           String.sub f 0 k ^ body ^ String.sub f (!j + 1) (String.length f - !j - 1))

let init (caps : < caps; .. >) =
  let def name f = Hashtbl.replace Eval.builtins name f in
  (* an aggr's members as data, each {name, format, offset, its complex
   * type or ""}: what a library prints a value by (ix's pcomplex) *)
  def "members" (fun vs ->
    let t = str "members" vs in
    match Eval.aggr t with
    | None -> error "members: %s is not a complex type" t
    | Some ms -> Value.list (List.map (fun (m : member) ->
        Value.list [ Value.string m.mname; Value.string (String.make 1 m.mfmt); Value.int 'D' (Int64.of_int m.moffset);
                     Value.string (match m.mtype with Some t -> t | None -> "") ]) ms));
  (* a variable's value by its name, which a string may hold: an ML
   * global's address for mini-ml -g's descriptions, read before the
   * program's symbols are set (not acid's) *)
  def "var" (fun vs -> Eval.get (str "var" vs));
  def "print" (fun vs -> Eval.print vs; Value.empty);
  def "fmt" (function
    | [ v; { kind = Int c; _ } ] when String.contains Value.formats (Char.chr (Int64.to_int c land 255)) ->
        { v with fmt = Char.chr (Int64.to_int c) }
    | [ _; _ ] -> error "bad format"
    | _ -> error "fmt(obj, fmt)");
  def "fmtof" (fun vs -> Value.int 'D' (Int64.of_int (Char.code (one "fmtof" vs).fmt)));
  def "fmtsize" (fun vs -> Value.int 'D' (Int64.of_int (Value.size (one "fmtsize" vs).fmt)));
  def "atoi" (fun vs -> Value.int 'V' (atoi (str "atoi" vs)));
  def "atof" (fun vs -> { kind = Float (try float_of_string (String.trim (str "atof" vs)) with Failure _ -> 0.); fmt = 'f'; comt = None });
  def "itoa" (function
    | [ { kind = Int i; _ } ] -> Value.string (itoa i None)
    | [ { kind = Int i; _ }; { kind = String f; _ } ] -> Value.string (itoa i (Some f))
    | _ -> error "itoa(integer [, fmt])");
  def "error" (fun vs -> raise (Eval.Error (str "error" vs)));
  (* an item's index in a list, -1 when not there (integers, floats and
   * strings compared; a list never matches) *)
  def "match" (function
    | [ item; { kind = List l; _ } ] ->
        let same (a : value) (b : value) = match a.kind, b.kind with
          | Int x, Int y -> x = y | Float x, Float y -> x = y | String x, String y -> x = y | _ -> false in
        let rec find i = function [] -> -1L | v :: rest -> if same item v then i else find (Int64.add i 1L) rest in
        Value.int 'D' (find 0L (Value.elements l))
    | [ _; _ ] -> error "match(obj, list): need list"
    | _ -> error "match(obj, list): arg count");
  def "access" (fun vs -> Value.int 'X' (match FS.read_opt caps (Fpath.v (str "access" vs)) with Some _ -> 1L | None -> 0L));
  (* a file's lines, without their newlines; {} when it cannot be read
   * (port.acid's findsrc) *)
  def "file" (fun vs ->
    match FS.read_opt caps (Fpath.v (str "file" vs)) with
    | Some text ->
        let lines = String.split_on_char '\n' text in
        let lines = match List.rev lines with "" :: rest -> List.rev rest | _ -> lines in
        Value.list (List.map Value.string lines)
    | None -> Value.empty);
  def "readfile" (fun vs ->
    match FS.read_opt caps (Fpath.v (str "readfile" vs)) with
    | Some s when s <> "" -> Value.string s
    | _ -> Value.empty)

(* the input's name, for the errors: <stdin>:12: (error) ... *)
let source = ref "<stdin>"

(* a statement at a time, run as soon as it is read; after a syntax
 * error the rest of the statement is dropped, up to its ; (an error in
 * running one comes after it is read whole) *)
let run (caps : < caps; .. >) lexbuf ~prompt =
  (* (written out at once: at a terminal, the answer before the next line) *)
  let write s = let oc = Console.stdout caps in output_string oc s; flush oc in
  let flush () =
    write (Buffer.contents Eval.out);
    Buffer.clear Eval.out in
  let report msg =
    flush ();
    write (Printf.sprintf "%s:%d: (error) %s\n" !source !Lexer.line msg);
    Eval.reset () in
  let rec skip () = match Lexer.token lexbuf with Parser.SEMI | Parser.EOF -> () | _ -> skip () | exception Lexer.Error _ -> skip () in
  let next () = flush (); if prompt then write "acid: " in
  Eval.ran := next;
  (* a parse to the end, or to an error: then another from where it was *)
  let rec loop () =
    match Parser.program Lexer.token lexbuf with
    | () -> flush (); if prompt then write "\n"     (* (acid's at the end) *)
    | exception Eval.Error msg -> report msg; next (); loop ()
    | exception Lexer.Error msg -> report msg; Lexer.depth := 0; skip (); next (); loop ()
    | exception Parsing.Parse_error ->
        flush ();
        write (Printf.sprintf "%s:%d: syntax error, near symbol '%s'\n" !source !Lexer.line !Lexer.symbol);
        Eval.reset (); Lexer.depth := 0; skip (); next (); loop ()
  in
  if prompt then write "acid: ";
  loop ()

(* the standard input as the lexer reads it: what a read gives, a line
 * at a terminal, so that a statement runs when its line is typed *)
let stdin_lexbuf (caps : < caps; .. >) =
  let fd = Console.stdin_fd caps in
  Lexing.from_function (fun b n -> try Unix.read fd b 0 n with Unix.Unix_error _ -> 0)

(* a library read: acid's loadmodule, statements run, no prompt *)
let run_text (caps : < caps; .. >) name text =
  source := name;
  Lexer.line := 1;
  Lexer.interactive := false;
  run caps (Lexing.from_string text) ~prompt:false

let library (caps : < caps; .. >) f = Option.iter (run_text caps f) (FS.read_opt caps (Fpath.v f))

(* where the default libraries are: Plan 9's /lib/acid; on Linux first
 * $ACIDLIB, then ix's debuggers/acid/lib in a directory above mini-acid's
 * executable (dune's _build/default/debuggers/acid/Main.exe, which ix's
 * bin/mini-acid is) *)
let libdir (caps : < caps; .. >) =
  let rec above d n =
    if n = 0 then [] else Filename.concat d "debuggers/acid/lib" :: above (Filename.dirname d) (n - 1) in
  let dirs =
    if Ptrace.available then
      (match CapSys.getenv caps "ACIDLIB" with d -> [ d ] | exception Not_found -> [])
      @ above (Filename.dirname Sys.executable_name) 6 @ [ "/lib/acid" ]
    else [ "/lib/acid" ] in
  match List.find_opt (fun d -> FS.read_opt caps (Fpath.v (Filename.concat d "port.acid")) <> None) dirs with
  | Some d -> d
  | None -> "/lib/acid"

let main (caps : < caps; .. >) (argv : string array) : Exit.t =
  let rec options libs = function
    | "-l" :: f :: rest -> options (f :: libs) rest
    | ("-q" | "-w" | "-k") :: rest -> options libs rest
    | rest when List.for_all (fun a -> a = "" || a.[0] <> '-') rest -> Some (List.rev libs, rest)
    | _ -> None in
  let number s = match int_of_string_opt s with Some n when n > 0 -> Some n | _ -> None in
  match options [] (List.tl (Array.to_list argv)) with
  | None -> Console.eprint caps help; Exit.Code 1
  | Some (files, args) ->
      Builtin.init caps;
      Proc.init caps;
      (* acid's main: its variables, the program and its process, the
       * registers, the libraries (/lib/acid's when there, then -l's),
       * acidinit(), the symbols as variables, acidmap() *)
      List.iter (fun (n, v) -> Eval.set_global n v)
        [ "proc", Value.int 'X' 0L; "pid", Value.int 'D' 0L; "proclist", Value.empty ];
      let aout, pid = match args with
        | [ p ] when number p <> None -> Some (Printf.sprintf "/proc/%s/text" p), number p
        | [ p; a ] when number p <> None -> Some a, number p
        | a :: _ -> Some a, None
        | [] -> None, None in
      let start f = try f () with Eval.Error msg ->
        Console.print caps (Buffer.contents Eval.out); Buffer.clear Eval.out;
        Console.print caps (Printf.sprintf "%s:%d: (error) %s\n" !source !Lexer.line msg) in
      (match aout with
       | Some a -> start (fun () -> Proc.program caps a; match pid with Some p -> Proc.attach caps p | None -> ())
       | None -> Proc.registers ());
      (* (the machine's the program's, arm64.acid for an arm64 one; none
       * when -l names a port.acid: the same library twice) *)
      let objtype = match (Eval.get "objtype").kind with String s -> s | _ -> "arm" | exception Eval.Error _ -> "arm" in
      if not (List.exists (fun f -> Filename.basename f = "port.acid") files) then begin
        let d = libdir caps in
        List.iter (library caps) [ Filename.concat d "port.acid"; Filename.concat d (objtype ^ ".acid") ]
      end;
      List.iter (fun f ->
        match FS.read_opt caps (Fpath.v f) with
        | Some text ->
            source := f;
            Lexer.line := 1;
            Lexer.interactive := false;
            run caps (Lexing.from_string text) ~prompt:false
        | None -> Console.print caps (Printf.sprintf "%s:%d: (error) pushfile: %s: file does not exist\n" !source !Lexer.line f)) files;
      (* the program's declarations, its own (mini-ld -g): as a -l's *)
      Option.iter (run_text caps (match aout with Some a -> a ^ ":.acid" | None -> ".acid")) (Proc.declarations ());
      (* userinit: the library's acidinit() (arm.acid's: bpfmt, srcpath) *)
      start (fun () -> Eval.call_if_defined "acidinit" []);
      if aout <> None then start Proc.symbols;
      start (fun () -> Eval.call_if_defined "acidmap" []);
      Console.print caps (Buffer.contents Eval.out); Buffer.clear Eval.out;
      source := "<stdin>";
      Lexer.line := 1;
      Lexer.interactive := true;
      run caps (stdin_lexbuf caps) ~prompt:true;
      (* die's: the processes left, how to kill them *)
      List.iter (fun p -> Console.print caps (if Ptrace.available then Printf.sprintf "kill %d\n" p else Printf.sprintf "echo kill > /proc/%d/ctl\n" p)) (Proc.attached ());
      Exit.OK
debuggers/acid/CLI.mli

(* mini-acid: Plan 9's acid (principia's debuggers/acid), a debugger
 * that is a language: C's expressions and statements, lists and
 * strings, functions (defn), and builtins that read a stopped
 * process's memory and registers by its /proc. What a debugger does
 * (a stack trace, a breakpoint, a step) is a function written in acid,
 * in a library read at the start (port.acid, arm.acid), so that a user
 * adds to the debugger as to the library.
 *
 *     acid: defn fact(n) { if n <= 1 then return 1; return n*fact(n-1); }
 *     acid: fact(10)
 *     0x00375f00
 *     acid: fact(10)\D
 *     3628800
 *
 * A top-level statement's way through the modules:
 *
 *     Lexer --> Parser --> Ast --> Eval --> what is printed
 *     acid's    a statement      | Value: the values, their formats
 *     tokens                     | Builtin: print, fmt, atoi...
 *
 * A value carries a format, a letter (X, D, s, a...) that says how it
 * prints and how big it is in memory; a result takes its left
 * operand's, so a pointer stays one through arithmetic (Value.mli).
 * The variables are dynamically scoped (Eval.mli).
 *
 * The program and the process (step 4, Proc): the symbols as variables,
 * the memory and the registers by /proc, start, stop, breakpoints,
 * strace (libmach's risctrace). The library is ix's own (lib/port.acid,
 * lib/arm.acid: acid's essentials, one stack walk for C's frames and
 * mini-ml's), read from /lib/acid or by -l; principia's runs too. Not yet: the instructions printed (the
 * i format: 5db's disassembler), complex types' . and casts, floats
 * printed as Plan 9's %g.
 *
 * cs-history:
 * acid is Phil Winterbottom's, for Plan 9's second edition (1995),
 * "Acid: A Debugger Built From A Language" (USENIX Winter 1994): a
 * debugger's commands are a language's functions, so the library
 * grows the debugger (a trace of a program's calls, a leak checker,
 * the kernel's own structures), where dbx and gdb grew commands in C.
 * gdb's Python (2009) and lldb's are the same idea, decades later.
 *
 * References: acid(1) in the Plan 9 manual; Winterbottom's paper and
 * "Acid Manual"; principia's Debugger.nw. *)

type caps = < Builtin.caps; Proc.caps; Cap.stdin; Cap.stdout; Cap.stderr; Cap.env >

val main : < caps; .. > -> string array -> Exit.t

(* See Code.mli *)

open Ast

let binop = function
  | Mul -> "*" | Div -> "/" | Mod -> "%" | Add -> "+" | Sub -> "-" | Rsh -> ">>" | Lsh -> "<<"
  | Lt -> "<" | Gt -> ">" | Leq -> "<=" | Geq -> ">=" | Eq -> "==" | Neq -> "!="
  | Land -> "&" | Xor -> "^" | Lor -> "|"

(* pstr: a string in quotes, its escapes written back *)
let str s =
  let b = Buffer.create (String.length s + 2) in
  Buffer.add_char b '"';
  String.iter (fun c ->
    match c with
    | '\000' -> Buffer.add_string b "\\0" | '\n' -> Buffer.add_string b "\\n" | '\r' -> Buffer.add_string b "\\r"
    | '\t' -> Buffer.add_string b "\\t" | '\b' -> Buffer.add_string b "\\b" | '\012' -> Buffer.add_string b "\\f"
    | '\007' -> Buffer.add_string b "\\a" | '\011' -> Buffer.add_string b "\\v" | '\\' -> Buffer.add_string b "\\\\"
    | '"' -> Buffer.add_string b "\\\"" | c -> Buffer.add_char b c) s;
  Buffer.add_char b '"';
  Buffer.contents b

let rec expr (e : expr) =
  match e with
  | Name s -> s
  | Const { kind = Int i; _ } -> Int64.to_string i
  | Const { kind = Float f; _ } -> Printf.sprintf "%g" f
  | Const { kind = String s; _ } -> str s
  | Const _ -> ""
  | Bin (op, a, b) -> "(" ^ expr a ^ binop op ^ expr b ^ ")"
  | Cand (a, b) -> "(" ^ expr a ^ "&&" ^ expr b ^ ")"
  | Cor (a, b) -> "(" ^ expr a ^ "||" ^ expr b ^ ")"
  | Assign (a, b) -> expr a ^ " = " ^ expr b
  | Indm a -> "*" ^ expr a
  | Indc a -> "@" ^ expr a
  | Predec a -> "--" ^ expr a
  | Preinc a -> "++" ^ expr a
  | Postinc a -> expr a ^ "++"
  | Postdec a -> expr a ^ "--"
  | Not a -> "!" ^ expr a
  | Plus a -> expr a
  | Call (f, args, _) -> f ^ "(" ^ String.concat "," (List.map expr args) ^ ")"
  | Construct es -> "{" ^ String.concat "," (List.map expr es) ^ "}"
  | Head a -> "head " ^ expr a
  | Tail a -> "tail " ^ expr a
  | Append (a, b) -> "append " ^ expr a ^ "," ^ expr b
  | Delete (a, b) -> "delete " ^ expr a ^ "," ^ expr b
  | Index (a, b) -> expr a ^ "[" ^ expr b ^ "]"
  | Dot (a, m) -> expr a ^ "." ^ m
  | Frame (f, v) -> f ^ ":" ^ v
  | Cast (t, a) -> "(" ^ t ^ ")" ^ expr a
  | Fmt (a, c) -> expr a ^ "\\" ^ String.make 1 c
  | Eval a -> "eval " ^ expr a
  | What None -> "whatis"
  | What (Some s) -> "whatis " ^ s

let tabs d = String.make d '\t'

(* a body (slist): braces when it is more than one statement *)
let rec body d (s : stmt) =
  match s with
  | Block [ s ] -> body d s
  | Block ss -> tabs (d - 1) ^ "{\n" ^ stmts d ss ^ tabs (d - 1) ^ "}\n"
  | s -> stmt d s

and stmt d (s : stmt) =
  match s with
  | Expr None -> ""
  | Expr (Some e) -> tabs d ^ expr e ^ ";\n"
  | Block ss -> stmts d ss
  | Local ns -> tabs d ^ "local " ^ String.concat ", " ns ^ ";\n"
  | Complex (t, v) -> Printf.sprintf "%scomplex %s %s;\n" (tabs d) t (expr v)
  | If (c, a, None) -> tabs d ^ "if " ^ expr c ^ " then\n" ^ body (d + 1) a
  | If (c, a, Some b) -> tabs d ^ "if " ^ expr c ^ " then\n" ^ body (d + 1) a ^ tabs d ^ "else\n" ^ body (d + 1) b
  | While (c, b) -> tabs d ^ "while " ^ expr c ^ " do\n" ^ body (d + 1) b
  | Return e -> tabs d ^ "return " ^ expr e ^ ";\n"
  | Loop (a, b, s) -> tabs d ^ "loop " ^ expr a ^ ", " ^ expr b ^ " do\n" ^ body (d + 1) s

and stmts d ss = String.concat "" (List.map (stmt d) ss)

val stmts : int -> Ast.stmt list -> string

(* Claude Code

(* See Das.mli *)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Words *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let u32 v = Int64.logand v 0xffffffffL
let s32 v = Int64.of_int32 (Int64.to_int32 v)

(* the bits of w from [sh], masked *)
let fld w sh m =
  Int64.to_int (Int64.logand (Int64.shift_right_logical w sh) (Int64.of_int m))
let bit w n = fld w n 1 = 1
let masked w m v = Int64.logand w m = v

(* ROR, of a word *)
let ror v s =
  let v = u32 v in
  if s = 0 then v
  else u32 (Int64.logor (Int64.shift_right_logical v s) (Int64.shift_left v (32 - s)))

(* Plan 9's %x as acid's xfmt makes it, 0x before; %lux unsigned, %lx
 * signed *)
let lux v = Printf.sprintf "0x%Lx" (u32 v)
let llux v = Printf.sprintf "0x%Lx" v
let lx v =
  let v = s32 v in
  if v < 0L then Printf.sprintf "-0x%Lx" (Int64.neg v) else Printf.sprintf "0x%Lx" v

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The symbols *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type table = {
  text : Symbols.sym array;
  locals : Symbols.sym list array;   (* each function's a, p, m entries *)
  globals : Symbols.sym array;
  sb : int64;
}

(* a symbol's value, a word (the table's 4 bytes: a parameter's
 * 0xfffffffc is not -4, on arm's 31-bit ints neither) *)
let value (s : Symbols.sym) = u32 (Int64.of_int s.value)

let is_text (s : Symbols.sym) = String.contains "TtLl" s.typ
let is_data (s : Symbols.sym) = String.contains "DdBb" s.typ

(* Plan 9's qsort (libc's port/qsort.c), which buildtbls sorts the
 * functions with: not stable, so of two functions at one address (cas
 * and casp) the one found is the one it puts last *)
let qsort cmp (a : 'a array) =
  let swap i j = let x = a.(i) in a.(i) <- a.(j); a.(j) <- x in
  let pivot lo n =
    let j = n / 6 in
    let pi = lo + j in
    let pj = pi + 2 * j in
    let pk = pj + 2 * j in
    if cmp a.(pi) a.(pj) < 0 then begin
      if cmp a.(pi) a.(pk) < 0 then (if cmp a.(pj) a.(pk) < 0 then pj else pk)
      else pi
    end
    else if cmp a.(pj) a.(pk) < 0 then (if cmp a.(pi) a.(pk) < 0 then pi else pk)
    else pj in
  let rec sorts lo n =
    let lo = ref lo and n = ref n in
    while !n > 1 do
      swap !lo (if !n > 10 then pivot !lo !n else !lo + !n / 2);
      let pn = !lo + !n in
      let pi = ref !lo and pj = ref pn and more = ref true in
      while !more do
        incr pi;
        while !pi < pn && cmp a.(!pi) a.(!lo) < 0 do incr pi done;
        decr pj;
        while !pj > !lo && cmp a.(!pj) a.(!lo) > 0 do decr pj done;
        if !pj < !pi then more := false else swap !pi !pj
      done;
      swap !lo !pj;
      let j = !pj - !lo in
      let rest = !n - j - 1 in
      if j >= rest then begin sorts !lo j; lo := !lo + j + 1; n := rest end
      else begin sorts (!lo + j + 1) rest; n := j end
    done in
  sorts 0 (Array.length a)

let table syms =
  let fns = ref [] and cur = ref None and locs = ref [] and globs = ref [] in
  let close () =
    match !cur with Some f -> fns := (f, List.rev !locs) :: !fns | None -> () in
  List.iter (fun (s : Symbols.sym) ->
    if is_text s then begin close (); cur := Some s; locs := [] end
    else if String.contains "apm" s.typ then locs := s :: !locs
    else if is_data s then globs := s :: !globs) syms;
  close ();
  let fns = Array.of_list (List.rev !fns) in
  qsort (fun ((a : Symbols.sym), _) ((b : Symbols.sym), _) ->
    compare (value a) (value b)) fns;
  (* the data by address, then name (symcomp) *)
  let globals = Array.of_list (List.sort (fun (a : Symbols.sym) (b : Symbols.sym) ->
    if value a <> value b then compare (value a) (value b)
    else compare a.name b.name) !globs) in
  let setr12 (s : Symbols.sym) = s.name = "setR12" && (is_text s || is_data s) in
  let sb = match List.find_opt setr12 syms with
    | Some s -> value s
    | None -> 0L in
  { text = Array.map fst fns; locals = Array.map snd fns; globals; sb }

(* srchtext, srchdata: the last entry at or below v, -1 if none *)
let search (a : Symbols.sym array) v =
  let lo = ref (-1) and hi = ref (Array.length a) in
  while !hi - !lo > 1 do
    let mid = (!lo + !hi) / 2 in
    if value a.(mid) <= v then lo := mid else hi := mid
  done;
  !lo

(* findsym: in the text (CTEXT), or anywhere (CANY: the text but its
 * last symbol, etext, then the data) *)
let findsym t v text_only =
  let i = search t.text v in
  if i >= 0 && (text_only || i <> Array.length t.text - 1) then Some t.text.(i)
  else if text_only then None
  else (let j = search t.globals v in if j >= 0 then Some t.globals.(j) else None)

(* a long's distance (a word's, as 5db's long delta) *)
let distance v (s : Symbols.sym) = Int64.abs (s32 (Int64.sub v (value s)))

let symoff t text_only v =
  match (if v = 0L then None else findsym t v text_only) with
  | None -> llux v
  | Some s ->
      let delta = distance v s in
      if s.typ <> 't' && s.typ <> 'T' && delta >= 4096L then llux v
      else if delta <> 0L then s.name ^ "+" ^ lux delta
      else s.name

(* gsymoff: a constant as a symbol, a data's plus an offset, or #0x... *)
let gsymoff t v =
  let v = u32 v in
  match (if v = 0L then None else findsym t v false) with
  | None -> "#" ^ lux v
  | Some s ->
      let delta = distance v s in
      if delta >= 4096L || s.name = ".string" then "#" ^ lux v
      else if delta = 0L then s.name
      else if s.typ <> 't' && s.typ <> 'T' then
        s.name ^ "+" ^ llux (Int64.sub v (value s))
      else "#" ^ lux v

(* 5db's Instr: the word and its fields, as the printers set them *)
type instr = {
  w : int64;
  addr : int64;
  op : int;                     (* the index in opcodes *)
  cond : int;                   (* bits 28-31 *)
  mutable store : int;
  mutable rd : int;             (* bits 12-15 *)
  mutable rn : int;             (* bits 16-19 *)
  mutable rs : int;             (* bits 0-3 *)
  mutable imm : int64;          (* a long's value *)
}

(* the printers (armdps...) and the follow functions (armfadd...) *)
type printer = Dps | Dpi | Sdti | Vstdi | Hwby | Sdts | Bdt | Unk | Branch | Bpt | Co
type foll = Next | Fadd | Fmov | Fmovm | Fbranch | Fbx

(* a mnemonic's template, its printer, its follow, its operands' *)
type opcode = { o : string; fmt : printer; foll : foll; a : string }

let op o fmt foll a = { o; fmt; foll; a }

(* the data processing instructions, 0 to 63: 16 operations, their
 * second operand a register, a register shifted by a constant or by a
 * register, a constant *)
let dp_names = [| "AND"; "EOR"; "SUB"; "RSB"; "ADD"; "ADC"; "SBC"; "RSC";
                  "TST"; "TEQ"; "CMP"; "CMN"; "ORR"; "MOVW"; "BIC"; "MVN" |]

let dp form k =
  let first = match form with
    | 0 -> "R%s" | 1 -> "(R%s%h%m)" | 2 -> "(R%s%hR%M)" | _ -> "$#%i" in
  let rest =
    if k >= 8 && k <= 11 then ",R%n"
    else if k = 13 || k = 15 then ",R%d"
    else ",R%n,R%d" in
  let foll = if k = 4 then Fadd else if k = 13 then Fmov else Next in
  op (dp_names.(k) ^ "%C%S") (if form = 3 then Dpi else Dps) foll (first ^ rest)

(* armclass: a word's opcode *)
let armclass w =
  let ldst base = base + fld w 22 1 + fld w 19 2 in
  match fld w 25 7 with
  | 0 ->                                (* data processing r,r,r *)
      if masked w 0x0ff00080L 0x01200000L then begin
        let op = fld w 4 7 in
        if op = 7 then 124                (* bkpt *)
        else if op > 0 && op < 4 then op + 124      (* bx, blx *)
        else 92
      end else begin
        let op = fld w 4 0xf in
        if op = 9 then begin             (* mul, swp or *rex *)
          if masked w 0x0ff00fffL 0x01900f9fL then 93
          else if masked w 0x0ff00ff0L 0x01800f90L then 94
          else if bit w 24 then 66 + fld w 22 1       (* swp, swpb *)
          else begin
            let op = if bit w 23 then 88 + 2 * fld w 22 1 else 64 in
            op + fld w 21 1             (* mla *)
          end
        end
        else if op land 9 = 9 then ldst 68     (* ld/st byte/half s/u *)
        else begin
          let op = fld w 21 0xf in
          if bit w 4 then op + 32
          else if fld w 7 31 <> 0 || bit w 5 then op + 16
          else op
        end
      end
  | 1 -> 48 + fld w 21 0xf              (* data processing i,r,r *)
  | 2 ->                                (* load/store byte/word i(r) *)
      let barrier =
        if masked w 0xffffff8fL 0xf57ff00fL then
          (match fld w 4 7 with 1 -> 95 | 4 -> 96 | 5 -> 97 | 6 -> 98 | _ -> 0)
        else 0 in
      if barrier <> 0 then barrier else ldst 72
  | 3 -> ldst 76                        (* load/store byte/word (r)(r) *)
  | 4 ->                                (* block data transfer *)
      if masked w 0xfe50ffffL 0xf8100a00L then 99 else 80 + fld w 20 1
  | 5 -> 82 + fld w 24 1                (* branch, branch and link *)
  | 7 ->                                (* coprocessors *)
      let cp = fld w 8 0xf in
      if cp = 10 || cp = 11 then begin  (* vfp *)
        if bit w 4 then
          (match fld w 21 7 with
           | 0 -> 118 + fld w 20 1
           | 7 -> 120 + fld w 20 1
           | _ -> 92)
        else if not (bit w 23) then 100 + fld w 19 6 + fld w 6 1
        else
          (match fld w 19 6 + fld w 6 1 with
           | 0 -> 108
           | 7 ->
               if not (bit w 19) then begin
                 if not (bit w 17) then 109 + fld w 16 4 + fld w 15 2 + fld w 7 1
                 else if fld w 16 7 = 7 then 117
                 else 92
               end
               else (match fld w 16 7 with 0 | 4 | 5 -> 117 | _ -> 92)
           | _ -> 92)
      end
      else 84 + fld w 3 2 + fld w 20 1
  | 6 -> if fld w 21 9 = 8 then 122 + fld w 20 1 else 92   (* vfp load/store *)
  | _ -> 92

let decode load pc =
  match load pc with
  | None -> None
  | Some w ->
      let w = u32 w in
      Some { w; addr = pc; op = armclass w; cond = fld w 28 0xf;
             store = 0; rd = 0; rn = 0; rs = 0; imm = 0L }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Printing *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let cond = [| "EQ"; "NE"; "CS"; "CC"; "MI"; "PL"; "VS"; "VC";
              "HI"; "LS"; "GE"; "LT"; "GT"; "LE"; ""; "NV" |]
let shtype = [| "<<"; ">>"; "->"; "@>" |]
let hb = [| "???"; "HU"; "B"; "H" |]
let addsub = [| "-"; "+" |]
let mode = [| ""; "IA"; "DB"; "IB" |]
let pw = [| "P"; "PW"; ""; "W" |]
let sw = [| ""; "W"; "S"; "SW" |]

let dot b s = if s <> "" then Buffer.add_string b ("." ^ s)

(* plocal: an offset from SP as the function's parameter or local, by
 * its .frame: below the frame a local, name-off(SP), above it a
 * parameter, name+off(FP) *)
let plocal t (i : instr) =
  let k = search t.text i.addr in
  let locals = if k < 0 then [] else t.locals.(k) in
  match List.find_opt (fun (s : Symbols.sym) -> s.name = ".frame") locals with
  | None -> None
  | Some f ->
      let frame = value f in
      let imm = s32 i.imm in
      (* (the frame unsigned, the offset converted: a negative one is
       * a parameter's) *)
      let auto = imm >= 0L && frame > imm in
      let off =
        s32 (if auto then Int64.sub frame imm else Int64.sub (Int64.sub imm frame) 4L) in
      let typ = if auto then 'a' else 'p' in
      let at (s : Symbols.sym) = s.typ = typ && value s = off in
      match List.find_opt at locals with
      | None -> None
      | Some s ->
          if auto then Some (s.name ^ "-" ^ Int64.to_string (value s) ^ "(SP)")
          else Some (s.name ^ "+" ^ Int64.to_string (value s) ^ "(FP)")

(* an operand at an address: a parameter or local; a load from the
 * literal pool after the function its constant; from R12, setR12's
 * base, a static's address *)
let address t load (i : instr) b =
  match (if i.rn = 13 then plocal t i else None) with
  | Some s -> Buffer.add_string b s
  | None ->
      let suffix = ref None in
      if i.rn = 15 then
        (match load (Int64.add (Int64.add i.addr i.imm) 8L) with
         | Some v -> i.imm <- s32 v; suffix := Some ""
         | None -> ());
      if t.sb <> 0L then begin
        if i.rd = 11 then
          (match load (Int64.add i.addr 4L) with
           | Some nxt when masked (u32 nxt) 0x0e0f0fffL 0x060c000bL ->
               i.imm <- s32 (Int64.add i.imm t.sb); suffix := Some "-SB"
           | _ -> ());
        if i.rn = 12 then begin
          i.imm <- s32 (Int64.add i.imm t.sb); suffix := Some "-SB(SB)"
        end
      end;
      match !suffix with
      | Some s -> Buffer.add_string b ("$" ^ gsymoff t i.imm ^ s)
      | None ->
          Buffer.add_string b ("#" ^ lx i.imm ^ "(R" ^ string_of_int i.rn ^ ")")

(* a register list, its runs as R0-R3 *)
let reglist (i : instr) b =
  let n = ref (Int64.to_int (Int64.logand i.imm 0xffffL)) in
  let j = ref 0 and k = ref false in
  while !n <> 0 do
    let m = !j in
    while !n land 1 = 1 do incr j; n := !n lsr 1 done;
    if !j <> m then begin
      if !k then Buffer.add_string b ",";
      if !j = m + 1 then Buffer.add_string b ("R" ^ string_of_int m)
      else
        Buffer.add_string b ("R" ^ string_of_int m ^ "-R" ^ string_of_int (!j - 1));
      k := true
    end;
    incr j;
    n := !n lsr 1
  done

(* a template expanded (format's loop) *)
let expand t load (i : instr) b f =
  let w = i.w in
  let add s = Buffer.add_string b s in
  let n = String.length f in
  let k = ref 0 in
  while !k < n do
    let c = f.[!k] in
    if c <> '%' then Buffer.add_char b c
    else if !k + 1 >= n then Buffer.add_char b '%'
    else begin
      incr k;
      match f.[!k] with
      | 'C' -> dot b cond.(i.cond)                      (* .CONDITION *)
      | 'S' -> if i.store <> 0 then add ".S"            (* .STORE *)
      | 'P' -> dot b mode.(fld w 23 3)                  (* block move's P, U *)
      | 'p' -> dot b pw.(i.store)                       (* P, W *)
      | 'a' -> dot b sw.(i.store)                       (* S, W *)
      | 's' -> add (string_of_int (i.rs land 0xf))
      | 'M' -> add (string_of_int (fld w 8 0xf))
      | 'm' -> add (string_of_int (fld w 7 0x1f))
      | 'h' -> add shtype.(fld w 5 3)
      | 'u' -> add hb.(fld w 5 3)                       (* signed, half, byte *)
      | 'I' -> address t load i b
      | 'U' -> add addsub.(fld w 23 1)
      | 'n' -> add (string_of_int i.rn)
      | 'd' -> add (string_of_int i.rd)
      | 'i' -> add (lux i.imm)
      | 'b' -> add (symoff t true (u32 i.imm))
      | 'g' -> add (gsymoff t i.imm)
      | 'f' -> (match fld w 8 0xf with 10 -> add "F" | 11 -> add "D" | _ -> ())
      | 'F' ->
          let unsigned = not (bit w 7) in
          (match fld w 15 0xe + fld w 8 1 with
           | 0x0 -> add (if unsigned then "WF.U" else "WF")
           | 0x1 -> add (if unsigned then "WD.U" else "WD")
           | 0x8 -> add "FW.U"
           | 0x9 -> add "DW.U"
           | 0xA -> add "FW"
           | 0xB -> add "DW"
           | 0xE -> add "FD"
           | 0xF -> add "DF"
           | _ -> ())
      | 'R' -> if not (bit w 7) then add "R"
      | 'x' ->
          (match i.rn with
           | 0 -> add "FPSID"
           | 1 -> add "FPSCR"
           | 2 -> add "FPEXC"
           | r -> add ("FPS(" ^ string_of_int r ^ ")"))
      | 'r' -> reglist i b
      | c -> add ("%" ^ String.make 1 c)
    end;
    incr k
  done

(* format: the mnemonic, a tab, the operands *)
let format t load (i : instr) b mnemonic operands =
  expand t load i b mnemonic;
  Buffer.add_char b '\t';
  expand t load i b operands

(* the printers: an instruction's fields, as its kind has them *)
let print t load (i : instr) b =
  let o = opcodes.(i.op) in
  let w = i.w in
  let fmt m a = format t load i b m a in
  let negated v = if bit w 23 then v else Int64.neg v in
  match o.fmt with
  | Dps ->
      i.store <- fld w 20 1;
      i.rn <- fld w 16 0xf;
      i.rd <- fld w 12 0xf;
      i.rs <- fld w 0 0xf;
      if i.rn = 15 && i.rs = 0 && i.op = 8 then fmt "MOVW" "CPSR, R%d"
      else if i.rn = 15 && i.rs = 0 && i.op = 10 then fmt "MOVW" "SPSR, R%d"
      else if i.rn = 9 && i.rd = 15 && i.op = 9 then fmt "MOVW" "R%s, CPSR"
      else if i.rn = 9 && i.rd = 15 && i.op = 11 then fmt "MOVW" "R%s, SPSR"
      else if i.rd = 15 && i.op = 120 then fmt "MOVW" "PSR, %x"
      else if i.rd = 15 && i.op = 121 then fmt "MOVW" "%x, PSR"
      else fmt o.o o.a
  | Dpi ->
      i.imm <- s32 (ror (Int64.logand w 0xffL) (2 * fld w 8 0xf));
      i.store <- fld w 20 1;
      i.rn <- fld w 16 0xf;
      i.rd <- fld w 12 0xf;
      i.rs <- fld w 0 0xf;
      (* RET is ADD $0,R14,R15 *)
      if masked w 0x0fffffffL 0x028ef000L then fmt "RET%C" ""
      else if masked w 0x0ff0ffffL 0x0280f000L then fmt "B%C" "0(R%n)"
      else fmt o.o o.a
  | Sdti ->
      i.imm <- s32 (negated (Int64.logand w 0xfffL));
      i.store <- fld w 23 2 lor fld w 21 1;
      i.rn <- fld w 16 0xf;
      i.rd <- fld w 12 0xf;
      (* RET is MOVW.P x(R13),R15 *)
      if masked w 0x0ffff000L 0x049df000L then fmt "RET%C%p" "%I"
      else fmt o.o o.a
  | Vstdi ->
      i.imm <- s32 (negated (Int64.shift_left (Int64.logand w 0xffL) 2));
      i.rn <- fld w 16 0xf;
      i.rd <- fld w 12 0xf;
      fmt o.o o.a
  | Hwby ->
      (* (5db's: the offset's two nibbles or'ed, not the high one
       * shifted) *)
      i.store <- fld w 23 2 lor fld w 21 1;
      i.imm <- s32 (negated (Int64.of_int (fld w 0 0xf lor fld w 8 0xf)));
      i.rn <- fld w 16 0xf;
      i.rd <- fld w 12 0xf;
      i.rs <- fld w 0 0xf;
      fmt o.o o.a
  | Sdts ->
      i.store <- fld w 23 2 lor fld w 21 1;
      i.rs <- fld w 0 0xf;
      i.rn <- fld w 16 0xf;
      i.rd <- fld w 12 0xf;
      fmt o.o o.a
  | Bdt ->
      i.store <- fld w 21 3;
      i.rn <- fld w 16 0xf;
      i.imm <- Int64.logand w 0xffffL;
      if w = 0xe8fd8000L then fmt "RFE" "" else fmt o.o o.a
  | Unk -> fmt o.o o.a
  | Branch ->
      let v = Int64.logand w 0xffffffL in
      let v = if bit v 23 then Int64.logor v 0xff000000L else v in
      i.imm <- s32 (Int64.add (Int64.shift_left v 2) (Int64.add i.addr 8L));
      fmt o.o o.a
  | Bpt ->
      i.imm <- Int64.of_int ((fld w 4 0xfff0) lor fld w 0 0xf);
      fmt o.o o.a
  | Co ->
      i.rn <- fld w 16 0xf;
      i.rd <- fld w 12 0xf;
      i.rs <- fld w 0 0xf;
      let cp = fld w 8 0xf and p = fld w 5 7 in
      let operands =
        if bit w 4 then
          Printf.sprintf "#0x%x, #0x%x, R%d, C(%d), C(%d), #0x%x"
            cp (fld w 21 7) i.rd i.rn i.rs p
        else
          Printf.sprintf "#0x%x, #0x%x, C(%d), C(%d), C(%d), #0x%x"
            cp (fld w 20 0xf) i.rd i.rn i.rs p in
      fmt o.o operands

let instruction t load pc =
  match decode load pc with
  | None -> None
  | Some i ->
      let b = Buffer.create 64 in
      print t load i b;
      Some (Buffer.contents b)

(* Following *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let r n = "R" ^ string_of_int n

(* armcondpass: whether the PSR's flags pass the condition *)
let condpass reg c =
  let psr = reg "PSR" in
  let n = bit psr 31 and z = bit psr 30 and c' = bit psr 29 and v = bit psr 28 in
  match c with
  | 1 -> not z
  | 2 -> c'
  | 3 -> not c'
  | 4 -> n
  | 5 -> not n
  | 6 -> v
  | 7 -> not v
  | 8 -> c' && not z
  | 9 -> not c' || z
  | 10 -> n = v
  | 11 -> n <> v
  | 12 -> not z && n = v
  | 13 -> z || n <> v
  | 14 -> true
  | 15 -> false
  | _ -> z

(* the carry, on top (RRX) *)
let carry reg v =
  let c = Int64.of_int (fld (reg "PSR") 29 1) in
  Int64.logor (Int64.shift_left c 31) (Int64.shift_right_logical v 1)

let sign v = if bit v 31 then 0xffffffffL else 0L
let asr32 v s = u32 (Int64.shift_right (s32 v) s)

(* armshiftval: a data processing instruction's second operand *)
let shiftval reg w =
  if bit w 25 then ror (Int64.logand w 0xffL) (fld w 7 0x1e)
  else begin
    let v = u32 (reg (r (fld w 0 0xf))) in
    let s = fld w 7 0x1f in
    let by () = Int64.to_int (Int64.logand (reg (r (s lsr 1))) 0xffL) in
    match fld w 4 7 with
    | 1 -> let s = by () in if s >= 32 then 0L else u32 (Int64.shift_left v s)
    | 2 -> Int64.shift_right_logical v s
    | 3 -> let s = by () in if s >= 32 then 0L else Int64.shift_right_logical v s
    | 4 -> if s = 0 then sign v else asr32 v s
    | 5 -> let s = by () in if s >= 32 then sign v else asr32 v s
    | 6 -> if s = 0 then carry reg v else ror v s
    | 7 ->
        let s = Int64.to_int (Int64.logand (reg (r ((s lsr 1) land 0xf))) 0xfL) in
        if s = 0 then v else ror v s
    | _ -> u32 (Int64.shift_left v s)
  end

let rec nbits v = if v = 0 then 0 else (v land 1) + nbits (v lsr 1)

(* armmaddr: a MOVM's first address (5db's count without R15) *)
let maddr reg w =
  let v = reg (r (fld w 16 0xf)) in
  let nb = Int64.of_int (4 * nbits (fld w 0 0x7fff)) in
  u32 (match fld w 23 3 with
       | 1 -> v
       | 2 -> Int64.sub v nb
       | 3 -> Int64.add v 4L
       | _ -> Int64.add (Int64.sub v nb) 4L)

(* armaddr: a load's address (its index register read as a byte, as
 * 5db's uchar) *)
let addr reg w =
  let rn = u32 (reg (r (fld w 16 0xf))) in
  let plus x = u32 (if bit w 23 then Int64.add rn x else Int64.sub rn x) in
  if not (bit w 24) then rn
  else if not (bit w 25) then plus (Int64.logand w 0xfffL)
  else begin
    let rm = Int64.logand (reg (r (fld w 0 0xf))) 0xffL in
    let s = fld w 7 0x1f in
    plus (match fld w 5 3 with
          | 0 -> u32 (Int64.shift_left rm s)
          | 1 | 2 -> Int64.shift_right_logical rm s
          | _ -> if s = 0 then carry reg rm else ror rm s)
  end

let follow load reg pc =
  match decode load pc with
  | None -> None
  | Some i ->
      let w = i.w in
      let next = Int64.add pc 4L in
      let pass () = condpass reg (fld w 28 0xf) in
      match opcodes.(i.op).foll with
      | Next -> Some next
      | Fadd ->
          if fld w 12 0xf <> 15 || not (pass ()) then Some next
          else Some (Int64.add (reg (r (fld w 16 0xf))) (shiftval reg w))
      | Fbx -> if not (pass ()) then Some next else Some (reg (r (fld w 0 0xf)))
      | Fmovm ->
          if not (bit w 15) || not (pass ()) then Some next
          else
            load (u32 (Int64.add (maddr reg w) (Int64.of_int (nbits (fld w 0 0xffff)))))
      | Fbranch ->
          if not (pass ()) then Some next
          else begin
            let off = Int64.shift_right (s32 (Int64.shift_left w 8)) 6 in
            Some (Int64.add pc (Int64.add off 8L))
          end
      | Fmov ->
          if fld w 12 0xf <> 15 || not (pass ()) then Some next
          else if fld w 26 3 = 1 then
            (match load (addr reg w) with Some v -> Some (u32 v) | None -> Some next)
          else Some (shiftval reg w)

(* The arm instructions read back (principia's debuggers/libmach/5db.c):
 * what acid's i format prints, and where the processor goes after an
 * instruction (machdata's das and foll), for step() and next().
 *
 * The syntax is Plan 9's, 5a's, the mnemonic, a tab, the operands, the
 * source first, the destination last:
 *
 *     MOVW.W   R14,#-0x4(R13)       a store, the base written back
 *     MOVW     $#0x3,R0             a constant ($), in hexadecimal (#)
 *     MOVW     R0,a+0(FP)           a parameter, by its name
 *     MOVW     $buf-SB(SB),R1       a static, from setR12's base
 *     BL       middle(SB)           a branch, to a symbol
 *     MOVM.DB.W [R0-R3,R14],(R13)   registers listed in brackets
 *
 * The condition and the flags are suffixes (.EQ, .S, .P, .W, .IA...).
 * A word is decoded as 5db does, in two steps: its class (armclass, an
 * index in a table of 128 opcodes: data processing, loads and stores,
 * multiple loads and stores, branches, coprocessors, VFP), then the
 * opcode's printer, which takes the fields its templates use (Rn, Rd,
 * the constant) and expands them (%C the condition, %I an address...).
 *
 * Its words, as acid's, Plan 9's fmt with the x verb flipped to print
 * 0x: #0x10, #-0x4(R13). 5db's oddities are kept: a halfword's offset
 * of its two nibbles or'ed, a MOVM's popped PC read at the count of
 * registers, not four times it, the register an LDR's index from a
 * byte, one address followed (the condition evaluated, not both).
 *
 * The numbers are int64s, a word in their low 32 bits: mini-acid runs
 * on arm, where an int has 31. *)

(* the symbols 5db names addresses with (libmach's buildtbls): the
 * functions sorted, each with its parameters and locals, the data's,
 * and the static base, setR12's address (acid's mach->sb, 0 without) *)
type table

(* the tables from a program's symbols, in the table's order *)
val table : Symbols.sym list -> table

(* libmach's symoff: an address as name+0x10, the name, or 0x...
 * (no symbol, or a data's 4096 bytes away); [text_only] the text's
 * symbols (CTEXT), else any (CANY: the data's after the text's last) *)
val symoff : table -> bool -> int64 -> string

(* the instruction at an address (printins): [load a] the word at a,
 * little-endian, None out of the map; None when the instruction can't
 * be read *)
val instruction : table -> (int64 -> int64 option) -> int64 -> string option

(* the address that runs after the instruction at an address (armfoll):
 * [load] reads the process's memory, [reg name] a register by 5db's
 * name (R0..R15, PSR); None when a word can't be read *)
val follow :
  (int64 -> int64 option) -> (string -> int64) -> int64 -> int64 option
