(* See Das_arm64.mli *)

let bits w lo n = Int64.to_int (Int64.logand (Int64.shift_right_logical w lo) (Int64.pred (Int64.shift_left 1L n)))

(* a field of n bits, its sign extended *)
let sbits w lo n = let v = bits w lo n in if v land (1 lsl (n - 1)) <> 0 then v - (1 lsl n) else v

let conds = [| "EQ"; "NE"; "HS"; "LO"; "MI"; "PL"; "VS"; "VC"; "HI"; "LS"; "GE"; "LT"; "GT"; "LE"; "AL"; "NV" |]

(* a condition, by the flags NZCV (the PSR's top four bits) *)
let holds cond psr =
  let f k = Int64.logand (Int64.shift_right_logical psr k) 1L = 1L in
  let n = f 31 and z = f 30 and c = f 29 and v = f 28 in
  let r = match cond lsr 1 with
    | 0 -> z | 1 -> c | 2 -> n | 3 -> v | 4 -> c && not z | 5 -> n = v | 6 -> n = v && not z | _ -> true in
  if cond land 1 = 1 && cond <> 15 then not r else r

type kind =
  | Branch of int64                       (* B, BL: always *)
  | Cond of int64 * ((string -> int64) -> bool)   (* taken when, by the registers *)
  | Indirect of int * bool                (* BR, BLR, RET: a register; a call *)
  | Other

let kind w pc =
  let off n = Int64.add pc (Int64.of_int (n * 4)) in
  if Int64.logand w 0x7c000000L = 0x14000000L then Branch (off (sbits w 0 26))
  else if Int64.logand w 0xff000010L = 0x54000000L then
    let c = bits w 0 4 in
    Cond (off (sbits w 5 19), fun reg -> holds c (reg "PSR"))
  else if Int64.logand w 0x7e000000L = 0x34000000L then
    let r = bits w 0 5 and nz = bits w 24 1 = 1 and wide = bits w 31 1 = 1 in
    Cond (off (sbits w 5 19), fun reg ->
      let v = reg (Printf.sprintf "R%d" r) in
      let v = if wide then v else Int64.logand v 0xffffffffL in
      (v <> 0L) = nz)
  else if Int64.logand w 0x7e000000L = 0x36000000L then
    let r = bits w 0 5 and nz = bits w 24 1 = 1 and b = (bits w 31 1 lsl 5) lor bits w 19 5 in
    Cond (off (sbits w 5 14), fun reg ->
      (Int64.logand (Int64.shift_right_logical (reg (Printf.sprintf "R%d" r)) b) 1L = 1L) = nz)
  else if Int64.logand w 0xff9ffc1fL = 0xd61f0000L then
    Indirect (bits w 5 5, bits w 21 2 = 1)
  else Other

let follow get reg pc =
  match get pc with
  | None -> None
  | Some w ->
      match kind w pc with
      | Branch t -> Some t
      | Cond (t, taken) -> Some (if taken reg then t else Int64.add pc 4L)
      | Indirect (r, _) -> Some (reg (Printf.sprintf "R%d" r))
      | Other -> Some (Int64.add pc 4L)

let reg n = if n = 31 then "ZR" else Printf.sprintf "R%d" n
let sp n = if n = 31 then "RSP" else Printf.sprintf "R%d" n

let instruction symoff get pc =
  match get pc with
  | None -> "?"
  | Some w ->
      let target t = symoff t in
      match kind w pc with
      | Branch t -> Printf.sprintf "%s\t%s" (if bits w 31 1 = 1 then "BL" else "B") (target t)
      | Cond (t, _) when Int64.logand w 0xff000010L = 0x54000000L -> Printf.sprintf "B%s\t%s" conds.(bits w 0 4) (target t)
      | Cond (t, _) when Int64.logand w 0x7e000000L = 0x34000000L ->
          Printf.sprintf "%s\t%s, %s" (if bits w 24 1 = 1 then "CBNZ" else "CBZ") (reg (bits w 0 5)) (target t)
      | Cond (t, _) ->
          Printf.sprintf "%s\t$%d, %s, %s" (if bits w 24 1 = 1 then "TBNZ" else "TBZ")
            ((bits w 31 1 lsl 5) lor bits w 19 5) (reg (bits w 0 5)) (target t)
      | Indirect (30, false) when bits w 21 2 = 2 -> "RET"
      | Indirect (r, call) -> Printf.sprintf "%s\t(%s)" (if call then "BL" else (if bits w 21 2 = 2 then "RET" else "B")) (reg r)
      | Other ->
          if w = 0xd503201fL then "NOP"
          else if Int64.logand w 0xffe0001fL = 0xd4200000L then Printf.sprintf "BRK\t$%d" (bits w 5 16)
          else if Int64.logand w 0xffe0001fL = 0xd4000001L then Printf.sprintf "SVC\t$%d" (bits w 5 16)
          (* LDR of a literal, a word or two from the pc *)
          else if Int64.logand w 0xbf000000L = 0x18000000L then
            Printf.sprintf "%s\t%s, %s" (if bits w 30 1 = 1 then "MOV" else "MOVW")
              (symoff (Int64.add pc (Int64.of_int (sbits w 5 19 * 4)))) (reg (bits w 0 5))
          (* ADD, SUB of a constant (64 bits): MOV to and from SP too *)
          else if Int64.logand w 0x7f800000L = 0x11000000L || Int64.logand w 0x7f800000L = 0x51000000L then begin
            let imm = bits w 10 12 lsl (if bits w 22 1 = 1 then 12 else 0) in
            let op = if bits w 30 1 = 1 then "SUB" else "ADD" in
            if imm = 0 && op = "ADD" then Printf.sprintf "MOV\t%s, %s" (sp (bits w 5 5)) (sp (bits w 0 5))
            else Printf.sprintf "%s\t$%d, %s, %s" op imm (sp (bits w 5 5)) (sp (bits w 0 5))
          end
          (* STP, LDP of two 64-bit registers: pre-index, offset, post-index *)
          else if Int64.logand w 0xfe000000L = 0xa8000000L then begin
            let mode = bits w 23 2 and load = bits w 22 1 = 1 in
            let off = sbits w 15 7 * 8 in
            let pair = Printf.sprintf "(%s, %s)" (reg (bits w 0 5)) (reg (bits w 10 5)) in
            let addr = Printf.sprintf "%d(%s)" off (sp (bits w 5 5)) in
            let suffix = match mode with 3 -> ".W" | 1 -> ".P" | _ -> "" in
            if load then Printf.sprintf "LDP%s\t%s, %s" suffix addr pair else Printf.sprintf "STP%s\t%s, %s" suffix pair addr
          end
          (* MOV Rm, Rd (ORR Rd, ZR, Rm, 64 bits) *)
          else if Int64.logand w 0xffe0ffe0L = 0xaa0003e0L then Printf.sprintf "MOV\t%s, %s" (reg (bits w 16 5)) (reg (bits w 0 5))
          (* LDR, STR of 64 and 32 bits, an unsigned offset *)
          else if Int64.logand w 0xbfc00000L = 0xb9400000L || Int64.logand w 0xbfc00000L = 0xb9000000L then begin
            let wide = bits w 30 1 = 1 and load = bits w 22 1 = 1 in
            let off = bits w 10 12 * (if wide then 8 else 4) in
            let op = if wide then "MOV" else "MOVW" in
            let addr = Printf.sprintf "%d(%s)" off (sp (bits w 5 5)) in
            if load then Printf.sprintf "%s\t%s, %s" op addr (reg (bits w 0 5)) else Printf.sprintf "%s\t%s, %s" op (reg (bits w 0 5)) addr
          end
          (* MOVZ: a constant *)
          else if Int64.logand w 0x7f800000L = 0x52800000L then
            Printf.sprintf "MOV\t$%d, %s" (bits w 5 16 lsl (16 * bits w 21 2)) (reg (bits w 0 5))
          else Printf.sprintf "WORD\t$0x%08Lx" w
debuggers/acid/Das_arm64.mli
1337
(* The arm64 instructions read back, a few (principia's libmach 7db.c
 * has them all): where the processor goes after one (machdata's foll),
 * for step() and next(), and what acid's i format prints, for a
 * program on this machine's Linux (plan_debugger.md, stage 8a).
 *
 * follow knows every instruction that changes the pc otherwise than by
 * 4: B and BL (26 bits, a word's offset), B.cond (19), CBZ and CBNZ
 * (19), TBZ and TBNZ (14), BR, BLR and RET (a register); a condition
 * evaluated by the flags (NZCV, the PSR's top bits) or the register,
 * one address, as 5db's foll. The printer knows these, NOP, BRK, SVC,
 * LDR of a literal, ADD and SUB of a constant, MOV, MOVZ, STP and LDP,
 * LDR and STR of an offset, in Plan 9's order (the source first); the
 * others are their word (WORD $0x...).
 *
 * Every instruction is a word of 32 bits, little-endian, at an address
 * a multiple of 4: decoding is masks and fields, no prefix nor length
 * (arm's too; x86's are 1 to 15 bytes). *)

(* the address after the instruction at pc (get reads a word, reg a
 * register by its name: R0..R30, PSR) *)
val follow : (int64 -> int64 option) -> (string -> int64) -> int64 -> int64 option

(* the instruction at pc, text (symoff names an address) *)
val instruction : (int64 -> string) -> (int64 -> int64 option) -> int64 -> string
debuggers/acid/Eval.ml
20741
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Eval.mli *)

open Ast

exception Error of string
exception Returned of value

let error fmt = Printf.ksprintf (fun s -> raise (Error s)) fmt

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The variables *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* a variable's binding (acid's Value): its value (None: not set), the
 * complex type complex T v gave it (the binding's: an assignment keeps
 * it, a function's own v has its own) *)
type binding = { bvalue : value option; btype : string option }

(* a name's meanings (acid's Lsym): its bindings' stack, the current
 * first, its function, its members when it names a complex type *)
type var = {
  mutable values : binding list;
  mutable defn : (param list * stmt list) option;
  mutable aggr : member list option;
}

let unset = { bvalue = None; btype = None }

let vars : (string, var) Hashtbl.t = Hashtbl.create 256
let builtins : (string, value list -> value) Hashtbl.t = Hashtbl.create 64

let var name =
  match Hashtbl.find_opt vars name with
  | Some v -> v
  | None -> let v = { values = [ unset ]; defn = None; aggr = None } in Hashtbl.replace vars name v; v

let get name =
  let x = var name in
  match x.values with { bvalue = Some v; btype } :: _ -> { v with comt = btype } | _ -> error "%s used but not set" name

let set name v =
  let x = var name in
  x.values <- (match x.values with b :: rest -> { b with bvalue = Some v } :: rest | [] -> [ { unset with bvalue = Some v } ])

(* the running functions, the innermost first: the names each pushed *)
let frames : string list ref list ref = ref []

let in_function () = !frames <> []

let push name v =
  match !frames with
  | pushed :: _ ->
      if List.mem name !pushed then error "%s declared twice" name;
      let x = var name in
      x.values <- { unset with bvalue = v } :: x.values;
      pushed := name :: !pushed
  | [] -> error "local not in function"

let pop name =
  let x = var name in
  x.values <- (match x.values with _ :: (_ :: _ as rest) -> rest | l -> l)

let reset () = frames := []

let set_global name v =
  let x = var name in
  x.values <- (match List.rev x.values with b :: older -> List.rev ({ b with bvalue = Some v } :: older) | [] -> [ { unset with bvalue = Some v } ])

let is_set name =
  match Hashtbl.find_opt vars name with Some { values = { bvalue = Some _; _ } :: _; _ } -> true | _ -> false

let complex_type name = match (var name).values with b :: _ -> b.btype | [] -> None

let aggr name = (var name).aggr

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Printing *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let out = Buffer.create 4096

(* the locals' complex types, complex T f:v's *)
let frame_types : (string * string, string) Hashtbl.t = Hashtbl.create 64

(* f:v's address and its size, Proc's (libmach's localaddr) *)
let local_addr : (string -> string -> int64 * int) ref = ref (fun _ _ -> error "colon: no process")

let load : (bool -> int64 -> int -> string) ref = ref (fun core _ _ -> (if core then error "no map for *" else error "no map for @"))
let store : (int64 -> string -> unit) ref = ref (fun _ _ -> error "no map for *")

(* without the program's symbols, an address is its number *)
let symbol = ref (fun i -> Printf.sprintf "0x%Lx" i)

let show v = Value.show ~symbol:(fun i -> !symbol i) v


let whatis = function
  | None -> Hashtbl.iter (fun name x -> if x.defn <> None then Buffer.add_string out (name ^ "\n")) vars
  | Some name ->
      let x = var name in
      let said = ref false in
      (match x.values with
       | { bvalue = Some v; btype } :: _ ->
           Buffer.add_string out (Value.type_name v ^ " variable");
           (match v.kind with Int _ | Float _ -> Buffer.add_string out (Printf.sprintf " format %c" v.fmt) | _ -> ());
           (match btype with Some t -> Buffer.add_string out (" complex " ^ t) | None -> ());
           Buffer.add_char out '\n';
           said := true
       | _ -> ());
      (match x.aggr with
       | Some ms ->
           Buffer.add_string out (Printf.sprintf "complex %s {\n" name);
           List.iter (fun m ->
             Buffer.add_string out (match m.mtype with
               | Some t when m.mfmt = 'a' -> Printf.sprintf "\t%s %d %s;\n" t m.moffset m.mname
               | Some t -> Printf.sprintf "\t'%c' %s %d %s;\n" m.mfmt t m.moffset m.mname
               | None -> Printf.sprintf "\t'%c' %d %s;\n" m.mfmt m.moffset m.mname)) ms;
           Buffer.add_string out "};\n";
           said := true
       | None -> ());
      (match x.defn with
       | Some (ps, body) ->
           Buffer.add_string out (Printf.sprintf "defn %s(%s) {\n%s}\n" name
             (String.concat "," (List.map (fun p -> if p.by_name then "*" ^ p.pname else p.pname) ps))
             (Code.stmts 1 body));
           said := true
       | None -> ());
      if Hashtbl.mem builtins name then (Buffer.add_string out "builtin function\n"; said := true);
      if not !said then Buffer.add_string out (name ^ " is undefined\n")

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The expressions *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let int fmt i = { kind = Int i; fmt; comt = None }
let truth = Value.truth

(* a rune added to a string: its UTF-8 *)
let utf8 c =
  let b = Buffer.create 4 in
  Buffer.add_utf_8_uchar b (Uchar.of_int (Int64.to_int c land 0x1fffff));
  Buffer.contents b

let rec last (c : cell) = match c.next with Some d -> last d | None -> c

(* + on lists: the right one linked at the left one's end, in place *)
let addlist a b = match a with None -> b | Some c -> (last c).next <- b; a

let to_float (v : value) = match v.kind with Int i -> Int64.to_float i | Float f -> f | _ -> 0.

let name_of_op = function
  | Mul -> "*" | Div -> "/" | Mod -> "%" | Add -> "+" | Sub -> "-" | Rsh -> ">>" | Lsh -> "<<"
  | Lt -> "<" | Gt -> ">" | Leq -> "<=" | Geq -> ">=" | Eq -> "==" | Neq -> "!="
  | Land -> "&" | Xor -> "^" | Lor -> "|"

(* (acid's words for a wrong operand: bad lhs type, bad rhs type, or
 * bad expr type for the integers' operators, and <='s) *)
let binop op (l : value) (r : value) =
  let number (v : value) = match v.kind with Int _ | Float _ -> true | _ -> false in
  let numbers = number l && number r in
  let bad () =
    match op with
    | Mod | Rsh | Lsh | Land | Xor | Lor | Leq -> error "bad expr type %s" (name_of_op op)
    | _ -> if number l then error "bad rhs type %s" (name_of_op op) else error "bad lhs type %s" (name_of_op op) in
  match op with
  | Add | Sub | Mul | Div | Mod ->
      (match op, l.kind, r.kind with
       | Add, String a, String b -> { kind = String (a ^ b); fmt = 's'; comt = None }
       | Add, String a, Int c -> { kind = String (a ^ utf8 c); fmt = 's'; comt = None }
       | Add, String _, _ -> error "bad rhs for +"
       | Add, List a, List b -> { kind = List (addlist a b); fmt = l.fmt; comt = None }
       | Add, List a, _ -> { kind = List (addlist a (Some { value = r; next = None })); fmt = l.fmt; comt = None }
       | (Div | Mod), Int _, Int 0L -> error "zero divide"
       | Div, _, Float 0. -> error "zero divide"
       | _, Int a, Int b ->
           let f = match op with Add -> Int64.add | Sub -> Int64.sub | Mul -> Int64.mul | Div -> Int64.div | _ -> Int64.rem in
           { kind = Int (f a b); fmt = l.fmt; comt = None }
       | (Add | Sub | Mul | Div), _, _ when numbers ->
           let a = to_float l and b = to_float r in
           let f = match op with Add -> a +. b | Sub -> a -. b | Mul -> a *. b | _ -> a /. b in
           { kind = Float f; fmt = l.fmt; comt = None }
       | _ -> bad ())
  | Rsh | Lsh | Land | Xor | Lor ->
      (match l.kind, r.kind with
       | Int a, Int b ->
           let v = match op with
             | Rsh -> Int64.shift_right_logical a (Int64.to_int b)
             | Lsh -> Int64.shift_left a (Int64.to_int b)
             | Land -> Int64.logand a b
             | Xor -> Int64.logxor a b
             | _ -> Int64.logor a b in
           { kind = Int v; fmt = l.fmt; comt = None }
       | _ -> bad ())
  | Eq | Neq ->
      let e = Value.equal l r in
      int 'D' (if (if op = Eq then e else not e) then 1L else 0L)
  | Lt | Gt | Leq | Geq ->
      if not numbers then bad ();
      let c = match l.kind, r.kind with Int a, Int b -> compare a b | _ -> compare (to_float l) (to_float r) in
      let b = match op with Lt -> c < 0 | Gt -> c > 0 | Leq -> c <= 0 | _ -> c >= 0 in
      int (match op with Lt | Gt -> l.fmt | _ -> 'D') (if b then 1L else 0L)

(* acid's indir: what is at an address, read as its format says (a
 * byte, a half, a word, 8 bytes, a string to its NUL, an instruction
 * as its text), little-endian; an address is 4 bytes on arm (a, A, W:
 * geta), 8 on arm64 (a, A: addr_size) *)
let addr_size = ref 4

let width = function
  | 'c' | 'C' | 'b' -> 1
  | 'x' | 'd' | 'u' | 'o' | 'q' | 'r' -> 2
  | 'a' | 'A' -> !addr_size
  | 'W' | 'B' | 'X' | 'D' | 'U' | 'O' | 'Q' -> 4
  | 'V' | 'Y' | 'Z' -> 8
  | c -> error "bad pointer format '%c' for *" c

let indir core addr fmt =
  match fmt with
  | 's' ->
      let b = Buffer.create 32 in
      let rec go a = if Buffer.length b < 511 then (let c = !load core a 1 in if c <> "\000" then (Buffer.add_string b c; go (Int64.add a 1L))) in
      go addr;
      { kind = String (if Buffer.length b = 0 then "(null)" else Buffer.contents b); fmt = 's'; comt = None }
  | 'f' | 'F' ->
      (* a float, a double (acid's 'f' and 'F') *)
      let n = if fmt = 'f' then 4 else 8 in
      let s = !load core addr n in
      let v = ref 0L in
      for i = n - 1 downto 0 do v := Int64.logor (Int64.shift_left !v 8) (Int64.of_int (Char.code s.[i])) done;
      { kind = Float (if n = 4 then Int32.float_of_bits (Int64.to_int32 !v) else Int64.float_of_bits !v); fmt; comt = None }
  | 'i' | 'I' ->
      (match !Value.das core addr with
       | Some s -> { kind = String s; fmt = 's'; comt = None }
       | None -> error "indir: can't read instruction")
  | _ ->
      let n = width fmt in
      let s = !load core addr n in
      let v = ref 0L in
      for i = n - 1 downto 0 do v := Int64.logor (Int64.shift_left !v 8) (Int64.of_int (Char.code s.[i])) done;
      { kind = Int !v; fmt; comt = None }

(* windir: a value written at an address, as many bytes as its format
 * says (a string: its bytes) *)
let windir addr (v : value) =
  match v.kind with
  | String s -> !store addr s
  | Int i ->
      let n = width v.fmt in
      !store addr (String.init n (fun k -> Char.chr (Int64.to_int (Int64.logand (Int64.shift_right_logical i (8 * k)) 0xffL))))
  | _ -> error "bad type for *"

let rec eval (e : expr) : value =
  match e with
  | Const v -> v
  | Name s -> get s
  | Bin (op, a, b) -> let l = eval a in binop op l (eval b)
  | Cand (a, b) -> int 'D' (if truth (eval a) && truth (eval b) then 1L else 0L)
  | Cor (a, b) -> int 'D' (if truth (eval a) || truth (eval b) then 1L else 0L)
  | Assign (Name s, r) -> let v = eval r in set s v; v
  | Assign (Indm a, r) ->
      let l = eval a in
      let v = eval r in
      (match l.kind with Int addr -> windir addr { v with fmt = l.fmt }; v | _ -> error "bad type for *")
  | Assign (Indc _, _) -> error "no map for @"
  | Assign _ -> error "need l-value"
  | Fmt (a, c) -> { (eval a) with fmt = c }
  | Plus a -> eval a
  | Not a -> let v = eval a in { kind = Int (if truth v then 0L else 1L); fmt = v.fmt; comt = None }
  | Preinc a -> step a 1 true
  | Predec a -> step a (-1) true
  | Postinc a -> step a 1 false
  | Postdec a -> step a (-1) false
  | Head a ->
      (match (eval a).kind with
       | List (Some c) -> c.value
       | List None -> Value.empty
       | _ -> error "head needs list")
  | Tail a ->
      (match (eval a).kind with
       | List (Some c) -> { kind = List c.next; fmt = 'X'; comt = None }
       | List None -> Value.empty
       | _ -> error "tail needs list")
  | Append (a, b) ->
      let l = eval a in
      let r = eval b in
      let cell = Some { value = r; next = None } in
      (match l.kind, a with
       | List None, Name s -> let v = { kind = List cell; fmt = l.fmt; comt = None } in set s v; v
       | List None, _ -> { kind = List cell; fmt = l.fmt; comt = None }
       | List (Some c), _ -> (last c).next <- cell; l
       | _ -> error "must append to list")
  | Delete (a, b) ->
      let l = eval a in
      let r = eval b in
      (match l.kind, r.kind with
       | List cells, Int n ->
           if n < 0L then error "negative index in delete";
           let rec drop prev (c : cell option) n =
             match c with
             | None -> error "element beyond end of list"
             | Some (c : cell) when n = 0L ->
                 (match prev with
                  | None -> { l with kind = List c.next }
                  | Some (p : cell) -> p.next <- c.next; l)
             | Some c -> drop (Some c) c.next (Int64.sub n 1L) in
           drop None cells n
       | List _, _ -> error "delete index must be integer"
       | _ -> error "must delete from list")
  | Eval a -> (match (eval a).kind with Code c -> eval c | _ -> error "bad type for eval")
  | Index (a, b) ->
      let l = eval a in
      let r = eval b in
      (match l.kind, r.kind with
       | List cells, Int n ->
           if n < 0L then error "negative index in []";
           let rec nth (c : cell option) n = match c with
             | None -> Value.empty
             | Some (c : cell) -> if n = 0L then c.value else nth c.next (Int64.sub n 1L) in
           nth cells n
       | String s, Int n ->
           int 'c' (if n >= 0L && n < Int64.of_int (String.length s) then Int64.of_int (Char.code s.[Int64.to_int n]) else 0L)
       | Int addr, Int n -> { (indir true (Int64.add addr (Int64.mul n (Int64.of_int (Value.size l.fmt)))) l.fmt) with fmt = l.fmt; comt = l.comt }
       | _, Int _ -> error "lhs[] has bad type"
       | _ -> error "bad type for []")
  | Construct es -> Value.list (List.map eval es)
  | What n -> whatis n; Value.empty
  | Call (f, args, builtin) -> call f args builtin
  | Indm a -> (match eval a with { kind = Int addr; fmt; comt } -> { (indir true addr fmt) with comt } | _ -> error "bad type for *")
  | Indc a -> (match eval a with { kind = Int addr; fmt; comt } -> { (indir false addr fmt) with comt } | _ -> error "bad type for @")
  | Cast (t, a) ->
      if (var t).aggr = None then error "%s is not a complex type" t;
      { (eval a) with comt = Some t; fmt = 'a' }
  | Dot (a, m) -> dot (eval a) m
  | Frame (f, v) ->
      (* a local's address in the innermost frame of f, typed as complex
       * f:v said (acid's Frtype) *)
      let addr, size = !local_addr f v in
      (match Hashtbl.find_opt frame_types (f, v) with
       | Some t -> { kind = Int addr; fmt = 'a'; comt = Some t }
       (* (its format its size's, what * reads: a word on arm, an int
        * or a pointer by DWARF on arm64, Plan 9's table's a word) *)
       | None -> { kind = Int addr; fmt = (match size with 1 -> 'b' | 2 -> 'x' | 8 -> 'Y' | _ -> 'X'); comt = None })

(* e.m (acid's odot): the member's address, the value's and its offset;
 * an aggregate there is its address (format a), else what is there read
 * by the member's format; the member's own complex type kept *)
and dot (v : value) m =
  let t = match v.comt with Some t -> t | None -> error "no type specified for (expr).%s" m in
  let addr = match v.kind with Int i -> i | _ -> error "pointer must be integer for (expr).%s" m in
  let ms = match (var t).aggr with Some ms -> ms | None -> [] in
  match List.find_opt (fun mb -> mb.mname = m) ms with
  | None -> error "no tag for (expr).%s" m
  | Some mb ->
      let a = Int64.add addr (Int64.of_int mb.moffset) in
      if mb.mfmt = 'a' then { kind = Int a; fmt = 'a'; comt = mb.mtype }
      else { (indir true a mb.mfmt) with comt = mb.mtype }

(* ++ and --: an integer moved by its format's size (a pointer's step),
 * a float by 1; the new value or the old *)
and step a delta pre =
  match a with
  | Name s ->
      let v = get s in
      let nv = match v.kind with
        | Int i -> { v with kind = Int (Int64.add i (Int64.of_int (delta * Value.size v.fmt))) }
        | Float f -> { v with kind = Float (f +. float_of_int delta) }
        | _ -> error "bad type for ++ or --" in
      set s nv;
      if pre then nv else v
  | _ -> error "need l-value"

and call f args builtin =
  let x = var f in
  match Hashtbl.find_opt builtins f, x.defn with
  | None, _ when builtin -> error "no builtin %s" f
  | Some b, d when builtin || d = None -> b (List.map eval args)
  | _, Some (params, body) -> apply f params args body
  | _ -> error "no function %s" f

and apply f params args body =
  let np = List.length args and nf = List.length params in
  if np < nf then error "%s: too few arguments" f;
  if np > nf then error "%s: too many arguments" f;
  let pushed = ref [] in
  frames := pushed :: !frames;
  let unwind () = List.iter pop !pushed; frames := List.tl !frames in
  match
    List.iter2 (fun (p : param) a ->
      let v = if p.by_name then { kind = Code a; fmt = 'X'; comt = None } else eval a in
      if List.mem p.pname !pushed then error "%s already declared at this scope" p.pname;
      push p.pname (Some v)) params args;
    List.iter exec body
  with
  | () -> unwind (); Value.empty
  | exception Returned v -> unwind (); v
  | exception e -> unwind (); raise e

(* print: a complex type's address by the library's pcomplex(addr,
 * "T") if it has one (ix's: by the aggr's members), else by its
 * function, if one (acid's comx: Node(addr), the one 5c -a writes),
 * else its type's name before it *)
and print vs =
  List.iter (fun (v : value) ->
    match v.comt with
    | Some t when (v.fmt = 'a' || v.fmt = 'A') && (var "pcomplex").defn <> None && (var t).aggr <> None ->
        (match (var "pcomplex").defn with
         | Some (ps, body) -> ignore (apply "pcomplex" ps [ Const v; Const (Value.string t) ] body)
         | None -> ())
    | Some t when (v.fmt = 'a' || v.fmt = 'A') && (var t).defn <> None ->
        (match (var t).defn with Some (ps, body) -> ignore (apply t ps [ Const v ] body) | None -> ())
    | Some t when v.fmt = 'a' || v.fmt = 'A' -> Buffer.add_string out ("(" ^ t ^ ")" ^ show v)
    | _ -> Buffer.add_string out (show v)) vs;
  if not (in_function ()) then Buffer.add_char out '\n'

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The statements *)
(*****************************************************************************)

and exec (s : stmt) =
  match s with
  | Expr None -> ()
  | Expr (Some ((Assign _ | Call _) as e)) -> ignore (eval e)
  | Expr (Some e) ->
      let v = eval e in
      let empty = match v.kind, e with List None, Bin (Add, _, _) -> false | List None, _ -> true | _ -> false in
      if not (in_function ()) && not empty then print [ v ]
  | Block ss -> List.iter exec ss
  | If (c, a, b) -> if truth (eval c) then exec a else (match b with Some b -> exec b | None -> ())
  | While (c, b) -> while truth (eval c) do exec b done
  | Loop (a, b, body) ->
      let s = match (eval a).kind with Int i -> i | _ -> error "loop must have integer start" in
      let e = match (eval b).kind with Int i -> i | _ -> error "loop must have integer end" in
      let i = ref s in
      while !i <= e do exec body; i := Int64.add !i 1L done
  | Return e -> if not (in_function ()) then error "return not in function" else raise (Returned (eval e))
  | Local names -> List.iter (fun n -> push n None) names
  | Complex (t, Name v) ->
      (* (acid's decl: the variable's type, its format a) *)
      if (var t).aggr = None then error "%s is not a complex type" t;
      let x = var v in
      x.values <- (match x.values with
        | b :: rest -> { bvalue = Option.map (fun (w : value) -> { w with fmt = 'a' }) b.bvalue; btype = Some t } :: rest
        | [] -> [ { unset with btype = Some t } ])
  | Complex (t, Frame (f, v)) ->
      if (var t).aggr = None then error "%s is not a complex type" t;
      Hashtbl.replace frame_types (f, v) t
  | Complex (t, _) -> if (var t).aggr = None then error "%s is not a complex type" t

let ran = ref (fun () -> ())

let call_if_defined f args =
  match (var f).defn with
  | Some (params, body) -> ignore (apply f params (List.map (fun v -> Const v) args) body)
  | None -> ()

let toplevel = function
  | Stmt s -> exec s
  | Defn (f, ps, body) -> (var f).defn <- Some (ps, body)
  | Undefn f -> (var f).defn <- None
  | Aggr (t, ms) -> (var t).aggr <- Some ms

(* acid's interpreter (principia's exec.c, expr.c, list.c): the
 * statements run, the expressions computed, as acid does.
 *
 * Its variables are dynamically scoped: a name is one variable, whose
 * value is a stack, a function's parameters and locals pushed on it at
 * the call and popped at its return, so a function sees its callers'
 * locals by their names. A parameter written *p gets its argument's
 * code (eval p runs it), the others its value, the arguments computed
 * one after the other, each after the parameters before it are bound.
 * A statement that is an expression prints its value at the top level
 * (not an assignment nor a call, not an empty list), not inside a
 * function. *)

exception Error of string

(* a builtin function: its arguments' values, its result (the empty
 * list for none) *)
val builtins : (string, Ast.value list -> Ast.value) Hashtbl.t

(* the memory (Proc's): [load core addr n], n bytes of the process
 * (core) or of the program's file (not core: @); Error when the
 * address is in no map. [store addr bytes] writes the process's *)
val load : (bool -> int64 -> int -> string) ref
val store : (int64 -> string -> unit) ref

(* the machine's address, what * reads of an a or an A: 4 bytes on
 * arm, 8 on arm64 (Proc's program sets it) *)
val addr_size : int ref

(* an address as the a format says it: a symbol and an offset *)
val symbol : (int64 -> string) ref

(* f:v's address and size, Proc's: v, a parameter or a local of f, in
 * f's innermost frame (libmach's localaddr) *)
val local_addr : (string -> string -> int64 * int) ref

(* a global variable set (the program's symbols, the registers, pid) *)
val set_global : string -> Ast.value -> unit

(* whether a variable has a value (the lexer's M.x, an ML unit's global) *)
val is_set : string -> bool

(* a variable's value, its complex type with it; Error if it has none *)
val get : string -> Ast.value

(* the complex type a variable was declared of (complex T v), if one *)
val complex_type : string -> string option

(* a complex type's members (aggr T {...}), if T is one *)
val aggr : string -> Ast.member list option

(* acid's function [name] called with [args], if it is defined (dostop's
 * stopped(pid)) *)
val call_if_defined : string -> Ast.value list -> unit

(* what is printed, until the caller writes it out *)
val out : Buffer.t

(* print's: the values printed, then a newline at the top level *)
val print : Ast.value list -> unit

(* a value as print prints it *)
val show : Ast.value -> string

(* whether a function is running (print's newline, return, local) *)
val in_function : unit -> bool

(* a top-level statement run: a statement, a definition, a complex type
 * (the parser's action: Parser.mly) *)
val toplevel : Ast.toplevel -> unit

(* what is done after each statement, not a definition (the CLI's: the
 * output written, the prompt: acid's bigstmnt's) *)
val ran : (unit -> unit) ref

(* after an error: the stacks of the functions it left (their
 * parameters and locals) popped *)
val reset : unit -> unit

(* Claude Code

(* See Frame64.mli *)

type frame = { start : int64; pc : int64; cfa : int64; ret : int64 }

type var = { vname : string; param : bool; addr : int64; size : int }

(* where a function's return is once its prologue has run (by fixed,
 * an instruction's address): in a frame record (Fp: the CFA that far
 * above R29), at 0(RSP) (Sp), or still in R30 (Link); drop: how far
 * the prologue moved the SP (the CFA less the SP) *)
type how = Fp of int64 | Sp | Link
type prologue = { fixed : int64; drop : int64; how : how }

(* SUB $n, RSP's n, if w is one *)
let sub_sp w =
  if w land 0xff8003ff <> 0xd10003ff then None
  else let n = (w lsr 10) land 0xfff in Some (if w land 0x400000 <> 0 then n lsl 12 else n)

(* STP (R29, R30), m(RSP)'s m (pre: STP.W's, the SP moved by it) *)
let stp_fp ~pre w =
  if w land 0xffc07fff <> (if pre then 0xa9807bfd else 0xa9007bfd) then None
  else let i = (w lsr 15) land 0x7f in Some (8 * (if i land 0x40 <> 0 then i - 0x80 else i))

(* ADD $m, RSP, R29's m (MOV RSP, R29 is m = 0) *)
let add_fp w = if w land 0xffc003ff = 0x910003fd then Some ((w lsr 10) land 0xfff) else None

let prologue read4 start =
  let word a = match read4 a with Some w -> Int64.to_int w land 0xffffffff | None -> 0 in
  let w0 = word start and w1 = word (Int64.add start 4L) and w2 = word (Int64.add start 8L) in
  let i64 = Int64.of_int in
  match sub_sp w0, stp_fp ~pre:true w0 with
  (* 7c's MOVD.W R30, -n(RSP) *)
  | _ when w0 land 0xffe00fff = 0xf8000ffe ->
      let imm = (w0 lsr 12) land 0x1ff in
      { fixed = start; drop = i64 (if imm land 0x100 <> 0 then 0x200 - imm else - imm); how = Sp }
  | Some n, _ when w1 = 0xf90003fe -> { fixed = Int64.add start 4L; drop = i64 n; how = Sp }
  | Some n, _ -> (
      match stp_fp ~pre:false w1, add_fp w2 with
      | Some m, Some m' when m = m' -> { fixed = Int64.add start 8L; drop = i64 n; how = Fp (i64 (n - m)) }
      | _ -> { fixed = start; drop = i64 n; how = Link })
  | None, Some m -> (
      match add_fp w1 with
      | Some m' -> { fixed = Int64.add start 4L; drop = i64 (- m); how = Fp (i64 (- m - m')) }
      | None -> { fixed = start; drop = 0L; how = Link })
  | None, None -> { fixed = start; drop = 0L; how = Link }

let walk read8 read4 fstart isstart pc sp link fp =
  let rec go pc sp fp n acc =
    match fstart pc with
    | Some start when n < 40 -> (
        let p = prologue read4 start in
        (* the frame's CFA, where it returns to, the caller's R29 *)
        let r =
          if pc <= p.fixed then
            (if n > 0 then None else Some ((if pc > start then Int64.add sp p.drop else sp), link, fp))
          else
            match p.how with
            | Fp off -> (
                match read8 (Int64.add fp 8L), read8 fp with
                | Some ret, Some fp' -> Some (Int64.add fp off, ret, fp')
                | _ -> None)
            | Sp -> Option.map (fun ret -> (Int64.add sp p.drop, ret, fp)) (read8 sp)
            | Link -> if n > 0 then None else Some (Int64.add sp p.drop, link, fp)
        in
        match r with
        | None -> List.rev acc
        | Some (cfa, ret, fp') ->
            let acc = { start; pc; cfa; ret } :: acc in
            if isstart start || ret = 0L then List.rev acc
            else go (Int64.sub ret 4L) cfa fp' (n + 1) acc)
    | _ -> List.rev acc
  in
  go pc sp fp 0 []

(* the table's entries after a function's symbol: p at CFA+8+off (7c's
 * FP, the return's slot above the frame), a at CFA-off; their sizes
 * unsaid, a word; the last written first (libmach's localsym) *)
let plan9 (autos : Symbols.sym list) cfa =
  List.rev @@ List.filter_map (fun (e : Symbols.sym) ->
    if e.name = "" || e.name.[0] = '.' then None
    else if e.typ = 'p' then Some { vname = e.name; param = true; addr = Int64.add cfa (Int64.of_int (8 + e.value)); size = 8 }
    else if e.typ = 'a' then Some { vname = e.name; param = false; addr = Int64.sub cfa (Int64.of_int e.value); size = 8 }
    else None) autos

(* DW_TAG_s and DW_AT_s *)
let t_subprogram = 0x2e and t_param = 0x05 and t_variable = 0x34 and t_block = 0x0b
let at_low_pc = 0x11 and at_frame_base = 0x40 and at_location = 0x02 and at_type = 0x49 and at_size = 0x0b

let sleb s o =
  let rec go o v sh =
    let b = Char.code s.[o] in
    let v = v lor ((b land 0x7f) lsl sh) in
    if b land 0x80 <> 0 then go (o + 1) v (sh + 7)
    else if b land 0x40 <> 0 then v lor (-1 lsl (sh + 7)) else v in
  go o 0 0

(* the entries by their offsets, kept for the program's units *)
let indexed : (Dwarf_info.die list * (int, Dwarf_info.die) Hashtbl.t) option ref = ref None

let dwarf (units : Dwarf_info.die list) start cfa =
  let idx = match !indexed with
    | Some (u, i) when u == units -> i
    | _ -> let i = Dwarf_info.index units in indexed := Some (units, i); i in
  (* a type's size, through its typedefs, const and volatile *)
  let rec size (d : Dwarf_info.die) =
    match Dwarf_info.int d at_size, Dwarf_info.ref_ d at_type with
    | Some n, _ -> n
    | None, Some r -> (match Hashtbl.find_opt idx r with Some t -> size t | None -> 8)
    | None, None -> 8 in
  let rec find (d : Dwarf_info.die) =
    if d.tag = t_subprogram && Dwarf_info.int d at_low_pc = Some start then Some d
    else List.find_map find d.children in
  match List.find_map find units with
  | Some f when Dwarf_info.attr f at_frame_base = Some (Dwarf_info.Block "\x9c") ->
      (* (a lexical block's variables the function's too) *)
      let rec vars (d : Dwarf_info.die) =
        List.concat_map (fun (c : Dwarf_info.die) ->
          if c.tag = t_block then vars c
          else
            match Dwarf_info.name c, Dwarf_info.attr c at_location with
            | Some n, Some (Dwarf_info.Block b)
              when (c.tag = t_param || c.tag = t_variable) && String.length b > 1 && b.[0] = '\x91' ->
                [ { vname = n; param = c.tag = t_param; addr = Int64.add cfa (Int64.of_int (sleb b 1)); size = size c } ]
            | _ -> []) d.children in
      vars f
  | _ -> []

(* arm64's frames for a frame's parameters and locals (plan_debugger.md,
 * stage 8a): the builtin strace's and f:v's, as Proc.walk is arm's.
 * port.acid's stk walks the frames in acid (arm64.acid's frames, by
 * each function's prologue); here the same walk says each frame's
 * base, its CFA (DWARF's Canonical Frame Address: the caller's SP at
 * the call), where both tables count a variable from:
 *
 *              | caller's frame |
 *     CFA ->   +----------------+  a parameter of 7c's at CFA+8+off
 *              | this frame     |  (Plan 9's p, the FP pseudo-register
 *              |                |  8 above), a local at CFA-off (a);
 *     SP  ->   +----------------+  gcc's at CFA+off (DW_OP_fbreg, its
 *                                  frame base DW_OP_call_frame_cfa)
 *
 * The CFA by the prologue, read in the program's file, its first
 * instructions:
 *
 *     STP.W (R29, R30), -n(RSP); MOV RSP, R29        gcc's: CFA = R29+n
 *     SUB $N, RSP; STP (R29, R30), m(RSP); ADD $m, RSP, R29
 *                                                    CFA = R29-m+N
 *     MOVD.W R30, -n(RSP)                            7c's: CFA = SP+n
 *     SUB $n, RSP; MOVD R30, 0(RSP)                  mini-ml's: SP+n
 *     SUB $n, RSP                                    gcc's leaf: SP+n
 *     (nothing)                                      a leaf: SP
 *
 * gcc's .eh_frame says the same exactly, for every instruction
 * (plan9port's dwarfcfa.c reads it); the prologue is what the acid
 * walk reads too. Not read: a frame of gcc -O2's, whose prologue
 * these are not (its frame then ends the walk). *)

type frame = {
  start : int64;            (* its function's *)
  pc : int64;
  cfa : int64;
  ret : int64;              (* where it returns to *)
}

(* the frames from the registers (pc, sp, the link R30, the frame
 * pointer R29), the innermost first, to the function isstart says
 * ends the stack: read8 an 8-byte word of the process, read4 an
 * instruction of the file, start the function around an address *)
val walk :
  (int64 -> int64 option) -> (int64 -> int64 option) -> (int64 -> int64 option) -> (int64 -> bool) ->
  int64 -> int64 -> int64 -> int64 -> frame list

(* a variable of a frame: a parameter or a local, its address and its
 * size in bytes *)
type var = { vname : string; param : bool; addr : int64; size : int }

(* a function's, by Plan 9's table: the entries after its symbol (p, a) *)
val plan9 : Symbols.sym list -> int64 -> var list

(* a function's, by DWARF: the subprogram at start (the file's address,
 * before a PIE's bias), its parameters and variables located on the
 * CFA (DW_OP_fbreg); none if its frame base is another *)
val dwarf : Dwarf_info.die list -> int -> int64 -> var list

{
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* acid's lexer (principia's lex.c): its keywords, its numbers (decimal,
 * 0x hexadecimal, 0 octal, 0b binary, a float with its . or e), 'c'
 * characters, strings with C's escapes, a format after a backslash
 * (x\D), // comments to the line's end; M.x one name, a symbol of
 * mini-ml's (not acid's). At a terminal a newline ends a
 * statement (a ;) but inside braces, so that a definition may take
 * lines; in a file it is a blank. *)

open Parser

exception Error of string

(* whether a newline ends a statement (the input is acid's terminal) *)
let interactive = ref false

(* the last name or number read, for a syntax error's message *)
let symbol = ref ""
let depth = ref 0
let line = ref 1

let keywords = [
  "do", DO; "if", IF; "then", THEN; "else", ELSE; "while", WHILE; "loop", LOOP;
  "head", HEAD; "tail", TAIL; "append", APPEND; "defn", DEFN; "return", RETURN;
  "local", LOCAL; "aggr", COMPLEX; "union", COMPLEX; "adt", COMPLEX;
  "complex", COMPLEX; "delete", DELETE; "whatis", WHAT; "eval", EVAL;
  "builtin", BUILTIN ]

let escape c =
  match c with
  | '0' -> '\000' | 'n' -> '\n' | 'r' -> '\r' | 't' -> '\t' | 'b' -> '\b'
  | 'f' -> '\012' | 'a' -> '\007' | 'v' -> '\011' | c -> c

(* strtoull's base 0: 0x, a leading 0 octal; 0b binary (acid's) *)
let integer s =
  let n = String.length s in
  if n > 2 && s.[0] = '0' && (s.[1] = 'b' || s.[1] = 'B') then Int64.of_string ("0b" ^ String.sub s 2 (n - 2))
  else if n > 2 && s.[0] = '0' && (s.[1] = 'x' || s.[1] = 'X') then Int64.of_string ("0x" ^ String.sub s 2 (n - 2))
  else if n > 1 && s.[0] = '0' then Int64.of_string ("0o" ^ String.sub s 1 (n - 1))
  else Int64.of_string s
}

let digit = ['0'-'9']
let ident = ['a'-'z' 'A'-'Z' '_' '$' '\128'-'\255'] ['a'-'z' 'A'-'Z' '0'-'9' '_' '$' '\128'-'\255']*

rule token = parse
  | [' ' '\t' '\r'] { token lexbuf }
  | "//" [^ '\n']* '\n'? | "/*" [^ '\n']* '\n'? { incr line; token lexbuf }
  | '\n' { incr line; if !interactive && !depth = 0 then SEMI else token lexbuf }
  | "0x" ['0'-'9' 'a'-'f' 'A'-'F']+ as s { symbol := s; CONST (integer s) }
  | "0b" ['0' '1']+ as s { symbol := s; CONST (integer s) }
  | (digit+ '.' digit* | '.' digit+ | digit+) (['e' 'E'] ['-' '+']? digit+) as s { symbol := s; FCONST (float_of_string s) }
  | (digit+ '.' digit* | '.' digit+) as s { symbol := s; FCONST (float_of_string s) }
  | digit+ as s { symbol := s; CONST (integer s) }
  | '\'' '\\' (_ as c) '\'' { CONST (Int64.of_int (Char.code (escape c))) }
  | '\'' (_ as c) '\'' { CONST (Int64.of_int (Char.code c)) }
  | '"' { STRING (str (Buffer.create 16) lexbuf) }
  (* an ML unit's global, M.x, one name when it is a variable (else M,
   * then .x a member) *)
  | (['A'-'Z'] ['a'-'z' 'A'-'Z' '0'-'9' '_']* as m) '.' ['a'-'z' '_'] ['a'-'z' 'A'-'Z' '0'-'9' '_']* as s
      { if Eval.is_set s then (symbol := s; ID s)
        else (lexbuf.Lexing.lex_curr_pos <- lexbuf.Lexing.lex_start_pos + String.length m; symbol := m; ID m) }
  | ident as s { symbol := s; match List.assoc_opt s keywords with Some k -> k | None -> ID s }
  | '\\' (_ as c) { if String.contains Value.formats c then FMT c else raise (Error "syntax error") }
  | "->" { INDIR } | "--" { DEC } | "++" { INC }
  | "<<" { LSH } | ">>" { RSH } | "<=" { LEQ } | ">=" { GEQ }
  | "==" { EQ } | "!=" { NEQ } | "&&" { ANDAND } | "||" { OROR }
  | '{' { incr depth; LBRACE } | '}' { decr depth; RBRACE }
  | '(' { LPAREN } | ')' { RPAREN } | '[' { LBRACK } | ']' { RBRACK }
  | ';' { SEMI } | ':' { COLON } | ',' { COMMA } | '~' { TILDE }
  | '*' { STAR } | '@' { AT } | '^' { CARET } | '%' { PERCENT }
  | '!' { BANG } | '+' { PLUS } | '-' { MINUS } | '&' { AMP } | '|' { BAR }
  | '=' { ASSIGN } | '<' { LT } | '>' { GT } | '/' { SLASH } | '.' { DOT }
  | eof { EOF }
  | _ as c { raise (Error (Printf.sprintf "syntax error near '%c'" c)) }

and str b = parse
  | '"' { Buffer.contents b }
  | '\\' (_ as c) { Buffer.add_char b (escape c); str b lexbuf }
  | '\n' { raise (Error "newline in string constant") }
  | eof { raise (Error "<eof> in string constant") }
  | _ as c { Buffer.add_char b c; str b lexbuf }

(* mini-acid, Plan 9's debugger built from a language: see CLI.mli *)

let () = Cap.main (fun caps -> Exit.exit caps (Exit.catch (fun () -> CLI.main caps (CapSys.argv caps))))

%{
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* acid's grammar (principia's dbg.y): a top-level statement run as
 * soon as it is read, by the grammar's own action (acid's bigstmnt's:
 * a parse that stopped after each would want the next token first);
 * an error in it ends the parse, and the caller starts another. Its
 * precedences as dbg.y's, a format (x\D) binding looser than the
 * operators *)

open Ast

let con i = Const { kind = Int i; fmt = 'W'; comt = None }

let name_of = function
  | Name s -> s
  | _ -> raise Parsing.Parse_error

let param_of = function
  | Name s -> { pname = s; by_name = false }
  | Indm (Name s) -> { pname = s; by_name = true }
  | _ -> raise Parsing.Parse_error
%}

%token <string> ID
%token <int64> CONST
%token <float> FCONST
%token <string> STRING
%token <char> FMT
%token IF DO THEN ELSE WHILE LOOP HEAD TAIL APPEND DEFN RETURN LOCAL
%token COMPLEX WHAT DELETE EVAL BUILTIN
%token INDIR DEC INC LSH RSH LEQ GEQ EQ NEQ ANDAND OROR
%token LBRACE RBRACE LPAREN RPAREN LBRACK RBRACK SEMI COLON COMMA TILDE
%token STAR AT CARET PERCENT BANG PLUS MINUS AMP BAR ASSIGN LT GT SLASH DOT
%token EOF

%left SEMI
%right ASSIGN
%left FMT
%left OROR
%left ANDAND
%left BAR
%left CARET
%left AMP
%left EQ NEQ
%left LT GT LEQ GEQ
%left LSH RSH
%left PLUS MINUS
%left STAR SLASH PERCENT
%right DEC INC INDIR DOT LBRACK LPAREN
%nonassoc ELSE

%start program
%type <unit> program

%%

program:
  | prog EOF { () }
  ;

prog:
  | { () }
  | prog bigstmnt { Eval.toplevel $2; (match $2 with Stmt _ -> !Eval.ran () | _ -> ()) }
  ;

bigstmnt:
  | stmnt { Stmt $1 }
  | DEFN ID LPAREN args RPAREN zsemi LBRACE slist RBRACE { Defn ($2, List.map param_of $4, List.rev $8) }
  | DEFN ID { Undefn $2 }
  | COMPLEX ID LBRACE members RBRACE SEMI { Aggr ($2, List.rev $4) }
  ;

stmnt:
  | zexpr SEMI { Expr $1 }
  | LBRACE slist RBRACE { Block (List.rev $2) }
  | IF expr THEN stmnt { If ($2, $4, None) }
  | IF expr THEN stmnt ELSE stmnt { If ($2, $4, Some $6) }
  | LOOP expr COMMA expr DO stmnt { Loop ($2, $4, $6) }
  | WHILE expr DO stmnt { While ($2, $4) }
  | RETURN expr SEMI { Return $2 }
  | LOCAL idlist { Local $2 }     /* (the last first, as acid's chain: whatis prints them so) */
  | COMPLEX ID name SEMI { Complex ($2, $3) }
  ;

slist:
  | stmnt { [ $1 ] }
  | slist stmnt { $2 :: $1 }
  ;

members:
  | member { $1 }
  | members member { $2 @ $1 }
  ;

/* (the members in reverse: members' List.rev puts them back) */
member:
  | CONST CONST ID SEMI { [ { mfmt = Char.chr (Int64.to_int $1); moffset = Int64.to_int $2; mname = $3; mtype = None } ] }
  | CONST ID CONST ID SEMI { [ { mfmt = Char.chr (Int64.to_int $1); moffset = Int64.to_int $3; mname = $4; mtype = Some $2 } ] }
  | ID CONST ID SEMI { [ { mfmt = 'a'; moffset = Int64.to_int $2; mname = $3; mtype = Some $1 } ] }
  | LBRACE members RBRACE SEMI { $2 }
  ;

expr:
  | castexpr { $1 }
  | expr STAR expr { Bin (Mul, $1, $3) }
  | expr SLASH expr { Bin (Div, $1, $3) }
  | expr PERCENT expr { Bin (Mod, $1, $3) }
  | expr PLUS expr { Bin (Add, $1, $3) }
  | expr MINUS expr { Bin (Sub, $1, $3) }
  | expr RSH expr { Bin (Rsh, $1, $3) }
  | expr LSH expr { Bin (Lsh, $1, $3) }
  | expr LT expr { Bin (Lt, $1, $3) }
  | expr GT expr { Bin (Gt, $1, $3) }
  | expr LEQ expr { Bin (Leq, $1, $3) }
  | expr GEQ expr { Bin (Geq, $1, $3) }
  | expr EQ expr { Bin (Eq, $1, $3) }
  | expr NEQ expr { Bin (Neq, $1, $3) }
  | expr AMP expr { Bin (Land, $1, $3) }
  | expr CARET expr { Bin (Xor, $1, $3) }
  | expr BAR expr { Bin (Lor, $1, $3) }
  | expr ANDAND expr { Cand ($1, $3) }
  | expr OROR expr { Cor ($1, $3) }
  | expr ASSIGN expr { Assign ($1, $3) }
  | expr FMT { Fmt ($1, $2) }
  ;

castexpr:
  | monexpr { $1 }
  | LPAREN ID RPAREN monexpr { Cast ($2, $4) }
  ;

monexpr:
  | term { $1 }
  | STAR monexpr { Indm $2 }
  | AT monexpr { Indc $2 }
  | PLUS monexpr { Plus $2 }
  | MINUS monexpr { Bin (Sub, con 0L, $2) }
  | DEC monexpr { Predec $2 }
  | INC monexpr { Preinc $2 }
  | HEAD monexpr { Head $2 }
  | TAIL monexpr { Tail $2 }
  | APPEND monexpr COMMA monexpr { Append ($2, $4) }
  | DELETE monexpr COMMA monexpr { Delete ($2, $4) }
  | BANG monexpr { Not $2 }
  | TILDE monexpr { Bin (Xor, $2, con (-1L)) }
  | EVAL monexpr { Eval $2 }
  ;

term:
  | LPAREN expr RPAREN { $2 }
  | LBRACE args RBRACE { Construct $2 }
  | term LBRACK expr RBRACK { Index ($1, $3) }
  | term DEC { Postdec $1 }
  | term DOT ID { Dot ($1, $3) }
  | term INDIR ID { Dot (Indm $1, $3) }
  | term INC { Postinc $1 }
  | name LPAREN args RPAREN { Call (name_of $1, $3, false) }
  | BUILTIN name LPAREN args RPAREN { Call (name_of $2, $4, true) }
  | name { $1 }
  | CONST { con $1 }
  | FCONST { Const { kind = Float $1; fmt = 'f'; comt = None } }
  | STRING { Const { kind = String $1; fmt = 's'; comt = None } }
  | WHAT zname { What $2 }
  ;

/* (acid's args: empty ones dropped, as flatten drops them) */
args:
  | zexpr { match $1 with Some e -> [ e ] | None -> [] }
  | args COMMA zexpr { match $3 with Some e -> $1 @ [ e ] | None -> $1 }
  ;

zexpr:
  | { None }
  | expr { Some $1 }
  ;

name:
  | ID { Name $1 }
  | ID COLON name { Frame ($1, name_of $3) }
  ;

zname:
  | { None }
  | ID { Some $1 }
  ;

zsemi:
  | { () }
  | SEMI zsemi { () }
  ;

idlist:
  | ID { [ $1 ] }
  | idlist COMMA ID { $3 :: $1 }
  ;
debuggers/acid/Proc.ml
32965
(* Claude Code
