(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* mini-doom: Doom (id Software, 1993), its renderer and its data, as a
 * program of ix's playground (docs/plans/done/plan_doom.md). A walk through
 * a level of a WAD -- Freedoom's E1M1 by default, made from Freedoom's
 * source by tools/Mkwad.ml (data/README.md) -- its walls, floors,
 * ceilings and sky textured and lit as Doom drew them, its doors and
 * lifts working, to its exit.
 *
 *   the keys: the arrows (or w, s) walk and turn; a and d step aside
 *   (Doom's , and .); shift runs; space (or e) uses (a door, a
 *   switch, a lift); control (or f) fires; 1 to 3 the weapons (1 the
 *   fist, or the chainsaw; 2 the pistol; 3 the shotgun)
 *
 *   usage: mini-doom [wad=file.wad] [map=E1M1] [scale=n] [x=X y=Y angle=A]
 *                    [nomonsters] [things=off] [ai=ways] [sound=off|3d]
 *                    [music=off] [graphics=only] [lumps]
 *     wad=   the WAD (default: /lib/doom/freedoom.wad, else
 *            games/fps/doom/data/freedoom.wad: the card's, the
 *            repository's); an IWAD of id's works the same
 *            (doom1.wad), the levels its own
 *     map=   which level (the WAD's first by default)
 *     scale= each of Doom's 320 by 200 pixels made n by n (1 to 4;
 *            2 by default); the platform's size= is then 320 n, so
 *            that it shows the picture as it is (unless size= is
 *            said). On Plan 9 by default, the picture is all of the
 *            window or screen, the largest whole n that fits (the
 *            device makes it n times larger: mini-9pi's 'z')
 *     x= y= angle=  the player put there, looking that way (degrees):
 *            a test's camera (tests/compare.sh)
 *     nomonsters  the level without its monsters (Doom's -nomonsters)
 *     things=off  the level without its things: no item, decoration
 *            nor monster drawn or moved
 *     ai=ways  the monsters find their way by the playground's AI
 *            (Ways), not id's (Enemy)
 *     sound=  off: none; 3d: the playground's Audio3d, not id's
 *            (Sound)
 *     music=  off, or on: the level's music (Audio's MIDI player); off
 *            by default on Plan 9: mini-ml's code makes a second of it
 *            in 7 (OCaml's in 0.3), the game's frames stopped meanwhile
 *     graphics=only  nomonsters things=off sound=off music=off: the
 *            renderer alone, the walls, floors and ceilings (its frames
 *            a second, the monsters' cost and the sound's apart)
 *     status=off  no status line (a test's picture: tests/compare.sh)
 *     lumps  the WAD's lumps listed, and the end
 *
 * A frame (the playground's view): Play's tics since the last frame
 * (35 a second, at most 4 a frame), then Render's picture of the
 * player's eye (between its last two tics: [eye]), 320 by 200 bytes
 * of the palette, made the platform's
 * pixels (each index its colour, n by n), one Bitmap shape; the
 * messages are the playground's words over it.
 *
 *          the keys                         the picture
 *   computer.keyboard --> Play.command --> Play.tic (x 35 a second)
 *                                              |
 *                                      the player's eye
 *                                              v
 *   Bitmap <-- the palette, n by n <-- Render.frame: 320 x 200 bytes
 *
 * This is the slow way on mini-9pi: the draw platform is given a new
 * picture at every frame (plan_doom.md, stage 6: a framebuffer).
 *
 * history:
 * id's game ran on DOS, then on NeXTSTEP (where it was written), Linux
 * (linuxdoom, whose source id gave in 1997), and everywhere since;
 * 9front's doom9 is linuxdoom with a draw device for its window: what
 * this does on mini-9pi. *)

module P = Playground

type model = {
  mutable play : World.t;
  (* the level again, from its start (the player dead, use pressed) *)
  restart : unit -> World.t;
  sound : Sound.t option;
  status : bool; (* the status line shown *)
  (* the palette reddened by the pain, 1 to 8 (id's PLAYPAL's 1 to 8),
   * or gilded by an item, 9 to 12: each made once, the same value
   * then *)
  palettes : string array;
  sprites : Things.sprites;
  render : Render.t;
  (* two pictures' bytes, one a frame in turn: the platform compares a
   * frame's shapes with the last's (Redraw), which must not be the same
   * bytes changed; and each frame's picture a new value over them
   * ([view]) *)
  screens : Bytes.t array;
  mutable frames : int;
  mutable last : float; (* the time of the last frame *)
  mutable pending : float; (* the time not yet made tics *)
  (* use pressed since the last tic: a frame's press between two tics
   * (60 frames a second, 35 tics) is not lost *)
  mutable use_pressed : bool;
  (* the eye at the tic before the last (x, y, z, angle): a frame shows
   * it between that tic and the last *)
  mutable before : float * float * float * float;
}

(* Doom's picture as it is, 320 by 200 bytes of the palette, given to
 * the platform (a Pixels shape), which makes of it what its device
 * wants: the screen's format on Plan 9, RGBA elsewhere, each pixel n by
 * n (docs/plans/done/plan_playground_framebuffer.md, F2).
 * old: made RGBA here, each pixel n by n (to_rgba), 30% of a frame on
 * the Pi 2 by mini-ml's code; the draw platform then made it again in
 * the screen's format *)
let snapshot (m : model) : unit =
  let src = Render.screen m.render in
  Bytes.blit src 0 m.screens.(m.frames land 1) 0 (Bytes.length src)

let tics_a_second = 35.

(* The eye drawn between its last two tics, as far as the time since
 * the last says: 35 tics at 60 frames a second, a frame that showed
 * the last tic's eye showed it again or moved by one, and the walk
 * went by jerks (the author, 2026-10-22: "this machine is 100x faster
 * than a 486Dx66 from 1995 where doom was running smoothly"; id's
 * game drew at most a frame a tic, and the ports since draw this way,
 * the picture a tic late). A move longer than a tic's run (a
 * teleporter) is not drawn on its way. *)
let eye (m : model) : float * float * float * float =
  let p = m.play.player and x, y, z, angle = m.before in
  let f = Float.min 1. (m.pending *. tics_a_second) in
  let between (a : float) (b : float) : float = a +. (f *. (b -. a)) in
  if Float.abs (p.x -. x) +. Float.abs (p.y -. y) > 64. then (p.x, p.y, p.viewz, p.angle)
  else (between x p.x, between y p.y, between z p.viewz, between angle p.angle)

(* ST_doPaletteStuff: red the more it hurt, gold a moment for an item *)
let palette (m : model) : string =
  let p = m.play.player in
  let red = (p.damagecount + 7) lsr 3 and gold = (p.bonuscount + 7) lsr 3 in
  if red > 0 then m.palettes.(min 8 red)
  else if gold > 0 then m.palettes.(8 + min 4 gold)
  else m.palettes.(0)

(* the palettes of [palette]: towards red by an ninth a step, towards
 * gold by an eighth (as Freedoom's playpal script makes PLAYPAL's) *)
let palettes (base : string) : string array =
  let tint ((r, g, b) : int * int * int) (k : float) : string =
    String.init 768 (fun (i : int) ->
        let c = Char.code base.[i] in
        let to_ = match i mod 3 with 0 -> r | 1 -> g | _ -> b in
        Char.chr (c + int_of_float (k *. float (to_ - c)))) in
  Array.init 13 (fun (i : int) ->
      if i = 0 then base
      else if i <= 8 then tint (255, 0, 0) (float i /. 9.)
      else tint (215, 186, 69) (float (i - 8) /. 8.))

(* the status bar's numbers, as words (no STBAR here) *)
let status (m : model) : string =
  let p = m.play.player in
  let ammo =
    match (Info.weaponinfo p.readyweapon).ammo with
    | Some Info.Clip -> string_of_int p.clips
    | Some Info.Shell -> string_of_int p.shells
    | None -> "-" in
  Printf.sprintf "HEALTH %d%%  ARMOR %d%%  AMMO %s  KILLS %d" p.health p.armor
    ammo m.play.kills

let view (computer : P.computer) (m : model) : P.shape list =
  let x, y, z, angle = eye m in
  let p = m.play.player in
  Render.set_extralight m.render p.extralight;
  Render.frame m.render m.play.level m.play.textures m.sprites m.play.by_sector m.play.tic x y z angle;
  (* R_DrawPlayerSprites: the weapon, then its flash *)
  let hand =
    List.filter_map
      (fun (sp : World.psprite) ->
        Option.map (fun (st : Info.state) -> (st, sp.sx, sp.sy)) sp.pstate)
      [ p.weapon_sp; p.flash_sp ] in
  let light = (Level.sector_at m.play.level p.x p.y).light in
  Render.hand m.render m.play.textures m.sprites light hand;
  m.frames <- m.frames + 1;
  snapshot m;
  let screen = computer.screen in
  (* (as many units as the platform has pixels: the window's, or the
   * square's at size=320n) *)
  let w = Float.min screen.width (screen.height *. float (Render.width m.render) /. float (Render.height m.render)) in
  let h = w *. float (Render.height m.render) /. float (Render.width m.render) in
  let text (s : string) (y : float) : P.shape = P.words P.white s |> P.scale 2. |> P.move 0. y in
  (* (a grey around the picture, where the screen is a square: the
   * Plan 9 platforms'; not black, where the platform's counter of
   * frames, in black, would not be seen. A window of the picture's
   * size has none, its pixels then the picture's only) *)
  (if h < screen.height || w < screen.width then [ P.rectangle (P.rgb 96 96 96) screen.width screen.height ] else [])
  (* (a new picture each frame, though its bytes are one of two: the
   * draw platform keeps the device's image of a picture it has shown,
   * found by the value itself (==), and a picture changed in place was
   * shown as it was the first time: on mini-9pi the eye never moved,
   * the author: "I see 15fps but I can't do anything") *)
  @ [ P.pixels w h
        { pwidth = Render.width m.render; pheight = Render.height m.render; indices = m.screens.(m.frames land 1);
          palette = palette m } ]
  @ (if m.status then [ text (status m) (20. -. (h /. 2.)) ] else [])
  @ (if m.play.message_tics > 0 then [ text m.play.message (h /. 2. -. 20.) ] else [])
  @ (if p.health <= 0 then [ text "Press use to play again." 0. ] else [])
  @
  if m.play.exited then
    [ text (Printf.sprintf "%s finished: %d of %d secrets" m.play.level.name m.play.secrets (Play.secrets_total m.play)) 0. ]
  else []

let update (computer : P.computer) (m : model) : model =
  let (P.Time now) = computer.time in
  (* (the first frame, or a clock that jumped: no time to catch up) *)
  if m.last = 0. || now -. m.last > 0.5 then m.last <- now;
  m.pending <- Float.min (4. /. tics_a_second) (m.pending +. (now -. m.last));
  m.last <- now;
  let k = computer.keyboard in
  let held (name : string) : bool = Set_.mem name k.keys in
  if k.kspace || held "e" then m.use_pressed <- true;
  let number =
    match List.find_opt held [ "1"; "2"; "3" ] with
    | Some n -> int_of_string n
    | None -> 0 in
  while m.pending >= 1. /. tics_a_second do
    m.pending <- m.pending -. (1. /. tics_a_second);
    let p = m.play.player in
    m.before <- (p.x, p.y, p.viewz, p.angle);
    if not m.play.exited then
      Play.tic m.play
        (Play.command m.play.player
           { up = k.kup || k.kw; down = k.kdown || k.ks; left = k.kleft; right = k.kright; run = k.kshift;
             strafe_left = k.ka || held ","; strafe_right = k.kd || held ".";
             use_key = m.use_pressed;
             fire = held "Control" || held "f"; number });
    m.use_pressed <- k.kspace || held "e";
    if m.play.reborn then begin
      m.play <- m.restart ();
      let p = m.play.player in
      m.before <- (p.x, p.y, p.viewz, p.angle)
    end
  done;
  (* the tics' sounds, from where they were made *)
  (match m.sound with Some s -> Sound.play s m.play | None -> m.play.sounds <- []);
  m

let default_wads = [ "/lib/doom/freedoom.wad"; "games/fps/doom/data/freedoom.wad" ]

let () =
  Cap.main (fun caps ->
      Exit.exit caps @@ Exit.catch @@ fun () ->
      (try
         let flags = Playground_platform.flags caps in
         (* graphics=only: the renderer alone, as the game was before its
          * things, monsters and sound: a frame rate of the drawing only *)
         let flags =
           if List.assoc_opt "graphics" flags = Some "only" then
             [ ("nomonsters", ""); ("things", "off"); ("sound", "off");
               ("music", "off") ]
             @ flags
           else flags
         in
         let flag (name : string) : string option = List.assoc_opt name flags in
         let path =
           match flag "wad" with
           | Some f -> f
           | None -> (
               match List.find_opt (fun (f : string) -> Sys.file_exists f) default_wads with
               | Some f -> f
               | None -> failwith "no WAD: wad=file.wad")
         in
         let wad = Wad.parse (FS.read caps (Fpath.v path)) in
         if flag "lumps" <> None then
           Array.iter
             (fun (l : Wad.lump) -> Console.print caps (Printf.sprintf "%-8s %d\n" l.name (String.length l.data)))
             wad.lumps
         else begin
           let textures = Textures.load wad in
           (* (texture 0 is no texture, as in Doom: R_TextureNumForName's
            * "-" and the first of TEXTURE1 the same) *)
           let texture (name : string) : int = let k = Textures.texture textures name in if k = 0 then -1 else k in
           let map = match flag "map" with Some m -> String.uppercase_ascii m | None -> (match Level.maps wad with m :: _ -> m | [] -> failwith "no level in the WAD") in
           let level () : Level.t =
             Level.load wad map texture (Textures.flat textures) in
           (* (None: the window's size, the platform's whole multiple) *)
           let scale = match Option.bind (flag "scale") int_of_string_opt with Some n when n >= 1 && n <= 4 -> Some n | _ -> if Sys.os_type = "Plan9" then None else Some 2 in
           let render = Render.create 320 200 in
           let palette =
             String.init 768 (fun (k : int) -> Char.chr ((textures.palette.(k / 3) lsr (8 * (2 - (k mod 3)))) land 255))
           in
           let ai = if flag "ai" = Some "ways" then World.Ways else World.Id in
           let start () : World.t =
             Play.create (level ()) textures (flag "nomonsters" = None) ai in
           let play = start () in
           (* (things=off: none drawn, a test's: tests/compare.sh) *)
           if flag "things" = Some "off" then List.iter (fun (m : Things.mobj) -> m.alive <- false) play.things;
           (* (x=, y=, angle=: the player put there, a test's camera) *)
           (match (Option.bind (flag "x") float_of_string_opt, Option.bind (flag "y") float_of_string_opt) with
           | Some x, Some y ->
               let a = match Option.bind (flag "angle") float_of_string_opt with Some a -> a | None -> 0. in
               Play.place play x y (a *. 4. *. atan 1. /. 180.)
           | _ -> ());
           let sound =
             if flag "sound" = Some "off" then None
             else Some (Sound.create wad (flag "sound" = Some "3d")) in
           let music =
             match flag "music" with
             | Some m -> m = "on"
             | None -> Sys.os_type <> "Plan9" in
           if music && sound <> None then Sound.music wad map;
           let model = {
               play; restart = start; sound; status = flag "status" <> Some "off";
               palettes = palettes palette; sprites = Things.load wad; render; screens = [| Bytes.create (320 * 200); Bytes.create (320 * 200) |]; frames = 0; last = 0.; pending = 0.; use_pressed = false;
               before = (play.player.x, play.player.y, play.player.viewz, play.player.angle) } in
           (* the window the picture's size, a unit a pixel
            * (Session.window); the software platform's square of 320 n
            * (it has no window=). No scale: the window, whatever its
            * size, and the software platform's square of 320 *)
           let flags =
             match (flag "window", scale) with
             | Some _, _ -> flags
             | None, Some n -> ("window", Printf.sprintf "%dx%d" (320 * n) (200 * n)) :: flags
             | None, None -> ("window", "") :: flags in
           let side = match scale with Some n -> 320 * n | None -> 320 in
           let flags = if flag "size" = None then ("size", string_of_int side) :: flags else flags in
           (* heap=modest: a WAD's megabytes are alive the whole game, and a
            * game's heap of eight times what is alive (Plan9_loop) does
            * not fit in mini-9pi's memory *)
           Playground_platform.run_app caps (("heap", "modest") :: flags) (P.game view update model)
         end
       with Failure msg ->
         Console.eprint caps ("mini-doom: " ^ msg ^ "\n");
         CapStdlib.exit caps 1);
      Exit.OK)
games/fps/doom/actors/Enemy.ml

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Enemy.mli *)

open World

let meleerange = 64.
let missilerange = 32. *. 64.

(* (a target that is shootable still) *)
let alive (t : t) (who : Things.target) : bool =
  match who with
  | Things.Nobody -> false
  | Things.The_player -> t.player.health > 0
  | Things.Thing m -> m.alive && m.flags land Info.shootable <> 0

let sees (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) (who : Things.target) : bool =
  let h = Things.height m in
  let x, y, z, th = Inter.where t who in
  Collision.check_sight t m.mx m.my (m.mz +. h -. (h /. 4.)) x y z th

let info (m : Things.mobj) : Info.mobjinfo =
  match m.actor with Some i -> i | None -> failwith "Enemy: not an actor"

let angle_to (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) (who : Things.target) : float =
  let x, y, _, _ = Inter.where t who in
  Float.atan2 (y -. m.my) (x -. m.mx)

let distance_to (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) (who : Things.target) : float =
  let x, y, _, _ = Inter.where t who in
  approx_distance (x -. m.mx) (y -. m.my)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Hearing *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* P_RecursiveSound: a sector, then its neighbours through the open
 * two-sided lines, a sound-blocking one (ML_SOUNDBLOCK, 64) crossed
 * once; [blocks] how many it crossed to get there *)
let noise_alert (t : t) : unit =
  let traversed = Array.make (Array.length t.level.sectors) (-1) in
  let rec flood (s : Level.sector) (blocks : int) : unit =
    if traversed.(s.index) < 0 || traversed.(s.index) > blocks + 1 then begin
      traversed.(s.index) <- blocks + 1;
      t.heard.(s.index) <- true;
      List.iter
        (fun (k : int) ->
          let l = t.level.lines.(k) in
          match
            ( Collision.opening t l,
              Level.line_sector t.level l 0,
              Level.line_sector t.level l 1 )
          with
          | Some (ob, ot), Some f, Some b when ot > ob ->
              let other = if f == s then b else f in
              if l.flags land 64 <> 0 then (if blocks = 0 then flood other 1)
              else flood other blocks
          | _ -> ())
        s.lines
    end
  in
  flood (Level.sector_at t.level t.player.x t.player.y) 0

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Moving *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the eight directions (dirtype_t): east, north-east, ... south-east;
 * 8 none. A diagonal's step is 47000/65536 of a straight one *)
let nodir = 8
let xspeed = [| 1.; 0.7172; 0.; -0.7172; -1.; -0.7172; 0.; 0.7172 |]
let yspeed = [| 0.; 0.7172; 1.; 0.7172; 0.; -0.7172; -1.; -0.7172 |]
let opposite (d : int) : int = if d = nodir then nodir else (d + 4) mod 8

(* P_Move: a step of its speed its way; blocked by a door, the door
 * opened (a monster opens the doors anyone can, DR's special 1, not a
 * secret one: ML_SECRET, 32) *)
let move (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) : bool =
  if m.movedir = nodir then false
  else begin
    let speed = (info m).speed in
    let x = m.mx +. (speed *. xspeed.(m.movedir))
    and y = m.my +. (speed *. yspeed.(m.movedir)) in
    let ok, pos = Collision.try_move_thing t m x y in
    if ok then begin
      m.mz <- m.floorz;
      true
    end
    else begin
      m.movedir <- nodir;
      let doors =
        List.filter
          (fun (l : Level.line) -> l.special = 1 && l.flags land 32 = 0)
          pos.special_lines
      in
      List.iter (fun (l : Level.line) -> Specials.line_special t l true) doors;
      doors <> []
    end
  end

(* P_TryWalk *)
let try_walk (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) : bool =
  if move t m then begin
    m.movecount <- Info.p_random () land 15;
    true
  end
  else false

(* P_NewChaseDir *)
let new_chase_dir (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) : unit =
  let olddir = m.movedir in
  let turnaround = opposite olddir in
  let tx, ty, _, _ = Inter.where t m.target in
  let dx = tx -. m.mx and dy = ty -. m.my in
  let d1 = if dx > 10. then 0 else if dx < -10. then 4 else nodir in
  let d2 = if dy < -10. then 6 else if dy > 10. then 2 else nodir in
  let walk (d : int) : bool =
    m.movedir <- d;
    try_walk t m
  in
  (* (the diagonal: north-west, north-east, south-west, south-east) *)
  let diags = [| 3; 1; 5; 7 |] in
  let diag =
    diags.(((if dy < 0. then 1 else 0) lsl 1) + if dx > 0. then 1 else 0)
  in
  if d1 <> nodir && d2 <> nodir && diag <> turnaround && walk diag then ()
  else begin
    let d1, d2 =
      if Info.p_random () > 200 || Float.abs dy > Float.abs dx then (d2, d1)
      else (d1, d2)
    in
    let d1 = if d1 = turnaround then nodir else d1
    and d2 = if d2 = turnaround then nodir else d2 in
    if d1 <> nodir && walk d1 then ()
    else if d2 <> nodir && walk d2 then ()
    else if olddir <> nodir && walk olddir then ()
    else begin
      let order =
        if Info.p_random () land 1 = 1 then [ 0; 1; 2; 3; 4; 5; 6; 7 ]
        else [ 7; 6; 5; 4; 3; 2; 1; 0 ]
      in
      if List.exists (fun (d : int) -> d <> turnaround && walk d) order then ()
      else if turnaround <> nodir && walk turnaround then ()
      else m.movedir <- nodir
    end
  end

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Looking, chasing *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* P_LookForPlayers: the player, seen; [allaround] or in front *)
let look_for_player (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) (allaround : bool) : bool =
  if t.player.health <= 0 || not (sees t m Things.The_player) then false
  else begin
    let a = View.norm (angle_to t m Things.The_player -. m.mangle) in
    let behind = a > pi /. 2. && a < 3. *. pi /. 2. in
    if
      (not allaround) && behind
      && distance_to t m Things.The_player > meleerange
    then false
    else begin
      m.target <- Things.The_player;
      true
    end
  end

let look (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) : unit =
  let i = info m in
  m.threshold <- 0;
  let heard = t.heard.(m.sector.index) && t.player.health > 0 in
  let woke =
    if heard && (m.flags land Info.ambush = 0 || sees t m Things.The_player)
    then begin
      m.target <- Things.The_player;
      true
    end
    else look_for_player t m false
  in
  if woke then begin
    let sound =
      match i.seesound with
      | "posit1" | "posit2" | "posit3" ->
          Printf.sprintf "posit%d" (1 + (Info.p_random () mod 3))
      | "bgsit1" | "bgsit2" ->
          Printf.sprintf "bgsit%d" (1 + (Info.p_random () mod 2))
      | s -> s
    in
    start_sound t (Some (m.mx, m.my)) sound;
    ignore (Mobj.set_state t m i.seestate)
  end

(* P_CheckMeleeRange *)
let check_melee_range (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) : bool =
  let r =
    match m.target with Things.Thing o -> Things.radius o | _ -> radius
  in
  alive t m.target
  && distance_to t m m.target < meleerange -. 20. +. r
  && sees t m m.target

(* P_CheckMissileRange: the further, the less likely *)
let check_missile_range (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) : bool =
  if not (sees t m m.target) then false
  else if m.flags land Info.justhit <> 0 then begin
    m.flags <- m.flags land lnot Info.justhit;
    true
  end
  else if m.reactiontime > 0 then false
  else begin
    let d = distance_to t m m.target -. 64. in
    let d = if (info m).meleestate = "" then d -. 128. else d in
    let d = Float.min 200. d in
    not (float (Info.p_random ()) < d)
  end

(* the way the monster turns to face its direction, an eighth of a turn a
 * chase (A_Chase's angle snapped to the eighths) *)
let turn (m : Things.mobj) : unit =
  if m.movedir < 8 then begin
    let eighth = pi /. 4. in
    let a = Float.floor (View.norm m.mangle /. eighth) *. eighth in
    let d = View.norm (a -. (float m.movedir *. eighth)) in
    let d = if d > pi then d -. (2. *. pi) else d in
    m.mangle <-
      (if d > 0.001 then a -. eighth else if d < -0.001 then a +. eighth else a)
  end

let chase (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) : unit =
  let i = info m in
  if m.reactiontime > 0 then m.reactiontime <- m.reactiontime - 1;
  if m.threshold > 0 then
    if not (alive t m.target) then m.threshold <- 0
    else m.threshold <- m.threshold - 1;
  turn m;
  if not (alive t m.target) then begin
    if not (look_for_player t m true) then
      ignore (Mobj.set_state t m i.spawnstate)
  end
  else if m.flags land Info.justattacked <> 0 then begin
    m.flags <- m.flags land lnot Info.justattacked;
    new_chase_dir t m
  end
  else if i.meleestate <> "" && check_melee_range t m then begin
    start_sound t (Some (m.mx, m.my)) i.attacksound;
    ignore (Mobj.set_state t m i.meleestate)
  end
  else if i.missilestate <> "" && m.movecount = 0 && check_missile_range t m
  then begin
    ignore (Mobj.set_state t m i.missilestate);
    m.flags <- m.flags lor Info.justattacked
  end
  else begin
    (* (the playground's way, for a monster that does not see the
     * player: Ways) *)
    let way =
      if t.ai = Ways && m.target = Things.The_player then begin
        if sees t m m.target then begin
          m.seen_for <- m.seen_for + m.stics;
          None
        end
        else begin
          m.seen_for <- 0;
          Ways.direction t m
        end
      end
      else None
    in
    match way with
    | Some d ->
        m.movedir <- d;
        if not (move t m) then new_chase_dir t m
    | None ->
        m.movecount <- m.movecount - 1;
        if m.movecount < 0 || not (move t m) then new_chase_dir t m
  end;
  if m.alive && i.activesound <> "" && Info.p_random () < 3 then
    start_sound t (Some (m.mx, m.my)) i.activesound

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Attacks *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let face_target (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) : unit =
  if m.target <> Things.Nobody then begin
    m.flags <- m.flags land lnot Info.ambush;
    m.mangle <- angle_to t m m.target
  end

(* a bullet's spread: id's P_Random2 () << 20, at most a 22nd of a turn
 * either way; the playground's aim error with ai=ways *)
let spread (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) : float =
  if t.ai = Ways then Ways.aim_error m
  else float (Info.p_random2 ()) *. 2. *. pi /. 4096.

(* the middle of a thing, where it shoots from (id's shootz: half up and
 * 8 above) *)
let shootz (m : Things.mobj) : float = m.mz +. (Things.height m /. 2.) +. 8.

let bullets (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) (n : int) (sound : string) : unit =
  if m.target <> Things.Nobody then begin
    face_target t m;
    let slope, _ =
      Inter.aim t (Things.Thing m) m.mx m.my (shootz m) m.mangle missilerange
    in
    start_sound t (Some (m.mx, m.my)) sound;
    for _i = 1 to n do
      let a = m.mangle +. spread t m in
      let damage = ((Info.p_random () mod 5) + 1) * 3 in
      Inter.line_attack t (Things.Thing m) m.mx m.my (shootz m) a missilerange
        slope damage
    done
  end

(* P_SpawnMissile: from 32 up, at the target, its speed, rising or
 * falling to it; moved half a step at once, and exploding there if it
 * cannot (P_CheckMissileSpawn) *)
let spawn_missile (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) (i : Info.mobjinfo) : unit =
  let mo = Mobj.spawn t i m.mx m.my (m.mz +. 32.) in
  start_sound t (Some (m.mx, m.my)) i.seesound;
  mo.target <- Things.Thing m;
  let a = angle_to t m m.target in
  mo.mangle <- a;
  mo.momx <- i.speed *. View.fcos a;
  mo.momy <- i.speed *. View.fsin a;
  let _, _, tz, _ = Inter.where t m.target in
  let dist = Float.max 1. (distance_to t m m.target /. i.speed) in
  mo.momz <- (tz -. m.mz) /. dist;
  mo.stics <- max 1 (mo.stics - (Info.p_random () land 3));
  let ok, _ =
    Collision.try_move_thing t mo
      (mo.mx +. (mo.momx /. 2.))
      (mo.my +. (mo.momy /. 2.))
  in
  if not ok then Mobj.explode_missile t mo

let act (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) (a : Info.action) : unit =
  match a with
  | Info.Look -> look t m
  | Info.Chase -> chase t m
  | Info.Face_target -> face_target t m
  | Info.Pos_attack -> bullets t m 1 "pistol"
  | Info.SPos_attack -> bullets t m 3 "shotgn"
  | Info.Troop_attack ->
      if m.target <> Things.Nobody then begin
        face_target t m;
        if check_melee_range t m then begin
          start_sound t (Some (m.mx, m.my)) "claw";
          Inter.damage t m.target (m.mx, m.my) (Things.Thing m)
            (((Info.p_random () mod 8) + 1) * 3)
        end
        else spawn_missile t m Info.troopshot
      end
  | Info.Sarg_attack ->
      if m.target <> Things.Nobody then begin
        face_target t m;
        if check_melee_range t m then
          Inter.damage t m.target (m.mx, m.my) (Things.Thing m)
            (((Info.p_random () mod 10) + 1) * 4)
      end
  | Info.Pain -> start_sound t (Some (m.mx, m.my)) (info m).painsound
  | Info.Scream ->
      let sound =
        match (info m).deathsound with
        | "podth1" | "podth2" | "podth3" ->
            Printf.sprintf "podth%d" (1 + (Info.p_random () mod 3))
        | "bgdth1" | "bgdth2" ->
            Printf.sprintf "bgdth%d" (1 + (Info.p_random () mod 2))
        | s -> s
      in
      start_sound t (Some (m.mx, m.my)) sound
  | Info.XScream -> start_sound t (Some (m.mx, m.my)) "slop"
  | Info.Fall -> m.flags <- m.flags land lnot Info.solid
  | Info.Explode -> Inter.radius_attack t m m.target 128
  | _ -> ()

let () = Mobj.act := act
games/fps/doom/actors/Enemy.mli
1932
(* Enemy: what the monsters do (Doom's p_enemy.c): wait, wake up, chase,
 * attack, flinch, die -- the actions of their states (Info).
 *
 * A monster stands in its spawn states, looking (A_Look) every 10
 * tics: it wakes when it sees the player in front of it (P_CheckSight,
 * the eighth of a turn behind it blind but within 64), or when the
 * player's shot was heard in its sector (P_NoiseAlert: the sound
 * flooded through the open lines from the player's sector, across one
 * sound-blocking line at most). Awake, it chases (A_Chase), each 2 to 4
 * tics:
 *
 *   in melee range (an imp's claws, a demon's bite)? the melee states
 *   moved since its last shot, and the dice say so (the further, the
 *     less likely: P_CheckMissileRange)? the missile states
 *   else a step of its speed in its direction (P_Move); blocked, or
 *     its steps counted down: a new direction (P_NewChaseDir)
 *
 * id's way is to go as the crow flies: the diagonal towards the player
 * first, then the axis of the larger distance, then the other, the old
 * direction, any, and back last. A monster behind a wall slides along
 * it or turns back; it never finds the door. With ai=ways (World.Ways)
 * the playground's AI (Ways, over Ai.flow) gives a monster that cannot
 * see the player its way through the level instead, and its aim error
 * (Ai.aim_error: off when it first sees, better as it keeps seeing),
 * where id's is the same spread throughout.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-doom: it fills Mobj.act; Play wakes the
 * monsters when the player shoots ([noise_alert]). *)

(* [noise_alert t]: P_NoiseAlert: the player's shot heard from its
 * sector *)
val noise_alert : World.t -> unit

(* [act t m action]: a state's action (Mobj.act's) *)
val act : World.t -> Things.mobj -> Info.action -> unit

(* P_CheckSight from a thing to a target: its eye, three quarters up *)
val sees : World.t -> Things.mobj -> Things.target -> bool

type action =
  | Nothing
  | Look
  | Chase
  | Face_target
  | Pos_attack
  | SPos_attack
  | Troop_attack
  | Sarg_attack
  | Pain
  | Scream
  | XScream
  | Fall
  | Explode
  | Weapon_ready
  | Lower
  | Raise
  | Punch
  | Fire_pistol
  | Fire_shotgun
  | Saw
  | Refire
  | Light0
  | Light1
  | Light2

type state = {
  sname : string;
  sprite : string;
  frame : int;
  bright : bool;
  tics : int;
  action : action;
  next : string;
}

 * {A_Look},S_POSS_STND2} is s "POSS_STND" "POSS" "A" 10 Look

let states : (string, state) Hashtbl.t =
  let h = Hashtbl.create 256 in
  List.iter (fun (st : state) -> Hashtbl.replace h st.sname st) table;
  h

let state (name : string) : state option =
  if name = "" then None else Hashtbl.find_opt states name

let p_random () : int =
  prndindex := (!prndindex + 1) land 255;
  rndtable.(!prndindex)

  let a = p_random () in
  a - p_random ()
games/fps/doom/actors/Info.mli

(* Info: what each thing that acts is, as tables (Doom's info.c,
 * d_items.c, sounds.c): the states its pictures go through, its
 * numbers (health, speed, the sounds it makes), the player's weapons.
 *
 * A state is a picture shown for some tics, an action done when it
 * starts, and the state after it: a monster's whole life is a few
 * loops of states, the actions doing the thinking (A_Look, A_Chase:
 * Enemy) and the attacking.
 *
 *   POSS_STND (A, 10 tics, Look) <-> POSS_STND2 (B, 10, Look)
 *        | Look sees the player: the seestate
 *        v
 *   POSS_RUN1 .. RUN8 (A A B B C C D D, 4 tics each, Chase) -- a loop
 *        | Chase: in range, and lucky       | shot (pain chance)
 *        v                                  v
 *   POSS_ATK1 (E, FaceTarget)           POSS_PAIN (G) --> RUN1
 *   POSS_ATK2 (F, PosAttack) -> ATK3 -> RUN1
 *        | its health at 0
 *        v
 *   POSS_DIE1 .. DIE5 (H .. L; Scream, Fall), the last for ever (-1)
 *
 * id's table has 967 states and 137 kinds of things; here those of the
 * monsters of Doom's first episode's first levels (the zombieman, the
 * shotgun guy, the imp and its fireball, the demon), the barrel, the
 * puffs and the blood, and the player's fist, pistol, shotgun and
 * chainsaw. A state is named as id's enum is, less its S_
 * (POSS_STND); "" is S_NULL, the thing removed.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-doom: Things spawns a thing with its info,
 * Mobj runs its states, Enemy, Weapons and Inter do their actions;
 * Mkwad asks [sounds] and [sprites] what to put in the WAD. *)

(* the actions of the states (id's A_ functions), done by Mobj's [act]:
 * Enemy's for the monsters, Weapons' for the player's psprites *)
type action =
  | Nothing
  (* the monsters' (p_enemy.c) *)
  | Look
  | Chase
  | Face_target
  | Pos_attack
  | SPos_attack
  | Troop_attack
  | Sarg_attack
  | Pain
  | Scream
  | XScream
  | Fall
  | Explode
  (* the weapons' (p_pspr.c) *)
  | Weapon_ready
  | Lower
  | Raise
  | Punch
  | Fire_pistol
  | Fire_shotgun
  | Saw
  | Refire
  | Light0
  | Light1
  | Light2

type state = {
  sname : string;
  sprite : string; (* its four letters, POSS *)
  frame : int; (* the letter: 0 is A *)
  bright : bool; (* drawn at full light (id's FF_FULLBRIGHT) *)
  tics : int; (* -1: for ever *)
  action : action;
  next : string;
}

(* [state name]: POSS_STND's; "" has none *)
val state : string -> state option

open World

let where (t : t) (who : Things.target) : float * float * float * float =
  match who with
  | Things.Thing m -> (m.mx, m.my, m.mz, Things.height m)
  | _ -> (t.player.x, t.player.y, t.player.z, height)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Damage *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* P_KillMobj: no more shootable, a corpse; gibbed if far below 0 *)
let kill (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) : unit =
  m.flags <-
    m.flags
    land lnot (Info.shootable lor Info.nogravity)
    lor Info.corpse lor Info.dropoff;
  if m.flags land Info.countkill <> 0 then t.kills <- t.kills + 1;
  match m.actor with
  | None -> ()
  | Some i -> (
      let st =
        if m.health < -i.spawnhealth && i.xdeathstate <> "" then i.xdeathstate
        else i.deathstate
      in
      if Mobj.set_state t m st then
        m.stics <- max 1 (m.stics - (Info.p_random () land 3));
      (* (what it held: a zombieman's clip, a shotgun guy's shotgun) *)
      match i.doomednum with
      | 3004 -> Mobj.spawn_item t 2007 m.mx m.my
      | 9 -> Mobj.spawn_item t 2001 m.mx m.my
      | _ -> ())

(* the player hurt: the armor's share, the red, the pain *)
let damage_player (t : t) (source : Things.target) (amount : int) : unit =
  let p = t.player in
  let saved = if p.armor > 100 then amount / 2 else amount / 3 in
  let saved = min saved p.armor in
  p.armor <- p.armor - saved;
  let amount = amount - saved in
  p.health <- max 0 (p.health - amount);
  (match source with Things.Thing m -> p.attacker <- Some m | _ -> ());
  p.damagecount <- min 100 (p.damagecount + amount);
  if p.health = 0 then begin
    (* (P_KillMobj's for a player: the dead player's view, Play's) *)
    start_sound t None (if amount > 50 then "pdiehi" else "pldeth")
  end
    (* (its pain sound and picture, A_Pain of S_PLAY_PAIN: the face's
     * only, here the sound) *)
  else if Info.p_random () < 255 then start_sound t None "plpain"

let damage (t : t) (target : Things.target) ((ix, iy) : float * float)
    (source : Things.target) (amount : int) : unit =
  match target with
  | Things.Nobody -> ()
  | Things.The_player ->
      if t.player.health > 0 then damage_player t source amount
  | Things.Thing m -> (
      match m.actor with
      | Some i when m.flags land Info.shootable <> 0 && m.health > 0 ->
          (* (pushed away from the blow, the lighter the further; not by
           * the chainsaw's, which holds the victim) *)
          let saw =
            source = Things.The_player && t.player.readyweapon = Info.Chainsaw
          in
          if not saw then begin
            let a = Float.atan2 (m.my -. iy) (m.mx -. ix) in
            let thrust = float amount *. 100. /. 8. /. float i.mass in
            m.momx <- m.momx +. (thrust *. Float.cos a);
            m.momy <- m.momy +. (thrust *. Float.sin a)
          end;
          m.health <- m.health - amount;
          if m.health <= 0 then kill t m
          else begin
            if Info.p_random () < i.painchance then begin
              m.flags <- m.flags lor Info.justhit;
              ignore (Mobj.set_state t m i.painstate)
            end;
            m.reactiontime <- 0;
            (* (it turns on who hurt it, for a while: BASETHRESHOLD) *)
            let self =
              match source with Things.Thing s -> s == m | _ -> false
            in
            if m.threshold = 0 && source <> Things.Nobody && not self then begin
              m.target <- source;
              m.threshold <- 100;
              let standing =
                match m.state with
                | Some st -> st.sname = i.spawnstate
                | None -> false
              in
              if standing && i.seestate <> "" then
                ignore (Mobj.set_state t m i.seestate)
            end
          end
      | _ -> ())

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Shots *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the slopes of the view: 100 rows up and down of a focal length of
 * 160 (id's topslope, bottomslope) *)
let view_slope = 100. /. 160.

(* the target an intercept is, if a shot can hit it *)
let target_of (i : Collision.intercept) : Things.target =
  match i with
  | Collision.Thing_hit (_, m) -> Things.Thing m
  | Collision.Player_hit _ -> Things.The_player
  | Collision.Line _ -> Things.Nobody

let aim (t : t) (shooter : Things.target) (x : float) (y : float) (z : float)
    (angle : float) (range : float) : float * Things.target =
  let x2 = x +. (range *. View.fcos angle)
  and y2 = y +. (range *. View.fsin angle) in
  let top = ref view_slope and bottom = ref (-.view_slope) in
  let rec go (l : Collision.intercept list) : float * Things.target =
    match l with
    | [] -> (0., Things.Nobody)
    | Collision.Line (f, line) :: rest -> (
        let d = f *. range in
        match Collision.opening t line with
        | Some (ob, ot) when ob < ot && d > 0. ->
            top := Float.min !top ((ot -. z) /. d);
            bottom := Float.max !bottom ((ob -. z) /. d);
            if !top <= !bottom then (0., Things.Nobody) else go rest
        | Some _ when d <= 0. -> go rest
        | _ -> (0., Things.Nobody))
    | i :: rest ->
        let d = Float.max 1. (Collision.fraction i *. range) in
        let _, _, tz, th = where t (target_of i) in
        let ttop = (tz +. th -. z) /. d and tbottom = (tz -. z) /. d in
        if ttop < !bottom || tbottom > !top then go rest
        else
          let ttop = Float.min ttop !top
          and tbottom = Float.max tbottom !bottom in
          ((ttop +. tbottom) /. 2., target_of i)
  in
  go (Collision.intercepts t shooter x y x2 y2)

let line_attack (t : t) (shooter : Things.target) (x : float) (y : float)
    (z : float) (angle : float) (range : float) (slope : float) (amount : int) :
    unit =
  let x2 = x +. (range *. View.fcos angle)
  and y2 = y +. (range *. View.fsin angle) in
  let at (f : float) (back : float) : float * float * float =
    let f = f -. (back /. range) in
    (x +. (f *. (x2 -. x)), y +. (f *. (y2 -. y)), z +. (slope *. f *. range))
  in
  let rec go (l : Collision.intercept list) : unit =
    match l with
    | [] -> ()
    | Collision.Line (f, line) :: rest -> (
        let d = f *. range in
        let hz = z +. (slope *. d) in
        match Collision.opening t line with
        | Some (ob, ot) when hz > ob && hz < ot -> go rest
        | _ ->
            let px, py, pz = at f 4. in
            (* (into the sky: no puff) *)
            let side = Level.point_on_line_side x y line in
            let sky =
              match Level.line_sector t.level line side with
              | Some s -> s.ceilingpic = t.textures.sky_flat && pz > s.ceiling
              | None -> false
            in
            if not sky then Mobj.spawn_puff t px py pz)
    | i :: rest ->
        let d = Float.max 1. (Collision.fraction i *. range) in
        let target = target_of i in
        let _, _, tz, th = where t target in
        if (tz +. th -. z) /. d < slope || (tz -. z) /. d > slope then go rest
        else begin
          let px, py, pz = at (Collision.fraction i) 10. in
          let noblood =
            match target with
            | Things.Thing m -> m.flags land Info.noblood <> 0
            | _ -> false
          in
          if noblood then Mobj.spawn_puff t px py pz
          else Mobj.spawn_blood t px py pz amount;
          damage t target (x, y) shooter amount
        end
  in
  go (Collision.intercepts t shooter x y x2 y2)

(* PIT_RadiusAttack: the distance the box's, not the centre's *)
let radius_attack (t : t) (spot : Things.mobj) (source : Things.target)
    (amount : int) : unit =
  let hurt (who : Things.target) (r : float) : unit =
    let x, y, z, h = where t who in
    let d =
      Float.max (Float.abs (x -. spot.mx)) (Float.abs (y -. spot.my)) -. r
    in
    let d = Float.max 0. d in
    if
      d < float amount
      && Collision.check_sight t spot.mx spot.my (spot.mz +. 8.) x y z h
    then damage t who (spot.mx, spot.my) source (amount - int_of_float d)
  in
  List.iter
    (fun (m : Things.mobj) ->
      if m.alive && m != spot && m.flags land Info.shootable <> 0 then
        hurt (Things.Thing m) (Things.radius m))
    t.things;
  hurt Things.The_player radius

let missile_hit (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) (target : Things.target) : unit =
  match m.actor with
  | Some i ->
      damage t target (m.mx, m.my) m.target
        (((Info.p_random () mod 8) + 1) * i.damage)
  | None -> ()

(* P_TouchSpecialThing, P_GiveAmmo, P_GiveBody, P_GiveArmor,
 * P_GiveWeapon: what an item gives, its message and sound, if it can be
 * taken (a medikit not at full health) *)
let give (t : t) (n : int) : (string * string) option =
  let p = t.player in
  let body (k : int) (most : int) (msg : string) : (string * string) option =
    if p.health >= most then None
    else begin
      p.health <- min most (p.health + k);
      Some (msg, "itemup")
    end
  in
  let clips (k : int) (msg : string) : (string * string) option =
    if p.clips >= 200 then None
    else begin
      p.clips <- min 200 (p.clips + k);
      Some (msg, "itemup")
    end
  in
  let shells (k : int) (msg : string) : (string * string) option =
    if p.shells >= 50 then None
    else begin
      p.shells <- min 50 (p.shells + k);
      Some (msg, "itemup")
    end
  in
  let weapon (w : Info.weapon) (msg : string) : (string * string) option =
    if not (List.mem w p.weapons) then begin
      p.weapons <- w :: p.weapons;
      p.pendingweapon <- Some w
    end;
    if w = Info.Shotgun then p.shells <- min 50 (p.shells + 8);
    Some (msg, "wpnup")
  in
  match n with
  | 2007 -> clips 10 "Picked up a clip."
  | 2048 -> clips 50 "Picked up a box of bullets."
  | 2008 -> shells 4 "Picked up 4 shotgun shells."
  | 2049 -> shells 20 "Picked up a box of shotgun shells."
  | 2011 -> body 10 100 "Picked up a stimpack."
  | 2012 -> body 25 100 "Picked up a medikit."
  | 2014 ->
      p.health <- min 200 (p.health + 1);
      Some ("Picked up a health bonus.", "itemup")
  | 2013 ->
      p.health <- min 200 (p.health + 100);
      Some ("Supercharge!", "getpow")
  | 2015 ->
      p.armor <- min 200 (p.armor + 1);
      Some ("Picked up an armor bonus.", "itemup")
  | 2018 ->
      if p.armor >= 100 then None
      else begin
        p.armor <- 100;
        Some ("Picked up the armor.", "itemup")
      end
  | 2019 ->
      if p.armor >= 200 then None
      else begin
        p.armor <- 200;
        Some ("Picked up the MegaArmor!", "itemup")
      end
  | 2001 -> weapon Info.Shotgun "You got the shotgun!"
  | 2005 -> weapon Info.Chainsaw "A chainsaw!  Find some meat!"
  | 5 | 6 | 13 | 38 | 39 | 40 ->
      p.keys <- n :: p.keys;
      let colour =
        match n with 5 | 40 -> "blue" | 6 | 39 -> "yellow" | _ -> "red"
      in
      Some
        ( Printf.sprintf "Picked up a %s %s." colour
            (if n >= 38 then "skull key" else "keycard"),
          "itemup" )
  | _ -> None

let touch_specials (t : t) : unit =
  let p = t.player in
  if p.health > 0 then
    List.iter
      (fun (m : Things.mobj) ->
        let r = radius +. m.kind.radius in
        if
          m.alive && m.actor = None
          && Float.abs (m.mx -. p.x) < r
          && Float.abs (m.my -. p.y) < r
          && m.mz <= p.z +. height
          && p.z <= m.mz +. 8. +. m.kind.height
        then
          match give t m.kind.doomednum with
          | Some (msg, sfx) ->
              Mobj.remove t m;
              say t msg;
              p.bonuscount <- p.bonuscount + 6;
              start_sound t None sfx
          | None -> ())
      t.things

(* Inter: the fights' consequences (Doom's p_inter.c, and p_map.c's
 * attacks): a shot aimed, a bullet's line, a blast; the damage, the
 * pain, the death; the items picked up.
 *
 * A bullet is not a thing: it is a line from the shooter's middle
 * (P_LineAttack), all at once, through the openings of the two-sided
 * lines, until a wall or a thing:
 *
 *        shooter            the line ahead, its intercepts in order
 *      +---+                      |        |            |
 *      | o-|---------------------[two-sided]--(thing)---[wall]
 *      +---+    the slope: the    |  the bullet passes
 *               aim's, or 0       |  if it is within the opening
 *
 * The aim (P_AimLineAttack) is the same walk, done first: the slope to
 * the first thing seen within the view's height, the openings
 * narrowing what is seen; so the player aims up and down by itself,
 * Doom having no looking up. The hit makes a puff (a wall) or blood (a
 * thing), and damage: the target's health, the armor taking a third
 * (green) or a half (blue) of the player's; a monster hurt may flinch
 * (its pain chance), turns on who hurt it, and dies at 0 (P_KillMobj):
 * its death states, a clip or a shotgun dropped, the kills counted.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-doom: Weapons and Enemy shoot through it;
 * Mobj's missiles hit through it; Play picks up the items it is on. *)

(* [damage t target inflictor source amount]: P_DamageMobj, P_KillMobj:
 * [inflictor] where the blow came from (it pushes), [source] who is
 * to blame (a monster turns on it) *)
val damage : World.t -> Things.target -> float * float -> Things.target -> int -> unit

(* [aim t shooter x y z angle range]: P_AimLineAttack: the slope to the
 * first thing in the view's height ahead, and it; else 0 and Nobody *)
val aim :
  World.t -> Things.target -> float -> float -> float -> float -> float ->
  float * Things.target

(* [line_attack t shooter x y z angle range slope amount]:
 * P_LineAttack: a bullet *)
val line_attack :
  World.t -> Things.target -> float -> float -> float -> float -> float ->
  float -> int -> unit

(* [radius_attack t spot source amount]: P_RadiusAttack: a blast, the
 * damage less the distance, to what it can see *)
val radius_attack : World.t -> Things.mobj -> Things.target -> int -> unit

(* [missile_hit t missile target]: PIT_CheckThing's: a missile's
 * damage, 1 to 8 times its info's *)
val missile_hit : World.t -> Things.mobj -> Things.target -> unit

(* P_TouchSpecialThing: the items the player is on, picked up *)
val touch_specials : World.t -> unit

(* the target's place and box (the player's, or a thing's): x, y, the
 * feet, the height *)
val where : World.t -> Things.target -> float * float * float * float

(* Claude Code

(* See Mobj.mli *)

let act : (World.t -> Things.mobj -> Info.action -> unit) ref =
  ref (fun (_ : World.t) (_ : Things.mobj) (_ : Info.action) -> ())

let remove (t : World.t) (m : Things.mobj) : unit =
  m.alive <- false;
  let k = m.sector.index in
  t.by_sector.(k) <-
    List.filter (fun (o : Things.mobj) -> o != m) t.by_sector.(k)

(* P_SetMobjState: a state, its action, and on through the states of
 * no tics *)
let rec set_state (t : World.t) (m : Things.mobj) (name : string) : bool =
  match Info.state name with
  | None ->
      m.state <- None;
      remove t m;
      false
  | Some st ->
      m.state <- Some st;
      m.stics <- st.tics;
      !act t m st.action;
      if m.alive && m.stics = 0 then set_state t m st.next else m.alive

(* (a thing of no map: its kind, for drawing, made from its info) *)
let kind_of (i : Info.mobjinfo) : Things.info =
  {
    doomednum = i.doomednum;
    sprite = "";
    frames = [||];
    tics = 1;
    radius = i.radius;
    height = i.height;
    solid = false;
    hanging = false;
    monster = false;
  }

let add (t : World.t) (m : Things.mobj) : unit =
  t.things <- m :: t.things;
  t.by_sector.(m.sector.index) <- m :: t.by_sector.(m.sector.index)

let spawn (t : World.t) (i : Info.mobjinfo) (x : float) (y : float) (z : float)
    : Things.mobj =
  let s = Level.sector_at t.level x y in
  let m = Things.make (kind_of i) (Some i) x y z s in
  add t m;
  (* (the first state's action, as P_SpawnMobj does not: none has one) *)
  m

let spawn_item (t : World.t) (n : int) (x : float) (y : float) : unit =
  match Things.info n with
  | Some i ->
      let s = Level.sector_at t.level x y in
      add t (Things.make i None x y s.floor s)
  | None -> ()

(* P_SpawnPuff: up a little, its first tics random *)
let spawn_puff (t : World.t) (x : float) (y : float) (z : float) : unit =
  let z = z +. (float (Info.p_random2 ()) /. 64.) in
  let m = spawn t Info.puff x y z in
  m.momz <- 1.;
  m.stics <- max 1 (m.stics - (Info.p_random () land 3))

(* P_SpawnBlood: redder the more it hurt *)
let spawn_blood (t : World.t) (x : float) (y : float) (z : float) (damage : int)
    : unit =
  let z = z +. (float (Info.p_random2 ()) /. 64.) in
  let m = spawn t Info.blood x y z in
  m.momz <- 2.;
  m.stics <- max 1 (m.stics - (Info.p_random () land 3));
  if damage <= 12 && damage >= 9 then ignore (set_state t m "BLOOD2")
  else if damage < 9 then ignore (set_state t m "BLOOD3")

let explode_missile (t : World.t) (m : Things.mobj) : unit =
  m.momx <- 0.;
  m.momy <- 0.;
  m.momz <- 0.;
  match m.actor with
  | Some i ->
      if set_state t m i.deathstate then begin
        m.stics <- max 1 (m.stics - (Info.p_random () land 3));
        m.flags <- m.flags land lnot Info.missile;
        World.start_sound t (Some (m.mx, m.my)) i.deathsound
      end
  | None -> ()

(* P_XYMovement: by the momentum, in steps of half the most a step can
 * be when it is large; a missile stopped explodes (or hits); friction
 * for the others on the ground, a corpse sliding to a stop *)
let xy_movement (t : World.t) (hit : Things.mobj -> Things.target -> unit)
    (m : Things.mobj) : unit =
  let clamp (v : float) : float =
    Float.max (-.World.maxmove) (Float.min World.maxmove v)
  in
  m.momx <- clamp m.momx;
  m.momy <- clamp m.momy;
  let big =
    Float.abs m.momx > World.maxmove /. 2.
    || Float.abs m.momy > World.maxmove /. 2.
  in
  let steps = if big then 2 else 1 in
  let n = float steps in
  let stopped = ref false in
  for _i = 1 to steps do
    if not !stopped then begin
      let ok, pos =
        Collision.try_move_thing t m
          (m.mx +. (m.momx /. n))
          (m.my +. (m.momy /. n))
      in
      if not ok then begin
        stopped := true;
        if m.flags land Info.missile <> 0 then begin
          if pos.hit <> Things.Nobody then hit m pos.hit;
          explode_missile t m
        end
        else begin
          m.momx <- 0.;
          m.momy <- 0.
        end
      end
    end
  done;
  if m.flags land Info.missile = 0 && m.mz <= m.floorz then begin
    if Float.abs m.momx < World.stopspeed && Float.abs m.momy < World.stopspeed
    then begin
      m.momx <- 0.;
      m.momy <- 0.
    end
    else begin
      m.momx <- m.momx *. World.friction;
      m.momy <- m.momy *. World.friction
    end
  end

(* P_ZMovement: up or down by the momentum, gravity off the floor; a
 * missile that meets the floor or the ceiling explodes *)
let z_movement (t : World.t) (m : Things.mobj) : unit =
  m.mz <- m.mz +. m.momz;
  let missile = m.flags land Info.missile <> 0 in
  if m.mz <= m.floorz then begin
    m.mz <- m.floorz;
    if m.momz < 0. then m.momz <- 0.;
    if missile then explode_missile t m
  end
  else if m.flags land Info.nogravity = 0 then
    m.momz <- (if m.momz = 0. then -2. else m.momz -. 1.);
  if m.alive && m.mz +. Things.height m > m.ceilingz then begin
    if m.momz > 0. then m.momz <- 0.;
    m.mz <- m.ceilingz -. Things.height m;
    if missile then explode_missile t m
  end

let think (t : World.t) (hit : Things.mobj -> Things.target -> unit)
    (m : Things.mobj) : unit =
  if m.momx <> 0. || m.momy <> 0. then xy_movement t hit m;
  if m.alive && (m.mz <> m.floorz || m.momz <> 0.) then z_movement t m;
  if m.alive && m.stics <> -1 then begin
    m.stics <- m.stics - 1;
    if m.stics <= 0 then
      match m.state with
      | Some st -> ignore (set_state t m st.next)
      | None -> ()
  end

(* Mobj: a thing that acts, its life a tic at a time (Doom's p_mobj.c):
 * its states gone through, its momentum, its fall; made, removed.
 *
 * P_MobjThinker each tic, for each thing that acts:
 *
 *   momentum?  P_XYMovement: moved by it, a missile exploding where it
 *              is stopped (a wall, a thing: Inter's damage)
 *   off the floor?  P_ZMovement: falls; a missile flies straight
 *   the state's tics run out?  P_SetMobjState: the next state, and its
 *              action done (Enemy's Look, Chase, ...), and the next if
 *              it lasts 0 tics
 *
 * A state's action is a function of id's (info.c's states point at
 * p_enemy.c's A_ functions); here [act] is filled by Enemy, which comes
 * after, as Doom's linker joins them.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-doom: Play runs [think] for every thing that
 * acts; Inter changes a thing's state when it is hurt or dies; Enemy
 * spawns missiles, Inter the puffs and the blood. *)

(* the actions of the states, Enemy's *)
val act : (World.t -> Things.mobj -> Info.action -> unit) ref

(* [set_state t m name]: P_SetMobjState: false if the thing is no more
 * ("": S_NULL) *)
val set_state : World.t -> Things.mobj -> string -> bool

(* [spawn t info x y z]: P_SpawnMobj, in the level's things *)
val spawn : World.t -> Info.mobjinfo -> float -> float -> float -> Things.mobj

(* [spawn_item t doomednum x y]: an item dropped (a clip, a shotgun) *)
val spawn_item : World.t -> int -> float -> float -> unit

(* P_RemoveMobj *)
val remove : World.t -> Things.mobj -> unit

(* P_SpawnPuff, P_SpawnBlood: where a bullet hit a wall or a thing *)
val spawn_puff : World.t -> float -> float -> float -> unit
val spawn_blood : World.t -> float -> float -> float -> int -> unit

(* P_ExplodeMissile: stopped, its death states, its sound *)
val explode_missile : World.t -> Things.mobj -> unit

(* [think t hit m]: P_MobjThinker; [hit] what a missile does to what it
 * runs into (Inter's damage) *)
val think : World.t -> (Things.mobj -> Things.target -> unit) -> Things.mobj -> unit

(* See Things.mli *)

type info = {
  doomednum : int;
  sprite : string;
  frames : (char * bool) array;
  tics : int;
  radius : float;
  height : float;
  solid : bool;
  hanging : bool;
  monster : bool;
}

(* "AB+": the frames' letters, each followed by its "+" if bright *)
let letters (s : string) : (char * bool) array =
  let acc = ref [] in
  String.iteri (fun (i : int) (c : char) -> if c <> '+' then acc := (c, i + 1 < String.length s && s.[i + 1] = '+') :: !acc) s;
  Array.of_list (List.rev !acc)

(* info.c's mobjinfo, the spawn states, for Doom's (and Doom II's
 * common) things: a decoration, an item, a monster; a thing's frames
 * said as "AB+" (A, then B bright) *)
let table : info list =
  let d (n : int) (sprite : string) (frames : string) (tics : int) (radius : float) (height : float) (solid : bool) : info =
    { doomednum = n; sprite; frames = letters frames; tics; radius; height; solid; hanging = false; monster = false } in
  let item (n : int) (sprite : string) (frames : string) : info = d n sprite frames 6 20. 16. false in
  let hang (n : int) (sprite : string) (frames : string) (height : float) (solid : bool) : info =
    { (d n sprite frames 8 16. height solid) with hanging = true } in
  let monster (n : int) (sprite : string) (radius : float) (height : float) : info =
    { (d n sprite "AB" 10 radius height true) with monster = true } in
  [ (* items *)
    item 2001 "SHOT" "A"; item 2002 "MGUN" "A"; item 2003 "LAUN" "A"; item 2004 "PLAS" "A"; item 2005 "CSAW" "A"; item 2006 "BFUG" "A";

let info (n : int) : info option = List.find_opt (fun (i : info) -> i.doomednum = n) table

let sprite_names (kinds : int list) : string list =
  List.fold_left
    (fun (acc : string list) (k : int) -> match info k with Some i when not (List.mem i.sprite acc) -> i.sprite :: acc | _ -> acc)
    [] kinds
  |> List.rev

type mobj = {
  mutable mx : float;
  mutable my : float;
  mutable mz : float;
  mutable mangle : float;
  kind : info;
  mutable sector : Level.sector;
  phase : int;
  mutable alive : bool;
  actor : Info.mobjinfo option;
  mutable state : Info.state option;
  mutable stics : int;
  mutable health : int;
  mutable flags : int;
  mutable momx : float;
  mutable momy : float;
  mutable momz : float;
  mutable floorz : float;
  mutable ceilingz : float;
  mutable target : target;
  mutable movedir : int;
  mutable movecount : int;
  mutable reactiontime : int;
  mutable threshold : int;
  mutable seen_for : int;
}

and target = Nobody | The_player | Thing of mobj

let radius (m : mobj) : float =
  match m.actor with Some a -> a.radius | None -> m.kind.radius

let height (m : mobj) : float =
  match m.actor with Some a -> a.height | None -> m.kind.height

(* P_SpawnMobj: an actor at its spawn state, its tics; a thing standing
 * as its kind says *)
let make (kind : info) (actor : Info.mobjinfo option) (x : float) (y : float)
    (z : float) (s : Level.sector) : mobj =
  let state =
    Option.bind actor (fun (a : Info.mobjinfo) -> Info.state a.spawnstate) in
  let flags =
    match actor with
    | Some a -> a.flags
    | None -> if kind.solid then Info.solid else 0 in
  { mx = x; my = y; mz = z; mangle = 0.; kind; sector = s; phase = 0;
    alive = true; actor; state;
    stics = (match state with Some st -> st.tics | None -> 0);
    health = (match actor with Some a -> a.spawnhealth | None -> 1000);
    flags; momx = 0.; momy = 0.; momz = 0.; floorz = s.floor;
    ceilingz = s.ceiling; target = Nobody; movedir = 8; movecount = 0;
    reactiontime = (match actor with Some a -> a.reactiontime | None -> 0);
    threshold = 0; seen_for = 0 }

(* P_SpawnMapThing *)
let spawn (level : Level.t) (monsters : bool) : mobj list =
  List.filter_map
    (fun ((k, th) : int * Level.thing) ->
      (* (the skills' bits: 1 the easy ones, 2 medium, 4 hard; 16 the
       * multiplayer's only) *)
      if th.tflags land 2 = 0 || th.tflags land 16 <> 0 then None
      else
        match info th.kind with
        | Some i when monsters || not i.monster ->
            let s = Level.sector_at level th.tx th.ty in
            let z = if i.hanging then s.ceiling -. i.height else s.floor in
            let m = { (make i (Info.of_doomednum th.kind) th.tx th.ty z s) with
                      mangle = th.tangle; phase = k * 7 } in
            (* (8: deaf, it waits to see the player) *)
            if th.tflags land 8 <> 0 then m.flags <- m.flags lor Info.ambush;
            (* (not all of a kind in step: 1 to its tics) *)
            if m.stics > 0 then m.stics <- 1 + (Info.p_random () mod m.stics);
            Some m
        | _ -> None)
    (List.mapi (fun (k : int) (th : Level.thing) -> (k, th))
       (Array.to_list level.things))

type frame = { lumps : string array; flip : bool array; rotates : bool }

type sprites = (string, frame) Hashtbl.t

(* R_InitSpriteDefs: each lump of S_START to S_END is a sprite's frame
 * at a rotation, or two (its last two letters: the mirrored one) *)
let load (wad : Wad.t) : sprites =
  let frames : sprites = Hashtbl.create 256 in
  let install (name : string) (letter : char) (rot : char) (data : string) (flip : bool) : unit =
    let key = name ^ String.make 1 letter in
    let f = match Hashtbl.find_opt frames key with Some f -> f | None -> { lumps = Array.make 8 ""; flip = Array.make 8 false; rotates = rot <> '0' } in
    let f = { f with rotates = rot <> '0' } in
    if rot = '0' then
      for r = 0 to 7 do f.lumps.(r) <- data; f.flip.(r) <- flip done
    else begin
      let r = Char.code rot - Char.code '1' in
      if r >= 0 && r < 8 then begin f.lumps.(r) <- data; f.flip.(r) <- flip end
    end;
    Hashtbl.replace frames key f in
  List.iter
    (fun (l : Wad.lump) ->
      let n = l.name in
      if String.length n >= 6 then begin
        let name = String.sub n 0 4 in
        install name n.[4] n.[5] l.data false;
        if String.length n >= 8 then install name n.[6] n.[7] l.data true
      end)
    (Wad.between wad "S_START" "S_END" @ Wad.between wad "SS_START" "SS_END");
  frames

let frame (sprites : sprites) (m : mobj) (tic : int) : (frame * bool) option =
  let c, bright =
    match m.state with
    | Some st -> (Char.chr (Char.code 'A' + st.frame), st.bright)
    | None ->
        let letters = m.kind.frames in
        let n = Array.length letters in
        letters.((((tic + m.phase) / m.kind.tics) mod n + n) mod n) in
  let sprite =
    match m.state with Some st -> st.sprite | None -> m.kind.sprite in
  Option.map (fun (f : frame) -> (f, bright))
    (Hashtbl.find_opt sprites (sprite ^ String.make 1 c))

let find (sprites : sprites) (name : string) : frame option =
  Hashtbl.find_opt sprites name

(* Things: what stands in a level besides its walls -- a barrel, a lamp,
 * a key, a body, a monster -- and the pictures it is drawn with (Doom's
 * info.c, r_things.c's R_InitSprites, p_mobj.c's P_SpawnMapThing).
 *
 * A thing of the map (THINGS) is a type number, the editor's
 * (doomednum: 2035 a barrel, 3001 an imp), a place, an angle, and the
 * skills and modes it is in. Its type says, in id's info.c, its first
 * state (its sprite, a frame, how many tics) and what it is (its
 * radius, its height, solid, hanging from the ceiling, a monster).
 * Here only what a thing standing needs: its sprite, the frames it
 * cycles through (a torch's flame, a lamp), bright or not, and its
 * size. A thing that acts -- a monster, a barrel, a fireball -- has
 * besides its info's states (Info), its health, its momentum, its
 * target: id's mobj_t.
 *
 * A sprite is four letters (BAR1, POSS), its pictures lumps between
 * S_START and S_END named by a frame letter and a rotation:
 *
 *   BAR1A0     frame A, the same from every side (0)
 *   POSSA1     frame A seen from the front (1) ... from behind (5)
 *   POSSA2A8   frame A from the front left (2), and mirrored, from the
 *              front right (8): one picture for two rotations
 *
 * The rotation seen is the angle from the eye to the thing less the
 * thing's own, in eighths of a turn (R_ProjectSprite).
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-doom: Play spawns the things of the level
 * (the skill's, the monsters' if asked) and takes the keys the player
 * walks on; Render draws them; Mkwad asks [sprite_names] which
 * pictures of Freedoom's a level needs. *)

type info = {
  doomednum : int;
  sprite : string;
  frames : (char * bool) array; (* the frames' letters, in turn, and bright or not *)
  tics : int; (* each frame's *)
  radius : float;
  height : float;
  solid : bool;
  hanging : bool; (* at the ceiling, less its height *)
  monster : bool;
}

val info : int -> info option

(* every sprite a thing of these types is drawn with *)
val sprite_names : int list -> string list

(* a thing of the level: one standing (its [kind]'s frames, in turn), or
 * one that acts (an [actor], its frames its states', Mobj runs them:
 * id's mobj_t); and what the shots make (a puff, blood, a fireball), or
 * a monster drops, which no map has *)
type mobj = {
  mutable mx : float;
  mutable my : float;
  mutable mz : float;
  mutable mangle : float;
  kind : info;
  mutable sector : Level.sector;
  phase : int; (* where in its frames it starts *)
  mutable alive : bool; (* false: no more, and not drawn *)
  (* what an actor has besides *)
  actor : Info.mobjinfo option;
  mutable state : Info.state option;
  mutable stics : int; (* the tics left in the state *)
  mutable health : int;
  mutable flags : int; (* Info's solid, shootable, ... *)
  mutable momx : float;
  mutable momy : float;
  mutable momz : float;
  mutable floorz : float;
  mutable ceilingz : float;
  mutable target : target;
  mutable movedir : int; (* 0 east, 1 north-east, ... 7; 8 none *)
  mutable movecount : int; (* steps before a new direction *)
  mutable reactiontime : int; (* tics before attacking *)
  mutable threshold : int; (* tics of chasing the one that hurt it *)
  mutable seen_for : int; (* tics it has seen its target (Ai.aim_error) *)
}

(* See Ways.mli *)

let cell = 32.

type grid = {
  level : Level.t;
  ox : float;
  oy : float;
  columns : int;
  rows : int;
  (* no wall across the cell's middle: once for the level *)
  open_ : bool array;
  (* the sector under the middle, whose room changes (a door) *)
  sectors : Level.sector array;
  mutable flow : Ai.flow option;
  mutable goal : int * int;
  mutable built : int; (* the tic *)
}

let grid : grid option ref = ref None

(* a wall within 8 of the middle, its box of 16 by 16: one-sided, or
 * blocking; the lines of the blockmap's cells under the box *)
let walled (level : Level.t) (x : float) (y : float) : bool =
  let bm = level.blockmap in
  let crosses (l : Level.line) : bool =
    (l.back = None || l.flags land (Level.blocking lor 2) <> 0)
    && Float.min l.v1.x l.v2.x < x +. 8.
    && Float.max l.v1.x l.v2.x > x -. 8.
    && Float.min l.v1.y l.v2.y < y +. 8.
    && Float.max l.v1.y l.v2.y > y -. 8.
    && Collision.box_on_line_side (x -. 8.) (x +. 8.) (y -. 8.) (y +. 8.) l = -1
  in
  let in_cell ((cx, cy) : float * float) : bool =
    let bx = int_of_float (Float.floor ((cx -. bm.originx) /. 128.))
    and by = int_of_float (Float.floor ((cy -. bm.originy) /. 128.)) in
    bx >= 0 && bx < bm.columns && by >= 0 && by < bm.rows
    && Array.exists
         (fun (k : int) -> crosses level.lines.(k))
         bm.cells.((by * bm.columns) + bx)
  in
  List.exists in_cell
    [
      (x -. 8., y -. 8.);
      (x +. 8., y -. 8.);
      (x -. 8., y +. 8.);
      (x +. 8., y +. 8.);
    ]

let make (level : Level.t) : grid =
  let xs =
    Array.concat
      (Array.to_list
         (Array.map (fun (l : Level.line) -> [| l.v1.x; l.v2.x |]) level.lines))
  in
  let ys =
    Array.concat
      (Array.to_list
         (Array.map (fun (l : Level.line) -> [| l.v1.y; l.v2.y |]) level.lines))
  in
  let ox = Array.fold_left Float.min infinity xs
  and oy = Array.fold_left Float.min infinity ys in
  let columns =
    int_of_float ((Array.fold_left Float.max neg_infinity xs -. ox) /. cell) + 1
  in
  let rows =
    int_of_float ((Array.fold_left Float.max neg_infinity ys -. oy) /. cell) + 1
  in
  let middle (k : int) : float * float =
    ( ox +. ((float (k mod columns) +. 0.5) *. cell),
      oy +. ((float (k / columns) +. 0.5) *. cell) )
  in
  let sectors =
    Array.init (columns * rows) (fun (k : int) ->
        let x, y = middle k in
        Level.sector_at level x y)
  in
  let open_ =
    Array.init (columns * rows) (fun (k : int) ->
        let x, y = middle k in
        not (walled level x y))
  in
  {
    level;
    ox;
    oy;
    columns;
    rows;
    open_;
    sectors;
    flow = None;
    goal = (-1, -1);
    built = -100;
  }

let cell_of (g : grid) (x : float) (y : float) : int * int =
  ( int_of_float (Float.floor ((x -. g.ox) /. cell)),
    int_of_float (Float.floor ((y -. g.oy) /. cell)) )

let walkable (g : grid) ((c, r) : int * int) : bool =
  c >= 0 && c < g.columns && r >= 0 && r < g.rows
  &&
  let k = (r * g.columns) + c in
  let s = g.sectors.(k) in
  g.open_.(k) && s.ceiling -. s.floor >= World.height

(* the grid of this level, and its flow from the player's cell *)
let flow (t : World.t) : grid * Ai.flow =
  let g =
    match !grid with
    | Some g when g.level == t.level -> g
    | _ ->
        let g = make t.level in
        grid := Some g;
        g
  in
  let here = cell_of g t.player.x t.player.y in
  (match g.flow with
  | Some _ when here = g.goal || t.tic - g.built < 16 -> ()
  | _ ->
      g.flow <- Some (Ai.flow ~walkable:(walkable g) ~diagonal:true here);
      g.goal <- here;
      g.built <- t.tic);
  match g.flow with Some f -> (g, f) | None -> assert false

let direction (t : World.t) (m : Things.mobj) : int option =
  let g, f = flow t in
  match Ai.next_step f (cell_of g m.mx m.my) with
  | None -> None
  | Some (c, r) ->
      let x = g.ox +. ((float c +. 0.5) *. cell)
      and y = g.oy +. ((float r +. 0.5) *. cell) in
      let a = Float.atan2 (y -. m.my) (x -. m.mx) in
      Some
        (((int_of_float (Float.round (a /. (World.pi /. 4.))) mod 8) + 8) mod 8)

let aim_error (m : Things.mobj) : float =
  Ai.aim_error ~spread:(World.pi /. 16.) ~settle:30. ~seen_for:m.seen_for
    ~seed:m.phase ()
games/fps/doom/actors/Ways.mli
1857
(* Ways: the playground's AI (lib_playground's Ai, over lib_playground/ai's
 * Pathfind) for Doom's monsters, with ai=ways: a way through the level
 * to the player, and an aim that gets better.
 *
 * id's monsters go as the crow flies (Enemy's P_NewChaseDir), and one
 * behind a wall stays there. Here the level is seen as a grid of cells
 * of 32 by 32, a cell walkable when no wall crosses its middle and its
 * sector has room to stand (a closed door's has not), and one search
 * from the player's cell outwards (Ai.flow, Dijkstra's) gives every
 * cell the step towards the player: thirty monsters read their own
 * cell's, where thirty searches would be twenty-nine too many.
 *
 *   . . . . # . . . .      the player P; # a wall; each cell's arrow
 *   > > v . # . v < <      its next step (Ai.next_step): around the
 *   > > > > > > P < <      wall's end, through the gap
 *   ^ ^ ^ . # . ^ ^ <
 *
 * The search is made again when the player is in another cell, at most
 * every 16 tics. A step the cells allow that the level does not (a
 * ledge, a thing in the way) fails in P_Move, and id's way takes over
 * for that chase.
 *
 * The aim: Ai.aim_error, a smooth wobble the size of [spread] when the
 * monster first sees the player, halving every 30 tics it keeps seeing
 * it -- a monster that has watched the player a while shoots straight,
 * one surprised does not; the same for the same game, as id's random
 * table is.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-doom: Enemy's chase asks [direction] of a
 * monster that does not see the player, its attacks [aim_error]. *)

(* [direction t m]: the way towards the player from where the monster
 * is, one of the eight (Enemy's movedir), if the cells know one *)
val direction : World.t -> Things.mobj -> int option

(* [aim_error m]: an angle off, in radians *)
val aim_error : Things.mobj -> float
