(* See Weapons.mli *)

open World

(* p_pspr.h's: where a weapon is held (its top), where it goes down to,
 * how fast *)
let weapontop = 32.
let weaponbottom = 128.
let lowerspeed = 6.
let raisespeed = 6.
let meleerange = 64.

(* the attack key this tic (the command's) *)
let attacking = ref false

let ammo_of (p : player) (w : Info.weapon) : int =
  match (Info.weaponinfo w).ammo with
  | None -> 1
  | Some Info.Clip -> p.clips
  | Some Info.Shell -> p.shells

(* P_CheckAmmo: enough to fire, else the best weapon left asked for
 * (the shotgun, the pistol, the chainsaw, the fist) *)
let check_ammo (p : player) : bool =
  if ammo_of p p.readyweapon > 0 then true
  else begin
    let has (w : Info.weapon) : bool =
      List.mem w p.weapons && ammo_of p w > 0
    in
    let best =
      if has Info.Shotgun then Info.Shotgun
      else if has Info.Pistol then Info.Pistol
      else if has Info.Chainsaw then Info.Chainsaw
      else Info.Fist
    in
    p.pendingweapon <- Some best;
    false
  end

let use_ammo (p : player) : unit =
  match (Info.weaponinfo p.readyweapon).ammo with
  | Some Info.Clip -> p.clips <- p.clips - 1
  | Some Info.Shell -> p.shells <- p.shells - 1
  | None -> ()

(* P_SetPsprite: a state of the hand, its action, on through those of
 * no tics *)
let rec set_psprite (t : t) (sp : psprite) (name : string) : unit =
  match Info.state name with
  | None -> sp.pstate <- None
  | Some st -> (
      sp.pstate <- Some st;
      sp.ptics <- st.tics;
      act t sp st.action;
      match sp.pstate with
      | Some cur when cur == st && sp.ptics = 0 -> set_psprite t sp st.next
      | _ -> ())

(* P_BringUpWeapon: the pending weapon, from below *)
and bring_up (t : t) : unit =
  let p = t.player in
  let w = match p.pendingweapon with Some w -> w | None -> p.readyweapon in
  if w = Info.Chainsaw then start_sound t None "sawup";
  p.readyweapon <- w;
  p.pendingweapon <- None;
  p.weapon_sp.sy <- weaponbottom;
  set_psprite t p.weapon_sp (Info.weaponinfo w).upstate

(* P_FireWeapon *)
and fire (t : t) : unit =
  let p = t.player in
  if check_ammo p then begin
    set_psprite t p.weapon_sp (Info.weaponinfo p.readyweapon).atkstate;
    Enemy.noise_alert t
  end

(* the player's shots: from 36 up (its middle and 8), as Inter's *)
and shootz (p : player) : float = p.z +. (height /. 2.) +. 8.

(* P_BulletSlope: the aim, or a 32nd of a turn to the left, the right *)
and bullet_slope (t : t) : float =
  let p = t.player in
  let aim (a : float) : float * Things.target =
    Inter.aim t Things.The_player p.x p.y (shootz p) a (16. *. 64.)
  in
  let slope, target = aim p.angle in
  if target <> Things.Nobody then slope
  else
    let slope, target = aim (p.angle +. (pi /. 32.)) in
    if target <> Things.Nobody then slope
    else fst (aim (p.angle -. (pi /. 32.)))

(* P_GunShot: 5, 10 or 15; spread unless the first of a series *)
and gun_shot (t : t) (slope : float) (accurate : bool) : unit =
  let p = t.player in
  let damage = 5 * ((Info.p_random () mod 3) + 1) in
  let a =
    if accurate then p.angle
    else p.angle +. (float (Info.p_random2 ()) *. 2. *. pi /. 16384.)
  in
  Inter.line_attack t Things.The_player p.x p.y (shootz p) a (32. *. 64.) slope
    damage

(* the fist and the chainsaw: a line of 64, turning to what they hit *)
and melee (t : t) (damage : int) (range : float) : Things.target =
  let p = t.player in
  let a = p.angle +. (float (Info.p_random2 ()) *. 2. *. pi /. 16384.) in
  let slope, target =
    Inter.aim t Things.The_player p.x p.y (shootz p) a range
  in
  Inter.line_attack t Things.The_player p.x p.y (shootz p) a range slope damage;
  (match target with
  | Things.Thing m -> p.angle <- Float.atan2 (m.my -. p.y) (m.mx -. p.x)
  | _ -> ());
  target

and act (t : t) (sp : psprite) (a : Info.action) : unit =
  let p = t.player in
  let wi = Info.weaponinfo p.readyweapon in
  match a with
  | Info.Weapon_ready ->
      (match sp.pstate with
      | Some st when st.sname = "SAW" -> start_sound t None "sawidl"
      | _ -> ());
      if p.pendingweapon <> None || p.health <= 0 then
        set_psprite t sp wi.downstate
      else if !attacking then begin
        p.attackdown <- true;
        fire t
      end
      else begin
        p.attackdown <- false;
        (* (the weapon bobbing as the player walks) *)
        let angle = 2. *. pi *. float (128 * t.tic) /. 8192. in
        sp.sx <- 1. +. (p.bob *. Float.cos angle);
        sp.sy <- weapontop +. (p.bob *. Float.abs (Float.sin angle))
      end
  | Info.Lower ->
      sp.sy <- sp.sy +. lowerspeed;
      if sp.sy >= weaponbottom then
        if p.health <= 0 then begin
          sp.sy <- weaponbottom;
          sp.pstate <- None
        end
        else bring_up t
  | Info.Raise ->
      sp.sy <- sp.sy -. raisespeed;
      if sp.sy <= weapontop then begin
        sp.sy <- weapontop;
        set_psprite t sp wi.readystate
      end
  | Info.Refire ->
      if !attacking && p.pendingweapon = None && p.health > 0 then begin
        p.refire <- p.refire + 1;
        fire t
      end
      else begin
        p.refire <- 0;
        ignore (check_ammo p)
      end
  | Info.Punch ->
      let damage = ((Info.p_random () mod 10) + 1) lsl 1 in
      if melee t damage meleerange <> Things.Nobody then
        start_sound t None "punch"
  | Info.Saw ->
      let damage = 2 * ((Info.p_random () mod 10) + 1) in
      if melee t damage (meleerange +. 1.) <> Things.Nobody then
        start_sound t None "sawhit"
      else start_sound t None "sawful"
  | Info.Fire_pistol ->
      start_sound t None "pistol";
      use_ammo p;
      set_psprite t p.flash_sp wi.flashstate;
      gun_shot t (bullet_slope t) (p.refire = 0)
  | Info.Fire_shotgun ->
      start_sound t None "shotgn";
      use_ammo p;
      set_psprite t p.flash_sp wi.flashstate;
      let slope = bullet_slope t in
      for _i = 1 to 7 do
        gun_shot t slope false
      done
  | Info.Light0 -> p.extralight <- 0
  | Info.Light1 -> p.extralight <- 1
  | Info.Light2 -> p.extralight <- 2
  | _ -> ()

let setup (t : t) : unit =
  let p = t.player in
  p.weapon_sp.pstate <- None;
  p.flash_sp.pstate <- None;
  p.pendingweapon <- Some p.readyweapon;
  bring_up t

(* P_MovePsprites: each psprite's tics, the flash where the weapon is *)
let tic (t : t) (attack : bool) (change : Info.weapon option) : unit =
  let p = t.player in
  attacking := attack;
  (match change with
  | Some w when List.mem w p.weapons && w <> p.readyweapon && p.health > 0 ->
      p.pendingweapon <- Some w
  | _ -> ());
  List.iter
    (fun (sp : psprite) ->
      match sp.pstate with
      | Some st when sp.ptics <> -1 ->
          sp.ptics <- sp.ptics - 1;
          if sp.ptics <= 0 then set_psprite t sp st.next
      | _ -> ())
    [ p.weapon_sp; p.flash_sp ];
  p.flash_sp.sx <- p.weapon_sp.sx;
  p.flash_sp.sy <- p.weapon_sp.sy

(* Weapons: the player's hand (Doom's p_pspr.c): the weapon held, raised,
 * lowered, fired, and its flash, each a picture with its own states
 * (a psprite: Info's PISTOL, PISTOL1 ...), drawn over the view.
 *
 *   PISTOL (A, Weapon_ready: the attack key? PISTOL1)
 *     PISTOL1 (A, 4) -> PISTOL2 (B, 6, Fire_pistol: a bullet, and the
 *       flash's psprite set to PISTOLFLASH) -> PISTOL3 (C, 4) ->
 *       PISTOL4 (B, 5, Refire: the key still held? PISTOL1 again)
 *       -> PISTOL
 *   another weapon asked (or the player dead): PISTOLDOWN (Lower, 6
 *     rows a tic down to 128), then the new one's UP (Raise, up to 32),
 *     then its ready state
 *
 * A bullet of the player's goes where the player looks, up or down to
 * the first thing ahead (P_BulletSlope: the aim, or a 32nd of a turn
 * to either side); the first of a series straight, the next ones
 * spread (P_GunShot's accurate). Each shot is heard by the monsters
 * (Enemy.noise_alert). The fist and the chainsaw reach 64.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-doom: Play gives it the attack key and the
 * weapon asked each tic; Doom.ml draws the psprites (Render). *)

(* P_SetupPsprites: the weapon held raised from below *)
val setup : World.t -> unit

(* [tic t attack change]: P_MovePsprites, with the tic's attack key held
 * and the weapon asked for, if any (the keys 1 to 4: 1 the fist, or
 * the chainsaw when held; 2 the pistol; 3 the shotgun) *)
val tic : World.t -> bool -> Info.weapon option -> unit

(* See Collision.mli *)

open World

(* P_BoxOnLineSide: 0 or 1 if the box is all on one side, else -1 *)
let box_on_line_side (left : float) (right : float) (bottom : float) (top : float) (l : Level.line) : int =
  let dx = l.v2.x -. l.v1.x and dy = l.v2.y -. l.v1.y in
  let side (x : float) (y : float) : int = Level.point_on_line_side x y l in
  let p1, p2 =
    if dy = 0. then
      let a = if top > l.v1.y then 1 else 0 and b = if bottom > l.v1.y then 1 else 0 in
      if dx < 0. then (1 - a, 1 - b) else (a, b)
    else if dx = 0. then
      let a = if right < l.v1.x then 1 else 0 and b = if left < l.v1.x then 1 else 0 in
      if dy < 0. then (1 - a, 1 - b) else (a, b)
    else if (dx > 0.) = (dy > 0.) then (side left top, side right bottom)
    else (side right top, side left bottom) in
  if p1 = p2 then p1 else -1

(* what P_CheckPosition finds for the box at (x, y) *)
type position = {
  ok : bool;
  pfloorz : float;
  pceilingz : float;
  pdropoffz : float; (* the lowest floor under the box *)
  blocker : Level.line option; (* the line that stopped it, or that set the room *)
  special_lines : Level.line list;
  hit : Things.target; (* a missile's: what it ran into *)
}

(* the box of who moves: its radius, its feet, its height *)
let box (t : t) (who : Things.target) : float * float * float =
  match who with
  | Things.Thing m -> (Things.radius m, m.mz, Things.height m)
  | _ -> (radius, t.player.z, height)

(* P_CheckPosition, PIT_CheckLine, P_LineOpening: the lines of the
 * blockmap's cells under the box; then PIT_CheckThing: the solid
 * things', and the player's for a thing *)
let check_position (t : t) (who : Things.target) (x : float) (y : float) : position =
  let level = t.level in
  let s = Level.sector_at level x y in
  let radius, z, h = box t who in
  let mover = match who with Things.Thing m -> Some m | _ -> None in
  let is_missile =
    match mover with Some m -> m.flags land Info.missile <> 0 | None -> false in
  let floorz = ref s.floor and ceilingz = ref s.ceiling and dropoffz = ref s.floor in
  let blocker = ref None and specials = ref [] and ok = ref true in
  let hit = ref Things.Nobody in
  let left = x -. radius and right = x +. radius and bottom = y -. radius and top = y +. radius in
  let bm = level.blockmap in
  let cell (v : float) (o : float) : int = int_of_float (Float.floor ((v -. o) /. 128.)) in
  let xl = max 0 (cell left bm.originx) and xh = min (bm.columns - 1) (cell right bm.originx) in
  let yl = max 0 (cell bottom bm.originy) and yh = min (bm.rows - 1) (cell top bm.originy) in
  let seen = Hashtbl.create 16 in
  for by = yl to yh do
    for bx = xl to xh do
      Array.iter
        (fun (k : int) ->
          if !ok && not (Hashtbl.mem seen k) then begin
            Hashtbl.replace seen k ();
            let l = level.lines.(k) in
            let lleft = Float.min l.v1.x l.v2.x and lright = Float.max l.v1.x l.v2.x in
            let lbottom = Float.min l.v1.y l.v2.y and ltop = Float.max l.v1.y l.v2.y in
            (* (a monster's lines too: ML_BLOCKMONSTERS, 2; not a
             * missile's) *)
            let blocks =
              (l.flags land Level.blocking <> 0 && not is_missile)
              || (mover <> None && not is_missile && l.flags land 2 <> 0) in
            if right > lleft && left < lright && top > lbottom && bottom < ltop && box_on_line_side left right bottom top l = -1 then
              match (l.back, Level.line_sector level l 0, Level.line_sector level l 1) with
              | Some _, Some f, Some b when not blocks ->
                  let opentop = Float.min f.ceiling b.ceiling and openbottom = Float.max f.floor b.floor in
                  let lowfloor = Float.min f.floor b.floor in
                  if opentop < !ceilingz then begin ceilingz := opentop; blocker := Some l end;
                  if openbottom > !floorz then begin floorz := openbottom; blocker := Some l end;
                  if lowfloor < !dropoffz then dropoffz := lowfloor;
                  if l.special <> 0 then specials := l :: !specials
              | _ ->
                  ok := false;
                  blocker := Some l
          end)
        bm.cells.((by * bm.columns) + bx)
    done
  done;
  (* PIT_CheckThing: a solid thing's box and the mover's overlap; a
   * missile's, a shootable thing hit (not its shooter, its target) *)
  let overlaps (ox : float) (oy : float) (r : float) : bool =
    let d = r +. radius in
    Float.abs (ox -. x) < d && Float.abs (oy -. y) < d in
  List.iter
    (fun (m : Things.mobj) ->
      let self = match mover with Some me -> me == m | None -> false in
      let blocks = m.flags land (Info.solid lor Info.shootable) <> 0 in
      if !ok && m.alive && (not self) && blocks
         && overlaps m.mx m.my (Things.radius m)
      then
        if is_missile then begin
          let shooter =
            match mover with
            | Some me -> (match me.target with Things.Thing s -> s == m | _ -> false)
            | None -> false in
          (* (over it or under it: missed) *)
          let across = z <= m.mz +. Things.height m && z +. h >= m.mz in
          if (not shooter) && across && m.flags land Info.shootable <> 0
          then begin
            ok := false;
            hit := Things.Thing m
          end
        end
        else if m.flags land Info.solid <> 0 then ok := false)
    t.things;
  (* (the player, for a thing; dead, not solid) *)
  (match mover with
  | Some m
    when !ok && t.player.health > 0 && overlaps t.player.x t.player.y radius ->
      let p = t.player in
      if not is_missile then ok := false
      else if m.target <> Things.The_player && z <= p.z +. height
              && z +. h >= p.z
      then begin
        ok := false;
        hit := Things.The_player
      end
  | _ -> ());
  { ok = !ok; pfloorz = !floorz; pceilingz = !ceilingz; pdropoffz = !dropoffz;
    blocker = !blocker; special_lines = !specials; hit = !hit }

(* P_TryMove: the player moved to (x, y) if it fits; each line with a
 * special crossed given to [cross] (P_CrossSpecialLine, which id's
 * P_TryMove calls itself: here Specials', by Play) *)
let try_move (cross : Level.line -> unit) (t : t) (x : float) (y : float) : bool * Level.line option =
  let p = t.player in
  let pos = check_position t Things.The_player x y in
  if not pos.ok then (false, pos.blocker)
  else if pos.pceilingz -. pos.pfloorz < height || pos.pceilingz -. p.z < height || pos.pfloorz -. p.z > maxstep then (false, pos.blocker)
  else begin
    let oldx = p.x and oldy = p.y in
    p.x <- x;
    p.y <- y;
    p.floorz <- pos.pfloorz;
    p.ceilingz <- pos.pceilingz;
    List.iter
      (fun (l : Level.line) ->
        if l.special <> 0 && Level.point_on_line_side oldx oldy l <> Level.point_on_line_side x y l then cross l)
      pos.special_lines;
    (true, None)
  end

(* P_UnsetThingPosition, P_SetThingPosition: a thing in its sector's
 * list, for Render *)
let set_position (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) (x : float) (y : float) : unit =
  let s = Level.sector_at t.level x y in
  if s != m.sector then begin
    let k = m.sector.index in
    t.by_sector.(k) <- List.filter (fun (o : Things.mobj) -> o != m) t.by_sector.(k);
    t.by_sector.(s.index) <- m :: t.by_sector.(s.index);
    m.sector <- s
  end;
  m.mx <- x;
  m.my <- y

(* P_TryMove for a thing: the room to stand, a step of 24 at most, and
 * (a monster) no drop of more than 24 either; else the position's,
 * whose lines with specials P_Move may open *)
let try_move_thing (t : t) (m : Things.mobj) (x : float) (y : float)
    : bool * position =
  let pos = check_position t (Things.Thing m) x y in
  let h = Things.height m in
  let fits =
    pos.ok && pos.pceilingz -. pos.pfloorz >= h && pos.pceilingz -. m.mz >= h
    && (m.flags land Info.missile <> 0 || pos.pfloorz -. m.mz <= maxstep)
    && (m.flags land (Info.dropoff lor Info.missile) <> 0
        || pos.pfloorz -. pos.pdropoffz <= maxstep) in
  if fits then begin
    set_position t m x y;
    m.floorz <- pos.pfloorz;
    m.ceilingz <- pos.pceilingz
  end;
  (fits, pos)

(* the player's place again after a sector moved (P_ChangeSector,
 * P_ThingHeightClip): on the floor, he goes with it; false if he no
 * longer fits. The things' too: one that no longer fits stops the
 * sector as the player does, but a corpse (crushed, in id's) *)
let change_sector (t : t) : bool =
  let p = t.player in
  let onfloor = p.z = p.floorz in
  let pos = check_position t Things.The_player p.x p.y in
  p.floorz <- pos.pfloorz;
  p.ceilingz <- pos.pceilingz;
  if onfloor then p.z <- p.floorz else if p.z +. height > p.ceilingz then p.z <- p.ceilingz -. height;
  let things_fit =
    List.for_all
      (fun (m : Things.mobj) ->
        let collides = m.actor <> None && m.flags land Info.noblockmap = 0 in
        if not (m.alive && collides) then true
        else begin
          let onfloor = m.mz = m.floorz in
          let pos = check_position t (Things.Thing m) m.mx m.my in
          m.floorz <- pos.pfloorz;
          m.ceilingz <- pos.pceilingz;
          if onfloor then m.mz <- m.floorz;
          m.ceilingz -. m.floorz >= Things.height m || m.flags land Info.corpse <> 0
        end)
      t.things in
  p.ceilingz -. p.floorz >= height && things_fit

(* P_UseLines, PTR_UseTraverse: the lines across the 64 ahead, nearest
 * first; the first with a special is the one used, from its front; one
 * that closes the way ends it *)
let use_target (t : t) : Level.line option =
  let p = t.player in
  let x2 = p.x +. (userange *. View.fcos p.angle) and y2 = p.y +. (userange *. View.fsin p.angle) in
  let dx = x2 -. p.x and dy = y2 -. p.y in
  let hits =
    List.filter_map
      (fun (l : Level.line) ->
        let ex = l.v2.x -. l.v1.x and ey = l.v2.y -. l.v1.y in
        let den = (dx *. ey) -. (dy *. ex) in
        if den = 0. then None
        else
          let u = (((l.v1.x -. p.x) *. ey) -. ((l.v1.y -. p.y) *. ex)) /. den in
          let v = (((l.v1.x -. p.x) *. dy) -. ((l.v1.y -. p.y) *. dx)) /. den in
          if u >= 0. && u <= 1. && v >= 0. && v <= 1. then Some (u, l) else None)
      (Array.to_list t.level.lines) in
  let sorted = List.sort (fun ((a, _) : float * Level.line) ((b, _) : float * Level.line) -> compare a b) hits in
  let rec go (l : (float * Level.line) list) : Level.line option =
    match l with
    | [] -> None
    | (_, line) :: rest ->
        if line.special <> 0 then (if Level.point_on_line_side p.x p.y line = 0 then Some line else None)
        else
          match (Level.line_sector t.level line 0, Level.line_sector t.level line 1) with
          | Some f, Some b when Float.min f.ceiling b.ceiling -. Float.max f.floor b.floor > 0. -> go rest
          | _ -> None in
  go sorted

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Along a line: what sees, what shoots *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the lines of the blockmap's cells a segment goes through, each once
 * (P_PathTraverse's walk of the cells, Amanatides and Woo's: from one
 * cell to the next across whichever of its sides the segment meets
 * first) *)
let lines_along (t : t) (x1 : float) (y1 : float) (x2 : float) (y2 : float)
    : Level.line list =
  let bm = t.level.blockmap in
  let cx (x : float) : float = (x -. bm.originx) /. 128.
  and cy (y : float) : float = (y -. bm.originy) /. 128. in
  let fx1 = cx x1 and fy1 = cy y1 and fx2 = cx x2 and fy2 = cy y2 in
  let bx = ref (int_of_float (Float.floor fx1))
  and by = ref (int_of_float (Float.floor fy1)) in
  let ex = int_of_float (Float.floor fx2) and ey = int_of_float (Float.floor fy2) in
  let dx = fx2 -. fx1 and dy = fy2 -. fy1 in
  let stepx = if dx > 0. then 1 else -1 and stepy = if dy > 0. then 1 else -1 in
  (* (the fraction of the segment to the next column's side, the next
   * row's, and the fraction a whole cell is) *)
  let delta (d : float) : float = if d = 0. then infinity else Float.abs (1. /. d) in
  let first (f : float) (d : float) (b : int) : float =
    if d > 0. then (float (b + 1) -. f) *. delta d
    else if d < 0. then (f -. float b) *. delta d
    else infinity in
  let tx = ref (first fx1 dx !bx) and ty = ref (first fy1 dy !by) in
  let seen = Hashtbl.create 64 and acc = ref [] in
  let visit (x : int) (y : int) : unit =
    if x >= 0 && x < bm.columns && y >= 0 && y < bm.rows then
      Array.iter
        (fun (k : int) ->
          if not (Hashtbl.mem seen k) then begin
            Hashtbl.replace seen k ();
            acc := t.level.lines.(k) :: !acc
          end)
        bm.cells.((y * bm.columns) + x) in
  visit !bx !by;
  let n = abs (ex - !bx) + abs (ey - !by) in
  for _i = 1 to n do
    if !tx < !ty then begin bx := !bx + stepx; tx := !tx +. delta dx end
    else begin by := !by + stepy; ty := !ty +. delta dy end;
    visit !bx !by
  done;
  !acc

(* where the segment from (x1, y1) by (dx, dy) crosses the line, as a
 * fraction of the segment, if it does *)
let crossing (x1 : float) (y1 : float) (dx : float) (dy : float)
    (l : Level.line) : float option =
  let ex = l.v2.x -. l.v1.x and ey = l.v2.y -. l.v1.y in
  let den = (dx *. ey) -. (dy *. ex) in
  if den = 0. then None
  else
    let u = (((l.v1.x -. x1) *. ey) -. ((l.v1.y -. y1) *. ex)) /. den in
    let v = (((l.v1.x -. x1) *. dy) -. ((l.v1.y -. y1) *. dx)) /. den in
    if u >= 0. && u <= 1. && v >= 0. && v <= 1. then Some u else None

(* P_LineOpening: the room between a two-sided line's sectors, the
 * higher floor and the lower ceiling; None for a wall *)
let opening (t : t) (l : Level.line) : (float * float) option =
  match (Level.line_sector t.level l 0, Level.line_sector t.level l 1) with
  | Some f, Some b when l.back <> None ->
      Some (Float.max f.floor b.floor, Float.min f.ceiling b.ceiling)
  | _ -> None

(* P_CheckSight: from the eye at (x1, y1, z1) to the box of (x2, y2)
 * from z2 to z2 + h2, a part of it seen through every line between:
 * id keeps the slopes of the eye to the top and the bottom of what is
 * still in view, and narrows them at each opening; seen if some is
 * left. (id walks the BSP from both ends; here the blockmap's cells
 * along the line, the same lines) *)
let check_sight (t : t) (x1 : float) (y1 : float) (z1 : float) (x2 : float)
    (y2 : float) (z2 : float) (h2 : float) : bool =
  let dx = x2 -. x1 and dy = y2 -. y1 in
  let dist = Float.sqrt ((dx *. dx) +. (dy *. dy)) in
  let top = ref ((z2 +. h2 -. z1) /. dist) and bottom = ref ((z2 -. z1) /. dist) in
  List.for_all
    (fun (l : Level.line) ->
      match crossing x1 y1 dx dy l with
      | None -> true
      | Some u -> (
          match opening t l with
          | None -> false
          | Some (openbottom, opentop) ->
              let d = u *. dist in
              if openbottom >= opentop then false
              else if d <= 0. then true
              else begin
                top := Float.min !top ((opentop -. z1) /. d);
                bottom := Float.max !bottom ((openbottom -. z1) /. d);
                !top > !bottom
              end))
    (lines_along t x1 y1 x2 y2)

(* what a shot's line meets (P_PathTraverse's intercepts): a line, a
 * thing, the player, at a fraction of the way, the nearest first *)
type intercept =
  | Line of float * Level.line
  | Thing_hit of float * Things.mobj
  | Player_hit of float

let fraction (i : intercept) : float =
  match i with Line (f, _) | Thing_hit (f, _) | Player_hit f -> f

(* [intercepts t shooter x1 y1 x2 y2]: the lines across, and the things
 * (not the shooter) whose box the line goes through: here their
 * nearest point to the line within their radius (id: the box's
 * diagonal facing the line, PIT_AddThingIntercepts) *)
let intercepts (t : t) (shooter : Things.target) (x1 : float) (y1 : float)
    (x2 : float) (y2 : float) : intercept list =
  let dx = x2 -. x1 and dy = y2 -. y1 in
  let len2 = (dx *. dx) +. (dy *. dy) in
  let near (x : float) (y : float) (r : float) : float option =
    let u = (((x -. x1) *. dx) +. ((y -. y1) *. dy)) /. len2 in
    let px = x1 +. (u *. dx) and py = y1 +. (u *. dy) in
    let d2 = ((x -. px) *. (x -. px)) +. ((y -. py) *. (y -. py)) in
    if d2 > r *. r then None
    else
      let u = u -. (Float.sqrt ((r *. r) -. d2) /. Float.sqrt len2) in
      if u >= 0. && u <= 1. then Some u else None in
  let lines =
    List.filter_map
      (fun (l : Level.line) ->
        Option.map (fun (u : float) -> Line (u, l)) (crossing x1 y1 dx dy l))
      (lines_along t x1 y1 x2 y2) in
  let things =
    List.filter_map
      (fun (m : Things.mobj) ->
        let self = match shooter with Things.Thing s -> s == m | _ -> false in
        if m.alive && (not self) && m.flags land Info.shootable <> 0 then
          Option.map
            (fun (u : float) -> Thing_hit (u, m))
            (near m.mx m.my (Things.radius m))
        else None)
      t.things in
  let player =
    if shooter = Things.The_player || t.player.health <= 0 then []
    else
      match near t.player.x t.player.y radius with
      | Some u -> [ Player_hit u ]
      | None -> [] in
  List.sort
    (fun (a : intercept) (b : intercept) -> compare (fraction a) (fraction b))
    (lines @ things @ player)

(* Collision: where the player can be (Doom's p_map.c, p_maputl.c). The
 * player is a box of 32 by 32, 56 high; a place is tried against the
 * lines near it, found by the blockmap, the level cut in cells of 128
 * by 128, each with the lines that cross it (Level):
 *
 *     +-------+-------+       the box (#) touches four cells; only
 *     |    ## | ##    |       their lines are tried, not the level's
 *     |    ## | ##    |       hundreds (P_CheckPosition's
 *     +-------+-------+       P_BlockLinesIterator)
 *     |    ## | ##    |
 *     +-------+-------+
 *
 * A line the box crosses (P_BoxOnLineSide: its corners on both sides)
 * stops it if it is one-sided or blocking; a two-sided one narrows the
 * room (P_LineOpening: the higher floor, the lower ceiling of its two
 * sectors). The place fits if the room is 56 high, under the ceiling,
 * and the floor at most a step of 24 above the feet (P_TryMove).
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-doom: Play's moves (P_XYMovement) try their
 * places here and Specials' sectors that move ask whether the player
 * still fits (change_sector). The things block too: a solid thing's box
 * (PIT_CheckThing). *)

(* P_BoxOnLineSide: 0 or 1 if the box (left, right, bottom, top) is all
 * on one side of the line, else -1 *)
val box_on_line_side : float -> float -> float -> float -> Level.line -> int

(* what P_CheckPosition finds for the box at (x, y) *)
type position = {
  ok : bool;
  pfloorz : float;
  pceilingz : float;
  pdropoffz : float; (* the lowest floor under the box *)
  blocker : Level.line option; (* the line that stopped it, or that set the room *)
  special_lines : Level.line list;
  hit : Things.target; (* a missile's: what it ran into *)
}

(* [check_position t who x y]: the player's box there, or a thing's; a
 * thing's stopped by the player too, and by the lines that block the
 * monsters (ML_BLOCKMONSTERS); a missile's by no line that is open,
 * and by what it can hit, not its shooter *)
val check_position : World.t -> Things.target -> float -> float -> position

(* [try_move cross t x y]: the player moved to (x, y) if it fits, and
 * each line with a special it crossed given to [cross]; else the line
 * in the way, if one is *)
val try_move : (Level.line -> unit) -> World.t -> float -> float -> bool * Level.line option

(* [set_position t m x y]: P_SetThingPosition: the thing there, and in
 * its sector's list *)
val set_position : World.t -> Things.mobj -> float -> float -> unit

(* [try_move_thing t m x y]: P_TryMove for a thing: moved if it fits
 * (the room, a step of 24, a monster no drop of more than 24); and the
 * position found *)
val try_move_thing : World.t -> Things.mobj -> float -> float -> bool * position

(* P_ChangeSector, P_ThingHeightClip: the player's floor and ceiling
 * again after a sector moved, the player on the floor going with it,
 * the things' too; false if one no longer fits (a corpse does) *)
val change_sector : World.t -> bool

(* P_UseLines: the line the use key acts on, if one is in reach *)
val use_target : World.t -> Level.line option

(* the lines of the blockmap's cells a segment goes through *)
val lines_along : World.t -> float -> float -> float -> float -> Level.line list

(* P_LineOpening: a two-sided line's room, its higher floor and lower
 * ceiling; None for a wall *)
val opening : World.t -> Level.line -> (float * float) option

(* [check_sight t x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2 h2]: P_CheckSight: from the eye at
 * (x1, y1, z1), some of the box at (x2, y2) from z2 up h2 seen through
 * the openings between (the slopes to its top and bottom narrowed at
 * each) *)
val check_sight :
  World.t -> float -> float -> float -> float -> float -> float -> float ->
  bool

(* what a shot's line meets: a line, a thing, the player, at a fraction
 * of the way *)
type intercept =
  | Line of float * Level.line
  | Thing_hit of float * Things.mobj
  | Player_hit of float

val fraction : intercept -> float

(* [intercepts t shooter x1 y1 x2 y2]: P_PathTraverse's: the lines
 * across and the shootable things the line goes through (their nearest
 * point within their radius), not the shooter; the nearest first *)
val intercepts :
  World.t -> Things.target -> float -> float -> float -> float ->
  intercept list

open World

type cmd = {
  forward : int;
  side : int;
  turn : int;
  use : bool;
  attack : bool;
  change : Info.weapon option;

let secrets_total (t : t) : int = Array.fold_left (fun (n : int) (s : Level.sector) -> if s.special = 9 then n + 1 else n) t.secrets t.level.sectors

let psprite () : psprite = { pstate = None; ptics = 0; sx = 1.; sy = 128. }

let create (level : Level.t) (textures : Textures.t) (monsters : bool)
    (ai : ai) : t =
  let start = match List.find_opt (fun (th : Level.thing) -> th.kind = 1) (Array.to_list level.things) with Some s -> s | None -> failwith (level.name ^ ": no player's start") in
  let s = Level.sector_at level start.tx start.ty in
  let player =
    { x = start.tx; y = start.ty; z = s.floor; angle = start.tangle; momx = 0.; momy = 0.; momz = 0.; floorz = s.floor; ceilingz = s.ceiling;
      viewheight; deltaviewheight = 0.; viewz = s.floor +. viewheight; bob = 0.; turnheld = 0; keys = [];
      health = 100; armor = 0; weapons = [ Info.Fist; Info.Pistol ];
      readyweapon = Info.Pistol; pendingweapon = None; clips = 50; shells = 0;
      weapon_sp = psprite (); flash_sp = psprite (); attackdown = false;
      refire = 0; extralight = 0; damagecount = 0; bonuscount = 0;
      attacker = None } in
  let things = Things.spawn level monsters in
  let by_sector = Array.make (Array.length level.sectors) [] in
  List.iter (fun (m : Things.mobj) -> by_sector.(m.sector.index) <- m :: by_sector.(m.sector.index)) things;
  let t =
    { level; textures; player; things; by_sector; tic = 0; thinkers = [];
      message = ""; message_tics = 0; exited = false; secrets = 0; kills = 0;
      sounds = []; ai; heard = Array.make (Array.length level.sectors) false;
      reborn = false } in
  ignore (Collision.change_sector t);
  Specials.spawn_lights t;
  Weapons.setup t;
  t

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The player *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let place (t : t) (x : float) (y : float) (angle : float) : unit =
  let p = t.player in
  p.x <- x;
  p.y <- y;
  p.angle <- angle;
  p.momx <- 0.;
  p.momy <- 0.;
  ignore (Collision.change_sector t);
  p.z <- p.floorz;
  p.viewheight <- viewheight;
  p.viewz <- p.z +. viewheight

(* the move tried, the lines crossed doing what they do *)
let try_move (t : t) (x : float) (y : float) : bool * Level.line option =
  Collision.try_move (fun (l : Level.line) -> Specials.line_special t l false) t x y

(* P_XYMovement: the momentum moved, half at a time when large; along
 * the wall when it stops it (P_SlideMove's purpose, by the projection
 * of the momentum on the wall, then each axis alone) *)
let xy_movement (t : t) (moving : bool) : unit =
  let p = t.player in
  let clamp (v : float) : float = Float.max (-.maxmove) (Float.min maxmove v) in
  p.momx <- clamp p.momx;
  p.momy <- clamp p.momy;
  let steps = if Float.abs p.momx > maxmove /. 2. || Float.abs p.momy > maxmove /. 2. then 2 else 1 in
  let n = float steps in
  for _n = 1 to steps do
    let mx = p.momx /. n and my = p.momy /. n in
    match try_move t (p.x +. mx) (p.y +. my) with
    | true, _ -> ()
    | false, blocker ->
        let slid =
          match blocker with
          | Some l ->
              let ex = l.v2.x -. l.v1.x and ey = l.v2.y -. l.v1.y in
              let len2 = (ex *. ex) +. (ey *. ey) in
              let k = ((mx *. ex) +. (my *. ey)) /. len2 in
              fst (try_move t (p.x +. (k *. ex)) (p.y +. (k *. ey)))
          | None -> false in
        if not slid then
          if not (fst (try_move t (p.x +. mx) p.y)) then
            if not (fst (try_move t p.x (p.y +. my))) then begin p.momx <- 0.; p.momy <- 0. end
  done;
  (* (no friction in the air) *)
  if p.z <= p.floorz then
    if Float.abs p.momx < stopspeed && Float.abs p.momy < stopspeed && not moving then begin p.momx <- 0.; p.momy <- 0. end
    else begin
      p.momx <- p.momx *. friction;
      p.momy <- p.momy *. friction
    end

(* P_ZMovement: a step up climbed by the feet at once, by the eye
 * smoothly; a fall by gravity, 1 a tic a tic *)
let z_movement (t : t) : unit =
  let p = t.player in
  if p.z < p.floorz then begin
    p.viewheight <- p.viewheight -. (p.floorz -. p.z);
    p.deltaviewheight <- (viewheight -. p.viewheight) /. 8.
  end;
  p.z <- p.z +. p.momz;
  if p.z <= p.floorz then begin
    if p.momz < 0. then begin
      if p.momz < -8. then p.deltaviewheight <- p.momz /. 8.;
      p.momz <- 0.
    end;
    p.z <- p.floorz
  end
  else p.momz <- (if p.momz = 0. then -2. else p.momz -. 1.);
  if p.z +. height > p.ceilingz then begin
    if p.momz > 0. then p.momz <- 0.;
    p.z <- p.ceilingz -. height
  end

(* P_CalcHeight: the eye *)
let calc_height (t : t) : unit =
  let p = t.player in
  p.bob <- Float.min maxbob (((p.momx *. p.momx) +. (p.momy *. p.momy)) /. 4.);
  if p.z > p.floorz then p.viewz <- Float.min (p.ceilingz -. 4.) (p.z +. viewheight)
  else begin
    let bob = p.bob /. 2. *. View.fsin (2. *. pi *. float t.tic /. 20.) in
    p.viewheight <- p.viewheight +. p.deltaviewheight;
    if p.viewheight > viewheight then begin p.viewheight <- viewheight; p.deltaviewheight <- 0. end;
    if p.viewheight < viewheight /. 2. then begin
      p.viewheight <- viewheight /. 2.;
      if p.deltaviewheight <= 0. then p.deltaviewheight <- 1. /. 65536.
    end;
    if p.deltaviewheight <> 0. then p.deltaviewheight <- p.deltaviewheight +. 0.25;
    p.viewz <- Float.min (p.ceilingz -. 4.) (p.z +. p.viewheight +. bob)
  end

(* P_DeathThink: the eye down to 6 above the floor, a unit a tic,
 * turned to the killer; use, and the level again *)
let death_think (t : t) (cmd : cmd) : unit =
  let p = t.player in
  if p.viewheight > 6. then p.viewheight <- p.viewheight -. 1.;
  if p.viewheight < 6. then p.viewheight <- 6.;
  p.deltaviewheight <- 0.;
  p.viewz <- p.z +. p.viewheight;
  (match p.attacker with
  | Some m when m.alive ->
      let a = Float.atan2 (m.my -. p.y) (m.mx -. p.x) in
      let d = View.norm (a -. p.angle) in
      if d < pi /. 32. || d > 2. *. pi -. (pi /. 32.) then p.angle <- a
      else p.angle <- p.angle +. (if d < pi then pi /. 32. else -.(pi /. 32.))
  | _ -> ());
  if cmd.use then t.reborn <- true

let use_down = ref false

(* P_PlayerThink, P_MovePlayer: the turn, the thrust, the eye, a secret
 * found, a line used *)
let move_player (t : t) (cmd : cmd) : unit =
  let p = t.player in
  p.angle <- p.angle +. (float cmd.turn *. 2. *. pi /. 65536.);
  let onground = p.z <= p.floorz in
  if onground then begin
    let thrust (a : float) (move : int) : unit =
      let m = float move /. 32. in
      p.momx <- p.momx +. (m *. View.fcos a);
      p.momy <- p.momy +. (m *. View.fsin a) in
    if cmd.forward <> 0 then thrust p.angle cmd.forward;
    if cmd.side <> 0 then thrust (p.angle -. (pi /. 2.)) cmd.side
  end;
  calc_height t;
  let s = Level.sector_at t.level p.x p.y in
  (* P_PlayerInSpecialSector: a secret found *)
  if s.special = 9 && p.z = s.floor then begin s.special <- 0; t.secrets <- t.secrets + 1 end;
  if cmd.use && not !use_down then Option.iter (fun (l : Level.line) -> Specials.line_special t l true) (Collision.use_target t);
  use_down := cmd.use

let tic (t : t) (cmd : cmd) : unit =
  let p = t.player in
  t.tic <- t.tic + 1;
  if p.health <= 0 then death_think t cmd else move_player t cmd;
  Weapons.tic t cmd.attack cmd.change;
  (* P_RunThinkers: the player's body first, then the others *)
  if p.momx <> 0. || p.momy <> 0. then xy_movement t (cmd.forward <> 0 || cmd.side <> 0);
  if p.z <> p.floorz || p.momz <> 0. then z_movement t;
  Inter.touch_specials t;
  (* the things that act (P_MobjThinker); those made during it from the
   * next tic *)
  List.iter
    (fun (m : Things.mobj) ->
      if m.alive && m.actor <> None then Mobj.think t (Inter.missile_hit t) m)
    t.things;
  t.things <- List.filter (fun (m : Things.mobj) -> m.alive) t.things;
  List.iter (fun (th : thinker) -> if th.alive then Specials.think t th) t.thinkers;
  t.thinkers <- List.filter (fun (th : thinker) -> th.alive) t.thinkers;
  (* P_UpdateSpecials *)
  Textures.animate t.textures t.tic;
  if t.message_tics > 0 then t.message_tics <- t.message_tics - 1;
  if p.damagecount > 0 then p.damagecount <- p.damagecount - 1;
  if p.bonuscount > 0 then p.bonuscount <- p.bonuscount - 1

type keys = {
  up : bool;
  down : bool;
  left : bool;
  right : bool;
  run : bool;
  strafe_left : bool;
  strafe_right : bool;
  use_key : bool;
  fire : bool;
  number : int;
}

(* G_BuildTiccmd *)
let command (p : player) (k : keys) : cmd =
  if k.left || k.right then p.turnheld <- p.turnheld + 1 else p.turnheld <- 0;
  let turnspeed = if p.turnheld < 6 then 320 else if k.run then 1280 else 640 in
  let forwardmove = if k.run then 50 else 25 and sidemove = if k.run then 40 else 24 in
  { forward = (if k.up then forwardmove else 0) - if k.down then forwardmove else 0;
    side = (if k.strafe_right then sidemove else 0) - if k.strafe_left then sidemove else 0;
    turn = (if k.left then turnspeed else 0) - if k.right then turnspeed else 0;
    use = k.use_key; attack = k.fire;
    (* (1: the chainsaw when held and not in hand, else the fist) *)
    change =
      (match k.number with
      | 1 ->
          let saw = List.mem Info.Chainsaw p.weapons && p.readyweapon <> Info.Chainsaw in
          Some (if saw then Info.Chainsaw else Info.Fist)
      | 2 -> Some Info.Pistol
      | 3 -> Some Info.Shotgun
      | _ -> None) }
games/fps/doom/play/Play.mli
3571
(* Play: the world moving, a tic (1/35 s) at a time, Doom's p_*.c for a
 * player alone in a level: the walk, the walls, the steps, the doors,
 * the lifts, the lights that flicker, the switches, the exit.
 *
 * A tic is the player's command (G_BuildTiccmd: forward, sideways, the
 * turn, use), then the player (P_PlayerThink), then everything else
 * that moves (P_RunThinkers: a door, a lift, a light; id's "thinkers",
 * a function called each tic until it removes itself):
 *
 *   the command          the momentum           the move
 *   forward 25 (walk)    += 25/32 a tic along    the box of 32 by 32
 *   50 (run)             the angle (P_Thrust),   tried at its new place
 *                        then * 0.90625 on the   (P_TryMove): every line
 *                        ground (FRICTION):      of the blockmap's cells
 *                        8 units a tic at most   it touches; a wall, or
 *                        walking                 a step over 24, or less
 *                                                than 56 to stand: no.
 *                                                Along the wall then
 *                                                (P_SlideMove's idea)
 *
 * The eye is 41 above the feet (VIEWHEIGHT), bobs with the speed, and
 * a step up is climbed at once by the feet and smoothly by the eye
 * (P_CalcHeight's deltaviewheight).
 *
 * Its parts are id's files: World (the state, the thinkers), Collision
 * (p_map.c: where the player can be), Specials (p_spec.c and the
 * others: what the lines and the sectors do), and this one, p_user.c
 * (the player), p_tick.c (the tic) and g_game.c's G_BuildTiccmd.
 *
 * Then the weapon in hand (Weapons), every thing that acts (Mobj's
 * P_MobjThinker: the monsters, their fireballs, the puffs), the items
 * picked up (Inter). Dead, the player's eye sinks to the floor, turned
 * to its killer, until use is pressed (P_DeathThink).
 *
 * What is not here: the keys' cards picked up but not drawn, the
 * dropoff and the falls' damage, the floors that hurt.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-doom: Doom.ml gives it the keys and reads the
 * eye from its World, for Render; it changes Level's sectors and sides
 * in place, which Render draws as they are. *)

(* a tic's command: forward and sideways (Doom's units: 25 a walk, 50 a
 * run; sideways 24 and 40), the turn (in 1/65536 of a turn: 640 a
 * walk, 1280 a run, the first tics of a turn 320), and use *)
type cmd = {
  forward : int;
  side : int;
  turn : int;
  use : bool;
  attack : bool;
  change : Info.weapon option; (* the weapon asked for *)
}

(* [create level textures monsters ai]: the player at the level's
 * start (thing 1), with a pistol and 50 bullets, the things spawned
 * (the monsters if asked), the sectors' lights started *)
val create : Level.t -> Textures.t -> bool -> World.ai -> World.t

(* [place t x y angle]: the player there, on the floor, still (a test's
 * camera, as the reference's: games/fps/doom/tests) *)
val place : World.t -> float -> float -> float -> unit

(* [tic t cmd]: a 35th of a second *)
val tic : World.t -> cmd -> unit

(* the keys held *)
type keys = {
  up : bool;
  down : bool;
  left : bool;
  right : bool;
  run : bool;
  strafe_left : bool;
  strafe_right : bool;
  use_key : bool;
  fire : bool;
  number : int; (* a weapon's key, 1 to 4; 0 none *)
}

(* the command from the keys held; [turnheld] counts the tics a turn
 * has been held (a turn starts slow) *)
val command : World.player -> keys -> cmd

(* the secrets of the level, all *)
val secrets_total : World.t -> int

(* Claude Code

(* See Specials.mli *)

open World

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The lines *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* a key's thing numbers: a card and a skull of each colour *)
let has_key (t : t) (colour : string) : bool =
  let cards = match colour with "blue" -> [ 5; 40 ] | "yellow" -> [ 6; 39 ] | _ -> [ 13; 38 ] in
  List.exists (fun (k : int) -> List.mem k t.player.keys) cards

(* a sector's sounds come from the middle of its box (id's soundorg) *)
let sound (t : t) (s : Level.sector) (sfx : string) : unit =
  let vs =
    List.concat_map
      (fun (k : int) -> let l = t.level.lines.(k) in [ l.v1; l.v2 ])
      s.lines in
  match vs with
  | [] -> start_sound t None sfx
  | v :: _ ->
      let mid (f : Level.vertex -> float) : float =
        let low = List.fold_left (fun (a : float) (v : Level.vertex) -> Float.min a (f v)) (f v) vs in
        let high = List.fold_left (fun (a : float) (v : Level.vertex) -> Float.max a (f v)) (f v) vs in
        (low +. high) /. 2. in
      let x (v : Level.vertex) : float = v.x and y (v : Level.vertex) : float = v.y in
      start_sound t (Some (mid x, mid y)) sfx

(* the doors' sounds: the blazing ones' (8 a tic) their own *)
let door_sound (t : t) (d : door) (up : bool) : unit =
  let blazing = d.dspeed > 2. in
  sound t d.dsector
    (match (up, blazing) with
    | true, false -> "doropn"
    | true, true -> "bdopn"
    | false, false -> "dorcls"
    | false, true -> "bdcls")

(* EV_DoDoor, EV_VerticalDoor: [manual] the line's back sector, else
 * the line's tagged sectors *)
let do_door (t : t) (l : Level.line) (kind : door_kind) (speed : float) (manual : bool) : unit =
  let start (s : Level.sector) : unit =
    match busy t s with
    | Some { what = Door d; _ } when manual ->
        (* (used again: it turns back) *)
        if kind = Raise then begin
          d.ddir <- (if d.ddir = -1 then 1 else -1);
          door_sound t d (d.ddir = 1)
        end
    | Some _ -> ()
    | None ->
        let dir = if kind = Close then -1 else 1 in
        let top = lowest_ceiling t s -. 4. in
        let d = { dsector = s; dkind = kind; ddir = dir; topheight = top;
                  dspeed = speed; dcount = 0 } in
        add t (Door d);
        door_sound t d (dir = 1) in
  if manual then Option.iter start (Level.line_sector t.level l 1) else List.iter start (tagged t l.tag)

let do_plat (t : t) (l : Level.line) (speed : float) : unit =
  List.iter
    (fun (s : Level.sector) ->
      if busy t s = None then begin
        sound t s "pstart";
        add t (Plat { psector = s; low = Float.min (lowest_floor t s) s.floor; high = s.floor; pspeed = speed; status = -1; pcount = 0 })
      end)
    (tagged t l.tag)

let do_floor_lowest (t : t) (l : Level.line) : unit =
  List.iter
    (fun (s : Level.sector) -> if busy t s = None then add t (Floor { fsector = s; dest = lowest_floor t s; fspeed = 1.; fdir = -1 }))
    (tagged t l.tag)

(* P_ChangeSwitchTexture: the front side's SW1 made SW2; back after a
 * second when the switch can be used again *)
let switch (t : t) (l : Level.line) (again : bool) : unit =
  let side = t.level.sides.(l.front) in
  let mx = (l.v1.x +. l.v2.x) /. 2. and my = (l.v1.y +. l.v2.y) /. 2. in
  let s = Level.sector_at t.level mx my in
  sound t s (if l.special = 11 || l.special = 51 then "swtchx" else "swtchn");
  let turn (where : int) (get : Level.side -> int) (set : int -> unit) : unit =
    match Textures.switch_of t.textures (get side) with
    | Some other ->
        if again then add t (Button { bside = side; where; texture = get side; btimer = 35 });
        set other
    | None -> () in
  turn 0 (fun (s : Level.side) -> s.top) (fun (k : int) -> side.top <- k);
  turn 1 (fun (s : Level.side) -> s.middle) (fun (k : int) -> side.middle <- k);
  turn 2 (fun (s : Level.side) -> s.bottom) (fun (k : int) -> side.bottom <- k)

(* P_UseSpecialLine and P_CrossSpecialLine together: a line's special,
 * [used] or crossed; a W1 or S1 one is then no more. The doors' speed
 * is 2 a tic (VDOORSPEED), the blazing ones' 8; the lifts' 4 *)
let line_special (t : t) (l : Level.line) (used : bool) : unit =
  let once () : unit = l.special <- 0 in
  let locked (colour : string) (f : unit -> unit) : unit =
    if has_key t colour then f () else say t (Printf.sprintf "You need a %s key to open this door" colour) in
  match (used, l.special) with
  (* DR, D1: the door the line is on *)
  | true, 1 -> do_door t l Raise 2. true
  | true, 26 -> locked "blue" (fun () -> do_door t l Raise 2. true)
  | true, 27 -> locked "yellow" (fun () -> do_door t l Raise 2. true)
  | true, 28 -> locked "red" (fun () -> do_door t l Raise 2. true)
  | true, 117 -> do_door t l Raise 8. true
  | true, 31 -> do_door t l Open 2. true; once ()
  | true, 32 -> locked "blue" (fun () -> do_door t l Open 2. true; once ())
  | true, 33 -> locked "red" (fun () -> do_door t l Open 2. true; once ())
  | true, 34 -> locked "yellow" (fun () -> do_door t l Open 2. true; once ())
  | true, 118 -> do_door t l Open 8. true; once ()
  (* switches: S1 once, SR again *)
  | true, 103 -> do_door t l Open 2. false; switch t l false; once ()
  | true, 63 -> do_door t l Raise 2. false; switch t l true
  | true, 62 -> do_plat t l 4.; switch t l true
  | true, 21 -> do_plat t l 4.; switch t l false; once ()
  | true, 123 -> do_plat t l 8.; switch t l true
  | true, 23 -> do_floor_lowest t l; switch t l false; once ()
  | true, (11 | 51) -> switch t l false; t.exited <- true
  (* walked over: W1 once, WR again *)
  | false, 2 -> do_door t l Open 2. false; once ()
  | false, 3 -> do_door t l Close 2. false; once ()
  | false, 4 -> do_door t l Raise 2. false; once ()
  | false, 86 -> do_door t l Open 2. false
  | false, 90 -> do_door t l Raise 2. false
  | false, 10 -> do_plat t l 4.; once ()
  | false, 88 -> do_plat t l 4.
  | false, 120 -> do_plat t l 8.
  | false, 38 -> do_floor_lowest t l; once ()
  | false, (52 | 124) -> t.exited <- true
  | _ -> ()

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The thinkers *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type moved = Ok | Crushed | Pastdest

(* T_MovePlane: a sector's floor (or ceiling) [speed] toward [dest];
 * back where it was if the player is in the way *)
let move_plane (t : t) (s : Level.sector) (speed : float) (dest : float) (floor : bool) (dir : int) : moved =
  let get () : float = if floor then s.floor else s.ceiling in
  let set (v : float) : unit = if floor then s.floor <- v else s.ceiling <- v in
  let last = get () in
  let past = if dir < 0 then last -. speed < dest else last +. speed > dest in
  set (if past then dest else if dir < 0 then last -. speed else last +. speed);
  (* (a floor going down, a ceiling going up never crush) *)
  if (floor && dir > 0) || ((not floor) && dir < 0) then begin
    if not (Collision.change_sector t) then begin
      set last;
      ignore (Collision.change_sector t);
      Crushed
    end
    else if past then Pastdest
    else Ok
  end
  else begin
    ignore (Collision.change_sector t);
    if past then Pastdest else Ok
  end

let think (t : t) (th : thinker) : unit =
  match th.what with
  | Door d -> (
      match d.ddir with
      | 0 ->
          d.dcount <- d.dcount - 1;
          if d.dcount <= 0 then begin d.ddir <- -1; door_sound t d false end
      | 1 -> (
          match move_plane t d.dsector d.dspeed d.topheight false 1 with
          | Pastdest -> if d.dkind = Raise then begin d.ddir <- 0; d.dcount <- 150 end else th.alive <- false
          | _ -> ())
      | _ -> (
          match move_plane t d.dsector d.dspeed d.dsector.floor false (-1) with
          | Pastdest -> th.alive <- false
          (* (the player under it: back up) *)
          | Crushed -> d.ddir <- 1; door_sound t d true
          | Ok -> ()))
  | Plat p -> (
      match p.status with
      | 1 -> (
          match move_plane t p.psector p.pspeed p.high true 1 with
          | Crushed -> p.pcount <- 105; p.status <- -1; sound t p.psector "pstart"
          | Pastdest -> th.alive <- false; sound t p.psector "pstop"
          | Ok -> ())
      | -1 -> (
          match move_plane t p.psector p.pspeed p.low true (-1) with
          | Pastdest -> p.pcount <- 105; p.status <- 0; sound t p.psector "pstop"
          | _ -> ())
      | _ ->
          p.pcount <- p.pcount - 1;
          if p.pcount <= 0 then begin
            p.status <- (if p.psector.floor = p.low then 1 else -1);
            sound t p.psector "pstart"
          end)
  | Floor f -> (
      (* (the stone's grinding every 8 tics) *)
      if t.tic land 7 = 0 then sound t f.fsector "stnmov";
      match move_plane t f.fsector f.fspeed f.dest true f.fdir with
      | Pastdest -> th.alive <- false; sound t f.fsector "pstop"
      | _ -> ())
  | Light l -> (
      let s = l.lsector in
      match l.lkind with
      | Flash ->
          l.lcount <- l.lcount - 1;
          if l.lcount <= 0 then
            if s.light = l.maxlight then begin s.light <- l.minlight; l.lcount <- (random () land l.darktime) + 1 end
            else begin s.light <- l.maxlight; l.lcount <- (random () land l.brighttime) + 1 end
      | Strobe ->
          l.lcount <- l.lcount - 1;
          if l.lcount <= 0 then
            if s.light = l.minlight then begin s.light <- l.maxlight; l.lcount <- l.brighttime end
            else begin s.light <- l.minlight; l.lcount <- l.darktime end
      | Glow ->
          if l.gdir < 0 then begin
            s.light <- s.light - 8;
            if s.light <= l.minlight then begin s.light <- s.light + 8; l.gdir <- 1 end
          end
          else begin
            s.light <- s.light + 8;
            if s.light >= l.maxlight then begin s.light <- s.light - 8; l.gdir <- -1 end
          end
      | Flicker ->
          l.lcount <- l.lcount - 1;
          if l.lcount <= 0 then begin
            let amount = (random () land 3) * 16 in
            s.light <- (if s.light - amount < l.minlight then l.minlight else l.maxlight - amount);
            l.lcount <- 4
          end)
  | Button b ->
      b.btimer <- b.btimer - 1;
      if b.btimer <= 0 then begin
        start_sound t None "swtchn";
        (match b.where with 0 -> b.bside.top <- b.texture | 1 -> b.bside.middle <- b.texture | _ -> b.bside.bottom <- b.texture);
        th.alive <- false
      end

(* P_SpawnSpecials: the sectors' lights *)
let spawn_lights (t : t) : unit =
  Array.iter
    (fun (s : Level.sector) ->
      let light (kind : light_kind) (minl : int) (maxl : int) (dark : int) (bright : int) (count : int) : unit =
        add t (Light { lsector = s; lkind = kind; minlight = minl; maxlight = maxl; darktime = dark; brighttime = bright; lcount = count; gdir = -1 }) in
      let lowest = min_light t s s.light in
      (* (P_SpawnStrobeFlash: no darker neighbour, then black) *)
      let strobe (dark : int) (sync : bool) : unit =
        light Strobe (if lowest = s.light then 0 else lowest) s.light dark 5 (if sync then 1 else (random () land 7) + 1) in
      match s.special with
      | 1 -> light Flash lowest s.light 7 64 ((random () land 64) + 1)
      | 2 | 4 -> strobe 15 false
      | 3 -> strobe 35 false
      | 8 -> light Glow lowest s.light 0 0 0
      | 12 -> strobe 35 true
      | 13 -> strobe 15 true
      | 17 -> light Flicker (lowest + 16) s.light 0 0 4
      | _ -> ())
    t.level.sectors

(* Specials: what the lines and the sectors do (Doom's p_spec.c,
 * p_doors.c, p_plats.c, p_floor.c, p_switch.c, p_lights.c).
 *
 * A line's special is a number the map gives it, what it does when it
 * is used (the space key, the nearest line within 64 ahead: DR doors,
 * S switches) or crossed (W, once; WR, again): a door's sector's
 * ceiling goes up to its lowest neighbour's less 4, waits 150 tics,
 * comes down (EV_VerticalDoor, T_VerticalDoor); a lift's floor down to
 * its lowest neighbour's, waits 105, up again (EV_DoPlat,
 * T_PlatRaise); a switch's texture turns (SW1 to SW2,
 * P_ChangeSwitchTexture), and back after a second if it can be used
 * again. A sector's special is its light: flashes, strobes, a glow, a
 * flicker (P_SpawnSpecials).
 *
 *   line 1 (DR), used    a Door thinker on the line's back sector:
 *                        up 2 a tic, 150 tics, down 2 a tic; back up
 *                        if the player is under it (T_MovePlane's
 *                        crush)
 *
 * Each starts a thinker (World), which think moves a tic at a time.
 *
 * What is not here: the specials of the levels after the first
 * (crushers, stairs, teleporters), the damage of a floor (a nukage floor
 * hurts nobody), id's random numbers (these lights flicker by another
 * generator).
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-doom: Play gives it the lines used and
 * crossed, and runs the thinkers each tic. *)

(* [line_special t line used]: the line's special, used or crossed
 * (P_UseSpecialLine, P_CrossSpecialLine); a W1 or S1 one is then no
 * more *)
val line_special : World.t -> Level.line -> bool -> unit

(* a thinker's tic (T_VerticalDoor, T_PlatRaise, T_MoveFloor, the
 * lights', a button's); done, it says so (alive false) *)
val think : World.t -> World.thinker -> unit

(* P_SpawnSpecials: the sectors' lights started *)
val spawn_lights : World.t -> unit

let neighbours (t : t) (s : Level.sector) : Level.sector list =
  List.filter_map
    (fun (k : int) ->
      let l = t.level.lines.(k) in
      match (Level.line_sector t.level l 0, Level.line_sector t.level l 1) with
      | Some a, Some b -> if a == s then Some b else if b == s then Some a else None
      | _ -> None)
    s.lines

(* P_FindLowestCeilingSurrounding, P_FindLowestFloorSurrounding,
 * P_FindMinSurroundingLight *)
let lowest_ceiling (t : t) (s : Level.sector) : float = List.fold_left (fun (m : float) (n : Level.sector) -> Float.min m n.ceiling) 32767. (neighbours t s)
let lowest_floor (t : t) (s : Level.sector) : float = List.fold_left (fun (m : float) (n : Level.sector) -> Float.min m n.floor) s.floor (neighbours t s)
let min_light (t : t) (s : Level.sector) (max : int) : int = List.fold_left (fun (m : int) (n : Level.sector) -> min m n.light) max (neighbours t s)

let tagged (t : t) (tag : int) : Level.sector list = List.filter (fun (s : Level.sector) -> s.tag = tag) (Array.to_list t.level.sectors)

(* a sector already moving (id's specialdata) *)
let busy (t : t) (s : Level.sector) : thinker option =
  List.find_opt
    (fun (th : thinker) ->
      th.alive && match th.what with Door d -> d.dsector == s | Plat p -> p.psector == s | Floor f -> f.fsector == s | _ -> false)
    t.thinkers

let start_sound (t : t) (origin : (float * float) option) (sfx : string) : unit =
  if sfx <> "" then t.sounds <- { sfx; origin } :: t.sounds

let approx_distance (dx : float) (dy : float) : float =
  let dx = Float.abs dx and dy = Float.abs dy in
  dx +. dy -. (Float.min dx dy /. 2.)

let add (t : t) (w : what) : unit = t.thinkers <- t.thinkers @ [ { alive = true; what = w } ]

games/fps/doom/render/Bsp.ml
7368
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Bsp.mli *)

(* OPTIMIZATION: Int's min and max, not Stdlib's polymorphic ones (as
 * View's) *)
let min = Int.min and max = Int.max

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The closed columns (solidsegs) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the open runs of columns first to last, the gaps between solidsegs'
 * ranges, each given to [f] (R_ClipPassWallSegment's loop) *)
let gaps (r : View.t) (first : int) (last : int) (f : int -> int -> unit) : unit =
  let rec go (x : int) (ranges : (int * int) list) : unit =
    if x <= last then
      match ranges with
      | [] -> f x last
      | (a, b) :: rest ->
          if a > x then f x (min last (a - 1));
          go (max x (b + 1)) rest in
  go first r.solidsegs

(* R_ClipSolidWallSegment: the gaps drawn, then first to last closed,
 * merged with the ranges it overlaps or touches *)
let clip_solid (r : View.t) (first : int) (last : int) (f : int -> int -> unit) : unit =
  gaps r first last f;
  let before = List.filter (fun ((_, b) : int * int) -> b < first - 1) r.solidsegs in
  let after = List.filter (fun ((a, _) : int * int) -> a > last + 1) r.solidsegs in
  let merged =
    List.fold_left
      (fun ((lo, hi) : int * int) ((a, b) : int * int) -> if b >= first - 1 && a <= last + 1 then (min lo a, max hi b) else (lo, hi))
      (first, last) r.solidsegs in
  r.solidsegs <- before @ (merged :: after)

(* R_ClipPassWallSegment: the gaps drawn, nothing closed (a window, a
 * step: what is behind is seen through) *)
let clip_pass (r : View.t) (first : int) (last : int) (f : int -> int -> unit) : unit = gaps r first last f

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The segs *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the two angles of a segment from the eye clipped to the view
 * (R_AddLine's and R_CheckBBox's): None if outside it, else its
 * columns *)
let columns_of (r : View.t) (angle1 : float) (angle2 : float) : (int * int) option =
  let clip = View.clipangle r in
  let span = View.norm (angle1 -. angle2) in
  if span >= View.pi then Some (0, r.width) (* (R_CheckBBox's: the eye in its span) *)
  else
    let a1 = View.norm (angle1 -. r.viewangle) and a2 = View.norm (angle2 -. r.viewangle) in
    let out = ref false in
    let a1 =
      let tspan = View.norm (a1 +. clip) in
      if tspan > 2. *. clip then (if tspan -. (2. *. clip) >= span then out := true; clip) else a1 in
    let a2 =
      let tspan = View.norm (clip -. a2) in
      if tspan > 2. *. clip then (if tspan -. (2. *. clip) >= span then out := true; -.clip) else a2 in
    if !out then None
    else
      let x1 = View.x_of_angle r (View.signed a1) and x2 = View.x_of_angle r (View.signed a2) in
      if x1 = x2 then None else Some (x1, x2)

(* R_AddLine *)
let add_line (r : View.t) (textures : Textures.t) (level : Level.t) (pl : View.planes) (seg : Level.seg) : unit =
  let angle1 = View.point_to_angle r seg.sv1.x seg.sv1.y and angle2 = View.point_to_angle r seg.sv2.x seg.sv2.y in
  (* (its back seen: more than half a turn from v1 to v2) *)
  if View.norm (angle1 -. angle2) < View.pi then
    match columns_of r angle1 angle2 with
    | None -> ()
    | Some (x1, x2) -> (
        let store = Segs.store_wall_range r textures level pl seg angle1 in
        match seg.back_sector with
        | None -> clip_solid r x1 (x2 - 1) store
        | Some back ->
            let front = seg.front_sector in
            if back.ceiling <= front.floor || back.floor >= front.ceiling then clip_solid r x1 (x2 - 1) store
            else if
              back.ceiling <> front.ceiling || back.floor <> front.floor || back.ceilingpic <> front.ceilingpic
              || back.floorpic <> front.floorpic || back.light <> front.light || seg.side.middle >= 0
            then clip_pass r x1 (x2 - 1) store
            (* (the same sector on both sides, nothing on the line: nothing
             * to draw, an editor's line) *))

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The tree *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* R_CheckBBox: may a box (top, bottom, left, right) be seen? *)
let check_box (r : View.t) (box : float array) : bool =
  let top = box.(0) and bottom = box.(1) and left = box.(2) and right = box.(3) in
  let bx = if r.viewx <= left then 0 else if r.viewx < right then 1 else 2 in
  let by = if r.viewy >= top then 0 else if r.viewy > bottom then 1 else 2 in
  if bx = 1 && by = 1 then true
  else
    (* the box's two corners that are its edges from the eye
     * (checkcoord) *)
    let x1, y1, x2, y2 =
      match (by * 3) + bx with
      | 0 -> (right, top, left, bottom)
      | 1 -> (right, top, left, top)
      | 2 -> (right, bottom, left, top)
      | 3 -> (left, top, left, bottom)
      | 5 -> (right, bottom, right, top)
      | 6 -> (left, top, right, bottom)
      | 7 -> (left, bottom, right, bottom)
      | _ -> (left, bottom, right, top) in
    match columns_of r (View.point_to_angle r x1 y1) (View.point_to_angle r x2 y2) with
    | None -> false
    | Some (sx1, sx2) ->
        (* not all in one closed range (they are merged: one covers
         * them, or some column is open) *)
        not (List.exists (fun ((a, b) : int * int) -> a <= sx1 && b >= sx2 - 1) r.solidsegs)

(* R_Subsector *)
let subsector (r : View.t) (textures : Textures.t) (level : Level.t) (sprites : Things.sprites) (things : Things.mobj list array) (tic : int)
    (k : int) : unit =
  let sub = level.subsectors.(k) in
  let s = sub.sub_sector in
  (* R_AddSprites: a sector's things, once a frame *)
  if r.sector_seen.(s.index) <> r.frame_number then begin
    r.sector_seen.(s.index) <- r.frame_number;
    List.iter (fun (m : Things.mobj) -> if m.alive then Sprites.project_sprite r sprites tic m) things.(s.index)
  end;
  let pl : View.planes =
    { floorplane = (if s.floor < r.viewz then Some (Planes.find_plane r textures s.floor s.floorpic s.light) else None);
      ceilingplane =
        (if s.ceiling > r.viewz || s.ceilingpic = textures.sky_flat then Some (Planes.find_plane r textures s.ceiling s.ceilingpic s.light) else None) } in
  for i = sub.first to sub.first + sub.count - 1 do add_line r textures level pl level.segs.(i) done

(* R_RenderBSPNode: nearest first, the far side only if its box may be
 * seen (once every column is closed, no box may: the walk goes on
 * through the near sides only, each seg refused by its clip)
 * old: an early stop, if every column was closed (an open_columns
 *   count); the same frames, no faster, and not id's *)
let rec render_node (r : View.t) (textures : Textures.t) (level : Level.t) (sprites : Things.sprites) (things : Things.mobj list array) (tic : int)
    (c : Level.child) : unit =
  match c with
  | Level.Subsector k -> subsector r textures level sprites things tic k
  | Level.Node k ->
      let n = level.nodes.(k) in
      let side = Level.point_on_side r.viewx r.viewy n in
      render_node r textures level sprites things tic n.children.(side);
      if check_box r n.boxes.(1 - side) then render_node r textures level sprites things tic n.children.(1 - side)
games/fps/doom/render/Bsp.mli
2716
(* Bsp: the tree walked, nearest first, and the columns it closes
 * (Doom's r_bsp.c). The tree is not made here: the node builder made
 * it from the map (idbsp then, ZDBSP or Freedoom's now) and the WAD
 * has it (Level: NODES, SSECTORS, SEGS).
 *
 * A node is a line that splits the level in two, each side a box and
 * a child: another node, or a subsector, a convex piece whose segs
 * cannot hide one another. From the eye, the side it is on first:
 *
 *     the map, from above              the tree
 *                   A                         A
 *          1        |      3                /   \
 *     -------B------|                      B     3
 *          2   e    |                     / \
 *                   |                    1   2
 *
 *   the eye e is left of A and below B: 2 first, then 1 (B's far
 *   side), then 3 (A's), each far side only if its box shows in a
 *   column still open (R_CheckBBox)
 *
 * So the segs come nearest first, and a column is done as soon as a
 * wall covers it: nothing behind is drawn there. Doom draws each pixel
 * of the walls once, with no z-buffer; the floors and the things are
 * drawn after, in what the walls left (Planes, Sprites).
 *
 * The columns closed are solidsegs, ranges of them, sorted, merged
 * when they touch: a wall's columns are drawn in the gaps between the
 * ranges, then added to them (R_ClipSolidWallSegment); a window's or a
 * step's are drawn in the gaps, and close nothing
 * (R_ClipPassWallSegment):
 *
 *   before   [0..40]          [120..200]          [290..319]
 *   a wall          60..250
 *   drawn              ^ 60..119       ^ 201..250
 *   after    [0..40]  [60..250]                   [290..319]
 *
 * A box is seen if its columns are not all in one range; at the end
 * the ranges are one, 0 to the width, and no box is.
 *
 * history:
 * The BSP is Henry Fuchs, Zvi Kedem and Bruce Naylor's ("On Visible
 * Surface Generation by A Priori Tree Structures", SIGGRAPH 1980), for
 * drawing back to front; John Carmack walked it front to back for
 * Doom (1993), with the closed columns, after Wolfenstein 3D's rays.
 * Fabien Sanglard's Game Engine Black Book: DOOM (2018) tells it, with
 * id's code: its renderer's chapter is this module and Segs.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-doom: Render's frame starts the walk at the
 * root; a seg in view goes to Segs (its columns), a subsector's
 * things to Sprites, its floor and ceiling to Planes. *)

(* [render_node r textures level sprites things tic child]: the subtree
 * drawn (R_RenderBSPNode), its things by their sectors' numbers *)
val render_node :
  View.t -> Textures.t -> Level.t -> Things.sprites -> Things.mobj list array -> int -> Level.child -> unit

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Planes.mli *)

(* OPTIMIZATION: Int's min and max, not Stdlib's polymorphic ones (as
 * View's) *)
let min = Int.min and max = Int.max

(* a new visplane of this frame, its columns none *)
let new_plane (r : View.t) (height : float) (pic : int) (light : int) : View.plane =
  if r.nplanes = Array.length r.planes then
    r.planes <-
      Array.append r.planes
        (Array.init (max 16 r.nplanes) (fun (_ : int) ->
             ({ pheight = 0.; pic = 0; plight = 0; minx = 0; maxx = 0; top = Array.make (r.width + 2) View.unset; bottom = Array.make (r.width + 2) 0 } : View.plane)));
  let p = r.planes.(r.nplanes) in
  r.nplanes <- r.nplanes + 1;
  p.pheight <- height;
  p.pic <- pic;
  p.plight <- light;
  p.minx <- r.width;
  p.maxx <- -1;
  Array.fill p.top 0 (r.width + 2) View.unset;
  p

(* R_FindPlane: this frame's plane of that height, flat and light, or a
 * new one (the sky's height and light are none: one plane for it) *)
let find_plane (r : View.t) (textures : Textures.t) (height : float) (pic : int) (light : int) : View.plane =
  let height, light = if pic = textures.sky_flat then (0., 0) else (height, light) in
  let rec look (k : int) : View.plane option =
    if k >= r.nplanes then None
    else
      let p = r.planes.(k) in
      if p.pheight = height && p.pic = pic && p.plight = light then Some p else look (k + 1) in
  match look 0 with Some p -> p | None -> new_plane r height pic light

(* R_CheckPlane: the plane, to mark columns start to stop in; another of
 * the same kind when some of those are marked already *)
let check_plane (r : View.t) (p : View.plane) (start : int) (stop : int) : View.plane =
  let intrl = max start p.minx and intrh = min stop p.maxx in
  let x = ref intrl in
  while !x <= intrh && p.top.(!x + 1) = View.unset do incr x done;
  if !x > intrh then begin
    p.minx <- min start p.minx;
    p.maxx <- max stop p.maxx;
    p
  end
  else begin
    let q = new_plane r p.pheight p.pic p.plight in
    q.minx <- start;
    q.maxx <- stop;
    q
  end

(* R_MapPlane: row y from x1 to x2 of a flat at [height] from the eye *)
let map_plane (r : View.t) (height : float) (flat : Bytes.t) (colormaps : Bytes.t) (zlight : int array) (y : int) (x1 : int) (x2 : int) : unit =
  let distance = height *. r.yslope.(y) in
  (* basexscale, baseyscale: a pixel's step along the row, the view's
   * right; the flat's y is the map's upside down *)
  let right = r.viewangle -. View.half_pi in
  let xstep = distance *. View.fcos right /. r.centerx and ystep = -.distance *. View.fsin right /. r.centerx in
  let length = distance *. r.distscale.(x1) in
  let angle = r.viewangle +. r.xtoviewangle.(x1) in
  let xf = r.viewx +. (View.fcos angle *. length) and yf = -.r.viewy -. (View.fsin angle *. length) in
  (* (modulo 64, the flat's size, so that 16.16 holds them) *)
  let xf = xf -. (64. *. floor (xf /. 64.)) and yf = yf -. (64. *. floor (yf /. 64.)) in
  let xfrac = ref (int_of_float (xf *. 65536.)) and yfrac = ref (int_of_float (yf *. 65536.)) in
  let dx = int_of_float (xstep *. 65536.) and dy = int_of_float (ystep *. 65536.) in
  let cmap = zlight.(max 0 (min (View.maxlightz - 1) (int_of_float (distance /. 16.)))) in
  let screen = r.screen in
  let ofs = ref ((y * r.width) + x1) in
  (* R_DrawSpan *)
  for _n = x1 to x2 do
    let spot = ((!yfrac asr 10) land 4032) + ((!xfrac asr 16) land 63) in
    Bytes.unsafe_set screen !ofs (Bytes.unsafe_get colormaps (cmap + Char.code (Bytes.unsafe_get flat spot)));
    xfrac := !xfrac + dx;
    yfrac := !yfrac + dy;
    incr ofs
  done

(* R_MakeSpans: column x's rows t2 to b2, where the column before had t1
 * to b1: the rows that end are drawn, the rows that start are noted *)
let make_spans (r : View.t) (draw : int -> int -> int -> unit) (x : int) (t1 : int) (b1 : int) (t2 : int) (b2 : int) : unit =
  let t1 = ref t1 and b1 = ref b1 and t2 = ref t2 and b2 = ref b2 in
  while !t1 < !t2 && !t1 <= !b1 do draw !t1 r.spanstart.(!t1) (x - 1); incr t1 done;
  while !b1 > !b2 && !b1 >= !t1 do draw !b1 r.spanstart.(!b1) (x - 1); decr b1 done;
  while !t2 < !t1 && !t2 <= !b2 do r.spanstart.(!t2) <- x; incr t2 done;
  while !b2 > !b1 && !b2 >= !t2 do r.spanstart.(!b2) <- x; decr b2 done

(* R_DrawPlanes *)
let draw_planes (r : View.t) (textures : Textures.t) : unit =
  let colormaps = textures.colormaps in
  for k = 0 to r.nplanes - 1 do
    let p = r.planes.(k) in
    if p.minx <= p.maxx then begin
      if p.pic = textures.sky_flat then begin
        (* R_DrawSky: a column of the sky by the ray's angle, 1024 columns
         * a turn (ANGLETOSKYSHIFT), its row 100 at the view's middle,
         * as tall as at 320 wide, the brightest colormap *)
        let sky = textures.textures.(textures.texture_translation.(textures.sky)) in
        let scale = float r.width /. 320. in
        for x = p.minx to p.maxx do
          let a = View.norm (r.viewangle +. r.xtoviewangle.(x)) in
          let col = int_of_float (a *. 1024. /. View.two_pi) land sky.width_mask in
          View.draw_column r x p.top.(x + 1) p.bottom.(x + 1) 100. scale sky.source sky.columns.(col) colormaps 0
        done
      end
      else begin
        let flat = textures.flats.(textures.flat_translation.(p.pic)) in
        let height = Float.abs (p.pheight -. r.viewz) in
        let zlight = r.zlight.(View.lit r p.plight) in
        let draw = map_plane r height flat colormaps zlight in
        p.top.(p.maxx + 2) <- View.unset;
        p.top.(p.minx) <- View.unset;
        for x = p.minx to p.maxx + 1 do
          make_spans r draw x p.top.(x) p.bottom.(x) p.top.(x + 1) p.bottom.(x + 1)
        done
      end
    end
  done
games/fps/doom/render/Planes.mli

(* Planes: the floors and the ceilings (Doom's r_plane.c), and the sky.
 *
 * A wall drawn marks, column by column, the rows above it that are
 * its sector's ceiling and those below that are its floor, in a
 * visplane: a height, a flat and a light, and for each column a run of
 * rows. When the walls are done, each visplane is drawn by rows, not
 * columns (R_MakeSpans: a row's span ends where the next column's rows
 * no longer include it): along a row of the screen a flat is at one
 * distance, height * yslope, so its texels are a fixed step apart,
 * distance / projection a pixel (R_MapPlane, R_DrawSpan), the step
 * along the view's right, from the point the row's first column's ray
 * meets the plane:
 *
 *       the screen                the floor, from above
 *     +--------------+          eye  \    |    /
 *     |              |                 \   |   /   a row's span: the
 *     |   ........   | <- row y         \..|../    points where the
 *     |  ..........  |                 the floor   rays of its columns
 *     +--------------+                             meet the floor
 *
 * The sky is a visplane too, F_SKY1's: not a flat but the sky's
 * texture drawn as walls are, a column by the ray's angle (1,024
 * columns a turn: the texture of 256 four times), row 100 at the
 * view's middle, at full light (R_DrawSky in R_DrawPlanes).
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-doom: Render finds a subsector's planes,
 * Segs marks them, Render draws them after the walls. *)

(* R_FindPlane: this frame's plane of that height, flat and light, or a
 * new one (the sky's: one for all its heights and lights) *)
val find_plane : View.t -> Textures.t -> float -> int -> int -> View.plane

(* [check_plane r plane start stop] (R_CheckPlane): the plane, to mark
 * columns start to stop in; another of the same kind when some of them
 * are marked already *)
val check_plane : View.t -> View.plane -> int -> int -> View.plane

(* R_DrawPlanes: every visplane of the frame, by spans; the sky's by
 * columns *)
val draw_planes : View.t -> Textures.t -> unit

games/fps/doom/render/Render.mli
