(* See Level.mli *)

type vertex = { x : float; y : float }

type sector = {
  index : int; (* its number in the level *)
  mutable floor : float;
  mutable ceiling : float;
  mutable floorpic : int;
  ceilingpic : int;
  mutable light : int;
  mutable special : int;
  tag : int;
  mutable lines : int list;
}

type side = { xoffset : float; yoffset : float; mutable top : int; mutable bottom : int; mutable middle : int; sector : int }

type line = { v1 : vertex; v2 : vertex; flags : int; mutable special : int; tag : int; front : int; back : int option }

let blocking = 1
let two_sided = 4
let upper_unpegged = 8
let lower_unpegged = 16

type seg = {
  sv1 : vertex;
  sv2 : vertex;
  angle : float;
  seg_line : int;
  seg_side : int;
  offset : float;
  side : side;
  front_sector : sector;
  back_sector : sector option;
}

type subsector = { first : int; count : int; sub_sector : sector }
type child = Node of int | Subsector of int
type node = { nx : float; ny : float; ndx : float; ndy : float; boxes : float array array; children : child array }
type thing = { tx : float; ty : float; tangle : float; kind : int; tflags : int }
type blockmap = { originx : float; originy : float; columns : int; rows : int; cells : int array array }

type t = {
  name : string;
  vertexes : vertex array;
  sectors : sector array;
  sides : side array;
  lines : line array;
  segs : seg array;
  subsectors : subsector array;
  nodes : node array;
  things : thing array;
  blockmap : blockmap;
}


let maps (wad : Wad.t) : string list =
  let n = Array.length wad.lumps in
  List.filter_map
    (fun (k : int) -> if k + 1 < n && wad.lumps.(k + 1).name = "THINGS" then Some wad.lumps.(k).name else None)
    (List.init n (fun (k : int) -> k))

(* [records data size f]: the lump's records of [size] bytes, each by f
 * given the lump and where the record starts *)
let records (data : string) (size : int) (f : string -> int -> 'a) : 'a array = Array.init (String.length data / size) (fun (k : int) -> f data (k * size))

let pi = 4. *. atan 1.

(* a short that is a count or an index (0xffff: none) *)
let ushort (d : string) (o : int) : int = Wad.short d o land 0xffff

let load (wad : Wad.t) (name : string) (texture : string -> int) (flat : string -> int) : t =
  let start = match Wad.index wad name with Some k -> k | None -> failwith ("no map " ^ name ^ " in the WAD") in
  let lump (n : string) : string =
    match List.find_opt (fun (k : int) -> start + k < Array.length wad.lumps && wad.lumps.(start + k).name = n) (List.init 11 (fun (k : int) -> k)) with
    | Some k -> wad.lumps.(start + k).data
    | None -> failwith (name ^ ": no " ^ n) in
  let s = Wad.short and name8 = Wad.name8 in
  let vertexes = records (lump "VERTEXES") 4 (fun (d : string) (o : int) -> { x = float (s d o); y = float (s d (o + 2)) }) in
  let sectors =
    records (lump "SECTORS") 26 (fun (d : string) (o : int) ->
        { index = o / 26; floor = float (s d o); ceiling = float (s d (o + 2)); floorpic = flat (name8 d (o + 4)); ceilingpic = flat (name8 d (o + 12));
          light = s d (o + 20); special = s d (o + 22); tag = s d (o + 24); lines = [] }) in
  let sides =
    records (lump "SIDEDEFS") 30 (fun (d : string) (o : int) ->
        { xoffset = float (s d o); yoffset = float (s d (o + 2)); top = texture (name8 d (o + 4)); bottom = texture (name8 d (o + 12));
          middle = texture (name8 d (o + 20)); sector = s d (o + 28) }) in
  let lines =
    records (lump "LINEDEFS") 14 (fun (d : string) (o : int) ->
        let back = ushort d (o + 12) in
        { v1 = vertexes.(ushort d o); v2 = vertexes.(ushort d (o + 2)); flags = s d (o + 4); special = s d (o + 6); tag = s d (o + 8);
          front = ushort d (o + 10); back = (if back = 0xffff then None else Some back) }) in
  Array.iteri
    (fun (k : int) (l : line) ->
      let add (sd : int) : unit = let sec = sectors.(sides.(sd).sector) in if not (List.mem k sec.lines) then sec.lines <- k :: sec.lines in
      add l.front;
      Option.iter add l.back)
    lines;
  let segs =
    records (lump "SEGS") 12 (fun (d : string) (o : int) ->
        let l = lines.(ushort d (o + 6)) and k = s d (o + 8) in
        let sd = if k = 0 then l.front else match l.back with Some b -> b | None -> l.front in
        let other = if k = 0 then l.back else Some l.front in
        { sv1 = vertexes.(ushort d o); sv2 = vertexes.(ushort d (o + 2));
          angle = float (ushort d (o + 4)) *. 2. *. pi /. 65536.; seg_line = ushort d (o + 6); seg_side = k;
          offset = float (s d (o + 10)); side = sides.(sd); front_sector = sectors.(sides.(sd).sector);
          back_sector =
            (if l.flags land two_sided = 0 then None else Option.map (fun (b : int) -> sectors.(sides.(b).sector)) other) }) in
  let subsectors =
    records (lump "SSECTORS") 4 (fun (d : string) (o : int) ->
        let first = ushort d (o + 2) in
        { first; count = ushort d o; sub_sector = segs.(first).front_sector }) in
  let child (v : int) : child = if v land 0x8000 <> 0 then Subsector (v land 0x7fff) else Node v in
  let nodes =
    records (lump "NODES") 28 (fun (d : string) (o : int) ->
        { nx = float (s d o); ny = float (s d (o + 2)); ndx = float (s d (o + 4)); ndy = float (s d (o + 6));
          boxes = Array.init 2 (fun (b : int) -> Array.init 4 (fun (i : int) -> float (s d (o + 8 + (8 * b) + (2 * i)))));
          children = [| child (ushort d (o + 24)); child (ushort d (o + 26)) |] }) in
  let things =
    records (lump "THINGS") 10 (fun (d : string) (o : int) ->
        { tx = float (s d o); ty = float (s d (o + 2)); tangle = float (s d (o + 4)) *. pi /. 180.; kind = s d (o + 6); tflags = s d (o + 8) }) in
  let blockmap =
    let d = lump "BLOCKMAP" in
    let columns = s d 4 and rows = s d 6 in
    let cell (c : int) : int array =
      let o = 2 * ushort d (8 + (2 * c)) in
      (* (a list starts with a 0, which is no line: id's builder's) *)
      let acc = ref [] and i = ref (o + 2) in
      while !i + 1 < String.length d && ushort d !i <> 0xffff do acc := ushort d !i :: !acc; i := !i + 2 done;
      Array.of_list (List.rev !acc) in
    { originx = float (s d 0); originy = float (s d 2); columns; rows; cells = Array.init (columns * rows) cell } in
  { name; vertexes; sectors; sides; lines; segs; subsectors; nodes; things; blockmap }

let root (level : t) : child = if level.nodes = [||] then Subsector 0 else Node (Array.length level.nodes - 1)

(* the side of (x, y) of the line through (ox, oy) along (dx, dy) *)
let side_of (x : float) (y : float) (ox : float) (oy : float) (dx : float) (dy : float) : int =
  let b (c : bool) : int = if c then 1 else 0 in
  (* (id's: a line along an axis first, where a point on it has a side
   * by the line's direction; else the cross product's sign) *)
  if dx = 0. then (if x <= ox then b (dy > 0.) else b (dy < 0.))
  else if dy = 0. then (if y <= oy then b (dx < 0.) else b (dx > 0.))
  else if (y -. oy) *. dx < dy *. (x -. ox) then 0
  else 1

let point_on_side (x : float) (y : float) (n : node) : int = side_of x y n.nx n.ny n.ndx n.ndy

let point_on_line_side (x : float) (y : float) (l : line) : int = side_of x y l.v1.x l.v1.y (l.v2.x -. l.v1.x) (l.v2.y -. l.v1.y)

let sector_at (level : t) (x : float) (y : float) : sector =
  let rec down (c : child) : sector =
    match c with
    | Subsector k -> level.subsectors.(k).sub_sector
    | Node k -> let n = level.nodes.(k) in down n.children.(point_on_side x y n) in
  down (root level)

let line_sector (level : t) (l : line) (k : int) : sector option =
  if k = 0 then Some level.sectors.(level.sides.(l.front).sector)
  else Option.map (fun (b : int) -> level.sectors.(level.sides.(b).sector)) l.back

(* Level: one map of a WAD (E1M1, MAP01), its lumps read into records:
 * the floor plan an editor drew, and what the node builder made of it.
 *
 *   what the designer drew                  what the node builder adds
 *   VERTEXES  points                        SEGS      the lines cut where
 *   LINEDEFS  lines between two, a side          a partition crossed them,
 *             or two                            each the side of one
 *   SIDEDEFS  a line's face: its three      SSECTORS  convex pieces of a
 *             textures, its sector                  sector: a run of segs
 *   SECTORS   a floor and a ceiling: their  NODES     the BSP tree: a line
 *             heights, flats, the light             that splits, a box a
 *   THINGS    the player, the monsters, ...         side, two children
 *                                           BLOCKMAP  the lines in each cell
 *                                                   of 128 by 128, for
 *                                                   the collisions
 *                                           REJECT    who can see whom (not
 *                                                   read: no monsters)
 *
 *   a sector seen from above, two subsectors, the node between:
 *
 *        v0 +-----------+ v1      the line v0-v1 is one-sided (a wall);
 *           |    \      |         the node's partition (\) cuts the
 *           | 1   \  2  |         square into two convex pieces, and
 *           |      \    |         the line v3-v0 into two segs, one
 *        v3 +-------\---+ v2      in each
 *
 * A map's unit is a pixel of a texture: a door is 128 wide, the player
 * 56 tall, his eyes at 41. Angles are radians, counter-clockwise from
 * the x axis (east); the WAD's are id's binary angles (65536 a turn),
 * turned into radians when read.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-doom: what Render draws (the nodes, the segs,
 * the sectors' heights) and what Play moves in and changes (a door's
 * ceiling, a switch's texture); Textures names the textures and flats
 * by their numbers. *)

type vertex = { x : float; y : float }

type sector = {
  index : int; (* its number in the level *)
  mutable floor : float;
  mutable ceiling : float;
  mutable floorpic : int; (* a flat's number (Textures) *)
  ceilingpic : int;
  mutable light : int; (* 0 to 255 *)
  mutable special : int;
  tag : int;
  mutable lines : int list; (* the lines that border it *)
}

type side = {
  xoffset : float;
  yoffset : float;
  (* the textures' numbers, -1 for none ("-") *)
  mutable top : int;
  mutable bottom : int;
  mutable middle : int;
  sector : int;
}

type line = {
  v1 : vertex;
  v2 : vertex;
  flags : int;
  mutable special : int;
  tag : int;
  front : int; (* its sides' numbers: the right one, as v1 to v2 goes *)
  back : int option;
}

(* the flags of a line that Render and Play read *)
val blocking : int (* the player cannot cross it, two-sided or not *)
val two_sided : int
val upper_unpegged : int (* an upper texture hangs from the top *)
val lower_unpegged : int (* a lower or one-sided one from the ceiling *)

type seg = {
  sv1 : vertex;
  sv2 : vertex;
  angle : float; (* of v1 to v2 *)
  seg_line : int;
  seg_side : int; (* the line's side it is on: 0 its front, 1 *)
  offset : float; (* from the line's start: the texture's first column *)
  side : side;
  front_sector : sector;
  back_sector : sector option;
}

type subsector = { first : int; count : int; sub_sector : sector }

type child = Node of int | Subsector of int

type node = {
  nx : float;
  ny : float;
  ndx : float;
  ndy : float;
  (* each child's box: top, bottom, left, right *)
  boxes : float array array;
  children : child array; (* the front's, then the back's *)
}

type thing = { tx : float; ty : float; tangle : float; kind : int; tflags : int }

type blockmap = { originx : float; originy : float; columns : int; rows : int; cells : int array array }

type t = {
  name : string;
  vertexes : vertex array;
  sectors : sector array;
  sides : side array;
  lines : line array;
  segs : seg array;
  subsectors : subsector array;
  nodes : node array;
  things : thing array;
  blockmap : blockmap;
}

(* [load wad name texture flat]: the map [name] of [wad], a texture's
 * name made its number by [texture] (-1 for "-" or one unknown), a
 * flat's by [flat]; Failure if the map is not there *)
val load : Wad.t -> string -> (string -> int) -> (string -> int) -> t

(* the maps of a WAD, in its order: E1M1 ..., MAP01 ... *)
val maps : Wad.t -> string list

(* [root level]: the tree's root, the last node (a map of one subsector
 * has none) *)
val root : t -> child

(* [point_on_side x y node]: 0 if the point is on the node's front
 * (right) side, else 1 (R_PointOnSide) *)
val point_on_side : float -> float -> node -> int

(* [side_of x y ox oy dx dy]: the same of the line through (ox, oy)
 * along (dx, dy) (a seg's: R_PointOnSegSide) *)
val side_of : float -> float -> float -> float -> float -> float -> int

(* the same of a line: 0 on its front (right) side (P_PointOnLineSide) *)
val point_on_line_side : float -> float -> line -> int

(* [sector_at level x y]: the sector under the point, down the tree
 * (R_PointInSubsector) *)
val sector_at : t -> float -> float -> sector

(* [line_sector level line k]: the sector of the line's side k (0 front,
 * 1 back) *)
val line_sector : t -> line -> int -> sector option

(* See Textures.mli *)

type texture = { name : string; width : int; height : int; width_mask : int; source : Bytes.t; columns : int array }

type t = {
  palette : int array;
  colormaps : Bytes.t;
  textures : texture array;
  flats : Bytes.t array;
  flat_names : string array;
  texture_translation : int array;
  flat_translation : int array;
  sky_flat : int;
  sky : int;
  numbers : (string, int) Hashtbl.t;
}

(* a patch's posts drawn into a texture's column, at [at] in [tex], from
 * the patch's column at [column], its top at [top] (R_DrawColumnInCache) *)
let draw_post (tex : Bytes.t) (height : int) (at : int) (patch : string) (column : int) (top : int) : unit =
  let i = ref column in
  while Wad.u8 patch !i <> 0xff do
    let delta = Wad.u8 patch !i and len = Wad.u8 patch (!i + 1) in
    let src = !i + 3 in
    let pos = top + delta and count = ref len in
    (* (id's bug, kept: above the top, the rows lost at the bottom, the
     * source not moved) *)
    let pos = if pos < 0 then (count := !count + pos; 0) else pos in
    if pos + !count > height then count := height - pos;
    for k = 0 to !count - 1 do Bytes.set tex (at + pos + k) patch.[src + k] done;
    i := !i + len + 4
  done

let power_mask (n : int) : int =
  let j = ref 1 in
  while !j * 2 <= n do j := !j * 2 done;
  !j - 1

(* the rows a column is read for (R_DrawColumn's & 127): what follows
 * the last column is zeros *)
let rows = 128

(* R_GenerateLookup, R_GenerateComposite: the texture's columns that
 * one patch covers are that patch's bytes, where its first post's
 * pixels start; the others are put together, column after column *)
let make_texture (tx : string) (o : int) (patches : Wad.lump option array) : texture =
  let width = Wad.short tx (o + 12) and height = Wad.short tx (o + 14) in
  let placed =
    List.init (Wad.short tx (o + 20)) (fun (p : int) ->
        let po = o + 22 + (10 * p) in
        (Wad.short tx po, Wad.short tx (po + 2), patches.(Wad.short tx (po + 4))))
    |> List.filter_map (fun ((x, y, l) : int * int * Wad.lump option) -> Option.map (fun (l : Wad.lump) -> (x, y, l.data)) l) in
  (* each column's patches *)
  let count = Array.make width 0 and only = Array.make width ("", 0) in
  List.iter
    (fun ((ox, _, d) : int * int * string) ->
      for c = 0 to Wad.short d 0 - 1 do
        let x = ox + c in
        if x >= 0 && x < width then begin
          count.(x) <- count.(x) + 1;
          only.(x) <- (d, Wad.int32 d (8 + (4 * c)) + 3)
        end
      done)
    placed;
  let composite = Array.fold_left (fun (n : int) (k : int) -> if k > 1 then n + height else n) 0 count in
  (* the patches read directly, each once, after the composite *)
  let direct = ref [] and size = ref (composite + rows) in
  Array.iteri
    (fun (x : int) (k : int) ->
      let d, _ = only.(x) in
      if k = 1 && not (List.exists (fun ((d', _) : string * int) -> d' == d) !direct) then begin
        direct := (d, !size) :: !direct;
        size := !size + String.length d + rows
      end)
    count;
  let source = Bytes.make !size '\000' in
  List.iter (fun ((d, at) : string * int) -> Bytes.blit_string d 0 source at (String.length d)) !direct;
  let next = ref 0 in
  let columns =
    Array.init width (fun (x : int) ->
        if count.(x) = 1 then
          let d, ofs = only.(x) in
          List.assq d !direct + ofs
        else begin
          (* (a column no patch covers: zeros, black; id's was what the
           * memory held) *)
          let at = !next in
          if count.(x) > 1 then next := !next + height;
          at
        end) in
  (* the composite: each patch's posts in its columns of more than one *)
  List.iter
    (fun ((ox, oy, d) : int * int * string) ->
      for c = 0 to Wad.short d 0 - 1 do
        let x = ox + c in
        if x >= 0 && x < width && count.(x) > 1 then draw_post source height columns.(x) d (Wad.int32 d (8 + (4 * c))) oy
      done)
    placed;
  { name = Wad.name8 tx o; width; height; width_mask = power_mask width; source; columns }

let load (wad : Wad.t) : t =
  let pal = Wad.get wad "PLAYPAL" in
  let palette = Array.init 256 (fun (i : int) -> (Wad.u8 pal (3 * i) lsl 16) lor (Wad.u8 pal ((3 * i) + 1) lsl 8) lor Wad.u8 pal ((3 * i) + 2)) in
  let colormaps = Bytes.of_string (Wad.get wad "COLORMAP") in
  let pn = Wad.get wad "PNAMES" in
  let patches = Array.init (Wad.int32 pn 0) (fun (k : int) -> Wad.find wad (Wad.name8 pn (4 + (8 * k)))) in
  let tx = Wad.get wad "TEXTURE1" in
  let textures = Array.init (Wad.int32 tx 0) (fun (k : int) -> make_texture tx (Wad.int32 tx (4 + (4 * k))) patches) in
  let flat_lumps = Array.of_list (Wad.between wad "F_START" "F_END") in
  let numbers = Hashtbl.create 512 in
  Array.iteri (fun (k : int) (t : texture) -> Hashtbl.replace numbers ("T" ^ t.name) k) textures;
  Array.iteri (fun (k : int) (l : Wad.lump) -> Hashtbl.replace numbers ("F" ^ l.name) k) flat_lumps;
  let number (key : string) : int = match Hashtbl.find_opt numbers key with Some k -> k | None -> -1 in
  { palette; colormaps; textures;
    flats = Array.map (fun (l : Wad.lump) -> Bytes.of_string l.data) flat_lumps;
    flat_names = Array.map (fun (l : Wad.lump) -> l.name) flat_lumps;
    texture_translation = Array.init (Array.length textures) (fun (k : int) -> k);
    flat_translation = Array.init (Array.length flat_lumps) (fun (k : int) -> k);
    sky_flat = number "FF_SKY1"; sky = max 0 (number "TSKY1"); numbers }

let texture (t : t) (name : string) : int = match Hashtbl.find_opt t.numbers ("T" ^ name) with Some k -> k | None -> -1
let flat (t : t) (name : string) : int = match Hashtbl.find_opt t.numbers ("F" ^ name) with Some k -> k | None -> -1

(* p_spec.c's animdefs: the flats', then the textures' *)
let flat_anims =
  [ [ "NUKAGE1"; "NUKAGE2"; "NUKAGE3" ]; [ "FWATER1"; "FWATER2"; "FWATER3"; "FWATER4" ]; [ "SWATER1"; "SWATER2"; "SWATER3"; "SWATER4" ];
    [ "LAVA1"; "LAVA2"; "LAVA3"; "LAVA4" ]; [ "BLOOD1"; "BLOOD2"; "BLOOD3" ] ]

let texture_anims =
  [ [ "BLODGR1"; "BLODGR2"; "BLODGR3"; "BLODGR4" ]; [ "SLADRIP1"; "SLADRIP2"; "SLADRIP3" ]; [ "BLODRIP1"; "BLODRIP2"; "BLODRIP3"; "BLODRIP4" ];
    [ "FIREWALA"; "FIREWALB"; "FIREWALL" ]; [ "GSTFONT1"; "GSTFONT2"; "GSTFONT3" ]; [ "FIRELAVA"; "FIRELAV3" ];
    [ "FIREMAG1"; "FIREMAG2"; "FIREMAG3" ]; [ "FIREBLU1"; "FIREBLU2" ]; [ "ROCKRED1"; "ROCKRED2"; "ROCKRED3" ];
    [ "BFALL1"; "BFALL2"; "BFALL3"; "BFALL4" ]; [ "SFALL1"; "SFALL2"; "SFALL3"; "SFALL4" ]; [ "WFALL1"; "WFALL2"; "WFALL3"; "WFALL4" ];
    [ "DBRAIN1"; "DBRAIN2"; "DBRAIN3"; "DBRAIN4" ] ]

let animate (t : t) (tic : int) : unit =
  let run (number : string -> int) (translation : int array) (anims : string list list) : unit =
    List.iter
      (fun (names : string list) ->
        let frames = Array.of_list (List.map number names) in
        let n = Array.length frames in
        (* (a WAD that has some frames and not others: none animated) *)
        if Array.for_all (fun (k : int) -> k >= 0) frames then
          Array.iteri (fun (i : int) (k : int) -> translation.(k) <- frames.(((tic / 8) + i) mod n)) frames)
      anims in
  run (flat t) t.flat_translation flat_anims;
  run (texture t) t.texture_translation texture_anims

let switch_of (t : t) (k : int) : int option =
  if k < 0 then None
  else
    let n = t.textures.(k).name in
    if String.length n > 3 && (String.sub n 0 3 = "SW1" || String.sub n 0 3 = "SW2") then
      let other = (if n.[2] = '1' then "SW2" else "SW1") ^ String.sub n 3 (String.length n - 3) in
      let o = texture t other in
      if o >= 0 then Some o else None
    else None

(* Textures: what a wall, a floor and the sky are painted with, and the
 * light (Doom's r_data.c, R_InitData). Every picture of Doom is the
 * palette's indices, a byte a pixel; its colours are PLAYPAL's 256, and
 * its light is COLORMAP's, 34 tables of 256 bytes: the colour an index
 * becomes at a light level, 0 the brightest, 31 nearly black.
 *
 *   PNAMES    the patches' names, numbered
 *   TEXTURE1  each texture: its size and its patches, each at an
 *             offset (a texture is put together of pictures, which
 *             the WAD stores once)
 *
 *     STARTAN3, 128 by 128         a patch is columns of posts (runs of
 *     +-------+-------+            opaque rows): made here a texture's
 *     | SW19_1| SW19_2|            column, a byte a row, the patches'
 *     |  0,0  | 64,0  |            posts copied into it in order
 *     +-------+-------+
 *
 *   flats     between F_START and F_END: 64 by 64 bytes, a floor's or
 *             a ceiling's picture, laid on the map's grid
 *
 * A texture's column is read as id's game read it, from memory laid
 * out as its was (R_GenerateLookup, R_GenerateComposite, R_GetColumn):
 * a column one patch covers is that patch's own bytes, from where its
 * first post's pixels start; the columns of more than one patch are put
 * together (composited), column after column; and a column's row is its
 * number & 127 (R_DrawColumn) wherever the texture ends. So a column
 * with a hole, or a texture not 128 high, shows what follows in
 * memory: the next posts' headers and pixels, the next column -- the
 * "tutti-frutti" and the "medusa" of Doom's levels, which the WADs of
 * the time were made to look right with, and a texture that does not
 * show them here would not be id's picture (a level's BROWNGRN, a lower
 * texture whose rows go past its patch, is green there, from the bytes
 * after). Past the last byte, zeros. id's one bug in compositing is
 * kept too: a patch above the texture's top (a negative offset) does
 * not lose its top rows but its bottom ones, the post starting at row 0
 * with its first pixel (R_DrawColumnInCache).
 *
 * id's game made a texture at its first use (the zone's cache); here
 * every texture is made at the start, a WAD's few being small.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-doom: Level asks a name's number; Render reads
 * the columns, the flats and the colormaps; Play animates (the
 * translation of an animated texture or flat to its current frame,
 * P_UpdateSpecials) and turns switches. *)

type texture = {
  name : string;
  width : int;
  height : int;
  (* the largest power of 2 that is not wider: a column's number wraps
   * at it (Doom's texturewidthmask) *)
  width_mask : int;
  (* its bytes, and where each column's rows start in them *)
  source : Bytes.t;
  columns : int array;
}

type t = {
  palette : int array; (* each index's colour: red lsl 16, green lsl 8, blue *)
  colormaps : Bytes.t; (* 34 * 256 *)
  textures : texture array;
  flats : Bytes.t array; (* 4096 each *)
  flat_names : string array;
  (* what Render draws for a texture's or a flat's number: its frame
   * when it is animated, else itself *)
  texture_translation : int array;
  flat_translation : int array;
  sky_flat : int; (* F_SKY1: a ceiling that shows the sky *)
  sky : int; (* the sky's texture, SKY1 *)
  numbers : (string, int) Hashtbl.t;
}

(* [load wad]: the WAD's textures, flats and palette; Failure if it has
 * no PLAYPAL, COLORMAP or TEXTURE1 *)
val load : Wad.t -> t

(* a texture's number by its name, -1 if none *)
val texture : t -> string -> int

(* a flat's number by its name, -1 if none *)
val flat : t -> string -> int

(* [animate t tic]: the animated textures and flats at that tic (35 a
 * second), each frame 8 tics *)
val animate : t -> int -> unit

(* a switch's other texture (SW1... and SW2...), if there is one *)
val switch_of : t -> int -> int option

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Wad.mli *)

type lump = { name : string; data : string }

type t = { kind : string; lumps : lump array }

let u8 (s : string) (i : int) : int = Char.code s.[i]

let short (s : string) (i : int) : int =
  let v = u8 s i lor (u8 s (i + 1) lsl 8) in
  if v >= 0x8000 then v - 0x10000 else v

let int32 (s : string) (i : int) : int =
  let v = u8 s i lor (u8 s (i + 1) lsl 8) lor (u8 s (i + 2) lsl 16) in
  let hi = u8 s (i + 3) in
  (* (the top byte signed: -1 is 0xffffffff) *)
  v lor ((if hi >= 0x80 then hi - 0x100 else hi) lsl 24)

let name8 (s : string) (i : int) : string =
  let n = ref 0 in
  while !n < 8 && s.[i + !n] <> '\000' do incr n done;
  String.uppercase_ascii (String.sub s i !n)

let parse (s : string) : t =
  if String.length s < 12 then failwith "not a WAD: too short";
  let kind = String.sub s 0 4 in
  if kind <> "IWAD" && kind <> "PWAD" then failwith "not a WAD: no IWAD nor PWAD";
  let n = int32 s 4 and dir = int32 s 8 in
  if dir < 0 || dir + (16 * n) > String.length s then failwith "not a WAD: its directory is outside it";
  let lump (k : int) : lump =
    let e = dir + (16 * k) in
    let pos = int32 s e and size = int32 s (e + 4) in
    if pos < 0 || size < 0 || pos + size > String.length s then failwith "a lump outside the WAD";
    { name = name8 s (e + 8); data = String.sub s pos size }
  in
  { kind; lumps = Array.init n lump }

let index (wad : t) (name : string) : int option =
  let rec look (k : int) : int option = if k < 0 then None else if wad.lumps.(k).name = name then Some k else look (k - 1) in
  look (Array.length wad.lumps - 1)

let find (wad : t) (name : string) : lump option = Option.map (fun (k : int) -> wad.lumps.(k)) (index wad name)

let get (wad : t) (name : string) : string =
  match find wad name with Some l -> l.data | None -> failwith ("no lump " ^ name ^ " in the WAD")

let between (wad : t) (first : string) (last : string) : lump list =
  let inside = ref false and acc = ref [] in
  Array.iter
    (fun (l : lump) ->
      if l.name = first then inside := true
      else if l.name = last then inside := false
      else if !inside && l.data <> "" then acc := l :: !acc)
    wad.lumps;
  List.rev !acc

let add_short (b : Buffer.t) (v : int) : unit =
  Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr (v land 0xff));
  Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr ((v lsr 8) land 0xff))

let add_int32 (b : Buffer.t) (v : int) : unit =
  add_short b (v land 0xffff);
  add_short b ((v lsr 16) land 0xffff)

let add_name8 (b : Buffer.t) (name : string) : unit =
  for i = 0 to 7 do Buffer.add_char b (if i < String.length name then name.[i] else '\000') done

let write (kind : string) (lumps : lump list) : string =
  let b = Buffer.create 1_000_000 in
  let size = List.fold_left (fun (n : int) (l : lump) -> n + String.length l.data) 0 lumps in
  Buffer.add_string b kind;
  add_int32 b (List.length lumps);
  add_int32 b (12 + size);
  List.iter (fun (l : lump) -> Buffer.add_string b l.data) lumps;
  let pos = ref 12 in
  List.iter
    (fun (l : lump) ->
      add_int32 b !pos;
      add_int32 b (String.length l.data);
      add_name8 b l.name;
      pos := !pos + String.length l.data)
    lumps;
  Buffer.contents b
games/fps/doom/wad/Wad.mli
2625
(* Wad: Doom's file of everything, "Where's All the Data?" -- the
 * levels, the pictures, the palette, the sounds, each a lump, a
 * name of eight letters and its bytes, in one file a directory ends:
 *
 *   0   "IWAD" (the game's own) or "PWAD" (a patch: lumps that replace
 *       or add to the game's), the number of lumps, where the
 *       directory is
 *   12  the lumps' bytes, one after the other
 *   ... the directory, 16 bytes a lump: where its bytes are, how
 *       many, its name (eight bytes, the rest zeros)
 *
 *   a level is a marker lump (E1M1, no bytes) and the ten after it,
 *   in this order: THINGS LINEDEFS SIDEDEFS VERTEXES SEGS SSECTORS
 *   NODES SECTORS REJECT BLOCKMAP; the flats are between F_START
 *   and F_END, the patches anywhere (PNAMES names them).
 *
 * Every number is little-endian, a short of 16 bits signed or an int
 * of 32. A name is looked up from the end: a PWAD loaded after the
 * IWAD wins (W_CheckNumForName's order), which is all Doom's mods were.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-doom: what Level, Textures and Mkwad read and
 * Mkwad writes; nothing here knows what a lump means.
 *
 * history:
 * The format is id's, for Doom (1993); Quake's PAK and WAD2 (1996) are
 * its children, and so, by way of Doom's modders, every game's archive
 * of data since. *)

type lump = { name : string; data : string }

type t = { kind : string; lumps : lump array }

(* [parse bytes]: a WAD file's lumps; Failure if it is none *)
val parse : string -> t

(* [find wad name]: the last lump of that name (in capitals) *)
val find : t -> string -> lump option

(* [get wad name]: the same, Failure if there is none *)
val get : t -> string -> string

(* [index wad name]: where that lump is in [wad.lumps], the last one *)
val index : t -> string -> int option

(* [between wad first last]: the lumps after the marker [first] and
 * before [last] (F_START, F_END: the flats), markers inside left out *)
val between : t -> string -> string -> lump list

(* [write kind lumps]: a WAD file of them *)
val write : string -> lump list -> string

(* the numbers in a lump: an unsigned byte, a short (signed), an int
 * of 32 bits (signed: on a Pi1's 31-bit ints only small ones are
 * right, which every int of a WAD is), and a name of eight bytes at
 * an offset, its zeros cut, in capitals *)
val u8 : string -> int -> int
val short : string -> int -> int
val int32 : string -> int -> int
val name8 : string -> int -> string

(* the same, written into a Buffer *)
val add_short : Buffer.t -> int -> unit
val add_int32 : Buffer.t -> int -> unit
val add_name8 : Buffer.t -> string -> unit
games/fps/quake/Quake.ml
17610
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* mini-quake: Quake (id Software, 1996), its software renderer and
 * its lightmaps, as a program of ix's playground
 * (docs/plans/done/plan_quake.md). A game in a level of a .bsp --
 * LibreQuake's lq_e0m1 by default, compiled by qbsp and vis, lit by
 * tools/Light.ml (data/README.md) -- textured and lit as Quake drew
 * it, its doors, buttons, lifts and triggers working, its monsters
 * awake and fighting (Monsters, Ai), its weapons fired (Weapons), its
 * sounds heard and its music played (Sound).
 *
 *   the keys: the arrows (or w, s) walk and turn; a and d step aside;
 *   shift runs; space jumps (swims up); control (or f) fires; 1 to 7
 *   the weapons (1 the axe, 2 the shotgun, 3 the super shotgun, 4 the
 *   nailgun, 6 the grenade launcher, 7 the rocket launcher); e uses (a
 *   secret door, a button: what Quake's shot did too); page up and
 *   down look
 *
 *   usage: mini-quake [bsp=file.bsp] [scale=n]
 *            [x=X y=Y z=Z angle=A pitch=P] [lightmaps] [things=off]
 *            [gamma=g] [nomonsters] [ai=ways] [weapons=all] [sound=off|3d]
 *            [music=off|on] [graphics=only] [entities] [models=simple]
 *     bsp=   the level (default: /lib/quake/e0m1.bsp, else
 *            games/fps/quake/data/e0m1.bsp); the palette and the
 *            colormap beside it
 *     scale= each pixel made n by n (1 to 4; 2 by default; on Plan 9
 *            the window or screen, the largest whole n that fits)
 *     x= y= z= angle= pitch=  the eye put there, looking that way
 *            (degrees): a test's camera
 *     lightmaps  the textures grey: the lightmaps alone
 *     things=off  no monster nor item drawn
 *     gamma= the brightness: 1 the palette as it is (id's default) to
 *            0.3; 0.7 by default
 *     nomonsters  the level without its monsters (Quake's -nomonsters)
 *     ai=ways  the monsters find their way by the playground's AI
 *            (Ways), not QuakeC's alone (Monster_ai)
 *     weapons=all  every weapon and ammunition (Quake's impulse 9):
 *            the grenade launcher, which lq_e0m1 does not have
 *     sound= off: none; 3d: the playground's Audio3d, not Quake's
 *     music= the level's CD track, music/trackNN.ogg (worldspawn's
 *            "sounds"); off by default on Plan 9 (Vorbis's decoding by
 *            mini-ml's code)
 *     graphics=only  nomonsters things=off sound=off music=off: the
 *            renderer alone (its frames a second, the monsters' cost
 *            and the sound's apart)
 *     entities   the level's entities listed, and the end
 *     models=simple  the models' triangles by the first way, not by
 *            their gradients (Alias.gradients)
 *     precache   the models, sounds and music the game reads, listed
 *
 * A frame (the playground's view): Play's move for the time since the
 * last frame, then Render's picture of the eye, 320 by 200 bytes of
 * the palette, made the platform's pixels (each index its colour, n by
 * n), one Bitmap shape:
 *
 *          the keys                           the picture
 *   computer.keyboard --> Play.frame dt --> the eye, the doors' places
 *                                                  |
 *   Bitmap <-- the palette, n by n <-- Render.frame: 320 x 200 bytes
 *
 * history:
 * id's game ran on DOS (its renderer in C and Pentium assembly, by John
 * Carmack and Michael Abrash), then WinQuake, GLQuake (1997, OpenGL),
 * QuakeWorld; id gave the source in 1999 (GPL), and every port since
 * comes from it. chocolate-quake keeps its C paths: what these modules
 * were read beside. *)

module P = Playground
open Model

type model = {
  level : Model.t;
  render : Render.t;
  mutable play : Play.t;
  mutable game : Game.t;
  (* the level again from its start: the player dead, a key pressed *)
  restart : unit -> Play.t * Game.t;
  sound : Sound.t option;
  (* the palette reddened by a hit, 1 to 8, gilded by an item, 9 to 12
   * (Quake's color shifts, V_UpdatePalette: made once each) *)
  palettes : string array;
  (* the level's message: its name *)
  name : string;
  (* two pictures' bytes, one a frame in turn: the platform compares a
   * frame's shapes with the last's, so each frame's picture is a new
   * value, not the same bytes changed *)
  screens : Bytes.t array;
  mutable frames : int;
  status : bool; (* the status line shown *)
  mutable last : float;
}

(* the picture as it is, 320 by 200 bytes of the palette, given to the
 * platform (a Pixels shape), which makes of it what its device wants,
 * each pixel n by n (docs/plans/done/plan_playground_framebuffer.md, F2).
 * old: made RGBA here (to_rgba), then again by the draw platform *)
let snapshot (m : model) : unit =
  let src = m.render.view.screen in
  Bytes.blit src 0 m.screens.(m.frames land 1) 0 (Bytes.length src)

(* the palettes of [palette]: towards red by a twelfth a step, towards
 * gold by a tenth *)
let palettes (base : string) : string array =
  let tint ((r, g, b) : int * int * int) (k : float) : string =
    String.init 768 (fun (i : int) ->
        let c = Char.code base.[i] in
        let to_ = match i mod 3 with 0 -> r | 1 -> g | _ -> b in
        Char.chr (c + int_of_float (k *. float (to_ - c))))
  in
  Array.init 13 (fun (i : int) ->
      if i = 0 then base
      else if i <= 8 then tint (255, 0, 0) (float i /. 12.)
      else tint (215, 186, 69) (float (i - 8) /. 10.))

let palette (m : model) : string =
  let c = m.game.world.client in
  if c.damage_count > 0. then
    m.palettes.(1 + min 7 (int_of_float (c.damage_count *. 8.)))
  else if c.bonus_count > 0. then
    m.palettes.(9 + min 3 (int_of_float (c.bonus_count *. 4.)))
  else m.palettes.(0)

(* the eye: Play's, or the floor's when dead (view_ofs '0 0 -8') *)
let eye (m : model) : vec =
  match Game.dead_for m.game with
  | Some _ -> { m.play.body.origin with z = m.play.body.origin.z -. 8. }
  | None -> Play.eye m.play

let view (computer : P.computer) (m : model) : P.shape list =
  let p = m.play in
  List.iter
    (fun (t : Things.thing) ->
      if Brushes.taken p.brushes t.classname t.origin then t.alive <- false)
    m.game.things;
  Render.frame m.render m.level (eye m) p.pitch (Play.yaw p) p.time p.styles
    (Play.bmodels p) m.game.things;
  (* the game's entities, its particles, the weapon in hand *)
  Game.draw m.game m.render.view;
  m.frames <- m.frames + 1;
  snapshot m;
  let screen = computer.screen in
  let v = m.render.view in
  let w =
    Float.min screen.width (screen.height *. float v.width /. float v.height)
  in
  let h = w *. float v.height /. float v.width in
  let text (s : string) (y : float) : P.shape =
    P.words P.white s |> P.scale 2. |> P.move 0. y
  in
  (if h < screen.height || w < screen.width then
     [ P.rectangle (P.rgb 96 96 96) screen.width screen.height ]
   else [])
  @ [
      P.pixels w h
        {
          pwidth = v.width;
          pheight = v.height;
          indices = m.screens.(m.frames land 1);
          palette = palette m;
        };
    ]
  @ (if m.status then [ text (Game.status m.game) (20. -. (h /. 2.)) ] else [])
  @ (match m.game.world.message with
    | Some (s, at) when p.time -. at < 2. -> [ text s ((h /. 4.) -. 20.) ]
    | _ -> [])
  @ (match Game.dead_for m.game with
    | Some _ -> [ text "Press jump to play again" 0. ]
    | None -> [])
  (* (a door's, a trigger's message, for 2 seconds: Quake's centerprint) *)
  @ (match Brushes.message p.brushes with
    | Some (s, at) when p.time -. at < 2. -> [ text s (h /. 4.) ]
    | _ -> [])
  @
  if Brushes.exited p.brushes then
    let found, total = Brushes.secrets p.brushes in
    [
      text
        (Printf.sprintf "%s finished: %d of %d secrets" m.name found total)
        0.;
    ]
  else []

let update (computer : P.computer) (m : model) : model =
  let (P.Time now) = computer.time in
  if m.last = 0. || now -. m.last > 0.5 then m.last <- now;
  let dt = Float.min 0.1 (now -. m.last) in
  m.last <- now;
  let k = computer.keyboard in
  let held (name : string) : bool = Set_.mem name k.keys in
  let alive = Game.dead_for m.game = None in
  Play.frame m.play dt
    {
      forward = alive && (k.kup || k.kw);
      back = alive && (k.kdown || k.ks);
      left = alive && k.kleft;
      right = alive && k.kright;
      strafe_left = alive && k.ka;
      strafe_right = alive && k.kd;
      jump = alive && k.kspace;
      run = k.kshift;
      look_up = held "pageup";
      look_down = held "pagedown";
      use_key = alive && held "e";
    };
  let impulse =
    match List.find_opt held [ "1"; "2"; "3"; "4"; "6"; "7" ] with
    | Some n -> int_of_string n
    | None -> 0
  in
  Game.frame m.game dt (held "Control" || held "f") impulse;
  (match m.sound with
  | Some s -> Sound.play s (Game.sounds m.game) (eye m) (Play.yaw m.play)
  | None -> ignore (Game.sounds m.game));
  (* dead a second, then jump: the level again (single player's
   * respawn: the map reloaded) *)
  (match Game.dead_for m.game with
  | Some t when t > 1. && k.kspace ->
      let play, game = m.restart () in
      m.play <- play;
      m.game <- game
  | _ -> ());
  m

(* The palette made brighter (id's BuildGammaTable, vid.c): each
 * component c becomes 255 ((c + 0.5) / 255.5)^gamma. Quake's Options
 * menu's Brightness was this, from 1 (the palette as it is, id's
 * default) to 0.5; it changes no pixel's index, only the colours shown,
 * so it costs nothing a frame. 0.7 by default here: LibreQuake's map
 * was lit by ericw-tools for brighter rooms than tools/Light.ml's (the
 * author, 2026-10-22: "many zones seems still very dark (it's actually
 * hard to see some dogs in the shadow)"). *)
let default_gamma = 0.7

let with_gamma (g : float) (c : int) : int =
  if g = 1. then c
  else
    max 0
      (min 255
         (int_of_float ((255. *. (((float c +. 0.5) /. 255.5) ** g)) +. 0.5)))

let default_bsps = [ "/lib/quake/e0m1.bsp"; "games/fps/quake/data/e0m1.bsp" ]

let () =
  Cap.main (fun caps ->
      Exit.exit caps @@ Exit.catch
      @@ fun () ->
      (try
         let flags = Playground_platform.flags caps in
         (* graphics=only: the renderer alone, as the game was before its
          * things, monsters and sound: a frame rate of the drawing only *)
         let flags =
           if List.assoc_opt "graphics" flags = Some "only" then
             [ ("nomonsters", ""); ("things", "off"); ("sound", "off");
               ("music", "off") ]
             @ flags
           else flags
         in
         let flag (name : string) : string option = List.assoc_opt name flags in
         let path =
           match flag "bsp" with
           | Some f -> f
           | None -> (
               match
                 List.find_opt
                   (fun (f : string) -> Sys.file_exists f)
                   default_bsps
               with
               | Some f -> f
               | None -> failwith "no level: bsp=file.bsp")
         in
         let level = Model.load (Bspfile.parse (FS.read caps (Fpath.v path))) in
         if flag "precache" <> None then
           (* what the game reads beside the level: its models, its
            * sounds, its music (tools/mkdata.sh copies them) *)
           List.iter
             (fun (f : string) -> Console.print caps (f ^ "\n"))
             (Monsters.models @ Weapons.models
             @ List.map
                 (fun (s : string) -> "sound/" ^ s ^ ".wav")
                 (Monsters.sounds @ Weapons.sounds @ Brushes.sound_names)
             @ [ Cdaudio.track level ])
         else if flag "entities" <> None then
           List.iter
             (fun (e : (string * string) list) ->
               Console.print caps
                 (String.concat " "
                    (List.map
                       (fun ((k, v) : string * string) ->
                         Printf.sprintf "%s=%S" k v)
                       e)
                 ^ "\n"))
             level.entities
         else begin
           let beside (f : string) : string =
             FS.read caps (Fpath.v (Filename.concat (Filename.dirname path) f))
           in
           let palette = beside "palette.lmp"
           and colormap = beside "colormap.lmp" in
           let scale =
             match Option.bind (flag "scale") int_of_string_opt with
             | Some n when n >= 1 && n <= 4 -> Some n
             (* (None: the window's size, the platform's whole multiple) *)
             | _ -> if Sys.os_type = "Plan9" then None else Some 2
           in
           let render = Render.create level colormap in
           let gamma =
             match Option.bind (flag "gamma") float_of_string_opt with
             | Some g when g >= 0.3 && g <= 1. -> g
             | _ -> default_gamma
           in
           let palette =
             String.map
               (fun (c : char) -> Char.chr (with_gamma gamma (Char.code c)))
               palette
           in
           if flag "lightmaps" <> None then Surfcache.grey := true;
           if flag "models" = Some "simple" then Alias.gradients := false;
           let place (play : Play.t) : unit =
             match
               ( Option.bind (flag "x") float_of_string_opt,
                 Option.bind (flag "y") float_of_string_opt,
                 Option.bind (flag "z") float_of_string_opt )
             with
             | Some x, Some y, Some z ->
                 let a =
                   match Option.bind (flag "angle") float_of_string_opt with
                   | Some a -> a
                   | None -> 0.
                 in
                 let pitch =
                   match Option.bind (flag "pitch") float_of_string_opt with
                   | Some a -> a
                   | None -> 0.
                 in
                 Play.place play { x; y; z } a pitch
             | _ -> ()
           in
           let read (f : string) : string option =
             FS.read_opt caps
               (Fpath.v (Filename.concat (Filename.dirname path) f))
           in
           (* (the models, read once for all the restarts) *)
           let cache = Hashtbl.create 32 in
           let models (f : string) : Alias.t option =
             match Hashtbl.find_opt cache f with
             | Some x -> x
             | None ->
                 let x = Option.map Alias.load (read f) in
                 Hashtbl.replace cache f x;
                 x
           in
           let start () : Play.t * Game.t =
             (* (the same level: Play makes its doors and lifts again,
              * and the renderer has marked its leaves) *)
             let play = Play.create level in
             place play;
             (* (the items standing; the monsters are Game's) *)
             let things =
               if flag "things" = Some "off" then []
               else
                 List.filter
                   (fun (t : Things.thing) ->
                     not
                       (String.length t.classname > 8
                       && String.sub t.classname 0 8 = "monster_"))
                   (Things.load level read)
             in
             let game =
               Game.create level play models things
                 (flag "nomonsters" = None && flag "things" <> Some "off")
                 (flag "ai" = Some "ways")
             in
             if flag "weapons" = Some "all" then Game.give_all game;
             (play, game)
           in
           let play, game = start () in
           let sound =
             if flag "sound" = Some "off" then None
             else Some (Sound.create read (flag "sound" = Some "3d"))
           in
           (* the level's CD track, looping (off by default on Plan 9:
            * mini-ml's decoding is most of a Pi's core) *)
           let music =
             match flag "music" with
             | Some m -> m = "on"
             | None -> Sys.os_type <> "Plan9"
           in
           (if music && sound <> None then
              match read (Cdaudio.track level) with
              | Some ogg -> Cdaudio.play ogg
              | None -> ());
           let name =
             match level.entities with
             | w :: _ -> (
                 match Model.value w "message" with Some s -> s | None -> path)
             | [] -> path
           in
           let model =
             {
               level;
               render;
               play;
               game;
               restart = start;
               sound;
               palettes = palettes palette;
               status = flag "status" <> Some "off";
               name;
               screens =
                 [| Bytes.create (320 * 200); Bytes.create (320 * 200) |];
               frames = 0;
               last = 0.;
             }
           in
           let flags =
             match (flag "window", scale) with
             | Some _, _ -> flags
             | None, Some n ->
                 ("window", Printf.sprintf "%dx%d" (320 * n) (200 * n)) :: flags
             | None, None -> ("window", "") :: flags
           in
           (* (no scale: the software platform's square of 320) *)
           let side = match scale with Some n -> 320 * n | None -> 320 in
           let flags =
             if flag "size" = None then ("size", string_of_int side) :: flags
             else flags
           in
           Playground_platform.run_app caps
             (("heap", "modest") :: flags)
             (P.game view update model)
         end
       with Failure msg ->
         Console.eprint caps ("mini-quake: " ^ msg ^ "\n");
         CapStdlib.exit caps 1);
      Exit.OK)
games/fps/quake/game/Brushes.ml

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Brushes.mli *)

open Model

type body = {
  mutable origin : vec;
  mutable velocity : vec;
  mutable yaw : float;
  mutable onground : bool;
  mutable ground : int;
}

(* STATE_TOP, STATE_BOTTOM, STATE_UP, STATE_DOWN *)
type state = Top | Bottom | Up | Down

(* what a mover does when it arrives, or when its time comes *)
type action =
  | Door_hit_top
  | Door_hit_bottom
  | Door_go_down
  | Button_wait
  | Button_return
  | Button_done
  | Plat_hit_top
  | Plat_hit_bottom
  | Plat_go_down
  (* fd_secret_move1 to 6 *)
  | Secret of int
  | Remove

type kind =
  | Door of {
      pos1 : vec;
      pos2 : vec;
      mutable dstate : state;
      mutable linked : int list;
      key : int;
      toggle : bool;
    }
  | Button of {
      bpos1 : vec;
      bpos2 : vec;
      mutable bstate : state;
      shootable : bool;
    }
  | Plat of {
      ppos1 : vec;
      ppos2 : vec;
      mutable pstate : state;
      mutable usable : bool;
    }
  | Secret_door of {
      start : vec;
      mutable dest1 : vec;
      mutable dest2 : vec;
      forward : vec;
      right : vec;
      up : vec;
      length : float;
      width : float;
      flags : int;
    }
  (* a door's field, a plat's: touched, it uses its owner *)
  | Field of { owner : int; fmins : vec; fmaxs : vec }
  | Trigger of { once : bool; secret : bool }
  | Teleport of { mutable enabled_until : float }
  | Changelevel
  | Wall
  | Light of { style : int; mutable on : bool }
  | Other

type ent = {
  num : int;
  classname : string;
  keys : (string * string) list;
  (* its brush model, -1 none *)
  bmodel : int;
  mutable eorigin : vec;
  mutable alive : bool;
  kind : kind;
  mutable frame : int;
  speed : float;
  wait : float;
  (* moving: towards dest, then the action *)
  mutable dest : vec;
  mutable moving : bool;
  mutable on_arrive : action;
  (* thinking: the action at that time *)
  mutable think : (float * action) option;
  (* (a touch's or a field's next possible time: attack_finished) *)
  mutable ready : float;
  mutable message : string;
}

type t = {
  level : Model.t;
  ents : ent array;
  styles : string array;
  mutable msg : (string * float) option;
  mutable exited : bool;
  mutable found : int;
  total : int;
  mutable keys_held : int;
  mutable now : float;
  (* the sounds made, their names and where (the brush's middle) *)
  mutable sounds : (string * vec option) list; (* None: the player's own *)
}

let key (e : ent) (k : string) : string option = List.assoc_opt k e.keys

let fkey (e : ent) (k : string) (default : float) : float =
  match
    Option.bind (key e k) (fun (s : string) ->
        float_of_string_opt (String.trim s))
  with
  | Some f -> f
  | None -> default

let ikey (e : ent) (k : string) : int = int_of_float (fkey e k 0.)

let size (m : Model.t) (e : ent) : vec =
  if e.bmodel < 0 then zero
  else
    let sm = m.submodels.(e.bmodel) in
    sub sm.maxs sm.mins

let absmins (m : Model.t) (e : ent) : vec =
  if e.bmodel < 0 then e.eorigin else add e.eorigin m.submodels.(e.bmodel).mins

let absmaxs (m : Model.t) (e : ent) : vec =
  if e.bmodel < 0 then e.eorigin else add e.eorigin m.submodels.(e.bmodel).maxs

(* (QuakeC's "if (!self.wait) self.wait = 5": 0 is unset) *)
let nonzero (v : float) (default : float) : float =
  if v = 0. then default else v

let fabs_dot (a : vec) (b : vec) : float = Float.abs (dot a b)

(* "angle": -1 up, -2 down, else a yaw (SetMovedir) *)
let movedir (e : ent) : vec =
  let a = fkey e "angle" 0. in
  if a = -1. then { x = 0.; y = 0.; z = 1. }
  else if a = -2. then { x = 0.; y = 0.; z = -1. }
  else
    let f, _, _ = View.angle_vectors 0. a in
    f

let player_mins = { x = -16.; y = -16.; z = -24. }
let player_maxs = { x = 16.; y = 16.; z = 32. }

let boxes_touch (amin : vec) (amax : vec) (bmin : vec) (bmax : vec) : bool =
  amin.x <= bmax.x && amax.x >= bmin.x && amin.y <= bmax.y && amax.y >= bmin.y
  && amin.z <= bmax.z && amax.z >= bmin.z

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Spawning *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let create (m : Model.t) (styles : string array) : t =
  Array.fill styles 0 (Array.length styles) "";
  List.iter (fun ((k, s) : int * string) -> styles.(k) <- s) View.styles;
  let ents =
    List.mapi
      (fun (num : int) (keys : (string * string) list) ->
        let classname =
          match List.assoc_opt "classname" keys with Some v -> v | None -> ""
        in
        let bmodel =
          match List.assoc_opt "model" keys with
          | Some s when String.length s > 1 && s.[0] = '*' ->
              int_of_string (String.sub s 1 (String.length s - 1))
          | _ -> -1
        in
        let flags =
          match
            Option.bind (List.assoc_opt "spawnflags" keys) int_of_string_opt
          with
          | Some f -> f
          | None -> 0
        in
        let origin =
          match List.assoc_opt "origin" keys with
          | Some o -> vec_of_string o
          | None -> zero
        in
        {
          num;
          classname;
          keys;
          bmodel;
          eorigin = origin;
          (* (not in medium skill: SPAWNFLAG_NOT_MEDIUM) *)
          alive = num = 0 || flags land 512 = 0;
          kind = Other;
          frame = 0;
          speed = 0.;
          wait = 0.;
          dest = origin;
          moving = false;
          on_arrive = Remove;
          think = None;
          ready = 0.;
          message =
            (match List.assoc_opt "message" keys with
            | Some v -> v
            | None -> "");
        })
      m.entities
    |> Array.of_list
  in
  let b =
    {
      level = m;
      ents;
      styles;
      msg = None;
      sounds = [];
      exited = false;
      found = 0;
      total = 0;
      keys_held = 0;
      now = 0.;
    }
  in
  let set (e : ent) (speed : float) (wait : float) (kind : kind) : unit =
    ents.(e.num) <- { e with speed; wait; kind }
  in
  let total = ref 0 in
  Array.iter
    (fun (e : ent) ->
      if e.alive then
        match e.classname with
        | "func_door" ->
            let dir = movedir e in
            let lip = fkey e "lip" 8. in
            let pos1 = e.eorigin in
            let pos2 = add pos1 (scale (fabs_dot dir (size m e) -. lip) dir) in
            let flags = ikey e "spawnflags" in
            (* (START_OPEN: the positions swapped) *)
            let pos1, pos2 =
              if flags land 1 <> 0 then (pos2, pos1) else (pos1, pos2)
            in
            set e (fkey e "speed" 100.) (fkey e "wait" 3.)
              (Door
                 {
                   pos1;
                   pos2;
                   dstate = Bottom;
                   linked = [ e.num ];
                   key = flags land (8 lor 16);
                   toggle = flags land 32 <> 0;
                 });
            ents.(e.num).eorigin <- pos1
        | "func_door_secret" ->
            let f, r, u = View.angle_vectors 0. (fkey e "angle" 0.) in
            set e (fkey e "speed" 50.)
              (nonzero (fkey e "wait" 0.) 5.)
              (Secret_door
                 {
                   start = e.eorigin;
                   dest1 = e.eorigin;
                   dest2 = e.eorigin;
                   forward = f;
                   right = r;
                   up = u;
                   length = fkey e "t_length" 0.;
                   width = fkey e "t_width" 0.;
                   flags = ikey e "spawnflags";
                 })
        | "func_button" ->
            let dir = movedir e in
            let pos2 =
              add e.eorigin
                (scale (fabs_dot dir (size m e) -. fkey e "lip" 4.) dir)
            in
            set e (fkey e "speed" 40.)
              (nonzero (fkey e "wait" 0.) 1.)
              (Button
                 {
                   bpos1 = e.eorigin;
                   bpos2 = pos2;
                   bstate = Bottom;
                   shootable = fkey e "health" 0. > 0.;
                 })
        | "func_plat" ->
            let sz = size m e in
            let pos1 = e.eorigin in
            let h = fkey e "height" 0. in
            let pos2 =
              {
                pos1 with
                z = (if h <> 0. then pos1.z -. h else pos1.z -. sz.z +. 8.);
              }
            in
            let targeted = key e "targetname" <> None in
            set e (fkey e "speed" 150.) 0.
              (Plat
                 {
                   ppos1 = pos1;
                   ppos2 = pos2;
                   pstate = (if targeted then Up else Bottom);
                   usable = targeted;
                 });
            if not targeted then ents.(e.num).eorigin <- pos2
        | "func_wall" -> set e 0. 0. Wall
        | "trigger_once" ->
            set e 0. (-1.) (Trigger { once = true; secret = false })
        | "trigger_multiple" ->
            set e 0.
              (nonzero (fkey e "wait" 0.) 0.2)
              (Trigger { once = false; secret = false })
        | "trigger_secret" ->
            incr total;
            set e 0. (-1.) (Trigger { once = true; secret = true });
            if e.message = "" then
              ents.(e.num).message <- "You found a secret area!"
        | "trigger_teleport" ->
            set e 0. 0.
              (Teleport
                 {
                   enabled_until =
                     (if key e "targetname" = None then infinity else 0.);
                 })
        | "trigger_changelevel" -> set e 0. 0. Changelevel
        | "light" | "light_fluoro" | "light_fluorospark" -> (
            match
              (key e "targetname", Option.bind (key e "style") int_of_string_opt)
            with
            | Some _, Some s when s >= 32 ->
                let on = ikey e "spawnflags" land 1 = 0 in
                styles.(s) <- (if on then "m" else "a");
                set e 0. 0. (Light { style = s; on })
            | _ -> ())
        | _ -> ())
    ents;
  (* the doors that touch, linked (LinkDoors); a field around each
   * group with nothing else to open it: no name, no key, not shot *)
  let doors =
    List.filter
      (fun (e : ent) ->
        e.alive && match e.kind with Door _ -> true | _ -> false)
      (Array.to_list ents)
  in
  let fields = ref [] in
  List.iter
    (fun (e : ent) ->
      match e.kind with
      | Door d when ikey e "spawnflags" land 4 = 0 && List.length d.linked = 1
        ->
          let group = ref [ e ] and changed = ref true in
          while !changed do
            changed := false;
            List.iter
              (fun (o : ent) ->
                if
                  (not (List.memq o !group))
                  && ikey o "spawnflags" land 4 = 0
                  && List.exists
                       (fun (g : ent) ->
                         boxes_touch (absmins m g) (absmaxs m g) (absmins m o)
                           (absmaxs m o))
                       !group
                then begin
                  group := o :: !group;
                  changed := true
                end)
              doors
          done;
          let nums = List.map (fun (g : ent) -> g.num) !group in
          List.iter
            (fun (g : ent) ->
              match g.kind with Door gd -> gd.linked <- nums | _ -> ())
            !group;
          if
            List.for_all
              (fun (g : ent) ->
                key g "targetname" = None
                && fkey g "health" 0. = 0.
                && match g.kind with Door gd -> gd.key = 0 | _ -> true)
              !group
          then begin
            let mins =
              List.fold_left
                (fun (a : vec) (g : ent) ->
                  let v = absmins m g in
                  {
                    x = Float.min a.x v.x;
                    y = Float.min a.y v.y;
                    z = Float.min a.z v.z;
                  })
                (absmins m e) !group
            in
            let maxs =
              List.fold_left
                (fun (a : vec) (g : ent) ->
                  let v = absmaxs m g in
                  {
                    x = Float.max a.x v.x;
                    y = Float.max a.y v.y;
                    z = Float.max a.z v.z;
                  })
                (absmaxs m e) !group
            in
            fields :=
              Field
                {
                  owner = e.num;
                  fmins =
                    { x = mins.x -. 60.; y = mins.y -. 60.; z = mins.z -. 8. };
                  fmaxs =
                    { x = maxs.x +. 60.; y = maxs.y +. 60.; z = maxs.z +. 8. };
                }
              :: !fields
          end
      | _ -> ())
    doors;
  (* a plat's field: over it, the height it travels (plat_spawn_inside_trigger) *)
  Array.iter
    (fun (e : ent) ->
      match e.kind with
      | Plat p ->
          let sm = m.submodels.(e.bmodel) in
          let mins = add sm.mins { x = 25.; y = 25.; z = 0. }
          and maxs = sub sm.maxs { x = 25.; y = 25.; z = -8. } in
          let mins =
            { mins with z = maxs.z -. (p.ppos1.z -. p.ppos2.z +. 8.) }
          in
          fields :=
            Field { owner = e.num; fmins = mins; fmaxs = maxs } :: !fields
      | _ -> ())
    ents;
  let extra =
    List.mapi
      (fun (i : int) (k : kind) ->
        {
          num = Array.length ents + i;
          classname = "field";
          keys = [];
          bmodel = -1;
          eorigin = zero;
          alive = true;
          kind = k;
          frame = 0;
          speed = 0.;
          wait = 0.;
          dest = zero;
          moving = false;
          on_arrive = Remove;
          think = None;
          ready = 0.;
          message = "";
        })
      (List.rev !fields)
  in
  { b with ents = Array.append ents (Array.of_list extra); total = !total }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Moving (SUB_CalcMove, SV_PushMove) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the noises of a mover, as its "sounds" key says (doors.qc, plats.qc,
 * buttons.qc): the one of its move, the one of its stop *)
let noises (e : ent) : string * string =
  let n = int_of_float (fkey e "sounds" 0.) in
  match e.kind with
  | Door _ -> (
      match n with
      | 1 -> ("doors/doormv1", "doors/drclos4")
      | 2 -> ("doors/hydro1", "doors/hydro2")
      | 3 -> ("doors/stndr1", "doors/stndr2")
      | 4 -> ("doors/ddoor1", "doors/ddoor2")
      | _ -> ("", ""))
  | Plat _ ->
      if n = 2 then ("plats/medplat1", "plats/medplat2")
      else ("plats/plat1", "plats/plat2")
  | Button _ ->
      ( (match n with
        | 1 -> "buttons/switch21"
        | 2 -> "buttons/switch02"
        | 3 -> "buttons/switch04"
        | _ -> "buttons/airbut1"),
        "" )
  | Secret_door _ -> (
      match n with
      | 1 -> ("doors/winch2", "doors/drclos4")
      | 2 -> ("doors/airdoor1", "doors/airdoor2")
      | _ -> ("doors/basesec1", "doors/basesec2"))
  | _ -> ("", "")

(* [sound b e which]: e's noise, from its middle *)
let sound (b : t) (e : ent) (sfx : string) : unit =
  if sfx <> "" then begin
    let mid = scale 0.5 (add (absmins b.level e) (absmaxs b.level e)) in
    b.sounds <- (sfx, Some mid) :: b.sounds
  end

(* SUB_CalcMove, its move's noise *)
let calc_move (b : t) (e : ent) (dest : vec) (arrive : action) : unit =
  (match e.kind with Button _ -> () | _ -> sound b e (fst (noises e)));
  e.dest <- dest;
  e.moving <- true;
  e.on_arrive <- arrive

(* centerprint, and its talk *)
let say (b : t) (s : string) : unit =
  if s <> "" then begin
    b.msg <- Some (s, b.now);
    b.sounds <- ("misc/talk", None) :: b.sounds
  end

let rec use_targets (b : t) (body : body) (e : ent) : unit =
  say b e.message;
  (match key e "killtarget" with
  | Some k ->
      Array.iter
        (fun (o : ent) -> if key o "targetname" = Some k then o.alive <- false)
        b.ents
  | None -> ());
  match key e "target" with
  | Some t ->
      Array.iter
        (fun (o : ent) ->
          if o.alive && key o "targetname" = Some t then use_ent b body o)
        b.ents
  | None -> ()

and door_go_up (b : t) (body : body) (e : ent) : unit =
  match e.kind with
  | Door d -> (
      match d.dstate with
      | Up -> ()
      | Top ->
          if e.wait >= 0. then e.think <- Some (b.now +. e.wait, Door_go_down)
      | _ ->
          d.dstate <- Up;
          calc_move b e d.pos2 Door_hit_top;
          use_targets b body e)
  | _ -> ()

and door_go_down (b : t) (e : ent) : unit =
  match e.kind with
  | Door d ->
      d.dstate <- Down;
      calc_move b e d.pos1 Door_hit_bottom
  | _ -> ()

and door_fire (b : t) (body : body) (e : ent) : unit =
  match e.kind with
  | Door d ->
      let group = List.map (fun (k : int) -> b.ents.(k)) d.linked in
      if d.toggle && (d.dstate = Up || d.dstate = Top) then
        List.iter (door_go_down b) group
      else List.iter (door_go_up b body) group
  | _ -> ()

and use_ent (b : t) (body : body) (e : ent) : unit =
  match e.kind with
  | Door _ -> door_fire b body e
  | Button bt ->
      if bt.bstate <> Up && bt.bstate <> Top then begin
        sound b e (fst (noises e));
        bt.bstate <- Up;
        calc_move b e bt.bpos2 Button_wait
      end
  | Plat p ->
      if p.usable then begin
        p.usable <- false;
        p.pstate <- Down;
        calc_move b e p.ppos2 Plat_hit_bottom
      end
      else if e.think = None && p.pstate = Top then begin
        p.pstate <- Down;
        calc_move b e p.ppos2 Plat_hit_bottom
      end
  | Secret_door s ->
      if (not e.moving) && e.eorigin = s.start then begin
        e.message <- "";
        use_targets b body e;
        (* back (or down), then aside along its angle *)
        let sz = size b.level e in
        let width =
          if s.width <> 0. then s.width
          else if s.flags land 4 <> 0 then fabs_dot s.up sz
          else fabs_dot s.right sz
        in
        let length =
          if s.length <> 0. then s.length else fabs_dot s.forward sz
        in
        let side = if s.flags land 2 <> 0 then -1. else 1. in
        s.dest1 <-
          (if s.flags land 4 <> 0 then sub s.start (scale width s.up)
           else add s.start (scale (width *. side) s.right));
        s.dest2 <- add s.dest1 (scale length s.forward);
        calc_move b e s.dest1 (Secret 1)
      end
  | Trigger tr -> trigger b body e tr.once tr.secret
  | Teleport tp -> tp.enabled_until <- b.now +. 0.2
  | Light l ->
      l.on <- not l.on;
      b.styles.(l.style) <- (if l.on then "m" else "a")
  | Field _ | Changelevel | Wall | Other -> use_targets b body e

(* multi_trigger *)
and trigger (b : t) (body : body) (e : ent) (once : bool) (secret : bool) : unit
    =
  if b.now >= e.ready then begin
    if secret then begin
      b.found <- b.found + 1;
      b.sounds <- ("misc/secret", None) :: b.sounds
    end;
    use_targets b body e;
    if once then e.alive <- false else e.ready <- b.now +. e.wait
  end

let arrive (b : t) (body : body) (e : ent) (a : action) : unit =
  match (a, e.kind) with
  | Door_hit_top, Door d ->
      sound b e (snd (noises e));
      d.dstate <- Top;
      (* (wait -1: never back, its think in the past never runs) *)
      if (not d.toggle) && e.wait >= 0. then
        e.think <- Some (b.now +. e.wait, Door_go_down)
  | Door_hit_bottom, Door d ->
      sound b e (snd (noises e));
      d.dstate <- Bottom
  | Door_go_down, Door _ -> door_go_down b e
  | Button_wait, Button bt ->
      bt.bstate <- Top;
      e.frame <- 1;
      if e.wait >= 0. then e.think <- Some (b.now +. e.wait, Button_return);
      use_targets b body e
  | Button_return, Button bt ->
      bt.bstate <- Down;
      e.frame <- 0;
      calc_move b e bt.bpos1 Button_done
  | Button_done, Button bt -> bt.bstate <- Bottom
  | Plat_hit_top, Plat p ->
      sound b e (snd (noises e));
      p.pstate <- Top;
      e.think <- Some (b.now +. 3., Plat_go_down)
  | Plat_hit_bottom, Plat p ->
      sound b e (snd (noises e));
      p.pstate <- Bottom
  | Plat_go_down, Plat p ->
      p.pstate <- Down;
      calc_move b e p.ppos2 Plat_hit_bottom
  | Secret k, Secret_door s -> (
      match k with
      | 1 -> e.think <- Some (b.now +. 1., Secret 2)
      | 2 -> calc_move b e s.dest2 (Secret 3)
      | 3 ->
          if s.flags land 1 = 0 && e.wait >= 0. then
            e.think <- Some (b.now +. e.wait, Secret 4)
      | 4 -> calc_move b e s.dest1 (Secret 5)
      | 5 -> e.think <- Some (b.now +. 1., Secret 6)
      | _ -> calc_move b e s.start Remove)
  | _ -> ()

(* the player in the brush's model at its origin *)
let inside (b : t) (e : ent) (body : body) : bool =
  let h = b.level.hulls.(1)
  and root = b.level.submodels.(e.bmodel).headnode.(1) in
  let rec contents (num : int) (p : vec) : int =
    if num < 0 then num
    else
      contents
        (if dot h.cplanes.(num).normal p -. h.cplanes.(num).dist >= 0. then
           h.front.(num)
         else h.back.(num))
        p
  in
  contents root (sub body.origin e.eorigin) = -2

let solids_but (b : t) (k : int) : (int * int * vec) list =
  Array.fold_left
    (fun (acc : (int * int * vec) list) (e : ent) ->
      match e.kind with
      | (Door _ | Button _ | Plat _ | Secret_door _ | Wall)
        when e.alive && e.num <> k && e.bmodel >= 0 ->
          (e.num, e.bmodel, e.eorigin) :: acc
      | _ -> acc)
    [] b.ents

let solids (b : t) : (int * int * vec) list = solids_but b (-1)

(* the mover moved by delta, the player with it; false if blocked *)
let push (b : t) (e : ent) (delta : vec) (body : body) : bool =
  let old = e.eorigin in
  e.eorigin <- add old delta;
  let riding = body.onground && body.ground = e.num in
  if riding || inside b e body then begin
    let t =
      Trace.move b.level 1 body.origin (add body.origin delta)
        (solids_but b e.num)
    in
    body.origin <- t.endpos;
    if inside b e body then begin
      e.eorigin <- old;
      false
    end
    else true
  end
  else true

let blocked (b : t) (e : ent) : unit =
  match e.kind with
  | Door d when e.wait >= 0. -> (
      match d.dstate with
      | Down ->
          d.dstate <- Up;
          calc_move b e d.pos2 Door_hit_top
      | _ -> door_go_down b e)
  | Plat p -> (
      match p.pstate with
      | Up ->
          p.pstate <- Down;
          calc_move b e p.ppos2 Plat_hit_bottom
      | Down ->
          p.pstate <- Up;
          calc_move b e p.ppos1 Plat_hit_top
      | _ -> ())
  | _ -> ()

let run (b : t) (body : body) (time : float) (dt : float) : unit =
  b.now <- time;
  Array.iter
    (fun (e : ent) ->
      if e.alive then begin
        if e.moving then begin
          let d = sub e.dest e.eorigin in
          let len = length d and step = e.speed *. dt in
          let delta = if len <= step then d else scale (step /. len) d in
          if push b e delta body then begin
            if len <= step then begin
              e.moving <- false;
              arrive b body e e.on_arrive
            end
          end
          else blocked b e
        end;
        match e.think with
        | Some (at, a) when at <= time ->
            e.think <- None;
            arrive b body e a
        | _ -> ()
      end)
    b.ents

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Touching *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let touch (b : t) (body : body) (time : float) : unit =
  b.now <- time;
  let pmin = add body.origin player_mins
  and pmax = add body.origin player_maxs in
  (* (a touch: the boxes overlap; a brush's walls, a unit around) *)
  let near (mins : vec) (maxs : vec) : bool =
    boxes_touch pmin pmax
      (sub mins { x = 1.; y = 1.; z = 1. })
      (add maxs { x = 1.; y = 1.; z = 1. })
  in
  let m = b.level in
  Array.iter
    (fun (e : ent) ->
      if e.alive then
        match e.kind with
        | Field f ->
            if boxes_touch pmin pmax f.fmins f.fmaxs && time >= e.ready then begin
              e.ready <- time +. 1.;
              let o = b.ents.(f.owner) in
              match o.kind with
              | Plat p -> (
                  match p.pstate with
                  | Bottom ->
                      p.pstate <- Up;
                      calc_move b o p.ppos1 Plat_hit_top;
                      e.ready <- time
                  | Top ->
                      o.think <- Some (time +. 1., Plat_go_down);
                      e.ready <- time
                  | _ -> e.ready <- time)
              | _ ->
                  say b o.message;
                  o.message <- "";
                  door_fire b body o
            end
        | Door d when near (absmins m e) (absmaxs m e) ->
            if d.key <> 0 && time >= e.ready then begin
              e.ready <- time +. 2.;
              if b.keys_held land d.key = d.key then begin
                b.keys_held <- b.keys_held land lnot d.key;
                door_fire b body e
              end
              else
                say b
                  (if d.key = 8 then "You need the gold key"
                   else "You need the silver key")
            end
        | Button bt when (not bt.shootable) && near (absmins m e) (absmaxs m e)
          ->
            use_ent b body e
        | Trigger tr
          when key e "targetname" = None
               && boxes_touch pmin pmax (absmins m e) (absmaxs m e) ->
            trigger b body e tr.once tr.secret
        | Teleport tp
          when tp.enabled_until >= time
               && boxes_touch pmin pmax (absmins m e) (absmaxs m e) -> (
            match
              Array.to_list b.ents
              |> List.find_opt (fun (o : ent) ->
                  key o "targetname" = key e "target"
                  && o.classname = "info_teleport_destination")
            with
            | Some d ->
                let yaw = fkey d "angle" 0. in
                let f, _, _ = View.angle_vectors 0. yaw in
                body.origin <- add d.eorigin { x = 0.; y = 0.; z = 27. };
                body.yaw <- yaw;
                body.velocity <- scale 300. f
            | None -> ())
        | Changelevel when boxes_touch pmin pmax (absmins m e) (absmaxs m e) ->
            b.exited <- true
        | _ -> ())
    b.ents;
  (* the keys, picked up within their box (item_key1: silver, 2: gold) *)
  Array.iter
    (fun (e : ent) ->
      if e.alive && (e.classname = "item_key1" || e.classname = "item_key2")
      then
        if
          boxes_touch pmin pmax
            (sub e.eorigin { x = 16.; y = 16.; z = 0. })
            (add e.eorigin { x = 16.; y = 16.; z = 56. })
        then begin
          e.alive <- false;
          b.keys_held <-
            (b.keys_held lor if e.classname = "item_key2" then 8 else 16);
          say b
            (if e.classname = "item_key2" then "You got the gold key"
             else "You got the silver key")
        end)
    b.ents

let use (b : t) (body : body) (eye : vec) (forward : vec) (time : float) : unit
    =
  b.now <- time;
  let t = Trace.move b.level 0 eye (add eye (scale 96. forward)) (solids b) in
  if t.hit >= 0 && t.fraction < 1. then begin
    let e = b.ents.(t.hit) in
    match e.kind with Secret_door _ | Button _ -> use_ent b body e | _ -> ()
  end

let drawn (b : t) : (int * int * vec * int) list =
  Array.fold_left
    (fun (acc : (int * int * vec * int) list) (e : ent) ->
      match e.kind with
      | (Door _ | Button _ | Plat _ | Secret_door _ | Wall)
        when e.alive && e.bmodel > 0 ->
          (e.num, e.bmodel, e.eorigin, e.frame) :: acc
      | _ -> acc)
    [] b.ents

let message (b : t) : (string * float) option = b.msg
let exited (b : t) : bool = b.exited
let secrets (b : t) : int * int = (b.found, b.total)

let taken (b : t) (classname : string) (origin : vec) : bool =
  Array.exists
    (fun (e : ent) ->
      e.classname = classname && e.eorigin = origin && not e.alive)
    b.ents

let sounds (b : t) : (string * vec option) list =
  let s = List.rev b.sounds in
  b.sounds <- [];
  s
