  ]
games/fps/quake/game/Brushes.mli
4019
(* Brushes: the level's moving and touched things, its brush models
 * and triggers, as QuakeC made them work (id's doors.qc, plats.qc,
 * buttons.qc, triggers.qc, subs.qc, misc.qc's lights).
 *
 * Quake's game logic was not in its engine: the entities of the map
 * (their "classname" and keys) were brought to life by progs.dat,
 * QuakeC compiled, run by the engine's virtual machine. No progs.dat
 * is free to ship (LibreQuake's QuakeC needs a compiler of it), so the
 * few kinds a walk meets are written here, the names of their
 * functions those of id's QuakeC:
 *
 *   func_door      moves along "angle" (-1 up, -2 down) by its size
 *                  less "lip", at "speed", waits "wait" (-1: stays
 *                  open), opened by a field around it (doors that touch
 *                  open together), by a target, or by touching it with
 *                  the key it needs (spawnflags 8 gold, 16 silver)
 *   func_door_secret  pushed back, then aside (fd_secret_use); opened
 *                  by a shot in Quake, here by the use key
 *   func_button    pressed by touch (or a shot, here the use key):
 *                  moves in, its textures' other frames (+a...), fires
 *                  its targets
 *   func_plat      a lift: goes up when stood on, down 3 s after
 *   trigger_once, trigger_multiple, trigger_secret, trigger_teleport,
 *   trigger_changelevel   invisible boxes, touched
 *   a light with a targetname  switched on and off (its style's
 *                  string "m" or "a")
 *
 * A mover (SUB_CalcMove) goes at its speed to its destination; on the
 * way it pushes the player (SV_PushMove): if the player's box is in
 * it, or stands on it, the player is moved the same; if that fails (a
 * wall behind), the mover stops and is blocked (a door goes back).
 *
 * A target is a name: an entity's "target" fires every entity whose
 * "targetname" it is (SUB_UseTargets), each by its own use.
 *
 * Entities flagged not for this skill (spawnflags 256, 512, 1024:
 * easy, medium, hard; this is medium) or for deathmatch only are not
 * spawned, as the engine's ED_LoadFromFile. *)

(* the player as the brushes see it *)
type body = {
  mutable origin : Model.vec;
  mutable velocity : Model.vec;
  mutable yaw : float;
  mutable onground : bool;
  (* what it stands on: -1 the world, else a brush's entity *)
  mutable ground : int;
}

type t

(* the player's box around its origin: 32 by 32 by 56 *)
val player_mins : Model.vec
val player_maxs : Model.vec

(* [create m styles]: the level's brush entities spawned; styles (64)
 * set to world.qc's *)
val create : Model.t -> string array -> t

(* [run b body time dt]: the brushes moved and thought for dt seconds,
 * up to time; the player pushed *)
val run : t -> body -> float -> float -> unit

(* [touch b body time]: the player's box touches what it touches *)
val touch : t -> body -> float -> unit

(* [use b body eye forward time]: the use key: the brush model the
 * eye looks at within 96 units, used as if shot *)
val use : t -> body -> Model.vec -> Model.vec -> float -> unit

(* [taken b classname origin]: an item of the map picked up (a key) *)
val taken : t -> string -> Model.vec -> bool

(* the solid brush models, for traces: (entity, model, origin) *)
val solids : t -> (int * int * Model.vec) list

(* the brush models drawn: (entity, model, origin, frame) *)
val drawn : t -> (int * int * Model.vec * int) list

(* the message shown (a door's, a trigger's), and since when *)
val message : t -> (string * float) option

(* the level ended (a changelevel touched); the secrets found, of how
 * many *)
val exited : t -> bool
val secrets : t -> int * int

(* the sounds made since the last call (a door's move and stop, a
 * button, a lift, a secret found, a message), and where (None: the
 * player's own); a mover's chosen by its "sounds" key, as QuakeC's *)
val sounds : t -> (string * Model.vec option) list

(* every sound the movers and triggers may make (precache) *)
val sound_names : string list

(* See Combat.mli *)

open Model

(* ThrowGib: a piece, tossed by the damage, gone in 10 seconds *)
let throw_gib (w : world) (o : vec) (model : string) (amount : float) : unit =
  let g = spawn w "gib" o zero zero in
  g.model <- w.models model;
  g.movetype <- Bounce;
  let k = Float.min 4. (-.amount /. 50.) in
  g.velocity <-
    {
      x = 100. *. crandom w *. (1. +. k);
      y = 100. *. crandom w *. (1. +. k);
      z = 200. +. (100. *. random w);
    };
  g.yaw <- random w *. 360.;
  g.nextthink <- time w +. 10. +. (random w *. 10.);
  g.think <- (fun (w : world) (g : t) -> remove w g)

(* the monster dead: gibbed, or its death frames *)
let killed (w : world) (e : t) (c : mclass) : unit =
  e.takedamage <- false;
  w.client.kills <- w.client.kills + 1;
  if e.health < c.gib_health then begin
    sound w (Some e.origin) "player/udeath" 1.;
    List.iter
      (fun (m : string) -> throw_gib w e.origin m e.health)
      [ "progs/gib1.mdl"; "progs/gib2.mdl"; "progs/gib3.mdl" ];
    (* (ThrowHead: the entity itself becomes its head) *)
    e.model <- w.models c.head;
    e.frame <- 0;
    e.solid <- false;
    e.nextthink <- 0.;
    e.movetype <- Bounce;
    e.onground <- false;
    e.velocity <- { x = 100. *. crandom w; y = 100. *. crandom w; z = 250. };
    (* (the backpack the death frames would have dropped) *)
    Items.drop_backpack w e
  end
  else begin
    let k = int_of_float (random w *. float (List.length c.deaths)) in
    let d = List.nth c.deaths (min k (List.length c.deaths - 1)) in
    Monster_ai.start w e d
  end

(* PlayerPain, PlayerDie *)
let player_hurt (w : world) (amount : float) : unit =
  let c = w.client in
  if c.phealth <= 0. then begin
    c.dead_time <- time w;
    sound w None
      (if c.phealth < -40. then "player/udeath"
       else Printf.sprintf "player/death%d" (1 + int_of_float (random w *. 5.)))
      1.
  end
  else if amount > 0. then
    sound w None
      (Printf.sprintf "player/pain%d" (1 + int_of_float (random w *. 6.)))
      1.

let damage (w : world) (target : who) (from : vec) (attacker : who)
    (amount : float) : unit =
  if alive w target then
    match target with
    | Nobody -> ()
    | The_player ->
        let c = w.client in
        let save = Float.min c.armor (Float.ceil (c.armortype *. amount)) in
        c.armor <- c.armor -. save;
        if c.armor <= 0. then c.armortype <- 0.;
        let take = Float.ceil (amount -. save) in
        c.phealth <- c.phealth -. take;
        c.damage_count <- Float.min 1. (c.damage_count +. (take /. 50.));
        let b = w.play.body in
        let dir = normalize (sub b.origin from) in
        b.velocity <- add b.velocity (scale (amount *. 8.) dir);
        player_hurt w take
    | Ent e -> (
        match e.mclass with
        | None -> ()
        | Some c ->
            e.health <- e.health -. amount;
            if e.health <= 0. then killed w e c
            else begin
              (* (it turns on what hurt it: a monster too, not of its
               * own kind, but soldiers on each other) *)
              let own =
                match attacker with
                | Ent a ->
                    a.classname = e.classname && e.classname <> "monster_army"
                | _ -> false
              in
              if
                alive w attacker
                && (not (same attacker target))
                && (not (same attacker e.enemy))
                && not own
              then begin
                e.enemy <- attacker;
                Monster_ai.found_target w e
              end;
              c.pain w e amount
            end)

(* CanDamage: a line to its middle, or a corner of its box at 15 *)
let can_damage (w : world) (o : vec) (target : who) : bool =
  let p, _, _ = where w target in
  List.exists
    (fun ((dx, dy) : float * float) ->
      let t =
        Physics.traceline w o
          { p with x = p.x +. dx; y = p.y +. dy }
          false Nobody
      in
      t.fraction = 1.)
    [ (0., 0.); (15., 15.); (-15., -15.); (-15., 15.); (15., -15.) ]

let radius_damage (w : world) (o : vec) (attacker : who) (amount : float)
    (ignore : who) : unit =
  let hurt (target : who) : unit =
    if alive w target && not (same target ignore) then begin
      let p, mins, maxs = where w target in
      let middle = add p (scale 0.5 (add mins maxs)) in
      let points = amount -. (0.5 *. length (sub o middle)) in
      let points = if same target attacker then points *. 0.5 else points in
      if points > 0. && can_damage w o target then
        damage w target o attacker points
    end
  in
  List.iter (fun (e : t) -> hurt (Ent e)) w.ents;
  hurt The_player

let explode (w : world) (e : t) : unit =
  if not e.removed then begin
    remove w e;
    radius_damage w e.origin e.owner 120. Nobody;
    sound w (Some e.origin) "weapons/r_exp3" 1.;
    burst w (Explosion e.origin)
  end

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Shots (weapons.qc's, which the monsters' share) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* a direction's right and up (makevectors of its angles) *)
let axes (dir : vec) : vec * vec =
  let right = normalize (cross dir { x = 0.; y = 0.; z = 1. }) in
  let right =
    if length right < 0.5 then { x = 0.; y = -1.; z = 0. } else right
  in
  (right, cross right dir)

(* FireBullets, TraceAttack: [n] pellets of 4 along dir, spread by
 * (sx, sy); blood where a thing is hit, a puff on a wall *)
let fire_bullets (w : world) (shooter : who) (src : vec) (dir : vec) (n : int)
    ((sx, sy) : float * float) : unit =
  let right, up = axes dir in
  for _i = 1 to n do
    let d =
      add dir (add (scale (crandom w *. sx) right) (scale (crandom w *. sy) up))
    in
    let t = Physics.traceline w src (add src (scale 2048. d)) true shooter in
    if t.fraction < 1. && not t.sky then begin
      let at = sub t.endpos (scale 4. d) in
      match t.what with
      | Nobody -> burst w (Gunshot at)
      | hit ->
          burst w (Blood (at, 8));
          damage w hit src shooter 4.
    end
  done

(* a missile: [model] from src along dir at speed, its touch *)
let launch (w : world) (owner : who) (classname : string) (model : string)
    (src : vec) (dir : vec) (speed : float) (touch : world -> t -> who -> unit)
    : t =
  let e = spawn w classname src zero zero in
  e.model <- w.models model;
  e.owner <- owner;
  e.movetype <- Fly_missile;
  e.velocity <- scale speed dir;
  e.yaw <- vectoyaw dir;
  e.pitch <-
    -.(Float.atan2 dir.z (sqrt ((dir.x *. dir.x) +. (dir.y *. dir.y)))
      *. 180. /. Float.pi);
  e.touch <- touch;
  (* (gone in 6 seconds if it touches nothing) *)
  e.nextthink <- time w +. 6.;
  e.think <- (fun (w : world) (e : t) -> remove w e);
  e

(* Combat: what a hit does (Quake's combat.qc: T_Damage, Killed,
 * T_RadiusDamage, CanDamage; player.qc's pain and death; ThrowGib).
 *
 * T_Damage: the armor takes its part first (green 30%, yellow 60%, as
 * long as it has points), the rest comes off the health; the blow
 * pushes the player away from where it came (its damage times 8 units
 * a second: a rocket jump is this); a monster hurt turns on who hurt
 * it, even another monster (but not one of its own kind, the soldiers
 * apart: infighting), then flinches (its kind's pain: a frame
 * sequence, at most so often). At 0 it dies: far below 0 (its kind's
 * gib health) it bursts into gibs and a head, else its death frames.
 *
 * A blast (T_RadiusDamage: a rocket, a grenade) hurts every box it
 * can reach (CanDamage: a line to its middle or a corner the level
 * does not cut), its damage less half the distance, the shooter's own
 * halved.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: Weapons' and Monsters' attacks call
 * it. *)

(* [damage w target from attacker amount]: T_Damage, [from] where the
 * blow came from *)
val damage : Edict.world -> Edict.who -> Model.vec -> Edict.who -> float -> unit

(* [radius_damage w origin attacker amount ignore]: T_RadiusDamage *)
val radius_damage :
  Edict.world -> Model.vec -> Edict.who -> float -> Edict.who -> unit

(* [explode w e]: a rocket's or a grenade's end where it is: the blast
 * (120), its sound, its particles, removed *)
val explode : Edict.world -> Edict.t -> unit

(* [fire_bullets w shooter src dir n (sx, sy)]: FireBullets: n
 * pellets of 4 damage, spread (QuakeC's '0.1 0.1 0') *)
val fire_bullets :
  Edict.world ->
  Edict.who ->
  Model.vec ->
  Model.vec ->
  int ->
  float * float ->
  unit

(* [launch w owner classname model src dir speed touch]: a missile *)
val launch :
  Edict.world ->
  Edict.who ->
  string ->
  string ->
  Model.vec ->
  Model.vec ->
  float ->
  (Edict.world -> Edict.t -> Edict.who -> unit) ->
  Edict.t

open Model

type t = { world : world; particles : Particles.t; things : Things.thing list }

let create (level : Model.t) (play : Play.t) (models : string -> Alias.t option)
    (things : Things.thing list) (monsters : bool) (ways : bool) : t =
  let client =
    {
      phealth = 100.;
      armor = 0.;
      armortype = 0.;
      shells = 25;
      nails = 0;
      rockets = 0;
      weapons = [ Axe; Shotgun ];
      weapon = Shotgun;
      pattack_finished = 0.;
      weaponframe = 0;
      weapon_time = 0.;
      damage_count = 0.;
      bonus_count = 0.;
      dead_time = 0.;
      punch = 0.;
      kills = 0;
      show_hostile = 0.;
    }
  in
  let w =
    {
      level;
      play;
      ents = [];
      next_id = 1;
      client;
      sounds = [];
      effects = [];
      sight_entity = None;
      sight_time = 0.;
      models;
      seed = 1;
      message = None;
      ways;
    }
  in
  if monsters then
    List.iter
      (fun (e : (string * string) list) ->
        match (value e "classname", value e "origin") with
        | Some c, Some o ->
            let flags =
              match Option.bind (value e "spawnflags") int_of_string_opt with
              | Some f -> f
              | None -> 0
            in
            let yaw =
              match Option.bind (value e "angle") float_of_string_opt with
              | Some a -> a
              | None -> 0.
            in
            (* (not in medium skill: 512) *)
            if flags land 512 = 0 then
              ignore (Monsters.spawn w c (vec_of_string o) yaw)
        | _ -> ())
      level.entities;
  (* the monsters' boxes in the player's way *)
  play.boxes <-
    (fun () ->
      List.filter_map
        (fun (e : Edict.t) ->
          if e.solid && not e.removed then
            Some (add e.origin e.mins, add e.origin e.maxs)
          else None)
        w.ents);
  { world = w; particles = Particles.create (); things }

let give_all (g : t) : unit =
  let c = g.world.client in
  c.weapons <-
    [ Axe; Shotgun; Super_shotgun; Nailgun; Grenade_launcher; Rocket_launcher ];
  c.shells <- 100;
  c.nails <- 200;
  c.rockets <- 100

(* the player's box overlapping an entity's *)
let in_box (w : world) (e : Edict.t) : bool =
  let p = w.play.body.origin in
  let a = add p Brushes.player_mins and b = add p Brushes.player_maxs in
  let ea = add e.origin e.mins and eb = add e.origin e.maxs in
  a.x < eb.x && b.x > ea.x && a.y < eb.y && b.y > ea.y && a.z < eb.z
  && b.z > ea.z

let frame (g : t) (dt : float) (attack : bool) (impulse : int) : unit =
  let w = g.world in
  let c = w.client in
  Weapons.frame w attack impulse;
  List.iter
    (fun (e : Edict.t) ->
      let before = e.origin in
      Physics.run w e dt;
      if e.trail > 0 && not e.removed then
        burst w (Trail (before, e.origin, e.trail));
      if e.trigger && (not e.removed) && c.phealth > 0. && in_box w e then
        e.touch w e The_player)
    w.ents;
  Items.touch_things w g.things;
  (* (the level's movers' and triggers' sounds, as the game's) *)
  List.iter
    (fun ((sfx, at) : string * vec option) -> sound w at sfx 1.)
    (Brushes.sounds w.play.brushes);
  w.ents <- List.filter (fun (e : Edict.t) -> not e.removed) w.ents;
  c.damage_count <- Float.max 0. (c.damage_count -. (1.5 *. dt));
  c.bonus_count <- Float.max 0. (c.bonus_count -. (2. *. dt));
  let now = time w in
  List.iter
    (fun (x : burst) ->
      match x with
      | Blood (o, n) -> Particles.blood g.particles now o n
      | Gunshot o -> Particles.gunshot g.particles now o
      | Explosion o -> Particles.explosion g.particles now o
      | Trail (a, b, k) -> Particles.trail g.particles now a b k)
    (List.rev w.effects);
  w.effects <- [];
  Particles.run g.particles now dt

let draw (g : t) (v : View.t) : unit =
  let w = g.world in
  let now = time w in
  List.iter
    (fun (e : Edict.t) ->
      match e.model with
      | Some mdl when not e.removed ->
          let leaf = Model.leaf_at w.level e.origin in
          if
            leaf.lvisframe = v.visframecount
            && dot (sub e.origin v.origin) v.vpn > -64.
          then begin
            let yaw =
              if mdl.flags land 8 <> 0 then Float.rem (now *. 100.) 360.
              else e.yaw
            in
            (* (a missile glows: full light) *)
            let light =
              if e.movetype = Fly_missile then 255
              else Alias.light_point w.level v e.origin
            in
            Alias.draw_pitched v mdl e.origin e.pitch yaw e.frame e.skin light
          end
      | _ -> ())
    w.ents;
  Particles.draw v g.particles;
  (* R_DrawViewModel: at the eye, the view's angles, the player's light *)
  if w.client.phealth > 0. then begin
    let name, frame = Weapons.view_model w in
    match w.models name with
    | Some mdl ->
        let light = max 24 (Alias.light_point w.level v w.play.body.origin) in
        Alias.draw_pitched v mdl v.origin
          (w.play.pitch +. w.client.punch)
          w.play.body.yaw frame 0 light
    | None -> ()
  end

let sounds (g : t) : sound list =
  let s = List.rev g.world.sounds in
  g.world.sounds <- [];
  s

let dead_for (g : t) : float option =
  let c = g.world.client in
  if c.phealth > 0. then None else Some (time g.world -. c.dead_time)

let status (g : t) : string =
  let c = g.world.client in
  Printf.sprintf "HEALTH %d  ARMOR %d  %s  KILLS %d"
    (int_of_float (Float.max 0. c.phealth))
    (int_of_float c.armor)
    (match Weapons.ammo g.world with
    | Some n -> Printf.sprintf "AMMO %d" n
    | None -> "AXE")
    c.kills
games/fps/quake/game/Game.mli
5367
(* Game: the server's frame and what the client is given to draw and
 * play (Quake's sv_main.c and sv_phys.c's SV_Physics, host.c's frame;
 * cl_main.c's entities; QuakeC's StartFrame and PlayerPreThink).
 *
 *   each frame:
 *     the player's weapon (Weapons: the attack key, the weapon asked)
 *     every entity (Physics.run: its move by its movetype, its think
 *       when its time came: a monster's frame, a grenade's fuse); a
 *       missile's trail from where it was to where it is
 *     the triggers the player is in (a backpack), the items it is on
 *     the effects made (Edict's) become particles
 *
 * The world's state is Edict's; this is its frame and its spawning:
 * the map's monster_* by Monsters (but with nomonsters), the player's
 * start: 100 health, the axe and the shotgun, 25 shells (client.qc's
 * SetNewParms).
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: Quake.ml makes one, calls [frame]
 * after Play's, [draw] after Render's world, plays the [sounds].
 *
 * What is ours: this folder, game/, is what Quake did not write in C.
 * Quake's engine (the renderer, the sound, the network, the traces and
 * moves of server/) knew nothing of a monster, a weapon or a door; all
 * of that was QuakeC, a language of its own, compiled to progs.dat and
 * run by the engine in a virtual machine. Here it is OCaml, compiled
 * with the rest: no compiler of QuakeC, no progs.dat, no VM. Each
 * module says which .qc it was written from (ai.qc, combat.qc,
 * grunt.qc ...), to read beside LibreQuake's qcsrc/ or id's.
 *
 * cs-history:
 * Doom (1993) had its game in C, in the engine: its monsters were
 * info.c's tables of states, compiled into the executable (mini-doom's
 * Info). Players changed them anyway, by patching the executable's
 * tables with DeHackEd; a new monster's behaviour, a new weapon, could
 * not be written, only numbers changed. For Quake (1996) John Carmack
 * made the game a program apart: QuakeC, a small C-like language
 * (floats, vectors, strings, entities, functions; no integers, no
 * structures, no pointers), compiled by id's qcc to progs.dat, a
 * bytecode of a few dozen instructions, each three addresses in a
 * table of globals, run by the engine's interpreter (pr_exec.c). The
 * engine gave it builtins (pr_cmds.c: traceline, sound, walkmove,
 * aim ...), and it gave the engine the functions to call
 * (StartFrame, PlayerPreThink, an entity's think and touch).
 *
 * design:
 * Why a VM, in 1996: Quake ran on DOS, which had no libraries loaded
 * at run time, so a mod could not be native code without a new
 * executable; a progs.dat ran the same on DOS, Windows, Linux and the
 * other ports, built once; and it could not crash the engine nor reach
 * the machine, only the builtins, so anyone could download a mod.
 * Mods were what Carmack wanted from it: Team Fortress, capture the
 * flag and the bots of 1996-97 were QuakeC. The price was speed (an
 * interpreter, every number a float) and a weak language.
 *
 * evolution:
 * Quake II (1997) took the other road: its game a native library
 * (gamex86.dll), plain C, fast, and trusted as the engine is. Quake III
 * (1999) came back to a VM, of its own bytecode (QVM), but compiled
 * from C by a modified lcc (q3lcc, Fraser and Hanson's retargetable
 * compiler) and q3asm, and turned into native code at load on x86
 * (a JIT): C's language, the VM's safety and portability, nearly
 * native speed. lcc is Quake III's, not Quake's: Quake's compiler was
 * id's own qcc.
 *
 * comeback:
 * The game's logic in a language the engine runs, safe and portable,
 * is everywhere since: UnrealScript (1998), Lua in World of Warcraft's
 * interface and in many engines, and now WebAssembly, a VM of a few
 * instructions again, compiled to native code at load as Quake III's.
 *
 * wib:
 * Why not here: ix's games are read to learn how they work, and one
 * language from the engine to the monster is one thing to read; a
 * QuakeC compiler and its VM would be a plan of their own (ix has
 * interpreters to learn from already: mini-rc's, Scheme's, Forth's),
 * and on a Pi an interpreter under mini-ml's code would cost the
 * frames. OCaml's types also catch what QuakeC found at run time (an
 * entity's field misspelled is a new field). What it costs: no mod
 * without recompiling mini-quake, and no progs.dat of anyone's can
 * run; the game is Quake's as far as these modules wrote it. *)

type t = {
  world : Edict.world;
  particles : Particles.t;
  things : Things.thing list; (* the items standing *)
}

(* [create level play models things monsters ways]: the world, its
 * monsters spawned if asked; [ways] the playground's AI (ai=ways) *)
val create :
  Model.t ->
  Play.t ->
  (string -> Alias.t option) ->
  Things.thing list ->
  bool ->
  bool ->
  t

(* [give_all g]: impulse 9: every weapon, ammunition *)
val give_all : t -> unit

(* [frame g dt attack impulse]: the game's dt seconds (after Play's) *)
val frame : t -> float -> bool -> int -> unit

(* [draw g v]: the entities' models, the particles, the weapon in hand,
 * into v after the world *)
val draw : t -> View.t -> unit

(* the sounds made since the last call, in order *)
val sounds : t -> Edict.sound list

(* the player dead, and for how long *)
val dead_for : t -> float option

(* the status line: health, armor, ammunition, kills *)
val status : t -> string

(* See Items.mli *)

open Model
open Edict

let rank (w : weapon) : int =
  match w with
  | Axe -> 0
  | Shotgun -> 1
  | Super_shotgun -> 2
  | Nailgun -> 3
  | Grenade_launcher -> 4
  | Rocket_launcher -> 5

(* the player's box and an item's (its origin at its feet, 32 wide, 56
 * high: items.qc's setsize '-16 -16 0' '16 16 56') overlap *)
let touches (w : world) (o : vec) (mins : vec) (maxs : vec) : bool =
  let p = w.play.body.origin in
  let pmin = add p Brushes.player_mins and pmax = add p Brushes.player_maxs in
  let a = add o mins and b = add o maxs in
  pmin.x < b.x && pmax.x > a.x && pmin.y < b.y && pmax.y > a.y && pmin.z < b.z
  && pmax.z > a.z

let take (w : world) (msg : string) (sfx : string) : unit =
  say w msg;
  sound w None sfx 1.;
  w.client.bonus_count <- 1.

let weapon (w : world) (wp : weapon) (msg : string) : bool =
  let c = w.client in
  (match wp with
  | Super_shotgun -> c.shells <- min 100 (c.shells + 5)
  | Nailgun -> c.nails <- min 200 (c.nails + 30)
  | Grenade_launcher | Rocket_launcher -> c.rockets <- min 100 (c.rockets + 5)
  | _ -> ());
  if not (List.mem wp c.weapons) then begin
    c.weapons <- wp :: c.weapons;
    if rank wp > rank c.weapon then c.weapon <- wp
  end;
  take w msg "weapons/pkup";
  true

let armor (w : world) (value : float) (kind : float) (msg : string) : bool =
  let c = w.client in
  if c.armor *. c.armortype >= value *. kind then false
  else begin
    c.armor <- value;
    c.armortype <- kind;
    take w msg "items/armor1";
    true
  end

let touch_things (w : world) (things : Things.thing list) : unit =
  if w.client.phealth > 0. then
    List.iter
      (fun (t : Things.thing) ->
        if
          t.alive
          && touches w t.origin
               { x = -16.; y = -16.; z = 0. }
               { x = 16.; y = 16.; z = 56. }
        then
          let taken =
            match t.classname with
            | "weapon_supershotgun" ->
                weapon w Super_shotgun "You got the Double-barrelled Shotgun"
            | "weapon_nailgun" -> weapon w Nailgun "You got the nailgun"
            | "weapon_grenadelauncher" ->
                weapon w Grenade_launcher "You got the Grenade Launcher"
            | "weapon_rocketlauncher" ->
                weapon w Rocket_launcher "You got the Rocket Launcher"
            | "item_armor1" -> armor w 100. 0.3 "You got armor"
            | "item_armor2" -> armor w 150. 0.6 "You got armor"
            | _ -> false
          in
          if taken then t.alive <- false)
      things

(* BackpackTouch *)
let backpack_touch (w : world) (e : t) (other : who) : unit =
  match other with
  | The_player when w.client.phealth > 0. ->
      w.client.shells <- min 100 (w.client.shells + e.ammo_shells);
      take w (Printf.sprintf "You get %d shells" e.ammo_shells) "weapons/lock4";
      remove w e
  | _ -> ()

let drop_backpack (w : world) (owner : t) : unit =
  if owner.ammo_shells > 0 then begin
    let e =
      spawn w "backpack" owner.origin
        { x = -16.; y = -16.; z = 0. }
        { x = 16.; y = 16.; z = 56. }
    in
    e.model <- w.models "progs/backpack.mdl";
    e.ammo_shells <- owner.ammo_shells;
    e.trigger <- true;
    e.movetype <- Toss;
    e.velocity <-
      {
        x = -100. +. (random w *. 200.);
        y = -100. +. (random w *. 200.);
        z = 300.;
      };
    e.touch <- backpack_touch;
    (* (gone in two minutes) *)
    e.nextthink <- time w +. 120.;
    e.think <- (fun (w : world) (e : t) -> remove w e)
  end

(* Items: what the player picks up (Quake's items.qc): the weapons and
 * armor standing in the level (Things), and the backpacks the dead
 * drop.

 * An item is a trigger: a box touched when the player's box overlaps
 * it. A weapon gives itself and some ammunition (the super shotgun 5
 * shells, the nailgun 30 nails, the launchers 5 rockets), and is
 * switched to if it is better than the one in hand; an armor is taken
 * only if it is worth more than the one worn (its points times the
 * part of the damage it takes: green 100 x 0.3, yellow 150 x 0.6); a
 * backpack gives what its owner had.

 * Not here: the health and ammunition boxes and the exploding box:
 * QuakeC made them brush models of their own (maps/b_*.bsp), not
 * compiled here (plan_quake.md).

 * backpacks. *)

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Monster_ai.mli *)

open Model
open Edict

type range = Melee_range | Near | Mid | Far

let mclass (e : t) : mclass =
  match e.mclass with
  | Some c -> c
  | None -> failwith "Monster_ai: not a monster"

let range (w : world) (e : t) (who : who) : range =
  let r = length (sub (eye w (Ent e)) (eye w who)) in
  if r < 120. then Melee_range
  else if r < 500. then Near
  else if r < 1000. then Mid
  else Far

let visible (w : world) (e : t) (who : who) : bool =
  let t = Physics.traceline w (eye w (Ent e)) (eye w who) false (Ent e) in
  t.fraction = 1.

let infront (w : world) (e : t) (who : who) : bool =
  let o, _, _ = where w who in
  let a = e.yaw *. Float.pi /. 180. in
  let forward = { x = Float.cos a; y = Float.sin a; z = 0. } in
  dot (normalize (sub o e.origin)) forward > 0.3

let seq (e : t) : seq = List.assoc e.seq (mclass e).seqs

(* a monster's frame: shown, the next one's think set, then what it
 * does (which may start another sequence) *)
let rec think (w : world) (e : t) : unit =
  let s = seq e in
  let i = e.step in
  e.frame <- s.frames.(i);
  e.nextthink <- time w +. 0.1;
  if i + 1 < Array.length s.acts then e.step <- i + 1
  else if s.next = "" then e.nextthink <- 0. (* the last frame, kept *)
  else begin
    e.seq <- s.next;
    e.step <- 0
  end;
  List.iter (act w e) s.acts.(i)

and start (w : world) (e : t) (name : string) : unit =
  e.seq <- name;
  e.step <- 0;
  think w e

(* (the sequence after this frame: QuakeC's self.think = th_run) *)
and next (e : t) (name : string) : unit =
  e.seq <- name;
  e.step <- 0

and face (w : world) (e : t) : unit =
  let o, _, _ = where w e.enemy in
  e.ideal_yaw <- vectoyaw (sub o e.origin);
  Physics.change_yaw e

and hunt_target (w : world) (e : t) : unit =
  let o, _, _ = where w e.enemy in
  e.ideal_yaw <- vectoyaw (sub o e.origin);
  next e (mclass e).run;
  e.nextthink <- time w +. 0.1;
  e.attack_finished <- time w +. 1.

and found_target (w : world) (e : t) : unit =
  if same e.enemy The_player then begin
    w.sight_entity <- Some e;
    w.sight_time <- time w
  end;
  let sights = (mclass e).sight in
  if sights <> [] then begin
    let k = int_of_float (random w *. float (List.length sights)) in
    sound w (Some e.origin)
      (List.nth sights (min k (List.length sights - 1)))
      1.
  end;
  hunt_target w e

(* FindTarget: the player, or the monster that saw it a tenth of a
 * second ago, checked as the player would be; the enemy then the
 * player. A monster that saw the player has show_hostile: those near
 * it wake even behind it, as near the player that shot *)
and find_target (w : world) (e : t) : bool =
  let c = w.client in
  let client, hostile =
    match w.sight_entity with
    | Some s when w.sight_time >= time w -. 0.1 && s != e && not s.removed ->
        (* (its show_hostile is FoundTarget's second ahead, as its
         * attack_finished: that one kept, not another field) *)
        (Ent s, s.attack_finished >= time w)
    | _ -> (The_player, c.show_hostile >= time w)
  in
  if c.phealth <= 0. || same e.enemy The_player then false
  else begin
    let r = range w e client in
    let ok =
      r <> Far && visible w e client
      &&
      match r with
      | Near -> hostile || infront w e client
      | Mid -> infront w e client
      | _ -> true
    in
    if ok then begin
      e.enemy <- The_player;
      found_target w e
    end;
    ok
  end

(* ai_run *)
and run (w : world) (e : t) (dist : float) : unit =
  let c = mclass e in
  if not (alive w e.enemy) then begin
    e.enemy <- Nobody;
    next e c.stand
  end
  else begin
    let seen = visible w e e.enemy in
    if seen then begin
      e.search_time <- time w +. 5.;
      e.seen_for <- e.seen_for + 1
    end
    else e.seen_for <- 0;
    if not (seen && c.check_attack w e) then
      (* (ai=ways, the player unseen: the playground's way to it) *)
      match
        if w.ways && (not seen) && same e.enemy The_player then
          Ways.direction w e
        else None
      with
      | Some yaw ->
          if not (Physics.step_direction w e yaw dist) then
            Physics.move_to_goal w e dist
      | None -> Physics.move_to_goal w e dist
  end

and act (w : world) (e : t) (a : act) : unit =
  let c = mclass e in
  match a with
  | Nothing | Refire _ -> ()
  | Stand | Walk _ -> ignore (find_target w e)
  | Run d -> run w e d
  | Face -> face w e
  | Charge d ->
      face w e;
      ignore (Physics.walk_move w e e.yaw d)
  | Back d | Pain_back d -> ignore (Physics.walk_move w e (e.yaw +. 180.) d)
  | Pain_forward d -> ignore (Physics.walk_move w e e.yaw d)
  | Fire | Leap -> c.fire w e
  | Melee -> c.bite w e
  | Drop ->
      e.solid <- false;
      Items.drop_backpack w e
  | Landed name -> if e.onground then next e name
  | Noise (sfx, chance) ->
      if random w < chance then sound w (Some e.origin) sfx 2.
games/fps/quake/game/Monster_ai.mli
2136
(* Monster_ai: how Quake's monsters think (QuakeC's ai.qc, and fight.qc's part
 * every monster shares).
 *
 * A monster's life is its frames (Edict's [seq]: Monsters writes each
 * kind's), one a tenth of a second, each with what to do. [think]
 * shows the frame, makes the next one the next think, and does it:
 *
 *   ai_stand   standing: FindTarget each frame
 *   ai_run     awake: the enemy still there? seen? its range; an
 *              attack if the kind's check says so (Monsters), else a
 *              step towards it (Physics.move_to_goal)
 *   ai_face, ai_charge, ai_back, ai_pain, ai_painforward: turning,
 *              stepping, as the frame asks (an attack's aim, a pain's
 *              stagger)
 *
 * FindTarget is what wakes a monster: the player within 1,000 units,
 * visible (a line from eye to eye that no wall cuts: monsters do not
 * block it), and in front (the sixth of a turn either side) -- or
 * within 500 and just having shot (show_hostile), or another monster
 * that saw the player a tenth of a second ago (sight_entity: a room
 * wakes together). Then FoundTarget: its sight sound, and HuntTarget:
 * the run frames, the first attack a second away.
 *
 *   range: melee < 120, near < 500, mid < 1000, far
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: Monsters' kinds are run by it; Combat
 * makes a hurt monster turn on its attacker by [found_target]. *)

type range = Melee_range | Near | Mid | Far

(* [range w e who] *)
val range : Edict.world -> Edict.t -> Edict.who -> range

(* visible: a line from e's eye to who's, the level only *)
val visible : Edict.world -> Edict.t -> Edict.who -> bool

(* infront: within 72 degrees of where e faces (a dot over 0.3) *)
val infront : Edict.world -> Edict.t -> Edict.who -> bool

(* [start w e seq]: the sequence's first frame, now (QuakeC's call of
 * army_atk1 ()) *)
val start : Edict.world -> Edict.t -> string -> unit

(* [think w e]: a monster's frame *)
val think : Edict.world -> Edict.t -> unit

(* FoundTarget *)
val found_target : Edict.world -> Edict.t -> unit

(* ai_face: turned towards its enemy *)
val face : Edict.world -> Edict.t -> unit
games/fps/quake/game/Monsters.ml
17389
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Monsters.mli *)

open Model
open Edict

(* a model's frames as its QuakeC declares them: each run's name and
 * length, in order *)
let first_of (layout : (string * int) list) (name : string) : int =
  let rec go (l : (string * int) list) (k : int) : int =
    match l with
    | (n, len) :: rest -> if n = name then k else go rest (k + len)
    | [] -> failwith ("Monsters: no frames " ^ name)
  in
  go layout 0

(* [seq layout run acts next]: a sequence over the run's frames *)
let seq (layout : (string * int) list) (run : string) (acts : act list list)
    (next : string) : seq =
  let f = first_of layout run in
  {
    frames =
      Array.of_list (List.mapi (fun (i : int) (_ : act list) -> f + i) acts);
    acts = Array.of_list acts;
    next;
  }

let nothing (n : int) : act list list = List.init n (fun (_ : int) -> [])

(* the aim turned by the playground's error, with ai=ways (Ways) *)
let aimed (w : world) (e : t) (dir : vec) : vec =
  if not w.ways then dir
  else
    let a = Ways.aim_error e *. Float.pi /. 180. in
    let c = Float.cos a and s = Float.sin a in
    {
      dir with
      x = (c *. dir.x) -. (s *. dir.y);
      y = (s *. dir.x) +. (c *. dir.y);
    }

let range_and_shot (w : world) (e : t) : Monster_ai.range option =
  let t = Physics.traceline w (eye w (Ent e)) (eye w e.enemy) true (Ent e) in
  if same t.what e.enemy || t.fraction = 1. then
    Some (Monster_ai.range w e e.enemy)
  else None

(* the pain sequences, by the random number, and the sound *)
let pains (w : world) (e : t) (choices : (float * float * string * string) list)
    : unit =
  if e.pain_finished <= time w then begin
    let r = random w in
    match
      List.find_opt
        (fun ((p, _, _, _) : float * float * string * string) -> r < p)
        choices
    with
    | Some (_, pause, s, sfx) ->
        e.pain_finished <- time w +. pause;
        sound w (Some e.origin) sfx 1.;
        Monster_ai.start w e s
    | None -> ()
  end

(* army_fire: behind where the player goes, 4 pellets *)
let army_fire (w : world) (e : t) : unit =
  Monster_ai.face w e;
  sound w (Some e.origin) "soldier/sattck1" 1.;
  let o, _, _ = where w e.enemy in
  let v =
    match e.enemy with
    | The_player -> w.play.body.velocity
    | Ent x -> x.velocity
    | Nobody -> zero
  in
  let dir = aimed w e (normalize (sub (sub o (scale 0.2 v)) e.origin)) in
  Combat.fire_bullets w (Ent e) (eye w (Ent e)) dir 4 (0.1, 0.1)

(* SoldierCheckAttack *)
let soldier_check (w : world) (e : t) : bool =
  match range_and_shot w e with
  | Some r when time w >= e.attack_finished ->
      let chance =
        match r with
        | Monster_ai.Melee_range -> 0.9
        | Monster_ai.Near -> 0.4
        | Monster_ai.Mid -> 0.05
        | Monster_ai.Far -> 0.
      in
      if random w < chance then begin
        Monster_ai.start w e "atk";
        e.attack_finished <- time w +. 1. +. random w;
        true
      end
      else false
  | _ -> false

(* dog_bite: within 100, (3 randoms) x 8 *)
let dog_bite (w : world) (e : t) : unit =
  sound w (Some e.origin) "dog/dattack1" 1.;
  let o, _, _ = where w e.enemy in
  Monster_ai.face w e;
  if length (sub o e.origin) <= 100. then
    Combat.damage w e.enemy e.origin (Ent e)
      ((random w +. random w +. random w) *. 8.)

(* Dog_JumpTouch: 10 to 20 to what it lands on, if fast *)
let dog_jump_touch (w : world) (e : t) (other : who) : unit =
  if e.health > 0. && alive w other && length e.velocity > 300. then
    Combat.damage w other e.origin (Ent e) (10. +. (10. *. random w))

(* dog_leap2: 300 forward, 200 up *)
let dog_leap (w : world) (e : t) : unit =
  Monster_ai.face w e;
  e.touch <- dog_jump_touch;
  let a = e.yaw *. Float.pi /. 180. in
  e.origin <- { e.origin with z = e.origin.z +. 1. };
  e.velocity <- { x = 300. *. Float.cos a; y = 300. *. Float.sin a; z = 200. };
  e.onground <- false

(* DogCheckAttack: CheckDogMelee, CheckDogJump *)
let dog_check (w : world) (e : t) : bool =
  let o, mins, maxs = where w e.enemy in
  match Monster_ai.range w e e.enemy with
  | Monster_ai.Melee_range ->
      Monster_ai.start w e "atta";
      true
  | _ ->
      let bottom = o.z +. mins.z and size = maxs.z -. mins.z in
      let d = length { (sub o e.origin) with z = 0. } in
      if e.origin.z +. e.mins.z > bottom +. (0.75 *. size) then false
      else if e.origin.z +. e.maxs.z < bottom +. (0.25 *. size) then false
      else if d < 80. || d > 150. then false
      else begin
        Monster_ai.start w e "leap";
        true
      end

(* Laser_Touch: 15, and the laser's stop *)
let laser_touch (w : world) (e : t) (other : who) : unit =
  sound w (Some e.origin) "enforcer/enfstop" 1.;
  (match other with
  | Nobody -> burst w (Gunshot e.origin)
  | _ ->
      burst w (Blood (e.origin, 15));
      Combat.damage w other e.origin e.owner 15.);
  remove w e

(* enforcer_fire: LaunchLaser at the enemy, from in front of its gun *)
let enforcer_fire (w : world) (e : t) : unit =
  Monster_ai.face w e;
  sound w (Some e.origin) "enforcer/enfire" 1.;
  let a = e.yaw *. Float.pi /. 180. in
  let src =
    {
      x = e.origin.x +. (30. *. Float.cos a);
      y = e.origin.y +. (30. *. Float.sin a);
      z = e.origin.z +. 16.;
    }
  in
  let o, _, _ = where w e.enemy in
  let dir = aimed w e (normalize (sub o src)) in
  ignore
    (Combat.launch w (Ent e) "laser" "progs/laser.mdl" src dir 600. laser_touch)

(* CheckAttack, fight.qc's for the monsters with no check of their own *)
let check_attack (w : world) (e : t) : bool =
  match range_and_shot w e with
  | Some r when time w >= e.attack_finished ->
      let chance =
        match r with
        | Monster_ai.Melee_range -> 0.9
        | Monster_ai.Near -> 0.4
        | Monster_ai.Mid -> 0.1
        | Monster_ai.Far -> 0.
      in
      if random w < chance then begin
        Monster_ai.start w e "atk";
        e.attack_finished <- time w +. (2. *. random w);
        true
      end
      else false
  | _ -> false

let classes = [ soldier; dog; enforcer ]

(* walkmonster_start: on the floor, thinking its first stand frame a
 * little later (spread over the first frames, as id's 0.1 to 0.2) *)
let spawn (w : world) (classname : string) (origin : vec) (yaw : float) :
    t option =
  match List.find_opt (fun (c : mclass) -> c.mname = classname) classes with
  | None -> None
  | Some c ->
      let e = spawn w classname origin c.mmins c.mmaxs in
      e.mclass <- Some c;
      e.model <- w.models c.mmodel;
      e.yaw <- yaw;
      e.ideal_yaw <- yaw;
      e.solid <- true;
      e.takedamage <- true;
      e.health <- c.mhealth;
      e.movetype <- Step;
      e.ammo_shells <- (if c == soldier then 5 else 0);
      (* droptofloor *)
      let t =
        Physics.trace w e.origin e.mins e.maxs
          { e.origin with z = e.origin.z -. 256. }
          (Ent e)
      in
      if t.fraction < 1. && not t.allsolid then e.origin <- t.endpos;
      e.onground <- true;
      e.seq <- c.stand;
      e.think <- Monster_ai.think;
      e.nextthink <- time w +. 0.1 +. (random w *. 0.1);
      Some e

games/fps/quake/game/Monsters.mli
2418
(* Monsters: the kinds of monsters of LibreQuake's first level, as their
 * QuakeC wrote them (grunt.qc the soldier, rottweiler.qc the dog,
 * enforcer.qc the enforcer): their frames, what each does, their
 * attacks, their pains and deaths.
 *
 * A model's frames are numbered in the order its QuakeC declares them
 * ($frame stand1 stand2 ... death1 ...): each kind's [layout] says
 * those runs, and a sequence takes its frames from them. The soldier:
 *
 *   stand  8 frames, ai_stand           run  8, ai_run 11 15 10 10 ...
 *   atk    shoot1-9: ai_face, the 5th fires 4 pellets (FireBullets,
 *          aimed behind a moving player: where it was 0.2 s ago)
 *   pain, painb, painc   staggers (ai_pain, ai_painforward)
 *   die, cdie   the 3rd frame not solid, the backpack (5 shells)
 *
 * The attacks: the soldier's chance to shoot is 0.9 within 120 units,
 * 0.4 within 500, 0.05 within 1,000 (SoldierCheckAttack), then a pause
 * of 1 to 2 s; the enforcer's (CheckAttack) 0.4 and 0.1, its laser a
 * missile (600 a second, 15); the dog bites within 120
 * ((3 randoms) x 8) and leaps from 80 to 150 (300 forward and 200
 * up, 10 to 20 on contact).
 *
 * reframe:
 * QuakeC's frame functions are Doom's state table written as code.
 * Doom's info.c had a row a state: a sprite's frame, its tics, an
 * action, the next state ({SPR_POSS, 0, 10, {A_Look}, S_POSS_STND2});
 * QuakeC gave the same row a syntax of its own,
 * [void() army_stand1 = [$stand1, army_stand2] {ai_stand();};] -- the
 * frame, the next think, and a body of any code where Doom had one
 * action. qcc made of it a function setting frame, think and nextthink
 * (0.1 s), then the body. Here it is the table again (a [seq]: its
 * frames, a list of acts a frame, its next), as mini-doom's Info is:
 * the bodies QuakeC's monsters wrote are few (ai_run, ai_face, a
 * sound, the attack), and named in [act]; the rest, the attacks and
 * the pains, are OCaml functions of each kind.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: Game spawns the map's monster_army,
 * monster_dog, monster_enforcer by [spawn]; Monster_ai runs their
 * frames. *)

(* [spawn w classname origin yaw]: the monster, standing, on the
 * floor (walkmonster_start); None for a kind not here *)
val spawn : Edict.world -> string -> Model.vec -> float -> Edict.t option

(* the models and sounds the kinds use (precache) *)
val models : string list
val sounds : string list

(* the keys, by the level's kind of world (worldspawn's worldtype: 0
 * medieval, 1 metal, 2 base) *)
let key_model (worldtype : int) (gold : bool) : string =
  let w = match worldtype with 1 -> "m" | 2 -> "b" | _ -> "w" in
  Printf.sprintf "progs/%s_%s_key.mdl" w (if gold then "g" else "s")

(* droptofloor: a monster's box (its origin 24 above its feet) or an
 * item's (its origin at its feet) traced 256 down, in the player's
 * hull: where it stops *)
let drop (m : Model.t) (monster : bool) (o : vec) : vec =
  let feet = if monster then 0. else 24. in
  let start = { o with z = o.z +. (if monster then 1. else 6.) +. feet } in
  let t = Trace.move m 1 start { start with z = start.z -. 256. } [] in
  if t.allsolid || t.fraction = 1. then o
  else { t.endpos with z = t.endpos.z -. feet }

let load (m : Model.t) (read : string -> string option) : thing list =
  let cache = Hashtbl.create 16 in
  let model (path : string) : Alias.t option =
    match Hashtbl.find_opt cache path with
    | Some x -> x
    | None ->
        let x = Option.map Alias.load (read path) in
        Hashtbl.add cache path x;
        x
  in
  let worldtype =
    match m.entities with
    | w :: _ -> (
        match Option.bind (value w "worldtype") int_of_string_opt with
        | Some t -> t
        | None -> 0)
    | [] -> 0
  in
  List.filter_map
    (fun (e : (string * string) list) ->
      let classname =
        match value e "classname" with Some c -> c | None -> ""
      in
      let flags =
        match Option.bind (value e "spawnflags") int_of_string_opt with
        | Some f -> f
        | None -> 0
      in
      let kind =
        if classname = "item_key1" then Some (key_model worldtype false, 0, "")
        else if classname = "item_key2" then
          Some (key_model worldtype true, 0, "")
        else List.assoc_opt classname kinds
      in
      match (kind, value e "origin") with
      (* (not in medium skill: SPAWNFLAG_NOT_MEDIUM) *)
      | Some (path, skin, anim), Some o when flags land 512 = 0 -> (
          match model path with
          | Some mdl ->
              let frames =
                if anim = "" then [ 0 ] else Alias.frames_named mdl anim
              in
              Some
                {
                  classname;
                  origin =
                    drop m
                      (String.length classname > 8
                      && String.sub classname 0 8 = "monster_")
                      (vec_of_string o);
                  yaw =
                    (match
                       Option.bind (value e "angle") float_of_string_opt
                     with
                    | Some a -> a
                    | None -> 0.);
                  model = mdl;
                  frames = Array.of_list (if frames = [] then [ 0 ] else frames);
                  skin;
                  alive = true;
                }
          | None -> None)
      | _ -> None)
    m.entities

let draw (v : View.t) (m : Model.t) (things : thing list) (time : float) : unit
    =
  List.iter
    (fun (t : thing) ->
      if t.alive then begin
        let leaf = Model.leaf_at m t.origin in
        (* in the PVS, and in front of the eye *)
        if
          leaf.lvisframe = v.visframecount
          && dot (sub t.origin v.origin) v.vpn > -64.
        then begin
          let frame =
            t.frames.(int_of_float (time *. 10.) mod Array.length t.frames)
          in
          let yaw =
            if t.model.flags land 8 <> 0 then Float.rem (time *. 100.) 360.
            else t.yaw
          in
          Alias.draw v t.model t.origin yaw frame t.skin
            (Alias.light_point m v t.origin)
        end
      end)
    things

(* Things: the level's monsters and items, as models standing where the
 * map puts them (QuakeC's monster_army, monster_dog, ... items.qc's
 * weapon_* and item_*: the model each one sets, its skin).
 *
 * Nothing moves here but the models' own animations (a monster's
 * stand frames, ten a second: QuakeC's think every 0.1 s) and the
 * items' turn (EF_ROTATE: 100 degrees a second, CL_RelinkEntities).
 * The monsters do not see, walk nor attack; the items are not picked
 * up (but the keys: Brushes); they are drawn, lit by the floor under
 * them (Alias.light_point).
 *
 * Each falls to the floor under it when the level starts (QuakeC's
 * droptofloor), as the map's origins are a few units above it.
 *
 * The items QuakeC made brush models (the health and ammunition boxes,
 * the explosive barrels: maps/b_*.bsp) are not drawn: LibreQuake
 * ships their sources, not their .bsp. *)

type thing = {
  classname : string;
  origin : Model.vec;
  yaw : float;
  model : Alias.t;
  (* its animation's frames *)
  frames : int array;
  skin : int;
  mutable alive : bool;
}

(* [load m read]: the things of the level's entities whose model
 * (progs/x.mdl) read finds; skill: medium, single player *)
val load : Model.t -> (string -> string option) -> thing list

(* [draw v m things time]: those in the leaves the PVS marked *)
val draw : View.t -> Model.t -> thing list -> float -> unit

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Ways.mli *)

open Model
open Edict

let cell = 32.
let half = 32 (* cells each side of the player's *)

type grid = {
  z : float; (* the floor's height: the player's origin *)
  flow : Ai.flow;
  goal : int * int; (* the player's cell, in the level's numbering *)
  built : float;
}

let grid : grid option ref = ref None

let cell_of (x : float) (y : float) : int * int =
  ( int_of_float (Float.floor (x /. cell)),
    int_of_float (Float.floor (y /. cell)) )

(* (hull 1's contents at p: empty where the player's box fits) *)
let empty (w : world) (p : vec) : bool =
  let t = Trace.move w.level 1 p p [] in
  not (t.startsolid || t.allsolid)

let make (w : world) : grid =
  let o = w.play.body.origin in
  let cx, cy = cell_of o.x o.y in
  let walkable ((c, r) : int * int) : bool =
    abs (c - cx) <= half
    && abs (r - cy) <= half
    &&
    let m =
      { x = (float c +. 0.5) *. cell; y = (float r +. 0.5) *. cell; z = o.z }
    in
    empty w m
    &&
    (* (a floor within 40 under it) *)
    let t = Trace.move w.level 1 m { m with z = m.z -. 40. } [] in
    t.fraction < 1.
  in
  {
    z = o.z;
    flow = Ai.flow ~walkable ~diagonal:true (cx, cy);
    goal = (cx, cy);
    built = time w;
  }

let direction (w : world) (e : t) : float option =
  let o = w.play.body.origin in
  let here = cell_of o.x o.y in
  let g =
    match !grid with
    | Some g
      when (g.goal = here || time w -. g.built < 0.5) && time w >= g.built ->
        g
    | _ ->
        let g = make w in
        grid := Some g;
        g
  in
  (* (on the player's floor, the monster's feet at the player's) *)
  if Float.abs (e.origin.z -. g.z) > 24. then None
  else
    match Ai.next_step g.flow (cell_of e.origin.x e.origin.y) with
    | None -> None
    | Some (c, r) ->
        let x = (float c +. 0.5) *. cell and y = (float r +. 0.5) *. cell in
        Some (vectoyaw { x = x -. e.origin.x; y = y -. e.origin.y; z = 0. })

let aim_error (e : t) : float =
  Ai.aim_error ~spread:22.5 ~settle:30. ~seen_for:e.seen_for ~seed:e.id ()
games/fps/quake/game/Ways.mli
1870
(* Ways: the playground's AI (lib_playground's Ai, over lib_playground/ai's
 * Pathfind) for Quake's monsters, with ai=ways, beside QuakeC's own:
 * a way to the player around the walls, and an aim that gets better.
 *
 * QuakeC's monsters walk as Doom's do (SV_NewChaseDir: the diagonal
 * towards the goal, then the axes, any way, back), and one behind a
 * wall stays there. mini-doom's Ways made the level a grid; a Quake
 * level is 3D, its floors over each other, so here the grid is the
 * player's floor alone, around it: cells of 32 by 32 over 2,048 by
 * 2,048, a cell walkable where the player's hull fits at the player's
 * height and a floor is under it within a step or two:
 *
 *   the player's floor at z     . . # # . . .    # a wall at z, or no
 *   a cell's middle at z:       . . # # . P .      floor under it
 *     hull 1 empty there,       . . . . . . .    each cell's next step
 *     and solid 40 below        . . # # # . .      to P (Ai.flow)
 *
 * Searched again (Ai.flow, Dijkstra's from the player's cell) when the
 * player is in another cell, at most twice a second. A monster on that
 * floor that does not see the player follows its cell's step; one
 * elsewhere, or blocked, QuakeC's way.
 *
 * The aim: Ai.aim_error, a smooth wobble a 16th of a turn wide when
 * the monster first sees the player, halving every 3 seconds it keeps
 * seeing it (30 thinks), added to where QuakeC aims.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: Monster_ai's ai_run asks [direction] for a
 * monster that does not see the player; the soldiers' and enforcers'
 * attacks turn their aim by [aim_error]. *)

(* [direction w e]: the way towards the player from where the monster
 * is (a yaw, degrees), if the grid knows one *)
val direction : Edict.world -> Edict.t -> float option

(* [aim_error e]: an angle off, in degrees *)
val aim_error : Edict.t -> float
games/fps/quake/game/Weapons.ml
9041
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Weapons.mli *)

open Model
open Edict

let ammo (w : world) : int option =
  let c = w.client in
  match c.weapon with
  | Axe -> None
  | Shotgun | Super_shotgun -> Some c.shells
  | Nailgun -> Some c.nails
  | Grenade_launcher | Rocket_launcher -> Some c.rockets

let has_ammo (c : client) (wp : weapon) : bool =
  match wp with
  | Axe -> true
  | Shotgun -> c.shells >= 1
  | Super_shotgun -> c.shells >= 2
  | Nailgun -> c.nails >= 1
  | Grenade_launcher | Rocket_launcher -> c.rockets >= 1

(* W_BestWeapon: the best one held that has its ammunition (the
 * launchers not: one does not switch to a rocket by surprise) *)
let best (c : client) : weapon =
  List.fold_left
    (fun (b : weapon) (wp : weapon) ->
      if List.mem wp c.weapons && has_ammo c wp && Items.rank wp > Items.rank b
      then wp
      else b)
    Axe
    [ Shotgun; Super_shotgun; Nailgun ]

(* the player's place, its eye, its forward *)
let origin (w : world) : vec = w.play.body.origin

let forward (w : world) : vec =
  let f, _, _ = View.angle_vectors w.play.pitch w.play.body.yaw in
  f

(* PF_aim: the look, or towards a monster within 0.93 of it that a
 * line reaches, its height only *)
let aim (w : world) (src : vec) : vec =
  let f = forward w in
  let t = Physics.traceline w src (add src (scale 2048. f)) true The_player in
  match t.what with
  | Ent e when e.takedamage -> f
  | _ -> (
      let best = ref None and bestdot = ref 0.93 in
      List.iter
        (fun (e : t) ->
          if e.takedamage && not e.removed then begin
            let middle = add e.origin (scale 0.5 (add e.mins e.maxs)) in
            let dir = normalize (sub middle src) in
            let d = dot dir f in
            if d > !bestdot then begin
              let t = Physics.traceline w src middle true The_player in
              if same t.what (Ent e) then begin
                bestdot := d;
                best := Some dir
              end
            end
          end)
        w.ents;
      match !best with Some dir -> normalize { f with z = dir.z } | None -> f)

(* the weapon in hand's frames started (player_shot1 ...) *)
let animate (w : world) : unit =
  w.client.weaponframe <- 1;
  w.client.weapon_time <- time w +. 0.1

(* W_FireAxe *)
let fire_axe (w : world) : unit =
  let src = { (origin w) with z = (origin w).z +. 16. } in
  let f = forward w in
  sound w None "weapons/ax1" 1.;
  let t = Physics.traceline w src (add src (scale 64. f)) true The_player in
  if t.fraction < 1. then begin
    let at = sub t.endpos (scale 4. f) in
    match t.what with
    | Nobody ->
        sound w (Some at) "player/axhit2" 1.;
        burst w (Gunshot at)
    | hit ->
        burst w (Blood (at, 20));
        Combat.damage w hit src The_player 20.
  end

(* spike_touch: 9, blood, or a ricochet's tink *)
let spike_touch (w : world) (e : t) (other : who) : unit =
  (match other with
  | Nobody ->
      burst w (Gunshot e.origin);
      let r = random w in
      sound w (Some e.origin)
        (if r < 0.25 then "weapons/tink1"
         else if r < 0.5 then "weapons/ric1"
         else if r < 0.75 then "weapons/ric2"
         else "weapons/ric3")
        1.
  | _ ->
      burst w (Blood (e.origin, 9));
      Combat.damage w other e.origin e.owner 9.);
  remove w e

(* T_MissileTouch: the rocket's hit, then its blast past it *)
let rocket_touch (w : world) (e : t) (other : who) : unit =
  if not e.removed then begin
    if alive w other then
      Combat.damage w other e.origin e.owner (100. +. (random w *. 20.));
    remove w e;
    Combat.radius_damage w e.origin e.owner 120. other;
    sound w (Some e.origin) "weapons/r_exp3" 1.;
    burst w (Explosion e.origin)
  end

(* GrenadeTouch: on a monster, at once; else a bounce's sound *)
let grenade_touch (w : world) (e : t) (other : who) : unit =
  match other with
  | Ent x when x.takedamage -> Combat.explode w e
  | The_player -> Combat.explode w e
  | _ ->
      if length e.velocity > 20. then
        sound w (Some e.origin) "weapons/bounce" 1.

let fire (w : world) : unit =
  let c = w.client in
  let src = { (origin w) with z = (origin w).z +. 16. } in
  c.show_hostile <- time w +. 1.;
  match c.weapon with
  | Axe ->
      fire_axe w;
      c.pattack_finished <- time w +. 0.5;
      animate w
  | Shotgun ->
      sound w None "weapons/guncock" 1.;
      c.shells <- c.shells - 1;
      c.punch <- -2.;
      Combat.fire_bullets w The_player src (aim w src) 6 (0.04, 0.04);
      c.pattack_finished <- time w +. 0.5;
      animate w
  | Super_shotgun ->
      sound w None "weapons/shotgn2" 1.;
      c.shells <- c.shells - 2;
      c.punch <- -4.;
      Combat.fire_bullets w The_player src (aim w src) 14 (0.14, 0.08);
      c.pattack_finished <- time w +. 0.7;
      animate w
  | Nailgun ->
      sound w None "weapons/rocket1i" 1.;
      c.nails <- c.nails - 1;
      c.punch <- -2.;
      (* (the barrels in turn: 4 to the right, then to the left) *)
      let _, right, _ = View.angle_vectors w.play.pitch w.play.body.yaw in
      let side = if c.weaponframe land 1 = 0 then 4. else -4. in
      let e =
        Combat.launch w The_player "spike" "progs/spike.mdl"
          (add src (scale side right))
          (aim w src) 1000. spike_touch
      in
      ignore e;
      c.pattack_finished <- time w +. 0.2;
      c.weaponframe <- (c.weaponframe mod 8) + 1;
      c.weapon_time <- time w +. 0.1
  | Grenade_launcher ->
      sound w None "weapons/grenade" 1.;
      c.rockets <- c.rockets - 1;
      c.punch <- -2.;
      let f, right, up = View.angle_vectors w.play.pitch w.play.body.yaw in
      let e =
        Combat.launch w The_player "grenade" "progs/grenade.mdl" src f 600.
          grenade_touch
      in
      e.movetype <- Bounce;
      e.velocity <-
        add (scale 600. f)
          (add (scale 200. up)
             (add
                (scale (crandom w *. 10.) right)
                (scale (crandom w *. 10.) up)));
      e.trail <- 2;
      e.nextthink <- time w +. 2.5;
      e.think <- Combat.explode;
      c.pattack_finished <- time w +. 0.6;
      animate w
  | Rocket_launcher ->
      sound w None "weapons/sgun1" 1.;
      c.rockets <- c.rockets - 1;
      c.punch <- -2.;
      let dir = aim w src in
      let e =
        Combat.launch w The_player "missile" "progs/missile.mdl"
          (add src (scale 8. dir))
          dir 1000. rocket_touch
      in
      e.trail <- 1;
      c.pattack_finished <- time w +. 0.8;
      animate w

let of_impulse (k : int) : weapon option =
  match k with
  | 1 -> Some Axe
  | 2 -> Some Shotgun
  | 3 -> Some Super_shotgun
  | 4 -> Some Nailgun
  | 6 -> Some Grenade_launcher
  | 7 -> Some Rocket_launcher
  | _ -> None

let frame (w : world) (attack : bool) (impulse : int) : unit =
  let c = w.client in
  if c.phealth > 0. then begin
    (* (the weapon in hand's frames, a tenth of a second each, back to
     * 0 after 6, the nailgun's while it fires) *)
    if c.weaponframe > 0 && time w >= c.weapon_time then
      if c.weapon = Nailgun || c.weaponframe >= 6 then c.weaponframe <- 0
      else begin
        c.weaponframe <- c.weaponframe + 1;
        c.weapon_time <- time w +. 0.1
      end;
    (* W_ChangeWeapon: held, and with ammunition *)
    (match of_impulse impulse with
    | Some wp when List.mem wp c.weapons && wp <> c.weapon ->
        if has_ammo c wp then begin
          c.weapon <- wp;
          c.weaponframe <- 0
        end
        else Edict.say w "not enough ammo."
    | _ -> ());
    if attack && time w >= c.pattack_finished then
      if has_ammo c c.weapon then fire w
      else begin
        c.weapon <- best c;
        c.weaponframe <- 0
      end;
    (* (the kick back to level, 10 degrees a second) *)
    if c.punch < 0. then c.punch <- Float.min 0. (c.punch +. 0.5)
  end

let view_model (w : world) : string * int =
  let c = w.client in
  ( (match c.weapon with
    | Axe -> "progs/v_axe.mdl"
    | Shotgun -> "progs/v_shot.mdl"
    | Super_shotgun -> "progs/v_shot2.mdl"
    | Nailgun -> "progs/v_nail.mdl"
    | Grenade_launcher -> "progs/v_rock.mdl"
    | Rocket_launcher -> "progs/v_rock2.mdl"),
    c.weaponframe )

let models =
  [
    "progs/v_axe.mdl";
    "progs/v_shot.mdl";
    "progs/v_shot2.mdl";
    "progs/v_nail.mdl";
    "progs/v_rock.mdl";
    "progs/v_rock2.mdl";
    "progs/spike.mdl";
    "progs/grenade.mdl";
    "progs/missile.mdl";
  ]

(* Weapons: the player's attacks (Quake's weapons.qc: W_Attack and the
 * W_Fire functions, W_ChangeWeapon, W_BestWeapon; player.qc's frames
 * of the weapon in hand).
 *
 *   1 the axe       64 units ahead, 20                      0.5 s
 *   2 the shotgun   6 pellets of 4, spread 0.04             0.5 s
 *   3 the super shotgun  14 pellets, 0.14 by 0.08, 2 shells 0.7 s
 *   4 the nailgun   a nail (1,000 a second, 9), from each barrel
 *                   in turn                                 0.2 s
 *   6 the grenade launcher  a grenade: 600 forward and 200 up, it
 *                   bounces (Physics' Bounce: half its speed back
 *                   off a wall, "weapons/bounce"), explodes on a
 *                   monster or after 2.5 s (120)            0.6 s
 *   7 the rocket launcher  a rocket (1,000 a second): 100 to 120 to
 *                   what it hits, and the blast (120)       0.8 s
 *
 * Every shot is aimed (QuakeC's aim (), the engine's PF_aim): the way
 * the player looks, unless a monster is within 0.93 of it (21 degrees)
 * that a line reaches: then up or down to it -- Quake's vertical
 * autoaim, which made a mouse's pitch optional. A shot wakes the
 * monsters near (show_hostile) and kicks the view (punchangle).
 *
 * The weapon in hand is a model drawn at the eye (v_shot.mdl ...), its
 * frames the attack's (weaponframe: 1 to 6 a tenth of a second each,
 * the nailgun's 1 to 8 while it fires).
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: Game calls [frame] each frame with
 * the attack key and the weapon asked; [view_model] for Render. *)

 * none), then an attack if the key is held and the last is done *)
val frame : Edict.world -> bool -> int -> unit

(* the model in hand and its frame *)
val view_model : Edict.world -> string * int

(* the weapon's ammunition, for the status line *)
val ammo : Edict.world -> int option

(* the models and sounds the weapons use (precache) *)
val models : string list
val sounds : string list

(* Claude Code

(* See Bspfile.mli *)

type t = { version : int; lumps : string array }

let entities = 0
let planes = 1
let textures = 2
let vertexes = 3
let visibility = 4
let nodes = 5
let texinfo = 6
let faces = 7
let lighting = 8
let clipnodes = 9
let leafs = 10
let marksurfaces = 11
let edges = 12
let surfedges = 13
let models = 14
let u8 (s : string) (i : int) : int = Char.code s.[i]
let ushort (s : string) (i : int) : int = u8 s i lor (u8 s (i + 1) lsl 8)

let short (s : string) (i : int) : int =
  let v = ushort s i in
  if v >= 0x8000 then v - 0x10000 else v

let int32 (s : string) (i : int) : int =
  let v = u8 s i lor (u8 s (i + 1) lsl 8) lor (u8 s (i + 2) lsl 16) in
  let hi = u8 s (i + 3) in
  (* (the top byte signed: -1 is 0xffffffff) *)
  v lor ((if hi >= 0x80 then hi - 0x100 else hi) lsl 24)

let float32 (s : string) (i : int) : float =
  (* (two halves: 0x80000000 and up are no int of 31 bits) *)
  let lo = Int32.of_int (ushort s i) and hi = Int32.of_int (ushort s (i + 2)) in
  Int32.float_of_bits (Int32.logor (Int32.shift_left hi 16) lo)

let name (s : string) (i : int) (n : int) : string =
  let k = ref 0 in
  while !k < n && s.[i + !k] <> '\000' do
    incr k
  done;
  String.sub s i !k

let parse (s : string) : t =
  if String.length s < 4 + (15 * 8) then failwith "not a .bsp: too short";
  let version = int32 s 0 in
  if version <> 29 then
    failwith (Printf.sprintf "a .bsp of version %d, not 29" version);
  let lump (k : int) : string =
    let pos = int32 s (4 + (8 * k)) and len = int32 s (8 + (8 * k)) in
    if pos < 0 || len < 0 || pos + len > String.length s then
      failwith "a lump outside the .bsp";
    String.sub s pos len
  in
  { version; lumps = Array.init 15 lump }

let add_short (b : Buffer.t) (v : int) : unit =
  Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr (v land 0xff));
  Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr ((v lsr 8) land 0xff))

let add_int32 (b : Buffer.t) (v : int) : unit =
  add_short b (v land 0xffff);
  add_short b ((v asr 16) land 0xffff)

let add_name (b : Buffer.t) (n : int) (name : string) : unit =
  for i = 0 to n - 1 do
    Buffer.add_char b (if i < String.length name then name.[i] else '\000')
  done

let write (bsp : t) : string =
  let b = Buffer.create 1_000_000 in
  add_int32 b bsp.version;
  (* (each lump at an offset that is a multiple of 4, as qbsp's) *)
  let pos = ref (4 + (15 * 8)) in
  Array.iter
    (fun (l : string) ->
      add_int32 b !pos;
      add_int32 b (String.length l);
      pos := (!pos + String.length l + 3) land lnot 3)
    bsp.lumps;
  Array.iter
    (fun (l : string) ->
      Buffer.add_string b l;
      while Buffer.length b land 3 <> 0 do
        Buffer.add_char b '\000'
      done)
    bsp.lumps;
  Buffer.contents b
games/fps/quake/model/Bspfile.mli
3029
(* Bspfile: Quake's level file, a .bsp of version 29 (id's bspfile.h),
 * as its fifteen lumps' bytes. What qbsp writes, vis and light add to,
 * and the game reads:
 *
 *   0   the version, 29
 *   4   fifteen (offset, length) pairs, a lump each:
 *         0 ENTITIES   the map's entities, as text ("classname" ...)
 *         1 PLANES     20 bytes: a normal (3 floats), its distance,
 *                      its type (an axis, or none)
 *         2 TEXTURES   the miptex: each texture and its 3 smaller mips
 *         3 VERTEXES   3 floats
 *         4 VISIBILITY the PVS, each leaf's row of bits run-length
 *                      coded (vis's)
 *         5 NODES      24 bytes: a plane, two children, a box, faces
 *         6 TEXINFO    40 bytes: how a texture lies on a face
 *         7 FACES      20 bytes: a plane, its edges, a texinfo, four
 *                      light styles and where its lightmaps are
 *         8 LIGHTING   the lightmaps, a byte a sample (light's)
 *         9 CLIPNODES  8 bytes: the hulls the bodies move in
 *        10 LEAFS      28 bytes: contents, its row of the PVS, a box,
 *                      its faces
 *        11 MARKSURFACES  a leaf's faces, shorts
 *        12 EDGES      two vertices' numbers
 *        13 SURFEDGES  a face's edges, signed: -e is e backwards
 *        14 MODELS     64 bytes: the world (0), then the brush models
 *                      (doors, lifts), each its own tree
 *
 * Every number little-endian; floats IEEE single.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: what Model reads, and what
 * tools/Light.ml reads and writes again with its lightmaps.
 *
 * history:
 * id's format for Quake (1996), version 29; Half-Life's is 30 (colours
 * in the lightmaps, the textures' palettes), Quake II's IBSP 38,
 * Quake III's 46. ericw-tools' "BSP2" lifts its limits of shorts. *)

type t = { version : int; lumps : string array }

(* the lumps' numbers *)
val entities : int
val planes : int
val textures : int
val vertexes : int
val visibility : int
val nodes : int
val texinfo : int
val faces : int
val lighting : int
val clipnodes : int
val leafs : int
val marksurfaces : int
val edges : int
val surfedges : int
val models : int

(* [parse bytes]: a .bsp's lumps; Failure if it is not of version 29 *)
val parse : string -> t

(* [write bsp]: the file again, its lumps in their order *)
val write : t -> string

(* the numbers in a lump, at an offset: an unsigned byte, a short
 * (signed), an unsigned short, an int of 32 bits (signed; on 31-bit
 * ints only the small ones are right, every offset and count of a
 * .bsp), a float of 32 bits, and a name of [n] bytes, its zeros cut *)
val u8 : string -> int -> int
val short : string -> int -> int
val ushort : string -> int -> int
val int32 : string -> int -> int
val float32 : string -> int -> float
val name : string -> int -> int -> string

(* the same, written into a Buffer *)
val add_short : Buffer.t -> int -> unit
val add_int32 : Buffer.t -> int -> unit
val add_name : Buffer.t -> int -> string -> unit

type vec = { x : float; y : float; z : float }

  height : int;

  mutable alternate : texture option;

  s : vec;
  s_offset : float;
  t : vec;
  t_offset : float;
  texture : texture;
  special : bool;

  index : int;

  back : bool;
  first_edge : int;
  num_edges : int;

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Vectors *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let zero = { x = 0.; y = 0.; z = 0. }

let dot (a : vec) (b : vec) : float =
  (a.x *. b.x) +. (a.y *. b.y) +. (a.z *. b.z)

let add (a : vec) (b : vec) : vec =
  { x = a.x +. b.x; y = a.y +. b.y; z = a.z +. b.z }

let sub (a : vec) (b : vec) : vec =
  { x = a.x -. b.x; y = a.y -. b.y; z = a.z -. b.z }

let scale (k : float) (a : vec) : vec =
  { x = k *. a.x; y = k *. a.y; z = k *. a.z }

let length (a : vec) : float = sqrt (dot a a)

let normalize (a : vec) : vec =
  let n = length a in
  if n = 0. then a else scale (1. /. n) a

let cross (a : vec) (b : vec) : vec =
  {
    x = (a.y *. b.z) -. (a.z *. b.y);
    y = (a.z *. b.x) -. (a.x *. b.z);
    z = (a.x *. b.y) -. (a.y *. b.x);
  }

let vec_of_string (s : string) : vec =
  match
    List.filter (fun (w : string) -> w <> "") (String.split_on_char ' ' s)
  with
  | [ x; y; z ] ->
      { x = float_of_string x; y = float_of_string y; z = float_of_string z }
  | _ -> failwith ("not a vector: " ^ s)

(* The entities *)

(* { "key" "value" ... } { ... }: COM_Parse's tokens *)
let parse_entities (s : string) : (string * string) list list =
  let n = String.length s in
  let i = ref 0 in
  let rec token () : string option =
    while
      !i < n
      && (s.[!i] = ' '
         || s.[!i] = '\n'
         || s.[!i] = '\r'
         || s.[!i] = '\t'
         || s.[!i] = '\000')
    do
      incr i
    done;
    if !i >= n then None
    else if !i + 1 < n && s.[!i] = '/' && s.[!i + 1] = '/' then begin
      while !i < n && s.[!i] <> '\n' do
        incr i
      done;
      token ()
    end
    else if s.[!i] = '"' then begin
      let start = !i + 1 in
      i := start;
      while !i < n && s.[!i] <> '"' do
        incr i
      done;
      let t = String.sub s start (!i - start) in
      incr i;
      Some t
    end
    else begin
      let start = !i in
      while
        !i < n
        && s.[!i] <> ' '
        && s.[!i] <> '\n'
        && s.[!i] <> '\t'
        && s.[!i] <> '\r'
      do
        incr i
      done;
      Some (String.sub s start (!i - start))
    end
  in
  let rec entities (acc : (string * string) list list) :
      (string * string) list list =
    match token () with
    | Some "{" ->
        let rec pairs (kv : (string * string) list) : (string * string) list =
          match token () with
          | Some "}" | None -> List.rev kv
          | Some k -> (
              match token () with
              | Some v -> pairs ((k, v) :: kv)
              | None -> List.rev kv)
        in
        entities (pairs [] :: acc)
    | Some _ -> entities acc
    | None -> List.rev acc
  in
  entities []

let value (e : (string * string) list) (k : string) : string option =
  List.assoc_opt k e
