(* Loading *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let contents_of (k : int) : contents =
  match k with
  | -1 -> Empty
  | -2 -> Solid
  | -3 -> Water
  | -4 -> Slime
  | -5 -> Lava
  | -6 -> Sky
  | k -> Other k

let records (lump : string) (size : int) (f : int -> 'a) : 'a array =
  if String.length lump mod size <> 0 then failwith "a lump of a funny size";
  Array.init (String.length lump / size) (fun (k : int) -> f (k * size))

let vec_at (s : string) (o : int) : vec =
  {
    x = Bspfile.float32 s o;
    y = Bspfile.float32 s (o + 4);
    z = Bspfile.float32 s (o + 8);
  }

let short_vec (s : string) (o : int) : vec =
  {
    x = float (Bspfile.short s o);
    y = float (Bspfile.short s (o + 2));
    z = float (Bspfile.short s (o + 4));
  }

(* an animated texture's frame: +0 to +9, or +a to +j *)
type frame = Main of int | Alt of int

let load_textures (lump : string) : texture option array =
  if lump = "" then [||]
  else begin
    let n = Bspfile.int32 lump 0 in
    let tex =
      Array.init n (fun (i : int) ->
          let o = Bspfile.int32 lump (4 + (4 * i)) in
          if o = -1 then None
          else begin
            let w = Bspfile.int32 lump (o + 16)
            and h = Bspfile.int32 lump (o + 20) in
            if w land 15 <> 0 || h land 15 <> 0 then
              failwith "a texture not 16 aligned";
            let mips =
              Array.init 4 (fun (k : int) ->
                  String.sub lump
                    (o + Bspfile.int32 lump (o + 24 + (4 * k)))
                    ((w * h) lsr (2 * k)))
            in
            Some
              {
                tname = Bspfile.name lump o 16;
                width = w;
                height = h;
                mips;
                anim_total = 0;
                anim_min = 0;
                anim_max = 0;
                anim_next = None;
                alternate = None;
              }
          end)
    in
    (* the animations sequenced: +0 to +9 the frames, +a to +j the
     * other set, two tenths each (ANIM_CYCLE) *)
    let frame (t : texture) : frame =
      let c = Char.uppercase_ascii t.tname.[1] in
      if c >= '0' && c <= '9' then Main (Char.code c - Char.code '0')
      else if c >= 'A' && c <= 'J' then Alt (Char.code c - Char.code 'A')
      else failwith ("a bad animating texture " ^ t.tname)
    in
    Array.iter
      (fun (t : texture option) ->
        match t with
        | Some t when t.tname.[0] = '+' && t.anim_next = None ->
            let rest = String.sub t.tname 2 (String.length t.tname - 2) in
            let same =
              Array.to_list tex
              |> List.filter_map (fun (u : texture option) ->
                  match u with
                  | Some u
                    when u.tname.[0] = '+'
                         && String.sub u.tname 2 (String.length u.tname - 2)
                            = rest ->
                      Some u
                  | _ -> None)
            in
            let main = Array.make 10 None and alt = Array.make 10 None in
            List.iter
              (fun (u : texture) ->
                match frame u with
                | Main k -> main.(k) <- Some u
                | Alt k -> alt.(k) <- Some u)
              same;
            let count (a : texture option array) : int =
              let n = ref 0 in
              Array.iteri
                (fun (k : int) (u : texture option) ->
                  if u <> None then n := k + 1)
                a;
              !n
            in
            let link (a : texture option array) (other : texture option array) :
                unit =
              let m = count a in
              for k = 0 to m - 1 do
                match a.(k) with
                | None -> failwith ("a missing frame of " ^ t.tname)
                | Some u ->
                    u.anim_total <- m * 2;
                    u.anim_min <- k * 2;
                    u.anim_max <- (k + 1) * 2;
                    u.anim_next <- a.((k + 1) mod m);
                    if count other > 0 then u.alternate <- other.(0)
              done
            in
            link main alt;
            link alt main
        | _ -> ())
      tex;
    tex
  end

let no_texture : texture =
  {
    tname = "notexture";
    width = 16;
    height = 16;
    mips = Array.init 4 (fun (k : int) -> String.make (256 lsr (2 * k)) '\015');
    anim_total = 0;
    anim_min = 0;
    anim_max = 0;
    anim_next = None;
    alternate = None;
  }

(* a face's texture extents, rounded out to 16s (CalcSurfaceExtents) *)
let extents (vertexes : vec array) (edge0 : int array) (edge1 : int array)
    (surfedges : int array) (ti : texinfo) (first : int) (n : int) :
    (int * int) * (int * int) =
  let mins = [| infinity; infinity |]
  and maxs = [| neg_infinity; neg_infinity |] in
  for i = 0 to n - 1 do
    let e = surfedges.(first + i) in
    let v = if e >= 0 then vertexes.(edge0.(e)) else vertexes.(edge1.(-e)) in
    let s = dot v ti.s +. ti.s_offset and t = dot v ti.t +. ti.t_offset in
    mins.(0) <- Float.min mins.(0) s;
    maxs.(0) <- Float.max maxs.(0) s;
    mins.(1) <- Float.min mins.(1) t;
    maxs.(1) <- Float.max maxs.(1) t
  done;
  let lo (k : int) : int = int_of_float (Float.floor (mins.(k) /. 16.))
  and hi (k : int) : int = int_of_float (Float.ceil (maxs.(k) /. 16.)) in
  ((lo 0 * 16, lo 1 * 16), ((hi 0 - lo 0) * 16, (hi 1 - lo 1) * 16))

let load (bsp : Bspfile.t) : t =
  let lump (k : int) : string = bsp.lumps.(k) in
  let vertexes =
    records (lump Bspfile.vertexes) 12 (vec_at (lump Bspfile.vertexes))
  in
  let el = lump Bspfile.edges in
  let edge0 = records el 4 (fun (o : int) -> Bspfile.ushort el o)
  and edge1 = records el 4 (fun (o : int) -> Bspfile.ushort el (o + 2)) in
  let sl = lump Bspfile.surfedges in
  let surfedges = records sl 4 (Bspfile.int32 sl) in
  let pl = lump Bspfile.planes in
  let planes =
    records pl 20 (fun (o : int) ->
        {
          normal = vec_at pl o;
          dist = Bspfile.float32 pl (o + 12);
          kind = Bspfile.int32 pl (o + 16);
        })
  in
  let textures = load_textures (lump Bspfile.textures) in
  let tl = lump Bspfile.texinfo in
  let texinfos =
    records tl 40 (fun (o : int) ->
        let m = Bspfile.int32 tl (o + 32) in
        let texture =
          if m >= 0 && m < Array.length textures then
            match textures.(m) with Some t -> t | None -> no_texture
          else no_texture
        in
        {
          s = vec_at tl o;
          s_offset = Bspfile.float32 tl (o + 12);
          t = vec_at tl (o + 16);
          t_offset = Bspfile.float32 tl (o + 28);
          texture;
          special = Bspfile.int32 tl (o + 36) land 1 <> 0;
        })
  in
  let fl = lump Bspfile.faces in
  let surfaces =
    records fl 20 (fun (o : int) ->
        let first_edge = Bspfile.int32 fl (o + 4)
        and num_edges = Bspfile.short fl (o + 8) in
        let ti = texinfos.(Bspfile.short fl (o + 10)) in
        let name = ti.texture.tname in
        let kind =
          if String.length name >= 3 && String.sub name 0 3 = "sky" then Sky
          else if name <> "" && name.[0] = '*' then Turbulent
          else Normal
        in
        let texturemins, extents =
          if kind = Turbulent then ((-8192, -8192), (16384, 16384))
          else extents vertexes edge0 edge1 surfedges ti first_edge num_edges
        in
        {
          index = o / 20;
          plane = planes.(Bspfile.short fl o);
          back = Bspfile.short fl (o + 2) <> 0;
          first_edge;
          num_edges;
          texinfo = ti;
          kind;
          texturemins;
          extents;
          styles = Array.init 4 (fun (k : int) -> Bspfile.u8 fl (o + 12 + k));
          samples = Bspfile.int32 fl (o + 16);
          visframe = 0;
        })
  in
  let ml = lump Bspfile.marksurfaces in
  let marks = records ml 2 (Bspfile.ushort ml) in
  let ll = lump Bspfile.leafs in
  let leaves =
    records ll 28 (fun (o : int) ->
        let first = Bspfile.ushort ll (o + 20)
        and n = Bspfile.ushort ll (o + 22) in
        {
          lindex = o / 28;
          contents = contents_of (Bspfile.int32 ll o);
          visofs = Bspfile.int32 ll (o + 4);
          lmins = short_vec ll (o + 8);
          lmaxs = short_vec ll (o + 14);
          marks = Array.init n (fun (k : int) -> surfaces.(marks.(first + k)));
          lvisframe = 0;
          key = 0;
          lparent = None;
        })
  in
  let nl = lump Bspfile.nodes in
  let count = String.length nl / 24 in
  (* (the nodes made from the last: a node's children come after it in
   * qbsp's order, but nothing says so; made on demand instead) *)
  let nodes : node option array = Array.make count None in
  let rec node (k : int) : node =
    match nodes.(k) with
    | Some n -> n
    | None ->
        let o = k * 24 in
        let ch (c : int) : child =
          if c >= 0 then Node (node c) else Leaf leaves.(-1 - c)
        in
        let n =
          {
            nplane = planes.(Bspfile.int32 nl o);
            children =
              [| ch (Bspfile.short nl (o + 4)); ch (Bspfile.short nl (o + 6)) |];
            nmins = short_vec nl (o + 8);
            nmaxs = short_vec nl (o + 14);
            first_surface = Bspfile.ushort nl (o + 20);
            num_surfaces = Bspfile.ushort nl (o + 22);
            nvisframe = 0;
            nparent = None;
          }
        in
        nodes.(k) <- Some n;
        n
  in
  let nodes = Array.init count node in
  (* the parents (Mod_SetParent) *)
  Array.iter
    (fun (n : node) ->
      Array.iter
        (fun (c : child) ->
          match c with
          | Node c -> c.nparent <- Some n
          | Leaf l -> l.lparent <- Some n)
        n.children)
    nodes;
  (* hull 0 from the nodes (Mod_MakeHull0) *)
  let hull0 =
    let raw (o : int) (c : int) : int =
      let k = Bspfile.short nl (o + c) in
      if k >= 0 then k else Bspfile.int32 ll ((-1 - k) * 28)
    in
    {
      cplanes = Array.map (fun (n : node) -> n.nplane) nodes;
      front = Array.init count (fun (k : int) -> raw (k * 24) 4);
      back = Array.init count (fun (k : int) -> raw (k * 24) 6);
      clip_mins = zero;
      clip_maxs = zero;
    }
  in
  let cl = lump Bspfile.clipnodes in
  let ncl = String.length cl / 8 in
  let clip (mins : vec) (maxs : vec) : hull =
    {
      cplanes =
        Array.init ncl (fun (k : int) -> planes.(Bspfile.int32 cl (k * 8)));
      front = Array.init ncl (fun (k : int) -> Bspfile.short cl ((k * 8) + 4));
      back = Array.init ncl (fun (k : int) -> Bspfile.short cl ((k * 8) + 6));
      clip_mins = mins;
      clip_maxs = maxs;
    }
  in
  let hulls =
    [|
      hull0;
      clip { x = -16.; y = -16.; z = -24. } { x = 16.; y = 16.; z = 32. };
      clip { x = -32.; y = -32.; z = -24. } { x = 32.; y = 32.; z = 64. };
    |]
  in
  let sml = lump Bspfile.models in
  let submodels =
    records sml 64 (fun (o : int) ->
        {
          mins = vec_at sml o;
          maxs = vec_at sml (o + 12);
          origin = vec_at sml (o + 24);
          headnode =
            Array.init 4 (fun (k : int) -> Bspfile.int32 sml (o + 36 + (4 * k)));
          visleafs = Bspfile.int32 sml (o + 52);
          first_face = Bspfile.int32 sml (o + 56);
          num_faces = Bspfile.int32 sml (o + 60);
        })
  in
  {
    vertexes;
    edge0;
    edge1;
    surfedges;
    planes;
    textures;
    surfaces;
    nodes;
    leaves;
    hulls;
    submodels;
    visibility = lump Bspfile.visibility;
    lighting = lump Bspfile.lighting;
    entities = parse_entities (lump Bspfile.entities);
  }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Queries *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let child (m : t) (k : int) : child =
  if k >= 0 then Node m.nodes.(k) else Leaf m.leaves.(-1 - k)

let submodel_root (m : t) (k : int) : child =
  child m m.submodels.(k).headnode.(0)

let leaf_at (m : t) (p : vec) : leaf =
  let rec walk (c : child) : leaf =
    match c with
    | Leaf l -> l
    | Node n ->
        if dot n.nplane.normal p -. n.nplane.dist > 0. then walk n.children.(0)
        else walk n.children.(1)
  in
  walk (submodel_root m 0)

(* (the world's leaves but the solid one: those the rows are of) *)
let visleafs (m : t) : int = m.submodels.(0).visleafs

let pvs (m : t) (l : leaf) : Bytes.t =
  let row = (visleafs m + 7) lsr 3 in
  let out = Bytes.make row '\000' in
  if l.lindex = 0 then out
  else if l.visofs < 0 || m.visibility = "" then Bytes.make row '\255'
  else begin
    (* a zero byte, then how many zero bytes: the rows are mostly
     * zeros, a leaf seeing few of the others *)
    let vis = m.visibility and i = ref l.visofs and o = ref 0 in
    while !o < row do
      let c = Char.code vis.[!i] in
      if c <> 0 then begin
        Bytes.set out !o vis.[!i];
        incr o;
        incr i
      end
      else begin
        o := !o + Char.code vis.[!i + 1];
        i := !i + 2
      end
    done;
    out
  end

let vertex (m : t) (s : surface) (i : int) : vec =
  let e = m.surfedges.(s.first_edge + i) in
  if e >= 0 then m.vertexes.(m.edge0.(e)) else m.vertexes.(m.edge1.(-e))
games/fps/quake/model/Model.mli
6485
(* Model: a Quake level, its .bsp's lumps made records (id's model.c,
 * Mod_LoadBrushModel), what the renderer, the hulls and light walk.
 *
 * A level is a BSP tree of 3D space: each node a plane, each side a
 * child, down to the leaves, convex pieces of space that are empty
 * (air), water, slime, lava, sky or solid rock:
 *
 *         node: z = 64
 *         /          \
 *    node: x = 0     leaf: solid
 *     /       \
 *   leaf:    leaf:          a face lies on its node's plane, and the
 *   empty    water          leaves it is seen from list it (marks)
 *
 * The faces are polygons, each a loop of edges (surfedges: an edge's
 * number, negative when it is walked backwards), a texinfo (how the
 * texture lies on it: s and t of a point are dot products, and the
 * texture repeats), and lightmaps: a byte every 16 texels, the face's
 * extents rounded out to 16s, one map a light style.
 *
 *     texturemins (s, t) +----16----+----------+
 *                        |  x       x          x   a sample of the
 *                        16         |          |   lightmap at each
 *                        |  x       x          x   corner of the 16 by
 *                        +----------+----------+   16 blocks: (extents
 *                           x       x          x   / 16 + 1) squared
 *
 * Besides the tree drawn (hull 0, the nodes), the bodies move in
 * clipnodes: the same space with the walls pushed out by a box's size,
 * so a box is traced as a point (Trace): hull 1 the player's (32 by 32
 * by 56), hull 2 a big monster's (64 by 64 by 88).
 *
 * Model 0 is the world; the others are brush models, the doors, lifts
 * and buttons, each a tree of its own, moved by the game.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: made once from Bspfile; everything
 * else reads it. Its mutable fields are the frame's marks
 * (visframe, key), as id's.
 *
 * history:
 * id's (1996); the tree is the BSP of Fuchs, Kedem and Naylor (1980),
 * of 3D space, built by qbsp from the map's brushes; Doom's was of 2D
 * (mini-doom's Level). *)

type vec = { x : float; y : float; z : float }

(* a plane: the points p with dot normal p = dist; kind 0, 1, 2 when
 * the normal is the x, y, z axis (a test of one coordinate) *)
type plane = { normal : vec; dist : float; kind : int }
type contents = Empty | Solid | Water | Slime | Lava | Sky | Other of int

(* a texture and its four mips, a byte a pixel; an animation's frames
 * (+0name, +1name ...: two tenths of a second each) and its other set
 * (+aname ...: a button pressed) *)
type texture = {
  tname : string;
  width : int;
  height : int;
  mips : string array;
  mutable anim_total : int;
  mutable anim_min : int;
  mutable anim_max : int;
  mutable anim_next : texture option;
  mutable alternate : texture option;
}

(* how a texture lies on a face: s = dot s point + s_offset, the same
 * for t; special: the sky or a liquid, no lightmap *)
type texinfo = {
  s : vec;
  s_offset : float;
  t : vec;
  t_offset : float;
  texture : texture;
  special : bool;
}

type kind = Normal | Sky | Turbulent

type surface = {
  index : int;
  plane : plane;
  (* the face's front is the plane's back *)
  back : bool;
  first_edge : int;
  num_edges : int;
  texinfo : texinfo;
  kind : kind;
  (* where the face's texture starts, rounded down to 16s, and its size
   * rounded out to them (s, t) *)
  texturemins : int * int;
  extents : int * int;
  (* the light styles of its lightmaps (255: none), and where the first
   * is in the lighting (-1: none) *)
  styles : int array;
  samples : int;
  mutable visframe : int;
}

type node = {
  nplane : plane;
  children : child array;
  (* the box, as shorts *)
  nmins : vec;
  nmaxs : vec;
  first_surface : int;
  num_surfaces : int;
  mutable nvisframe : int;
  mutable nparent : node option;
}

and leaf = {
  lindex : int;
  contents : contents;
  (* where its row of the PVS is in the visibility (-1: none) *)
  visofs : int;
  lmins : vec;
  lmaxs : vec;
  marks : surface array;
  mutable lvisframe : int;
  (* the order it was reached in this frame: its faces' and models' *)
  mutable key : int;
  mutable lparent : node option;
}

and child = Node of node | Leaf of leaf

(* a hull: clipnodes, each a plane and two children, a child >= 0 a
 * clipnode and < 0 contents (-1 empty, -2 solid ...) *)
type hull = {
  cplanes : plane array;
  front : int array;
  back : int array;
  (* the box the hull is for, around a body's origin *)
  clip_mins : vec;
  clip_maxs : vec;
}

(* a model's box, its trees' roots (a hull each: 0 the nodes, 1 and 2
 * clipnodes), its leaves in the PVS (the world's), its faces *)
type submodel = {
  mins : vec;
  maxs : vec;
  origin : vec;
  headnode : int array;
  visleafs : int;
  first_face : int;
  num_faces : int;
}

type t = {
  vertexes : vec array;
  (* edge e from vertex edge0.(e) to edge1.(e) *)
  edge0 : int array;
  edge1 : int array;
  surfedges : int array;
  planes : plane array;
  textures : texture option array;
  surfaces : surface array;
  nodes : node array;
  leaves : leaf array;
  (* hull 0 made of the nodes (Mod_MakeHull0), hulls 1 and 2 qbsp's *)
  hulls : hull array;
  submodels : submodel array;
  visibility : string;
  lighting : string;
  entities : (string * string) list list;
}

val load : Bspfile.t -> t

(* [contents_of k]: a leaf's or a clipnode's contents number *)
val contents_of : int -> contents

(* [child m k]: a node's child as the .bsp numbers it (>= 0 a node,
 * else leaf -1 - k) *)
val child : t -> int -> child

(* [submodel_root m k]: the root of model k's tree *)
val submodel_root : t -> int -> child

(* [leaf_at m p]: the leaf of the world point p is in (Mod_PointInLeaf) *)
val leaf_at : t -> vec -> leaf

(* [pvs m leaf]: the leaves seen from it (Mod_LeafPVS): bit i of the
 * string is leaf i + 1; all of them when vis was not run *)
val pvs : t -> leaf -> Bytes.t

(* [vertex m surface i]: the i-th corner of a face, in its edges'
 * order *)
val vertex : t -> surface -> int -> vec

(* the entities' text parsed: each a list of (key, value) *)
val parse_entities : string -> (string * string) list list
val value : (string * string) list -> string -> string option

(* vectors *)
val dot : vec -> vec -> float
val add : vec -> vec -> vec
val sub : vec -> vec -> vec
val scale : float -> vec -> vec
val length : vec -> float
val normalize : vec -> vec
val cross : vec -> vec -> vec
val zero : vec

(* [vec_of_string "x y z"] *)
val vec_of_string : string -> vec

open Model

type frame = { fname : string; verts : Bytes.t; mutable normals : float array }

type t = {
  scale : vec;
  scale_origin : vec;
  skinwidth : int;
  skinheight : int;
  skins : string array;
  onseam : bool array;
  s : int array;
  t : int array;
  tris : int array;
  facesfront : bool array;
  frames : frame array;
  flags : int;
}

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Loading (Mod_LoadAliasModel) *)

(* each vertex's normal: the faces' around it, in the model's space *)
let normals (scale : vec) (numverts : int) (tris : int array) (verts : Bytes.t)
    : float array =
  let pos (i : int) : vec =
    let c (k : int) (s : float) : float =
      float (Char.code (Bytes.get verts ((4 * i) + k))) *. s
    in
    { x = c 0 scale.x; y = c 1 scale.y; z = c 2 scale.z }
  in
  let acc = Array.make (3 * numverts) 0. in
  for k = 0 to (Array.length tris / 3) - 1 do
    let a = tris.(3 * k)
    and b = tris.((3 * k) + 1)
    and c = tris.((3 * k) + 2) in
    (* (id's triangles turn clockwise seen from outside) *)
    let n = cross (sub (pos c) (pos a)) (sub (pos b) (pos a)) in
    List.iter
      (fun (i : int) ->
        acc.(3 * i) <- acc.(3 * i) +. n.x;
        acc.((3 * i) + 1) <- acc.((3 * i) + 1) +. n.y;
        acc.((3 * i) + 2) <- acc.((3 * i) + 2) +. n.z)
      [ a; b; c ]
  done;
  for i = 0 to numverts - 1 do
    let n =
      normalize
        { x = acc.(3 * i); y = acc.((3 * i) + 1); z = acc.((3 * i) + 2) }
    in
    acc.(3 * i) <- n.x;
    acc.((3 * i) + 1) <- n.y;
    acc.((3 * i) + 2) <- n.z
  done;
  acc

let load (d : string) : t =
  if
    String.length d < 84 || String.sub d 0 4 <> "IDPO" || Bspfile.int32 d 4 <> 6
  then failwith "not an .mdl of version 6";
  let i32 (o : int) : int = Bspfile.int32 d o
  and f32 (o : int) : float = Bspfile.float32 d o in
  let v3 (o : int) : vec = { x = f32 o; y = f32 (o + 4); z = f32 (o + 8) } in
  let scale = v3 8 and scale_origin = v3 20 in
  let numskins = i32 48
  and sw = i32 52
  and sh = i32 56
  and numverts = i32 60
  and numtris = i32 64
  and numframes = i32 68 in
  let flags = i32 76 in
  let o = ref 84 in
  let skins =
    Array.init numskins (fun _ ->
        if i32 !o = 0 then begin
          let s = String.sub d (!o + 4) (sw * sh) in
          o := !o + 4 + (sw * sh);
          s
        end
        else begin
          (* a group: its count, its intervals, its pictures; the first *)
          let n = i32 (!o + 4) in
          let first = !o + 8 + (4 * n) in
          o := first + (n * sw * sh);
          String.sub d first (sw * sh)
        end)
  in
  let onseam =
    Array.init numverts (fun (k : int) -> i32 (!o + (12 * k)) <> 0)
  in
  let s = Array.init numverts (fun (k : int) -> i32 (!o + (12 * k) + 4)) in
  let t = Array.init numverts (fun (k : int) -> i32 (!o + (12 * k) + 8)) in
  o := !o + (12 * numverts);
  let facesfront =
    Array.init numtris (fun (k : int) -> i32 (!o + (16 * k)) <> 0)
  in
  let tris =
    Array.init (3 * numtris) (fun (k : int) ->
        i32 (!o + (16 * (k / 3)) + 4 + (4 * (k mod 3))))
  in
  o := !o + (16 * numtris);
  let frames = ref [] in
  let simple () : unit =
    (* (its box, 8 bytes, then its name and its vertices) *)
    let fname = Bspfile.name d (!o + 8) 16 in
    let verts = Bytes.of_string (String.sub d (!o + 24) (4 * numverts)) in
    (* (the normals made when the frame is first drawn: most frames of
     * a model never are) *)
    frames := { fname; verts; normals = [||] } :: !frames;
    o := !o + 24 + (4 * numverts)
  in
  for _f = 1 to numframes do
    let kind = i32 !o in
    o := !o + 4;
    if kind = 0 then simple ()
    else begin
      let n = i32 !o in
      o := !o + 12 + (4 * n);
      for _k = 1 to n do
        simple ()
      done
    end
  done;
  {
    scale;
    scale_origin;
    skinwidth = sw;
    skinheight = sh;
    skins;
    onseam;
    s;
    t;
    tris;
    facesfront;
    frames = Array.of_list (List.rev !frames);
    flags;
  }

let frames_named (m : t) (prefix : string) : int list =
  let n = String.length prefix in
  List.filter
    (fun (k : int) ->
      let f = m.frames.(k).fname in
      String.length f >= n && String.sub f 0 n = prefix)
    (List.init (Array.length m.frames) (fun (k : int) -> k))

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The light under it (R_LightPoint) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let light_point (m : Model.t) (v : View.t) (p : vec) : int =
  if m.lighting = "" then 255
  else begin
    let rec walk (c : child) (start : vec) (stop : vec) : int =
      match c with
      | Leaf _ -> -1
      | Node n ->
          let pl = n.nplane in
          let front = dot start pl.normal -. pl.dist
          and back = dot stop pl.normal -. pl.dist in
          let side = if front < 0. then 1 else 0 in
          if back < 0. = (side = 1) then walk n.children.(side) start stop
          else begin
            let mid =
              add start (scale (front /. (front -. back)) (sub stop start))
            in
            let r = walk n.children.(side) start mid in
            if r >= 0 then r
            else begin
              (* the faces of this node under the mid point *)
              let found = ref (-2) in
              for k = n.first_surface to n.first_surface + n.num_surfaces - 1 do
                let f = m.surfaces.(k) in
                if !found = -2 && f.kind = Normal then begin
                  let ti = f.texinfo in
                  let s = int_of_float (dot mid ti.s +. ti.s_offset)
                  and t = int_of_float (dot mid ti.t +. ti.t_offset) in
                  let smin, tmin = f.texturemins and ew, eh = f.extents in
                  let ds = s - smin and dt = t - tmin in
                  if ds >= 0 && dt >= 0 && ds <= ew && dt <= eh then
                    if f.samples < 0 then found := 0
                    else begin
                      let w = (ew lsr 4) + 1 and h = (eh lsr 4) + 1 in
                      let r = ref 0 and maps = ref 0 in
                      while !maps < 4 && f.styles.(!maps) <> 255 do
                        let o =
                          f.samples
                          + (!maps * w * h)
                          + ((dt lsr 4) * w)
                          + (ds lsr 4)
                        in
                        r :=
                          !r
                          + Char.code m.lighting.[o]
                            * v.lightstyles.(f.styles.(!maps));
                        incr maps
                      done;
                      found := !r asr 8
                    end
                end
              done;
              if !found <> -2 then !found
              else walk n.children.(1 - side) mid stop
            end
          end
    in
    max 0 (walk (submodel_root m 0) p { p with z = p.z -. 2048. })
  end

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Drawing (r_alias.c, d_polyse.c) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* a vertex on the screen: u, v, 1/z (x 2^24), s, t (16.16), light *)
type screen_vert = {
  su : float;
  sv : float;
  zi : float;
  ss : float;
  st : float;
  light : float;
}

(* one triangle, its pixels nearer than the z-buffer's drawn: rows
 * top to bottom, the left and right edges' values interpolated, then
 * stepped across (D_PolysetDraw's work, without its edge tables); the
 * first way, models=simple's: each row's values by closures along its
 * edges, 1,400 instructions a triangle where most are a few pixels *)
let triangle_simple (v : View.t) (skin : string) (sw : int) (a : screen_vert)
    (b : screen_vert) (c : screen_vert) : unit =
  let sorted =
    List.sort
      (fun (p : screen_vert) (q : screen_vert) -> compare p.sv q.sv)
      [ a; b; c ]
  in
  match sorted with
  | [ p0; p1; p2 ] when p2.sv > p0.sv ->
      let screen = v.screen
      and zbuf = v.zbuffer
      and colormap = v.colormap
      and width = v.width in
      let y0 = max 0 (int_of_float (Float.ceil p0.sv))
      and y1 = min (v.height - 1) (int_of_float (Float.ceil p2.sv) - 1) in
      (* a value along the edge from p to q at row y *)
      let at (p : screen_vert) (q : screen_vert) (y : float)
          (f : screen_vert -> float) : float =
        if q.sv = p.sv then f p
        else f p +. ((f q -. f p) *. (y -. p.sv) /. (q.sv -. p.sv))
      in
      for y = y0 to y1 do
        let fy = float y in
        let long (f : screen_vert -> float) : float = at p0 p2 fy f in
        let short (f : screen_vert -> float) : float =
          if fy < p1.sv then at p0 p1 fy f else at p1 p2 fy f
        in
        let xa = long (fun (p : screen_vert) -> p.su)
        and xb = short (fun (p : screen_vert) -> p.su) in
        let l, r, sel = if xa <= xb then (xa, xb, true) else (xb, xa, false) in
        let left (f : screen_vert -> float) : float =
          if sel then long f else short f
        in
        let right (f : screen_vert -> float) : float =
          if sel then short f else long f
        in
        let x0 = max 0 (int_of_float (Float.ceil l))
        and x1 = min (width - 1) (int_of_float (Float.ceil r) - 1) in
        if x1 >= x0 then begin
          let span = r -. l in
          let fixed (f : screen_vert -> float) : int * int =
            let lv = left f and rv = right f in
            let step = if span > 0. then (rv -. lv) /. span else 0. in
            let start = lv +. ((float x0 -. l) *. step) in
            (int_of_float (start *. 65536.), int_of_float (step *. 65536.))
          in
          let zi, zistep =
            let lv = left (fun (p : screen_vert) -> p.zi)
            and rv = right (fun (p : screen_vert) -> p.zi) in
            let step = if span > 0. then (rv -. lv) /. span else 0. in
            ( ref (int_of_float (lv +. ((float x0 -. l) *. step))),
              int_of_float step )
          in
          let s, sstep = fixed (fun (p : screen_vert) -> p.ss)
          and t, tstep = fixed (fun (p : screen_vert) -> p.st) in
          let li, listep = fixed (fun (p : screen_vert) -> p.light) in
          let s = ref s and t = ref t and li = ref li in
          let o = y * width in
          for x = x0 to x1 do
            if !zi >= zbuf.(o + x) then begin
              zbuf.(o + x) <- !zi;
              let texel =
                Char.code
                  (String.unsafe_get skin (((!t asr 16) * sw) + (!s asr 16)))
              in
              Bytes.unsafe_set screen (o + x)
                (String.unsafe_get colormap
                   (((!li asr 16) land 0xFF00) + texel))
            end;
            zi := !zi + zistep;
            s := !s + sstep;
            t := !t + tstep;
            li := !li + listep
          done
        end
      done
  | _ -> ()

(* OPTIMIZATION (gradients): the same pixels, as id's
 * D_PolysetCalcGradients: s, t, light and 1/z are a plane over the
 * triangle, so their steps along x and y are computed once, and a
 * row's start is p0's value plus the steps to it; only the edges' x
 * are found a row at a time. No list sorted, no closure, no tuple:
 * the fight's frame (games/tests/frames.expected's, arm instructions
 * by mini-5i) 29.0M to 21.8M, the same pixels (the vertices' nine
 * products, in draw_pitched, 34.7M to 29.0M before) *)
let gradients = ref true

let triangle (v : View.t) (skin : string) (sw : int) (a : screen_vert)
    (b : screen_vert) (c : screen_vert) : unit =
  (* the three by their row, top first *)
  let a, b = if b.sv < a.sv then (b, a) else (a, b) in
  let b, c = if c.sv < b.sv then (c, b) else (b, c) in
  let p0, p1 = if b.sv < a.sv then (b, a) else (a, b) in
  let p2 = c in
  let du1 = p1.su -. p0.su and dv1 = p1.sv -. p0.sv
  and du2 = p2.su -. p0.su and dv2 = p2.sv -. p0.sv in
  let d = (du1 *. dv2) -. (du2 *. dv1) in
  if p2.sv > p0.sv && d <> 0. then begin
    let screen = v.screen
    and zbuf = v.zbuffer
    and colormap = v.colormap
    and width = v.width in
    (* a value's steps along x and along y *)
    let gx1 = dv2 /. d and gx2 = dv1 /. d in
    let gy1 = du2 /. d and gy2 = du1 /. d in
    let zx = ((p1.zi -. p0.zi) *. gx1) -. ((p2.zi -. p0.zi) *. gx2)
    and zy = ((p2.zi -. p0.zi) *. gy2) -. ((p1.zi -. p0.zi) *. gy1) in
    let sx = ((p1.ss -. p0.ss) *. gx1) -. ((p2.ss -. p0.ss) *. gx2)
    and sy = ((p2.ss -. p0.ss) *. gy2) -. ((p1.ss -. p0.ss) *. gy1) in
    let tx = ((p1.st -. p0.st) *. gx1) -. ((p2.st -. p0.st) *. gx2)
    and ty = ((p2.st -. p0.st) *. gy2) -. ((p1.st -. p0.st) *. gy1) in
    let lx = ((p1.light -. p0.light) *. gx1) -. ((p2.light -. p0.light) *. gx2)
    and ly = ((p2.light -. p0.light) *. gy2) -. ((p1.light -. p0.light) *. gy1) in
    (* the edges' x along y: the long one p0 p2, the short ones p0 p1
     * and p1 p2 *)
    let k02 = du2 /. dv2 in
    let k01 = if dv1 > 0. then du1 /. dv1 else 0. in
    let k12 =
      if p2.sv > p1.sv then (p2.su -. p1.su) /. (p2.sv -. p1.sv) else 0.
    in
    let sstep = int_of_float (sx *. 65536.)
    and tstep = int_of_float (tx *. 65536.)
    and listep = int_of_float (lx *. 65536.)
    and zistep = int_of_float zx in
    let y0 = max 0 (int_of_float (Float.ceil p0.sv))
    and y1 = min (v.height - 1) (int_of_float (Float.ceil p2.sv) - 1) in
    for y = y0 to y1 do
      let fy = float y in
      let xa = p0.su +. ((fy -. p0.sv) *. k02) in
      let xb =
        if fy < p1.sv then p0.su +. ((fy -. p0.sv) *. k01)
        else p1.su +. ((fy -. p1.sv) *. k12)
      in
      let l = if xa <= xb then xa else xb
      and r = if xa <= xb then xb else xa in
      let x0 = max 0 (int_of_float (Float.ceil l))
      and x1 = min (width - 1) (int_of_float (Float.ceil r) - 1) in
      if x1 >= x0 then begin
        let ux = float x0 -. p0.su and uy = fy -. p0.sv in
        let zi = ref (int_of_float (p0.zi +. (ux *. zx) +. (uy *. zy)))
        and s = ref (int_of_float ((p0.ss +. (ux *. sx) +. (uy *. sy)) *. 65536.))
        and t = ref (int_of_float ((p0.st +. (ux *. tx) +. (uy *. ty)) *. 65536.))
        and li =
          ref (int_of_float ((p0.light +. (ux *. lx) +. (uy *. ly)) *. 65536.))
        in
        let o = y * width in
        for x = x0 to x1 do
          if !zi >= zbuf.(o + x) then begin
            zbuf.(o + x) <- !zi;
            let texel =
              Char.code
                (String.unsafe_get skin (((!t asr 16) * sw) + (!s asr 16)))
            in
            Bytes.unsafe_set screen (o + x)
              (String.unsafe_get colormap (((!li asr 16) land 0xFF00) + texel))
          end;
          zi := !zi + zistep;
          s := !s + sstep;
          t := !t + tstep;
          li := !li + listep
        done
      end
    done
  end

let rec draw (v : View.t) (m : t) (origin : vec) (yaw : float) (frame : int)
    (skin : int) (light : int) : unit =
  draw_pitched v m origin 0. yaw frame skin light

and draw_pitched (v : View.t) (m : t) (origin : vec) (pitch : float)
    (yaw : float) (frame : int) (skin : int) (light : int) : unit =
  let fr = m.frames.(frame mod Array.length m.frames) in
  if fr.normals = [||] then
    fr.normals <- normals m.scale (Array.length m.onseam) m.tris fr.verts;
  let skin = m.skins.(skin mod Array.length m.skins) in
  let forward, right, up = View.angle_vectors pitch yaw in
  (* the light (R_AliasSetupLighting): an ambient part, at least 5, at
   * most 128, and a shade from one side, as colormap rows x 256 *)
  let ambient = max 5 (min 128 light) in
  let shade = max 0 (min light (192 - ambient)) in
  let r_ambient = float ((255 - ambient) lsl 6)
  and r_shade = float (shade * 64) in
  (* (the light comes along -x in the world: in the model's space) *)
  let lv = { x = -1.; y = 0.; z = 0. } in
  let plv = { x = dot lv forward; y = -.dot lv right; z = dot lv up } in
  let n = Array.length m.onseam in
  (* the model's axes and origin in the eye's, once: a vertex is then
   * nine products away *)
  let f = View.transform v forward
  and r = View.transform v right
  and u = View.transform v up
  and o = View.transform v (sub origin v.origin) in
  (* the skin's texels kept inside it *)
  let sw = float m.skinwidth -. 1. and sh = float m.skinheight -. 1. in
  let clamp_s (s : float) : float = Float.max 0. (Float.min sw s) in
  let clamp_t (t : float) : float = Float.max 0. (Float.min sh t) in
  let verts =
    Array.init n (fun (i : int) ->
        let c (k : int) : float =
          float (Char.code (Bytes.get fr.verts ((4 * i) + k)))
        in
        let px = (c 0 *. m.scale.x) +. m.scale_origin.x
        and py = (c 1 *. m.scale.y) +. m.scale_origin.y
        and pz = (c 2 *. m.scale.z) +. m.scale_origin.z in
        (* the model's x forward, y left, z up
         * old: add origin (add (scale p.x forward) (add (scale (-.p.y)
         * right) (scale p.z up))), less v.origin, then View.transform:
         * six vectors made a vertex *)
        let t =
          {
            x = o.x +. (px *. f.x) -. (py *. r.x) +. (pz *. u.x);
            y = o.y +. (px *. f.y) -. (py *. r.y) +. (pz *. u.y);
            z = o.z +. (px *. f.z) -. (py *. r.z) +. (pz *. u.z);
          }
        in
        let z = Float.max t.z 0.01 in
        let lightcos =
          (fr.normals.(3 * i) *. plv.x)
          +. (fr.normals.((3 * i) + 1) *. plv.y)
          +. (fr.normals.((3 * i) + 2) *. plv.z)
        in
        let l =
          if lightcos < 0. then Float.max 0. (r_ambient +. (r_shade *. lightcos))
          else r_ambient
        in
        ( t.z,
          {
            su = v.xcenter +. (v.xscale *. t.x /. z);
            sv = v.ycenter -. (v.yscale *. t.y /. z);
            zi = 16777216. /. z;
            ss = clamp_s (float m.s.(i));
            st = clamp_t (float m.t.(i));
            light = l;
          } ))
  in
  (* a vertex on the seam, in a triangle facing back: the skin's back
   * half's texel *)
  let seams =
    Array.mapi
      (fun (i : int) ((z, p) : float * screen_vert) ->
        if m.onseam.(i) then
          ( z,
            { p with ss = clamp_s (float (m.s.(i) + (m.skinwidth / 2))) } )
        else (z, p))
      verts
  in
  for k = 0 to Array.length m.facesfront - 1 do
    let ia = m.tris.(3 * k)
    and ib = m.tris.((3 * k) + 1)
    and ic = m.tris.((3 * k) + 2) in
    let za, a = verts.(ia) and zb, b = verts.(ib) and zc, c = verts.(ic) in
    (* (a triangle with a corner behind the eye is left out: id's clips
     * it; a model that near is rare) *)
    if za > 1. && zb > 1. && zc > 1. then begin
      (* facing the eye (d_xdenom < 0) *)
      let denom =
        ((a.sv -. b.sv) *. (a.su -. c.su)) -. ((a.su -. b.su) *. (a.sv -. c.sv))
      in
      if denom < 0. then begin
        let corner (i : int) (p : screen_vert) : screen_vert =
          if (not m.facesfront.(k)) && m.onseam.(i) then snd seams.(i) else p
        in
        (if !gradients then triangle else triangle_simple)
          v skin m.skinwidth (corner ia a) (corner ib b) (corner ic c)
      end
    end
  done
games/fps/quake/render/Alias.mli
3691
(* Alias: Quake's models, the monsters and items (an .mdl, "alias"
 * models: id's model.c Mod_LoadAliasModel, r_alias.c, d_polyse.c,
 * r_light.c's R_LightPoint).
 *
 * The world is drawn without a z-buffer (Scan sorts its spans), but
 * the things that move cannot be in the BSP. So the world's spans
 * write 1/z of each pixel as they draw it (D_DrawZSpans), and the
 * models are drawn after, a triangle at a time, each pixel kept only
 * where it is nearer than what is there:
 *
 *    the world's spans: the picture, and 1/z at each pixel
 *    a model's triangles: s, t, light and 1/z interpolated across;
 *    a pixel drawn if its 1/z >= the buffer's (nearer), and the
 *    buffer then its own (so the model's triangles hide each other)
 *
 * The mapping is affine, not perspective (no division a pixel): a
 * model's triangles are small on the screen, the error not seen; the
 * world's large faces needed the division every 8 pixels (Spans).
 *
 * A model is a skin (a picture, its front half and its back half, the
 * vertices on the seam taking the back half's texels when their
 * triangle faces back), triangles over vertices given as bytes in a
 * box scaled to the model's size, and frames: the vertices again for
 * each pose (a monster's stand1 to stand8). An animation is its frames
 * one after the other, ten a second, no in-between.
 *
 * A model is lit by the world's lightmap where it stands: the light of
 * the face under its origin (R_LightPoint: a ray straight down, the
 * lightmap's sample where it hits), plus a light from one direction
 * shading the vertices whose normals look away from it. id's vertex
 * normals were indices into a table of 162 directions; here each
 * frame's normals are computed from its triangles (the average of the
 * faces around a vertex): no table copied.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: Things lists the level's models;
 * Render draws them after the world, each with the z-buffer. *)

(* a pose: its vertices' x y z, bytes, and their normals, x y z a
 * vertex, made when it is first drawn *)
type frame = { fname : string; verts : Bytes.t; mutable normals : float array }

type t = {
  scale : Model.vec;
  scale_origin : Model.vec;
  skinwidth : int;
  skinheight : int;
  (* each skin's picture (a group's first) *)
  skins : string array;
  (* a vertex's texel, and whether it is on the seam *)
  onseam : bool array;
  s : int array;
  t : int array;
  (* a triangle's three vertices, and whether it faces front *)
  tris : int array;
  facesfront : bool array;
  (* (a frame group's frames, one after the other) *)
  frames : frame array;
  (* the model's flags: 8 rotates (EF_ROTATE: the items) *)
  flags : int;
}

(* [load bytes]: an .mdl's model; Failure if it is none *)
val load : string -> t

(* [frames_named m prefix]: the frames whose name starts with prefix
 * (stand: stand1 ...) *)
val frames_named : t -> string -> int list

(* [light_point m v p]: the world's light under p, 0 to 255 x 2
 * (R_LightPoint) *)
val light_point : Model.t -> View.t -> Model.vec -> int

(* the triangles' values by their steps along x and y, computed once a
 * triangle (id's D_PolysetCalcGradients); false: along each row's
 * edges, the first way (mini-quake's models=simple) *)
val gradients : bool ref

(* [draw v m model origin yaw frame skin light]: the model's triangles
 * into v.screen, against v.zbuffer *)
val draw : View.t -> t -> Model.vec -> float -> int -> int -> int -> unit

(* [draw_pitched v m origin pitch yaw frame skin light]: the same,
 * turned up or down too (a rocket's flight, the weapon in hand) *)
val draw_pitched :
  View.t -> t -> Model.vec -> float -> float -> int -> int -> int -> unit

(* See Bsp.mli *)

open Model

let marked = ref 0

let mark_leaves (v : View.t) (m : Model.t) (leaf : leaf) : unit =
  if v.oldviewleaf <> leaf.lindex then begin
    v.oldviewleaf <- leaf.lindex;
    v.visframecount <- v.visframecount + 1;
    let vis = Model.pvs m leaf in
    let n = m.submodels.(0).visleafs in
    marked := 0;
    for i = 0 to n - 1 do
      if Char.code (Bytes.get vis (i lsr 3)) land (1 lsl (i land 7)) <> 0 then begin
        let l = m.leaves.(i + 1) in
        incr marked;
        l.lvisframe <- v.visframecount;
        (* the parents, up to one already marked *)
        let rec up (p : node option) : unit =
          match p with
          | Some p when p.nvisframe <> v.visframecount ->
              p.nvisframe <- v.visframecount;
              up p.nparent
          | _ -> ()
        in
        up l.lparent
      end
    done
  end

(* the box against the planes still to clip by: -1 out of one, else
 * the planes it crosses (R_RecursiveWorldNode's test, R_BmodelCheckBBox) *)
let clip_box (v : View.t) (mins : vec) (maxs : vec) (clipflags : int) : int =
  let flags = ref clipflags and out = ref false in
  for i = 0 to 3 do
    if (not !out) && !flags land (1 lsl i) <> 0 then begin
      let idx = v.frustum_indexes.(i) and c = v.clips.(i) in
      let corner (o : int) : vec =
        {
          x = View.minmax mins maxs idx.(o);
          y = View.minmax mins maxs idx.(o + 1);
          z = View.minmax mins maxs idx.(o + 2);
        }
      in
      (* the corner farthest out: if out, all is *)
      if dot (corner 0) c.cnormal -. c.cdist <= 0. then out := true
      else if dot (corner 3) c.cnormal -. c.cdist >= 0. then
        (* the farthest in is in: no clip by it *)
        flags := !flags land lnot (1 lsl i)
    end
  done;
  if !out then -1 else !flags

let backface_epsilon = 0.01

let rec world_node (e : Edges.t) (v : View.t) (m : Model.t) (c : child)
    (clipflags : int) : unit =
  match c with
  | Leaf l ->
      if l.contents <> Solid && l.lvisframe = v.visframecount then begin
        let flags =
          if clipflags = 0 then 0 else clip_box v l.lmins l.lmaxs clipflags
        in
        if flags >= 0 then begin
          (* its faces may be drawn, when their node is reached *)
          Array.iter (fun (s : surface) -> s.visframe <- v.framecount) l.marks;
          l.key <- v.currentkey;
          (* (all brush models in a leaf share its key) *)
          v.currentkey <- v.currentkey + 1
        end
      end
  | Node n ->
      if n.nvisframe = v.visframecount then begin
        let flags =
          if clipflags = 0 then 0 else clip_box v n.nmins n.nmaxs clipflags
        in
        if flags >= 0 then begin
          let p = n.nplane in
          let d = dot v.modelorg p.normal -. p.dist in
          let side = if d >= 0. then 0 else 1 in
          (* the eye's side first *)
          world_node e v m n.children.(side) flags;
          if n.num_surfaces > 0 then begin
            (* the node's faces that look at the eye, those marked by
             * the leaves reached *)
            for k = n.first_surface to n.first_surface + n.num_surfaces - 1 do
              let s = m.surfaces.(k) in
              if
                s.visframe = v.framecount
                && ((s.back && d < -.backface_epsilon)
                   || ((not s.back) && d > backface_epsilon))
              then Edges.render_face e v m s flags None
            done;
            (* (all the faces of a node share a key: they are on one
             * plane, none hides another) *)
            v.currentkey <- v.currentkey + 1
          end;
          world_node e v m n.children.(1 - side) flags
        end
      end

let render_world (e : Edges.t) (v : View.t) (m : Model.t) : unit =
  v.modelorg <- v.origin;
  View.transform_frustum v;
  e.in_submodel <- false;
  e.current_entity <- 0;
  world_node e v m (submodel_root m 0) 15

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The brush models (R_DrawBEntitiesOnList) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the box's sides of a plane: 1 in front, 2 behind, 3 both
 * (BOX_ON_PLANE_SIDE) *)
let box_side (mins : vec) (maxs : vec) (p : plane) : int =
  let n = p.normal in
  let near =
    {
      x = (if n.x >= 0. then mins.x else maxs.x);
      y = (if n.y >= 0. then mins.y else maxs.y);
      z = (if n.z >= 0. then mins.z else maxs.z);
    }
  in
  let far =
    {
      x = (if n.x >= 0. then maxs.x else mins.x);
      y = (if n.y >= 0. then maxs.y else mins.y);
      z = (if n.z >= 0. then maxs.z else mins.z);
    }
  in
  (if dot far n -. p.dist >= 0. then 1 else 0)
  lor if dot near n -. p.dist < 0. then 2 else 0

(* the node whose plane splits the box first, or the one leaf it is
 * in, among those seen (R_SplitEntityOnNode2) *)
let rec top_node (v : View.t) (mins : vec) (maxs : vec) (c : child) :
    child option =
  match c with
  | Leaf l ->
      if l.lvisframe = v.visframecount && l.contents <> Solid then Some c
      else None
  | Node n ->
      if n.nvisframe <> v.visframecount then None
      else begin
        let sides = box_side mins maxs n.nplane in
        if sides = 3 then Some c
        else
          top_node v mins maxs n.children.(if sides land 1 <> 0 then 0 else 1)
      end

(* a brush model's face cut by the world's planes, each piece in a leaf
 * drawn with that leaf's key (R_RecursiveClipBPoly) *)
let rec clip_bpoly (e : Edges.t) (v : View.t) (fa : surface) (clipflags : int)
    (origin : vec) (edges : (vec * vec) list) (c : child) : unit =
  match c with
  | Leaf l ->
      if l.lvisframe = v.visframecount && l.contents <> Solid then
        Edges.render_poly e v fa clipflags
          (fun (f : vec -> vec -> unit) ->
            List.iter (fun ((a, b) : vec * vec) -> f a b) edges)
          (Some l.key) false
  | Node n ->
      if n.nvisframe = v.visframecount then begin
        (* (the plane in the model's space: its origin moved) *)
        let p = n.nplane in
        let dist = p.dist -. dot origin p.normal in
        let side (q : vec) : int =
          if dot q p.normal -. dist > 0. then 0 else 1
        in
        let front = ref []
        and back = ref []
        and enter = ref None
        and exit = ref None in
        List.iter
          (fun ((a, b) : vec * vec) ->
            let sa = side a and sb = side b in
            if sa = sb then
              if sa = 0 then front := (a, b) :: !front
              else back := (a, b) :: !back
            else begin
              let da = dot a p.normal -. dist and db = dot b p.normal -. dist in
              let mid = add a (scale (da /. (da -. db)) (sub b a)) in
              let put (s : int) (x : vec * vec) : unit =
                if s = 0 then front := x :: !front else back := x :: !back
              in
              put sa (a, mid);
              put sb (mid, b);
              if sb = 0 then enter := Some mid else exit := Some mid
            end)
          edges;
        (* the cut's own edge, on both sides, opposite ways *)
        (match (!enter, !exit) with
        | Some en, Some ex ->
            front := (ex, en) :: !front;
            back := (en, ex) :: !back
        | _ -> ());
        if !front <> [] then
          clip_bpoly e v fa clipflags origin (List.rev !front) n.children.(0);
        if !back <> [] then
          clip_bpoly e v fa clipflags origin (List.rev !back) n.children.(1)
      end

let render_bmodels (e : Edges.t) (v : View.t) (m : Model.t)
    (entities : (int * int * vec) list) : unit =
  e.in_submodel <- true;
  List.iter
    (fun ((ent, k, origin) : int * int * vec) ->
      let sm = m.submodels.(k) in
      let mins = add origin sm.mins and maxs = add origin sm.maxs in
      v.modelorg <- v.origin;
      View.transform_frustum v;
      let clipflags = clip_box v mins maxs 15 in
      if clipflags >= 0 then
        match top_node v mins maxs (submodel_root m 0) with
        | None -> ()
        | Some top ->
            e.current_entity <- ent;
            (* the eye in the model's space, and the view's planes *)
            v.modelorg <- sub v.origin origin;
            View.transform_frustum v;
            for f = sm.first_face to sm.first_face + sm.num_faces - 1 do
              let s = m.surfaces.(f) in
              let p = s.plane in
              let d = dot v.modelorg p.normal -. p.dist in
              if
                (s.back && d < -.backface_epsilon)
                || ((not s.back) && d > backface_epsilon)
              then
                match top with
                | Leaf l -> Edges.render_face e v m s clipflags (Some l.key)
                | Node _ ->
                    let edges =
                      List.init s.num_edges (fun (i : int) ->
                          let k = m.surfedges.(s.first_edge + i) in
                          if k >= 0 then
                            (m.vertexes.(m.edge0.(k)), m.vertexes.(m.edge1.(k)))
                          else
                            ( m.vertexes.(m.edge1.(-k)),
                              m.vertexes.(m.edge0.(-k)) ))
                    in
                    clip_bpoly e v s clipflags origin edges top
            done)
    entities;
  e.in_submodel <- false;
  e.current_entity <- 0;
  v.modelorg <- v.origin;
  View.transform_frustum v
games/fps/quake/render/Bsp.mli
2561
(* Bsp: the level's tree walked front to back, what the eye may see
 * made edges (Quake's r_bsp.c, R_RenderWorld, R_RecursiveWorldNode;
 * r_main.c, R_MarkLeaves).
 *
 * First the PVS, vis's work (Model.pvs): the leaves seen from the
 * eye's leaf, wherever in it the eye stands, are marked with the
 * frame's number, and so are their parents up to the root; the walk
 * goes only into marked nodes. In a level of rooms and corridors most
 * of the tree is cut there, before any test of the view:
 *
 *              root*                * marked: a leaf seen, or a node
 *             /     \                 above one
 *          n1*       n2             the walk never enters n2: nothing
 *         /   \     /  \            under it can be seen from here,
 *      leaf*  leaf leaf leaf        whatever the way the eye looks
 *
 * Then the walk (R_RecursiveWorldNode): at each node, its box against
 * the four planes of the view (a box wholly out is skipped, wholly in
 * one plane needs no clipping by it: clipflags); the side of its plane
 * the eye is on first, then the node's faces that look at the eye,
 * then the other side. A leaf reached marks its faces (they may be
 * drawn, from the node they lie on) and takes the next key. So the
 * faces come front to back, each with a key larger than any in front
 * of it: Scan sorts by that.
 *
 * A face facing away (the eye behind its plane) is not drawn: a
 * level's faces are one-sided, the inside of the rock never seen.
 *
 * history:
 * Doom walked its 2D tree front to back (mini-doom's Bsp); Quake's is
 * of 3D space, and the PVS is what is new (Seth Teller's thesis,
 * Berkeley 1992, on visibility in architectural models; Carmack's vis
 * computed it over the portals between the leaves). Abrash, Black
 * Book chapters 59-64.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: Render's frame calls mark_leaves, then
 * render_world, then render_bmodels, then Scan. *)

(* [mark_leaves v m leaf]: the PVS of the eye's leaf marked
 * (v.visframecount) *)
val mark_leaves : View.t -> Model.t -> Model.leaf -> unit

(* [render_world e v m]: the world's visible faces made edges *)
val render_world : Edges.t -> View.t -> Model.t -> unit

(* [render_bmodels e v m entities]: the brush models (doors, lifts),
 * each (number, its model, its origin), made edges with the key of
 * the leaf they are in (R_DrawBEntitiesOnList) *)
val render_bmodels :
  Edges.t -> View.t -> Model.t -> (int * int * Model.vec) list -> unit

(* the leaves marked in the last mark_leaves (the PVS's count) *)
val marked : int ref

let create (height : int) : t =

let clear (e : t) : unit =
  e.num_edges <- 4;
  Array.fill e.newedges 0 (Array.length e.newedges) (-1);
  Array.fill e.removeedges 0 (Array.length e.removeedges) (-1);
  (* the background: the farthest, drawn where nothing else is *)
  e.key.(background) <- max_int;
  e.face.(background) <- -1;
  e.spans.(background) <- -1;
  e.insubmodel.(background) <- false;
  e.spanstate.(background) <- 0;
  e.num_surfaces <- 2;
  e.num_spans <- 0

(*****************************************************************************)
(* An edge (R_EmitEdge) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* a point projected: u, v (clamped to the screen), 1/z *)
let project (v : View.t) (p : vec) : float * float * float =
  let t = View.transform v (sub p v.modelorg) in
  (* (NEAR_CLIP: the clip by the view's planes leaves nothing behind
   * the eye, but a point on it) *)
  let z = Float.max t.z 0.01 in
  let lzi = 1. /. z in
  let clamp (lo : float) (hi : float) (x : float) : float =
    Float.max lo (Float.min hi x)
  in
  let u =
    clamp (-0.5) (float v.width -. 0.5) (v.xcenter +. (v.xscale *. lzi *. t.x))
  in
  let w =
    clamp (-0.5) (float v.height -. 0.5) (v.ycenter -. (v.yscale *. lzi *. t.y))
  in
  (u, w, lzi)

let emit_edge (e : t) (v : View.t) (pv0 : vec) (pv1 : vec) : unit =
  let u0, v0, lzi0, ceilv0 =
    if e.lastvertvalid then (e.u1, e.v1, e.lzi1, e.ceilv1)
    else begin
      let u0, v0, lzi0 = project v pv0 in
      (u0, v0, lzi0, int_of_float (Float.ceil v0))
    end
  in
  let u1, v1, lzi1 = project v pv1 in
  e.u1 <- u1;
  e.v1 <- v1;
  e.lzi1 <- lzi1;
  (* (the nearest of the face's points: its mip level) *)
  let lzi0 = Float.max lzi0 lzi1 in
  if lzi0 > e.nearzi_face then e.nearzi_face <- lzi0;
  if not e.nearzi_only then begin
    e.emitted <- true;
    e.ceilv1 <- int_of_float (Float.ceil v1);
    (* (a horizontal edge crosses no scanline's center) *)
    if ceilv0 <> e.ceilv1 && e.num_edges < Array.length e.u then begin
      let k = e.num_edges in
      e.num_edges <- k + 1;
      let surf = e.num_surfaces in
      let first, last, u, step =
        if ceilv0 < e.ceilv1 then begin
          (* going down: it trails *)
          e.surf_trail.(k) <- surf;
          e.surf_lead.(k) <- 0;
          let step = (u1 -. u0) /. (v1 -. v0) in
          (ceilv0, e.ceilv1 - 1, u0 +. ((float ceilv0 -. v0) *. step), step)
        end
        else begin
          (* going up: it leads, from v1 *)
          e.surf_trail.(k) <- 0;
          e.surf_lead.(k) <- surf;
          let step = (u0 -. u1) /. (v0 -. v1) in
          (e.ceilv1, ceilv0 - 1, u1 +. ((float e.ceilv1 -. v1) *. step), step)
        end
      in
      let one = float (1 lsl shift) in
      let w = float v.width in
      e.u_step.(k) <- int_of_float (Float.max (-.w) (Float.min w step) *. one);
      let lo = (1 lsl (shift - 1)) - 1 in
      (* (the pixel whose center is past u: + 0.99...) *)
      e.u.(k) <-
        max lo
          (min
             ((v.width lsl shift) + lo)
             (int_of_float (u *. one) + (1 lsl shift) - 1));
      (* sorted in its first scanline, a trailing edge after a leading
       * one at the same u *)
      let check = if e.surf_trail.(k) <> 0 then e.u.(k) + 1 else e.u.(k) in
      let h = e.newedges.(first) in
      if h < 0 || e.u.(h) >= check then begin
        e.next.(k) <- h;
        e.newedges.(first) <- k
      end
      else begin
        let p = ref h in
        while e.next.(!p) >= 0 && e.u.(e.next.(!p)) < check do
          p := e.next.(!p)
        done;
        e.next.(k) <- e.next.(!p);
        e.next.(!p) <- k
      end;
      e.next_remove.(k) <- e.removeedges.(last);
      e.removeedges.(last) <- k
    end
  end

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Its clips (R_ClipEdge) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let rec clip_edge (e : t) (v : View.t) (pv0 : vec) (pv1 : vec)
    (planes : int list) : unit =
  match planes with
  | [] -> emit_edge e v pv0 pv1
  | i :: rest ->
      let c = v.clips.(i) in
      let d0 = dot pv0 c.cnormal -. c.cdist
      and d1 = dot pv1 c.cnormal -. c.cdist in
      let cut () : vec =
        let f = d0 /. (d0 -. d1) in
        add pv0 (scale f (sub pv1 pv0))
      in
      if d0 >= 0. then begin
        if d1 >= 0. then clip_edge e v pv0 pv1 rest
        else begin
          (* it leaves the view here *)
          let p = cut () in
          if i = 0 then begin
            e.left_clipped <- true;
            e.left_exit <- p
          end
          else if i = 1 then begin
            e.right_clipped <- true;
            e.right_exit <- p
          end;
          clip_edge e v pv0 p rest
        end
      end
      else if d1 >= 0. then begin
        (* it enters the view here *)
        e.lastvertvalid <- false;
        let p = cut () in
        if i = 0 then begin
          e.left_clipped <- true;
          e.left_enter <- p
        end
        else if i = 1 then begin
          e.right_clipped <- true;
          e.right_enter <- p
        end;
        clip_edge e v p pv1 rest
      end

(*****************************************************************************)
(* A face (R_RenderFace) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* a face's edges, given by [iter] (each from vertex a to vertex b,
 * clockwise), clipped and filed; its surface made, of the key given
 * or the next (R_RenderFace, R_RenderBmodelFace) *)
let render_poly (e : t) (v : View.t) (fa : surface) (clipflags : int)
    (iter : (vec -> vec -> unit) -> unit) (key : int option) (chained : bool) :
    unit =
  if
    e.num_surfaces < Array.length e.key
    && e.num_edges + fa.num_edges + 8 < Array.length e.u
  then begin
    let planes =
      List.filter
        (fun (i : int) -> clipflags land (1 lsl i) <> 0)
        [ 0; 1; 2; 3 ]
    in
    e.emitted <- false;
    e.nearzi_face <- 0.;
    e.nearzi_only <- false;
    e.lastvertvalid <- false;
    let make_left = ref false and make_right = ref false in
    iter (fun (a : vec) (b : vec) ->
        e.left_clipped <- false;
        e.right_clipped <- false;
        clip_edge e v a b planes;
        if e.left_clipped then make_left := true;
        if e.right_clipped then make_right := true;
        (* (the next edge starts where this one ended: its first point
         * already projected) *)
        e.lastvertvalid <- chained);
    (* the left border's edge, where the face went out of the view and
     * came back; the right's, only for the nearest 1/z *)
    if !make_left then begin
      e.lastvertvalid <- false;
      clip_edge e v e.left_exit e.left_enter
        (List.filter (fun (i : int) -> i <> 0) planes)
    end;
    if !make_right then begin
      e.lastvertvalid <- false;
      e.nearzi_only <- true;
      clip_edge e v e.right_exit e.right_enter
        (List.filter (fun (i : int) -> i > 1) planes)
    end;
    if e.emitted then begin
      let s = e.num_surfaces in
      e.num_surfaces <- s + 1;
      e.face.(s) <- fa.index;
      e.nearzi.(s) <- e.nearzi_face;
      e.insubmodel.(s) <- e.in_submodel;
      e.entity.(s) <- e.current_entity;
      e.spanstate.(s) <- 0;
      (match key with
      | Some k -> e.key.(s) <- k
      | None ->
          e.key.(s) <- v.currentkey;
          v.currentkey <- v.currentkey + 1);
      e.spans.(s) <- -1;
      (* 1/z on the screen: the plane's distance from the eye seen
       * through each pixel *)
      let p = fa.plane in
      let n = View.transform v p.normal in
      let distinv = 1. /. (p.dist -. dot v.modelorg p.normal) in
      e.zistepu.(s) <- n.x *. v.xscaleinv *. distinv;
      e.zistepv.(s) <- -.n.y *. v.yscaleinv *. distinv;
      e.ziorigin.(s) <-
        (n.z *. distinv)
        -. (v.xcenter *. e.zistepu.(s))
        -. (v.ycenter *. e.zistepv.(s))
    end
  end

let render_face (e : t) (v : View.t) (m : Model.t) (fa : surface)
    (clipflags : int) (key : int option) : unit =
  render_poly e v fa clipflags
    (fun (f : vec -> vec -> unit) ->
      for i = 0 to fa.num_edges - 1 do
        let k = m.surfedges.(fa.first_edge + i) in
        if k >= 0 then f m.vertexes.(m.edge0.(k)) m.vertexes.(m.edge1.(k))
        else f m.vertexes.(m.edge1.(-k)) m.vertexes.(m.edge0.(-k))
      done)
    key true
games/fps/quake/render/Edges.mli
4975
(* Edges: a face made edges of the screen (Quake's r_draw.c,
 * R_RenderFace, R_ClipEdge, R_EmitEdge), and the tables of a frame's
 * edges, surfaces and spans (r_edge.c's, r_shared.h's edge_t, surf_t,
 * espan_t).
 *
 * Quake does not draw a face as a polygon. Each of its edges is
 * clipped by the planes of the view, projected, and filed under the
 * first scanline it crosses, sorted by where it crosses it (newedges);
 * and under its last (removeedges). An edge going down the screen is
 * a face's right side (it trails: the face ends there), one going up
 * its left (it leads: the face starts):
 *
 *            v0 (lead: from v1 up to v0)
 *           /  \
 *          /    \  (trail: from v0 down to v1)
 *         /      \        a face, its edges clockwise as seen
 *        v2 ------v1      (a horizontal edge crosses no scanline:
 *                          none is made)
 *
 * The face itself becomes a surface: its key (the order the BSP's walk
 * reached it, front to back: smaller is nearer) and its 1/z's plane on
 * the screen (zistepu, zistepv, ziorigin: 1/z is linear in u and v).
 * Scan turns the edges into spans, each a surface's run of pixels on a
 * scanline; Spans draws them.
 *
 * An edge clipped by the left plane loses the face's left side on the
 * screen: a vertical edge along the left border is made for it, from
 * where the face left the view to where it came back. The right side
 * needs none (a face still open at the right border ends there).
 *
 * The edges are not shared between the two faces that have one, as
 * id's cache did (cachededgeoffset): each face makes its own; the same
 * spans, twice the edges.
 *
 * The tables are arrays of ints and floats indexed by an edge's, a
 * surface's or a span's number, linked by numbers, as id's arrays of
 * structs: a frame makes thousands and keeps none, and no allocation
 * is made while drawing. Edges 0 to 3 are the scan's own: the head
 * (the left border, starting the background), the tail (the right
 * border), the one after the tail and a sentinel; surface 1 is the
 * background, behind everything (key max_int).
 *
 * Fixed point: u is 16.16 here, where id's was 12.20 (a 31-bit int
 * holds 320 x 2^16, not x 2^20); a u_step is that of an edge that
 * crosses at least two scanlines, at most the screen's width. *)

type t = {
  (* the edges *)
  u : int array;
  u_step : int array;
  (* the surface it ends (trailing), the one it starts (leading); 0
   * none *)
  surf_trail : int array;
  surf_lead : int array;
  next : int array;
  prev : int array;
  next_remove : int array;
  mutable num_edges : int;
  (* each scanline's new edges and those it is the last of: -1 none *)
  newedges : int array;
  removeedges : int array;
  (* the surfaces *)
  key : int array;
  last_u : int array;
  spanstate : int array;
  snext : int array;
  sprev : int array;
  insubmodel : bool array;
  (* the face (Model's surface number), the entity (0 the world) *)
  face : int array;
  entity : int array;
  nearzi : float array;
  zistepu : float array;
  zistepv : float array;
  ziorigin : float array;
  (* the first of its spans; -1 none *)
  spans : int array;
  mutable num_surfaces : int;
  (* the spans *)
  span_u : int array;
  span_v : int array;
  span_count : int array;
  span_next : int array;
  mutable num_spans : int;
  (* what the next faces are: in a brush model, which entity *)
  mutable in_submodel : bool;
  mutable current_entity : int;
  (* a face's edges' state (r_draw.c's globals) *)
  mutable lastvertvalid : bool;
  mutable u1 : float;
  mutable v1 : float;
  mutable lzi1 : float;
  mutable ceilv1 : int;
  mutable nearzi_face : float;
  mutable nearzi_only : bool;
  mutable emitted : bool;
  mutable left_clipped : bool;
  mutable right_clipped : bool;
  mutable left_enter : Model.vec;
  mutable left_exit : Model.vec;
  mutable right_enter : Model.vec;
  mutable right_exit : Model.vec;
}

val head : int
val tail : int
val after_tail : int
val sentinel : int
val background : int

(* the fraction's bits of u *)
val shift : int

(* [create height]: the tables, empty *)
val create : int -> t

(* [clear e]: a frame's start: no edge, no surface but the background,
 * no span *)
val clear : t -> unit

(* [render_face e v m face clipflags key]: the face's edges filed, its
 * surface made (R_RenderFace); clipflags the planes (bits 0 to 3:
 * left, right, top, bottom) its node's box crosses; key the
 * surface's, or None for the next (v.currentkey) *)
val render_face :
  t -> View.t -> Model.t -> Model.surface -> int -> int option -> unit

(* [render_poly e v face clipflags iter key chained]: the same for a
 * piece of a face, its edges given by iter (a brush model's face cut
 * by the world's planes: R_RenderBmodelFace); chained if each edge
 * starts where the one before ended *)
val render_poly :
  t ->
  View.t ->
  Model.surface ->
  int ->
  ((Model.vec -> Model.vec -> unit) -> unit) ->
  int option ->
  bool ->
  unit

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Particles.mli *)

open Model

type kind = Slowgrav | Fire | Explode | Explode2

type particle = {
  mutable org : vec;
  mutable vel : vec;
  mutable color : int;
  mutable ramp : float;
  die : float;
  kind : kind;
}

(* (the particles' own random numbers: Lehmer's, as the game's) *)
type t = { mutable all : particle list; mutable seed : int }

let create () : t = { all = []; seed = 1 }

let rand (p : t) : int =
  p.seed <- p.seed * 16807 mod 2147483647;
  p.seed land 0x7fff

(* -n to n - 1 *)
let around (p : t) (n : int) : float = float ((rand p mod (2 * n)) - n)

(* r_part.c's ramps of the palette *)
let ramp1 = [| 0x6f; 0x6d; 0x6b; 0x69; 0x67; 0x65; 0x63; 0x61 |]
let ramp2 = [| 0x6f; 0x6e; 0x6d; 0x6c; 0x6b; 0x6a; 0x68; 0x66 |]
let ramp3 = [| 0x6d; 0x6b; 6; 5; 4; 3 |]
let add (p : t) (x : particle) : unit = p.all <- x :: p.all

(* R_RunParticleEffect *)
let run_effect (p : t) (time : float) (org : vec) (color : int) (count : int)
    : unit =
  for _i = 1 to count do
    add p
      {
        org =
          {
            x = org.x +. around p 8;
            y = org.y +. around p 8;
            z = org.z +. around p 8;
          };
        vel = zero;
        color = (color land lnot 7) + (rand p land 7);
        ramp = 0.;
        die = time +. (0.1 *. float (rand p mod 5));
        kind = Slowgrav;
      }
  done

let blood (p : t) (time : float) (org : vec) (count : int) : unit =
  run_effect p time org 73 (2 * count)

let gunshot (p : t) (time : float) (org : vec) : unit =
  run_effect p time org 0 20

let explosion (p : t) (time : float) (org : vec) : unit =
  for i = 1 to 1024 do
    let r = float (rand p land 3) in
    add p
      {
        org =
          {
            x = org.x +. around p 16;
            y = org.y +. around p 16;
            z = org.z +. around p 16;
          };
        vel = { x = around p 256; y = around p 256; z = around p 256 };
        color = ramp1.(0);
        ramp = r;
        die = time +. 5.;
        kind = (if i land 1 = 0 then Explode else Explode2);
      }
  done

let trail (p : t) (time : float) (from : vec) (to_ : vec) (kind : int) : unit =
  let d = sub to_ from in
  let len = length d in
  if len > 0. then begin
    let step = scale (3. /. len) d in
    let o = ref from and left = ref len in
    while !left > 0. do
      let r =
        if kind = 2 then float ((rand p land 3) + 2) else float (rand p land 3)
      in
      add p
        {
          org =
            {
              x = !o.x +. around p 3;
              y = !o.y +. around p 3;
              z = !o.z +. around p 3;
            };
          vel = zero;
          color = ramp3.(int_of_float r);
          ramp = r;
          die = time +. 2.;
          kind = Fire;
        };
      o := Model.add !o step;
      left := !left -. 3.
    done
  end

(* R_DrawParticles' moves *)
let run (p : t) (time : float) (dt : float) : unit =
  let grav = dt *. 800. *. 0.05 in
  p.all <-
    List.filter
      (fun (x : particle) ->
        x.org <- Model.add x.org (scale dt x.vel);
        let alive =
          match x.kind with
          | Slowgrav ->
              x.vel <- { x.vel with z = x.vel.z -. grav };
              true
          | Fire ->
              x.ramp <- x.ramp +. (dt *. 5.);
              if x.ramp >= 6. then false
              else begin
                x.color <- ramp3.(int_of_float x.ramp);
                x.vel <- { x.vel with z = x.vel.z +. grav };
                true
              end
          | Explode ->
              x.ramp <- x.ramp +. (dt *. 10.);
              if x.ramp >= 8. then false
              else begin
                x.color <- ramp1.(int_of_float x.ramp);
                x.vel <- Model.add x.vel (scale (4. *. dt) x.vel);
                x.vel <- { x.vel with z = x.vel.z -. grav };
                true
              end
          | Explode2 ->
              x.ramp <- x.ramp +. (dt *. 15.);
              if x.ramp >= 8. then false
              else begin
                x.color <- ramp2.(int_of_float x.ramp);
                x.vel <- sub x.vel (scale dt x.vel);
                x.vel <- { x.vel with z = x.vel.z -. grav };
                true
              end
        in
        alive && time < x.die)
      p.all

(* D_DrawParticle: a square, 256 / z pixels wide (1 to 4 at 320
 * across), if nearer than what is there *)
let draw (v : View.t) (p : t) : unit =
  let k = float v.width /. 320. in
  List.iter
    (fun (x : particle) ->
      let t = View.transform v (sub x.org v.origin) in
      if t.z >= 8. then begin
        let u = int_of_float (v.xcenter +. (v.xscale *. t.x /. t.z)) in
        let w = int_of_float (v.ycenter -. (v.yscale *. t.y /. t.z)) in
        let zi = int_of_float (16777216. /. t.z) in
        let pix =
          max 1 (min (int_of_float (4. *. k)) (int_of_float (256. *. k /. t.z)))
        in
        for yy = w to w + pix - 1 do
          for xx = u to u + pix - 1 do
            if xx >= 0 && xx < v.width && yy >= 0 && yy < v.height then begin
              let i = (yy * v.width) + xx in
              if zi >= v.zbuffer.(i) then begin
                v.zbuffer.(i) <- zi;
                Bytes.set v.screen i (Char.chr x.color)
              end
            end
          done
        done
      end)
    p.all

(* Particles: Quake's points of colour (r_part.c, d_part.c): the blood
 * of a hit, the puff of a bullet on a wall, an explosion, the trails
 * of rockets and grenades.
 *
 * A particle is a place, a velocity, a colour of the palette and a
 * time to die; each frame it moves, and its kind changes it:
 *
 *   slowgrav   blood, a puff: falls slowly (gravity x 0.05)
 *   fire       a trail's: rises, its colour along ramp3 (yellow to
 *              dark red), gone at the ramp's end
 *   explode    half an explosion's: speeds up, ramp1 (yellow, orange,
 *              red, dark), in 0.8 s
 *   explode2   the other half: slows down, ramp2, faster
 *
 * An explosion is 1,024 of them, 16 around its centre, flying at up to
 * 256 units a second; a trail a particle every 3 units of the
 * missile's way. Each is drawn as a square of 1 to 4 pixels, bigger
 * nearer (D_DrawParticle), against the z-buffer the world and the
 * models wrote, which it writes too.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: Game gives it the effects of the
 * frame; Quake.ml draws them after the models. *)

type t

val create : unit -> t

(* [blood p org count]: R_RunParticleEffect's blood (colour 73) *)
val blood : t -> float -> Model.vec -> int -> unit

(* [gunshot p org]: a bullet's puff on a wall (colour 0, 20) *)
val gunshot : t -> float -> Model.vec -> unit

(* [explosion p time org]: R_ParticleExplosion *)
val explosion : t -> float -> Model.vec -> unit

(* [trail p time from to_ kind]: R_RocketTrail (1 a rocket's fire, 2 a
 * grenade's smoke) *)
val trail : t -> float -> Model.vec -> Model.vec -> int -> unit

(* [run p time dt]: dt seconds of their lives *)
val run : t -> float -> float -> unit

(* [draw v p]: into v.screen, against v.zbuffer *)
val draw : View.t -> t -> unit

(* Claude Code

(* See Render.mli *)

type t = {
  view : View.t;
  edges : Edges.t;
  spans : Spans.t;
  cache : Surfcache.t;
}

let width = 320
let height = 200

let create (m : Model.t) (colormap : string) : t =
  {
    view = View.create colormap width height;
    edges = Edges.create height;
    spans = Spans.create m;
    cache = Surfcache.create ();
  }

let frame (r : t) (m : Model.t) (eye : Model.vec) (pitch : float) (yaw : float)
    (time : float) (styles : string array)
    (bmodels : (int * int * Model.vec * int) list) (things : Things.thing list)
    : unit =
  let v = r.view in
  v.time <- time;
  View.animate_lights v styles;
  View.setup v eye pitch yaw;
  Bsp.mark_leaves v m (Model.leaf_at m eye);
  Edges.clear r.edges;
  v.currentkey <- 0;
  Bsp.render_world r.edges v m;
  Bsp.render_bmodels r.edges v m
    (List.map
       (fun ((ent, k, o, _) : int * int * Model.vec * int) -> (ent, k, o))
       bmodels);
  (* the entities' origins and frames, by their numbers *)
  let n =
    List.fold_left
      (fun (n : int) ((ent, _, _, _) : int * int * Model.vec * int) ->
        max n (ent + 1))
      1 bmodels
  in
  let origins = Array.make n Model.zero and frames = Array.make n 0 in
  List.iter
    (fun ((ent, _, o, f) : int * int * Model.vec * int) ->
      origins.(ent) <- o;
      frames.(ent) <- f)
    bmodels;
  Scan.scan_edges r.edges v (fun () ->
      Spans.draw r.spans r.edges v m r.cache origins frames);
  (* the models, over the world, by its z-buffer *)
  Things.draw v m things time

(* Render: a frame of Quake's software renderer (r_main.c,
 * R_RenderView, R_EdgeDrawing): what the eye sees, 320 by 200 bytes of
 * the palette.
 *
 *   the eye's leaf --> Bsp.mark_leaves: the PVS marked

 *        |

 *               the texture lit by its lightmaps, kept), or the
 *               water, or the sky
 *
 * Each pixel of the world is drawn once. The models (monsters, items)
 * are drawn after, over it, by a z-buffer the spans filled (Alias,
 * Things).
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: the game (Quake.ml) makes one, and
 * asks a frame of it at each frame of the playground. *)

  view : View.t;
  edges : Edges.t;
  spans : Spans.t;
  cache : Surfcache.t;
}

(* [create m colormap] *)
val create : Model.t -> string -> t

 * brush models drawn, each (its entity's number, its model, its
 * origin, its frame); things the models *)
val frame :

  Model.t ->
  Model.vec ->
