(* See Scan.mli *)

open Edges

(* the new edges of a scanline merged into the active ones, both
 * sorted by u (R_InsertNewEdges) *)
let insert_new_edges (e : Edges.t) (first : int) : unit =
  let at = ref e.next.(head) and k = ref first in
  while !k >= 0 do
    let after = e.next.(!k) in
    while e.u.(!at) < e.u.(!k) do
      at := e.next.(!at)
    done;
    (* before !at *)
    e.next.(!k) <- !at;
    e.prev.(!k) <- e.prev.(!at);
    e.next.(e.prev.(!at)) <- !k;
    e.prev.(!at) <- !k;
    k := after
  done

let remove_edges (e : Edges.t) (first : int) : unit =
  let k = ref first in
  while !k >= 0 do
    e.prev.(e.next.(!k)) <- e.prev.(!k);
    e.next.(e.prev.(!k)) <- e.next.(!k);
    k := e.next_remove.(!k)
  done

(* each edge a scanline down, and those out of order put back
 * (R_StepActiveU): the edge after the tail is at u = -1, which ends it *)
let step_active_u (e : Edges.t) : unit =
  let k = ref e.next.(head) and continue = ref true in
  while !continue do
    let c = !k in
    e.u.(c) <- e.u.(c) + e.u_step.(c);
    if e.u.(c) < e.u.(e.prev.(c)) then begin
      if c = after_tail then continue := false
      else begin
        let after = e.next.(c) in
        (* out, then back before the first edge whose u is not above *)
        e.prev.(e.next.(c)) <- e.prev.(c);
        e.next.(e.prev.(c)) <- e.next.(c);
        let w = ref e.prev.(e.prev.(c)) in
        while e.u.(!w) > e.u.(c) do
          w := e.prev.(!w)
        done;
        e.next.(c) <- e.next.(!w);
        e.prev.(c) <- !w;
        e.prev.(e.next.(c)) <- c;
        e.next.(!w) <- c;
        k := after;
        if after = tail then continue := false
      end
    end
    else k := e.next.(c)
  done

(* a span of surface s, from its last_u to iu, on scanline v *)
let span (e : Edges.t) (s : int) (iu : int) (v : int) : unit =
  if iu > e.last_u.(s) && e.num_spans < Array.length e.span_u then begin
    let k = e.num_spans in
    e.num_spans <- k + 1;
    e.span_u.(k) <- e.last_u.(s);
    e.span_count.(k) <- iu - e.last_u.(s);
    e.span_v.(k) <- v;
    e.span_next.(k) <- e.spans.(s);
    e.spans.(s) <- k
  end

let trailing_edge (e : Edges.t) (s : int) (edge : int) (v : int) : unit =
  e.spanstate.(s) <- e.spanstate.(s) - 1;
  if e.spanstate.(s) = 0 then begin
    if s = e.snext.(background) then begin
      (* the top going away: its span, and the one below starts here *)
      let iu = e.u.(edge) asr shift in
      span e s iu v;
      e.last_u.(e.snext.(s)) <- iu
    end;
    e.snext.(e.sprev.(s)) <- e.snext.(s);
    e.sprev.(e.snext.(s)) <- e.sprev.(s)
  end

(* is s nearer than s2, both brush models' of a leaf: their 1/z where
 * the edge is, s's lowered by 1%, then by the slope *)
let nearer (e : Edges.t) (s : int) (s2 : int) (edge : int) (fv : float) : bool =
  let fu = float (e.u.(edge) - ((1 lsl shift) - 1)) /. float (1 lsl shift) in
  let newzi =
    e.ziorigin.(s) +. (fv *. e.zistepv.(s)) +. (fu *. e.zistepu.(s))
  in
  let testzi =
    e.ziorigin.(s2) +. (fv *. e.zistepv.(s2)) +. (fu *. e.zistepu.(s2))
  in
  newzi *. 0.99 >= testzi
  || (newzi *. 1.01 >= testzi && e.zistepu.(s) >= e.zistepu.(s2))

let leading_edge (e : Edges.t) (edge : int) (v : int) : unit =
  let s = e.surf_lead.(edge) in
  if s <> 0 then begin
    e.spanstate.(s) <- e.spanstate.(s) + 1;
    (* (a span whose end edge came first, inverted, is not started) *)
    if e.spanstate.(s) = 1 then begin
      let fv = float v in
      let top = e.snext.(background) in
      let new_top =
        e.key.(s) < e.key.(top)
        || e.insubmodel.(s)
           && e.key.(s) = e.key.(top)
           && nearer e s top edge fv
      in
      let s2 =
        if new_top then begin
          (* it hides the top: the top's span ends here *)
          let iu = e.u.(edge) asr shift in
          span e top iu v;
          e.last_u.(s) <- iu;
          top
        end
        else begin
          (* its place in the stack: before the first surface farther *)
          let s2 = ref top and found = ref false in
          while not !found do
            s2 := e.snext.(!s2);
            while e.key.(s) > e.key.(!s2) do
              s2 := e.snext.(!s2)
            done;
            (* (of the same key: the one already there is in front, but
             * for brush models, by 1/z) *)
            if
              e.key.(s) <> e.key.(!s2)
              || (e.insubmodel.(s) && nearer e s !s2 edge fv)
            then found := true
          done;
          !s2
        end
      in
      (* before s2 *)
      e.snext.(s) <- s2;
      e.sprev.(s) <- e.sprev.(s2);
      e.snext.(e.sprev.(s2)) <- s;
      e.sprev.(s2) <- s
    end
  end

(* the spans of a scanline (R_GenerateSpans, R_CleanupSpan) *)
let generate_spans (e : Edges.t) (v : int) : unit =
  e.snext.(background) <- background;
  e.sprev.(background) <- background;
  e.last_u.(background) <- e.u.(head) asr shift;
  let k = ref e.next.(head) in
  while !k <> tail do
    let edge = !k in
    let s = e.surf_trail.(edge) in
    if s <> 0 then trailing_edge e s edge v;
    if s = 0 || e.surf_lead.(edge) <> 0 then leading_edge e edge v;
    k := e.next.(edge)
  done;
  (* the right border: what is on top ends there *)
  let top = e.snext.(background) in
  span e top (e.u.(tail) asr shift) v;
  let s = ref top in
  let continue = ref true in
  while !continue do
    e.spanstate.(!s) <- 0;
    s := e.snext.(!s);
    if !s = background then continue := false
  done

let scan_edges (e : Edges.t) (v : View.t) (draw : unit -> unit) : unit =
  (* the borders: the head starts the background at the left, the tail
   * ends it at the right *)
  e.u.(head) <- 0;
  e.u_step.(head) <- 0;
  e.prev.(head) <- -1;
  e.next.(head) <- tail;
  e.surf_trail.(head) <- 0;
  e.surf_lead.(head) <- background;
  e.u.(tail) <- (v.width lsl shift) + ((1 lsl shift) - 1);
  e.u_step.(tail) <- 0;
  e.prev.(tail) <- head;
  e.next.(tail) <- after_tail;
  e.surf_trail.(tail) <- background;
  e.surf_lead.(tail) <- 0;
  e.u.(after_tail) <- -1;
  e.u_step.(after_tail) <- 0;
  e.next.(after_tail) <- sentinel;
  e.prev.(after_tail) <- tail;
  e.u.(sentinel) <- max_int;
  e.prev.(sentinel) <- after_tail;
  for iv = 0 to v.height - 1 do
    e.spanstate.(background) <- 1;
    if e.newedges.(iv) >= 0 then insert_new_edges e e.newedges.(iv);
    generate_spans e iv;
    (* (the table nearly full: drawn and emptied, as id's) *)
    if e.num_spans >= Array.length e.span_u - v.width then begin
      draw ();
      e.num_spans <- 0;
      for s = 1 to e.num_surfaces - 1 do
        e.spans.(s) <- -1
      done
    end;
    if iv < v.height - 1 then begin
      if e.removeedges.(iv) >= 0 then remove_edges e e.removeedges.(iv);
      if e.next.(head) <> tail then step_active_u e
    end
  done;
  draw ()
games/fps/quake/render/Scan.mli

(* Scan: the edges made spans, scanline by scanline, top to bottom
 * (Quake's r_edge.c, R_ScanEdges): Quake's answer to which face is in
 * front at each pixel, with no z-buffer and no pixel drawn twice.
 *
 * On a scanline, the active edges are sorted by u. Walking them left
 * to right, a leading edge pushes its surface on a stack sorted by key
 * (nearest on top), a trailing edge pops it; whenever the top changes,
 * the old top's run of pixels since it became the top is a span:
 *
 *   u:      0     40        120     200       319
 *   edges:  |head  A(lead)  B(lead)  B(trail)  A(trail)  tail|
 *   stack:  bg     A,bg     B,A,bg   A,bg      bg
 *                           (B nearer than A)
 *   spans:  bg 0-39, A 40-119, B 120-199, A 200-..., bg ...-319
 *
 * Then the edges step to the next scanline (u += u_step), those out of
 * order are moved back in place (an insertion sort of a list almost
 * sorted), the new ones merged in, the finished ones taken out.
 *
 * The keys come from the BSP's walk, front to back: a face reached
 * first is never behind one reached later, so the key alone orders
 * the world's faces. Two surfaces of the same key are brush models'
 * in one leaf (a door, a button): those are ordered by their 1/z at
 * the edge's pixel, the nearer on top.
 *
 * history:
 * The edge list, sorted spans and the surface stack are the
 * scanline algorithms of Wylie, Romney, Evans and Erdahl (1967) and
 * Watkins (1970), the hidden-surface methods before the z-buffer won;
 * Abrash tells why Carmack chose them for Quake (Graphics Programming
 * Black Book, chapters 66-67, "Quake's Hidden-Surface Removal"): a
 * level's worst views drew fewer pixels, each once.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: Render calls it once a frame, after
 * Bsp filed the edges; it calls Spans' drawing when the spans' table
 * is full, and at the end. *)

(* [scan_edges e v draw]: the spans of the frame, each surface's; draw
 * called to draw (and empty) the spans' table *)
val scan_edges : Edges.t -> View.t -> (unit -> unit) -> unit

(* Claude Code

(* See Spans.mli *)

open Model

type t = {
  (* the sky (R_InitSky): the back layer, and the front's colours and
   * where it has a hole, 128 by 128; the two made one at each frame
   * (R_MakeSky) *)
  back : Bytes.t;
  front : Bytes.t;
  hole : Bytes.t;
  sky : Bytes.t;
  mutable sky_time : float;
  (* the water's swirl: 128 values of a sine, 0 to 16 texels (16.16) *)
  sintable : int array;
}

let create (m : Model.t) : t =
  let back = Bytes.make (128 * 128) '\000'
  and front = Bytes.make (128 * 128) '\000'
  and hole = Bytes.make (128 * 128) '\001' in
  (match
     Array.to_list m.textures
     |> List.find_map (fun (t : texture option) ->
         match t with
         | Some t
           when String.length t.tname >= 3
                && String.sub t.tname 0 3 = "sky"
                && t.width = 256 ->
             Some t
         | _ -> None)
   with
  | Some t ->
      let src = t.mips.(0) in
      for i = 0 to 127 do
        for j = 0 to 127 do
          (* (the texture's right half the back, its left the front, its
           * colour 0 a hole) *)
          Bytes.set back ((i * 128) + j) src.[(i * 256) + j + 128];
          let c = src.[(i * 256) + j] in
          Bytes.set front ((i * 128) + j) c;
          Bytes.set hole ((i * 128) + j) (if c = '\000' then '\001' else '\000')
        done
      done
  | None -> ());
  {
    back;
    front;
    hole;
    sky = Bytes.create (128 * 128);
    sky_time = -1.;
    sintable =
      Array.init 128 (fun (i : int) ->
          int_of_float
            (8. *. 65536.
            *. (1. +. sin (float i *. 2. *. 4. *. atan 1. /. 128.))));
  }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The gradients (D_CalcGradients) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* a surface's s/z, t/z, 1/z planes on the screen, at a mip *)
type gradients = {
  mutable sdivzstepu : float;
  mutable tdivzstepu : float;
  mutable sdivzstepv : float;
  mutable tdivzstepv : float;
  mutable sdivzorigin : float;
  mutable tdivzorigin : float;
  mutable zistepu : float;
  mutable zistepv : float;
  mutable ziorigin : float;
  mutable sadjust : int;
  mutable tadjust : int;
  (* the last texel, 16.16 (- 1: never past the surface's edge) *)
  mutable bbextents : int;
  mutable bbextentt : int;
}

let g : gradients =
  {
    sdivzstepu = 0.;
    tdivzstepu = 0.;
    sdivzstepv = 0.;
    tdivzstepv = 0.;
    sdivzorigin = 0.;
    tdivzorigin = 0.;
    zistepu = 0.;
    zistepv = 0.;
    ziorigin = 0.;
    sadjust = 0;
    tadjust = 0;
    bbextents = 0;
    bbextentt = 0;
  }

let calc_gradients (v : View.t) (face : Model.surface) (mip : int) (turb : bool)
    : unit =
  let ti = face.texinfo in
  let mipscale = 1. /. float (1 lsl mip) in
  let saxis = View.transform v ti.s and taxis = View.transform v ti.t in
  let t = v.xscaleinv *. mipscale in
  g.sdivzstepu <- saxis.x *. t;
  g.tdivzstepu <- taxis.x *. t;
  let t = v.yscaleinv *. mipscale in
  g.sdivzstepv <- -.saxis.y *. t;
  g.tdivzstepv <- -.taxis.y *. t;
  g.sdivzorigin <-
    (saxis.z *. mipscale)
    -. (v.xcenter *. g.sdivzstepu)
    -. (v.ycenter *. g.sdivzstepv);
  g.tdivzorigin <-
    (taxis.z *. mipscale)
    -. (v.xcenter *. g.tdivzstepu)
    -. (v.ycenter *. g.tdivzstepv);
  (* the eye's own s and t, less where the surface starts: s = s/z x z
   * + sadjust *)
  let org = View.transform v v.modelorg in
  let smin, tmin = if turb then (0, 0) else face.texturemins in
  let ew, eh = face.extents in
  g.sadjust <-
    int_of_float (((dot org saxis +. ti.s_offset) *. mipscale *. 65536.) +. 0.5)
    - ((smin lsl 16) asr mip);
  g.tadjust <-
    int_of_float (((dot org taxis +. ti.t_offset) *. mipscale *. 65536.) +. 0.5)
    - ((tmin lsl 16) asr mip);
  if not turb then begin
    g.bbextents <- ((ew lsl 16) asr mip) - 1;
    g.bbextentt <- ((eh lsl 16) asr mip) - 1
  end

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The spans (D_DrawSpans8) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let clamp (lo : int) (hi : int) (x : int) : int =
  if x > hi then hi else if x < lo then lo else x

let draw_spans (e : Edges.t) (v : View.t) (first : int) (src : Bytes.t)
    (cachewidth : int) : unit =
  let screen = v.screen and width = v.width in
  let sdivz8 = g.sdivzstepu *. 8.
  and tdivz8 = g.tdivzstepu *. 8.
  and zi8 = g.zistepu *. 8. in
  let bbs = g.bbextents and bbt = g.bbextentt in
  let k = ref first in
  while !k >= 0 do
    let sp = !k in
    let pdest = ref ((e.span_v.(sp) * width) + e.span_u.(sp)) in
    let count = ref e.span_count.(sp) in
    let du = float e.span_u.(sp) and dv = float e.span_v.(sp) in
    let sdivz =
      ref (g.sdivzorigin +. (dv *. g.sdivzstepv) +. (du *. g.sdivzstepu))
    in
    let tdivz =
      ref (g.tdivzorigin +. (dv *. g.tdivzstepv) +. (du *. g.tdivzstepu))
    in
    let zi = ref (g.ziorigin +. (dv *. g.zistepv) +. (du *. g.zistepu)) in
    let z = 65536. /. !zi in
    let s = ref (clamp 0 bbs (int_of_float (!sdivz *. z) + g.sadjust)) in
    let t = ref (clamp 0 bbt (int_of_float (!tdivz *. z) + g.tadjust)) in
    while !count > 0 do
      let spancount = if !count >= 8 then 8 else !count in
      count := !count - spancount;
      (* s and t, and their steps, each a value of its own, not a tuple
       * of the four: a block every 8 pixels otherwise ([@@zero_alloc]
       * refused it). old:
       *   let snext, tnext, sstep, tstep =
       *     if !count > 0 then begin ... (snext, tnext, ...) end
       *     else begin ... end *)
      let more = !count > 0 in
      if more then begin
        (* the exact s and t 8 pixels on *)
        sdivz := !sdivz +. sdivz8;
        tdivz := !tdivz +. tdivz8;
        zi := !zi +. zi8
      end
      else begin
        (* the last pixel's, so as not to step off the surface *)
        let n1 = float (spancount - 1) in
        sdivz := !sdivz +. (g.sdivzstepu *. n1);
        tdivz := !tdivz +. (g.tdivzstepu *. n1);
        zi := !zi +. (g.zistepu *. n1)
      end;
      let z = 65536. /. !zi in
      (* (at least 8: a step back past 0 by rounding would run off the
       * texture) *)
      let snext = clamp 8 bbs (int_of_float (!sdivz *. z) + g.sadjust) in
      let tnext = clamp 8 bbt (int_of_float (!tdivz *. z) + g.tadjust) in
      let sstep =
        if more then (snext - !s) asr 3
        else if spancount > 1 then (snext - !s) / (spancount - 1)
        else 0
      and tstep =
        if more then (tnext - !t) asr 3
        else if spancount > 1 then (tnext - !t) / (spancount - 1)
        else 0
      in
      let ss = ref !s and tt = ref !t and o = !pdest in
      for i = 0 to spancount - 1 do
        Bytes.unsafe_set screen (o + i)
          (Bytes.unsafe_get src ((!ss asr 16) + ((!tt asr 16) * cachewidth)));
        ss := !ss + sstep;
        tt := !tt + tstep
      done;
      pdest := o + spancount;
      s := snext;
      t := tnext
    done;
    k := e.span_next.(sp)
  done
[@@zero_alloc]

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The liquids (Turbulent8) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let turbulent (sp_ : t) (e : Edges.t) (v : View.t) (first : int) (src : string)
    : unit =
  let screen = v.screen and width = v.width in
  (* (the sine's phase: 20 of its 128 steps a second) *)
  let phase = int_of_float (v.time *. 20.) land 127 in
  let turb = sp_.sintable in
  let sdivz16 = g.sdivzstepu *. 16.
  and tdivz16 = g.tdivzstepu *. 16.
  and zi16 = g.zistepu *. 16. in
  (* s and t at 1/z zi, each a value of its own: st's pair, its floats
   * boxed for the call, refused by [@@zero_alloc]. old:
   *   let st (sdivz : float) (tdivz : float) (zi : float) : int * int =
   *     let z = 65536. /. zi in
   *     ( int_of_float (sdivz *. z) + g.sadjust,
   *       int_of_float (tdivz *. z) + g.tadjust ) *)
  let k = ref first in
  while !k >= 0 do
    let sp = !k in
    let pdest = ref ((e.span_v.(sp) * width) + e.span_u.(sp)) in
    let count = ref e.span_count.(sp) in
    let du = float e.span_u.(sp) and dv = float e.span_v.(sp) in
    let sdivz =
      ref (g.sdivzorigin +. (dv *. g.sdivzstepv) +. (du *. g.sdivzstepu))
    in
    let tdivz =
      ref (g.tdivzorigin +. (dv *. g.tdivzstepv) +. (du *. g.tdivzstepu))
    in
    let zi = ref (g.ziorigin +. (dv *. g.zistepv) +. (du *. g.zistepu)) in
    let z = 65536. /. !zi in
    let s = ref (int_of_float (!sdivz *. z) + g.sadjust)
    and t = ref (int_of_float (!tdivz *. z) + g.tadjust) in
    while !count > 0 do
      let spancount = if !count >= 16 then 16 else !count in
      count := !count - spancount;
      let n = if !count > 0 then 16. else float (spancount - 1) in
      sdivz := !sdivz +. if !count > 0 then sdivz16 else g.sdivzstepu *. n;
      tdivz := !tdivz +. if !count > 0 then tdivz16 else g.tdivzstepu *. n;
      zi := !zi +. if !count > 0 then zi16 else g.zistepu *. n;
      let z = 65536. /. !zi in
      let snext = int_of_float (!sdivz *. z) + g.sadjust
      and tnext = int_of_float (!tdivz *. z) + g.tadjust in
      let sstep =
        if !count > 0 then (snext - !s) asr 4
        else if spancount > 1 then (snext - !s) / (spancount - 1)
        else 0
      and tstep =
        if !count > 0 then (tnext - !t) asr 4
        else if spancount > 1 then (tnext - !t) / (spancount - 1)
        else 0
      in
      (* (no extents: s and t taken modulo the 64 by 64 texture, the
       * swirl a cycle of 128 texels) *)
      let ss = ref (!s land ((128 lsl 16) - 1))
      and tt = ref (!t land ((128 lsl 16) - 1))
      and o = !pdest in
      for i = 0 to spancount - 1 do
        let sturb =
          ((!ss + turb.(((!tt asr 16) + phase) land 127)) asr 16) land 63
        in
        let tturb =
          ((!tt + turb.(((!ss asr 16) + phase) land 127)) asr 16) land 63
        in
        Bytes.unsafe_set screen (o + i)
          (String.unsafe_get src ((tturb lsl 6) + sturb));
        ss := !ss + sstep;
        tt := !tt + tstep
      done;
      pdest := o + spancount;
      s := snext;
      t := tnext
    done;
    k := e.span_next.(sp)
  done
[@@zero_alloc]

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The sky (d_sky.c, r_sky.c) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the two layers made one: the front moved by the time, the back seen
 * through its holes (R_MakeSky) *)
let make_sky (sp_ : t) (shift : int) : unit =
  for y = 0 to 127 do
    for x = 0 to 127 do
      let ofs = ((y + shift) land 127 * 128) + ((x + shift) land 127) in
      let c =
        if Bytes.get sp_.hole ofs = '\001' then
          Bytes.get sp_.back ((y * 128) + x)
        else Bytes.get sp_.front ofs
      in
      Bytes.set sp_.sky ((y * 128) + x) c
    done
  done

(* a pixel's direction, flattened, made s and t of the sky (16.16)
 * (D_Sky_uv_To_st) *)
let sky_st (v : View.t) (time : float) (u : int) (w : int) : int * int =
  let temp = float (max v.width v.height) in
  let wu = 8192. *. float (u - (v.width / 2)) /. temp
  and wv = 8192. *. float ((v.height / 2) - w) /. temp in
  let e = add (scale 4096. v.vpn) (add (scale wu v.vright) (scale wv v.vup)) in
  let e = normalize { e with z = e.z *. 3. } in
  ( int_of_float ((time +. (6. *. 63. *. e.x)) *. 65536.),
    int_of_float ((time +. (6. *. 63. *. e.y)) *. 65536.) )

let draw_sky (sp_ : t) (e : Edges.t) (v : View.t) (first : int) : unit =
  (* (the back at 8 texels a second, the front at 16) *)
  let time = v.time *. 8. in
  let shift = int_of_float time in
  if float shift <> sp_.sky_time then begin
    make_sky sp_ shift;
    sp_.sky_time <- float shift
  end;
  let screen = v.screen and sky = sp_.sky in
  let k = ref first in
  while !k >= 0 do
    let sp = !k in
    let u = ref e.span_u.(sp)
    and w = e.span_v.(sp)
    and count = ref e.span_count.(sp) in
    let pdest = ref ((w * v.width) + !u) in
    let s0, t0 = sky_st v time !u w in
    let s = ref s0 and t = ref t0 in
    while !count > 0 do
      (* (the direction exact every 32 pixels) *)
      let spancount = if !count >= 32 then 32 else !count in
      count := !count - spancount;
      let n = if !count > 0 then spancount else spancount - 1 in
      let snext, tnext = if n > 0 then sky_st v time (!u + n) w else (!s, !t) in
      u := !u + spancount;
      let sstep = if n > 0 then (snext - !s) / n else 0
      and tstep = if n > 0 then (tnext - !t) / n else 0 in
      let o = !pdest in
      for i = 0 to spancount - 1 do
        Bytes.unsafe_set screen (o + i)
          (Bytes.unsafe_get sky
             (((!t asr 16) land 127 * 128) + ((!s asr 16) land 127)));
        s := !s + sstep;
        t := !t + tstep
      done;
      pdest := o + spancount;
      s := snext;
      t := tnext
    done;
    k := e.span_next.(sp)
  done

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The z-buffer (D_DrawZSpans) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* each pixel's 1/z, for the models drawn after: the surface's plane of
 * 1/z, stepped along the span *)
let draw_zspans (e : Edges.t) (v : View.t) (first : int) : unit =
  let zbuf = v.zbuffer and width = v.width in
  let one = 16777216. in
  let step = int_of_float (g.zistepu *. one) in
  let k = ref first in
  while !k >= 0 do
    let sp = !k in
    let du = float e.span_u.(sp) and dv = float e.span_v.(sp) in
    let izi =
      ref
        (int_of_float
           ((g.ziorigin +. (dv *. g.zistepv) +. (du *. g.zistepu)) *. one))
    in
    let o = (e.span_v.(sp) * width) + e.span_u.(sp) in
    for i = 0 to e.span_count.(sp) - 1 do
      Array.unsafe_set zbuf (o + i) !izi;
      izi := !izi + step
    done;
    k := e.span_next.(sp)
  done
[@@zero_alloc]

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The surfaces (D_DrawSurfaces) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the mip level for a face's nearest 1/z (D_MipLevelForScale): its
 * texels' size on the screen, 1 or more mip 0, 0.4 mip 1, 0.2 mip 2 *)
let mip_level (v : View.t) (face : Model.surface) (nearzi : float) : int =
  let ti = face.texinfo in
  let len = (length ti.s +. length ti.t) /. 2. in
  let mipadjust =
    if len < 0.32 then 4.
    else if len < 0.49 then 3.
    else if len < 0.99 then 2.
    else 1. /. Float.floor (len +. 0.1)
  in
  let scale = nearzi *. Float.max v.xscale v.yscale *. mipadjust in
  if scale >= 1. then 0
  else if scale >= 0.4 then 1
  else if scale >= 0.2 then 2
  else 3

let draw (sp_ : t) (e : Edges.t) (v : View.t) (m : Model.t)
    (cache : Surfcache.t) (origins : vec array) (frames : int array) : unit =
  let world_org = v.modelorg in
  for s = 1 to e.num_surfaces - 1 do
    let first = e.spans.(s) in
    if first >= 0 then begin
      g.zistepu <- e.zistepu.(s);
      g.zistepv <- e.zistepv.(s);
      g.ziorigin <- e.ziorigin.(s);
      if s = Edges.background then begin
        (* (r_clearcolor: what shows where the level has a hole) *)
        let k = ref first in
        while !k >= 0 do
          Bytes.fill v.screen
            ((e.span_v.(!k) * v.width) + e.span_u.(!k))
            e.span_count.(!k) '\002';
          Array.fill v.zbuffer
            ((e.span_v.(!k) * v.width) + e.span_u.(!k))
            e.span_count.(!k) 0;
          k := e.span_next.(!k)
        done
      end
      else begin
        let face = m.surfaces.(e.face.(s)) in
        let ent = e.entity.(s) in
        if e.insubmodel.(s) then v.modelorg <- sub v.origin origins.(ent);
        (match face.kind with
        | Sky -> draw_sky sp_ e v first
        | Turbulent ->
            calc_gradients v face 0 true;
            turbulent sp_ e v first
              (Surfcache.animation face.texinfo.texture v.time frames.(ent))
                .mips.(0)
        | Normal ->
            let mip = mip_level v face e.nearzi.(s) in
            let surf = Surfcache.surface cache v m face mip frames.(ent) in
            calc_gradients v face mip false;
            draw_spans e v first surf.data surf.width);
        draw_zspans e v first;
        v.modelorg <- world_org
      end
    end
  done;
  (* (the spans drawn: the table emptied by Scan) *)
  ()
games/fps/quake/render/Spans.mli
1892
(* Spans: the surfaces' spans drawn (Quake's d_edge.c, D_DrawSurfaces;
 * d_scan.c, D_DrawSpans8 and Turbulent8; d_sky.c; r_sky.c).
 *
 * A span is a run of pixels of one surface on a scanline. Its texture
 * (the surface cache's, Surfcache) is mapped with perspective: s and t
 * are not linear on the screen, but s/z, t/z and 1/z are
 * (D_CalcGradients makes their planes from the face's texinfo and the
 * eye). A true s and t need a division, z = 1/(1/z); Quake divides
 * every 8 pixels and steps linearly between (the assembly's 16, the
 * divide of the next 16 running on the Pentium's FPU while its integer
 * unit drew these: Abrash's chapter 70):
 *
 *   pixels:  |0 . . . . . . 7|8 . . . . . 15|16 ...
 *   exact:    ^ s, t          ^ s, t          ^      (a division)
 *   between:    s += sstep, t += tstep: 16.16 integers
 *
 * The error between is small enough not to be seen; an affine map
 * across the whole span, as the PlayStation's, wobbles.
 *
 * Water, slime and lava (textures named *...) are not lit nor cached:
 * the texture itself, its s and t pushed by a sine of the other and of
 * the time (D_DrawTurbulent8Span): the liquids' swirl.
 *
 * The sky is no face's texture either: two layers of 128 by 128, the
 * clouds with holes scrolling over the back at another speed, seen in
 * the direction of each pixel (D_Sky_uv_To_st), squashed vertically:
 * a dome far away, the same wherever the eye stands.
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: Scan calls [draw] when its spans'
 * table is full and at the end of a frame. *)

type t

(* [create m]: for the level's sky texture *)
val create : Model.t -> t

(* [draw sp e v m cache origins frames]: every surface's spans drawn
 * into v.screen; origins.(k) and frames.(k) entity k's (0 the world) *)
val draw :
  t ->
  Edges.t ->
  View.t ->
  Model.t ->
  Surfcache.t ->
  Model.vec array ->
  int array ->
  unit

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Surfcache.mli *)

open Model

type surface = { data : Bytes.t; width : int }

type entry = {
  mutable etexture : texture;
  lightadj : int array;
  surf : surface;
}

type t = {
  entries : (int, entry) Hashtbl.t;
  (* the entries' keys in the order they were made: the oldest first
   * out *)
  order : int Queue.t;
  mutable bytes : int;
  mutable made : int;
  (* a face's light at each sample, then its colormap's row x 256
   * (blocklights) *)
  blocklights : int array;
}

let budget = 1_000_000
let grey = ref false

let create () : t =
  {
    entries = Hashtbl.create 1024;
    order = Queue.create ();
    bytes = 0;
    made = 0;
    blocklights = Array.make (18 * 18) 0;
  }

let made (c : t) : int = c.made

let animation (base : texture) (time : float) (frame : int) : texture =
  let base =
    match base.alternate with Some a when frame <> 0 -> a | _ -> base
  in
  if base.anim_total = 0 then base
  else begin
    let rel = int_of_float (time *. 10.) mod base.anim_total in
    let t = ref base and count = ref 0 in
    while !t.anim_min > rel || !t.anim_max <= rel do
      (match !t.anim_next with
      | Some n -> t := n
      | None -> failwith ("a broken animation: " ^ base.tname));
      incr count;
      if !count > 100 then failwith ("an endless animation: " ^ base.tname)
    done;
    !t
  end

(* the light at each sample, as a row of the colormap times 256
 * (R_BuildLightMap) *)
let build_lightmap (c : t) (m : Model.t) (face : Model.surface)
    (lightadj : int array) : unit =
  let ew, eh = face.extents in
  let size = ((ew lsr 4) + 1) * ((eh lsr 4) + 1) in
  let bl = c.blocklights in
  Array.fill bl 0 size 0;
  if face.samples >= 0 && m.lighting <> "" then begin
    let maps = ref 0 in
    while !maps < 4 && face.styles.(!maps) <> 255 do
      (* (8.8: 256 the light as baked) *)
      let scale = lightadj.(!maps) and base = face.samples + (!maps * size) in
      for i = 0 to size - 1 do
        bl.(i) <-
          bl.(i) + (Char.code (String.unsafe_get m.lighting (base + i)) * scale)
      done;
      incr maps
    done
  end;
  (* (bright is a low row: 255 x 256 less it, 6 bits of row, at least
   * row 0.25) *)
  for i = 0 to size - 1 do
    let t = ((255 * 256) - bl.(i)) asr 2 in
    bl.(i) <- (if t < 64 then 64 else t)
  done

(* the texture tiled over the face, lit block by block (R_DrawSurface,
 * R_DrawSurfaceBlock8_mip0 to 3) *)
let draw_surface (c : t) (v : View.t) (face : Model.surface) (tex : texture)
    (mip : int) (dst : Bytes.t) (width : int) (height : int) : unit =
  let src = tex.mips.(mip) in
  let colormap = v.colormap in
  let texw = tex.width lsr mip and texh = tex.height lsr mip in
  let blocksize = 16 lsr mip and blockshift = 4 - mip in
  let lightwidth = (fst face.extents lsr 4) + 1 in
  let hblocks = width lsr blockshift and vblocks = height lsr blockshift in
  let smin, tmin = face.texturemins in
  (* (where the face starts in the texture, the texture repeating) *)
  let soffset = (((smin asr mip) mod texw) + texw) mod texw in
  let toffset = (((tmin asr mip) mod texh) + texh) mod texh in
  let bl = c.blocklights in
  let grey = !grey in
  for u = 0 to hblocks - 1 do
    let s = (soffset + (u * blocksize)) mod texw in
    for b = 0 to vblocks - 1 do
      let lp = (b * lightwidth) + u in
      let lightleft = ref bl.(lp) and lightright = ref bl.(lp + 1) in
      let leftstep = (bl.(lp + lightwidth) - !lightleft) asr blockshift in
      let rightstep = (bl.(lp + lightwidth + 1) - !lightright) asr blockshift in
      for i = 0 to blocksize - 1 do
        let t = (toffset + (b * blocksize) + i) mod texh in
        let row = t * texw in
        let step = (!lightleft - !lightright) asr blockshift in
        let light = ref !lightright in
        let o = (((b * blocksize) + i) * width) + (u * blocksize) in
        (* (right to left, as id's) *)
        for x = blocksize - 1 downto 0 do
          let pix =
            if grey then 9 else Char.code (String.unsafe_get src (row + s + x))
          in
          Bytes.unsafe_set dst (o + x)
            (String.unsafe_get colormap ((!light land 0xFF00) + pix));
          light := !light + step
        done;
        lightleft := !lightleft + leftstep;
        lightright := !lightright + rightstep
      done
    done
  done

let surface (c : t) (v : View.t) (m : Model.t) (face : Model.surface)
    (mip : int) (frame : int) : surface =
  let tex = animation face.texinfo.texture v.time frame in
  let adj (k : int) : int =
    let s = face.styles.(k) in
    if s = 255 then 0 else v.lightstyles.(s)
  in
  let key = (face.index * 4) + mip in
  let fresh (e : entry) : bool =
    e.etexture == tex
    && e.lightadj.(0) = adj 0
    && e.lightadj.(1) = adj 1
    && e.lightadj.(2) = adj 2
    && e.lightadj.(3) = adj 3
  in
  match Hashtbl.find_opt c.entries key with
  | Some e when fresh e -> e.surf
  | found ->
      let ew, eh = face.extents in
      let width = ew lsr mip and height = eh lsr mip in
      let e =
        match found with
        | Some e -> e
        | None ->
            (* the oldest out, until it fits *)
            while
              c.bytes + (width * height) > budget
              && not (Queue.is_empty c.order)
            do
              let k = Queue.pop c.order in
              match Hashtbl.find_opt c.entries k with
              | Some old ->
                  Hashtbl.remove c.entries k;
                  c.bytes <- c.bytes - Bytes.length old.surf.data
              | None -> ()
            done;
            let e =
              {
                etexture = tex;
                lightadj = Array.make 4 0;
                surf = { data = Bytes.create (width * height); width };
              }
            in
            Hashtbl.replace c.entries key e;
            Queue.push key c.order;
            c.bytes <- c.bytes + (width * height);
            e
      in
      e.etexture <- tex;
      for k = 0 to 3 do
        e.lightadj.(k) <- adj k
      done;
      build_lightmap c m face e.lightadj;
      draw_surface c v face tex mip e.surf.data width height;
      c.made <- c.made + 1;
      e.surf
games/fps/quake/render/Surfcache.mli

(* Surfcache: a face's texture lit, made once and kept (Quake's
 * r_surf.c, d_surf.c, r_light.c's R_AnimateLight): the trick that
 * made a lightmap free at each pixel.
 *
 * A face's lightmap has a sample every 16 texels (light, tools/Light.ml
 * made them); texture times light, computed at each pixel while
 * drawing, was too slow for a Pentium. So before a face is drawn, its
 * surface is made: the texture tiled over the face's extents, each
 * texel through the colormap's row for its light, the light
 * interpolated across each 16 by 16 block between the four samples at
 * its corners (R_DrawSurfaceBlock8):
 *
 *        sample            sample          a texel's light is the
 *          a ------------- b               samples' bilinear mix;
 *          |  . . . . . .  |               light 0 to 63 is the
 *          |  . texel  . . |               colormap's row: the
 *          |  . . . . . .  |               texel's colour as lit is
 *          c ------------- d               colormap[row * 256 + texel]
 *
 * The surface is then a texture of its own, the face drawn with it as
 * any texture (Spans), and it is kept: the next frames draw the same
 * bytes. It is made again only when what made it changed: the texture
 * (an animation's frame), or the value of one of its light styles (a
 * flickering light: only the faces it reaches are remade).
 *
 * A surface is made at the mip level the face is seen at (1/z of its
 * nearest point): far faces are half, a quarter, an eighth of the
 * size, from the texture's smaller mips, and so are their lightmaps'
 * blocks (8, 4, 2 texels). The light is the samples' sum, each times
 * its style's value (256 the light as baked), then 255 x 256 less it,
 * shifted to a row of the colormap (R_BuildLightMap): bright is row 0.
 *
 * The cache: id's was a ring of blocks in a memory of fixed size, the
 * oldest surfaces made again when it wrapped around (D_SCAlloc). Here
 * each face's mip is an entry, and the oldest entries are dropped
 * when their bytes pass a budget (a megabyte): the same order of
 * eviction, without the ring's arithmetic.
 *
 * history:
 * Carmack's idea for Quake (1996), told by Abrash in the Black Book's
 * chapter 68 ("Quake's Lighting Model"), the one that answers why a
 * lightmap rather than Gouraud's shading: the shadows are sharp and
 * cost nothing at drawing. Hardware's multitexturing (GLQuake, 1997;
 * the Voodoo 2's two units) drew texture times lightmap at each pixel
 * at last, and the surface cache went. *)

type t
type surface = { data : Bytes.t; width : int }

(* [create ()] *)
val create : unit -> t

(* [surface c v m face mip frame]: the face lit at that mip (0 to 3),
 * made or kept; frame: the entity's (1: a brush model's other set of
 * animations, a button pressed) *)
val surface : t -> View.t -> Model.t -> Model.surface -> int -> int -> surface

(* [animation texture time frame]: the frame of an animated texture at
 * that time (R_TextureAnimation) *)
val animation : Model.texture -> float -> int -> Model.texture

(* [made c]: how many surfaces were made since the start (a frame's
 * count: the difference) *)
val made : t -> int

(* the lightmaps alone: every texture a mid grey (the flag lightmaps) *)
val grey : bool ref

(* See View.mli *)

open Model

type clip = { mutable cnormal : vec; mutable cdist : float }

type t = {
  width : int;
  height : int;
  screen : Bytes.t;
  zbuffer : int array;
  colormap : string;
  xcenter : float;
  ycenter : float;
  xscale : float;

  mutable origin : vec;

  mutable vup : vec;
  mutable modelorg : vec;
  clips : clip array;
  frustum_indexes : int array array;
  mutable framecount : int;
  mutable visframecount : int;
  mutable oldviewleaf : int;
  mutable currentkey : int;
  lightstyles : int array;
  mutable time : float;
}

let deg (a : float) : float = a *. 4. *. atan 1. /. 180.

let angle_vectors (pitch : float) (yaw : float) : vec * vec * vec =
  let sy = sin (deg yaw)
  and cy = cos (deg yaw)
  and sp = sin (deg pitch)
  and cp = cos (deg pitch) in
  (* (no roll) *)
  ( { x = cp *. cy; y = cp *. sy; z = -.sp },
    { x = sy; y = -.cy; z = 0. },
    { x = sp *. cy; y = sp *. sy; z = cp } )

let create (colormap : string) (width : int) (height : int) : t =
  (* (90 degrees across) *)
  let hfov = 2. *. tan (deg 45.) in
  let xscale = float width /. hfov in
  let yscale = xscale in
  let vfov = hfov /. (float width /. float height) in
  let edge (x : float) (y : float) : vec = normalize { x; y; z = 1. } in
  {
    width;
    height;
    screen = Bytes.make (width * height) '\000';
    zbuffer = Array.make (width * height) 0;
    colormap;
    xcenter = (float width /. 2.) -. 0.5;
    ycenter = (float height /. 2.) -. 0.5;
    xscale;
    yscale;
    xscaleinv = 1. /. xscale;
    yscaleinv = 1. /. yscale;
    screenedge =
      [|
        edge (-1. /. (0.5 *. hfov)) 0.;
        edge (1. /. (0.5 *. hfov)) 0.;
        edge 0. (-1. /. (0.5 *. vfov));
        edge 0. (1. /. (0.5 *. vfov));
      |];
    origin = zero;
    vpn = zero;
    vright = zero;
    vup = zero;
    modelorg = zero;
    clips = Array.init 4 (fun _ -> { cnormal = zero; cdist = 0. });
    frustum_indexes = Array.make_matrix 4 6 0;
    framecount = 0;
    visframecount = 0;
    oldviewleaf = -1;
    currentkey = 0;
    lightstyles = Array.make 256 264;
    time = 0.;
  }

let transform (v : t) (p : vec) : vec =
  { x = dot p v.vright; y = dot p v.vup; z = dot p v.vpn }

let transform_frustum (v : t) : unit =
  Array.iteri
    (fun (i : int) (n : vec) ->
      (* (into the world: the view's y up, z forward, and its x the
       * other way, as id's screenedge has it) *)
      let w =
        add (scale (-.n.x) v.vright) (add (scale n.y v.vup) (scale n.z v.vpn))
      in
      v.clips.(i).cnormal <- w;
      v.clips.(i).cdist <- dot v.modelorg w)
    v.screenedge

let minmax (mins : vec) (maxs : vec) (k : int) : float =
  match k with
  | 0 -> mins.x
  | 1 -> mins.y
  | 2 -> mins.z
  | 3 -> maxs.x
  | 4 -> maxs.y
  | _ -> maxs.z

let setup (v : t) (origin : vec) (pitch : float) (yaw : float) : unit =
  let f, r, u = angle_vectors pitch yaw in
  v.origin <- origin;
  v.modelorg <- origin;
  v.vpn <- f;
  v.vright <- r;
  v.vup <- u;
  v.framecount <- v.framecount + 1;
  transform_frustum v;
  (* for each plane, the box's corner farthest out of it first (if it
   * is out, so is the box) then the farthest in (if it is in, the box
   * needs no clip by that plane) *)
  Array.iteri
    (fun (i : int) (c : clip) ->
      let idx = v.frustum_indexes.(i) in
      List.iteri
        (fun (j : int) (n : float) ->
          if n < 0. then begin
            idx.(j) <- j;
            idx.(j + 3) <- j + 3
          end
          else begin
            idx.(j) <- j + 3;
            idx.(j + 3) <- j
          end)
        [ c.cnormal.x; c.cnormal.y; c.cnormal.z ])
    v.clips

let styles =
  [
    (0, "m");
    (1, "mmnmmommommnonmmonqnmmo");
    (2, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba");
    (3, "mmmmmaaaaammmmmaaaaaabcdefgabcdefg");
    (4, "mamamamamama");
    (5, "jklmnopqrstuvwxyzyxwvutsrqponmlkj");
    (6, "nmonqnmomnmomomno");
    (7, "mmmaaaabcdefgmmmmaaaammmaamm");
    (8, "mmmaaammmaaammmabcdefaaaammmmabcdefmmmaaaa");
    (9, "aaaaaaaazzzzzzzz");
    (10, "mmamammmmammamamaaamammma");
    (11, "abcdefghijklmnopqrrqponmlkjihgfedcba");
    (63, "a");
  ]

let animate_lights (v : t) (strings : string array) : unit =
  let i = int_of_float (v.time *. 10.) in
  Array.iteri
    (fun (j : int) (s : string) ->
      if s = "" then v.lightstyles.(j) <- 256
      else
        v.lightstyles.(j) <-
          (Char.code s.[i mod String.length s] - Char.code 'a') * 22)
    strings

4211
(* View: the renderer's state and what all its parts share (Quake's
 * r_main.c, r_misc.c, r_local.h, d_local.h): the picture and its
 * colormap, the eye and its axes, the projection, the four planes of
 * the view, the frame's counters, the light styles' values.
 *
 * The eye looks along vpn (forward), vright and vup its other axes;
 * a point is seen at
 *
 *     x = dot (p - origin) vright, y = ... vup, z = ... vpn
 *     u = xcenter + xscale x / z,  v = ycenter - yscale y / z
 *
 * xscale is the width over the field of view's 2 tan (fov / 2): 160
 * for 90 degrees at 320 wide. Quake drew 320 by 200 for a 4:3 screen,
 * its pixels taller than wide (yscale = xscale x 0.83); this picture
 * is shown with square pixels, so yscale = xscale.
 *
 *              left plane          right plane
 *                   \                 /     the four planes through the
 *                    \   in view     /      eye, their normals inward:
 *                     \             /       a box wholly inside one
 *                      \           /        needs no clip by it, wholly
 *                       \         /         outside is not drawn
 *                           eye
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: Render makes one (create) and sets
 * the eye each frame (setup); Bsp, Edges, Scan, Surfcache and Spans
 * all read it. *)

(* a plane of the view: its normal in the world, its distance *)
type clip = { mutable cnormal : Model.vec; mutable cdist : float }

type t = {
  width : int;
  height : int;
  (* the picture, a byte of the palette a pixel *)
  screen : Bytes.t;
  (* 1/z of each pixel, x 2^24: the world's spans write it, the models
   * read it (Alias) *)
  zbuffer : int array;
  (* 64 rows of 256: row 0 the brightest, 32 the colours as they are,
   * 63 the darkest; the last 32 colours (fullbright) the same in all *)
  colormap : string;
  (* the projection (R_ViewChanged) *)
  xcenter : float;
  ycenter : float;
  xscale : float;
  yscale : float;
  xscaleinv : float;
  yscaleinv : float;
  (* the view's planes in its own space: left, right, top, bottom *)
  screenedge : Model.vec array;
  (* the eye (R_SetupFrame) *)
  mutable origin : Model.vec;
  mutable vpn : Model.vec;
  mutable vright : Model.vec;
  mutable vup : Model.vec;
  (* the eye in the space of the model drawn: the world's, or a brush
   * model's (a door: its origin moved) *)
  mutable modelorg : Model.vec;
  (* the planes in the world (R_TransformFrustum), and for each, which
   * corner of a box is the farthest in and the farthest out
   * (R_SetUpFrustumIndexes: 0 the min, 1 the max of each axis) *)
  clips : clip array;
  frustum_indexes : int array array;
  mutable framecount : int;
  mutable visframecount : int;
  mutable oldviewleaf : int;
  (* the order of what the walk reaches, front to back: a surface's or
   * a leaf's key *)
  mutable currentkey : int;
  (* each light style's value, 256 the light as baked ('m': 264) *)
  lightstyles : int array;
  (* the time, in seconds: the textures' animations, the water, the sky *)
  mutable time : float;
}

(* [create colormap width height] *)
val create : string -> int -> int -> t

(* [setup v origin pitch yaw]: the eye there, looking that way
 * (degrees; pitch down positive, as Quake's), the planes moved *)
val setup : t -> Model.vec -> float -> float -> unit

(* [transform v p]: a direction in the eye's axes (TransformVector) *)
val transform : t -> Model.vec -> Model.vec

(* [transform_frustum v]: the planes again, for v.modelorg *)
val transform_frustum : t -> unit

(* [angle_vectors pitch yaw]: forward, right, up (AngleVectors) *)
val angle_vectors : float -> float -> Model.vec * Model.vec * Model.vec

(* [minmax mins maxs k]: coordinate k (0 to 5: the mins then the
 * maxs, x y z) of a box, as id's minmaxs *)
val minmax : Model.vec -> Model.vec -> int -> float

(* world.qc's light styles: the strings, a letter a tenth of a second,
 * 'a' dark, 'm' normal, 'z' twice as bright *)
val styles : (int * string) list

(* [animate_lights v strings]: the styles' values at v.time
 * (R_AnimateLight); strings the styles said so far (by the level's
 * switches too) *)
val animate_lights : t -> string array -> unit

(* Lehmer's generator, as Doom's lights' and the playground's, its 31
 * bits a float *)
let random (w : world) : float =
  w.seed <- w.seed * 16807 mod 2147483647;
  float w.seed /. 2147483647.

let crandom (w : world) : float = (2. *. random w) -. 1.
let no_think (_ : world) (_ : t) : unit = ()
let no_touch (_ : world) (_ : t) (_ : who) : unit = ()

let spawn (w : world) (classname : string) (origin : vec) (mins : vec)
    (maxs : vec) : t =
  let e =
    {
      id = w.next_id;
      classname;
      origin;
      velocity = zero;
      yaw = 0.;
      pitch = 0.;
      ideal_yaw = 0.;
      mins;
      maxs;
      solid = false;
      trigger = false;
      movetype = Mnone;
      onground = false;
      model = None;
      frame = 0;
      skin = 0;
      health = 0.;
      takedamage = false;
      nextthink = 0.;
      think = no_think;
      touch = no_touch;
      owner = Nobody;
      enemy = Nobody;
      removed = false;
      mclass = None;
      seq = "";
      step = 0;
      attack_finished = 0.;
      pain_finished = 0.;
      search_time = 0.;
      pausetime = 0.;
      lefty = false;
      trail = 0;
      ammo_shells = 0;
      seen_for = 0;
    }
  in
  w.next_id <- w.next_id + 1;
  w.ents <- w.ents @ [ e ];
  e

let remove (_ : world) (e : t) : unit =
  e.removed <- true;
  e.solid <- false;
  e.takedamage <- false

    unit =
  if sfx <> "" then w.sounds <- { sfx; at; attenuation } :: w.sounds

let burst (w : world) (x : burst) : unit = w.effects <- x :: w.effects
let time (w : world) : float = w.play.time

let where (w : world) (who : who) : vec * vec * vec =
  match who with
  | Ent e -> (e.origin, e.mins, e.maxs)
  | _ -> (w.play.body.origin, Brushes.player_mins, Brushes.player_maxs)

let eye (w : world) (who : who) : vec =
  match who with
  | Ent e -> { e.origin with z = e.origin.z +. 25. }
  | _ ->
      let o = w.play.body.origin in
      { o with z = o.z +. 22. }

let alive (w : world) (who : who) : bool =
  match who with
  | Nobody -> false
  | The_player -> w.client.phealth > 0.
  | Ent e -> (not e.removed) && e.takedamage && e.health > 0.

let same (a : who) (b : who) : bool =
  match (a, b) with
  | The_player, The_player -> true
  | Ent x, Ent y -> x == y
  | _ -> false

let vectoyaw (v : vec) : float =
  if v.x = 0. && v.y = 0. then 0.
  else
    let a = Float.atan2 v.y v.x *. 180. /. Float.pi in
    if a < 0. then a +. 360. else a
games/fps/quake/server/Edict.mli

(* Edict: a thing that acts in the level, and the world they act in
 * (Quake's edict_t and QuakeC's defs.qc: the fields every entity has,
 * and the globals).
 *
 * In Quake, the engine knew an entity by a few fields -- its origin,
 * its box, how it moves (movetype), what it collides as (solid), its
 * model and frame -- and QuakeC gave it the rest, and functions:
 * [think], called at [nextthink], and [touch], called when it runs
 * into something. A monster is a chain of thinks, one a frame of its
 * animation, a tenth of a second apart (QuakeC's
 * [void() army_run1 = [$run1, army_run2] {ai_run(11);}]: the frame,
 * the next think, and what it does); a grenade is a think in 2.5
 * seconds, its explosion, and a touch, its bounce.
 *
 *   the world: the level, the player (Play), the entities, the time
 *     |
 *     |-- an entity: origin, velocity, box, movetype, solid, model
 *     |     think at nextthink   (Monster_ai's frames, a grenade's fuse)
 *     |     touch on contact     (a rocket's explosion)
 *     |-- the player's fight: health, armor, ammo, weapons
 *     |-- what the client shows: sounds made, particles, the flash
 *
 * Here a monster's frames are data ([mclass], [seq], [act]: Monsters
 * writes them out as grunt.qc does), run by Monster_ai; the other
 * entities' think and touch are OCaml functions, as QuakeC's were.
 *
 * design:
 * In Quake this record was the border between two programs. The
 * engine's C knew the fields defs.qc declares first, the "system
 * fields" (origin, velocity, mins, maxs, movetype, solid, think,
 * nextthink, touch, health, frame ...): qcc wrote them out as a C
 * header, progdefs.h, compiled into the engine, so that both agreed on
 * where each was in an entity's memory. The fields declared after
 * (enemy, attack_finished, pain_finished, th_run ...) were QuakeC's
 * alone, the engine kept room for them without knowing what they were.
 * A think was not a function pointer but a function's number in
 * progs.dat, called by the interpreter. Here there is one program: one
 * OCaml record, every field known to every module, a think an OCaml
 * closure (Game.mli says why there is no VM).
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: Game makes the world, spawns the
 * entities, runs them each frame; Physics moves them, Combat hurts
 * them, Monster_ai and Monsters think for the monsters, Weapons and
 * Items for the player; Quake.ml plays the sounds and Render draws the
 * rest. *)

(* how it moves (sv_phys.c's movetypes) *)
type movetype =
  | Mnone (* still *)
  | Step (* a monster: walks by Physics.move_step, falls *)
  | Toss (* thrown: falls, stops at the floor (a backpack, a gib) *)
  | Bounce (* a grenade: falls, bounces *)
  | Fly_missile (* straight, no gravity (a rocket, a nail) *)

(* what a monster's frame does (ai.qc's and fight.qc's functions, and
 * the monster's own) *)
type act =
  | Nothing
  | Stand (* ai_stand: looks for the player *)
  | Walk of float (* ai_walk *)
  | Run of float (* ai_run: chases, attacks *)
  | Face (* ai_face *)
  | Charge of float (* ai_charge: faces and steps *)
  | Back of float (* ai_back *)
  | Pain_back of float (* ai_pain *)
  | Pain_forward of float (* ai_painforward *)
  | Fire (* the class's attack *)
  | Refire of string (* SUB_CheckRefire: again from that sequence *)
  | Melee (* the class's bite *)
  | Leap (* the dog's jump *)
  | Drop (* solid no more, the backpack dropped *)
  | Noise of string * float (* a sound, at that chance *)
  | Landed of string (* on the ground again (a leap's end): that sequence *)

(* an animation: its frames of the model, what each does, the sequence
 * after ("": its last frame kept, a death's) *)
type seq = { frames : int array; acts : act list array; next : string }

type who = Nobody | The_player | Ent of t

and t = {
  id : int;
  classname : string;
  mutable origin : Model.vec;
  mutable velocity : Model.vec;
  mutable yaw : float; (* degrees *)
  mutable pitch : float;
  mutable ideal_yaw : float;
  mins : Model.vec;
  maxs : Model.vec;
  mutable solid : bool; (* a box others collide with *)
  mutable trigger : bool; (* touched by the player on overlap (SOLID_TRIGGER) *)
  mutable movetype : movetype;
  mutable onground : bool;
  mutable model : Alias.t option;
  mutable frame : int;
  skin : int;
  mutable health : float;
  mutable takedamage : bool;
  mutable nextthink : float; (* 0: none *)
  mutable think : world -> t -> unit;
  mutable touch : world -> t -> who -> unit;
  mutable owner : who; (* a missile's shooter *)
  mutable enemy : who;
  mutable removed : bool;
  (* a monster's *)
  mutable mclass : mclass option;
  mutable seq : string;
  mutable step : int;
  mutable attack_finished : float;
  mutable pain_finished : float;
  mutable search_time : float;
  mutable pausetime : float;
  mutable lefty : bool;
  mutable trail : int;
      (* particles behind: 0 none, 1 a rocket's, 2 a grenade's *)
  mutable ammo_shells : int; (* what its backpack gives *)
  mutable seen_for : int; (* thinks it has seen its enemy (Ai.aim_error) *)
}

  mutable bonus_count : float; (* the screen gold *)
  mutable dead_time : float; (* when it died, 0 alive *)
  mutable punch : float; (* the view kicked up, degrees (punchangle) *)
  mutable kills : int;
  mutable show_hostile : float;
      (* it shot: the monsters near wake, even behind *)
}

and weapon =
  | Axe
  | Shotgun
  | Super_shotgun
  | Nailgun
  | Grenade_launcher
  | Rocket_launcher

(* a sound made: its name (sound/x.wav's x), from where (None: the
 * player's own), its attenuation (1 normal, 2 idle, 0 everywhere) *)
and sound = { sfx : string; at : Model.vec option; attenuation : float }

(* a burst of particles (r_part.c's effects) *)
and burst =
  | Blood of Model.vec * int (* where, how many *)
  | Gunshot of Model.vec
  | Explosion of Model.vec

and world = {

  mutable message : (string * float) option;
  ways : bool;

      (* centerprint's, since when *)
}

(* QuakeC's random (): 0 to 1, the same game for the same keys *)

val crandom : world -> float

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Physics.mli *)

open Model
open Edict

let gravity = 800.
let stepsize = 18.

type hit = {
  fraction : float;
  endpos : vec;
  normal : vec;
  startsolid : bool;
  allsolid : bool;
  what : who;
  sky : bool;
}

(* (is this one ignored by a move of pass's: itself, its owner, what it
 * owns) *)
let ignored (pass : who) (e : who) : bool =
  same pass e
  || (match pass with Ent p -> same p.owner e | _ -> false)
  || match e with Ent x -> same x.owner pass | _ -> false

let trace_with (w : world) (start : vec) (mins : vec) (maxs : vec)
    (finish : vec) (pass : who) (monsters : bool) : hit =
  let point = mins = zero && maxs = zero in
  let t =
    Trace.move w.level
      (if point then 0 else 1)
      start finish
      (Brushes.solids w.play.brushes)
  in
  (* (a missile into the sky: what it hit was the sky's face) *)
  let sky =
    t.fraction < 1.
    && Trace.point_contents w.level (add t.endpos (scale (-1.) t.normal))
       = (Sky : contents)
  in
  let best =
    ref
      {
        fraction = t.fraction;
        endpos = t.endpos;
        normal = t.normal;
        startsolid = t.startsolid;
        allsolid = t.allsolid;
        what = Nobody;
        sky;
      }
  in
  let clip (who : who) ((o, omins, omaxs) : vec * vec * vec) : unit =
    if not (ignored pass who) then
      match
        Trace.box start finish (sub (add o omins) maxs) (sub (add o omaxs) mins)
      with
      | Some b when b.fraction < !best.fraction && not b.startsolid ->
          best :=
            {
              fraction = b.fraction;
              endpos = b.endpos;
              normal = b.normal;
              startsolid = false;
              allsolid = false;
              what = who;
              sky = false;
            }
      | _ -> ()
  in
  if monsters then
    List.iter
      (fun (e : t) ->
        if e.solid && not e.removed then clip (Ent e) (e.origin, e.mins, e.maxs))
      w.ents;
  (* (nomonsters: no entity at all, the player neither: QuakeC's
   * visible looks through every one) *)
  if monsters && w.client.phealth > 0. then clip The_player (where w The_player);
  !best

let trace (w : world) (start : vec) (mins : vec) (maxs : vec) (finish : vec)
    (pass : who) : hit =
  trace_with w start mins maxs finish pass true

let traceline (w : world) (start : vec) (finish : vec) (monsters : bool)
    (pass : who) : hit =
  trace_with w start zero zero finish pass monsters

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The monsters' steps (sv_move.c) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* SV_movestep: 18 up, the move, down twice that: on a floor, the step
 * taken; in the air (a ledge), refused. (The box is tested where it
 * ends, not swept across: a step is shorter than the box) *)
let move_step (w : world) (e : t) (move : vec) : bool =
  let neworg = add e.origin move in
  let start = { neworg with z = neworg.z +. stepsize } in
  let finish = { neworg with z = neworg.z -. (stepsize *. 2.) } in
  let t = trace w start e.mins e.maxs finish (Ent e) in
  let t =
    if t.startsolid then
      trace w
        { start with z = start.z -. stepsize }
        e.mins e.maxs finish (Ent e)
    else t
  in
  if t.allsolid || t.startsolid || t.fraction = 1. then false
  else if t.normal.z < 0.7 then false
  else begin
    e.origin <- t.endpos;
    e.onground <- true;
    true
  end

let anglemod (a : float) : float =
  let a = Float.rem a 360. in
  if a < 0. then a +. 360. else a

let change_yaw (e : t) : unit =
  let current = anglemod e.yaw in
  let move = e.ideal_yaw -. current in
  let move =
    if move > 180. then move -. 360.
    else if move < -180. then move +. 360.
    else move
  in
  let speed = 20. in
  let move = Float.max (-.speed) (Float.min speed move) in
  e.yaw <- anglemod (current +. move)

let walk_move (w : world) (e : t) (yaw : float) (dist : float) : bool =
  let a = yaw *. Float.pi /. 180. in
  move_step w e { x = Float.cos a *. dist; y = Float.sin a *. dist; z = 0. }

(* SV_StepDirection: turn that way, and step if not turning too much *)
let step_direction (w : world) (e : t) (yaw : float) (dist : float) : bool =
  e.ideal_yaw <- yaw;
  change_yaw e;
  let old = e.origin in
  if walk_move w e yaw dist then begin
    let delta = anglemod (e.yaw -. e.ideal_yaw) in
    (* (not facing it yet: back where it was, but the turn kept) *)
    if delta > 45. && delta < 315. then e.origin <- old;
    true
  end
  else false

(* SV_NewChaseDir: as Doom's P_NewChaseDir, in degrees *)
let new_chase_dir (w : world) (e : t) (goal : vec) (dist : float) : unit =
  let olddir = anglemod (Float.round (e.ideal_yaw /. 45.) *. 45.) in
  let turnaround = anglemod (olddir -. 180.) in
  let dx = goal.x -. e.origin.x and dy = goal.y -. e.origin.y in
  let d1 = if dx > 10. then 0. else if dx < -10. then 180. else -1. in
  let d2 = if dy < -10. then 270. else if dy > 10. then 90. else -1. in
  let try_dir (d : float) : bool =
    d <> -1. && d <> turnaround && step_direction w e d dist
  in
  let diag =
    if d1 <> -1. && d2 <> -1. then
      if d1 = 0. then if d2 = 90. then 45. else 315.
      else if d2 = 90. then 135.
      else 215.
    else -1.
  in
  if not (try_dir diag) then begin
    let d1, d2 =
      if random w < 0.25 || Float.abs dy > Float.abs dx then (d2, d1)
      else (d1, d2)
    in
    if not (try_dir d1 || try_dir d2 || try_dir olddir) then begin
      let dirs = [ 0.; 45.; 90.; 135.; 180.; 225.; 270.; 315. ] in
      let dirs = if random w < 0.5 then dirs else List.rev dirs in
      if not (List.exists try_dir dirs) then
        if not (step_direction w e turnaround dist) then e.ideal_yaw <- olddir
    end
  end

(* SV_CloseEnough: within dist of the goal's box *)
let close_enough (w : world) (e : t) (goal : who) (dist : float) : bool =
  let o, mins, maxs = where w goal in
  let a = add o mins and b = add o maxs in
  let em = add e.origin e.mins and ex = add e.origin e.maxs in
  not
    (a.x > ex.x +. dist
    || b.x < em.x -. dist
    || a.y > ex.y +. dist
    || b.y < em.y -. dist
    || a.z > ex.z +. dist
    || b.z < em.z -. dist)

let move_to_goal (w : world) (e : t) (dist : float) : unit =
  let chasing = e.onground && alive w e.enemy in
  if chasing && not (close_enough w e e.enemy dist) then begin
    let goal, _, _ = where w e.enemy in
    (* (a fourth of the time, or blocked: another way) *)
    if random w < 0.25 || not (step_direction w e e.ideal_yaw dist) then
      new_chase_dir w e goal dist
  end

(*****************************************************************************)
(* SV_Physics *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* ClipVelocity: the part into the plane taken away, times backoff *)
let clip_velocity (v : vec) (n : vec) (backoff : float) : vec =
  let b = dot v n *. backoff in
  sub v (scale b n)

(* SV_PushEntity: moved as far as it goes, what it hit touched *)
let push_entity (w : world) (e : t) (move : vec) : hit =
  let t = trace w e.origin e.mins e.maxs (add e.origin move) (Ent e) in
  e.origin <- t.endpos;
  if t.fraction < 1. && not t.sky then e.touch w e t.what;
  if t.fraction < 1. && t.sky then remove w e;
  t

(* SV_Physics_Toss: Toss, Bounce, Fly_missile *)
let toss (w : world) (e : t) (dt : float) : unit =
  if not e.onground then begin
    if e.movetype <> Fly_missile then
      e.velocity <- { e.velocity with z = e.velocity.z -. (gravity *. dt) };
    let t = push_entity w e (scale dt e.velocity) in
    if t.fraction < 1. && not e.removed then begin
      let backoff = if e.movetype = Bounce then 1.5 else 1. in
      e.velocity <- clip_velocity e.velocity t.normal backoff;
      (* (on a floor: stopped once slow, as a toss at once) *)
      if t.normal.z > 0.7 then
        if e.velocity.z < 60. || e.movetype <> Bounce then begin
          e.onground <- true;
          e.velocity <- zero
        end
    end
  end

(* SV_Physics_Step: a monster falls when it is not on the ground (a
 * dog's leap, a floor gone) *)
let step (w : world) (e : t) (dt : float) : unit =
  if not e.onground then begin
    e.velocity <- { e.velocity with z = e.velocity.z -. (gravity *. dt) };
    let t = push_entity w e (scale dt e.velocity) in
    if t.fraction < 1. then begin
      e.velocity <- clip_velocity e.velocity t.normal 1.;
      if t.normal.z > 0.7 then begin
        e.onground <- true;
        e.velocity <- zero
      end
    end
  end

(* SV_RunThink: its think when its time comes, as often as it asks
 * within this frame *)
let run_think (w : world) (e : t) : unit =
  let guard = ref 0 in
  while
    (not e.removed) && e.nextthink > 0. && e.nextthink <= time w && !guard < 8
  do
    incr guard;
    e.nextthink <- 0.;
    e.think w e
  done

let run (w : world) (e : t) (dt : float) : unit =
  if not e.removed then begin
    (match e.movetype with
    | Toss | Bounce | Fly_missile -> toss w e dt
    | Step -> step w e dt
    | Mnone -> ());
    run_think w e
  end
games/fps/quake/server/Physics.mli

(* Physics: how the entities move (Quake's sv_phys.c and sv_move.c, and
 * world.c's SV_Move with the entities).
 *
 * A move is a trace: the entity's box from where it is to where it
 * would be, through the level (Trace, the hull its size picks: a point
 * for a missile, the player's for a monster) and through the other
 * solid entities' boxes; the nearest impact wins, and what was hit
 * is touched (SV_Impact: the rocket's touch explodes it).
 *
 *   Toss, Bounce   gravity (800 a second, squared), the trace; on a
 *                  plane the velocity loses its part into it, a bounce
 *                  half of it back again (backoff 1.5: a grenade jumps
 *                  off walls), and a floor stops it once slow
 *   Fly_missile    straight on, no gravity, until it touches something
 *   Step           a monster: a step is asked by its AI (move_step),
 *                  18 up, the move, then down to the floor; a step off
 *                  a ledge is refused (monsters do not fall off); in
 *                  the air (a dog's leap) it falls as a toss
 *
 * The walk towards a goal (SV_MoveToGoal) is Doom's: the way it faces
 * if it can, else a new direction, the diagonal towards the goal
 * first, then the axes, the old way, any, back (SV_NewChaseDir).
 *
 * Where it stands in mini-quake: Game runs [run] for each entity a
 * frame, Monster_ai walks the monsters by [move_to_goal] and [walk_move],
 * Weapons and Combat trace their shots and sights by [trace]. *)

type hit = {
  fraction : float;
  endpos : Model.vec;
  normal : Model.vec;
  startsolid : bool;
  allsolid : bool;
  what : Edict.who; (* Nobody: the level *)
  sky : bool; (* the level's sky was hit: a missile vanishes *)
}

(* [trace w start mins maxs finish pass]: a box (mins, maxs: zero a
 * point) moved from start to finish through the level, its doors, and
 * the solid entities and the player, but [pass] and what [pass] owns
 * (a missile and its shooter), and [pass]'s owner *)
val trace :
  Edict.world ->
  Model.vec ->
  Model.vec ->
  Model.vec ->
  Model.vec ->
  Edict.who ->
  hit

(* [traceline w start finish pass]: a point's trace (QuakeC's
 * traceline); [monsters] false: through the monsters (visible) *)
val traceline :
  Edict.world -> Model.vec -> Model.vec -> bool -> Edict.who -> hit

(* [walk_move w e yaw dist]: QuakeC's walkmove: a step that way *)
val walk_move : Edict.world -> Edict.t -> float -> float -> bool

(* [change_yaw e]: turned towards its ideal_yaw, its yaw_speed (20
 * degrees a think) at most *)
val change_yaw : Edict.t -> unit

(* [step_direction w e yaw dist]: SV_StepDirection: turned that way, a
 * step if it faces it *)
val step_direction : Edict.world -> Edict.t -> float -> float -> bool

(* [new_chase_dir w e goal dist]: SV_NewChaseDir *)
val new_chase_dir : Edict.world -> Edict.t -> Model.vec -> float -> unit

(* [move_to_goal w e dist]: SV_MoveToGoal, towards its enemy *)
val move_to_goal : Edict.world -> Edict.t -> float -> unit

(* [run w e dt]: SV_Physics for one entity: its move by its movetype,
 * then its think if its time came *)
val run : Edict.world -> Edict.t -> float -> unit
val gravity : float

(* Claude Code

(* See Play.mli *)

open Model

type command = {
  forward : bool;
  back : bool;
  left : bool;
  right : bool;
  strafe_left : bool;
  strafe_right : bool;
  jump : bool;
  run : bool;
  look_up : bool;
  look_down : bool;
  use_key : bool;
}

type t = {
  level : Model.t;
  brushes : Brushes.t;
  body : Brushes.body;
  mutable pitch : float;
  mutable waterlevel : int;
  mutable jump_released : bool;
  mutable use_released : bool;
  mutable time : float;
  styles : string array;
  mutable bob_speed : float;
  mutable boxes : unit -> (Model.vec * Model.vec) list;
}

(* sv_*'s and cl_*'s defaults *)
let maxspeed = 320.
let friction = 4.
let edgefriction = 2.
let stopspeed = 100.
let accelerate = 10.
let gravity = 800.
let stepsize = 18.
let view_height = 22.
let player_mins = Brushes.player_mins
let player_maxs = Brushes.player_maxs

let create (m : Model.t) : t =
  let styles = Array.make 64 "" in
  let brushes = Brushes.create m styles in
  let start =
    List.find_opt
      (fun (e : (string * string) list) ->
        value e "classname" = Some "info_player_start")
      m.entities
  in
  let origin, yaw =
    match start with
    | Some e ->
        ( add
            (vec_of_string
               (match value e "origin" with Some v -> v | None -> "0 0 0"))
            { x = 0.; y = 0.; z = 1. },
          match Option.bind (value e "angle") float_of_string_opt with
          | Some a -> a
          | None -> 0. )
    | None -> (zero, 0.)
  in
  {
    level = m;
    brushes;
    body = { origin; velocity = zero; yaw; onground = false; ground = -1 };
    pitch = 0.;
    waterlevel = 0;
    jump_released = true;
    use_released = true;
    time = 0.;
    styles;
    bob_speed = 0.;
    boxes = (fun () -> []);
  }

let place (p : t) (origin : vec) (yaw : float) (pitch : float) : unit =
  p.body.origin <- origin;
  p.body.yaw <- yaw;
  p.body.velocity <- zero;
  p.pitch <- pitch

let yaw (p : t) : float = p.body.yaw

(* V_CalcBob: up and down with the steps, as fast as the walk *)
let bob (p : t) : float =
  let cycle = Float.rem p.time 0.6 /. 0.6 in
  let pi = 4. *. atan 1. in
  let cycle =
    if cycle < 0.5 then pi *. cycle /. 0.5
    else pi +. (pi *. (cycle -. 0.5) /. 0.5)
  in
  let b = p.bob_speed *. 0.02 in
  let b = (b *. 0.3) +. (b *. 0.7 *. sin cycle) in
  Float.max (-7.) (Float.min 4. b)

let eye (p : t) : vec =
  add p.body.origin { x = 0.; y = 0.; z = view_height +. bob p }

let bmodels (p : t) : (int * int * vec * int) list = Brushes.drawn p.brushes

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The move (sv_phys.c) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the level and its doors, then the monsters' boxes grown by the
 * player's (SV_Move's entities) *)
let trace (p : t) (start : vec) (finish : vec) : Trace.trace =
  let t = Trace.move p.level 1 start finish (Brushes.solids p.brushes) in
  List.fold_left
    (fun (best : Trace.trace) ((mins, maxs) : vec * vec) ->
      match
        Trace.box start finish (sub mins player_maxs) (sub maxs player_mins)
      with
      (* (one the player is already in does not hold it: it walks out) *)
      | Some b when b.fraction < best.fraction && not b.startsolid -> b
      | _ -> best)
    t (p.boxes ())

(* the velocity along the plane (ClipVelocity), its tiny parts zero *)
let clip_velocity (v : vec) (n : vec) : vec =
  let backoff = dot v n in
  let c (a : float) : float = if a > -0.1 && a < 0.1 then 0. else a in
  let r = sub v (scale backoff n) in
  { x = c r.x; y = c r.y; z = c r.z }

(* SV_FlyMove: the box along its velocity for time, sliding along what
 * it hits, up to 4 planes; 1 a floor was hit, 2 a wall (a step?) *)
let fly_move (p : t) (time : float) : int =
  let b = p.body in
  let primal = b.velocity in
  let original = ref b.velocity in
  let planes = ref []
  and blocked = ref 0
  and time_left = ref time
  and bump = ref 0
  and stop = ref false in
  while (not !stop) && !bump < 4 do
    incr bump;
    if b.velocity = zero then stop := true
    else begin
      let t = trace p b.origin (add b.origin (scale !time_left b.velocity)) in
      if t.allsolid then begin
        b.velocity <- zero;
        blocked := 3;
        stop := true
      end
      else begin
        if t.fraction > 0. then begin
          b.origin <- t.endpos;
          original := b.velocity;
          planes := []
        end;
        if t.fraction = 1. then stop := true
        else begin
          if t.normal.z > 0.7 then begin
            blocked := !blocked lor 1;
            b.onground <- true;
            b.ground <- t.hit
          end;
          if t.normal.z = 0. then blocked := !blocked lor 2;
          time_left := !time_left -. (!time_left *. t.fraction);
          planes := !planes @ [ t.normal ];
          (* along a plane that keeps the others' sides, or the crease
           * of two *)
          let along =
            List.find_map
              (fun (n : vec) ->
                let v = clip_velocity !original n in
                if
                  List.for_all
                    (fun (o : vec) -> o == n || dot v o >= 0.)
                    !planes
                then Some v
                else None)
              !planes
          in
          (match along with
          | Some v -> b.velocity <- v
          | None -> (
              match !planes with
              | [ a; c ] ->
                  let dir = cross a c in
                  b.velocity <- scale (dot dir b.velocity) dir
              | _ ->
                  b.velocity <- zero;
                  blocked := 7;
                  stop := true));
          (* (against the first velocity: stop, no jitter in corners) *)
          if dot b.velocity primal <= 0. then begin
            b.velocity <- zero;
            stop := true
          end
        end
      end
    end
  done;
  !blocked

(* SV_PushEntity: moved by a vector, as far as it goes *)
let push_entity (p : t) (move : vec) : Trace.trace =
  let t = trace p p.body.origin (add p.body.origin move) in
  p.body.origin <- t.endpos;
  t

(* SV_WalkMove: the slide, or the same 18 units up and put down *)
let walk_move (p : t) (dt : float) : unit =
  let b = p.body in
  let oldonground = b.onground in
  b.onground <- false;
  let oldorg = b.origin and oldvel = b.velocity in
  let clip = fly_move p dt in
  if clip land 2 <> 0 && (oldonground || p.waterlevel > 0) then begin
    let nosteporg = b.origin and nostepvel = b.velocity in
    b.origin <- oldorg;
    ignore (push_entity p { x = 0.; y = 0.; z = stepsize });
    b.velocity <- { oldvel with z = 0. };
    ignore (fly_move p dt);
    let down =
      push_entity p { x = 0.; y = 0.; z = -.stepsize +. (oldvel.z *. dt) }
    in
    if down.fraction < 1. && down.normal.z > 0.7 then begin
      b.onground <- true;
      b.ground <- down.hit
    end
    else begin
      (* not on a floor: the move without the step *)
      b.origin <- nosteporg;
      b.velocity <- nostepvel
    end
  end

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The wish (sv_user.c) *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let user_friction (p : t) (dt : float) : unit =
  let v = p.body.velocity in
  let speed = sqrt ((v.x *. v.x) +. (v.y *. v.y)) in
  if speed > 0. then begin
    (* over a drop, more friction: the edge's *)
    let o = p.body.origin in
    let start =
      {
        x = o.x +. (v.x /. speed *. 16.);
        y = o.y +. (v.y /. speed *. 16.);
        z = o.z +. player_mins.z;
      }
    in
    let t =
      Trace.move p.level 0 start
        { start with z = start.z -. 34. }
        (Brushes.solids p.brushes)
    in
    let f = if t.fraction = 1. then friction *. edgefriction else friction in
    let control = if speed < stopspeed then stopspeed else speed in
    let newspeed = Float.max 0. (speed -. (dt *. control *. f)) in
    p.body.velocity <- scale (newspeed /. speed) v
  end

let accelerate_to (p : t) (dt : float) (wishdir : vec) (wishspeed : float)
    (cap : float) : unit =
  let current = dot p.body.velocity wishdir in
  let add_speed = Float.min cap wishspeed -. current in
  if add_speed > 0. then begin
    let a = Float.min add_speed (accelerate *. dt *. wishspeed) in
    p.body.velocity <- add p.body.velocity (scale a wishdir)
  end

let water_move (p : t) (dt : float) (fmove : float) (smove : float)
    (umove : float) : unit =
  let f, r, _ = View.angle_vectors p.pitch p.body.yaw in
  let wish = add (scale fmove f) (scale smove r) in
  let wish =
    if fmove = 0. && smove = 0. && umove = 0. then
      { wish with z = wish.z -. 60. }
    else { wish with z = wish.z +. umove }
  in
  let wishspeed = Float.min maxspeed (length wish) *. 0.7 in
  let v = p.body.velocity in
  let speed = length v in
  let newspeed =
    if speed > 0. then Float.max 0. (speed -. (dt *. speed *. friction)) else 0.
  in
  if speed > 0. then p.body.velocity <- scale (newspeed /. speed) v;
  if wishspeed > 0. && wishspeed -. newspeed > 0. then begin
    let a = Float.min (wishspeed -. newspeed) (accelerate *. wishspeed *. dt) in
    p.body.velocity <- add p.body.velocity (scale a (normalize wish))
  end

(* SV_CheckWater: how deep *)
let check_water (p : t) : unit =
  let o = p.body.origin in
  let wet (z : float) : bool =
    match Trace.point_contents p.level { o with z = o.z +. z } with
    | Water | Slime | Lava -> true
    | _ -> false
  in
  p.waterlevel <-
    (if not (wet (player_mins.z +. 1.)) then 0
     else if not (wet ((player_mins.z +. player_maxs.z) *. 0.5)) then 1
     else if not (wet view_height) then 2
     else 3)

let frame (p : t) (dt : float) (c : command) : unit =
  p.time <- p.time +. dt;
  let b = p.body in
  if not (Brushes.exited p.brushes) then begin
    (* the turns: 140 degrees a second, 210 running *)
    let turn = (if c.run then 1.5 else 1.) *. 140. *. dt in
    if c.left then b.yaw <- b.yaw +. turn;
    if c.right then b.yaw <- b.yaw -. turn;
    if c.look_up then p.pitch <- Float.max (-70.) (p.pitch -. (150. *. dt));
    if c.look_down then p.pitch <- Float.min 80. (p.pitch +. (150. *. dt));
    let k = if c.run then 2. else 1. in
    let fmove =
      k *. 200. *. ((if c.forward then 1. else 0.) -. if c.back then 1. else 0.)
    in
    let smove =
      k *. 350.
      *. ((if c.strafe_right then 1. else 0.)
         -. if c.strafe_left then 1. else 0.)
    in
    check_water p;
    (* the jump (player.qc's PlayerJump): once a press, from the
     * ground; in water, up *)
    let umove = if c.jump && p.waterlevel >= 2 then 200. else 0. in
    if c.jump && p.jump_released && b.onground && p.waterlevel < 2 then begin
      b.velocity <- { b.velocity with z = b.velocity.z +. 270. };
      b.onground <- false;
      p.jump_released <- false
    end;
    if not c.jump then p.jump_released <- true;
    if p.waterlevel >= 2 then water_move p dt fmove smove umove
    else begin
      (* the wish on the ground's plane: the yaw only *)
      let f, r, _ = View.angle_vectors 0. b.yaw in
      let wish = add (scale fmove f) (scale smove r) in
      let wishspeed = length wish in
      let wishdir =
        if wishspeed > 0. then scale (1. /. wishspeed) wish else zero
      in
      let wishspeed = Float.min maxspeed wishspeed in
      if b.onground then begin
        user_friction p dt;
        accelerate_to p dt wishdir wishspeed wishspeed
      end
      else accelerate_to p dt wishdir wishspeed 30.
    end;
    (* gravity, out of the water *)
    if p.waterlevel <= 1 then
      b.velocity <- { b.velocity with z = b.velocity.z -. (gravity *. dt) };
    walk_move p dt;
    p.bob_speed <-
      sqrt ((b.velocity.x *. b.velocity.x) +. (b.velocity.y *. b.velocity.y));
    Brushes.touch p.brushes b p.time;
    if c.use_key && p.use_released then begin
      let f, _, _ = View.angle_vectors p.pitch b.yaw in
      Brushes.use p.brushes b (eye p) f p.time
    end;
    p.use_released <- not c.use_key
  end;
  Brushes.run p.brushes b p.time dt
games/fps/quake/server/Play.mli
