(* mini-virtuaracing: Virtua Racing (Yu Suzuki, Sega AM2, 1992), the
 * arcade's first great polygon racer, as a program of ix's playground,
 * drawn by a renderer of its own: flat faces, a depth for each pixel,
 * a byte a pixel (docs/plans/plan_virtuaracing.md). The author's
 * playground's TinyVirtuaRacing is its inspiration: its courses, its
 * cars, its rules.
 *
 * Stage 3 of the plan, under way: the title (the grid, a camera going
 * round the player's car), the course select (the course's miniature
 * turning on a table), the race on Big Forest (the countdown, fifteen
 * rivals, the clock and its checkpoints, five laps, the race's display)
 * and its end (GOAL!, or GAME OVER when the clock runs out); the
 * sound (Sound: the V12 through its gears, the tyres, the countdown,
 * the checkpoints' jingles). Not yet the coast.
 *
 *   the keys: space (from the title, to race, after it), left and right
 *   (the course; the wheel), up (the gas), down (the brake), v the view
 *   (close behind, behind and above, high overhead, in the cockpit:
 *   V.R.'s four buttons)
 *
 *   usage: mini-virtuaracing [view=close|behind|overhead|cockpit]
 *                            [picture=WxH] [scale=n] [stats] [cull=off]
 *                            [course=n] [sound=off] [lod=off]
 *                            [render=depth|painter|table] [layers=off]
 *     view=     the view at the start (default: close)
 *     picture=  the picture's size in pixels (default: 320x240), each
 *               made n by n on the screen (scale=, 1 to 4; 2 by
 *               default; on Plan 9 the window's largest whole n)
 *     stats     each frame's faces drawn and the race (its time, the
 *               clock, the car's distance, speed, place, lap), on the
 *               standard error
 *     cull=off  the faces turned away drawn too (Render.cull)
 *     course=n  a race on the n-th course at once (0: Big Forest), not
 *               the title (the frames' sessions)
 *     sound=off no sound made (Sound.on)
 *     lod=off   the far road chunks drawn whole too (Course.lod)
 *     render=   how the hidden faces are hidden: depth, a depth for
 *               each pixel (the default), painter, the faces sorted
 *               and drawn from the farthest, or table, the same by an
 *               ordering table, the PlayStation's (Render.algorithm)
 *     layers=off  painter and table: the ground sorted with the rest,
 *               not drawn first (Render.layers): green where the road
 *               was
 *
 * A frame:
 *
 *    the course's meshes near the eye            the picture
 *    (Course: land tiles, road chunks,  --> Render: cull, turn, cut,
 *     landmarks; what moves; the cars)      project, fill by spans
 *                                                  |
 *          Bitmap <-- the course's Palette <-- width x height bytes
 *
 * history:
 * Virtua Racing ran on Sega's Model 1 board: a V60 processor for the
 * game, and five DSPs of Fujitsu's for the geometry, 180,000 polygons
 * a second at 30 frames. Its home version (the Mega Drive's, 1994) had
 * a chip in the cartridge for the same work (the SVP), at a fraction of
 * the polygons and of the frames; the Saturn's and the 32X's
 * followed. Here, a Pi 2's processor alone (plan_virtuaracing.md: the
 * budget of a frame). *)

module P = Playground

type view = Close | Behind | Overhead | Cockpit

let next_view (v : view) : view =
  match v with
  | Close -> Behind
  | Behind -> Overhead
  | Overhead -> Cockpit
  | Cockpit -> Close

type scene = Title | Select of int | Racing | Finished

(* a course built, its palette made and its meshes lit; its miniature
 * once the course select asks for it *)
type loaded = {
  course : Course.t;
  palette : Palette.t;
  mutable miniature : Mesh.t option;
}

type model = {
  (* the courses, each built the first time it is needed *)
  catalog : (unit -> Course.t) array;
  loaded : loaded option array;
  mutable current : int;
  render : Render.t;
  (* the player's car, and braking; the rivals', by the grid's order *)
  player_car : Mesh.t * Mesh.t;
  rival_cars : Mesh.t array;
  mutable race : Race.t;
  mutable braking : bool;
  mutable scenes : scene Scene2d.t;
  (* two pictures' bytes, one a frame in turn (mini-doom's screens: the
   * platform keeps a picture it has shown by the value) *)
  screens : Bytes.t array;
  mutable frames : int;
  mutable view : view;
  (* stats: each frame's faces and the race said there *)
  stats : (string -> unit) option;
}

let radians (d : float) : float = d *. Float.pi /. 180.

let lens (eye : Vec3.t) (target : Vec3.t) (fov : float) : Camera.t =
  { eye; target; up = Camera.up_hint; fov; ortho = 0.; near = 0.1; far = 2000. }

(* Camera3d.behind: [back] behind the car and [height] above it,
 * looking at [look] above the road [ahead] of it; a wider angle at
 * speed (the fraction of the top speed): the road rushes past the
 * edges *)
let camera (view : view) (speed : float) (((x, y, z), heading) : Vec3.t * float)
    : Camera.t =
  let back, height, ahead, look =
    match view with
    | Cockpit -> (0.1, 1.3, 20., 0.4)
    | Close -> (7.5, 2.6, 8., 1.)
    | Behind -> (14., 6.5, 12., 1.)
    | Overhead -> (22., 34., 16., 0.)
  in
  let fx = sin (radians heading) and fz = -.cos (radians heading) in
  lens
    (x -. (back *. fx), y +. height, z -. (back *. fz))
    (x +. (ahead *. fx), y +. look, z +. (ahead *. fz))
    (60. +. (10. *. speed))

(* Camera3d.orbit: [distance] from (x, y, z) at [angle] round it,
 * [height] above, looking at [look] above it *)
let orbit (distance : float) (height : float) (look : float) (angle : float)
    ((x, y, z) : Vec3.t) : Camera.t =
  let a = radians angle in
  lens
    (x +. (distance *. sin a), y +. height, z +. (distance *. cos a))
    (x, y +. look, z)
    60.

(* the course select's table, under the miniature *)
let table = Mesh.rgb 40 80 50

(* the course's palette: its faces, what moves, the sky (over the land
 * and over the course select's table), the miniature's road, the cars
 * at every brightness; its meshes lit *)
let build (course : Course.t) (cars : Mesh.t list) (sky : Camera.t) : loaded =
  let palette = Palette.create () in
  let statics = Course.meshes course in
  List.iter (Palette.add_mesh palette) statics;
  List.iter
    (fun (s : Mesh.shape) -> Palette.add_mesh palette (Mesh.make s))
    (course.animated 0.);
  Palette.add_mesh palette (Mesh.make (Course.sky course sky));
  Palette.add_mesh palette (Mesh.make (Course.sky_over sky (-40.) table));
  List.iter
    (fun (c : Mesh.color) -> Palette.add_all_levels palette c)
    [ Mesh.white; Mesh.rgb 90 90 95; table ];
  List.iter
    (fun (mesh : Mesh.t) ->
      Array.iter (Palette.add_all_levels palette) mesh.colors)
    cars;
  Palette.make palette;
  List.iter
    (fun (mesh : Mesh.t) -> Mesh.light mesh (Palette.index palette))
    (statics @ Course.far_meshes course);
  { course; palette; miniature = None }

let load (m : model) (i : int) : loaded =
  match m.loaded.(i) with
  | Some l -> l
  | None ->
      let course = m.catalog.(i) () in
      let race = Race.start course in
      let l =
        build course
          (fst m.player_car :: snd m.player_car :: Array.to_list m.rival_cars)
          (camera m.view 0. (Driving.world course race.drive))
      in
      m.loaded.(i) <- Some l;
      l

let lit (l : loaded) (shape : Mesh.shape) : Mesh.t =
  let mesh = Mesh.make shape in
  Mesh.light mesh (Palette.index l.palette);
  mesh

(* the course round the eye: its sky, land, road near [s], landmarks,
 * what moves; the cars of [race] (the player's but from its cockpit) *)
let draw_course (m : model) (l : loaded) (cam : Camera.t) (time : float)
    (race : Race.t) : unit =
  let c = l.course and r = m.render in
  let d = race.drive in
  let sky = lit l (Course.sky c cam) in
  Render.frame r cam (Char.code (Bytes.get sky.shades 1));
  Render.draw r sky;
  List.iter (Render.draw r) (Course.land_near c cam.eye);
  (* (the ground under the rest, for the painter's and the table) *)
  Render.next_layer r;
  List.iter (Render.draw r) (Course.road_near c d.s cam.eye);
  List.iter (Render.draw r) c.landmarks;
  List.iter (fun (s : Mesh.shape) -> Render.draw r (lit l s)) (c.animated time);
  let index = Palette.index l.palette in
  let (x, y, z), heading = Driving.world c d in
  (* (the player's own car not drawn from its cockpit) *)
  if m.view <> Cockpit || m.scenes.scene = Title then
    Render.draw_at r
      (if m.braking then snd m.player_car else fst m.player_car)
      (-.heading) (x, y, z) index;
  let ex, _, ez = cam.eye in
  List.iteri
    (fun (k : int) (rv : Rivals.t) ->
      let ((rx, _, rz) as at), h = Rivals.place c rv in
      if Float.hypot (rx -. ex) (rz -. ez) <= 350. then
        Render.draw_at r m.rival_cars.(k) (-.h) at index)
    race.rivals

(* the race's camera: following the car's heading, not its spin; off
 * the road, and against the rail, shaking with the car *)
let race_camera (m : model) (c : Course.t) (race : Race.t) : Camera.t =
  let d = race.drive in
  let at, heading = Driving.world c d in
  let follow = if d.spin > 0 then 90. -. d.car.heading else heading in
  let cam =
    camera m.view (Float.abs d.car.speed /. Driving.top_speed) (at, follow)
  in
  let shake =
    (if Float.abs d.offset > 1.15 *. Course.road_width then
       0.12 *. Float.abs d.car.speed /. Driving.top_speed
     else 0.)
    +. if d.bump < 12 then 0.3 *. float_of_int (12 - d.bump) /. 12. else 0.
  in
  let ex, ey, ez = cam.eye in
  {
    cam with
    eye = (ex, ey +. (shake *. sin (float_of_int race.time *. 2.1)), ez);
  }

(* the scene's picture drawn, and what goes over it *)
let draw (computer : P.computer) (m : model) (time : float) :
    loaded * P.shape list =
  (* the playground's texts are placed for a screen 1000 high: drawn on
   * one (as wide as the window's proportions), then scaled to the
   * window ([view]) *)
  let s = m.scenes in
  let screen =
    P.to_screen (computer.screen.width *. 1000. /. computer.screen.height) 1000.
  in
  let blink (period : float) : P.shape list -> P.shape list =
    Scene2d.blink period s
  in
  match s.scene with
  | Title ->
      let l = load m 0 in
      let r = Race.start l.course in
      let at, _ = Driving.world l.course r.drive in
      draw_course m l (orbit 11. 3.5 0.8 (Course.spin 12. time) at) time r;
      (l, Screens.title (blink 1.))
  | Select i ->
      (* the course on a table, turning, seen from above and aside *)
      let l = load m i in
      let cam = orbit 110. 105. 0. (Course.spin 10. time) (0., 0., 0.) in
      let mini =
        match l.miniature with
        | Some mesh -> mesh
        | None ->
            let mesh = lit l (Course.miniature l.course) in
            l.miniature <- Some mesh;
            mesh
      in
      let r = m.render in
      let sky = lit l (Course.sky_over cam (-40.) table) in
      Render.frame r cam (Char.code (Bytes.get sky.shades 1));
      Render.draw r sky;
      Render.draw r mini;
      List.iter
        (fun (sh : Mesh.shape) ->
          Render.draw r (lit l (Course.shrink l.course sh)))
        (l.course.animated time);
      (l, Screens.select screen (blink 1.) l.course)
  | Racing ->
      let l = load m m.current in
      draw_course m l (race_camera m l.course m.race) time m.race;
      (l, Screens.race screen (blink 0.3) l.course m.race)
  | Finished ->
      let l = load m m.current in
      draw_course m l (race_camera m l.course m.race) time m.race;
      (l, Screens.finished (blink 1.) l.course m.race)

let view (computer : P.computer) (m : model) : P.shape list =
  let (P.Time now) = computer.time in
  let l, over = draw computer m now in
  Render.finish m.render;
  Option.iter
    (fun (say : string -> unit) ->
      say
        (let r = m.race in
         Printf.sprintf
           "frame %d: %d faces; time %d, clock %d, %.1f m, %.0f km/h, %s, lap \
            %d%s\n"
           m.frames
           (Render.faces_drawn m.render)
           r.time r.clock r.drive.s
           (Driving.kmh r.drive.car.speed)
           (Rivals.ordinal (Rivals.position r.drive r.rivals))
           (Race.lap l.course r.drive + 1)
           (if r.over then ", over" else if r.finished then ", goal" else "")))
    m.stats;
  m.frames <- m.frames + 1;
  let src = Render.pixels m.render and dst = m.screens.(m.frames land 1) in
  Bytes.blit src 0 dst 0 (Bytes.length src);
  let screen = computer.screen in
  let pw = float (Render.width m.render)
  and ph = float (Render.height m.render) in
  let w = Float.min screen.width (screen.height *. pw /. ph) in
  let h = w *. ph /. pw in
  (if h < screen.height || w < screen.width then
     [ P.rectangle (P.rgb 96 96 96) screen.width screen.height ]
   else [])
  @ [
      P.pixels w h
        {
          pwidth = Render.width m.render;
          pheight = Render.height m.render;
          indices = dst;
          palette = Palette.colors l.palette;
        };
    ]
  @ [ P.group over |> P.scale (screen.height /. 1000.) ]

let start_race (m : model) (i : int) : unit =
  m.current <- i;
  m.race <- Race.start (load m i).course;
  m.braking <- false

let update (computer : P.computer) (m : model) : model =
  let s = Scene2d.update computer m.scenes in
  let k = computer.keyboard in
  let space = Scene2d.pressed (fun (k : P.keyboard) -> k.kspace) s in
  let keys : Race.keys =
    { up = k.kup; down = k.kdown; left = k.kleft; right = k.kright }
  in
  (* a frame of the race, and its sound in the playground's order: a
   * gear's change and a crash, the engine and the road, the countdown
   * and the checkpoints' (before the start, the engine revs with the
   * pedal, the car held) *)
  let drive () =
    if Scene2d.pressed (fun (k : P.keyboard) -> Set_.mem "v" k.keys) s then
      m.view <- next_view m.view;
    let c = (load m m.current).course and before = m.race in
    let race, events = Race.step c keys before in
    let first, rest =
      List.partition
        (fun (e : Race.event) ->
          match e with
          | Shift | Crash -> true
          | _ -> false)
        events
    in
    List.iter Sound.event first;
    let rpm =
      if before.time < 0 then
        if k.kup then 0.7 +. (0.2 *. P.wave 0. 1. 0.3 computer.time) else 0.2
      else Race.revs race.drive
    in
    Sound.engine rpm
      (k.kup && not before.finished)
      (Course.in_span c.spans [ Tunnel ] (Driving.wrap c race.drive.s) <> None);
    Sound.road race.drive;
    List.iter Sound.event rest;
    m.race <- race;
    m.braking <- k.kdown || race.finished
  in
  m.scenes <-
    (match s.scene with
    | Title -> if space then Scene2d.go (Select 0) s else s
    | Select i ->
        let n = Array.length m.catalog in
        let left = Scene2d.pressed (fun (k : P.keyboard) -> k.kleft) s
        and right = Scene2d.pressed (fun (k : P.keyboard) -> k.kright) s in
        if left || right then Sound.play Sound.pick;
        if space then (
          Sound.play Sound.go_beep;
          start_race m i;
          Scene2d.go Racing s)
        else if left then Scene2d.go (Select ((i + n - 1) mod n)) s
        else if right then Scene2d.go (Select ((i + 1) mod n)) s
        else s
    | Racing ->
        drive ();
        if m.race.finished then Scene2d.go Finished s else s
    | Finished ->
        drive ();
        if space then Scene2d.go (Select m.current) s else s);
  m

(* the cars' meshes; the first course built (the title's, or [course]'s:
 * a race on it at once, not the title, for the frames' sessions) *)
let start (view : view) (width : int) (height : int) (course : int option)
    (stats : (string -> unit) option) : model =
  let catalog = [| Course.big_forest; Course.bay_bridge; Course.acropolis |] in
  let red = Mesh.rgb 220 30 40 in
  let player_car =
    (Mesh.make (Cars.model red false), Mesh.make (Cars.model red true))
  and rival_cars =
    Array.init (Array.length Cars.liveries) (fun (k : int) ->
        Mesh.make (Cars.model Cars.liveries.(k) false))
  in
  let first =
    match course with
    | None -> 0
    | Some i when i >= 0 && i < Array.length catalog -> i
    | Some i -> failwith (Printf.sprintf "no course %d" i)
  in
  let c = catalog.(first) () in
  let race = Race.start c in
  let loaded = Array.make (Array.length catalog) None in
  loaded.(first) <-
    Some
      (build c
         (fst player_car :: snd player_car :: Array.to_list rival_cars)
         (camera view 0. (Driving.world c race.drive)));
  {
    catalog;
    loaded;
    current = first;
    render = Render.create width height;
    player_car;
    rival_cars;
    race;
    braking = false;
    scenes = Scene2d.start (if course = None then Title else Racing);
    screens = [| Bytes.create (width * height); Bytes.create (width * height) |];
    frames = 0;
    view;
    stats;
  }

let () =
  Cap.main (fun caps ->
      Exit.exit caps @@ Exit.catch
      @@ fun () ->
      (try
         let flags = Playground_platform.flags caps in
         let flag (name : string) : string option = List.assoc_opt name flags in
         let first =
           match flag "view" with
           | Some "behind" -> Behind
           | Some "overhead" -> Overhead
           | Some "cockpit" -> Cockpit
           | Some "close" | None -> Close
           | Some v -> failwith ("no view " ^ v)
         in
         let width, height =
           match Option.map (String.split_on_char 'x') (flag "picture") with
           | Some [ w; h ] -> (int_of_string w, int_of_string h)
           | Some _ -> failwith "picture=WxH"
           | None -> (320, 240)
         in
         let scale =
           match Option.bind (flag "scale") int_of_string_opt with
           | Some n when n >= 1 && n <= 4 -> Some n
           | _ -> if Sys.os_type = "Plan9" then None else Some 2
         in
         let stats =
           if flag "stats" <> None then Some (Console.eprint caps) else None
         in
         if flag "cull" = Some "off" then Render.cull := false;
         if flag "sound" = Some "off" then Sound.on := false;
         if flag "lod" = Some "off" then Course.lod := false;
         if flag "layers" = Some "off" then Render.layers := false;
         (match flag "render" with
         | Some "painter" -> Render.algorithm := Render.Painter
         | Some "table" -> Render.algorithm := Render.Table
         | _ -> ());
         let course = Option.bind (flag "course") int_of_string_opt in
         let model = start first width height course stats in
         (* the window the picture's size, a unit a pixel; or, without
          * scale, the window whatever its size (mini-doom's) *)
         let flags =
           match (flag "window", scale) with
           | Some _, _ -> flags
           | None, Some n ->
               ("window", Printf.sprintf "%dx%d" (width * n) (height * n))
               :: flags
           | None, None -> ("window", "") :: flags
         in
         let side =
           match scale with
           | Some n -> width * n
           | None -> width
         in
         let flags =
           if flag "size" = None then ("size", string_of_int side) :: flags
           else flags
         in
         Playground_platform.run_app caps
           (("heap", "modest") :: flags)
           (P.game view update model)
       with Failure msg ->
         Console.eprint caps ("mini-virtuaracing: " ^ msg ^ "\n");
         CapStdlib.exit caps 1);
      Exit.OK)

(* Claude Code

(* See Course.mli *)

(* ix: the author's playground's games/racing/TinyVirtuaRacing.ml, its
 * "The courses", "The road, cut in chunks", and the sky of its
 * "View" *)

let rgb = Mesh.rgb
let polygon3d = Mesh.polygon3d
let rotate3d = Mesh.rotate3d
let move3d = Mesh.move3d
let box = Mesh.box
let road_width = 6. (* half of it *)

(* The land next to the road is this far below it, the road standing on
 * the sides of its embankment ([segment]): an eye above a road only
 * 0.1 over the land sees the land win the depth test near the bottom
 * of the screen, where a quad of land straddles the eye *)
let ground = -1.5
let verge = 2.5 *. road_width (* the grass along it, up to the rail *)
let water_level = ground +. 0.2
let rumble_length = 3
let chunk_size = 40
let map_unit = 40.

let angle_diff (a : float) (b : float) : float =
  Float.rem (Float.rem (b -. a +. 180.) 360. +. 360.) 360. -. 180.

(* a turn of [period] seconds, in degrees, at [time] (Playground.spin) *)
let spin (period : float) (time : float) : float =
  360. *. Float.rem time period /. period

(* A circuit through points (x, y on the map, height in metres), each
 * corner leaning into itself: the bank is read from how much the
 * course turns at each point, so a course is written as where the road
 * goes and nothing else. *)
let circuit (points : (float * float * float) list) : Track3d.t =
  let a =
    Array.of_list
      (List.map
         (fun ((x, y, h) : float * float * float) ->
           (x *. map_unit, y *. map_unit, h))
         points)
  in
  let n = Array.length a in
  let heading (i : int) (j : int) : float =
    let x1, z1, _ = a.(i mod n) and x2, z2, _ = a.(j mod n) in
    atan2 (x2 -. x1) (-.(z2 -. z1)) *. 180. /. Float.pi
  in
  Track3d.build 2.
    (List.init n (fun (i : int) ->
         let turn = angle_diff (heading (i + n - 1) i) (heading i (i + 1)) in
         let x, z, y = a.(i) in
         Track3d.control ~y ~width:road_width
           ~bank:(Float.max (-10.) (Float.min 10. (-.turn *. 0.2)))
           x z))

(* how much the road turns at segment [i], in degrees per segment,
 * averaged over a few (the resampled spline wobbles by a hair from one
 * sample to the next) *)
let turn_at (ribbon : Track3d.t) (i : int) : float =
  let at (k : int) : Track3d.place =
    Track3d.at ribbon (float_of_int k *. Track3d.step ribbon)
  in
  angle_diff (at (i - 3)).heading (at (i + 4)).heading /. 7.

(* the road's box, x0 x1 z0 z1 (bounds) *)
let box_of (ribbon : Track3d.t) : float * float * float * float =
  let n = Track3d.segments ribbon in
  List.fold_left
    (fun ((x0, x1, z0, z1) : float * float * float * float) (k : int) ->
      let p = Track3d.at ribbon (float_of_int k *. Track3d.step ribbon) in
      ( Float.min x0 p.px,
        Float.max x1 p.px,
        Float.min z0 p.pz,
        Float.max z1 p.pz ))
    (infinity, neg_infinity, infinity, neg_infinity)
    (List.init n (fun (k : int) -> k))

(* Stretches of road that are more than a road: a suspension bridge, an
 * overpass (the road crossing over itself), a tunnel, and the grey
 * concrete walls that stand instead of the rails in places. *)
type span_kind = Suspension | Overpass | Tunnel | Wall
type span = { kind : span_kind; s0 : float; s1 : float }

let in_span (spans : span list) (kinds : span_kind list) (s : float) :
    span option =
  List.find_opt
    (fun (sp : span) -> List.mem sp.kind kinds && s >= sp.s0 && s <= sp.s1)
    spans

(* the road off the land: the land under it is left as it is *)
let lifted = [ Suspension; Overpass; Tunnel ]

type piece = { mesh : Mesh.t; far : Mesh.t; mx : float; mz : float }

type t = {
  name : string;
  level : string;
  ribbon : Track3d.t;
  laps : int;
  checkpoints : int;
  start_time : int;
  bonus : int;
  rivals : int;
  spans : span list;
  terrain : Land.t;
  grass : Mesh.color * Mesh.color;
  chunks : piece array;
  tiles : piece array;
  landmarks : Mesh.t list;
  landscape : Mesh.shape list;
  animated : float -> Mesh.shape list;
  box : float * float * float * float;
  turns : Float.Array.t;
}

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Placing things *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* what the scenery of a course is placed from: the road, its spans,
 * the land, and where nothing stands (the sea) *)
type site = {
  ribbon : Track3d.t;
  spans : span list;
  terrain : Land.t;
  taken : float * float -> bool;
  (* the scenery for a far chunk (road_near): its simpler trees; the
   * trees' places, found once for the two ([trees]); whether a tree
   * has a far kind of its own (else the far chunk is the near one) *)
  far : bool;
  places : (int * int, (int * float * float * float) list) Hashtbl.t;
  far_kinds : bool ref;
}

let place (ribbon : Track3d.t) (s : float) (offset : float) (shape : Mesh.shape)
    : Mesh.shape =
  let x, y, z = Track3d.across ribbon s offset in
  let p = Track3d.at ribbon s in
  shape |> rotate3d 0. (-.p.heading) 0. |> move3d x y z

(* [on_land site x y shape]: standing on the land at (x, y) on the map,
 * a little sunk (the land between the corners of a cell is not quite
 * flat) *)
let on_land (site : site) (x : float) (y : float) (shape : Mesh.shape) :
    Mesh.shape =
  let x = x *. map_unit and z = y *. map_unit in
  shape |> move3d x (Land.height site.terrain x z -. 0.4) z

(* [trees (kind, far) every rows site i]: a tree each side of segment
 * [i], beyond the rail, every [every] segments: on the land, clear of
 * the road (of *another* part of it too, since a circuit comes back
 * near itself), not in the sea, not on the rock; [far]'s for a far
 * chunk. Its places found once, for the near chunk and the far one
 * (a Track3d.locate each: the course's start 45% longer when found
 * twice) *)
let trees ((near, far) : (int -> Mesh.shape) * (int -> Mesh.shape))
    (every : int) (rows : int) (site : site) (i : int) : Mesh.shape list =
  if near != far then site.far_kinds := true;
  let kind = if site.far then far else near in
  if i mod every <> 0 then []
  else
    let found () : (int * float * float * float) list =
      let s = float_of_int i *. Track3d.step site.ribbon in
      let _, road_y, _ = Track3d.across site.ribbon s 0. in
      List.concat_map
        (fun (row : int) ->
          List.filter_map
            (fun (side : float) ->
              let off =
                side
                *. (verge +. 4.
                   +. (float_of_int row *. 9.)
                   +. (5. *. Scenery.jitter i (row + int_of_float side)))
              in
              let x, _, z = Track3d.across site.ribbon s off in
              let _, nearest = Track3d.locate site.ribbon x z in
              let h = Land.height site.terrain x z in
              if
                Float.abs nearest >= verge +. 2.
                && (not (site.taken (x, z)))
                && h < road_y +. 30.
              then Some (i + row, x, h -. 0.4, z)
              else None)
            [ -1.; 1. ])
        (List.init rows (fun (r : int) -> r))
    in
    let places =
      match Hashtbl.find_opt site.places (i, every) with
      | Some l -> l
      | None ->
          let l = found () in
          Hashtbl.replace site.places (i, every) l;
          l
    in
    List.map
      (fun ((k, x, y, z) : int * float * float * float) ->
        kind k |> move3d x y z)
      places

(* signs every 150 segments, chevrons outside the sharp curves *)
let signs (site : site) (i : int) : Mesh.shape list =
  let s = float_of_int i *. Track3d.step site.ribbon in
  let turn = turn_at site.ribbon i in
  if in_span site.spans [ Suspension; Overpass; Tunnel ] s <> None then []
  else if i mod 150 = 75 then
    [ place site.ribbon s (1.3 *. road_width) Scenery.sign ]
  else if Float.abs turn > 1.8 && i mod 5 = 0 then
    [
      place site.ribbon s
        ((if turn > 0. then -1.4 else 1.4) *. road_width)
        Scenery.chevron;
    ]
  else []

(* the start, on a circuit: the line chequered, the gantry over it,
 * the grandstand on the left, over the rail, and the checkpoints'
 * gantries round the lap *)
let start (ribbon : Track3d.t) (checkpoints : int) : Mesh.shape list =
  let w = road_width in
  let chequer =
    List.concat
      (List.init 2 (fun (row : int) ->
           List.init 8 (fun (k : int) ->
               let a = -.w +. (float_of_int k *. w /. 4.) in
               Track3d.strip ribbon
                 (if (k + row) mod 2 = 0 then Mesh.white else Mesh.black)
                 row a
                 (a +. (w /. 4.)))))
  in
  [
    Mesh.group3d chequer;
    place ribbon 0. 0. (Scenery.gantry (rgb 30 60 200) w);
    place ribbon 30. (-.verge -. 1.) (Scenery.grandstand ground);
  ]
  @ List.init (checkpoints - 1) (fun (k : int) ->
      place ribbon
        (float_of_int (k + 1)
        *. Track3d.length ribbon /. float_of_int checkpoints)
        0.
        (Scenery.gantry (rgb 240 200 30) w))

(* The suspension bridge, along the ribbon from [s0] to [s1]: two
 * towers standing in the sea, the two main cables hanging between
 * them (a parabola, the shape a cable takes under an evenly spread
 * deck) and running down to the ends, a hanger every few metres from
 * cable to deck. The deck itself is in the road's chunks ([segment]).
 * Its hundreds of polygons are what made Model 1 famous. The cables
 * and the hangers one face thick: seen from both sides. *)
let bridge (ribbon : Track3d.t) (s0 : float) (s1 : float) : Mesh.shape list =
  let w = road_width in
  let side_off = 1.55 *. w in
  let len = s1 -. s0 in
  let t1 = s0 +. (0.22 *. len) and t2 = s1 -. (0.22 *. len) in
  let top = 26. and bed = -8. in
  let deck (s : float) (side : float) : float =
    let _, y, _ = Track3d.across ribbon s (side *. side_off) in
    y
  in
  let cable (s : float) (side : float) : float =
    let d = deck s side in
    if s < t1 then d +. 1.5 +. ((top -. 1.5) *. (s -. s0) /. (t1 -. s0))
    else if s > t2 then d +. 1.5 +. ((top -. 1.5) *. (s1 -. s) /. (s1 -. t2))
    else
      let u = (2. *. (s -. t1) /. (t2 -. t1)) -. 1. in
      d +. 2. +. ((top -. 2.) *. u *. u)
  in
  let red = rgb 235 85 55 and steel = rgb 190 60 40 in
  let tower (s : float) : Mesh.shape =
    let _, y, _ = Track3d.across ribbon s 0. in
    let h = y -. bed +. top +. 1. in
    let leg (side : float) : Mesh.shape =
      box red 1.6 h 1.6 |> move3d (side *. side_off) (h /. 2.) 0.
    in
    let beam (y : float) : Mesh.shape =
      box red ((2. *. side_off) +. 1.6) 1.2 1.2 |> Mesh.move_y3d y
    in
    let at = Track3d.at ribbon s in
    Mesh.group3d
      [
        leg (-1.);
        leg 1.;
        beam (h -. 0.6);
        beam (y -. bed +. (top *. 0.55));
        beam (y -. bed -. 1.8);
      ]
    |> rotate3d 0. (-.at.heading) 0.
    |> move3d at.px bed at.pz
  in
  let ds = 2. in
  let pieces = int_of_float (len /. ds) in
  let cables =
    List.concat_map
      (fun (side : float) ->
        List.init pieces (fun (k : int) ->
            let sa = s0 +. (float_of_int k *. ds)
            and sb = s0 +. (float_of_int (k + 1) *. ds) in
            let xa, _, za = Track3d.across ribbon sa (side *. side_off)
            and xb, _, zb = Track3d.across ribbon sb (side *. side_off) in
            let ya = cable sa side and yb = cable sb side in
            Mesh.two_sided
              (polygon3d steel
                 [
                   (xa, ya, za);
                   (xb, yb, zb);
                   (xb, yb +. 0.5, zb);
                   (xa, ya +. 0.5, za);
                 ])))
      [ -1.; 1. ]
  in
  let hangers =
    List.concat_map
      (fun (side : float) ->
        List.init (pieces / 2) (fun (k : int) ->
            let s = s0 +. (float_of_int (2 * k) *. ds) in
            let x, y, z = Track3d.across ribbon s (side *. side_off)
            and fx, fz = Track3d.forward ribbon s in
            let yc = cable s side in
            Mesh.two_sided
              (polygon3d (rgb 220 220 220)
                 [
                   (x, y, z);
                   (x +. (fx *. 0.25), y, z +. (fz *. 0.25));
                   (x +. (fx *. 0.25), yc, z +. (fz *. 0.25));
                   (x, yc, z);
                 ])))
      [ -1.; 1. ]
  in
  [ tower t1; tower t2 ] @ cables @ hangers

(* piers under a raised road, every 30 m, down to [bed] *)
let piers (ribbon : Track3d.t) (bed : float) (s0 : float) (s1 : float) :
    Mesh.shape list =
  List.init
    (int_of_float ((s1 -. s0) /. 30.) + 1)
    (fun (k : int) ->
      let s = s0 +. (float_of_int k *. 30.) in
      let at = Track3d.at ribbon s in
      let h = at.py -. 1.8 -. bed in
      box (rgb 170 170 165) (2.6 *. road_width) h 2.5
      |> Mesh.move_y3d (bed +. (h /. 2.))
      |> rotate3d 0. (-.at.heading) 0.
      |> move3d at.px 0. at.pz)

(* the mouths of a tunnel: a concrete face around the road at each end *)
let portals (ribbon : Track3d.t) (s0 : float) (s1 : float) : Mesh.shape list =
  let concrete = rgb 150 150 145 in
  let face =
    Mesh.group3d
      [
        box concrete (2. *. verge) 4. 1.5 |> Mesh.move_y3d 8.;
        box concrete 4. 8. 1.5 |> move3d (-.verge +. 2.) 4. 0.;
        box concrete 4. 8. 1.5 |> move3d (verge -. 2.) 4. 0.;
      ]
  in
  [ place ribbon s0 0. face; place ribbon s1 0. face ]

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The road, cut in chunks *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* A segment of road: the kerbs and the tarmac; then, on land, the
 * grass verges, the rail at their edge (red and white, what the car
 * bounces off) and the sides of the embankment down to the land; grey
 * concrete walls instead of the rails where the course has them; on a
 * bridge or an overpass, the deck's edges, its rails and the girders
 * under it; in a tunnel, its walls and its roof. *)
let segment (ribbon : Track3d.t) (spans : span list)
    (grass2 : Mesh.color * Mesh.color) (i : int) : Mesh.shape list =
  let strip = Track3d.strip ribbon and wall = Track3d.wall ribbon in
  let light = i / rumble_length mod 2 = 0 in
  let rumble = if light then rgb 240 240 240 else rgb 200 40 40 in
  let tarmac = if light then rgb 110 110 110 else rgb 100 100 100 in
  let w = road_width in
  let road =
    [
      strip rumble i (-1.15 *. w) (-.w);
      strip tarmac i (-.w) w;
      strip rumble i w (1.15 *. w);
    ]
    @ if light then [ strip Mesh.white i (-0.03 *. w) (0.03 *. w) ] else []
  in
  let light_grass, dark_grass = grass2 in
  let grass = if light then light_grass else dark_grass in
  let s = float_of_int i *. Track3d.step ribbon in
  match in_span spans [ Suspension; Overpass; Tunnel; Wall ] s with
  | Some { kind = Suspension | Overpass; _ } ->
      road
      @ [
          strip (rgb 150 150 150) i (-.verge) (-1.15 *. w);
          strip (rgb 150 150 150) i (1.15 *. w) verge;
          wall (rgb 230 230 230) i (-.verge) 1.;
          wall (rgb 230 230 230) i verge 1.;
          wall (rgb 180 70 40) i (-.verge) (-1.8);
          wall (rgb 180 70 40) i verge (-1.8);
        ]
  | Some { kind = Tunnel; _ } ->
      (* the roof: the ribbon's quad lifted 8 metres, facing down *)
      let up ((x, y, z) : Vec3.t) : Vec3.t = (x, y +. 8., z) in
      let near (o : float) : Vec3.t = up (Track3d.across ribbon s o)
      and far (o : float) : Vec3.t =
        up (Track3d.across ribbon (s +. Track3d.step ribbon) o)
      in
      road
      @ [
          strip (rgb 90 90 90) i (-.verge) (-1.15 *. w);
          strip (rgb 90 90 90) i (1.15 *. w) verge;
          wall (rgb 120 120 115) i (-.verge) 8.;
          wall (rgb 120 120 115) i verge 8.;
          polygon3d (rgb 80 80 80)
            [ near verge; near (-.verge); far (-.verge); far verge ];
        ]
  | Some { kind = Wall; _ } ->
      road
      @ [
          strip grass i (-.verge) (-1.15 *. w);
          strip grass i (1.15 *. w) verge;
          wall (rgb 175 175 170) i (-.verge) 2.5;
          wall (rgb 175 175 170) i verge 2.5;
          wall dark_grass i (-.verge) (-3.);
          wall dark_grass i verge (-3.);
        ]
  | None ->
      let rail = if i / 2 mod 2 = 0 then rgb 230 230 230 else rgb 210 50 40 in
      road
      @ [
          strip grass i (-.verge) (-1.15 *. w);
          strip grass i (1.15 *. w) verge;
          wall rail i (-.verge) 0.8;
          wall rail i verge 0.8;
          wall dark_grass i (-.verge) (-3.);
          wall dark_grass i verge (-3.);
        ]

(*****************************************************************************)
(* A course *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* a hill at (x, y) on the map, [radius] and [top] (the radius of a flat
 * top, a plateau) in squares, [height] in metres *)
let hill (top : float) (x : float) (y : float) (radius : float) (height : float)
    : Land.hill =
  {
    hx = x *. map_unit;
    hz = y *. map_unit;
    radius = radius *. map_unit;
    height;
    top = top *. map_unit;
  }

(* what a course is written as *)
type description = {
  d_name : string;
  d_level : string;
  points : (float * float * float) list;
  d_laps : int;
  d_checkpoints : int;
  d_start_time : int;
  d_bonus : int;
  d_rivals : int;
  (* its spans, two points on the map each, where they start and end *)
  d_spans : (span_kind * (float * float) * (float * float)) list;
  palette : Land.palette;
  d_grass : Mesh.color * Mesh.color;
  hills : Land.hill list;
  sea : (float * float) list list;
  scenery : site -> int -> Mesh.shape list; (* along segment i *)
  landscape : site -> Mesh.shape list; (* the landmarks *)
  moving : site -> float -> Mesh.shape list;
}

let make (d : description) : t =
  let ribbon = circuit d.points in
  let spans =
    List.map
      (fun ((kind, (x0, y0), (x1, y1)) :
             span_kind * (float * float) * (float * float)) ->
        let s0, _ = Track3d.locate ribbon (x0 *. map_unit) (y0 *. map_unit)
        and s1, _ = Track3d.locate ribbon (x1 *. map_unit) (y1 *. map_unit) in
        { kind; s0; s1 })
      d.d_spans
  in
  let sea =
    List.map
      (List.map (fun ((x, y) : float * float) -> (x *. map_unit, y *. map_unit)))
      d.sea
  in
  (* the road's samples, every 4 m *)
  let step = Track3d.step ribbon in
  let samples =
    Array.init
      (Track3d.segments ribbon / 2)
      (fun (k : int) ->
        let s = float_of_int (2 * k) *. step in
        let p = Track3d.at ribbon s in
        {
          Land.sx = p.px;
          sz = p.pz;
          sy = p.py;
          lifted = in_span spans lifted s <> None;
        })
  in
  let terrain = Land.make samples d.hills sea d.palette ground verge in
  let site =
    {
      ribbon;
      spans;
      terrain;
      taken =
        (fun (p : float * float) ->
          List.exists (fun (w : (float * float) list) -> Land.inside w p) sea);
      far = false;
      places = Hashtbl.create 1024;
      far_kinds = ref false;
    }
  in
  let far_site = { site with far = true } in
  let segments = Track3d.segments ribbon in
  let chunks =
    Array.init
      ((segments + chunk_size - 1) / chunk_size)
      (fun (k : int) ->
        let first = k * chunk_size in
        let last = min segments (first + chunk_size) - 1 in
        let mid =
          Track3d.at ribbon (float_of_int ((first + last) / 2) *. step)
        in
        let shapes (site : site) : Mesh.shape list =
          List.concat
            (List.init
               (last - first + 1)
               (fun (j : int) ->
                 segment ribbon spans d.d_grass (first + j)
                 @ d.scenery site (first + j)))
        in
        let mesh = Mesh.make (Mesh.group3d (shapes site)) in
        let far =
          if !(site.far_kinds) then Mesh.make (Mesh.group3d (shapes far_site))
          else mesh
        in
        { mesh; far; mx = mid.px; mz = mid.pz })
  in
  (* (the places no more needed: site is kept, by the landscape's
   * closures) *)
  Hashtbl.reset site.places;
  let tiles =
    Array.of_list
      (List.map
         (fun (((x, z), shape) : (float * float) * Mesh.shape) ->
           let mesh = Mesh.make shape in
           { mesh; far = mesh; mx = x; mz = z })
         (Land.tiles terrain water_level 1))
  in
  {
    name = d.d_name;
    level = d.d_level;
    ribbon;
    laps = d.d_laps;
    checkpoints = d.d_checkpoints;
    start_time = d.d_start_time;
    bonus = d.d_bonus;
    rivals = d.d_rivals;
    spans;
    terrain;
    grass = d.d_grass;
    chunks;
    tiles;
    landmarks = List.map Mesh.make (d.landscape site);
    landscape = d.landscape site;
    animated = d.moving site;
    box = box_of ribbon;
    turns = Float.Array.make (Track3d.segments ribbon + 64) nan;
  }

(* Big Forest, the beginner's: a long pit straight up the diagonal, the

(* Acropolis, the expert's: the blob of the map -- the long straight up
 * the left, round the top, the bends down the right with the sea
 * beyond, back along the bottom -- and the finger up its middle: a
 * long straight to the keyhole hairpin, a hard long left, and a long
 * straight back; the zigzag, the canyon's twisty bends to the line.
 * The ruins on their hill, houses on the mountainside. *)
let acropolis () : t =
  make
    {
      d_name = "ACROPOLIS";
      d_level = "EXPERT";
      points =
        [
          (1.6, 13., 0.);
          (2., 10.8, 2.);
          (3.3, 8.6, 5.);
          (4.6, 6.8, 8.);
          (7., 5.1, 11.);

(*****************************************************************************)
(* What is drawn *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let lod = ref true
let far_away = 150.

let road_near (c : t) (s : float) ((ex, _, ez) : Vec3.t) : Mesh.t list =
  let len = Track3d.length c.ribbon in
  let wrapped = Float.rem (Float.rem s len +. len) len in
  let chunk = int_of_float (wrapped /. Track3d.step c.ribbon) / chunk_size in
  let n = Array.length c.chunks in
  let closed = c.laps > 1 in
  let near = ref [] in
  for k = n - 1 downto 0 do
    let ahead =
      if closed then (((k - chunk + 1) mod n) + n) mod n else k - chunk + 1
    in
    let p = c.chunks.(k) in
    let d = Float.hypot (p.mx -. ex) (p.mz -. ez) in
    if (ahead >= 0 && ahead < 7) || d < 160. then
      near := (if !lod && d > far_away then p.far else p.mesh) :: !near
  done;
  !near

let land_near (c : t) ((ex, _, ez) : Vec3.t) : Mesh.t list =
  Array.fold_right
    (fun (p : piece) (l : Mesh.t list) ->
      if Float.hypot (p.mx -. ex) (p.mz -. ez) < 1300. then p.mesh :: l else l)
    c.tiles []

(* The sky, the haze and the floor. A ceiling 200 up (over the tallest
 * mountain), from behind the eye to far ahead; the floor, under the
 * land (for beyond its edge), goes as far; and the haze is a slope
 * rising from the floor's far edge to meet the ceiling, which bends
 * down to it -- all within the far plane (2000), and all nearly flat,
 * facing up: flat shading lights a face by its slope, and a steep haze
 * would be grey, darker or lighter with the heading; the sky is seen
 * from below. The haze starts past the mountains: in front of them it
 * would hide their feet and leave their tops floating.
 *
 *     ceiling  ________________________
 *      (200 up)                        \___  (40 up)
 *       eye                           ___/
 *     floor ___________________________/  haze
 *                                  1400  1560 ahead *)
let sky_over (cam : Camera.t) (ground : float) (floor : Mesh.color) : Mesh.shape
    =
  let ex, ey, ez = cam.eye and tx, _, tz = cam.target in
  let d = Float.max 1e-9 (Float.hypot (tx -. ex) (tz -. ez)) in
  let fx = (tx -. ex) /. d and fz = (tz -. ez) /. d in
  let at (ahead : float) (k : float) (y : float) : Vec3.t =
    ( ex +. (ahead *. fx) -. (k *. 1200. *. fz),
      y,
      ez +. (ahead *. fz) +. (k *. 1200. *. fx) )
  in
  let top = ey +. 200.
  and low = ey +. 40.
  and bend = 1000.
  and far = 1400.
  and edge = 1560. in
  let blue = rgb 150 205 250 in
  Mesh.group3d
    [
      polygon3d floor
        [
          at (-300.) (-1.) ground;
          at (-300.) 1. ground;
          at far 1. ground;
          at far (-1.) ground;
        ];
      polygon3d blue
        [
          at (-300.) (-1.) top;
          at (-300.) 1. top;
          at bend 1. top;
          at bend (-1.) top;
        ];
      polygon3d blue
        [ at bend (-1.) top; at bend 1. top; at edge 1. low; at edge (-1.) low ];
      polygon3d (rgb 215 232 248)
        [
          at far (-1.) ground;
          at far 1. ground;
          at edge 1. low;
          at edge (-1.) low;
        ];
    ]

let sky (c : t) (cam : Camera.t) : Mesh.shape =
  sky_over cam ground (snd c.grass)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The course select's miniature *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let miniature_scale = 0.1

(* OPTIMIZATION (once): what the race's display and the rivals asked of
 * the road at each frame, the same answers, made once: the course's
 * box (a Track3d.at for each segment, at each frame: the map), a
 * segment's turn (41 for each rival at each frame: its braking); with
 * the map's dots (Screens), 2,800 Track3d.at a frame, 10% of it.
 * old: bounds walked the road, Rivals called turn_at *)
let bounds (c : t) : float * float * float * float = c.box

let turn (c : t) (i : int) : float =
  if i < 0 || i >= Float.Array.length c.turns then turn_at c.ribbon i
  else begin
    let v = Float.Array.get c.turns i in
    if Float.is_nan v then begin
      let v = turn_at c.ribbon i in
      Float.Array.set c.turns i v;
      v
    end
    else v
  end

let miniature_center (c : t) : float * float =
  let x0, x1, z0, z1 = bounds c in
  ((x0 +. x1) /. 2., (z0 +. z1) /. 2.)

let shrink (c : t) (s : Mesh.shape) : Mesh.shape =
  let cx, cz = miniature_center c in
  s |> Mesh.move3d (-.cx) 0. (-.cz) |> Mesh.scale3d miniature_scale

(* the land a quad of two cells, the road a band of three segments (the
 * line's white), the landmarks *)
let miniature (c : t) : Mesh.shape =
  let n = Track3d.segments c.ribbon in
  let band =
    List.init (n / 3) (fun (k : int) ->
        let at (j : int) = float_of_int j *. Track3d.step c.ribbon in
        let sa = at (3 * k) and sb = at (min n ((3 * k) + 3)) in
        let a (o : float) = Track3d.across c.ribbon sa o
        and b (o : float) = Track3d.across c.ribbon sb o in
        let lift ((x, y, z) : Vec3.t) : Vec3.t = (x, y +. 1.5, z) in
        polygon3d
          (if k = 0 then Mesh.white else rgb 90 90 95)
          (List.map lift
             [
               a (-2. *. road_width);
               a (2. *. road_width);
               b (2. *. road_width);
               b (-2. *. road_width);
             ]))
  in
  let tiles = List.map snd (Land.tiles c.terrain water_level 2) in
  shrink c (Mesh.group3d (tiles @ band @ c.landscape))

(* (the playground's course's lap_length) *)
let lap_length (c : t) : float =
  if c.laps = 1 then Track3d.length c.ribbon -. (2. *. Track3d.step c.ribbon)
  else Track3d.length c.ribbon

let far_meshes (c : t) : Mesh.t list =
  Array.fold_right (fun (p : piece) (l : Mesh.t list) -> p.far :: l) c.chunks []

let meshes (c : t) : Mesh.t list =
  Array.fold_right
    (fun (p : piece) (l : Mesh.t list) -> p.mesh :: l)
    c.chunks []
  @ Array.fold_right
      (fun (p : piece) (l : Mesh.t list) -> p.mesh :: l)
      c.tiles []
  @ c.landmarks

(* Course: a circuit of Virtua Racing's, its road, its land and what
 * stands on them, made into meshes at its start.
 *
 * A course is written on the squares of its map -- the course select's
 * maps of the Mega Drive version's manual, traced -- one square 40
 * metres, x to the right and y down the map (+z: a heading of 0 is up
 * the map): the points the middle of the road goes through, each with
 * its height. Track3d walks them into a ribbon; each corner leans into
 * itself, the bank read from how much the course turns there. Then:
 *
 *   the road     a segment every 2 m: kerbs, tarmac, the line, the
 *                grass verges, the rail, the embankment's sides
 *                (or a wall, a bridge's deck, a tunnel), with the
 *                trees and signs along it; cut in chunks of 40
 *                segments, a mesh each
 *   the land     Land's grid, its tiles a mesh each
 *   landmarks    the start (its chequers, gantries, grandstand), the
 *                amusement park: a mesh each
 *   what moves   the Ferris wheel: shapes made again at each frame
 *
 *       chunk k-1     chunk k        chunk k+1
 *   ===|=========|==============|==========|===   the road, its
 *                     ^ the car                   chunks drawn from
 *                                                 the car's, 7 ahead,
 *                                                 and any near the eye
 *
 * Where it stands: the game (Virtua) makes a course at its start, then
 * draws at each frame the chunks and tiles near the eye ([road_near],
 * [land_near]), the landmarks, what moves, and the sky ([sky]); Cars
 * stand on its road.
 *
 * What is ours: TinyVirtuaRacing's courses, written as there (its
 * functions' names, its numbers); one course for now, Big Forest
 * (plan_virtuaracing.md: the other two at stage 3, TinyOutRun's coast
 * later). *)

val road_width : float

(* the land beside the road, below it: the road on its embankment *)
val ground : float

(* the verges' outer edge, where the rail stands *)
val verge : float

(* degrees from [a] to [b], the short way round *)
val angle_diff : float -> float -> float

(* [spin period time]: a turn of [period] seconds, in degrees, at [time]
 * (Playground.spin) *)
val spin : float -> float -> float

(* [turn_at ribbon i]: how much the road turns at segment i, degrees a
 * segment (averaged over a few) *)
val turn_at : Track3d.t -> int -> float

type span_kind = Suspension | Overpass | Tunnel | Wall
type span = { kind : span_kind; s0 : float; s1 : float }

(* [in_span spans kinds s]: the span of one of [kinds] that s is in *)
val in_span : span list -> span_kind list -> float -> span option

(* a chunk of the road, or a tile of the land, and its middle (x, z);
 * far: the chunk seen from far, its scenery simpler (a tile's the
 * same mesh) *)
type piece = { mesh : Mesh.t; far : Mesh.t; mx : float; mz : float }

type t = {
  name : string;
  level : string; (* BEGINNER, MEDIUM, EXPERT *)
  ribbon : Track3d.t;
  laps : int;
  checkpoints : int; (* a lap's, the line one of them, evenly spaced *)
  start_time : int; (* seconds on the clock at the start *)
  bonus : int; (* the seconds each checkpoint adds *)
  rivals : int;
  spans : span list;
  terrain : Land.t;
  grass : Mesh.color * Mesh.color; (* the verges, light and dark *)
  chunks : piece array;
  tiles : piece array;
  landmarks : Mesh.t list;
  landscape : Mesh.shape list; (* the landmarks' shapes (the miniature) *)
  (* what moves, at a time in seconds *)
  animated : float -> Mesh.shape list;
  (* the course's box, x0 x1 z0 z1 (bounds); each segment's turn, nan
   * until asked (turn) *)
  box : float * float * float * float;
  turns : Float.Array.t;
}

val big_forest : unit -> t

(* Bay Bridge, medium: its suspension bridge across the inlet, an
 * overpass, a tunnel, windmills, palms by the sea; Acropolis, the
 * expert's: the ruins on their hill, houses on the mountainside, the
 * dry land, sailing boats in its sea *)
val bay_bridge : unit -> t
val acropolis : unit -> t

(* a lap's length: the course's, or a stage's less its two ends *)
val lap_length : t -> float

(* [road_near c s eye]: the chunks around the car, at [s] along the
 * lap, and any near the eye (an overpass, the other side of a
 * hairpin) *)
val road_near : t -> float -> Vec3.t -> Mesh.t list

(* OPTIMIZATION (lod): a chunk whose middle is farther than [far_away]
 * from the eye drawn by its far mesh (a level of detail: its pines a
 * cone each); old: each chunk whole (lod := false, Virtua's lod=off) *)
val lod : bool ref
val far_away : float

(* [land_near c eye]: the land's tiles within sight of the eye *)
val land_near : t -> Vec3.t -> Mesh.t list

(* [sky c camera]: the sky, the haze and the floor, around the eye;
 * [sky_over camera ground floor]: over a floor of another height and
 * colour (the course select's table) *)
val sky : t -> Camera.t -> Mesh.shape
val sky_over : Camera.t -> float -> Mesh.color -> Mesh.shape

(* The course select's: the course on a table, a tenth of its size,
 * around (0, 0, 0): [miniature c] its land (a quad of two cells), its
 * road a band, its landmarks; [shrink c s] what moves, the same way.
 * [bounds c]: the course's box, x0 x1 z0 z1 (the race's map) *)
val miniature : t -> Mesh.shape
val shrink : t -> Mesh.shape -> Mesh.shape
val bounds : t -> float * float * float * float

(* [turn c i]: turn_at c.ribbon i, kept once asked (the rivals' braking,
 * at each frame) *)
val turn : t -> int -> float

(* every mesh that does not move, for the palette (Palette.add_mesh) *)
val meshes : t -> Mesh.t list

(* the far chunks' meshes (lod): lit by the palette, not counted in it,
 * which is then the same with lod or without *)
val far_meshes : t -> Mesh.t list

(* ix: the author's playground's gamekits/heightmap/Heightmap.ml
 * (docs/plans/plan_virtuaracing.md) *)

(* See Heightmap.mli *)

type t = { size : int; cells : float array; top : float; sea : float }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Making it up *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* every step keeps the low 30 bits: those of a product are the same
 * whether it was computed on 32 bits (the web) or 63 (native) *)
let random (seed : int) (i : int) (j : int) : float =
  let mask = 0x3FFFFFFF in
  let h = ((seed * 0x27d4eb2d) + (i * 0x165667b1) + (j * 0x1b873593)) land mask in
  let h = h lxor (h lsr 15) in
  let h = (h * 0x2c1b3c6d) land mask in
  let h = h lxor (h lsr 12) in
  let h = (h * 0x297a2d39) land mask in
  let h = h lxor (h lsr 15) in
  (float_of_int h /. float_of_int mask *. 2.) -. 1.

(* Diamond-square, on a grid that wraps around (the cell after the last
 * is the first: no edges to special-case), [step] halved each time:
 *
 *    a . . . b       a . . . b        a . e . b
 *    . . . . .       . . . . .        . . . . .
 *    . . . . .  ->   . . m . .   ->   h . m . f
 *    . . . . .       . . . . .        . . . . .
 *    d . . . c       d . . . c        d . g . c
 *                   the diamond:     the square: e, f, g, h, the
 *                   m, a b c d's     average of the 4 points around
 *                   average + bump   (the next squares' m's too) + bump
 *)
let diamond_square (seed : int) (size : int) (roughness : float) : float array =
  let a = Array.make (size * size) 0. in
  let index i j = ((j land (size - 1)) * size) + (i land (size - 1)) in
  let get i j = a.(index i j) in
  let set i j v = a.(index i j) <- v in
  let rec go step bump =
    if step > 1 then begin
      let h = step / 2 in
      for y = 0 to (size / step) - 1 do
        for x = 0 to (size / step) - 1 do
          let i = x * step and j = y * step in
          let corners = get i j +. get (i + step) j +. get i (j + step) +. get (i + step) (j + step) in
          set (i + h) (j + h) ((corners /. 4.) +. (bump *. random seed (i + h) (j + h)))
        done
      done;
      for y = 0 to (size / h) - 1 do
        for x = 0 to (size / h) - 1 do
          (* the edges' middles: an odd number of halves from the corner *)
          if (x + y) land 1 = 1 then begin
            let i = x * h and j = y * h in
            let around = get (i - h) j +. get (i + h) j +. get i (j - h) +. get i (j + h) in
            set i j ((around /. 4.) +. (bump *. random seed i j))
          end
        done
      done;
      go h (bump *. roughness)
    end
  in
  go size 1.;
  a

let generate ~(seed : int) ~(size : int) ~(top : float) ~(roughness : float) : t =
  let a = diamond_square seed size roughness in
  let lo = Array.fold_left Float.min infinity a and hi = Array.fold_left Float.max neg_infinity a in
  (* 0..1, then lowered by the squared distance to the middle (0 there,
   * 1 at an edge's middle): the island *)
  let half = float_of_int size /. 2. in
  let island =
    Array.mapi
      (fun k h ->
        let dx = (float_of_int (k mod size) -. half) /. half and dy = (float_of_int (k / size) -. half) /. half in
        ((h -. lo) /. (hi -. lo)) -. (1.5 *. ((dx *. dx) +. (dy *. dy))))
      a
  in
  let high = Array.fold_left Float.max neg_infinity island in
  let sea = top /. 5. in
  (* 0 (and less) the sea's level, [high] the top *)
  { size; top; sea; cells = Array.map (fun h -> Float.max sea (sea +. (h /. high *. (top -. sea)))) island }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Asking *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let cell (t : t) (i : int) (j : int) : float =
  if i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= t.size || j >= t.size then t.sea else t.cells.((j * t.size) + i)

let height (t : t) (x : float) (y : float) : float =
  let i = Float.to_int (Float.floor x) and j = Float.to_int (Float.floor y) in
  let fx = x -. Float.floor x and fy = y -. Float.floor y in
  let mix a b f = a +. ((b -. a) *. f) in
  mix (mix (cell t i j) (cell t (i + 1) j) fx) (mix (cell t i (j + 1)) (cell t (i + 1) (j + 1)) fx) fy
games/racing/virtua/course/Heightmap.mli
3392
(* A terrain as a grid of heights: an island, made up at startup, and
   its height anywhere.

   Comanche (NovaLogic, 1992) flew a helicopter over hills no game had
   shown before: not polygons, a "height map", a picture whose every
   pixel is a height, and a "color map", its colors, 1024 x 1024 each.
   A terrain as a height map is a grid of numbers, one per cell:

        j                          a cell's height, the ground there;
        ^   0  0  1  2  1          between the cells, the heights
        |   0  1  3  4  2          around, mixed ([height]): a
        |   0  2  6  5  2          surface, not columns
        |   0  1  3  2  1
        +-------------> i

   It can't have a cave or an overhang (one height per point: "2.5D",
   like Doom's sectors, gamekits/sectors/Sectors.mli), but it's compact, and
   everything is quick to ask: the ground under a point, a line of
   sight. Drawn two ways: TinyComanche.ml, Comanche's "Voxel Space"
   (each cell a column, drawn screen column by screen column), and
   TinyComanche3d.ml, the same grid as triangles, the way flight
   simulators drew it.

   The heights are made up ([generate]), by "diamond-square" (Alain
   Fournier, Don Fussell, Loren Carpenter, "Computer Rendering of
   Stochastic Models", CACM 1982; Gavin Miller's "The Definition and
   Rendering of Terrain Maps", SIGGRAPH 1986, named the steps): a coarse
   grid's heights, then the middle of each square and of each edge set
   to its corners' average plus a random bump, the bumps halved (times
   [roughness]) at each finer step. Big bumps make the mountains, small
   ones their slopes: the same look at every scale, a "fractal", like a
   real coast. Comanche's maps were made the same way, then painted.
   Then an island: the heights lowered with the distance to the middle,
   and everything under the sea level flat, the sea.

   The randomness is a hash of the seed and the cell ([random]), not
   Random: the same island for a seed, native and on the web. *)

(* ix: the author's playground's gamekits/heightmap/Heightmap.mli
 * (docs/plans/plan_virtuaracing.md): what mini-virtuaracing asks
 * (the land's rolling, Land), not its colours nor [clear] *)

type t = {
  (* the grid's side, a power of 2: the cells are (i, j), 0 <= i, j < size *)
  size : int;
  (* the heights, row after row: the cell (i, j) at [j * size + i] *)
  cells : float array;
  (* the highest, and the sea's level: no height below it *)
  top : float;
  sea : float;
}

(* [generate ~seed ~size ~top ~roughness]: an island of [size] x [size]
 * cells, its heights from [sea] to [top] (the sea a fifth of the way
 * up). [roughness], 0 to 1: how much of a step's bumps the next finer
 * step keeps (0.5: half, the usual; more: rougher). *)
val generate : seed:int -> size:int -> top:float -> roughness:float -> t

(* the cell's height; outside the grid, the sea's *)
val cell : t -> int -> int -> float

(* [height t x y]: the ground at the point (x, y), a cell a unit wide:
 * the four cells around mixed by how near each is ("bilinear"), e.g.
 * halfway between a cell at 0 and its neighbor at 4, 2 *)
val height : t -> float -> float -> float

(* [random seed i j]: between -1 and 1, always the same for the same
 * arguments, on every platform (a hash, computed on 30 bits: js_of_ocaml's
 * ints have 32, native ones 63) *)
val random : int -> int -> int -> float

        rgb 78 150 62;
        rgb 70 140 58;
        rgb 88 160 68;
        rgb 96 152 60;
        rgb 66 132 60;
      ];
    mid = [ rgb 50 115 52; rgb 58 124 50; rgb 44 104 50; rgb 70 120 56 ];
    rock =
      [ rgb 130 124 112; rgb 118 112 104; rgb 142 134 118; rgb 110 106 100 ];
    snow = true;
  }

let dry : palette =
  {
    low =
      [
        rgb 160 150 88;
        rgb 150 140 80;
        rgb 170 158 96;
        rgb 144 138 86;
        rgb 164 146 84;
      ];
    mid = [ rgb 150 126 80; rgb 138 118 76; rgb 160 134 86; rgb 128 120 80 ];
    rock =
      [ rgb 176 150 116; rgb 160 138 108; rgb 186 162 124; rgb 150 130 104 ];
    snow = false;
  }

type t = {
  x0 : float;
  z0 : float;
  cell : float;
  nx : int;
  nz : int;
  heights : float array;
  wet : bool array;
  palette : palette;
}

type sample = { sx : float; sz : float; sy : float; lifted : bool }

let inside (poly : (float * float) list) ((x, z) : float * float) : bool =
  let a = Array.of_list poly in
  let n = Array.length a in
  let c = ref false in
  for i = 0 to n - 1 do
    let x1, z1 = a.(i) and x2, z2 = a.((i + 1) mod n) in
    if z1 > z <> (z2 > z) && x < x1 +. ((z -. z1) /. (z2 -. z1) *. (x2 -. x1))
    then c := not !c
  done;
  !c

let smoothstep (a : float) (b : float) (x : float) : float =
  let t = Float.max 0. (Float.min 1. ((x -. a) /. (b -. a))) in
  t *. t *. (3. -. (2. *. t))

let rolling = Heightmap.generate ~seed:7 ~size:32 ~top:1. ~roughness:0.55

let natural (hills : hill list) (x : float) (z : float) : float =
  let bump (h : hill) : float =
    let d = Float.hypot (x -. h.hx) (z -. h.hz) in
    if d <= h.top then h.height
    else if d >= h.radius then 0.
    else
      h.height
      *. (0.5 +. (0.5 *. cos (Float.pi *. (d -. h.top) /. (h.radius -. h.top))))
  in
  let hills =
    List.fold_left (fun (m : float) (h : hill) -> Float.max m (bump h)) 0. hills
  in
  let rx = Float.rem (Float.abs (x /. 50.)) 31.
  and rz = Float.rem (Float.abs (z /. 50.)) 31. in
  hills +. (14. *. Float.max 0. (Heightmap.height rolling rx rz -. 0.2))

(* The road's samples are searched for the nearest one to each point of
 * the grid. *)
let make (samples : sample array) (hills : hill list)
    (sea : (float * float) list list) (palette : palette) (ground : float)
    (verge : float) : t =
  let x0, x1, z0, z1 =
    Array.fold_left
      (fun ((a, b, c, d) : float * float * float * float) (s : sample) ->
        (Float.min a s.sx, Float.max b s.sx, Float.min c s.sz, Float.max d s.sz))
      (infinity, neg_infinity, infinity, neg_infinity)
      samples
  in
  let margin = 600. and cell = 32. in
  let x0 = x0 -. margin and z0 = z0 -. margin in
  let nx = int_of_float ((x1 -. x0 +. margin) /. cell) + 1
  and nz = int_of_float ((z1 -. z0 +. margin) /. cell) + 1 in
  let point (k : int) : float * float =
    ( x0 +. (float_of_int (k mod (nx + 1)) *. cell),
      z0 +. (float_of_int (k / (nx + 1)) *. cell) )
  in
  let wet =
    Array.init
      ((nx + 1) * (nz + 1))
      (fun (k : int) ->
        List.exists (fun (w : (float * float) list) -> inside w (point k)) sea)
  in
  (* OPTIMIZATION (buckets): the samples in squares of [size] m, and a
   * point's nearest searched in rings of squares around its own, until
   * none left can be nearer (before ring r, those left are more than
   * r - 1 squares away); the first of equals, as the whole array's
   * walk: the same sample. Every point against every sample was a
   * sixth of mini-virtuaracing's start on arm.
   * old: Array.iter over the samples, for each point *)
  let size = 64. in
  let bx0, bz0 =
    Array.fold_left
      (fun ((a, b) : float * float) (s : sample) ->
        (Float.min a s.sx, Float.min b s.sz))
      (infinity, infinity) samples
  in
  let col (v : float) (o : float) : int =
    int_of_float (Float.floor ((v -. o) /. size))
  in
  let bnx =
    1
    + Array.fold_left
        (fun (m : int) (s : sample) -> max m (col s.sx bx0))
        0 samples
  and bnz =
    1
    + Array.fold_left
        (fun (m : int) (s : sample) -> max m (col s.sz bz0))
        0 samples
  in
  let buckets = Array.make (bnx * bnz) [] in
  for i = Array.length samples - 1 downto 0 do
    let s = samples.(i) in
    let b = (col s.sz bz0 * bnx) + col s.sx bx0 in
    buckets.(b) <- i :: buckets.(b)
  done;
  let height (k : int) : float =
    let x, z = point k in
    let best = ref infinity and first = ref max_int in
    let ci = col x bx0 and cj = col z bz0 in
    let visit (i : int) (j : int) : unit =
      if i >= 0 && i < bnx && j >= 0 && j < bnz then
        List.iter
          (fun (n : int) ->
            let s = samples.(n) in
            let d = Float.hypot (x -. s.sx) (z -. s.sz) in
            if d < !best || (d = !best && n < !first) then begin
              best := d;
              first := n
            end)
          buckets.((j * bnx) + i)
    in
    let far = max (max ci (bnx - 1 - ci)) (max cj (bnz - 1 - cj)) in
    let r = ref 0 in
    while !r <= far && not (!best < float_of_int (!r - 1) *. size) do
      let r' = !r in
      for i = ci - r' to ci + r' do
        visit i (cj - r');
        if r' > 0 then visit i (cj + r')
      done;
      for j = cj - r' + 1 to cj + r' - 1 do
        visit (ci - r') j;
        visit (ci + r') j
      done;
      incr r
    done;
    let nearest = samples.(!first) in
    let own = if wet.(k) then -8. else natural hills x z in
    if nearest.lifted then own
    else
      let t = smoothstep (verge +. 10.) (verge +. 60.) !best in
      let level = nearest.sy +. ground in
      level +. ((own -. level) *. t)
  in
  let heights =
    Array.init
      ((nx + 1) * (nz + 1))
      (fun (k : int) ->
        (* a hair of noise, so that no two facets of a slope are lit
         * alike *)
        height k
        +. (1.2 *. (Scenery.jitter (k mod (nx + 1)) ((k / (nx + 1)) + 7) -. 0.5)))
  in
  { x0; z0; cell; nx; nz; heights; wet; palette }

let clamp_index (l : t) (i : int) (j : int) : int =
  (max 0 (min l.nz j) * (l.nx + 1)) + max 0 (min l.nx i)

let at (l : t) (i : int) (j : int) : float = l.heights.(clamp_index l i j)

let height (l : t) (x : float) (z : float) : float =
  let fx = (x -. l.x0) /. l.cell and fz = (z -. l.z0) /. l.cell in
  let i = int_of_float (Float.floor fx) and j = int_of_float (Float.floor fz) in
  let u = fx -. Float.floor fx and v = fz -. Float.floor fz in
  let mix (a : float) (b : float) (f : float) : float = a +. ((b -. a) *. f) in
  mix
    (mix (at l i j) (at l (i + 1) j) u)
    (mix (at l i (j + 1)) (at l (i + 1) (j + 1)) u)
    v

let facet_color (l : t) (water : float) (wet : bool) (h : float) (k : int) :
    Mesh.color =
  let pick (colors : Mesh.color list) : Mesh.color =
    List.nth colors (k mod List.length colors)
  in
  if wet && h < water +. 1.5 then
    rgb 200 190 140 (* the beach, and the sand under the sea *)
  else if h < 22. then pick l.palette.low
  else if h < 55. then pick l.palette.mid
  else if h < 95. || not l.palette.snow then pick l.palette.rock
  else if k mod 3 = 0 then rgb 225 228 235
  else rgb 244 244 248

(* a facet's hash, from its cell and which of the two it is *)
let hash (i : int) (j : int) (k : int) : int =
  int_of_float ((Heightmap.random (3 + k) i j +. 1.) *. 5000.)

(* the sea over the wet cells, a quad each, flat (its shore is where the
 * land's facets come out of it) *)
let tiles (l : t) (water : float) (stride : int) :
    ((float * float) * Mesh.shape) list =
  let p (i : int) (j : int) : Vec3.t =
    ( l.x0 +. (float_of_int i *. l.cell),
      at l i j,
      l.z0 +. (float_of_int j *. l.cell) )
  in
  let quad (i : int) (j : int) : Mesh.shape list =
    let i' = i + stride and j' = j + stride in
    let wet =
      List.exists
        (fun ((i, j) : int * int) -> l.wet.(clamp_index l i j))
        [ (i, j); (i', j); (i, j'); (i', j') ]
    in
    let color (k : int) ((_, y1, _) : Vec3.t) ((_, y2, _) : Vec3.t)
        ((_, y3, _) : Vec3.t) : Mesh.color =
      facet_color l water wet ((y1 +. y2 +. y3) /. 3.) (hash i j k)
    in
    let a = p i j and b = p i' j' and c = p i' j and d = p i j' in
    let flat ((x, _, z) : Vec3.t) : Vec3.t = (x, water, z) in
    (* counterclockwise seen from above: faces up *)
    [
      Mesh.polygon3d (color 0 a b c) [ a; b; c ];
      Mesh.polygon3d (color 1 a d b) [ a; d; b ];
    ]
    @
    if wet then
      [ Mesh.polygon3d (rgb 50 110 190) [ flat a; flat d; flat b; flat c ] ]
    else []
  in
  let tile = 8 * stride in
  List.concat
    (List.init
       ((l.nz / tile) + 1)
       (fun (tj : int) ->
         List.filter_map
           (fun (ti : int) ->
             let quads =
               List.concat
                 (List.init 8 (fun (a : int) ->
                      List.concat
                        (List.init 8 (fun (b : int) ->
                             let i = (ti * tile) + (b * stride)
                             and j = (tj * tile) + (a * stride) in
                             if i + stride <= l.nx && j + stride <= l.nz then
                               quad i j
                             else []))))
             in
             if quads = [] then None
             else
               let cx =
                 l.x0
                 +. (float_of_int (ti * tile) +. (float_of_int tile /. 2.))
                    *. l.cell
               and cz =
                 l.z0
                 +. (float_of_int (tj * tile) +. (float_of_int tile /. 2.))
                    *. l.cell
               in
               Some ((cx, cz), Mesh.group3d quads))
           (List.init ((l.nx / tile) + 1) (fun (i : int) -> i))))
games/racing/virtua/course/Land.mli

(* Land: the ground around a course, a grid of heights drawn as two
 * triangles a cell, each one flat colour picked by its height and a
 * hash, then lit by the sun by its slope: hundreds of facets, no two
 * alike, which is what Virtua Racing's hills looked like.
 *
 * A height is the course's own hills and mountains (smooth bumps, some
 * with a flat top), the rolling of a fractal (Heightmap, diamond-square)
 * on top, the sea sunk -- and, near the road, the road's own height,
 * the land blending from it to its own over 50 meters: the road runs
 * along embankments and through cuttings, never over a hole or under a
 * hill (but where it is meant to: a bridge, a tunnel).
 *
 *        cutting                              embankment
 *   \                  road          _____________________
 *    \___ ___________==========_____/       road            \
 *        (the band: the land takes the road's height, then its own)
 *
 * The grid is cut in tiles of 8 by 8 cells, a mesh each with its
 * middle: the game draws the tiles near the eye, and the renderer
 * leaves out those outside the view (Render).
 *
 * Where it stands: Course makes a course's land from its road; Course
 * and the cars ask [height] to stand things on it.
 *
 * What is ours: the playground's TinyVirtuaRacing's, but for the hash
 * that picks a facet's colour (Heightmap.random, the same by both
 * compilers). *)

(* a hill at (x, y) on the map in metres, [radius] and [top] (a flat
 * top's radius) in metres too, [height] *)
type hill = { hx : float; hz : float; radius : float; height : float; top : float }

(* the land's colours: the lowlands', the higher slopes', the rock's;
 * and snow on the tops or not *)
type palette = {
  low : Mesh.color list;
  mid : Mesh.color list;
  rock : Mesh.color list;
  snow : bool;
}

val green : palette

(* the dry land's, Acropolis': yellows and browns, no snow *)
val dry : palette

type t = {
  x0 : float;
  z0 : float;
  cell : float;
  nx : int;
  nz : int;
  (* the corners' heights, (nx + 1) by (nz + 1), row after row *)
  heights : float array;
  (* a corner under the sea *)
  wet : bool array;
  palette : palette;
}

(* the road's samples: where (x, z), how high, and lifted off the land
 * (a bridge, a tunnel) or not *)
type sample = { sx : float; sz : float; sy : float; lifted : bool }

(* [make samples hills sea palette ground verge]: the grid over the
 * road's samples and a margin around; the land [ground] below the
 * road near it, blending to its own from [verge] *)
val make :
  sample array -> hill list -> (float * float) list list -> palette -> float -> float -> t

(* [height l x z]: the land at (x, z), its cell's four corners mixed *)
val height : t -> float -> float -> float

(* [tiles l water stride]: the land's tiles of 8 by 8 quads, each with
 * its middle (x, z); a quad [stride] cells wide (1; 2 for the course
 * select's miniature); the sea at [water] over the wet cells *)
val tiles : t -> float -> int -> ((float * float) * Mesh.shape) list

(* a point in a polygon (crossing number): the sea *)
val inside : (float * float) list -> float * float -> bool

(* See Scenery.mli *)

(* ix: the author's playground's games/racing/TinyVirtuaRacing.ml, its
 * "Shapes made of polygons", "The scenery" and "The landmarks" (Big
 * Forest's) *)

let rgb = Mesh.rgb
let polygon3d = Mesh.polygon3d
let group3d = Mesh.group3d
let box = Mesh.box
let move3d = Mesh.move3d
let move_y3d = Mesh.move_y3d
let rotate3d = Mesh.rotate3d

let jitter (i : int) (k : int) : float =
  (Heightmap.random 1 i k +. 1.) /. 2.0001

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Shapes made of polygons *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let loft (color : Mesh.color) (a : (float * float) list)
    (b : (float * float) list) (z0 : float) (z1 : float) : Mesh.shape =
  let a = Array.of_list a and b = Array.of_list b in
  let n = Array.length a in
  let at ((x, y) : float * float) (z : float) : Vec3.t = (x, y, z) in
  let side (i : int) : Mesh.shape =
    let j = (i + 1) mod n in
    polygon3d color [ at a.(i) z0; at a.(j) z0; at b.(j) z1; at b.(i) z1 ]
  in
  group3d
    (polygon3d color
       (List.map (fun (p : float * float) -> at p z1) (Array.to_list b))
    :: polygon3d color
         (List.rev_map (fun (p : float * float) -> at p z0) (Array.to_list a))
    :: List.init n side)

let ring (sides : int) (r : float) : (float * float) list =
  List.init sides (fun (k : int) ->
      let a = 2. *. Float.pi *. float_of_int k /. float_of_int sides in
      (r *. cos a, r *. sin a))

let wheel (color : Mesh.color) (sides : int) (r : float) (w : float) :
    Mesh.shape =
  loft color (ring sides r) (ring sides r) (-.w /. 2.) (w /. 2.)
  |> rotate3d 0. 90. 0.

(* The base points go round counterclockwise seen from above, so
 * [b_k; apex; b_k+1] faces out. *)
let cone (seed : int) (snow : float) (color : Mesh.color) (sides : int)
    (r : float) (h : float) : Mesh.shape =
  let base =
    Array.init sides (fun (k : int) ->
        let a =
          2. *. Float.pi
          *. (float_of_int k +. (0.4 *. jitter seed k))
          /. float_of_int sides
        in
        let r = r *. (0.75 +. (0.4 *. jitter seed (k + 50))) in
        (r *. cos a, 0., r *. sin a))
  in
  let apex =
    ((jitter seed 99 -. 0.5) *. r *. 0.3, h, (jitter seed 98 -. 0.5) *. r *. 0.3)
  in
  let mix ((x1, y1, z1) : Vec3.t) ((x2, y2, z2) : Vec3.t) (f : float) : Vec3.t =
    (x1 +. ((x2 -. x1) *. f), y1 +. ((y2 -. y1) *. f), z1 +. ((z2 -. z1) *. f))
  in
  group3d
    (List.concat
       (List.init sides (fun (k : int) ->
            let b0 = base.(k) and b1 = base.((k + 1) mod sides) in
            if snow = 0. then [ polygon3d color [ b0; apex; b1 ] ]
            else
              let m0 = mix b0 apex (1. -. snow)
              and m1 = mix b1 apex (1. -. snow) in
              [
                polygon3d color [ b0; m0; m1; b1 ];
                polygon3d (rgb 245 245 250) [ m0; apex; m1 ];
              ])))

let column (color : Mesh.color) (sides : int) (r : float) (h : float) :
    Mesh.shape =
  let base =
    Array.of_list
      (List.map (fun ((x, z) : float * float) -> (x, 0., z)) (ring sides r))
  in
  group3d
    (polygon3d color
       (List.rev_map
          (fun ((x, _, z) : Vec3.t) -> (x, h, z))
          (Array.to_list base))
    :: List.init sides (fun (k : int) ->
        let x0, _, z0 = base.(k) and x1, _, z1 = base.((k + 1) mod sides) in
        polygon3d color [ (x0, 0., z0); (x0, h, z0); (x1, h, z1); (x1, 0., z1) ])
    )

(* a roof over a house, the triangle of its gable lofted along its depth *)
let roof (color : Mesh.color) (w : float) (h : float) (d : float) : Mesh.shape =
  let gable = [ (-.w /. 2., 0.); (w /. 2., 0.); (0., h) ] in
  loft color gable gable (-.d /. 2.) (d /. 2.)

(* The scenery *)

let pine (k : int) : Mesh.shape =
  let green = if k mod 2 = 0 then rgb 30 100 45 else rgb 40 115 50 in
  group3d
    [
      box (rgb 100 65 30) 0.5 1.6 0.5 |> move_y3d 0.8;
      cone k 0. green 6 2.2 4. |> move_y3d 1.4;
      cone (k + 7) 0. green 5 1.6 3.4 |> move_y3d 3.6;
    ]

let pine_far (k : int) : Mesh.shape =
  let green = if k mod 2 = 0 then rgb 30 100 45 else rgb 40 115 50 in
  cone k 0. green 5 2.2 5.6 |> move_y3d 1.4

(* a palm: its trunk leaning, six fronds drooping from the top (one
 * face thick: seen from both sides) *)
let palm (k : int) : Mesh.shape =
  let lean = 8. +. (10. *. jitter k 3) in
  let frond (a : float) : Mesh.shape =
    let r = a *. Float.pi /. 180. in
    let c = cos r and s = sin r in
    Mesh.two_sided
      (polygon3d (rgb 60 150 60)
         [
           (0., 7., 0.);
           ((3.2 *. c) -. (0.6 *. s), 6.2, (3.2 *. s) +. (0.6 *. c));
           (4. *. c, 5.2, 4. *. s);
         ])
  in
  group3d
    (column (rgb 140 100 60) 5 0.3 7.
    :: List.init 6 (fun (i : int) ->
        frond ((60. *. float_of_int i) +. (30. *. jitter k i))))
  |> rotate3d lean (360. *. jitter k 4) 0.

let cypress (k : int) : Mesh.shape =
  group3d [ cone k 0. (rgb 55 115 55) 5 1.1 7. ]

let rock (k : int) : Mesh.shape = cone k 0. (rgb 150 130 105) 5 2.2 1.8

let sign : Mesh.shape =
  group3d
    [
      box (rgb 90 90 90) 0.3 2. 0.3 |> move3d (-1.5) 1. 0.;
      box (rgb 90 90 90) 0.3 2. 0.3 |> move3d 1.5 1. 0.;
      box Mesh.white 4. 1.4 0.3 |> move_y3d 2.6;
      box Mesh.red 3.4 0.5 0.35 |> move_y3d 2.6;
    ]

let chevron : Mesh.shape =
  group3d
    [
      box (rgb 60 60 60) 0.2 1.2 0.2 |> move_y3d 0.6;
      box (rgb 250 210 0) 1.6 1. 0.2 |> move_y3d 1.6;
      box Mesh.black 0.5 1.02 0.22 |> move_y3d 1.6;
    ]

(* The landmarks *)
