(* five steps of spectators (a stripe of colours each) under a roof *)
let grandstand (ground : float) : Mesh.shape =
  let len = 36. in
  let crowd =
    [|
      rgb 220 60 60;
      rgb 240 200 40;
      rgb 60 110 220;
      rgb 240 240 240;
      rgb 60 170 90;
    |]
  in
  let steps =
    List.concat
      (List.init 5 (fun (k : int) ->
           let y = 1. +. (1.2 *. float_of_int k)
           and x = -2. -. (2.2 *. float_of_int k) in
           [
             box (rgb 170 170 170) 2.2 (y -. ground) len
             |> move3d x ((y +. ground) /. 2.) 0.;
             box crowd.(k) 1.2 0.5 (len -. 1.)
             |> move3d (x +. 0.4) (y +. 0.25) 0.;
           ]))
  in
  group3d
    (steps
    @ [
        box (rgb 120 120 130) 0.4 8. 0.4 |> move3d (-12.) 4. (-.len /. 2.);
        box (rgb 120 120 130) 0.4 8. 0.4 |> move3d (-12.) 4. (len /. 2.);
        box (rgb 40 60 140) 13. 0.4 (len +. 2.)
        |> rotate3d 0. 0. (-8.) |> move3d (-6.) 8.4 0.;
      ])

let gantry (color : Mesh.color) (w : float) : Mesh.shape =
  group3d
    [
      box (rgb 230 230 230) 1. 7. 1. |> move3d (-.w -. 1.) 3.5 0.;
      box (rgb 230 230 230) 1. 7. 1. |> move3d (w +. 1.) 3.5 0.;
      box color ((2. *. w) +. 3.) 1.6 0.6 |> move_y3d 7.;
      box (rgb 250 60 40) 1. 0.6 0.7 |> move3d (-2.) 7. 0.;
      box (rgb 250 60 40) 1. 0.6 0.7 |> move3d 2. 7. 0.;
    ]

(* its rim, spokes and cars are polygons in the wheel's plane (x, y),
 * on two A-frames *)
let ferris_wheel (angle : float) : Mesh.shape =
  let r = 20. and hub = 23. and n = 16 in
  let point (k : int) (rr : float) : float * float =
    let a =
      (angle +. (360. *. float_of_int k /. float_of_int n)) *. Float.pi /. 180.
    in
    (rr *. cos a, hub +. (rr *. sin a))
  in
  let quad (color : Mesh.color) ((x1, y1) : float * float)
      ((x2, y2) : float * float) ((x3, y3) : float * float)
      ((x4, y4) : float * float) (z : float) : Mesh.shape =
    polygon3d color [ (x1, y1, z); (x2, y2, z); (x3, y3, z); (x4, y4, z) ]
  in
  let rim =
    List.concat
      (List.init n (fun (k : int) ->
           List.map
             (fun (z : float) ->
               quad (rgb 240 240 240) (point k r)
                 (point (k + 1) r)
                 (point (k + 1) (r -. 0.8))
                 (point k (r -. 0.8))
                 z)
             [ -1.2; 1.2 ]))
  in
  let spokes =
    List.init n (fun (k : int) ->
        let x, y = point k r
        and a =
          (angle +. (360. *. float_of_int k /. float_of_int n))
          *. Float.pi /. 180.
        in
        let dx = -0.2 *. sin a and dy = 0.2 *. cos a in
        quad (rgb 200 200 210)
          (-.dx, hub -. dy)
          (dx, hub +. dy)
          (x +. dx, y +. dy)
          (x -. dx, y -. dy)
          0.)
  in
  let colors = Array.of_list Mesh.rainbow in
  let cars =
    List.init n (fun (k : int) ->
        let x, y = point k r in
        box colors.(k mod Array.length colors) 1.8 1.6 1.6
        |> move3d x (y -. 1.4) 0.)
  in
  let leg (x : float) (z : float) : Mesh.shape =
    polygon3d (rgb 150 150 160)
      [ (x -. 0.6, 0., z); (x +. 0.6, 0., z); (0.3, hub, z); (-0.3, hub, z) ]
  in
  (* (the rim, the spokes and the legs one face thick: seen from both
   * sides, Mesh.two_sided) *)
  group3d
    (List.map Mesh.two_sided rim
    @ List.map Mesh.two_sided spokes
    @ cars
    @ List.map Mesh.two_sided
        [ leg (-9.) (-2.); leg 9. (-2.); leg (-9.) 2.; leg 9. 2. ]
    @ [ box (rgb 90 90 100) 1.2 1.2 5. |> move_y3d hub ])

(* a track on stilts, a loop the loop in the middle (a ring of short
 * boxes), the cars resting at the station *)
let roller_coaster : Mesh.shape =
  let rail = rgb 240 220 40 and stilt = rgb 200 200 200 in
  let loop =
    List.init 20 (fun (k : int) ->
        let a = 18. *. float_of_int k in
        let r = a *. Float.pi /. 180. in
        box rail 1.2 0.4 2. |> rotate3d a 0. 0.
        |> move3d 0. (9. +. (8. *. cos r)) (8. *. sin r))
  in
  let run =
    List.init 12 (fun (k : int) ->
        let z = -30. +. (5. *. float_of_int k)
        and y = 4. +. (3. *. sin (float_of_int k *. 0.9)) in
        [
          box rail 1.2 0.4 5. |> move3d 0. y z;
          box stilt 0.3 y 0.3 |> move3d 0. (y /. 2.) z;

  in
  group3d
    (loop @ List.concat run
    @ List.init 3 (fun (k : int) ->
        box (rgb 220 40 40) 1.4 1. 1.8
        |> move3d 0. 4.9 (-20. +. (2. *. float_of_int k))))

games/racing/virtua/course/Scenery.mli

(* Scenery: the solids the courses are built of, and the things that
 * stand along them: pines, signs, the start's gantry and grandstand,
 * the amusement park's Ferris wheel and roller coaster.
 *
 * Each is a few flat faces, wound counterclockwise as seen from
 * outside (Mesh): flat shading lights a face from its normal, and a
 * face wound backwards is lit from inside, black in the sun. The
 * solids are made from sections ([loft]: a section at one z, another
 * at the next, the sides between):
 *
 *        b (at z1)                 a car's nose: a small section at
 *       +-----+                    its tip, a larger one at the tub;
 *      /|    /|                    a wheel: the same octagon twice
 *     +-----+ |   the sides, a
 *     | +---|-+   quad each, and
 *     |/    |/    the two ends
 *     +-----+
 *       a (at z0)
 *
 * Virtua Racing's courses were famous for these landmarks, each a heap
 * of polygons no sprite game could have turned around.
 *
 * Where it stands: Course places them along the road and on the land;
 * Cars builds the cars with [loft] and [wheel].
 *
 * What is ours: the playground's TinyVirtuaRacing's shapes, those Big
 * Forest has (Bay Bridge's and Acropolis' come with them, at
 * plan_virtuaracing.md's stage 3); [jitter] a hash of our own
 * (Heightmap.random), not OCaml's Hashtbl.hash, whose numbers are not
 * the same by mini-ml: so the trees are not where the playground's
 * are. *)

(* [jitter i k]: a number in [0, 1) for the k-th thing at i: the
 * scenery is the same at every run *)
val jitter : int -> int -> float

(* [loft color a b z0 z1]: a solid from the section [a] at [z0] to the
 * section [b] at [z1] (z1 > z0), both lists of (x, y), the same length,
 * counterclockwise seen from +z *)
val loft :
  Mesh.color -> (float * float) list -> (float * float) list -> float -> float ->
  Mesh.shape

(* [ring sides r]: a regular polygon, counterclockwise *)
val ring : int -> float -> (float * float) list

(* [wheel color sides r w]: [sides] around, [w] wide, its axle along x *)
val wheel : Mesh.color -> int -> float -> float -> Mesh.shape

(* [cone seed snow color sides r h]: a peak on the ground, its facets
 * each one flat colour; the top [snow] of its height (0: none) white *)
val cone : int -> float -> Mesh.color -> int -> float -> float -> Mesh.shape

(* a pine, the k-th: a trunk and two cones *)
val pine : int -> Mesh.shape

(* the k-th pine seen from far (Course's far chunks): one cone of five
 * faces, as tall, where the pine has seventeen *)
val pine_far : int -> Mesh.shape

(* [column color sides r h]: a column of [sides] faces round, its top
 * capped; [roof color w h d]: a gable roof lofted along its depth *)
val column : Mesh.color -> int -> float -> float -> Mesh.shape
val roof : Mesh.color -> float -> float -> float -> Mesh.shape

(* Bay Bridge's palms (by the sea), Acropolis' cypresses and rocks; [k]
 * their seed (Scenery.jitter) *)
val palm : int -> Mesh.shape
val cypress : int -> Mesh.shape
val rock : int -> Mesh.shape

(* a sign by the road, every 150 segments *)
val sign : Mesh.shape

(* a chevron board on the outside of a sharp curve *)
val chevron : Mesh.shape

(* the grandstand at the start, along z, the road on its +x side; its
 * steps down to [ground], the land beside the road *)
val grandstand : float -> Mesh.shape

(* [gantry color half]: over a road [half] wide on each side: the
 * start's (blue), a checkpoint's (yellow) *)
val gantry : Mesh.color -> float -> Mesh.shape

(* [ferris_wheel angle]: turned [angle] degrees, its cars hanging
 * level *)
val ferris_wheel : float -> Mesh.shape

val roller_coaster : Mesh.shape

(* Bay Bridge's windmills, their sails at [angle]; its lighthouse *)
val windmill : float -> Mesh.shape
val lighthouse : Mesh.shape

(* Acropolis': a sailing boat in its sea, the ruins on their hill, a
 * house of the mountainside ([k] its seed) *)
val sailboat : Mesh.shape
val temple : Mesh.shape
val house : int -> Mesh.shape
games/racing/virtua/course/Track3d.ml
11616
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* ix: the author's playground's gamekits/racing/3d/Track3d.ml
 * (docs/plans/plan_virtuaracing.md) *)

(* See Track3d.mli *)

type control = { x : float; y : float; z : float; width : float; bank : float }

let control ~(y : float) ~(width : float) ~(bank : float) (x : float) (z : float) : control =
  { x; y; z; width; bank }

type place = { px : float; py : float; pz : float; heading : float; width : float; bank : float }

(* The samples, one every [step] along the middle. A circuit is
 * [closed]: the loop runs from the last sample back to the first, and
 * every distance wraps. A stage is not: it has one segment fewer than
 * it has samples (the last one leads nowhere), and a distance past its
 * end stays at its end. *)
type t = { step : float; points : place array; closed : bool }

let segments (t : t) : int = if t.closed then Array.length t.points else Array.length t.points - 1
let step (t : t) : float = t.step
let length (t : t) : float = float_of_int (segments t) *. t.step

let radians (d : float) : float = d *. Float.pi /. 180.

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Building *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* one coordinate of the Catmull-Rom spline through p0..p3, at [u] in
 * [0, 1] between p1 and p2: the curve passes through p1 and p2, and
 * leaves each of them along the line between its neighbors *)
let catmull (p0 : float) (p1 : float) (p2 : float) (p3 : float) (u : float) : float =
  let u2 = u *. u in
  let u3 = u2 *. u in
  0.5
  *. ((2. *. p1)
     +. ((p2 -. p0) *. u)
     +. (((2. *. p0) -. (5. *. p1) +. (4. *. p2) -. p3) *. u2)
     +. ((-.p0 +. (3. *. p1) -. (3. *. p2) +. p3) *. u3))

(* the fine polyline through the controls, [per] points between each
 * pair: the spline for the middle of the road, the width and the lean
 * carried along it (eased the same way, so a course can change them
 * anywhere it puts a control point) *)
let fine (controls : control array) (per : int) : (float * float * float * float * float) array =
  let n = Array.length controls in
  let get (i : int) : control = controls.(((i mod n) + n) mod n) in
  Array.init (n * per) (fun k ->
      let i = k / per and u = float_of_int (k mod per) /. float_of_int per in
      let a = get (i - 1) and b = get i and c = get (i + 1) and d = get (i + 2) in
      ( catmull a.x b.x c.x d.x u,
        catmull a.y b.y c.y d.y u,
        catmull a.z b.z c.z d.z u,
        catmull a.width b.width c.width d.width u,
        catmull a.bank b.bank c.bank d.bank u ))

let build (step : float) (controls : control list) : t =
  let controls = Array.of_list controls in
  if Array.length controls < 4 then invalid_arg "Track3d.build: at least four control points";
  let fine = fine controls 24 in
  let n = Array.length fine in
  let point (i : int) = fine.(((i mod n) + n) mod n) in
  let dist (i : int) (j : int) : float =
    let x1, _, z1, _, _ = point i and x2, _, z2, _, _ = point j in
    Float.hypot (x2 -. x1) (z2 -. z1)
  in
  (* the spline's own points are not evenly spaced (it goes faster
   * through the straights), so walk it and drop a sample every [step]:
   * then "how far along" is a distance, and every quad is the same
   * length *)
  let total = ref 0. in
  for i = 0 to n - 1 do
    total := !total +. dist i (i + 1)
  done;
  let count = max 4 (int_of_float (Float.round (!total /. step))) in
  let step = !total /. float_of_int count in
  let samples = Array.make count (0., 0., 0., 0., 0.) in
  let i = ref 0 and walked = ref 0. in
  for k = 0 to count - 1 do
    let wanted = float_of_int k *. step in
    while !walked +. dist !i (!i + 1) < wanted && !i < n do
      walked := !walked +. dist !i (!i + 1);
      incr i
    done;
    let x1, y1, z1, w1, b1 = point !i and x2, y2, z2, w2, b2 = point (!i + 1) in
    let leg = dist !i (!i + 1) in
    let f = if leg = 0. then 0. else (wanted -. !walked) /. leg in
    samples.(k) <-
      ( x1 +. ((x2 -. x1) *. f),
        y1 +. ((y2 -. y1) *. f),
        z1 +. ((z2 -. z1) *. f),
        w1 +. ((w2 -. w1) *. f),
        b1 +. ((b2 -. b1) *. f) )
  done;
  let points =
    Array.init count (fun k ->
        let x, y, z, width, bank = samples.(k) in
        let nx, _, nz, _, _ = samples.((k + 1) mod count) in
        (* the heading of the segment leaving this sample: 0 towards
         * -z, 90 towards +x (Camera3d's) *)
        let heading = atan2 (nx -. x) (-.(nz -. z)) *. 180. /. Float.pi in
        { px = x; py = y; pz = z; heading; width; bank })
  in
  { step; points; closed = true }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Places *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* degrees from [a] to [b], the short way: headings wrap, and mixing
 * 359 with 1 must give 0, not 180 *)
let angle_diff (a : float) (b : float) : float = Float.rem (Float.rem (b -. a +. 180.) 360. +. 360.) 360. -. 180.

let at (t : t) (s : float) : place =
  let n = Array.length t.points in
  let total = length t in
  (* a circuit wraps round; a stage stops at its end *)
  let s =
    if t.closed then Float.rem (Float.rem s total +. total) total
    else Float.max 0. (Float.min (total -. 0.001) s)
  in
  let k = int_of_float (s /. t.step) in
  let k = max 0 (min (segments t - 1) k) in
  let f = (s -. (float_of_int k *. t.step)) /. t.step in
  let a = t.points.(k) and b = t.points.((k + 1) mod n) in
  let mix (u : float) (v : float) : float = u +. ((v -. u) *. f) in
  { px = mix a.px b.px;
    py = mix a.py b.py;
    pz = mix a.pz b.pz;
    heading = a.heading +. (angle_diff a.heading b.heading *. f);
    width = mix a.width b.width;
    bank = mix a.bank b.bank }

let forward (t : t) (s : float) : float * float =
  let p = at t s in
  (sin (radians p.heading), -.cos (radians p.heading))

(* the way across the road at a place: to the right of the way it is
 * driven, tilted by the lean -- so the outside of a banked corner
 * rises, and a thing standing at an offset stands on the slope *)
let across_at (p : place) (offset : float) : float * float * float =
  let a = radians p.heading and b = radians p.bank in
  let rx = cos a and rz = sin a in
  (p.px +. (offset *. rx *. cos b), p.py +. (offset *. sin b), p.pz +. (offset *. rz *. cos b))

let across (t : t) (s : float) (offset : float) : float * float * float = across_at (at t s) offset

(* [project i x z]: how far along segment [i] (0 to 1, clamped), how far
 * to the right of it the point (x, z) is, and how far the point really
 * is from it.
 *
 * That last one is what [locate] sorts by, and it is not the offset: a
 * segment the point is long past can still show a tiny offset, since
 * the offset is measured across the whole line the segment lies on and
 * not across the segment itself. Sort by the offset instead and a kart
 * on the straight is told it is halfway round the lap, which sends the
 * computer that believes it driving in circles. *)
let project (t : t) (i : int) (x : float) (z : float) : float * float * float =
  let n = segments t in
  (* ix: no mod for an i that is one already (arm's division is a
   * call: a fifth of mini-virtuaracing's start, its trees' locate)
   * old: let k = ((i mod n) + n) mod n *)
  let k = if i >= 0 && i < n then i else ((i mod n) + n) mod n in
  (* a circuit's last segment goes back to the first sample; a stage's
   * goes to its own last sample (it has one more than its segments),
   * not back to the start across the whole course *)
  let a = t.points.(k) and b = t.points.(if t.closed then (if k + 1 = n then 0 else k + 1) else k + 1) in
  let dx = b.px -. a.px and dz = b.pz -. a.pz in
  let len2 = (dx *. dx) +. (dz *. dz) in
  let u = if len2 = 0. then 0. else (((x -. a.px) *. dx) +. ((z -. a.pz) *. dz)) /. len2 in
  let u = Float.max 0. (Float.min 1. u) in
  let cx = a.px +. (dx *. u) and cz = a.pz +. (dz *. u) in
  (* the sign: to the right of the way it goes. The direction is
   * (dx, dz) and the right is (-dz, dx), so the offset is their dot
   * product with what is left of the point. *)
  let leg = Float.sqrt len2 in
  let offset = if leg = 0. then 0. else (((x -. cx) *. -.dz) +. ((z -. cz) *. dx)) /. leg in
  (u, offset, Float.hypot (x -. cx) (z -. cz))

let locate_near (t : t) (near : float) (x : float) (z : float) : float * float =
  let n = segments t in
  let first, last =
    if near < 0. then (0, n - 1)
    else
      (* a circuit comes back near itself, so look near where the thing
       * was: twelve segments either way, which at any sane speed is
       * further than it can have gone. A stage does not come back, so
       * its window is clipped to its two ends rather than wrapped. *)
      let k = int_of_float (Float.rem (Float.rem near (length t) +. length t) (length t) /. t.step) in
      if t.closed then (k - 12, k + 12) else (max 0 (k - 12), min (n - 1) (k + 12))
  in
  let best = ref (infinity, 0., 0.) in
  for i = first to last do
    let far, _, _ = !best in
    (* ix: a segment whose box is farther than the nearest found (by a
     * millimetre, for the roundings) is no nearer: not projected. The
     * same segment found, the first of equals still (mini-virtuaracing's
     * trees each search the whole course) *)
    let k = if i >= 0 && i < n then i else ((i mod n) + n) mod n in
    let a = t.points.(k) and b = t.points.(if t.closed then (if k + 1 = n then 0 else k + 1) else k + 1) in
    let gap (v : float) (p : float) (q : float) : float =
      if v < p && v < q then (if p < q then p else q) -. v
      else if v > p && v > q then v -. (if p > q then p else q)
      else 0.
    in
    let gx = gap x a.px b.px and gz = gap z a.pz b.pz in
    if far = infinity || (gx *. gx) +. (gz *. gz) <= (far +. 0.001) *. (far +. 0.001) then begin
      let u, offset, d = project t i x z in
      if d < far then
        let s = Float.rem (float_of_int k +. u) (float_of_int n) *. t.step in
        best := (d, s, offset)
    end
  done;
  let _, s, offset = !best in
  (s, offset)

let locate (t : t) (x : float) (z : float) : float * float = locate_near t (-1.) x z

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Drawing *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let strip (t : t) (color : Mesh.color) (i : int) (a : float) (b : float) : Mesh.shape =
  let n = Array.length t.points in
  let p = t.points.(((i mod n) + n) mod n) and q = t.points.((((i mod n) + n) mod n + 1) mod n) in
  (* Near left, near right, far right, far left: counterclockwise seen
   * from above, so that the face points *up*. Wind it the other way
   * round and the road still draws -- a game with no lighting and no
   * back-face culling cannot tell -- but a flat-shaded one lights it
   * from underneath and the whole course goes black. *)
  Mesh.polygon3d color [ across_at p a; across_at p b; across_at q b; across_at q a ]

let wall (t : t) (color : Mesh.color) (i : int) (offset : float) (height : float) : Mesh.shape =
  let n = Array.length t.points in
  let p = t.points.(((i mod n) + n) mod n) and q = t.points.((((i mod n) + n) mod n + 1) mod n) in
  let x1, y1, z1 = across_at p offset and x2, y2, z2 = across_at q offset in
  (* ix: seen from both sides (Mesh.two_sided): the same winding on
   * both sides of the road, its height down for a bank's side *)
  Mesh.two_sided
    (Mesh.polygon3d color [ (x1, y1, z1); (x2, y2, z2); (x2, y2 +. height, z2); (x1, y1 +. height, z1) ])
games/racing/virtua/course/Track3d.mli
7471
(* A circuit in space: a closed line through the middle of a road,
   which has a width, a height and a lean at every point, turned into a
   ribbon of quads.

   Where gamekits/racing/Road.mli describes a course as a *list of
   segments* read as the car advances -- the way the arcade's pseudo-3D
   racers did, and what TinyOutRun and TinyVirtuaRacing
   drive on -- this one describes it as a *shape in space*, which is
   what a polygon racer with hills and banked corners needs:

     Road.t              a table: curve 2, hill 20, straight, ...
                         the road never really turns; the drawing does

     Track3d.t           a closed line through points in space, each
                         with its width and its bank; the road turns,
                         climbs and leans, and you can stand anywhere
                         and look at it

   A course is written as a handful of control points, and the line
   through them is a Catmull-Rom spline (Edwin Catmull and Raphael Rom,
   1974), which has the property that matters here: it passes *through*
   its control points, so a course is drawn by saying where the road
   goes, not by guessing at weights. The spline is then resampled at
   even distances, so that a segment is the same length everywhere and
   "how far along" is a distance in world units, not a parameter.

   Everything a game asks is in terms of that distance [s] along the
   middle, and an [offset] across it (positive to the right of the way
   it is driven):

                    offset < 0     |     offset > 0
                                   |
        ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~+~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~   the middle
             s = 0           s = 100          s = 200            [at]
        <--- width ---><--- width --->

   so that the road's surface is [across], the whole of a kart's
   position is (s, offset), an item box stands at (s, offset), the
   traffic's lane is a constant offset, "am I on the road" is
   |offset| < width, and the lap is s / [length]. [locate] is the way
   back: a point in the world to (s, offset).

   The lean ([bank], degrees) tilts the ribbon around its own middle,
   so the outside of a banked corner is *higher* than the inside, and a
   kart drawn at its offset stands on the slope. It is what lets a toy
   have Suzuka's 130R or Wario Stadium's walls without any physics:
   nothing here pushes a car into the corner, it only puts the road
   where the eye expects it (an exercise: let the bank pull the car,
   which is the whole of a banked corner in a real game).

   In the playground, part of the racing kit (gamekits/racing/, beside
   Road.mli). Here, mini-virtuaracing's: the courses (Course) are
   written as its controls, and the road's faces are its strips and
   walls, meshes (Mesh) the game's renderer draws (Render).

   References: Jake Gordon, "How to build a racing game" (2012), for the
   segments and their kerbs; Catmull and Rom, "A class of local
   interpolating splines" (1974); and, for what the numbers are for,
   the tracks of Mario Kart 64 (Nintendo, 1996), which are exactly this
   -- a closed ribbon that climbs, drops and leans. *)

(* ix: the author's playground's gamekits/racing/3d/Track3d.mli
 * (docs/plans/plan_virtuaracing.md); a strip and a wall a Mesh.shape,
 * no optional argument (mini-ml has none), no [of_road] (the coast, not
 * here yet) *)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* {1 Writing a course} *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* A control point: where the middle of the road passes, how wide it is
 * there ([width] is *half* the road, since everything across the
 * ribbon is measured from the middle), and how much it leans, in
 * degrees (positive: the right-hand side lifted, for a left-hand
 * corner). Between two control points all three are eased from one to
 * the other, so a course need only say where each thing changes. *)
type control = { x : float; y : float; z : float; width : float; bank : float }

(* [control ~y ~width ~bank x z]: a control point at (x, z) *)
val control : y:float -> width:float -> bank:float -> float -> float -> control

type t

(* [build step controls]: the closed circuit through [controls], cut
 * into segments of [step] -- the quads a game draws, and
 * the grain of every answer below. At least four control points are
 * needed for a spline; fewer raises [Invalid_argument]. *)
val build : float -> control list -> t

(* the course's length, in world units: [segments] times [step] *)
val length : t -> float

val segments : t -> int
val step : t -> float

(*****************************************************************************)
(* {1 Places on it} *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the middle of the road at some distance along: where it is, which
 * way it goes (degrees, 0 towards -z and 90 towards +x, Camera3d's
 * headings), and the width and lean there *)
type place = {
  px : float;
  py : float;
  pz : float;
  heading : float;
  width : float;
  bank : float;
}

(* [at t s]: the place at the distance [s] along the middle, the two
 * nearest samples mixed. On a circuit the distance wraps round the lap
 * (so [at t (length t +. 1.)] is [at t 1.]); on a stage it stops at
 * each end. *)
val at : t -> float -> place

(* [across t s offset]: the point on the road's surface [offset] to the
 * right of the middle at [s] (negative: to the left), lifted and
 * tilted by the lean there. This is the ribbon: every quad, every kart
 * and every item box goes through it. *)
val across : t -> float -> float -> float * float * float

(* [locate t x z]: the other way -- (how far along, how far to the
 * right) for a point in the world, the ground under it forgotten (a
 * circuit that climbs over itself would need more). Every segment is
 * tried. *)
val locate : t -> float -> float -> float * float

(* [locate_near t near x z]: the same, near [near] along.
 * A circuit comes back near itself, so the answer is not unique: pass
 * [near], the distance the thing was at last frame, and the search
 * stays within a few segments of it, which is both right and quick. *)
val locate_near : t -> float -> float -> float -> float * float

(* [forward t s] : the direction of travel at [s], as (x, z): what
 * Camera3d.forward gives for [at t s]'s heading *)
val forward : t -> float -> float * float

(*****************************************************************************)
(* {1 Drawing it} *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* [strip t color i a b]: the quad of segment [i] (0 to [segments] - 1)
 * from [a] to [b] across, its face up. The road, its kerbs, its verges
 * and the line down its middle are all strips at different offsets --
 * the game chooses the colors and where each one stops, since that is
 * all a course looks like:
 *
 *     grass | kerb |        road        | kerb | grass
 *        -6w  -1.15w  -w     0      w   1.15w    6w
 *)
val strip : t -> Mesh.color -> int -> float -> float -> Mesh.shape

(* [wall t color i offset height]: the quad standing along segment
 * [i] at [offset], [height] tall: a rail, a barrier, the side of a
 * tunnel. Drawn on both sides, since which side a game sees it from
 * depends on where the car is. *)
val wall : t -> Mesh.color -> int -> float -> float -> Mesh.shape

(* Cars: the formula cars, as Virtua Racing's were, each part a solid
 * of a few flat faces, and where they stand on the grid.
 *
 *          rear wing              the nose tapering to its tip, the
 *        |=========|              tub, the engine cover sloping from
 *   (O)  |  _/^\_  |  (O)         the airbox to the gearbox, the
 *        |_| tub |_|              sidepods, the two wings with their
 *            | |                  endplates, the four wheels (octagons:
 *   (o)    __| |__    (o)         the flat shading shows every face),
 *         |=======|               the brake lights; and its shadow on
 *         front wing              the road under it
 *
 * A car is a mesh made once for each livery (Mesh), at the origin
 * facing -z, the road at y = 0; at each frame it is turned to its
 * heading and moved to its place (Render.draw_at), its faces lit as
 * they then face the sun.
 *
 * Where it stands: the game (Virtua) draws the sixteen; at stage 3
 * (plan_virtuaracing.md) they drive (the playground's Topdown for the
 * player's, the rivals on the road's lanes).
 *
 * What is ours: TinyVirtuaRacing's car, its liveries and its grid; the
 * front wheels not turned with the steering wheel yet (a mesh for each
 * angle, or the wheels a mesh of their own, at stage 3). *)

(* [model livery braking]: a car, its shadow under it *)
val model : Mesh.color -> bool -> Mesh.shape

(* the rivals' colours, the k-th's at k mod 15 *)
val liveries : Mesh.color array

(* the player's place on the grid: 9th, as the arcade put you
 * mid-field *)
val player_slot : int

(* [slot_s k] and [slot_lane k]: the grid's k-th place, two columns, 8
 * metres apart in each, behind the line: how far along (negative) and
 * across *)
val slot_s : int -> float
val slot_lane : int -> float

(* Claude Code

(* See Driving.mli *)

(* ix: the author's playground's games/racing/TinyVirtuaRacing.ml, its
 * "The car" *)

let top_speed = 124.
let grass_speed = 45.
let kmh (speed : float) : float = Float.abs speed /. top_speed *. 330.

let params : Topdown.params =
  {
    accel = 78.;
    friction = 0.55;
    grip = 0.2;
    steering = 2.2;
    steering_speed = 25.;
  }

let grass_params : Topdown.params = { params with grip = 0.07 }
let plane_heading (world : float) : float = 90. -. world

type t = {
  car : Topdown.t;
  s : float;
  offset : float;
  wheel : float;
  bump : int;
  spin : int;
}

let spin_frames = 70

let at (c : Course.t) (s : float) (offset : float) : t =
  let x, _, z = Track3d.across c.ribbon s offset in
  let p = Track3d.at c.ribbon s in
  {
    car =
      {
        x;
        y = -.z;
        vx = 0.;
        vy = 0.;
        heading = plane_heading p.heading;
        speed = 0.;
      };
    s;
    offset;
    wheel = 0.;
    bump = 99;
    spin = 0;
  }

let length (c : Course.t) : float = Track3d.length c.ribbon

let wrap (c : Course.t) (s : float) : float =
  Float.rem (Float.rem s (length c) +. length c) (length c)

let world (c : Course.t) (d : t) : Vec3.t * float =
  let _, y, _ = Track3d.across c.ribbon d.s d.offset in
  let spun =
    if d.spin > 0 then
      720. *. (1. -. ((float_of_int d.spin /. float_of_int spin_frames) ** 2.))
    else 0.
  in
  ((d.car.x, y, -.d.car.y), 90. -. d.car.heading +. spun)

let slip (d : t) : float =
  if Float.hypot d.car.vx d.car.vy < 5. then 0.
  else
    Course.angle_diff d.car.heading (atan2 d.car.vy d.car.vx *. 180. /. Float.pi)

let steer (c : Course.t) (gas : float) (wanted : float) (d : t) : t =
  let near = if c.laps > 1 then wrap c d.s else d.s in
  let road = plane_heading (Track3d.at c.ribbon near).heading in
  let spinning = d.spin > 0 in
  let gas, wanted = if spinning then (0., 0.) else (gas, wanted) in
  let wheel = d.wheel +. Float.max (-0.1) (Float.min 0.1 (wanted -. d.wheel)) in
  let on_road = Float.abs d.offset <= 1.15 *. Course.road_width in
  let car =
    if (not on_road) && d.car.speed > grass_speed then
      { d.car with speed = d.car.speed -. 1.2 }
    else d.car
  in
  let car =
    if spinning then
      {
        car with
        speed = car.speed *. 0.96;
        vx = car.vx *. 0.96;
        vy = car.vy *. 0.96;
      }
    else car
  in
  let lock = wheel *. (1. -. (0.5 *. Float.abs car.speed /. top_speed)) in
  let moved =
    Topdown.drive
      (if on_road then params else grass_params)
      top_speed gas lock car
  in
  let rail (x : float) (y : float) : bool =
    let _, off = Track3d.locate_near c.ribbon near x (-.y) in
    Float.abs off > Course.verge -. 0.8
  in
  let after = Topdown.bounce rail car moved in
  let hit = after.x <> moved.x || after.y <> moved.y in
  (* against the rail the car scrapes along it: some of its speed lost
   * (Topdown.bounce would halve it every frame the gas pushes it back
   * in, a stop), and its nose turned back along the road *)
  let turn = Course.angle_diff after.heading road in
  let after : Topdown.t =
    if not hit then after
    else
      {
        after with
        speed = moved.speed *. 0.85;
        heading =
          (if Float.abs turn < 90. then after.heading +. (0.25 *. turn)
           else after.heading);
      }
  in
  let s, offset = Track3d.locate_near c.ribbon near after.x (-.after.y) in
  let ds =
    if c.laps > 1 then
      Course.angle_diff (near *. 360. /. length c) (s *. 360. /. length c)
      *. length c /. 360.
    else s -. near
  in
  let d' =
    {
      car = after;
      s = d.s +. ds;
      offset;
      wheel;
      bump = (if hit then 0 else d.bump + 1);
      spin = max 0 (d.spin - 1);
    }
  in
  (* a spin: the rail hit hard and not along it, or the car sliding too
   * far sideways; when it ends, the car is set facing the road, as the
   * arcade did *)
  if
    (not spinning)
    && ((hit && car.speed > 55. && Float.abs turn > 14.)
       || (Float.abs (slip d') > 32. && car.speed > 45.))
  then { d' with spin = spin_frames }
  else if spinning && d'.spin = 0 then
    {
      d' with
      car =
        {
          d'.car with
          heading = road;
          vx = 0.;
          vy = 0.;
          speed = Float.min 10. d'.car.speed;
        };
      wheel = 0.;
    }
  else d'
games/racing/virtua/race/Driving.mli
2405
(* Driving: the player's car on the course, a Topdown car with the
 * road's rules.
 *
 * The car is the racing kit's Topdown: a heading of its own, a speed,
 * and a velocity that only turns towards the heading by the grip's
 * fraction each frame, so it goes where it points, and in a fast turn
 * slides wide before it does. Not a car *across* a road with the road
 * turning under it (TinyOutRun's): here the road is a shape in space,
 * the car drives on it, and where it is on the road is found again at
 * each frame (Track3d.locate_near).
 *
 * What the game adds is the road's own rules: the wheel turned by the
 * keys a little at a time (a keyboard has no wheel, and a full lock at
 * once is a spin), and less of it at speed; the grass slowing the car
 * and taking its grip; the rail at the edge of the grass, which it
 * scrapes along (Topdown.bounce); and Virtua Racing's spins: too much
 * slide, or the rail hit too hard, and the car spins round, stops
 * sliding, and is set back facing the road.
 *
 * The Topdown plane is the world's (x, -z), its headings
 * counterclockwise from +x ([plane_heading]); the world's headings are
 * the course's (Track3d: 0 along +z, clockwise seen from above). *)

(* the top speed, 330 km/h at the road's scale; on the grass *)
val top_speed : float
val grass_speed : float
val kmh : float -> float

(* a world heading as the plane's *)
val plane_heading : float -> float

type t = {
  car : Topdown.t;
  s : float; (* how far along the course, laps included *)
  offset : float; (* how far to the right of the middle *)
  wheel : float; (* -1 full right, 1 full left *)
  bump : int; (* frames since the car last hit the rail *)
  spin : int; (* frames of a spin left; 0: driving *)
}

(* a spin's frames *)
val spin_frames : int

(* [at course s offset]: a car standing on the road there *)
val at : Course.t -> float -> float -> t

(* the course's length, and s within one lap of it *)
val length : Course.t -> float
val wrap : Course.t -> float -> float

(* where the car is in the world, and which way its body points (in a
 * spin, round and round) *)
val world : Course.t -> t -> Vec3.t * float

(* the angle between where the car points and where it goes: a slide *)
val slip : t -> float

(* [steer course gas wanted d]: one frame, [gas] -1 to 1, the wheel
 * wanted -1 (right) to 1 (left) *)
val steer : Course.t -> float -> float -> t -> t
games/racing/virtua/race/Race.ml
4966
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Race.mli *)

(* ix: the author's playground's games/racing/TinyVirtuaRacing.ml, its
 * race, drive and update; its sounds as events *)

type keys = { up : bool; down : bool; left : bool; right : bool }

type event =
  | Beep
  | Go
  | Shift
  | Crash
  | Checkpoint of int
  | Final_lap
  | Goal
  | Game_over

type t = {
  drive : Driving.t;
  rivals : Rivals.t list;
  time : int;
  clock : int;
  passed : int;
  message : string * int;
  lap_times : int list;
  finished : bool;
  over : bool;
}

let countdown = 180

let start (c : Course.t) : t =
  let slot = if c.rivals > 0 then Cars.player_slot else 0 in
  let d =
    Driving.at c
      (if c.rivals > 0 then Cars.slot_s slot else 0.)
      (if c.rivals > 0 then Cars.slot_lane slot else 0.)
  in
  {
    drive = d;
    rivals = Rivals.grid c;
    time = -countdown - 1;
    clock = c.start_time * 60;
    passed = 0;
    message = ("", 0);
    lap_times = [];
    finished = false;
    over = false;
  }

let lap (c : Course.t) (d : Driving.t) : int =
  int_of_float (Float.floor (d.s /. Course.lap_length c))

let checkpoint (c : Course.t) (d : Driving.t) : int =
  int_of_float
    (Float.floor (d.s /. (Course.lap_length c /. float_of_int c.checkpoints)))

let gears = 7

let gear (d : Driving.t) : int =
  max 1
    (min gears
       (1
       + int_of_float
           (Float.abs d.car.speed /. Driving.top_speed *. float_of_int gears)))

let revs (d : Driving.t) : float =
  let g =
    Float.max 0.
      (Float.abs d.car.speed /. Driving.top_speed *. float_of_int gears)
  in
  let f = g -. float_of_int (int_of_float g) in
  if g >= float_of_int gears then 1.
  else if g < 1. then 0.2 +. (0.8 *. f)
  else 0.45 +. (0.55 *. f)

(* one frame of the cars and the clock: the player's by the keys (after
 * the line, or out of time, steering itself along the road to a stop),
 * the rivals', the bumps *)
let drive (c : Course.t) (k : keys) (r : t) : t * event list =
  let d = r.drive in
  let d' =
    if r.time < 0 then d
    else if r.finished then
      let road =
        Driving.plane_heading (Track3d.at c.ribbon (Driving.wrap c d.s)).heading
      in
      let wanted =
        Float.max (-1.)
          (Float.min 1.
             ((Course.angle_diff d.car.heading road /. 15.)
             +. (d.offset *. 0.08)))
      in
      Driving.steer c (if d.car.speed > 1. then -0.5 else 0.) wanted d
    else
      let gas =
        if k.up then 1.
        else if k.down then if d.car.speed > 1. then -1.6 else -0.5
        else 0.
      in
      let wanted = (if k.left then 1. else 0.) -. if k.right then 1. else 0. in
      Driving.steer c gas wanted d
  in
  let rivals = if r.time < 0 then r.rivals else Rivals.drive c d' r.rivals in
  let d', rivals, bumped =
    if r.time < 0 then (d', rivals, false) else Rivals.bump c d' rivals
  in
  let time = r.time + 1 in
  let events =
    (if gear d' > gear d then [ Shift ] else [])
    @ (if
         (d'.bump = 0 && d.bump > 10)
         || (d'.spin > 0 && d.spin = 0)
         || (bumped && d.bump > 10)
       then [ Crash ]
       else [])
    @ (if time < 0 && time mod 60 = 0 then [ Beep ] else [])
    @ if time = 0 then [ Go ] else []
  in
  ( {
      r with
      drive = d';
      rivals;
      time;
      clock =
        (if time > 0 && not r.finished then max 0 (r.clock - 1) else r.clock);
    },
    events )

let step (c : Course.t) (k : keys) (r : t) : t * event list =
  let r', events = drive c k r in
  if r.finished then (r', events)
  else
    let lap_done = lap c r'.drive in
    let cp = checkpoint c r'.drive in
    let lap_time = r'.time - List.fold_left ( + ) 0 r.lap_times in
    if cp > r.passed && cp >= 1 && lap_done >= c.laps then
      (* the goal *)
      ( {
          r' with
          lap_times = lap_time :: r.lap_times;
          passed = cp;
          finished = true;
        },
        events @ [ Goal ] )
    else if cp > r.passed && cp >= 1 then begin
      (* a checkpoint: time added; at the line, a lap done *)
      let at_line = cp mod c.checkpoints = 0 in
      let lap_times =
        if at_line then lap_time :: r.lap_times else r.lap_times
      in
      let best =
        at_line && List.for_all (fun (t : int) -> lap_time < t) r.lap_times
      in
      let final = at_line && lap_done = c.laps - 1 in
      let message =
        if final then "FINAL LAP"
        else if best then Printf.sprintf "TIME BONUS  +%d   BEST LAP" c.bonus
        else Printf.sprintf "TIME BONUS  +%d" c.bonus
      in
      ( {
          r' with
          passed = cp;
          clock = r'.clock + (c.bonus * 60);
          lap_times;
          message = (message, r'.time + 150);
        },
        events @ [ Checkpoint cp ] @ if final then [ Final_lap ] else [] )
    end
    else if r'.clock = 0 && r'.time > 0 then
      ({ r' with finished = true; over = true }, events @ [ Game_over ])
    else (r', events)
games/racing/virtua/race/Race.mli
2291
(* Race: one race on a course, a frame at a time: the countdown, the
 * player's car by the keys, the rivals, the clock and its checkpoints,
 * the laps, the goal.
 *
 * The clock is the arcade's: it counts down from the course's start
 * time, each checkpoint (a lap's few, the line one of them) adds its
 * bonus, and at 0 the race is over wherever the car is. The laps are
 * counted from the line; the grid is behind it, so the first
 * checkpoint passed is a lap's first.
 *
 *   time:  -181 ... -1      0          ...      the goal, or 0 left
 *          the countdown    GO! the clock runs  the car steers itself
 *          (the cars held)                      to a stop ([finished])
 *
 * What is ours: the playground's sounds are events here ([event]),
 * played by the game (stage 4); its scenes (title, select, goal) are
 * the game's too. *)

type keys = { up : bool; down : bool; left : bool; right : bool }

(* what the race says of a frame, for the sound *)
type event =
  | Beep (* a second of the countdown *)
  | Go
  | Shift (* a gear up *)
  | Crash (* the rail hit, a spin, a rival bumped *)
  | Checkpoint of int (* passed, the n-th from the start *)
  | Final_lap
  | Goal
  | Game_over (* the clock at 0 *)

type t = {
  drive : Driving.t;
  rivals : Rivals.t list;
  time : int; (* frames since the start; negative: the countdown *)
  clock : int; (* frames left on the clock *)
  passed : int; (* checkpoints passed *)
  message : string * int; (* in the middle of the screen, and until when *)
  lap_times : int list; (* in frames, the last one first *)
  finished : bool; (* past the goal, or out of time *)
  over : bool; (* out of time *)
}

(* the countdown's frames *)
val countdown : int

(* [start course]: the cars on the grid, the countdown to come *)
val start : Course.t -> t

(* [step course keys r]: one frame (a 60th of a second) *)
val step : Course.t -> keys -> t -> t * event list

(* the lap the car is on (from 0), and the checkpoints passed *)
val lap : Course.t -> Driving.t -> int
val checkpoint : Course.t -> Driving.t -> int

(* the automatic box's seven gears: the one the car is in, and where
 * the revs are in it (0 to 1: the tachometer, the engine's pitch) *)
val gears : int
val gear : Driving.t -> int
val revs : Driving.t -> float

(* See Rivals.mli *)

(* ix: the author's playground's games/racing/TinyVirtuaRacing.ml, its
 * "The rivals" *)

type t = {
  rs : float;
  lane : float;
  rspeed : float;
  home : float;
  top : float;
  livery : Mesh.color;
}

let grid (c : Course.t) : t list =
  List.init c.rivals (fun (k : int) ->
      let slot = if k < Cars.player_slot then k else k + 1 in
      {
        rs = Cars.slot_s slot;
        lane = Cars.slot_lane slot;
        rspeed = 0.;
        home = Cars.slot_lane slot;
        top =
          (Driving.top_speed *. (0.9 -. (0.012 *. float_of_int k)))
          +. (4. *. Scenery.jitter k 9);
        livery = Cars.liveries.(k mod Array.length Cars.liveries);
      })

(* the speed for the sharpest turn 10 to 50 segments ahead: radius r
 * allows sqrt (grip * r), the speed at which a car going round a circle
 * needs all its tyres' grip (v^2 / r = grip) *)
let corner_speed (c : Course.t) (s : float) : float =
  let step = Track3d.step c.ribbon in
  let k0 = int_of_float (Driving.wrap c s /. step) in
  let sharpest = ref 0. in
  for k = 10 to 50 do
    sharpest :=
      Float.max !sharpest (Float.abs (Course.turn c (k0 + k)))
  done;
  if !sharpest < 0.05 then infinity
  else
    let radius = step /. (!sharpest *. Float.pi /. 180.) in
    Float.sqrt (32. *. radius)

let drive (c : Course.t) (player : Driving.t) (rivals : t list) : t list =
  let dt = 1. /. 60. in
  let arr = Array.of_list rivals in
  Array.to_list
    (Array.map
       (fun (r : t) ->
         let wanted = Float.min r.top (corner_speed c r.rs) in
         (* accelerating as the player's car does, harder from low speed *)
         let accel = 70. *. (1. -. (0.6 *. r.rspeed /. Driving.top_speed)) in
         let rspeed =
           if r.rspeed < wanted then r.rspeed +. (accel *. dt)
           else Float.max wanted (r.rspeed -. (45. *. dt))
         in
         (* a slower car just ahead in my lane: move over *)
         let blocked (lane : float) : bool =
           Array.exists
             (fun (o : t) ->
               o != r && o.rs > r.rs
               && o.rs -. r.rs < 25.
               && o.rspeed < rspeed
               && Float.abs (o.lane -. lane) < 3.)
             arr
           || player.s > r.rs
              && player.s -. r.rs < 25.
              && player.car.speed < rspeed
              && Float.abs (player.offset -. lane) < 3.
         in
         let target =
           if blocked r.lane then
             if blocked (-.r.home) then r.lane else -.r.home
           else if blocked r.home then r.lane
           else r.home
         in
         let lane =
           r.lane +. Float.max (-0.08) (Float.min 0.08 (target -. r.lane))
         in
         { r with rs = r.rs +. (rspeed *. dt); rspeed; lane })
       arr)

let place (c : Course.t) (r : t) : Vec3.t * float =
  (Track3d.across c.ribbon r.rs r.lane, (Track3d.at c.ribbon r.rs).heading)

let bump (c : Course.t) (d : Driving.t) (rivals : t list) :
    Driving.t * t list * bool =
  let d, acc, crashed =
    List.fold_left
      (fun ((d, acc, crashed) : Driving.t * t list * bool) (r : t) ->
        let (x, _, z), h = place c r in
        if Float.hypot (x -. d.car.x) (z +. d.car.y) > 4.4 then
          (d, r :: acc, crashed)
        else
          let a = Driving.plane_heading h *. Float.pi /. 180. in
          let other : Topdown.t =
            {
              x;
              y = -.z;
              vx = r.rspeed *. cos a;
              vy = r.rspeed *. sin a;
              heading = Driving.plane_heading h;
              speed = r.rspeed;
            }
          in
          let hard = Float.abs (d.car.speed -. r.rspeed) > 30. in
          let car, _ = Topdown.push 2.2 d.car other in
          let d : Driving.t =
            {
              d with
              car =
                {
                  car with
                  speed = Float.min car.speed (Float.hypot car.vx car.vy);
                };
              bump = 0;
            }
          in
          let d =
            if hard && d.spin = 0 then { d with spin = Driving.spin_frames }
            else d
          in
          (d, { r with rspeed = r.rspeed *. 0.9 } :: acc, true))
      (d, [], false) rivals
  in
  (d, List.rev acc, crashed)

let position (d : Driving.t) (rivals : t list) : int =
  1 + List.length (List.filter (fun (r : t) -> r.rs > d.s) rivals)

let ordinal (n : int) : string =
  let suffix =
    if n mod 100 >= 11 && n mod 100 <= 13 then "TH"
    else
      match n mod 10 with
      | 1 -> "ST"
      | 2 -> "ND"
      | 3 -> "RD"
      | _ -> "TH"
  in
  string_of_int n ^ suffix
games/racing/virtua/race/Rivals.mli
2019
(* Rivals: the fifteen other cars, as in the arcade.
 *
 * Not Topdown cars: they drive *on* the road, a distance along it and a
 * lane across it, as TinyOutRun's traffic does, which is what makes
 * them good drivers cheaply. Each one:
 *   - wants its top speed (a little under the player's), and less before
 *     a corner: it looks 10 to 50 segments ahead for the sharpest turn,
 *     whose radius r allows sqrt (grip * r) ([corner_speed]);
 *   - brakes hard to it, accelerates from it as the player does;
 *   - keeps to its lane, and moves over to pass a slower car ahead in
 *     it (the player's too), back when the lane is clear.
 * The player bumps them as a disc bumps a disc (Topdown.push): the
 * rival slows down a little, the player is pushed aside, or spins if
 * the hit was hard.
 *
 *   the grid (Cars): two columns, 8 m apart in each, behind the line;
 *   the player in the 9th place, as the arcade put you mid-field
 *
 * What is ours: a rival's top speed has a part by Scenery.jitter (the
 * playground's by Hashtbl.hash), so a race is not the playground's to
 * the hundredth. *)

type t = {
  rs : float; (* how far along the course *)
  lane : float; (* across the road *)
  rspeed : float;
  home : float; (* the lane it keeps to *)
  top : float;
  livery : Mesh.color;
}

(* the rivals on the grid *)
val grid : Course.t -> t list

(* [corner_speed course s]: the speed for the corners ahead of s *)
val corner_speed : Course.t -> float -> float

(* [drive course player rivals]: one frame of every rival *)
val drive : Course.t -> Driving.t -> t list -> t list

(* where a rival is in the world, and its heading *)
val place : Course.t -> t -> Vec3.t * float

(* [bump course player rivals]: the player against the rivals, each a
 * disc of 2.2 m; whether one was hit *)
val bump : Course.t -> Driving.t -> t list -> Driving.t * t list * bool

(* the player's place: 1 + the rivals ahead; as said (1ST, 2ND...) *)
val position : Driving.t -> t list -> int
val ordinal : int -> string

(* Claude Code

(* See Screens.mli *)

(* ix: the author's playground's games/racing/TinyVirtuaRacing.ml, its
 * race's display (time_text, minimap, tachometer, hud_race) and its
 * scenes' texts (in its view) *)

module P = Playground

let text (color : P.color) (size : float) (str : string) : P.shape =
  P.words color str |> P.scale size

let time_text (frames : int) : string =
  let frames = max 0 frames in
  Printf.sprintf "%d'%02d\"%02d" (frames / 3600)
    (frames / 60 mod 60)
    (frames mod 60 * 100 / 60)

(* the map's dots, made for a course and a screen (Course's
 * OPTIMIZATION (once): a Track3d.at each, at each frame); old: made at
 * each frame *)
let outline : (Course.t * float * float * P.shape list) option ref = ref None

(* the course's map, bottom right, its level under it; the rivals dots,
 * the player a red marker *)
let minimap (screen : P.screen) (c : Course.t) (d : Driving.t)
    (rivals : Rivals.t list) : P.shape list =
  let x0, x1, z0, z1 = Course.bounds c in
  let k = 170. /. Float.max (x1 -. x0) (z1 -. z0) in
  let cx = screen.right -. 120. and cy = screen.bottom +. 150. in
  let at (px : float) (pz : float) : float * float =
    ( cx +. ((px -. ((x0 +. x1) /. 2.)) *. k),
      cy -. ((pz -. ((z0 +. z1) /. 2.)) *. k) )
  in
  let n = Track3d.segments c.ribbon in
  let dots =
    match !outline with
    | Some (c', right, bottom, dots)
      when c' == c && right = screen.right && bottom = screen.bottom ->
        dots
    | _ ->
        let dots =
          List.init (n / 6) (fun (j : int) ->
              let p =
                Track3d.at c.ribbon
                  (float_of_int (6 * j) *. Track3d.step c.ribbon)
              in
              let x, y = at p.px p.pz in
              P.square (P.rgb 230 230 230) 3. |> P.move x y)
        in
        outline := Some (c, screen.right, screen.bottom, dots);
        dots
  in
  let others =
    List.map
      (fun (r : Rivals.t) ->
        let p = Track3d.at c.ribbon r.rs in
        let x, y = at p.px p.pz in
        P.circle (P.rgb 60 140 255) 3.5 |> P.move x y)
      rivals
  in
  let x, y = at d.car.x (-.d.car.y) in
  dots @ others
  @ [
      P.circle P.red 6. |> P.move x y;
      text P.yellow 2. c.level |> P.move cx (cy -. 110.);
    ]

(* the tachometer, an arc on the left: the revs round it, the yellow
 * zone where to change gear, the red one past it, the needle *)
let tachometer (screen : P.screen) (rpm : float) (gear : int) : P.shape list =
  let cx = screen.left +. 120. and cy = screen.bottom +. 190. in
  let r = 80. in
  let angle (f : float) : float = 210. -. (240. *. f) in
  let marks =
    List.init 25 (fun (k : int) ->
        let f = float_of_int k /. 24. in
        let color =
          if f > 0.92 then P.red else if f > 0.78 then P.yellow else P.white
        in
        let a = angle f *. Float.pi /. 180. in
        P.rectangle color 4. 14.
        |> P.rotate (angle f -. 90.)
        |> P.move (cx +. (r *. cos a)) (cy +. (r *. sin a)))
  in
  let a = angle (Float.min 1. rpm) in
  let ar = a *. Float.pi /. 180. in
  let needle =
    P.rectangle (P.rgb 255 90 40) 72. 4.
    |> P.rotate a
    |> P.move (cx +. (36. *. cos ar)) (cy +. (36. *. sin ar))
  in
  marks
  @ [
      needle;
      P.circle (P.rgb 40 40 40) 22. |> P.move cx cy;
      text P.white 2.5 (string_of_int gear) |> P.move cx cy;
    ]

let race (screen : P.screen) (blink : P.shape list -> P.shape list)
    (c : Course.t) (r : Race.t) : P.shape list =
  let top = screen.top and left = screen.left and right = screen.right in
  let bottom = screen.bottom in
  let d = r.drive in
  let lap_now = max 1 (min c.laps (Race.lap c d + 1)) in
  let current = r.time - List.fold_left ( + ) 0 r.lap_times in
  let best =
    match r.lap_times with
    | [] -> None
    | l -> Some (List.fold_left min max_int l)
  in
  let hurry = r.clock < 10 * 60 && r.time > 0 in
  [
    text P.white 2. "TIME" |> P.move_y (top -. 30.);
    text
      (if hurry then P.red else P.yellow)
      7.
      (string_of_int ((r.clock + 59) / 60))
    |> P.move_y (top -. 80.);
    text P.white 2. "LAP TIME" |> P.move (right -. 150.) (top -. 30.);
    text P.white 2.8 (time_text (max 0 current))
    |> P.move (right -. 150.) (top -. 62.);
    text P.yellow 2.4
      (match best with
      | Some b -> "BEST " ^ time_text b
      | None -> "")
    |> P.move (right -. 150.) (top -. 96.);
    text P.white 2.4
      (Printf.sprintf "SPEED %3.0f km/h" (Driving.kmh d.car.speed))
    |> P.move (left +. 170.) (bottom +. 70.);
    text P.white 2.4
      (if c.laps > 1 then Printf.sprintf "LAPS %d/%d" lap_now c.laps else c.name)
    |> P.move (left +. 170.) (bottom +. 35.);
  ]
  @ (if c.rivals > 0 then
       [
         text P.white 2. "POSITION" |> P.move (left +. 110.) (top -. 30.);
         text P.yellow 4.
           (Printf.sprintf "%s/%d"
              (Rivals.ordinal (Rivals.position d r.rivals))
              (c.rivals + 1))
         |> P.move (left +. 110.) (top -. 70.);
       ]
     else [])
  @ tachometer screen (Race.revs d) (Race.gear d)
  @ minimap screen c d r.rivals
  @ (if r.time < 0 then
       [
         text P.yellow 12. (string_of_int (((-r.time - 1) / 60) + 1))
         |> P.move_y 150.;
       ]
     else if r.time < 60 then
       [ text (P.rgb 60 230 90) 12. "GO!" |> P.move_y 150. ]
     else [])
  @
  let msg, until = r.message in
  if r.time < until then blink [ text P.yellow 4. msg |> P.move_y 180. ] else []

let title (blink : P.shape list -> P.shape list) : P.shape list =
  [
    text (P.rgb 250 60 40) 7. "TINY VIRTUA RACING" |> P.move_y 300.;
    text P.white 2.5
      "up: accelerate   down: brake   left/right: steer   v: view"
    |> P.move_y 230.;
  ]
  @ blink [ text P.yellow 3. "PRESS SPACE" |> P.move_y 170. ]

let select (screen : P.screen) (blink : P.shape list -> P.shape list)
    (c : Course.t) : P.shape list =
  [
    text P.white 4. "SELECT COURSE" |> P.move_y (screen.top -. 60.);
    text (P.rgb 250 140 30) 7. (Printf.sprintf "<  %s  >" c.name)
    |> P.move_y (screen.bottom +. 170.);
    text P.white 3.
      (Printf.sprintf "%s   %s   %.1f km" c.level
         (if c.laps > 1 then Printf.sprintf "%d LAPS" c.laps else "TO THE GOAL")
         (Course.lap_length c /. 1000.))
    |> P.move_y (screen.bottom +. 110.);
  ]
  @ blink
      [
        text P.yellow 3. "left/right: course    space: race"
        |> P.move_y (screen.bottom +. 60.);
      ]

let finished (blink : P.shape list -> P.shape list) (c : Course.t) (r : Race.t)
    : P.shape list =
  if r.over then
    [
      text P.red 8. "GAME OVER" |> P.move_y 250.;
      text P.white 3. (Printf.sprintf "%d LAPS DONE" (List.length r.lap_times))
      |> P.move_y 170.;
    ]
    @ blink [ text P.white 3. "PRESS SPACE" |> P.move_y 100. ]
  else
    [
      text P.yellow 8. "GOAL!" |> P.move_y 250.;
      text P.white 4. (Printf.sprintf "TIME %s" (time_text r.time))
      |> P.move_y 160.;
    ]
    @ (match r.lap_times with
      | [] | [ _ ] -> []
      | times ->
          [
            text P.white 3.
              (Printf.sprintf "BEST LAP %s"
                 (time_text (List.fold_left min max_int times)))
            |> P.move_y 110.;
          ])
    @ (if c.rivals > 0 then
         [
           text P.white 3.
             (Printf.sprintf "POSITION %s"
                (Rivals.ordinal (Rivals.position r.drive r.rivals)))
           |> P.move_y 70.;
         ]
       else [])
    @ blink [ text P.white 3. "PRESS SPACE" |> P.move_y 20. ]

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Sound.mli *)

(* ix: the author's playground's games/racing/TinyVirtuaRacing.ml, its
 * "Sound" (and its update's plays) *)

let on = ref true

let engine (rpm : float) (throttle : bool) (tunnel : bool) : unit =
  if !on then begin
    let hz = 45. +. (110. *. rpm) in
    let open_ = if throttle then 1. else 0.3 in
    let room = if tunnel then 1.6 else 1. in
    Audio.keep_playing "engine"
      (Audio.sawtooth hz
      |> Audio.low_pass ((400. +. (2400. *. rpm *. open_)) /. room)
      |> Audio.louder ((0.05 +. (0.04 *. open_)) *. room));
    Audio.keep_playing "engine_low"
      (Audio.square (hz /. 2.)
      |> Audio.low_pass 300.
      |> Audio.louder (0.05 *. room))
  end

let road (d : Driving.t) : unit =
  if !on then begin
    let frac = Float.abs d.car.speed /. Driving.top_speed in
    let slide = Float.abs (Driving.slip d) in
    if
      Float.abs d.offset > 1.15 *. Course.road_width
      && Float.abs d.car.speed > 3.
    then
      Audio.keep_playing "gravel"
        (Audio.noise 500.
        |> Audio.low_pass (200. +. (600. *. frac))
        |> Audio.louder 0.15)
    else if (slide > 4. || d.spin > 0) && Float.abs d.car.speed > 25. then
      Audio.keep_playing "squeal"
        (Audio.triangle 1050. |> Audio.vibrato 11. 0.5
        |> Audio.louder
             (if d.spin > 0 then 0.06 else Float.min 0.06 (0.006 *. slide)));
    if frac > 0.3 then
      Audio.keep_playing "wind"
        (Audio.noise 6000. |> Audio.high_pass 1500.
        |> Audio.louder (0.03 *. frac *. frac))
  end

let beep =
  Audio.sfx { Sfx.blip with frequency = 440.; sustain = 0.15; volume = 0.3 }

let go_beep =
  Audio.sfx { Sfx.blip with frequency = 880.; sustain = 0.5; volume = 0.3 }

let shift =
  Audio.noise 900. |> Audio.lasting 0.07 |> Audio.fading |> Audio.louder 0.12

let crash = Audio.sfx { Sfx.hit with volume = 0.35 }

let final_lap =
  Audio.after
    [
      Audio.square 660. |> Audio.lasting 0.12;
      Audio.square 880. |> Audio.lasting 0.3;
    ]
  |> Audio.louder 0.2

(* the checkpoints' jingles: the arcade played one of a dozen short
 * ones, cut off before their end; here three, in turn *)
let jingles =
  List.map
    (fun (notes : string) ->
      Audio.abc (Printf.sprintf "X:1\nL:1/16\nQ:1/4=150\nK:C\n%s|\n" notes)
      |> Audio.louder 0.22)
    [ "c2e2g2c'4"; "g2e2c'2g2e'4"; "d2f2a2d'2c'4" ]

let fanfare =
  Audio.abc "X:1\nL:1/8\nQ:1/4=160\nK:C\nG2 c2 e2 g4 e2 | g6 z2 |\n"
  |> Audio.louder 0.25

let game_over =
  Audio.after
    [
      Audio.square 392. |> Audio.lasting 0.25;
      Audio.square 330. |> Audio.lasting 0.25;
      Audio.square 262. |> Audio.lasting 0.6;
    ]
  |> Audio.louder 0.2

let pick = Audio.sfx { Sfx.blip with frequency = 660.; volume = 0.25 }

let play (s : Audio.sound) : unit = if !on then Audio.play s

let event (e : Race.event) : unit =
  match e with
  | Beep -> play beep
  | Go -> play go_beep
  | Shift -> play shift
  | Crash -> play crash
  | Checkpoint cp -> play (List.nth jingles (cp mod List.length jingles))
  | Final_lap -> play final_lap
  | Goal -> play fanfare
  | Game_over -> play game_over

(* Sound: the race's, by the playground's Audio (its synthesizer, its
 * voices kept playing frame after frame, its sounds played once).
 *
 * A formula car's V12: seven gears (the automatic box, Race.gear), each
 * taking the revs from low to high over a seventh of the top speed, so
 * the pitch climbs, drops at each change, and climbs again: the sound
 * of speed. Two voices, a bright sawtooth opened up by the throttle
 * and a square an octave down, the body. In a tunnel, the walls give
 * it back: louder, lower, boomier. Under it the road: the tyres
 * squealing as the car slides, the grass under it off the road, the
 * wind at speed. Over it the race's events (Race.event): the
 * countdown's beeps, a gear's change, a crash, a checkpoint's jingle
 * (the arcade played one of a dozen short ones; here three, in turn),
 * the final lap, the goal's fanfare, game over.
 *
 *   rpm (Race.revs)  1 |    /|    /|    /|
 *                      |   / |   / |   / |  ...   seven gears
 *                      |  /  |  /  |  /  |
 *                  0.2 | /   | /   | /   |
 *                      +---------------------- speed *)

(* false: no sound made (the flag sound=off): on mini-9pi the sound of
 * the time a frame took is made after it, so a slow frame makes a
 * longer sound, and the sound slows the frames further *)
val on : bool ref

(* [engine rpm throttle tunnel]: the engine's two voices this frame *)
val engine : float -> bool -> bool -> unit

(* [road d]: the gravel, the tyres' squeal, the wind, by the car *)
val road : Driving.t -> unit

(* an event of the race, played *)
val event : Race.event -> unit

(* [play s]: [s] played, when [on] *)
val play : Audio.sound -> unit

(* the course select's: a course changed, the race chosen *)
val pick : Audio.sound
val go_beep : Audio.sound

(* See Topdown.mli *)

(* ix: the author's playground's gamekits/racing/Topdown.ml, its car,
 * drive, bounce and push *)

type t = {
  x : float;
  y : float;
  vx : float;
  vy : float;
  heading : float;
  speed : float;
}

type params = {
  accel : float;
  friction : float;
  grip : float;
  steering : float;
  steering_speed : float;
}

let radians (d : float) : float = d *. Float.pi /. 180.

let drive (p : params) (top : float) (gas : float) (steer : float) (c : t) : t =
  let dt = 1. /. 60. in
  let speed = c.speed +. (gas *. p.accel *. dt) in
  let speed = speed -. (speed *. p.friction *. dt) in
  let speed = Float.max (-.top /. 3.) (Float.min top speed) in
  let heading =
    c.heading
    +. steer *. p.steering
       *. Float.min 1. (Float.abs speed /. p.steering_speed)
  in
  let a = radians heading in
  let vx = c.vx +. (p.grip *. ((speed *. cos a) -. c.vx))
  and vy = c.vy +. (p.grip *. ((speed *. sin a) -. c.vy)) in
  { x = c.x +. (vx *. dt); y = c.y +. (vy *. dt); vx; vy; heading; speed }

let bounce (wall : float -> float -> bool) (before : t) (after : t) : t =
  if (not (wall after.x after.y)) || wall before.x before.y then after
  else
    let x, vx =
      if wall after.x before.y then (before.x, -0.5 *. after.vx)
      else (after.x, after.vx)
    in
    let y, vy =
      if wall x after.y then (before.y, -0.5 *. after.vy)
      else (after.y, after.vy)
    in
    { after with x; y; vx; vy; speed = after.speed /. 2. }

let push (radius : float) (a : t) (b : t) : t * t =
  let dx = b.x -. a.x and dy = b.y -. a.y in
  let d = Float.hypot dx dy in
  if d >= 2. *. radius || d = 0. then (a, b)
  else
    let nx = dx /. d and ny = dy /. d in
    let half = ((2. *. radius) -. d) /. 2. in
    (* the velocities along the line, swapped *)
    let va = (a.vx *. nx) +. (a.vy *. ny)
    and vb = (b.vx *. nx) +. (b.vy *. ny) in
    let dv = vb -. va in
    ( {
        a with
        x = a.x -. (half *. nx);
        y = a.y -. (half *. ny);
        vx = a.vx +. (dv *. nx);
        vy = a.vy +. (dv *. ny);
      },
      {
        b with
        x = b.x +. (half *. nx);
        y = b.y +. (half *. ny);
        vx = b.vx -. (dv *. nx);
        vy = b.vy -. (dv *. ny);
      } )
games/racing/virtua/race/Topdown.mli

(* Topdown: a car on a plane seen from above, its heading, its speed
 * and its slide: the racing kit's model of a car (the playground's
 * gamekits/racing/Topdown), here mini-virtuaracing's player's. The
 * world is a plane, the car a point on it with a heading; what the game
 * draws (here a formula car on a road in space) is another matter.
 *
 * The car slides ([drive]): its speed follows the gas, but its velocity
 * only turns towards where it points by a fraction each frame, the
 * "grip"; a fast turn keeps going the old way a moment, it drifts:
 *
 *         heading  ^                 velocity after one frame:
 *                  |   / velocity    grip of the way from the old
 *                  |  /              velocity to heading * speed
 *                  | /
 *                  car
 *
 * Not physics either (a rigid body with tyres and friction forces):
 * the arcade's few rules. Two cars, or a car and a wall, bump as the
 * arcade's did ([bounce], [push]): a wall sends it back where it came
 * from, two discs push apart and swap their speeds along the line.
 *
 *          wall                 e.g. a wall from x = 100: from (95, 0)
 *           |                   to (105, 0) at vx = 300: back at
 *      --->*|     then  <-*|    (95, 0), vx = -150
 *           |
 *
 * What is ours: only the car and its two bumps (the kit's waypoint
 * track, its distance and its computer driver are not this game's:
 * its rivals drive on the road, Rivals). *)

type t = {
  x : float;
  y : float;
  vx : float; (* the velocity, world units per second *)
  vy : float;
  heading : float; (* degrees, counterclockwise from +x *)
  speed : float; (* along the heading, what the gas controls *)
}

type params = {
  accel : float; (* the speed full gas adds per second *)
  friction : float; (* the fraction of its speed lost per second *)
  grip : float; (* the fraction of the way the velocity turns to the heading, per frame *)
  steering : float; (* degrees per frame, the wheel full over *)
  steering_speed : float; (* the speed from which the wheel turns fully *)
}

(* [drive params top gas steer car]: one frame (a 60th of a second),
 * [gas] -1 to 1, [steer] -1 (right) to 1 (left), the speed within
 * [-top / 3, top] *)
val drive : params -> float -> float -> float -> t -> t

(* [bounce wall before after]: [after], or, if it went into the wall
 * ([wall x y]), back along each axis that crossed it, that speed
 * reversed and halved *)
val bounce : (float -> float -> bool) -> t -> t -> t

(* [push radius a b]: two discs of [radius] that overlap pushed apart,
 * their velocities along the line between them swapped *)
val push : float -> t -> t -> t * t

type color = int

let rgb (r : int) (g : int) (b : int) : color = (r lsl 16) lor (g lsl 8) lor b

(* the playground's (Color: the Tango palette's) *)
let white = rgb 255 255 255
let black = rgb 0 0 0
let red = rgb 0xcc 0 0
let yellow = rgb 0xed 0xd4 0

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Shapes *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* both: seen from both sides, never culled (two_sided) *)
type face = { color : color; points : Vec3.t list; both : bool }
type shape = face list

let polygon3d (color : color) (points : Vec3.t list) : shape =
  if List.length points < 3 then failwith "polygon3d needs at least 3 points";
  [ { color; points; both = false } ]

let group3d (shapes : shape list) : shape = List.concat shapes

let two_sided (s : shape) : shape =
  List.map (fun (f : face) -> { f with both = true }) s
let is_empty (s : shape) : bool = s = []

(* Playground3d's box_faces: each face counterclockwise seen from
 * outside *)
let box (color : color) (width : float) (height : float) (depth : float) : shape
    =
  let hx = width /. 2. and hy = height /. 2. and hz = depth /. 2. in
  let p000 = (-.hx, -.hy, -.hz)
  and p001 = (-.hx, -.hy, hz)
  and p010 = (-.hx, hy, -.hz)
  and p011 = (-.hx, hy, hz)
  and p100 = (hx, -.hy, -.hz)
  and p101 = (hx, -.hy, hz)
  and p110 = (hx, hy, -.hz)
  and p111 = (hx, hy, hz) in
  List.map
    (fun (points : Vec3.t list) -> { color; points; both = false })
    [
      [ p100; p110; p111; p101 ] (* +x *);
      [ p001; p011; p010; p000 ] (* -x *);
      [ p010; p011; p111; p110 ] (* +y *);
      [ p000; p100; p101; p001 ] (* -y *);
      [ p001; p101; p111; p011 ] (* +z *);
      [ p000; p010; p110; p100 ] (* -z *);
    ]

let map_points (f : Vec3.t -> Vec3.t) (s : shape) : shape =
  List.map (fun (fc : face) -> { fc with points = List.map f fc.points }) s

let move3d (dx : float) (dy : float) (dz : float) (s : shape) : shape =
  map_points (fun ((x, y, z) : Vec3.t) -> (x +. dx, y +. dy, z +. dz)) s

let move_x3d (dx : float) (s : shape) : shape = move3d dx 0. 0. s
let move_y3d (dy : float) (s : shape) : shape = move3d 0. dy 0. s
let radians (d : float) : float = d *. Float.pi /. 180.

(* (Playground3d's order: x, then y, then z; an angle of 0 skipped, the
 * points as they are) *)
let rotate3d (ax : float) (ay : float) (az : float) (s : shape) : shape =
  let around (a : float) (f : float -> float -> Vec3.t -> Vec3.t) (s : shape) :
      shape =
    if a = 0. then s
    else
      let r = radians a in
      let c = cos r and sn = sin r in
      map_points (f c sn) s
  in
  s
  |> around ax (fun (c : float) (sn : float) ((x, y, z) : Vec3.t) ->
      (x, (y *. c) -. (z *. sn), (y *. sn) +. (z *. c)))
  |> around ay (fun (c : float) (sn : float) ((x, y, z) : Vec3.t) ->
      ((x *. c) +. (z *. sn), y, (-.x *. sn) +. (z *. c)))
  |> around az (fun (c : float) (sn : float) ((x, y, z) : Vec3.t) ->
      ((x *. c) -. (y *. sn), (x *. sn) +. (y *. c), z))

let scale3d (k : float) (s : shape) : shape = map_points (Vec3.scale k) s

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Meshes *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type t = {
  xs : Float.Array.t;
  ys : Float.Array.t;
  zs : Float.Array.t;
  first : int array;
  colors : color array;
  nxs : Float.Array.t;
  nys : Float.Array.t;
  nzs : Float.Array.t;
  shades : Bytes.t;
  both : Bytes.t;
  cx : float;
  cy : float;
  cz : float;
  radius : float;
}

let faces (m : t) : int = Array.length m.colors

let make (s : shape) : t =
  let faces = Array.of_list s in
  let n = Array.length faces in
  let first = Array.make (n + 1) 0 in
  Array.iteri
    (fun (k : int) (f : face) ->
      first.(k + 1) <- first.(k) + List.length f.points)
    faces;
  let corners = first.(n) in
  let xs = Float.Array.make corners 0.
  and ys = Float.Array.make corners 0.
  and zs = Float.Array.make corners 0. in
  let nxs = Float.Array.make n 0.
  and nys = Float.Array.make n 0.
  and nzs = Float.Array.make n 0. in
  Array.iteri
    (fun (k : int) (f : face) ->
      List.iteri
        (fun (i : int) ((x, y, z) : Vec3.t) ->
          Float.Array.set xs (first.(k) + i) x;
          Float.Array.set ys (first.(k) + i) y;
          Float.Array.set zs (first.(k) + i) z)
        f.points;
      let nx, ny, nz = Vec3.face_normal f.points in
      Float.Array.set nxs k nx;
      Float.Array.set nys k ny;
      Float.Array.set nzs k nz)
    faces;
  (* the sphere: around the box's middle, as far as the farthest
   * corner (not the smallest sphere, near enough to it) *)
  let lo (a : Float.Array.t) : float =
    Float.Array.fold_left Float.min infinity a
  in
  let hi (a : Float.Array.t) : float =
    Float.Array.fold_left Float.max neg_infinity a
  in
  let cx = (lo xs +. hi xs) /. 2.
  and cy = (lo ys +. hi ys) /. 2.
  and cz = (lo zs +. hi zs) /. 2. in
  let r2 = ref 0. in
  for i = 0 to corners - 1 do
    let dx = Float.Array.get xs i -. cx
    and dy = Float.Array.get ys i -. cy
    and dz = Float.Array.get zs i -. cz in
    r2 := Float.max !r2 ((dx *. dx) +. (dy *. dy) +. (dz *. dz))
  done;
  {
    xs;
    ys;
    zs;
    first;
    colors = Array.map (fun (f : face) -> f.color) faces;
    nxs;
    nys;
    nzs;
    shades = Bytes.make n '\000';
    both =
      Bytes.init n (fun (k : int) -> if faces.(k).both then '\001' else '\000');
    cx;
    cy;
    cz;
    radius = Float.sqrt !r2;
  }

let light (m : t) (index : color -> float -> int) : unit =
  for k = 0 to faces m - 1 do
    let b =
      Lighting.brightness_of_normal
        ( Float.Array.get m.nxs k,
          Float.Array.get m.nys k,
          Float.Array.get m.nzs k )
    in
    Bytes.set m.shades k (Char.chr (index m.colors.(k) b))
  done
games/racing/virtua/render/Mesh.mli

(* Mesh: the scene's solids, written as the playground's 3D writes them
 * (polygon3d, box, group3d, move3d, rotate3d, scale3d), and made once
 * into arrays that a frame reads without building anything.
 *
 * A shape is a list of flat faces, each a colour and its corners,
 * counterclockwise as seen from outside (the face's front: the side
 * its normal points to, by Newell's method, Vec3.face_normal):
 *
 *     polygon3d red [ a; b; c; d ]          d +-------+ c
 *                                             |       |    seen from
 *     box red 2. 1. 1.: six of them,          |  -->  |    its front:
 *     each wound the same way                 |       |    a b c d go
 *                                           a +-------+ b  counterclockwise
 *
 * and [make] turns a shape into a mesh: the corners of all its faces
 * in three Float.Array (x, y, z), where face k's are [first.(k)] to
 * [first.(k + 1) - 1]; each face's colour and normal; a sphere around
 * it all (the renderer's test of whether the mesh is in view at all).
 * The colour a face is drawn in, its palette's index once lit by the
 * sun ([light]), is computed once too, for a mesh that never moves.
 *
 *   the playground's TinyVirtuaRacing          here
 *   a frame:  the scene's lists of shapes,     a frame:  the meshes in
 *             walked, every face made a                  view, their arrays
 *             triangle with closures                     read (Render)
 *
 * The survey (plan_virtuaracing.md) found the playground's frame a
 * third the GC and the lists: the scene was made again at each frame
 * from its groups. A mesh is made at the course's start.
 *
 * What is ours: the shapes' functions are the playground's
 * (Playground3d), so the courses read as TinyVirtuaRacing's; a shape is
 * only a list of faces here (no texture, no alpha, no cache: the game
 * has none of them), its transforms applied to the points at once, as
 * there. *)

(* 0xRRGGBB *)
type color = int

val rgb : int -> int -> int -> color
val white : color
val black : color
val red : color
val yellow : color

(* the colours of the rainbow, the playground's (Playground.rainbow) *)
val rainbow : color list

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Shapes *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type shape

(* [polygon3d color points]: one flat face, at least three points,
 * counterclockwise seen from its front *)
val polygon3d : color -> Vec3.t list -> shape

val group3d : shape list -> shape

(* the faces seen from both sides, never culled ([Render.cull]): a
 * face that is not a solid's side, the Ferris wheel's spokes, a wall
 * seen from both its sides *)
val two_sided : shape -> shape

(* [box color width height depth]: centered on the origin, its six
 * faces outward *)
val box : color -> float -> float -> float -> shape

val move3d : float -> float -> float -> shape -> shape
val move_x3d : float -> shape -> shape
val move_y3d : float -> shape -> shape

(* [rotate3d ax ay az shape]: degrees around the origin, first around
 * x, then y, then z *)
val rotate3d : float -> float -> float -> shape -> shape

(* [scale3d s shape]: s times larger, from the origin *)
val scale3d : float -> shape -> shape

val is_empty : shape -> bool

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Meshes *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type t = {
  xs : Float.Array.t;
  ys : Float.Array.t;
  zs : Float.Array.t;
  (* face k's corners: first.(k) to first.(k + 1) - 1; one more than
   * the faces *)
  first : int array;
  colors : color array;
  (* the faces' unit normals, x, y and z *)
  nxs : Float.Array.t;
  nys : Float.Array.t;
  nzs : Float.Array.t;
  (* each face's palette index, lit by the sun ([light]) *)
  shades : Bytes.t;
  (* each face's two_sided: '\001' when it is *)
  both : Bytes.t;
  (* the sphere around the corners: its center and radius *)
  cx : float;
  cy : float;
  cz : float;
  radius : float;
}

val make : shape -> t

(* the number of faces *)
val faces : t -> int

(* [light m index]: each face's shade, [index color brightness] (the
 * palette's), its brightness the sun's on its normal (Lighting) *)
val light : t -> (color -> float -> int) -> unit
