(* What -a writes: acid's declarations of the program's types (acid.c),
 * for a debugger to print a value by its type. 5c's text, byte for
 * byte (debuggers/tests/acid/types/target.acid is 5c -an's):
 *
 *     struct Node { char *name; Point p; Node *next; };
 *
 *     sizeofNode = 20;            the width
 *     aggr Node                   each member's format and offset ('A':
 *     {                           a pointer to a complex type, its name)
 *         'X' 0 name;
 *         Point 4 p;
 *         'A' Node 12 next;
 *     };
 *     defn                        a function printing one, given its
 *     Node(addr) {                address: acid's print calls it on a
 *         complex Node addr;      value of the type
 *         print("	name	", addr.name\X, "\n");
 *         ...
 *     };
 *     complex Node n1;            a global's type, a local's (f:v), an
 *     complex Node walk:n;        enum's constants as variables
 *
 * written as the compiler goes: a structure once its body is aligned
 * (Declare.sualign), a name once declared (Declare.dodecl, doenum).
 * In acid's syntax a keyword is no name: a member called loop is
 * $loop (amap).
 *
 * History: Phil Winterbottom's acid (1994) and 5c's -a, Plan 9 2nd
 * edition: the compiler, which knows the types, writes them in the
 * debugger's language; the debugger knows no C (decision 6 of
 * plan_debugger.md; decision 14: the same text in the program, -g). *)

(* -a's level: 0 none, 1 -a, 2 -aa (only the file compiled, not its
 * #includes) *)
val level : int ref

(* the declarations written, the last first: a structure's aggr and
 * function one, a variable's line another (mini-ld -g keeps each once:
 * every file says libc.h's) *)
val decls : string list ref

(* them as -a writes them *)
val text : unit -> string

(* a structure or union, its elements' offsets and width known
 * (acidtype) *)
val acidtype : Tree.typ -> unit

(* a name declared (acidvar): a global's or a local's complex type, an
 * enum's constant; fn the function being defined (its type: thisfn) *)
val acidvar : fn:Tree.typ option -> Tree.sym -> unit

(* Claude Code

(* See Cil_exprs.mli *)

open Tree
open Tree_helpers
open Cil_types
module S = Signature
module W = Writer
module Str = Cil_strings

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The file's globals *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* each global: its name, type, field (an array: of one element for
 * all but an array) *)
let globals : (string * typ * int) list ref = ref []

let reset () : unit =
  Str.reset ();
  globals := []

let global (c : c) (line : int) (name : string) (t : typ) : int =
  match List.find_opt (fun ((n, _, _) : string * typ * int) -> n = name) !globals with
  | Some (_, _, f) -> f
  | None ->
      let f = W.field_def c.w c.cls name 0x0016 (S.SzArray (cts c line (base t))) in
      globals := (name, t, f) :: !globals;
      f

(*****************************************************************************)
(* A function being compiled *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* a local's or a parameter's place: its slot, or a local holding an
 * array (a C array, or one element: a variable whose address is taken) *)
type var = Slot of bool * int | Boxed of int | Array_var of int

type fn = {
  c : c;
  k : code;
  fname : string;
  vars : (string, var) Hashtbl.t;     (* by key *)
}

(* a local's key: two blocks' may share an offset *)
let key (s : sym) (off : int) (t : typ) : string =
  Printf.sprintf "%s@%d:%s%d" s.name off (tname t.etype) t.width

(* where an l-value is: what is pushed before its value (re-pushed as
 * often as asked: a temporary's, or a variable's) *)
type place =
  | Pslot of bool * int               (* an argument, a local *)
  | Pelem of (unit -> unit) * typ     (* an array and an index; the element's type *)
  | Pfield of (unit -> unit) * int    (* an object; its field *)
  | Pptr of (unit -> unit) * S.t      (* a Ptr; what it points to *)

let is_ptr (t : typ) : bool = t.etype = Tind
let is_float (t : typ) : bool = t.etype = Tfloat || t.etype = Tdouble
let is_wide (t : typ) : bool = t.etype = Tvlong || t.etype = Tuvlong

let load (f : fn) (p : place) : unit =
  match p with
  | Pslot (true, i) -> emit f.k (Il.Ldarg i)
  | Pslot (false, i) -> emit f.k (Il.Ldloc i)
  | Pelem (pre, t) -> pre (); emit f.k (Il.Ldelem (load_kind f.c 0 t))
  | Pfield (pre, fld) -> pre (); emit f.k (Il.Ldfld fld)
  | Pptr (pre, t) -> pre (); emit f.k (Il.Call (ptr_get f.c t))

let store (f : fn) (p : place) (v : unit -> unit) : unit =
  match p with
  | Pslot (true, i) -> v (); emit f.k (Il.Starg i)
  | Pslot (false, i) -> v (); emit f.k (Il.Stloc i)
  | Pelem (pre, t) -> pre (); v (); emit f.k (Il.Stelem (store_kind f.c 0 t))
  | Pfield (pre, fld) -> pre (); v (); emit f.k (Il.Stfld fld)
  | Pptr (pre, t) -> pre (); v (); emit f.k (Il.Call (ptr_set f.c t))

(* a char's or short's value as its type keeps it, in an int32 *)
let narrow (k : code) (t : typ) : unit =
  match t.etype with
  | Tchar -> emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i1, false, false))
  | Tuchar -> emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_u1, false, false))
  | Tshort -> emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i2, false, false))
  | Tushort -> emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_u2, false, false))
  | _ -> ()

(* C's conversion of a number: the stack's int32 (C's int and smaller),
 * int64 or float, to another *)
let conv (k : code) (from : typ) (t : typ) : unit =
  let c (kind : Il.kind) = emit k (Il.Conv (kind, false, false)) in
  let fl = is_float from in
  match t.etype with
  | Tchar | Tuchar | Tshort | Tushort -> narrow k t
  | Tint | Tlong | Tenum | Tuint | Tulong ->
      if fl then c (if typeu t.etype then Il.K_u4 else Il.K_i4)
      else if is_wide from then c Il.K_i4
  | Tvlong | Tuvlong ->
      if fl then c (if t.etype = Tuvlong then Il.K_u8 else Il.K_i8)
      else if not (is_wide from) then
        c (if typeu from.etype then Il.K_u8 else Il.K_i8)
  | Tfloat | Tdouble ->
      let r = if t.etype = Tfloat then Il.K_r4 else Il.K_r8 in
      if (not fl) && typeu from.etype then emit k Il.Conv_r_un;
      c r
  | _ -> ()

(* an operand of a pointer's + that is its offset, though the typing
 * typed it a pointer: a number scaled, converted *)
let rec is_offset (x : expr) : bool =
  match x.e with
  | Const _ -> true
  | Unary (Cast, y) -> not (is_ptr y.t)
  | Binary ((Mul | Lmul | Div | Ldiv | Ashl | Ashr | Lshr), _, _) -> true
  | Binary ((Add | Sub), a, b) -> is_offset a && is_offset b
  | _ -> not (is_ptr x.t)

let const (f : fn) (line : int) (t : typ) (v : int64) : unit =
  match t.etype with
  | Tvlong | Tuvlong -> emit f.k (Il.Ldc_i8 v)
  | Tfloat | Tdouble -> emit f.k (Il.Ldc_r (Int64.to_float v))
  | Tind when v = 0L -> emit f.k Il.Ldnull
  | Tind -> refuse line "an integer made a pointer"
  | _ -> emit f.k (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int64.to_int32 v))

let binop (o : binop) : Il.binop =
  match o with
  | Add -> Il.Add
  | Sub -> Il.Sub
  | Mul | Lmul -> Il.Mul
  | Div -> Il.Div
  | Ldiv -> Il.Div_un
  | Mod -> Il.Rem
  | Lmod -> Il.Rem_un
  | And -> Il.And
  | Or -> Il.Or
  | Xor -> Il.Xor
  | Ashl -> Il.Shl
  | Ashr -> Il.Shr
  | Lshr -> Il.Shr_un
  | _ -> failwith "binop"

(* a function's method, by its name and type: made at its first call
 * or its definition, whichever comes first *)
let func_method (c : c) (line : int) (name : string) (t : typ) : int =
  memo c ("fn " ^ name) (fun () ->
      let m = static (params c line t) (slot c line (link t)) in
      W.method_def c.w c.cls name 0x0096 m)

(* the functions C's library has from .NET or the compiler *)
let builtins = [ "print"; "sprint"; "malloc"; "free"; "_write"; "_exit" ]

(* a function as a value: its delegate, one for the program (kept in a
 * field), so that two are equal as their functions are *)
let delegate_value (f : fn) (line : int) (name : string) (t : typ) : unit =
  if List.mem name builtins then refuse line (name ^ " as a value");
  let c = f.c and k = f.k in
  let d = delegate c line t in
  let fld =
    memo c ("delegate " ^ name) (fun () ->
        W.field_def c.w c.cls ("<fn>" ^ name) 0x0016 d) in
  let l = label k in
  emit k (Il.Ldsfld fld);
  emit k Il.Dup;
  emit k (Il.Brtrue l);
  emit k Il.Pop;
  emit k Il.Ldnull;
  emit k (Il.Ldftn (func_method c line name t));
  emit k (Il.Newobj (delegate_ctor c line t));
  emit k Il.Dup;
  emit k (Il.Stsfld fld);
  place k l

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Expressions *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let rec expr (f : fn) (n : expr) : unit =
  let k = f.k and c = f.c and line = n.line in
  match n.e with
  | Const v -> const f line n.t v
  | Fconst x -> emit k (Il.Ldc_r x)
  | Name (s, _, _) when n.t.etype = Tfunc -> delegate_value f line s.name n.t
  | Name _ when n.t.etype = Tarray -> refuse line "an array as a value"
  | Name _ | Dot _ -> load f (place_of f n)
  | Unary (Ind, p) when (link p.t).etype = Tfunc -> expr f p
  | Unary (Ind, _) -> load f (place_of f n)
  | Unary (Addr, l) -> address f l
  | Unary (Cast, x) -> cast f x n.t
  | Unary (Neg, x) -> expr f x; emit k Il.Neg
  | Unary (Com, x) -> expr f x; emit k Il.Not
  | Unary (Pos, x) -> expr f x
  | Unary (Not, _) | Binary ((Andand | Oror), _, _) -> truth_value f n
  | Unary ((Preinc | Predec | Postinc | Postdec) as o, l) -> incdec f o l true
  | Binary (Comma, a, b) -> drop f a; expr f b
  | Binary (o, a, b) when is_rel o ->
      compare_value f (operands f o a b) (is_float a.t)
  | Binary (Sub, a, b)
    when is_ptr a.t && is_ptr b.t && not (is_offset a || is_offset b) ->
      (* (the difference's bytes: the typing divides by the size) *)
      let t = pointee c line (link a.t) in
      expr f a; expr f b;
      emit k (Il.Call (ptr_diff c t));
      ldc k (base (link a.t)).width;
      emit k (Il.Binop Il.Mul)
  | Binary ((Add | Sub) as o, a, b) when is_ptr a.t || is_ptr b.t ->
      let p, off = if is_ptr a.t && not (is_offset a) then (a, b) else (b, a) in
      expr f p;
      elements f off (base (link p.t)).width;
      if o = Sub then emit k Il.Neg;
      emit k (Il.Call (ptr_add c (pointee c line (link p.t))))
  | Binary (o, a, b) -> expr f a; expr f b; emit k (Il.Binop (binop o))
  | Assign (None, l, r) ->
      let p = place_of f l in
      store f p (fun () -> assigned f l.t r);
      load f p
  | Assign (Some o, l, r) -> opassign f n o l r; load f (place_of f l)
  | Cond (cnd, a, b) ->
      let other = label k and stop = label k in
      branch f cnd false other;
      expr f a;
      emit k (Il.Br stop);
      place k other;
      expr f b;
      place k stop
  | Call (fn, args) -> call f n fn args true
  | Sizeof _ | Sizeof_type _ | Str _ | Lstr _ | Reg _ | Indreg _ | Elem _ | Typed _ ->
      refuse line "a tree the typing does not leave"

(* a value given to a variable or an argument: a structure's copy *)
and value (f : fn) (n : expr) : unit =
  expr f n;
  if n.t.etype = Tstruct then
    emit f.k (Il.Callvirt (struct_info f.c n.line n.t).sclone)

(* a value given to a place of type t: malloc's, an array of t's
 * elements, whether the typing made the conversion a cast or not *)
and assigned (f : fn) (t : typ) (n : expr) : unit =
  match n.e with
  | Call ({ e = Name (s, _, _); _ }, [ size ]) when s.name = "malloc" && is_ptr t ->
      alloc f t size
  | _ -> value f n

(* malloc(size) given to a t: an array of size's elements, a Ptr to its
 * first *)
and alloc (f : fn) (t : typ) (size : expr) : unit =
  let line = size.line in
  let b = base (link t) in
  if b.etype = Tvoid then refuse line "malloc's memory given no type";
  new_array f.c f.k line b (fun () -> elements f size b.width);
  ldc f.k 0;
  emit f.k (Il.Newobj (ptr_ctor f.c (pointee f.c line b)))

(* n for its effects *)
and drop (f : fn) (n : expr) : unit =
  let k = f.k in
  match n.e with
  | Assign (None, l, r) ->
      let p = place_of f l in
      store f p (fun () -> assigned f l.t r)
  | Assign (Some o, l, r) -> opassign f n o l r
  | Unary ((Preinc | Predec | Postinc | Postdec) as o, l) -> incdec f o l false
  | Unary (Cast, x) -> drop f x
  | Binary (Comma, a, b) -> drop f a; drop f b
  | Call (fn, args) -> call f n fn args false
  | Cond (cnd, a, b) ->
      let other = label k and stop = label k in
      branch f cnd false other;
      drop f a;
      emit k (Il.Br stop);
      place k other;
      drop f b;
      place k stop
  | _ -> expr f n; if n.t.etype <> Tvoid then emit k Il.Pop

(* a pointer's offset, which the typing made bytes (of the pointer's
 * type: the index converted to it, then multiplied), as elements of bw
 * bytes *)
and elements (f : fn) (off : expr) (bw : int) : unit =
  let k = f.k in
  let by (x : expr) (v : int64) =
    let n = Int64.to_int v / bw in
    offset f x;
    if n <> 1 then (ldc k n; emit k (Il.Binop Il.Mul)) in
  let whole (v : int64) = Int64.to_int v mod bw = 0 in
  let power (v : int64) = Int64.shift_left 1L (Int64.to_int v) in
  match off.e with
  | Const v when whole v -> ldc k (Int64.to_int v / bw)
  | Binary ((Mul | Lmul), x, { e = Const v; _ }) when whole v -> by x v
  | Binary ((Mul | Lmul), { e = Const v; _ }, x) when whole v -> by x v
  | Binary (Ashl, x, { e = Const v; _ }) when whole (power v) -> by x (power v)
  | _ -> offset f off; if bw <> 1 then (ldc k bw; emit k (Il.Binop Il.Div))

(* an offset, an int32, though typed a pointer *)
and offset (f : fn) (x : expr) : unit =
  let k = f.k in
  let int32 (t : typ) = if is_wide t then emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false)) in
  match x.e with
  | Const v -> emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int64.to_int32 v))
  | Unary (Cast, y) when not (is_ptr y.t) -> expr f y; int32 y.t
  | Binary ((Add | Sub | Mul | Lmul | Div | Ldiv | Ashl | Ashr | Lshr) as o, a, b)
    when is_ptr x.t ->
      offset f a; offset f b; emit k (Il.Binop (binop o))
  | _ when is_ptr x.t -> refuse x.line "a pointer as an offset"
  | _ -> expr f x; int32 x.t

(* an l-value's place, its parts computed once *)
and place_of (f : fn) (n : expr) : place =
  let c = f.c and line = n.line in
  match n.e with
  | Name (s, cl, off) -> (
      match cl with
      | Cauto | Cparam -> (
          match Hashtbl.find_opt f.vars (key s off n.t) with
          | Some (Slot (a, i)) -> Pslot (a, i)
          | Some (Boxed i) ->
              Pelem ((fun () -> emit f.k (Il.Ldloc i); ldc f.k 0), n.t)
          | Some (Array_var _) -> refuse line "an array as a value"
          | None -> refuse line ("the variable " ^ s.name ^ ", unseen"))
      | Cextern | Cglobl | Cstatic | Clocal ->
          let fld = global c line (global_name f s cl) n.t in
          Pelem ((fun () -> emit f.k (Il.Ldsfld fld); ldc f.k 0), n.t)
      | _ -> refuse line ("a variable of class " ^ cname cl))
  | Unary (Ind, p) -> Pptr (stash f p, pointee c line (link p.t))
  | Dot (l, o) -> (
      let s = struct_info c line l.t in
      match List.find_opt (fun ((o', _, _) : int * typ * int) -> o' = o) s.fields with
      | Some (_, _, fld) -> Pfield (stash f l, fld)
      | None -> refuse line "a member of an unnamed structure")
  | _ -> refuse line "not an l-value"

(* a static's name: a function's own, or the file's *)
and global_name (f : fn) (s : sym) (cl : cls) : string =
  if cl = Clocal then f.fname ^ "." ^ s.name else s.name

(* n's value, pushed as often as asked: a variable's again, or a
 * temporary's *)
and stash (f : fn) (n : expr) : unit -> unit =
  let slot_var (s : sym) (off : int) =
    match Hashtbl.find_opt f.vars (key s off n.t) with
    | Some (Slot _) -> true
    | _ -> false in
  match n.e with
  | Name (s, (Cauto | Cparam), off) when slot_var s off -> fun () -> expr f n
  | _ ->
      let t = local f.k (slot f.c n.line n.t) in
      expr f n;
      emit f.k (Il.Stloc t);
      fun () -> emit f.k (Il.Ldloc t)

(* an array's: what holds it *)
and array_of (f : fn) (l : expr) : unit =
  let line = l.line in
  match l.e with
  | Name (s, Cstatic, off) when s.name = ".string" ->
      Str.literal_array f.c f.k (Str.literal_bytes line l.t off)
  | Name (s, ((Cauto | Cparam) as cl), off) -> (
      match Hashtbl.find_opt f.vars (key s off l.t) with
      | Some (Boxed i | Array_var i) -> emit f.k (Il.Ldloc i)
      | _ -> refuse line ("the address of " ^ s.name ^ ", a " ^ cname cl))
  | Name (s, cl, _) -> emit f.k (Il.Ldsfld (global f.c line (global_name f s cl) l.t))
  | Dot _ when l.t.etype = Tarray -> load f (place_of f l)
  | Dot _ -> refuse line "the address of a member"
  | _ -> refuse line "an address of this"

(* &l: a Ptr to its array's first element *)
and address (f : fn) (l : expr) : unit =
  let line = l.line in
  match l.e with
  | Name (s, _, _) when l.t.etype = Tfunc -> delegate_value f line s.name l.t
  | Unary (Ind, p) -> expr f p
  | _ ->
      array_of f l;
      ldc f.k 0;
      emit f.k (Il.Newobj (ptr_ctor f.c (pointee f.c line l.t)))

and cast (f : fn) (x : expr) (t : typ) : unit =
  let line = x.line in
  if t.etype = Tvoid then drop f x
  else if is_ptr t then begin
    match x.e with
    | Call ({ e = Name (s, _, _); _ }, [ size ]) when s.name = "malloc" ->
        alloc f t size
    | Const 0L -> emit f.k Il.Ldnull
    | _ when is_ptr x.t && cts f.c line x.t = cts f.c line t -> expr f x
    | _ when is_ptr x.t -> refuse line "a pointer cast to another type"
    | _ -> refuse line "an integer made a pointer"
  end
  else if is_ptr x.t then refuse line "a pointer made an integer"
  else begin
    expr f x;
    conv f.k x.t t
  end

(* x op= y: x converted to the operation's type n.t, the result back *)
and opassign (f : fn) (n : expr) (o : binop) (l : expr) (r : expr) : unit =
  let p = place_of f l in
  if is_ptr l.t then
    store f p (fun () ->
        load f p;
        elements f r (base (link l.t)).width;
        if o = Sub then emit f.k Il.Neg;
        emit f.k (Il.Call (ptr_add f.c (pointee f.c n.line (link l.t)))))
  else
    store f p (fun () ->
        load f p;
        conv f.k l.t n.t;
        expr f r;
        emit f.k (Il.Binop (binop o));
        conv f.k n.t l.t)

and incdec (f : fn) (o : unop) (l : expr) (used : bool) : unit =
  let k = f.k and line = l.line in
  let p = place_of f l in
  let up = o = Preinc || o = Postinc in
  let step () =
    if is_ptr l.t then begin
      ldc k (if up then 1 else -1);
      emit k (Il.Call (ptr_add f.c (pointee f.c line (link l.t))))
    end
    else begin
      if is_wide l.t then emit k (Il.Ldc_i8 1L)
      else if is_float l.t then emit k (Il.Ldc_r 1.0)
      else ldc k 1;
      emit k (Il.Binop (if up then Il.Add else Il.Sub));
      narrow k l.t
    end in
  if used && (o = Postinc || o = Postdec) then begin
    let old = local k (slot f.c line l.t) in
    load f p;
    emit k (Il.Stloc old);
    store f p (fun () -> emit k (Il.Ldloc old); step ());
    emit k (Il.Ldloc old)
  end
  else begin
    store f p (fun () -> load f p; step ());
    if used then load f p
  end

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Conditions *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* a relation's operands pushed; the comparison of them to make, and
 * whether it is unsigned (for floats: unordered) *)
and operands (f : fn) (o : binop) (a : expr) (b : expr) : Il.cmp * bool =
  let c = f.c and k = f.k and line = a.line in
  let data = is_ptr a.t && (link a.t).etype <> Tfunc in
  let null (x : expr) = match x.e with Const 0L -> true | _ -> false in
  let rel o =
    match o with
    | Eq -> (Il.Eq, false)
    | Ne -> (Il.Ne, true)
    | Lt | Lo -> (Il.Lt, o = Lo)
    | Le | Ls -> (Il.Le, o = Ls)
    | Gt | Hi -> (Il.Gt, o = Hi)
    | Ge | Hs -> (Il.Ge, o = Hs)
    | _ -> failwith "rel" in
  if data && not (null a || null b) then begin
    let t = pointee c line (link a.t) in
    expr f a;
    expr f b;
    match o with
    | Eq | Ne -> emit k (Il.Call (ptr_eq c t)); ldc k 1; rel o
    | _ ->
        emit k (Il.Call (ptr_diff c t));
        ldc k 0;
        (* (an order of pointers is of their indexes, signed) *)
        fst (rel o), false
  end
  else begin
    expr f a;
    expr f b;
    rel o
  end

and negate (x : Il.cmp) : Il.cmp =
  match x with
  | Il.Eq -> Il.Ne | Il.Ne -> Il.Eq | Il.Lt -> Il.Ge
  | Il.Ge -> Il.Lt | Il.Gt -> Il.Le | Il.Le -> Il.Gt

(* a comparison's 0 or 1: ceq, clt, cgt, and their negations *)
and compare_value (f : fn) ((x, un) : Il.cmp * bool) (fl : bool) : unit =
  let k = f.k in
  let not_ () = ldc k 0; emit k Il.Ceq in
  let un' = if fl then not un else un in
  match x with
  | Il.Eq -> emit k Il.Ceq
  | Il.Ne -> emit k Il.Ceq; not_ ()
  | Il.Lt -> emit k (Il.Clt un)
  | Il.Gt -> emit k (Il.Cgt un)
  | Il.Le -> emit k (Il.Cgt un'); not_ ()
  | Il.Ge -> emit k (Il.Clt un'); not_ ()

(* to l if n's truth is sense *)
and branch (f : fn) (n : expr) (sense : bool) (l : int) : unit =
  let k = f.k in
  match n.e with
  | Unary (Not, x) -> branch f x (not sense) l
  | Binary (Andand, a, b) ->
      if sense then begin
        let skip = label k in
        branch f a false skip;
        branch f b true l;
        place k skip
      end
      else (branch f a false l; branch f b false l)
  | Binary (Oror, a, b) ->
      if sense then (branch f a true l; branch f b true l)
      else begin
        let skip = label k in
        branch f a true skip;
        branch f b false l;
        place k skip
      end
  | Binary (o, a, b) when is_rel o ->
      let x, un = operands f o a b in
      let fl = is_float a.t in
      let x, un = if sense then (x, un) else (negate x, if fl then not un else un) in
      (* (beq has no .un, bne only its .un) *)
      let un = match x with Il.Eq -> false | Il.Ne -> true | _ -> un in
      emit k (Il.Bcmp (x, un, l))
  | _ when is_float n.t ->
      expr f n;
      emit k (Il.Ldc_r 0.0);
      emit k (if sense then Il.Bcmp (Il.Ne, true, l) else Il.Bcmp (Il.Eq, false, l))
  | _ -> expr f n; emit k (if sense then Il.Brtrue l else Il.Brfalse l)

and truth_value (f : fn) (n : expr) : unit =
  let k = f.k in
  let yes = label k and stop = label k in
  branch f n true yes;
  ldc k 0;
  emit k (Il.Br stop);
  place k yes;
  ldc k 1;
  place k stop

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Calls *)
(*****************************************************************************)

and call (f : fn) (n : expr) (fn : expr) (args : expr list) (used : bool) : unit =
  let c = f.c and k = f.k and line = n.line in
  (match fn.e with
   | Name (s, _, _) -> (
       match s.name, args with
       | "print", _ -> format f line None args
       | "sprint", buf :: rest -> format f line (Some buf) rest
       | "malloc", _ -> refuse line "malloc's memory given no type"
       | "free", _ -> List.iter (drop f) args
       | "_write", [ p; len ] ->
           (* (a Ptr<uint8>'s bytes, by the console's Stream) *)
           let t = pointee c line (link p.t) in
           let p = stash f p in
           let stream = S.Class (sys c "IO.Stream") in
           emit k (Il.Call (lib c "Console" "OpenStandardOutput" (static [] stream)));
           p (); emit k (Il.Ldfld (ptr_array c t));
           p (); emit k (Il.Ldfld (ptr_index c t));
           expr f len;
           let write = instance [ S.SzArray S.U1; S.I4; S.I4 ] S.Void in
           emit k (Il.Callvirt (lib c "IO.Stream" "Write" write))
       | "_exit", _ ->
           List.iter (expr f) args;
           emit k (Il.Call (lib c "Environment" "Exit" (static [ S.I4 ] S.Void)))
       | name, _ ->
           if List.mem name builtins then refuse line (name ^ "'s arguments");
           List.iter (value f) args;
           emit k (Il.Call (func_method c line name fn.t)))
   | Unary (Ind, p) ->
       expr f p;
       List.iter (value f) args;
       emit k (Il.Callvirt (invoke c line (link p.t)))
   | _ -> refuse line "a call of this");
  if (not used) && n.t.etype <> Tvoid then emit k Il.Pop
  else if used && n.t.etype = Tvoid then refuse line "a void function's value"

(* print's and sprint's format, a literal, compiled (Cil_strings): its
 * arguments computed first *)
and format (f : fn) (line : int) (buf : expr option) (args : expr list) : unit =
  match args with
  | { e = Unary (Addr, { e = Name (s, Cstatic, off); t; _ }); _ } :: rest
    when s.name = ".string" ->
      let text = Str.literal_bytes line t off in
      let buf = Option.map (stash f) buf in
      let args = List.map (fun (a : expr) -> (a, stash f a)) rest in
      Str.format f.c f.k line buf args text
  | _ -> refuse line "a format that is not a literal"
languages/c/dotnet/Cil_exprs.mli
2553
(* C's expressions to IL, for mini-cc -dotnet: a typed tree
 * (Check.complex, managed: a member a Dot, an array's address its own
 * type) pushed on IL's stack, its l-values places.
 *
 * A place is what an assignment, ++ or += reads and writes: a slot (an
 * argument, a local), an array's element (a global, a boxed variable),
 * a field (a member), a Ptr's ( *p ). What it needs is pushed once, kept
 * in a temporary when it has effects, so that *p++ += 2 computes p++
 * once:
 *
 *     *p++ += 2     t = p; p = p.Add(1)      (the place: Pptr t)
 *                   t.Set(t.Get() + 2)
 *
 * The typing leaves C's machine in the tree: a pointer's offset is
 * bytes, the index converted to the pointer's type and multiplied by
 * the element's size; p - q is bytes divided by it. Here an offset is
 * made elements again ([elements]: a product by the size is the index,
 * a constant divided, else a division), and p - q is Ptr.Diff
 * multiplied, which the typing's division undoes.
 *
 * print and sprint's formats are compiled where they are (Cil_strings),
 * their arguments computed first, in order. *)

open Cil_types

(* the file's globals: name, type when first seen, field (an array) *)
val globals : (string * Tree.typ * int) list ref
val reset : unit -> unit

(* a global's field, made at its first use *)
val global : c -> int -> string -> Tree.typ -> int

(* a variable of a function: an argument or local, or a local holding
 * an array (a C array; Boxed: a scalar or structure whose address is
 * taken, one element) *)
type var = Slot of bool * int | Boxed of int | Array_var of int

(* a function being compiled: the variables by key *)
type fn = {
  c : c;
  k : code;
  fname : string;
  vars : (string, var) Hashtbl.t;
}

(* a variable's key: name, offset, type (two blocks' may share one) *)
val key : Tree.sym -> int -> Tree.typ -> string

(* a function's method, by name and type: made at its first call or its
 * definition *)
val func_method : c -> int -> string -> Tree.typ -> int

val const : fn -> int -> Tree.typ -> int64 -> unit

(* n pushed; a value given (a structure's copy); given to a place of a
 * type (malloc's array of it); for effects only *)
val expr : fn -> Tree.expr -> unit
val value : fn -> Tree.expr -> unit
val assigned : fn -> Tree.typ -> Tree.expr -> unit
val drop : fn -> Tree.expr -> unit

(* &l: a Ptr to its array's first element, or a function's delegate *)
val address : fn -> Tree.expr -> unit

(* to the label if n's truth is the bool *)
val branch : fn -> Tree.expr -> bool -> int -> unit

(* Claude Code

(* See Cil_strings.mli *)

open Tree
open Tree_helpers
open Cil_types
module S = Signature
module W = Writer

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Literals *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the literals' bytes, as the typing writes them (Check.outstring) *)
let strings : Buffer.t = Buffer.create 1024

let outstring (s : string) (n : int) : int =
  let r = Buffer.length strings in
  for i = 0 to n - 1 do
    Buffer.add_char strings (if i < String.length s then s.[i] else '\000')
  done;
  r

(* each literal: its bytes, its field (an sbyte[], NUL ended) *)
let literals : (string * int) list ref = ref []

let reset () : unit =
  Buffer.clear strings;
  literals := []

(* a .NET string to C's: its chars' low bytes, then a NUL *)
let cstr (c : c) : int =
  memo c "cstr" (fun () ->
      let m =
        W.method_def c.w c.cls "<cstr>" 0x0091
          (static [ S.String ] (S.SzArray S.I1)) in
      let k = new_code () in
      let a = local k (S.SzArray S.I1) and i = local k S.I4 in
      let top = label k and stop = label k in
      let length = lib c "String" "get_Length" (instance [] S.I4) in
      let chars = lib c "String" "get_Chars" (instance [ S.I4 ] S.Char) in
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Callvirt length); ldc k 1;
      emit k (Il.Binop Il.Add);
      emit k (Il.Newarr (sys c "SByte")); emit k (Il.Stloc a);
      ldc k 0; emit k (Il.Stloc i);
      place k top;
      emit k (Il.Ldloc i); emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Callvirt length);
      emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Ge, false, stop));
      emit k (Il.Ldloc a); emit k (Il.Ldloc i);
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Ldloc i); emit k (Il.Callvirt chars);
      emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i1, false, false)); emit k (Il.Stelem Il.K_i1);
      emit k (Il.Ldloc i); ldc k 1; emit k (Il.Binop Il.Add); emit k (Il.Stloc i);
      emit k (Il.Br top);
      place k stop;
      emit k (Il.Ldloc a); emit k Il.Ret;
      finish c k m;
      m)

let literal (c : c) (bytes : string) : int =
  match List.assoc_opt bytes !literals with
  | Some f -> f
  | None ->
      let name = Printf.sprintf "<str>%d" (List.length !literals) in
      let f = W.field_def c.w c.cls name 0x0016 (S.SzArray S.I1) in
      literals := (bytes, f) :: !literals;
      f

(* a literal's bytes, from the typing's .string *)
let literal_bytes (line : int) (t : typ) (off : int) : string =
  if t.etype <> Tarray || (link t).etype <> Tchar then
    refuse line "a literal of wide characters";
  Buffer.sub strings off (t.width - 1)

(* a literal's array: its field, made at its first use *)
let literal_array (c : c) (k : code) (bytes : string) : unit =
  let fld = literal c bytes and l = label k in
  emit k (Il.Ldsfld fld);
  emit k Il.Dup;
  emit k (Il.Brtrue l);
  emit k Il.Pop;
  emit k (Il.Ldstr (W.user_string c.w bytes));
  emit k (Il.Call (cstr c));
  emit k Il.Dup;
  emit k (Il.Stsfld fld);
  place k l

(*****************************************************************************)
(* print's formats *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* libc.c's functions the compiler calls: their methods, as libc.c
 * defines them (read after the program) *)
let helper (c : c) (name : string) : int =
  let str = ptr_of c S.I1 in
  let ps, r =
    match name with
    | "_begin" | "exits" -> ([ str ], S.Void)
    | "_puts" -> ([ str; S.I4; S.I4 ], S.Void)
    | "_putc" -> ([ S.I4 ], S.Void)
    | "_putint" -> ([ S.I8; S.I4; S.I4; S.I4; S.I4 ], S.Void)
    | "_end" -> ([], S.I4)
    | _ -> failwith ("helper " ^ name) in
  memo c ("fn " ^ name) (fun () -> W.method_def c.w c.cls name 0x0096 (static ps r))

let format (c : c) (k : code) (line : int) (buf : (unit -> unit) option)
    (args : (expr * (unit -> unit)) list) (text : string) : unit =
  let call (name : string) = emit k (Il.Call (helper c name)) in
  let rest = ref args in
  let next () =
    match !rest with
    | x :: tl -> rest := tl; x
    | [] -> refuse line "print: more verbs than arguments" in
  (match buf with Some b -> b () | None -> emit k Il.Ldnull);
  call "_begin";
  let lit (s : string) =
    if s <> "" then begin
      literal_array c k s; ldc k 0;
      emit k (Il.Newobj (ptr_ctor c S.I1));
      ldc k 0; ldc k 0;
      call "_puts"
    end in
  let n = String.length text in
  let rec go (i : int) (start : int) =
    if i >= n then lit (String.sub text start (i - start))
    else if text.[i] <> '%' then go (i + 1) start
    else begin
      lit (String.sub text start (i - start));
      (* flags, width, h and l, then the verb *)
      let j = ref (i + 1) and width = ref 0 in
      let left = ref false and zero = ref false in
      while !j < n && (text.[!j] = '-' || text.[!j] = '0') && !width = 0 do
        if text.[!j] = '-' then left := true else zero := true;
        incr j
      done;
      while !j < n && text.[!j] >= '0' && text.[!j] <= '9' do
        width := !width * 10 + Char.code text.[!j] - 48;
        incr j
      done;
      while !j < n && (text.[!j] = 'h' || text.[!j] = 'l') do incr j done;
      if !j >= n then refuse line "a format ending in %";
      let flags = (if !left then 1 else 0) + if !zero then 2 else 0 in
      (match text.[!j] with
       | '%' -> lit "%"
       | 's' ->
           let a, v = next () in
           if a.t.etype <> Tind then refuse line "%s of no string";
           v (); ldc k !width; ldc k flags; call "_puts"
       | 'c' -> let _, v = next () in v (); call "_putc"
       (* (u a verb, as goken's libc and the tests' have it: %ud the
        * number, then a d) *)
       | ('d' | 'u' | 'x' | 'X' | 'o' | 'b') as verb ->
           let a, v = next () in
           if not (typei a.t.etype) then
             refuse line ("%" ^ String.make 1 verb ^ " of no integer");
           v ();
           if a.t.etype <> Tvlong && a.t.etype <> Tuvlong then begin
             let unsigned = typeu a.t.etype || verb <> 'd' in
             emit k (Il.Conv ((if unsigned then Il.K_u8 else Il.K_i8), false, false))
           end;
           ldc k (match verb with 'x' | 'X' -> 16 | 'o' -> 8 | 'b' -> 2 | _ -> 10);
           ldc k (if verb = 'X' then 1 else 0);
           ldc k !width; ldc k flags;
           call "_putint"
       | v -> refuse line (Printf.sprintf "print's verb %%%c" v));
      go (!j + 1) (!j + 1)
    end in
  go 0 0;
  if !rest <> [] then refuse line "print: more arguments than verbs";
  call "_end"
languages/c/dotnet/Cil_strings.mli

(* C's strings for mini-cc -dotnet: the literals, and print's formats
 * compiled.
 *
 * A literal is an sbyte[] (int8[], NUL ended) in a static field of the
 * program, made at its first use from a .NET string (ldstr, then
 * <cstr>, which takes each char's low byte: the writer's user strings
 * are Latin-1, a byte a char), and the same field for the same bytes.
 * A pointer to it is a Ptr<int8> as any char*: a program may write in
 * a literal, as in Plan 9's C.
 *
 * print and sprint are not calls: their format, a literal, is compiled
 * where they are, as mini-ml's Printf (Il_printf). The arguments are
 * computed first, in order (Cil_exprs), then each piece of text or verb
 * is a call of libc.c's _puts, _putc or _putint between _begin
 * (sprint's buffer, or nil) and _end (the count):
 *
 *     print("%d: %s\n", n, s)     _begin(nil); _putint(n, 10, 0, 0, 0);
 *                                 _puts(": ", 0, 0); _puts(s, 0, 0);
 *                                 _puts("\n", 0, 0); _end()
 *
 * The verbs are Plan 9's, as goken's libc and the tests' have them:
 * %d %x %X %o %b %c %s, flags - and 0 and a width, h and l, and %u a
 * verb of its own (%ud prints the number, then a d). *)

open Cil_types

(* Check.outstring's: the literals' bytes, their offsets *)
val outstring : string -> int -> int
val reset : unit -> unit

(* a .NET string to a C string (int8[], NUL ended): the method *)
val cstr : c -> int
(* a literal's bytes, from its .string name's type and offset *)
val literal_bytes : int -> Tree.typ -> int -> string
(* its array pushed *)
val literal_array : c -> code -> string -> unit

(* libc.c's functions whose calls the compiler makes (_puts, exits...) *)
val helper : c -> string -> int

(* a format's pieces: sprint's buffer (pushed by the function), the
 * arguments and what pushes each, the format's text *)
val format :
  c -> code -> int -> (unit -> unit) option -> (Tree.expr * (unit -> unit)) list ->
  string -> unit

(* Claude Code

(* See Cil_types.mli *)

open Tree
open Tree_helpers
module S = Signature
module W = Writer

exception Refused of int * string

let refuse (line : int) (what : string) : 'a =
  raise (Refused (line, what ^ ": not in mini-cc's managed C"
                        ^ " (plan_dotnet_languages.md, decision 4)"))

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The assembly's classes and members, each made when first needed *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type strukt = {
  stok : int;
  sctor : int;
  sclone : int;
  fields : (int * typ * int) list;      (* each member: its offset, type, field *)
}

type c = {
  w : W.t;
  runtime : int;                        (* the assembly System.Runtime *)
  console : int;                        (* System.Console, in its own assembly *)
  cls : int;                            (* the program's class *)
  memo : (string, int) Hashtbl.t;       (* what is made, by a name of ours *)
  mutable structs : (typ * strukt) list;
  mutable classes : (typ * int) list;   (* a structure's class, before its fields *)
}

let memo (c : c) (key : string) (make : unit -> int) : int =
  match Hashtbl.find_opt c.memo key with
  | Some x -> x
  | None ->
      let x = make () in
      Hashtbl.replace c.memo key x;
      x

let static (ps : S.t list) (r : S.t) : S.meth =
  { S.has_this = false; generic = 0; vararg = false; ret = r; params = ps }
let instance (ps : S.t list) (r : S.t) : S.meth =
  { (static ps r) with has_this = true }

let sys (c : c) (name : string) : int =
  memo c ("type " ^ name) (fun () ->
      if name = "Console" then c.console
      else
        match String.rindex_opt name '.' with
        | Some i ->
            W.type_ref c.w c.runtime ("System." ^ String.sub name 0 i)
              (String.sub name (i + 1) (String.length name - i - 1))
        | None -> W.type_ref c.w c.runtime "System" name)

(* a member of .NET's library: its class (IO.Stream: System.IO's), name
 * and signature *)
let lib (c : c) (cls : string) (name : string) (m : S.meth) : int =
  memo c (cls ^ "::" ^ name ^ S.encode_method m) (fun () ->
      W.member_ref c.w (sys c cls) name m)

let object_ctor (c : c) : int = lib c "Object" ".ctor" (instance [] S.Void)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* A method's code: the instructions, their labels, the locals *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type code = {
  mutable ops : Il.op list;             (* reversed *)
  mutable n : int;
  labels : (int, int) Hashtbl.t;        (* a label to its instruction *)
  mutable nlabels : int;
  mutable locals : S.t list;            (* reversed *)
  mutable nlocals : int;
}

let new_code () : code =
  { ops = []; n = 0; labels = Hashtbl.create 8; nlabels = 0; locals = [];
    nlocals = 0 }

let emit (k : code) (op : Il.op) : unit =
  k.ops <- op :: k.ops;
  k.n <- k.n + 1

let label (k : code) : int =
  k.nlabels <- k.nlabels + 1;
  k.nlabels

let place (k : code) (l : int) : unit = Hashtbl.replace k.labels l k.n

let local (k : code) (ty : S.t) : int =
  k.locals <- ty :: k.locals;
  k.nlocals <- k.nlocals + 1;
  k.nlocals - 1

(* the labels made instructions' numbers, and the body set *)
let finish (c : c) (k : code) (meth : int) : unit =
  let at (l : int) : int = Hashtbl.find k.labels l in
  let ops =
    Array.of_list
      (List.rev_map
         (fun (op : Il.op) ->
           match op with
           | Il.Br l -> Il.Br (at l)
           | Il.Brfalse l -> Il.Brfalse (at l)
           | Il.Brtrue l -> Il.Brtrue (at l)
           | Il.Bcmp (x, u, l) -> Il.Bcmp (x, u, at l)
           | op -> op)
         k.ops) in
  W.set_body c.w meth (List.rev k.locals) ops []

(* an int32 constant *)
let ldc (k : code) (n : int) : unit = emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_int n))

(*****************************************************************************)
(* C's types as .NET's *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* what an array is made of: an array of arrays is one array of their
 * elements (int m[3][4], 12 ints), as C lays it out *)
let rec base (t : typ) : typ = if t.etype = Tarray then base (link t) else t

let count (line : int) (t : typ) : int =
  let b = base t in
  if b.width < 1 then refuse line "an array of an incomplete type"
  else t.width / b.width

(* the Ptr class (a C pointer: an array and an index in it, null for
 * 0), made once; its methods' signatures as its own body names them *)
let ptr_class (c : c) : int = Hashtbl.find c.memo "class Ptr"
let ptr_of (c : c) (t : S.t) : S.t = S.GenericInst (S.Class (ptr_class c), [ t ])
let self (c : c) : S.t = ptr_of c (S.Var 0)

let ptr_member (c : c) (t : S.t) (name : string) (m : S.meth) : int =
  memo c ("Ptr " ^ S.encode_type_spec t ^ " " ^ name) (fun () ->
      W.member_ref c.w (W.type_spec c.w (ptr_of c t)) name m)

let ptr_field (c : c) (t : S.t) (name : string) (ty : S.t) : int =
  memo c ("Ptr field " ^ S.encode_type_spec t ^ " " ^ name) (fun () ->
      W.field_ref c.w (W.type_spec c.w (ptr_of c t)) name ty)

let ptr_ctor (c : c) (t : S.t) : int =
  ptr_member c t ".ctor" (instance [ S.SzArray (S.Var 0); S.I4 ] S.Void)
let ptr_get (c : c) (t : S.t) : int = ptr_member c t "Get" (instance [] (S.Var 0))
let ptr_set (c : c) (t : S.t) : int =
  ptr_member c t "Set" (instance [ S.Var 0 ] S.Void)
let ptr_add (c : c) (t : S.t) : int =
  ptr_member c t "Add" (instance [ S.I4 ] (self c))
let ptr_diff (c : c) (t : S.t) : int =
  ptr_member c t "Diff" (static [ self c; self c ] S.I4)
let ptr_eq (c : c) (t : S.t) : int =
  ptr_member c t "Eq" (static [ self c; self c ] S.I4)
let ptr_array (c : c) (t : S.t) : int = ptr_field c t "a" (S.SzArray (S.Var 0))
let ptr_index (c : c) (t : S.t) : int = ptr_field c t "i" S.I4

(* its class: Get and Set the element, Add an offset, Diff of two, Eq
 * (both null, or the same array and index) *)
let make_ptr_class (c : c) : unit =
  let w = c.w in
  let cls = W.type_def w "" "Ptr`1" 0x00100101 (sys c "Object") in
  W.generic_param w cls 0 "T";
  Hashtbl.replace c.memo "class Ptr" cls;
  ignore (W.field_def w cls "a" 0x0006 (S.SzArray (S.Var 0)));
  ignore (W.field_def w cls "i" 0x0006 S.I4);
  let v = S.Var 0 in
  let a = ptr_array c v and i = ptr_index c v and elt = W.type_spec w v in
  let body (name : string) (flags : int) (m : S.meth) (ops : Il.op list) =
    let meth = W.method_def w cls name flags m in
    W.set_body w meth [] (Array.of_list ops) [] in
  body ".ctor" 0x1886 (instance [ S.SzArray v; S.I4 ] S.Void)
    [ Il.Ldarg 0; Il.Call (object_ctor c); Il.Ldarg 0; Il.Ldarg 1; Il.Stfld a;
      Il.Ldarg 0; Il.Ldarg 2; Il.Stfld i; Il.Ret ];
  body "Get" 0x0086 (instance [] v)
    [ Il.Ldarg 0; Il.Ldfld a; Il.Ldarg 0; Il.Ldfld i; Il.Ldelem_any elt; Il.Ret ];
  body "Set" 0x0086 (instance [ v ] S.Void)
    [ Il.Ldarg 0; Il.Ldfld a; Il.Ldarg 0; Il.Ldfld i; Il.Ldarg 1;
      Il.Stelem_any elt; Il.Ret ];
  body "Add" 0x0086 (instance [ S.I4 ] (self c))
    [ Il.Ldarg 0; Il.Ldfld a; Il.Ldarg 0; Il.Ldfld i; Il.Ldarg 1; Il.Binop Il.Add;
      Il.Newobj (ptr_ctor c v); Il.Ret ];
  body "Diff" 0x0096 (static [ self c; self c ] S.I4)
    [ Il.Ldarg 0; Il.Ldfld i; Il.Ldarg 1; Il.Ldfld i; Il.Binop Il.Sub; Il.Ret ];
  (* (a branch's target an instruction's index: 6, 10, 21) *)
  body "Eq" 0x0096 (static [ self c; self c ] S.I4)
    [ Il.Ldarg 0; Il.Brtrue 6; Il.Ldarg 1; Il.Ldnull; Il.Ceq; Il.Ret;
      Il.Ldarg 1; Il.Brtrue 10; Il.Ldc_i4 0l; Il.Ret;
      Il.Ldarg 0; Il.Ldfld a; Il.Ldarg 1; Il.Ldfld a; Il.Bcmp (Il.Ne, true, 21);
      Il.Ldarg 0; Il.Ldfld i; Il.Ldarg 1; Il.Ldfld i; Il.Ceq; Il.Ret;
      Il.Ldc_i4 0l; Il.Ret ]

(* a .NET type's token: System's class for a primitive, a class's own,
 * a TypeSpec for the others *)
let token_of (c : c) (ty : S.t) : int =
  match ty with
  | S.I1 -> sys c "SByte"
  | S.U1 -> sys c "Byte"
  | S.I2 -> sys c "Int16"
  | S.U2 -> sys c "UInt16"
  | S.I4 -> sys c "Int32"
  | S.U4 -> sys c "UInt32"
  | S.I8 -> sys c "Int64"
  | S.U8 -> sys c "UInt64"
  | S.R4 -> sys c "Single"
  | S.R8 -> sys c "Double"
  | S.Object -> sys c "Object"
  | S.Class tok -> tok
  | ty -> memo c ("spec " ^ S.encode_type_spec ty) (fun () -> W.type_spec c.w ty)

(* a structure's, by its type or its tag (a type copied for a
 * qualifier is the same structure) *)
let same_struct (t : typ) (l : (typ * 'a) list) : 'a option =
  let same (t' : typ) =
    t' == t || (match t.tag, t'.tag with Some a, Some b -> a == b | _ -> false) in
  Option.map snd (List.find_opt (fun ((t', _) : typ * 'a) -> same t') l)

(* a value's type where it is stored: an array's element, a member *)
let rec cts (c : c) (line : int) (t : typ) : S.t =
  match t.etype with
  | Tchar -> S.I1
  | Tuchar -> S.U1
  | Tshort -> S.I2
  | Tushort -> S.U2
  | Tint | Tlong | Tenum -> S.I4
  | Tuint | Tulong -> S.U4
  | Tvlong -> S.I8
  | Tuvlong -> S.U8
  | Tfloat -> S.R4
  | Tdouble -> S.R8
  | Tvoid -> S.Void
  | Tind ->
      let p = link t in
      if p.etype = Tfunc then delegate c line p else ptr_of c (pointee c line p)
  | Tarray -> S.SzArray (cts c line (base t))
  | Tstruct -> S.Class (struct_class c line t)
  | Tunion -> refuse line "a union"
  | Tfunc | Tdot | Told | Txxx -> refuse line ("a value of type " ^ tname t.etype)

(* what a pointer's array holds: void*'s an object *)
and pointee (c : c) (line : int) (p : typ) : S.t =
  let b = base p in
  if b.etype = Tvoid then S.Object else cts c line b

(* a function's pointer: a Func (Action if void) of its parameters and
 * result, each a slot's type *)
and delegate (c : c) (line : int) (f : typ) : S.t =
  let ps = params c line f and r = slot c line (link f) in
  let generic (name : string) (ts : S.t list) =
    let cls = sys c (Printf.sprintf "%s`%d" name (List.length ts)) in
    S.GenericInst (S.Class cls, ts) in
  if r <> S.Void then generic "Func" (ps @ [ r ])
  else if ps = [] then S.Class (sys c "Action")
  else generic "Action" ps

and params (c : c) (line : int) (f : typ) : S.t list =
  let rec go (p : typ option) =
    match p with
    | None -> []
    | Some p when p.etype = Tvoid && p.down = None -> []
    | Some p when p.etype = Tdot || p.etype = Told ->
        refuse line "a function of variable arguments"
    | Some p -> slot c line p :: go p.down in
  go f.down

(* a variable's, a parameter's, a result's: a char or short an int32,
 * as C passes it (an array is its reference) *)
and slot (c : c) (line : int) (t : typ) : S.t =
  match t.etype with
  | Tchar | Tuchar | Tshort | Tushort -> S.I4
  | _ -> cts c line t

(* a structure's class: its token, which its members may name (a
 * Node's next), given before they are made *)
and struct_class (c : c) (line : int) (t : typ) : int =
  match same_struct t c.classes with
  | Some tok -> tok
  | None -> (struct_info c line t).stok

and struct_info (c : c) (line : int) (t : typ) : strukt =
  match same_struct t c.structs with
  | Some s -> s
  | None ->
      let w = c.w in
      let name =
        match t.tag with
        | Some s -> s.name
        | None -> Printf.sprintf "struct%d" (List.length c.classes) in
      let tok = W.type_def w "" name 0x00100101 (sys c "Object") in
      c.classes <- (t, tok) :: c.classes;
      let rec members (m : typ option) =
        match m with
        | None -> []
        | Some m -> (
            match m.tsym with
            | None -> refuse line ("an unnamed member of struct " ^ name)
            | Some s ->
                (m.offset, m, W.field_def w tok s.name 0x0006 (cts c line m))
                :: members m.down) in
      let fields = members t.link in
      let ctor = W.method_def w tok ".ctor" 0x1886 (instance [] S.Void) in
      let clone = W.method_def w tok "Clone" 0x0086 (instance [] (S.Class tok)) in
      let s = { stok = tok; sctor = ctor; sclone = clone; fields } in
      c.structs <- (t, s) :: c.structs;
      (* its constructor makes its arrays and structures *)
      let k = new_code () in
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0);
      emit k (Il.Call (object_ctor c));
      List.iter
        (fun ((_, m, f) : int * typ * int) ->
          match m.etype with
          | Tarray ->
              emit k (Il.Ldarg 0);
              new_array c k line m (fun () -> ldc k (count line m));
              emit k (Il.Stfld f)
          | Tstruct ->
              emit k (Il.Ldarg 0);
              emit k (Il.Newobj (struct_info c line m).sctor);
              emit k (Il.Stfld f)
          | _ -> ())
        fields;
      emit k Il.Ret;
      finish c k ctor;
      (* its copy: C's assignment of a structure *)
      let k = new_code () in
      let r = local k (S.Class tok) in
      emit k (Il.Newobj ctor);
      emit k (Il.Stloc r);
      List.iter
        (fun ((_, m, f) : int * typ * int) ->
          match m.etype with
          | Tarray ->
              let b = base m in
              let i = local k S.I4 and top = label k and stop = label k in
              ldc k 0;
              emit k (Il.Stloc i);
              place k top;
              emit k (Il.Ldloc i);
              ldc k (count line m);
              emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Ge, false, stop));
              emit k (Il.Ldloc r); emit k (Il.Ldfld f); emit k (Il.Ldloc i);
              emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Ldfld f); emit k (Il.Ldloc i);
              emit k (Il.Ldelem (load_kind c line b));
              if b.etype = Tstruct then
                emit k (Il.Callvirt (struct_info c line b).sclone);
              emit k (Il.Stelem (store_kind c line b));
              emit k (Il.Ldloc i); ldc k 1; emit k (Il.Binop Il.Add);
              emit k (Il.Stloc i);
              emit k (Il.Br top);
              place k stop
          | _ ->
              emit k (Il.Ldloc r);
              emit k (Il.Ldarg 0);
              emit k (Il.Ldfld f);
              if m.etype = Tstruct then
                emit k (Il.Callvirt (struct_info c line m).sclone);
              emit k (Il.Stfld f))
        fields;
      emit k (Il.Ldloc r);
      emit k Il.Ret;
      finish c k clone;
      s

(* a new array of t's elements, their number pushed by n; a structure's
 * made each *)
and new_array (c : c) (k : code) (line : int) (t : typ) (n : unit -> unit) : unit =
  let b = base t in
  n ();
  emit k (Il.Newarr (type_token c line b));
  if b.etype = Tstruct then begin
    let a = local k (S.SzArray (cts c line b)) and i = local k S.I4 in
    let top = label k and stop = label k in
    emit k (Il.Stloc a);
    ldc k 0;
    emit k (Il.Stloc i);
    place k top;
    emit k (Il.Ldloc i);
    emit k (Il.Ldloc a);
    emit k Il.Ldlen;
    emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false));
    emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Ge, false, stop));
    emit k (Il.Ldloc a); emit k (Il.Ldloc i);
    emit k (Il.Newobj (struct_info c line b).sctor); emit k (Il.Stelem Il.K_ref);
    emit k (Il.Ldloc i); ldc k 1; emit k (Il.Binop Il.Add); emit k (Il.Stloc i);
    emit k (Il.Br top);
    place k stop;
    emit k (Il.Ldloc a)
  end

(* a type's token, as newarr takes it *)
and type_token (c : c) (line : int) (t : typ) : int = token_of c (pointee c line t)

and load_kind (c : c) (line : int) (t : typ) : Il.kind =
  match cts c line t with
  | S.I1 -> Il.K_i1
  | S.U1 -> Il.K_u1
  | S.I2 -> Il.K_i2
  | S.U2 -> Il.K_u2
  | S.I4 -> Il.K_i4
  | S.U4 -> Il.K_u4
  | S.I8 | S.U8 -> Il.K_i8
  | S.R4 -> Il.K_r4
  | S.R8 -> Il.K_r8
  | _ -> Il.K_ref

and store_kind (c : c) (line : int) (t : typ) : Il.kind =
  match load_kind c line t with
  | Il.K_u1 -> Il.K_i1
  | Il.K_u2 -> Il.K_i2
  | Il.K_u4 -> Il.K_i4
  | k -> k

(* a delegate's Invoke and constructor (an object, a method's address) *)
let invoke (c : c) (line : int) (f : typ) : int =
  let d = delegate c line f in
  let n = List.length (params c line f) in
  let r = if slot c line (link f) = S.Void then S.Void else S.Var n in
  memo c ("invoke " ^ S.encode_type_spec d) (fun () ->
      let ps = List.init n (fun (i : int) -> S.Var i) in
      W.member_ref c.w (W.type_spec c.w d) "Invoke" (instance ps r))

let delegate_ctor (c : c) (line : int) (f : typ) : int =
  let d = delegate c line f in
  memo c ("delegate ctor " ^ S.encode_type_spec d) (fun () ->
      let cls = match d with S.Class t -> t | _ -> W.type_spec c.w d in
      W.member_ref c.w cls ".ctor" (instance [ S.Object; S.I ] S.Void))
languages/c/dotnet/Cil_types.mli
5913
(* C's types as .NET's, for mini-cc -dotnet (plan_dotnet_languages.md,
 * stage 5, decision 4): a managed C, whose values are the CTS's, so
 * that a C# or ML program can take them as they are. What C does
 * that the CTS's types do not allow is refused at compile time, as
 * C++/CLI's safe mode (/clr:safe) refused it.
 *
 *     C                        .NET
 *     char, short, int, long   int8, int16, int32, int32 (Plan 9's long)
 *     vlong, float, double     int64, float32, float64
 *     unsigned ...             uint8 ... uint64
 *     int a[3][4]              int32[] of 12: an array of arrays one array
 *     struct Node              a class, Node: its members fields, its
 *                              arrays and structures made by its
 *                              constructor; copied by Clone (=)
 *     T*                       Ptr<T>: an array and an index; 0 is null
 *     int ( * )(int, char* )   Func<int32, Ptr<int8>, int32>
 *     void*                    Ptr<object>: malloc's, given a type
 *
 * A pointer is a pair, not a managed reference (int32&): a reference
 * can neither be kept in a field nor moved, and C's pointers are kept
 * in structures (a Node's next) and moved (p++). The pair moves within
 * its array and .NET checks each access against the array's bounds:
 * arithmetic past the end is caught when the pointer is used, not
 * when it is made. Ptr's methods: Get and Set ( *p ), Add (p + n, in
 * elements), Diff (p - q, Ptr's indexes), Eq (p == q: both null, or
 * one array and one index):
 *
 *     int a[10], *p = &a[3];      p    Ptr<int32> { a = the array; i = 3 }
 *     *p = 100;                   p.Set(100), as a.[3] <- 100
 *     p++;                        p = p.Add(1)
 *
 * A variable whose address is taken (&x, x a scalar or a structure)
 * lives in an array of one element, so that its Ptr has an array; a
 * global always does (its address may be taken in a function not yet
 * read). Each slot (a local, a parameter, a result) of a char or a
 * short is an int32, as C passes them; an array's element and a
 * member keep their width (stelem.i1 truncates, ldelem.i1 extends).
 *
 * others: decision 4's first plan was C++/CLI's int32& for a pointer
 * into an array. Microsoft's C++/CLI (2005) compiled all of C++ with
 * /clr (unverifiable: raw pointers into the native heap) and refused
 * pointers with /clr:safe, where a program used .NET's handles (T^);
 * Ptr here is the safe C a fat pointer makes, as Cyclone's (2002) and
 * CCured's (2002) did for safety on native machines. *)

exception Refused of int * string

(* not in the managed C: the line, what *)
val refuse : int -> string -> 'a

(* a structure's class: its token, constructor, Clone, and each member's
 * offset, type and field *)
type strukt = {
  stok : int;
  sctor : int;
  sclone : int;
  fields : (int * Tree.typ * int) list;
}

(* the assembly being made: its writer, references, the program's class
 * (its functions, globals, literals), what is made by a name of ours *)
type c = {
  w : Writer.t;
  runtime : int;
  console : int;
  cls : int;
  memo : (string, int) Hashtbl.t;
  mutable structs : (Tree.typ * strukt) list;
  mutable classes : (Tree.typ * int) list;
}

val memo : c -> string -> (unit -> int) -> int
val static : Signature.t list -> Signature.t -> Signature.meth
val instance : Signature.t list -> Signature.t -> Signature.meth
(* System's class (IO.Stream: System.IO's), a member of it *)
val sys : c -> string -> int
val lib : c -> string -> string -> Signature.meth -> int

 * the locals *)

  mutable n : int;

  mutable nlabels : int;

}

(* Claude Code

(* See Lower_cil.mli *)

open Tree
open Tree_helpers
open Cil_types
module E = Cil_exprs
module S = Signature
module W = Writer

(* the assembly being made, its file's name, its functions defined,
 * the globals' initializers (gextern's) *)
type state = {
  c : c;
  name : string;
  mutable defined : string list;
  mutable inits : (sym * typ * int * expr) list;   (* reversed *)
}

let current : state option ref = ref None

let state () : state =
  match !current with Some s -> s | None -> failwith "Lower_cil.start not called"

(* a refusal, the front end's error at its line *)
let guard (f : unit -> 'a) : 'a =
  try f () with Refused (line, m) -> error_at line "%s" m

let start (name : string) : unit =
  let w = W.create name in
  let runtime = W.assembly_ref w "System.Runtime" in
  let console =
    W.type_ref w (W.assembly_ref w "System.Console") "System" "Console" in
  let obj = W.type_ref w runtime "System" "Object" in
  (* (a static class, its initializer run at its first use) *)
  let cls = W.type_def w "" name 0x00000181 obj in
  let c =
    { w; runtime; console; cls; memo = Hashtbl.create 64; structs = [];
      classes = [] } in
  Hashtbl.replace c.memo "type Object" obj;
  make_ptr_class c;
  E.reset ();
  current := Some { c; name; defined = []; inits = [] }

(*****************************************************************************)
(* A function's variables *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the subexpressions of n, n first *)
let rec walk (visit : expr -> unit) (n : expr) : unit =
  visit n;
  match n.e with
  | Unary (_, a) | Dot (a, _) | Elem (a, _) | Sizeof a | Typed a -> walk visit a
  | Binary (_, a, b) | Assign (_, a, b) -> walk visit a; walk visit b
  | Cond (a, b, x) -> walk visit a; walk visit b; walk visit x
  | Call (fn, args) -> walk visit fn; List.iter (walk visit) args
  | Name _ | Const _ | Fconst _ | Str _ | Lstr _ | Reg _ | Indreg _
  | Sizeof_type _ -> ()

let rec exprs (visit : expr -> unit) (s : stmt) : unit =
  let go = exprs visit and e = walk visit in
  match s with
  | Expr x -> e x
  | Block l -> List.iter go l
  | If (x, a, b) -> e x; go a; Option.iter go b
  | While (x, a) | Dowhile (a, x) | Switch (x, a) -> e x; go a
  | For (a, x, b, body) -> go a; Option.iter e x; go b; go body
  | Case (Some x) -> e x
  | Return (Some x, _) -> e x
  | Case None | Label _ | Goto _ | Break | Continue | Return (None, _)
  | Used _ | Set _ -> ()

(* the statement typed (Check.complex), its expressions in their order *)
let rec checked (s : stmt) : stmt =
  match s with
  | Expr x -> Expr (Check.complex x)
  | Block l -> Block (List.map checked l)
  | If (x, a, b) ->
      let x = Check.complex x in
      let a = checked a in
      If (x, a, Option.map checked b)
  | While (x, a) -> let x = Check.complex x in While (x, checked a)
  | Dowhile (a, x) -> let a = checked a in Dowhile (a, Check.complex x)
  | For (a, x, b, body) ->
      let a = checked a in
      let x = Option.map Check.complex x in
      let b = checked b in
      For (a, x, b, checked body)
  | Switch (x, a) -> let x = Check.complex x in Switch (x, checked a)
  | Case (Some x) -> Case (Some (Check.complex x))
  | Return (Some x, rt) -> Return (Some (Check.complex_ret rt x), rt)
  | s -> s

(* each parameter's offset, in order (Declare's param) *)
let parameter_offsets (t : typ) : int list =
  let offset =
    ref (match t.link with Some r -> Declare.align 0 r Declare.Aarg0 | None -> 0) in
  let rec go (p : typ option) : int list =
    match p with
    | None -> []
    | Some p when p.etype = Tvoid -> []
    | Some p ->
        offset := Declare.align !offset p Declare.Aarg1;
        let here = !offset in
        offset := Declare.align !offset p Declare.Aarg2;
        here :: go p.down in
  go t.down

(* the function's variables: each a slot, or a local holding an array
 * (made here, at the start) when it is one or its address is taken *)
let variables (f : E.fn) (t : typ) (body : stmt) : unit =
  let c = f.c and k = f.k in
  let taken = Hashtbl.create 8 and names = ref [] in
  exprs
    (fun (n : expr) ->
      match n.e with
      | Unary (Addr, { e = Name (s, (Cauto | Cparam), off); t; _ }) ->
          Hashtbl.replace taken (E.key s off t) ()
      | Name (s, ((Cauto | Cparam) as cl), off) ->
          let key = E.key s off n.t in
          if not (List.mem_assoc key !names) then
            names := (key, (cl, off, n.t, n.line)) :: !names
      | _ -> ())
    body;
  let offsets = parameter_offsets t in
  List.iter
    (fun ((key, (cl, off, t, line)) : string * (cls * int * typ * int)) ->
      let boxed = Hashtbl.mem taken key && t.etype <> Tarray in
      let var =
        match cl with
        | Cparam ->
            let rec index (i : int) (l : int list) =
              match l with
              | o :: rest -> if o = off then i else index (i + 1) rest
              | [] -> refuse line "a parameter not in the prototype" in
            let i = index 0 offsets in
            if boxed then begin
              let a = local k (S.SzArray (cts c line t)) in
              ldc k 1;
              emit k (Il.Newarr (type_token c line t));
              emit k (Il.Stloc a);
              emit k (Il.Ldloc a); ldc k 0; emit k (Il.Ldarg i);
              emit k (Il.Stelem (store_kind c line t));
              E.Boxed a
            end
            else E.Slot (true, i)
        | _ when t.etype = Tarray || boxed ->
            let a = local k (S.SzArray (cts c line (base t))) in
            new_array c k line t (fun () ->
                ldc k (if boxed then 1 else count line t));
            emit k (Il.Stloc a);
            if boxed then E.Boxed a else E.Array_var a
        | _ when t.etype = Tstruct ->
            let l = local k (S.Class (struct_class c line t)) in
            emit k (Il.Newobj (struct_info c line t).sctor);
            emit k (Il.Stloc l);
            E.Slot (false, l)
        | _ -> E.Slot (false, local k (slot c line t)) in
      Hashtbl.replace f.vars key var)
    (List.rev !names)

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Statements *)
(*****************************************************************************)

type ctx = {
  brk : int option;
  cont : int option;
  cases : int list ref;                  (* the switch's labels not yet placed *)
  labels : (string, int) Hashtbl.t;      (* the function's *)
}

(* a switch's cases, in order, not those of a switch inside *)
let rec cases (s : stmt) : expr option list =
  match s with
  | Case x -> [ x ]
  | Block l -> List.concat_map cases l
  | If (_, a, b) -> cases a @ (match b with Some b -> cases b | None -> [])
  | While (_, a) | Dowhile (a, _) | For (_, _, _, a) -> cases a
  | _ -> []

let rec stmt (f : E.fn) (ctx : ctx) (s : stmt) : unit =
  let k = f.k in
  let go = stmt f ctx in
  let named (l : label) = match Hashtbl.find_opt ctx.labels l.lsym.name with
    | Some x -> x
    | None -> let x = label k in Hashtbl.replace ctx.labels l.lsym.name x; x in
  match s with
  | Expr x -> E.drop f x
  | Block l -> List.iter go l
  | If (x, a, b) ->
      let other = label k and stop = label k in
      E.branch f x false other;
      go a;
      emit k (Il.Br stop);
      place k other;
      Option.iter go b;
      place k stop
  | While (x, a) ->
      let top = label k and stop = label k in
      place k top;
      E.branch f x false stop;
      stmt f { ctx with brk = Some stop; cont = Some top } a;
      emit k (Il.Br top);
      place k stop
  | Dowhile (a, x) ->
      let top = label k and test = label k and stop = label k in
      place k top;
      stmt f { ctx with brk = Some stop; cont = Some test } a;
      place k test;
      E.branch f x true top;
      place k stop
  | For (a, x, b, body) ->
      let top = label k and step = label k and stop = label k in
      go a;
      place k top;
      Option.iter (fun (x : expr) -> E.branch f x false stop) x;
      stmt f { ctx with brk = Some stop; cont = Some step } body;
      place k step;
      stmt f ctx b;
      emit k (Il.Br top);
      place k stop
  | Switch (x, body) ->
      let line = x.line in
      let v = local k (slot f.c line x.t) and stop = label k in
      E.expr f x;
      emit k (Il.Stloc v);
      let cs = cases body in
      let ls = List.map (fun (_ : expr option) -> label k) cs in
      List.iter2
        (fun (cs : expr option) (l : int) ->
          match cs with
          | Some { e = Const n; _ } ->
              emit k (Il.Ldloc v);
              E.const f line x.t n;
              emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Eq, false, l))
          | Some _ -> refuse line "a case of no constant"
          | None -> ())
        cs ls;
      emit k (Il.Br (match List.assoc_opt None (List.combine cs ls) with
                     | Some l -> l | None -> stop));
      stmt f { ctx with brk = Some stop; cases = ref ls } body;
      place k stop
  | Case _ -> (
      match !(ctx.cases) with
      | l :: rest -> ctx.cases := rest; place k l
      | [] -> refuse !lineno "a case outside a switch")
  | Label l -> place k (named l)
  | Goto l -> emit k (Il.Br (named l))
  | Break -> (
      match ctx.brk with
      | Some l -> emit k (Il.Br l)
      | None -> refuse !lineno "a break outside a loop")
  | Continue -> (
      match ctx.cont with
      | Some l -> emit k (Il.Br l)
      | None -> refuse !lineno "a continue outside a loop")
  | Return (None, _) -> emit k Il.Ret
  | Return (Some x, rt) -> E.assigned f rt x; emit k Il.Ret
  | Used _ | Set _ -> ()

(* a function: its method's body *)
let func (fs : sym) (body : stmt) : unit =
  guard (fun () ->
      let st = state () in
      let c = st.c and line = !lineno in
      let t =
        match fs.typ with Some t -> t | None -> refuse line "a function, no type" in
      let meth = E.func_method c line fs.name t in
      st.defined <- fs.name :: st.defined;
      let body = checked body in
      let f = { E.c; k = new_code (); fname = fs.name; vars = Hashtbl.create 16 } in
      variables f t body;
      stmt f { brk = None; cont = None; cases = ref []; labels = Hashtbl.create 4 }
        body;
      (* (the end: a value of none if the function has a result) *)
      (match slot c line (link t) with
       | S.Void -> ()
       | S.I8 | S.U8 -> emit f.k (Il.Ldc_i8 0L)
       | S.R4 | S.R8 -> emit f.k (Il.Ldc_r 0.0)
       | S.I4 | S.U4 -> ldc f.k 0
       | _ -> emit f.k Il.Ldnull);
      emit f.k Il.Ret;
      finish c f.k meth)

(* a global's initializer at an offset (Declare's gextern) *)
let gextern (s : sym) (x : expr) (o : int) (_ : int) : unit =
  let st = state () in
  match s.typ with
  | Some t -> st.inits <- (s, t, o, x) :: st.inits
  | None -> ()

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The assembly *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* the globals' initializers (<init>), then their arrays made, before
 * (the class's .cctor) *)
let initializers (st : state) : unit =
  let c = st.c in
  let k = new_code () in
  let f = { E.c; k; fname = "<init>"; vars = Hashtbl.create 1 } in
  List.iter
    (fun ((s, t, o, x) : sym * typ * int * expr) ->
      let line = x.line in
      let b = base t in
      if b.etype = Tstruct then
        refuse line ("the initializer of a structure: " ^ s.name);
      let fld = E.global c line s.name t in
      match x.e with
      | Name (n, Cstatic, off) when n.name = ".string" && b.etype = Tchar ->
          (* (char a[] = "...": the literal's bytes, its NUL) *)
          String.iteri
            (fun (i : int) (ch : char) ->
              emit k (Il.Ldsfld fld); ldc k (o + i); ldc k (Char.code ch);
              emit k (Il.Stelem Il.K_i1))
            (Cil_strings.literal_bytes line x.t off ^ "\000")
      | _ ->
          emit k (Il.Ldsfld fld);
          ldc k (o / b.width);
          (* (an array, a literal: its address, as Declare leaves it) *)
          if x.t.etype = Tarray then E.address f x else E.assigned f b x;
          emit k (Il.Stelem (store_kind c line b)))
    (List.rev st.inits);
  emit k Il.Ret;
  let init = W.method_def c.w c.cls "<init>" 0x0091 (static [] S.Void) in
  finish c k init;
  let k = new_code () in
  List.iter
    (fun ((name, t0, fld) : string * typ * int) ->
      let line = !lineno in
      (* (the declaration's type, complete: int a[] = {...}) *)
      let t =
        match (lookup name).typ with Some t when t.etype = t0.etype -> t | _ -> t0 in
      new_array c k line t (fun () ->
          ldc k (if t.etype = Tarray then count line t else 1));
      emit k (Il.Stsfld fld))
    (List.rev !E.globals);
  emit k (Il.Call init);
  emit k Il.Ret;
  finish c k (W.method_def c.w c.cls ".cctor" 0x1891 (static [] S.Void))

(* the entry point: C's argv of the arguments, after the program's
 * name, main called, then exits(nil) *)
let entry (st : state) (main : sym) : unit =
  let c = st.c in
  let line = !lineno in
  let t = Option.get main.typ in
  let str = ptr_of c S.I1 in
  let k = new_code () in
  let a = local k (S.SzArray str) and i = local k S.I4 in
  let top = label k and stop = label k in
  let cstring () =
    emit k (Il.Call (Cil_strings.cstr c)); ldc k 0;
    emit k (Il.Newobj (ptr_ctor c S.I1)) in
  (* (.NET's arguments, plus n) *)
  let args (n : int) =
    emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k Il.Ldlen; emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false));
    if n > 0 then (ldc k n; emit k (Il.Binop Il.Add)) in
  args 2;
  emit k (Il.Newarr (token_of c str));
  emit k (Il.Stloc a);
  emit k (Il.Ldloc a); ldc k 0;
  emit k (Il.Ldstr (W.user_string c.w ("./" ^ st.name))); cstring ();
  emit k (Il.Stelem Il.K_ref);
  ldc k 0; emit k (Il.Stloc i);
  place k top;
  emit k (Il.Ldloc i); args 0;
  emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Ge, false, stop));
  emit k (Il.Ldloc a); emit k (Il.Ldloc i); ldc k 1; emit k (Il.Binop Il.Add);
  emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Ldloc i); emit k (Il.Ldelem Il.K_ref); cstring ();
  emit k (Il.Stelem Il.K_ref);
  emit k (Il.Ldloc i); ldc k 1; emit k (Il.Binop Il.Add); emit k (Il.Stloc i);
  emit k (Il.Br top);
  place k stop;
  (match params c line t with
   | [] -> ()
   | [ _; _ ] ->
       args 1;
       emit k (Il.Ldloc a); ldc k 0; emit k (Il.Newobj (ptr_ctor c str))
   | _ -> refuse line "a main of other than argc and argv");
  emit k (Il.Call (E.func_method c line "main" t));
  if slot c line (link t) <> S.Void then emit k Il.Pop;
  emit k Il.Ldnull;
  emit k (Il.Call (Cil_strings.helper c "exits"));
  emit k Il.Ret;
  let m =
    W.method_def c.w c.cls "Main" 0x0096 (static [ S.SzArray S.String ] S.Void) in
  finish c k m;
  W.set_entry_point c.w m

(* the assembly's bytes: every function called is defined *)
let finish () : string =
  guard (fun () ->
      let st = state () in
      let c = st.c in
      initializers st;
      if List.mem "main" st.defined then entry st (lookup "main");
      Hashtbl.iter
        (fun (key : string) (_ : int) ->
          if String.length key > 3 && String.sub key 0 3 = "fn " then begin
            let name = String.sub key 3 (String.length key - 3) in
            if not (List.mem name st.defined) then
              error_at !lineno "%s: called, not defined (libc.c: Plan 9's few)" name
          end)
        c.memo;
      W.write c.w)

(* mini-cc -dotnet's back end: a C file to a .NET assembly, a class of
 * its name holding its functions as static methods and its globals as
 * static fields, with libc.c read after it (CLI's prelude).
 *
 *     ptr.c                   ptr.dll
 *     int a[10];              class ptr { static int32[] a;
 *     int sum(int *p, int n)    static int32 sum(Ptr<int32>, int32)
 *     void main(int, char**x)   static void main(int32, Ptr<Ptr<int8>>)
 *                               static void Main(string[]): argv, main,
 *                                 exits(nil)
 *                               .cctor: the globals' arrays, <init> }
 *     (libc.c's)                print's _puts..., strlen, exits...
 *
 * A function's variables are found before its code is made: each name
 * of its typed body, and the ones whose address is taken, which get an
 * array of one element; its arrays and structures are made at its
 * start. A global's initializer (Declare's gextern) is an element
 * stored in <init>, which the class's initializer (.cctor) calls after
 * making each global's array; a literal's array is made at its first
 * use. The entry point, Main, makes C's argv of .NET's arguments, the
 * program's name first (./ptr), and calls exits(nil) after main, which
 * writes what is buffered.
 *
 * What is refused (Cil_types.refuse) is the front end's error, at its
 * line. *)

(* an assembly begun, of this name *)
val start : string -> unit

(* Declare's hooks: a function's body, a global's initializer at an
 * offset *)
val func : Tree.sym -> Tree.stmt -> unit
val gextern : Tree.sym -> Tree.expr -> int -> int -> unit

(* the assembly's bytes: every function called is defined *)
val finish : unit -> string
languages/c/dotnet/libc.c
2515
// Claude Code
// Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt.
//
// mini-cc -dotnet's C library: the part of Plan 9's libc the programs
// use (tiny/tests/TinyC_tests/libc.h), in the managed C itself,
// compiled with each program, read after it (mini-cc -L: this
// directory). Beneath it two functions of .NET's, which the compiler
// makes calls (Cil_exprs): _write, the console's bytes (Stream.Write),
// and _exit (Environment.Exit). And what the compiler does itself:
// malloc a new array of the pointer's type, free nothing (the
// collector's), print and sprint their format compiled, each piece a
// call of _puts, _putc or _putint below, between _begin and _end.

extern void _write(unsigned char*, int);
extern void _exit(int);

unsigned char _obuf[4096];
int _on;
char *_sbuf;	// sprint's buffer; nil: the console
int _sn;	// what is printed

void
_flush(void)
{
	if(_on > 0)
		_write(_obuf, _on);
	_on = 0;
}

void
_putc(int c)
{
	if(_sbuf != 0)
		_sbuf[_sn] = c;
	else{
		_obuf[_on++] = c;
		if(_on == sizeof _obuf)
			_flush();
	}
	_sn++;
}

// flags: 1 left-justified, 2 zeros before
void
_puts(char *s, int width, int flags)
{
	int n;

	n = 0;
	if(s == 0)
		s = "<nil>";
	while(s[n])
		n++;
	if((flags & 1) == 0)
		for(; n < width; width--)
			_putc(' ');
	for(; *s; s++)
		_putc(*s);
	for(; n < width; width--)
		_putc(' ');
}

void
_putint(long long v, int base, int upper, int width, int flags)
{
	char buf[72];
	int n, neg;
	unsigned long long u;

	neg = base == 10 && v < 0;
	u = neg ? -v : v;
	n = sizeof buf;
	buf[--n] = 0;
	do{
		buf[--n] = (upper ? "0123456789ABCDEF" : "0123456789abcdef")[u % base];
		u /= base;
	}while(u != 0);
	if((flags & 2) != 0)
		while(sizeof buf - 1 - n < width - neg)
			buf[--n] = '0';
	if(neg)
		buf[--n] = '-';
	_puts(buf + n, width, flags);
}

void
_begin(char *s)
{
	_sbuf = s;
	_sn = 0;
}

int
_end(void)
{
	if(_sbuf != 0)
		_sbuf[_sn] = 0;
	_sbuf = 0;
	return _sn;
}

void
exits(char *s)
{
	_flush();
	_exit(s != 0 && *s != 0);
}

long
strlen(char *s)
{
	long n;

	n = 0;
	while(s[n])
		n++;
	return n;
}

char*
strcpy(char *d, char *s)
{
	char *p;

	p = d;
	while(*p++ = *s++)
		;
	return d;
}

int
strcmp(char *a, char *b)
{
	for(; *a == *b; a++, b++)
		if(*a == 0)
			return 0;
	return (*a & 0xFF) - (*b & 0xFF);
}

int
atoi(char *s)
{
	int n, neg;

	n = 0;
	while(*s == ' ' || *s == '\t')
		s++;
	neg = *s == '-';
	if(*s == '-' || *s == '+')
		s++;
	while(*s >= '0' && *s <= '9')
		n = n * 10 + *s++ - '0';
	return neg ? -n : n;
}

(* ix: the author's playground's languages/c/Highlight_c.ml (docs/plans/done/plan_emacs.md), a token's category from its kind; without the pass over the tree (Parse_c, 898 lines, and Ast_c: what each name is) and analyze *)

open Highlight_code

(*****************************************************************************)
(* From the tokens *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let control_keywords = [ "if"; "else"; "while"; "for"; "do"; "switch"; "case"; "default"; "return"; "break"; "continue"; "goto" ]
let type_keywords = [ "void"; "char"; "short"; "int"; "long"; "float"; "double"; "signed"; "unsigned"; "_Bool"; "__signed__" ]

(* a banner comment: /*****...*/ or //*****... *)
let is_banner (t : Token_c.t) : bool =
  t.kind = Comment
  && String.length t.text >= 7
  && (String.sub t.text 0 7 = "/******" || String.sub t.text 0 7 = "//*****")

(* a token's category from its kind alone *)
let of_kind (t : Token_c.t) : category =
  match t.kind with
  | Comment -> Comment
  | Keyword ->
      if List.mem t.text control_keywords then Keyword_control
      else if List.mem t.text type_keywords then Type
      else Keyword
  | Ident -> if Token_c.is_constant t.text then Constructor else Normal
  | Int | Float -> Number
  | Char | String -> String
  | Operator -> Operator
  | Punctuation -> Punctuation
  | Directive -> Keyword_module
  | Error -> Error

let categorize (toks : Token_c.t list) : (Token_c.t * category) list =
  let all = Array.of_list toks in
  let n = Array.length all in
  Array.to_list (Array.mapi (fun (i : int) (t : Token_c.t) ->
    (t, if is_banner t || (t.kind = Comment && i > 0 && is_banner all.(i - 1) && i + 1 < n && is_banner all.(i + 1)) then Comment_section
        else of_kind t)) all)

let lines (src : string) : span list array =
  Highlight_code.lines src
    (List.rev (List.rev_map (fun ((t : Token_c.t), (c : category)) -> (t.line, t.col, t.text, c)) (categorize (Lexer_c.tokens src))))

(* Highlight_c: every token of a C file given its category
   (Highlight_code's, shared by every language), the colour a code view
   draws it in.

   Two passes, as Highlight_ml: a token's kind gives a first category
   (a keyword, a number, a comment; a name in capitals a constant, by
   C's habit), then the tree (Parse_c) says what each name is -- a
   function or a global defined, a parameter, a local within its
   block, a field (declared, p->x, s.x, .x = in an initializer), a type,
   an enum's constant, a label, a #define's name and parameters. What
   did not parse keeps the first category.

   Worked example (the tests'):

     static int f(Proc *p) { int n = p->len; return n; }

     static: Keyword  int: Type  f: Def_function  Proc: Type
     p: Parameter  n: Local  p: Parameter  len: Field  n: Local

   Here only the first pass was copied (Highlight_c.ml's first line
   says so: the playground's Parse_c and Ast_c, a thousand lines, were
   not), so the above is the playground's answer and this module's is
   the first category alone:

     static: Keyword  int: Type  return: Keyword_control
     f, Proc, p, n, len: Normal  (N or O_RDWR would be Constructor,
     a name in capitals)

   A banner comment, a line of stars, and the comment it frames are
   Comment_section. Highlight_ml got its second pass back from
   mini-ml's parser (Names_ml); the same from mini-cc's is not done:
   its parser declares as it reads and keeps no tree of a file, and
   needs the headers a file includes, where a highlighter is asked to
   color one file as it is. mini-emacs's C_mode is who calls [lines].

   design:
   C is the language a highlighter cannot parse honestly. What a name
   is depends on the declarations before it, typedefs above all
   (Lexer.mli of the compiler), and those are in headers, behind
   macros a highlighter does not expand. So every editor's C colors
   are guesses of this kind, by capitals and by neighbours, until it
   asks a compiler that has seen the build's flags; that is what the
   language servers (clangd) are for. *)

(* the tokens of a file, each with its category *)
val categorize : Token_c.t list -> (Token_c.t * Highlight_code.category) list

(* [src] lexed, categorized and cut into lines, ready to draw *)
val lines : string -> Highlight_code.span list array
