(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Image.mli *)

type t = {
  file : string;
  sections : (int * int * int * int) list;
  entry_point : int;
  version : string;
  strings : int;
  user_strings : int;
  blobs : int;
  guids : int;
  blobs_size : int;
  rows : int array;
  tables : int array array array;
}

exception Bad_image of string

let bad (msg : string) = raise (Bad_image msg)

let u8 = Binary.u8
let u16 = Binary.le16
let u32 = Binary.le32

let offset_in (sections : (int * int * int * int) list) (rva : int) : int =
  match List.find_opt (fun (va, vsize, _, raw) -> rva >= va && rva < va + max vsize raw) sections with
  | Some (va, _, off, _) -> off + rva - va
  | None -> bad (Printf.sprintf "RVA 0x%x in no section" rva)

let offset (img : t) (rva : int) : int = offset_in img.sections rva

(* a NUL-terminated name at [at] *)
let cstring (s : string) (at : int) : string =
  match String.index_from_opt s at '\000' with
  | Some e -> String.sub s at (e - at)
  | None -> bad "a name without its end"

(* II.24.2.4: a blob's length in 1, 2 or 4 bytes, by its first's high
 * bits (0, 10, 110): (the length, where the bytes start) *)
let compressed (s : string) (at : int) : int * int =
  let b = u8 s at in
  if b land 0x80 = 0 then (b, at + 1)
  else if b land 0xC0 = 0x80 then (((b land 0x3F) lsl 8) lor u8 s (at + 1), at + 2)
  else
    ((((b land 0x1F) lsl 24) lor (u8 s (at + 1) lsl 16) lor (u8 s (at + 2) lsl 8)
      lor u8 s (at + 3)), at + 4)

let string (img : t) (i : int) : string = cstring img.file (img.strings + i)

let blob (img : t) (i : int) : string =
  let n, at = compressed img.file (img.blobs + i) in
  String.sub img.file at n

let guid (img : t) (i : int) : string =
  if i = 0 then "" else String.sub img.file (img.guids + (i - 1) * 16) 16

(* UTF-16, its last byte a flag (II.24.2.4); kept as UTF-8, so Latin-1
 * text is one byte a character (plan_dotnet.md, decision 7) *)
let user_string (img : t) (i : int) : string =
  let n, at = compressed img.file (img.user_strings + i) in
  let b = Buffer.create n in
  let k = ref 0 in
  while !k + 1 < n do
    let c = u16 img.file (at + !k) in
    if c < 256 then Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr c)
    else Buffer.add_utf_8_uchar b (Uchar.of_int c);
    k := !k + 2
  done;
  Buffer.contents b

let decode (c : Metadata.coded) (v : int) : int * int =
  let row = v lsr c.bits in
  if row = 0 then (-1, 0)
  else
    let tag = v land ((1 lsl c.bits) - 1) in
    if tag >= Array.length c.tables then bad ("a coded index " ^ c.cname ^ " out of its tables")
    else (c.tables.(tag), row)

let get (img : t) (table : int) (row : int) (col : string) : int =
  img.tables.(table).(row).(Metadata.col table col)

let range (img : t) (table : int) (row : int) (col : string) (target : int) : int * int =
  let first = get img table row col in
  let last =
    if row < img.rows.(table) then get img table (row + 1) col - 1
    else img.rows.(target) in
  (first, last)

(* II.24.2.6: the tables' stream *)
let read_tables (s : string) (at : int) : int array * int array array array =
  let heaps = u8 s (at + 6) in
  (* (Valid, 64 bits, by its two halves: arm's int has 31) *)
  let lo = u32 s (at + 8) and hi = u32 s (at + 12) in
  let present t = if t < 32 then (lo lsr t) land 1 = 1 else (hi lsr (t - 32)) land 1 = 1 in
  let rows = Array.make 64 0 in
  let p = ref (at + 24) in
  for t = 0 to 63 do
    if present t then begin rows.(t) <- u32 s !p; p := !p + 4 end
  done;
  if heaps land 0x20 <> 0 then p := !p + 4;
  for t = Metadata.count to 63 do
    if rows.(t) > 0 then bad (Printf.sprintf "table 0x%x, not ECMA-335's" t)
  done;
  let size (k : Metadata.column) : int =
    match k with
    | U8 | U16 -> 2
    | U32 -> 4
    | String -> if heaps land 1 <> 0 then 4 else 2
    | Guid -> if heaps land 2 <> 0 then 4 else 2
    | Blob -> if heaps land 4 <> 0 then 4 else 2
    | Table t -> if rows.(t) < 0x10000 then 2 else 4
    | Coded c ->
        let most = Array.fold_left (fun m t -> if t < 0 then m else max m rows.(t)) 0 c.tables in
        if most < 1 lsl (16 - c.bits) then 2 else 4 in
  let tables =
    Array.init Metadata.count (fun t ->
        let cols = Array.map (fun (_, k) -> size k) (Metadata.columns t) in
        Array.init (rows.(t) + 1) (fun r ->
            if r = 0 then [||]
            else
              Array.map (fun n ->
                  let v = if n = 2 then u16 s !p else u32 s !p in
                  p := !p + n;
                  v) cols)) in
  (Array.sub rows 0 Metadata.count, tables)

let read (file : string) : t =
  try
    if String.length file < 0x80 || String.sub file 0 2 <> "MZ" then bad "not a PE file (no MZ)";
    let pe = u32 file 0x3C in
    if String.sub file pe 4 <> "PE\000\000" then bad "not a PE file (no PE)";
    let coff = pe + 4 in
    let nsections = u16 file (coff + 2) in
    let opt = coff + 20 in
    let opt_size = u16 file (coff + 16) in
    (* PE32 or PE32+: the directories at 96 or 112, the 15th the CLI's *)
    let dirs = match u16 file opt with
      | 0x10b -> opt + 96
      | 0x20b -> opt + 112
      | m -> bad (Printf.sprintf "an optional header 0x%x" m) in
    let sections =
      List.init nsections (fun i ->
          let h = opt + opt_size + i * 40 in
          (u32 file (h + 12), u32 file (h + 8), u32 file (h + 20), u32 file (h + 16))) in
    let cli_rva = u32 file (dirs + 14 * 8) in
    if cli_rva = 0 then bad "no CLI header: not a .NET assembly";
    let cli = offset_in sections cli_rva in
    let md = offset_in sections (u32 file (cli + 8)) in
    let entry_point = u32 file (cli + 20) in
    if u32 file md <> 0x424A5342 then bad "no metadata (BSJB)";
    let vlen = u32 file (md + 12) in
    let version = cstring (String.sub file (md + 16) vlen ^ "\000") 0 in
    let nstreams = u16 file (md + 16 + vlen + 2) in
    let p = ref (md + 16 + vlen + 4) in
    let streams =
      List.init nstreams (fun _ ->
          let off = u32 file !p and size = u32 file (!p + 4) in
          let name = cstring file (!p + 8) in
          p := !p + 8 + ((String.length name + 4) land (lnot 3));
          (name, (md + off, size))) in
    let stream n = match List.assoc_opt n streams with
      | Some (o, _) -> o
      | None -> bad ("no stream " ^ n) in
    let tables_at = match List.assoc_opt "#~" streams with
      | Some (o, _) -> o
      | None -> bad "no #~ stream (an assembly being edited: #-)" in
    let rows, tables = read_tables file tables_at in
    let opt_stream n = match List.assoc_opt n streams with Some (o, _) -> o | None -> 0 in
    { file; sections; entry_point; version;
      strings = stream "#Strings"; user_strings = opt_stream "#US";
      blobs = opt_stream "#Blob"; guids = opt_stream "#GUID";
      blobs_size = (match List.assoc_opt "#Blob" streams with Some (_, n) -> n | None -> 0);
      rows; tables }
  with Invalid_argument _ -> bad "truncated"

type clause = {
  kind : int;
  try_start : int;
  try_end : int;
  handler_start : int;
  handler_end : int;
  class_token : int;
}
type body = {
  max_stack : int;
  locals_token : int;
  init_locals : bool;
  code : string;
  clauses : clause list;
}

(* II.25.4: a tiny header (a byte: the size, 2 in its low bits) or a
 * fat one (12 bytes), then the IL, then, aligned on 4, the sections of
 * exception clauses, small (12 bytes a clause) or fat (24) *)
let body (img : t) (rva : int) : body =
  let s = img.file in
  let at = offset img rva in
  let b = u8 s at in
  if b land 3 = 2 then
    { max_stack = 8; locals_token = 0; init_locals = false;
      code = String.sub s (at + 1) (b lsr 2); clauses = [] }
  else if b land 3 = 3 then begin
    let flags = u16 s at in
    let hsize = (flags lsr 12) * 4 in
    let size = u32 s (at + 4) in
    let code_at = at + hsize in
    let clauses = ref [] in
    let more = ref (flags land 0x08 <> 0) in
    let p = ref ((code_at + size + 3) land (lnot 3)) in
    while !more do
      let kind = u8 s !p in
      let fat = kind land 0x40 <> 0 in
      let n =
        if fat then (u8 s (!p + 1) lor (u8 s (!p + 2) lsl 8) lor (u8 s (!p + 3) lsl 16) - 4) / 24
        else (u8 s (!p + 1) - 4) / 12 in
      for i = 0 to n - 1 do
        let c =
          if fat then
            let q = !p + 4 + i * 24 in
            let ts = u32 s (q + 4) and hs = u32 s (q + 12) in
            { kind = u32 s q; try_start = ts; try_end = ts + u32 s (q + 8);
              handler_start = hs; handler_end = hs + u32 s (q + 16);
              class_token = u32 s (q + 20) }
          else
            let q = !p + 4 + i * 12 in
            let ts = u16 s (q + 2) and hs = u16 s (q + 5) in
            { kind = u16 s q; try_start = ts; try_end = ts + u8 s (q + 4);
              handler_start = hs; handler_end = hs + u8 s (q + 7);
              class_token = u32 s (q + 8) } in
        if kind land 1 <> 0 then clauses := c :: !clauses
      done;
      let len = if fat then 4 + n * 24 else 4 + n * 12 in
      more := kind land 0x80 <> 0;
      p := (!p + len + 3) land (lnot 3)
    done;
    { max_stack = u16 s (at + 2); locals_token = u32 s (at + 8);
      init_locals = flags land 0x10 <> 0; code = String.sub s code_at size;
      clauses = List.rev !clauses }
  end
  else bad (Printf.sprintf "a method's header 0x%x at RVA 0x%x" b rva)
languages/dotnet/assembly/Image.mli
4425
(* An assembly's file read: the PE around it, the metadata's heaps and
 * tables, a method's body. The reader of ECMA-335's Partition II; the
 * one module that knows where the bytes are (Writer is its inverse).
 *
 * A .NET assembly is a PE file, Windows's format for its executables,
 * kept on every system: on Linux too `hello.dll` starts with "MZ" and
 * a stub that says "This program cannot be run in DOS mode". The
 * machine's code is not in it (a tiny stub at most); a directory of
 * the PE's header, the 15th, points to the CLI header, which points to
 * the metadata and gives the entry point's token.
 *
 *     hello.dll (4,096 bytes)
 *     0x000  MZ, the DOS stub; at 0x3C the PE header's offset
 *     0x080  "PE\0\0", the COFF header, the optional header and its
 *            16 directories (the 15th: the CLI header)
 *     0x178  the sections: .text (code and metadata), .reloc
 *     0x200  .text:  the CLI header (72 bytes)
 *                    the methods' bodies (headers, IL, clauses)
 *                    the metadata: "BSJB", the version, 5 streams
 *                      #~        the tables: a row count each, the rows
 *                      #Strings  names, NUL-terminated (UTF-8)
 *                      #US       ldstr's strings (UTF-16, a length each)
 *                      #GUID     16 bytes each
 *                      #Blob     signatures, a length each
 *
 * An address in the file is an RVA (relative virtual address: where it
 * would be in memory, the section's place there and not in the file);
 * the sections' table turns it into a file offset.
 *
 * The tables are read whole into arrays of ints, a row an array of its
 * columns (Metadata's shapes): 1-based like the tokens, row 0 unused.
 * Microsoft's System.Private.CoreLib.dll (13 MB, 2,466 types, 33,768
 * methods) is read in under a second.
 *
 * modern:
 * The PE format is from Windows NT (1993); .NET (2002) put its own
 * world inside it so that Windows's loader would start a .NET program
 * as any other, the stub then calling the runtime (mscoree.dll's
 * _CorExeMain). On Linux and macOS the `dotnet` host reads the same
 * file and ignores the stub: the format stayed for that compatibility,
 * not for its own merits.
 *
 * References: ECMA-335, Partition II, 24 (the metadata's physical
 * layout), 25 (the PE file); Microsoft's "PE Format" page. *)

type t = {
  file : string;          (* the whole file's bytes *)
  sections : (int * int * int * int) list;
    (* (rva, virtual size, file offset, raw size) a section *)
  entry_point : int;      (* a MethodDef's token, 0 for a library *)
  version : string;       (* the metadata's: "v4.0.30319" *)
  strings : int;          (* the heaps' offsets in [file], and their sizes *)
  user_strings : int;
  blobs : int;
  guids : int;
  blobs_size : int;
  rows : int array;       (* each table's count of rows *)
  tables : int array array array;
    (* tables.(t).(row).(column), row from 1 *)
}

exception Bad_image of string

(* a file's bytes read: Bad_image if not an assembly *)
val read : string -> t

(* an RVA's offset in the file *)
val offset : t -> int -> int

(* the heaps: a name (#Strings), a user's string (#US, decoded from UTF-16:
 * a character above 255 is kept as UTF-8), a blob's bytes, a GUID's *)
val string : t -> int -> string
val user_string : t -> int -> string
val blob : t -> int -> string
val guid : t -> int -> string

(* a row's column, by its name (Metadata.col) *)
val get : t -> int -> int -> string -> int
(* a coded index decoded: (its table, its row); the table -1 for row 0 *)
val decode : Metadata.coded -> int -> int * int

(* the rows [first, last] of a range column: a type's fields
 * (FieldList), its methods (MethodList), a method's parameters
 * (ParamList), each until the next row's first or the table's end *)
val range : t -> int -> int -> string -> int -> int * int

(* a method's body, at its RVA *)
type clause = {
  kind : int;             (* 0 catch, 1 filter, 2 finally, 4 fault *)
  try_start : int;
  try_end : int;          (* offsets in the IL, the end excluded *)
  handler_start : int;
  handler_end : int;
  class_token : int;      (* the type caught; a filter's offset for 1 *)
}
type body = {
  max_stack : int;
  locals_token : int;     (* a StandAloneSig, 0 for none *)
  init_locals : bool;
  code : string;          (* the IL *)
  clauses : clause list;
}
val body : t -> int -> body

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Listing.mli *)

module M = Metadata

let sprintf = Printf.sprintf

(* the TypeDef row enclosing a nested one, 0 if none (NestedClass is
 * sorted by its first column, but small: searched) *)
let enclosing (img : Image.t) (row : int) : int =
  let t = img.tables.(M.t_nested_class) in
  let rec go i =
    if i >= Array.length t then 0
    else if t.(i).(0) = row then t.(i).(1)
    else go (i + 1) in
  go 1

let dotted (ns : string) (n : string) : string = if ns = "" then n else ns ^ "." ^ n

let rec type_name (img : Image.t) (tok : int) : string =
  let row = M.token_row tok in
  match M.token_table tok with
  | t when t = M.t_type_def ->
      let n = dotted (Image.string img (Image.get img t row "TypeNamespace"))
                (Image.string img (Image.get img t row "TypeName")) in
      let outer = enclosing img row in
      if outer = 0 then n else type_name img (M.token M.t_type_def outer) ^ "/" ^ n
  | t when t = M.t_type_ref ->
      let n = dotted (Image.string img (Image.get img t row "TypeNamespace"))
                (Image.string img (Image.get img t row "TypeName")) in
      let st, sr = Image.decode M.resolution_scope (Image.get img t row "ResolutionScope") in
      if st = M.t_assembly_ref then
        "[" ^ Image.string img (Image.get img st sr "Name") ^ "]" ^ n
      else if st = M.t_type_ref then type_name img (M.token st sr) ^ "/" ^ n
      else n
  | t when t = M.t_type_spec ->
      Signature.show (type_name img) (Signature.type_spec (Image.blob img (Image.get img t row "Signature")))
  | t -> sprintf "<token 0x%08x of %s>" tok (M.name t)

(* a MethodDef's or a Field's type: the TypeDef whose range holds it *)
let owner (img : Image.t) (table : int) (row : int) : int =
  let col = if table = M.t_field then "FieldList" else "MethodList" in
  let n = img.rows.(M.t_type_def) in
  let rec go r = if r > n then 0
    else let first, last = Image.range img M.t_type_def r col table in
      if row >= first && row <= last then r else go (r + 1) in
  go 1

let rec token_name (img : Image.t) (tok : int) : string =
  let name = type_name img in
  let row = M.token_row tok in
  match M.token_table tok with
  | t when t = M.t_method_def ->
      let m = Signature.method_ (Image.blob img (Image.get img t row "Signature")) in
      let cls = name (M.token M.t_type_def (owner img t row)) in
      Signature.show_meth name (cls ^ "::" ^ Image.string img (Image.get img t row "Name")) m
  | t when t = M.t_field ->
      let ty = Signature.field (Image.blob img (Image.get img t row "Signature")) in
      let cls = name (M.token M.t_type_def (owner img t row)) in
      Signature.show name ty ^ " " ^ cls ^ "::" ^ Image.string img (Image.get img t row "Name")
  | t when t = M.t_member_ref ->
      let pt, pr = Image.decode M.member_ref_parent (Image.get img t row "Class") in
      let cls = if pt = M.t_method_def then "" else name (M.token pt pr) in
      let n = Image.string img (Image.get img t row "Name") in
      let sg = Image.blob img (Image.get img t row "Signature") in
      if String.length sg > 0 && sg.[0] = '\006' then
        Signature.show name (Signature.field sg) ^ " " ^ cls ^ "::" ^ n
      else Signature.show_meth name (cls ^ "::" ^ n) (Signature.method_ sg)
  | t when t = M.t_method_spec ->
      let mt, mr = Image.decode M.method_def_or_ref (Image.get img t row "Method") in
      let args = Signature.method_spec (Image.blob img (Image.get img t row "Instantiation")) in
      (* (the method, then its type arguments: ildasm puts them after
       * the name, here after the whole) *)
      token_name img (M.token mt mr)
      ^ " with <" ^ String.concat ", " (List.map (Signature.show name) args) ^ ">"
  | t when t = M.t_user_string -> sprintf "%S" (Image.user_string img row)
  | t when t = M.t_stand_alone_sig ->
      let sg = Image.blob img (Image.get img t row "Signature") in
      if String.length sg > 0 && sg.[0] = '\007' then
        "locals (" ^ String.concat ", " (List.map (Signature.show name) (Signature.locals sg)) ^ ")"
      else Signature.show_meth name "" (Signature.method_ sg)
  | _ -> name tok

(* -tables *)

let tables (img : Image.t) : string =
  let b = Buffer.create 4096 in
  Buffer.add_string b (sprintf "metadata %s\n" img.version);
  for t = 0 to M.count - 1 do
    let n = img.rows.(t) in
    if n > 0 then begin
      let cols = M.columns t in
      Buffer.add_string b (sprintf "\n0x%02X %s, %d row%s: %s\n" t (M.name t) n
                             (if n = 1 then "" else "s")
                             (String.concat " " (Array.to_list (Array.map fst cols))));
      for r = 1 to n do
        let v = img.tables.(t).(r) in
        let cell i (_, k) =
          let x = v.(i) in
          match (k : M.column) with
          | U8 | U16 | U32 -> sprintf "0x%x" x
          | String -> sprintf "%S" (Image.string img x)
          | Guid -> if x = 0 then "-" else sprintf "guid#%d" x
          | Blob -> sprintf "blob#%x" x
          | Table tt -> sprintf "%s#%d" (M.name tt) x
          | Coded c ->
              let ct, cr = Image.decode c x in
              if ct < 0 then "-" else sprintf "%s#%d" (M.name ct) cr in
        Buffer.add_string b (sprintf "  %3d  %s\n" r
                               (String.concat "  " (Array.to_list (Array.mapi cell cols))))
      done
    end
  done;
  Buffer.contents b

(* -S *)

let operand (img : Image.t) (instrs : Il.instr array) (op : Il.op) : string =
  let lbl i = if i < Array.length instrs then sprintf "IL_%04x" instrs.(i).at else "IL_end" in
  let name t = try token_name img t with _ -> sprintf "0x%08x" t in
  match op with
  | Ldarg n | Ldarga n | Starg n | Ldloc n | Ldloca n | Stloc n -> string_of_int n
  | Ldc_i4 v -> Int32.to_string v
  | Ldc_i8 v -> Int64.to_string v
  | Ldc_r f -> sprintf "%.17g" f
  | Br t | Brfalse t | Brtrue t | Bcmp (_, _, t) | Leave t -> lbl t
  | Switch ts -> "(" ^ String.concat ", " (Array.to_list (Array.map lbl ts)) ^ ")"
  | Jmp t | Call t | Calli t | Callvirt t | Cpobj t | Ldobj t | Stobj t | Ldstr t
  | Newobj t | Castclass t | Isinst t | Unbox t | Unbox_any t | Box t
  | Ldfld t | Ldflda t | Stfld t | Ldsfld t | Ldsflda t | Stsfld t
  | Newarr t | Ldelema t | Ldelem_any t | Stelem_any t | Refanyval t | Mkrefany t
  | Ldtoken t | Ldftn t | Ldvirtftn t | Initobj t | Sizeof t | Constrained t -> name t
  | _ -> ""

let method_listing (b : Buffer.t) (img : Image.t) (row : int) : unit =
  let t = M.t_method_def in
  let name = Image.string img (Image.get img t row "Name") in
  let m = Signature.method_ (Image.blob img (Image.get img t row "Signature")) in
  let flags = Image.get img t row "Flags" in
  let rva = Image.get img t row "RVA" in
  let attrs =
    (if flags land 0x0010 <> 0 then "static " else "")
    ^ (if flags land 0x0040 <> 0 then "virtual " else "")
    ^ (if flags land 0x0400 <> 0 then "abstract " else "") in
  Buffer.add_string b (sprintf "  .method %s%s" attrs (Signature.show_meth (type_name img) name m));
  if rva = 0 then Buffer.add_string b
      (if Image.get img t row "ImplFlags" land 0x3 = 0x3 then "   // runtime\n" else "   // no body\n")
  else begin
    let body = Image.body img rva in
    Buffer.add_string b (sprintf "   // RVA 0x%x, %d bytes\n  {\n" rva (String.length body.code));
    if M.token t row = img.entry_point then Buffer.add_string b "    .entrypoint\n";
    Buffer.add_string b (sprintf "    .maxstack %d\n" body.max_stack);
    if body.locals_token <> 0 then
      Buffer.add_string b (sprintf "    .%s\n" (token_name img body.locals_token));
    let instrs = Il.decode body.code in
    Array.iter (fun (ins : Il.instr) ->
        (* (ldarg.0, ldc.i4.m1: the operand in the name) *)
        let implicit = match String.rindex_opt ins.name '.' with
          | Some i -> (match String.sub ins.name (i + 1) (String.length ins.name - i - 1) with
              | "0" | "1" | "2" | "3" | "4" | "5" | "6" | "7" | "8" | "m1" -> true
              | _ -> false)
          | None -> false in
        let o = if implicit then "" else operand img instrs ins.op in
        Buffer.add_string b (sprintf "    IL_%04x: %s%s\n" ins.at ins.name (if o = "" then "" else " " ^ o)))
      instrs;
    List.iter (fun (c : Image.clause) ->
        let what = match c.kind with
          | 0 -> "catch " ^ (try token_name img c.class_token with _ -> "?")
          | 1 -> "filter" | 2 -> "finally" | _ -> "fault" in
        Buffer.add_string b (sprintf "    .try IL_%04x to IL_%04x %s handler IL_%04x to IL_%04x\n"
                               c.try_start c.try_end what c.handler_start c.handler_end))
      body.clauses;
    Buffer.add_string b "  }\n"
  end

let listing (img : Image.t) : string =
  let b = Buffer.create 8192 in
  let asm = if img.rows.(M.t_assembly) > 0
    then Image.string img (Image.get img M.t_assembly 1 "Name") else "(a module)" in
  Buffer.add_string b (sprintf ".assembly %s\n" asm);
  for r = 1 to img.rows.(M.t_assembly_ref) do
    Buffer.add_string b (sprintf ".assembly extern %s\n"
                           (Image.string img (Image.get img M.t_assembly_ref r "Name")))
  done;
  for r = 1 to img.rows.(M.t_type_def) do
    let t = M.t_type_def in
    let flags = Image.get img t r "Flags" in
    let et, er = Image.decode M.type_def_or_ref (Image.get img t r "Extends") in
    let ifaces = ref [] in
    for i = img.rows.(M.t_interface_impl) downto 1 do
      if Image.get img M.t_interface_impl i "Class" = r then
        let it, ir = Image.decode M.type_def_or_ref (Image.get img M.t_interface_impl i "Interface") in
        ifaces := type_name img (M.token it ir) :: !ifaces
    done;
    Buffer.add_string b (sprintf "\n.class %s%s%s%s\n{\n"
                           (if flags land 0x20 <> 0 then "interface " else "")
                           (type_name img (M.token t r))
                           (if et < 0 then "" else " extends " ^ type_name img (M.token et er))
                           (if !ifaces = [] then "" else " implements " ^ String.concat ", " !ifaces));
    let ff, fl = Image.range img t r "FieldList" M.t_field in
    for f = ff to fl do
      let fflags = Image.get img M.t_field f "Flags" in
      let ty = Signature.field (Image.blob img (Image.get img M.t_field f "Signature")) in
      Buffer.add_string b (sprintf "  .field %s%s %s\n"
                             (if fflags land 0x10 <> 0 then "static " else "")
                             (Signature.show (type_name img) ty)
                             (Image.string img (Image.get img M.t_field f "Name")))
    done;
    let mf, ml = Image.range img t r "MethodList" M.t_method_def in
    for m = mf to ml do method_listing b img m done;
    Buffer.add_string b "}\n"
  done;
  Buffer.contents b

let sizes (img : Image.t) : int * int * int =
  let il = ref 0 in
  for m = 1 to img.rows.(M.t_method_def) do
    let rva = Image.get img M.t_method_def m "RVA" in
    if rva <> 0 then begin
      let body = Image.body img rva in
      ignore (Il.decode body.code);
      il := !il + String.length body.code
    end
  done;
  (img.rows.(M.t_type_def), img.rows.(M.t_method_def), !il)

(* An assembly as text: its tables row by row (-tables), and its types
 * and methods with their IL, as Microsoft's ildasm writes them (-S).
 * What the reader (Image, Signature, Il) understood, shown; the first
 * stage of plan_dotnet.md, and the way to look at what mini-tiger and
 * mini-csc write.
 *
 *     $ mini-dotnet -S hello.dll
 *     .assembly hello
 *     .class Hello extends [System.Runtime]System.Object
 *     {
 *       .method static void Main()   // RVA 0x2050, 11 bytes
 *       {
 *         .entrypoint
 *         .maxstack 8
 *         IL_0000: ldstr "Hello, World!"
 *         IL_0005: call void [System.Console]System.Console::WriteLine(string)
 *         IL_000a: ret
 *       }
 *       ...
 *
 * The names are the tokens' rows followed: a TypeRef's scope (the
 * assembly in brackets), a MemberRef's class and signature. *)

(* a token as ildasm names it: a type, a field or method with its class *)
val token_name : Image.t -> int -> string
(* a type's full name: Namespace.Name, a nested one Outer/Inner *)
val type_name : Image.t -> int -> string

(* -tables: each table that has rows, its columns' names, a row a line *)
val tables : Image.t -> string
(* -S: the types, their fields and methods, the IL *)
val listing : Image.t -> string

(* the survey's numbers, Survey.cs -size's: types, methods, bytes of
 * IL; each body's IL decoded (Il.Bad_il if one is not) *)
val sizes : Image.t -> int * int * int

(* See Metadata.mli *)

type column =
  | U8
  | U16
  | U32
  | String
  | Guid
  | Blob
  | Table of int
  | Coded of coded

and coded = { cname : string; bits : int; tables : int array }

let t_module = 0x00
let t_type_ref = 0x01
let t_type_def = 0x02
let t_field = 0x04
let t_method_def = 0x06
let t_param = 0x08
let t_interface_impl = 0x09
let t_member_ref = 0x0A
let t_constant = 0x0B
let t_custom_attribute = 0x0C
let t_class_layout = 0x0F
let t_stand_alone_sig = 0x11
let t_property_map = 0x15
let t_property = 0x17
let t_method_semantics = 0x18
let t_method_impl = 0x19
let t_module_ref = 0x1A
let t_type_spec = 0x1B
let t_field_rva = 0x1D
let t_assembly = 0x20
let t_assembly_ref = 0x23
let t_nested_class = 0x29
let t_generic_param = 0x2A
let t_method_spec = 0x2B
let t_generic_param_constraint = 0x2C
let t_user_string = 0x70

(* (the tables no program of ours has, by number where a coded index
 * names them) *)
let t_event = 0x14
let t_decl_security = 0x0E
let t_file = 0x26
let t_exported_type = 0x27
let t_manifest_resource = 0x28

(* II.24.2.6, the coded indexes' tables in the order of their tags *)
let type_def_or_ref =
  { cname = "TypeDefOrRef"; bits = 2; tables = [| t_type_def; t_type_ref; t_type_spec |] }
let has_constant =
  { cname = "HasConstant"; bits = 2; tables = [| t_field; t_param; t_property |] }
let has_custom_attribute =
  { cname = "HasCustomAttribute"; bits = 5;
    tables = [| t_method_def; t_field; t_type_ref; t_type_def; t_param;
                t_interface_impl; t_member_ref; t_module; t_decl_security;
                t_property; t_event; t_stand_alone_sig; t_module_ref;
                t_type_spec; t_assembly; t_assembly_ref; t_file;
                t_exported_type; t_manifest_resource; t_generic_param;
                t_generic_param_constraint; t_method_spec |] }
let has_field_marshal =
  { cname = "HasFieldMarshal"; bits = 1; tables = [| t_field; t_param |] }
let has_decl_security =
  { cname = "HasDeclSecurity"; bits = 2; tables = [| t_type_def; t_method_def; t_assembly |] }
let member_ref_parent =
  { cname = "MemberRefParent"; bits = 3;
    tables = [| t_type_def; t_type_ref; t_module_ref; t_method_def; t_type_spec |] }
let has_semantics =
  { cname = "HasSemantics"; bits = 1; tables = [| t_event; t_property |] }
let method_def_or_ref =
  { cname = "MethodDefOrRef"; bits = 1; tables = [| t_method_def; t_member_ref |] }
let member_forwarded =
  { cname = "MemberForwarded"; bits = 1; tables = [| t_field; t_method_def |] }
let implementation =
  { cname = "Implementation"; bits = 2; tables = [| t_file; t_assembly_ref; t_exported_type |] }
let custom_attribute_type =
  { cname = "CustomAttributeType"; bits = 3;
    tables = [| -1; -1; t_method_def; t_member_ref; -1 |] }
let resolution_scope =
  { cname = "ResolutionScope"; bits = 2;
    tables = [| t_module; t_module_ref; t_assembly_ref; t_type_ref |] }
let type_or_method_def =
  { cname = "TypeOrMethodDef"; bits = 1; tables = [| t_type_def; t_method_def |] }

(* II.22, a table a line: its number is its place *)
let tables : (string * (string * column) array) array = [|
  "Module", [| "Generation", U16; "Name", String; "Mvid", Guid;
               "EncId", Guid; "EncBaseId", Guid |];
  "TypeRef", [| "ResolutionScope", Coded resolution_scope;
                "TypeName", String; "TypeNamespace", String |];
  "TypeDef", [| "Flags", U32; "TypeName", String; "TypeNamespace", String;
                "Extends", Coded type_def_or_ref; "FieldList", Table t_field;
                "MethodList", Table t_method_def |];
  "FieldPtr", [| "Field", Table t_field |];
  "Field", [| "Flags", U16; "Name", String; "Signature", Blob |];
  "MethodPtr", [| "Method", Table t_method_def |];

let count = Array.length tables
let name (t : int) : string = fst tables.(t)
let columns (t : int) : (string * column) array = snd tables.(t)

let col (t : int) (c : string) : int =
  let cols = columns t in
  let rec go i =
    if i >= Array.length cols then raise Not_found
    else if fst cols.(i) = c then i
    else go (i + 1) in
  go 0

let token (table : int) (row : int) : int = (table lsl 24) lor row
let token_table (tok : int) : int = (tok lsr 24) land 0xFF
let token_row (tok : int) : int = tok land 0xFFFFFF
languages/dotnet/assembly/Metadata.mli
4441
(* The metadata's shape: what the 45 tables of an assembly hold, column
 * by column, as data (ECMA-335, Partition II, chapter 22). The reader
 * (Image) walks it to find each row's bytes; the writer (Writer) to lay
 * them out; the listing (Listing) to name them.
 *
 * An assembly describes itself. Where a C program's object file has
 * code, a symbol table and relocations, an assembly has a small
 * relational database: a table of the types it defines (TypeDef), of
 * their fields (Field) and methods (MethodDef), of the types and
 * members of other assemblies it uses (TypeRef, MemberRef)... A row
 * names another by its number, which is its token's low 24 bits, the
 * table's number the high 8:
 *
 *     call 0x0A000001          MemberRef, row 1
 *       MemberRef #1   Class: TypeRef #3   Name: "WriteLine"   Signature: blob 0x1A
 *       TypeRef #3     Scope: AssemblyRef #2   Name: "Console"   Namespace: "System"
 *       AssemblyRef #2 Name: "System.Console"   Version: 8.0.0.0
 *
 * So `System.Console::WriteLine(string)` is found by its name when the
 * call is first run: no header file, no link step.
 *
 * A column is a number (2 or 4 bytes), an index into one of the heaps
 * (the strings, the blobs of signatures, the GUIDs: 2 bytes or 4, by
 * the heap's size), an index of a row of one table (2 bytes or 4, by
 * that table's rows), or a coded index: a row of one of several tables,
 * the table in the low bits. So a row's size is known only once every
 * table's count is: the reader reads the counts first.
 *
 *     TypeDefOrRef: 2 bits   00 TypeDef   01 TypeRef   10 TypeSpec
 *     0x0D = 3 << 2 | 01     TypeRef, row 3
 *
 * Of the 45 tables, the survey's ten programs fill 19
 * (survey/survey.txt); the others still need their shape, since a
 * table's place in the file is after all those before it.
 *
 * others:
 * The JVM's class file is the same idea at a smaller scale: one class a
 * file, its constant pool a list of entries naming each other by index.
 * A .NET assembly is a whole program's (or library's) classes in one
 * database, and the tables are sorted and indexed for a loader to
 * search: the parent of a method is found by the MethodList ranges of
 * TypeDef, not stored in the method.
 *
 * References: ECMA-335, 6th edition (2012), Partition II, 22 (the
 * tables), 24.2.6 (the #~ stream and the sizes of indexes). *)

(* the kind of a column *)
type column =
  | U8          (* stored as 2 bytes: Constant's Type and its padding *)
  | U16
  | U32
  | String      (* an index into #Strings *)
  | Guid        (* into #GUID *)
  | Blob        (* into #Blob *)
  | Table of int            (* a row of that table *)
  | Coded of coded          (* a row of one of several *)

(* a coded index: its name, the bits of the tag, the tables by tag (-1:
 * a tag no table has, CustomAttributeType's) *)
and coded = { cname : string; bits : int; tables : int array }

val type_def_or_ref : coded
val has_constant : coded
val has_custom_attribute : coded
val has_field_marshal : coded
val has_decl_security : coded
val member_ref_parent : coded
val has_semantics : coded
val method_def_or_ref : coded
val member_forwarded : coded
val implementation : coded
val custom_attribute_type : coded
val resolution_scope : coded
val type_or_method_def : coded

(* the tables, by number: their names and their columns' (name, kind) *)
val count : int
val name : int -> string
val columns : int -> (string * column) array

(* the tables' numbers, for the reader's code *)
val t_module : int
val t_type_ref : int
val t_type_def : int
val t_field : int
val t_method_def : int
val t_param : int
val t_interface_impl : int
val t_member_ref : int

(* See Signature.mli *)

type t =
  | Void
  | Bool
  | Char
  | I1 | U1 | I2 | U2 | I4 | U4 | I8 | U8
  | R4 | R8
  | I | U
  | String
  | Object
  | TypedRef
  | Class of int
  | ValueType of int
  | Var of int
  | MVar of int
  | Ptr of t
  | ByRef of t
  | SzArray of t
  | Array of t * int
  | GenericInst of t * t list
  | FnPtr of meth

and meth = {
  has_this : bool;
  generic : int;
  vararg : bool;
  ret : t;
  params : t list;
}

exception Bad of string

let type_token (v : int) : int =
  let row = v lsr 2 in
  match v land 3 with
  | 0 -> Metadata.token Metadata.t_type_def row
  | 1 -> Metadata.token Metadata.t_type_ref row
  | 2 -> Metadata.token Metadata.t_type_spec row
  | _ -> raise (Bad "a TypeDefOrRef's tag 3")

(* a reader: the blob and where it is *)
type r = { s : string; mutable p : int }

let byte (r : r) : int = let b = Char.code r.s.[r.p] in r.p <- r.p + 1; b

let number (r : r) : int =
  let b = byte r in
  if b land 0x80 = 0 then b
  else if b land 0xC0 = 0x80 then ((b land 0x3F) lsl 8) lor byte r
  else
    let b1 = byte r in let b2 = byte r in let b3 = byte r in
    ((b land 0x1F) lsl 24) lor (b1 lsl 16) lor (b2 lsl 8) lor b3

let rec typ (r : r) : t =
  match byte r with
  | 0x01 -> Void
  | 0x02 -> Bool
  | 0x03 -> Char
  | 0x04 -> I1 | 0x05 -> U1 | 0x06 -> I2 | 0x07 -> U2
  | 0x08 -> I4 | 0x09 -> U4 | 0x0A -> I8 | 0x0B -> U8
  | 0x0C -> R4 | 0x0D -> R8
  | 0x0E -> String
  | 0x0F -> Ptr (typ r)
  | 0x10 -> ByRef (typ r)
  | 0x11 -> ValueType (type_token (number r))
  | 0x12 -> Class (type_token (number r))
  | 0x13 -> Var (number r)
  | 0x14 ->
      let elt = typ r in
      let rank = number r in
      (* (the sizes and lower bounds: read past) *)
      let nsizes = number r in
      for _i = 1 to nsizes do ignore (number r) done;
      let nlo = number r in
      for _i = 1 to nlo do ignore (number r) done;
      Array (elt, rank)
  | 0x15 ->
      let g = typ r in
      let n = number r in
      let args = List.init n (fun _ -> typ r) in
      GenericInst (g, args)
  | 0x16 -> TypedRef
  | 0x18 -> I | 0x19 -> U
  | 0x1B -> FnPtr (meth r)
  | 0x1C -> Object
  | 0x1D -> SzArray (typ r)
  | 0x1E -> MVar (number r)
  (* a custom modifier (modreq, modopt), pinned: no meaning for us *)
  | 0x1F | 0x20 -> ignore (number r); typ r
  | 0x45 -> typ r
  | b -> raise (Bad (Printf.sprintf "an element type 0x%x" b))

and meth (r : r) : meth =
  let cc = byte r in
  let generic = if cc land 0x10 <> 0 then number r else 0 in
  let n = number r in
  let ret = typ r in
  let params = List.init n (fun _ -> typ r) in
  (* (a vararg call's sentinel, 0x41, before the extra arguments: none
   * in our programs) *)
  { has_this = cc land 0x20 <> 0; generic; vararg = cc land 0xF = 5; ret; params }

let reader (s : string) : r = { s; p = 0 }

let field (s : string) : t =
  let r = reader s in
  if byte r <> 0x06 then raise (Bad "not a field's signature");
  typ r

let method_ (s : string) : meth = meth (reader s)

let locals (s : string) : t list =
  let r = reader s in
  if byte r <> 0x07 then raise (Bad "not the locals' signature");
  let n = number r in
  List.init n (fun _ -> typ r)

let type_spec (s : string) : t = typ (reader s)

let method_spec (s : string) : t list =
  let r = reader s in
  if byte r <> 0x0A then raise (Bad "not a generic method's instantiation");
  let n = number r in
  List.init n (fun _ -> typ r)

let property (s : string) : t =
  let r = reader s in
  ignore (byte r);
  ignore (number r);
  typ r

(* the writer's side *)

let add_number (b : Buffer.t) (n : int) : unit =
  if n < 0x80 then Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr n)
  else if n < 0x4000 then begin
    Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr (0x80 lor (n lsr 8)));
    Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr (n land 0xFF))
  end else begin
    Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr (0xC0 lor ((n lsr 24) land 0x1F)));
    Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr ((n lsr 16) land 0xFF));
    Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr ((n lsr 8) land 0xFF));
    Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr (n land 0xFF))
  end

(* a token as TypeDefOrRef: its row, its table in the low 2 bits *)
let add_token (b : Buffer.t) (tok : int) : unit =
  let tag = match Metadata.token_table tok with
    | t when t = Metadata.t_type_def -> 0
    | t when t = Metadata.t_type_ref -> 1
    | _ -> 2 in
  add_number b ((Metadata.token_row tok lsl 2) lor tag)

let rec add_type (b : Buffer.t) (t : t) : unit =
  let c n = Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr n) in
  match t with
  | Void -> c 0x01 | Bool -> c 0x02 | Char -> c 0x03
  | I1 -> c 0x04 | U1 -> c 0x05 | I2 -> c 0x06 | U2 -> c 0x07
  | I4 -> c 0x08 | U4 -> c 0x09 | I8 -> c 0x0A | U8 -> c 0x0B
  | R4 -> c 0x0C | R8 -> c 0x0D | String -> c 0x0E
  | Ptr t -> c 0x0F; add_type b t
  | ByRef t -> c 0x10; add_type b t
  | ValueType tok -> c 0x11; add_token b tok
  | Class tok -> c 0x12; add_token b tok
  | Var n -> c 0x13; add_number b n
  | Array (t, rank) -> c 0x14; add_type b t; add_number b rank; add_number b 0; add_number b 0
  | GenericInst (g, args) ->
      c 0x15; add_type b g; add_number b (List.length args); List.iter (add_type b) args
  | TypedRef -> c 0x16
  | I -> c 0x18 | U -> c 0x19
  | FnPtr m -> c 0x1B; add_meth b m
  | Object -> c 0x1C
  | SzArray t -> c 0x1D; add_type b t
  | MVar n -> c 0x1E; add_number b n

and add_meth (b : Buffer.t) (m : meth) : unit =
  Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr ((if m.has_this then 0x20 else 0) lor (if m.generic > 0 then 0x10 else 0)
                               lor (if m.vararg then 5 else 0)));
  if m.generic > 0 then add_number b m.generic;
  add_number b (List.length m.params);
  add_type b m.ret;
  List.iter (add_type b) m.params

let with_buffer (f : Buffer.t -> unit) : string =
  let b = Buffer.create 16 in f b; Buffer.contents b

let encode_field (t : t) : string = with_buffer (fun b -> Buffer.add_char b '\006'; add_type b t)
let encode_method (m : meth) : string = with_buffer (fun b -> add_meth b m)
let encode_locals (l : t list) : string =
  with_buffer (fun b -> Buffer.add_char b '\007'; add_number b (List.length l); List.iter (add_type b) l)
let encode_type_spec (t : t) : string = with_buffer (fun b -> add_type b t)

let rec show (name : int -> string) (t : t) : string =
  match t with
  | Void -> "void" | Bool -> "bool" | Char -> "char"
  | I1 -> "int8" | U1 -> "uint8" | I2 -> "int16" | U2 -> "uint16"
  | I4 -> "int32" | U4 -> "uint32" | I8 -> "int64" | U8 -> "uint64"
  | R4 -> "float32" | R8 -> "float64"
  | I -> "native int" | U -> "native uint"
  | String -> "string" | Object -> "object" | TypedRef -> "typedref"
  | Class tok -> "class " ^ name tok
  | ValueType tok -> "valuetype " ^ name tok
  | Var n -> "!" ^ string_of_int n
  | MVar n -> "!!" ^ string_of_int n
  | Ptr t -> show name t ^ "*"
  | ByRef t -> show name t ^ "&"
  | SzArray t -> show name t ^ "[]"
  | Array (t, rank) -> show name t ^ "[" ^ String.make (rank - 1) ',' ^ "]"
  | GenericInst (g, args) ->
      show name g ^ "<" ^ String.concat ", " (List.map (show name) args) ^ ">"
  | FnPtr m -> "method " ^ show_meth name "*" m

and show_meth (name : int -> string) (what : string) (m : meth) : string =
  (if m.has_this then "instance " else "")
  ^ show name m.ret ^ " " ^ what
  ^ (if m.generic > 0 then "<" ^ String.concat ", " (List.init m.generic (fun i -> "!!" ^ string_of_int i)) ^ ">" else "")
  ^ "(" ^ String.concat ", " (List.map (show name) m.params) ^ ")"
languages/dotnet/assembly/Signature.mli
3014
(* Signatures: the types of a field, a method, a method's locals, a
 * generic type's instantiation, as the blobs encode them (ECMA-335,
 * II.23.2). They stay at the metadata's level: a class is a token
 * (TypeDef, TypeRef or TypeSpec), a type parameter its number; the
 * loader (Types) gives them their meaning in a context.
 *
 *     static int Rec(int n)     00 01 08 08
 *                               |  |  |  the parameter: int32 (0x08)
 *                               |  |  the return type: int32
 *                               |  one parameter
 *                               no `this`, not generic
 *
 *     Dictionary<string, int>   15 12 <TypeRef> 02 0E 08
 *                               generic instance of a class, 2 arguments
 *
 * A number in a blob is compressed: 1, 2 or 4 bytes as its size needs
 * (Image.compressed's rule), a token too, its table in the low 2 bits
 * (TypeDefOrRef).
 *
 * others:
 * The JVM writes its signatures as text, `(I)I` for Rec, `Ljava/lang/
 * String;` for a class, read by a small parser; .NET's are bytes, which
 * name a class by its row rather than by its name and so are shorter,
 * but need the tables to be read. *)

type t =
  | Void
  | Bool
  | Char
  | I1 | U1 | I2 | U2 | I4 | U4 | I8 | U8
  | R4 | R8
  | I | U                     (* native int: a pointer's size *)
  | String
  | Object
  | TypedRef
  | Class of int              (* a reference type, by its token *)
  | ValueType of int          (* a value type (a struct, an enum) *)
  | Var of int                (* the class's type parameter number n: !0 *)
  | MVar of int               (* the method's: !!0 *)
  | Ptr of t                  (* an unmanaged pointer *)
  | ByRef of t                (* a managed one: `ref`, `out` *)
  | SzArray of t              (* T[], from 0 *)
  | Array of t * int          (* T[,]: its rank *)
  | GenericInst of t * t list (* List<int>: Class or ValueType, and the arguments *)
  | FnPtr of meth

and meth = {
  has_this : bool;            (* an instance method: `this` its argument 0 *)
  generic : int;              (* its type parameters, 0 if none *)
  vararg : bool;
  ret : t;
  params : t list;
}

(* the blobs, by what they describe *)
val field : string -> t
val method_ : string -> meth
val locals : string -> t list
val type_spec : string -> t
val method_spec : string -> t list
(* a property's: its type *)
val property : string -> t

(* a token in the TypeDefOrRef encoding (II.23.2.8) as a token *)
val type_token : int -> int

(* the blobs written: the inverse of the above, for Writer; a token
 * given its TypeDefOrRef encoding *)
val encode_field : t -> string
val encode_method : meth -> string
val encode_locals : t list -> string
val encode_type_spec : t -> string
(* a number as a blob writes it: 1, 2 or 4 bytes *)
val add_number : Buffer.t -> int -> unit

(* as ildasm writes it, the classes named by the function given *)
val show : (int -> string) -> t -> string
val show_meth : (int -> string) -> string -> meth -> string

(* See Writer.mli *)

module M = Metadata

type clause = {
  kind : int;
  try_start : int;
  try_end : int;
  handler_start : int;
  handler_end : int;
  catch : int;
}

(* a heap: its bytes, and what is in it already, to write each once *)
type heap = { bytes : Buffer.t; seen : (string, int) Hashtbl.t }

let new_heap (first : string) : heap =
  let h = { bytes = Buffer.create 256; seen = Hashtbl.create 64 } in
  Buffer.add_string h.bytes first;
  h

(* a field or a method defined: its owner, its row's columns but the
 * owner's ranges; its body *)
type fdef = { fowner : int; fname : string; fflags : int; fsig : string }
type mdef = {
  mowner : int; mname : string; mflags : int; msig : Signature.meth;
  mutable body : (Signature.t list * Il.op array * clause list) option;
}

type t = {
  name : string;
  strings : heap;
  user_strings : heap;
  blobs : heap;
  assembly_refs : (string, int) Hashtbl.t;
  mutable assembly_ref_rows : string list;           (* in order, reversed *)
  type_refs : (int * string * string, int) Hashtbl.t;
  mutable type_ref_rows : (int * string * string) list;
  member_refs : (int * string * string, int) Hashtbl.t;
  mutable member_ref_rows : (int * string * string) list;
  sigs : (int, int * bool) Hashtbl.t;               (* a method's token: its arguments, a result? *)
  type_specs : (string, int) Hashtbl.t;
  mutable type_spec_rows : string list;
  mutable type_defs : (int * string * string * int) list;   (* flags, namespace, name, extends; reversed *)
  mutable fields : fdef list;                        (* reversed, by provisional number - 1 *)
  mutable methods : mdef list;
  mutable nested : (int * int) list;
  mutable impls : (int * int) list;
  mutable stand_alone : string list;
  mutable entry : int;
  (* (owner, number, name): a generic type's or method's parameters *)
  mutable generic_params : (int * int * string) list;
  method_specs : (int * string, int) Hashtbl.t;
  mutable method_spec_rows : (int * string) list;
}

let create (name : string) : t =
  let w = { name; strings = new_heap "\000"; user_strings = new_heap "\000";
            blobs = new_heap "\000"; assembly_refs = Hashtbl.create 4;
            assembly_ref_rows = []; type_refs = Hashtbl.create 16; type_ref_rows = [];
            member_refs = Hashtbl.create 16; member_ref_rows = [];
            sigs = Hashtbl.create 16; type_specs = Hashtbl.create 8; type_spec_rows = [];
            type_defs = []; fields = []; methods = []; nested = []; impls = []; stand_alone = [];
            entry = 0; generic_params = []; method_specs = Hashtbl.create 8; method_spec_rows = [] } in
  (* the first TypeDef, <Module>: what is global *)
  w.type_defs <- [ (0, "", "<Module>", 0) ];
  w

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The heaps *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let add_heap (h : heap) (key : string) (bytes : string) : int =
  match Hashtbl.find_opt h.seen key with
  | Some i -> i
  | None ->
      let i = Buffer.length h.bytes in
      Buffer.add_string h.bytes bytes;
      Hashtbl.replace h.seen key i;
      i

let str (w : t) (s : string) : int =
  if s = "" then 0 else add_heap w.strings s (s ^ "\000")

let blob (w : t) (s : string) : int =
  let b = Buffer.create (String.length s + 2) in
  Signature.add_number b (String.length s);
  Buffer.add_string b s;
  add_heap w.blobs s (Buffer.contents b)

(* #US: UTF-16, its length in bytes and one more, the last byte 1 if
 * a character needs more than a simple comparison (II.24.2.4) *)
let user_string (w : t) (s : string) : int =
  let b = Buffer.create (2 * String.length s + 3) in
  let n = String.length s in
  Signature.add_number b (2 * n + 1);
  let special = ref 0 in
  String.iter (fun c ->
      let k = Char.code c in
      if k >= 0x80 || (k >= 1 && k <= 8) || (k >= 0x0E && k <= 0x1F) || k = 0x27 || k = 0x2D || k = 0x7F
      then special := 1;
      Buffer.add_char b c; Buffer.add_char b '\000') s;
  Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr !special);
  M.token M.t_user_string (add_heap w.user_strings s (Buffer.contents b))

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* What is used, what is defined *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let assembly_ref (w : t) (name : string) : int =
  match Hashtbl.find_opt w.assembly_refs name with
  | Some t -> t
  | None ->
      w.assembly_ref_rows <- name :: w.assembly_ref_rows;
      let t = M.token M.t_assembly_ref (List.length w.assembly_ref_rows) in
      Hashtbl.replace w.assembly_refs name t;
      t

let type_ref (w : t) (scope : int) (ns : string) (name : string) : int =
  let k = (scope, ns, name) in
  match Hashtbl.find_opt w.type_refs k with
  | Some t -> t
  | None ->
      w.type_ref_rows <- k :: w.type_ref_rows;
      let t = M.token M.t_type_ref (List.length w.type_ref_rows) in
      Hashtbl.replace w.type_refs k t;
      t

let args_of (m : Signature.meth) : int * bool =
  (List.length m.params + (if m.has_this then 1 else 0), m.ret <> Signature.Void)

let member (w : t) (parent : int) (name : string) (sg : string) : int =
  let k = (parent, name, sg) in
  match Hashtbl.find_opt w.member_refs k with
  | Some t -> t
  | None ->
      w.member_ref_rows <- k :: w.member_ref_rows;
      let t = M.token M.t_member_ref (List.length w.member_ref_rows) in
      Hashtbl.replace w.member_refs k t;
      t

let member_ref (w : t) (parent : int) (name : string) (m : Signature.meth) : int =
  let t = member w parent name (Signature.encode_method m) in
  Hashtbl.replace w.sigs t (args_of m);
  t

let field_ref (w : t) (parent : int) (name : string) (ty : Signature.t) : int =
  member w parent name (Signature.encode_field ty)

let type_spec (w : t) (ty : Signature.t) : int =
  let sg = Signature.encode_type_spec ty in
  match Hashtbl.find_opt w.type_specs sg with
  | Some t -> t
  | None ->
      w.type_spec_rows <- sg :: w.type_spec_rows;
      let t = M.token M.t_type_spec (List.length w.type_spec_rows) in
      Hashtbl.replace w.type_specs sg t;
      t

let type_def (w : t) (ns : string) (name : string) (flags : int) (extends : int) : int =
  w.type_defs <- (flags, ns, name, extends) :: w.type_defs;
  M.token M.t_type_def (List.length w.type_defs)

(* (provisional: the n-th field or method defined, renumbered by write) *)
let field_def (w : t) (owner : int) (name : string) (flags : int) (ty : Signature.t) : int =
  w.fields <- { fowner = M.token_row owner; fname = name; fflags = flags;
                fsig = Signature.encode_field ty } :: w.fields;
  M.token M.t_field (List.length w.fields)

(* a generic type's or method's parameter: its owner (a TypeDef, a
 * MethodDef), its number, its name *)
let generic_param (w : t) (owner : int) (number : int) (name : string) : unit =
  w.generic_params <- (owner, number, name) :: w.generic_params

(* a generic method instantiated (II.23.2.15): the method, a MethodDef
 * or a MemberRef, and its type arguments; called as the method is *)
let method_spec (w : t) (meth : int) (args : Signature.t list) : int =
  let blob = "\x0a" ^ String.make 1 (Char.chr (List.length args)) ^ String.concat "" (List.map Signature.encode_type_spec args) in
  match Hashtbl.find_opt w.method_specs (meth, blob) with
  | Some t -> t
  | None ->
      w.method_spec_rows <- (meth, blob) :: w.method_spec_rows;
      let t = M.token M.t_method_spec (List.length w.method_spec_rows) in
      Hashtbl.replace w.method_specs (meth, blob) t;
      (match Hashtbl.find_opt w.sigs meth with Some s -> Hashtbl.replace w.sigs t s | None -> ());
      t

let method_def (w : t) (owner : int) (name : string) (flags : int) (m : Signature.meth) : int =
  w.methods <- { mowner = M.token_row owner; mname = name; mflags = flags; msig = m; body = None }
               :: w.methods;
  let t = M.token M.t_method_def (List.length w.methods) in
  Hashtbl.replace w.sigs t (args_of m);
  t

let nest (w : t) (inner : int) (outer : int) : unit =
  w.nested <- (M.token_row inner, M.token_row outer) :: w.nested

let implements (w : t) (cls : int) (iface : int) : unit =
  w.impls <- (M.token_row cls, iface) :: w.impls

let set_body (w : t) (tok : int) (locals : Signature.t list) (code : Il.op array) (clauses : clause list) : unit =
  let n = List.length w.methods in
  let m = List.nth w.methods (n - M.token_row tok) in
  m.body <- Some (locals, code, clauses)

let set_entry_point (w : t) (tok : int) : unit = w.entry <- tok

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A method's body *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* the deepest the stack goes: each instruction's depth from the ones
 * that lead to it (the next, a branch's target; a handler's start: the
 * exception, or nothing for a finally) *)
let max_stack (w : t) (returns : bool) (code : Il.op array) (clauses : clause list) : int =
  let n = Array.length code in
  let depth = Array.make (n + 1) (-1) in
  let work = ref [ 0 ] in
  depth.(0) <- 0;
  List.iter (fun c ->
      depth.(c.handler_start) <- (if c.kind = 0 then 1 else 0);
      work := c.handler_start :: !work) clauses;
  let most = ref 0 in
  let call t = match Hashtbl.find_opt w.sigs t with
    | Some s -> s
    | None -> failwith (Printf.sprintf "Writer: a call to 0x%08x, not made by this writer" t) in
  let reach i d = if i <= n && depth.(i) < 0 then (depth.(i) <- d; work := i :: !work) in
  while !work <> [] do
    let i = List.hd !work in
    work := List.tl !work;
    if i < n then begin
      let op = code.(i) in
      let pops, pushes = Il.stack_effect call returns op in
      (* (an empty stack popped: wrong code, written as it is, the
       * verifier's to refuse; its depth taken as 0, so a depth is never
       * negative and each instruction is reached once) *)
      let d = max 0 (depth.(i) - pops) + pushes in
      if d > !most then most := d;
      if depth.(i) > !most then most := depth.(i);
      (match op with
       | Il.Br t -> reach t d
       | Il.Leave t -> reach t 0
       | Il.Brfalse t | Il.Brtrue t | Il.Bcmp (_, _, t) -> reach t d; reach (i + 1) d
       | Il.Switch ts -> Array.iter (fun t -> reach t d) ts; reach (i + 1) d
       | Il.Ret | Il.Throw | Il.Rethrow | Il.Endfinally -> ()
       | _ -> reach (i + 1) d)
    end
  done;
  !most

(* II.25.4: the body's header, its IL, its clauses; the IL's tokens
 * renumbered *)
let body_bytes (w : t) (remap : int -> int) (locals_tok : int) (m : mdef)
    (code : Il.op array) (clauses : clause list) : string =
  (* (its depth from the tokens as they were made: the calls' signatures
   * are known by those) *)
  let stack = max_stack w (m.msig.ret <> Signature.Void) code clauses in
  let code = Array.map (Il.map_tokens remap) code in
  (* the instructions' offsets: each one's size, a branch in its long
   * form whatever its target *)
  let n = Array.length code in
  let offsets = Array.make (n + 1) 0 in
  let tmp = Buffer.create 16 in
  for i = 0 to n - 1 do
    Buffer.clear tmp;
    let sized = match code.(i) with
      | Il.Br _ -> Il.Br 0 | Il.Brfalse _ -> Il.Brfalse 0 | Il.Brtrue _ -> Il.Brtrue 0
      | Il.Bcmp (c, u, _) -> Il.Bcmp (c, u, 0) | Il.Leave _ -> Il.Leave 0
      | op -> op in
    Il.encode tmp sized;
    offsets.(i + 1) <- offsets.(i) + Buffer.length tmp
  done;
  let il = Buffer.create offsets.(n) in
  let at i = offsets.(i) in
  Array.iter (fun op ->
      Il.encode il (match op with
          | Il.Br t -> Il.Br (at t) | Il.Brfalse t -> Il.Brfalse (at t)
          | Il.Brtrue t -> Il.Brtrue (at t) | Il.Bcmp (c, u, t) -> Il.Bcmp (c, u, at t)
          | Il.Leave t -> Il.Leave (at t) | Il.Switch ts -> Il.Switch (Array.map at ts)
          | op -> op)) code;
  let il = Buffer.contents il in
  let b = Buffer.create (String.length il + 32) in
  if String.length il < 64 && stack <= 8 && locals_tok = 0 && clauses = [] then
    Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr ((String.length il lsl 2) lor 2))
  else begin
    let flags = 0x3003 lor (if clauses <> [] then 0x08 else 0) lor (if locals_tok <> 0 then 0x10 else 0) in
    Buffer.add_uint16_le b flags;
    Buffer.add_uint16_le b stack;
    Buffer.add_int32_le b (Int32.of_int (String.length il));
    Buffer.add_int32_le b (Int32.of_int locals_tok)
  end;
  Buffer.add_string b il;
  if clauses <> [] then begin
    while Buffer.length b mod 4 <> 0 do Buffer.add_char b '\000' done;
    (* a fat section: 24 bytes a clause *)
    let size = 4 + 24 * List.length clauses in
    Buffer.add_char b '\x41';
    Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr (size land 0xFF));
    Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr ((size lsr 8) land 0xFF));
    Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr ((size lsr 16) land 0xFF));
    let i32 x = Buffer.add_int32_le b (Int32.of_int x) in
    List.iter (fun c ->
        i32 c.kind; i32 (at c.try_start); i32 (at c.try_end - at c.try_start);
        i32 (at c.handler_start); i32 (at c.handler_end - at c.handler_start);
        i32 (if c.kind = 0 then remap c.catch else 0)) clauses
  end;
  Buffer.contents b

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The file *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let pad4 (b : Buffer.t) : unit = while Buffer.length b mod 4 <> 0 do Buffer.add_char b '\000' done

(* (the invariant culture: a number read and written as C's and
 * OCaml's, 1.5, whatever the machine's language) *)
let runtime_config =
  "{\"runtimeOptions\":{\"tfm\":\"net8.0\",\"framework\":{\"name\":\"Microsoft.NETCore.App\",\"version\":\"8.0.0\"},"
  ^ "\"configProperties\":{\"System.Globalization.Invariant\":true}}}\n"

(* where .text starts in memory and in the file *)
let text_rva = 0x2000
let text_file = 0x200

let write (w : t) : string =
  (* the fields and methods by their owner, in the order defined: their
   * rows; a provisional token to its row's *)
  let fields = Array.of_list (List.rev w.fields) in
  let methods = Array.of_list (List.rev w.methods) in
  let order owner a : int array =
    let idx = Array.init (Array.length a) (fun i -> i) in
    let l = List.stable_sort (fun i j -> compare (owner a.(i)) (owner a.(j))) (Array.to_list idx) in
    Array.of_list l in
  let forder = order (fun f -> f.fowner) fields in
  let morder = order (fun m -> m.mowner) methods in
  let frow = Array.make (Array.length fields) 0 and mrow = Array.make (Array.length methods) 0 in
  Array.iteri (fun row i -> frow.(i) <- row + 1) forder;
  Array.iteri (fun row i -> mrow.(i) <- row + 1) morder;
  let remap (tok : int) : int =
    match M.token_table tok with
    | t when t = M.t_field -> M.token t frow.(M.token_row tok - 1)
    | t when t = M.t_method_def -> M.token t mrow.(M.token_row tok - 1)
    | _ -> tok in
  let type_defs = Array.of_list (List.rev w.type_defs) in
  (* the bodies, after the CLI header, each on 4 bytes *)
  let text = Buffer.create 4096 in
  Buffer.add_string text (String.make 72 '\000');         (* the CLI header, written last *)
  let rvas = Array.make (Array.length methods) 0 in
  Array.iteri (fun i m ->
      match m.body with
      | None -> ()
      | Some (locals, code, clauses) ->
          let ltok =
            if locals = [] then 0
            else begin
              w.stand_alone <- Signature.encode_locals locals :: w.stand_alone;
              M.token M.t_stand_alone_sig (List.length w.stand_alone)
            end in
          pad4 text;
          rvas.(i) <- text_rva + Buffer.length text;
          Buffer.add_string text (body_bytes w remap ltok m code clauses)) methods;
  pad4 text;
  (* the tables' rows, as columns of ints *)
  let rows = Array.make M.count [] in
  let add t r = rows.(t) <- r :: rows.(t) in
  add M.t_module [| 0; str w (w.name ^ ".dll"); 1; 0; 0 |];
  List.iter (fun (scope, ns, name) ->
      let st, sr = (M.token_table scope, M.token_row scope) in
      let tag = if st = M.t_assembly_ref then 2 else if st = M.t_type_ref then 3 else 0 in
      add M.t_type_ref [| (sr lsl 2) lor tag; str w name; str w ns |]) (List.rev w.type_ref_rows);
  (* (a type's first field and method: the first row whose owner is it
   * or after it) *)
  let first (owners : int array) (n : int) (row : int) =
    let rec go i = if i >= n || owners.(i) >= row then i + 1 else go (i + 1) in
    go 0 in
  let fowners = Array.map (fun i -> fields.(i).fowner) forder in
  let mowners = Array.map (fun i -> methods.(i).mowner) morder in
  Array.iteri (fun i (flags, ns, name, extends) ->
      let ext = if extends = 0 then 0 else
          let tag = match M.token_table extends with
            | t when t = M.t_type_def -> 0 | t when t = M.t_type_ref -> 1 | _ -> 2 in
          (M.token_row extends lsl 2) lor tag in
      add M.t_type_def [| flags; str w name; str w ns; ext;
                          first fowners (Array.length fowners) (i + 1);
                          first mowners (Array.length mowners) (i + 1) |]) type_defs;
  Array.iter (fun i -> let f = fields.(i) in
               add M.t_field [| f.fflags; str w f.fname; blob w f.fsig |]) forder;
  Array.iter (fun i -> let m = methods.(i) in
               add M.t_method_def [| rvas.(i); 0; m.mflags; str w m.mname;
                                     blob w (Signature.encode_method m.msig); 1 |]) morder;
  List.iter (fun (parent, name, sg) ->
      let tag = match M.token_table parent with
        | t when t = M.t_type_def -> 0 | t when t = M.t_type_ref -> 1
        | t when t = M.t_method_def -> 3 | _ -> 4 in
      add M.t_member_ref [| (M.token_row parent lsl 3) lor tag; str w name; blob w sg |])
    (List.rev w.member_ref_rows);
  List.iter (fun sg -> add M.t_stand_alone_sig [| blob w sg |]) (List.rev w.stand_alone);
  List.iter (fun sg -> add M.t_type_spec [| blob w sg |]) (List.rev w.type_spec_rows);
  (* (a MethodDef's provisional token to its row's) *)
  let def_or_ref (tok : int) : int =
    let tok = remap tok in
    if M.token_table tok = M.t_method_def then M.token_row tok lsl 1 else (M.token_row tok lsl 1) lor 1 in
  List.iter (fun (meth, sg) -> add M.t_method_spec [| def_or_ref meth; blob w sg |]) (List.rev w.method_spec_rows);
  (* (GenericParam sorted by its owner, then its number, as ECMA asks) *)
  let owner (tok : int) : int =
    let tok = remap tok in
    if M.token_table tok = M.t_type_def then M.token_row tok lsl 1 else (M.token_row tok lsl 1) lor 1 in
  List.iter (fun ((o, n, name) : int * int * string) -> add M.t_generic_param [| n; 0; o; str w name |])
    (List.stable_sort compare (List.map (fun ((o, n, name) : int * int * string) -> (owner o, n, name)) (List.rev w.generic_params)));
  add M.t_assembly [| 0x8004; 0; 0; 0; 0; 0; 0; str w w.name; 0 |];
  (* Microsoft's key's token and version, for its assemblies; another,
   * written as this one is: version 0, no key *)
  let key = blob w "\xb0\x3f\x5f\x7f\x11\xd5\x0a\x3a" in
  let microsoft (name : string) =
    name = "System" || (String.length name > 7 && String.sub name 0 7 = "System.") in
  List.iter
    (fun name ->
      if microsoft name then add M.t_assembly_ref [| 8; 0; 0; 0; 0; key; str w name; 0; 0 |]
      else add M.t_assembly_ref [| 0; 0; 0; 0; 0; 0; str w name; 0; 0 |])
    (List.rev w.assembly_ref_rows);
  (* (InterfaceImpl sorted by its class, as ECMA asks) *)
  List.iter (fun (cls, iface) ->
      let tag = match M.token_table iface with
        | t when t = M.t_type_def -> 0 | t when t = M.t_type_ref -> 1 | _ -> 2 in
      add M.t_interface_impl [| cls; (M.token_row iface lsl 2) lor tag |])
    (List.stable_sort (fun (a, _) (b, _) -> compare a b) (List.rev w.impls));
  List.iter (fun (inner, outer) -> add M.t_nested_class [| inner; outer |])
    (List.sort compare w.nested);
  let rows = Array.map (fun l -> Array.of_list (List.rev l)) rows in
  (* the indexes' sizes, as the reader computes them *)
  let counts = Array.map Array.length rows in
  let big_heap h = Buffer.length h.bytes >= 0x10000 in
  let heaps = (if big_heap w.strings then 1 else 0) lor (if big_heap w.blobs then 4 else 0) in
  let size (k : M.column) = match k with
    | U8 | U16 -> 2
    | U32 -> 4
    | String -> if heaps land 1 <> 0 then 4 else 2
    | Guid -> 2
    | Blob -> if heaps land 4 <> 0 then 4 else 2
    | Table t -> if counts.(t) < 0x10000 then 2 else 4
    | Coded c ->
        let most = Array.fold_left (fun m t -> if t < 0 then m else max m counts.(t)) 0 c.tables in
        if most < 1 lsl (16 - c.bits) then 2 else 4 in
  let tables = Buffer.create 1024 in
  Buffer.add_int32_le tables 0l;
  Buffer.add_char tables '\002'; Buffer.add_char tables '\000';
  Buffer.add_char tables (Char.chr heaps); Buffer.add_char tables '\001';
  let valid = ref 0L in
  Array.iteri (fun t n -> if n > 0 then valid := Int64.logor !valid (Int64.shift_left 1L t)) counts;
  Buffer.add_int64_le tables !valid;
  (* (sorted: NestedClass among those ECMA asks to be, Roslyn's mask) *)
  Buffer.add_int64_le tables 0x000016003301FA00L;
  Array.iter (fun n -> if n > 0 then Buffer.add_int32_le tables (Int32.of_int n)) counts;
  Array.iteri (fun t rs ->
      let cols = M.columns t in
      Array.iter (fun r ->
          Array.iteri (fun i (_, k) ->
              if size k = 2 then Buffer.add_uint16_le tables r.(i)
              else Buffer.add_int32_le tables (Int32.of_int r.(i))) cols) rs) rows;
  pad4 tables;
  (* the metadata: its root, its five streams *)
  let guid = Digest.string w.name in
  let pad h = let b = h.bytes in while Buffer.length b mod 4 <> 0 do Buffer.add_char b '\000' done; Buffer.contents b in
  let streams = [ "#~", Buffer.contents tables; "#Strings", pad w.strings;
                  "#US", pad w.user_strings; "#GUID", guid; "#Blob", pad w.blobs ] in
  let md = Buffer.create 4096 in
  Buffer.add_int32_le md 0x424A5342l;
  Buffer.add_uint16_le md 1; Buffer.add_uint16_le md 1;
  Buffer.add_int32_le md 0l;
  Buffer.add_int32_le md 12l;
  Buffer.add_string md "v4.0.30319\000\000";
  Buffer.add_uint16_le md 0;
  Buffer.add_uint16_le md (List.length streams);
  let header_size = Buffer.length md + List.fold_left (fun a (n, _) ->
      a + 8 + ((String.length n + 4) land (lnot 3))) 0 streams in
  let off = ref header_size in
  List.iter (fun (n, data) ->
      Buffer.add_int32_le md (Int32.of_int !off);
      Buffer.add_int32_le md (Int32.of_int (String.length data));
      Buffer.add_string md n;
      Buffer.add_string md (String.make (((String.length n + 4) land (lnot 3)) - String.length n) '\000');
      off := !off + String.length data) streams;
  List.iter (fun (_, data) -> Buffer.add_string md data) streams;
  let md_rva = text_rva + Buffer.length text in
  Buffer.add_buffer text md;
  (* the CLI header *)
  let cli = Buffer.create 72 in
  Buffer.add_int32_le cli 72l;
  Buffer.add_uint16_le cli 2; Buffer.add_uint16_le cli 5;
  Buffer.add_int32_le cli (Int32.of_int md_rva);
  Buffer.add_int32_le cli (Int32.of_int (Buffer.length md));
  Buffer.add_int32_le cli 1l;                                   (* IL only *)
  Buffer.add_int32_le cli (Int32.of_int (remap w.entry));
  Buffer.add_string cli (String.make 48 '\000');
  let text = Buffer.contents text in
  let text = Buffer.contents cli ^ String.sub text 72 (String.length text - 72) in
  (* the PE around it: a DOS header, the PE's and one section *)
  let raw = (String.length text + 0x1FF) land (lnot 0x1FF) in
  let vsize = String.length text in
  let image_size = (text_rva + vsize + 0x1FFF) land (lnot 0x1FFF) in
  let pe = Buffer.create (text_file + raw) in
  let u16 x = Buffer.add_uint16_le pe x and u32 x = Buffer.add_int32_le pe (Int32.of_int x) in
  Buffer.add_string pe "MZ\x90\x00\x03\x00\x00\x00\x04\x00\x00\x00\xff\xff\x00\x00\xb8";
  Buffer.add_string pe (String.make (0x3C - Buffer.length pe) '\000');
  u32 0x80;
  Buffer.add_string pe "\x0e\x1f\xba\x0e\x00\xb4\x09\xcd\x21\xb8\x01\x4c\xcd\x21This program cannot be run in DOS mode.\r\r\n$";
  Buffer.add_string pe (String.make (0x80 - Buffer.length pe) '\000');
  Buffer.add_string pe "PE\000\000";
  u16 0x14c; u16 1; u32 0; u32 0; u32 0; u16 0xE0; u16 0x22;
  (* the optional header, PE32 *)
  u16 0x10b; Buffer.add_char pe '\048'; Buffer.add_char pe '\000';
  u32 raw; u32 0; u32 0; u32 0; u32 text_rva; u32 0;
  u32 0x400000; u32 0x2000; u32 0x200;
  u16 4; u16 0; u16 0; u16 0; u16 4; u16 0; u32 0;
  u32 image_size; u32 text_file; u32 0; u16 3; u16 0x8540;
  u32 0x100000; u32 0x1000; u32 0x100000; u32 0x1000; u32 0; u32 16;
  for d = 0 to 15 do
    if d = 14 then (u32 text_rva; u32 72) else (u32 0; u32 0)
  done;
  (* the section *)
  Buffer.add_string pe ".text\000\000\000";
  u32 vsize; u32 text_rva; u32 raw; u32 text_file; u32 0; u32 0; u16 0; u16 0;
  u32 0x60000020;
  Buffer.add_string pe (String.make (text_file - Buffer.length pe) '\000');
  Buffer.add_string pe text;
  Buffer.add_string pe (String.make (raw - String.length text) '\000');
  Buffer.contents pe
languages/dotnet/assembly/Writer.mli
3960
(* An assembly written: the reader's inverse (Image), for the compilers
 * to .NET (mini-tiger, mini-csc). A compiler names what it uses and
 * defines, in any order, and gets a token for each, to put in its
 * instructions; then gives each method its IL. The writer lays the
 * rows out, renumbers the tokens it had to, sizes the indexes, and
 * writes the PE around the metadata (ECMA-335, Partition II, 24-25).
 *
 *     let w = Writer.create "hello" in
 *     let console = Writer.type_ref w (Writer.assembly_ref w "System.Console") "System" "Console" in
 *     let wl = Writer.member_ref w console "WriteLine" { (static) void (string) } in
 *     let prog = Writer.type_def w "" "Hello" 0x100001 obj in
 *     let main = Writer.method_def w prog "Main" 0x16 { void () } in
 *     Writer.set_body w main [] [| Ldstr (Writer.user_string w "hi"); Call wl; Ret |] [];
 *     Writer.set_entry_point w main;
 *     Writer.write w      (* 2,048 bytes: Microsoft's dotnet runs it *)
 *
 * A field's and a method's row are known only at the end (a table
 * holds a type's fields together, and a compiler may add one to a
 * class it made earlier): their tokens are provisional until then, and
 * the instructions are renumbered as they are written. A method's
 * .maxstack is computed from its instructions (Il.stack_effect), each
 * branch's depth the same as where it comes from.
 *
 * What is written is what .NET needs, no more: one section (.text)
 * without the stub of machine code that Windows's loader once called
 * (.NET Core never runs it), no attributes, no names of parameters.
 * The file is written the same each time: its GUID is a digest of its
 * name, its date 0. *)

type t

(* an assembly to be written, of this name (its module name.dll) *)
val create : string -> t

(* tokens for what the assembly uses: another assembly (version 8.0.0.0,
 * Microsoft's key), one of its types, a member of a type, a type
 * built of others (a generic instance, an array as a class) *)
val assembly_ref : t -> string -> int
val type_ref : t -> int -> string -> string -> int
val member_ref : t -> int -> string -> Signature.meth -> int
val field_ref : t -> int -> string -> Signature.t -> int
val type_spec : t -> Signature.t -> int
val user_string : t -> string -> int

(* and for what it defines: a type (namespace, name, flags, the token
 * of what it extends; 0 for none), its fields and methods (their flags,
 * ECMA's II.23.1) *)
val type_def : t -> string -> string -> int -> int -> int
val field_def : t -> int -> string -> int -> Signature.t -> int
val method_def : t -> int -> string -> int -> Signature.meth -> int

(* a generic type's or method's parameter: its owner (a TypeDef's or a
 * MethodDef's token), its number, its name; the method's signature
 * says how many (Signature.meth's generic) *)
val generic_param : t -> int -> int -> string -> unit

(* a generic method instantiated (a MethodSpec): the method (a MethodDef
 * or a MemberRef) and its type arguments; its token is called as the
 * method's *)
val method_spec : t -> int -> Signature.t list -> int
(* an interface a type implements (InterfaceImpl) *)
val implements : t -> int -> int -> unit
(* a nested type's enclosing one *)
val nest : t -> int -> int -> unit

(* an exception clause, by instructions' indexes as the branches *)
type clause = {
  kind : int;              (* 0 catch, 2 finally *)
  try_start : int;
  try_end : int;
  handler_start : int;
  handler_end : int;
  catch : int;             (* the type caught, a token *)
}

(* a method's body: its locals' types, its instructions (a branch's
 * target the index of an instruction), its clauses *)
val set_body : t -> int -> Signature.t list -> Il.op array -> clause list -> unit
val set_entry_point : t -> int -> unit

(* the file *)
val write : t -> string

(* what Microsoft's dotnet needs beside a program to run it: its
 * runtimeconfig.json, .NET 8, the invariant culture *)
val runtime_config : string

(* Claude Code

(* See CLI.mli *)

type caps = < Cap.open_in; Cap.open_out; Cap.stdout; Cap.stderr >

let usage = "usage: mini-csc [-o file.dll] file.cs"

let compile (caps : < caps; .. >) (file : string) (out : string) : (unit, string) result =
  match FS.path file with
  | Error e -> Error e
  | Ok p ->
      let text = FS.read caps p in
      let at line = Printf.sprintf "%s:%d: " file line in
      match Csc_parser.program text with
      | exception Csc_lexer.Error (msg, l) -> Error (at l ^ msg)
      | exception Csc_parser.Error (msg, l) -> Error (at l ^ msg)
      | ast ->
          let name = Filename.remove_extension (Filename.basename out) in
          match Csc_compile.program name ast with
          | exception Csc_types.Error (msg, l) -> Error (at l ^ msg)
          | bytes ->
              (match FS.path out, FS.path (Filename.remove_extension out ^ ".runtimeconfig.json") with
               | Ok o, Ok cfg -> FS.write caps o bytes; FS.write caps cfg Writer.runtime_config; Ok ()
               | Error e, _ | _, Error e -> Error e)

let main (caps : < caps; .. >) (argv : string array) : int =
  let out = ref "" and files = ref [] in
  let options = [ ("-o", Arg.Set_string out, " the assembly written (file.dll, here, by default)") ] in
  match Arg.parse_argv argv options (fun (f : string) -> files := f :: !files) usage with
  | exception Arg.Help _ -> Console.print caps (usage ^ "\n"); 0
  | exception Arg.Bad msg -> Console.eprint caps msg; 1
  | () ->
      match !files with
      | [ f ] ->
          let out = if !out = "" then Filename.remove_extension (Filename.basename f) ^ ".dll" else !out in
          (match compile caps f out with
           | Ok () -> 0
           | Error msg -> Console.eprint caps (msg ^ "\n"); 1
           | exception Sys_error msg -> Console.eprint caps ("mini-csc: " ^ msg ^ "\n"); 1)
      | _ -> Console.eprint caps (usage ^ "\n"); 1
