(* mini-csc: a C# reduced to what the survey's simpler programs need,
 * compiled to .NET (plan_dotnet.md, its stage 6 and decision 11):
 * classes, interfaces, virtual methods, statics, constructors, a
 * property's getter, arrays, strings, exceptions, foreach over arrays
 * and the library's collections, out parameters. Not: structs,
 * generics of the program's own, lambdas, interpolation, switch. Its
 * usage: [usage] in CLI.ml.
 *
 *     shapes.cs
 *        | Csc_lexer, Csc_parser    ocamllex's; by hand (C# is not LALR)
 *     Csc_ast
 *        | Csc_types                the classes, the library's from
 *        |                          Library, overloads
 *        | Csc_compile, Csc_emit    the classes declared, the bodies'
 *        |                          IL (Writer: languages/dotnet/)
 *     shapes.dll, shapes.runtimeconfig.json
 *
 * Its assemblies run on Microsoft's dotnet and on mini-dotnet; its
 * test (tests/features.cs) prints what Microsoft's csc's assembly
 * prints.
 *
 * history:
 * C# (2000, Anders Hejlsberg's team at Microsoft) was .NET's language,
 * Java's shape with Delphi's properties and events; its compiler, csc,
 * was in C++ until Roslyn (2014), in C#, open source, its parser
 * written by hand. Mono had its own, mcs (Miguel de Icaza, 2001), the
 * first C# compiler written in C#.
 *
 * References: ECMA-334, "C# Language Specification", 1st edition
 * (2001), the language this reduced one is of. *)

type caps = < Cap.open_in; Cap.open_out; Cap.stdout; Cap.stderr >

val main : < caps; .. > -> string array -> int
languages/dotnet/csc/Csc_ast.ml
2918
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* The reduced C#'s tree, as Csc_parser makes it (plan_dotnet.md,
 * decision 11): classes and interfaces, their fields, methods,
 * constructors and properties with a getter; the statements and
 * expressions of C# 1 with foreach. No structs, generics of the
 * program's own, lambdas, interpolation, switch. A place is a line. *)

type pos = int

type ty =
  | Named of string list * ty list        (* System.Text.StringBuilder, List<int> *)
  | Array of ty
  | Byref of ty                             (* a parameter out or ref *)

type modifier =
  | Public | Private | Protected | Internal | Static | Abstract
  | Virtual | Override | Sealed | New | Readonly

type expr = { e : desc; pos : pos }

and desc =
  | Int of int32
  | Long of int64
  | Double of float
  | Str of string
  | Char of int
  | Bool of bool
  | Null
  | Name of string
  | This
  | Base
  | Member of expr * string                   (* e.name *)
  | Call of expr * expr list                  (* f(args): f a Name or a Member *)
  | Index of expr * expr
  | New of ty * expr list                     (* new T(args) *)
  | New_array of ty * expr                    (* new T[n] *)
  | Array_init of ty * expr list              (* new T[] { ... } *)
  | Unary of string * expr                    (* - ! *)
  | Binary of string * expr * expr            (* + - * / % == != < <= > >= && || *)
  | Assign of string * expr * expr            (* = += -= *= /= %= *)
  | Incr of bool * bool * expr                (* ++ or --, prefix?, the place *)
  | Cast of ty * expr
  | Is of expr * ty
  | Cond of expr * expr * expr
  | Typed_name of ty                          (* int.Parse: a type before a dot *)
  | Out of expr                               (* an argument out or ref: its address *)

type stmt = { s : sdesc; spos : pos }

and sdesc =
  | Block of stmt list
  | Local of ty * (string * expr option) list
  | Expr of expr
  | If of expr * stmt * stmt option
  | While of expr * stmt
  | Do of stmt * expr
  | For of stmt list * expr option * expr list * stmt
  | Foreach of ty * string * expr * stmt
  | Return of expr option
  | Break
  | Continue
  | Throw of expr option
  | Try of stmt * (ty * string option * stmt) list * stmt option
  | Empty

type member =
  | Field of modifier list * ty * (string * expr option) list * pos
  | Method of modifier list * ty * string * (ty * string) list * stmt option * pos
  | Ctor of modifier list * string * (ty * string) list * (bool * expr list) option * stmt * pos
      (* : base(args) (true) or : this(args) *)
  | Property of modifier list * ty * string * stmt option * pos   (* its getter *)

type class_decl = {
  cname : string;
  interface : bool;
  cmods : modifier list;
  bases : ty list;
  members : member list;
  cpos : pos;
}

type program = { usings : string list list; classes : class_decl list }
languages/dotnet/csc/Csc_compile.ml
6314
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Csc_compile.mli *)

module A = Csc_ast
module W = Writer
module M = Metadata
open Csc_types

let has (mods : A.modifier list) (x : A.modifier) : bool = List.mem x mods

(* ECMA's II.23.1.10: a method's flags (public and hidebysig always) *)
let flags (k : cls) (mt : meth) (getter : bool) : int =
  let base = 0x0006 lor 0x0080 in
  if mt.mname = ".ctor" then 0x1886
  else if mt.mname = ".cctor" then 0x1891
  else if k.kind = K_interface then 0x05C6
  else
    base
    lor (if mt.mstatic then 0x0010 else 0)
    lor (if mt.mabstract then 0x0400 lor 0x0040 lor 0x0100 else 0)
    lor (if mt.moverride then 0x0040 else if mt.mvirtual then 0x0040 lor 0x0100 else 0)
    lor (if mt.implements && not mt.mvirtual then 0x0040 lor 0x0020 lor 0x0100 else 0)
    lor (if getter then 0x0800 else 0)

let program (name : string) (p : A.program) : string =
  Hashtbl.reset classes;
  usings := "System" :: List.map (String.concat ".") p.usings;
  let w = W.create name in
  let c = { Csc_emit.w; memo = Hashtbl.create 64 } in
  (* the classes, their TypeDefs' rows known before they are made (row
   * 1 is <Module>), so a class may name one declared after it *)
  let user = List.mapi (fun i (d : A.class_decl) ->
      if Hashtbl.mem classes d.cname then error d.cpos ("the class " ^ d.cname ^ " declared twice");
      let k = { name = d.cname; short = d.cname; kind = (if d.interface then K_interface else K_class);
                user = Some d; spec = None; parent = None; ifaces = []; fields = []; methods = [];
                token = M.token M.t_type_def (i + 2) } in
      Hashtbl.replace classes d.cname k;
      (k, d)) p.classes in
  (* their parents and interfaces *)
  List.iter (fun ((k : cls), (d : A.class_decl)) ->
      let bases = List.map (resolve d.cpos) d.bases in
      let is_iface t = match t with Class (x, _) -> x.kind = K_interface | _ -> false in
      if d.interface then k.ifaces <- bases
      else begin
        (match List.filter (fun t -> not (is_iface t)) bases with
         | [] -> k.parent <- Some Object
         | [ t ] -> k.parent <- Some t
         | _ -> error d.cpos (d.cname ^ ": two classes to derive from"));
        k.ifaces <- List.filter is_iface bases
      end) user;
  List.iter (fun ((k : cls), (d : A.class_decl)) ->
      let tflags = if d.interface then 0x00A1 else 0x00100001 lor (if has d.cmods A.Abstract then 0x80 else 0) in
      let ext = match k.parent with Some t -> Csc_emit.type_token c t | None -> 0 in
      let tok = W.type_def w "" k.name tflags ext in
      assert (tok = k.token);
      List.iter (fun i -> W.implements w k.token (Csc_emit.type_token c i)) k.ifaces) user;
  (* their members *)
  List.iter (fun ((k : cls), (d : A.class_decl)) ->
      let meth name mods ps ret body init =
        { mname = name; mowner = k; mstatic = has mods A.Static;
          mvirtual = d.interface || has mods A.Virtual || has mods A.Abstract || has mods A.Override;
          mabstract = d.interface || has mods A.Abstract; moverride = has mods A.Override;
          mparams = List.map (fun (t, _) -> resolve d.cpos t) ps; pnames = List.map snd ps;
          mret = ret; mgeneric = 0; body; init; mtoken = 0; implements = false } in
      List.iter (fun (mb : A.member) -> match mb with
          | A.Field (mods, t, vars, pos) ->
              let t = resolve pos t in
              List.iter (fun (n, init) ->
                  k.fields <- k.fields @ [ { fname = n; ftype = t; fstatic = has mods A.Static; fowner = k;
                                             finit = init; ftoken = 0 } ]) vars
          | A.Method (mods, t, n, ps, body, pos) ->
              k.methods <- k.methods @ [ meth n mods ps (resolve pos t) body None ]
          | A.Ctor (mods, _, ps, init, body, _) ->
              k.methods <- k.methods @ [ { (meth ".ctor" mods ps Void (Some body) init) with mvirtual = false } ]
          | A.Property (mods, t, n, body, pos) ->
              k.methods <- k.methods @ [ meth ("get_" ^ n) mods [] (resolve pos t) body None ]) d.members;
      if not d.interface && not (List.exists (fun m -> m.mname = ".ctor") k.methods) then
        k.methods <- k.methods @ [ meth ".ctor" [] [] Void None None ];
      if List.exists (fun f -> f.fstatic && f.finit <> None) k.fields then
        k.methods <- k.methods @ [ meth ".cctor" [ A.Static ] [] Void None None ]) user;
  (* a class's method that an interface of it asks: virtual, as .NET's
   * dispatch through an interface wants (C#'s "virtual final") *)
  List.iter (fun ((k : cls), _) ->
      let rec all_ifaces (k : cls) =
        k.ifaces @ List.concat_map (fun i -> match i with Class (x, _) -> all_ifaces x | _ -> []) k.ifaces
        @ (match k.parent with Some (Class (p, _)) when p.user <> None -> all_ifaces p | _ -> []) in
      List.iter (fun i -> match i with
          | Class (x, _) ->
              List.iter (fun (im : meth) ->
                  List.iter (fun (mt : meth) ->
                      if mt.mname = im.mname && not mt.mstatic && List.length mt.mparams = List.length im.mparams
                         && List.for_all2 same mt.mparams im.mparams then mt.implements <- true) k.methods)
                x.methods
          | _ -> ()) (all_ifaces k)) user;
  (* the rows *)
  List.iter (fun ((k : cls), _) ->
      List.iter (fun f ->
          f.ftoken <- W.field_def w k.token f.fname (0x0006 lor (if f.fstatic then 0x0010 else 0))
              (Csc_emit.sig_of c f.ftype)) k.fields;
      List.iter (fun mt ->
          let getter = String.length mt.mname > 4 && String.sub mt.mname 0 4 = "get_" in
          mt.mtoken <- W.method_def w k.token mt.mname (flags k mt getter) (Csc_emit.meth_sig c mt))
        k.methods) user;
  (* the bodies *)
  List.iter (fun ((k : cls), _) ->
      List.iter (fun mt ->
          if not mt.mabstract && (mt.body <> None || mt.mname = ".ctor" || mt.mname = ".cctor") then
            Csc_emit.body c k mt) k.methods) user;
  (* the entry point: a static Main *)
  (match List.concat_map (fun ((k : cls), _) ->
       List.filter (fun mt -> mt.mname = "Main" && mt.mstatic) k.methods) user with
   | [ mt ] -> W.set_entry_point w mt.mtoken
   | [] -> error 0 "no static Main"
   | _ -> error 0 "several static Main");
  W.write w

(* A program of the reduced C# to an assembly: its classes declared
 * first (their TypeDefs' rows known before they are made, so a class
 * may name one declared after it), their parents, fields, methods,
 * constructors (a default one where none is written), a static
 * constructor for the static fields' initial values; a method an
 * interface asks made virtual (C#'s "virtual final", as .NET's dispatch
 * through an interface wants); then each body (Csc_emit). *)

val program : string -> Csc_ast.program -> string
languages/dotnet/csc/Csc_emit.ml
35111
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Csc_emit.mli *)

module A = Csc_ast
module T = Csc_types
module S = Signature
module W = Writer
module M = Metadata

open Csc_types

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Tokens: the library's names, the program's rows *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

type ctx = {
  w : W.t;
  memo : (string, int) Hashtbl.t;
}

let memo (c : ctx) (key : string) (make : unit -> int) : int =
  match Hashtbl.find_opt c.memo key with
  | Some x -> x
  | None -> let x = make () in Hashtbl.replace c.memo key x; x

(* the reference assembly a library type is in *)
let assembly (c : ctx) (name : string) : int =
  let a =
    if name = "System.Console" then "System.Console"
    else if String.length name > 27 && String.sub name 0 27 = "System.Collections.Generic." then "System.Collections"
    else "System.Runtime" in
  W.assembly_ref c.w a

let rec cls_token (c : ctx) (k : cls) : int =
  if k.token <> 0 then k.token
  else begin
    let t = match String.rindex_opt k.name '+' with
      | Some i ->
          (* a nested type: a TypeRef whose scope is its outer type's *)
          let outer = match lib_class (String.sub k.name 0 i) with
            | Some o -> cls_token c o | None -> error 0 ("no class " ^ k.name) in
          W.type_ref c.w outer "" (String.sub k.name (i + 1) (String.length k.name - i - 1))
      | None ->
          let ns, n = match String.rindex_opt k.name '.' with
            | Some i -> (String.sub k.name 0 i, String.sub k.name (i + 1) (String.length k.name - i - 1))
            | None -> ("", k.name) in
          W.type_ref c.w (assembly c k.name) ns n in
    k.token <- t;
    t
  end

let rec sig_of (c : ctx) (t : ty) : S.t =
  match t with
  | Void -> S.Void | Bool -> S.Bool | Char -> S.Char | Int -> S.I4 | Long -> S.I8
  | Double -> S.R8 | String -> S.String | Object | Null -> S.Object
  | Array e -> S.SzArray (sig_of c e)
  | Ref e -> S.ByRef (sig_of c e)
  | Var n -> S.Var n
  | MVar n -> S.MVar n
  | Class (k, args) ->
      let base = if k.kind = K_struct then S.ValueType (cls_token c k) else S.Class (cls_token c k) in
      if args = [] then base else S.GenericInst (base, List.map (sig_of c) args)

(* a type as an instruction's operand: newarr, box, castclass *)
let type_token (c : ctx) (t : ty) : int =
  match t with
  | Class (k, []) -> cls_token c k
  | Bool | Char | Int | Long | Double | String | Object ->
      let name = List.assoc t (List.map (fun (n, t) -> (t, n)) primitives) in
      (match lib_class name with Some k -> cls_token c k | None -> error 0 ("no class " ^ name))
  | _ -> memo c ("spec " ^ S.encode_type_spec (sig_of c t)) (fun () -> W.type_spec c.w (sig_of c t))

let meth_sig (c : ctx) (m : meth) : S.meth =
  { S.has_this = not m.mstatic; generic = m.mgeneric; vararg = false;
    ret = sig_of c m.mret; params = List.map (sig_of c) m.mparams }

(* a method's token: the program's MethodDef, or a MemberRef on the
 * class it is called on (a generic instance: a TypeSpec) *)
let meth_token (c : ctx) (on : ty) (m : meth) : int =
  if m.mtoken <> 0 then m.mtoken
  else begin
    let parent = match on with
      | Class (k, args) when k == m.mowner && args <> [] -> type_token c on
      | _ -> cls_token c m.mowner in
    W.member_ref c.w parent m.mname (meth_sig c m)
  end

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A method's code: instructions and labels, locals, scopes *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

type item = Op of Il.op | Label of int

type m = {
  c : ctx;
  cls : cls;
  meth : meth;
  mutable items : item list;                       (* reversed *)
  mutable nlabels : int;
  mutable locals : S.t list;                       (* reversed *)
  mutable nlocals : int;
  mutable scopes : (string * (int * ty)) list list;
  args : (string * (int * ty)) list;
  mutable loops : (int * int * int) list;          (* break, continue, the trys around *)
  mutable trys : int;
  mutable clauses : (int * int * int * int * int * int) list;   (* kind, labels, class *)
  mutable ret : (int * int) option;                (* a return inside a try: its label, its local *)
}

let emit (m : m) (op : Il.op) : unit = m.items <- Op op :: m.items
let label (m : m) : int = m.nlabels <- m.nlabels + 1; m.nlabels
let place (m : m) (l : int) : unit = m.items <- Label l :: m.items
let local (m : m) (t : ty) : int =
  m.locals <- sig_of m.c t :: m.locals; m.nlocals <- m.nlocals + 1; m.nlocals - 1

(* a name in a method: a local, an argument, or neither *)
type found = Found_local of int * ty | Found_arg of int * ty | Not_found_here

let lookup (m : m) (n : string) : found =
  let rec go l = match l with
    | [] -> (match List.assoc_opt n m.args with Some (i, t) -> Found_arg (i, t) | None -> Not_found_here)
    | s :: rest -> (match List.assoc_opt n s with Some (i, t) -> Found_local (i, t) | None -> go rest) in
  go m.scopes

let declare (m : m) (pos : int) (n : string) (t : ty) : int =
  (match m.scopes with
   | s :: _ when List.mem_assoc n s -> error pos ("the local " ^ n ^ " declared twice")
   | _ -> ());
  let i = local m t in
  (match m.scopes with s :: rest -> m.scopes <- ((n, (i, t)) :: s) :: rest | [] -> ());
  i

let lib_meth (pos : int) (cls : string) (name : string) (args : ty list) : meth * ty =
  match lib_class cls with
  | Some k -> let mt, _ = best pos (cls ^ "::" ^ name) (methods (Class (k, [])) name) args in (mt, Class (k, []))
  | None -> error pos ("no class " ^ cls)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Conversions *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* the value of type [from] on the stack made one of [to_] *)
let coerce (m : m) (pos : int) (from : ty) (to_ : ty) : unit =
  match convertible from to_ with
  | None -> error pos (Printf.sprintf "a %s where a %s is expected" (show from) (show to_))
  | Some 0 -> ()
  | Some _ ->
      match from, to_ with
      | (Int | Char), Long -> emit m (Il.Conv (Il.K_i8, false, false))
      | (Int | Char | Long), Double -> emit m (Il.Conv (Il.K_r8, false, false))
      | t, Object when is_value t -> emit m (Il.Box (type_token m.c t))
      | _ -> ()

(* the type two operands are computed in (C#'s binary numeric
 * promotions, 7.3.6.2) *)
let promote (a : ty) (b : ty) : ty option =
  match a, b with
  | (Int | Char | Long | Double), (Int | Char | Long | Double) ->
      Some (if a = Double || b = Double then Double else if a = Long || b = Long then Long else Int)
  | _ -> None

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Expressions *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* a type named in an expression: System.Console, int, Shape *)
let rec as_type (m : m) (e : A.expr) : ty option =
  let rec names (e : A.expr) = match e.e with
    | A.Name n -> Some [ n ]
    | A.Member (e, n) -> Option.map (fun l -> l @ [ n ]) (names e)
    | _ -> None in
  match e.e with
  | A.Typed_name t -> Some (resolve e.pos t)
  | A.Name n when lookup m n <> Not_found_here || field (Class (m.cls, [])) n <> None -> None
  | A.Name _ | A.Member _ ->
      (match names e with
       | Some l -> (match resolve e.pos (A.Named (l, [])) with t -> Some t | exception Error _ -> None)
       | None -> None)
  | _ -> None

and this_type (m : m) : ty = Class (m.cls, [])

and expr (m : m) (e : A.expr) : ty =
  match e.e with
  | A.Int n -> emit m (Il.Ldc_i4 n); Int
  | A.Long n -> emit m (Il.Ldc_i8 n); Long
  | A.Double f -> emit m (Il.Ldc_r f); Double
  | A.Str s -> emit m (Il.Ldstr (W.user_string m.c.w s)); String
  | A.Char ch -> emit m (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_int ch)); Char
  | A.Bool b -> emit m (Il.Ldc_i4 (if b then Int32.one else Int32.zero)); Bool
  | A.Null -> emit m Il.Ldnull; Null
  | A.This | A.Base ->
      if m.meth.mstatic then error e.pos "this in a static method";
      emit m (Il.Ldarg 0); this_type m
  | A.Name n ->
      (match lookup m n with
       | Found_local (i, t) -> emit m (Il.Ldloc i); t
       | Found_arg (i, Ref t) -> emit m (Il.Ldarg i); emit m (ldind m t); t
       | Found_arg (i, t) -> emit m (Il.Ldarg i); t
       | Not_found_here ->
           match field (this_type m) n with
           | Some f -> load_field m e.pos None f
           | None -> (match getter m e.pos (this_type m) n with
               | Some g -> call_with m e.pos (if g.mstatic then None else Some (this_expr m)) (this_type m) g []
               | None -> error e.pos ("no variable " ^ n)))
  | A.Member (target, n) ->
      (match as_type m target with
       | Some t ->
           (match field t n with
            | Some f when f.fstatic -> load_field m e.pos None f
            | _ -> (match getter m e.pos t n with
                | Some g -> call_with m e.pos None t g []
                | None -> error e.pos (Printf.sprintf "%s has no static %s" (show t) n)))
       | None ->
           let t = expr m target in
           (match t, n with
            | Array _, "Length" -> emit m Il.Ldlen; emit m (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false)); Int
            | _ ->
                match field t n with
                | Some f -> if f.fstatic then (emit m Il.Pop; load_field m e.pos None f)
                  else load_field m e.pos (Some ()) f
                | None ->
                    match getter m e.pos t n with
                    | Some g -> call_on m e.pos t g []
                    | None -> error e.pos (Printf.sprintf "%s has no member %s" (show t) n)))
  | A.Call (f, args) -> call m e.pos f args
  | A.Index (a, i) ->
      let t = expr m a in
      (match t with
       | Array el ->
           expr_to m i Int;
           emit m (ldelem m el); el
       | _ ->
           let g = match getter m e.pos t "Item" with
             | Some g -> g
             | None -> if t = String then fst (lib_meth e.pos "System.String" "get_Chars" [ Int ])
               else error e.pos ("an index of a " ^ show t) in
           call_on m e.pos t g [ i ])
  | A.New (t, args) ->
      let t = resolve e.pos t in
      let ctor, ps = best e.pos ("constructor of " ^ show t) (methods t ".ctor") (List.map (type_of m) args) in
      List.iter2 (fun a p -> expr_to m a p) args ps;
      emit m (Il.Newobj (meth_token m.c t ctor));
      t
  | A.New_array (t, n) ->
      let t = resolve e.pos t in
      expr_to m n Int;
      emit m (Il.Newarr (type_token m.c t));
      Array t
  | A.Array_init (t, elems) ->
      let t = resolve e.pos t in
      emit m (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_int (List.length elems)));
      emit m (Il.Newarr (type_token m.c t));
      List.iteri (fun i x ->
          emit m Il.Dup; emit m (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_int i));
          expr_to m x t; emit m (stelem m t)) elems;
      Array t
  | A.Unary ("-", x) ->
      let t = expr m x in
      (match promote t t with
       | Some p -> coerce m e.pos t p; emit m Il.Neg; p
       | None -> error e.pos ("- of a " ^ show t))
  | A.Unary (_, x) -> expr_to m x Bool; emit m (Il.Ldc_i4 Int32.zero); emit m Il.Ceq; Bool
  | A.Binary (("&&" | "||") as o, a, b) ->
      let out = label m and short = label m in
      expr_to m a Bool;
      emit m (if o = "&&" then Il.Brfalse short else Il.Brtrue short);
      expr_to m b Bool;
      emit m (Il.Br out);
      place m short;
      emit m (Il.Ldc_i4 (if o = "&&" then Int32.zero else Int32.one));
      place m out;
      Bool
  | A.Binary (o, a, b) -> binary m e.pos o a b
  | A.Assign (o, place_e, value) -> assign m e.pos o place_e value true
  | A.Incr (up, prefix, x) -> step m e.pos up prefix x true
  | A.Cast (t, x) ->
      let t = resolve e.pos t in
      let from = expr m x in
      cast m e.pos from t;
      t
  | A.Is (x, t) ->
      let t = resolve e.pos t in
      let from = expr m x in
      if is_value from then emit m (Il.Box (type_token m.c from));
      emit m (Il.Isinst (type_token m.c t));
      emit m Il.Ldnull; emit m (Il.Cgt true);
      Bool
  | A.Cond (c, a, b) ->
      let ta = type_of m a and tb = type_of m b in
      let t = if convertible ta tb <> None then tb else ta in
      let other = label m and out = label m in
      expr_to m c Bool;
      emit m (Il.Brfalse other);
      expr_to m a t; emit m (Il.Br out);
      place m other;
      expr_to m b t;
      place m out;
      t
  | A.Out x ->
      (match x.e with
       | A.Name n ->
           (match lookup m n with
            | Found_local (i, t) -> emit m (Il.Ldloca i); Ref t
            | Found_arg (i, (Ref _ as t)) -> emit m (Il.Ldarg i); t
            | Found_arg (i, t) -> emit m (Il.Ldarga i); Ref t
            | Not_found_here -> error x.pos ("out of what is not a local: " ^ n))
       | _ -> error x.pos "out of what is not a local")
  | A.Typed_name _ -> error e.pos "a type where a value is expected"

(* its type, without its code: the code made and thrown away *)
and type_of (m : m) (e : A.expr) : ty =
  let items = m.items and locals = m.locals and n = m.nlocals and l = m.nlabels in
  let t = expr m e in
  (* (the labels made stay made: their numbers are not reused) *)
  m.items <- items; m.locals <- locals; m.nlocals <- n;
  ignore l;
  t

and expr_to (m : m) (e : A.expr) (t : ty) : unit =
  let from = expr m e in
  coerce m e.pos from t

and this_expr (_m : m) : A.expr = { A.e = A.This; pos = 0 }

and ldelem (m : m) (t : ty) : Il.op =
  match t with
  | Int -> Il.Ldelem Il.K_i4 | Bool -> Il.Ldelem Il.K_u1 | Char -> Il.Ldelem Il.K_u2
  | Long -> Il.Ldelem Il.K_i8 | Double -> Il.Ldelem Il.K_r8
  | t when is_value t -> Il.Ldelem_any (type_token m.c t)
  | _ -> Il.Ldelem Il.K_ref

and stelem (m : m) (t : ty) : Il.op =
  match t with
  | Int -> Il.Stelem Il.K_i4 | Bool -> Il.Stelem Il.K_i1 | Char -> Il.Stelem Il.K_i2
  | Long -> Il.Stelem Il.K_i8 | Double -> Il.Stelem Il.K_r8
  | t when is_value t -> Il.Stelem_any (type_token m.c t)
  | _ -> Il.Stelem Il.K_ref

and ldind (m : m) (t : ty) : Il.op =
  match t with
  | Int -> Il.Ldind Il.K_i4 | Bool -> Il.Ldind Il.K_u1 | Char -> Il.Ldind Il.K_u2
  | Long -> Il.Ldind Il.K_i8 | Double -> Il.Ldind Il.K_r8
  | t when is_value t -> Il.Ldobj (type_token m.c t)
  | _ -> Il.Ldind Il.K_ref

and stind (m : m) (t : ty) : Il.op =
  match t with
  | Int -> Il.Stind Il.K_i4 | Bool -> Il.Stind Il.K_i1 | Char -> Il.Stind Il.K_i2
  | Long -> Il.Stind Il.K_i8 | Double -> Il.Stind Il.K_r8
  | t when is_value t -> Il.Stobj (type_token m.c t)
  | _ -> Il.Stind Il.K_ref

and load_field (m : m) (pos : int) (on_stack : unit option) (f : field) : ty =
  if f.fstatic then emit m (Il.Ldsfld f.ftoken)
  else begin
    if on_stack = None then begin
      if m.meth.mstatic then error pos ("the field " ^ f.fname ^ " in a static method");
      emit m (Il.Ldarg 0)
    end;
    emit m (Il.Ldfld f.ftoken)
  end;
  f.ftype

and getter (_m : m) (_pos : int) (t : ty) (n : string) : meth option =
  match methods t ("get_" ^ n) with
  | (g, _) :: _ when g.mparams = [] || n = "Item" -> Some g
  | _ -> None

(* a call: f(args), x.f(args), T.f(args), base.f(args) *)
and call (m : m) (pos : int) (f : A.expr) (args : A.expr list) : ty =
  let types = List.map (type_of m) args in
  match f.e with
  | A.Name n ->
      let mt, _ = best pos n (methods (this_type m) n) types in
      call_with m pos (if mt.mstatic then None else Some (this_expr m)) (this_type m) mt args
  | A.Member ({ e = A.Base; _ }, n) ->
      let parent = match m.cls.parent with Some p -> p | None -> Object in
      let mt, ps = best pos n (methods parent n) types in
      emit m (Il.Ldarg 0);
      List.iter2 (fun a p -> expr_to m a p) args ps;
      emit m (Il.Call (meth_token m.c parent mt));
      mt.mret
  | A.Member (target, n) ->
      (match as_type m target with
       | Some t ->
           let mt, _ = best pos (show t ^ "." ^ n) (List.filter (fun (x, _) -> x.mstatic) (methods t n)) types in
           call_with m pos None t mt args
       | None ->
           let t = type_of m target in
           let mt, _ = best pos (show t ^ "." ^ n) (methods t n) types in
           if mt.mstatic then error pos (n ^ " is static: called on its class");
           call_with m pos (Some target) t mt args)
  | _ -> error pos "a call of what is not a method"

(* a method called, `this` the target's value (a value type's: its
 * address, by a local) *)
and call_with (m : m) (pos : int) (target : A.expr option) (t : ty) (mt : meth) (args : A.expr list) : ty =
  (match target with
   | None -> ()
   | Some x ->
       let tt = expr m x in
       if is_value tt then begin
         let tmp = local m tt in
         emit m (Il.Stloc tmp); emit m (Il.Ldloca tmp)
       end);
  let ps = List.map (subst (match t with Class (_, a) -> a | _ -> []) []) mt.mparams in
  List.iter2 (fun a p -> expr_to m a p) args ps;
  let tok = meth_token m.c t mt in
  emit m (if mt.mstatic || is_value t then Il.Call tok else Il.Callvirt tok);
  ignore pos;
  subst (match t with Class (_, a) -> a | _ -> []) [] mt.mret

(* the target already on the stack *)
and call_on (m : m) (pos : int) (t : ty) (mt : meth) (args : A.expr list) : ty =
  if is_value t then begin
    let tmp = local m t in
    emit m (Il.Stloc tmp); emit m (Il.Ldloca tmp)
  end;
  let ps = List.map (subst (match t with Class (_, a) -> a | _ -> []) []) mt.mparams in
  if List.length ps <> List.length args then error pos (mt.mname ^ ": the arguments' count");
  List.iter2 (fun a p -> expr_to m a p) args ps;
  let tok = meth_token m.c t mt in
  emit m (if is_value t then Il.Call tok else Il.Callvirt tok);
  subst (match t with Class (_, a) -> a | _ -> []) [] mt.mret

and binary (m : m) (pos : int) (o : string) (a : A.expr) (b : A.expr) : ty =
  let ta = type_of m a and tb = type_of m b in
  match o with
  | "+" when ta = String || tb = String ->
      (* String.Concat: of two strings, or of two objects (a value boxed) *)
      if ta = String && tb = String then begin
        expr m a |> ignore; expr m b |> ignore;
        let c, on = lib_meth pos "System.String" "Concat" [ String; String ] in
        emit m (Il.Call (meth_token m.c on c))
      end else begin
        expr_to m a Object; expr_to m b Object;
        let c, on = lib_meth pos "System.String" "Concat" [ Object; Object ] in
        emit m (Il.Call (meth_token m.c on c))
      end;
      String
  | ("==" | "!=") when ta = String && tb <> Null || tb = String && ta <> Null ->
      expr_to m a String; expr_to m b String;
      let c, on = lib_meth pos "System.String" (if o = "==" then "op_Equality" else "op_Inequality") [ String; String ] in
      emit m (Il.Call (meth_token m.c on c));
      Bool
  | "==" | "!=" | "<" | ">" | "<=" | ">=" ->
      let t = match promote ta tb with
        | Some t -> t
        | None ->
            if (ta = Bool && tb = Bool) || (not (is_value ta) && not (is_value tb)) then Object
            else error pos (Printf.sprintf "%s %s %s" (show ta) o (show tb)) in
      if t = Object then (expr m a |> ignore; expr m b |> ignore)
      else (expr_to m a t; expr_to m b t);
      let negate () = emit m (Il.Ldc_i4 Int32.zero); emit m Il.Ceq in
      (match o with
       | "==" -> emit m Il.Ceq
       | "!=" -> emit m Il.Ceq; negate ()
       | "<" -> emit m (Il.Clt false)
       | ">" -> emit m (Il.Cgt false)
       | "<=" -> emit m (Il.Cgt (t = Double)); negate ()
       | _ -> emit m (Il.Clt (t = Double)); negate ());
      Bool
  | _ ->
      match promote ta tb with
      | Some t ->
          expr_to m a t; expr_to m b t;
          emit m (Il.Binop (match o with
              | "+" -> Il.Add | "-" -> Il.Sub | "*" -> Il.Mul | "/" -> Il.Div | "%" -> Il.Rem
              | _ -> error pos ("an operator " ^ o)));
          t
      | None -> error pos (Printf.sprintf "%s %s %s" (show ta) o (show tb))

and cast (m : m) (pos : int) (from : ty) (t : ty) : unit =
  match from, t with
  | _ when same from t -> ()
  | (Int | Char | Long | Double), (Int | Char | Long | Double) ->
      emit m (Il.Conv ((match t with Int -> Il.K_i4 | Char -> Il.K_u2 | Long -> Il.K_i8 | _ -> Il.K_r8), false, false))
  | _, _ when convertible from t <> None -> coerce m pos from t
  | (Object | Class _), t when is_value t -> emit m (Il.Unbox_any (type_token m.c t))
  | _, _ when not (is_value from) && not (is_value t) -> emit m (Il.Castclass (type_token m.c t))
  | _ -> error pos (Printf.sprintf "no cast from %s to %s" (show from) (show t))

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Places: what can be assigned *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

and target (m : m) (e : A.expr) : (unit -> unit) * (unit -> unit) * ty =
  (* (what it needs computed first, kept in locals; then how to load it,
   * how to store the value of a local) *)
  let store_with f = f in
  match e.e with
  | A.Name n ->
      (match lookup m n with
       | Found_local (i, t) -> ((fun () -> emit m (Il.Ldloc i)), store_with (fun () -> emit m (Il.Stloc i)), t)
       | Found_arg (i, Ref t) ->
           let value = local m t in
           ((fun () -> emit m (Il.Ldarg i); emit m (ldind m t)),
            (fun () -> emit m (Il.Stloc value); emit m (Il.Ldarg i); emit m (Il.Ldloc value); emit m (stind m t)),
            t)
       | Found_arg (i, t) -> ((fun () -> emit m (Il.Ldarg i)), (fun () -> emit m (Il.Starg i)), t)
       | Not_found_here ->
           match field (this_type m) n with
           | Some f when f.fstatic ->
               ((fun () -> emit m (Il.Ldsfld f.ftoken)), (fun () -> emit m (Il.Stsfld f.ftoken)), f.ftype)
           | Some f -> field_place m (fun () -> emit m (Il.Ldarg 0)) f
           | None -> error e.pos ("no variable " ^ n))
  | A.Member (x, n) ->
      (match as_type m x with
       | Some t -> (match field t n with
           | Some f when f.fstatic ->
               ((fun () -> emit m (Il.Ldsfld f.ftoken)), (fun () -> emit m (Il.Stsfld f.ftoken)), f.ftype)
           | _ -> error e.pos (show t ^ " has no static field " ^ n))
       | None ->
           let t = expr m x in
           let tmp = local m t in
           emit m (Il.Stloc tmp);
           match field t n with
           | Some f -> field_place m (fun () -> emit m (Il.Ldloc tmp)) f
           | None -> error e.pos (show t ^ " has no field " ^ n))
  | A.Index (a, i) ->
      let t = expr m a in
      let ta = local m t in
      emit m (Il.Stloc ta);
      (match t with
       | Array el ->
           expr_to m i Int;
           let ti = local m Int in
           emit m (Il.Stloc ti);
           let value = local m el in
           ((fun () -> emit m (Il.Ldloc ta); emit m (Il.Ldloc ti); emit m (ldelem m el)),
            (fun () -> emit m (Il.Stloc value); emit m (Il.Ldloc ta); emit m (Il.Ldloc ti);
              emit m (Il.Ldloc value); emit m (stelem m el)),
            el)
       | _ ->
           let g = match getter m e.pos t "Item" with Some g -> g | None -> error e.pos ("an index of " ^ show t) in
           let s = match methods t "set_Item" with (s, _) :: _ -> s | [] -> error e.pos ("no set_Item in " ^ show t) in
           let args = match t with Class (_, a) -> a | _ -> [] in
           let kt = subst args [] (List.hd g.mparams) and vt = subst args [] g.mret in
           expr_to m i kt;
           let ti = local m kt in
           emit m (Il.Stloc ti);
           let value = local m vt in
           ((fun () -> emit m (Il.Ldloc ta); emit m (Il.Ldloc ti); emit m (Il.Callvirt (meth_token m.c t g))),
            (fun () -> emit m (Il.Stloc value); emit m (Il.Ldloc ta); emit m (Il.Ldloc ti);
              emit m (Il.Ldloc value); emit m (Il.Callvirt (meth_token m.c t s))),
            vt))
  | _ -> error e.pos "this cannot be assigned"

and field_place (m : m) (obj : unit -> unit) (f : field) : (unit -> unit) * (unit -> unit) * ty =
  let value = local m f.ftype in
  ((fun () -> obj (); emit m (Il.Ldfld f.ftoken)),
   (fun () -> emit m (Il.Stloc value); obj (); emit m (Il.Ldloc value); emit m (Il.Stfld f.ftoken)),
   f.ftype)

(* x = v, x += v: the value, if [want], left on the stack *)
and assign (m : m) (pos : int) (o : string) (x : A.expr) (v : A.expr) (want : bool) : ty =
  let load, store, t = target m x in
  if o = "=" then expr_to m v t
  else begin
    let bin = String.sub o 0 1 in
    let tv = binary_on m pos bin load t v in
    cast m pos tv t
  end;
  if want then emit m Il.Dup;
  store ();
  if want then t else Void

(* load, op, v: what x op= v computes *)
and binary_on (m : m) (pos : int) (o : string) (load : unit -> unit) (t : ty) (v : A.expr) : ty =
  let tv = type_of m v in
  if o = "+" && (t = String || tv = String) then begin
    load (); coerce m pos t Object; expr_to m v Object;
    let c, on = lib_meth pos "System.String" "Concat" [ Object; Object ] in
    emit m (Il.Call (meth_token m.c on c));
    String
  end else
    match promote t tv with
    | Some p ->
        load (); coerce m pos t p; expr_to m v p;
        emit m (Il.Binop (match o with "+" -> Il.Add | "-" -> Il.Sub | "*" -> Il.Mul | "/" -> Il.Div | _ -> Il.Rem));
        p
    | None -> error pos (Printf.sprintf "%s %s= %s" (show t) o (show tv))

and step (m : m) (pos : int) (up : bool) (prefix : bool) (x : A.expr) (want : bool) : ty =
  let load, store, t = target m x in
  load ();
  if want && not prefix then emit m Il.Dup;
  emit m (Il.Ldc_i4 Int32.one);
  if t = Long then emit m (Il.Conv (Il.K_i8, false, false));
  emit m (Il.Binop (if up then Il.Add else Il.Sub));
  (match t with Char -> emit m (Il.Conv (Il.K_u2, false, false)) | Int | Long -> () | _ -> error pos ("++ of a " ^ show t));
  if want && prefix then emit m Il.Dup;
  store ();
  if want then t else Void

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Statements *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let rec stmt (m : m) (s : A.stmt) : unit =
  match s.s with
  | A.Empty -> ()
  | A.Block l ->
      m.scopes <- [] :: m.scopes;
      List.iter (stmt m) l;
      m.scopes <- List.tl m.scopes
  | A.Local (t, vars) ->
      let t = resolve s.spos t in
      List.iter (fun (n, init) ->
          let i = declare m s.spos n t in
          match init with
          | Some e -> expr_to m e t; emit m (Il.Stloc i)
          | None -> ()) vars
  | A.Expr e ->
      (match e.e with
       | A.Assign (o, x, v) -> ignore (assign m e.pos o x v false)
       | A.Incr (up, prefix, x) -> ignore (step m e.pos up prefix x false)
       | _ -> if expr m e <> Void then emit m Il.Pop)
  | A.If (c, t, f) ->
      let other = label m and out = label m in
      expr_to m c Bool;
      emit m (Il.Brfalse other);
      stmt m t;
      emit m (Il.Br out);
      place m other;
      (match f with Some f -> stmt m f | None -> ());
      place m out
  | A.While (c, body) ->
      let test = label m and out = label m in
      place m test;
      expr_to m c Bool;
      emit m (Il.Brfalse out);
      loop m out test body;
      emit m (Il.Br test);
      place m out
  | A.Do (body, c) ->
      let top = label m and test = label m and out = label m in
      place m top;
      loop m out test body;
      place m test;
      expr_to m c Bool;
      emit m (Il.Brtrue top);
      place m out
  | A.For (init, c, step, body) ->
      m.scopes <- [] :: m.scopes;
      List.iter (stmt m) init;
      let test = label m and next = label m and out = label m in
      place m test;
      (match c with Some c -> expr_to m c Bool; emit m (Il.Brfalse out) | None -> ());
      loop m out next body;
      place m next;
      List.iter (fun e -> stmt m { A.s = A.Expr e; spos = s.spos }) step;
      emit m (Il.Br test);
      place m out;
      m.scopes <- List.tl m.scopes
  | A.Foreach (t, n, coll, body) ->
      let t = resolve s.spos t in
      m.scopes <- [] :: m.scopes;
      let ct = expr m coll in
      let test = label m and next = label m and out = label m in
      (match ct with
       | Array el ->
           (* for (i = 0; i < a.Length; i++) { T n = a[i]; body } *)
           let a = local m ct and i = local m Int in
           emit m (Il.Stloc a);
           emit m (Il.Ldc_i4 Int32.zero); emit m (Il.Stloc i);
           place m test;
           emit m (Il.Ldloc i); emit m (Il.Ldloc a); emit m Il.Ldlen; emit m (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false));
           emit m (Il.Bcmp (Il.Ge, false, out));
           let v = declare m s.spos n t in
           emit m (Il.Ldloc a); emit m (Il.Ldloc i); emit m (ldelem m el);
           coerce m s.spos el t; emit m (Il.Stloc v);
           loop m out next body;
           place m next;
           emit m (Il.Ldloc i); emit m (Il.Ldc_i4 Int32.one); emit m (Il.Binop Il.Add); emit m (Il.Stloc i);
           emit m (Il.Br test);
           place m out
       | _ ->
           (* its enumerator, a struct: MoveNext, Current *)
           let ge = match methods ct "GetEnumerator" with (g, _) :: _ -> g | [] -> error s.spos ("foreach over a " ^ show ct) in
           let et = call_on m s.spos ct ge [] in
           let en = local m et in
           emit m (Il.Stloc en);
           let mn = match methods et "MoveNext" with (x, _) :: _ -> x | [] -> error s.spos "no MoveNext" in
           let cur = match methods et "get_Current" with (x, _) :: _ -> x | [] -> error s.spos "no Current" in
           let address () = emit m (if is_value et then Il.Ldloca en else Il.Ldloc en) in
           let invoke x = emit m (if is_value et then Il.Call (meth_token m.c et x) else Il.Callvirt (meth_token m.c et x)) in
           place m test;
           address (); invoke mn;
           emit m (Il.Brfalse out);
           let v = declare m s.spos n t in
           address (); invoke cur;
           coerce m s.spos (subst (match et with Class (_, a) -> a | _ -> []) [] cur.mret) t;
           emit m (Il.Stloc v);
           loop m out test body;
           place m next;
           emit m (Il.Br test);
           place m out);
      m.scopes <- List.tl m.scopes
  | A.Return e ->
      (match e with Some e -> expr_to m e m.meth.mret | None -> ());
      if m.trys > 0 then begin
        let l, v = match m.ret with
          | Some r -> r
          | None -> let r = (label m, if m.meth.mret = Void then -1 else local m m.meth.mret) in m.ret <- Some r; r in
        if v >= 0 then emit m (Il.Stloc v);
        emit m (Il.Leave l)
      end else emit m Il.Ret
  | A.Break ->
      (match m.loops with
       | (out, _, trys) :: _ -> emit m (if m.trys > trys then Il.Leave out else Il.Br out)
       | [] -> error s.spos "a break outside a loop")
  | A.Continue ->
      (match m.loops with
       | (_, next, trys) :: _ -> emit m (if m.trys > trys then Il.Leave next else Il.Br next)
       | [] -> error s.spos "a continue outside a loop")
  | A.Throw (Some e) -> ignore (expr m e); emit m Il.Throw
  | A.Throw None -> emit m Il.Rethrow
  | A.Try (body, catches, fin) ->
      let out = label m and start = label m and inner_end = label m in
      m.trys <- m.trys + 1;
      place m start;
      stmt m body;
      emit m (Il.Leave out);
      let starts = List.map (fun _ -> label m) catches in
      List.iteri (fun i (t, n, h) ->
          let hs = List.nth starts i in
          place m hs;
          let t = resolve s.spos t in
          m.scopes <- [] :: m.scopes;
          (match n with
           | Some n -> let v = declare m s.spos n t in emit m (Il.Stloc v)
           | None -> emit m Il.Pop);
          stmt m h;
          m.scopes <- List.tl m.scopes;
          emit m (Il.Leave out);
          let stop = if i + 1 < List.length starts then List.nth starts (i + 1) else inner_end in
          m.clauses <- (0, start, List.hd starts, hs, stop, type_token m.c t) :: m.clauses) catches;
      place m inner_end;
      (match fin with
       | Some f ->
           let fs = inner_end and fe = label m in
           stmt m f;
           emit m Il.Endfinally;
           place m fe;
           m.clauses <- (2, start, fs, fs, fe, 0) :: m.clauses
       | None -> ());
      m.trys <- m.trys - 1;
      place m out

and loop (m : m) (out : int) (next : int) (body : A.stmt) : unit =
  m.loops <- (out, next, m.trys) :: m.loops;
  stmt m body;
  m.loops <- List.tl m.loops

(* the method's code to the writer: labels to indexes *)
let finish (m : m) : unit =
  let at = Hashtbl.create 16 in
  let n = ref 0 in
  let ops = List.rev m.items in
  List.iter (fun it -> match it with Op _ -> incr n | Label l -> Hashtbl.replace at l !n) ops;
  let pos l = Hashtbl.find at l in
  let code = Array.of_list (List.filter_map (fun it -> match it with
      | Op (Il.Br l) -> Some (Il.Br (pos l)) | Op (Il.Brfalse l) -> Some (Il.Brfalse (pos l))
      | Op (Il.Brtrue l) -> Some (Il.Brtrue (pos l)) | Op (Il.Bcmp (x, u, l)) -> Some (Il.Bcmp (x, u, pos l))
      | Op (Il.Leave l) -> Some (Il.Leave (pos l))
      | Op op -> Some op | Label _ -> None) ops) in
  (* the clauses, innermost first: in the order made, a nested try's
   * before its outer's, as ECMA asks *)
  let clauses = List.rev_map (fun (kind, ts, te, hs, he, cls) ->
      { W.kind; try_start = pos ts; try_end = pos te; handler_start = pos hs;
        handler_end = pos he; catch = cls }) m.clauses in
  W.set_body m.c.w m.meth.mtoken (List.rev m.locals) code clauses

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The classes *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let new_m (c : ctx) (k : cls) (mt : meth) : m =
  let first = if mt.mstatic then 0 else 1 in
  { c; cls = k; meth = mt; items = []; nlabels = 0; locals = []; nlocals = 0; scopes = [ [] ];
    args = List.mapi (fun i (n, t) -> (n, (i + first, t))) (List.combine mt.pnames mt.mparams);
    loops = []; trys = 0; clauses = []; ret = None }

(* a method's body; a constructor's: its fields' initial values, its
 * parent's constructor, then its own *)
let body (c : ctx) (k : cls) (mt : meth) : unit =
  let m = new_m c k mt in
  if mt.mname = ".cctor" then
    List.iter (fun f -> match f.finit with
        | Some e when f.fstatic -> expr_to m e f.ftype; emit m (Il.Stsfld f.ftoken)
        | _ -> ()) k.fields
  else if mt.mname = ".ctor" then begin
    (match mt.init with
     | Some (false, _) -> ()
     | _ ->
         List.iter (fun f -> match f.finit with
             | Some e when not f.fstatic -> emit m (Il.Ldarg 0); expr_to m e f.ftype; emit m (Il.Stfld f.ftoken)
             | _ -> ()) k.fields);
    let parent = match k.parent with Some p -> p | None -> Object in
    let on, args = match mt.init with
      | Some (true, args) -> (parent, args)
      | None -> (parent, [])
      | Some (false, args) -> (Class (k, []), args) in
    let types = List.map (type_of m) args in
    let ctor, ps = best 0 ("constructor of " ^ show on) (methods on ".ctor") types in
    emit m (Il.Ldarg 0);
    List.iter2 (fun a p -> expr_to m a p) args ps;
    emit m (Il.Call (meth_token c on ctor))
  end;
  (match mt.body with Some b -> stmt m b | None -> ());
  (match m.ret with
   | Some (l, v) -> place m l; if v >= 0 then emit m (Il.Ldloc v); emit m Il.Ret
   | None -> if mt.mret = Void then emit m Il.Ret);
  finish m
languages/dotnet/csc/Csc_emit.mli
1624
(* The reduced C#'s methods to IL, in one pass over each body, as
 * mini-pascal compiles (its Pascal_compile): an expression's code is
 * written as its type is found. Where a choice needs the types first
 * (an overload by its arguments', a + of a string), they are found by
 * compiling the arguments and throwing the code away (type_of).
 *
 * What C# writes for the machine, and how:
 *   - a string's + is String.Concat (of two strings, or of two objects,
 *     a value boxed), == of strings String.op_Equality;
 *   - foreach over an array is a loop on its index; over a List, its
 *     Enumerator, a struct in a local, MoveNext and Current called on
 *     its address (C#'s finally around it, Dispose, left out);
 *   - an assignment computes its place first (an object, an array and
 *     an index), kept in locals, then the value, then stores: what is
 *     assigned may be used as a value (a = b = c);
 *   - a return inside a try is a leave to the method's end, its value
 *     in a local: IL forbids a ret there;
 *   - an argument out is a local's address (ldloca), a parameter out
 *     a pointer read and written with ldind and stind. *)

type ctx = { w : Writer.t; memo : (string, int) Hashtbl.t }

(* a type in the writer: as a signature, as an instruction's operand *)
val sig_of : ctx -> Csc_types.ty -> Signature.t
val type_token : ctx -> Csc_types.ty -> int
val meth_sig : ctx -> Csc_types.meth -> Signature.meth

(* a method's body to the writer; a constructor's with its fields'
 * initial values and its parent's constructor first *)
val body : ctx -> Csc_types.cls -> Csc_types.meth -> unit

{
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* The reduced C#'s tokens: identifiers and keywords, numbers (an L for
 * long, a dot for double), strings and characters with C#'s escapes,
 * comments of both kinds, the operators by their longest form. *)

type token =
  | ID of string
  | KW of string                  (* class, int, new, if... *)
  | INT of int32
  | LONG of int64
  | DOUBLE of float
  | STRING of string
  | CHAR of int
  | OP of string                  (* ( ) { } [ ] ; , . ? : and the operators *)
  | EOF

exception Error of string * int

let keywords = [
  "abstract"; "base"; "bool"; "break"; "catch"; "char"; "class"; "continue";
  "do"; "double"; "else"; "false"; "finally"; "for"; "foreach"; "get"; "if";
  "in"; "int"; "interface"; "internal"; "is"; "long"; "namespace"; "new";
  "null"; "object"; "out"; "override"; "private"; "protected"; "public";
  "readonly"; "ref"; "return"; "sealed"; "static"; "string"; "this"; "throw";
  "true"; "try"; "using"; "virtual"; "void"; "while";
]

let line = ref 1
let buf = Buffer.create 64

let escape (c : char) : char =
  match c with
  | 'n' -> '\n' | 't' -> '\t' | 'r' -> '\r' | '0' -> '\000'
  | c -> c
}

let blank = [' ' '\t' '\r']
let letter = ['a'-'z' 'A'-'Z' '_']
let digit = ['0'-'9']

rule token = parse
  | '\n' { incr line; token lexbuf }
  | blank+ { token lexbuf }
  | "//" [^ '\n']* { token lexbuf }
  | "/*" { comment lexbuf; token lexbuf }
  | letter (letter | digit)* as id
      { if List.mem id keywords then KW id else ID id }
  | (digit+ as n) ['L' 'l'] { LONG (Int64.of_string n) }
  | digit+ '.' digit+ as f { DOUBLE (float_of_string f) }
  | digit+ as n
      { match Int32.of_string n with
        | v -> INT v
        | exception _ -> raise (Error ("the number " ^ n ^ " is too big", !line)) }
  | '"' { Buffer.clear buf; string lexbuf }
  | "'\\" (_ as c) "'" { CHAR (Char.code (escape c)) }
  | "'" ([^ '\\' '\''] as c) "'" { CHAR (Char.code c) }
  | "++" | "--" | "&&" | "||" | "==" | "!=" | "<=" | ">=" | "+=" | "-=" | "*="
  | "/=" | "%=" | "=>" as op { OP op }
  | ['(' ')' '{' '}' '[' ']' ';' ',' '.' '?' ':' '+' '-' '*' '/' '%' '<' '>'
     '=' '!' '&' '|'] as c { OP (String.make 1 c) }
  | eof { EOF }
  | _ as c { raise (Error (Printf.sprintf "a character %C" c, !line)) }

and comment = parse
  | "*/" { () }
  | '\n' { incr line; comment lexbuf }
  | eof { raise (Error ("a comment without its end", !line)) }
  | _ { comment lexbuf }

and string = parse
  | '"' { STRING (Buffer.contents buf) }
  | '\\' (_ as c) { Buffer.add_char buf (escape c); string lexbuf }
  | '\n' { raise (Error ("a string without its end", !line)) }
  | eof { raise (Error ("a string without its end", !line)) }
  | _ as c { Buffer.add_char buf c; string lexbuf }
languages/dotnet/csc/Csc_parser.ml
15576
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Csc_parser.mli *)

open Csc_ast
module L = Csc_lexer

exception Error of string * int

(* the tokens, each with its line, and where the parser is *)
type p = { toks : (L.token * int) array; mutable i : int }

let peek (p : p) : L.token = fst p.toks.(p.i)
let peek2 (p : p) (k : int) : L.token =
  if p.i + k < Array.length p.toks then fst p.toks.(p.i + k) else L.EOF
let line (p : p) : int = snd p.toks.(p.i)
let advance (p : p) : unit = if p.i < Array.length p.toks - 1 then p.i <- p.i + 1

let show (t : L.token) : string =
  match t with
  | L.ID s -> s | L.KW s -> s | L.OP s -> s
  | L.INT n -> Int32.to_string n | L.LONG n -> Int64.to_string n
  | L.DOUBLE f -> string_of_float f | L.STRING s -> Printf.sprintf "%S" s
  | L.CHAR c -> Printf.sprintf "'%c'" (Char.chr c) | L.EOF -> "the end"

let fail (p : p) (what : string) =
  raise (Error (Printf.sprintf "%s expected, not %s" what (show (peek p)), line p))

let is (p : p) (t : L.token) : bool = peek p = t
let op (p : p) (s : string) : bool = peek p = L.OP s
let kw (p : p) (s : string) : bool = peek p = L.KW s
let expect (p : p) (t : L.token) : unit = if is p t then advance p else fail p (show t)
let expect_op (p : p) (s : string) : unit = expect p (L.OP s)
let accept (p : p) (t : L.token) : bool = if is p t then (advance p; true) else false

let ident (p : p) : string =
  match peek p with
  | L.ID s -> advance p; s
  | L.KW "get" -> advance p; "get"
  | _ -> fail p "a name"

let predefined = [ "int"; "bool"; "string"; "char"; "void"; "object"; "long"; "double" ]

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Types *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let rec ty (p : p) : ty =
  let base =
    match peek p with
    | L.KW k when List.mem k predefined -> advance p; Named ([ k ], [])
    | L.ID _ ->
        let rec names acc =
          let n = ident p in
          if op p "." && (match peek2 p 1 with L.ID _ -> true | _ -> false) then (advance p; names (n :: acc))
          else List.rev (n :: acc) in
        let ns = names [] in
        let args =
          if op p "<" then begin
            advance p;
            let rec go acc =
              let t = ty p in
              if accept p (L.OP ",") then go (t :: acc) else (expect_op p ">"; List.rev (t :: acc)) in
            go []
          end else [] in
        Named (ns, args)
    | _ -> fail p "a type" in
  let rec arrays t =
    if op p "[" && peek2 p 1 = L.OP "]" then (advance p; advance p; arrays (Array t)) else t in
  arrays base

(* is a type there, and what is after it? (a declaration, a cast) *)
let try_type (p : p) : ty option =
  let save = p.i in
  match ty p with
  | t -> Some t
  | exception Error _ -> p.i <- save; None

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Expressions, by C#'s precedences *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let mk (p : p) (e : desc) : expr = { e; pos = line p }

(* the binary operators, from the loosest *)
let levels = [ [ "||" ]; [ "&&" ]; [ "=="; "!=" ]; [ "<"; ">"; "<="; ">=" ]; [ "+"; "-" ]; [ "*"; "/"; "%" ] ]

let rec expr (p : p) : expr =
  let l = cond p in
  match peek p with
  | L.OP ("=" | "+=" | "-=" | "*=" | "/=" | "%=" as o) ->
      advance p;
      let r = expr p in
      { e = Assign (o, l, r); pos = l.pos }
  | _ -> l

and cond (p : p) : expr =
  let c = binary p 0 in
  if op p "?" then begin
    advance p;
    let a = expr p in
    expect_op p ":";
    let b = expr p in
    { e = Cond (c, a, b); pos = c.pos }
  end else c

and binary (p : p) (level : int) : expr =
  if level >= List.length levels then unary p
  else begin
    let ops = List.nth levels level in
    let rec go (l : expr) =
      match peek p with
      | L.OP o when List.mem o ops ->
          advance p;
          let r = binary p (level + 1) in
          go { e = Binary (o, l, r); pos = l.pos }
      | L.KW "is" when level = 3 ->
          advance p;
          let t = ty p in
          go { e = Is (l, t); pos = l.pos }
      | _ -> l in
    go (binary p (level + 1))
  end

and unary (p : p) : expr =
  match peek p with
  | L.OP ("-" | "!" as o) -> advance p; let e = unary p in mk p (Unary (o, e))
  | L.OP ("++" | "--" as o) -> advance p; let e = unary p in mk p (Incr (o = "++", true, e))
  | L.OP "(" when is_cast p ->
      advance p;
      let t = ty p in
      expect_op p ")";
      let e = unary p in
      mk p (Cast (t, e))
  | _ -> postfix p (primary p)

(* ( type ) followed by what starts an operand: a cast (C#'s rule,
 * 7.7.6: a predefined type is always one) *)
and is_cast (p : p) : bool =
  let save = p.i in
  advance p;
  let r = match try_type p with
    | Some (Named ([ k ], [])) when List.mem k predefined && op p ")" -> true
    | Some _ when op p ")" ->
        advance p;
        (match peek p with
         | L.ID _ | L.INT _ | L.LONG _ | L.DOUBLE _ | L.STRING _ | L.CHAR _ -> true
         | L.KW ("this" | "new" | "true" | "false" | "null" | "base") -> true
         | L.OP ("(" | "!") -> true
         | _ -> false)
    | _ -> false in
  p.i <- save;
  r

and args (p : p) : expr list =
  expect_op p "(";
  if accept p (L.OP ")") then []
  else
    let rec go acc =
      let e = if kw p "out" || kw p "ref" then (advance p; let x = expr p in { e = Out x; pos = x.pos })
        else expr p in
      if accept p (L.OP ",") then go (e :: acc) else (expect_op p ")"; List.rev (e :: acc)) in
    go []

and postfix (p : p) (e : expr) : expr =
  match peek p with
  | L.OP "." -> advance p; let n = ident p in postfix p { e = Member (e, n); pos = e.pos }
  | L.OP "(" -> let a = args p in postfix p { e = Call (e, a); pos = e.pos }
  | L.OP "[" ->
      advance p;
      let i = expr p in
      expect_op p "]";
      postfix p { e = Index (e, i); pos = e.pos }
  | L.OP ("++" | "--" as o) -> advance p; postfix p { e = Incr (o = "++", false, e); pos = e.pos }
  | _ -> e

and elements (p : p) : expr list =
  expect_op p "{";
  if accept p (L.OP "}") then []
  else
    let rec go acc =
      let e = expr p in
      if accept p (L.OP ",") then
        (if op p "}" then (advance p; List.rev (e :: acc)) else go (e :: acc))
      else (expect_op p "}"; List.rev (e :: acc)) in
    go []

and primary (p : p) : expr =
  match peek p with
  | L.INT n -> advance p; mk p (Int n)
  | L.LONG n -> advance p; mk p (Long n)
  | L.DOUBLE f -> advance p; mk p (Double f)
  | L.STRING s -> advance p; mk p (Str s)
  | L.CHAR c -> advance p; mk p (Char c)
  | L.KW "true" -> advance p; mk p (Bool true)
  | L.KW "false" -> advance p; mk p (Bool false)
  | L.KW "null" -> advance p; mk p Null
  | L.KW "this" -> advance p; mk p This
  | L.KW "base" -> advance p; mk p Base
  | L.ID n -> advance p; mk p (Name n)
  | L.KW k when List.mem k predefined -> advance p; mk p (Typed_name (Named ([ k ], [])))
  | L.OP "(" -> advance p; let e = expr p in expect_op p ")"; e
  | L.KW "new" ->
      advance p;
      let pos = line p in
      (* new T(args), new T[n], new T[] { ... } *)
      let save = p.i in
      let elem = ty p in
      (match elem with
       | Array t when op p "{" -> { e = Array_init (t, elements p); pos }
       | _ ->
           if op p "[" then begin
             p.i <- save;
             (* (the element's type, then [n]) *)
             let base = match peek p with
               | L.KW k when List.mem k predefined -> advance p; Named ([ k ], [])
               | _ -> (match ty p with Array t -> t | t -> t) in
             expect_op p "[";
             let n = expr p in
             expect_op p "]";
             { e = New_array (base, n); pos }
           end else { e = New (elem, args p); pos })
  | _ -> fail p "an expression"

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Statements *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let rec stmt (p : p) : stmt =
  let spos = line p in
  let mk s = { s; spos } in
  match peek p with
  | L.OP "{" -> mk (Block (block p))
  | L.OP ";" -> advance p; mk Empty
  | L.KW "if" ->
      advance p; expect_op p "(";
      let c = expr p in
      expect_op p ")";
      let t = stmt p in
      let e = if accept p (L.KW "else") then Some (stmt p) else None in
      mk (If (c, t, e))
  | L.KW "while" ->
      advance p; expect_op p "(";
      let c = expr p in
      expect_op p ")";
      mk (While (c, stmt p))
  | L.KW "do" ->
      advance p;
      let b = stmt p in
      expect p (L.KW "while"); expect_op p "(";
      let c = expr p in
      expect_op p ")"; expect_op p ";";
      mk (Do (b, c))
  | L.KW "for" ->
      advance p; expect_op p "(";
      let init = if op p ";" then [] else [ simple p ] in
      expect_op p ";";
      let c = if op p ";" then None else Some (expr p) in
      expect_op p ";";
      let rec steps acc =
        if op p ")" then List.rev acc
        else let e = expr p in
          if accept p (L.OP ",") then steps (e :: acc) else List.rev (e :: acc) in
      let step = steps [] in
      expect_op p ")";
      mk (For (init, c, step, stmt p))
  | L.KW "foreach" ->
      advance p; expect_op p "(";
      let t = ty p in
      let n = ident p in
      expect p (L.KW "in");
      let e = expr p in
      expect_op p ")";
      mk (Foreach (t, n, e, stmt p))
  | L.KW "return" ->
      advance p;
      let e = if op p ";" then None else Some (expr p) in
      expect_op p ";"; mk (Return e)
  | L.KW "break" -> advance p; expect_op p ";"; mk Break
  | L.KW "continue" -> advance p; expect_op p ";"; mk Continue
  | L.KW "throw" ->
      advance p;
      let e = if op p ";" then None else Some (expr p) in
      expect_op p ";"; mk (Throw e)
  | L.KW "try" ->
      advance p;
      let body = mk (Block (block p)) in
      let rec catches acc =
        if accept p (L.KW "catch") then begin
          let t, n =
            if accept p (L.OP "(") then begin
              let t = ty p in
              let n = match peek p with L.ID n -> advance p; Some n | _ -> None in
              expect_op p ")"; (t, n)
            end else (Named ([ "System"; "Exception" ], []), None) in
          let b = { s = Block (block p); spos = line p } in
          catches ((t, n, b) :: acc)
        end else List.rev acc in
      let cs = catches [] in
      let fin = if accept p (L.KW "finally") then Some { s = Block (block p); spos = line p } else None in
      mk (Try (body, cs, fin))
  | _ -> let s = simple p in expect_op p ";"; s

(* a declaration of locals, or an expression *)
and simple (p : p) : stmt =
  let spos = line p in
  let save = p.i in
  let decl =
    match try_type p with
    | Some t -> (match peek p with
        | L.ID _ when (match peek2 p 1 with L.OP ("=" | ";" | ",") -> true | L.KW "in" -> false | _ -> false) -> Some t
        | _ -> None)
    | None -> None in
  match decl with
  | Some t ->
      let rec vars acc =
        let n = ident p in
        let init =
          if accept p (L.OP "=") then
            Some (if op p "{" then { e = Array_init ((match t with Array e -> e | t -> t), elements p); pos = spos }
                  else expr p)
          else None in
        if accept p (L.OP ",") then vars ((n, init) :: acc) else List.rev ((n, init) :: acc) in
      { s = Local (t, vars []); spos }
  | None -> p.i <- save; { s = Expr (expr p); spos }

and block (p : p) : stmt list =
  expect_op p "{";
  let rec go acc = if accept p (L.OP "}") then List.rev acc else go (stmt p :: acc) in
  go []

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Classes *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let modifier (t : L.token) : modifier option =
  match t with
  | L.KW "public" -> Some Public | L.KW "private" -> Some Private
  | L.KW "protected" -> Some Protected | L.KW "internal" -> Some Internal
  | L.KW "static" -> Some Static | L.KW "abstract" -> Some Abstract
  | L.KW "virtual" -> Some Virtual | L.KW "override" -> Some Override
  | L.KW "sealed" -> Some Sealed | L.KW "new" -> Some New
  | L.KW "readonly" -> Some Readonly
  | _ -> None

let modifiers (p : p) : modifier list =
  let rec go acc = match modifier (peek p) with
    | Some m -> advance p; go (m :: acc)
    | None -> List.rev acc in
  go []

let params (p : p) : (ty * string) list =
  expect_op p "(";
  if accept p (L.OP ")") then []
  else
    let rec go acc =
      let byref = kw p "out" || kw p "ref" in
      if byref then advance p;
      let t = ty p in
      let t = if byref then Byref t else t in
      let n = ident p in
      if accept p (L.OP ",") then go ((t, n) :: acc) else (expect_op p ")"; List.rev ((t, n) :: acc)) in
    go []

let member (p : p) (cls : string) : member =
  let pos = line p in
  let mods = modifiers p in
  match peek p, peek2 p 1 with
  | L.ID n, L.OP "(" when n = cls ->
      advance p;
      let ps = params p in
      let init =
        if accept p (L.OP ":") then
          let base = if accept p (L.KW "base") then true else (expect p (L.KW "this"); false) in
          Some (base, args p)
        else None in
      Ctor (mods, n, ps, init, { s = Block (block p); spos = line p }, pos)
  | _ ->
      let t = ty p in
      let n = ident p in
      if op p "(" then begin
        let ps = params p in
        let body = if accept p (L.OP ";") then None else Some { s = Block (block p); spos = line p } in
        Method (mods, t, n, ps, body, pos)
      end else if op p "{" then begin
        (* a property: its getter alone *)
        advance p;
        expect p (L.KW "get");
        let body = if accept p (L.OP ";") then None else Some { s = Block (block p); spos = line p } in
        expect_op p "}";
        Property (mods, t, n, body, pos)
      end else begin
        let rec vars acc name =
          let init = if accept p (L.OP "=") then
              Some (if op p "{" then { e = Array_init ((match t with Array e -> e | t -> t), elements p); pos }
                    else expr p)
            else None in
          if accept p (L.OP ",") then vars ((name, init) :: acc) (ident p)
          else (expect_op p ";"; List.rev ((name, init) :: acc)) in
        Field (mods, t, vars [] n, pos)
      end

let class_decl (p : p) : class_decl =
  let cpos = line p in
  let cmods = modifiers p in
  let interface = if accept p (L.KW "interface") then true else (expect p (L.KW "class"); false) in
  let cname = ident p in
  let bases =
    if accept p (L.OP ":") then
      let rec go acc = let t = ty p in if accept p (L.OP ",") then go (t :: acc) else List.rev (t :: acc) in
      go []
    else [] in
  expect_op p "{";
  let rec members acc = if accept p (L.OP "}") then List.rev acc else members (member p cname :: acc) in
  { cname; interface; cmods; bases; members = members []; cpos }

let program (text : string) : program =
  L.line := 1;
  let lexbuf = Lexing.from_string text in
  let rec toks acc =
    let t = L.token lexbuf in
    let acc = (t, !L.line) :: acc in
    if t = L.EOF then Array.of_list (List.rev acc) else toks acc in
  let p = { toks = toks []; i = 0 } in
  let rec usings acc =
    if accept p (L.KW "using") then begin
      let rec names acc = let n = ident p in if accept p (L.OP ".") then names (n :: acc) else List.rev (n :: acc) in
      let ns = names [] in
      expect_op p ";";
      usings (ns :: acc)
    end else List.rev acc in
  let us = usings [] in
  let rec classes acc = if is p L.EOF then List.rev acc else classes (class_decl p :: acc) in
  { usings = us; classes = classes [] }

(* The reduced C#'s text to its tree (Csc_ast), by recursive descent
 * over the tokens (Csc_lexer), each with its line.
 *
 * By hand, where mini-tiger's grammar is ocamlyacc's: C# is not
 * LALR(1). (T)x is a cast or a parenthesized expression by what follows
 * the parenthesis (C#'s 7.7.6: a cast if T is a predefined type, or if
 * an operand starts after it); `a < b` is a comparison but List<int> a
 * type; a statement that starts with a name is a declaration if a type
 * and a name follow, else an expression. Each needs to look past a
 * whole type, which the parser does by trying one and going back.
 * Roslyn's parser is written by hand too, for the same reasons.
 *
 *     List<int> primes = new List<int>();    try_type: List<int>, then a
 *                                            name and = : a declaration
 *     (Exceptions)o                          a type, ), a name: a cast
 *     (n % p == 0)                           an expression *)

exception Error of string * int

val program : string -> Csc_ast.program

(* See Csc_types.mli *)

module A = Csc_ast

exception Error of string * int

let error (pos : int) (msg : string) = raise (Error (msg, pos))

type ty =
  | Void | Bool | Char | Int | Long | Double | String | Object | Null
  | Class of cls * ty list
  | Array of ty
  | Var of int                       (* a library class's type parameter *)
  | MVar of int                      (* a library method's *)
  | Ref of ty                        (* out, ref: an address *)

and cls = {
  name : string;
  short : string;
  kind : kind;
  user : A.class_decl option;
  spec : Library.spec option;
  mutable parent : ty option;
  mutable ifaces : ty list;
  mutable fields : field list;
  mutable methods : meth list;
  mutable token : int;               (* the writer's: a TypeDef, a TypeRef *)
}

and kind = K_class | K_interface | K_struct

and field = {
  fname : string;
  ftype : ty;
  fstatic : bool;
  fowner : cls;
  finit : A.expr option;
  mutable ftoken : int;
}

and meth = {
  mname : string;
  mowner : cls;
  mstatic : bool;
  mvirtual : bool;                   (* virtual, abstract, override, or an interface's *)
  mabstract : bool;
  moverride : bool;
  mparams : ty list;                 (* as declared: Var for a library class's T *)
  pnames : string list;
  mret : ty;
  mgeneric : int;
  body : A.stmt option;
  init : (bool * A.expr list) option;    (* a constructor's base(...) or this(...) *)
  mutable mtoken : int;
  mutable implements : bool;         (* a class's method an interface asks: virtual final *)
}

(* the classes by name: the program's, the library's when first named *)
let classes : (string, cls) Hashtbl.t = Hashtbl.create 64
let usings : string list ref = ref [ "System" ]

let rec show (t : ty) : string =
  match t with
  | Void -> "void" | Bool -> "bool" | Char -> "char" | Int -> "int" | Long -> "long"
  | Double -> "double" | String -> "string" | Object -> "object" | Null -> "null"
  | Class (c, []) -> c.short
  | Class (c, args) ->
      (match String.index_opt c.short '`' with Some i -> String.sub c.short 0 i | None -> c.short)
      ^ "<" ^ String.concat ", " (List.map show args) ^ ">"
  | Array t -> show t ^ "[]"
  | Var n -> "!" ^ string_of_int n
  | MVar n -> "!!" ^ string_of_int n
  | Ref t -> "ref " ^ show t

let is_value (t : ty) : bool =
  match t with
  | Bool | Char | Int | Long | Double -> true
  | Class (c, _) -> c.kind = K_struct
  | _ -> false

(* the library's keys of the primitives *)
let primitives = [
  "System.Boolean", Bool; "System.Char", Char; "System.Int32", Int; "System.Int64", Long;
  "System.Double", Double; "System.String", String; "System.Object", Object; "System.Void", Void;
]

let short_of (name : string) : string =
  let cut c s = match String.rindex_opt s c with
    | Some i -> String.sub s (i + 1) (String.length s - i - 1) | None -> s in
  cut '+' (cut '.' name)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The library's classes, from Library's descriptions *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let rec lib_class (name : string) : cls option =
  match Hashtbl.find_opt classes name with
  | Some c -> Some c
  | None ->
      match Hashtbl.find_opt Library.specs name with
      | None -> None
      | Some sp ->
          let kind = match sp.skind with
            | Value.Interface -> K_interface | Value.Struct | Value.Enum -> K_struct
            | _ -> K_class in
          let c = { name; short = short_of name; kind; user = None; spec = Some sp;
                    parent = None; ifaces = []; fields = []; methods = []; token = 0 } in
          Hashtbl.replace classes name c;
          if sp.sparent <> "" then c.parent <- Some (parse sp.sparent);
          c.ifaces <- List.map parse sp.sinterfaces;
          c.methods <- List.map (fun (sm : Library.smeth) ->
              { mname = sm.mn; mowner = c; mstatic = sm.mstatic;
                mvirtual = sm.mvirt; mabstract = sm.impl = Library.Abstract; moverride = false;
                mparams = List.map parse sm.mparams; pnames = []; mret = parse sm.mret;
                mgeneric = sm.mgeneric; body = None; init = None; mtoken = 0; implements = false })
              sp.smethods;
          Some c

(* a key of the library's ("System.Int32", "!0", "List`1+Enumerator<!0>") *)
and parse (s : string) : ty =
  let n = String.length s in
  let pos = ref 0 in
  let rec typ () =
    let base =
      if s.[!pos] = '!' then begin
        let mvar = !pos + 1 < n && s.[!pos + 1] = '!' in
        pos := !pos + (if mvar then 2 else 1);
        let start = !pos in
        while !pos < n && s.[!pos] >= '0' && s.[!pos] <= '9' do incr pos done;
        let k = int_of_string (String.sub s start (!pos - start)) in
        if mvar then MVar k else Var k
      end else begin
        let start = !pos in
        while !pos < n && not (List.mem s.[!pos] [ '<'; '>'; ','; '['; '&'; '*' ]) do incr pos done;
        let name = String.sub s start (!pos - start) in
        let args =
          if !pos < n && s.[!pos] = '<' then begin
            incr pos;
            let rec go acc =
              let t = typ () in
              if s.[!pos] = ',' then (incr pos; go (t :: acc)) else (incr pos; List.rev (t :: acc)) in
            go []
          end else [] in
        match List.assoc_opt name primitives with
        | Some t -> t
        | None -> match lib_class name with
          | Some c -> Class (c, args)
          | None -> Object      (* (a type the library names but has not: IntPtr...) *)
      end in
    let rec suffix t =
      if !pos + 1 < n && s.[!pos] = '[' && s.[!pos + 1] = ']' then (pos := !pos + 2; suffix (Array t))
      else if !pos < n && s.[!pos] = '&' then (incr pos; suffix (Ref t))
      else if !pos < n && s.[!pos] = '*' then (incr pos; suffix t)
      else t in
    suffix base in
  typ ()

let rec subst (args : ty list) (margs : ty list) (t : ty) : ty =
  match t with
  | Var k when k < List.length args -> List.nth args k
  | MVar k when k < List.length margs -> List.nth margs k
  | Array e -> Array (subst args margs e)
  | Ref e -> Ref (subst args margs e)
  | Class (c, l) -> Class (c, List.map (subst args margs) l)
  | t -> t

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Names to types *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let find_class (pos : int) (names : string list) (nargs : int) : cls =
  let n = String.concat "." names in
  let n = if nargs > 0 then n ^ "`" ^ string_of_int nargs else n in
  let candidates = n :: List.map (fun u -> u ^ "." ^ n) !usings in
  let rec go l = match l with
    | [] -> error pos ("no type " ^ n)
    | x :: rest ->
        match Hashtbl.find_opt classes x with
        | Some c -> c
        | None -> match lib_class x with Some c -> c | None -> go rest in
  go candidates

let rec resolve (pos : int) (t : A.ty) : ty =
  match t with
  | A.Array e -> Array (resolve pos e)
  | A.Byref e -> Ref (resolve pos e)
  | A.Named ([ "int" ], []) -> Int
  | A.Named ([ "bool" ], []) -> Bool
  | A.Named ([ "char" ], []) -> Char
  | A.Named ([ "long" ], []) -> Long
  | A.Named ([ "double" ], []) -> Double
  | A.Named ([ "string" ], []) -> String
  | A.Named ([ "object" ], []) -> Object
  | A.Named ([ "void" ], []) -> Void
  | A.Named (names, args) ->
      let c = find_class pos names (List.length args) in
      (match List.assoc_opt c.name primitives with
       | Some t -> t
       | None -> Class (c, List.map (resolve pos) args))

(* the class of a type, for its members: int's System.Int32 *)
let class_of (t : ty) : (cls * ty list) option =
  match t with
  | Class (c, args) -> Some (c, args)
  | Int -> Option.map (fun c -> (c, [])) (lib_class "System.Int32")
  | Bool -> Option.map (fun c -> (c, [])) (lib_class "System.Boolean")
  | Char -> Option.map (fun c -> (c, [])) (lib_class "System.Char")
  | Long -> Option.map (fun c -> (c, [])) (lib_class "System.Int64")
  | Double -> Option.map (fun c -> (c, [])) (lib_class "System.Double")
  | String -> Option.map (fun c -> (c, [])) (lib_class "System.String")
  | Object | Null -> Option.map (fun c -> (c, [])) (lib_class "System.Object")
  | Array _ -> Option.map (fun c -> (c, [])) (lib_class "System.Array")
  | _ -> None

let parent_of (c : cls) : (cls * ty list) option =
  match c.parent with Some t -> class_of t | None -> None

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Conversions and overloads *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let rec same (a : ty) (b : ty) : bool =
  match a, b with
  | Class (c, x), Class (d, y) -> c == d && List.length x = List.length y && List.for_all2 same x y
  | Array x, Array y | Ref x, Ref y -> same x y
  | _ -> a = b

let rec derives (c : cls) (d : cls) : bool =
  c == d
  || List.exists (fun i -> match i with Class (k, _) -> derives k d | _ -> false) c.ifaces
  || (match parent_of c with Some (p, _) -> derives p d | None -> false)

(* an implicit conversion (C#'s 6.1), and what it costs: None if there
 * is none, 0 if the types are the same *)
let convertible (from : ty) (to_ : ty) : int option =
  if same from to_ then Some 0
  else match from, to_ with
    | Null, (String | Object | Class _ | Array _) when not (is_value to_) -> Some 1
    | (Int | Char), Long | (Int | Char | Long), Double | Char, Int -> Some 1
    | _, Object -> Some 2
    | Class (c, _), Class (d, _) when derives c d -> Some 1
    | String, Class (d, _) -> (match lib_class "System.String" with Some c when derives c d -> Some 1 | _ -> None)
    | Array _, Class (d, _) when d.name = "System.Array" -> Some 1
    | _ -> None

(* the best of the methods for these arguments: the one whose
 * conversions cost least, the first of those that cost the same *)
let best (pos : int) (what : string) (cands : (meth * ty list) list) (args : ty list) : meth * ty list =
  let scored = List.filter_map (fun (m, ps) ->
      if List.length ps <> List.length args then None
      else
        let costs = List.map2 convertible args ps in
        if List.for_all (fun c -> c <> None) costs then
          Some ((m, ps), List.fold_left (fun a c -> a + Option.get c) 0 costs)
        else None) cands in
  match List.sort (fun (_, a) (_, b) -> compare a b) scored with
  | (x, _) :: _ -> x
  | [] ->
      error pos (Printf.sprintf "no %s for (%s)%s" what (String.concat ", " (List.map show args))
                   (if cands = [] then "" else Printf.sprintf ": %d of that name" (List.length cands)))

(* the methods of a name in a class and its parents, their parameters
 * instantiated; a method overridden is found once, the most derived *)
let methods (t : ty) (name : string) : (meth * ty list) list =
  let rec go (c : cls) (args : ty list) (acc : (meth * ty list) list) =
    let own = List.filter (fun m -> m.mname = name) c.methods in
    let own = List.map (fun m -> (m, List.map (subst args []) m.mparams)) own in
    let fresh = List.filter (fun (m, ps) ->
        not (List.exists (fun ((n : meth), qs) -> n.mstatic = m.mstatic
                                                 && List.length ps = List.length qs
                                                 && List.for_all2 same ps qs) acc)) own in
    let acc = acc @ fresh in
    let acc = List.fold_left (fun acc i -> match i with
        | Class (k, a) when c.kind = K_interface -> go k a acc | _ -> acc) acc c.ifaces in
    match parent_of c with
    | Some (p, a) when name <> ".ctor" -> go p a acc
    | _ -> acc in
  match class_of t with
  | Some (c, args) -> go c args []
  | None -> []

let field (t : ty) (name : string) : field option =
  let rec go (c : cls) =
    match List.find_opt (fun f -> f.fname = name) c.fields with
    | Some f -> Some f
    | None -> match parent_of c with Some (p, _) -> go p | None -> None in
  match class_of t with Some (c, _) -> go c | None -> None
