(* The reduced C#'s types and names: the program's classes and the
 * library's, a member looked for in a class and its parents, and the
 * overloads (C#'s 7.5.3, reduced: the candidate whose arguments
 * convert at the least cost, the first of equals).
 *
 * The library is not read from Microsoft's reference assemblies, as
 * csc does: it is mini-dotnet's own description of System (Library),
 * the same data the runtime runs, so a member mini-csc accepts is one
 * mini-dotnet has. Microsoft's dotnet has them all too, by name and
 * signature (a MemberRef), which is how one assembly runs on both.
 *
 *     Console.WriteLine(n + 1)          n an int
 *       methods System.Console "WriteLine": 9 candidates
 *       (int) costs 0, (long) 1, (double) 1, (object) 2: (int)
 *
 *     C#'s conversions (6.1): the same type 0; int to long or double, a
 *     class to its parent or an interface, null to a reference 1; a
 *     value to object (a box) 2. *)

exception Error of string * int
val error : int -> string -> 'a

  | Void | Bool | Char | Int | Long | Double | String | Object | Null
  | Class of cls * ty list
  | Array of ty
  | Var of int                       (* a library class's type parameter *)
  | MVar of int                      (* a library method's *)
  | Ref of ty                        (* out, ref: an address *)

}

and field = {
  fname : string;
  ftype : ty;

}

(* See Arith.mli *)

open Value

let i4 (n : int) : value = I4 (Int32.of_int n)
let bool_v (b : bool) : value = if b then I4 Int32.one else I4 Int32.zero

let truthy (v : value) : bool =
  match v with
  | I4 n -> Int32.compare n Int32.zero <> 0
  | I8 n -> Int64.compare n Int64.zero <> 0
  | R8 f -> f <> 0.0
  | Null -> false
  | _ -> true

let int_of (v : value) : int =
  match v with
  | I4 n -> Int32.to_int n
  | I8 n -> Int64.to_int n
  | _ -> Frame.error "an integer expected"

(* unsigned, as an int64 *)
let u32 (n : int32) : int64 = Int64.logand (Int64.of_int32 n) 0xFFFFFFFFL

let ucompare64 (a : int64) (b : int64) : int =
  Int64.compare (Int64.add a Int64.min_int) (Int64.add b Int64.min_int)

(* a comparison of two values; None when unordered (a NaN) *)
let compare_values (un : bool) (a : value) (b : value) : int option =
  match a, b with
  | I4 x, I4 y -> Some (if un then Int64.compare (u32 x) (u32 y) else Int32.compare x y)
  | I8 x, I8 y -> Some (if un then ucompare64 x y else Int64.compare x y)
  | I4 x, I8 y -> Some (Int64.compare (Int64.of_int32 x) y)
  | I8 x, I4 y -> Some (Int64.compare x (Int64.of_int32 y))
  | R8 x, R8 y -> if Float.is_nan x || Float.is_nan y then None else Some (compare x y)
  | Null, Null -> Some 0
  | Null, _ -> Some (-1)
  | _, Null -> Some 1
  | Obj x, Obj y -> Some (if x == y then 0 else 1)
  | Str x, Str y -> Some (if x == y then 0 else 1)
  | Fn x, Fn y -> Some (if x == y then 0 else 1)
  | _ -> Some 1

let test (c : Il.cmp) (un : bool) (a : value) (b : value) : bool =
  match compare_values un a b with
  | None -> un && c <> Il.Eq || c = Il.Ne
  | Some k ->
      match c with
      | Il.Eq -> k = 0 | Il.Ne -> k <> 0 | Il.Ge -> k >= 0
      | Il.Gt -> k > 0 | Il.Le -> k <= 0 | Il.Lt -> k < 0

let divide_by_zero () = Frame.throw_new "System.DivideByZeroException" "Attempted to divide by zero."

let binop (op : Il.binop) (a : value) (b : value) : value =
  match a, b with
  | I4 x, I4 y -> (
      match op with
      | Add -> I4 (Int32.add x y) | Sub -> I4 (Int32.sub x y) | Mul -> I4 (Int32.mul x y)
      | Div ->
          if Int32.compare y Int32.zero = 0 then divide_by_zero ()
          else if Int32.compare x Int32.min_int = 0 && Int32.compare y Int32.minus_one = 0 then Frame.overflow ()
          else I4 (Int32.div x y)
      | Rem ->
          if Int32.compare y Int32.zero = 0 then divide_by_zero ()
          else if Int32.compare y Int32.minus_one = 0 then I4 Int32.zero
          else I4 (Int32.rem x y)
      | Div_un ->
          if Int32.compare y Int32.zero = 0 then divide_by_zero ()
          else I4 (Int64.to_int32 (Int64.div (u32 x) (u32 y)))
      | Rem_un ->
          if Int32.compare y Int32.zero = 0 then divide_by_zero ()
          else I4 (Int64.to_int32 (Int64.rem (u32 x) (u32 y)))
      | And -> I4 (Int32.logand x y) | Or -> I4 (Int32.logor x y) | Xor -> I4 (Int32.logxor x y)
      | Shl -> I4 (Int32.shift_left x (Int32.to_int y land 31))
      | Shr -> I4 (Int32.shift_right x (Int32.to_int y land 31))
      | Shr_un -> I4 (Int32.shift_right_logical x (Int32.to_int y land 31))
      | Add_ovf | Sub_ovf | Mul_ovf ->
          let r = (match op with Add_ovf -> Int64.add | Sub_ovf -> Int64.sub | _ -> Int64.mul)
                    (Int64.of_int32 x) (Int64.of_int32 y) in
          if Int64.compare r (Int64.of_int32 Int32.max_int) > 0 || Int64.compare r (Int64.of_int32 Int32.min_int) < 0
          then Frame.overflow () else I4 (Int64.to_int32 r)
      | Add_ovf_un | Sub_ovf_un | Mul_ovf_un ->
          let r = (match op with Add_ovf_un -> Int64.add | Sub_ovf_un -> Int64.sub | _ -> Int64.mul)
                    (u32 x) (u32 y) in
          if Int64.compare r 0xFFFFFFFFL > 0 || Int64.compare r 0L < 0 then Frame.overflow ()
          else I4 (Int64.to_int32 r))
  | (I8 _ | I4 _), (I8 _ | I4 _) -> (
      let w v = match v with I8 n -> n | I4 n -> Int64.of_int32 n | _ -> assert false in
      let x = w a and y = w b in
      match op with
      | Shl -> I8 (Int64.shift_left x (int_of b land 63))
      | Shr -> I8 (Int64.shift_right x (int_of b land 63))
      | Shr_un -> I8 (Int64.shift_right_logical x (int_of b land 63))
      | Add | Add_ovf | Add_ovf_un -> I8 (Int64.add x y)
      | Sub | Sub_ovf | Sub_ovf_un -> I8 (Int64.sub x y)
      | Mul | Mul_ovf | Mul_ovf_un -> I8 (Int64.mul x y)
      | Div -> if Int64.compare y 0L = 0 then divide_by_zero () else I8 (Int64.div x y)
      | Rem -> if Int64.compare y 0L = 0 then divide_by_zero () else I8 (Int64.rem x y)
      | Div_un -> if Int64.compare y 0L = 0 then divide_by_zero () else I8 (Int64.unsigned_div x y)
      | Rem_un -> if Int64.compare y 0L = 0 then divide_by_zero () else I8 (Int64.unsigned_rem x y)
      | And -> I8 (Int64.logand x y) | Or -> I8 (Int64.logor x y) | Xor -> I8 (Int64.logxor x y))
  | R8 x, R8 y -> (
      match op with
      | Add -> R8 (x +. y) | Sub -> R8 (x -. y) | Mul -> R8 (x *. y)
      | Div -> R8 (x /. y) | Rem -> R8 (Float.rem x y)
      | _ -> Frame.error "a float in an integer's operation")
  | _ -> Frame.error "an arithmetic on what is not a number"

let conv (k : Il.kind) (ovf : bool) (un : bool) (v : value) : value =
  (* the value as an int64, and a float if it is one *)
  let wide = match v with
    | I4 n -> if un then u32 n else Int64.of_int32 n
    | I8 n -> n
    | R8 f -> Int64.of_float f
    | Ptr _ | Obj _ | Str _ | Null | Fn _ -> 0L
    | _ -> Frame.error "a conversion of what is not a number" in
  let check lo hi =
    if ovf && (Int64.compare wide lo < 0 || Int64.compare wide hi > 0
               || (match v with R8 f -> Float.is_nan f | _ -> false)) then Frame.overflow () in
  let small bits signed =
    let m = Int64.of_int ((1 lsl bits) - 1) in
    let x = Int64.logand wide m in
    let x = if signed && Int64.compare x (Int64.of_int (1 lsl (bits - 1))) >= 0 then Int64.sub x (Int64.add m 1L) else x in
    I4 (Int64.to_int32 x) in
  match k with
  | K_i1 -> check (-128L) 127L; small 8 true
  | K_u1 -> check 0L 255L; small 8 false
  | K_i2 -> check (-32768L) 32767L; small 16 true
  | K_u2 -> check 0L 65535L; small 16 false
  | K_i4 | K_i -> check (-2147483648L) 2147483647L;
      (match v with Ptr _ | Obj _ | Str _ | Fn _ -> v | _ -> I4 (Int64.to_int32 wide))
  | K_u4 | K_u -> check 0L 4294967295L;
      (match v with Ptr _ | Obj _ | Str _ | Fn _ -> v | _ -> I4 (Int64.to_int32 wide))
  | K_i8 -> (match v with I4 n when not un -> I8 (Int64.of_int32 n) | _ -> I8 wide)
  | K_u8 -> (match v with I4 n -> I8 (u32 n) | _ -> I8 wide)
  | K_r4 -> let f = (match v with R8 f -> f | I4 n when un -> Int64.to_float (u32 n) | _ -> Int64.to_float wide) in
      R8 (Int32.float_of_bits (Int32.bits_of_float f))
  | K_r8 -> R8 (match v with R8 f -> f | _ -> Int64.to_float wide)
  | K_ref -> v

(* What the instructions do to numbers (ECMA-335, Partition III,
 * 1.5, its tables of operands): `add` and its family, the comparisons,
 * the conversions, on the machine's tagged values.
 *
 *     add          int32   int64   float     (binop)
 *       int32      int32     -       -       the two must agree: the
 *       int64        -     int64     -       IL is typed by its stack,
 *       float        -       -     float     and the verifier checks it
 *
 * An int32 is an Int32.t everywhere (plan_dotnet.md, decision 6): on
 * arm an OCaml int has 31 bits, and Fib's 47th number must wrap as
 * .NET's does. The unsigned operations (div.un, clt.un) go through
 * int64; `.un` on floats means unordered: true if one is a NaN.
 * A division by zero throws DivideByZeroException, int32's smallest
 * divided by -1 OverflowException, as the x86 and arm machines .NET
 * runs on would trap or not (arm does not: .NET checks). *)

open Value

val i4 : int -> value
val bool_v : bool -> value
(* brtrue's: a number not zero, a reference not null *)
val truthy : value -> bool
val int_of : value -> int
(* an int32 seen unsigned *)
val u32 : int32 -> int64

(* a comparison: None if unordered (a NaN); references by identity *)
val compare_values : bool -> value -> value -> int option
(* a conditional branch's test, .un or not *)
val test : Il.cmp -> bool -> value -> value -> bool

val binop : Il.binop -> value -> value -> value
(* conv.*: to the kind, .ovf checked, .un its source unsigned *)
val conv : Il.kind -> bool -> bool -> value -> value

(* See Frame.mli *)

open Value

exception Error of string
exception Unhandled of string * string
exception Stack_overflow

let trace : (string -> unit) option ref = ref None
let steps = ref 0

(* -profile: each method's own instructions (its calls' not), by name;
 * the instructions of the calls of the frame running *)
let profile : (string, int ref) Hashtbl.t option ref = ref None
let in_calls = ref 0

let error (s : string) = raise (Error s)

type frame = {
  meth : meth;
  code : code;
  args : value array;
  locals : value array;
  stack : value array;
  mutable sp : int;
  mutable pc : int;              (* the next instruction *)
  mutable at : int;              (* the one running *)
  mutable caught : store option; (* the exception of the catch running: rethrow's *)
}

(* the frames running, the innermost first *)
let frames : frame list ref = ref []

(* the frames running, and their most *)
let depth = ref 0
let max_depth = 30_000

(* .NET does not let a program catch it: it stops the process *)

(* how a run of a method's instructions ends *)
(* Tail: a call after the prefix tail., its method and arguments, made
 * in the caller's place (Machine.run_method's loop) *)
type outcome = Returned of value | End_finally | Filtered of bool | Tail of meth * value array

let name_of (m : meth) : string = m.mcls.name ^ "::" ^ m.mname

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Exceptions *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* pass 1's choice: the frame and the clause that will catch, a filter
 * having said yes *)
let chosen : (frame * int) option ref = ref None

(* a filter run: in its frame, as that frame stands, the exception its
 * argument; true if it takes it (an exception in it: false) *)
let filter_hook : (frame -> clause -> store -> bool) ref = ref (fun _ _ _ -> false)

(* pass 1: which frame's clause will catch it? Nothing is unwound; a
 * filter's code is run to say *)
let handled (exn : store) : bool =
  chosen := None;
  let rec frames_from l = match l with
    | [] -> false
    | f :: rest ->
        let rec clauses i =
          if i >= Array.length f.code.clauses then frames_from rest
          else
            let c = f.code.clauses.(i) in
            if f.at >= c.tstart && f.at < c.tend
               && (match c.ckind, c.catch with
                   | 0, Some k -> subclass exn.cls k
                   | 1, _ -> !filter_hook f c exn
                   | _ -> false)
            then (chosen := Some (f, i); true)
            else clauses (i + 1) in
        clauses 0 in
  frames_from !frames

let message (st : store) : string =
  let rec find (c : cls) = match List.find_opt (fun (f : field) -> f.fname = "_message") c.fields with
    | Some f -> (match st.r.(f.roff) with Str s -> s | _ -> "")
    | None -> (match c.parent with Some p -> find p | None -> "") in
  find st.cls

let throw (exn : store) : 'a =
  if handled exn then raise (Thrown exn)
  else raise (Unhandled (exn.cls.name, message exn))

(* an exception of the library's, made by the machine *)
let throw_new (name : string) (msg : string) : 'a =
  let c = Types.find_class name [||] in
  let st = make_store c 0 in
  let rec set (c : cls) = match List.find_opt (fun (f : field) -> f.fname = "_message") c.fields with
    | Some f -> st.r.(f.roff) <- Str msg
    | None -> (match c.parent with Some p -> set p | None -> ()) in
  set c;
  throw st

let null_ref () = throw_new "System.NullReferenceException" "Object reference not set to an instance of an object."
let out_of_range () = throw_new "System.IndexOutOfRangeException" "Index was outside the bounds of the array."
let overflow () = throw_new "System.OverflowException" "Arithmetic operation resulted in an overflow."
let invalid_cast (from : cls) (to_ : cls) =
  throw_new "System.InvalidCastException"
    ("Unable to cast object of type '" ^ from.name ^ "' to type '" ^ to_.name ^ "'.")
languages/dotnet/interpreter/Frame.mli
3324
(* A call's frame, the frames running, and an exception's first pass:
 * what the machine (Machine) and its arithmetic (Arith) share.
 *
 *     frames (the innermost first)
 *       Exceptions::Check   at IL_0009 (a div): DivideByZeroException
 *       Exceptions::Try     at IL_0002 (the call), in a try whose
 *                           catch takes DivideByZeroException
 *       Exceptions::Main    ...
 *
 * {b The first pass} (ECMA-335, Partition I, 12.4.2.5): a frame after
 * the other, its clauses whose try holds the instruction running are
 * asked, a catch by its class, a filter by running its code there and
 * then; nothing is unwound. If none takes it, the program stops
 * ("Unhandled exception"), its finally blocks not run, as .NET does,
 * so that a debugger sees the program where the exception was thrown.
 * Else the exception is raised (Value.Thrown) and the frames are left
 * one by one, their finally blocks run (Machine.run: the second
 * pass), to the clause chosen.
 *
 * others:
 * C++'s exceptions on Itanium's ABI and Windows's SEH have the same two
 * phases, "search" and "cleanup"; OCaml's have one, its handlers a
 * chain on the stack, a raise a jump to the nearest. *)

open Value

(* a mistake of the program's or a feature mini-dotnet has not, with
 * where: not a .NET exception *)
exception Error of string
val error : string -> 'a

(* an exception no frame catches: its class's name and its message *)
exception Unhandled of string * string

(* a recursion too deep (10,000 frames): as .NET, the program stops,
 * no catch can take it *)
exception Stack_overflow

(* each instruction said as it runs (-trace), and the count of them (-s) *)
val trace : (string -> unit) option ref
val steps : int ref
(* -profile's: each method's own instructions, by its name, when set;
 * those of the running frame's calls *)
val profile : (string, int ref) Hashtbl.t option ref
val in_calls : int ref

type frame = {
  meth : meth;
  code : code;
  args : value array;
  locals : value array;
  stack : value array;
  mutable sp : int;
  mutable pc : int;              (* the next instruction *)
  mutable at : int;              (* the one running *)
  mutable caught : store option; (* the exception of the catch running: rethrow's *)
}

(* the frames running, the innermost first, and how many *)
val frames : frame list ref
val depth : int ref
val max_depth : int

(* how a run of a method's instructions ends: its return, a finally's
 * end, a filter's answer *)
(* Tail: a call after the prefix tail., its method and arguments, made
 * in the caller's place (Machine.run_method's loop) *)
type outcome = Returned of value | End_finally | Filtered of bool | Tail of meth * value array

(* Class::Method *)
val name_of : meth -> string

(* the first pass's choice (the frame and its clause), for the second;
 * a filter's code run (Machine's) *)
val chosen : (frame * int) option ref
val filter_hook : (frame -> clause -> store -> bool) ref
val handled : store -> bool

(* an exception thrown: Thrown if a catch will take it, else Unhandled *)
val throw : store -> 'a
(* one of the library's, made by the machine, with its message *)
val throw_new : string -> string -> 'a
val null_ref : unit -> 'a
val out_of_range : unit -> 'a
val overflow : unit -> 'a
val invalid_cast : cls -> cls -> 'a
languages/dotnet/interpreter/Machine.ml
31019
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Machine.mli *)

open Value

let jit : (meth -> (value array -> value) option) option ref = ref None

(* Tiers (.NET's tiered compilation, Core 3.0): a method interpreted
 * first (tier 0), compiled (tier 1) at its call after [tier] calls, so
 * that the code run once, a Main, an initialization, is not compiled;
 * but a method with a loop at its first call, its loop maybe the
 * program's time (.NET's QuickJitForLoops off, before its on-stack
 * replacement). The JIT asked once: refused, the method stays the
 * interpreter's. *)
let tier = ref 30

let hot (m : meth) (code : code) : bool =
  m.calls <- m.calls + 1;
  let loops () = Array.exists (fun (x : Il.instr) -> match x.op with
      | Il.Br t | Il.Brfalse t | Il.Brtrue t | Il.Bcmp (_, _, t) | Il.Leave t -> t <= Il.index code.instrs x.at
      | Il.Switch ts -> Array.exists (fun t -> t <= Il.index code.instrs x.at) ts
      | _ -> false) code.instrs in
  m.calls = !tier + 1 || (m.calls = 1 && loops ())

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Places: fields, elements, pointers *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* a struct's copy out of a store *)
let extract (st : store) (so : int) (ro : int) (c : cls) : value =
  let s = Bytes.sub st.s so c.nbytes and r = Array.sub st.r ro c.nrefs in
  Vt { cls = c; s; r; len = 0; native = No_native }

let blit (v : value) (st : store) (so : int) (ro : int) : unit =
  match v with
  | Vt src | Obj src ->
      Bytes.blit src.s 0 st.s so (Bytes.length src.s);
      Array.blit src.r 0 st.r ro (Array.length src.r)
  | _ -> Frame.error "a struct expected"

(* a value of type [t] at (so, ro) in a store *)
let read (st : store) (so : int) (ro : int) (t : typ) : value =
  match t with
  | T_value c -> extract st so ro c
  | t when is_ref t -> st.r.(ro)
  | t -> load st.s so t

let write (st : store) (so : int) (ro : int) (t : typ) (v : value) : unit =
  match t with
  | T_value _ -> blit v st so ro
  | t when is_ref t -> st.r.(ro) <- v
  | t -> store_at st.s so t v

(* the store an object reference, a struct or a pointer to one is in *)
let view (v : value) : store * int * int =
  match v with
  | Obj st | Vt st -> (st, 0, 0)
  | Ptr (Slot (a, i)) -> (match a.(i) with
      | Vt st | Obj st -> (st, 0, 0)
      | Null -> Frame.null_ref ()
      | _ -> Frame.error "a pointer to a number used as an object")
  | Ptr (Inside (st, so, ro, _)) -> (st, so, ro)
  | Null -> Frame.null_ref ()
  | _ -> Frame.error "not an object"

let copy_value (v : value) : value = match v with Vt st -> Vt (copy st) | v -> v

let deref (p : value) : value =
  match p with
  | Ptr (Slot (a, i)) -> copy_value a.(i)
  | Ptr (Bytes (st, off, t)) -> load st.s off t
  | Ptr (Inside (st, so, ro, c)) -> extract st so ro c
  | Null -> Frame.null_ref ()
  | _ -> Frame.error "not a pointer"

let assign (p : value) (v : value) : unit =
  match p with
  | Ptr (Slot (a, i)) -> a.(i) <- v
  | Ptr (Bytes (st, off, t)) -> store_at st.s off t v
  | Ptr (Inside (st, so, ro, _)) -> blit v st so ro
  | Null -> Frame.null_ref ()
  | _ -> Frame.error "not a pointer"

let element_type (st : store) : typ =
  match st.cls.element with Some e -> e | None -> Frame.error "not an array"

let element (v : value) (i : value) : store * int * int * typ =
  let st = match v with Obj st -> st | Null -> Frame.null_ref () | _ -> Frame.error "not an array" in
  let i = match i with I4 n -> Int32.to_int n | I8 n -> Int64.to_int n | _ -> Frame.error "an index" in
  if i < 0 || i >= st.len then Frame.out_of_range ();
  let e = element_type st in
  let b, r = footprint e in
  (st, i * b, i * r, e)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Classes at run time *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let string_class () = Types.find_class "System.String" [||]

let class_of_value (v : value) : cls =
  match v with
  | Obj st | Vt st -> st.cls
  | Str _ -> string_class ()
  | I4 _ -> Types.find_class "System.Int32" [||]
  | I8 _ -> Types.find_class "System.Int64" [||]
  | R8 _ -> Types.find_class "System.Double" [||]
  | Null -> Frame.null_ref ()
  | _ -> Frame.error "the class of a pointer"

(* can a value of class [c] be seen as of type [t]? *)
let rec instance_of (c : cls) (t : cls) : bool =
  subclass c t
  || (match c.element, t.element with
      | Some e, Some f -> (match e, f with
          | (T_class a | T_value a), (T_class b | T_value b) -> instance_of a b
          | _ -> typ_key e = typ_key f)
      | Some _, None -> t.name = "System.Object" || t.name = "System.Array"
      | _ -> false)

(* a value type's box, a reference type's value as it is *)
let box (t : typ) (v : value) : value =
  match t, v with
  | T_value _, Vt st -> Obj (copy st)
  | t, (I4 _ | I8 _ | R8 _) when Types.is_value_type t ->
      let c = Types.class_of_typ t in
      let st = make_store c 0 in
      store_at st.s 0 t v;
      Obj st
  | _, v -> v

let unbox (t : typ) (v : value) : value =
  match v with
  | Null -> Frame.null_ref ()
  | Obj st ->
      let c = Types.class_of_typ t in
      if st.cls != c then Frame.invalid_cast st.cls c;
      (match t with T_value _ -> Vt (copy st) | t -> load st.s 0 t)
  | v -> v

(* a static constructor, before the class is first used *)
let rec ensure_init (c : cls) : unit =
  if c.init = Not_run then begin
    c.init <- Running;
    (match List.find_opt (fun (m : meth) -> m.mname = ".cctor" && m.static) c.methods with
     | Some m -> ignore (invoke m [||])
     | None -> ());
    c.init <- Done
  end

and statics (f : field) : store =
  ensure_init f.fcls;
  match f.fcls.statics with
  | Some st -> st
  | None -> Frame.error ("no static storage for " ^ f.fname)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Calls *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

and invoke (m : meth) (args : value array) : value =
  match m.body with
  | Native f -> f args
  | Il_body _ | Decoded _
    when (match !jit with
        | Some compile when hot m (Types.code m) ->
            (match compile m with Some f -> m.body <- Native f; true | None -> false)
        | _ -> false) ->
      invoke m args
  | Runtime ->
      if m.mname = "Invoke" then begin
        let st = match args.(0) with Obj st -> st | Null -> Frame.null_ref () | _ -> Frame.error "a delegate" in
        match st.native with
        | N_delegate (target, fn) ->
            let rest = Array.sub args 1 (Array.length args - 1) in
            if fn.static then invoke fn rest
            else call_virtual_this fn (Array.append [| target |] rest) false
        | _ -> Frame.error "a delegate without its method"
      end
      else Frame.error (Frame.name_of m ^ ": a runtime method mini-dotnet has not")
  | No_body -> Frame.error (Frame.name_of m ^ ": abstract, called")
  | Il_body _ | Decoded _ -> run_method m args

(* a call whose `this` is in args.(0): to a value type's method, a
 * pointer to the struct (a box's inside) *)
and call_virtual_this (m : meth) (args : value array) (virt : bool) : value =
  let this = args.(0) in
  (match this with Null -> Frame.null_ref () | _ -> ());
  let target = match this with
    | (Obj _ | Str _ | Vt _ | I4 _ | I8 _ | R8 _) when virt && m.virt ->
        Types.virtual_target (class_of_value this) m
    | _ -> m in
  (match this, Types.typ_of_cls target.mcls with
   | Obj st, (T_value _ | T_bool | T_char | T_i1 | T_u1 | T_i2 | T_u2 | T_i4 | T_u4
             | T_i8 | T_u8 | T_r4 | T_r8 | T_i | T_u) when target.def <> None ->
       args.(0) <- Ptr (Inside (st, 0, 0, st.cls))
   | _ -> ());
  invoke target args

and run_method (m : meth) (args : value array) : value =
  (* (a recursion with no end: .NET's stack is a megabyte, here OCaml's
   * own stack would be used up first, its Frame.frames bigger) *)
  incr Frame.depth;
  if !Frame.depth > Frame.max_depth then raise Frame.Stack_overflow;
  (* (a tail call: the callee's frame in this one's place, in this loop:
   * OCaml's stack and the depth as they were, as .NET's tail. asks) *)
  let rec go (m : meth) (args : value array) : value =
    let code = Types.code m in
    let (f : Frame.frame) = { meth = m; code; args;
              locals = Array.map zero code.locals;
              stack = Array.make (code.max_stack + 1) Null; sp = 0; pc = 0; at = 0; caught = None } in
    Frame.frames := f :: !Frame.frames;
    (* (-profile: the frame's instructions, less its calls') *)
    let start = !Frame.steps and outer = !Frame.in_calls in
    let counted () =
      match !Frame.profile with
      | None -> ()
      | Some h ->
          let all = !Frame.steps - start in
          let name = Frame.name_of m in
          (match Hashtbl.find_opt h name with
           | Some n -> n := !n + all - !Frame.in_calls
           | None -> Hashtbl.replace h name (ref (all - !Frame.in_calls)));
          Frame.in_calls := outer + all in
    if !Frame.profile <> None then Frame.in_calls := 0;
    match run f with
    | Frame.Returned v -> counted (); Frame.frames := List.tl !Frame.frames; decr Frame.depth; v
    | Frame.Tail (m', args') -> counted (); Frame.frames := List.tl !Frame.frames; go m' args'
    | Frame.End_finally | Frame.Filtered _ -> Frame.error "endfinally or endfilter outside their block"
    | exception e -> Frame.frames := List.tl !Frame.frames; decr Frame.depth; raise e in
  go m args

(* the instructions run, an exception caught by this frame's clauses *)
and run (f : Frame.frame) : Frame.outcome =
  match loop (-1) f with
  | o -> o
  | exception Thrown exn ->
      let at = f.at in
      let rec search i =
        if i >= Array.length f.code.clauses then raise (Thrown exn)
        else
          let c = f.code.clauses.(i) in
          if at >= c.tstart && at < c.tend then
            let mine = match !Frame.chosen with Some (g, j) -> g == f && j = i | None -> false in
            match c.ckind, c.catch with
            | 0, Some k when subclass exn.cls k || mine ->
                f.sp <- 0;
                f.stack.(0) <- Obj exn; f.sp <- 1;
                f.pc <- c.hstart;
                f.caught <- Some exn
            | 1, _ when mine ->
                f.sp <- 0;
                f.stack.(0) <- Obj exn; f.sp <- 1;
                f.pc <- c.hstart;
                f.caught <- Some exn
            | (2 | 4), _ -> run_finally f c.hstart; search (i + 1)
            | _ -> search (i + 1)
          else search (i + 1) in
      search 0;
      run f

and run_finally (f : Frame.frame) (start : int) : unit =
  let pc = f.pc and at = f.at in
  f.sp <- 0;
  f.pc <- start;
  (match run f with Frame.End_finally -> () | _ -> Frame.error "a return in a finally");
  f.pc <- pc; f.at <- at

and run_filter (f : Frame.frame) (c : clause) (exn : store) : bool =
  let pc = f.pc and at = f.at and sp = f.sp in
  let saved = Array.copy f.stack in
  f.sp <- 0;
  f.stack.(0) <- Obj exn; f.sp <- 1;
  f.pc <- c.filter;
  let r = match run f with Frame.Filtered b -> b | _ -> false | exception Thrown _ -> false in
  Array.blit saved 0 f.stack 0 (Array.length saved);
  f.pc <- pc; f.at <- at; f.sp <- sp;
  r

(* the instructions from f.pc; [until] (exec's, else -1): to the one
 * at that index, alone or after its prefix *)
and loop (until : int) (f : Frame.frame) : Frame.outcome =
  let push v = f.stack.(f.sp) <- v; f.sp <- f.sp + 1 in
  let pop () = f.sp <- f.sp - 1; f.stack.(f.sp) in
  let pop_n n = let a = Array.sub f.stack (f.sp - n) n in f.sp <- f.sp - n; a in
  let ctx = Types.ctx_of f.meth in
  let resolve tok (make : unit -> resolved) : resolved =
    match Hashtbl.find_opt f.meth.cache tok with
    | Some r -> r
    | None -> let r = make () in Hashtbl.replace f.meth.cache tok r; r in
  let typ tok = match resolve tok (fun () -> R_type (Types.typ_of_token ctx tok)) with
    | R_type t -> t | _ -> assert false in
  let meth tok = match resolve tok (fun () -> R_meth (Types.meth_of_token ctx tok)) with
    | R_meth m -> m | _ -> assert false in
  let field tok = match resolve tok (fun () -> R_field (Types.field_of_token ctx tok)) with
    | R_field x -> x | _ -> assert false in
  let args_of (m : meth) =
    pop_n (List.length m.params + if m.static then 0 else 1) in
  let result (m : meth) (v : value) = if m.ret <> T_void then push v in
  let constrained = ref None in
  (* (after tail.: the next call made in this frame's place, when its
   * method is IL to interpret; a native one, the library's or the
   * JIT's, called as any) *)
  let tail = ref false in
  let interpreted (m : meth) = match m.body with Il_body _ | Decoded _ -> true | _ -> false in
  let rec go () : Frame.outcome =
    let ins = f.code.instrs.(f.pc) in
    f.at <- f.pc;
    f.pc <- f.pc + 1;
    incr Frame.steps;
    (match !Frame.trace with
     | Some say -> say (Printf.sprintf "%s IL_%04x: %s  [%d]" (Frame.name_of f.meth) ins.at ins.name f.sp)
     | None -> ());
    match ins.op with
    | Ret -> Frame.Returned (if f.meth.ret = T_void then Null else pop ())
    | Prefix "tail." -> tail := true; go ()
    | Call tok when !tail && !constrained = None && (let m = meth tok in m.static && interpreted m) ->
        tail := false;
        let m = meth tok in
        ensure_init m.mcls;
        Frame.Tail (m, args_of m)
    (* (a delegate's Invoke, its target a static method to interpret:
     * ML's closures' calls) *)
    | Callvirt tok when !tail && !constrained = None
                        && (let m = meth tok in m.body = Runtime && m.mname = "Invoke") ->
        tail := false;
        let m = meth tok in
        let a = args_of m in
        let st = match a.(0) with Obj st -> st | Null -> Frame.null_ref () | _ -> Frame.error "a delegate" in
        (match st.native with
         | N_delegate (target, fn) when interpreted fn ->
             let rest = Array.sub a 1 (Array.length a - 1) in
             if fn.static then Frame.Tail (fn, rest) else Frame.Tail (fn, Array.append [| target |] rest)
         | _ -> result m (invoke m a); go ())
    | Endfinally -> Frame.End_finally
    | Endfilter -> Frame.Filtered (Arith.truthy (pop ()))
    | op ->
        (match op with
         | Nop | Prefix _ | Break -> tail := false
         | Ldarg n -> push (copy_value f.args.(n))
         | Ldarga n -> push (Ptr (Slot (f.args, n)))
         | Starg n -> f.args.(n) <- pop ()
         | Ldloc n -> push (copy_value f.locals.(n))
         | Ldloca n -> push (Ptr (Slot (f.locals, n)))
         | Stloc n -> f.locals.(n) <- pop ()
         | Ldnull -> push Null
         | Ldc_i4 n -> push (I4 n)
         | Ldc_i8 n -> push (I8 n)
         | Ldc_r x -> push (R8 x)
         | Dup -> let v = pop () in push v; push (copy_value v)
         | Pop -> ignore (pop ())
         | Call tok ->
             let m = meth tok in
             if m.static then ensure_init m.mcls;
             let a = args_of m in
             let v = match !constrained with
               | Some _ -> constrained := None; invoke m a
               | None -> if m.static then invoke m a else call_virtual_this m a false in
             result m v
         | Callvirt tok ->
             let m = meth tok in
             let a = args_of m in
             (match !constrained with
              | Some t ->
                  constrained := None;
                  (* the `this` a pointer to a T: a value type's own
                   * method on it, or the value boxed; a reference's
                   * value *)
                  if Types.is_value_type t then begin
                    let c = Types.class_of_typ t in
                    match List.find_opt (fun (x : meth) -> x.mname = m.mname && not x.static
                                          && Types.virtual_target c m == x) c.methods with
                    | Some own -> result m (invoke own a)
                    | None -> a.(0) <- box t (deref a.(0)); result m (call_virtual_this m a true)
                  end else begin
                    a.(0) <- deref a.(0);
                    result m (call_virtual_this m a true)
                  end
              | None -> result m (call_virtual_this m a true))
         | Constrained tok -> constrained := Some (typ tok)
         | Newobj tok ->
             let m = meth tok in
             let c = m.mcls in
             ensure_init c;
             let a = pop_n (List.length m.params) in
             (match c.kind with
              | Delegate ->
                  let st = make_store c 0 in
                  (match a.(1) with
                   | Fn fn -> st.native <- N_delegate (a.(0), fn)
                   | _ -> Frame.error "a delegate made of what?");
                  push (Obj st)
              | Struct | Enum ->
                  let cell = [| Vt (make_store c 0) |] in
                  ignore (invoke m (Array.append [| Ptr (Slot (cell, 0)) |] a));
                  push cell.(0)
              | _ when Types.is_value_type (Types.typ_of_cls c) ->
                  (* (a primitive's constructor: none we know) *)
                  Frame.error ("new " ^ c.name)
              | _ ->
                  let o = Obj (make_store c 0) in
                  ignore (invoke m (Array.append [| o |] a));
                  push o)
         | Br t -> f.pc <- t
         | Brfalse t -> if not (Arith.truthy (pop ())) then f.pc <- t
         | Brtrue t -> if Arith.truthy (pop ()) then f.pc <- t
         | Bcmp (c, un, t) -> let b = pop () in let a = pop () in if Arith.test c un a b then f.pc <- t
         | Switch ts ->
             let i = Arith.int_of (pop ()) in
             if i >= 0 && i < Array.length ts then f.pc <- ts.(i)
         | Ceq -> let b = pop () in let a = pop () in push (Arith.bool_v (Arith.test Il.Eq false a b))
         | Cgt un -> let b = pop () in let a = pop () in
             push (Arith.bool_v (match Arith.compare_values un a b with Some k -> k > 0 | None -> un))
         | Clt un -> let b = pop () in let a = pop () in
             push (Arith.bool_v (match Arith.compare_values un a b with Some k -> k < 0 | None -> un))
         | Binop o -> let b = pop () in let a = pop () in push (Arith.binop o a b)
         | Neg -> push (match pop () with
             | I4 n -> I4 (Int32.neg n) | I8 n -> I8 (Int64.neg n) | R8 x -> R8 (-. x)
             | _ -> Frame.error "neg of what is not a number")
         | Not -> push (match pop () with
             | I4 n -> I4 (Int32.lognot n) | I8 n -> I8 (Int64.lognot n)
             | _ -> Frame.error "not of what is not an integer")
         | Conv (k, ovf, un) -> push (Arith.conv k ovf un (pop ()))
         | Conv_r_un -> push (match pop () with
             | I4 n -> R8 (Int64.to_float (Arith.u32 n)) | I8 n -> R8 (Int64.to_float n) | v -> v)
         | Ckfinite -> (match f.stack.(f.sp - 1) with
             | R8 x when Float.is_nan x || Float.abs x = infinity ->
                 Frame.throw_new "System.ArithmeticException" "Function does not accept floating point Not-a-Number values."
             | _ -> ())
         | Ldstr tok ->
             let row = Metadata.token_row tok in
             push (match Hashtbl.find_opt ctx.im.strings row with
                 | Some s -> s
                 | None -> let s = Str (Image.user_string ctx.im.img row) in
                   Hashtbl.replace ctx.im.strings row s; s)
         | Ldfld tok ->
             let fd = field tok in
             let o = pop () in
             if fd.fstatic then (ignore o; let st = statics fd in push (read st fd.off fd.roff fd.ftype))
             else let st, so, ro = view o in push (read st (so + fd.off) (ro + fd.roff) fd.ftype)
         | Ldflda tok ->
             let fd = field tok in
             let st, so, ro = view (pop ()) in
             push (Ptr (match fd.ftype with
                 | T_value c -> Inside (st, so + fd.off, ro + fd.roff, c)
                 | t when is_ref t -> Slot (st.r, ro + fd.roff)
                 | t -> Bytes (st, so + fd.off, t)))
         | Stfld tok ->
             let fd = field tok in
             let v = pop () in
             let st, so, ro = view (pop ()) in
             write st (so + fd.off) (ro + fd.roff) fd.ftype v
         | Ldsfld tok -> let fd = field tok in let st = statics fd in push (read st fd.off fd.roff fd.ftype)
         | Ldsflda tok ->
             let fd = field tok in
             let st = statics fd in
             push (Ptr (match fd.ftype with
                 | T_value c -> Inside (st, fd.off, fd.roff, c)
                 | t when is_ref t -> Slot (st.r, fd.roff)
                 | t -> Bytes (st, fd.off, t)))
         | Stsfld tok -> let fd = field tok in let v = pop () in write (statics fd) fd.off fd.roff fd.ftype v
         | Newarr tok ->
             let e = typ tok in
             let n = Arith.int_of (pop ()) in
             if n < 0 then Frame.overflow ();
             push (Obj (make_store (Types.array_class e) n))
         | Ldlen -> (match pop () with Obj st -> push (Arith.i4 st.len) | Null -> Frame.null_ref () | _ -> Frame.error "ldlen of what?")
         | Ldelema _ ->
             let i = pop () in
             let st, so, ro, e = element (pop ()) i in
             push (Ptr (match e with
                 | T_value c -> Inside (st, so, ro, c)
                 | t when is_ref t -> Slot (st.r, ro)
                 | t -> Bytes (st, so, t)))
         | Ldelem _ | Ldelem_any _ ->
             let i = pop () in
             let st, so, ro, e = element (pop ()) i in
             push (read st so ro e)
         | Stelem _ | Stelem_any _ ->
             let v = pop () in
             let i = pop () in
             let st, so, ro, e = element (pop ()) i in
             (match v, e with
              | (Obj o), T_class k when not (instance_of o.cls k) ->
                  Frame.throw_new "System.ArrayTypeMismatchException"
                    "Attempted to access an element as a type incompatible with the array."
              | _ -> ());
             write st so ro e v
         | Ldind _ | Ldobj _ -> push (deref (pop ()))
         | Stind _ | Stobj _ -> let v = pop () in assign (pop ()) v
         | Cpobj _ -> let src = pop () in assign (pop ()) (deref src)
         | Initobj tok ->
             let t = typ tok in
             (match pop () with
              | Ptr (Slot (a, i)) -> a.(i) <- zero t
              | Ptr (Bytes (st, off, t)) -> store_at st.s off t (zero t)
              | Ptr (Inside (st, so, ro, c)) ->
                  Bytes.fill st.s so c.nbytes '\000'; Array.fill st.r ro c.nrefs Null
              | _ -> Frame.error "initobj of what?")
         | Box tok -> let t = typ tok in push (box t (pop ()))
         | Unbox_any tok ->
             let t = typ tok in
             let v = pop () in
             if Types.is_value_type t then push (unbox t v)
             else (match v with
                 | Null -> push Null
                 | v -> let c = Types.class_of_typ t in
                   if instance_of (class_of_value v) c then push v else Frame.invalid_cast (class_of_value v) c)
         | Unbox tok ->
             let t = typ tok in
             (match pop () with
              | Obj st ->
                  let c = Types.class_of_typ t in
                  if st.cls != c then Frame.invalid_cast st.cls c;
                  push (Ptr (match t with T_value c -> Inside (st, 0, 0, c) | t -> Bytes (st, 0, t)))
              | Null -> Frame.null_ref ()
              | _ -> Frame.error "unbox of what?")
         | Castclass tok ->
             let c = Types.class_of_typ (typ tok) in
             (match f.stack.(f.sp - 1) with
              | Null -> ()
              | v -> let k = class_of_value v in if not (instance_of k c) then Frame.invalid_cast k c)
         | Isinst tok ->
             let c = Types.class_of_typ (typ tok) in
             (match pop () with
              | Null -> push Null
              | v -> push (if instance_of (class_of_value v) c then v else Null))
         | Throw ->
             (match pop () with
              | Obj st -> Frame.throw st
              | Null -> Frame.null_ref ()
              | _ -> Frame.error "Frame.throw of what is not an exception")
         | Rethrow -> (match f.caught with Some st -> Frame.throw st | None -> Frame.error "rethrow outside a catch")
         | Leave t ->
             (* the finally blocks of the trys left, the innermost first *)
             Array.iter (fun c ->
                 if c.ckind = 2 && f.at >= c.tstart && f.at < c.tend
                    && not (t >= c.tstart && t < c.tend) then run_finally f c.hstart)
               f.code.clauses;
             f.sp <- 0;
             f.pc <- t
         | Ldtoken tok when Metadata.token_table tok = Metadata.t_field ->
             (* { 5, 3, 8 }: the field's bytes, in the file *)
             let img = ctx.im.img in
             let t = Metadata.t_field_rva in
             let rec find r =
               if r > img.rows.(t) then Frame.error "ldtoken of a field without data"
               else if Image.get img t r "Field" = Metadata.token_row tok then
                 Data (img.file, Image.offset img (Image.get img t r "RVA"))
               else find (r + 1) in
             push (find 1)
         | Ldtoken tok -> push (Handle (typ tok))
         | Ldftn tok -> push (Fn (meth tok))
         | Ldvirtftn tok ->
             let m = meth tok in
             let o = pop () in
             push (Fn (Types.virtual_target (class_of_value o) m))
         | Sizeof tok -> let b, _ = footprint (typ tok) in push (Arith.i4 b)
         | Jmp _ | Calli _ | Refanyval _ | Mkrefany _ | Refanytype | Arglist | Localloc
         | Cpblk | Initblk ->
             Frame.error (Printf.sprintf "%s IL_%04x: %s, not in mini-dotnet" (Frame.name_of f.meth) ins.at ins.name)
         | Ret | Endfinally | Endfilter -> assert false);
        if until >= 0 && f.at >= until then Frame.Returned Null else go () in
  go ()

(* the JIT's call-outs: the instruction at [i] of m's code run on the
 * operands, its result the value it pushes (Null if none) *)
let exec (m : meth) (code : code) (i : int) (operands : value array) : value =
  let n = Array.length operands in
  let stack = Array.make (n + 1) Null in
  Array.blit operands 0 stack 0 n;
  (* (a constrained. prefix run first: the callvirt is told its type) *)
  let start = if i > 0 && (match code.instrs.(i - 1).op with Constrained _ -> true | _ -> false) then i - 1 else i in
  let (f : Frame.frame) = { meth = m; code; args = [||]; locals = [||]; stack; sp = n;
                            pc = start; at = start; caught = None } in
  ignore (loop i f);
  if f.sp > 0 then f.stack.(0) else Null

(* OPTIMIZATION (call-outs): the instructions the JIT's code asks for
 * most, each made once for its call-out, its token resolved at its
 * first run (a class loaded then, as the interpreter would); the
 * others by exec. A static field read by the counter of
 * jit/objects.cs took 350 ns by exec, the loop set up for one
 * instruction (its closures).
 * old: exec for every call-out *)
let once (make : unit -> 'a) : unit -> 'a =
  let cell = ref None in
  fun () -> match !cell with
    | Some x -> x
    | None -> let x = make () in cell := Some x; x

let call_out (m : meth) (code : code) (i : int) : value array -> value =
  let ctx = Types.ctx_of m in
  match code.instrs.(i).op with
  | Ldsfld tok ->
      let fd = once (fun () -> Types.field_of_token ctx tok) in
      fun _ -> let fd = fd () in read (statics fd) fd.off fd.roff fd.ftype
  | Stsfld tok ->
      let fd = once (fun () -> Types.field_of_token ctx tok) in
      fun a -> let fd = fd () in write (statics fd) fd.off fd.roff fd.ftype a.(0); Null
  | Stfld tok ->
      let fd = once (fun () -> Types.field_of_token ctx tok) in
      fun a -> let fd = fd () in let st, so, ro = view a.(0) in
        write st (so + fd.off) (ro + fd.roff) fd.ftype a.(1); Null
  | Call tok ->
      let callee = once (fun () -> Types.meth_of_token ctx tok) in
      fun a -> let c = callee () in
        if c.static then (ensure_init c.mcls; invoke c a) else call_virtual_this c a false
  | Callvirt _ when i > 0 && (match code.instrs.(i - 1).op with Constrained _ -> true | _ -> false) -> exec m code i
  | Callvirt tok ->
      let callee = once (fun () -> Types.meth_of_token ctx tok) in
      fun a -> call_virtual_this (callee ()) a true
  | Newobj tok ->
      let ctor = once (fun () -> Types.meth_of_token ctx tok) in
      fun a -> let c = ctor () in
        (match c.mcls.kind with
         | Class when not (Types.is_value_type (Types.typ_of_cls c.mcls)) ->
             ensure_init c.mcls;
             let o = Obj (make_store c.mcls 0) in
             ignore (invoke c (Array.append [| o |] a));
             o
         | _ -> exec m code i a)
  | _ -> exec m code i

let call_method (name : string) (v : value) : value =
  let c = class_of_value v in
  let obj = Types.find_class "System.Object" [||] in
  let m = List.find (fun (m : meth) -> m.mname = name) obj.methods in
  let target = Types.virtual_target c m in
  let this = match v with
    | Vt st -> (match target.def with Some _ -> Ptr (Slot ([| Vt st |], 0)) | None -> v)
    | Obj st when Types.is_value_type (Types.typ_of_cls c) && target.def <> None -> Ptr (Inside (st, 0, 0, c))
    | v -> v in
  invoke target [| this |]

let to_string (v : value) : string =
  match v with
  | Null -> ""
  | Str s -> s
  | I4 _ | I8 _ | R8 _ -> Library.format T_i4 v
  | v -> (match call_method "ToString" v with Str s -> s | Null -> "" | _ -> Frame.error "ToString's result")

let install () : unit =
  Frame.filter_hook := run_filter;
  let h = Library.hooks in
  h.to_string <- to_string;
  h.equals <- (fun a b ->
      match a, b with
      | Str x, Str y -> x = y
      | (I4 _ | I8 _ | R8 _), _ -> a = b
      | Null, _ | _, Null -> a == b
      | a, b ->
          let c = class_of_value a in
          let obj = Types.find_class "System.Object" [||] in
          let m = List.find (fun (m : meth) -> m.mname = "Equals") obj.methods in
          Arith.truthy (invoke (Types.virtual_target c m) [| a; b |]));
  h.hash <- (fun v ->
      match v with
      | Str s -> Hashtbl.hash s
      | I4 n -> Int32.to_int n
      | I8 _ | R8 _ -> Hashtbl.hash v
      | Null -> 0
      | v -> Arith.int_of (call_method "GetHashCode" v));
  h.throw <- Frame.throw_new;
  h.instance <- Types.find_class;
  h.array <- (fun (t : typ) (n : int) -> make_store (Types.array_class t) n)

let run_main (im : image) (argv : string list) : int =
  let tok = im.img.entry_point in
  if tok = 0 then Frame.error "no entry point: a library, not a program";
  let m = Types.meth_of_def im (Metadata.token_row tok) in
  ensure_init m.mcls;
  let args =
    if m.params = [] then [||]
    else begin
      let st = make_store (Types.array_class (T_class (string_class ()))) (List.length argv) in
      List.iteri (fun i a -> st.r.(i) <- Str a) argv;
      [| Obj st |]
    end in
  match invoke m args with
  | I4 n -> Int32.to_int n
  | _ -> 0
languages/dotnet/interpreter/Machine.mli
4861
(* The machine: a method's IL run, an instruction at a time, on an
 * evaluation stack of tagged values (ECMA-335, Partition III). The
 * reference that the JIT will be checked against (plan_dotnet.md,
 * decision 12: what the JIT does not compile, this runs).
 *
 * A call is a frame: the method's arguments, its locals (their types
 * from the StandAloneSig of its header), its stack (as deep as its
 * .maxstack), its pc. A call in the IL is a call of OCaml's here, so the
 * .NET stack is OCaml's; the frames are also kept in a list, for the
 * exceptions' first pass and for -trace.
 *
 *     Fib::Rec(20)                 args [| I4 20 |]   locals [||]
 *       IL_0000: ldarg.0           stack [ I4 20 ]
 *       IL_0001: ldc.i4.2          stack [ I4 20; I4 2 ]
 *       IL_0002: bge.s IL_0006     both int32: 20 >= 2, to IL_0006
 *       IL_0006: ldarg.0  ...
 *       IL_0009: call Fib::Rec     a frame of its own, its result pushed
 *
 * {b A tail call reuses its caller's frame}: a call after the prefix
 * tail. (and a ret), to a method this runs, is its frame's last
 * outcome (Frame.Tail), and run_method's loop makes the callee's frame
 * in its place, no deeper in OCaml's stack nor in the depth; a
 * delegate's Invoke to such a method too (ML's closures). So a loop
 * that ML writes as a tail recursion (mini-ml -dotnet) runs ten million
 * turns in a frame (plan_dotnet_languages.md, decision 3). A native
 * callee, the library's or the JIT's, is called as any; a method only
 * tail-called is not counted hot, so stays interpreted.
 *
 * {b An instruction is typed by its operands} (lesson 3): `add` looks
 * at its two values' tags, int32 and int32, int64 and int64, floats.
 *
 * {b Value types are copied} (lesson 4): a struct loaded from a local,
 * a field or an element is a copy (Value.copy); `ldloca`, `ldflda`,
 * `ldelema` make a managed pointer instead, through which a struct is
 * changed in place, and a struct's method gets its `this` so.
 *
 * {b Exceptions have two passes}, as the CLR's: when an exception is
 * thrown, the frames are searched for a `catch` that takes it, without
 * running anything; if none does, the program stops there ("Unhandled
 * exception"), its `finally` blocks not run. Else the frames are left
 * one by one (an OCaml exception, Value.Thrown), each running its
 * `finally` blocks on the way, until the catch. A `leave` out of a try
 * runs the `finally` blocks it leaves.
 *
 *     try { Check(0) }            Check: 100 / 0, DivideByZeroException
 *     catch (Refused) {...}       pass 1: Try's frame, this clause: no;
 *     catch (DivideByZero) {...}           this one: yes
 *     finally {...}               pass 2: Check's frame left; Try's
 *                                 catch runs, then its leave the finally
 *
 * A class's static constructor runs before its first static field is
 * read or written, its first static method called, its first object
 * made.
 *
 * others:
 * The JVM's interpreter (HotSpot's "template interpreter") is the same
 * loop written in the machine's code, one template an opcode; its
 * stack's slots are not tagged since javac's opcodes say their types.
 * Mono's interpreter (2017) and .NET's (for iOS, WebAssembly) first
 * turn the IL into a code of their own, typed, as the verifier would.
 *
 * Its parts: Frame (a call's frame, the frames running, an exception's
 * first pass and the machine's own exceptions), Arith (what the
 * instructions do to numbers: add, compare, convert), and here the
 * places (fields, elements, pointers), the classes at run time (boxes,
 * casts, static constructors), the calls and the loop. *)

open Value

(* a method called with its arguments (`this` first), its result *)
val invoke : meth -> value array -> value

(* asked for a method's code by the JIT when the method is hot (tier),
 * which then is its body (Native); None, the interpreter's. Jit_run.jit
 * with -jit; by default no JIT, and no call counted *)
val jit : (meth -> (value array -> value) option) option ref

(* the calls a method is interpreted before the JIT is asked (30, -tier
 * n: .NET's tier-up); a method with a loop at its first call *)
val tier : int ref

(* the JIT's call-outs (Jit_run): the instruction at index i of a
 * method's code run alone on its operands (the bottom first), what it
 * pushes returned, Null if nothing *)
val exec : meth -> code -> int -> value array -> value

(* the same, made once for a call-out: the instructions it asks most
 * (a static field, a field written, a call, new) without the loop *)
val call_out : meth -> code -> int -> value array -> value

(* the program's entry point run with the command line's arguments:
 * Main's result, 0 if it returns none *)
val run_main : image -> string list -> int

(* the machine's services to the library (Library.hooks) *)
val install : unit -> unit

(* The JIT's memory: code written, then run (plan_dotnet.md, decision
 * 12). Two files of the same interface: this directory's, for dune's
 * build (ocamlopt's conventions are not mini-ml's: no JIT, the
 * interpreter alone), and mini-ml/'s, which the mkfile compiles.
 *
 * On Linux, mini-ml's on arm64, by three system calls and no C: the
 * code written to a file of memory (memfd_create, write), the file
 * mapped readable and executable (mmap). So no page is ever both
 * writable and executable (W^X), and the kernel makes the instruction
 * cache see the bytes as it maps them, which is the step a JIT on arm
 * must not forget:
 *
 *     the code's bytes --write--> memfd --mmap(PROT_READ|PROT_EXEC)--> run
 *
 * On Plan 9 (mini-9pi; mini-5i's Plan 9), mini-ml's on arm: a segment
 * attached (segattach, class "memory": zeros), the bytes put there by
 * a read from a pipe they were written to (ML writes no memory but its
 * values'; the kernel writes where a read is asked to), then segflush,
 * the bytes in memory and the instructions' cache emptied of what was
 * there. The memory of a Plan 9 process runs, arm having no right to
 * run apart from reading; the cells, a segment too, through the pipe.
 *
 *     the code's bytes --pwrite--> pipe --pread--> segment --segflush--> run
 *
 * The code is then called as mini-ml calls any closure (Gen: the
 * closure in R0, its argument in R1, field 0 its code): a block of
 * two fields, the code's address in both, is a closure.
 *
 * others:
 * The simplest JIT maps memory both writable and executable (mmap's
 * PROT_WRITE|PROT_EXEC), which SELinux and OpenBSD refuse; mprotect
 * between the writing and the running is the usual way; .NET (since 7)
 * maps the same memory twice, one view writable and one executable,
 * by memfd_create too. Inferno's JIT, on Plan 9, wrote its code in its
 * heap and called segflush, as here. *)

(* whether code can be run here: mini-ml's build, Linux on arm64 or
 * Plan 9 *)
val available : bool

(* the code's bytes made executable: their address *)
val load : string -> int

(* words the code reads and ML writes (the methods' cells): their
 * first values, their address, and a word's writer (its index, its
 * value). Mapped readable only, as the code: a word is written through
 * the file (pwrite), not the memory *)
val cells : int array -> int * (int -> int -> unit)

(* the address of the runtime's ml_handler, the latest of ML's
 * handlers' records, which the code's trys push theirs on *)
val handler : unit -> int

(* a closure of mini-ml's whose code is at an address *)
val closure : int -> Obj.t

(* the address of a block (a static closure: it does not move) *)
val address : Obj.t -> int
