type hooks = {
  mutable out : string -> unit;
  mutable read : unit -> int;
  mutable to_string : value -> string;
  mutable equals : value -> value -> bool;
  mutable hash : value -> int;
  mutable throw : string -> string -> value;
  mutable instance : string -> typ array -> cls;
  mutable array : typ -> int -> store;
  mutable std : int -> stream;
  mutable file : string -> string -> stream option;
  mutable os : os;
}

let hooks = {
  out = (fun _ -> ());
  read = (fun () -> -1);
  to_string = (fun _ -> failwith "Library.hooks: no machine");
  equals = (fun _ _ -> failwith "Library.hooks: no machine");
  hash = (fun _ -> failwith "Library.hooks: no machine");
  throw = (fun _ _ -> failwith "Library.hooks: no machine");
  instance = (fun _ _ -> failwith "Library.hooks: no machine");
  array = (fun _ _ -> failwith "Library.hooks: no machine");
  std = (fun _ -> failwith "Library.hooks: no program");
  file = (fun _ _ -> None);
  os = { argv = []; getenv = (fun _ -> None); kind = (fun _ -> 0); remove = (fun _ -> false);
         rename = (fun _ _ -> false); mkdir = (fun _ -> false); entries = (fun _ -> None);
         cwd = (fun () -> "/"); chdir = (fun _ -> false); ticks = (fun () -> 0) };
}

(* the keys of the types the members name *)
let void = "System.Void"
let int = "System.Int32"
let long = "System.Int64"
let double = "System.Double"
let bool = "System.Boolean"
let char = "System.Char"
let string = "System.String"
let obj = "System.Object"

(* the members, by kind *)
let inst mn mparams mret f =
  { mn; mstatic = false; mvirt = false; mparams; mret; mgeneric = 0; impl = Impl f }
let stat mn mparams mret f =
  { mn; mstatic = true; mvirt = false; mparams; mret; mgeneric = 0; impl = Impl f }
let virt mn mparams mret f =
  { mn; mstatic = false; mvirt = true; mparams; mret; mgeneric = 0; impl = Impl f }

(* a class: its name and members after what differs from [d]'s, a
 * class of Object's: spec { d with skind = Struct } "System.Foo" [...] *)
let d = { sname = ""; sparent = obj; skind = Class; sgeneric = 0; sinterfaces = [];
          sfields = []; smethods = [] }
let spec (h : spec) (sname : string) (smethods : smeth list) : spec = { h with sname; smethods }

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The values *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let i4 (n : int) : value = I4 (Int32.of_int n)
let bool_v (b : bool) : value = I4 (if b then Int32.one else Int32.zero)

let to_int (v : value) : int =
  match v with
  | I4 n -> Int32.to_int n
  | I8 n -> Int64.to_int n
  | _ -> invalid_arg "Library: not an integer"

let to_str (v : value) : string =
  match v with
  | Str s -> s
  | Null -> ignore (hooks.throw "System.NullReferenceException" "Object reference not set to an instance of an object."); ""
  | _ -> invalid_arg "Library: not a string"

(* the object a reference or `this` points to: its store, and where in
 * it (a struct's `this` is a pointer, maybe into another object) *)
let view (v : value) : store * int * int =
  match v with
  | Obj st | Vt st -> (st, 0, 0)
  | Ptr (Slot (a, i)) -> (match a.(i) with Vt st | Obj st -> (st, 0, 0)
                                           | _ -> invalid_arg "Library.view: not a struct")
  | Ptr (Inside (st, so, ro, _)) -> (st, so, ro)
  | Null -> ignore (hooks.throw "System.NullReferenceException" "Object reference not set to an instance of an object."); invalid_arg "null"
  | _ -> invalid_arg "Library.view: not an object"

(* a primitive's value from `this`: a pointer to it, or its box *)
let number (v : value) : value =
  match v with
  | I4 _ | I8 _ | R8 _ -> v
  | Ptr (Slot (a, i)) -> a.(i)
  | Ptr (Bytes (st, off, t)) -> load st.s off t
  | Ptr (Inside (st, so, _, c)) -> let f = List.hd c.fields in load st.s (so + f.off) f.ftype
  | Obj st -> let f = List.hd st.cls.fields in load st.s f.off f.ftype
  | _ -> invalid_arg "Library.number"

let field_of (c : cls) (name : string) : field =
  let rec go (c : cls) =
    match List.find_opt (fun (f : field) -> f.fname = name && not f.fstatic) c.fields with
    | Some f -> f
    | None -> (match c.parent with Some p -> go p | None -> invalid_arg ("Library: no field " ^ name)) in
  go c

(* a field of a library object by its name: a reference's or a number's *)
let get (v : value) (name : string) : value =
  let st, so, ro = view v in
  let c = match v with Ptr (Inside (_, _, _, c)) -> c | _ -> st.cls in
  let f = field_of c name in
  if is_ref f.ftype then st.r.(ro + f.roff) else load st.s (so + f.off) f.ftype

let set (v : value) (name : string) (x : value) : unit =
  let st, so, ro = view v in
  let c = match v with Ptr (Inside (_, _, _, c)) -> c | _ -> st.cls in
  let f = field_of c name in
  if is_ref f.ftype then st.r.(ro + f.roff) <- x else store_at st.s (so + f.off) f.ftype x


(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Numbers as text *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* .NET Core 3.0's double.ToString(): the shortest digits that read
 * back the same, written plainly from 1E-05 to 1E+15, else with E *)
let format_double (f : float) : string =
  if Float.is_nan f then "NaN"
  else if f = infinity then "\xe2\x88\x9e"
  else if f = neg_infinity then "-\xe2\x88\x9e"
  else if f = 0.0 then (if 1.0 /. f < 0.0 then "-0" else "0")
  else begin
    (* the shortest %e that reads back *)
    let rec shortest p =
      let s = Printf.sprintf "%.*e" p f in
      if p >= 16 || float_of_string s = f then s else shortest (p + 1) in
    let s = shortest 0 in
    let neg = s.[0] = '-' in
    let s = if neg then String.sub s 1 (String.length s - 1) else s in
    let e = String.index s 'e' in
    let mant = String.sub s 0 e in
    let exp = int_of_string (String.sub s (e + 1) (String.length s - e - 1)) in
    let digits = String.concat "" (String.split_on_char '.' mant) in
    let n = String.length digits in
    let body =
      if exp >= 15 || exp < -5 then
        (if n = 1 then digits else String.sub digits 0 1 ^ "." ^ String.sub digits 1 (n - 1))
        ^ "E" ^ (if exp < 0 then "-" else "+") ^ Printf.sprintf "%02d" (abs exp)
      else if exp < 0 then "0." ^ String.make (- exp - 1) '0' ^ digits
      else if n <= exp + 1 then digits ^ String.make (exp + 1 - n) '0'
      else String.sub digits 0 (exp + 1) ^ "." ^ String.sub digits (exp + 1) (n - exp - 1) in
    (if neg then "-" else "") ^ body
  end

(* double.ToString("E6"), ("F2"): .NET's exponent signed and of three
 * digits at least, 1.500000E+003; another format as ToString() *)
let format_double_as (fmt : string) (f : float) : string =
  let n = String.length fmt in
  let p = if n > 1 then int_of_string_opt (String.sub fmt 1 (n - 1)) else Some 6 in
  match (if n > 0 then fmt.[0] else ' '), p with
  | ('E' | 'e'), Some p when not (Float.is_nan f) && abs_float f <> infinity ->
      let s = Printf.sprintf "%.*e" p f in
      let e = String.index s 'e' in
      let exp = int_of_string (String.sub s (e + 1) (String.length s - e - 1)) in
      String.sub s 0 e ^ String.make 1 fmt.[0] ^ (if exp < 0 then "-" else "+") ^ Printf.sprintf "%03d" (abs exp)
  | ('F' | 'f'), Some p when not (Float.is_nan f) && abs_float f <> infinity -> Printf.sprintf "%.*f" p f
  | _ -> format_double f

let format_char (c : int) : string =
  if c < 256 then String.make 1 (Char.chr c) else "?"

let format (t : typ) (v : value) : string =
  match t, v with
  | T_bool, _ -> if to_int v <> 0 then "True" else "False"
  | T_char, _ -> format_char (to_int v)
  | (T_u4 | T_u), I4 n -> Int64.to_string (Int64.logand (Int64.of_int32 n) 0xFFFFFFFFL)
  | _, I4 n -> Int32.to_string n
  | _, I8 n -> Int64.to_string n
  | (T_r4 | T_r8), R8 f -> format_double f
  | _, R8 f -> format_double f
  | _ -> hooks.to_string v

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* System: Object, the primitives, String, Console *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let object_ =
  spec { d with sparent = "" } obj [
    inst ".ctor" [] void (fun _ -> Null);
    virt "ToString" [] string (fun a ->
        match a.(0) with
        | Str s -> Str s
        | v -> let st, _, _ = view v in
            Str (match v with Ptr (Inside (_, _, _, c)) -> c.name | _ -> st.cls.name));
    virt "Equals" [obj] bool (fun a ->
        bool_v (match a.(0), a.(1) with
            | Str x, Str y -> x = y
            | Obj x, Obj y -> x == y
            | _ -> false));
    (* (both null, or the first's Equals: mini-ml -dotnet's array =) *)
    stat "Equals" [obj; obj] bool (fun a -> bool_v (hooks.equals a.(0) a.(1)));
    virt "GetHashCode" [] int (fun a ->
        match a.(0) with
        | Str s -> i4 (Hashtbl.hash s)
        | v -> let st, _, _ = view v in i4 (Hashtbl.hash st.cls.name));
    inst "GetType" [] "System.Type" (fun a ->
        let st, _, _ = view a.(0) in
        let t = Obj (make_store (hooks.instance "System.Type" [||]) 0) in
        (match t with Obj ts -> ts.native <- N_type (T_class st.cls) | _ -> ());
        t);
  ]

(* a primitive: a struct of one field, its ToString, Equals,
 * GetHashCode *)
let primitive (name : string) (field : string) (extra : smeth list) =
  let ty = match name with
    | "System.Int32" -> T_i4 | "System.Int64" -> T_i8 | "System.Double" -> T_r8
    | "System.Single" -> T_r4 | "System.Boolean" -> T_bool | "System.Char" -> T_char
    | "System.Byte" -> T_u1 | "System.SByte" -> T_i1 | "System.Int16" -> T_i2
    | "System.UInt16" -> T_u2 | "System.UInt32" -> T_u4 | "System.UInt64" -> T_u8
    | "System.IntPtr" -> T_i | _ -> T_u in
  spec { d with sparent = "System.ValueType"; skind = Struct; sfields = ["m_value", field] }
    name ([
    virt "ToString" [] string (fun a -> Str (format ty (number a.(0))));
    virt "Equals" [obj] bool (fun a ->
        bool_v (match a.(1) with
            | Obj st when st.cls.name = name -> number a.(0) = number (Obj st)
            | _ -> false));
    virt "GetHashCode" [] int (fun a ->
        i4 (match number a.(0) with I4 n -> Int32.to_int n | v -> Hashtbl.hash v));
  ] @ extra)

(* Int32.Parse: a sign and digits, blanks around *)
let parse_int (s : string) : value =
  let t = String.trim s in
  let n = String.length t in
  let start = if n > 0 && (t.[0] = '-' || t.[0] = '+') then 1 else 0 in
  let digits = ref (n > start) in
  for i = start to n - 1 do if t.[i] < '0' || t.[i] > '9' then digits := false done;
  if not !digits then
    hooks.throw "System.FormatException" ("The input string '" ^ s ^ "' was not in a correct format.")
  else begin
    let v = ref 0L in
    for i = start to n - 1 do
      if Int64.compare !v 0x80000000L <= 0 then
        v := Int64.add (Int64.mul !v 10L) (Int64.of_int (Char.code t.[i] - 48))
    done;
    let v = if t.[0] = '-' then Int64.neg !v else !v in
    if Int64.compare v 0x7FFFFFFFL > 0 || Int64.compare v (-0x80000000L) < 0 then
      hooks.throw "System.OverflowException" "Value was either too large or too small for an Int32."
    else I4 (Int64.to_int32 v)
  end

let primitives = [
  spec { d with sparent = "System.ValueType"; skind = Struct } "System.Void" [];
  primitive int int [
    stat "Parse" [string] int (fun a -> parse_int (to_str a.(0)));
  ];
  primitive long long [];
  primitive double double [
    stat "Parse" [string] double (fun a ->
        match float_of_string_opt (String.trim (to_str a.(0))) with
        | Some f -> R8 f
        | None -> hooks.throw "System.FormatException" ("The input string '" ^ to_str a.(0) ^ "' was not in a correct format."));
    inst "ToString" [string] string (fun a ->
        match number a.(0) with R8 f -> Str (format_double_as (to_str a.(1)) f) | _ -> invalid_arg "Double.ToString");
  ];
  primitive "System.Single" "System.Single" [];
  primitive bool bool [];
  primitive char char [
    stat "ToString" [char] string (fun a -> Str (format_char (to_int a.(0))));
  ];
  primitive "System.Byte" "System.Byte" [];
  primitive "System.SByte" "System.SByte" [];
  primitive "System.Int16" "System.Int16" [];
  primitive "System.UInt16" "System.UInt16" [];
  primitive "System.UInt32" "System.UInt32" [];
  primitive "System.UInt64" "System.UInt64" [];
  primitive "System.IntPtr" "System.IntPtr" [];
  primitive "System.UIntPtr" "System.UIntPtr" [];
  spec d "System.ValueType" [];
  spec { d with sparent = "System.ValueType" } "System.Enum" [];
  spec d "System.Array" [
    inst "get_Length" [] int (fun a -> let st, _, _ = view a.(0) in i4 st.len);
  ];
]

(* System.Math: a double's functions, C's *)
let math =
  let f1 (name : string) (f : float -> float) =
    stat name [double] double (fun a -> match a.(0) with R8 x -> R8 (f x) | _ -> invalid_arg name) in
  let f2 (name : string) (f : float -> float -> float) =
    stat name [double; double] double (fun a ->
        match a.(0), a.(1) with R8 x, R8 y -> R8 (f x y) | _ -> invalid_arg name) in
  spec d "System.Math" [
    f1 "Sqrt" sqrt; f1 "Abs" abs_float; f1 "Exp" exp; f1 "Log" log; f1 "Log10" log10;
    f1 "Sin" sin; f1 "Cos" cos; f1 "Tan" tan; f1 "Asin" asin; f1 "Acos" acos; f1 "Atan" atan;
    f1 "Sinh" sinh; f1 "Cosh" cosh; f1 "Tanh" tanh; f1 "Floor" floor; f1 "Ceiling" ceil;
    f1 "Truncate" (fun x -> if x < 0.0 then -. floor (-. x) else floor x);
    f2 "Pow" ( ** ); f2 "Atan2" atan2;
    (* (x less y times x/y rounded to the nearest, to the even at a
     * half: glibc's way, by fmod over 2y, exact) *)
    f2 "IEEERemainder" (fun x y ->
        let p = abs_float y in
        let r = if 2.0 *. p < infinity then mod_float x (2.0 *. p) else x in
        let a = abs_float r in
        let a = if a +. a > p then (let a = a -. p in if a +. a >= p then a -. p else a) else a in
        if x < 0.0 || (x = 0.0 && 1.0 /. x < 0.0) then -. a else a);
    stat "ScaleB" [double; int] double (fun a ->
        match a.(0) with R8 x -> R8 (ldexp x (to_int a.(1))) | _ -> invalid_arg "ScaleB");
    (* (the exponent of 1.m: frexp's less one; 0's, NaN's, infinity's
     * Int32's minimum and maximum, .NET's) *)
    stat "ILogB" [double] int (fun a ->
        match a.(0) with
        | R8 x when x = 0.0 -> i4 (-2147483648)
        | R8 x when x <> x -> i4 (-2147483648)
        | R8 x when x = infinity || x = neg_infinity -> i4 2147483647
        | R8 x -> i4 (snd (frexp x) - 1)
        | _ -> invalid_arg "ILogB");
  ]

(* MD5.HashData: a byte[]'s digest, OCaml's Digest's *)
let md5 =
  spec d "System.Security.Cryptography.MD5" [
    stat "HashData" ["System.Byte[]"] "System.Byte[]" (fun a ->
        let st, _, _ = view a.(0) in
        let h = Digest.string (Bytes.sub_string st.s 0 st.len) in
        let r = hooks.array T_u1 16 in
        Bytes.blit_string h 0 r.s 0 16;
        Obj r);
  ]

(* BitConverter: a double's bits as an int64 and back *)
let bit_converter =
  spec d "System.BitConverter" [
    stat "Int64BitsToDouble" [long] double (fun a ->
        match a.(0) with I8 n -> R8 (Int64.float_of_bits n) | _ -> invalid_arg "Int64BitsToDouble");
    stat "DoubleToInt64Bits" [double] long (fun a ->
        match a.(0) with R8 x -> I8 (Int64.bits_of_float x) | _ -> invalid_arg "DoubleToInt64Bits");
    (* (a float32 a double here, rounded to a single's precision) *)
    stat "SingleToInt32Bits" ["System.Single"] int (fun a ->
        match a.(0) with R8 x -> I4 (Int32.bits_of_float x) | _ -> invalid_arg "SingleToInt32Bits");
    stat "Int32BitsToSingle" [int] "System.Single" (fun a -> R8 (Int32.float_of_bits (Int32.of_int (to_int a.(0)))));
  ]

(* Environment.Exit: the program stops there, its status said *)
exception Exit of int

(* (Latin-1: a byte a char, as the strings here are) *)
let encoding =
  spec d "System.Text.Encoding" [
    stat "get_Latin1" [] "System.Text.Encoding" (fun _ ->
        let st = make_store (hooks.instance "System.Text.Encoding" [||]) 0 in
        st.native <- N_message "Latin1";
        Obj st);
    virt "GetString" ["System.Byte[]"] string (fun a ->
        let st, _, _ = view a.(1) in Str (Bytes.sub_string st.s 0 st.len));
    virt "GetBytes" [string] "System.Byte[]" (fun a ->
        let s = to_str a.(1) in
        let st = hooks.array T_u1 (String.length s) in
        Bytes.blit_string s 0 st.s 0 (String.length s);
        Obj st);
    (* (a string's chars into a byte[]: lib_core/dotnet's blit_string) *)
    virt "GetBytes" [string; int; int; "System.Byte[]"; int] int (fun a ->
        let s = to_str a.(1) and n = to_int a.(3) in
        let st, _, _ = view a.(4) in
        Bytes.blit_string s (to_int a.(2)) st.s (to_int a.(5)) n;
        i4 n);
  ]

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* System.IO: Stream, FileStream, File *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let stream_of (v : value) : stream =
  let st, _, _ = view v in
  match st.native with N_stream s -> s | _ -> invalid_arg "Library: not a stream"

let new_stream (cls : string) (s : stream) : value =
  let st = make_store (hooks.instance cls [||]) 0 in
  st.native <- N_stream s;
  Obj st

let io_error (what : string) : value = hooks.throw "System.IO.IOException" what

(* (an array and its range: .NET's ArgumentException when it is out) *)
let range (a : value) (off : value) (n : value) : Bytes.t * int * int =
  let st, _, _ = view a in
  let off = to_int off and n = to_int n in
  if off < 0 || n < 0 || off + n > st.len then
    ignore (hooks.throw "System.ArgumentException" "Offset and length were out of bounds for the array or count is greater than the number of elements from index to the end of the source collection.");
  (st.s, off, n)

let streams = [
  spec d "System.IO.Stream" [
    virt "Read" ["System.Byte[]"; int; int] int (fun a ->
        let b, off, n = range a.(1) a.(2) a.(3) in i4 ((stream_of a.(0)).sread b off n));
    virt "Write" ["System.Byte[]"; int; int] void (fun a ->
        let b, off, n = range a.(1) a.(2) a.(3) in (stream_of a.(0)).swrite b off n; Null);
    virt "Flush" [] void (fun a -> (stream_of a.(0)).sflush (); Null);
    inst "Dispose" [] void (fun a -> (stream_of a.(0)).sclose (); Null);
    virt "get_Length" [] long (fun a -> I8 (Int64.of_int ((stream_of a.(0)).slength ())));
    virt "get_Position" [] long (fun a -> I8 (Int64.of_int ((stream_of a.(0)).sposition ())));
    virt "set_Position" [long] void (fun a -> (stream_of a.(0)).sseek (to_int a.(1)); Null);
  ];
  spec { d with sparent = "System.IO.Stream" } "System.IO.FileStream" [];
  (* (a name the program cannot open: IOException, .NET's
   * FileNotFoundException's and UnauthorizedAccessException's parent
   * in spirit) *)
  spec d "System.IO.File" (
    List.map (fun (name : string) ->
        stat name [string] "System.IO.FileStream" (fun a ->
            let f = to_str a.(0) in
            match hooks.file name f with
            | Some s -> new_stream "System.IO.FileStream" s
            | None -> io_error ("Could not open file '" ^ f ^ "'.")))
      [ "OpenRead"; "OpenWrite"; "Create" ]
    @ [ stat "Exists" [string] bool (fun a -> bool_v (hooks.os.kind (to_str a.(0)) = 1));
        stat "Delete" [string] void (fun a ->
            let f = to_str a.(0) in
            if hooks.os.kind f = 1 && not (hooks.os.remove f) then io_error ("Access to the path '" ^ f ^ "' is denied.") else Null);
        stat "Move" [string; string; bool] void (fun a ->
            let f = to_str a.(0) in
            if hooks.os.rename f (to_str a.(1)) then Null else io_error ("Could not find file '" ^ f ^ "'.")) ]);
  spec d "System.IO.DirectoryInfo" [];
  spec d "System.IO.Directory" [
    stat "Exists" [string] bool (fun a -> bool_v (hooks.os.kind (to_str a.(0)) = 2));
    stat "CreateDirectory" [string] "System.IO.DirectoryInfo" (fun a ->
        let f = to_str a.(0) in
        if hooks.os.kind f = 2 || hooks.os.mkdir f then Obj (make_store (hooks.instance "System.IO.DirectoryInfo" [||]) 0)
        else io_error ("Could not create the directory '" ^ f ^ "'."));
    stat "GetCurrentDirectory" [] string (fun _ -> Str (hooks.os.cwd ()));
    stat "SetCurrentDirectory" [string] void (fun a ->
        let f = to_str a.(0) in
        if hooks.os.chdir f then Null else hooks.throw "System.IO.DirectoryNotFoundException" ("Could not find a part of the path '" ^ f ^ "'."));
    (* (each entry its path, the directory's then its name, as .NET's) *)
    stat "GetFileSystemEntries" [string] "System.String[]" (fun a ->
        let f = to_str a.(0) in
        match hooks.os.entries f with
        | Some names ->
            let st = hooks.array (T_class (hooks.instance string [||])) (List.length names) in
            List.iteri (fun (i : int) (n : string) -> st.r.(i) <- Str (Filename.concat f n)) names;
            Obj st
        | None -> hooks.throw "System.IO.DirectoryNotFoundException" ("Could not find a part of the path '" ^ f ^ "'."));
  ];
]

let environment =
  spec d "System.Environment" [
    stat "Exit" [int] void (fun a -> raise (Exit (to_int a.(0))));
    stat "GetCommandLineArgs" [] "System.String[]" (fun _ ->
        let st = hooks.array (T_class (hooks.instance string [||])) (List.length hooks.os.argv) in
        List.iteri (fun (i : int) (s : string) -> st.r.(i) <- Str s) hooks.os.argv;
        Obj st);
    stat "GetEnvironmentVariable" [string] string (fun a ->
        match hooks.os.getenv (to_str a.(0)) with Some v -> Str v | None -> Null);
    stat "get_TickCount64" [] long (fun _ -> I8 (Int64.of_int (hooks.os.ticks ())));
  ]

let concat (l : value list) : value =
  Str (String.concat "" (List.map (fun v -> match v with Str s -> s | v -> hooks.to_string v) l))

let index_of (s : string) (sub : string) (from : int) : int =
  let n = String.length s and m = String.length sub in
  let rec go i = if i + m > n then -1 else if String.sub s i m = sub then i else go (i + 1) in
  go from

let range_error () =
  hooks.throw "System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException" "Index and length must refer to a location within the string."

let string_ =
  spec d string [
    inst "get_Length" [] int (fun a -> i4 (String.length (to_str a.(0))));
    inst "get_Chars" [int] char (fun a ->
        let s = to_str a.(0) and i = to_int a.(1) in
        if i < 0 || i >= String.length s then
          hooks.throw "System.IndexOutOfRangeException" "Index was outside the bounds of the array."
        else i4 (Char.code s.[i]));
    inst "Substring" [int] string (fun a ->
        let s = to_str a.(0) and i = to_int a.(1) in
        if i < 0 || i > String.length s then range_error ()
        else Str (String.sub s i (String.length s - i)));
    inst "Substring" [int; int] string (fun a ->
        let s = to_str a.(0) and i = to_int a.(1) and n = to_int a.(2) in
        if i < 0 || n < 0 || i + n > String.length s then range_error ()
        else Str (String.sub s i n));
    inst "IndexOf" [string] int (fun a -> i4 (index_of (to_str a.(0)) (to_str a.(1)) 0));
    inst "IndexOf" [char] int (fun a -> i4 (index_of (to_str a.(0)) (format_char (to_int a.(1))) 0));
    inst "Contains" [string] bool (fun a -> bool_v (index_of (to_str a.(0)) (to_str a.(1)) 0 >= 0));
    inst "StartsWith" [string] bool (fun a ->
        let s = to_str a.(0) and p = to_str a.(1) in
        bool_v (String.length p <= String.length s && String.sub s 0 (String.length p) = p));
    inst "ToUpper" [] string (fun a -> Str (String.uppercase_ascii (to_str a.(0))));
    inst "ToLower" [] string (fun a -> Str (String.lowercase_ascii (to_str a.(0))));
    inst "Trim" [] string (fun a -> Str (String.trim (to_str a.(0))));
    virt "ToString" [] string (fun a -> a.(0));
    virt "Equals" [obj] bool (fun a -> bool_v (match a.(1) with Str t -> to_str a.(0) = t | _ -> false));
    virt "GetHashCode" [] int (fun a -> i4 (Hashtbl.hash (to_str a.(0))));
    inst "CompareTo" [string] int (fun a -> i4 (compare (to_str a.(0)) (to_str a.(1))));
    stat "Compare" [string; string] int (fun a -> i4 (compare (to_str a.(0)) (to_str a.(1))));
    stat "CompareOrdinal" [string; string] int (fun a -> i4 (compare (to_str a.(0)) (to_str a.(1))));
    stat "op_Equality" [string; string] bool (fun a ->
        bool_v (match a.(0), a.(1) with Str x, Str y -> x = y | Null, Null -> true | _ -> false));
    stat "op_Inequality" [string; string] bool (fun a ->
        bool_v (not (match a.(0), a.(1) with Str x, Str y -> x = y | Null, Null -> true | _ -> false)));
    stat "IsNullOrEmpty" [string] bool (fun a -> bool_v (match a.(0) with Str "" | Null -> true | _ -> false));
    stat "Concat" [string; string] string (fun a -> concat [a.(0); a.(1)]);
    stat "Concat" [string; string; string] string (fun a -> concat [a.(0); a.(1); a.(2)]);
    stat "Concat" [string; string; string; string] string (fun a -> concat [a.(0); a.(1); a.(2); a.(3)]);
    stat "Concat" [obj] string (fun a -> concat [a.(0)]);
    stat "Concat" [obj; obj] string (fun a -> concat [a.(0); a.(1)]);
    stat "Concat" [obj; obj; obj] string (fun a -> concat [a.(0); a.(1); a.(2)]);
    stat "Concat" ["System.String[]"] string (fun a ->
        let st, _, _ = view a.(0) in concat (Array.to_list st.r));
    stat "Concat" ["System.Object[]"] string (fun a ->
        let st, _, _ = view a.(0) in concat (Array.to_list st.r));
  ]

(* the console's text: a byte above 127 (Latin-1) as UTF-8, as .NET writes it *)
let utf8 (s : string) : string =
  if not (String.exists (fun c -> Char.code c >= 128) s) then s
  else begin
    let b = Buffer.create (String.length s + 8) in
    String.iter (fun c -> Buffer.add_utf_8_uchar b (Uchar.of_int (Char.code c))) s;
    Buffer.contents b
  end

(* Console.OutputEncoding = Encoding.Latin1: a character a byte, as
 * mini-tiger's programs ask *)
let latin1 = ref false

let write (s : string) : unit = hooks.out (if !latin1 then s else utf8 s)

let console =
  let both name typ =
    [ stat "Write" [name] void (fun a -> write (format typ a.(0)); Null);
      stat "WriteLine" [name] void (fun a -> write (format typ a.(0) ^ "\n"); Null) ] in
  spec d "System.Console" (
    [ stat "WriteLine" [] void (fun _ -> write "\n"; Null);
      stat "Write" [string] void (fun a -> write (match a.(0) with Str s -> s | _ -> ""); Null);
      stat "WriteLine" [string] void (fun a -> write ((match a.(0) with Str s -> s | _ -> "") ^ "\n"); Null);
      stat "Write" [obj] void (fun a -> write (hooks.to_string a.(0)); Null);
      stat "WriteLine" [obj] void (fun a -> write (hooks.to_string a.(0) ^ "\n"); Null);
      stat "Read" [] int (fun _ -> i4 (hooks.read ()));
      (* (the standard streams: their bytes as they are, the console's
       * channel the same as Write's) *)
      stat "OpenStandardInput" [] "System.IO.Stream" (fun _ -> new_stream "System.IO.Stream" (hooks.std 0));
      stat "OpenStandardOutput" [] "System.IO.Stream" (fun _ -> new_stream "System.IO.Stream" (hooks.std 1));
      stat "OpenStandardError" [] "System.IO.Stream" (fun _ -> new_stream "System.IO.Stream" (hooks.std 2));
      (* (the input is read a byte at a time whatever the encoding) *)
      stat "set_InputEncoding" ["System.Text.Encoding"] void (fun _ -> Null);
      stat "set_OutputEncoding" ["System.Text.Encoding"] void (fun a ->
          latin1 := (match a.(0) with
              | Obj st -> (match st.native with N_message "Latin1" -> true | _ -> false)
              | _ -> false);
          Null);
      stat "ReadLine" [] string (fun _ ->
          let b = Buffer.create 80 in
          let rec go () = match hooks.read () with
            | -1 -> if Buffer.length b = 0 then Null else Str (Buffer.contents b)
            | 10 -> Str (Buffer.contents b)
            | c -> Buffer.add_char b (Char.chr c); go () in
          go ()) ]
    @ both int T_i4 @ both long T_i8 @ both double T_r8 @ both bool T_bool
    @ both char T_char @ both "System.UInt32" T_u4 @ both "System.Single" T_r4)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The exceptions *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let message (v : value) : string =
  match get v "_message" with Str s -> s | _ -> ""

(* an exception's class: its message when none is given *)
let exception_ (name : string) (parent : string) (default : string) =
  let ctor0 = inst ".ctor" [] void (fun a -> set a.(0) "_message" (Str default); Null) in
  let ctor1 = inst ".ctor" [string] void (fun a -> set a.(0) "_message" a.(1); Null) in
  if name = "System.Exception" then
    spec { d with sfields = ["_message", string] } name [
      ctor0; ctor1;
      virt "get_Message" [] string (fun a -> Str (message a.(0)));
      virt "ToString" [] string (fun a ->
          let st, _, _ = view a.(0) in
          Str (st.cls.name ^ ": " ^ message a.(0)));
    ]
  else spec { d with sparent = parent } name [ ctor0; ctor1 ]

let exceptions = [
  exception_ "System.Exception" obj "Exception of type 'System.Exception' was thrown.";
  exception_ "System.SystemException" "System.Exception" "System error.";
  exception_ "System.ArithmeticException" "System.SystemException" "Overflow or underflow in the arithmetic operation.";
  exception_ "System.DivideByZeroException" "System.ArithmeticException" "Attempted to divide by zero.";
  exception_ "System.OverflowException" "System.ArithmeticException" "Arithmetic operation resulted in an overflow.";
  exception_ "System.IndexOutOfRangeException" "System.SystemException" "Index was outside the bounds of the array.";
  exception_ "System.NullReferenceException" "System.SystemException" "Object reference not set to an instance of an object.";
  exception_ "System.InvalidCastException" "System.SystemException" "Specified cast is not valid.";
  exception_ "System.InvalidOperationException" "System.SystemException" "Operation is not valid due to the current state of the object.";
  exception_ "System.FormatException" "System.SystemException" "One of the identified items was in an invalid format.";
  exception_ "System.ArgumentException" "System.SystemException" "Value does not fall within the expected range.";
  exception_ "System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException" "System.ArgumentException" "Specified argument was out of the range of valid values.";
  exception_ "System.ArgumentNullException" "System.ArgumentException" "Value cannot be null.";
  exception_ "System.NotSupportedException" "System.SystemException" "Specified method is not supported.";
  exception_ "System.NotImplementedException" "System.SystemException" "The method or operation is not implemented.";
  exception_ "System.ArrayTypeMismatchException" "System.SystemException" "Attempted to access an element as a type incompatible with the array.";
  exception_ "System.Collections.Generic.KeyNotFoundException" "System.SystemException" "The given key was not present in the dictionary.";
  exception_ "System.StackOverflowException" "System.SystemException" "Operation caused a stack overflow.";

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* StringBuilder, the interpolation's handler, Type *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let buffer (v : value) : Buffer.t =
  let st, _, _ = view v in
  match st.native with
  | N_buffer b -> b
  | _ -> let b = Buffer.create 16 in st.native <- N_buffer b; b

let append (s : string) (a : value array) : value = Buffer.add_string (buffer a.(0)) s; a.(0)

let string_builder =
  let sb = "System.Text.StringBuilder" in
  spec d sb [
    inst ".ctor" [] void (fun a -> ignore (buffer a.(0)); Null);
    inst ".ctor" [string] void (fun a -> Buffer.add_string (buffer a.(0)) (match a.(1) with Str s -> s | _ -> ""); Null);
    inst "Append" [string] sb (fun a -> append (match a.(1) with Str s -> s | _ -> "") a);
    inst "Append" [int] sb (fun a -> append (format T_i4 a.(1)) a);
    inst "Append" [long] sb (fun a -> append (format T_i8 a.(1)) a);
    inst "Append" [char] sb (fun a -> append (format T_char a.(1)) a);
    inst "Append" [bool] sb (fun a -> append (format T_bool a.(1)) a);
    inst "Append" [double] sb (fun a -> append (format T_r8 a.(1)) a);
    inst "Append" [obj] sb (fun a -> append (hooks.to_string a.(1)) a);
    inst "get_Length" [] int (fun a -> i4 (Buffer.length (buffer a.(0))));
    virt "ToString" [] string (fun a -> Str (Buffer.contents (buffer a.(0))));
  ]

(* what C# makes of $"n is {n}": a struct of the library's, a local,
 * its methods called on its address *)
let interpolation =
  spec { d with sparent = "System.ValueType"; skind = Struct; sfields = ["_unused", int] }
    "System.Runtime.CompilerServices.DefaultInterpolatedStringHandler" [
    inst ".ctor" [int; int] void (fun a -> Buffer.clear (buffer a.(0)); Null);
    inst "AppendLiteral" [string] void (fun a -> ignore (append (to_str a.(1)) a); Null);
    inst "AppendFormatted" [string] void (fun a ->
        ignore (append (match a.(1) with Str s -> s | _ -> "") a); Null);
    { (inst "AppendFormatted" ["!!0"] void (fun a ->
          ignore (append (hooks.to_string a.(1)) a); Null)) with mgeneric = 1 };
    inst "ToStringAndClear" [] string (fun a ->
        let b = buffer a.(0) in
        let s = Buffer.contents b in
        Buffer.clear b; Str s);
  ]

let type_of (v : value) : typ =
  let st, _, _ = view v in
  match st.native with N_type t -> t | _ -> invalid_arg "Library: not a Type"

(* Type.Name: the class's name without its namespace or arguments *)
let short_name (t : typ) : string =
  match t with
  | T_class c | T_value c -> c.short
  | t -> let k = typ_key t in
      (match String.rindex_opt k '.' with Some i -> String.sub k (i + 1) (String.length k - i - 1) | None -> k)

let reflection = [
  spec { d with sparent = "System.ValueType"; skind = Struct; sfields = ["_unused", int] }
    "System.RuntimeTypeHandle" [];
  spec d "System.Reflection.MemberInfo" [
    virt "get_Name" [] string (fun a -> Str (short_name (type_of a.(0))));
  ];
  spec { d with sparent = "System.Reflection.MemberInfo" } "System.Type" [
    stat "GetTypeFromHandle" ["System.RuntimeTypeHandle"] "System.Type" (fun a ->
        match a.(0) with
        | Handle t ->
            let st = make_store (hooks.instance "System.Type" [||]) 0 in
            st.native <- N_type t;
            Obj st
        | _ -> invalid_arg "Library: GetTypeFromHandle");
    virt "ToString" [] string (fun a -> Str (typ_key (type_of a.(0))));
    virt "get_FullName" [] string (fun a -> Str (typ_key (type_of a.(0))));
  ];
  spec d "System.Attribute" [];
  spec { d with sparent = "System.ValueType"; skind = Struct; sfields = ["_unused", int] }
    "System.RuntimeFieldHandle" [];
  spec d "System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers" [
    stat "InitializeArray" ["System.Array"; "System.RuntimeFieldHandle"] void (fun a ->
        (match a.(0), a.(1) with
         | Obj st, Data (file, off) -> Bytes.blit_string file off st.s 0 (Bytes.length st.s)
         | _ -> invalid_arg "InitializeArray");
        Null);
  ];
]

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The collections *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let vec (v : value) : vec =
  let st, _, _ = view v in
  match st.native with
  | N_list l -> l
  | _ -> let l = { items = [||]; count = 0 } in st.native <- N_list l; l

let check_index (l : vec) (i : int) : unit =
  if i < 0 || i >= l.count then
    ignore (hooks.throw "System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException"
              "Index was out of range. Must be non-negative and less than the size of the collection. (Parameter 'index')")

let list_add (l : vec) (x : value) : unit =
  if l.count = Array.length l.items then begin
    let bigger = Array.make (max 4 (2 * l.count)) Null in
    Array.blit l.items 0 bigger 0 l.count;
    l.items <- bigger
  end;
  l.items.(l.count) <- x;
  l.count <- l.count + 1

let list_ = "System.Collections.Generic.List`1"
let enumerator = "System.Collections.Generic.List`1+Enumerator"

let list =
  spec { d with sgeneric = 1 } list_ [
    inst ".ctor" [] void (fun a -> ignore (vec a.(0)); Null);
    inst ".ctor" [int] void (fun a -> ignore (vec a.(0)); Null);
    inst "Add" ["!0"] void (fun a -> list_add (vec a.(0)) a.(1); Null);
    inst "get_Count" [] int (fun a -> i4 (vec a.(0)).count);
    inst "get_Item" [int] "!0" (fun a ->
        let l = vec a.(0) and i = to_int a.(1) in check_index l i; l.items.(i));
    inst "set_Item" [int; "!0"] void (fun a ->
        let l = vec a.(0) and i = to_int a.(1) in check_index l i; l.items.(i) <- a.(2); Null);
    inst "Clear" [] void (fun a -> (vec a.(0)).count <- 0; Null);
    inst "Contains" ["!0"] bool (fun a ->
        let l = vec a.(0) in
        let rec go i = i < l.count && (hooks.equals l.items.(i) a.(1) || go (i + 1)) in
        bool_v (go 0));
    inst "GetEnumerator" [] (enumerator ^ "<!0>") (fun a ->
        let st, _, _ = view a.(0) in
        let e = make_store (hooks.instance enumerator st.cls.args) 0 in
        let v = Vt e in
        set v "_list" a.(0);
        set v "_index" (i4 0);
        v);
  ]

(* foreach's struct: List<T>.Enumerator, a generic value type nested in
 * a generic class; its current element a field of type T *)
let list_enumerator =
  spec { d with sparent = "System.ValueType"; skind = Struct; sgeneric = 1;
              sinterfaces = ["System.IDisposable"];
              sfields = ["_list", list_ ^ "<!0>"; "_index", int; "_current", "!0"] }
    enumerator [
    inst "MoveNext" [] bool (fun a ->
        let l = vec (get a.(0) "_list") in
        let i = to_int (get a.(0) "_index") in
        if i < l.count then begin
          set a.(0) "_current" l.items.(i);
          set a.(0) "_index" (i4 (i + 1));
          bool_v true
        end else bool_v false);
    inst "get_Current" [] "!0" (fun a -> get a.(0) "_current");
    virt "Dispose" [] void (fun _ -> Null);
  ]

let dict (v : value) : dict =
  let st, _, _ = view v in
  match st.native with
  | N_dict d -> d
  | _ -> let d = { index = Hashtbl.create 8; keys = [||]; vals = [||]; used = 0 } in
      st.native <- N_dict d; d

(* the entry of a key, -1 if none *)
let find (d : dict) (k : value) : int =
  let rec go l = match l with
    | [] -> -1
    | i :: rest -> if hooks.equals d.keys.(i) k then i else go rest in
  go (Hashtbl.find_all d.index (hooks.hash k))

let dict_set (d : dict) (k : value) (v : value) : unit =
  match find d k with
  | -1 ->
      if d.used = Array.length d.keys then begin
        let n = max 4 (2 * d.used) in
        let grow a = let b = Array.make n Null in Array.blit a 0 b 0 d.used; b in
        d.keys <- grow d.keys; d.vals <- grow d.vals
      end;
      d.keys.(d.used) <- k; d.vals.(d.used) <- v;
      Hashtbl.add d.index (hooks.hash k) d.used;
      d.used <- d.used + 1
  | i -> d.vals.(i) <- v

let no_key (k : value) =
  hooks.throw "System.Collections.Generic.KeyNotFoundException"
    ("The given key '" ^ hooks.to_string k ^ "' was not present in the dictionary.")

let dictionary =
  spec { d with sgeneric = 2 } "System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2" [
    inst ".ctor" [] void (fun a -> ignore (dict a.(0)); Null);
    inst "get_Count" [] int (fun a -> i4 (dict a.(0)).used);
    inst "ContainsKey" ["!0"] bool (fun a -> bool_v (find (dict a.(0)) a.(1) >= 0));
    inst "get_Item" ["!0"] "!1" (fun a ->
        let d = dict a.(0) in
        match find d a.(1) with -1 -> no_key a.(1) | i -> d.vals.(i));
    inst "set_Item" ["!0"; "!1"] void (fun a -> dict_set (dict a.(0)) a.(1) a.(2); Null);
    inst "Add" ["!0"; "!1"] void (fun a ->
        let d = dict a.(0) in
        if find d a.(1) >= 0 then
          ignore (hooks.throw "System.ArgumentException"
                    ("An item with the same key has already been added. Key: " ^ hooks.to_string a.(1)));
        dict_set d a.(1) a.(2); Null);
    inst "TryGetValue" ["!0"; "!1&"] bool (fun a ->
        let d = dict a.(0) in
        let out x = match a.(2) with
          | Ptr (Slot (arr, i)) -> arr.(i) <- x
          | Ptr (Bytes (st, off, t)) -> store_at st.s off t x
          | _ -> invalid_arg "TryGetValue: its out" in
        match find d a.(1) with
        | -1 -> bool_v false
        | i -> out d.vals.(i); bool_v true);
  ]

(* the delegates: their .ctor and Invoke made by the machine *)
let delegate (name : string) (generic : int) (params : string list) (ret : string) =
  spec { d with sparent = "System.MulticastDelegate"; skind = Delegate; sgeneric = generic } name [
    { (inst ".ctor" [obj; "System.IntPtr"] void (fun _ -> Null)) with impl = By_runtime };
    { (virt "Invoke" params ret (fun _ -> Null)) with impl = By_runtime };
  ]

let delegates = [
  spec d "System.Delegate" [];
  spec { d with sparent = "System.Delegate" } "System.MulticastDelegate" [];
  delegate "System.Action" 0 [] void;
  delegate "System.Action`1" 1 ["!0"] void;
  delegate "System.Action`2" 2 ["!0"; "!1"] void;
  delegate "System.Func`1" 1 [] "!0";
  delegate "System.Func`2" 2 ["!0"] "!1";
  delegate "System.Func`3" 3 ["!0"; "!1"] "!2";
  (* (named by a delegate's BeginInvoke and EndInvoke, which .NET Core
   * does not run either) *)
  spec { d with skind = Interface } "System.IAsyncResult" [];
  delegate "System.AsyncCallback" 0 ["System.IAsyncResult"] void;
  (* (ML's records and variants: their structural order) *)
  spec { d with skind = Interface } "System.IComparable" [
    { (virt "CompareTo" [obj] int (fun _ -> Null)) with impl = Abstract };
  ];
  spec { d with skind = Interface } "System.IDisposable" [
    { (virt "Dispose" [] void (fun _ -> Null)) with impl = Abstract };
  ];
]

languages/dotnet/runtime/Library.mli
4529
(* .NET's library, ix's own: the classes of `System` that the programs
 * name, each member an OCaml function over the machine's values
 * (plan_dotnet.md, decision 3). Microsoft's cannot be run:
 * System.Private.CoreLib.dll is 2,466 types and 33,768 methods, much
 * of it about the runtime itself (threads, the collector, P/Invoke), and
 * the survey's ten programs ask 47 of its members.
 *
 * A class is described here as data, its members' signatures written
 * as the keys by which a reference names them (Value.typ_key), and
 * loaded by Types as an assembly's class is: laid out, its virtual
 * methods given their slots. So a program's class can derive from
 * Exception, and Console.WriteLine(object) calls a program's ToString.
 *
 *     callvirt instance string System.String::Substring(int32)
 *        Types: the class System.String, its method of key
 *               "Substring(System.Int32)System.String"
 *        here:  inst "Substring" [ int ] string (fun a -> ... String.sub ...)
 *
 * What only the machine can do (a virtual call, an exception thrown, a
 * class instantiated) a member asks by [hooks], which Machine fills.
 *
 * The adapters are lib_core's code under .NET's names: a string is an
 * OCaml string and its methods String's, StringBuilder a Buffer, List
 * a growing array, a Dictionary a Hashtbl to the entries in their
 * order of insertion, Console the standard output by its capability.
 *
 * others:
 * Chris Bacon's DotNetAnywhere (2009, an interpreter in C that the
 * first Blazor ran in the browser) took the same path: its own
 * corlib, in C# with its internal calls in C. Mono and .NET Core run
 * Microsoft's library, written in C#, over a few hundred "FCalls" into
 * the runtime. *)

open Value

type impl =
  | Impl of (value array -> value)     (* the arguments, `this` first *)
  | By_runtime                         (* a delegate's .ctor and Invoke *)
  | Abstract

type smeth = {
  mn : string;
  mstatic : bool;
  mvirt : bool;
  mparams : string list;               (* keys: "System.Int32", "!0", "!!0[]" *)
  mret : string;
  mgeneric : int;
  impl : impl;
}

type spec = {
  sname : string;                      (* System.Collections.Generic.List`1 *)
  sparent : string;                    (* "" for System.Object *)
  skind : kind;
  sgeneric : int;
  sinterfaces : string list;
  sfields : (string * string) list;    (* the instance fields: name, type's key *)
  smethods : smeth list;
}

(* the classes, by name *)
val specs : (string, spec) Hashtbl.t

(* the system, by the program's capabilities (CLI's): its arguments
 * (the assembly's path first, as GetCommandLineArgs says), a variable
 * of the environment, a path's kind (0 nothing, 1 a file, 2 a
 * directory), a file removed, renamed, a directory made (false when it
 * cannot be), a directory's entries' names, the current one, set; the
 * milliseconds of a clock *)
type os = {
  argv : string list;
  getenv : string -> string option;
  kind : string -> int;
  remove : string -> bool;
  rename : string -> string -> bool;
  mkdir : string -> bool;
  entries : string -> string list option;
  cwd : unit -> string;
  chdir : string -> bool;
  ticks : unit -> int;
}

type hooks = {
  mutable out : string -> unit;                 (* the console's output *)
  mutable read : unit -> int;                   (* a byte of its input, -1 at its end *)
  mutable to_string : value -> string;          (* the virtual ToString, "" for null *)
  mutable equals : value -> value -> bool;      (* the virtual Equals *)
  mutable hash : value -> int;                  (* the virtual GetHashCode *)
  mutable throw : string -> string -> value;    (* a class of the library's, a message: raises Thrown *)
  mutable instance : string -> typ array -> cls;  (* a class, instantiated *)
  mutable array : typ -> int -> store;          (* a T[] of n zeros or nulls *)
  mutable std : int -> stream;                  (* the standard input, output, error *)
  (* a file opened as File's method of this name (OpenRead, OpenWrite,
   * Create) says, None when it cannot be; "Exists" opens nothing *)
  mutable file : string -> string -> stream option;
  mutable os : os;
}
val hooks : hooks

(* Environment.Exit's: the program stops, with this status *)
exception Exit of int

(* a number as .NET writes it: an int32's ToString, a double's shortest
 * form that reads back the same (1.5, 1E+20) *)
val format_double : float -> string
(* a value whose type is a number, as its ToString *)
val format : typ -> value -> string

(* See Types.mli *)

open Value
module M = Metadata
module S = Signature

exception Load_error of string

let error (s : string) = raise (Load_error s)

type ctx = { im : image; targs : typ array; margs : typ array }

(* the assemblies, in the order they were loaded *)
let images : image list ref = ref []

(* every class made, by its name with its arguments *)
let classes : (string, cls) Hashtbl.t = Hashtbl.create 64

(* an assembly's tables turned around: a TypeDef by its full name, the
 * owner of a method's and a field's row, the generic parameters of a
 * TypeDef *)
type extra = {
  by_name : (string, int) Hashtbl.t;
  method_owner : int array;
  field_owner : int array;
  generics : int array;
}
let extras : (string, extra) Hashtbl.t = Hashtbl.create 4
let extra (im : image) : extra = Hashtbl.find extras im.aname

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Names *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let dotted (ns : string) (n : string) : string = if ns = "" then n else ns ^ "." ^ n

let enclosing (img : Image.t) (row : int) : int =
  let t = img.tables.(M.t_nested_class) in
  let rec go i =
    if i >= Array.length t then 0 else if t.(i).(0) = row then t.(i).(1) else go (i + 1) in
  go 1

let rec def_name (img : Image.t) (row : int) : string =
  let t = M.t_type_def in
  let n = dotted (Image.string img (Image.get img t row "TypeNamespace"))
            (Image.string img (Image.get img t row "TypeName")) in
  match enclosing img row with
  | 0 -> n
  | outer -> def_name img outer ^ "+" ^ n

let rec ref_name (img : Image.t) (row : int) : string =
  let t = M.t_type_ref in
  let n = dotted (Image.string img (Image.get img t row "TypeNamespace"))
            (Image.string img (Image.get img t row "TypeName")) in
  let st, sr = Image.decode M.resolution_scope (Image.get img t row "ResolutionScope") in
  if st = M.t_type_ref then ref_name img sr ^ "+" ^ n else n

(* a class's name instantiated: Stack`1[System.Int32], as ToString *)
let inst_name (base : string) (args : typ array) : string =
  if args = [||] then base
  else base ^ "[" ^ String.concat "," (Array.to_list (Array.map typ_key args)) ^ "]"

let short_of (base : string) : string =
  let cut c s = match String.rindex_opt s c with
    | Some i -> String.sub s (i + 1) (String.length s - i - 1) | None -> s in
  cut '+' (cut '.' base)

(* a signature as a key, its classes by their names: the same whether
 * written in this assembly (a TypeDef) or another (a TypeRef), so a
 * MemberRef finds its method *)
let rec sig_key (img : Image.t) (t : S.t) : string =
  let tok_name tok =
    let row = M.token_row tok in
    match M.token_table tok with
    | x when x = M.t_type_def -> def_name img row
    | x when x = M.t_type_ref -> ref_name img row
    | _ -> sig_key img (S.type_spec (Image.blob img (Image.get img M.t_type_spec row "Signature"))) in
  match t with
  | S.Void -> "System.Void" | S.Bool -> "System.Boolean" | S.Char -> "System.Char"
  | S.I1 -> "System.SByte" | S.U1 -> "System.Byte" | S.I2 -> "System.Int16"
  | S.U2 -> "System.UInt16" | S.I4 -> "System.Int32" | S.U4 -> "System.UInt32"
  | S.I8 -> "System.Int64" | S.U8 -> "System.UInt64" | S.R4 -> "System.Single"
  | S.R8 -> "System.Double" | S.I -> "System.IntPtr" | S.U -> "System.UIntPtr"
  | S.String -> "System.String" | S.Object -> "System.Object"
  | S.TypedRef -> "System.TypedReference"
  | S.Class tok | S.ValueType tok -> tok_name tok
  | S.Var n -> "!" ^ string_of_int n
  | S.MVar n -> "!!" ^ string_of_int n
  | S.Ptr t -> sig_key img t ^ "*"
  | S.ByRef t -> sig_key img t ^ "&"
  | S.SzArray t -> sig_key img t ^ "[]"
  | S.Array (t, r) -> sig_key img t ^ "[" ^ String.make (r - 1) ',' ^ "]"
  | S.GenericInst (g, args) ->
      sig_key img g ^ "<" ^ String.concat "," (List.map (sig_key img) args) ^ ">"
  | S.FnPtr _ -> "System.IntPtr"

let meth_sig_key (img : Image.t) (name : string) (m : S.meth) : string =
  name ^ "(" ^ String.concat "," (List.map (sig_key img) m.params) ^ ")" ^ sig_key img m.ret

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Types and classes *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

let primitives = [
  "System.Boolean", T_bool; "System.Char", T_char; "System.SByte", T_i1;
  "System.Byte", T_u1; "System.Int16", T_i2; "System.UInt16", T_u2;
  "System.Int32", T_i4; "System.UInt32", T_u4; "System.Int64", T_i8;
  "System.UInt64", T_u8; "System.Single", T_r4; "System.Double", T_r8;
  "System.IntPtr", T_i; "System.UIntPtr", T_u; "System.Void", T_void;
]

let typ_of_cls (c : cls) : typ =
  match List.assoc_opt c.name primitives with
  | Some t -> t
  | None ->
      match c.kind with
      | Enum -> (match List.find_opt (fun (f : field) -> not f.fstatic) c.fields with
          | Some f -> f.ftype | None -> T_i4)
      | Struct -> T_value c
      | Class | Interface | Delegate -> T_class c

let is_value_type (t : typ) : bool =
  match t with
  | T_class _ | T_array _ | T_byref _ | T_ptr _ | T_void | T_var _ | T_mvar _ -> false
  | _ -> true

(* a new class, before its parent, fields and methods are known: in the
 * table first, so a field of its own type finds it *)
let new_cls (name : string) (short : string) (kind : kind) (args : typ array) (origin : origin) : cls =
  let c = { name; short; kind; args; parent = None; interfaces = []; fields = [];
            methods = []; vtable = [||]; nbytes = 0; nrefs = 0; statics = None;
            init = Not_run; element = None; imap = Hashtbl.create 4; origin } in
  Hashtbl.replace classes name c;
  c

(* the fields laid out, the instance ones after the parent's, the
 * static ones in a store of their own *)
let layout (c : cls) : unit =
  let b, r = match c.parent with Some p -> (p.nbytes, p.nrefs) | None -> (0, 0) in
  let b = ref b and r = ref r and sb = ref 0 and sr = ref 0 in
  List.iter (fun (f : field) ->
      let fb, fr = match f.ftype with
        | T_value v -> (v.nbytes, v.nrefs)
        | t when is_ref t -> (0, 1)
        | t -> (scalar_size t, 0) in
      let bytes, refs = if f.fstatic then (sb, sr) else (b, r) in
      f.off <- !bytes; f.roff <- !refs;
      bytes := !bytes + fb; refs := !refs + fr) c.fields;
  c.nbytes <- !b; c.nrefs <- !r;
  if !sb > 0 || !sr > 0 then
    c.statics <- Some { cls = c; s = Bytes.make !sb '\000'; r = Array.make !sr Null; len = 0; native = No_native }

(* a method's key as overrides compare it: its types instantiated *)
let ikey (m : meth) : string = meth_key m.mname m.params m.ret

(* the virtual methods' slots: the parent's table, a method overriding
 * one in its slot, a new one at the end *)
let vtable (c : cls) : unit =
  let vt = ref (match c.parent with Some p -> Array.to_list p.vtable | None -> []) in
  List.iter (fun (m : meth) ->
      if m.virt && c.kind <> Interface then begin
        let rec find i l = match l with
          | [] -> -1
          | (x : meth) :: rest -> if x.mname = m.mname && ikey x = ikey m then i else find (i + 1) rest in
        match if m.newslot then -1 else find 0 !vt with
        | -1 -> m.slot <- List.length !vt; vt := !vt @ [m]
        | i -> m.slot <- i; vt := List.mapi (fun j x -> if j = i then m else x) !vt
      end) c.methods;
  c.vtable <- Array.of_list !vt

let array_classes : (string, cls) Hashtbl.t = Hashtbl.create 16

(* a generic method's instantiations, each once: its IL decoded once,
 * its tokens' cache kept *)
let instances : (string, meth) Hashtbl.t = Hashtbl.create 16

(* the library's classes, made from their description *)
let rec class_of_spec (sp : Library.spec) (args : typ array) : cls =
  let name = inst_name sp.sname args in
  match Hashtbl.find_opt classes name with
  | Some c -> c
  | None ->
      let c = new_cls name (short_of sp.sname) sp.skind args Builtin in
      if sp.sparent <> "" then c.parent <- Some (find_class sp.sparent [||]);
      c.interfaces <- List.map (fun i -> class_of_typ (parse args [||] i)) sp.sinterfaces;
      c.fields <- List.map (fun (n, t) ->
          { fname = n; fcls = c; ftype = parse args [||] t; fstatic = false; off = 0; roff = 0 })
          sp.sfields;
      layout c;
      c.methods <- List.map (fun (sm : Library.smeth) ->
          { mname = sm.mn; mcls = c; static = sm.mstatic; virt = sm.mvirt;
            abstract = (sm.impl = Library.Abstract); newslot = false;
            params = List.map (parse args [||]) sm.mparams; ret = parse args [||] sm.mret;
            generic = sm.mgeneric; margs = [||];
            key = sm.mn ^ "(" ^ String.concat "," sm.mparams ^ ")" ^ sm.mret;
            slot = -1;
            body = (match sm.impl with
                | Library.Impl f -> Native f
                | Library.By_runtime -> Runtime
                | Library.Abstract -> No_body);
            calls = 0; def = None; cache = Hashtbl.create 1 })
          sp.smethods;
      vtable c;
      c

(* a type's key, as the library writes them, read: "System.Int32",
 * "!0", "!!0[]", "System.Collections.Generic.List`1+Enumerator<!0>" *)
and parse (targs : typ array) (margs : typ array) (s : string) : typ =
  let n = String.length s in
  let pos = ref 0 in
  let rec typ () : typ =
    let base =
      if !pos < n && s.[!pos] = '!' then begin
        let mvar = !pos + 1 < n && s.[!pos + 1] = '!' in
        pos := !pos + (if mvar then 2 else 1);
        let start = !pos in
        while !pos < n && s.[!pos] >= '0' && s.[!pos] <= '9' do incr pos done;
        let k = int_of_string (String.sub s start (!pos - start)) in
        if mvar then (if k < Array.length margs then margs.(k) else T_mvar k)
        else (if k < Array.length targs then targs.(k) else T_var k)
      end else begin
        let start = !pos in
        while !pos < n && not (List.mem s.[!pos] ['<'; '>'; ','; '['; '&'; '*']) do incr pos done;
        let name = String.sub s start (!pos - start) in
        let args =
          if !pos < n && s.[!pos] = '<' then begin
            incr pos;
            let rec go acc =
              let t = typ () in
              if s.[!pos] = ',' then (incr pos; go (t :: acc))
              else (incr pos; List.rev (t :: acc)) in
            Array.of_list (go [])
          end else [||] in
        match List.assoc_opt name primitives with
        | Some t -> t
        | None -> typ_of_cls (find_class name args)
      end in
    suffix base
  and suffix t =
    if !pos + 1 < n && s.[!pos] = '[' && s.[!pos + 1] = ']' then (pos := !pos + 2; suffix (T_array t))
    else if !pos < n && s.[!pos] = '&' then (incr pos; suffix (T_byref t))
    else if !pos < n && s.[!pos] = '*' then (incr pos; suffix (T_ptr t))
    else t in
  typ ()

and find_class (name : string) (args : typ array) : cls =
  match Hashtbl.find_opt classes (inst_name name args) with
  | Some c -> c
  | None ->
      match Hashtbl.find_opt Library.specs name with
      | Some sp -> class_of_spec sp args
      | None ->
          let rec go l = match l with
            | [] -> error ("no class " ^ name ^ " (mini-dotnet's library has not got it)")
            | im :: rest ->
                match Hashtbl.find_opt (extra im).by_name name with
                | Some row -> class_of_def im row args
                | None -> go rest in
          go !images

and class_of_typ (t : typ) : cls =
  match t with
  | T_class c | T_value c -> c
  | T_array e -> array_class e
  | T_byref _ | T_ptr _ -> find_class "System.IntPtr" [||]
  | T_var _ | T_mvar _ -> find_class "System.Object" [||]
  | t -> find_class (typ_key t) [||]

and array_class (e : typ) : cls =
  let name = typ_key e ^ "[]" in
  match Hashtbl.find_opt array_classes name with
  | Some c -> c
  | None ->
      let c = new_cls name (short_of (typ_key e) ^ "[]") Class [||] Builtin in
      Hashtbl.replace array_classes name c;
      c.parent <- Some (find_class "System.Array" [||]);
      c.element <- Some e;
      c.vtable <- (match c.parent with Some p -> p.vtable | None -> [||]);
      c

(* an assembly's class *)
and class_of_def (im : image) (row : int) (args : typ array) : cls =
  let img = im.img in
  let base = def_name img row in
  let name = inst_name base args in
  match Hashtbl.find_opt classes name with
  | Some c -> c
  | None ->
      Logs.debug (fun m -> m "class %s loaded" name);
      let t = M.t_type_def in
      let flags = Image.get img t row "Flags" in
      let et, er = Image.decode M.type_def_or_ref (Image.get img t row "Extends") in
      let parent_name =
        if et < 0 then ""
        else if et = M.t_type_def then def_name img er
        else if et = M.t_type_ref then ref_name img er
        else match S.type_spec (Image.blob img (Image.get img M.t_type_spec er "Signature")) with
          | S.GenericInst ((S.Class tok | S.ValueType tok), _) ->
              (match M.token_table tok with
               | x when x = M.t_type_def -> def_name img (M.token_row tok)
               | _ -> ref_name img (M.token_row tok))
          | _ -> "" in
      let kind =
        if flags land 0x20 <> 0 then Interface
        else match parent_name with
          | "System.ValueType" when base <> "System.Enum" -> Struct
          | "System.Enum" -> Enum
          | "System.MulticastDelegate" -> Delegate
          | _ -> Class in
      let c = new_cls name (short_of base) kind args (From (im, row)) in
      let ctx = { im; targs = args; margs = [||] } in
      if et >= 0 then c.parent <- Some (class_of_typ (typ_of_token ctx (M.token et er)));
      for i = 1 to img.rows.(M.t_interface_impl) do
        if Image.get img M.t_interface_impl i "Class" = row then
          let it, ir = Image.decode M.type_def_or_ref (Image.get img M.t_interface_impl i "Interface") in
          c.interfaces <- c.interfaces @ [class_of_typ (typ_of_token ctx (M.token it ir))]
      done;
      let ff, fl = Image.range img t row "FieldList" M.t_field in
      for f = ff to fl do
        let fflags = Image.get img M.t_field f "Flags" in
        (* (a literal, const, has no room: its uses are the constant) *)
        if fflags land 0x40 = 0 then
          c.fields <- c.fields @ [
            { fname = Image.string img (Image.get img M.t_field f "Name"); fcls = c;
              ftype = sig_typ ctx (S.field (Image.blob img (Image.get img M.t_field f "Signature")));
              fstatic = fflags land 0x10 <> 0; off = 0; roff = 0 } ]
      done;
      layout c;
      let mf, ml = Image.range img t row "MethodList" M.t_method_def in
      for m = mf to ml do c.methods <- c.methods @ [method_of_def im m c [||]] done;
      vtable c;
      (* explicit implementations: MethodImpl's rows *)
      for i = 1 to img.rows.(M.t_method_impl) do
        if Image.get img M.t_method_impl i "Class" = row then begin
          let bt, br = Image.decode M.method_def_or_ref (Image.get img M.t_method_impl i "MethodBody") in
          let dt, dr = Image.decode M.method_def_or_ref (Image.get img M.t_method_impl i "MethodDeclaration") in
          let body = meth_of_token ctx (M.token bt br) in
          let decl = meth_of_token ctx (M.token dt dr) in
          if decl.mcls.kind = Interface then Hashtbl.replace c.imap (decl.mcls.name ^ "::" ^ ikey decl) body
          else if decl.slot >= 0 then (body.slot <- decl.slot; c.vtable.(decl.slot) <- body)
        end
      done;
      c

and method_of_def (im : image) (row : int) (c : cls) (margs : typ array) : meth =
  let img = im.img in
  let t = M.t_method_def in
  let flags = Image.get img t row "Flags" in
  let name = Image.string img (Image.get img t row "Name") in
  let sg = S.method_ (Image.blob img (Image.get img t row "Signature")) in
  let ctx = { im; targs = c.args; margs } in
  let rva = Image.get img t row "RVA" in
  { mname = name; mcls = c; static = flags land 0x10 <> 0; virt = flags land 0x40 <> 0;
    abstract = flags land 0x400 <> 0; newslot = flags land 0x100 <> 0;
    params = List.map (sig_typ ctx) sg.params; ret = sig_typ ctx sg.ret;
    generic = sg.generic; margs; key = meth_sig_key img name sg; slot = -1;
    body = (if rva <> 0 then Il_body rva
            else if c.kind = Delegate || Image.get img t row "ImplFlags" land 3 = 3 then Runtime
            else No_body);
    calls = 0; def = Some (im, row); cache = Hashtbl.create 8 }

and sig_typ (ctx : ctx) (t : S.t) : typ =
  match t with
  | S.Void -> T_void | S.Bool -> T_bool | S.Char -> T_char
  | S.I1 -> T_i1 | S.U1 -> T_u1 | S.I2 -> T_i2 | S.U2 -> T_u2
  | S.I4 -> T_i4 | S.U4 -> T_u4 | S.I8 -> T_i8 | S.U8 -> T_u8
  | S.R4 -> T_r4 | S.R8 -> T_r8 | S.I -> T_i | S.U -> T_u
  | S.String -> T_class (find_class "System.String" [||])
  | S.Object -> T_class (find_class "System.Object" [||])
  | S.TypedRef -> error "a typedref: not in mini-dotnet"
  | S.Class tok | S.ValueType tok -> typ_of_token ctx tok
  | S.Var n -> if n < Array.length ctx.targs then ctx.targs.(n) else T_var n
  | S.MVar n -> if n < Array.length ctx.margs then ctx.margs.(n) else T_mvar n
  | S.Ptr t -> T_ptr (sig_typ ctx t)
  | S.ByRef t -> T_byref (sig_typ ctx t)
  | S.SzArray t -> T_array (sig_typ ctx t)
  | S.Array _ -> error "an array of several dimensions: not in mini-dotnet"
  | S.GenericInst (g, args) ->
      let args = Array.of_list (List.map (sig_typ ctx) args) in
      let tok = match g with S.Class t | S.ValueType t -> t | _ -> error "a generic instance of what?" in
      let img = ctx.im.img in
      let row = M.token_row tok in
      if M.token_table tok = M.t_type_def then typ_of_cls (class_of_def ctx.im row args)
      else typ_of_cls (find_class (ref_name img row) args)
  | S.FnPtr _ -> T_i

and typ_of_token (ctx : ctx) (tok : int) : typ =
  let img = ctx.im.img in
  let row = M.token_row tok in
  match M.token_table tok with
  | x when x = M.t_type_def ->
      let n = (extra ctx.im).generics.(row) in
      (* (a generic class named bare, in its own code: its arguments
       * are the context's) *)
      typ_of_cls (class_of_def ctx.im row (if n > 0 then Array.sub ctx.targs 0 n else [||]))
  | x when x = M.t_type_ref ->
      let name = ref_name img row in
      (match List.assoc_opt name primitives with
       | Some t -> t
       | None -> typ_of_cls (find_class name [||]))
  | x when x = M.t_type_spec ->
      sig_typ ctx (S.type_spec (Image.blob img (Image.get img M.t_type_spec row "Signature")))
  | x -> error (Printf.sprintf "a type's token in %s" (M.name x))

and meth_of_token (ctx : ctx) (tok : int) : meth =
  let img = ctx.im.img in
  let row = M.token_row tok in
  match M.token_table tok with
  | x when x = M.t_method_def ->
      let owner = (extra ctx.im).method_owner.(row) in
      let n = (extra ctx.im).generics.(owner) in
      let c = class_of_def ctx.im owner (if n > 0 then Array.sub ctx.targs 0 n else [||]) in
      (* (the image by ==: = walked all its tables for each method, 95%
       * of a 2.3 MB assembly's run, 15 s before its first instruction) *)
      let mine (m : meth) = match m.def with Some (im, r) -> im == ctx.im && r = row | None -> false in
      (match List.find_opt mine c.methods with
       | Some m -> m
       | None -> error "a MethodDef in no class")
  | x when x = M.t_member_ref ->
      let pt, pr = Image.decode M.member_ref_parent (Image.get img x row "Class") in
      let c = class_of_typ (typ_of_token ctx (M.token pt pr)) in
      let name = Image.string img (Image.get img x row "Name") in
      let key = meth_sig_key img name (S.method_ (Image.blob img (Image.get img x row "Signature"))) in
      let rec find (c : cls) = match List.find_opt (fun (m : meth) -> m.key = key) c.methods with
        | Some m -> m
        | None -> match c.parent with
          | Some p -> find p
          | None -> error ("no method " ^ c.name ^ "::" ^ key) in
      find c
  | x when x = M.t_method_spec ->
      let mt, mr = Image.decode M.method_def_or_ref (Image.get img x row "Method") in
      let m = meth_of_token ctx (M.token mt mr) in
      let args = S.method_spec (Image.blob img (Image.get img x row "Instantiation")) in
      instantiate m (Array.of_list (List.map (sig_typ ctx) args))
  | x -> error (Printf.sprintf "a method's token in %s" (M.name x))

and instantiate (m : meth) (args : typ array) : meth =
  let k = m.mcls.name ^ "::" ^ m.key ^ "<" ^ String.concat "," (Array.to_list (Array.map typ_key args)) ^ ">" in
  match Hashtbl.find_opt instances k with
  | Some x -> x
  | None ->
      let x = instantiate_new m args in
      Hashtbl.replace instances k x;
      x

and instantiate_new (m : meth) (args : typ array) : meth =
  match m.def with
  | Some (im, row) -> method_of_def im row m.mcls args
  | None ->
      let rec subst t = match t with
        | T_mvar k when k < Array.length args -> args.(k)
        | T_array e -> T_array (subst e)
        | T_byref e -> T_byref (subst e)
        | t -> t in
      { m with margs = args; params = List.map subst m.params; ret = subst m.ret;
               calls = 0; cache = Hashtbl.create 1 }

let field_of_token (ctx : ctx) (tok : int) : field =
  let img = ctx.im.img in
  let row = M.token_row tok in
  let find (c : cls) (name : string) =
    let rec go (c : cls) = match List.find_opt (fun (f : field) -> f.fname = name) c.fields with
      | Some f -> f
      | None -> match c.parent with Some p -> go p | None -> error ("no field " ^ c.name ^ "::" ^ name) in
    go c in
  match M.token_table tok with
  | x when x = M.t_field ->
      let owner = (extra ctx.im).field_owner.(row) in
      let n = (extra ctx.im).generics.(owner) in
      let c = class_of_def ctx.im owner (if n > 0 then Array.sub ctx.targs 0 n else [||]) in
      find c (Image.string img (Image.get img x row "Name"))
  | x when x = M.t_member_ref ->
      let pt, pr = Image.decode M.member_ref_parent (Image.get img x row "Class") in
      let c = class_of_typ (typ_of_token ctx (M.token pt pr)) in
      find c (Image.string img (Image.get img x row "Name"))
  | x -> error (Printf.sprintf "a field's token in %s" (M.name x))

let meth_of_def (im : image) (row : int) : meth =
  meth_of_token { im; targs = [||]; margs = [||] } (M.token M.t_method_def row)

let virtual_target (c : cls) (m : meth) : meth =
  if m.mcls.kind = Interface then begin
    let k = m.mcls.name ^ "::" ^ ikey m in
    let rec explicit (c : cls) = match Hashtbl.find_opt c.imap k with
      | Some x -> Some x
      | None -> match c.parent with Some p -> explicit p | None -> None in
    match explicit c with
    | Some x -> x
    | None ->
        let key = ikey m in
        let found = ref None in
        Array.iter (fun (x : meth) -> if x.mname = m.mname && ikey x = key then found := Some x) c.vtable;
        (* (a struct's or a sealed class's method, not virtual) *)
        let rec own (c : cls) = match List.find_opt (fun (x : meth) -> x.mname = m.mname && ikey x = key && not x.static) c.methods with
          | Some x -> Some x | None -> (match c.parent with Some p -> own p | None -> None) in
        match (match !found with Some x -> Some x | None -> own c) with
        | Some x -> Hashtbl.replace c.imap k x; x
        | None -> error ("no implementation of " ^ m.mcls.name ^ "::" ^ m.mname ^ " in " ^ c.name)
  end
  else if m.slot >= 0 && m.slot < Array.length c.vtable then c.vtable.(m.slot)
  else m

let ctx_of (m : meth) : ctx =
  match m.def with
  | Some (im, _) -> { im; targs = m.mcls.args; margs = m.margs }
  | None -> error "a native method has no context"

let code (m : meth) : code =
  match m.body with
  | Decoded c -> c
  | Il_body rva ->
      let im = match m.def with Some (im, _) -> im | None -> error "IL without its assembly" in
      let body = Image.body im.img rva in
      let instrs = Il.decode body.code in
      let ctx = ctx_of m in
      let locals =
        if body.locals_token = 0 then [||]
        else
          let row = M.token_row body.locals_token in
          Array.of_list (List.map (sig_typ ctx)
                           (S.locals (Image.blob im.img (Image.get im.img M.t_stand_alone_sig row "Signature")))) in
      let clauses = Array.of_list (List.map (fun (cl : Image.clause) ->
          let ix = Il.index instrs in
          { ckind = cl.kind; tstart = ix cl.try_start; tend = ix cl.try_end;
            hstart = ix cl.handler_start; hend = ix cl.handler_end;
            catch = if cl.kind = 0 then Some (class_of_typ (typ_of_token ctx cl.class_token)) else None;
            filter = if cl.kind = 1 then ix cl.class_token else -1 })
          body.clauses) in
      let c = { instrs; clauses; locals; max_stack = body.max_stack } in
      m.body <- Decoded c;
      c
  | _ -> error (m.mcls.name ^ "::" ^ m.mname ^ " has no IL")

let load (img : Image.t) : image =
  let aname = if img.rows.(M.t_assembly) > 0
    then Image.string img (Image.get img M.t_assembly 1 "Name") else "module" in
  let im = { img; aname; types = Hashtbl.create 16; strings = Hashtbl.create 16 } in
  let ntypes = img.rows.(M.t_type_def) in
  let by_name = Hashtbl.create 16 in
  let method_owner = Array.make (img.rows.(M.t_method_def) + 1) 0 in
  let field_owner = Array.make (img.rows.(M.t_field) + 1) 0 in
  let generics = Array.make (ntypes + 1) 0 in
  for r = 1 to ntypes do
    Hashtbl.replace by_name (def_name img r) r;
    let mf, ml = Image.range img M.t_type_def r "MethodList" M.t_method_def in
    for m = mf to ml do method_owner.(m) <- r done;
    let ff, fl = Image.range img M.t_type_def r "FieldList" M.t_field in
    for f = ff to fl do field_owner.(f) <- r done
  done;
  for g = 1 to img.rows.(M.t_generic_param) do
    let ot, orow = Image.decode M.type_or_method_def (Image.get img M.t_generic_param g "Owner") in
    if ot = M.t_type_def then generics.(orow) <- generics.(orow) + 1
  done;
  Hashtbl.replace extras aname { by_name; method_owner; field_owner; generics };
  images := !images @ [im];
  Logs.info (fun m -> m "assembly %s loaded: %d types, %d methods" aname ntypes img.rows.(M.t_method_def));
  im

(* The loader: a class made when it is first named, from its assembly's
 * rows or from the Library's description, and the tokens of a method's
 * IL given their meaning. The runtime's part that ECMA-335 calls the
 * class loader (Partition II, 10 and 22; Partition I, 8.9 and 9).
 *
 * A class, when it is loaded:
 *   - its parent first, then its interfaces;
 *   - its fields laid out (Value: the numbers in the bytes, the
 *     references apart), after its parent's: a subclass's object is
 *     its parent's with more at the end, so a field has one offset in
 *     every subclass;
 *   - its static fields in a store of their own, its static
 *     constructor (.cctor) run when the machine first needs it;
 *   - its virtual methods given their slots: its parent's table
 *     copied, a method that overrides one (same name, same signature,
 *     not `newslot`) takes its slot, the others are added at the end;
 *     a MethodImpl row (C#'s explicit `IFoo.Bar`) says the slot itself.
 *
 *     Shape:  [ ToString | Equals | GetHashCode | Area | Name ]
 *     Square: [ Shape::ToString | ... | Square::Area | Square::Name ]
 *     Rect:   [ Shape::ToString | ... | Rect::Area | Shape::Name ]
 *
 *   so `callvirt Shape::Area` is the slot of Shape::Area looked up in
 *   the object's class's table. An interface's method has no slot in
 *   the class: it is looked for there by its name and signature, once
 *   (the class's imap).
 *
 * {b Generics are kept at run time} (plan_dotnet.md's lesson 5): a
 * generic class is a class only once instantiated, Stack`1[System.Int32]
 * and Stack`1[System.String] two of them, each its own layout (an
 * int32 in the bytes, a string among the references), its own statics,
 * its own Type; a token in a generic method's IL is read in the context
 * of its class's arguments and its own (!0, !!0).
 *
 * A reference to another assembly's member (a TypeRef, a MemberRef) is
 * resolved by its name and its signature's key (Value.typ_key): the
 * library's classes first (System.*: Library), then the assemblies
 * loaded. The assembly a TypeRef names is not read: mini-dotnet has one
 * library, its own.
 *
 * others:
 * The JVM's loader does the same work, a class at a time, with its
 * vtables, but erases the generics: there is one List and its elements
 * are Objects. The CLR shares the code of the instantiations over
 * references (one compiled List<__Canon>) and makes a copy for each
 * value type; here each instantiation has its own records but their IL
 * is the same. *)

open Value

exception Load_error of string

(* an assembly loaded: its classes made when named *)
val load : Image.t -> image

(* what a method's IL is read in: its assembly, its class's type
 * arguments, its own *)
type ctx = { im : image; targs : typ array; margs : typ array }

(* a class by its name (Namespace.Name, Outer+Inner), instantiated *)
val find_class : string -> typ array -> cls
(* the class of a type: System.Int32 for int32, an array's *)
val class_of_typ : typ -> cls
(* the type of a class: int32 for System.Int32, an enum its underlying *)
val typ_of_cls : cls -> typ
val array_class : typ -> cls
val is_value_type : typ -> bool

(* the tokens of a method's IL *)
val typ_of_token : ctx -> int -> typ
val meth_of_token : ctx -> int -> meth
val field_of_token : ctx -> int -> field

let scalar_size (t : typ) : int =
  match t with
  | T_bool | T_i1 | T_u1 -> 1
  | T_char | T_i2 | T_u2 -> 2
  | T_i4 | T_u4 | T_r4 | T_i | T_u -> 4
  | T_i8 | T_u8 | T_r8 -> 8
  | _ -> 0

let is_ref (t : typ) : bool =
  match t with
  | T_class _ | T_array _ | T_byref _ | T_ptr _ -> true
  | _ -> false

let rec typ_key (t : typ) : string =
  match t with
  | T_void -> "System.Void" | T_bool -> "System.Boolean" | T_char -> "System.Char"
  | T_i1 -> "System.SByte" | T_u1 -> "System.Byte"
  | T_i2 -> "System.Int16" | T_u2 -> "System.UInt16"
  | T_i4 -> "System.Int32" | T_u4 -> "System.UInt32"
  | T_i8 -> "System.Int64" | T_u8 -> "System.UInt64"
  | T_r4 -> "System.Single" | T_r8 -> "System.Double"
  | T_i -> "System.IntPtr" | T_u -> "System.UIntPtr"
  | T_class c | T_value c -> c.name
  | T_array e -> typ_key e ^ "[]"
  | T_byref e -> typ_key e ^ "&"
  | T_ptr e -> typ_key e ^ "*"
  | T_var n -> "!" ^ string_of_int n
  | T_mvar n -> "!!" ^ string_of_int n

let meth_key (name : string) (params : typ list) (ret : typ) : string =
  name ^ "(" ^ String.concat "," (List.map typ_key params) ^ ")" ^ typ_key ret

let load (b : Bytes.t) (at : int) (t : typ) : value =
  match t with
  | T_bool | T_u1 -> I4 (Int32.of_int (Bytes.get_uint8 b at))
  | T_i1 -> I4 (Int32.of_int (Bytes.get_int8 b at))
  | T_char | T_u2 -> I4 (Int32.of_int (Bytes.get_uint16_le b at))
  | T_i2 -> let n = Bytes.get_uint16_le b at in I4 (Int32.of_int (if n >= 0x8000 then n - 0x10000 else n))
  | T_i4 | T_u4 | T_i | T_u -> I4 (Bytes.get_int32_le b at)
  | T_i8 | T_u8 -> I8 (Bytes.get_int64_le b at)
  | T_r4 -> R8 (Int32.float_of_bits (Bytes.get_int32_le b at))
  | T_r8 -> R8 (Int64.float_of_bits (Bytes.get_int64_le b at))
  | _ -> invalid_arg "Value.load: not a number"

let to_i32 (v : value) : int32 =
  match v with
  | I4 n -> n
  | I8 n -> Int64.to_int32 n
  | R8 f -> Int32.of_float f
  | _ -> invalid_arg "Value.store_at: not a number"

let store_at (b : Bytes.t) (at : int) (t : typ) (v : value) : unit =
  match t with
  | T_bool | T_u1 | T_i1 -> Bytes.set_uint8 b at (Int32.to_int (to_i32 v) land 0xFF)
  | T_char | T_u2 | T_i2 -> Bytes.set_uint16_le b at (Int32.to_int (to_i32 v) land 0xFFFF)
  | T_i4 | T_u4 | T_i | T_u -> Bytes.set_int32_le b at (to_i32 v)
  | T_i8 | T_u8 ->
      Bytes.set_int64_le b at (match v with I8 n -> n | I4 n -> Int64.of_int32 n
                                           | R8 f -> Int64.of_float f
                                           | _ -> invalid_arg "Value.store_at: not a number")
  | T_r4 ->
      Bytes.set_int32_le b at (Int32.bits_of_float (match v with R8 f -> f | _ -> invalid_arg "Value.store_at: not a float"))
  | T_r8 ->
      Bytes.set_int64_le b at (Int64.bits_of_float (match v with R8 f -> f | _ -> invalid_arg "Value.store_at: not a float"))
  | _ -> invalid_arg "Value.store_at: not a number"

(* an element's or a field's room: (bytes, references) *)
let footprint (t : typ) : int * int =
  match t with
  | T_value c -> (c.nbytes, c.nrefs)
  | t when is_ref t -> (0, 1)
  | t -> (scalar_size t, 0)

let make_store (c : cls) (n : int) : store =
  match c.element with
  | Some e ->
      let b, r = footprint e in
      { cls = c; s = Bytes.make (b * n) '\000'; r = Array.make (r * n) Null; len = n; native = No_native }
  | None ->
      { cls = c; s = Bytes.make c.nbytes '\000'; r = Array.make c.nrefs Null; len = 0; native = No_native }

let copy (st : store) : store =
  { st with s = Bytes.copy st.s; r = Array.copy st.r }

let zero (t : typ) : value =
  match t with
  | T_i8 | T_u8 -> I8 Int64.zero
  | T_r4 | T_r8 -> R8 0.0
  | T_value c -> Vt (make_store c 0)
  | t when is_ref t -> Null
  | T_class _ | T_array _ | T_byref _ | T_ptr _ | T_var _ | T_mvar _ | T_void -> Null
  | _ -> I4 Int32.zero

let rec subclass (c : cls) (d : cls) : bool =
  c == d
  || List.exists (fun i -> subclass i d) c.interfaces
  || (match c.parent with Some p -> subclass p d | None -> false)
languages/dotnet/runtime/Value.mli
