(* See Il_patterns.mli *)

module S = Signature
module W = Writer
open Il_code
open Il_types

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Patterns *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* a variable bound to the value [load] pushes, in a local of its own *)
let bind (c : c) (k : code) (v : Scope.var) (load : unit -> unit) : unit =
  let ty = match Il_types.var_type v.vid with Some t -> cts c 0 t | None -> refuse 0 (v.vname ^ ", a variable whose type was not kept") "1a" in
  if ty <> S.Void then begin
    let i = match Hashtbl.find_opt k.slots v.vid with Some i -> i | None -> let i = local k ty in Hashtbl.replace k.slots v.vid i; i in
    load ();
    emit k (Il.Stloc i)
  end

(* the pattern tested on the value [load] pushes (of type [ty]): to
 * [fail] if it does not match, its variables bound if it does. A
 * value's parts are loaded again from it each time (a local, a field:
 * cheap), a constructor's after a cast to its class *)
let rec pattern (c : c) (k : code) (load : unit -> unit) (ty : Scope.ty) (p : Scope.pattern) (fail : int) : unit =
  match p with
  | Pany -> ()
  | Pvar v -> bind c k v load
  | Palias (p, v) ->
      pattern c k load ty p fail;
      bind c k v load
  | Pconstraint (p, _) -> pattern c k load ty p fail
  | Pconst (Int n) ->
      load ();
      emit k (Il.Ldc_i8 (Int64.of_int n));
      emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Ne, false, fail))
  | Pconst (Char ch) ->
      load ();
      emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_int (Char.code ch)));
      emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Ne, false, fail))
  | Pconst (String s) ->
      load ();
      emit k (Il.Ldstr (W.user_string c.w s));
      emit k (Il.Call (lib c "String" "op_Equality" (static [ S.String; S.String ] S.Bool)));
      emit k (Il.Brfalse fail)
  | Pconst (Int64 n) ->
      load ();
      emit k (Il.Ldc_i8 (Int64.of_string n));
      emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Ne, false, fail))
  | Pconst (Int32 n) ->
      load ();
      emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_string n));
      emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Ne, false, fail))
  (* (a float: bne.un, a NaN equal to nothing) *)
  | Pconst (Float f) ->
      load ();
      emit k (Il.Ldc_r (float_of_string f));
      emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Ne, true, fail))
  | Prange (a, b) ->
      load ();
      emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_int (Char.code a)));
      emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Lt, false, fail));
      load ();
      emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_int (Char.code b)));
      emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Gt, false, fail))
  | Pcons (k', []) when k'.cname = "()" -> ()
  | Pcons (k', []) when k'.cname = "true" -> load (); emit k (Il.Brfalse fail)
  | Pcons (k', []) when k'.cname = "false" -> load (); emit k (Il.Brtrue fail)
  | Pcons (k', ps) ->
      let _, args, _ = k'.ctype in
      if List.length ps <> List.length args then refuse 0 (k'.cname ^ "'s arguments as one tuple") "1d";
      let cls, _, fld, args =
        match k'.kind with
        | Exn g -> let cls, ctor, fld = exn c 0 g.gsym args in (cls, ctor, fld, args)
        | Const _ | Block _ -> case c 0 k' ty in
      load ();
      emit k (Il.Isinst cls);
      emit k (Il.Brfalse fail);
      List.iteri
        (fun (i : int) ((p, t) : Scope.pattern * Scope.ty) ->
          pattern c k (fun () -> load (); emit k (Il.Castclass cls); emit k (Il.Ldfld (fld i))) t p fail)
        (List.combine ps args)
  | Precord fs ->
      List.iter
        (fun ((l, p) : Scope.label * Scope.pattern) ->
          pattern c k (fun () -> load (); emit k (Il.Ldfld (field c 0 ty l.lname))) (label_type l ty) p fail)
        fs
  | Por (a, b) ->
      let other = label k and ok = label k in
      pattern c k load ty a other;
      emit k (Il.Br ok);
      place k other;
      pattern c k load ty b fail;
      place k ok
  | Ptuple ps ->
      let ts = match unabbrev ty with Ttuple ts -> ts | _ -> refuse 0 "a tuple pattern of no tuple type" "1d" in
      List.iteri
        (fun (i : int) ((p, t) : Scope.pattern * Scope.ty) ->
          pattern c k (fun () -> load (); emit k (Il.Ldfld (tuple_field c 0 ty i))) t p fail)
        (List.combine ps ts)
languages/ml/dotnet/Il_patterns.mli
695
(* A pattern tested on a value (Lower_il's match, try, let and
 * functions of cases): constants by comparisons, a constructor by
 * isinst on its class then its fields after a cast, a record by its
 * fields, an or-pattern by its left then its right; on failure a jump
 * to a label, on success its variables bound in locals. *)

(* a variable bound to the value [load] pushes, in a local of its own *)
val bind : Il_code.c -> Il_code.code -> Scope.var -> (unit -> unit) -> unit

(* the pattern tested on the value [load] pushes, of an ML type: to
 * the label [fail] if it does not match *)
val pattern : Il_code.c -> Il_code.code -> (unit -> unit) -> Scope.ty -> Scope.pattern -> int -> unit
languages/ml/dotnet/Il_prims.ml
19047
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Il_prims.mli *)

module S = Signature
module W = Writer
open Il_code
open Il_types
open Il_functions

(* the expressions' compiler (Il_exprs'), which the primitives' operands
 * are given to *)
type compiler = {
  expr : Scope.expr -> unit;
  operands : Scope.expr list -> unit;
  values : Scope.expr list -> unit;
  drop : Scope.expr -> unit;
}

(* a call of the runtime unit's function of a C primitive's name, all
 * its arguments given, it not polymorphic: each argument converted to
 * its parameter's type, which may be another than the external's (the
 * primitive of output_char is output_byte's, an int there), the result
 * back; sys_exit's 'a, which no value reaches, a default one. false
 * when it is not so (a partial application: call's) *)
let rec runtime_call (c : c) (k : code) (cx : compiler) (e : Scope.expr) (f : fn) (args : Scope.expr list) : bool =
  if f.gvars <> [] || List.length args <> List.length f.params then false
  else begin
    let saved = k.pending in
    List.iter2
      (fun (a : Scope.expr) ((_, t) : Scope.var option * S.t) ->
        cx.expr a;
        if t <> S.Void then begin
          Il_externals.convert c k (cts_of c a) t;
          k.pending <- k.pending + 1
        end)
      args f.params;
    k.pending <- saved;
    emit k (Il.Call f.tok);
    let ret = if raises_always f then S.Void else cts c e.loc f.rty in
    (match ret, cts_of c e with
     | S.Void, t -> default k t
     | _, S.Void -> emit k Il.Pop
     | r, t -> Il_externals.convert c k r t);
    true
  end

(* a value of a type where a call returned none (a function that always
 * raises, invalid_arg, its method's result void; sys_exit): never
 * reached, but the stack typed as the caller's *)
and default (k : code) (t : S.t) : unit =
  match t with
  | S.Void -> ()
  | S.I8 -> emit k (Il.Ldc_i8 0L)
  | S.I4 | S.Bool | S.Char | S.U1 -> emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l)
  | S.R8 -> emit k (Il.Ldc_r 0.0)
  | _ -> emit k Il.Ldnull

(* a call of an external naming a .NET member (decision 7): its
 * arguments converted to its parameters' .NET types, its result back *)
and dotnet (c : c) (k : code) (cx : compiler) (e : Scope.expr) (p : string) (pty : Scope.ty) (args : Scope.expr list) : unit =
  let m = Il_externals.member c e.loc p pty in
  let n = List.length (fst (Il_externals.arrows pty)) in
  if List.length args <> n then refuse e.loc (p ^ ", an external given fewer or more arguments than its type's") "3b";
  let saved = k.pending in
  let pending = ref (List.combine m.from m.into) in
  (* (a this of a value type, a double's ToString: its address, and a
   * call, not a callvirt) *)
  let by_address = not m.static && (match m.into with t :: _ -> Il_externals.is_value t | [] -> false) in
  List.iteri
    (fun (i : int) (a : Scope.expr) ->
      cx.expr a;
      if cts_of c a <> S.Void then begin
        (match !pending with
         | (f, t) :: rest -> Il_externals.convert c k f t; pending := rest
         | [] -> ());
        if i = 0 && by_address then begin
          let v = local k (List.hd m.into) in
          emit k (Il.Stloc v);
          emit k (Il.Ldloca v)
        end;
        k.pending <- k.pending + 1
      end)
    args;
  k.pending <- saved;
  emit k (if m.static || by_address then Il.Call m.tok else Il.Callvirt m.tok);
  if m.ml_ret = S.Void && m.ret <> S.Void then emit k Il.Pop
  else Il_externals.convert c k m.ret m.ml_ret

and prim (c : c) (env : env) (k : code) (cx : compiler) (e : Scope.expr) (p : string) (args : Scope.expr list) : unit =
  (* (Pervasives' string_length and bytes_length: the native compiler's
   * builtin, of either type, as %string_length is) *)
  let p = if p = "ml_string_length" then "%string_length" else p in
  let all () = cx.operands args in
  let op (o : Il.op) = all (); emit k o in
  let first () : S.t = match args with a :: _ -> cts_of c a | [] -> S.Void in
  (* both operands boxed (a type variable's value) *)
  let boxed () =
    let ty = first () in
    match args with
    | [ a; b ] ->
        cx.expr a; emit k (Il.Box (W.type_spec c.w ty));
        k.pending <- k.pending + 1; cx.expr b; emit k (Il.Box (W.type_spec c.w ty)); k.pending <- k.pending - 1
    | _ -> refuse e.loc "a comparison of a polymorphic value" "1d" in
  (* (bytes compared, = too, by their contents: as strings, the runtime
   * unit's copies) *)
  let as_strings () =
    let sob = match Hashtbl.find_opt env.by_sym "Runtime.string_of_bytes" with
      | Some f -> f.tok | None -> refuse e.loc "bytes compared, without the runtime unit" "3b" in
    match args with
    | [ a; b ] ->
        cx.expr a; emit k (Il.Call sob);
        k.pending <- k.pending + 1; cx.expr b; emit k (Il.Call sob); k.pending <- k.pending - 1
    | _ -> refuse e.loc "bytes compared" "1d" in
  (* a comparison: a string's by CompareOrdinal against 0; a type
   * variable's by the assembly's Ml::compare *)
  let compare (lt : bool) (negate : bool) =
    (match first () with
    | S.SzArray S.U1 ->
        as_strings ();
        emit k (Il.Call (lib c "String" "CompareOrdinal" (static [ S.String; S.String ] S.I4)));
        emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l)
    | S.String ->
        all ();
        emit k (Il.Call (lib c "String" "CompareOrdinal" (static [ S.String; S.String ] S.I4)));
        emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l)
    | S.MVar _ | S.Var _ ->
        boxed ();
        emit k (Il.Call (ml_compare c));
        emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l)
    (* (a record's, a variant's: their structural CompareTo, by it) *)
    | S.Class _ | S.GenericInst _ ->
        all ();
        emit k (Il.Call (ml_compare c));
        emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l)
    (* (an array's: its length, then its elements) *)
    | S.SzArray t ->
        all ();
        emit k (Il.Call (memo c ("array_compare " ^ S.encode_type_spec t) (fun () -> W.method_spec c.w (ml_array_compare c) [ t ])));
        emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l)
    | _ -> all ());
    (* (a float's NaN: unordered, so a <= b is not (a > b, or unordered)) *)
    let unordered = negate && first () = S.R8 in
    emit k (if lt then Il.Clt unordered else Il.Cgt unordered);
    if negate then (emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l); emit k Il.Ceq) in
  let equal () =
    match first () with
    | S.String -> op (Il.Call (lib c "String" "op_Equality" (static [ S.String; S.String ] S.Bool)))
    | S.SzArray S.U1 when p = "%equal" || p = "%notequal" ->
        as_strings (); emit k (Il.Call (lib c "String" "op_Equality" (static [ S.String; S.String ] S.Bool)))
    (* (a polymorphic function's value: boxed, its own Equals, an int's
     * or a record's) *)
    | (S.MVar _ | S.Var _) as t when p = "%equal" || p = "%notequal" ->
        let box () = emit k (Il.Box (W.type_spec c.w t)) in
        (match args with
         | [ a; b ] ->
             cx.expr a; box ();
             k.pending <- k.pending + 1; cx.expr b; box (); k.pending <- k.pending - 1;
             emit k (Il.Callvirt (lib c "Object" "Equals" (instance [ S.Object ] S.Bool)))
         | _ -> refuse e.loc "= of a polymorphic value" "1d")
    (* (a record's or a variant's Equals, structural; an exception's
     * the same object) *)
    | S.Class _ | S.GenericInst _ when p = "%equal" || p = "%notequal" -> op (Il.Callvirt (lib c "Object" "Equals" (instance [ S.Object ] S.Bool)))
    (* (an array's by its elements, not its place) *)
    | S.SzArray t when p = "%equal" || p = "%notequal" ->
        op (Il.Call (memo c ("array_equal " ^ S.encode_type_spec t) (fun () -> W.method_spec c.w (ml_array_equal c) [ t ])))
    | _ -> op Il.Ceq in
  match p, args with
  | ("%addint" | "%addfloat"), _ -> op (Il.Binop Il.Add)
  | ("%subint" | "%subfloat"), _ -> op (Il.Binop Il.Sub)
  | ("%mulint" | "%mulfloat"), _ -> op (Il.Binop Il.Mul)
  | ("%divint" | "%divfloat"), _ -> op (Il.Binop Il.Div)
  | "%modint", _ -> op (Il.Binop Il.Rem)
  | "%andint", _ -> op (Il.Binop Il.And)
  | "%orint", _ -> op (Il.Binop Il.Or)
  | "%xorint", _ -> op (Il.Binop Il.Xor)
  | ("%negint" | "%negfloat"), _ -> op Il.Neg
  | "%lnot", _ -> op Il.Not
  | "%succint", _ -> all (); emit k (Il.Ldc_i8 1L); emit k (Il.Binop Il.Add)
  | "%predint", _ -> all (); emit k (Il.Ldc_i8 1L); emit k (Il.Binop Il.Sub)
  (* (a shift's count an int32, IL's) *)
  | ("%lslint" | "%asrint" | "%lsrint"), _ ->
      all ();
      emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false));
      emit k (Il.Binop (match p with "%lslint" -> Il.Shl | "%asrint" -> Il.Shr | _ -> Il.Shr_un))
  | "%floatofint", _ -> op (Il.Conv (Il.K_r8, false, false))
  | "%intoffloat", _ -> op (Il.Conv (Il.K_i8, false, false))
  | "%boolnot", _ -> all (); emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l); emit k Il.Ceq
  | ("%equal" | "%eq"), _ -> equal ()
  | ("%notequal" | "%noteq"), _ -> equal (); emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l); emit k Il.Ceq
  | "%lessthan", _ -> compare true false
  | "%greaterthan", _ -> compare false false
  | "%lessequal", _ -> compare false true
  | "%greaterequal", _ -> compare true true
  | "%sequand", [ a; b ] ->
      let no = label k and over = label k in
      cx.expr a;
      emit k (Il.Brfalse no);
      cx.expr b;
      emit k (Il.Br over);
      place k no;
      emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l);
      place k over
  | "%sequor", [ a; b ] ->
      let yes = label k and over = label k in
      cx.expr a;
      emit k (Il.Brtrue yes);
      cx.expr b;
      emit k (Il.Br over);
      place k yes;
      emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 1l);
      place k over
  | "%string_length", [ s ] when cts_of c s = S.SzArray S.U1 -> all (); emit k Il.Ldlen; emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i8, false, false))
  | "%string_length", _ -> all (); emit k (Il.Callvirt (lib c "String" "get_Length" (instance [] S.I4))); emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i8, false, false))
  (* (bytes: a byte[]'s element, a uint8, our char an int32) *)
  | ("%string_safe_get" | "%string_unsafe_get"), [ s; i ] when cts_of c s = S.SzArray S.U1 ->
      cx.expr s;
      k.pending <- k.pending + 1; cx.expr i; k.pending <- k.pending - 1;
      emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false));
      emit k (Il.Ldelem Il.K_u1)
  (* (a byte[] made, IL's newarr: the runtime unit's create_string) *)
  | "%bytes_create", _ -> all (); emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false)); emit k (Il.Newarr (sys c "Byte"))
  (* (little-endian 16 and 32 bits at an index of a string or bytes:
   * their bytes, read or written one by one) *)
  | ("%caml_bytes_get16" | "%caml_bytes_get32"), [ s; i ] ->
      let n = if p = "%caml_bytes_get16" then 2 else 4 in
      let st = cts_of c s in
      let sv = local k st and iv = local k S.I4 in
      cx.expr s; emit k (Il.Stloc sv);
      cx.expr i; emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false)); emit k (Il.Stloc iv);
      for j = 0 to n - 1 do
        emit k (Il.Ldloc sv); emit k (Il.Ldloc iv); emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_int j)); emit k (Il.Binop Il.Add);
        if st = S.String then emit k (Il.Callvirt (lib c "String" "get_Chars" (instance [ S.I4 ] S.Char)))
        else emit k (Il.Ldelem Il.K_u1);
        if j > 0 then (emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_int (8 * j))); emit k (Il.Binop Il.Shl); emit k (Il.Binop Il.Or))
      done;
      if n = 2 then emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i8, false, false))
  | ("%caml_bytes_set16" | "%caml_bytes_set32"), [ b; i; x ] ->
      let n = if p = "%caml_bytes_set16" then 2 else 4 in
      let bv = local k (S.SzArray S.U1) and iv = local k S.I4 and xv = local k S.I4 in
      cx.expr b; emit k (Il.Stloc bv);
      cx.expr i; emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false)); emit k (Il.Stloc iv);
      cx.expr x; emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false)); emit k (Il.Stloc xv);
      for j = 0 to n - 1 do
        emit k (Il.Ldloc bv); emit k (Il.Ldloc iv); emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_int j)); emit k (Il.Binop Il.Add);
        emit k (Il.Ldloc xv); emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_int (8 * j))); emit k (Il.Binop Il.Shr);
        emit k (Il.Stelem Il.K_i1)
      done
  (* (Hashtbl.hash's: Ml::hash of the value boxed, the runtime unit's
   * hash_univ_param) *)
  | "%hash", [ a ] ->
      cx.expr a;
      (match cts_of c a with
       | S.I8 -> emit k (Il.Box (sys c "Int64"))
       | S.R8 -> emit k (Il.Box (sys c "Double"))
       | S.I4 -> emit k (Il.Box (sys c "Int32"))
       | S.Bool -> emit k (Il.Box (sys c "Boolean"))
       | (S.Var _ | S.MVar _) as t -> emit k (Il.Box (W.type_spec c.w t))
       | _ -> ());
      emit k (Il.Call (ml_hash c));
      emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i8, false, false))
  (* (Float.Array's, a float64[]) *)
  | "%floatarray_length", _ -> all (); emit k Il.Ldlen; emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i8, false, false))
  | ("%floatarray_safe_get" | "%floatarray_unsafe_get"), [ a; i ] ->
      cx.expr a;
      k.pending <- k.pending + 1; cx.expr i; k.pending <- k.pending - 1;
      emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false));
      emit k (Il.Ldelem Il.K_r8)
  | ("%floatarray_safe_set" | "%floatarray_unsafe_set"), [ a; i; x ] ->
      cx.expr a;
      k.pending <- k.pending + 1; cx.expr i; emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false));
      k.pending <- k.pending + 1; cx.expr x;
      k.pending <- k.pending - 2;
      emit k (Il.Stelem Il.K_r8)
  | "%absfloat", _ -> all (); emit k (Il.Call (lib c "Math" "Abs" (static [ S.R8 ] S.R8)))
  (* (Sys's: .NET's int an int64, its word 64 bits) *)
  | ("%word_size" | "%int_size"), _ -> all (); emit k (Il.Ldc_i8 64L)
  (* (a T[] of n nulls or zeros: the runtime unit's make_vect) *)
  | "%array_create", _ ->
      let tok = match cts_of c e with S.SzArray t -> type_token c t | _ -> refuse e.loc "an array" "1d" in
      all (); emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false)); emit k (Il.Newarr tok)
  | ("%string_safe_set" | "%string_unsafe_set"), [ s; i; x ] when cts_of c s = S.SzArray S.U1 ->
      cx.expr s;
      k.pending <- k.pending + 1; cx.expr i; emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false));
      k.pending <- k.pending + 1; cx.expr x;
      k.pending <- k.pending - 2;
      emit k (Il.Stelem Il.K_i1)
  (* (s.[i]: String's Chars, a UTF-16 unit, a byte here: our char) *)
  | ("%string_safe_get" | "%string_unsafe_get"), [ s; i ] ->
      cx.expr s;
      k.pending <- k.pending + 1;
      cx.expr i;
      k.pending <- k.pending - 1;
      emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false));
      emit k (Il.Callvirt (lib c "String" "get_Chars" (instance [ S.I4 ] S.Char)));
      emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false))
  (* ref, !, :=, incr, decr: Pervasives' 'a ref, a record *)
  | "%makemutable", _ -> cx.values args; emit k (Il.Newobj (record_ctor c e.loc (type_of e)))
  (* (fst and snd: a tuple's Item1 and Item2) *)
  | ("%field0" | "%field1"), [ r ] when (match unabbrev (type_of r) with Ttuple _ -> true | _ -> false) ->
      cx.expr r;
      emit k (Il.Ldfld (tuple_field c e.loc (type_of r) (if p = "%field0" then 0 else 1)));
      if cts_of c e = S.Void then emit k Il.Pop
  (* (Obj.field: .NET's values are no blocks; null, which only
   * Callback.register_exception asks for, its value then ignored) *)
  | "%obj_field", _ -> List.iter cx.drop args; emit k Il.Ldnull
  | "%field0", [ r ] ->
      cx.expr r;
      emit k (Il.Ldfld (field0 c e.loc (type_of r)));
      if cts_of c e = S.Void then emit k Il.Pop
  | "%setfield0", [ r; _ ] -> cx.values args; emit k (Il.Stfld (field0 c e.loc (type_of r)))
  | ("%incr" | "%decr"), [ r ] ->
      let f = field0 c e.loc (type_of r) in
      cx.expr r;
      emit k Il.Dup;
      emit k (Il.Ldfld f);
      emit k (Il.Ldc_i8 1L);
      emit k (Il.Binop (if p = "%incr" then Il.Add else Il.Sub));
      emit k (Il.Stfld f)
  | "compare", [ _; _ ] -> (
      match first () with
      | S.MVar _ | S.Var _ | S.String | S.I8 | S.R8 | S.I4 | S.Bool ->
          (match first () with
           | S.MVar _ | S.Var _ -> boxed ()
           | ty ->
               let box = match ty with S.String -> [] | S.I8 -> [ Il.Box (sys c "Int64") ] | S.R8 -> [ Il.Box (sys c "Double") ] | S.I4 -> [ Il.Box (sys c "Int32") ] | _ -> [ Il.Box (sys c "Boolean") ] in
               (match args with
                | [ a; b ] ->
                    cx.expr a; List.iter (emit k) box;
                    k.pending <- k.pending + 1; cx.expr b; List.iter (emit k) box; k.pending <- k.pending - 1
                | _ -> ()));
          emit k (Il.Call (ml_compare c));
          emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i8, false, false))
      | S.Class _ | S.GenericInst _ -> all (); emit k (Il.Call (ml_compare c)); emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i8, false, false))
      | S.SzArray S.U1 -> as_strings (); emit k (Il.Call (ml_compare c)); emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i8, false, false))
      (* (an array's: its length, then its elements) *)
      | S.SzArray t ->
          all ();
          emit k (Il.Call (memo c ("array_compare " ^ S.encode_type_spec t) (fun () -> W.method_spec c.w (ml_array_compare c) [ t ])));
          emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i8, false, false))
      | _ -> refuse e.loc "compare of a value of no order (a function)" "1d")
  (* an array's length, an element read and written (an index an
   * int32: IL's) *)
  | "%array_length", _ -> all (); emit k Il.Ldlen; emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i8, false, false))
  | ("%array_safe_get" | "%array_unsafe_get"), [ a; i ] ->
      let tok = match cts_of c a with S.SzArray t -> type_token c t | _ -> refuse e.loc "an array" "1d" in
      cx.expr a;
      k.pending <- k.pending + 1; cx.expr i; k.pending <- k.pending - 1;
      emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false));
      emit k (Il.Ldelem_any tok);
      if cts_of c e = S.Void then emit k Il.Pop
  | ("%array_safe_set" | "%array_unsafe_set"), [ a; i; x ] ->
      let tok = match cts_of c a with S.SzArray t -> type_token c t | _ -> refuse e.loc "an array" "1d" in
      cx.expr a;
      k.pending <- k.pending + 1; cx.expr i; emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false));
      k.pending <- k.pending + 1; cx.expr x; if cts_of c x = S.Void then emit k Il.Ldnull;
      k.pending <- k.pending - 2;
      emit k (Il.Stelem_any tok)
  (* (bytes a string and back, Bytes.to_string's: a copy, by the
   * runtime unit's functions, .NET's string being another object) *)
  | "%identity", [ a ] when (match cts_of c a, cts_of c e with S.SzArray S.U1, S.String | S.String, S.SzArray S.U1 -> true | _ -> false) ->
      let name = if cts_of c a = S.String then "Runtime.bytes_of_string" else "Runtime.string_of_bytes" in
      (match Hashtbl.find_opt env.by_sym name with
       | Some f -> all (); emit k (Il.Call f.tok)
       | None -> refuse e.loc ("bytes and strings, without the runtime unit's " ^ name) "3b")
  (* (an int a char and back, Char.code's: int64 and int32; an abstract
   * type's object the class it is) *)
  | "%identity", [ a ] ->
      all ();
      (* (Obj.repr (): unit's nothing an object's null, and back) *)
      (match cts_of c a, cts_of c e with
       | S.Void, t -> default k t
       | _, S.Void -> emit k Il.Pop
       | f, t -> Il_externals.convert c k f t)
  | "%ignore", [ a ] -> cx.drop a
  | "%raise", [ a ] -> cx.expr a; emit k Il.Throw
  (* (a primitive of the native runtime's C: the library's) *)
  | _ when String.length p > 0 && p.[0] <> '%' -> refuse e.loc ("the primitive " ^ p ^ ", not in the runtime unit (lib_core/dotnet/Runtime.ml)") "3b"
  | _ -> refuse e.loc ("the primitive " ^ p) "1a"

(* The primitives' calls, IL: an external's of OCaml's (%addint, a
 * comparison, an array's element, Obj.repr...), its code here; one of
 * C (sqrt_float, caml_flush), a call of the runtime unit's function of
 * its name (lib_core/dotnet/Runtime.ml), its arguments converted to the
 * function's parameters; one naming a .NET member (decision 7: dotnet:

  expr : Scope.expr -> unit;
  operands : Scope.expr list -> unit;
  values : Scope.expr list -> unit;
  drop : Scope.expr -> unit;

 * not polymorphic; false (nothing emitted) otherwise *)
val runtime_call :
  Il_code.c -> Il_code.code -> compiler -> Scope.expr -> Il_functions.fn -> Scope.expr list -> bool

(* a value of the type where a call left none (a raise's method, a
 * unit's): never reached, the stack typed as the caller's *)

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Il_printf.mli *)

module S = Signature
module W = Writer
open Il_code
open Il_types
open Il_functions

type piece =
  | Text of string
  | Conv of string * char       (* its spec, %-5d, and its letter *)
  | Flush                       (* %! *)

(* [format]: Format's, its @ directives text: @. and @\n a newline,
 * @  and @; a space, @@ an @, the boxes and the rest nothing (no
 * pretty-printing: a string is made) *)
let parse (loc : int) (format : bool) (f : string) : piece list =
  let n = String.length f in
  let b = Buffer.create 16 and out = ref [] in
  let text () = if Buffer.length b > 0 then (out := Text (Buffer.contents b) :: !out; Buffer.clear b) in
  let i = ref 0 in
  (* (a directive's <...>, skipped) *)
  let skip_angle () = if !i < n && f.[!i] = '<' then (while !i < n && f.[!i] <> '>' do incr i done; incr i) in
  while !i < n do
    if format && f.[!i] = '@' && !i + 1 < n then begin
      let ch = f.[!i + 1] in
      i := !i + 2;
      match ch with
      | '@' -> Buffer.add_char b '@'
      | '.' | '\n' -> Buffer.add_char b '\n'
      | ' ' -> Buffer.add_char b ' '
      | ';' -> Buffer.add_char b ' '; skip_angle ()
      | '[' -> skip_angle ()
      | '{' -> skip_angle ()
      | _ -> ()
    end
    else if f.[!i] <> '%' then (Buffer.add_char b f.[!i]; incr i)
    else if !i + 1 < n && f.[!i + 1] = '%' then (Buffer.add_char b '%'; i := !i + 2)
    else if !i + 1 < n && f.[!i + 1] = '!' then (text (); out := Flush :: !out; i := !i + 2)
    else begin
      let j = ref (!i + 1) in
      while !j < n && String.contains "-0+ #.123456789" f.[!j] do incr j done;
      while !j < n && (f.[!j] = 'l' || f.[!j] = 'L' || f.[!j] = 'n') do incr j done;
      if !j >= n then refuse loc "a format ending in %" "3c";
      text ();
      out := Conv (String.sub f !i (!j - !i + 1), f.[!j]) :: !out;
      i := !j + 1
    end
  done;
  text ();
  List.rev !out

let printers =
  [ "Printf.printf"; "Printf.eprintf"; "Printf.sprintf"; "Printf.fprintf"; "Printf.bprintf"; "Printf.ksprintf";
    "Format.asprintf"; "Format.sprintf" ]

(* the arguments before the format: fprintf's channel, bprintf's
 * buffer, ksprintf's continuation *)
let before (sym : string) : int = match sym with "Printf.fprintf" | "Printf.bprintf" | "Printf.ksprintf" -> 1 | _ -> 0

(* (a format with %a or %t, or given fewer arguments than it takes: a
 * value, Il_exprs.format_value's, given to the overlay's function) *)
let applies (sym : string) (args : Scope.expr list) : bool =
  List.mem sym printers
  && (match List.nth_opt args (before sym) with
      | Some { e = Econst (String s); _ } ->
          let pieces = parse 0 (String.length sym > 7 && String.sub sym 0 7 = "Format.") s in
          let convs = List.length (List.filter (fun (p : piece) -> match p with Conv _ -> true | _ -> false) pieces) in
          not (List.exists (fun (p : piece) -> match p with Conv (_, ('a' | 't')) -> true | _ -> false) pieces)
          && List.length args = before sym + 1 + convs
      | _ -> false)

let call (env : env) (k : code) (sym : string) =
  match Hashtbl.find_opt env.by_sym sym with
  | Some f -> emit k (Il.Call f.tok)
  | None -> refuse 0 (sym ^ ", a printf's, its unit not compiled") "3c"

let compile (c : c) (env : env) (k : code) (expr : Scope.expr -> unit) (e : Scope.expr) (sym : string) (args : Scope.expr list) : unit =
  let pre = before sym in
  let fmt = match List.nth args pre with { e = Econst (String s); _ } -> s | _ -> "" in
  let pieces = parse e.loc (String.length sym > 7 && String.sub sym 0 7 = "Format.") fmt in
  let convs = List.filter (fun (p : piece) -> match p with Conv _ -> true | _ -> false) pieces in
  let rest = List.filteri (fun (i : int) (_ : Scope.expr) -> i > pre) args in
  if List.length rest <> List.length convs then
    refuse e.loc (sym ^ " given fewer or more arguments than its format's conversions") "3c";
  (* (the channel, buffer or continuation, then the arguments: in locals,
   * in order) *)
  let into (a : Scope.expr) : int option =
    let t = cts_of c a in
    expr a;
    if t = S.Void then None else (let v = local k t in emit k (Il.Stloc v); Some v) in
  let target = if pre = 1 then into (List.hd args) else None in
  let values = List.map (fun (a : Scope.expr) -> (a, into a)) rest in
  let load (v : int option) = match v with Some v -> emit k (Il.Ldloc v) | None -> () in
  (* the string, piece by piece *)
  let first = ref true in
  let joined () =
    if !first then first := false
    else emit k (Il.Call (lib c "String" "Concat" (static [ S.String; S.String ] S.String))) in
  let values = ref values in
  List.iter
    (fun (p : piece) ->
      match p with
      | Text s -> emit k (Il.Ldstr (W.user_string c.w s)); joined ()
      | Flush -> ()
      | Conv (spec, ch) ->
          let a, v = match !values with x :: r -> values := r; x | [] -> assert false in
          let t = cts_of c a in
          let arg (into_t : S.t) = load v; Il_externals.convert c k t into_t in
          let runtime (name : string) (into_t : S.t) =
            emit k (Il.Ldstr (W.user_string c.w spec)); arg into_t; call env k ("Runtime." ^ name) in
          (match ch with
           | 'd' | 'i' | 'u' | 'x' | 'X' | 'o' -> runtime "format_int" S.I8
           | 'f' | 'e' | 'E' | 'g' | 'G' | 'h' | 'H' -> runtime "format_float" S.R8
           | 's' when spec = "%s" -> load v
           | 's' -> runtime "format_string" S.String
           | 'c' -> runtime "format_char" S.I4
           | 'S' -> runtime "format_quoted" S.String
           | 'C' -> runtime "format_quoted_char" S.I4
           | 'b' | 'B' -> runtime "format_bool" S.Bool
           | ch -> refuse a.loc (Printf.sprintf "%%%c in a format compiled (a printer, %%a or %%t: the library's Printf)" ch) "3c");
          joined ())
    pieces;
  if !first then emit k (Il.Ldstr (W.user_string c.w ""));
  let flushes = List.exists (fun (p : piece) -> p = Flush) pieces in
  let channel (name : string) =
    match Hashtbl.find_opt env.fields name with
    | Some (f, _) -> emit k (Il.Ldsfld f)
    | None -> refuse e.loc (name ^ ", its unit not compiled") "3c" in
  match sym with
  | "Printf.sprintf" | "Format.asprintf" | "Format.sprintf" -> ()
  | "Printf.printf" ->
      call env k "Pervasives.print_string";
      if flushes then (channel "Pervasives.stdout"; call env k "Runtime.caml_flush")
  | "Printf.eprintf" ->
      call env k "Pervasives.prerr_string";
      if flushes then (channel "Pervasives.stderr"; call env k "Runtime.caml_flush")
  | "Printf.fprintf" | "Printf.bprintf" ->
      let s = local k S.String in
      emit k (Il.Stloc s);
      load target;
      emit k (Il.Ldloc s);
      call env k (if sym = "Printf.fprintf" then "Pervasives.output_string" else "Buffer.add_string");
      if flushes && sym = "Printf.fprintf" then (load target; call env k "Runtime.caml_flush")
  | _ ->
      (* ksprintf: k's Invoke of the string, its result the call's *)
      let s = local k S.String in
      emit k (Il.Stloc s);
      load target;
      emit k (Il.Ldloc s);
      let kt = cts_of c (List.hd args) in
      emit k (Il.Callvirt (invoke c kt));
      if cts_of c e = S.Void then emit k Il.Pop
languages/ml/dotnet/Il_printf.mli
2097
(* Printf's functions given a literal format, compiled: the format's
 * pieces at compile time, as the type checker read it, each conversion
 * a call of the runtime unit's formatter, the pieces joined, the
 * string then where the function puts it:
 *
 *   Printf.printf "%s is %5d\n" name n
 *     ->  Ldloc name                               (%s: itself)
 *         Ldstr " is "; Concat
 *         Ldstr "%5d"; Ldloc n; call Runtime::format_int; Concat
 *         Ldstr "\n"; Concat
 *         call Pervasives::print_string
 *
 * lib_core's Printf interprets the format at run time, a string, and
 * builds its result's closures with Obj.magic: untyped, what .NET's
 * delegates, typed, cannot be without casts the verifier refuses
 * (decision 6's "untyped corners" of lib_core). printf, eprintf,
 * sprintf, fprintf, bprintf, ksprintf with all their arguments; %d %i
 * %u %x %X %o (an int, an int32's, an int64's), %f %e %E %g %G, %s, %c,
 * %b, %!, flags, width and precision. Refused: %a and %t (a printer of
 * the program's), a format that is not a literal, a printf given fewer
 * arguments (Printf's own then, which does not run here).
 *
 * others:
 * F#'s printf is typed as this one (the format's type from its
 * literal) and run by FSharp.Core, a cache of each format's parsed
 * pieces; C#'s interpolated strings ($"{name} is {n,5}") are compiled
 * as here, a DefaultInterpolatedStringHandler's appends; OCaml's own
 * is CamlinternalFormat's GADT, typed, interpreted at run time. *)

(* a format's pieces; Format's (true), its @ directives text *)
type piece = Text of string | Conv of string * char | Flush
val parse : int -> bool -> string -> piece list

(* is it a call of one of Printf's functions with a literal format
 * (Format's asprintf and sprintf too)? *)
val applies : string -> Scope.expr list -> bool

(* the call compiled, given the function's symbol, its arguments, and
 * the compiler of an expression (Il_exprs.expr's) *)
val compile :
  Il_code.c -> Il_functions.env -> Il_code.code -> (Scope.expr -> unit) -> Scope.expr -> string -> Scope.expr list -> unit

(* Claude Code

(* See Il_types.mli *)

module S = Signature
module W = Writer
open Il_code

(*****************************************************************************)
(* A type's class *)
(*****************************************************************************)

(* a class made for a type (a record, a variant, a variant's
 * constructor): its TypeDef, its generic parameters' number, its
 * fields' names and types as declared (in its own parameters, !0...),
 * their FieldDefs, its constructor (the fields in order) *)
type tclass = {
  tok : int;
  arity : int;
  mutable fields : (string * S.t) list;
  mutable ftoks : int list;
  mutable ctor : int;
}

(* the unit's, by type (path) and by constructor (path|name) *)
let classes : (string, tclass) Hashtbl.t = Hashtbl.create 16

(* the types of the expressions this back end makes (a primitive as a
 * value, η-expanded), by their spans, which no source has *)
let synthetic : (Ast.span, Scope.ty) Hashtbl.t = Hashtbl.create 16

(* and of the variables those bind (by their ids, negative) *)
let synthetic_vars : (int, Scope.ty) Hashtbl.t = Hashtbl.create 16

let var_type (vid : int) : Scope.ty option =
  match Hashtbl.find_opt synthetic_vars vid with Some t -> Some t | None -> Typing.var_type vid

(* the types the assembly's units declare, by path: what another unit,
 * whose .mli says type t abstract, sees of them (Uchar.utf_decode an
 * int) *)
let implementations : (string, Scope.tdecl) Hashtbl.t = Hashtbl.create 64

(* a type's key among the classes: its path, a unit's own qualified by
 * the unit (Asm's mem is Asm.mem in Opti; two units' t two classes);
 * the predefined list as it is *)
let qkey (c : c) (d : Scope.tdecl) : string =
  if d == Resolve.list_d || String.contains d.tpath '.' then d.tpath else c.uname ^ "." ^ d.tpath

(* a constant constructor's class: its static field Instance *)
let instances : (int, int) Hashtbl.t = Hashtbl.create 16

let reset () : unit =
  Hashtbl.reset classes; Hashtbl.reset synthetic; Hashtbl.reset synthetic_vars; Hashtbl.reset implementations;
  Hashtbl.reset instances

(* a class's own parameters, !0..., as its methods see them *)
let own (t : tclass) : S.t list = List.init t.arity (fun (i : int) -> S.Var i)

(* the class at type arguments: itself, or its instance *)
let at (t : tclass) (args : S.t list) : S.t = if t.arity = 0 then S.Class t.tok else S.GenericInst (S.Class t.tok, args)

(* its token for isinst, castclass, a parent: the TypeDef, or the
 * instance's TypeSpec *)
let type_tok (c : c) (t : tclass) (args : S.t list) : int = if t.arity = 0 then t.tok else W.type_spec c.w (at t args)

(* its i-th field at type arguments: the FieldDef, or a MemberRef on the
 * instance (C#'s, and what a generic class's own methods use) *)
let field_tok (c : c) (t : tclass) (args : S.t list) (i : int) : int =
  if t.arity = 0 then List.nth t.ftoks i
  else
    let name, ty = List.nth t.fields i in
    memo c ("field " ^ S.encode_type_spec (at t args) ^ "." ^ name) (fun () -> W.field_ref c.w (W.type_spec c.w (at t args)) name ty)

let ctor_tok (c : c) (t : tclass) (args : S.t list) : int =
  if t.arity = 0 then t.ctor
  else
    memo c ("ctor " ^ S.encode_type_spec (at t args)) (fun () ->
        W.member_ref c.w (W.type_spec c.w (at t args)) ".ctor" (instance (List.map snd t.fields) S.Void))

(* a constant constructor's one value (OCaml's None == None): its
 * class's static field Instance, made by its .cctor, at type arguments *)
let instance_tok (c : c) (t : tclass) (args : S.t list) : int =
  if t.arity = 0 then Hashtbl.find instances t.tok
  else
    memo c ("instance " ^ S.encode_type_spec (at t args)) (fun () ->
        W.field_ref c.w (W.type_spec c.w (at t args)) "Instance" (at t (own t)))

(* a method of such a class at its instance: the MethodDef, or a
 * MemberRef of the instance, its signature the declared one *)
let method_tok (c : c) (t : tclass) (args : S.t list) (name : string) (tok : int) (m : S.meth) : int =
  if t.arity = 0 then tok
  else memo c ("method " ^ S.encode_type_spec (at t args) ^ "." ^ name) (fun () -> W.member_ref c.w (W.type_spec c.w (at t args)) name m)

(* the assembly's class of ML's helpers, Stdlib.Ml (compare, hash) *)
let ml_class (c : c) : int =
  memo c "type Stdlib.Ml" (fun () -> W.type_def c.w "Stdlib" "Ml" 0x00100181 (sys c "Object"))

(* OCaml's compare of two values of a type variable, boxed: the
 * assembly's helper Stdlib.Ml::compare(object, object), made once: a
 * string's ordinal, an int's, a float's, a char's, a boolean's order;
 * another value (a record's, a variant's: OCaml's structural order, not
 * yet) an exception *)
let ml_compare (c : c) : int =
  memo c "ml compare" (fun () ->
      let cls = ml_class c in
      let m = W.method_def c.w cls "compare" 0x0096 (static [ S.Object; S.Object ] S.I4) in
      let k = new_code () in
      let order (ty : string) (t : S.t) =
        (* (a < b: -1, a > b: 1, else 0) *)
        let next = label k in
        emit k (Il.Ldarg 0);
        emit k (Il.Isinst (sys c ty));
        emit k (Il.Brfalse next);
        let x = local k t and y = local k t in
        emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Unbox_any (sys c ty)); emit k (Il.Stloc x);
        emit k (Il.Ldarg 1); emit k (Il.Unbox_any (sys c ty)); emit k (Il.Stloc y);
        let not_less = label k and not_more = label k in
        emit k (Il.Ldloc x); emit k (Il.Ldloc y); emit k (Il.Clt false); emit k (Il.Brfalse not_less);
        emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 (-1l)); emit k Il.Ret;
        place k not_less;
        emit k (Il.Ldloc x); emit k (Il.Ldloc y); emit k (Il.Cgt false); emit k (Il.Brfalse not_more);
        emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 1l); emit k Il.Ret;
        place k not_more;
        emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l); emit k Il.Ret;
        place k next in
      (* (unit, null: equal to itself, before anything else) *)
      let a_set = label k and b_set = label k in
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Brtrue a_set);
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 1); emit k (Il.Ldnull); emit k (Il.Cgt true); emit k (Il.Neg); emit k Il.Ret;
      place k a_set;
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 1); emit k (Il.Brtrue b_set);
      emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 1l); emit k Il.Ret;
      place k b_set;
      (* (a string's: CompareOrdinal's sign, -1, 0 or 1 as OCaml's) *)
      let not_string = label k in
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0);
      emit k (Il.Isinst (sys c "String"));
      emit k (Il.Brfalse not_string);
      let d = local k S.I4 in
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Castclass (sys c "String"));
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 1); emit k (Il.Castclass (sys c "String"));
      emit k (Il.Call (lib c "String" "CompareOrdinal" (static [ S.String; S.String ] S.I4)));
      emit k (Il.Stloc d);
      emit k (Il.Ldloc d); emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l); emit k (Il.Cgt false);
      emit k (Il.Ldloc d); emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l); emit k (Il.Clt false);
      emit k (Il.Binop Il.Sub);
      emit k Il.Ret;
      place k not_string;
      order "Int64" S.I8;
      order "Double" S.R8;
      order "Int32" S.I4;
      order "Boolean" S.Bool;
      (* (a record's, a variant's, a tuple's, a list's: their CompareTo,
       * structural, IComparable's) *)
      let none = label k in
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Isinst (sys c "IComparable")); emit k (Il.Brfalse none);
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Castclass (sys c "IComparable")); emit k (Il.Ldarg 1);
      emit k (Il.Callvirt (lib c "IComparable" "CompareTo" (instance [ S.Object ] S.I4)));
      emit k Il.Ret;
      place k none;
      emit k (Il.Ldstr (W.user_string c.w "compare: a value of no order (a function, an array)"));
      emit k (Il.Newobj (lib c "Exception" ".ctor" (instance [ S.String ] S.Void)));
      emit k Il.Throw;
      finish c k m;
      m)

(* = of two arrays (OCaml's: their lengths and elements, not their
 * places): the assembly's helper Stdlib.Ml::array_equal<T>(T[], T[]),
 * each pair of elements by Object.Equals, boxed (a record's, a
 * variant's structural, a number's or a string's by value); an array
 * inside a record or another array still compared as a place *)
let ml_array_equal (c : c) : int =
  memo c "ml array_equal" (fun () ->
      let cls = ml_class c in
      let a = S.SzArray (S.MVar 0) in
      let m = W.method_def c.w cls "array_equal" 0x0096 { (static [ a; a ] S.Bool) with generic = 1 } in
      W.generic_param c.w m 0 "T";
      let t = W.type_spec c.w (S.MVar 0) in
      let k = new_code () in
      let yes = label k and no = label k and top = label k in
      let i = local k S.I4 in
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Ldarg 1); emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Eq, false, yes));
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Brfalse no);
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 1); emit k (Il.Brfalse no);
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k Il.Ldlen; emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false));
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 1); emit k Il.Ldlen; emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false));
      emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Ne, true, no));
      emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l); emit k (Il.Stloc i);
      place k top;
      emit k (Il.Ldloc i); emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k Il.Ldlen; emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false));
      emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Ge, false, yes));
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Ldloc i); emit k (Il.Ldelem_any t); emit k (Il.Box t);
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 1); emit k (Il.Ldloc i); emit k (Il.Ldelem_any t); emit k (Il.Box t);
      emit k (Il.Call (lib c "Object" "Equals" (static [ S.Object; S.Object ] S.Bool)));
      emit k (Il.Brfalse no);
      emit k (Il.Ldloc i); emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 1l); emit k (Il.Binop Il.Add); emit k (Il.Stloc i);
      emit k (Il.Br top);
      place k yes; emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 1l); emit k Il.Ret;
      place k no; emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l); emit k Il.Ret;
      finish c k m;
      m)

(* compare of two arrays, OCaml's order: the shorter first, then by
 * their elements in turn, each pair by the assembly's Ml::compare,
 * boxed: the helper Stdlib.Ml::array_compare<T>(T[], T[]) *)
let ml_array_compare (c : c) : int =
  memo c "ml array_compare" (fun () ->
      let cls = ml_class c in
      let a = S.SzArray (S.MVar 0) in
      let m = W.method_def c.w cls "array_compare" 0x0096 { (static [ a; a ] S.I4) with generic = 1 } in
      W.generic_param c.w m 0 "T";
      let t = W.type_spec c.w (S.MVar 0) in
      let k = new_code () in
      let i = local k S.I4 and d = local k S.I4 and n = local k S.I4 in
      let top = label k and equal = label k and same_length = label k in
      let length (arg : int) = emit k (Il.Ldarg arg); emit k Il.Ldlen; emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false)) in
      (* (the lengths' order: -1, 0 or 1) *)
      length 0; length 1; emit k (Il.Cgt false);
      length 0; length 1; emit k (Il.Clt false);
      emit k (Il.Binop Il.Sub); emit k (Il.Stloc d);
      emit k (Il.Ldloc d); emit k (Il.Brfalse same_length);
      emit k (Il.Ldloc d); emit k Il.Ret;
      place k same_length;
      length 0; emit k (Il.Stloc n);
      emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l); emit k (Il.Stloc i);
      place k top;
      emit k (Il.Ldloc i); emit k (Il.Ldloc n); emit k (Il.Bcmp (Il.Ge, false, equal));
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Ldloc i); emit k (Il.Ldelem_any t); emit k (Il.Box t);
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 1); emit k (Il.Ldloc i); emit k (Il.Ldelem_any t); emit k (Il.Box t);
      emit k (Il.Call (ml_compare c)); emit k (Il.Stloc d);
      let next = label k in
      emit k (Il.Ldloc d); emit k (Il.Brfalse next);
      emit k (Il.Ldloc d); emit k Il.Ret;
      place k next;
      emit k (Il.Ldloc i); emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 1l); emit k (Il.Binop Il.Add); emit k (Il.Stloc i);
      emit k (Il.Br top);
      place k equal; emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l); emit k Il.Ret;
      finish c k m;
      m)

(* OCaml's Hashtbl.hash of a value: the assembly's helper
 * Stdlib.Ml::hash(object), made once, the same on every runtime (.NET's
 * String.GetHashCode is not: Microsoft's varies by process): a
 * string's chars (h * 31 + c), an int64's halves, a float's bits, an
 * int32's or a boolean's value, an ML value's structural GetHashCode
 * (which hashes its fields here), null 0 *)
let ml_hash (c : c) : int =
  memo c "ml hash" (fun () ->
      let cls = ml_class c in
      let m = W.method_def c.w cls "hash" 0x0096 (static [ S.Object ] S.I4) in
      let k = new_code () in
      let set = label k in
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Brtrue set); emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l); emit k Il.Ret;
      place k set;
      (* a string *)
      let not_string = label k in
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Isinst (sys c "String")); emit k (Il.Brfalse not_string);
      let str = local k S.String and h = local k S.I4 and i = local k S.I4 in
      let top = label k and over = label k in
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Castclass (sys c "String")); emit k (Il.Stloc str);
      emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l); emit k (Il.Stloc h);
      emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l); emit k (Il.Stloc i);
      place k top;
      emit k (Il.Ldloc i); emit k (Il.Ldloc str);
      emit k (Il.Callvirt (lib c "String" "get_Length" (instance [] S.I4)));
      emit k (Il.Clt false); emit k (Il.Brfalse over);
      emit k (Il.Ldloc h); emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 31l); emit k (Il.Binop Il.Mul);
      emit k (Il.Ldloc str); emit k (Il.Ldloc i);
      emit k (Il.Callvirt (lib c "String" "get_Chars" (instance [ S.I4 ] S.Char)));
      emit k (Il.Binop Il.Add); emit k (Il.Stloc h);
      emit k (Il.Ldloc i); emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 1l); emit k (Il.Binop Il.Add); emit k (Il.Stloc i);
      emit k (Il.Br top);
      place k over;
      emit k (Il.Ldloc h); emit k Il.Ret;
      place k not_string;
      (* an int64, a float (its bits): the two halves *)
      let halves () =
        emit k Il.Dup; emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 32l); emit k (Il.Binop Il.Shr); emit k (Il.Binop Il.Xor);
        emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false)); emit k Il.Ret in
      let not_long = label k in
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Isinst (sys c "Int64")); emit k (Il.Brfalse not_long);
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Unbox_any (sys c "Int64")); halves ();
      place k not_long;
      let not_double = label k in
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Isinst (sys c "Double")); emit k (Il.Brfalse not_double);
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Unbox_any (sys c "Double"));
      emit k (Il.Call (lib c "BitConverter" "DoubleToInt64Bits" (static [ S.R8 ] S.I8))); halves ();
      place k not_double;
      let value (name : string) (t : S.t) =
        let next = label k in
        emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Isinst (sys c name)); emit k (Il.Brfalse next);
        emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Unbox_any (sys c name));
        if t = S.Bool then emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false));
        emit k Il.Ret;
        place k next in
      value "Int32" S.I4;
      value "Boolean" S.Bool;
      (* an ML value's, and any other's *)
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0);
      emit k (Il.Callvirt (lib c "Object" "GetHashCode" (instance [] S.I4)));
      emit k Il.Ret;
      finish c k m;
      m)

(* structural equality, F#'s: Equals of an object of the same class
 * whose fields are equal (an int's, a float's, a string's text, an ML
 * value's own Equals, a type parameter's boxed), and GetHashCode of the
 * fields', so that = is a call of Equals, and a .NET set or dictionary
 * holds ML values as OCaml's = sees them *)
let structural (c : c) (t : tclass) (tag : int) (variant : (tclass * int * int) option) : unit =
  let me = own t in
  let fields = List.mapi (fun (i : int) ((_, ty) : string * S.t) -> (field_tok c t me i, ty)) t.fields in
  let box (ty : S.t) (k : code) = match ty with S.Var _ -> emit k (Il.Box (W.type_spec c.w ty)) | _ -> () in
  let eq = W.method_def c.w t.tok "Equals" 0x00C6 (instance [ S.Object ] S.Bool) in
  let k = new_code () in
  let o = local k (at t me) and no = label k in
  emit k (Il.Ldarg 1);
  emit k (Il.Isinst (type_tok c t me));
  emit k (Il.Stloc o);
  emit k (Il.Ldloc o);
  emit k (Il.Brfalse no);
  List.iter
    (fun ((f, ty) : int * S.t) ->
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0);
      emit k (Il.Ldfld f);
      box ty k;
      emit k (Il.Ldloc o);
      emit k (Il.Ldfld f);
      box ty k;
      (match ty with
       | S.String -> emit k (Il.Call (lib c "String" "op_Equality" (static [ S.String; S.String ] S.Bool)))
       | S.Class _ | S.GenericInst _ | S.Var _ -> emit k (Il.Callvirt (lib c "Object" "Equals" (instance [ S.Object ] S.Bool)))
       | _ -> emit k Il.Ceq);
      emit k (Il.Brfalse no))
    fields;
  emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 1l);
  emit k Il.Ret;
  place k no;
  emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l);
  emit k Il.Ret;
  finish c k eq;
  let hash = W.method_def c.w t.tok "GetHashCode" 0x00C6 (instance [] S.I4) in
  let k = new_code () in
  emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_int tag));
  List.iter
    (fun ((f, ty) : int * S.t) ->
      emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 31l);
      emit k (Il.Binop Il.Mul);
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0);
      emit k (Il.Ldfld f);
      (match ty with
       | S.I8 ->
           (* (its two halves mixed) *)
           emit k Il.Dup;
           emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 32l);
           emit k (Il.Binop Il.Shr);
           emit k (Il.Binop Il.Xor);
           emit k (Il.Conv (Il.K_i4, false, false))
       (* (the others by Ml::hash: a string's the same everywhere, null's 0) *)
       | S.R8 -> emit k (Il.Box (sys c "Double")); emit k (Il.Call (ml_hash c))
       | S.Var _ -> box ty k; emit k (Il.Call (ml_hash c))
       | S.String | S.Class _ | S.GenericInst _ -> emit k (Il.Call (ml_hash c))
       (* (an abstract type's object, an array: Equals compares their
        * references, so nothing of theirs) *)
       | S.Object | S.SzArray _ -> emit k Il.Pop; emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l)
       | _ -> ());
      emit k (Il.Binop Il.Add))
    fields;
  emit k Il.Ret;
  finish c k hash;
  (* CompareTo, OCaml's order (IComparable's, which Ml::compare calls):
   * a variant's constructors by their order ([variant]: the parent,
   * its ml_order, this one's: OCaml's constants before its blocks),
   * then the fields in turn *)
  let cmp = W.method_def c.w t.tok "CompareTo" 0x01E6 (instance [ S.Object ] S.I4) in
  W.implements c.w t.tok (sys c "IComparable");
  let k = new_code () in
  (match variant with
   | Some (parent, ord, order) ->
       let other = local k S.I4 and same = label k and more = label k in
       emit k (Il.Ldarg 1);
       emit k (Il.Castclass (type_tok c parent me));
       emit k (Il.Callvirt (method_tok c parent me "ml_order" ord (instance [] S.I4)));
       emit k (Il.Stloc other);
       emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_int order)); emit k (Il.Ldloc other); emit k Il.Ceq; emit k (Il.Brtrue same);
       emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_int order)); emit k (Il.Ldloc other); emit k (Il.Clt false); emit k (Il.Brfalse more);
       emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 (-1l)); emit k Il.Ret;
       place k more;
       emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 1l); emit k Il.Ret;
       place k same
   | None -> ());
  let y = local k (at t me) and over = label k in
  emit k (Il.Ldarg 1); emit k (Il.Castclass (type_tok c t me)); emit k (Il.Stloc y);
  let boxed (ty : S.t) =
    match ty with
    | S.I8 -> emit k (Il.Box (sys c "Int64"))
    | S.R8 -> emit k (Il.Box (sys c "Double"))
    | S.I4 -> emit k (Il.Box (sys c "Int32"))
    | S.Bool -> emit k (Il.Box (sys c "Boolean"))
    | S.Var _ | S.MVar _ -> emit k (Il.Box (W.type_spec c.w ty))
    | _ -> () in
  List.iter
    (fun ((f, ty) : int * S.t) ->
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0); emit k (Il.Ldfld f); boxed ty;
      emit k (Il.Ldloc y); emit k (Il.Ldfld f); boxed ty;
      emit k (Il.Call (ml_compare c));
      emit k Il.Dup; emit k (Il.Brtrue over); emit k Il.Pop)
    fields;
  emit k (Il.Ldc_i4 0l); emit k Il.Ret;
  place k over;
  emit k Il.Ret;
  finish c k cmp

(* a constructor taking the fields in order, after its parent's *)
let constructor (c : c) (t : tclass) (parent_ctor : int) : unit =
  let ctor = W.method_def c.w t.tok ".ctor" 0x1886 (instance (List.map snd t.fields) S.Void) in
  t.ctor <- ctor;
  let me = own t in
  let k = new_code () in
  emit k (Il.Ldarg 0);
  emit k (Il.Call parent_ctor);
  List.iteri
    (fun (i : int) (_ : string * S.t) ->
      emit k (Il.Ldarg 0);
      emit k (Il.Ldarg (i + 1));
      emit k (Il.Stfld (field_tok c t me i)))
    t.fields;
  emit k Il.Ret;
  finish c k ctor

(* a class of the lowering's own (a closure's, a partial application's):
 * nested in the unit's class, sealed, generic in [arity] parameters
 * (the enclosing method's or class's type variables, its own !0...),
 * its fields (declared in those) set by its constructor *)
let helper_class (c : c) (name : string) (arity : int) (fields : (string * S.t) list) : tclass =
  let tok = W.type_def c.w "" (if arity > 0 then Printf.sprintf "%s`%d" name arity else name) 0x00100102 (sys c "Object") in
  W.nest c.w tok c.cls;
  for i = 0 to arity - 1 do
    W.generic_param c.w tok i (Printf.sprintf "T%d" i)
  done;
  let t = { tok; arity; fields; ftoks = List.map (fun ((n, ty) : string * S.t) -> W.field_def c.w tok n 0x0006 ty) fields; ctor = 0 } in
  constructor c t (object_ctor c);
  t

(*****************************************************************************)
(* Types *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let decl (t : Scope.ty) : Scope.tdecl = match t with Tconstr (d, _) -> d | _ -> assert false
let int_d = decl Resolve.int_t and bool_d = decl Resolve.bool_t and unit_d = decl Resolve.unit_t
let char_d = decl Resolve.char_t and float_d = decl Resolve.float_t and string_d = decl Resolve.string_t
let exn_d = decl Resolve.exn_t

(* the list's constructors, the language's own, which Resolve's tables
 * of a type's constructors have not (they are Resolve's predefined
 * ones, as written there) *)
let list_conses : (string * Scope.cons) list =
  let list = Scope.Tconstr (Resolve.list_d, [ Tvar "a" ]) in
  [ ("[]", { cname = "[]"; kind = Const 0; arity = 0; nconst = 1; nblock = 1; ctype = ([ "a" ], [], list); cinline = [] });
    ("::", { cname = "::"; kind = Block 0; arity = 2; nconst = 1; nblock = 1; ctype = ([ "a" ], [ Tvar "a"; list ], list); cinline = [] }) ]

let conses (d : Scope.tdecl) : (string * Scope.cons) list option =
  if d == Resolve.list_d then Some list_conses else Resolve.type_conses d

(* a type's namespace and name: a path's own, else the unit's *)
let split (c : c) (path : string) : string * string =
  match String.rindex_opt path '.' with
  | Some i -> (String.sub path 0 i, String.sub path (i + 1) (String.length path - i - 1))
  | None -> (c.uname, path)

(* a unit's class, this one's or one compiled before it in the
 * assembly *)
let unit_class (c : c) (name : string) : int option =
  if name = c.uname then Some c.cls else Hashtbl.find_opt c.memo ("unit " ^ name)

(* a type's class made: of the unit, nested in the unit's (F#'s modules:
 * so C# names it Unit.t, and no namespace has the unit's class's name);
 * of Pervasives (ref, option), in the namespace Stdlib of this assembly
 * (until several units: stage 1e); another unit's, not yet. Generic,
 * t`1 as .NET names it, its parameters T0... [flags]: its own, the
 * visibility added *)
let make_class (c : c) (loc : int) (path : string) (arity : int) (flags : int) (parent : int) : int =
  let ns, name = split c path in
  let name = if arity > 0 then Printf.sprintf "%s`%d" name arity else name in
  let cls =
    match unit_class c ns with
    | Some outer ->
        let cls = W.type_def c.w "" name (flags lor 0x2) parent in
        W.nest c.w cls outer;
        cls
    | None when ns = "Pervasives" -> W.type_def c.w "Stdlib" name (flags lor 0x1) parent
    | None -> refuse loc ("the type " ^ path ^ ", of a unit not compiled with it") "1e" in
  for i = 0 to arity - 1 do
    W.generic_param c.w cls i (Printf.sprintf "T%d" i)
  done;
  cls

(* a declaration's type parameters made a class's own (!0...) while [f]
 * makes its fields' types *)
let in_class (c : c) (params : string list) (f : unit -> 'a) : 'a =
  let saved = c.tvars in
  c.tvars <- List.mapi (fun (i : int) (p : string) -> (p, S.Var i)) params;
  let x = f () in
  c.tvars <- saved;
  x

(* a declared type with its parameters given *)
let rec subst (params : string list) (args : Scope.ty list) (t : Scope.ty) : Scope.ty =
  match t with
  | Tvar n -> (match List.assoc_opt n (List.combine params args) with Some a -> a | None -> t)
  | Tarrow (a, b) -> Tarrow (subst params args a, subst params args b)
  | Ttuple ts -> Ttuple (List.map (subst params args) ts)
  | Tconstr (d, ts) -> Tconstr (d, List.map (subst params args) ts)

(* a type's abbreviations expanded at its top: 'a msgf to the function
 * it is *)
let rec unabbrev (t : Scope.ty) : Scope.ty =
  match t with Tconstr ({ tabbrev = Some a; tparams; _ }, args) -> unabbrev (subst tparams args a) | t -> t

(* an ML type's .NET type; unit's Void (no value) *)
let rec cts (c : c) (loc : int) (t : Scope.ty) : S.t =
  match t with
  | Tconstr (d, []) when d == int_d -> S.I8
  | Tconstr (d, []) when d == bool_d -> S.Bool
  | Tconstr (d, []) when d == char_d -> S.I4
  | Tconstr (d, []) when d == float_d -> S.R8
  | Tconstr (d, []) when d == string_d -> S.String
  (* (bytes, .NET's byte[]: a channel's Stream reads and writes them) *)
  | Tconstr (d, []) when d.tpath = "bytes" -> S.SzArray S.U1
  (* (int64 and int32, lib_core's abstract Int64.t and Int32.t: .NET's
   * own, unboxed) *)
  | Tconstr (d, []) when d.tpath = "Int64.t" -> S.I8
  | Tconstr (d, []) when d.tpath = "Int32.t" -> S.I4
  (* (Float.Array.t, OCaml's floatarray: .NET's float64[]) *)
  | Tconstr (d, []) when d.tpath = "Float.Array.t" -> S.SzArray S.R8
  | Tconstr (d, []) when d == unit_d -> S.Void
  | Tconstr (d, []) when d == exn_d -> S.Class (sys c "Exception")
  | Tconstr ({ tabbrev = Some t; _ }, []) -> cts c loc t
  | Tconstr ({ tabbrev = Some t; tparams; _ }, args) -> cts c loc (subst tparams args t)
  | Tconstr (d, args) when Resolve.type_fields d <> None -> at (record c loc d) (List.map (arg_type c loc) args)
  | Tconstr (d, args) when conses d <> None -> at (variant c loc d) (List.map (arg_type c loc) args)
  (* (a polymorphic function's variable its method's parameter; one
   * that nothing constrains, an object) *)
  | Tvar n -> (match List.assoc_opt n c.tvars with Some t -> t | None -> S.Object)
  | Tarrow (a, b) -> func c loc a b
  | Ttuple ts -> at (tuple c loc (List.length ts)) (List.map (arg_type c loc) ts)
  (* (an array, .NET's own: T[]) *)
  | Tconstr (d, [ a ]) when d == Resolve.array_d -> S.SzArray (arg_type c loc a)
  (* (a format, ('a, 'b, 'c, 'd) format4: a function of k : string ->
   * 'd, the curried function of its arguments, k of their text; F#'s
   * way, typed, a literal's compiled: Il_exprs.format_value) *)
  | Tconstr (d, [ a; _; _; dd ]) when d.tpath = "format4" -> func c loc (Tarrow (Resolve.string_t, dd)) a
  (* (a type abstract in its unit's .mli, defined in its .ml, compiled
   * in this assembly: that definition) *)
  | Tconstr (d, args) when d.tabbrev = None && (match Hashtbl.find_opt implementations d.tpath with Some d' -> d' != d | None -> false) ->
      cts c loc (Tconstr (Hashtbl.find implementations d.tpath, args))
  (* (a unit's abstract type, Pervasives' in_channel: an object, which
   * the runtime unit casts to what it is) *)
  | Tconstr (d, _) when d.tabbrev = None && String.contains d.tpath '.' -> S.Object
  | Tconstr (d, _) -> refuse loc ("a value of type " ^ d.tpath) "1d"

(* a type as a type argument (a Func's, a generic class's): unit an
 * object, always null (F#'s unit: .NET has no void type argument) *)
and arg_type (c : c) (loc : int) (t : Scope.ty) : S.t = match cts c loc t with S.Void -> S.Object | t -> t

(* a function, System.Func<A, B>: curried as ML's, int -> int -> int a
 * Func<long, Func<long, long>> *)
and func (c : c) (loc : int) (a : Scope.ty) (b : Scope.ty) : S.t =
  S.GenericInst (S.Class (sys c "Func`2"), [ arg_type c loc a; arg_type c loc b ])

(* a record type: a class of its fields, in their order; seen from
 * another unit, its declaration the unit's own (implementations: its
 * fields there) *)
and record (c : c) (loc : int) (d : Scope.tdecl) : tclass =
  let key = qkey c d in
  match Hashtbl.find_opt classes key with
  | Some t -> t
  | None ->
      let d = match Resolve.type_fields d, Hashtbl.find_opt implementations key with
        | None, Some d' -> d' | _ -> d in
      let labels = match Resolve.type_fields d with Some l -> l | None -> [] in
      let labels = List.sort (fun ((_, a) : string * Scope.label) ((_, b) : string * Scope.label) -> compare a.pos b.pos) labels in
      let arity = List.length d.tparams in
      (* (known before its fields' types, which may be its own: a type of
       * the metadata is its token, known at once) *)
      let t = { tok = make_class c loc (if String.contains d.tpath '.' then d.tpath else key) arity 0x00100000 (sys c "Object"); arity; fields = []; ftoks = []; ctor = 0 } in
      Hashtbl.replace classes key t;
      t.fields <-
        List.map
          (fun ((n, l) : string * Scope.label) ->
            let params, ty, _ = l.ltype in
            (n, in_class c params (fun () -> arg_type c loc ty)))
          labels;
      t.ftoks <- List.map (fun ((n, ty) : string * S.t) -> W.field_def c.w t.tok n 0x0006 ty) t.fields;
      constructor c t (object_ctor c);
      structural c t 0 None;
      t

(* a tuple of n: ML's own class, Stdlib.tuple`n, its fields Item1...
 * (System.ValueTuple's names: mini-dotnet's library has not got it) *)
and tuple (c : c) (loc : int) (n : int) : tclass =
  let key = Printf.sprintf "tuple %d" n in
  match Hashtbl.find_opt classes key with
  | Some t -> t
  | None ->
      let t = { tok = make_class c loc "Pervasives.tuple" n 0x00100100 (sys c "Object"); arity = n; fields = []; ftoks = []; ctor = 0 } in
      Hashtbl.replace classes key t;
      t.fields <- List.init n (fun (i : int) -> (Printf.sprintf "Item%d" (i + 1), S.Var i));
      t.ftoks <- List.map (fun ((f, ty) : string * S.t) -> W.field_def c.w t.tok f 0x0006 ty) t.fields;
      constructor c t (object_ctor c);
      structural c t 0 None;
      t

(* a variant type: an abstract class, and a class of each constructor's,
 * nested in it, its fields the constructor's arguments (Item1...);
 * generic, each a class of the same parameters, its parent the
 * variant's at them *)
and variant (c : c) (loc : int) (d : Scope.tdecl) : tclass =
  let key = qkey c d in
  match Hashtbl.find_opt classes key with
  | Some t -> t
  | None ->
      let arity = List.length d.tparams in
      (* (OCaml's list, a variant of the language's: Stdlib's too, its
       * constructors' classes Nil and Cons, names that C# can say) *)
      let predefined = d == Resolve.list_d in
      let path = if predefined then "Pervasives." ^ d.tpath else d.tpath in
      let t = { tok = make_class c loc path arity 0x00100080 (sys c "Object"); arity; fields = []; ftoks = []; ctor = 0 } in
      Hashtbl.replace classes key t;
      constructor c t (object_ctor c);
      let me = own t in
      let parent = type_tok c t me and parent_ctor = ctor_tok c t me in
      (* (each constructor's place in OCaml's order, its classes' ml_order) *)
      let ord = W.method_def c.w t.tok "ml_order" 0x05C6 (instance [] S.I4) in
      List.iteri
        (fun (tag : int) ((cname, k) : string * Scope.cons) ->
          if k.cinline <> [] then refuse loc (cname ^ ", a constructor of an inline record") "1b";
          let params, args, _ = k.ctype in
          let cname' = match cname with "[]" -> "Nil" | "::" -> "Cons" | n -> n in
          let name = if arity > 0 then Printf.sprintf "%s`%d" cname' arity else cname' in
          let tok = W.type_def c.w "" name 0x00100102 parent in
          W.nest c.w tok t.tok;
          for i = 0 to arity - 1 do
            W.generic_param c.w tok i (Printf.sprintf "T%d" i)
          done;
          let case = { tok; arity; fields = []; ftoks = []; ctor = 0 } in
          case.fields <-
            List.mapi (fun (i : int) (ty : Scope.ty) -> (Printf.sprintf "Item%d" (i + 1), in_class c params (fun () -> arg_type c loc ty))) args;
          case.ftoks <- List.map (fun ((n, ty) : string * S.t) -> W.field_def c.w tok n 0x0006 ty) case.fields;
          constructor c case parent_ctor;
          (match k.kind with
           | Const _ ->
               (* (its one value: made once, as OCaml's constant is one
                * word; == of two None true) *)
               let me = own case in
               let f = W.field_def c.w tok "Instance" 0x0016 (at case me) in
               Hashtbl.replace instances tok f;
               let init = W.method_def c.w tok ".cctor" 0x1891 (static [] S.Void) in
               W.set_body c.w init []
                 [| Il.Newobj (ctor_tok c case me); Il.Stsfld (instance_tok c case me); Il.Ret |] []
           | _ -> ());
          let order = match k.kind with Const n -> n | Block n -> 1000000 + n | _ -> tag in
          let m = W.method_def c.w tok "ml_order" 0x00C6 (instance [] S.I4) in
          W.set_body c.w m [] [| Il.Ldc_i4 (Int32.of_int order); Il.Ret |] [];
          structural c case tag (Some (t, ord, order));
          Hashtbl.replace classes (key ^ "|" ^ cname) case)
        (match conses d with Some l -> l | None -> []);
      t

(* a record's type's class and its type arguments *)
let record_at (c : c) (loc : int) (ty : Scope.ty) : tclass * S.t list =
  (* (through abbreviations: Ir's type mem = Asm.mem) *)
  match unabbrev ty with
  | Tconstr (d, args) -> (record c loc d, List.map (arg_type c loc) args)
  | _ -> refuse loc "a record of no record type" "1b"

(* the index of a record's field, by its name *)
let index (t : tclass) (name : string) : int =
  let rec go (i : int) (l : (string * S.t) list) : int =
    match l with (n, _) :: rest -> if n = name then i else go (i + 1) rest | [] -> raise Not_found in
  go 0 t.fields

let field (c : c) (loc : int) (ty : Scope.ty) (name : string) : int =
  let t, args = record_at c loc ty in
  match index t name with
  | i -> field_tok c t args i
  | exception Not_found ->
      refuse loc (Printf.sprintf "%s, a field its record's class has not (%s)" name
                    (String.concat " " (List.map fst t.fields))) "1b"

let field0 (c : c) (loc : int) (ty : Scope.ty) : int =
  let t, args = record_at c loc ty in
  field_tok c t args 0

let record_ctor (c : c) (loc : int) (ty : Scope.ty) : int =
  let t, args = record_at c loc ty in
  ctor_tok c t args

(* a tuple's i-th field at its type, its constructor there *)
let tuple_at (c : c) (loc : int) (ty : Scope.ty) : tclass * S.t list =
  match unabbrev ty with
  | Ttuple ts -> (tuple c loc (List.length ts), List.map (arg_type c loc) ts)
  | _ -> refuse loc "a tuple of no tuple type" "1d"

let tuple_field (c : c) (loc : int) (ty : Scope.ty) (i : int) : int =
  let t, args = tuple_at c loc ty in
  field_tok c t args i

let tuple_ctor (c : c) (loc : int) (ty : Scope.ty) : int =
  let t, args = tuple_at c loc ty in
  ctor_tok c t args

(* a constructor of a variant at the variant's type: its class's token,
 * its constructor, its fields, its arguments' types there *)
(* a type's declaration, through the abbreviations a re-export makes
 * (Option's type 'a t = 'a option = None | Some of 'a): one class
 * for each constructor, the first declaration's *)
let rec canonical (d : Scope.tdecl) : Scope.tdecl =
  match d.tabbrev with Some (Tconstr (d', _)) when d' != d -> canonical d' | _ -> d

(* a constant constructor's one value, at its type's arguments *)
let constant (c : c) (loc : int) (k : Scope.cons) (ty : Scope.ty) : int =
  let _, _, res = k.ctype in
  let d = canonical (decl res) in
  let inst = match unabbrev ty with Tconstr (_, a) -> a | _ -> [] in
  ignore (variant c loc d);
  let t = Hashtbl.find classes (qkey c d ^ "|" ^ k.cname) in
  instance_tok c t (List.map (arg_type c loc) inst)

let case (c : c) (loc : int) (k : Scope.cons) (ty : Scope.ty) : int * int * (int -> int) * Scope.ty list =
  let params, targs, res = k.ctype in
  let d = canonical (decl res) in
  (* (its type's arguments through abbreviations: Relset's hint, a
   * Btree.hint option) *)
  let inst = match unabbrev ty with Tconstr (_, a) -> a | _ -> [] in
  ignore (variant c loc d);
  let t = Hashtbl.find classes (qkey c d ^ "|" ^ k.cname) in
  let args = List.map (arg_type c loc) inst in
  let types = if List.length params = List.length inst then List.map (subst params inst) targs else targs in
  (type_tok c t args, ctor_tok c t args, field_tok c t args, types)

(* a record's fields' types at the record's type, by label *)
let label_type (l : Scope.label) (ty : Scope.ty) : Scope.ty =
  let params, fty, _ = l.ltype in
  match unabbrev ty with Tconstr (_, inst) when List.length params = List.length inst -> subst params inst fty | _ -> fty

(* an exception: a class of System.Exception's, its message its name;
 * OCaml's Division_by_zero .NET's own, which a division throws *)
let exn (c : c) (loc : int) (sym : string) (args : Scope.ty list) : int * int * (int -> int) =
  if sym = "caml_exn_Division_by_zero" then
    (sys c "DivideByZeroException", lib c "DivideByZeroException" ".ctor" (instance [] S.Void), fun (_ : int) -> 0)
  else begin
    let key = "exn " ^ sym in
    let name =
      if String.length sym > 9 && String.sub sym 0 9 = "caml_exn_" then String.sub sym 9 (String.length sym - 9)
      else snd (split c sym) in
    let predefined = String.length sym > 9 && String.sub sym 0 9 = "caml_exn_" in
    if not (Hashtbl.mem c.memo key) then begin
      let fields = List.mapi (fun (i : int) (t : Scope.ty) -> (Printf.sprintf "Item%d" (i + 1), cts c loc t)) args in
      let base = lib c "Exception" ".ctor" (instance [ S.String ] S.Void) in
      (* (OCaml's own, Failure, Not_found...: Stdlib's; the unit's
       * nested in its class) *)
      let outer = if predefined then None else unit_class c (fst (split c sym)) in
      if not predefined && outer = None then refuse loc ("the exception " ^ sym ^ ", of a unit not compiled with it") "1e";
      let cls, ctor, toks =
        new_class c (if predefined then "Stdlib" else "") name (if predefined then 0x00100001 else 0x00100002) (sys c "Exception") base
          [ Il.Ldstr (W.user_string c.w name) ] fields in
      (match outer with Some o -> W.nest c.w cls o | None -> ());
      Hashtbl.replace c.memo key cls;
      Hashtbl.replace c.memo (key ^ " ctor") ctor;
      List.iteri (fun (i : int) (f : int) -> Hashtbl.replace c.memo (Printf.sprintf "%s.%d" key i) f) toks
    end;
    (Hashtbl.find c.memo key, Hashtbl.find c.memo (key ^ " ctor"), fun (i : int) -> Hashtbl.find c.memo (Printf.sprintf "%s.%d" key i))
  end

(* the calls of Pervasives this stage has, as .NET's library's *)
let builtin (c : c) (sym : string) : Il.op list option =
  let write (t : S.t) = Il.Call (lib c "Console" "Write" (static [ t ] S.Void)) in
  let throw (name : string) =
    let _, ctor, _ = exn c 0 ("caml_exn_" ^ name) [ Resolve.string_t ] in
    [ Il.Newobj ctor; Il.Throw ] in
  match sym with
  | "Pervasives.print_int" -> Some [ write S.I8 ]
  | "Pervasives.print_string" -> Some [ write S.String ]
  | "Pervasives.print_char" -> Some [ Il.Conv (Il.K_u2, false, false); write S.Char ]
  | "Pervasives.print_endline" -> Some [ Il.Call (lib c "Console" "WriteLine" (static [ S.String ] S.Void)) ]
  | "Pervasives.print_newline" -> Some [ Il.Call (lib c "Console" "WriteLine" (static [] S.Void)) ]
  | "Pervasives.^" -> Some [ Il.Call (lib c "String" "Concat" (static [ S.String; S.String ] S.String)) ]
  (* (an int64 boxed, its ToString: Int64's own, by the object's class) *)
  | "Pervasives.string_of_int" -> Some [ Il.Box (sys c "Int64"); Il.Callvirt (lib c "Object" "ToString" (instance [] S.String)) ]
  | "Pervasives.failwith" -> Some (throw "Failure")
  | "Pervasives.invalid_arg" -> Some (throw "Invalid_argument")
  | _ -> None

let type_of (e : Scope.expr) : Scope.ty =
  match Hashtbl.find_opt synthetic e.span with
  | Some t -> t
  | None -> (match Typing.expr_type e with Some t -> t | None -> refuse e.loc "an expression whose type was not kept" "1a")

(* (a raise's type is any: nothing is left by it) *)
let is_raise (e : Scope.expr) : bool =
  match e.e with Eapply ({ e = Evar (Prim ("%raise", _, _)); _ }, _) -> true | _ -> false

let cts_of (c : c) (e : Scope.expr) : S.t = if is_raise e then S.Void else cts c e.loc (type_of e)

(* a Func's Invoke and constructor (an object, a method's address) *)
let invoke (c : c) (f : S.t) : int =
  memo c ("invoke " ^ S.encode_type_spec f) (fun () -> W.member_ref c.w (W.type_spec c.w f) "Invoke" (instance [ S.Var 0 ] (S.Var 1)))

let func_ctor (c : c) (f : S.t) : int =
  memo c ("func ctor " ^ S.encode_type_spec f) (fun () ->
      W.member_ref c.w (W.type_spec c.w f) ".ctor" (instance [ S.Object; S.I ] S.Void))

(* a .NET type's token, as newarr, box, ldelem.any take it: System's
 * class for a primitive, a class's own, a TypeSpec for the others *)
let type_token (c : c) (t : S.t) : int =
  match t with
  | S.I8 -> sys c "Int64"
  | S.I4 -> sys c "Int32"
  | S.Bool -> sys c "Boolean"
  | S.R8 -> sys c "Double"
  | S.String -> sys c "String"
  | S.Object -> sys c "Object"
  | S.Class tok -> tok
  | t -> W.type_spec c.w t

(* ML's types as .NET's (Lower_il.mli's table): the primitives, and the
 * unit's records, variants and exceptions as classes, made when a type
 * is first met, nested in the unit's class (F#'s modules), with the
 * structural Equals and GetHashCode that make OCaml's = .NET's. A type
 * of parameters a generic class, tree`1 (its constructors' classes of
 * the same parameters, their parent tree`1<!0>); a use of it at types
 * its instance, int tree a tree`1<long>, its fields and constructor
 * MemberRefs of that, as C# makes them. Pervasives' ref and option,
 * until units are several (stage 1e), Stdlib's in each assembly. *)

(* a class made for a type or by the lowering: its TypeDef, its generic
 * parameters' number, its fields (declared in its own parameters) *)
type tclass = {
  tok : int;
  arity : int;
  mutable fields : (string * Signature.t) list;
  mutable ftoks : int list;
  mutable ctor : int;
}

module S = Signature
module W = Writer

(* A unit *)
