/* A part of mini-ml's runtime: runtime.c includes it. */

/*****************************************************************************/
/* The heap: two halves in the bss, Cheney's collector, and a young generation */
/*****************************************************************************/

/* a half's words, at most: 512 MB on 64 bits (a link of ix's is 200 MB
 * of blocks), 256 on 32 (it was 32: mini-ld built for arm could not
 * link itself). They are the bss: the pages not touched are not
 * memory. (A kernel gives its own, -DMAXHEAP and -DSTACK: its bss is
 * the board's memory, cleared at the start.) */
#ifndef MAXHEAP
#ifdef plan9
/* (mini-9pi's processes: 512 MB of addresses each, the stack's 8 at
 * their top: here 192 MB a half, the value stack, a large thread's
 * and the program beside. A half was 64 MB (16 M words): Hacker
 * News's comments in mini-netscape are 57.6 MB alive, the page before
 * kept besides. Memory only as a half grows to it: the author, "My pi2
 * has 1GB of memory, so no reason to limit ourselves to 64MB") */
#define MAXHEAP 50331648
#define STACK 1048576
#else
#define MAXHEAP 67108864
#define STACK 4194304           /* the value stack's */
#endif
/* and as much again past its end, pages no one touches but a recursion
 * too deep, seen at the next collection (collect); a kernel's has none */
#define GUARD STACK
/* large blocks of no pointers outside the halves, the system's memory
 * (a kernel has none: they stay in the half; nor Plan 9, where the
 * halves are most of a process's 512 MB, the break only moves up, and
 * mini-ld linking mini-netscape on the card, its buffers doubling, went
 * past the stack: "out of memory", self-mix) */
#ifndef plan9
#define LARGE
#endif
#endif
/* a half's words at the start (ML_HEAP says another); it doubles when
 * less than half is free after a collection */
#ifndef HEAPSTART
#ifdef plan9
/* (4 MB on mini-9pi: a compile by mini-ml on the card collected
 * from 1 MB up, 5% of its time; 16 MB gave no more,
 * plan_self_hosting.md) */
#define HEAPSTART (1 << 20)
#else
#define HEAPSTART (1 << 18)
#endif
#endif

/* Both halves have been written after two collections, so a program
 * holds twice its heap: mini-ld built by mini-ml 267 MB to link
 * mini-rm, where 54 MB are alive (OCaml's holds 136), and sixty such
 * links at once, which is ix built by ix, do not fit in a machine of
 * 16 GB (GitHub's: make test-ix-fixpoint there).
 * Tried, worked, and not kept: the half just emptied given back to the
 * system at the end of a collection (Linux's madvise, MADV_DONTNEED, on
 * its pages above what the next collection will copy there, for a heap
 * of 16 MB a half or more: a game's frames paid nothing). That link
 * 192 MB where it was 264, half a second of page faults in six, the
 * same bytes, on arm and arm64. But it is one system's call (not Plan 9's, not a kernel's),
 * conditionals in the collector for it, and the problem it was for is
 * the build's, solved there: a program links the units of the stdlib
 * it uses (mkconfig's STDOBJS, a library), no longer all of them. */
static value space0[MAXHEAP];
static value space1[MAXHEAP];
#ifdef GUARD
static value vstack[STACK + GUARD];
#else
static value vstack[STACK];
#endif
static value *from;             /* the heap: from..ml_limit, allocated up to ml_hp */
static value *other;
/* (not static: mini-ml's code takes a block from the heap itself, Gen's
 * alloc_in_place, and calls ml_alloc when there is no room) */
value *ml_hp;
value *ml_limit;
static value size;
static value *lo;               /* the collector's: the space collected, */
static value *hi;
static value *next;             /* and where the next copy goes */
static value collections;       /* how many there were */
/* the program's machine stack's top (main's frame), for a stack
 * overflow's calls (exceptions.c's overflowed) */
static char *machine_top;
static void overflowed(char*, char*, char*);
static value top;               /* the largest half so far, in words */
static value live;              /* what was alive after the last one, in words */

/* An index out of bounds: OCaml's Invalid_argument "index out of
 * bounds", which a program may catch (tiny-cpu's search of a table
 * does). Made once, at the start, and kept as a root: the generated
 * code calls here without saying where the value stack's top is, so
 * nothing may be allocated now. */
/* old: fatal("Fatal error: out-of-bound access in array or string\n"),
 * as ocaml-light's ocamlopt on arm64 */
static value bound_exn;

/* the named values of Callback.register, roots too */
#define NAMED 64
static value named_names[NAMED];
static value named_values[NAMED];
static int nnamed;

/* The value stacks. A program has one, vstack. A kernel's processes
 * each have theirs (plan_kernel_mini_ml.md: "a process is two
 * pointers"): the kernel gives each a number and its memory
 * (ml_stack), and says which one runs (ml_stack_switch: the top and
 * the handler of the one that stops are kept, those of the other put
 * back; the kernel switches the machine's stack, and the register that
 * holds the top in ML's code). The collector scans them all. */
/* (256 threads at once: a window system has one a window) */
#define STACKS 257
static value *stack_base[STACKS];
static value *stack_top[STACKS];
static void *stack_handler[STACKS];
static struct caml__roots_block *stack_roots[STACKS];
static int stack_now;

/* C's own values (memory.h's CAMLparam and CAMLlocal, ocaml-light's): a
 * C function that allocates, or calls ML, while it holds values says
 * where they are, in a block on its frame, chained here; the collector
 * moves them. A chain per stack: a process's C frames are its own. */
struct caml__roots_block *local_roots;

void
ml_root(struct caml__roots_block *b, value *v0, value *v1, value *v2)
{
	b->next = local_roots;
	b->v[0] = v0;
	b->v[1] = v1;
	b->v[2] = v2;
	local_roots = b;
}

void
ml_stack(int i, value *base)
{
	stack_base[i] = base;
	stack_top[i] = base;
	stack_handler[i] = nil;
	stack_roots[i] = nil;
}

void
ml_stack_switch(int i)
{
	stack_top[stack_now] = ml_vsp;
	stack_handler[stack_now] = ml_handler;
	stack_roots[stack_now] = local_roots;
	stack_now = i;
	ml_vsp = stack_top[i];
	ml_handler = stack_handler[i];
	local_roots = stack_roots[i];
}

/* Threads (lib_core/concurrency's Thread, whose scheduler is OCaml's:
 * plan_rio.md). A thread is a value stack (the stacks above: 0 the
 * program's) and a machine stack, in one piece of memory: the
 * machine's grows down from its middle, the values' up from there.
 * Its context is what a switch keeps of a thread that does not run
 * (ml_swtch, the start object's: mini-ml's Gen): the machine's stack
 * pointer, where to return, the value stack's register. A new one
 * starts at thread_entry, on its own stacks, the function it runs the
 * first value of its stack (a root, as the rest). Cooperative: a
 * switch is a call, so nothing else is in a register. Not with gcc's C
 * (it keeps values in registers across a call). */
#ifndef __GNUC__
#define TSTACK (256 * 1024)	/* a thread's machine stack, in bytes */
#define TVALUES 32768		/* and its value stack, in words */
/* A large thread (Thread.create_large: mini-netscape's worker, which
 * lays out a page as the program's first thread did) has the
 * program's value stack, and a machine stack as large in bytes:
 * TVALUES was a List.map over Hacker News's page, past the end of the
 * memory, a fault (bugs/ix.md; 47 KB of the machine's used for 128 KB
 * of values). Each stack has a guard as large as itself on the side
 * it grows to, as the program's value stack (vstack's): pages no one
 * touches but an overflow, seen by collect. A thread's memory:
 *
 *   | guard | machine stack <- | -> value stack | guard |
 *
 * Addresses, not memory: a page is the system's at its first touch. */
#define LVALUES STACK
static value thread_context[STACKS][3];
static char *thread_memory[STACKS];
static char thread_used[STACKS];
/* each one's memory made large, its machine stack's bytes and its value stack's words */
static char thread_large[STACKS];
static value thread_machine[STACKS];
static value thread_values[STACKS];
extern void ml_swtch(value**);
extern value callback(value, value);
static void fatal(char*);
static void *m_alloc(value);

static void
thread_entry(void)
{
	callback(stack_base[stack_now][0], Val_unit);
	fatal("Fatal error: a thread's function returned\n");	/* (Thread.create's ends by Thread.exit) */
}

value
thread_new(value large, value f)
{
	value *base;
	int i, l, machine;

	/* (a number free whose memory is of the size asked, or has none:
	 * memory is not given back, a large one not made again) */
	l = Bool_val(large);
	for(i = 1; i < STACKS && (thread_used[i] || (thread_memory[i] != nil && thread_large[i] != l)); i++)
		;
	if(i == STACKS)
		failwith("Thread.create: too many threads");
	if(thread_memory[i] == nil){
		thread_values[i] = l ? LVALUES : TVALUES;
		thread_machine[i] = l ? LVALUES * sizeof(value) : TSTACK;
		thread_memory[i] = m_alloc(2 * thread_machine[i] + 2 * thread_values[i] * sizeof(value));
		thread_large[i] = l;
	}
	thread_used[i] = 1;
	machine = 2 * thread_machine[i];
	base = (value*)(thread_memory[i] + machine);
	ml_stack(i, base);
	base[0] = f;
	stack_top[i] = base + 1;
	thread_context[i][0] = (value)(thread_memory[i] + machine - 64);
	thread_context[i][1] = (value)thread_entry;
	thread_context[i][2] = 0;
	return Val_int(i);
}

value
thread_switch(value to)
{
	value *pair[2];
	int from;

	from = stack_now;
	if(Long_val(to) == from)
		return Val_unit;
	pair[0] = thread_context[from];
	pair[1] = thread_context[Long_val(to)];
	ml_stack_switch(Long_val(to));
	ml_swtch(pair);
	return Val_unit;
}

/* a finished thread's number free again, its stack empty for the collector */
value
thread_free(value t)
{
	int i;

	i = Long_val(t);
	if(i > 0 && i < STACKS && i != stack_now){
		thread_used[i] = 0;
		ml_stack(i, stack_base[i]);
	}
	return Val_unit;
}
#endif

/* OPTIMIZATION (generations): the young generation, OCaml's minor heap.
 * Every block is made here (ml_hp and ml_limit are its), and most are
 * dead before it is full: a minor collection copies what is alive of
 * it to the half, the old generation, where it stays until a major
 * one (the halves' Cheney, as before, both generations at once). So a
 * collection copies the young survivors, not everything alive: mini-ml
 * compiling its Typing.ml spent a quarter of its instructions copying
 * the same interfaces again at each collection.
 *
 *     young: [made ... ml_hp | free ]      minor: the alive to old_hp
 *     half:  [old blocks ... old_hp | free to from + size ]
 *
 * The roots of a minor collection are the major's (the stacks, the
 * globals) and the old fields that point to a young block: each store
 * of a block in a field (Ir's SetField and SetIndex) goes through
 * ml_modify (the start object's: Gen.startup), which remembers the
 * field when the value is young and the field old, in refs. A block
 * too large for the young generation is made in the half, after a
 * minor collection (its fields then point to nothing young).
 * Off with ML_YOUNG=0, and with gcc's C (-gas: its code has no
 * barrier): every block in the half, as before.
 * old: one generation, the halves; ml_hp and ml_limit the half's
 * (young_words 0) */
#ifndef YOUNG
#define YOUNG (MAXHEAP / 16 < 1048576 ? MAXHEAP / 16 : 1048576)
#endif
static value young[YOUNG];
static value young_words;       /* 0: no young generation */
static value *old_hp;           /* the half's next free word (young_words) */
value *ml_young_lo;             /* the young generation, for ml_modify */
value *ml_young_hi;
/* the old fields remembered; when full, the last one written again
 * and refs_lost said: the next minor collection scans all the old.
 * OPTIMIZATION (refs_soon): at seven eighths of it (ml_refs_end), a
 * minor collection asked for (ml_limit at ml_hp: the next allocation
 * makes it), the table's last eighth for the stores until then
 * (ml_refs_hard). A loop that stores many blocks and makes few was a
 * scan of the whole old generation at each minor collection
 * (mini-virtuaracing's frame on arm: each float stored in an array a
 * new block, once its arithmetic made none, plan_ml_floats.md).
 * old: ml_refs_end the table's end, lost when reached */
#define REFS (YOUNG / 16 < 4096 ? 4096 : YOUNG / 16)
static value *refs[REFS];
value **ml_refs;
value **ml_refs_end;
value **ml_refs_hard;
value ml_refs_lost;
static value minors;            /* the minor collections */

/* a value's copy in to-space: an integer or a pointer outside the
 * spaces collected (lo..hi, and lo2..hi2: a major collection's young
 * generation) as is; a copied block's header is 0, its first field the
 * copy's address (every block has a field: an empty array is static) */
static value *lo2, *hi2;

/* OPTIMIZATION (large): a large block of no pointers (bytes, a string,
 * a float array: a tag from 251, YOUNG / 2 words or more) is
 * not in the halves: its memory is the system's (m_alloc), taken when
 * it is made, given back when a major collection did not reach it. So
 * it is not copied at each major collection, and may be larger than a
 * half: mini-5i built by mini-ml for arm64 holds the arm program's
 * data, 642 MB, as one Bytes ("out of memory" when in the half). A
 * major collection marks those it reaches (copy), then frees the others
 * (large_sweep); a minor one has nothing to do with them, no field of
 * theirs points to a block. Nothing is reserved for them: a program
 * that makes none has no more memory. Plan 9 takes no memory back
 * (sbrk): a dead block is kept, for the next one it fits. OCaml makes
 * blocks past Max_young_wosize (256 words) in its major heap, which
 * does not move them: mark and sweep for all of them, here for these.
 * A large block, its three words before the header:
 *
 *   | next | words | mark | header | fields ...
 *
 * old: in the half, after a minor collection, as a large block of
 * pointers (ml_alloc) */
#ifdef LARGE
static value *large;            /* the large blocks, chained by next */
static value *large_lo;         /* their fields between these */
static value *large_hi;
static value large_words;       /* their words, */
static value large_kept;        /* and after the last major collection */
static value marking;           /* in a major collection */
#ifdef plan9
static value *large_free;       /* the dead ones, to make others in */
#endif
static void m_free(void*, value);

static void
large_mark(value *p)
{
	value *b;

	/* (between large_lo and large_hi there may be other memory: a
	 * thread's, or C's) */
	for(b = large; b != nil; b = (value*)b[0])
		if(b + 4 == p){
			b[2] = 1;
			return;
		}
}

/* after a major collection: the large blocks not marked freed */
static void
large_sweep(void)
{
	value *b, **l;

	large_words = 0;
	large_lo = large_hi = nil;
	l = &large;
	while((b = *l) != nil){
		if(b[2]){
			b[2] = 0;
			large_words += b[1];
			if(large_lo == nil || b + 4 < large_lo)
				large_lo = b + 4;
			if(b + b[1] > large_hi)
				large_hi = b + b[1];
			l = (value**)b;
			continue;
		}
		*l = (value*)b[0];
#ifdef plan9
		b[0] = (value)large_free;
		large_free = b;
#else
		m_free(b, b[1] * sizeof(value));
#endif
	}
	large_kept = large_words;
}
#endif

/* OPTIMIZATION (copy's code): written for mini-cc's code, which keeps
 * each variable in memory (compat's, 5c's without its registerizer):
 * the block walked by two pointers, not an index loaded, shifted and
 * added to both at each word (13 instructions a word, 6); a field that
 * is an int, or a block not collected, left by scan_copies itself,
 * not a call (2 of 5.1 million calls in mini-ml's compile of
 * Ssa_build.ml). ocaml-light's oldify is C as well, by gcc.
 * old: for(i = 0; i < n; i++) q[i] = p[i]; and scan_copies's
 *      scan[i] = copy(scan[i]) for each field */
#define Collected(p) (((p) >= lo && (p) < hi) || ((p) >= lo2 && (p) < hi2))

static value
copy(value v)
{
	value *p, *q, *e, *b;
	value h;

	p = (value*)v;
	if(Is_int(v))
		return v;
	if(!Collected(p)){
#ifdef LARGE
		if(p >= large_lo && p < large_hi && marking)
			large_mark(p);
#endif
		return v;
	}
	h = p[-1];
	if(h == 0)
		return p[0];
	q = next;
	*q++ = h;
	b = q;
	e = q + (((uvalue)h) >> 10);
	while(q < e)
		*q++ = *p++;
	next = q;
	p = (value*)v;
	p[-1] = 0;
	p[0] = (value)b;
	return (value)b;
}

/* OPTIMIZATION (copy in the scan): scan_copies with copy's work in its
 * loop, next, lo and hi in its own variables: what scan_arm.s and
 * scan_arm64.s did by hand, which mini-cc -simple -O -ssa (lib_core's
 * mkfile) now makes of this C, the copy of the words two post-indexed
 * accesses, as theirs (plan_cc_ssa.md). As ocaml-light's arm.S
 * (caml_alloc, caml_call_gc), the hot path was in assembly a day.
 * old: scan_copies(scan) { ... *f = copy((value)p); ... }, copy for
 *      each field; then ml_scan(&s), the assembly, its state in a
 *      struct Scan */

/* the fields of the blocks from scan to next copied, next chasing scan
 * (Cheney's breadth first) */
static void
scan_copies(value *scan)
{
	value *f, *e, *p, *q, *b, *n, *l, *u;
	value h, w;

	n = next;
	l = lo;
	u = hi;
	while(scan < n){
		h = *scan++;
		e = scan + (((uvalue)h) >> 10);
		if((h & 255) < 251)
			for(f = scan; f < e; f++){
				w = *f;
				if(Is_int(w))
					continue;
				p = (value*)w;
				if(!((p >= l && p < u) || (p >= lo2 && p < hi2))){
#ifdef LARGE
					/* (a large block marked: in a major) */
					if(marking && p >= large_lo && p < large_hi)
						large_mark(p);
#endif
					continue;
				}
				h = p[-1];
				if(h == 0){             /* copied already: where to */
					*f = p[0];
					continue;
				}
				*n++ = h;
				b = n;
				q = n + (((uvalue)h) >> 10);
				while(n < q)
					*n++ = *p++;
				p = (value*)w;
				p[-1] = 0;
				p[0] = (value)b;
				*f = (value)b;
			}
		scan = e;
	}
	next = n;
}

/* the roots copied: the stacks, C's values, the globals */
static void
copy_roots(void)
{
	value *v, *roots;
	value i, u;
	struct caml__roots_block *b;

#ifdef GUARD
	/* The ML code does not check the value stack's end: a recursion
	 * too deep wrote past it, over the statics that follow (stack_now,
	 * stack_roots: this scan followed an integer as a block, a crash
	 * of nowhere, mini-netscape on YouTube's style sheet; bugs/ix.md).
	 * Into the guard now, and said, by ml_vsp alone (the statics are
	 * what an overflow past the guard would have written over). A
	 * fatal error, not a Stack_overflow to catch: raised from inside an
	 * allocation. */
	if(ml_vsp > vstack + STACK && ml_vsp <= vstack + STACK + GUARD)
		overflowed("Fatal error: stack overflow (mini-ml's value stack)", (char*)&v, stack_now > 0 ? nil : machine_top);
#ifndef __GNUC__
	/* (a thread's, into one of its guards: its machine stack's is
	 * below, where this frame is) */
	if(stack_now > 0 && ml_vsp > stack_base[stack_now] + thread_values[stack_now])
		overflowed("Fatal error: stack overflow (a thread's value stack)", (char*)&v, thread_memory[stack_now] + 2 * thread_machine[stack_now]);
	if(stack_now > 0 && (char*)&v < thread_memory[stack_now] + thread_machine[stack_now])
		overflowed("Fatal error: stack overflow (a thread's machine stack)", (char*)&v, thread_memory[stack_now] + 2 * thread_machine[stack_now]);
#endif
#endif
	stack_top[stack_now] = ml_vsp;
	stack_roots[stack_now] = local_roots;
	for(i = 0; i < STACKS; i++){
		for(v = stack_base[i]; v < stack_top[i]; v++)
			*v = copy(*v);
		for(b = stack_roots[i]; b != nil; b = b->next)
			for(u = 0; u < 3; u++)
				if(b->v[u] != nil)
					*b->v[u] = copy(*b->v[u]);
	}
	for(u = 1; u <= ml_units[0]; u++){
		roots = (value*)ml_units[u];
		/* (a unit named by the start and not linked: mini-ld's weak) */
		if(roots == nil)
			continue;
		for(i = 1; i <= roots[0]; i++){
			v = (value*)roots[i];
			*v = copy(*v);
		}
	}
	bound_exn = copy(bound_exn);
	for(i = 0; i < nnamed; i++){
		named_names[i] = copy(named_names[i]);
		named_values[i] = copy(named_values[i]);
	}
}

/* the young generation empty again, nothing remembered */
static void
young_empty(void)
{
	ml_hp = young;
	ml_limit = young + young_words;
	ml_refs = refs;
	ml_refs_end = refs + REFS - REFS / 8;
	ml_refs_hard = refs + REFS;
	ml_refs_lost = 0;
}

/* a major collection: the half's blocks and the young ones copied to
 * the other half, the halves swapped */
static void
collect(void)
{
	lo = from;
	hi = young_words ? old_hp : ml_hp;
	lo2 = young_words ? young : nil;
	hi2 = young_words ? ml_hp : nil;
	next = other;
#ifdef LARGE
	marking = 1;
#endif
	copy_roots();
	scan_copies(other);
#ifdef LARGE
	marking = 0;
	large_sweep();
#endif
	other = from;
	from = lo == space0 ? space1 : space0;
	lo2 = hi2 = nil;
	if(young_words){
		old_hp = next;
		young_empty();
	}else
		ml_hp = next;
	collections++;
}

/* a minor collection: the young blocks alive copied to the half, after
 * its last; their roots the major's and the remembered fields (or every
 * old block's, when some were lost) */
static void
minor(void)
{
	value **r;
	value *start;

	lo = young;
	hi = ml_hp;
	lo2 = hi2 = nil;
	next = old_hp;
	start = old_hp;
	copy_roots();
	if(ml_refs_lost)
		scan_copies(from);
	else
		for(r = refs; r < ml_refs; r++)
			**r = copy(**r);
	scan_copies(start);
	old_hp = next;
	young_empty();
	minors++;
}

/* a store of v in a field of C's (memory.h's Store_field): ml_modify's
 * test, for C */
void
ml_store(value *field, value v)
{
	*field = v;
	if(!Is_int(v) && (value*)v >= ml_young_lo && (value*)v < ml_young_hi
	&& (field < ml_young_lo || field >= ml_young_hi)){
		if(ml_refs == ml_refs_end){
			ml_limit = ml_hp;
			if(ml_refs_end == ml_refs_hard){
				ml_refs--;
				ml_refs_lost = 1;
			}else
				ml_refs_end = ml_refs_hard;
		}
		*ml_refs++ = field;
	}
}

/* Gc.set's space_overhead, OCaml's name for it: how much more than what
 * is alive the heap is let to be, in hundredths of it. 100, the heap
 * twice what is alive, is what this collector always did; a program
 * that makes much and keeps little (a game: a frame's floats) asks for
 * more, and is collected that much less often: each collection copies
 * all that is alive. */
static value overhead = 100;

/* a major collection; if less than half is free after (the overhead's
 * share), the heap grows, up to its halves
 * old: while((ml_hp - from + need) * 2 > size && size < MAXHEAP)
 * (tried, and not kept: a half grown to just what is alive and its
 * overhead, where doubling leaves it up to twice that: mini-ld's link
 * of mini-rm 5% less memory, 16% longer, a collection coming sooner) */
static void
major(value need)
{
	value *hp;

	collect();
	hp = young_words ? old_hp : ml_hp;
	live = hp - from;
	while((uvlong)(hp - from + need) * (100 + overhead) / 100 > (uvlong)size && size < MAXHEAP)
		size = size * 2;
	if(size > MAXHEAP)
		size = MAXHEAP;
	if(size > top)
		top = size;
	if(!young_words)
		ml_limit = from + size;
	if(hp + need > from + size)
		fatal("Fatal error: out of memory\n");
}

/* OPTIMIZATION (old_reads): what Marshal reads made in the half
 * itself, not in the young generation: ml_hp and ml_limit the half's
 * between ml_old_begin and ml_old_end (Marshal.from_string's), the
 * young generation's kept aside. What is read is kept, most of it (a
 * link's objects, a unit's interfaces): made young, it was copied at
 * the next minor collection and scanned again, a block at a time
 * (OCaml's intern.c reserves the whole value in the major heap, its
 * intern_alloc). A collection meanwhile is made as without, the young
 * generation's pointers back (gc). The blocks read point only to
 * blocks read: none is remembered. */
static value old_reading;       /* how deep in Marshal's reading */
static value *young_hp, *young_limit;

static void
old_leave(void)
{
	old_hp = ml_hp;
	ml_hp = young_hp;
	ml_limit = young_limit;
}

static void
old_enter(void)
{
	young_hp = ml_hp;
	young_limit = ml_limit;
	ml_hp = old_hp;
	ml_limit = from + size;
}

value
ml_old_begin(value u)
{
	if(young_words && old_reading++ == 0)
		old_enter();
	return u;
}

value
ml_old_end(value u)
{
	if(young_words && --old_reading == 0)
		old_leave();
	return u;
}

/* need words, in the young generation (a minor collection, then a major
 * one when the half is past its size), or in the half */
static void
gc(value need)
{
	if(!young_words){
		major(need);
		return;
	}
	if(old_reading)
		old_leave();
	/* (the half holds the young survivors, at most all of it, as its
	 * memory goes to MAXHEAP: else a major collection first) */
	if(old_hp + (ml_hp - young) > from + MAXHEAP)
		major(0);
	else
		minor();
	if(old_hp + need > from + size)
		major(need);
	if(old_reading)
		old_enter();
}

/* Gc's: a collection, whichever was asked */
value gc_full_major(value u) { gc(0); if(young_words) major(0); return u; }
value gc_major(value u) { gc(0); if(young_words) major(0); return u; }
value gc_minor(value u) { gc(0); return u; }
value gc_compaction(value u) { gc(0); if(young_words) major(0); return u; }
/* (Marshal's: the blocks moved, and the addresses it kept are old) */
value gc_collections(value u) { return Val_int(collections + minors); }

#ifdef LARGE
static value
large_alloc(value n, value tag)
{
	value *b, words;
#ifdef plan9
	value **l;
#endif

	/* (a major collection when as much again as it kept was made since
	 * the last one, and a half besides: else dead ones pile up while
	 * the half does not fill) */
	if(large_words + n > 2 * large_kept + size){
		gc(0);
		if(young_words)
			major(0);
	}
	words = n + 4;
	b = nil;
#ifdef plan9
	for(l = &large_free; *l != nil; l = (value**)*l)
		if((*l)[1] >= words){
			b = *l;
			*l = (value*)b[0];
			break;
		}
#endif
	if(b == nil){
		b = m_alloc(words * sizeof(value));
		b[1] = words;
	}
	b[0] = (value)large;
	large = b;
	b[2] = 0;
	b[3] = (n << 10) | tag;
	large_words += b[1];
	if(large_lo == nil || b + 4 < large_lo)
		large_lo = b + 4;
	if(b + b[1] > large_hi)
		large_hi = b + b[1];
	return (value)(b + 4);
}
#endif

value
ml_alloc(value n, value tag)
{
	value *p;

	/* (larger, the header would say another size: the collector then
	 * walks garbage; Array.make and Bytes.create raise before) */
	if((uvalue)n > Max_wosize)
		fatal("Fatal error: a block too large\n");
#ifdef LARGE
	if(tag >= 251 && n + 1 > YOUNG / 2)
		return large_alloc(n, tag);
#endif

	if(ml_hp + n + 1 > ml_limit){
		/* a large block in the half, the young ones moved first */
		if(young_words && !old_reading && n + 1 > young_words / 2){
			gc(n + 1);
			p = old_hp + 1;
			p[-1] = (n << 10) | tag;
			old_hp = p + n;
			return (value)p;
		}
		gc(n + 1);
	}
	p = ml_hp + 1;
	p[-1] = (n << 10) | tag;
	ml_hp = p + n;
	return (value)p;
}

/* Gc.get and Gc.set: OCaml's record of four, of which the heap's size
 * (read only) and the overhead mean something here */
value
gc_get(value u)
{
	value r;

	r = ml_alloc(4, 0);
	Field(r, 0) = Val_int(size);
	Field(r, 1) = Val_int(0);
	Field(r, 2) = Val_int(overhead);
	Field(r, 3) = Val_int(0);
	return r;
}

value
gc_set(value c)
{
	overhead = Long_val(Field(c, 2));
	if(overhead < 100)
		overhead = 100;
	return Val_unit;
}

/* Gc.stat's: the collections, a half's words now and at most so far,
 * the words alive after the last collection */
value
gc_counters(value u)
{
	value r;

	r = ml_alloc(4, 0);
	Field(r, 0) = Val_int(collections);
	Field(r, 1) = Val_int(size);
	Field(r, 2) = Val_int(top > size ? top : size);
	Field(r, 3) = Val_int(live);
	return r;
}

static void
push(value v)
{
	*ml_vsp = v;
	ml_vsp++;
}

static value
pop(void)
{
	ml_vsp--;
	return *ml_vsp;
}

/* open's modes, POSIX's own bits; create, which makes a directory too */
#define OREAD O_RDONLY
#define OWRITE O_WRONLY
#define OTRUNC O_TRUNC
#define OEXCL O_EXCL
#define DMDIR 0x80000000
#define seek lseek
#define getwd(buf, n) getcwd(buf, n)

static int
create(char *name, int mode, unsigned long perm)
{
	if(perm & DMDIR){
		if(mkdir(name, perm & 0777) < 0)
			return -1;
		return open(name, O_RDONLY);
	}
	return open(name, mode | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, perm);
}

/* a file's Dir, what the runtime reads of it: its mode's DMDIR, its name */
typedef struct Dir Dir;
struct Dir {
	unsigned long mode;
	char *name;
};

static Dir*
dirstat(char *name)
{
	struct stat st;
	Dir *d;

	if(stat(name, &st) < 0)
		return nil;
	d = malloc(sizeof(Dir));
	d->mode = S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) ? DMDIR : 0;
	d->name = nil;
	return d;
}

/* a directory's entries but . and .., in one block, the names after */
static long
dirreadall(int fd, Dir **dp)
{
	DIR *dir;
	struct dirent *e;
	long n, size, i;
	char *names;

	dir = fdopendir(dup(fd));
	if(dir == nil)
		return -1;
	n = 0;
	size = 0;
	*dp = nil;
	for(i = 0; i < 2; i++){
		/* the first pass counts, the second fills */
		if(i == 1)
			*dp = malloc(n * sizeof(Dir) + size + 1);
		names = (char*)(*dp + n);
		n = 0;
		rewinddir(dir);
		while((e = readdir(dir)) != nil){
			if(strcmp(e->d_name, ".") == 0 || strcmp(e->d_name, "..") == 0)
				continue;
			if(i == 1){
				(*dp)[n].name = strcpy(names, e->d_name);
				names += strlen(e->d_name) + 1;
			}
			size += strlen(e->d_name) + 1;
			n++;
		}
	}
	closedir(dir);
	return n;
}

/* a directory's file under another name: POSIX's rename */
static int
rename_in_dir(char *from, char *to, char *name)
{
	(void)name;
	return rename(from, to);
}

/* the shell's status for a command */
static int
shell(char *cmd)
{
	int st;

	st = system(cmd);
	return WIFEXITED(st) ? WEXITSTATUS(st) : 255;
}

/* a system call, the kernel's answer: a negative errno when it fails
 * (glibc's syscall gives -1 and errno) */
static intptr
ux(intptr n, intptr a, intptr b, intptr c, intptr d, intptr e, intptr f)
{
	intptr r;

	r = syscall(n, a, b, c, d, e, f);
	return r < 0 ? -errno : r;
}

/* a signal's disposition: 0 the default, 1 ignored, 2 noted; without
 * SA_RESTART, so that a call interrupted says so */
static void note_signal(int);
static void
set_signal(int sig, int how)
{
	struct sigaction a;

	memset(&a, 0, sizeof a);
	a.sa_handler = how == 0 ? SIG_DFL : how == 1 ? SIG_IGN : note_signal;
	sigaction(sig, &a, 0);
}

#define ml_fsqrt sqrt

/*****************************************************************************/
/* Int32 and Int64 */
/*****************************************************************************/

static value
copy_int32(int n)
{
	value b;

	b = ml_alloc(1, Int32_tag);
	Field(b, 0) = 0;
	Int32_val(b) = n;
	return b;
}

/* a string's (or bytes') little-endian integer of 2 or 4 bytes at i:
 * the compiled code's when it is not in place (simple's, and ssa's
 * when there is no room for an int32's block); i to i+n-1 checked */
static uchar*
bytes_at(value s, value i, int n)
{
	value k;

	k = Long_val(i);
	if(k < 0 || k + n > length(s))
		ml_raise_c(bound_exn);
	return (uchar*)Bytes(s) + k;
}

value
caml_bytes_get16(value s, value i)
{
	uchar *p;

	p = bytes_at(s, i, 2);
	return Val_int(p[0] | (p[1] << 8));
}

value
caml_bytes_get32(value s, value i)
{
	uchar *p;

	p = bytes_at(s, i, 4);
	return copy_int32(p[0] | (p[1] << 8) | (p[2] << 16) | ((uint)p[3] << 24));
}

value
caml_bytes_set16(value s, value i, value v)
{
	uchar *p;

	p = bytes_at(s, i, 2);
	p[0] = Long_val(v);
	p[1] = Long_val(v) >> 8;
	return Val_unit;
}

value
caml_bytes_set32(value s, value i, value v)
{
	uchar *p;
	uint n;

	p = bytes_at(s, i, 4);
	n = Int32_val(v);
	p[0] = n;
	p[1] = n >> 8;
	p[2] = n >> 16;
	p[3] = n >> 24;
	return Val_unit;
}

static value
copy_int64(vlong n)
{
	value b;

	b = ml_alloc(8 / W, Int64_tag);
	Int64_val(b) = n;
	return b;
}

/* the arithmetic unsigned, so that it wraps; the divisions and the
 * right shift signed */
#define U32(v) ((unsigned int)Int32_val(v))
#define U64(v) ((uvlong)Int64_val(v))

value int32_neg(value a) { return copy_int32(-U32(a)); }
value int32_add(value a, value b) { return copy_int32(U32(a) + U32(b)); }
value int32_sub(value a, value b) { return copy_int32(U32(a) - U32(b)); }
value int32_mul(value a, value b) { return copy_int32(U32(a) * U32(b)); }
value int32_and(value a, value b) { return copy_int32(U32(a) & U32(b)); }
value int32_or(value a, value b) { return copy_int32(U32(a) | U32(b)); }
value int32_xor(value a, value b) { return copy_int32(U32(a) ^ U32(b)); }
value int32_shift_left(value a, value n) { return copy_int32(U32(a) << Long_val(n)); }
value int32_shift_right(value a, value n) { return copy_int32(Int32_val(a) >> Long_val(n)); }
value int32_shift_right_unsigned(value a, value n) { return copy_int32(U32(a) >> Long_val(n)); }
value int32_of_int(value n) { return copy_int32((int)Long_val(n)); }

value int32_format(value fmt, value a) { return format_num(fmt, Int32_val(a), 32); }
value int32_of_string(value s) { return copy_int32((int)parse_int(s, "Int32.of_string")); }

int32_div(value a, value b)
{
	if(Int32_val(b) == 0)
		raise_const(caml_exn_Division_by_zero);
	return copy_int32(Int32_val(a) / Int32_val(b));
}

value
int32_mod(value a, value b)
{
	if(Int32_val(b) == 0)
		raise_const(caml_exn_Division_by_zero);
	return copy_int32(Int32_val(a) % Int32_val(b));
}

/* Wide.mul_high: the bits of a * b above an int's (a and b not
 * negative), from the products of their halves, none of which
 * overflows a word; simple's code, ssa's is the processor's (MULLU on
 * arm, UMULH on arm64: Emit). The same as Wide.ml's, in OCaml */
value
ml_mul_high(value a, value b)
{
	uvalue x, y, x0, x1, y0, y1, m, mid, mid2, hi;
	int n, h;

	n = 8 * sizeof(value) - 1;	/* an int's bits */
	h = n / 2;
	m = ((uvalue)1 << h) - 1;
	x = Long_val(a); y = Long_val(b);
	x0 = x & m; x1 = x >> h;
	y0 = y & m; y1 = y >> h;
	mid = x1 * y0 + ((x0 * y0) >> h);
	mid2 = x0 * y1 + (mid & m);
	hi = x1 * y1 + (mid >> h) + (mid2 >> h);	/* a * b over 2^2h */
	return Val_long(hi >> (n - 2 * h));
}

value int64_neg(value a) { return copy_int64(-U64(a)); }
value int64_add(value a, value b) { return copy_int64(U64(a) + U64(b)); }
value int64_sub(value a, value b) { return copy_int64(U64(a) - U64(b)); }
value int64_mul(value a, value b) { return copy_int64(U64(a) * U64(b)); }
value int64_and(value a, value b) { return copy_int64(U64(a) & U64(b)); }
value int64_or(value a, value b) { return copy_int64(U64(a) | U64(b)); }
value int64_xor(value a, value b) { return copy_int64(U64(a) ^ U64(b)); }
value int64_shift_left(value a, value n) { return copy_int64(U64(a) << Long_val(n)); }
value int64_shift_right(value a, value n) { return copy_int64(Int64_val(a) >> Long_val(n)); }
value int64_shift_right_unsigned(value a, value n) { return copy_int64(U64(a) >> Long_val(n)); }
value int64_of_int(value n) { return copy_int64((vlong)Long_val(n)); }
value int64_to_int(value a) { return Val_int((value)Int64_val(a)); }
value int64_of_int32(value a) { return copy_int64((vlong)Int32_val(a)); }
value int64_to_int32(value a) { return copy_int32((int)Int64_val(a)); }
value int64_format(value fmt, value a) { return format_num(fmt, Int64_val(a), 64); }
value int64_of_string(value s) { return copy_int64(parse_int(s, "Int64.of_string")); }

/* Claude Code

/* A part of mini-ml's runtime: runtime.c includes it. */

/*****************************************************************************/
/* Channels: ocaml-light's io.c, a buffer written when full */
/*****************************************************************************/

typedef struct Chan Chan;
struct Chan {
	int fd;
	int len;                /* output: the bytes buffered; input: those left, */
	int pos;                /* from pos */
	vlong offset;
	uchar buf[4096];
};

value
caml_open_descriptor(value fd)
{
	Chan *c;

	c = malloc(sizeof(Chan));
	c->fd = Long_val(fd);
	c->len = 0;
	c->pos = 0;
	c->offset = 0;
	return (value)c;
}

static void
flush_chan(Chan *c)
{
	if(c->len > 0)
		write(c->fd, c->buf, c->len);
	c->offset += c->len;
	c->len = 0;
}

value
caml_flush(value ch)
{
	flush_chan((Chan*)ch);
	return Val_unit;
}

static void
putc_chan(Chan *c, int b)
{
	if(c->len == 4096)
		flush_chan(c);
	c->buf[c->len++] = b;
}

value
caml_output_char(value ch, value b)
{
	putc_chan((Chan*)ch, Long_val(b));
	return Val_unit;
}

value
caml_output(value ch, value s, value ofs, value len)
{
	value i;

	for(i = 0; i < Long_val(len); i++)
		putc_chan((Chan*)ch, Bytes(s)[Long_val(ofs) + i]);
	return Val_unit;
}

value
caml_output_int(value ch, value n)
{
	Chan *c;

	c = (Chan*)ch;
	n = Long_val(n);
	putc_chan(c, n >> 24);
	putc_chan(c, n >> 16);
	putc_chan(c, n >> 8);
	putc_chan(c, n);
	return Val_unit;
}

/* a system call of Linux's, by its number (the Unix section below):
 * goken's _syscall6, or gnu.h's ux. On Plan 9 (-Dplan9), one of Plan
 * 9's by its number (libc/ix/syscall6_plan9_arm.s), for Unix only:
 * what the runtime itself asks there is the libc's, Plan 9's own */
#ifndef __GNUC__
/* a word each (a long is 32 bits for 7c: a pointer would lose its half) */
extern value _syscall6(value, value, value, value, value, value, value);
#define ux _syscall6
#endif

/* strings.c's copy, words when it can */
extern void move_bytes(char*, char*, value);

/* Linux's read, by its number: its answer says an interruption (-4,
 * EINTR), which a libc's read hides */
#define Interrupted (-4)
static int signalled[65];	/* the signals noted ([0]: one is); below */
static long
fill(Chan *c)
{
	long n;

#ifdef plan9
	/* (signalled: declared below. A read a note interrupted fails,
	 * the note noted by then: note_handler) */
	n = read(c->fd, c->buf, 4096);
	if(n < 0 && signalled[0])
		n = Interrupted;
#else
	n = ux(W == 8 ? 63 : 3, c->fd, (value)c->buf, 4096, 0, 0, 0);
#endif
	if(n > 0){
		c->offset += n;
		c->len = n;
		c->pos = 0;
	}
	return n;
}

/* the next byte, or -1 at the end; a signal's interruption is not one
 * (the signal stays noted, for the next place that runs the handlers) */
static int
getc_chan(Chan *c)
{
	long n;

	if(c->len == 0){
		do n = fill(c); while(n == Interrupted);
		if(n <= 0)
			return -1;
	}
	c->len--;
	return c->buf[c->pos++];
}

value
caml_input_char(value ch)
{
	int b;

	b = getc_chan((Chan*)ch);
	if(b < 0)
		raise_const(caml_exn_End_of_file);
	return Val_int(b);
}

/* The three a program waits in (Pervasives' input_char, input and
 * input_line): interrupted by a signal, they say so (-2, -1, and
 * Scan_interrupted), for Pervasives to run the signal's handler, which
 * is OCaml's, and ask again. Interrupted too, without reading, when a
 * signal came before (signalled[0]: one is noted). */

static long
fill_or_signal(Chan *c)
{
	return signalled[0] ? Interrupted : fill(c);
}

value
ml_input_char(value ch)
{
	Chan *c;
	long n;

	c = (Chan*)ch;
	if(c->len == 0){
		n = fill_or_signal(c);
		if(n <= 0)
			return Val_int(n == Interrupted ? -2 : -1);
	}
	c->len--;
	return Val_int(c->buf[c->pos++]);
}

value
caml_input(value ch, value s, value ofs, value len)
{
	Chan *c;
	value n;

	c = (Chan*)ch;
	if(c->len == 0 && Long_val(len) > 0 && fill_or_signal(c) == Interrupted)
		return Val_int(-1);
	/* what the buffer has, at once (strings.c's move_bytes: the C
	 * library's memmove). A file read was a call of getc_chan a byte: mini-doom's
	 * WAD of 2 MB, 90 million instructions of its start (mini-prof,
	 * plan_profiler.md).
	 * old: n = 0;
	 *   while(n < Long_val(len) && c->len > 0){
	 *     b = getc_chan(c);
	 *     if(b < 0) break;
	 *     Bytes(s)[Long_val(ofs) + n] = b;
	 *     n++;
	 *   } */
	n = Long_val(len) < c->len ? Long_val(len) : c->len;
	if(n < 0)
		n = 0;
	move_bytes((char*)Bytes(s) + Long_val(ofs), (char*)c->buf + c->pos, n);
	c->pos += n;
	c->len -= n;
	return Val_int(n);
}

/* how far to the next newline (included), negated if the buffer ends
 * first: ocaml-light's input_scan_line, which input_line loops on */
#define Scan_interrupted (-100000)
value
caml_input_scan_line(value ch)
{
	Chan *c;
	int i;
	long n;

	c = (Chan*)ch;
	if(c->len == 0){
		n = fill_or_signal(c);
		if(n <= 0)
			return Val_int(n == Interrupted ? Scan_interrupted : 0);
	}
	for(i = 0; i < c->len; i++)
		if(c->buf[c->pos + i] == '\n')
			return Val_int(i + 1);
	return Val_int(-c->len);
}

value
caml_close_channel(value ch)
{
	Chan *c;

	c = (Chan*)ch;
	flush_chan(c);
	close(c->fd);
	return Val_unit;
}

value
caml_pos_out(value ch)
{
	return Val_int(((Chan*)ch)->offset + ((Chan*)ch)->len);
}

value
caml_pos_in(value ch)
{
	return Val_int(((Chan*)ch)->offset - ((Chan*)ch)->len);
}

/* a file's size: its end sought, then where the channel was (offset is
 * the file's position: what was read of it, or written) */
value
caml_channel_size(value ch)
{
	Chan *c;
	vlong size;

	c = (Chan*)ch;
	size = seek(c->fd, 0, 2);
	if(size < 0 || seek(c->fd, c->offset, 0) < 0)
		raise_with(caml_exn_Sys_error, "not a file");
	return Val_int(size);
}

/* what is buffered is dropped (read), or written first */
value
caml_seek_in(value ch, value n)
{
	Chan *c;

	c = (Chan*)ch;
	if(seek(c->fd, Long_val(n), 0) < 0)
		raise_with(caml_exn_Sys_error, "seek_in");
	c->offset = Long_val(n);
	c->len = 0;
	c->pos = 0;
	return Val_unit;
}

value
caml_seek_out(value ch, value n)
{
	Chan *c;

	c = (Chan*)ch;
	flush_chan(c);
	if(seek(c->fd, Long_val(n), 0) < 0)
		raise_with(caml_exn_Sys_error, "seek_out");
	c->offset = Long_val(n);
	return Val_unit;
}

/* output_binary_int's 4 bytes, the high one first, with its sign */
value
caml_input_int(value ch)
{
	int i, b, n;

	n = 0;
	for(i = 0; i < 4; i++){
		b = getc_chan((Chan*)ch);
		if(b < 0)
			raise_const(caml_exn_End_of_file);
		n = n << 8 | b;
	}
	return Val_int((value)n);
}

/* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. */
/* A part of mini-ml's runtime: runtime.c includes it. */

/*****************************************************************************/
/* Digest: MD5 (RFC 1321) */
/*****************************************************************************/

typedef struct MD5 MD5;
struct MD5 {
	unsigned int h[4];
	uvlong len;             /* the bytes added */
	uchar buf[64];          /* those of the block not yet full */
};

/* 2^32 |sin(i + 1)|: a table, not computed, for arm has no floats here */
static unsigned int md5_k[64] = {
	0xd76aa478, 0xe8c7b756, 0x242070db, 0xc1bdceee,
	0xf57c0faf, 0x4787c62a, 0xa8304613, 0xfd469501,
	0x698098d8, 0x8b44f7af, 0xffff5bb1, 0x895cd7be,
	0x6b901122, 0xfd987193, 0xa679438e, 0x49b40821,
	0xf61e2562, 0xc040b340, 0x265e5a51, 0xe9b6c7aa,
	0xd62f105d, 0x02441453, 0xd8a1e681, 0xe7d3fbc8,
	0x21e1cde6, 0xc33707d6, 0xf4d50d87, 0x455a14ed,
	0xa9e3e905, 0xfcefa3f8, 0x676f02d9, 0x8d2a4c8a,
	0xfffa3942, 0x8771f681, 0x6d9d6122, 0xfde5380c,
	0xa4beea44, 0x4bdecfa9, 0xf6bb4b60, 0xbebfbc70,
	0x289b7ec6, 0xeaa127fa, 0xd4ef3085, 0x04881d05,
	0xd9d4d039, 0xe6db99e5, 0x1fa27cf8, 0xc4ac5665,
	0xf4292244, 0x432aff97, 0xab9423a7, 0xfc93a039,
	0x655b59c3, 0x8f0ccc92, 0xffeff47d, 0x85845dd1,
	0x6fa87e4f, 0xfe2ce6e0, 0xa3014314, 0x4e0811a1,
	0xf7537e82, 0xbd3af235, 0x2ad7d2bb, 0xeb86d391,
};
/* a round's four rotations */
static uchar md5_s[16] = { 7, 12, 17, 22, 5, 9, 14, 20, 4, 11, 16, 23, 6, 10, 15, 21 };

static void
md5_block(MD5 *m)
{
	unsigned int a, b, c, d, f, t, w[16];
	uchar *p;
	int i, g, r;

	p = m->buf;
	for(i = 0; i < 16; i++, p += 4)
		w[i] = p[0] | p[1] << 8 | p[2] << 16 | (unsigned int)p[3] << 24;
	a = m->h[0]; b = m->h[1]; c = m->h[2]; d = m->h[3];
	for(i = 0; i < 64; i++){
		/* without ~ on 32 bits: 7c's EORW $0xffffffff is an illegal
		 * instruction by 7l (and so by mini-ld, its twin). The first two
		 * are (b & c) | (~b & d) and (d & b) | (~d & c); ~d is -1 - d */
		switch(i >> 4){
		case 0: f = d ^ (b & (c ^ d)); g = i; break;
		case 1: f = c ^ (d & (b ^ c)); g = (5 * i + 1) & 15; break;
		case 2: f = b ^ c ^ d; g = (3 * i + 5) & 15; break;
		default: f = c ^ (b | (0xffffffff - d)); g = (7 * i) & 15; break;
		}
		t = a + f + md5_k[i] + w[g];
		r = md5_s[(i >> 4) * 4 + (i & 3)];
		a = d; d = c; c = b;
		b += t << r | t >> (32 - r);
	}
	m->h[0] += a; m->h[1] += b; m->h[2] += c; m->h[3] += d;
}

static void
md5_init(MD5 *m)
{
	m->h[0] = 0x67452301; m->h[1] = 0xefcdab89; m->h[2] = 0x98badcfe; m->h[3] = 0x10325476;
	m->len = 0;
}

static void
md5_add(MD5 *m, uchar *p, long n)
{
	long i;

	for(i = 0; i < n; i++){
		m->buf[m->len++ & 63] = p[i];
		if((m->len & 63) == 0)
			md5_block(m);
	}
}

/* the padding (a 1 bit, zeros, the length in bits), then the digest,
 * its 16 bytes in d */
static void
md5_digest(MD5 *m, uchar *d)
{
	uchar pad[8], b;
	uvlong bits;
	int i;

	bits = m->len * 8;
	for(i = 0; i < 8; i++)
		pad[i] = bits >> (8 * i);
	b = 0x80;
	md5_add(m, &b, 1);
	b = 0;
	while((m->len & 63) != 56)
		md5_add(m, &b, 1);
	md5_add(m, pad, 8);
	for(i = 0; i < 16; i++)
		d[i] = m->h[i >> 2] >> (8 * (i & 3));
}

/* the digest as an ML string */
static value
md5_end(MD5 *m)
{
	value s;

	s = string_alloc(16);
	md5_digest(m, (uchar*)Bytes(s));
	return s;
}

value
md5_string(value s, value ofs, value len)
{
	MD5 m;

	md5_init(&m);
	md5_add(&m, Bytes(s) + Long_val(ofs), Long_val(len));
	return md5_end(&m);
}

/* len bytes of the channel (End_of_file if it has fewer), or with a
 * negative len all that is left */
value
md5_chan(value ch, value len)
{
	MD5 m;
	value n;
	int b;
	uchar c;

	md5_init(&m);
	for(n = Long_val(len); n != 0; n--){
		b = getc_chan((Chan*)ch);
		if(b < 0){
			if(n > 0)
				raise_const(caml_exn_End_of_file);
			break;
		}
		c = b;
		md5_add(&m, &c, 1);
	}
	return md5_end(&m);
}

/* ocaml-light's memory.h, over mini-ml's runtime (mlvalues.h says how):
 * a C function's own values, for a collector that moves them. A
 * function that allocates, or calls ML, while it holds values declares
 * its parameters with CAMLparam and its locals with CAMLlocal (once
 * each), and returns with CAMLreturn; a store of a value in a block
 * that may be old (made before the last allocation) is Store_field. */
struct caml__roots_block {
	struct caml__roots_block *next;
	value *v[3];
};
extern struct caml__roots_block *local_roots;
void ml_root(struct caml__roots_block *b, value *v0, value *v1, value *v2);

#define CAMLparam0() struct caml__roots_block *caml__frame = local_roots
#define CAMLparam1(a) CAMLparam0(); struct caml__roots_block caml__p; ml_root(&caml__p, &a, nil, nil)
#define CAMLparam2(a, b) CAMLparam0(); struct caml__roots_block caml__p; ml_root(&caml__p, &a, &b, nil)
#define CAMLlocal1(a) value a = Val_unit; struct caml__roots_block caml__l; ml_root(&caml__l, &a, nil, nil)
#define CAMLlocal2(a, b) value a = Val_unit, b = Val_unit; struct caml__roots_block caml__l; ml_root(&caml__l, &a, &b, nil)
#define CAMLreturn(x) { local_roots = caml__frame; return (x); }
#define CAMLreturn0 { local_roots = caml__frame; return; }

/* (a store remembered when it makes an old block point to a young one:
 * gc.c's generations) */
void ml_store(value *field, value v);
#define Store_field(b, i, v) ml_store(&Field(b, i), v)
#define modify(fp, v) ml_store(fp, v)

/* ocaml-light's mlvalues.h, for C compiled by mini-cc and linked with
 * mini-ml's code, over its runtime (runtime.c): the names ocaml-light's
 * and OCaml's have, so that C written for them says the same #include
 * <mlvalues.h>, and the directory searched (-I) says which runtime. The
 * kernels' C is the first (plan_kernel_mini_ml.md, decision 5). A value
 * is a word: an integer n as 2n+1, or a block's address. */
#ifdef __GNUC__
#include "gnu.h"
#else
#include <u.h>
#include <libc.h>
#endif

/* (for C that asks which runtime it is on: a kernel's processes) */
#define MINI_ML 1
#ifndef __GNUC__
#define NULL nil
#endif

typedef intptr value;
typedef uintptr uvalue;

#define W ((value)sizeof(value))
#define Val_long(n) ((((value)(n)) << 1) + 1)
#define Long_val(v) ((v) >> 1)
#define Val_int(n) Val_long(n)
#define Int_val(v) ((int)Long_val(v))
#define Val_unit Val_long(0)
#define Val_false Val_long(0)
#define Val_bool(b) ((b) ? Val_long(1) : Val_long(0))
#define Bool_val(v) (Long_val(v) != 0)
#define Is_int(v) (((v) & 1) != 0)

/* a block: its fields, its header the word before (the size in words
 * << 10, the tag in the low byte) */
#define Field(v, i) (((value*)(v))[i])
#define Hd(v) (((value*)(v))[-1])
#define Wosize(v) (((uvalue)Hd(v)) >> 10)
/* the largest block, its size what the header's bits above the tag's
 * hold: 4M words on 32 bits (OCaml's Max_wosize) */
#define Max_wosize ((((uvalue)1) << (8 * sizeof(value) - 10)) - 1)
#define Tag(v) (Hd(v) & 255)
#define Closure_tag 247
/* a string's bytes, a float's double: no value in them */
#define String_tag 252
#define Bytes(v) ((uchar*)(v))
#define String_val(v) ((char*)(v))
#define Double_tag 253
#define Double_val(v) (*(double*)(v))
/* a Float.Array: its doubles in the block, after each other (OCaml's
 * Double_array_tag, 254, is Int32_tag here; 251 is OCaml's Abstract_tag,
 * which mini-ml does not have); none a value, so not scanned */
#define Double_array_tag 251
#define Double_array_length(v) (Wosize(v) / (sizeof(double) / W))
/* an int32 and an int64, boxed: their bits, which the collector doesn't
 * scan (a tag of 251 and above), compared and hashed by value */
#define Int32_tag 254
#define Int64_tag 255
#define Int32_val(v) (*(int*)(v))
#define Int64_val(v) (*(vlong*)(v))

/* mini-ml's runtime (plan_ml.md, decision 5; the tutorial's section
 * 11), in C for mini-cc and goken's libc, on arm and arm64: the
 * allocator and Cheney's copying collector (with a young generation:
 * gc.c), the primitives the stdlib names, the channels, the uncaught
 * exception, and main. No assembly: the code mini-ml generates calls
 * ml_alloc and the others with 5c's and 7c's convention, and main calls
 * ml_start (the start object's, which has ml_modify, the write
 * barrier, in assembly too).
 *
 * A value is a word: an integer n as 2n+1, or the address of a block's
 * first field, the block's header the word before it (its size in
 * words << 10, its tag in the low byte: 247 a closure, 252 a string,
 * 253 a float, whose fields hold no value). The roots: the value
 * stack, from its base to ml_vsp (the ML code stores its top there
 * before calling C), and the units' globals (ml_units, the start
 * object's table of each unit's). A C function that allocates pushes
 * its values on the value stack first, and reads them back: the
 * collector moves them. A static block (a string, a closure, an
 * exception) is outside the heap, and the collector leaves it.
 *
 * ocaml-light's names are kept (format_int, make_vect, caml_flush...),
 * and its behavior on arm64, the contract: stdout's buffer is 4096
 * bytes, flushed by flush and at exit, lost on an uncaught exception;
 * an index out of bounds a fatal error. Floats are for phase 7: their
 * primitives here fail when called. */

#include "mlvalues.h"
#include "memory.h"

#ifdef plan9

 * (as rc's exit 3; the libc's exit says "error" for all) */
static void
exit_status(int n)
{
	char buf[16];

	if(n == 0)
		exits(nil);
	snprint(buf, sizeof buf, "%d", n);
	exits(buf);
}
#define exit exit_status
#endif

 * register (R10 on arm, R26 on arm64), stores it here before each call
 * of C and loads it back after, so this C may change it (a push, a
 * thread's switch) and may use that register as any other (the
 * conventions between ML and C: mini-ml's Emit) */

void *ml_handler;

/* the stdlib's other externals, which a unit's closure of its externals
 * names (Lower's Iexternal): each fails when called. The list is the
 * stdlib's non-% primitives this file doesn't define (the
 * floats' functions, Gc, and some of Sys) */
/* by Linux's numbers: chdir, and clock_gettime of the process's
 * processor time (the clock 2), its seconds and nanoseconds a word each */
value
sys_chdir(value name)
{
#ifdef plan9
	if(chdir((char*)Bytes(name)) < 0)
#else
	if(ux(W == 8 ? 49 : 12, (value)Bytes(name), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) < 0)
#endif
		raise_with(caml_exn_Sys_error, (char*)Bytes(name));
	return Val_unit;
}

value
sys_time(value unit)
{
	value t[2];

#ifdef plan9
	/* Plan 9's /dev/cputime: the process's milliseconds in its own
	 * code, then in the kernel's (two of six numbers of 12 bytes);
	 * 0 where the file is not */
	char buf[64];
	int fd, n;

	t[0] = t[1] = 0;
	fd = open("/dev/cputime", OREAD);
	if(fd >= 0){
		n = read(fd, buf, sizeof buf - 1);
		close(fd);
		if(n > 12){
			buf[n] = 0;
			n = atoi(buf) + atoi(buf + 12);
			t[0] = n / 1000;
			t[1] = (n % 1000) * 1000000;
		}
	}
#else
	ux(W == 8 ? 113 : 263, 2, (value)t, 0, 0, 0, 0);
#endif
	return copy_double(t[0] + t[1] / 1e9);
}

/*****************************************************************************/
/* main */
/*****************************************************************************/

void
main(int ac, char *av[])
{
	char *s;

	machine_top = (char*)&s;
	argc = ac;
	argv = av;
	init_exceptions();
	caml_atom0[0] = 0;
	size = HEAPSTART;
#ifdef plan9
	ml_tracing = 1;
#else
#ifdef TRACING
	/* (a kernel's, mkkernel's: its panics say the raise's addresses,
	 * plan_debugger.md's stage 6) */
	ml_tracing = 1;
#else
	ml_tracing = getenv("ML_TRACE") != nil;
#endif
#endif
	s = getenv("ML_HEAP");
	if(s != nil)
		size = atoi(s);
	if(size < 16)
		size = 16;
	if(size > MAXHEAP)
		size = MAXHEAP;
	from = space0;
	other = space1;
	ml_hp = from;
	ml_limit = from + size;
	/* the young generation (gc.c), unless ML_YOUNG=0 or gcc's C */
#ifdef __GNUC__
	young_words = 0;
#else
	young_words = YOUNG;
#endif
#ifndef plan9
	s = getenv("ML_YOUNG");
	if(s != nil && atoi(s) < young_words)
		young_words = atoi(s);
#endif
	/* (a block of 16 fields always young: Emit's fresh) */
	if(young_words > 0 && young_words < 256)
		young_words = 256;
	if(young_words > 0){
		old_hp = from;
		ml_young_lo = young;
		ml_young_hi = young + young_words;
		young_empty();
	}
	ml_vsp = vstack;
	ml_stack(0, vstack);
	push(ml_string("index out of bounds"));
	bound_exn = ml_alloc(2, 0);
	Field(bound_exn, 0) = (value)(caml_exn_Invalid_argument + 1);
	Field(bound_exn, 1) = pop();
	ml_start(vstack);
	exit(0);
}

/* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. */
/* A part of mini-ml's runtime: runtime.c includes it. */

/*****************************************************************************/
/* A trace's line of code, from /src */
/*****************************************************************************/

/* plan_debugger.md, stage 5b: after an uncaught exception's frames, the
 * line of code of the innermost one whose source is there,
 *     Typed.ml:10  let check n = if n > 2 then raise (Bad (...
 * read from the card's /src (the repository: plan_self_hosting.md), or
 * from $ML_SRC elsewhere (a checkout of ix). Its unit compiled with -g:
 * the history says the file by its path in ix (Lines_ml.source), the
 * descriptions its MD5 (mlsources); a copy whose MD5 is not the same,
 * of another day, says nothing rather than a line that moved. The file
 * read a block at a time, summed as it goes (md5.c), nothing kept but
 * the line. */
#ifndef __GNUC__
/* the history's components (their numbers, two bytes each) joined by
 * '/', in p; its length, 0 when it does not fit or a number has no
 * name */
static int
joinpath(uchar *nums, long n, char *p, int max)
{
	long i, o, len;
	uint v, k;
	int t, at, found;
	uchar *nm;

	at = 0;
	for(i = 0; i + 1 < n; i += 2){
		k = (nums[i] << 8) | nums[i + 1];
		found = 0;
		for(o = 0; o + 5 <= nsyms && !found; ){
			o = entry(o, &v, &t, &nm, &len);
			found = t == 'f' && v == k;
		}
		if(!found || at + len + 2 > max)
			return 0;
		if(at > 0 && p[at - 1] != '/')
			p[at++] = '/';
		memmove(p + at, nm, len);
		at += len;
	}
	p[at] = 0;
	return at;
}

/* line n of the file at path, its blanks before it left out, in b (at
 * most max - 1); whether the file's MD5 is hex's */
static int
codeline(char *path, long n, char *hex, char *b, int max)
{
	char buf[4096], h[33];
	uchar d[16];
	MD5 m;
	fdt fd;
	long r, i, line;
	int len, start;

	fd = open(path, OREAD);
	if(fd < 0)
		return 0;
	md5_init(&m);
	line = 1;
	len = 0;
	start = 1;
	while((r = read(fd, buf, sizeof buf)) > 0){
		md5_add(&m, (uchar*)buf, r);
		for(i = 0; i < r; i++)
			if(buf[i] == '\n')
				line++;
			else if(line == n && !(start && (buf[i] == ' ' || buf[i] == '\t')) && len < max - 1){
				b[len++] = buf[i];
				start = 0;
			}
	}
	close(fd);
	b[len] = 0;
	md5_digest(&m, d);
	for(i = 0; i < 16; i++){
		h[2 * i] = "0123456789abcdef"[d[i] >> 4];
		h[2 * i + 1] = "0123456789abcdef"[d[i] & 15];
	}
	return memcmp(h, hex, 32) == 0 && len > 0;
}

/* the trace's line of code, "file:line  text" (cut at 80 columns), in
 * b; its length, 0 when no frame's source is there */
static int
srcline(char *b, int max)
{
	char rel[256], path[512], text[160], d[20], *root, *desc, *hex;
	long line, flen, fl, plen;
	uchar *file, *nums;
	int k, n, s, len;

	root = getenv("ML_SRC");
	if(root == nil)
		root = "/src";
	for(k = 0; k < ntpc; k++){
		line = pc2line(tpc[k]);
		if(line <= 0 || !fileline(tpc[k], line, &file, &flen, &fl, &nums, &plen)
		|| (n = joinpath(nums, plen, rel, sizeof rel)) == 0 || rel[0] == '/'
		|| strlen(root) + n + 2 > sizeof path)
			continue;
		desc = described("mlsources = append mlsources, ", rel, n);
		hex = elnth(desc, 1);
		if(hex == nil || ellen(hex) != 32)
			continue;
		s = strlen(root);
		memmove(path, root, s);
		path[s] = '/';
		memmove(path + s + 1, rel, n + 1);
		if(!codeline(path, fl, hex + 1, text, sizeof text))
			continue;
		len = add(b, 0, max, (char*)file, flen);
		len = add(b, len, max, ":", 1);
		s = digits(fl, 10, 0, d, 20);
		len = add(b, len, max, d + s, 20 - s);
		len = add(b, len, max, "  ", 2);
		/* within the console's 80 columns */
		s = strlen(text);
		if(len + s > 80 && len < 60){
			len = add(b, len, max, text, 80 - 3 - len);
			return add(b, len, max, "...", 3);
		}
		return add(b, len, max, text, s);
	}
	return 0;
}
#else
static int
srcline(char *b, int max)
{
	USED(b);
	USED(max);
	return 0;
}
#endif

/*****************************************************************************/
/* Strings: the last byte the number of padding bytes before it */
/*****************************************************************************/

static value
string_alloc(value len)
{
	value w, s;

	w = len / W + 1;
	s = ml_alloc(w, String_tag);
	Field(s, w - 1) = 0;
	Bytes(s)[w * W - 1] = w * W - 1 - len;
	return s;
}

static value
length(value s)
{
	return Wosize(s) * W - 1 - Bytes(s)[Wosize(s) * W - 1];
}

/* a C string as an ML one */
value
ml_string(char *s)
{
	value r, n;

	n = strlen(s);
	r = string_alloc(n);
	memmove(Bytes(r), s, n);
	return r;
}

value
ml_string_length(value s)
{
	return Val_int(length(s));
}

static void
bound(value s, value i)
{
	if(i < 0 || i >= length(s))
		ml_raise_c(bound_exn);
}

value
ml_string_get(value s, value i)
{
	bound(s, Long_val(i));
	return Val_int(Bytes(s)[Long_val(i)]);
}

value
ml_string_set(value s, value i, value c)
{
	bound(s, Long_val(i));
	Bytes(s)[Long_val(i)] = Long_val(c);
	return Val_unit;
}

void
caml_array_bound_error(void)
{
	ml_raise_c(bound_exn);
}

/* (exceptions.c's) */
extern value caml_exn_Invalid_argument[];
static void raise_with(value*, char*);

value
create_string(value n)
{
	if(Long_val(n) < 0 || (uvalue)(Long_val(n) / W + 1) > Max_wosize)
		raise_with(caml_exn_Invalid_argument, "Bytes.create");
	return string_alloc(Long_val(n));
}

/* a string's bytes copied: the C library's memmove, each machine's
 * assembly (lib_core/libc/arch: 16 bytes a turn on arm64), where it
 * was a byte a turn and this copied by words (docs/plans/plan_pi4.md:
 * 9% of the Pi 4's boot then).
 * old: if((((uvalue)d ^ (uvalue)s) & (W - 1)) != 0 || (d > s && d < s + n)){
 *     memmove(d, s, n);
 *     return;
 *   }
 *   while(n > 0 && ((uvalue)d & (W - 1)) != 0){ *d++ = *s++; n--; }
 *   for(; n >= W; n -= W){ *(value*)d = *(value*)s; d += W; s += W; }
 *   while(n > 0){ *d++ = *s++; n--; }
 * which was itself an optimization (plan_playground_speed.md: copy and
 * fill 29% of a frame's instructions) of
 *   memmove(Bytes(s2) + Long_val(o2), Bytes(s1) + Long_val(o1), Long_val(n)); */
void
move_bytes(char *d, char *s, value n)
{
	memmove(d, s, n);
}

value
blit_string(value s1, value o1, value s2, value o2, value n)
{
	move_bytes((char*)Bytes(s2) + Long_val(o2), (char*)Bytes(s1) + Long_val(o1), Long_val(n));
	return Val_unit;
}

value
fill_string(value s, value o, value n, value c)
{
	char *p;
	uvalue w;

	p = (char*)Bytes(s) + Long_val(o);
	n = Long_val(n);
	c = Long_val(c) & 255;
	w = c | (c << 8);
	w = w | (w << 16);
	if(W == 8)
		w = w | ((w << 16) << 16);
	while(n > 0 && ((uvalue)p & (W - 1)) != 0){
		*p++ = c;
		n--;
	}
	for(; n >= W; n -= W){
		*(uvalue*)p = w;
		p += W;
	}
	while(n > 0){
		*p++ = c;
		n--;
	}
	return Val_unit;
}

value
is_printable(value c)
{
	c = Long_val(c);
	return Val_bool(c >= 32 && c < 127);
}

/* OPTIMIZATION (strings): two strings are equal when their words are,
 * the padding's included: it is 0 (string_alloc, Gen's data,
 * exceptions.c's names), and the last byte, the padding's count, is
 * the same when the lengths are. For = and <> on strings (Lower.string_eqs)
 * and compare.c's relations.
 * old: the lengths compared, then memcmp, a byte a turn:
 *   n = length(a); if(n != length(b)) return Val_false;
 *   return Val_bool(memcmp(Bytes(a), Bytes(b), n) == 0); */
static int
string_equal(value a, value b)
{
	value n, i;

	if(a == b)
		return 1;
	n = Wosize(a);
	if(n != Wosize(b))
		return 0;
	for(i = 0; i < n; i++)
		if(Field(a, i) != Field(b, i))
			return 0;
	return 1;
}

value caml_string_equal(value a, value b) { return Val_bool(string_equal(a, b)); }
value caml_string_notequal(value a, value b) { return Val_bool(!string_equal(a, b)); }

/* n's digits, in base b, at the end of buf; where they start */
static int
digits(uvalue n, int b, int upper, char *buf, int end)
{
	int d;

	do {
		d = n % b;
		buf[--end] = d < 10 ? '0' + d : (upper ? 'A' : 'a') + d - 10;
		n = n / b;
	} while(n != 0);
	return end;
}

/* the same for what a word doesn't hold: an int64 on arm */
static int
digits64(uvlong n, int b, int upper, char *buf, int end)
{
	int d;

	do {
		d = n % b;
		buf[--end] = d < 10 ? '0' + d : (upper ? 'A' : 'a') + d - 10;
		n = n / b;
	} while(n != 0);
	return end;
}

/* printf's integers: %[-0 +]width[d i u x X o], as C's; n of bits bits
 * when it is printed unsigned: 31 or 63 an int's, as ocaml-light's,
 * 32 and 64 an int32's and an int64's */
static value
format_num(value fmt, vlong n, int bits)
{
	char buf[96];
	uchar *f;
	int i, start, left, zero, sign, space, width, neg, b, upper, len, pad, k;
	uvlong u;

	f = Bytes(fmt);
	left = zero = sign = space = width = 0;
	for(i = 1; f[i] == '-' || f[i] == '0' || f[i] == '+' || f[i] == ' '; i++)
		switch(f[i]){
		case '-': left = 1; break;
		case '0': zero = 1; break;
		case '+': sign = 1; break;
		case ' ': space = 1; break;
		}
	while(f[i] >= '0' && f[i] <= '9')
		width = width * 10 + f[i++] - '0';
	while(f[i] == 'l' || f[i] == 'n' || f[i] == 'L')
		i++;
	b = 10; upper = 0; neg = 0;
	switch(f[i]){
	case 'x': b = 16; break;
	case 'X': b = 16; upper = 1; break;
	case 'o': b = 8; break;
	}
	if((f[i] == 'd' || f[i] == 'i') && n < 0){
		neg = 1;
		u = -(uvlong)n;
	}else if((b != 10 || f[i] == 'u') && bits < 64)
		u = (uvlong)n & (((uvlong)1 << bits) - 1);
	else
		u = n;
	start = u == (uvalue)u ? digits(u, b, upper, buf, 64) : digits64(u, b, upper, buf, 64);
	if(neg)
		buf[--start] = '-';
	else if(sign)
		buf[--start] = '+';
	else if(space)
		buf[--start] = ' ';
	len = 64 - start;
	pad = width > len ? width - len : 0;
	k = 0;
	if(pad > 0 && !left && !zero)
		for(; k < pad; k++) buf[k] = ' ';
	if(pad > 0 && zero && !left){
		/* the sign first, then the zeros */
		if(neg || sign || space){
			buf[k++] = buf[start++];
			len--;
		}
		for(i = 0; i < pad; i++) buf[k++] = '0';
	}
	memmove(buf + k, buf + start, len);
	k += len;
	if(pad > 0 && left)
		for(i = 0; i < pad; i++) buf[k++] = ' ';
	buf[k] = 0;
	return ml_string(buf);
}

value format_int(value fmt, value arg) { return format_num(fmt, Long_val(arg), 8 * W - 1); }

/* an integer's value: -, then 0x 0o 0b or decimal, _ between digits;
 * who is the function that fails */
static vlong
parse_int(value s, char *who)
{
	uchar *p;
	value neg, b, d, len, i;
	uvlong n;

	p = Bytes(s);
	len = length(s);
	i = 0; neg = 0; n = 0; b = 10;
	if(i < len && p[i] == '-'){ neg = 1; i++; }
	else if(i < len && p[i] == '+')	/* as OCaml's: +5 */
		i++;
	if(i + 1 < len && p[i] == '0'){
		switch(p[i + 1]){
		case 'x': case 'X': b = 16; i += 2; break;
		case 'o': case 'O': b = 8; i += 2; break;
		case 'b': case 'B': b = 2; i += 2; break;
		}
	}
	if(i == len)
		goto bad;
	for(; i < len; i++){
		if(p[i] == '_')
			continue;
		if(p[i] >= '0' && p[i] <= '9') d = p[i] - '0';
		else if(p[i] >= 'a' && p[i] <= 'f') d = p[i] - 'a' + 10;
		else if(p[i] >= 'A' && p[i] <= 'F') d = p[i] - 'A' + 10;
		else goto bad;
		if(d >= b)
			goto bad;
		n = n * b + d;
	}
	return neg ? -(vlong)n : (vlong)n;
bad:
	failwith(who);
	return 0;
}

value int_of_string(value s) { return Val_int((value)parse_int(s, "int_of_string")); }
