mouseDown: anEvent
	"From a viewer, a copy is taken and the viewer keeps its own;

justDroppedInto: aMorph

	| script |

!ScriptEditorMorph methodsFor: 'initialize'!

	target := aMorph.
	ticking := false.
	borderWidth := 1.
	color := Color r: 1 g: 9/10 b: 7/10.
	title := StringMorph contents: aMorph etoyName, ' script'.
	button := SimpleButtonMorph new.
	button label: 'paused'; target: nil selector: #toggle.
	self addMorph: title; addMorph: button.
	self layout! !

!ScriptEditorMorph methodsFor: 'accessing'!
phrases
	"In the order they are done: from the top."
	^submorphs select: [:m | m isPhraseTile]!

isTicking
	^ticking!

	"Its button: done every cycle, or not at all."
	ticking := ticking not.
	button label: (ticking ifTrue: ['ticking'] ifFalse: ['paused']).
	self layout! !

!ScriptEditorMorph methodsFor: 'dropping'!
wantsDroppedMorph: aMorph
	^aMorph isPhraseTile!

acceptDroppedMorph: aMorph
	"Under the others."
	self addMorphBack: aMorph.
	self layout! !

!ScriptEditorMorph methodsFor: 'layout'!
layout
	"Its name and its button at the top, the phrases under them, and
	itself as big as that takes."
	| y width extent |
	title position: bounds origin + (4 @ 3).
	button position: (title bounds right + 8) @ (bounds top + 2).
	y := bounds top + 26.
	width := button bounds right - bounds left + 4.
	self phrases do: [:p |
		p position: (bounds left + 4) @ y.
		y := p bounds bottom + 2.
		width := width max: p bounds width + 8].
	extent := width @ (y - bounds top + 2).
	extent = bounds extent ifFalse: [self extent: extent]! !

!ScriptEditorMorph methodsFor: 'stepping'!
step
	"A phrase may have been taken out, or its number typed over. And
	if it is ticking, each phrase is done."
	self layout.
	ticking ifTrue: [self phrases do: [:p | p run]]! !

!ViewerMorph class methodsFor: 'instance creation'!
on: aMorph
	^self new setTarget: aMorph! !

!ViewerMorph methodsFor: 'initialize'!
setTarget: aMorph
	"What the morph has, each shown as it is now; then what it can
	do, a phrase each, a !! before it to do it once."
	| y |
	target := aMorph.
	self labelString: aMorph etoyName, ' viewer'.
	self extent: 220 @ 150.
	y := bounds top + self titleHeight + 4.
	#(#x #y #heading) do: [:each | | name value |
		name := StringMorph contents: aMorph etoyName, '''s ', each.
		name position: (bounds left + 8) @ y.
		value := UpdatingStringMorph new.
		value target: aMorph selector: each.
		value position: (bounds left + 140) @ y.
		self addMorph: name; addMorph: value.
		y := y + 19].
	y := self addCommand: #forward: label: 'forward by' at: y + 4.
	self addCommand: #turn: label: 'turn by' at: y!

addCommand: aSymbol label: aString at: y
	"Answers the y under it."
	| phrase bang |
	phrase := PhraseTileMorph target: target selector: aSymbol label: aString argument: 5.
	phrase position: (bounds left + 30) @ y.
	bang := SimpleButtonMorph new.
	bang label: '!!'; target: phrase selector: #run.
	bang position: (bounds left + 6) @ y.
	self addMorph: phrase; addMorph: bang.
	^phrase bounds bottom + 4! !

!ViewerMorph methodsFor: 'accessing'!
target
	^target!

phrases
	^submorphs select: [:m | m isPhraseTile]! !
languages/smalltalk/kernel/squeak/Morphic.st
21634
"Squeak's kernel, the fourth file: Morphic (John Maloney and Randall
Smith, for Self, 1995; Squeak's from 1997). MiniMorphic
(kernel/morphic/MiniMorphic.st) is its four ideas in one file, to read
first: everything on the screen is a Morph; a morph is alive (step);
nobody redraws, a morph says where it changed and the world redraws
those rectangles; the cycle -- events, steps, display -- is the whole
program. Here is what makes it an environment:

- colour and shapes: a FormCanvas draws rectangles, ovals and text on
  a Form of 32 bits, clipped;
- events: the HandMorph turns the mouse and the keyboard into
  messages. A button going down is offered to the morph under the
  hand, then to its owner, and on up: the first that says
  handlesMouseDown: gets mouseDown:, then every mouseMove: and the
  mouseUp:, wherever the hand goes (it has the mouse focus). If none
  does, the morph is picked up: anything on the screen can be dragged.
  The keys go to the morph that has the keyboard focus;
- the halo: the blue button on a morph puts handles around it -- to
  delete it, pick it up, duplicate it, resize it, inspect it. They
  work on any morph, since they only send it delete, duplicate,
  extent: and inspect. The
  halo is a morph too, and follows its target by its step.

The morphs themselves are in Morphs.st. The interpreter knows none of
this: all it gives is BitBlt, the mouse, the keys and the clock."!

!Rectangle methodsFor: 'morphic'!
left
	^origin x!

top
	^origin y!

right
	^corner x!

bottom
	^corner y!

translateBy: aPoint
	^Rectangle origin: origin + aPoint corner: corner + aPoint!

insetBy: anInteger
	"Smaller by that much on every side."
	^Rectangle origin: origin + anInteger corner: corner - anInteger!

expandBy: anInteger
	^Rectangle origin: origin - anInteger corner: corner + anInteger!

intersects: aRectangle
	"The kernel's, in four comparisons of numbers and no Point made:
	it is asked of every morph for every rectangle redrawn."
	^origin x < aRectangle corner x
		and: [aRectangle origin x < corner x
		and: [origin y < aRectangle corner y
		and: [aRectangle origin y < corner y]]]!

intersect: aRectangle
	"What the two have in common; empty (no width) if nothing."
	^Rectangle origin: (origin max: aRectangle origin) corner: (corner min: aRectangle corner)!

merge: aRectangle
	"The smallest rectangle holding both."
	^Rectangle origin: (origin min: aRectangle origin) corner: (corner max: aRectangle corner)! !

!FormCanvas class methodsFor: 'instance creation'!
on: aForm
	^self new setForm: aForm! !

!FormCanvas methodsFor: 'private'!
setForm: aForm
	"One BitBlt for everything filled, with no source: only its
	halftone (the colour), its rectangle and its clipping change."
	form := aForm.
	clip := aForm boundingBox.
	blt := BitBlt destForm: aForm sourceForm: nil halftoneForm: nil combinationRule: 3
		destOrigin: 0 @ 0 sourceOrigin: 0 @ 0 extent: 0 @ 0 clipRect: clip!

setColor: aColor
	"The colour's pixel as the halftone: stored, or blended if it is
	glass. Not made again for the colour just used."
	aColor == color ifTrue: [^self].
	color := aColor.
	blt halftoneForm: (aColor pixelFormForDepth: form depth);
		combinationRule: ((form depth = 32 and: [aColor isOpaque not]) ifTrue: [24] ifFalse: [3])! !

!FormCanvas methodsFor: 'clipping'!
clip
	^clip!

clip: aRectangle
	"Nothing is drawn outside it, whatever is asked: how the world
	redraws one rectangle of the screen and no more."
	clip := aRectangle.
	blt clipRect: aRectangle!

clipBy: aRectangle during: aBlock
	"A morph that keeps what it draws inside itself."
	| old |
	old := clip.
	self clip: (clip intersect: aRectangle).
	aBlock value.
	self clip: old! !

!FormCanvas methodsFor: 'drawing'!
fillRectangle: aRectangle color: aColor
	self setColor: aColor.
	blt destX: aRectangle left destY: aRectangle top; width: aRectangle width height: aRectangle height.
	blt copyBits!

frameRectangle: r width: w color: aColor
	"Its four sides."
	self fillRectangle: (r origin corner: r right @ (r top + w)) color: aColor.
	self fillRectangle: (r left @ (r bottom - w) corner: r corner) color: aColor.
	self fillRectangle: (r left @ (r top + w) corner: (r left + w) @ (r bottom - w)) color: aColor.
	self fillRectangle: ((r right - w) @ (r top + w) corner: r right @ (r bottom - w)) color: aColor!

fillOval: r color: aColor
	"A row at a time: how far the ellipse comes in from its box at that
	height. From its equation, a and b its width and height, k how
	far the row's middle is from the oval's, in half pixels:

	    half the row = a / 2 * sqrt (1 - (k / b) squared)
	                 = sqrt (b squared - k squared) * a / (2 * b)

	Integers but for the root, and no Integer added to a Float: that
	is a coercion each time."
	| a b scale mid |
	(r intersects: clip) ifFalse: [^self].
	self setColor: aColor.
	a := r width.
	b := r height.
	b > 0 ifFalse: [^self].
	scale := a asFloat / (2 * b) asFloat.
	mid := a asFloat / 2.0.
	(r top max: clip top) to: (r bottom min: clip bottom) - 1 do: [:y | | k inset |
		k := y - r top * 2 + 1 - b.
		inset := (mid - ((b * b - (k * k)) asFloat sqrt * scale) + 0.5) truncated.
		blt destX: r left + inset destY: y; width: a - inset - inset height: 1.
		blt copyBits]!

drawString: aString at: aPoint font: aFont color: aColor
	form drawString: aString at: aPoint font: aFont color: aColor clipRect: clip! !

!Morph methodsFor: 'initialize'!

	bounds := 0 @ 0 corner: 50 @ 40.
	submorphs := OrderedCollection new.
	color := Color blue! !

!Morph methodsFor: 'accessing'!
bounds
	^bounds!

	^bounds origin!

	^bounds extent!

	^color!

	^owner!

	^submorphs!

fullBounds
	"With what it holds, which may stick out of it."
	| r |
	r := bounds.
	submorphs do: [:m | r := r merge: m fullBounds].
	^r!

	and on no screen has none."
	^owner == nil ifTrue: [nil] ifFalse: [owner world]!

	the hand: what is picked up when no part of it wants the mouse."
	^(owner == nil or: [owner isWorldOrHand]) ifTrue: [self] ifFalse: [owner root]!

	^false! !

!Morph methodsFor: 'changing'!
color: aColor
	color := aColor.
	self changed!

position: aPoint
	"Move, with all it holds. The place left and the place taken both
	changed: one rectangle if they touch (a small step, the usual
	case), so that the morph is redrawn once, not once for each."
	| delta old new |
	delta := aPoint - bounds origin.
	(delta x = 0 and: [delta y = 0]) ifTrue: [^self].
	old := self fullBounds.
	self privateMoveBy: delta.
	new := self fullBounds.
	(old intersects: new)
		ifTrue: [self invalidRect: (old merge: new)]
		ifFalse: [self invalidRect: old; invalidRect: new]!

extent: aPoint
	self changed.
	bounds := bounds origin extent: aPoint.
	self extentChanged.
	self changed!

bounds: aRectangle
	self position: aRectangle origin; extent: aRectangle extent!

extentChanged
	"For a morph that places what it holds: its size is new."!

privateMoveBy: delta
	bounds := bounds translateBy: delta.
	submorphs do: [:m | m privateMoveBy: delta]!

changed
	"All a morph does about the screen: say where it is no longer
	right. Its submorphs may stick out of it."
	self invalidRect: bounds.
	submorphs do: [:m | m changed]!

invalidRect: aRectangle
	"Up to the world, which keeps it."
	owner == nil ifFalse: [owner invalidRect: aRectangle]! !

!Morph methodsFor: 'submorphs'!
addMorph: aMorph
	"In front of the others: the first submorph is the frontmost."
	aMorph delete.
	submorphs addFirst: aMorph.
	aMorph privateOwner: self.
	aMorph changed!

addMorphBack: aMorph
	aMorph delete.
	submorphs addLast: aMorph.
	aMorph privateOwner: self.
	aMorph changed!

delete
	"Out of its owner, off the screen."
	owner == nil ifTrue: [^self].
	self changed.
	owner submorphs remove: self ifAbsent: [].
	owner := nil!

privateOwner: aMorph
	owner := aMorph!

comeToFront
	(owner == nil or: [owner submorphs first == self]) ifFalse: [owner addMorph: self]!

containsPoint: aPoint
	"A morph that is not a rectangle says where it really is."
	^bounds containsPoint: aPoint!

morphAt: aPoint
	"The frontmost morph there: a submorph before its owner, the first
	submorph before the others."
	submorphs do: [:m | | found |
		found := m morphAt: aPoint.
		found == nil ifFalse: [^found]].
	^(self containsPoint: aPoint) ifTrue: [self] ifFalse: [nil]!

allMorphsDo: aBlock
	aBlock value: self.
	submorphs do: [:m | m allMorphsDo: aBlock]! !

!Morph methodsFor: 'copying'!
duplicate
	"A copy of it and of all it holds, in nobody's hands."
	| new |
	new := self shallowCopy.
	new privateOwner: nil.
	new privateCopySubmorphs.
	^new!

privateCopySubmorphs
	"Each submorph copied; and an instance variable that was one of
	them (a window's label) is now its copy."
	| old |
	old := submorphs.
	submorphs := OrderedCollection new.
	old do: [:m | | c |
		c := m duplicate.
		c privateOwner: self.
		submorphs addLast: c.
		1 to: self class instSize do: [:i | (self instVarAt: i) == m ifTrue: [self instVarAt: i put: c]]]! !

!Morph methodsFor: 'drawing'!
drawOn: aCanvas
	"What a morph looks like: the one method a new kind of morph
	writes."
	aCanvas fillRectangle: bounds color: color!

fullDrawOn: aCanvas
	"Itself, then what it holds, the frontmost last. A morph outside
	the canvas's clipping rectangle is not drawn at all."
	(bounds intersects: aCanvas clip) ifTrue: [self drawOn: aCanvas].
	submorphs reverseDo: [:m | m fullDrawOn: aCanvas]! !

!Morph methodsFor: 'stepping'!
step
	"Sent every cycle. A morph that does something by itself does it
	here."!

fullStep
	self step.
	submorphs copy do: [:m | m fullStep]! !

!Morph methodsFor: 'events'!
handlesMouseDown: anEvent
	"Does it want the mouse? If neither it nor an owner does, it is
	picked up."
	^false!

mouseDown: anEvent
	"The button went down on it."!

mouseMove: anEvent
	"The hand moved, the button still down."!

mouseUp: anEvent
	"The button went up, wherever the hand now is."!

keyStroke: anEvent
	"A character typed while it has the keyboard focus."! !

!Morph methodsFor: 'dropping'!
wantsDroppedMorph: aMorph
	"Does it take what the hand puts down on it? A world does; a
	script takes tiles (Etoys.st)."
	^false!

acceptDroppedMorph: aMorph
	self addMorph: aMorph!

justDroppedInto: aMorph
	"The hand put it down in that morph."! !

!HandMorph methodsFor: 'initialize'!
initialize
	super initialize.
	bounds := 0 @ 0 corner: 0 @ 0.
	lastButtons := 0.
	dragging := false.
	shadow := Color black alpha: 3/10! !

!HandMorph methodsFor: 'accessing'!
isWorldOrHand
	^true!

world
	^owner!

mouseFocus
	^mouseFocus!

keyboardFocus
	^keyboardFocus!

keyboardFocus: aMorph
	"The morph the keys go to. Both the old one and the new one show
	it (a text's caret)."
	| old |
	old := keyboardFocus.
	keyboardFocus := aMorph.
	old == nil ifFalse: [old changed].
	aMorph == nil ifFalse: [aMorph changed]! !

!HandMorph methodsFor: 'changing'!
position: aPoint
	"Carrying nothing, nothing on the screen changes."
	submorphs isEmpty ifFalse: [^super position: aPoint].
	bounds := aPoint corner: aPoint!

changed
	"The hand itself is not drawn: only what it carries."
	submorphs do: [:m | m changed]!

invalidRect: aRectangle
	"What it carries has a shadow."
	owner invalidRect: (aRectangle origin corner: aRectangle corner + 5)! !

!HandMorph methodsFor: 'drawing'!
fullDrawOn: aCanvas
	"What it carries, lifted off the screen: each over its shadow, a
	black glass."
	submorphs reverseDo: [:m |
		aCanvas fillRectangle: (m bounds translateBy: 5 @ 5) color: shadow.
		m fullDrawOn: aCanvas]! !

!HandMorph methodsFor: 'events'!
processEvents
	"The mouse and the keys read once a cycle, and made messages.
	What the buttons were is remembered before a message is sent: if
	it ends in an error, which stops the cycle there, the next cycle
	does not send it again."
	| p buttons before event key |
	p := Sensor mousePoint.
	buttons := Sensor buttons.
	before := lastButtons.
	lastButtons := buttons.
	event := MorphicEvent position: p buttons: buttons key: nil.
	p = bounds origin ifFalse: [
		self position: p.
		mouseFocus == nil ifFalse: [mouseFocus mouseMove: event]].
	(buttons ~= 0 and: [before = 0]) ifTrue: [self mouseDown: event].
	(buttons = 0 and: [before ~= 0]) ifTrue: [self mouseUp: event].
	[(key := Sensor keyboard) == nil] whileFalse: [
		keyboardFocus == nil ifFalse: [
			keyboardFocus keyStroke: (MorphicEvent position: p buttons: buttons key: (Character value: key))]]!

mouseDown: anEvent
	"What it carries is put down. Else, the frontmost morph under it:
	none, the world's menu; with the blue button, its halo; else the
	first of it and its owners that wants the mouse gets it (the
	yellow button too: a text's menu), and if none does the whole is
	picked up."
	| m handler |
	submorphs isEmpty ifFalse: [^self dropAll].
	m := owner morphAt: anEvent position.
	owner closeMenusBut: m.
	anEvent blueButtonPressed ifTrue: [^owner haloOn: m].
	m == nil ifTrue: [^owner openMenuAt: anEvent position].
	handler := m.
	[handler isWorldOrHand or: [handler handlesMouseDown: anEvent]] whileFalse: [handler := handler owner].
	m root comeToFront.
	handler isWorldOrHand ifTrue: [^self grab: m root].
	mouseFocus := handler.
	handler mouseDown: anEvent!

mouseUp: anEvent
	"The focus forgotten before it is told, for the same reason."
	| focus |
	focus := mouseFocus.
	mouseFocus := nil.
	dragging ifTrue: [self dropAll].
	focus == nil ifFalse: [focus mouseUp: anEvent]!

grab: aMorph
	"Picked up, to be put down when the button goes up. It keeps its
	place under the hand."
	self addMorph: aMorph.
	dragging := true!

attachMorph: aMorph
	"Given to the hand, at the hand, to be put down at the next
	click: a morph new from a menu."
	aMorph position: bounds origin.
	self addMorph: aMorph!

dropAll
	"Each into the morph under the hand that wants it, the frontmost
	there or the first of its owners that does; the world wants
	anything, and puts it in front. Then the morph is told where it
	landed."
	submorphs copy do: [:m | | target |
		target := owner morphAt: bounds origin.
		[target == nil or: [target wantsDroppedMorph: m]] whileFalse: [target := target owner].
		target == nil ifTrue: [target := owner].
		target acceptDroppedMorph: m.
		m justDroppedInto: target].
	dragging := false! !

!PasteUpMorph class methodsFor: 'instance creation'!
on: aForm
	"A world drawn on that Form, of 8 or 32 bits. The last one made
	is where the tools open."
	^Current := self new setForm: aForm!

current
	^Current! !

!PasteUpMorph methodsFor: 'initialize'!
setForm: aForm
	bounds := aForm boundingBox.
	color := Color r: 4/5 g: 4/5 b: 4/5.
	canvas := FormCanvas on: aForm.
	damage := OrderedCollection new.
	hand := HandMorph new.
	hand privateOwner: self.
	self invalidRect: bounds! !

!PasteUpMorph methodsFor: 'accessing'!
isWorldOrHand
	^true!

world
	^self!

hand
	^hand!

damage
	^damage! !

!PasteUpMorph methodsFor: 'submorphs'!
wantsDroppedMorph: aMorph
	^true!

morphAt: aPoint
	"A morph of the world, never the world itself."
	| found |
	found := super morphAt: aPoint.
	^found == self ifTrue: [nil] ifFalse: [found]! !

!PasteUpMorph methodsFor: 'damage'!
invalidRect: aRectangle
	"Remember a rectangle to redraw. Nothing clever here: this is sent
	twice for every morph that moves."
	damage add: aRectangle!

damageToRedraw
	"The rectangles to redraw this cycle, and none remembered after.
	A few: each of them, and what did not change is not touched.
	Many: the one rectangle that holds them all, drawn once
	(MiniMorphic.st says why)."
	| rects all |
	rects := damage.
	damage := OrderedCollection new.
	rects size <= 8 ifTrue: [^rects].
	all := rects first.
	rects do: [:r | all := all merge: r].
	^OrderedCollection new add: all; yourself! !

!PasteUpMorph methodsFor: 'stepping'!
doOneCycle
	"The whole of Morphic's main loop."
	hand processEvents.
	submorphs copy do: [:m | m fullStep].
	self displayWorld!

displayWorld
	"Each damaged rectangle: the background, then every morph, back to
	front, what the hand carries last -- the canvas clipped to the
	rectangle, so that what did not change is not touched."
	self damageToRedraw do: [:r | | clip |
		clip := r intersect: bounds.
		canvas clip: clip.
		canvas fillRectangle: clip color: color.
		submorphs reverseDo: [:m | m fullDrawOn: canvas].
		hand fullDrawOn: canvas]! !

!PasteUpMorph methodsFor: 'halo'!
haloOn: aMorph
	"The halo around the whole morph that one is part of, and no
	other halo; on nothing, none."
	submorphs copy do: [:m | m isHalo ifTrue: [m delete]].
	(aMorph == nil or: [aMorph root isHalo]) ifTrue: [^self].
	self addMorph: (HaloMorph on: aMorph root)! !

!HaloMorph class methodsFor: 'instance creation'!
on: aMorph
	^self new setTarget: aMorph! !

!HaloMorph methodsFor: 'initialize'!
setTarget: aMorph
	"Its handles, in the order step places them."
	target := aMorph.
	color := Color blue.
	self addHandle: #delete color: (Color r: 1 g: 2/5 b: 2/5).
	self addHandle: #grab color: Color black.
	self addHandle: #duplicate color: Color green.
	self addHandle: #resize color: Color yellow.
	self addHandle: #inspect color: (Color r: 3/5 g: 4/5 b: 1).
	self addHandle: #viewer color: (Color r: 2/5 g: 9/10 b: 4/5).
	bounds := 0 @ 0 corner: 0 @ 0.
	self step!

addHandle: aSymbol color: aColor
	self addMorphBack: (HaloHandleMorph new setAction: aSymbol color: aColor)! !

!HaloMorph methodsFor: 'accessing'!
isHalo
	^true!

target
	^target!

containsPoint: aPoint
	"Only its handles are there: a click inside goes to the target."
	^false! !

!HaloMorph methodsFor: 'stepping'!
step
	"Follow the target: around it, a handle at the top left (delete),
	the top's middle (pick up), the top right (duplicate), the bottom
	right (resize), the bottom left (inspect) and the left's middle
	(its viewer: Etoys.st). Gone with it."
	| box |
	target owner == nil ifTrue: [^self delete].
	box := target bounds expandBy: 14.
	box = bounds ifTrue: [^self].
	self changed.
	bounds := box.
	(submorphs at: 1) position: box origin.
	(submorphs at: 2) position: (box left + box right - 14 // 2) @ box top.
	(submorphs at: 3) position: (box right - 14) @ box top.
	(submorphs at: 4) position: box corner - 14.
	(submorphs at: 5) position: box left @ (box bottom - 14).
	(submorphs at: 6) position: box left @ (box top + box bottom - 14 // 2).
	self changed! !

!HaloMorph methodsFor: 'drawing'!
drawOn: aCanvas
	aCanvas frameRectangle: (target bounds expandBy: 1) width: 1 color: color! !

!HaloMorph methodsFor: 'handles'!
handle: action down: anEvent
	| hand |
	hand := self world hand.
	action == #delete ifTrue: [
		target delete.
		^self delete].
	action == #inspect ifTrue: [^target inspect].
	action == #viewer ifTrue: [^target openViewer].
	action == #grab ifTrue: [^hand grab: target].
	action == #duplicate ifTrue: [
		target := target duplicate.
		target position: target position + 10.
		^hand grab: target]!

handle: action move: anEvent
	action == #resize ifTrue: [target extent: (anEvent position - target position max: 10 @ 10)]! !

!HaloHandleMorph methodsFor: 'initialize'!
setAction: aSymbol color: aColor
	action := aSymbol.
	color := aColor.
	bounds := 0 @ 0 corner: 14 @ 14! !

!HaloHandleMorph methodsFor: 'drawing'!
drawOn: aCanvas
	aCanvas fillOval: bounds color: Color black.
	aCanvas fillOval: (bounds insetBy: 1) color: color! !

!HaloHandleMorph methodsFor: 'events'!
handlesMouseDown: anEvent
	^true!

mouseDown: anEvent
	owner handle: action down: anEvent!

mouseMove: anEvent
	owner handle: action move: anEvent! !
languages/smalltalk/kernel/squeak/Morphs.st
25361
"Squeak's kernel, the fifth file: the morphs. Morphic.st is the
machinery; these are what one sees. Each is small, because a morph
says little: what it looks like (drawOn:), what it does alone (step),
and what it does with the mouse and the keys, if it wants them.

- BorderedMorph, RectangleMorph, EllipseMorph: a shape and its border;
- AtomMorph: an ellipse that bounces in its owner, the morph that
  steps; BouncingAtomsMorph, a box of them, Squeak's first demo (an
  ideal gas: John Maloney's); PartsBinMorph, a strip of morphs whose
  copies are dragged out of it;
- StringMorph: a line of text; TextMorph: text one types in, selects
  with the mouse, and evaluates (the yellow button's menu: do it,
  print it, inspect it, accept); ListMorph: a column of items, one
  picked;
- SimpleButtonMorph: a click sends a message;
- MenuMorph: a column of items, gone at the next click; the world's
  menu makes new morphs and gives them to the hand;
- SystemWindow: a title, a box to close it, and panes, each placed by
  a rectangle of fractions of the window, so that they follow its
  size.

A window is dragged by its title and comes to the front when touched
without a line here saying so: its label does not want the mouse, so
the hand picks the window up (Morphic.st)."!

	super initialize.
	color := Color yellow! !

!EllipseMorph methodsFor: 'drawing'!
drawOn: aCanvas

	borderWidth > 0 ifTrue: [aCanvas fillOval: bounds color: borderColor].
	aCanvas fillOval: (bounds insetBy: borderWidth) color: color! !

!EllipseMorph methodsFor: 'submorphs'!
containsPoint: aPoint
	"Inside the ellipse, not only its box: the equation, multiplied
	out so that the numbers stay whole. A click in a corner goes to
	what is behind."
	| x y a b |
	(bounds containsPoint: aPoint) ifFalse: [^false].
	x := aPoint x * 2 - bounds left - bounds right.
	y := aPoint y * 2 - bounds top - bounds bottom.
	a := bounds width.
	b := bounds height.
	^(x * x * b * b) + (y * y * a * a) <= (a * a * b * b)! !

!AtomMorph methodsFor: 'initialize'!
initialize
	super initialize.
	bounds := 0 @ 0 corner: 14 @ 14.
	borderWidth := 1.
	color := Color red.
	velocity := 3 @ 2! !

!AtomMorph methodsFor: 'accessing'!
velocity
	^velocity!

velocity: aPoint
	velocity := aPoint! !

!AtomMorph methodsFor: 'stepping'!
step
	"Move by the velocity, and turn back at the owner's walls. In the
	hand, be still."
	| box p vx vy |
	(owner isKindOf: HandMorph) ifTrue: [^self].
	box := owner bounds.
	vx := velocity x.
	vy := velocity y.
	p := bounds origin + velocity.
	(p x < box left or: [p x + bounds width > box right]) ifTrue: [vx := vx negated].
	(p y < box top or: [p y + bounds height > box bottom]) ifTrue: [vy := vy negated].
	velocity := vx @ vy.
	self position: bounds origin + velocity! !

!BouncingAtomsMorph methodsFor: 'initialize'!
initialize
	"A box and twelve atoms in it, each with its place, its speed and
	its colour. Nothing else: an atom bounces in its owner, the box
	steps what it holds, and moves with it when dragged."
	| colors |
	super initialize.
	bounds := 0 @ 0 corner: 190 @ 160.
	borderWidth := 1.
	color := Color r: 1 g: 1 b: 4/5.
	colors := Array with: Color red with: Color blue with: Color green.
	1 to: 12 do: [:i | | atom |
		atom := AtomMorph new.
		atom extent: 10 @ 10.
		atom color: (colors at: i \\ 3 + 1).
		atom velocity: (i \\ 5 - 2 * 2 + 1) @ (i \\ 3 - 1 * 2 + 1).
		self addMorph: atom.
		atom position: (i * 53 \\ 170 + 5) @ (i * i * 29 \\ 140 + 5)]! !

!PartsBinMorph methodsFor: 'initialize'!
initialize
	"A rectangle, an ellipse, a string and a box of atoms, side by
	side."
	| x |
	super initialize.
	borderWidth := 1.
	color := Color r: 9/10 g: 9/10 b: 1.
	x := 8.
	(Array with: RectangleMorph new with: EllipseMorph new with: (StringMorph contents: 'Text') with: AtomMorph new) do: [:part |
		part position: x @ 8.
		self addMorphBack: part.
		x := part bounds right + 8].
	bounds := 0 @ 0 corner: x @ 56! !

!PartsBinMorph methodsFor: 'events'!
handlesMouseDown: anEvent
	^true!

mouseDown: anEvent
	"On a part: a copy of it in the hand, the part stays. Elsewhere:
	the bin itself is picked up."
	| part |
	part := submorphs detect: [:m | m containsPoint: anEvent position] ifNone: [nil].
	self world hand grab: (part == nil ifTrue: [self] ifFalse: [part duplicate])! !

!PartsBinMorph methodsFor: 'stepping'!
fullStep
	"Its parts are for show: an atom in the bin does not bounce."! !

!TextMorph methodsFor: 'initialize'!
initialize
	super initialize.
	bounds := 0 @ 0 corner: 200 @ 80.
	color := Color white.
	ink := Color black.
	highlight := Color r: 7/10 g: 4/5 b: 1.
	font := StrikeFont default.
	text := ''.
	cursor := 0.
	anchor := 0.
	firstLine := 0! !

!TextMorph methodsFor: 'accessing'!
contents
	^text!

contents: aString
	"The lines end with a return, Character value: 13."
	text := aString.
	cursor := 0.
	anchor := 0.
	firstLine := 0.
	self changed!

cursor
	"How many characters are before the caret."
	^cursor!

selection
	"From the anchor, where the button went down, to the cursor."
	^text copyFrom: (cursor min: anchor) + 1 to: (cursor max: anchor)!

selectFrom: start to: stop
	"The characters after the first start, up to the stop-th."
	anchor := start.
	cursor := stop.
	self scrollToCursor.
	self changed!

receiver: anObject
	"Who self is in what is evaluated here: nil in a Workspace, the
	object in its Inspector."
	receiver := anObject!

acceptTarget: anObject selector: aSymbol
	"Who is given the text when it is accepted: a Browser, to
	compile it."
	acceptTarget := anObject.
	acceptSelector := aSymbol!

hasFocus
	| w |
	w := self world.
	^w notNil and: [w hand keyboardFocus == self]! !

!TextMorph methodsFor: 'lines'!
linesDo: aBlock
	"Each line and how many characters are before it."
	| start |
	start := 0.
	1 to: text size do: [:i |
		(text at: i) value = 13 ifTrue: [
			aBlock value: (text copyFrom: start + 1 to: i - 1) value: start.
			start := i]].
	aBlock value: (text copyFrom: start + 1 to: text size) value: start!

visibleLines
	^bounds height - 4 // font height!

cursorRow
	"The line the cursor is on, the first one 0."
	| row |
	row := 0.
	1 to: cursor do: [:i | (text at: i) value = 13 ifTrue: [row := row + 1]].
	^row!

scrollToCursor
	"The first line shown changed so that the cursor's is."
	| row |
	row := self cursorRow.
	row < firstLine ifTrue: [firstLine := row].
	row >= (firstLine + self visibleLines) ifTrue: [firstLine := row - self visibleLines + 1 max: 0]!

cursorPoint
	"The top of the caret: on the line that has the cursor, after the
	width of what is before it."
	| y |
	y := bounds top + 2 - (firstLine * font height).
	self linesDo: [:line :start |
		cursor <= (start + line size) ifTrue: [
			^(bounds left + 3 + (font widthOfString: (line copyFrom: 1 to: cursor - start))) @ y].
		y := y + font height].
	^(bounds left + 3) @ y!

indexAt: aPoint
	"The cursor for a click there: its line, then the characters
	whose middle is left of it."
	| row n |
	row := (aPoint y - bounds top - 2) // font height + firstLine max: 0.
	n := 0.
	self linesDo: [:line :start | | x i |
		n = row ifTrue: [
			x := bounds left + 3.
			i := 0.
			[i < line size and: [x + ((font widthOf: (line at: i + 1)) // 2) < aPoint x]] whileTrue: [
				i := i + 1.
				x := x + (font widthOf: (line at: i))].
			^start + i].
		n := n + 1].
	^text size! !

!TextMorph methodsFor: 'editing'!
replaceSelectionWith: aString
	"What is typed takes the place of what is selected."
	| lo hi |
	lo := cursor min: anchor.
	hi := cursor max: anchor.
	text := (text copyFrom: 1 to: lo), aString, (text copyFrom: hi + 1 to: text size).
	cursor := lo + aString size.
	anchor := cursor!

backspace
	cursor = anchor ifTrue: [
		cursor = 0 ifTrue: [^self].
		anchor := cursor - 1].
	self replaceSelectionWith: ''!

insertAfterSelection: aString
	"After what is selected, and selected itself: an answer printed,
	the compiler's complaint -- a backspace takes it away."
	| end |
	end := cursor max: anchor.
	cursor := end.
	anchor := end.
	self replaceSelectionWith: aString.
	anchor := end.
	self scrollToCursor.
	self changed! !

!TextMorph methodsFor: 'evaluating'!
selectLine
	"Nothing selected: the cursor's line is."
	cursor = anchor ifFalse: [^self].
	self linesDo: [:line :start |
		cursor <= (start + line size) ifTrue: [
			anchor := start.
			cursor := start + line size.
			^self]]!

evaluateThen: aBlock
	"The selection compiled as a method of the receiver's class, DoIt,
	whose answer is the last statement's, and sent: the compiler and
	the interpreter are the ones that run everything else. The
	compiler's complaint, if any, goes after the selection."
	| return compiled |
	self selectLine.
	return := String with: (Character value: 13).
	compiled := receiver class compile: 'DoIt', return, '^[', self selection, return, '] value' classified: 'do its'.
	compiled isSymbol ifFalse: [^self insertAfterSelection: ' ', compiled].
	aBlock value: (receiver perform: #DoIt)!

doIt
	self evaluateThen: [:value | self changed]!

printIt
	self evaluateThen: [:value | self insertAfterSelection: ' ', value printString]!

inspectIt
	self evaluateThen: [:value | value inspect]!

accept
	acceptTarget == nil ifFalse: [acceptTarget perform: acceptSelector with: text]! !

!TextMorph methodsFor: 'events'!
handlesMouseDown: anEvent
	^true!

mouseDown: anEvent
	"The keys are now for this text. The red button: the caret where
	the click is, and the selection starts there. The yellow one: its
	menu."
	self world hand keyboardFocus: self.
	anEvent redButtonPressed ifFalse: [^self openMenuAt: anEvent position].
	cursor := self indexAt: anEvent position.
	anchor := cursor.
	self changed!

mouseMove: anEvent
	"The selection follows the hand; past the top or the bottom, the
	text scrolls."
	anEvent redButtonPressed ifFalse: [^self].
	anEvent position y < bounds top ifTrue: [firstLine := firstLine - 1 max: 0].
	anEvent position y > bounds bottom ifTrue: [firstLine := firstLine + 1].
	cursor := self indexAt: anEvent position.
	self scrollToCursor.
	self changed!

openMenuAt: aPoint
	| menu |
	menu := MenuMorph new.
	menu add: 'do it' target: self selector: #doIt.
	menu add: 'print it' target: self selector: #printIt.
	menu add: 'inspect it' target: self selector: #inspectIt.
	acceptTarget == nil ifFalse: [menu add: 'accept' target: self selector: #accept].
	menu popUpAt: aPoint in: self world!

keyStroke: anEvent
	"A character typed, a return, a tab, a backspace (8), the arrows
	(28 left, 29 right, 30 up, 31 down). A character typed in a line
	damages that line only."
	| c first plain |
	c := anEvent keyCharacter value.
	first := firstLine.
	plain := c >= 32 and: [c < 127 and: [cursor = anchor]].
	c = 8 ifTrue: [self backspace].
	c = 28 ifTrue: [cursor := cursor - 1 max: 0. anchor := cursor].
	c = 29 ifTrue: [cursor := cursor + 1 min: text size. anchor := cursor].
	c = 30 ifTrue: [cursor := self indexAt: self cursorPoint - (0 @ font height). anchor := cursor].
	c = 31 ifTrue: [cursor := self indexAt: self cursorPoint + (0 @ font height). anchor := cursor].
	(c = 13 or: [c = 9 or: [c >= 32 and: [c < 127]]]) ifTrue: [
		self replaceSelectionWith: (String with: anEvent keyCharacter)].
	self scrollToCursor.
	(plain and: [first = firstLine])
		ifTrue: [self invalidRect: (bounds left @ self cursorPoint y corner: bounds right @ (self cursorPoint y + font height))]
		ifFalse: [self changed]! !

!TextMorph methodsFor: 'drawing'!
drawOn: aCanvas
	"The paper, then the lines that are in what is redrawn, each over
	its part of the selection, kept inside the paper; the caret if
	the keys come here and nothing is selected."
	| lo hi row |
	aCanvas fillRectangle: bounds color: color.
	lo := cursor min: anchor.
	hi := cursor max: anchor.
	row := 0.
	aCanvas clipBy: bounds during: [
		self linesDo: [:line :start | | y |
			y := bounds top + 2 + (row - firstLine * font height).
			(row >= firstLine and: [y < aCanvas clip bottom and: [y + font height > aCanvas clip top]]) ifTrue: [
				(lo < hi and: [lo <= (start + line size) and: [hi > start]]) ifTrue: [
					aCanvas
						fillRectangle: ((self xIn: line at: lo - start) @ y
							corner: ((self xIn: line at: hi - start) + (hi > (start + line size) ifTrue: [4] ifFalse: [0])) @ (y + font height))
						color: highlight].
				aCanvas drawString: line at: (bounds left + 3) @ y font: font color: ink].
			row := row + 1].
		(lo = hi and: [self hasFocus]) ifTrue: [
			aCanvas fillRectangle: (self cursorPoint extent: 1 @ font height) color: ink]]!

xIn: aLine at: n
	"Where the n-th character of a line ends on the screen; before
	the line's start, its start; past its end, its end."
	^bounds left + 3 + (font widthOfString: (aLine copyFrom: 1 to: ((n max: 0) min: aLine size)))! !

!ListMorph methodsFor: 'initialize'!
initialize
	super initialize.
	bounds := 0 @ 0 corner: 100 @ 100.
	color := Color white.
	font := StrikeFont default.
	ink := Color black.
	edge := Color gray.
	items := #().
	selection := 0.
	firstItem := 0! !

!ListMorph methodsFor: 'accessing'!
items
	^items!

items: aCollection
	"What it lists: Strings or Symbols. Nothing selected."
	items := aCollection asArray.
	selection := 0.
	firstItem := 0.
	self changed!

selection
	"The selected item's place, 0 for none."
	^selection!

selectedItem
	^selection = 0 ifTrue: [nil] ifFalse: [items at: selection]!

target: anObject selector: aSymbol
	"Who is told when an item is picked, with its place."
	target := anObject.
	selector := aSymbol!

visibleRows
	^bounds height - 4 // font height! !

!ListMorph methodsFor: 'selecting'!
highlight: anInteger
	"Shown as selected, scrolled to, nobody told yet."
	selection := (anInteger max: 0) min: items size.
	selection > 0 ifTrue: [
		selection <= firstItem ifTrue: [firstItem := selection - 1].
		selection > (firstItem + self visibleRows) ifTrue: [firstItem := selection - self visibleRows max: 0]].
	self changed!

select: anInteger
	"An item picked: the target told."
	self highlight: anInteger.
	(target == nil or: [selection = 0]) ifFalse: [target perform: selector with: selection]!

selectItem: anObject
	"Picked by what it is, as a click on it would."
	self select: (items indexOf: anObject)! !

!ListMorph methodsFor: 'events'!
handlesMouseDown: anEvent
	^true!

mouseDown: anEvent
	self world hand keyboardFocus: self.
	self mouseMove: anEvent!

mouseMove: anEvent
	"The item under the hand shown selected; past the top or the
	bottom, the list scrolls."
	| y |
	y := anEvent position y.
	y < bounds top ifTrue: [^self highlight: firstItem].
	y >= bounds bottom ifTrue: [^self highlight: firstItem + self visibleRows + 1].
	self highlight: (y - bounds top - 2 // font height + firstItem + 1 max: 1)!

mouseUp: anEvent
	"Picked when the button goes up."
	self select: selection!

keyStroke: anEvent
	"The arrows up (30) and down (31)."
	| c |
	c := anEvent keyCharacter value.
	c = 30 ifTrue: [self select: (selection - 1 max: 1)].
	c = 31 ifTrue: [self select: selection + 1]! !

!ListMorph methodsFor: 'drawing'!
drawOn: aCanvas
	"The rows that fit, from the first one shown; the selected one
	white on black."
	aCanvas fillRectangle: bounds color: color.
	aCanvas clipBy: bounds during: [
		firstItem + 1 to: (firstItem + self visibleRows + 1 min: items size) do: [:i | | y |
			y := bounds top + 2 + (i - 1 - firstItem * font height).
			i = selection
				ifTrue: [
					aCanvas fillRectangle: (bounds left @ y corner: bounds right @ (y + font height)) color: ink.
					aCanvas drawString: (items at: i) at: (bounds left + 3) @ y font: font color: color]
				ifFalse: [aCanvas drawString: (items at: i) at: (bounds left + 3) @ y font: font color: ink]]].
	aCanvas frameRectangle: bounds width: 1 color: edge! !

!SimpleButtonMorph methodsFor: 'initialize'!
initialize
	super initialize.
	borderWidth := 1.
	color := Color r: 9/10 g: 9/10 b: 9/10! !

!SimpleButtonMorph methodsFor: 'accessing'!
target: anObject selector: aSymbol
	"What a click sends, and to whom; to nobody, to its owner."
	target := anObject.
	selector := aSymbol!

label: aString
	"A string in its middle, the button as big as needed."
	| s |
	submorphs copy do: [:m | m delete].
	s := StringMorph contents: aString.
	self extent: s extent + (12 @ 4).
	s position: bounds origin + (6 @ 2).
	self addMorph: s! !

!SimpleButtonMorph methodsFor: 'events'!
handlesMouseDown: anEvent
	^true!

mouseUp: anEvent
	"A click is the button going up while still on it."
	(self containsPoint: anEvent position) ifFalse: [^self].
	(target == nil ifTrue: [owner] ifFalse: [target]) perform: selector! !

!MenuItemMorph methodsFor: 'initialize'!
initialize
	super initialize.
	highlighted := false!

setTarget: anObject selector: aSymbol arguments: anArray
	target := anObject.
	selector := aSymbol.
	arguments := anArray! !

!MenuItemMorph methodsFor: 'events'!
handlesMouseDown: anEvent
	^true!

mouseDown: anEvent
	highlighted := true.
	self changed!

mouseUp: anEvent
	"Chosen: the menu goes, the message is sent."
	highlighted := false.
	self changed.
	(self containsPoint: anEvent position) ifFalse: [^self].
	owner delete.
	target perform: selector withArguments: arguments! !

!MenuItemMorph methodsFor: 'drawing'!
drawOn: aCanvas
	highlighted ifFalse: [^super drawOn: aCanvas].
	aCanvas fillRectangle: bounds color: color.
	aCanvas drawString: contents at: bounds origin font: font color: Color white! !

!MenuMorph methodsFor: 'initialize'!

	super initialize.
	borderWidth := 1.
	color := Color white.
	bounds := 0 @ 0 corner: 8 @ 4! !

!MenuMorph methodsFor: 'accessing'!
isMenu
	^true! !

!MenuMorph methodsFor: 'items'!
add: aString target: anObject selector: aSymbol
	self add: aString target: anObject selector: aSymbol arguments: #()!

add: aString target: anObject selector: aSymbol argument: argument
	self add: aString target: anObject selector: aSymbol arguments: (Array with: argument)!

add: aString target: anObject selector: aSymbol arguments: anArray
	"Under the last one; the menu as wide as its widest item."
	| item |
	item := MenuItemMorph contents: aString.
	item setTarget: anObject selector: aSymbol arguments: anArray.
	item position: (bounds left + 4) @ (bounds bottom - 2).
	self addMorphBack: item.
	bounds := bounds origin corner: (bounds right max: item bounds right + 4) @ (item bounds bottom + 2)!

popUpAt: aPoint in: aWorld
	"Every item as wide as the menu: the whole line is the item."
	self position: aPoint.
	submorphs do: [:item | item extent: (bounds width - 8) @ item extent y].
	aWorld addMorph: self! !

!PasteUpMorph methodsFor: 'menus'!
closeMenusBut: aMorph
	"A menu goes at the next click that is not on it."
	submorphs copy do: [:m |
		(m isMenu and: [aMorph == nil or: [aMorph root ~~ m]]) ifTrue: [m delete]]!

openMenuAt: aPoint
	"The world's menu, a click on the world itself."
	| menu |
	menu := MenuMorph new.
	menu add: 'new rectangle' target: self selector: #newMorph: argument: RectangleMorph.
	menu add: 'new ellipse' target: self selector: #newMorph: argument: EllipseMorph.
	menu add: 'new string' target: self selector: #newMorph: argument: StringMorph.
	menu add: 'new text' target: self selector: #newMorph: argument: TextMorph.
	menu add: 'new window' target: self selector: #newMorph: argument: SystemWindow.
	menu add: 'new car' target: self selector: #newMorph: argument: CarMorph.
	menu add: 'bouncing atoms' target: self selector: #newMorph: argument: BouncingAtomsMorph.
	menu add: 'parts bin' target: self selector: #newMorph: argument: PartsBinMorph.
	menu add: 'workspace' target: Workspace selector: #open.
	menu add: 'browser' target: Browser selector: #open.
	menu add: 'transcript' target: Transcript selector: #open.
	menu add: 'restore display' target: self selector: #restoreDisplay.
	menu popUpAt: aPoint in: self!

newMorph: aClass
	"In the hand, to be put down where the next click is."
	hand attachMorph: aClass new!

restoreDisplay
	self invalidRect: bounds! !

!SystemWindow methodsFor: 'initialize'!
initialize
	super initialize.
	borderWidth := 1.
	color := Color r: 9/10 g: 9/10 b: 9/10.
	titleColor := Color r: 3/5 g: 4/5 b: 1.
	bounds := 0 @ 0 corner: 260 @ 160.
	panes := OrderedCollection new.
	frames := OrderedCollection new.
	closeBox := SimpleButtonMorph new.
	closeBox extent: 13 @ 13; color: (Color r: 1 g: 2/5 b: 2/5); target: nil selector: #delete.
	label := StringMorph contents: 'Window'.
	self addMorph: closeBox; addMorph: label.
	self extentChanged! !

!SystemWindow methodsFor: 'accessing'!
labelString: aString
	label contents: aString!

titleHeight
	^label extent y + 4!

paneArea
	"Under the title, inside the border."
	^(bounds left + 1) @ (bounds top + self titleHeight) corner: bounds corner - 1! !

!SystemWindow methodsFor: 'opening'!
openInWorld
	"In the world the tools open in, each a little further than the
	last."
	| world |
	world := PasteUpMorph current.
	self position: world submorphs size * 24 + 30 @ (world submorphs size * 24 + 30).
	world addMorph: self! !

!SystemWindow methodsFor: 'panes'!
addMorph: aMorph frame: aRectangle
	"A pane: where it is, in fractions of the area under the title
	(0 @ 0 corner: 1/2 @ 1, its left half)."
	panes add: aMorph.
	frames add: aRectangle.
	self addMorph: aMorph.
	self extentChanged!

extentChanged
	"Everything put where the window's size says."
	| area |
	closeBox position: bounds origin + 4.
	label position: bounds origin + (24 @ 2).
	area := self paneArea.
	panes with: frames do: [:pane :f |
		pane bounds: ((area left + (area width * f left) rounded) @ (area top + (area height * f top) rounded)
			corner: (area left + (area width * f right) rounded) @ (area top + (area height * f bottom) rounded))]! !

!SystemWindow methodsFor: 'copying'!
privateCopySubmorphs
	"The panes are the copies' too."
	| old |
	old := submorphs.
	super privateCopySubmorphs.
	panes := panes collect: [:p | submorphs at: (old indexOf: p)]! !

!SystemWindow methodsFor: 'drawing'!
drawOn: aCanvas
	super drawOn: aCanvas.
	aCanvas fillRectangle: (bounds origin + 1 corner: (bounds right - 1) @ (bounds top + self titleHeight))
		color: titleColor! !
languages/smalltalk/kernel/squeak/Text.st
8329
"Squeak's kernel, the third file: text. A font is a picture: all its
characters drawn side by side in one Form of one bit a pixel, the
glyphs, and a table saying where each one starts (the strike format,
the Alto's, 1973: a strike is that long row of characters).

          xTable:  0     9      18    27 ...
          glyphs:  |  A  |  B   |  C  |
                   +-----+------+-----+

A string is drawn a character at a time, each one a BitBlt from its
place in the glyphs to the next place on the line: nothing else, text
is BitBlt. Its colour is a colour map (Color.st): the glyphs' 0 is
nothing, their 1 the ink.

The glyphs are not stored: they are drawn the first time the font is
asked for, by a Pen, from Hershey's strokes (A. V. Hershey,
'Calligraphy for Computers', 1967: letters as a few lines, made for
pen plotters). A glyph is a String, each point two characters, their
distances from the letter R (R is 0, S is 1, Q is -1); the first two
are its left and right sides, and a space then R lifts the pen. For A:

    I[RFJ[ RRFZ[ RMTWT     I [  from -9 to 9: 18 wide
                           RF J[   (0, -12) to (-8, 9): the left leg
                           RF Z[   (0, -12) to (8, 9): the right leg
                           MT WT   (-5, 2) to (5, 2): the bar

y goes down, from -16 to 16, 33 rows; the baseline is at 9. A font of
height h is those rows scaled to h rows of pixels: 33 is a pixel a
unit, the default, 17, half of it."!

Object subclass: #StrikeFont
	instanceVariableNames: 'glyphs xTable height'
	classVariableNames: 'Default'
	poolDictionaries: ''
	category: 'Graphics-Text'!

!StrikeFont class methodsFor: 'instance creation'!
height: pixels
	"Drawn now: some 300,000 bytecodes."
	^self new renderHershey: pixels!

default
	Default == nil ifTrue: [Default := self height: 17].
	^Default! !

!StrikeFont methodsFor: 'private'!
renderHershey: pixels
	"The table first, each glyph as wide as its two sides say; then
	the glyphs, a Pen following the strokes."
	| strokes x pen |
	height := pixels.
	strokes := StrikeFont hersheyStrokes.
	xTable := Array new: strokes size + 1.
	x := 0.
	1 to: strokes size do: [:i | | s |
		s := strokes at: i.
		xTable at: i put: x.
		x := x + (self scale: (s at: 2) value - (s at: 1) value)].
	xTable at: strokes size + 1 put: x.
	glyphs := Form extent: x @ height.
	pen := Pen new.
	pen destForm: glyphs.
	1 to: strokes size do: [:i |
		"a stroke that rounds past its glyph's side must not mark the next one"
		pen clipRect: ((xTable at: i) @ 0 corner: (xTable at: i + 1) @ height).
		self draw: (strokes at: i) with: pen at: (xTable at: i)]!

scale: units
	"Hershey's units to pixels, rounded."
	^units * (height - 1) + 16 // 32!

draw: aString with: aPen at: left
	"A glyph's strokes: the pen goes to each point, down but for the
	first of a stroke."
	| side i x y |
	side := (aString at: 1) value.
	aPen up.
	i := 3.
	[i < aString size] whileTrue: [
		x := (aString at: i) value.
		y := (aString at: i + 1) value.
		(x = 32 and: [y = 82])
			ifTrue: [aPen up]
			ifFalse: [
				aPen goto: (left + (self scale: x - side)) @ (self scale: y - 82 + 16).
				aPen down].
		i := i + 2]!

indexOf: aCharacter
	"Its place in the table; a character the font does not have is
	a question mark."
	| v |
	v := aCharacter value.
	^(v < 32 or: [v > 127]) ifTrue: [32] ifFalse: [v - 31]! !

!StrikeFont methodsFor: 'accessing'!
glyphs
	^glyphs!

height
	^height!

ascent
	"From the top of a line down to the baseline, where the letters
	sit: Hershey's 9, of -16 to 16."
	^self scale: 25!

leftOf: aCharacter
	"Where its glyph starts in the glyphs."
	^xTable at: (self indexOf: aCharacter)!

widthOf: aCharacter
	"A tab is four spaces wide, and nothing drawn."
	| i |
	aCharacter value = 9 ifTrue: [^(xTable at: 2) * 4].
	i := self indexOf: aCharacter.
	^(xTable at: i + 1) - (xTable at: i)!

widthOfString: aString
	^aString inject: 0 into: [:sum :c | sum + (self widthOf: c)]! !

!Form methodsFor: 'text'!
drawString: aString at: aPoint font: aFont color: aColor
	^self drawString: aString at: aPoint font: aFont color: aColor clipRect: self boundingBox!

drawString: aString at: aPoint font: aFont color: aColor clipRect: aRectangle
	"From aPoint, the top left of the line; answers the x where it
	ends. One BitBlt, sent copyBits once a character: its source the
	font's glyphs, through the colour's map, blended (painted at 8
	bits), so that the ink may be glass. With one bit a pixel, no
	map: or-ed for black, erased for white."
	| d blt x |
	d := self depth.
	blt := BitBlt destForm: self sourceForm: aFont glyphs halftoneForm: nil
		combinationRule: (d = 32 ifTrue: [24] ifFalse: [d = 8 ifTrue: [25] ifFalse: [aColor isDark ifTrue: [7] ifFalse: [4]]])
		destOrigin: aPoint sourceOrigin: 0 @ 0 extent: 0 @ aFont height clipRect: aRectangle.
	d = 1 ifFalse: [blt colorMap: (aColor inkMapForDepth: d)].
	x := aPoint x.
	aString do: [:c | | w |
		w := aFont widthOf: c.
		c value = 9 ifFalse: [
			blt sourceX: (aFont leftOf: c); destX: x destY: aPoint y; width: w height: aFont height; copyBits].
		x := x + w].
	^x!

drawString: aString at: aPoint
	^self drawString: aString at: aPoint font: StrikeFont default color: Color black! !

"Squeak's kernel, the sixth file: the tools, as morphs. Smalltalk-80's
Workspace, Transcript, Inspector and System Browser (the Blue Book's
were windows of its own Model-View-Controller; TinySmalltalk80's are
OCaml), here windows of Morphic: a SystemWindow whose panes are
ListMorphs and TextMorphs, and an object behind that answers them.

They are made of what the system already has. To evaluate, a text
compiles a method named DoIt in the receiver's class and sends it
(Behavior>>compile:classified:, what the Browser's accept uses): there
is no evaluator, only the compiler. The Browser asks the classes
themselves: Smalltalk for the classes, a class for its category, its
organization (the protocols and their selectors) and its methods'
sources. And what it compiles is in use at once: accept a new
Morph>>drawOn:, and every morph on the screen is drawn that way at the
next redraw -- the Browser too, it is morphs.

An error in what is evaluated stops the process that ran it, the
world's cycle (Object>>error:): the host starts the next cycle and
says why in the Transcript (showError:). A debugger as a morph is to
come."!

!Browser methodsFor: 'the system'!

	"The categories of the classes, each once, in the order met."
	| result |
	result := OrderedCollection new.
	Smalltalk classesDo: [:each | (result includes: each category) ifFalse: [result add: each category]].
	^result!

	| result |
	result := OrderedCollection new.
	Smalltalk classesDo: [:each | each category = aString ifTrue: [result add: each name]].
	^result!

	"The class picked, or its metaclass on the class side; nil."
	| class |
	classList selection = 0 ifTrue: [^nil].
	class := Smalltalk at: classList selectedItem.
	^meta ifTrue: [class class] ifFalse: [class]!

	"What a new method looks like."
	| return |
	return := String with: (Character value: 13).
	^'message selector and argument names', return, (String with: (Character value: 9)), '"comment stating purpose of message"', return,

!Browser methodsFor: 'accepting'!
accept: aString
	"The code pane's text. With a protocol picked it is a method:
	compiled in the class, filed under the protocol, and from now on
	what the system runs. With only a class, its definition:
	evaluated."
	| class protocol selector name |
	class := self behavior.
	class == nil ifTrue: [^self].
	protocolList selection = 0 ifTrue: [
		name := classList selectedItem.
		codePane selectFrom: 0 to: aString size; doIt.
		self categoryPicked: categoryList selection.
		^classList selectItem: name].
	protocol := protocolList selectedItem.
	selector := class compile: aString classified: protocol.
	selector isSymbol ifFalse: [^codePane insertAfterSelection: ' ', selector].
	selectorList items: (class selectorsIn: protocol).
	selectorList highlight: (selectorList items indexOf: selector)! !

(* Claude Code

(* See St_boot.mli *)
(* After the playground's (languages/smalltalk there), made what mini-ml
 * takes (docs/plans/plan_system_squeak.md): [boot] takes its host and its
 * kernel, both always said; Option.value is written out. *)

open St_ast
module M = St_memory
module C = St_class
module I = St_interp

exception Error of string

let quiet_host : I.host =
  {
    transcript = (fun _ -> ());
    (* old: Sys.time's, with no capability; a host's clock is its own *)
    milliseconds = (fun () -> 0);
    inspect = (fun _ -> ());
    mouse = (fun () -> (0, 0, 0));
    keyboard = (fun () -> None);
  }

let class_named (m : M.t) (name : string) : M.oop =
  match C.global m name with Some a -> M.fetch m a 1 | None -> raise (Error ("no class " ^ name))

(* a definition: its superclass's name, the class's, the kind, the
 * instance and class variables, the category *)
type definition = { sup : string; name : string; kind : C.kind; ivs : string list; cvs : string list; cat : string }

let words (s : string) : string list =
  String.split_on_char ' ' s |> List.concat_map (String.split_on_char '\t') |> List.concat_map (String.split_on_char '\n')
  |> List.filter (( <> ) "")

let definition (text : string) : definition option =
  match St_parse.parse_doit text with
  | {
   body =
     [
       Expr
         {
           e =
             Send
               ( { e = Var sup; _ },
                 sel,
                 [ { e = Lit (L_symbol name); _ }; { e = Lit (L_string ivs); _ }; { e = Lit (L_string cvs); _ }; _; { e = Lit (L_string cat); _ } ] );
           _;
         };
     ];
   _;
  } -> (
      let kind =
        match (name, sel) with
        | "Float", _ -> Some C.Float_kind
        | "CompiledMethod", _ -> Some C.Method_kind
        | _, "subclass:instanceVariableNames:classVariableNames:poolDictionaries:category:" -> Some C.Fixed
        | _, "variableSubclass:instanceVariableNames:classVariableNames:poolDictionaries:category:" -> Some C.Indexable
        | _, "variableByteSubclass:instanceVariableNames:classVariableNames:poolDictionaries:category:" -> Some C.Byte_indexable
        | _ -> None
      in
      match kind with Some kind -> Some { sup; name; kind; ivs = words ivs; cvs = words cvs; cat } | None -> None)
  | _ -> None
  | exception St_parse.Error _ -> None

let line_of (text : string) (pos : int) : int =
  let n = ref 1 in
  String.iteri (fun i c -> if i < pos && c = '\n' then incr n) text;
  !n

let boot (host : I.host) (kernel : (string * string) list) : I.vm =
  let m = M.create () in
  let k = M.known m in
  let items = List.concat_map (fun (file, text) -> List.map (fun i -> (file, text, i)) (St_chunk.read text)) kernel in
  let defs =
    List.filter_map (fun (_, _, i) -> match i with St_chunk.Doit (t, _) -> definition t | St_chunk.Methods _ -> None) items
  in
  (* a class defined twice, by a later file changing an earlier
   * one's (Squeak's MethodContext): its last definition, in the place
   * of the first *)
  let defs =
    let last name = List.find (fun d -> d.name = name) (List.rev defs) in
    let rec go seen = function
      | [] -> []
      | d :: rest -> if List.mem d.name seen then go seen rest else last d.name :: go (d.name :: seen) rest
    in
    go [] defs
  in
  (* 1. the classes, empty *)
  let table = Hashtbl.create 64 in
  let metas =
    List.map
      (fun d ->
        let meta = M.alloc m ~cls:M.nil (M.Pointers (Array.make 6 M.nil)) in
        let cls = M.alloc m ~cls:meta (M.Pointers (Array.make 9 M.nil)) in
        Hashtbl.replace table d.name cls;
        meta)
      defs
  in
  let get n = match Hashtbl.find_opt table n with Some c -> c | None -> raise (Error ("the kernel defines no " ^ n)) in
  k.metaclass <- get "Metaclass";
  List.iter (fun meta -> M.set_class m meta k.metaclass) metas;
  k.small_integer <- get "SmallInteger";
  k.string <- get "String";
  k.symbol <- get "Symbol";
  k.array <- get "Array";
  k.float <- get "Float";
  k.character <- get "Character";
  k.compiled_method <- get "CompiledMethod";
  k.method_context <- get "MethodContext";
  k.block_context <- get "BlockContext";
  k.block_closure <- (match Hashtbl.find_opt table "BlockClosure" with Some v -> v | None -> M.nil);
  k.message <- get "Message";
  k.association <- get "Association";
  k.point <- get "Point";
  k.large_positive <- get "LargePositiveInteger";
  k.large_negative <- get "LargeNegativeInteger";
  k.method_dictionary <- get "MethodDictionary";
  M.set_class m M.nil (get "UndefinedObject");
  k.true_ <- M.alloc m ~cls:(get "True") (M.Pointers [||]);
  k.false_ <- M.alloc m ~cls:(get "False") (M.Pointers [||]);
  k.characters <- Array.init 256 (fun i -> M.alloc m ~cls:k.character (M.Pointers [| M.of_int i |]));
  k.smalltalk <- M.alloc m ~cls:(get "SystemDictionary") (M.Pointers [| M.new_array m [||] |]);
  k.special_selectors <- Array.map (M.symbol m) St_bytecode.special_selectors;
  ignore (C.declare_global m "Smalltalk" k.smalltalk);
  List.iter (fun d -> ignore (C.declare_global m d.name (get d.name))) defs;
  (* 2. the classes filled *)
  List.iter
    (fun d ->
      let superclass = if d.sup = "nil" then M.nil else get d.sup in
      ignore (C.define_class m ~superclass ~name:d.name ~kind:d.kind ~inst_vars:d.ivs ~class_vars:d.cvs ~category:d.cat))
    defs;
  (* 3. the methods *)
  List.iter
    (fun (file, text, item) ->
      match item with
      | St_chunk.Methods { class_name; meta; category; methods } ->
          let cls = get class_name in
          let cls = if meta then M.class_of m cls else cls in
          List.iter
            (fun (src, pos) ->
              try ignore (St_compile.compile_and_install m ~cls ~category ~declare:true src)
              with St_compile.Error (p, msg) ->
                raise (Error (Printf.sprintf "%s:%d: %s>>%s" file (line_of text (pos + p)) (C.name m cls) msg)))
            methods
      | St_chunk.Doit _ -> ())
    items;
  (* 4. the machine, and the rest of the chunks run *)
  let vm = I.create m host in
  St_primitives.install vm;
  List.iter
    (fun (file, text, item) ->
      match item with
      | St_chunk.Doit (src, pos) when definition src = None -> (
          let empty = match St_parse.parse_doit src with { body = []; _ } -> true | _ -> false | exception St_parse.Error _ -> false in
          if not empty then
            match I.evaluate vm src with
            | Ok _ -> ()
            | Error msg -> raise (Error (Printf.sprintf "%s:%d: %s" file (line_of text pos) msg)))
      | _ -> ())
    items;
  vm
languages/smalltalk/vm/St_boot.mli
3308
(* St_boot: from the kernel's text to a running Smalltalk.

   Smalltalk-80 never booted: its image was the world, saved and loaded,
   each one made by the previous one since 1976. Here there is no image
   to start from, so the world is made from the text of its classes
   (St_kernel.mli, kernel/*.st), in four steps:

   1. the classes, empty: an object and a metaclass for every class
      definition in the text, before anything is read -- so that the
      Array, String, Symbol, Character objects made next have their
      classes. nil, true, false, the 256 Characters, the Smalltalk
      dictionary with a global per class;
   2. the classes filled from their definitions (St_class.define_class):
      superclasses, formats, instance variables; the knot at the top
      tied by the same code: Object's metaclass's superclass is Class,
      found as a global, and every metaclass is an instance of
      Metaclass, itself a class whose metaclass is an instance of
      Metaclass;
   3. every method compiled, by the OCaml compiler (St_compile.mli) --
      a Smalltalk compiler would need a running Smalltalk to run it, the
      chicken and the egg every self-hosted language has to break once;
   4. the virtual machine made, and the chunks that are not definitions
      run: from here, everything is Smalltalk.

   A later file may define again a class of an earlier one, with
   other instance variables: the last definition is the class's.

   A mistake in the kernel is an OCaml exception naming its file and
   line.

   Where it stands: CLI and Squeak call [boot] with one of St_kernel's
   lists of files, read by St_chunk; St_image.load_vm is the other way
   to a running system, with no text compiled, and what a host on a
   slow machine starts from (Squeak.resume).

   others:
   The same knot in every system written in itself, and the three
   ways out of it. Keep the last result and start from it: Smalltalk's
   image, a Lisp's core, and a C compiler's binary, which compiles the
   next compiler. Keep a result small enough to carry with the
   sources: OCaml's boot/ocamlc, bytecode in its repository. Or write
   the first one in another language, as here, and as ix's own start
   does (mini-ml compiled by OCaml before it compiles itself). The
   first is the fastest and the hardest to trust: nobody can read an
   image, and what is in it was put there by a program that is in it
   (Ken Thompson, "Reflections on Trusting Trust", 1984).

   modern:
   Pharo, Squeak's fork, builds its image again from its sources at
   each release, by a second Smalltalk that makes the first objects of
   the new one as steps 1 and 2 here do. *)

exception Error of string

(* a host that throws the Transcript away, its clock stopped at 0 (a
 * host that tells the time holds Cap.clock: the CLI's, SDL's) *)
val quiet_host : St_interp.host

(* the running system: Smalltalk-80, from the Blue Book's kernel
 * (St_kernel.files), or the system of another kernel -- Squeak's,
 * [~kernel:St_kernel.squeak], whose BlockClosure class makes the
 * compiler emit closures for every method, the Blue Book's included *)
val boot : St_interp.host -> (string * string) list -> St_interp.vm

(* a class by name, from the globals *)
val class_named : St_memory.t -> string -> St_memory.oop
