(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Noweb.mli *)

open Latex_state
open Latex_input
open Latex_output

let add_to (table : (string, int list) Hashtbl.t) (key : string) (n : int) =
  let l = match Hashtbl.find_opt table key with Some l -> l | None -> [] in
  if not (List.mem n l) then Hashtbl.replace table key (l @ [ n ])

(* a chunk's number, or on paper its sheet's (noweb's 12b) *)
let number (style : Doc.style) (n : int) : Doc.inline = Doc.Page (style, "chunk:" ^ string_of_int n, string_of_int n)

let numbers (style : Doc.style) (l : int list) : Doc.inline list =
  List.concat (List.mapi (fun k n -> (if k > 0 then [ Doc.Text (style, ", ") ] else []) @ [ number style n ]) l)

(* A chunk: its name, in which chunk the name was first defined, and
 * its lines, the chunks it names in them said the same way; then
 * where it is used. *)
let chunk (t : t) (chunk_name : string) =
  par t;
  t.chunk <- t.chunk + 1;
  let me = t.chunk in
  if not t.final then add_to t.known.defs chunk_name me;
  let lines = ref [] in
  let going = ref true in
  while !going do
    match peek t with
    | None -> going := false
    | Some _ ->
        if looking t "@\n" || looking t "@ " || (match t.input with f :: _ -> f.i + 1 = String.length f.s && f.s.[f.i] = '@' | [] -> false) then begin ignore (rest_of_line t); going := false end
        else begin
          let ends_def = looking t "<<" && (match t.input with f :: _ -> (let e = match String.index_from_opt f.s f.i '\n' with Some e -> e | None -> String.length f.s in let l = String.trim (String.sub f.s f.i (e - f.i)) in String.length l > 5 && String.sub l (String.length l - 3) 3 = ">>=") | [] -> false) in
          if ends_def then going := false else lines := rest_of_line t :: !lines
        end
  done;
  let rec trim (l : string list) : string list = match l with "" :: rest -> trim rest | l -> l in
  let lines = List.rev (trim !lines) in
  let small : Doc.style = { font = Doc.Mono; size = -2; shift = 0 } in
  let italic : Doc.style = { font = Doc.Italic; size = -2; shift = 0 } in
  let roman : Doc.style = { font = Doc.Roman; size = -2; shift = 0 } in
  let first (n : string) : Doc.inline list = match Hashtbl.find_opt t.known.defs n with Some (d :: _) -> [ Doc.Text (italic, " "); number italic d ] | _ -> [] in
  let named (n : string) : Doc.inline list =
    [ Doc.Text (italic, "\xe2\x80\xb9") ] @ with_look t { style = italic; caps = false; center = false } n @ first n @ [ Doc.Text (italic, "\xe2\x80\xba") ] in
  let line (l : string) : Doc.inline list =
    let n = String.length l in
    let rec go (i : int) (from : int) (acc : Doc.inline list) : Doc.inline list =
      let piece (upto : int) : Doc.inline list = if upto > from then [ Doc.Text (small, String.sub l from (upto - from)) ] else [] in
      if i + 1 >= n then acc @ piece n
      else if l.[i] = '@' && l.[i + 1] = '<' && i + 2 < n && l.[i + 2] = '<' then go (i + 3) (i + 1) (acc @ piece i)
      else if l.[i] = '<' && l.[i + 1] = '<' then begin
        let rec close (j : int) : int option = if j + 1 >= n then None else if l.[j] = '>' && l.[j + 1] = '>' then Some j else close (j + 1) in
        match close (i + 2) with
        | Some j ->
            let used = String.trim (String.sub l (i + 2) (j - i - 2)) in
            if not t.final then add_to t.known.uses used me;
            go (j + 2) (j + 2) (acc @ piece i @ named used)
        | None -> go (i + 2) from acc
      end else go (i + 1) from acc in
    go 0 0 [] in
  let defs = match Hashtbl.find_opt t.known.defs chunk_name with Some l -> l | None -> [ me ] in
  let is_first = (match defs with d :: _ -> d = me | [] -> true) in
  let head = named chunk_name @ [ Doc.Text (roman, if is_first then "=" else "+=") ] in
  let uses = match Hashtbl.find_opt t.known.uses chunk_name with Some l -> l | None -> [] in
  let notes =
    (if is_first && uses <> [] then [ Doc.Text (roman, "used in ") :: numbers roman uses ] else [])
    @ (if is_first && List.length defs > 1 then [ Doc.Text (roman, "more in ") :: numbers roman (List.tl defs) ] else []) in
  let head = if notes = [] then head else head @ [ Doc.Text (roman, "   (") ] @ List.concat (List.mapi (fun k l -> if k > 0 then Doc.Text (roman, "; ") :: l else l) notes) @ [ Doc.Text (roman, ")") ] in
  anchor t ("chunk:" ^ string_of_int me) true;
  block t (lines_as_they_are t (-2) (head :: List.map line lines))

(* \nowebindex: the chunks by name, each with the chunks that define it *)
let index (t : t) =
  par t;
  let names = List.sort compare (Hashtbl.fold (fun (k : string) (_ : int list) (acc : string list) -> k :: acc) t.known.defs []) in
  let italic : Doc.style = { font = Doc.Italic; size = -1; shift = 0 } in
  List.iter (fun (n : string) ->
    let defs = match Hashtbl.find_opt t.known.defs n with Some l -> l | None -> [] in
    let body = [ Doc.Text (italic, "\xe2\x80\xb9") ] @ with_look t { style = italic; caps = false; center = false } n @ [ Doc.Text (italic, "\xe2\x80\xba"); Doc.Text ({ italic with font = Doc.Roman }, "  ") ] @ numbers { italic with font = Doc.Roman } defs in
    emit t (Doc.Para { fill = true; first = 0.; short = 0.; tabs = []; center = false; body })) names
typesetting/troff/latex/Noweb.mli
1501
(* Noweb: a chunk of code in a document, noweb's.
 *
 *   <<function [[addrule]]>>=        its name, then its lines as they
 *   void addrule(char *head) {       are, to a line with @ alone or to
 *       <<[[addrule()]] locals>>     the next chunk; a chunk named in
 *   }                                them
 *   @
 *
 * A chunk is given a number, in the file's order. Its name is written
 * with the number of the chunk that first defines it, here and where
 * another chunk names it; the first definition says where it is used
 * and where it goes on:
 *
 *   <function addrule 41>=   (used in 12; more in 44)
 *
 * The first reading fills the tables (Latex_state.known: defs, uses),
 * the second writes from them: a chunk is used above its definition.
 *
 * cs-history:
 * Literate programming is Donald Knuth's (WEB, 1981, for TeX itself):
 * a program written as a text for a person, its code in chunks named
 * and ordered for the explanation, from which one tool makes the
 * program (tangle) and another the document (weave). noweb is Norman
 * Ramsey's (1989): the same with two marks, <<name>>= and @, and any
 * language. Its weaver says a chunk by its page and a letter (12b);
 * a page is not known when a document is read. *)

(* [chunk t name]: the line <<name>>= was read; the chunk's lines are
 * read and the chunk written *)
val chunk : Latex_state.t -> string -> unit

(* \nowebindex: the chunks by name, each with the chunks that define it *)
val index : Latex_state.t -> unit
typesetting/troff/pic/Pic.ml
20273
(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Pic.mli *)

open Pic_ast

type point = float * float

(* An object once placed: the box it is in, where a line starts and
 * ends (a box's: its centre), and, of a block, the names in it. *)
type obj = {
  kind : string;
  x0 : float; y0 : float; x1 : float; y1 : float;
  first : point; last : point;
  names : (string * obj) list;
}

type env = {
  vars : (string, float) Hashtbl.t;
  mutable here : point;
  mutable dir : string;
  (* the objects, the last first; those with a name *)
  mutable objs : obj list;
  mutable names : (string * obj) list;
  mutable marks : Doc.mark list;
  words : string -> Doc.inline list;
}

exception Unknown of string

let vector (dir : string) : point = match dir with "up" -> (0., 1.) | "down" -> (0., -1.) | "left" -> (-1., 0.) | _ -> (1., 0.)

let var (e : env) (name : string) : float = match Hashtbl.find_opt e.vars name with Some v -> v | None -> raise (Unknown name)

(* a corner of an object: of the box it is in, but a round one's
 * diagonal corners, which are on it *)
let corner_of (o : obj) (c : corner option) : point =
  let cx = (o.x0 +. o.x1) /. 2. and cy = (o.y0 +. o.y1) /. 2. in
  let rx = (o.x1 -. o.x0) /. 2. and ry = (o.y1 -. o.y0) /. 2. in
  let k = if o.kind = "circle" || o.kind = "ellipse" then 0.7071 else 1. in
  match c with
  | None -> if o.kind = "line" then o.last else (cx, cy)
  | Some "n" -> (cx, o.y1) | Some "s" -> (cx, o.y0) | Some "e" -> (o.x1, cy) | Some "w" -> (o.x0, cy)
  | Some "ne" -> (cx +. (k *. rx), cy +. (k *. ry)) | Some "nw" -> (cx -. (k *. rx), cy +. (k *. ry))
  | Some "se" -> (cx +. (k *. rx), cy -. (k *. ry)) | Some "sw" -> (cx -. (k *. rx), cy -. (k *. ry))
  | Some "start" -> o.first | Some "end" -> o.last
  | Some _ -> (cx, cy)

let rec place (e : env) (p : place) : point =
  match p with
  | Here -> e.here
  | Named (path, c) ->
      let rec find (names : (string * obj) list) (path : string list) : obj =
        match path with
        | [] -> raise (Unknown "a place")
        | [ name ] -> (match List.assoc_opt name names with Some o -> o | None -> raise (Unknown name))
        | name :: rest -> (match List.assoc_opt name names with Some o -> find o.names rest | None -> raise (Unknown name)) in
      corner_of (find e.names path) c
  | Nth (n, kind, c) ->
      let kind = if kind = "arrow" || kind = "spline" then "line" else kind in
      let same = List.filter (fun (o : obj) -> o.kind = kind) e.objs in
      let o = if n < 0 then List.nth_opt same 0 else List.nth_opt (List.rev same) (n - 1) in
      (match o with Some o -> corner_of o c | None -> raise (Unknown ("no " ^ kind)))

and expr (e : env) (x : expr) : float =
  match x with
  | Num v -> v
  | Var name -> var e name
  | Neg a -> -.expr e a
  | Coord (p, axis) -> let x, y = place e p in if axis = "y" then y else x
  | Bin (op, a, b) ->
      let a = expr e a and b = expr e b in
      (match op with '+' -> a +. b | '-' -> a -. b | '*' -> a *. b | _ -> if b = 0. then 0. else a /. b)


and position (e : env) (p : position) : point =
  match p with
  | Xy (x, y) -> (expr e x, expr e y)
  | Place pl -> place e pl
  | Shift (p, dx, dy) -> let x, y = position e p in (x +. expr e dx, y +. expr e dy)
  | Between (t, a, b) ->
      let t = expr e t and ax, ay = position e a and bx, by = position e b in
      (ax +. (t *. (bx -. ax)), ay +. (t *. (by -. ay)))

let rec moved (dx : float) (dy : float) (o : obj) : obj =
  { o with x0 = o.x0 +. dx; x1 = o.x1 +. dx; y0 = o.y0 +. dy; y1 = o.y1 +. dy; first = (fst o.first +. dx, snd o.first +. dy); last = (fst o.last +. dx, snd o.last +. dy);
    names = List.map (fun (n, x) -> (n, moved dx dy x)) o.names }

let stroke (e : env) (points : point list) = e.marks <- Doc.Stroke points :: e.marks

(* an arrow's head at b, coming from a *)
let head (e : env) ((ax, ay) : point) ((bx, by) : point) =
  let dx = bx -. ax and dy = by -. ay in
  let len = Float.sqrt ((dx *. dx) +. (dy *. dy)) in
  if len > 0. then begin
    let ux = dx /. len and uy = dy /. len in
    let h = var e "arrowht" and w = var e "arrowwid" /. 2. in
    let px = bx -. (h *. ux) and py = by -. (h *. uy) in
    stroke e [ (px -. (w *. uy), py +. (w *. ux)); (bx, by); (px +. (w *. uy), py -. (w *. ux)) ]
  end

(* a circle or an ellipse, as the lines that look like it *)
let round (cx : float) (cy : float) (rx : float) (ry : float) : point list =
  List.init 33 (fun k -> let a = float_of_int k *. 6.283185307 /. 32. in (cx +. (rx *. Float.cos a), cy +. (ry *. Float.sin a)))

(* a spline: a curve that starts and ends at its first and last points
 * and is drawn towards the others (between the middles of each two) *)
let curve (points : point list) : point list =
  match points with
  | [] | [ _ ] | [ _; _ ] -> points
  | first :: _ ->
      let a = Array.of_list points in
      let n = Array.length a in
      let mid i = ((fst a.(i) +. fst a.(i + 1)) /. 2., (snd a.(i) +. snd a.(i + 1)) /. 2.) in
      let out = ref [ first ] in
      for i = 1 to n - 2 do
        let p0 = if i = 1 then a.(0) else mid (i - 1) and p1 = a.(i) and p2 = if i = n - 2 then a.(n - 1) else mid i in
        for k = 1 to 8 do
          let t = float_of_int k /. 8. in
          let u = 1. -. t in
          out := ((u *. u *. fst p0) +. (2. *. u *. t *. fst p1) +. (t *. t *. fst p2), (u *. u *. snd p0) +. (2. *. u *. t *. snd p1) +. (t *. t *. snd p2)) :: !out
        done
      done;
      List.rev !out

(* the texts said of an object, one under the other round a point *)
let texts (e : env) ((x, y) : point) (attrs : attr list) =
  let rec strings (l : attr list) (acc : (string * string list) list) =
    match l with
    | Str s :: rest -> strings rest ((s, []) :: acc)
    | Just j :: rest -> (match acc with (s, js) :: more -> strings rest ((s, j :: js) :: more) | [] -> strings rest acc)
    | _ :: rest -> strings rest acc
    | [] -> List.rev acc in
  let all = strings attrs [] in
  let n = List.length all and line = var e "textht" in
  List.iteri (fun i (s, js) ->
    let dy = (((float_of_int (n - 1)) /. 2.) -. float_of_int i) *. line in
    let dy = if List.mem "above" js then dy +. (line /. 2.) else if List.mem "below" js then dy -. (line /. 2.) else dy in
    let side = if List.mem "ljust" js then -1 else if List.mem "rjust" js then 1 else 0 in
    if s <> "" then e.marks <- Doc.Label (x, y +. dy, side, e.words s) :: e.marks) all

let add (e : env) (label : string option) (o : obj) =
  e.objs <- o :: e.objs;
  match label with Some name -> e.names <- (name, o) :: List.remove_assoc name e.names | None -> ()

(* the first of an object's attributes that is of a kind *)
let find (attrs : attr list) (f : attr -> 'a option) : 'a option = List.find_map f attrs

let rec statement (e : env) (s : statement) =
  match s with
  | Direction d -> e.dir <- d
  | Assign ("scale", x) ->
      (* the sizes that were inches are now so many of the new unit *)
      let v = expr e x and old = var e "scale" in
      List.iter (fun name -> Hashtbl.replace e.vars name (var e name *. v /. old))
        [ "boxwid"; "boxht"; "circlerad"; "ellipsewid"; "ellipseht"; "linewid"; "lineht"; "movewid"; "moveht"; "arcrad"; "arrowht"; "arrowwid"; "textht" ];
      Hashtbl.replace e.vars "scale" v
  | Assign (name, x) -> Hashtbl.replace e.vars name (expr e x)
  | Object (label, kind, attrs) ->
      let has (a : attr) = List.mem a attrs in
      let invis = has Invis in
      let dx, dy = vector e.dir in
      (* a box's place: by a corner said at a place, or where the one
       * before ended, its side towards it there *)
      let boxed (name : string) (w : float) (h : float) : obj =
        let cx, cy =
          match find attrs (fun a -> match a with At p -> Some p | _ -> None) with
          | Some p ->
              let x, y = position e p in
              let c = find attrs (fun a -> match a with With c -> Some c | _ -> None) in
              let probe = { kind = name; x0 = -.w /. 2.; x1 = w /. 2.; y0 = -.h /. 2.; y1 = h /. 2.; first = (0., 0.); last = (0., 0.); names = [] } in
              let ox, oy = match c with Some _ -> corner_of probe c | None -> (0., 0.) in
              (x -. ox, y -. oy)
          | None -> (fst e.here +. (dx *. w /. 2.), snd e.here +. (dy *. h /. 2.)) in
        let o = { kind = name; x0 = cx -. (w /. 2.); x1 = cx +. (w /. 2.); y0 = cy -. (h /. 2.); y1 = cy +. (h /. 2.); first = (cx, cy); last = (cx, cy); names = [] } in
        e.here <- (cx +. (dx *. w /. 2.), cy +. (dy *. h /. 2.));
        o in
      let size (f : attr -> expr option) (default : string) : float = match find attrs f with Some x -> expr e x | None -> var e default in
      (match kind with
       | Box ->
           let o = boxed "box" (size (fun a -> match a with Wid x -> Some x | _ -> None) "boxwid") (size (fun a -> match a with Ht x -> Some x | _ -> None) "boxht") in
           if not invis then stroke e [ (o.x0, o.y0); (o.x1, o.y0); (o.x1, o.y1); (o.x0, o.y1); (o.x0, o.y0) ];
           texts e o.first attrs; add e label o
       | Circle | Ellipse ->
           let name = if kind = Circle then "circle" else "ellipse" in
           let w, h =
             if kind = Circle then begin let r = size (fun a -> match a with Rad x -> Some x | _ -> None) "circlerad" in (2. *. r, 2. *. r) end
             else (size (fun a -> match a with Wid x -> Some x | _ -> None) "ellipsewid", size (fun a -> match a with Ht x -> Some x | _ -> None) "ellipseht") in
           let o = boxed name w h in
           if not invis then stroke e (round (fst o.first) (snd o.first) (w /. 2.) (h /. 2.));
           texts e o.first attrs; add e label o
       | Text ->
           let at = match find attrs (fun a -> match a with At p -> Some p | _ -> None) with Some p -> position e p | None -> e.here in
           texts e at attrs;
           add e label { kind = "text"; x0 = fst at; x1 = fst at; y0 = snd at; y1 = snd at; first = at; last = at; names = [] }
       | Block inner ->
           let sub = { e with here = (0., 0.); dir = "right"; objs = []; names = []; marks = [] } in
           List.iter (statement sub) inner;
           let x0, y0, x1, y1 = bounds sub in
           let o = boxed "block" (x1 -. x0) (y1 -. y0) in
           (* (with (0,0) at a place: the block's own origin there) *)
           let mx, my =
             if has (With "origin") then (match find attrs (fun a -> match a with At p -> Some p | _ -> None) with Some p -> position e p | None -> (0., 0.))
             else (o.x0 -. x0, o.y0 -. y0) in
           let o = if has (With "origin") then { o with x0 = x0 +. mx; x1 = x1 +. mx; y0 = y0 +. my; y1 = y1 +. my } else o in
           e.marks <- List.map (fun (m : Doc.mark) ->
               match m with
               | Doc.Stroke ps -> Doc.Stroke (List.map (fun (x, y) -> (x +. mx, y +. my)) ps)
               | Doc.Label (x, y, side, t) -> Doc.Label (x +. mx, y +. my, side, t)
               | Doc.Image (x, y, w, h, name, img) -> Doc.Image (x +. mx, y +. my, w, h, name, img)) sub.marks @ e.marks;
           add e label { o with names = List.map (fun (n, x) -> (n, moved mx my x)) sub.names }
       | Line | Arrow | Spline | Move ->
           let start = match find attrs (fun a -> match a with From p -> Some p | _ -> None) with Some p -> position e p | None -> e.here in
           let wid = if kind = Move then "movewid" else "linewid" and ht = if kind = Move then "moveht" else "lineht" in
           (* the points: each "then" ends a move made of what was said
            * since the one before; "to" is a point of its own *)
           let points = ref [ start ] and cur = ref start and pending = ref None in
           let flush () = match !pending with Some (px, py) -> cur := (fst !cur +. px, snd !cur +. py); points := !cur :: !points; pending := None | None -> () in
           let go (d : string) (far : float) =
             let vx, vy = vector d and px, py = match !pending with Some p -> p | None -> (0., 0.) in
             pending := Some (px +. (vx *. far), py +. (vy *. far)); e.dir <- d in
           List.iter (fun (a : attr) ->
             match a with
             | Go (d, far) -> go d (match far with Some x -> expr e x | None -> if d = "up" || d = "down" then var e ht else var e wid)
             | Dist x -> go e.dir (expr e x)
             | Then -> flush ()
             | To p -> flush (); cur := position e p; points := !cur :: !points
             | _ -> ()) attrs;
           flush ();
           if List.length !points = 1 then begin go e.dir (if e.dir = "up" || e.dir = "down" then var e ht else var e wid); flush () end;
           let points = List.rev !points in
           let last = List.nth points (List.length points - 1) in
           if kind <> Move && not invis then begin
             let drawn = if kind = Spline then curve points else points in
             stroke e drawn;
             let at_start, at_end = match find attrs (fun a -> match a with Head (s, t) -> Some (s, t) | _ -> None) with Some h -> h | None -> (false, kind = Arrow) in
             (match List.rev drawn with b :: a :: _ when at_end -> head e a b | _ -> ());
             (match drawn with b :: a :: _ when at_start -> head e a b | _ -> ())
           end;
           let xs = List.map fst points and ys = List.map snd points in
           let o = { kind = "line"; x0 = List.fold_left Float.min (List.hd xs) xs; x1 = List.fold_left Float.max (List.hd xs) xs;
                     y0 = List.fold_left Float.min (List.hd ys) ys; y1 = List.fold_left Float.max (List.hd ys) ys; first = start; last; names = [] } in
           (* (a line's texts are at its middle) *)
           texts e ((fst start +. fst last) /. 2., (snd start +. snd last) /. 2.) attrs;
           e.here <- last;
           if kind <> Move || label <> None then add e label o
       | Arc ->
           let r = size (fun a -> match a with Rad x -> Some x | _ -> None) "arcrad" in
           let cw = has Cw in
           let p1 = match find attrs (fun a -> match a with From p -> Some p | _ -> None) with Some p -> position e p | None -> e.here in
           let p2 =
             match find attrs (fun a -> match a with To p -> Some p | _ -> None) with
             | Some p -> position e p
             (* a quarter of a circle, turning left (right, if cw) *)
             | None ->
                 let tx, ty = if cw then (dy, -.dx) else (-.dy, dx) in
                 (fst p1 +. (r *. (dx +. tx)), snd p1 +. (r *. (dy +. ty))) in
           let mx = (fst p1 +. fst p2) /. 2. and my = (snd p1 +. snd p2) /. 2. in
           let hx = fst p2 -. fst p1 and hy = snd p2 -. snd p1 in
           let half = Float.sqrt ((hx *. hx) +. (hy *. hy)) /. 2. in
           let r = Float.max r half in
           let h = Float.sqrt (Float.max 0. ((r *. r) -. (half *. half))) in
           (* the centre: to the left of the way from p1 to p2 when
            * turning left *)
           let nx = if half = 0. then 0. else -.hy /. (2. *. half) and ny = if half = 0. then 0. else hx /. (2. *. half) in
           let cx, cy = if cw then (mx -. (h *. nx), my -. (h *. ny)) else (mx +. (h *. nx), my +. (h *. ny)) in
           let a1 = Float.atan2 (snd p1 -. cy) (fst p1 -. cx) and a2 = Float.atan2 (snd p2 -. cy) (fst p2 -. cx) in
           let sweep = if cw then (let d = a1 -. a2 in if d <= 0. then d +. 6.283185307 else d) else (let d = a2 -. a1 in if d <= 0. then d +. 6.283185307 else d) in
           let points = List.init 17 (fun k -> let t = float_of_int k /. 16. in let a = if cw then a1 -. (t *. sweep) else a1 +. (t *. sweep) in (cx +. (r *. Float.cos a), cy +. (r *. Float.sin a))) in
           if not invis then begin
             stroke e points;
             let at_start, at_end = match find attrs (fun a -> match a with Head (s, t) -> Some (s, t) | _ -> None) with Some h -> h | None -> (false, false) in
             (match List.rev points with b :: a :: _ when at_end -> head e a b | _ -> ());
             (match points with b :: a :: _ when at_start -> head e a b | _ -> ())
           end;
           let xs = List.map fst points and ys = List.map snd points in
           e.here <- p2;
           (* (turned: the way things go is now across the one it was) *)
           if find attrs (fun a -> match a with To p -> Some p | _ -> None) = None then
             e.dir <- (match (e.dir, cw) with
               | "right", false | "left", true -> "up" | "right", true | "left", false -> "down"
               | "up", false | "down", true -> "left" | _ -> "right");
           add e label { kind = "arc"; x0 = List.fold_left Float.min (List.hd xs) xs; x1 = List.fold_left Float.max (List.hd xs) xs;
                         y0 = List.fold_left Float.min (List.hd ys) ys; y1 = List.fold_left Float.max (List.hd ys) ys; first = p1; last = p2; names = [] })

(* the box that everything drawn is in *)
and bounds (e : env) : float * float * float * float =
  let points = List.concat_map (fun (m : Doc.mark) -> match m with Doc.Stroke ps -> ps | Doc.Label (x, y, _, _) -> [ (x, y) ] | Doc.Image (x, y, w, h, _, _) -> [ (x, y); (x +. w, y +. h) ]) e.marks
               @ List.concat_map (fun (o : obj) -> [ (o.x0, o.y0); (o.x1, o.y1) ]) e.objs in
  match points with
  | [] -> (0., 0., 0., 0.)
  | (x, y) :: rest -> List.fold_left (fun (x0, y0, x1, y1) (px, py) -> (Float.min x0 px, Float.min y0 py, Float.max x1 px, Float.max y1 py)) (x, y, x, y) rest

(* a word of the grammar, to say where a picture stopped being understood *)
let show (t : Pic_parser.token) : string =
  match t with
  | Pic_parser.NUMBER v -> string_of_float v | Pic_parser.STRING s -> "\"" ^ s ^ "\"" | Pic_parser.LABEL s | Pic_parser.VAR s | Pic_parser.PRIM s | Pic_parser.DIR s | Pic_parser.JUST s -> s
  | Pic_parser.CORNER s -> "." ^ s | Pic_parser.EOL -> ";" | Pic_parser.COLON -> ":" | Pic_parser.LBRACK -> "[" | Pic_parser.RBRACK -> "]"
  | Pic_parser.LPAREN -> "(" | Pic_parser.RPAREN -> ")" | Pic_parser.COMMA -> "," | Pic_parser.LT -> "<" | Pic_parser.GT -> ">" | Pic_parser.EQ -> "="
  | Pic_parser.PLUS -> "+" | Pic_parser.MINUS -> "-" | Pic_parser.STAR -> "*" | Pic_parser.SLASH -> "/" | Pic_parser.DOT -> "." | Pic_parser.AT -> "at"
  | Pic_parser.WITH -> "with" | Pic_parser.FROM -> "from" | Pic_parser.TO -> "to" | Pic_parser.EOF -> "the end" | _ -> "?"

let read (load : string -> string option) (width : float) (words : string -> Doc.inline list) (text : string) : (Doc.picture, string) result =
  let vars = Hashtbl.create 32 in
  List.iter (fun (name, v) -> Hashtbl.replace vars name v)
    [ ("scale", 1.); ("boxwid", 0.75); ("boxht", 0.5); ("circlerad", 0.25); ("ellipsewid", 0.75); ("ellipseht", 0.5); ("linewid", 0.5); ("lineht", 0.5);
      ("movewid", 0.5); ("moveht", 0.5); ("arcrad", 0.25); ("arrowht", 0.1); ("arrowwid", 0.05); ("textht", 0.17) ];
  let e = { vars; here = (0., 0.); dir = "right"; objs = []; names = []; marks = []; words } in
  (* the words read last, the last first *)
  let seen = ref [] in
  match
    let tokens = ref (Pic_lexer.tokens load text) in
    let next (_ : Lexing.lexbuf) : Pic_parser.token =
      match !tokens with t :: rest -> tokens := rest; seen := show t :: !seen; t | [] -> Pic_parser.EOF in
    List.iter (statement e) (Pic_parser.picture next (Lexing.from_string ""))
  with
  | exception Parsing.Parse_error -> Error ("at: " ^ String.concat " " (List.rev (List.filteri (fun k _ -> k < 8) !seen)))
  | exception Unknown name -> Error ("no " ^ name)
  | exception Failure why -> Error why
  | () ->
      let x0, y0, x1, y1 = bounds e in
      let scale = var e "scale" in
      let wide = (x1 -. x0) /. scale in
      (* (.PS 3i: that wide, whatever its own width) *)
      let k = (if width > 0. && wide > 0. then width /. wide else 1.) /. scale in
      let at (x, y) = ((x -. x0) *. k, (y -. y0) *. k) in
      let p : Doc.picture = { wide = (x1 -. x0) *. k; high = (y1 -. y0) *. k;
             marks = List.rev_map (fun (m : Doc.mark) ->
               match m with
               | Doc.Stroke ps -> Doc.Stroke (List.map at ps)
               | Doc.Label (x, y, side, t) -> let x, y = at (x, y) in Doc.Label (x, y, side, t)
               | Doc.Image (x, y, w, h, name, img) -> let x, y = at (x, y) in Doc.Image (x, y, w, h, name, img)) e.marks } in
      Ok p
typesetting/troff/pic/Pic.mli
2519
(* Pic: a picture read and drawn -- what is between .PS and .PE, pic's
 * language, the part of it that draws.
 *
 *   .PS
 *   A: box "readers"; arrow; B: box "Doc.t"
 *   arrow from B.s down 0.3
 *   ellipse "layout"
 *   .PE
 *
 *   +---------+     +-------+
 *   | readers |---->| Doc.t |          a picture is objects, each put
 *   +---------+     +-------+          where the one before ended and
 *                       |              in the way things are going
 *                       v              (right, to begin with); or at a
 *                    (layout)          place said: "at A.ne", "from
 *                                      B.s", "with .w at last box.e"
 *
 * The objects: box, circle, ellipse, line, arrow, arc, spline, move
 * (nothing drawn), a text alone, and a block of statements between
 * brackets, which is an object too, with the names in it its own
 * (Block.Inner.s). Of an object: its size (wid, ht, rad), its place
 * (at, with a corner), a line's points (from, to, up 0.5, then), an
 * arrow's heads (-> <- <->), invis, its texts and where each is
 * (ljust, above). A place: a name and a corner, the last box, a point
 * (x, y), a place and a move from it, a part of the way between two
 * (0.3 <A, B>). Variables (boxwid = 0.5, scale = 100) and arithmetic;
 * macros (define, in Pic_lexer).
 *
 * What comes out is lines and words, in inches from the picture's
 * lower left: a circle and a spline are the short lines that look
 * like them. Dashes and fills are not drawn (the line is solid, the
 * box empty), nor pic's programs run (for, if, sh).
 *
 * cs-history:
 * pic is Brian Kernighan's (Bell Labs, 1981), the third of troff's
 * preprocessors and the one that made "little languages" a phrase:
 * a picture described in words, in the document, by someone who
 * cannot draw, "box; arrow; box" being a picture already. Jon
 * Bentley's column of 1986 took its name from it. Graphviz's dot and
 * TikZ are its descendants in spirit: the first lays the boxes out
 * itself, the second gives TeX's users the same words. *)

(* [read load width words text]: a picture's text drawn; [width] is
 * what .PS says the picture's is, in inches (0: its own); [load] reads
 * a file that it copies; [words] makes of a string between quotes the
 * words in their fonts. Or why it is not understood: the words of it
 * read last, a name that is not there. *)
val read : (string -> string option) -> float -> (string -> Doc.inline list) -> string -> (Doc.picture, string) result

(* A picture as it is written, in pic's language: what Pic_parser makes
 * and Pic draws (see Pic.mli). *)

(* n, s, e, w, ne, nw, se, sw, c, start, end *)
type corner = string

type expr =
  | Num of float
  | Var of string
  | Bin of char * expr * expr
  | Neg of expr
  (* A.e.x: how far right a place is, or up (y) *)
  | Coord of place * string

and place =
  (* A, A.ne, Block.Inner.s *)
  | Named of string list * corner option
  (* last box (-1), 2nd circle *)
  | Nth of int * string * corner option
  | Here

type position =
  | Xy of expr * expr
  | Place of place
  (* a place and how far from it *)
  | Shift of position * expr * expr
  (* 0.3 <A, B>: that part of the way from A to B *)
  | Between of expr * position * position

type kind = Box | Circle | Ellipse | Line | Arrow | Arc | Spline | Move | Text | Block of statement list

and attr =
  | Wid of expr
  | Ht of expr
  | Rad of expr
  | From of position
  | To of position
  | At of position
  (* which of its corners is at the place said by At *)
  | With of corner
  | Then
  (* up, down, left, right, and how far *)
  | Go of string * expr option
  (* a number alone: that far, the way it was going *)
  | Dist of expr
  | Dashed
  | Dotted
  | Invis
  | Fill
  | Same
  | Chop
  (* an arrow's head at its start, at its end *)
  | Head of bool * bool
  | Cw
  | Ccw
  | Str of string
  (* ljust, rjust, above, below: of the string before *)
  | Just of string

and statement =
  | Object of string option * kind * attr list
  | Direction of string
  | Assign of string * expr

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Pic_lexer.mli *)

open Pic_parser

let is_digit (c : char) = c >= '0' && c <= '9'
let is_letter (c : char) = (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || c = '_'

let corners = [ "n"; "s"; "e"; "w"; "ne"; "nw"; "se"; "sw"; "c"; "center"; "start"; "end"; "t"; "top"; "b"; "bot"; "bottom"; "l"; "left"; "r"; "right"; "north"; "south"; "east"; "west" ]

let corner (s : string) : string =
  match s with
  | "center" -> "c" | "t" | "top" | "north" -> "n" | "b" | "bot" | "bottom" | "south" -> "s"
  | "l" | "left" | "west" -> "w" | "r" | "right" | "east" -> "e" | _ -> s

let word (s : string) : token =
  match s with
  | "box" | "circle" | "ellipse" | "line" | "arrow" | "arc" | "spline" | "move" -> PRIM s
  | "up" | "down" | "left" | "right" -> DIR s
  | "wid" | "width" -> WID
  | "ht" | "height" -> HT
  | "rad" | "radius" -> RAD
  | "from" -> FROM | "to" -> TO | "at" -> AT | "with" -> WITH | "then" -> THEN
  | "dashed" -> DASHED | "dotted" -> DOTTED | "invis" | "invisible" -> INVIS | "fill" | "filled" -> FILL
  | "same" -> SAME | "chop" -> CHOP | "cw" -> CW | "ccw" -> CCW | "last" -> LAST | "Here" | "here" -> HERE
  | "ljust" | "rjust" | "above" | "below" -> JUST s
  | _ -> if s.[0] >= 'A' && s.[0] <= 'Z' then LABEL s else VAR s

(* a macro's arguments: what is between its parentheses, cut at the
 * commas that are in no parentheses and no string; and where the text
 * goes on *)
let arguments (s : string) (i : int) : string list * int =
  let n = String.length s in
  let b = Buffer.create 16 in
  let rec go j (depth : int) (quoted : bool) (acc : string list) : string list * int =
    if j >= n then (List.rev (String.trim (Buffer.contents b) :: acc), j)
    else
      let c = s.[j] in
      if quoted then begin Buffer.add_char b c; go (j + 1) depth (c <> '"') acc end
      else if c = '"' then begin Buffer.add_char b c; go (j + 1) depth true acc end
      else if c = '(' then begin Buffer.add_char b c; go (j + 1) (depth + 1) false acc end
      else if c = ')' && depth = 0 then (List.rev (String.trim (Buffer.contents b) :: acc), j + 1)
      else if c = ')' then begin Buffer.add_char b c; go (j + 1) (depth - 1) false acc end
      else if c = ',' && depth = 0 then begin let a = String.trim (Buffer.contents b) in Buffer.clear b; go (j + 1) depth false (a :: acc) end
      else begin Buffer.add_char b c; go (j + 1) depth false acc end in
  go i 0 false []

(* a macro's body with $1 ... $9 put in *)
let with_arguments (args : string list) (body : string) : string =
  let n = String.length body and out = Buffer.create (String.length body) in
  let rec go i =
    if i < n then
      if body.[i] = '$' && i + 1 < n && is_digit body.[i + 1] then begin
        (match List.nth_opt args (Char.code body.[i + 1] - Char.code '1') with Some a -> Buffer.add_string out a | None -> ());
        go (i + 2)
      end
      else begin Buffer.add_char out body.[i]; go (i + 1) end in
  go 0; Buffer.contents out

let tokens (load : string -> string option) (text : string) : token list =
  (* troff's requests in the picture, and comments, are not pic's *)
  let lines = List.filter (fun l -> not (String.length l > 0 && l.[0] = '.')) (String.split_on_char '\n' text) in
  let lines = List.map (fun l -> match String.index_opt l '#' with Some i when not (String.contains l '"') -> String.sub l 0 i | _ -> l) lines in
  let macros : (string, string) Hashtbl.t = Hashtbl.create 8 in
  let out = ref [] in
  let emit (t : token) = out := t :: !out in
  (* the end of a statement, once: not after another *)
  let eol () = match !out with EOL :: _ | COLON :: _ | LBRACK :: _ | [] -> () | _ -> emit EOL in
  (* how many times a macro's text was put back: a macro that calls
   * itself has no end *)
  let depth = ref 0 in
  let rec go (s : string) (i : int) =
    let n = String.length s in
    if i < n then
      let c = s.[i] in
      if c = ' ' || c = '\t' || c = '{' || c = '}' then go s (i + 1)
      else if c = '\n' || c = ';' then begin eol (); go s (i + 1) end
      else if c = '\\' && i + 1 < n && s.[i + 1] = '\n' then go s (i + 2)
      else if c = '"' then begin
        let j = ref (i + 1) in
        while !j < n && s.[!j] <> '"' do incr j done;
        emit (STRING (String.sub s (i + 1) (!j - i - 1))); go s (!j + 1)
      end
      else if is_digit c || (c = '.' && i + 1 < n && is_digit s.[i + 1]) then begin
        let j = ref i in
        while !j < n && (is_digit s.[!j] || s.[!j] = '.') do incr j done;
        let v = match float_of_string_opt (String.sub s i (!j - i)) with Some v -> v | None -> 0. in
        (* 2nd, 3rd: which one; 1.5i: inches, which is what a number is *)
        if !j + 1 < n && List.mem (String.sub s !j 2) [ "st"; "nd"; "rd"; "th" ] then begin emit (ORD (int_of_float v)); go s (!j + 2) end
        else begin emit (NUMBER v); go s (if !j < n && s.[!j] = 'i' && not (!j + 1 < n && is_letter s.[!j + 1]) then !j + 1 else !j) end
      end
      else if c = '.' then begin
        let j = ref (i + 1) in
        while !j < n && (is_letter s.[!j] || is_digit s.[!j]) do incr j done;
        let name = String.sub s (i + 1) (!j - i - 1) in
        if List.mem name corners then begin emit (CORNER (corner name)); go s !j end
        else begin emit DOT; go s (i + 1) end
      end
      else if is_letter c then begin
        let j = ref i in
        while !j < n && (is_letter s.[!j] || is_digit s.[!j]) do incr j done;
        let name = String.sub s i (!j - i) in
        (* "end of last line": a corner said before its object *)
        let of_ =
          let k = ref !j in
          while !k < n && (s.[!k] = ' ' || s.[!k] = '\t') do incr k done;
          if !k + 2 < n && String.sub s !k 2 = "of" && not (is_letter s.[!k + 2]) then Some (!k + 2) else None in
        if List.mem name corners && of_ <> None then begin
          emit (CORNEROF (corner name));
          go s (match of_ with Some k -> k | None -> !j)
        end
        else if name = "define" then begin
          (* define name X body X, or { body } *)
          let k = ref !j in
          while !k < n && (s.[!k] = ' ' || s.[!k] = '\t') do incr k done;
          let m = ref !k in
          while !m < n && (is_letter s.[!m] || is_digit s.[!m]) do incr m done;
          let macro = String.sub s !k (!m - !k) in
          while !m < n && (s.[!m] = ' ' || s.[!m] = '\t' || s.[!m] = '\n') do incr m done;
          if !m < n then begin
            let close = if s.[!m] = '{' then '}' else s.[!m] in
            (* (a brace's own braces are counted) *)
            let rec find (p : int) (d : int) : int =
              if p >= n then n
              else if s.[p] = close && d = 0 then p
              else if close = '}' && s.[p] = '{' then find (p + 1) (d + 1)
              else if close = '}' && s.[p] = '}' then find (p + 1) (d - 1)
              else find (p + 1) d in
            let stop = find (!m + 1) 0 in
            Hashtbl.replace macros macro (String.sub s (!m + 1) (stop - !m - 1));
            go s (min n (stop + 1))
          end
        end
        else if name = "copy" then begin
          let k = ref !j in
          while !k < n && s.[!k] <> '"' && s.[!k] <> '\n' do incr k done;
          if !k < n && s.[!k] = '"' then begin
            let e = match String.index_from_opt s (!k + 1) '"' with Some e -> e | None -> n in
            let file = String.sub s (!k + 1) (e - !k - 1) in
            let body = match load file with Some t -> String.concat "\n" (List.filter (fun l -> not (String.length l > 0 && l.[0] = '.')) (String.split_on_char '\n' t)) | None -> "" in
            go (body ^ "\n" ^ String.sub s (min n (e + 1)) (n - min n (e + 1))) 0
          end
          else go s !k
        end
        else
          match Hashtbl.find_opt macros name with
          | Some body when !depth < 1000 ->
              incr depth;
              let args, after = if !j < n && s.[!j] = '(' then arguments s (!j + 1) else ([], !j) in
              go (with_arguments args body ^ " " ^ String.sub s after (n - after)) 0
          | _ -> emit (word name); go s !j
      end
      else begin
        let two = if i + 1 < n then String.sub s i 2 else "" and three = if i + 2 < n then String.sub s i 3 else "" in
        if three = "<->" then begin emit HEAD_BOTH; go s (i + 3) end
        else if two = "->" then begin emit HEAD_END; go s (i + 2) end
        else if two = "<-" then begin emit HEAD_START; go s (i + 2) end
        else begin
          (match c with
           | ':' -> emit COLON | '[' -> emit LBRACK | ']' -> eol (); emit RBRACK
           | '(' -> emit LPAREN | ')' -> emit RPAREN | ',' -> emit COMMA
           | '+' -> emit PLUS | '-' -> emit MINUS | '*' -> emit STAR | '/' -> emit SLASH
           | '<' -> emit LT | '>' -> emit GT | '=' -> emit EQ
           | _ -> ());
          go s (i + 1)
        end
      end in
  go (String.concat "\n" lines) 0;
  eol ();
  List.rev (EOF :: !out)
typesetting/troff/pic/Pic_lexer.mli
1050
(* Pic_lexer: a picture's text as the words of pic's grammar
 * (Pic_parser), its macros done: they are text put for text.
 *
 *   define pair { box wid $1; box wid $2 }
 *   pair(0.2, 0.4)          is read as   box wid 0.2; box wid 0.4
 *
 * A macro's body is between two braces or two of any character
 * (define m | ... |); its arguments are $1 to $9, a name alone being a
 * call with none. Also done here: a comment (# to the line's end), a
 * request of troff's in the picture (a line that starts with a dot:
 * passed over), a file read in the middle (copy "file"), an inch said
 * (1.5i is 1.5), and the end of a statement before a closing bracket,
 * so that the grammar has one way to end one.
 *
 * By hand and not by lex: what a word is depends on the macros
 * defined so far, and a macro's text goes back in front of what is
 * left to read. *)

(* [tokens load text]: the picture's words; [load] reads a file that a
 * copy names (none: the copy is nothing) *)
val tokens : (string -> string option) -> string -> Pic_parser.token list
typesetting/troff/pic/Pic_parser.mly
4099
/* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. */
/* pic's grammar, the part that draws: an object a statement (a box, a
 * line, a text, a block of statements between brackets), with what is
 * said of it after its name; places by name and by corner; arithmetic.
 * Its macros are the lexer's (Pic_lexer): they are text put for text.
 * Not here: pic's programming (for, if, sprintf, sh).
 *
 * Two things could be read two ways, and each is said (LOW: lower than
 * what could follow, so what follows is taken):
 *  - a number after a direction is how far (up 0.2), not a move of its
 *    own the way things were going (arrow 0.8); the same after dashed,
 *    dotted, fill and chop;
 *  - in "x, y + ..." the sum is y's. */
%{
open Pic_ast
%}

%token <float> NUMBER
%token <string> STRING LABEL VAR CORNER CORNEROF PRIM DIR JUST
%token <int> ORD
%token WID HT RAD FROM TO AT WITH THEN DASHED DOTTED INVIS FILL SAME CHOP CW CCW LAST HERE
%token HEAD_END HEAD_START HEAD_BOTH
%token COLON LBRACK RBRACK LPAREN RPAREN COMMA PLUS MINUS STAR SLASH LT GT EQ DOT EOL EOF

%nonassoc LOW
%nonassoc NUMBER
%left PLUS MINUS
%left STAR SLASH
%nonassoc UMINUS

%start picture
%type <Pic_ast.statement list> picture

%%

picture: stmts EOF { List.rev $1 }
;
stmts:
    /* nothing */ { [] }
  | stmts EOL { $1 }
  | stmts stmt EOL { $2 :: $1 }
;
stmt:
    LABEL COLON obj { let (k, a) = $3 in Object (Some $1, k, a) }
  | obj { let (k, a) = $1 in Object (None, k, a) }
  | DIR { Direction $1 }
  | VAR EQ expr { Assign ($1, $3) }
;
obj:
    PRIM attrs { ((match $1 with "box" -> Box | "circle" -> Circle | "ellipse" -> Ellipse | "line" -> Line | "arrow" -> Arrow | "arc" -> Arc | "spline" -> Spline | _ -> Move), List.rev $2) }
  | STRING attrs { (Text, Str $1 :: List.rev $2) }
  | LBRACK stmts RBRACK attrs { (Block (List.rev $2), List.rev $4) }
;
attrs:
    /* nothing */ { [] }
  | attrs attr { $2 :: $1 }
;
attr:
    WID expr { Wid $2 }
  | HT expr { Ht $2 }
  | RAD expr { Rad $2 }
  | FROM position { From $2 }
  | TO position { To $2 }
  | AT position { At $2 }
  | WITH CORNER { With $2 }
  | WITH LPAREN expr COMMA expr RPAREN { With "origin" }
  | THEN { Then }
  | DIR %prec LOW { Go ($1, None) }
  | DIR expr { Go ($1, Some $2) }
  | NUMBER { Dist (Num $1) }
  | DASHED %prec LOW { Dashed }
  | DASHED expr { Dashed }
  | DOTTED %prec LOW { Dotted }
  | DOTTED expr { Dotted }
  | INVIS { Invis }
  | FILL %prec LOW { Fill }
  | FILL expr { Fill }
  | SAME { Same }
  | CHOP %prec LOW { Chop }
  | CHOP expr { Chop }
  | HEAD_END { Head (false, true) }
  | HEAD_START { Head (true, false) }
  | HEAD_BOTH { Head (true, true) }
  | CW { Cw }
  | CCW { Ccw }
  | STRING { Str $1 }
  | JUST { Just $1 }
;
position:
    expr COMMA expr %prec LOW { Xy ($1, $3) }
  | LPAREN expr COMMA expr RPAREN { Xy ($2, $4) }
  | place { Place $1 }
  | position PLUS LPAREN expr COMMA expr RPAREN { Shift ($1, $4, $6) }
  | position MINUS LPAREN expr COMMA expr RPAREN { Shift ($1, Neg $4, Neg $6) }
  | expr LT position COMMA position GT { Between ($1, $3, $5) }
;
place:
    path { Named (List.rev $1, None) }
  | cornered { $1 }
  | CORNEROF path { Named (List.rev $2, Some $1) }
  | CORNEROF LAST PRIM { Nth (-1, $3, Some $1) }
  | CORNEROF ORD PRIM { Nth ($2, $3, Some $1) }
;
/* a place that ends with what cannot go on as a name: A.x is then A's x */
cornered:
    path CORNER { Named (List.rev $1, Some $2) }
  | LAST PRIM { Nth (-1, $2, None) }
  | LAST PRIM CORNER { Nth (-1, $2, Some $3) }
  | ORD PRIM { Nth ($1, $2, None) }
  | ORD PRIM CORNER { Nth ($1, $2, Some $3) }
  | HERE { Here }
;
path:
    LABEL { [ $1 ] }
  | path DOT LABEL { $3 :: $1 }
;
expr:
    NUMBER { Num $1 }
  | VAR { Var $1 }
  | expr PLUS expr { Bin ('+', $1, $3) }
  | expr MINUS expr { Bin ('-', $1, $3) }
  | expr STAR expr { Bin ('*', $1, $3) }
  | expr SLASH expr { Bin ('/', $1, $3) }
  | MINUS expr %prec UMINUS { Neg $2 }
  | PLUS expr %prec UMINUS { $2 }
  | cornered DOT VAR { Coord ($1, $3) }
  | path DOT VAR { Coord (Named (List.rev $1, None), $3) }
  | LPAREN expr RPAREN { $2 }
;

(* Claude Code

(* See Fill.mli *)

type item =
  | Par of float * Doc.par
  | Tag of float * float * Doc.inline list
  | Gap of float
  | Head of int * Doc.inline list
  | Open of wrapper
  | Close
  | Whole of float * Doc.block

and wrapper = Footnote | Keep

type t = {
  roff : Roff.t;
  base : float;
  length : float;
  mutable indent : float;
  mutable indent_before : float;
  mutable ti : float option;
  mutable short : float;
  mutable short_before : float;
  mutable fill : bool;
  mutable tabs : float list;
  mutable center : int;
  mutable no_space : bool;
  mutable par : Doc.inline list;
  mutable started : bool;
  mutable first : float;
  mutable par_tabs : float list;
  mutable sentence : bool;
  mutable glued : bool;
  mutable blank_end : bool;
  mutable capture : (Doc.inline list -> unit) option;
  mutable tag_open : bool;
  mutable one_line : bool;
  mutable heading : int option;
  mutable items : item list;
}

let create (roff : Roff.t) (base : float) (length : float) (tabs : float list) : t =
  { roff; base; length; indent = 0.; indent_before = 0.; ti = None; short = 0.; short_before = 0.; fill = true; tabs; center = 0;
    no_space = false; par = []; started = false; first = 0.; par_tabs = []; sentence = false; glued = false; blank_end = false;
    capture = None; tag_open = false; one_line = false; heading = None; items = [] }

let emit (m : t) (it : item) = m.items <- it :: m.items

let break (m : t) =
  (* (a tag whose line is ended before any word: it has the line to
   * itself, said by a paragraph of nothing) *)
  if m.tag_open && not m.started then begin m.started <- true; m.first <- m.indent; m.par_tabs <- m.tabs end;
  m.tag_open <- false;
  if m.started then begin
    (match m.heading with
     | Some level -> m.heading <- None; emit m (Head (level, List.rev m.par))
     | None ->
         emit m (Par (m.indent, { fill = m.fill; first = m.first -. m.indent; short = m.short; tabs = m.par_tabs; center = m.center > 0; body = List.rev m.par })));
    (* (a line written: a .ns said while it was being filled is forgotten) *)
    m.par <- []; m.started <- false; m.glued <- false; m.sentence <- false; m.blank_end <- false; m.no_space <- false
  end

let gap (m : t) (n : float) = if not m.no_space && n > 0. then emit m (Gap n)

let space : Doc.inline = Doc.Text (Doc.plain, " ")

(* A tab in a line that is filled: troff makes of it a move as wide as
 * it would be from the start of the line as it was written, wherever
 * its words end up on the page; so "int", a tab and a name are a word
 * with a hole in it. Said here by spaces a line is not cut at (U+00A0). *)
let untab (tabs : float list) (words : Doc.inline list) : Doc.inline list =
  let col = ref 0 in
  List.map (fun (w : Doc.inline) ->
    match w with
    | Doc.Break | Doc.Page _ -> w
    | Doc.Text (_, s) when not (String.contains s '\t') -> col := !col + Utf8.length (Doc.letters s); w
    | Doc.Text (style, s) ->
        let out = Buffer.create (String.length s) in
        List.iter (fun c ->
          if c = "\t" then begin
            let stop = match List.find_opt (fun t -> t > float_of_int !col +. 0.01) tabs with Some t -> int_of_float t | None -> !col in
            (* (at the line's start it is a word of its own: the line before
             * may end there) *)
            if !col = 0 then Buffer.add_string out "\xe2\x80\x8b";
            Buffer.add_string out (String.concat "" (List.init (max 0 (stop - !col)) (fun _ -> "\xc2\xa0")));
            col := stop
          end
          else begin Buffer.add_string out c; if Doc.letters c <> "" then incr col end) (fst (Utf8.chars s));
        Doc.Text (style, Buffer.contents out)) words

(* does a text start with a tab *)
let rec tab_first (words : Doc.inline list) : bool =
  match words with
  | Doc.Text (_, s) :: rest -> if Doc.letters s = "" then tab_first rest else (Doc.letters s).[0] = '\t'
  | _ -> false

let text (m : t) (words : Doc.inline list) (sentence : bool) (glued : bool) =
  (match m.capture with
   | Some f -> m.capture <- None; f words
   | None ->
       m.tag_open <- false;
       if not m.started then begin
         m.started <- true; m.par_tabs <- m.tabs;
         m.first <- (match m.ti with Some x -> x | None -> m.indent);
         m.ti <- None
       end
       else if not m.fill then m.par <- Doc.Break :: m.par
       (* (the end of a line is a space, two after a sentence; one, when
        * the line ended with blanks; none before a tab) *)
       else if m.glued then ()
       else if m.blank_end then m.par <- space :: m.par
       else if not (tab_first words) then m.par <- (if m.sentence then [ space; space ] else [ space ]) @ m.par;
       (* (on paper a letter has no column: a tab is left to the layout,
        * which takes it from the start of the line it is on) *)
       let words = if m.fill && Roff.device m.roff = Roff.Terminal then untab m.tabs words else words in
       m.blank_end <- false;
       m.par <- List.rev_append words m.par;
       m.sentence <- sentence; m.glued <- glued; m.no_space <- false;
       if m.center > 0 then begin break m; m.center <- m.center - 1 end);
  if m.one_line then begin m.one_line <- false; Roff.reset_style m.roff end

(* do these words end a sentence: with a dot, a question or an
 * exclamation mark, and what may close after it. (Not "e.g.\&": the
 * nothing that \& is, U+2060, is after the dot.) *)
let ends_sentence (words : Doc.inline list) : bool =
  let s = String.concat "" (List.map (fun (w : Doc.inline) -> match w with Doc.Text (_, t) | Doc.Page (_, _, t) -> t | Doc.Break -> "") words) in
  let rec go i = i >= 0 && (if String.contains "\"')]*" s.[i] then go (i - 1) else String.contains ".?!" s.[i]) in
  go (String.length s - 1)

let glued (args : string list) : bool = match List.rev args with last :: _ -> Roff.continues last | [] -> false

let length (m : t) (s : string) : float = Roff.ens m.roff (Roff.number m.roff 'n' s)

(* a terminal has no place between two columns: nroff takes the one on
 * the left, of where a request ends up (an indent of 12.5 is 12, and
 * 2.5 to its left is 9) *)
let column (m : t) (x : float) : float = if Roff.device m.roff = Roff.Terminal then Float.floor (x +. 0.001) else x

let moved (m : t) (from : float) (s : string) : float =
  if s = "" then from
  else if s.[0] = '+' then column m (from +. length m (String.sub s 1 (String.length s - 1)))
  else if s.[0] = '-' then column m (from -. length m (String.sub s 1 (String.length s - 1)))
  else column m (length m s -. m.base)

(* a line without the blanks at its end (not one after a backslash) *)
let rec without_end (s : string) : string =
  let n = String.length s in
  if n > 0 && s.[n - 1] = ' ' && not (n > 1 && s.[n - 2] = '\\') then without_end (String.sub s 0 (n - 1)) else s

let line (m : t) (raw : string) =
  let s = if m.fill then without_end raw else raw in
  if s = "" then begin
    (* a blank line is a .sp, a line of an example when not filling *)
    if m.fill then begin break m; gap m 1. end else text m [] false false
  end
  else begin
    if m.fill && s.[0] = ' ' then break m;
    let words = Roff.inlines m.roff s in
    let blank = String.length s < String.length raw in
    (* (a line that only changes the font is no word, and no space; a
     * blank at a line's end is enough for troff to see no sentence's
     * end) *)
    if words <> [] || not m.fill || m.capture <> None then begin
      text m words (ends_sentence words && not blank) (Roff.continues s);
      if m.started && m.fill then m.blank_end <- blank
    end
  end

let aside (m : t) (run : unit -> 'a) : Doc.inline list * 'a =
  let was = { m with roff = m.roff } and font = Roff.font m.roff in
  m.par <- []; m.started <- false; m.glued <- false; m.sentence <- false; m.blank_end <- false; m.capture <- None; m.tag_open <- false;
  m.heading <- None; m.fill <- true; m.center <- 0; m.ti <- None; m.indent <- 0.; m.short <- 0.;
  Roff.reset_style m.roff;
  let r = run () in
  break m;
  (* what it made, taken back: its paragraphs' words, a line's end between two *)
  let rec made (items : item list) (acc : Doc.inline list) : Doc.inline list =
    if items == was.items then acc
    else match items with
      | Par (_, p) :: rest -> made rest (p.body @ (if acc = [] then [] else Doc.Break :: acc))
      | _ :: rest -> made rest acc
      | [] -> acc in
  let words = made m.items [] in
  m.items <- was.items;
  m.par <- was.par; m.started <- was.started; m.first <- was.first; m.par_tabs <- was.par_tabs; m.glued <- was.glued;
  m.sentence <- was.sentence; m.blank_end <- was.blank_end; m.capture <- was.capture; m.tag_open <- was.tag_open;
  m.heading <- was.heading; m.fill <- was.fill; m.center <- was.center; m.ti <- was.ti; m.indent <- was.indent; m.short <- was.short;
  m.no_space <- was.no_space; Roff.reset_style m.roff; Roff.set_font m.roff font;
  (words, r)

let request (m : t) (name : string) (args : string list) : bool =
  let arg k = match List.nth_opt args k with Some a -> a | None -> "" in
  let roff = m.roff in
  match name with
  | "nf" -> break m; m.fill <- false; true
  | "fi" -> break m; m.fill <- true; true
  | "br" -> break m; true
  | "sp" -> break m; gap m (if arg 0 = "" then 1. else Roff.lines roff (Roff.number roff 'v' (arg 0))); true
  | "ti" -> break m; m.ti <- Some (moved m m.indent (arg 0)); true
  | "in" ->
      break m;
      let now = m.indent in
      m.indent <- (if arg 0 = "" then m.indent_before else moved m m.indent (arg 0));
      m.indent_before <- now; true
  | "ll" ->
      (* (no break: the line being filled keeps its length, in troff;
       * here the paragraph does) *)
      let now = m.short and a = arg 0 in
      m.short <- (if a = "" then m.short_before
                  else if a.[0] = '+' then m.short -. length m (String.sub a 1 (String.length a - 1))
                  else if a.[0] = '-' then m.short +. length m (String.sub a 1 (String.length a - 1))
                  else m.length -. length m a);
      m.short_before <- now; true
  | "ta" ->
      let rec stops (at : float) (l : string list) : float list =
        match l with
        | [] -> []
        | s :: rest ->
            let x = column m (if s <> "" && s.[0] = '+' then at +. length m (String.sub s 1 (String.length s - 1)) else length m s) in
            x :: stops x rest in
      (* (lines not filled are one paragraph, and a paragraph has one set
       * of stops: the lines after this are another) *)
      if m.started && not m.fill then break m;
      m.tabs <- stops 0. args; true
  | "tl" ->
      (* a line in three parts, 'left'middle'right': here one after the
       * other, the line not being measured *)
      let all = String.concat " " args in
      break m;
      if String.length all > 1 then begin
        let parts = List.filter (fun p -> p <> "") (String.split_on_char all.[0] all) in
        let fill = m.fill in
        m.fill <- false;
        text m (List.concat_map (fun p -> Roff.inlines roff p @ [ Doc.Text (Doc.plain, "  ") ]) parts) false false;
        break m; m.fill <- fill
      end;
      true
  | "ce" -> break m; m.center <- (if arg 0 = "" then 1 else int_of_float (Roff.number roff 'u' (arg 0))); true
  | "ns" -> m.no_space <- true; true
  | "rs" -> m.no_space <- false; true
  | "ft" -> Roff.set_font roff (Roff.font_named roff (arg 0)); true
  | "ps" -> Roff.resize roff (arg 0); true
  (* what is not done: the line's height, room asked on the page,
   * hyphens, the margins filled, a new sheet *)
  | "vs" | "ne" | "na" | "ad" | "nh" | "hy" | "lg" | "bp" -> true
  | _ -> false

(*****************************************************************************)
(* The tree, from the places *)
(*****************************************************************************)

let same (a : float) (b : float) : bool = Float.abs (a -. b) < 0.01

(* where the next thing that is not a space is *)
let rec place (base : float) (items : item list) : float =
  match items with
  | [] | Head _ :: _ -> 0.
  | Par (k, _) :: _ -> k
  | Tag (k, _, _) :: _ -> k
  | Gap _ :: rest -> place base rest
  | Whole (k, _) :: _ -> k
  (* (a footnote, a keep: where the text is; and what they have ends
   * with them) *)
  | Open _ :: _ | Close :: _ -> base

(* [blocks root base items]: the blocks at [base] and to its right, and
 * the items left: the first that is to its left closes it. (At the
 * root nothing is left: what is to the left of the text's margin is
 * an indent of less than nothing.) *)
let rec blocks (root : bool) (base : float) (items : item list) : Doc.block list * item list =
  match items with
  | [] -> ([], [])
  | Head (level, words) :: rest ->
      if not root then ([], items) else let bs, left = blocks root base rest in (Doc.Heading (level, words) :: bs, left)
  | Close :: _ -> ([], items)
  | Open w :: rest ->
      let inner, rest = blocks true base rest in
      let rest = match rest with Close :: after -> after | _ -> rest in
      let bs, left = blocks root base rest in
      ((match w with Footnote -> Doc.Footnote inner | Keep -> Doc.Keep inner) :: bs, left)
  | Gap n :: (Close :: _ as rest) -> let bs, left = blocks root base rest in (Doc.Space n :: bs, left)
  | _ ->
      let k = place base items in
      if k < base && not (same k base) && not root then ([], items)
      else if not (same k base) then begin
        let inner, rest = blocks false k items in
        let bs, left = blocks root base rest in
        (Doc.Indent (k -. base, inner) :: bs, left)
      end
      else
        match items with
        | Gap n :: rest -> let bs, left = blocks root base rest in (Doc.Space n :: bs, left)
        | Par (_, p) :: rest -> let bs, left = blocks root base rest in (Doc.Para p :: bs, left)
        | Whole (_, b) :: rest -> let bs, left = blocks root base rest in (b :: bs, left)
        | Tag (_, to_, tag) :: rest ->
            let body, rest = if to_ > base then blocks false to_ rest else ([], rest) in
            let bs, left = blocks root base rest in
            (Doc.Tagged { tag; width = to_ -. base; body } :: bs, left)
        | _ -> ([], [])


let tree (m : t) : Doc.block list = fst (blocks true 0. (List.rev m.items))

(* Fill: the text being read, as troff has it under any macro package --
 * the paragraph that the lines of text are added to, where it is, and
 * the requests of troff's own that a document writes between the
 * macros. What Man and Ms are written on.
 *
 *   .in +2       the text is 2 further right, from here on
 *   .ti -2       the next line only
 *   .nf / .fi    the lines as they are, or filled
 *   .ta 10n +6n  where a tab goes
 *   .ll -5n      the line's end, 5 to the left
 *   .br          the line ends
 *   .sp 2        and two blank lines
 *   .ce          the next line in the middle
 *   .ft B  .ps -2
 *
 * A paragraph is what is between two breaks. Each is kept with its
 * place, how far right of the text's margin it is, and the tree is
 * made at the end from the places ([tree]): what is to the right of
 * the paragraph before it is inside an [Indent], a paragraph that
 * started with a tag a [Tagged], and both close where the text comes
 * back to the left. So a package only says where the text is (.RS:
 * further right by so much), and a page that moves its margin by hand
 * comes out right the same way.
 *
 * What a page looks like depends on rules of troff's that no page
 * says and every page counts on. Those found by setting principia's
 * 553 manual pages beside troff's own output (tests/man.sh):
 *
 *   - a line's end is a space; two after a sentence (a dot, ? or !,
 *     and a quote or a parenthesis closing after it); one when the
 *     line ended with a blank, which is why "e.g. " is written with
 *     one;
 *   - .ns takes the space of the next request, unless a line was
 *     being filled;
 *   - a tab in a filled line is as wide as it would be from the start
 *     of the line as written, not from where its words end up, and
 *     the line before may end in front of it;
 *   - a terminal has whole columns: 0.75i is 7, and 2.5 columns to the
 *     left of 12.5 is 9.
 *)

(* What is read, before it is a tree: each thing with how far right of
 * the text's margin it is. A tag has two places, its own and its
 * body's. [Open] and [Close] are round what a footnote has, or what
 * is to stay on one sheet. *)
type item =
  | Par of float * Doc.par
  | Tag of float * float * Doc.inline list
  | Gap of float
  | Head of int * Doc.inline list
  | Open of wrapper
  | Close
  (* a block made elsewhere, at its place: a table *)
  | Whole of float * Doc.block

and wrapper = Footnote | Keep

type t = {
  roff : Roff.t;
  (* the text's margin, from where a place said alone counts (.in 7):
   * the manual's 5 letters, a paper's 0 *)
  base : float;
  (* the line's length, for .ll said alone *)
  length : float;
  (* troff's own indent, from the text's margin *)
  mutable indent : float;
  mutable indent_before : float;
  (* .ti: the next line's place *)
  mutable ti : float option;
  (* .ll: how much shorter than the others the lines are *)
  mutable short : float;
  mutable short_before : float;
  mutable fill : bool;
  mutable tabs : float list;
  mutable center : int;
  (* .ns: the spaces asked are not made, until some text *)
  mutable no_space : bool;
  (* the paragraph being read, its last words first *)
  mutable par : Doc.inline list;
  mutable started : bool;
  mutable first : float;
  (* the stops there were when it started *)
  mutable par_tabs : float list;
  (* the line before ended a sentence; it ended with \c; with a blank *)
  mutable sentence : bool;
  mutable glued : bool;
  mutable blank_end : bool;
  (* the next line of text is not the paragraph's but this one's: a
   * heading's words, a tag *)
  mutable capture : (Doc.inline list -> unit) option;
  (* a tag was just said, and no word of its body yet *)
  mutable tag_open : bool;
  (* a font asked for one line *)
  mutable one_line : bool;
  (* the paragraph being read is a heading, of this level *)
  mutable heading : int option;
  mutable items : item list;
}

(* [create roff base length tabs] *)
val create : Roff.t -> float -> float -> float list -> t

val emit : t -> item -> unit

(* the paragraph so far is one: every request that ends a line *)
val break : t -> unit

(* [gap t n]: n lines of space, unless .ns *)
val gap : t -> float -> unit

(* [text t words sentence glued]: a line's words, added to the
 * paragraph (or given to what was waiting for them); whether they end
 * a sentence, and whether the line ended with \c *)
val text : t -> Doc.inline list -> bool -> bool -> unit

(* [aside t run]: the text being read put aside, [run] reads another
 * (a table's cell of several lines, with the package's macros in it),
 * and the first is back as it was: the other's words, and what [run]
 * gave *)
val aside : t -> (unit -> 'a) -> Doc.inline list * 'a

(* a line of text as it was written *)
val line : t -> string -> unit

(* one of troff's own requests; false if it is not one known here *)
val request : t -> string -> string list -> bool

val ends_sentence : Doc.inline list -> bool

(* does a macro's last argument end with \c *)
val glued : string list -> bool

(* a length as written, in ens *)
val length : t -> string -> float

(* on a terminal, the column on the left of a place *)
val column : t -> float -> float

(* [moved t from s]: a place said from the one there is: +2, -2, or 7 *)
val moved : t -> float -> string -> float

(* the tree, from the places *)
val tree : t -> Doc.block list

(* Claude Code
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Yoann Padioleau. LGPL 2.1: see license.txt. *)

(* See Man.mli *)

type state = {
  fill : Fill.t;
  roff : Roff.t;
  (* tmac.an's )M: a tag's width when none is said, a .RS's, and the
   * text's own margin: 5 letters on a terminal, 3.6 ems on paper *)
  step : float;
  (* tmac.an's )R and )I: the text's place (.RS), and how far right of
   * it a tagged paragraph's body is *)
  mutable r : float;
  mutable i : float;
  (* the lines between two paragraphs (.PD) *)
  mutable pd : float;
  (* what it is when none is said: a line on a terminal, 0.4 on paper *)
  pd0 : float;
  (* what .RS put aside, the last first: i and r *)
  mutable levels : (float * float) list;
  mutable header : string * string * string;
}

let default_tabs (step : float) : float list = List.init 13 (fun k -> step *. float_of_int (k + 1))

(* tmac.an's }E: the margin back where the text is *)
let margin (m : state) = m.fill.indent <- m.r; Roff.reset_style m.roff

let break (m : state) = Fill.break m.fill
let gap (m : state) (n : float) = Fill.gap m.fill n
let text (m : state) (words : Doc.inline list) (sentence : bool) (glued : bool) = Fill.text m.fill words sentence glued
let ends_sentence = Fill.ends_sentence
let glued = Fill.glued
let length (m : state) (s : string) : float = Fill.length m.fill s
let column (m : state) (x : float) : float = Fill.column m.fill x

let tag_width (m : state) (s : string) = if s <> "" then begin let v = column m (length m s) in m.i <- (if v = 0. then m.step else v) end

(* the next line of text is a section's heading; a tag *)
let heading (m : state) (level : int) (words : Doc.inline list) =
  Fill.emit m.fill (Fill.Head (level, words));
  m.i <- m.step; margin m; m.fill.no_space <- true

let tag (m : state) (words : Doc.inline list) =
  Fill.emit m.fill (Fill.Tag (m.r, m.r +. m.i, words));
  m.fill.indent <- m.r +. m.i; Roff.reset_style m.roff; m.fill.no_space <- false; m.fill.tag_open <- true

let font_of (name : char) : Doc.font = match name with 'I' -> Doc.Italic | 'R' -> Doc.Roman | _ -> Doc.Mono

(* arguments set in a font, a space between: .B, .I. (No sentence
 * ends there for troff: tmac.an writes its six arguments, and the
 * blanks between those not given are at the line's end.) *)
let in_font (m : state) (f : Doc.font) (args : string list) =
  if args = [] then begin Roff.set_font m.roff f; m.fill.one_line <- true end
  else begin
    Roff.set_font m.roff f;
    (* (.B's first word is not to be cut: tmac.an's \%) *)
    (* (tmac.an writes its six arguments with a blank between: those
     * not given leave blanks at the line's end, which count when the
     * line is centered) *)
    let blanks = if m.fill.center > 0 then String.concat "" (List.init (max 0 (6 - List.length args)) (fun _ -> "\\ ")) else "" in
    let words = Roff.inlines m.roff ((if f = Doc.Mono then "\\%" else "") ^ String.concat " " args ^ blanks) in
    Roff.reset_style m.roff;
    text m words false (glued args)
  end

let quote (m : state) (s : string) : Doc.inline list =
  match Roff.device m.roff with
  | Roff.Terminal -> Roff.inlines_in m.roff Doc.Mono ("`" ^ s ^ "'")
  | Roff.Typesetter -> Roff.inlines_in m.roff Doc.Mono s

let rec request (m : state) (name : string) (args : string list) =
  (* (tmac.an's macros read six arguments) *)
  let args = if List.mem name [ "B"; "I"; "SM"; "RI"; "IR"; "IB"; "RB"; "BR"; "BI" ] then List.filteri (fun k _ -> k < 6) args else args in
  let arg k = match List.nth_opt args k with Some a -> a | None -> "" in
  let roff = m.roff in
  match name with
  | "TH" ->
      let title = arg 0 ^ "(" ^ arg 1 ^ ")" in
      m.header <- (title, (if arg 2 = "" then "" else "(" ^ arg 2 ^ ")"), title)
  | "SH" | "SS" ->
      break m; m.pd <- m.pd0; gap m m.pd;
      m.r <- 0.; m.levels <- []; m.fill.fill <- true; m.fill.ti <- None;
      Roff.reset_style roff; Roff.set_font roff Doc.Bold;
      m.fill.capture <- Some (heading m (if name = "SH" then 1 else 2));
      if args <> [] then text m (Roff.inlines roff (String.concat " " args)) false false
  | "PP" | "LP" | "P" -> break m; gap m m.pd; m.i <- m.step; margin m; m.fill.no_space <- true
  | "PD" -> m.pd <- (if arg 0 = "" then m.pd0 else Roff.lines roff (Roff.number roff 'v' (arg 0)))
  | "TP" ->
      tag_width m (arg 0);
      break m; gap m m.pd; m.fill.indent <- m.r; m.fill.no_space <- true; m.fill.capture <- Some (tag m)
  | "IP" ->
      if arg 0 <> "" then begin
        request m "TP" [ arg 1 ];
        text m (Roff.inlines roff (arg 0)) false false
      end
      else begin break m; gap m m.pd; tag_width m (arg 1); Roff.reset_style roff; m.fill.indent <- m.r +. m.i end
  | "HP" ->
      break m; gap m m.pd; tag_width m (arg 0);
      m.fill.indent <- m.r +. m.i; m.fill.ti <- Some m.r; Roff.reset_style roff
  | "TF" ->
      (* a list of names as wide as the widest, closed up *)
      request m "IP" [ ""; "\\w'" ^ arg 0 ^ "\\ \\ 'u" ]; m.pd <- 0.
  | "RS" ->
      break m;
      m.levels <- (m.i, m.r) :: m.levels;
      m.r <- m.r +. (if arg 0 = "" then m.i else column m (length m (arg 0)));
      m.i <- m.step; margin m
  | "RE" ->
      break m;
      (* .RE 2: back to what it was before the second .RS *)
      let keep = if arg 0 = "" then List.length m.levels - 1 else max 0 (int_of_float (Roff.number roff 'u' (arg 0)) - 1) in
      let rec pop () =
        match m.levels with
        | (i, r) :: rest when List.length m.levels > keep -> m.i <- i; m.r <- r; m.levels <- rest; pop ()
        | _ -> () in
      pop (); margin m
  | "EX" -> break m; m.fill.fill <- false; if Roff.device roff = Roff.Typesetter then Roff.set_font roff Doc.Mono
  | "EE" -> break m; m.fill.fill <- true; Roff.reset_style roff
  | "DT" -> if m.fill.started && not m.fill.fill then break m; m.fill.tabs <- default_tabs m.step
  (* (the size and the line's length are tmac.an's own business) *)
  | "ps" | "ll" -> ()
  | "B" | "I" -> in_font m (font_of name.[0]) args
  | "L" ->
      if args = [] then begin Roff.set_font roff Doc.Mono; m.fill.one_line <- true end
      else begin let words = quote m (String.concat " " args) in text m words (ends_sentence words) false end
  | "SM" ->
      (* each argument as a line of its own, a size smaller *)
      if args = [] then m.fill.one_line <- true
      else
        List.iter (fun a ->
          let small = List.map (fun (x : Doc.inline) -> match x with Doc.Text (s, w) -> Doc.Text ({ s with size = s.size - 1 }, w) | Doc.Break | Doc.Page _ -> x) (Roff.inlines roff a) in
          text m small (ends_sentence small) (Roff.continues a)) args
  | "RI" | "IR" | "IB" | "RB" | "BR" | "BI" ->
      (* the arguments in the two fonts in turn, nothing between *)
      (* (tmac.an's \%, but for .RI and .IR: the word is not to be cut) *)
      let args = match args with a :: rest when name <> "RI" && name <> "IR" -> ("\\%" ^ a) :: rest | _ -> args in
      let words = List.concat (List.mapi (fun k a -> Roff.inlines_in roff (font_of name.[k mod 2]) a) args) in

      Roff.reset_style roff;
      (* (not .IR of two arguments: tmac.an ends the second with a note
       * for the HTML manual, and troff sees no dot at the end) *)
      text m words ((name <> "IR" || List.length args > 2) && ends_sentence words) (glued args)
  | "LR" ->
      let words = quote m ("\\%" ^ arg 0) @ Roff.inlines_in roff Doc.Roman (arg 1) in
      text m words (ends_sentence words) false
  | "RL" ->
      let words = Roff.inlines_in roff Doc.Roman ("\\%" ^ arg 0) @ quote m (arg 1) @ Roff.inlines_in roff Doc.Roman (arg 2) in
      text m words (ends_sentence words) false
  | "TS" ->
      break m;
      let table = Tbl.read roff (fun () -> block m) in
      Fill.emit m.fill (Fill.Whole (m.fill.indent, Doc.Table table))
  | "PS" ->
      break m; let f = m.fill in
      (* .PS <file: the picture is in a file; .PS 3i: it is 3 inches wide *)
      let all = String.concat "" args in
      let text, width =
        if String.length all > 0 && all.[0] = '<' then
          ((match Roff.load roff (String.trim (String.sub all 1 (String.length all - 1))) with Some t -> t | None -> ""), 0.)
        else begin
          let lines = ref [] in
          let rec until () =
            match Roff.next roff with
            | None | Some (Roff.Request (("PE" | "PF"), _)) -> ()
            | Some (Roff.Text s) -> lines := s :: !lines; until ()
            | Some (Roff.Request (_, _)) -> until () in
          until ();
          let w = let a = arg 0 in if a <> "" && a.[String.length a - 1] = 'i' then String.sub a 0 (String.length a - 1) else a in
          (String.concat "\n" (List.rev !lines), (match float_of_string_opt w with Some v -> v | None -> 0.))
        end in
      (match Pic.read (Roff.load roff) width (fun s -> let w = Roff.inlines roff s in Roff.reset_style roff; w) text with
       | Ok p -> Fill.emit f (Fill.Whole (f.indent, Doc.Picture p)); ()
       | Error why -> Roff.unknown roff (".PS (a picture, " ^ why ^ ")"))
  | "EQ" ->
      (* not read yet: its lines passed over *)
      Roff.unknown roff ".EQ";
      let rec until () = match Roff.next roff with None -> () | Some (Roff.Request ("EN", _)) -> () | Some _ -> until () in
      until ()
  | _ -> if not (Fill.request m.fill name args) then Roff.unknown roff ("." ^ name)

(* a table's cell of several lines, to its T} *)
and block (m : state) : Doc.inline list * string =
  Fill.aside m.fill (fun () ->
    let rec go () : string =
      match Roff.next m.roff with
      | None -> ""
      | Some (Roff.Text s) when String.starts_with ~prefix:"T}" s -> String.sub s 2 (String.length s - 2)
      | Some (Roff.Text s) -> Fill.line m.fill s; go ()
      | Some (Roff.Request (name, args)) -> request m name args; go () in
    go ())

let read (roff : Roff.t) : Doc.t =
  let terminal = Roff.device roff = Roff.Terminal in
  let step = if terminal then 5. else 7.2 and pd0 = if terminal then 1. else 0.4 in
  let m = { fill = Fill.create roff step (if terminal then 65. else 93.6) (default_tabs step); roff; step; r = 0.; i = step; pd = pd0; pd0;
            levels = []; header = ("", "", "") } in
  let rec go () =
    match Roff.next roff with
    | None -> ()
    | Some (Roff.Request (name, args)) -> request m name args; go ()
    | Some (Roff.Text s) -> Fill.line m.fill s; go () in
  go (); break m;
  { header = m.header; width = (if terminal then 65. else 93.6); margin = step; sub = 3.; body = Fill.tree m.fill }
typesetting/troff/roff/Man.mli

(* Man: a manual page read -- the macros of man(6), Plan 9's tmac.an,
 * each as what it means and not as the troff it was written in.
 *
 *   .TH TR 1                    header "TR(1)"
 *   .SH NAME                    Heading 1 "NAME"
 *   tr \- translate characters  Para "tr - translate characters"
 *   .SH DESCRIPTION
 *   .PP                         Space 1, a new paragraph
 *   .TP                         a paragraph that hangs from its tag,
 *   .B -c                       the next line: Tagged "-c"
 *   Complement
 *   .IR string1 :               fonts in turn, no space between
 *   .RS / .RE                   what is between, further right
 *   .EX / .EE                   lines as they are (an example)
 *
 * The package keeps two numbers, as tmac.an does: how far right the
 * text is (its .RS), and how far right of that a paragraph's body
 * hangs from its tag (.TP 10; it stays for the tags that follow).
 * From them each paragraph has a place, and the tree is made of the
 * places at the end ([Indent] and [Tagged] where the text goes right,
 * closed where it comes back): a page may also move its margin by
 * hand (.in +2), and comes out right the same way.
 *
 * For a typesetter the same, with tmac.an's other numbers: the text
 * 3.6 ems from the margin where 5 letters, 0.4 lines between two
 * paragraphs where one, .L and .B in the font of what is typed where
 * a terminal has quotes.
 *
 * Also read, being what the pages write between the macros: .br .sp
 * .nf .fi .in .ti .ta .ft .ce (Fill's). A table is Tbl's, a picture
 * Pic's. Not read yet: an equation (.EQ: passed over, and said).
 *
 * The rules of troff's own that a page's look depends on are Fill's
 * (Fill.mli lists them). tmac.an's, found the same way, by setting
 * principia's 553 pages beside troff's output (tests/man.sh):
 *
 *   - .B and .I end no sentence: tmac.an writes six arguments, and the
 *     blanks between the missing ones are at the line's end;
 *   - a tag has its body on its line if it is shorter than the width
 *     by half a letter (tmac.an's 3 points);
 *   - .PD 0 closes a list up until the next .SH.
 *
 * Where troff's output is an accident (a heading lost, a macro's own
 * request printed: docs/plans/bugs/goken.md, 37 and 38), this has
 * what the page's author wrote.
 *
 * cs-history:
 * The manual is as old as Unix: the first edition's pages, of
 * November 1971, already had NAME, SYNOPSIS, DESCRIPTION, FILES, SEE
 * ALSO, DIAGNOSTICS and BUGS, typed with roff's own requests. The
 * macros came with the seventh edition (1979), -man, and have been
 * the format of a Unix page since; Plan 9's are those, with .EX and
 * .L added and bold replaced by the font of what is typed.
 *
 * others:
 * BSD's mdoc (1990) names what a word is (.Fl a flag, .Ar an
 * argument) where man names its font. mandoc (Kristaps Dzonsons,
 * 2008) reads both as this module does, into a tree, with no troff
 * under it. *)

(* a page's text read; what was not understood is the Roff.t's to say
 * ([Roff.complaints]) *)
val read : Roff.t -> Doc.t
